simple_meaning: When your mind is empty and free of thoughts, you no longer see options like gain or loss, satisfaction or dissatisfaction. You rest in a state like perfect freedom.
insight: It shifts your mind from grasping at outcomes to resting in acceptance beyond duality.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by choices or worries about outcomes, you can find calm by stepping back and letting go of judgments about what is good or bad.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
निर्ममो निरहङ्कारो न किञ्चिदिति निश्चितः ।
अन्तर्गलितसर्वाशः कुर्वन्नपि करोति न ॥
translation: भीतर से गलित हो गयी हैं आशाएँ जिसकी, और जो निश्चयपूर्वक जानता है कि कुछ भी नहीं है – ऐसा ममतारहित, अहंकारशून्य पुरुष कर्म करता हुआ भी उनमें लिप्त नहीं होता ।
english_translation: One who is free of attachment and ego, firmly knowing there is nothing, acts without being entangled in any desire.
essence: You can act without ego or desire while remaining fully present and free.
simple_meaning: If you let go of ego and attachments, knowing nothing truly belongs to you, you can act without being caught in desires.
insight: It teaches you to perform actions while witnessing your mind's urges without becoming involved in them.
modern_relevance: You complete a task without over-identifying or craving the outcome, staying calm even when faced with pressure or uncertainty.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
मनःप्रकाशसंमोहस्वप्नजाड्यविवर्जितः ।
दशां कामपि सम्प्राप्तो भवेद् गलितमानसः ॥
translation: जिसका मन गलित हो गया है और जिसके मन में कर्म, मोह, स्वप्न और जड़ता सब समाप्त हो गए हैं, वह पुरुष कैसी अनिर्वचनीय अवस्था को प्राप्त होता है।
english_translation: When the mind is purified, free from action, confusion, sleep, and dullness, it attains an indescribable state.
essence: A mind free from confusion and dullness attains an indescribable clarity.
simple_meaning: A mind that is clear and free from confusion, sleepiness, and inactivity reaches a special, indescribable state.
insight: It teaches you to recognize clarity as freedom from mental fog and rest, opening a gateway to deeper awareness.
modern_relevance: When your mind is free from distraction, tiredness, and confusion, you glimpse a clarity that words cannot capture.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
यस्य बोधोदये तावत्स्वप्नवद् भवति भ्रमः ।
तस्मै सुखैकरूपाय नमः शान्ताय तेजसे ॥
translation: जिसके उदय होने पर समस्त भ्रान्ति स्वप्न के समान तिरोहित हो जाती है, उस एकमात्र आनन्दस्वरूप, शान्त और तेजोमय को नमस्कार है।
english_translation: Salutations to that one blissful, peaceful, and radiant being whose arising dispels all illusion like a dream.
essence: True knowing dissolves all illusion as completely as waking ends a dream.
simple_meaning: When you truly awaken to your inner being, all confusion disappears like a fading dream, revealing peace and joy.
insight: It shifts your view from identifying with confusion to resting in peaceful clarity as your natural state.
modern_relevance: You’ve had moments when worries suddenly seem unreal, like a bad dream fading upon waking — that’s the power of true awareness.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
अर्जयित्वाखिलान् अर्थान् भोगानाप्नोति पुष्कलान् ।
न हि सर्वपरित्यागमन्तरेण सुखी भवेत् ॥
translation: सारे धन कमाकर मनुष्य अतिशय भोगों को पाता है । लेकिन सबके त्याग के बिना सुखी नहीं होता।
english_translation: By earning all wealth, one gains abundant pleasures. But without completely giving up everything, one cannot be truly happy.
essence: True happiness requires completely letting go, not just gaining pleasures.
simple_meaning: Having many pleasures from wealth is possible, but true happiness requires giving up attachment to everything.
insight: It shifts your view from accumulating possessions to releasing attachment as the key to happiness.
modern_relevance: You might chase every comfort and pleasure, yet feel unrest until you let go fully of craving for them.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
कर्तव्यदुःखमार्तण्डज्वालादग्धान्तरात्मनः ।
कुतः प्रशमपीयूषधारासारमृते सुखम् ॥
translation: कर्तव्य से पैदा हुए दुःखरूप सूर्य के ताप से जला अन्तर्मन जिसका, ऐसे पुरुष को शान्तिरूपी अमृतधारा की वर्षा के बिना सुख कहाँ है।
english_translation: A person whose inner being is burned by the fiery sun of duty-born suffering finds no happiness without the shower of peace-like nectar.
essence: True happiness comes only when peace soothes the suffering caused by fulfilling duty.
simple_meaning: Suffering caused by fulfilling duty can feel like burning inside; only a peaceful, soothing experience can bring true happiness.
insight: This verse teaches you to seek inner peace as the essential remedy when duty causes emotional pain.
modern_relevance: You’ve pushed yourself through a difficult obligation that left you drained; only moments of genuine calm can restore your joy.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
भवोऽयं भावनामात्रो न किञ्चित् परमर्थतः ।
नास्त्यभावः स्वभावानां भावाभावविभाविनाम् ॥
translation: यह संसार भावनामात्र है, परमार्थतः कुछ भी नहीं है । भावरूप और अभावरूप पदार्थों में स्थित स्वभाव का अभाव नहीं है।
english_translation: This world is only appearance; ultimately, it is nothing real. The true nature of things is the presence of both existence and non-existence aspects inseparable in the nature of all that appears.
essence: Everything appears but nothing exists separately; existence and non-existence are inseparable.
simple_meaning: The world you experience is only appearance; in truth, nothing exists independently. Existence and non-existence coexist inseparably in all things.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing things as fixed entities to recognizing their inseparable unity of existence and non-existence.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by change or loss, remember that what you grasp as solid is just appearance, not fixed reality.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
न दूरं न च सङ्कोचाल्लब्धमेवात्मनः पदम् ।
निर्विकल्पं निरायासं निर्विकारं निरञ्जनम् ॥
translation: यह आत्मपद न तो दूर है, न संकोच से ही प्राप्त होता है । यह निर्विकल्प, निरायास, निर्विकार और निरञ्जन है।
english_translation: The state of the true self is neither distant nor attained by effort; it is without alternatives, effortless, unchanging, and spotless.
essence: The true self is always present, effortless, unchanging, and pure.
simple_meaning: The true self is always present and cannot be reached by struggle or effort. It is steady, effortless, and pure.
insight: It shifts your view from striving to recognize the true self as already here, beyond all effort or change.
modern_relevance: You pause, anxious about achieving peace, then realize it’s always been inside you—no effort or distance needed.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
व्यामोहमात्रविरतौ स्वरूपादानमात्रतः ।
वीतशोका विराजन्ते निरावरणदृष्टयः ॥
translation: मोहमात्र से निवृत्त होने पर और अपने स्वरूप के ग्रहण मात्र से वीतशोक और निरावरण दृष्टि वाले पुरुष शोभायमान होते हैं।
english_translation: By renouncing only delusion and simply embracing your true nature, you become free of sorrow and shine with unobstructed vision.
essence: Renouncing delusion and embracing your true self dissolves sorrow and reveals clear vision.
simple_meaning: When you stop believing in false illusions and simply accept who you truly are, sorrow disappears and your vision becomes clear and unobstructed.
insight: Shift focus from chasing illusions to resting in your true nature, which dissolves sorrow and reveals clarity.
modern_relevance: You feel overwhelmed when caught in self-doubt or confusion, but simply accepting who you are can clear your mind and ease your heart.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
समस्तं कल्पनामात्रमात्मा मुक्तः सनातनः ।
इति विज्ञाय धीरो हि किमभ्यस्यति बालवत् ॥
translation: समस्त जगत कल्पना मात्र है और आत्मा मुक्त और सनातन है । ऐसा जानकर धीर पुरुष बालक के समान क्या चेष्टा करता है।
english_translation: Everything is merely an imagination, the true self is free and eternal; knowing this, what effort can a steady person make like a child?
essence: Your true self is eternally free beyond all imagined effort.
simple_meaning: Everything you see and think is just imagination; your true self is free and eternal. When you realize this, striving like a child makes no sense.
insight: It shifts your mind from trying to control imagined realities to resting in the freedom of your true self.
modern_relevance: You stress over things that feel urgent, but knowing your true self is free can ease your constant striving.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
आत्मा ब्रह्मेति निश्चित्य भावाभावौ च कल्पितौ ।
निष्कामः किं विजानाति किं ब्रूते च करोति किम् ॥
translation: आत्मा ब्रह्म है और भाव एवं अभाव कल्पित हैं । यह निश्चयपूर्वक जानकर निष्काम पुरुष क्या जानता है, क्या कहता है और क्या करता है।
english_translation: Knowing for certain that the true self is the supreme reality and that existence and non-existence are imagined, a desireless person neither knows nor speaks nor acts.
essence: Fully knowing the true self dissolves all desire, knowledge, speech, and action.
simple_meaning: When you fully understand that your true self is the supreme reality and that existence and non-existence are just imagined, a desireless person no longer knows, speaks, or acts.
insight: It shifts your mind from reacting and doing to resting in the truth beyond all imagined dualities.
modern_relevance: You stop obsessing over choices and outcomes when you deeply realize your essential nature beyond all appearances.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
अयं सोऽहमयं नाहमिति क्षीणा विकल्पना ।
सर्वमात्मेति निश्चित्य तूष्णीम्भूतस्य  योगिनः ॥
translation: सब आत्मा है । ऐसा निश्चयपूर्वक जानकर शान्त हुए योगी की ऐसी कल्पनाएँ कि ‘वह मैं हूँ’ और ‘वह मैं नहीं हूँ’ क्षीण हो जाती हैं।
english_translation: Knowing firmly that everything is the true self, the yogi becomes peaceful as the notions ‘I am this’ and ‘I am not this’ fade away.
essence: True peace arises when all conflicting thoughts of self vanish into one knowing.
simple_meaning: When you firmly realize that everything is your true self, conflicting thoughts about being or not being something disappear, bringing deep peace.
insight: It teaches you to release mental divisions of self versus other and rest in the unified true self.
modern_relevance: After a long day of conflicting feelings about your identity or choices, a quiet certainty about your true nature can calm your restless mind.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
न विक्षेपो न चैकाग्र्यं नातिबोधो न मूढता ।
न सुखं न च वा दुःखमुपशान्तस्य योगिनः ॥
translation: अपशान्त हुए योगी के लिए न विक्षेप है और न एकाग्रता है, न अतिबोध है और न मूढ़ता है, न सुख है और न दुःख है।
english_translation: For the tranquil yogi, there is no distraction, no concentration, no excessive awareness, no confusion, no pleasure, and no pain.
essence: True calm is beyond distraction, focus, pleasure, pain, and confusion.
simple_meaning: A truly peaceful yogi experiences no distractions, no focused effort, no confusion, and no feelings of pleasure or pain.
insight: It teaches you to let go of both craving and aversion, resting in neutral awareness beyond all feelings.
modern_relevance: When your mind stops chasing every emotion or thought, you find a calm that no success or failure can shake.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
स्वाराज्ये भैक्षवृत्तौ च लाभालाभे जने वने ।
निर्विकल्पस्वभावस्य न विशेषोऽस्ति योगिनः ॥
translation: निर्विकल्प स्वभाव वाले योगी के लिए राज्य और भिक्षावृत्ति में, लाभ और हानि में, समाज और वन में फर्क नहीं है।
english_translation: For a yogi of unwavering nature, there is no difference between rulership and mendicancy, gain and loss, society and solitude.
essence: The steady self is unaffected by external roles, outcomes, or surroundings.
simple_meaning: A yogi who has an unshakable inner nature sees no difference between wealth or poverty, company or loneliness.
insight: This shifts your focus from external situations to the steady self beneath changing circumstances.
modern_relevance: You face chaos at work, social events, or quiet moments alone — but your inner peace remains unshaken.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
क्व धर्मः क्व च वा कामः क्व चार्थः क्व विवेकिता ।
इदं कृतमिदं नेति द्वन्द्वैर्मुक्तस्य योगिनः ॥
translation: यह किया है और यह अनकिया है इस प्रकार के द्वन्द्व से मुक्त योगी के लिए कहाँ धर्म है, कहाँ काम है, कहाँ अर्थ है, कहाँ विवेक है।
english_translation: For the yogi free from dualities, where is duty, where desire, where wealth, where discrimination in what is done and what is not?
essence: Beyond dualities, concepts like duty, desire, and discrimination lose meaning.
simple_meaning: When you are free from seeing things as opposites, concepts like duty, desire, wealth, and even discrimination lose their meaning.
insight: It shifts your mind from clinging to labels and judgments toward experiencing life as seamless and whole.
modern_relevance: In moments when your mind stops labeling actions as right or wrong, you feel a rare calm beyond stress and ambition.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
कृत्यं किमपि नैवास्ति न कापि हृदि रञ्जना ।
यथा जीवनमेवेह जीवन्मुक्तस्य योगिनः ॥
translation: जीवनमुक्त योगी के लिए कर्तव्यकर्म कुछ भी नहीं है और न हृदय में कोई अनुराग है । वह संसार में यथाप्राप्त जीवन जीता है।
english_translation: For the life-liberated yogi, no duty exists and no attachment stains the heart; they live in the world just as life itself.
essence: Complete freedom means no inner obligations or cravings, just living naturally here and now.
simple_meaning: A fully liberated yogi feels no obligation or desire and lives naturally in the world without attachment.
insight: It shifts your mind from feeling bound by roles or desires to embracing life without internal resistance.
modern_relevance: You finish your tasks without clinging to outcomes or stress, simply being present with whatever life brings.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
क्व मोहः क्व च वा विश्वं क्व तद् ध्यानं क्व मुक्तता ।
सर्वसङ्कल्पसीमायां विश्रान्तस्य महात्मनः ॥
translation: सम्पूर्ण संकल्पों के अन्त होने पर विश्रान्त हुए महात्मा के लिए कहाँ मोह और कहाँ संसार है, कहाँ वह ध्यान है, कहाँ मुक्ति है।
english_translation: For the great soul who is at rest beyond all intentions, where is delusion, where is the world, where is meditation, where is liberation?
essence: Complete rest beyond all desires ends delusion, the world, and the need for liberation.
simple_meaning: When a great soul stops all mental intentions and desires, there is no delusion, no world, no meditation, and no separate liberation.
insight: It shifts your view from seeking something outside to recognizing resting as the true freedom.
modern_relevance: You lie awake, your mind finally quiet after endless striving. In that calm, all worries about progress and escape dissolve naturally.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
येन विश्वमिदं दृष्टं स नास्तीति करोतु वै ।
निर्वासनः किं कुरुते पश्यन्नपि न पश्यति ॥
translation: जिसने जगत को देखा है वह भला उसे इनकार भी करे, लेकिन वासनारहित पुरुष को क्या करना है । वह देखता हुआ भी नहीं देखता है।
english_translation: He who has truly seen this entire world can even deny it; but what can a desireless man do? Though he sees, he does not really see.
essence: True seeing recognizes the world as unreal, though it still appears to the senses.
simple_meaning: A person who has truly understood the nature of the world can deny its reality. A desireless person may look but does not actually perceive the world as real.
insight: It teaches to distinguish between mere sensory perception and true understanding beyond appearances.
modern_relevance: You might scroll endlessly through images and news, but true understanding means seeing beyond appearances, not just looking.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
येन दृष्टं परं ब्रह्म सोऽहं ब्रह्मेति चिन्तयेत् ।
किं चिन्तयति निश्चिन्तो द्वितीयं यो न पश्यति ॥
translation: जिसने पर-ब्रह्म को देखा है वह भला ‘मैं ब्रह्म हूँ’ का चिन्तन भी करे, लेकिन जो निश्चिन्त होकर दूसरा कोई नहीं देखता वह क्या चिन्तन करे।
english_translation: One who has seen the supreme reality thinks 'I am that supreme reality'; but one who is without thought and sees no other, what contemplation remains for them?
essence: True realization ends all dual thoughts and leaves nothing left to contemplate.
simple_meaning: If you have truly realized the supreme reality as yourself, then the usual thinking about separation fades and no other thoughts remain.
insight: It shifts your mind from constant mental analysis to resting in direct knowing beyond thought.
modern_relevance: After a breakthrough moment where you deeply understand yourself, your restless mind quiets and you don't need to analyze or overthink anymore.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
दृष्टो येनात्मविक्षेपो निरोधं कुरुते त्वसौ ।
उदारस्तु न विक्षिप्तः साध्याभावात्करोति किम् ॥
translation: जो आत्मा में विक्षेप देखता है वह भला चित्त का निरोध करे, लेकिन विक्षेपमुक्त उदारपुरुष साध्य के अभाव में क्या करे।
english_translation: The one who sees distraction in the self rightly restrains the mind, but what can the noble man who is free from distraction do without a goal?
essence: Calming distraction is not enough; purpose is necessary for meaningful freedom.
simple_meaning: When you notice distraction in yourself, you can calm your mind. But if someone is free from distraction and has no purpose, what can they do?
insight: It teaches you to balance inner calm with a guiding purpose to avoid feeling aimless.
modern_relevance: You might meditate to quiet your busy thoughts, but without a clear aim, that stillness can feel like emptiness rather than peace.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
धीरो लोकविपर्यस्तो वर्तमानोऽपि लोकवत् ।
न समाधिं न विक्षेपं न लोपं स्वस्य पश्यति ॥
translation: जो संसार की तरह बरतता हुआ भी संसार से भिन्न है । वह धीर पुरुष न अपनी समाधि को और न बन्धन को ही देखता है।
english_translation: The wise one behaves like the world but remains distinct; they neither see their stillness nor their bondage.
essence: You can live fully yet remain untouched by both stillness and bondage.
simple_meaning: You can live in the world without being caught by either your inner calm or your attachments.
insight: It shifts your mind from identifying with your states to seeing yourself as the presence beyond both calm and disturbance.
modern_relevance: You navigate daily challenges like everyone else but no longer get swept away by your emotions or limiting beliefs.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
भावाभावविहीनो यस्तृप्तो निर्वासनो बुधः ।
नैव किञ्चित्कृतं तेन लोकदृष्ट्या विकुर्वता ॥
translation: जो ज्ञानी पुरुष तृप्त है, भाव-अभाव से रहित है, वासना-रहित है वह लोक-दृष्टि से कर्म करता हुआ भी कुछ नहीं करता है।
english_translation: A wise person who is satisfied, free from desire and aversion, acts in the world yet does nothing.
essence: Acting without desire or aversion means doing yet not truly doing anything at all.
simple_meaning: A wise person who is satisfied and free from desire acts in the world but is not attached to the results or affected by actions.
insight: It teaches you to act without attachment, seeing action as a natural flow, not a binding obligation.
modern_relevance: You finish a demanding project without craving praise or fearing failure—your peace stays intact regardless of outcome.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
प्रवृत्तौ वा निवृत्तौ वा नैव धीरस्य दुर्ग्रहः ।
यदा यत्कर्तुमायाति तत्कृत्वा तिष्ठतः सुखम् ॥
translation: धीर पुरुष प्रवृत्ति अथवा निवृत्ति में दुराग्रह नहीं रखता । वह जब कभी भी कुछ करने को आ पड़ता है, उसको करके सुखपूर्वक रहता है ।
english_translation: The steady person holds no stubborn attachment in action or rest; whenever something calls, they do it and remain at ease.
essence: True steadiness means no stubborn grip in doing or not doing, with ease throughout.
simple_meaning: You can be steady and peaceful whether you are doing something or resting, without clinging or resisting what happens.
insight: It encourages shifting from pushing or resisting experiences to accepting and engaging with them naturally, fostering inner balance.
modern_relevance: You finish a task or take a break, without obsessing or resisting. That calm steadiness keeps stress away and lets you rest or act fully.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
निर्वासनो निरालम्बः स्वच्छन्दो मुक्तबन्धनः ।
क्षिप्तः संस्कारवातेन चेष्टते शुष्कपर्णवत् ॥
translation: ज्ञानी पुरुष वासना-रहित, आलम्बन-रहित, स्वच्छन्द और बन्धन-रहित संसाररूपी वायु से प्रेरित होकर शुष्क पत्ते की भाँति व्यवहार करता है।
english_translation: The wise person is free from desires and attachments, acting spontaneously, moved by the wind of worldly impressions like a dry leaf.
essence: True freedom means acting spontaneously without craving or attachment, like a dry leaf in the wind.
simple_meaning: A wise person acts without craving or dependence, spontaneously moving like a dry leaf blown by the wind of impressions.
insight: It teaches you to let go of craving and support, acting with freedom instead of resistance.
modern_relevance: You notice how sometimes you're pushed by moods or expectations, yet the freer you are from clinging, the more naturally you respond without stress.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
असंसारस्य तु क्वापि न हर्षो न विषादता ।
स शीतलमना नित्यं विदेह इव राजये ॥
translation: संसारमुक्त पुरुष को न तो कभी हर्ष होता है, न विषाद । वह शान्तमना सदा विदेह की भाँति शोभता है।
english_translation: The one free from worldly existence neither feels joy nor sorrow; always calm, they shine like the bodiless.
essence: True freedom means being steady and calm beyond all joy and sorrow.
simple_meaning: A person free from worldly bonds does not experience joy or sorrow and remains calm like one without a body.
insight: It teaches you to hold steady and shine with calmness regardless of emotional swings.
modern_relevance: You’ve faced moments when success or failure no longer disturb your inner calm but you remain steady and clear within.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
कुत्रापि न जिहासास्ति नाशो वापि न कुत्रचित् ।
आत्मारामस्य धीरस्य शीतलाच्छतरात्मनः ॥
translation: आत्मा में रमण करने वाले और शीतल तथा निर्मल चित्त वाले धीर पुरुष की न कहीं त्याग की इच्छा है, न कहीं ग्रहण की आशा है।
english_translation: The steady one who delights in the true self and has a calm, clear mind neither desires to give up nor hopes to acquire anything.
essence: True steadiness comes from neither wanting to lose nor hoping to gain anything.
simple_meaning: A person who enjoys their true self and has a calm, pure mind does not desire to give up or to acquire anything.
insight: It teaches you to rest fully in yourself without chasing or rejecting experiences, freeing your mind from craving.
modern_relevance: After a tough day, you sit quietly and realize you don’t need to push for more or fear losing what you have to feel calm.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
प्रकृत्या शून्यचित्तस्य कुर्वतोऽस्य यदृच्छया ।
प्राकृतस्येव धीरस्य न मानो नावमानता ॥
translation: स्वाभाविक रूप से जो शून्यचित्त है और सहजरूप से जो कर्म करता है, उस धीर पुरुष को सामान्यजन की तरह, न मान है और न अपमान है।
english_translation: A steady person whose mind is naturally empty and who acts spontaneously is neither honored nor dishonored like ordinary people.
essence: Natural action from an empty mind leaves you untouched by praise or blame.
simple_meaning: You act naturally with an empty mind and stay steady without caring about praise or insult.
insight: It guides you to act from your true nature without craving recognition or fearing judgment.
modern_relevance: You completed your task honestly and naturally. Whether others applaud or criticize, you remain steady and unshaken.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
कृतं देहेन कर्मेदं न मया शुद्धरूपिणा ।
इति चिन्तानुरोधी यः कुर्वन्नपि करोति न ॥
translation: यह कर्म शरीर से किया गया है, मुझ शुद्ध स्वरूप द्वारा नहीं । ऐसी चिन्तना का जो अनुगमन करता है, वह कर्म करता हुआ भी नहीं करता है।
english_translation: The actions are done by the body, not by my pure true self. One who follows this understanding acts but is not truly acting.
essence: Your pure true self is always separate and untouched by bodily actions.
simple_meaning: The body performs actions, but your pure true self does not. If you understand this, you act without being truly bound by the actions.
insight: It shifts your perspective from identifying with your actions to witnessing them as separate from your true self.
modern_relevance: When you face pressure to perform or succeed, remember that your deepest self is not responsible for the outcomes, only your body and mind are.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
अतद्वादीव कुरुते न भवेदपि बालिशः ।
जीवन्मुक्तः सुखी श्रीमान् संसरन्नपि शोभते ॥
translation: जीवन्मुक्त, उस सामान्यजन की तरह कर्म करता है, जो कहता कुछ और है और करता कुछ और है, तो वह मूढ़ नहीं होता है और वह सुखी श्रीमान् संसार में रहकर भी शोभायमान होता है।
english_translation: One liberated while living acts like an ordinary person, not foolish, and shines happily even within the world.
essence: True freedom lets you live fully and shine happily within the world.
simple_meaning: A person who is free inside can act like any normal person without confusion and live happily within the world.
insight: It teaches you that inner freedom does not require withdrawing or acting differently; you can engage fully and still be free.
modern_relevance: You might feel pressured to hide your true freedom or joy to fit in, but real freedom means shining authentically wherever you are.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
नानाविचारसुश्रान्तो धीरो विश्रान्तिमागतः ।
न कल्पते न जाति न श‍ृणोति न पश्यति ॥
translation: जो धीर पुरुष अनेक प्रकार के विचारों से थककर शान्ति को उपलब्ध होता है वह न कल्पना करता है, न जानता है, न सुनता है, न देखता है।
english_translation: The wise man, exhausted by many kinds of thoughts and having attained peace, neither imagines, knows, hears, nor sees.
essence: Deep peace arises when the mind ceases all mental and sensory activity.
simple_meaning: When your mind tires of endless thoughts and reaches peace, it stops imagining, knowing, hearing, and seeing.
insight: It teaches you to rest beyond active mind and senses, opening space for true peace.
modern_relevance: After a day overwhelmed by nonstop mental chatter and distractions, you finally feel a deep calm when your mind stops reacting to it all.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
असमाधेरविक्षेपान् न मुमुक्षुर्न चेतरः ।
निश्चित्य कल्पितं पश्यन् ब्रह्मैवास्ते महाशयः ॥
translation: महाशय पुरुष विक्षेप-रहित और समाधि-रहित होने के कारण न मुमुक्षु है, न गैर-मुमुक्षु होता है । वह निश्चयपूर्वक संसार को कल्पित देखकर ब्रह्मवत् रहता है।
english_translation: A great being, free from distraction and without attachment to stillness, is neither seeker nor non-seeker; firmly seeing the world as imagined, they remain like the supreme reality.
essence: Freedom comes when seeking and rejecting both fall away by clearly seeing the world as imagined.
simple_meaning: A truly free person neither desires liberation nor rejects it; they see the world as a creation of the mind and remain steady like the supreme reality.
insight: It shifts your mind from restless wanting or rejecting to steady clear seeing without distraction or attachment.
modern_relevance: When you stop chasing every desire or pushing away what comes, and simply observe your thoughts as passing images, you find calm that isn’t shaken by craving.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
यस्यान्तः स्यादहङ्कारो न करोति करोति सः ।
निरहङ्कारधीरेण न किञ्चिदकृतं कृतम् ॥
translation: जिसके अन्तःकरण में अहंकार है, वह कर्म नहीं करते हुए भी कर्म करता है और अहंकार-रहित धीर पुरुष कर्म करते हुए भी नहीं करता है।
english_translation: One with ego inside acts without acting; one free of ego acts without acting.
essence: Ego causes you to act compulsively; freedom lets you act without attachment.
simple_meaning: If your mind is filled with ego, you act even when you don’t intend to. If you are free from ego, you may act but remain untouched by it.
insight: It teaches you to distinguish ego-driven reactions from conscious, detached action, freeing your experience of doing.
modern_relevance: You may feel trapped by your own pride or self-importance, causing restless doing. Yet when you let go of ego, your actions flow freely without inner conflict.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
नोद्विग्नं न च सन्तुष्टमकर्तृ स्पन्दवर्जितम् ।
निराशं गतसन्देहं चित्तं मुक्तस्य राजते ॥
translation: मुक्तपुरुष का उद्वेग-रहित, संतोष-रहित, कर्तव्य-रहित, स्पन्द-रहित, आशा-रहित, सन्देह-रहित चित्त ही शोभायमान है।
english_translation: The mind of a liberated person shines, free from agitation, contentment, doership, movement, hope, and doubt.
essence: A liberated mind shines by being free from agitation, hope, and doubt.
simple_meaning: A truly free person’s mind is calm and steady, without restlessness, desires, or doubts.
insight: This verse teaches you to recognize the natural peace and clarity that arises when you release restless wanting and uncertainty.
modern_relevance: When your thoughts race and doubts cloud your mind, imagine the calm brightness of a mind free from all that.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
निर्ध्यातुं चेष्टितुं वापि यच्चित्तं न प्रवर्तते ।
निर्निमित्तमिदं किन्तु निर्ध्यायेति विचेष्टते ॥
translation: मुक्तपुरुष का चित्त ध्यान या चेष्टा में प्रवृत्त नहीं होता है । लेकिन वह निमित्त या हेतु के बिना ध्यान करता है और कर्म करता है।
english_translation: The mind of the liberated person neither dwells on meditation nor on effort; yet it meditates and acts without any cause.
essence: True freedom means acting and meditating naturally without effort or cause.
simple_meaning: The liberated mind does not get caught in trying to meditate or act, yet it naturally does both without needing a reason.
insight: It teaches you to release the need to force meditation or action and trust natural flow without cause or effort.
modern_relevance: You sit quietly, not forcing calm or productivity, yet your focus and actions arise naturally without strain or pressure.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
तत्त्वं यथार्थमाकर्ण्य मन्दः प्राप्नोति मूढताम् ।
अथवा याति सङ्कोचममूढः कोऽपि मूढवत् ॥
translation: मन्दबुद्धि यथार्थत्व को सुनकर मूढ़ता को ही प्राप्त होता है । लेकिन कोई ज्ञानी मूढ़वत् होकर संकोच या समाधि को प्राप्त होता है।
english_translation: A dull mind perceives truth and only attains confusion; a wise person may also appear foolish by entering hesitation or absorption.
essence: Not hearing truth clearly causes confusion; wisdom may appear foolish in deep hesitation.
simple_meaning: Ignoring or not truly understanding truth leads to confusion; even a wise person can seem foolish when deeply hesitant or absorbed.
insight: This verse shifts your view of hesitation from weakness to a phase of deep inquiry and growth.
modern_relevance: You may feel stuck or foolish when wrestling with complex ideas, but hesitation is part of deep understanding.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
एकाग्रता निरोधो वा मूढैरभ्यस्यते भृशम् ।
धीराः कृत्यं न पश्यन्ति सुप्तवत्स्वपदे स्थिताः ॥
translation: अज्ञानी चित्त की एकाग्रता अथवा निरोध का बहुत अभ्यास करता है लेकिन धीर पुरुष सोये हुए व्यक्ति की तरह अपने स्वभाव में स्थिर रहकर कुछ करने योग्य नहीं देखता है।
english_translation: The ignorant intensely practice concentration or restraint of the mind, but the wise, like one asleep, remain steady in their nature and see no need for action.
essence: True wisdom is steady and effortless; forced concentration is the ignorant's struggle.
simple_meaning: Trying hard to force your mind to focus is a struggle of the ignorant. The wise remain naturally steady and do not feel the need to force anything.
insight: It teaches you to stop pushing your mind and instead gently rest in natural steadiness, seeing no need for forced effort.
modern_relevance: You find yourself exhausting endless efforts to quiet your racing thoughts, but lasting peace comes when you stop forcing control and simply rest in your true nature.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
अप्रयत्नात् प्रयत्नाद् वा मूढो नाप्नोति निर्वृतिम् ।
तत्त्वनिश्चयमात्रेण प्राज्ञो भवति निर्वृतः ॥
translation: अज्ञानी पुरुष प्रयत्न अथवा अप्रयत्न से निवृत्ति को प्राप्त नहीं होता है जबकि ज्ञानी पुरुष केवल तत्त्व को निश्चयपूर्वक जानकर ही निवृत्त हो जाता है।
english_translation: A fool does not attain freedom by effort or non-effort; the wise become free only by firm certainty in truth.
essence: Freedom arises from firm certainty in truth, not from effort or non-effort.
simple_meaning: Trying hard or not trying at all does not bring freedom; only firm understanding of truth frees you.
insight: It shifts your focus from action or inaction to cultivating clear inner certainty as the path to freedom.
modern_relevance: You’ve pushed yourself to the limit or tried to quit, yet freedom still feels distant. This shows freedom is about clear inner certainty, not effort alone.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
शुद्धं बुद्धं प्रियं पूर्णं निष्प्रपञ्चं निरामयम् ।
आत्मानं तं न जानन्ति तत्राभ्यासपरा जनाः ॥
translation: इस संसार में अभ्यास परायण पुरुष उस आत्मा को नहीं जान पाते जो शुद्ध, बुद्ध, प्रिय, पूर्ण, प्रपञ्च-रहित और दुःख-रहित है।
english_translation: In this world, those devoted to practice do not know the true self that is pure, wise, beloved, complete, free from appearance, and free from suffering.
essence: Devoted effort alone cannot reveal the pure and complete true self.
simple_meaning: Many who focus deeply on practice fail to recognize their true self, which is pure, wise, and free from suffering and illusion.
insight: It teaches that effort alone doesn’t guarantee self-knowledge; recognition of the true self requires a shift beyond practice.
modern_relevance: You might spend hours on self-improvement routines yet still feel disconnected from your true essence hidden beneath the surface.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
नाप्नोति कर्मणा मोक्षं विमूढोऽभ्यासरूपिणा ।
धन्यो विज्ञानमात्रेण मुक्तस्तिष्ठत्यविक्रियः ॥
translation: अज्ञानी पुरुष अभ्यासरूपी कर्म से मोक्ष को प्राप्त नहीं होता है । जबकि क्रिया-रहित ज्ञानी पुरुष केवल ज्ञान के द्वारा मुक्त हुआ स्थिर रहता है।
english_translation: A confused person does not attain freedom through habitual action; instead, the wise, free and unmoved, remains established by knowledge alone.
essence: Freedom is not earned by busy action but by steady, unmoved knowledge.
simple_meaning: Freedom cannot be gained through repeated actions done in confusion. Only steady knowledge brings true freedom and stillness.
insight: Shift from relying on repeated effort to trusting clear understanding as the source of freedom.
modern_relevance: You might push yourself through endless routines, hoping for peace, but real freedom arrives when you understand and stop the restless cycle.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
मूढो नाप्नोति तद् ब्रह्म यतो भवितुमिच्छति ।
अनिच्छन्नपि धीरो हि परब्रह्मस्वरूपभाक् ॥
translation: अज्ञानी जैसे ब्रह्म होने की इच्छा करता है वैसे ही ब्रह्म नहीं हो पाता है और धीर पुरुष नहीं चाहता हुआ भी निश्चित ही परब्रह्म स्वरूप को भजने वाला होता है।
english_translation: The ignorant who desires to become the supreme reality does not attain it; the wise, even without desire, naturally reflect the supreme reality's nature.
essence: Desiring to become the true self blocks you; wisdom embodies it effortlessly.
simple_meaning: Trying to become the true self by desire keeps you from it, but a wise person naturally embodies it without wanting.
insight: It teaches you to release your craving for transformation and trust in the natural expression of your true nature.
modern_relevance: You may struggle to become who you truly are by forcing change, but real transformation happens when you stop pushing and simply let your true self emerge.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
निराधारा ग्रहव्यग्रा मूढाः संसारपोषकाः ।
एतस्यानर्थमूलस्य मूलच्छेदः कृतो बुधैः ॥
translation: इस आधार-रहित, दुराग्रह-युक्त संसार का पोषक अज्ञानी पुरुष ही है । इस अनर्थ के मूल संसार का मूलाच्छेद ज्ञानियों द्वारा किया गया है।
english_translation: The ignorant person who clings to this unsupported, grasping world is its sustainer; the root of this harm, the root of the world, has been cut by the wise.
essence: Clinging ignorance sustains the world; wisdom ends it by cutting grasping’s root.
simple_meaning: People who ignorantly cling to the unstable world keep it alive; the wise remove this root cause by cutting attachment.
insight: It teaches you to recognize clinging as the source of suffering and to let go with wisdom.
modern_relevance: You hold tightly to worries and desires that lack stable ground, feeding your own stress; true relief comes when you stop supporting these harmful patterns.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
न शान्तिं लभते मूढो यतः शमितुमिच्छति ।
धीरस्तत्त्वं विनिश्चित्य सर्वदा शान्तमानसः ॥
translation: अज्ञानी जैसे शान्त होने की इच्छा करता है, वैसे ही वह शान्ति को नहीं प्राप्त होता है किन्तु धीर पुरुष तत्त्व को जानकर सदैव शान्त मन वाला है।
english_translation: The foolish never find peace because they try to force it; the wise, knowing the truth, remain always calm.
essence: Peace cannot be forced; it arises naturally from deep knowing and steady mind.
simple_meaning: Trying to force peace never works. True calm comes when you understand reality deeply and accept it.
insight: It shifts the mind from pushing for peace to resting in clear understanding and acceptance.
modern_relevance: After a hectic day, trying hard to relax only makes you more restless. Real calm begins when you stop forcing it and accept things as they are.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
क्वात्मनो दर्शनं तस्य यद् दृष्टमवलम्बते ।
धीरास्तं तं न पश्यन्ति पश्यन्त्यात्मानमव्ययम् ॥
translation: उसको आत्मा का दर्शन कहाँ जो दृश्य का अवलम्बन करता है । धीर पुरुष दृश्य को नहीं देखते हैं । वे अविनाशी आत्मा को देखते हैं।
english_translation: Those who depend on what is seen do not perceive the true self; the wise see the imperishable true self.
essence: Your true self cannot be found by relying on what is seen.
simple_meaning: You cannot truly know your inner self by relying on external appearances; the wise perceive the unchanging true self beyond what is seen.
insight: Shift focus from external appearances to the unchanging true self for deeper clarity.
modern_relevance: When you judge yourself or others by surface impressions, you miss their deeper value and your own inner truth.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
क्व निरोधो विमूढस्य यो निर्बन्धं करोति वै ।
स्वारामस्यैव धीरस्य सर्वदासावकृत्रिमः ॥
translation: जो हठपूर्वक चित्त का निरोध करता है, उस अज्ञानी को कहाँ चित्त का निरोध है । स्वयं में रमण करने वाले धीर पुरुष के लिए यह चित्त का निरोध स्वाभाविक है।
english_translation: Where is the restraint of the mind for one who forcibly tries to control it? For the steady person absorbed in the self, that restraint is natural.
essence: True mental calm cannot be forced; it arises naturally from steady self-absorption.
simple_meaning: Trying to forcibly control the restless mind shows confusion. Real calm happens naturally when you are steady and absorbed in your true self.
insight: It shifts the mind from pushing to letting be, revealing that calmness is a natural state, not a forced achievement.
modern_relevance: You try to quiet your racing thoughts by sheer willpower, but peace only comes when you stop forcing it and relax into yourself.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
भावस्य भावकः कश्चिन् न किञ्चिद् भावकोपरः ।
उभयाभावकः कश्चिद् एवमेव निराकुलः ॥
translation: कोई भाव को मानने वाला है और कोई ‘कुछ भी नहीं है’ ऐसा मानने वाला है । वैसे ही कोई दोनों को मानने वाला है । वैसे ही कोई दोनों को नहीं मानने वाला है और वही स्वस्थचित्त है।
english_translation: Some identify with feelings, some deny them; one who is free from both is truly steady.
essence: True steadiness arises by neither accepting nor rejecting feelings.
simple_meaning: You may accept your feelings or deny them, but true peace comes when you neither cling nor reject them.
insight: Shift your attention away from reacting to feelings and towards simply witnessing them without judgment.
modern_relevance: You feel overwhelmed when you try to control emotions or pretend they don’t exist; peace grows by simply resting beyond that struggle.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
शुद्धमद्वयमात्मानं भावयन्ति कुबुद्धयः ।
न तु जानन्ति संमोहाद्यावज्जीवमनिर्वृताः ॥
translation: कुबुद्धि पुरुष शुद्ध अद्वैत आत्मा की भावना करते हैं लेकिन मोहवश उसे नहीं जानते हैं इसलिए जीवन भर सुखरहित रहते हैं।
english_translation: Fools imagine the true self is pure non-duality but, lost in confusion, never truly know it and remain unhappy all their lives.
essence: Imagining the true self is not the same as knowing it, and confusion causes lifelong unrest.
simple_meaning: People confused by their mind imagine the true self as pure non-duality but never realize it due to their delusion, remaining unhappy their whole life.
insight: It teaches you to distinguish between intellectual ideas of truth and direct knowing, shifting focus from concepts to experience.
modern_relevance: You might think you understand yourself fully, but hidden confusion keeps you restless and unfulfilled despite your efforts.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
मुमुक्षोर्बुद्धिरालम्बमन्तरेण न विद्यते ।
निरालम्बैव निष्कामा बुद्धिर्मुक्तस्य सर्वदा ॥
translation: मुमुक्षु पुरुष की बुद्धि आलम्बन के बिना नहीं रहती । मुक्तपुरुष की बुद्धि सदा निष्काम और निरालम्ब रहती है।
english_translation: The seeker’s mind cannot stay without support; the liberated one’s mind is always desireless and unsupported.
essence: True freedom is a mind free from craving and dependence on anything.
simple_meaning: A person seeking freedom depends on something to hold their mind. A truly free mind is always without craving or support.
insight: It teaches you to notice your mind’s dependence and gently let go of needing support.
modern_relevance: You notice how often your mind clings to ideas or things to feel steady, and how tiring that is.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
विषयद्वीपिनो वीक्ष्य चकिताः शरणार्थिनः ।
विशन्ति झटिति क्रोडं निरोधैकाग्रसिद्धये ॥
translation: विषयरूपी बाघ को देखकर भयभीत हुआ मनुष्य शरण की खोज में शीघ्र ही चित्त के निरोध और एकाग्रता की सिद्धि के लिए पहाड़ की गुफा में प्रवेश करता है।
english_translation: Seeing the tiger of desires, the fearful person quickly seeks refuge in a mountain cave to achieve control of mind and single-pointed concentration.
essence: Fear of desires drives you to find calm through focused mind control.
simple_meaning: When overwhelmed by desires, a fearful mind seeks refuge by calming and focusing itself deeply.
insight: It teaches you to respond to emotional overwhelm by withdrawing inward and sharpening your mental focus.
modern_relevance: When your cravings flood your thoughts, you might retreat to a quiet room to regain control and focus your attention.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
निर्वासनं हरिं दृष्ट्वा तूष्णीं विषयदन्तिनः ।
पलायन्ते न शक्तास्ते सेवन्ते कृतचाटवः ॥
translation: वासना-रहित पुरुष-सिंह को देखकर विषयरूपी हाथी चुपचाप भाग जाते हैं या वे असमर्थ होकर चाटुकार की तरह उसकी सेवा करने लगते हैं।
english_translation: Seeing the desireless lion-like man, the elephant of senses silently flees or, powerless, serves him like a flatterer.
essence: Calm, desireless strength makes restless urges either flee or obey without resistance.
simple_meaning: When you become free from desire and remain calm like a lion, your restless senses either quietly leave or become powerless and serve you obediently.
insight: It teaches you to embody calmness so impulses lose their grip and either disappear or yield to your presence.
modern_relevance: You’re sitting quietly amid distractions, and the usual impulses to react or crave either fade away or lose control, letting you stay steady.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
न मुक्तिकारिकां धत्ते निःशङ्को युक्तमानसः ।
पश्यन् श‍ृण्वन् स्पृशन् जिघ्रन्नश्नन्नास्ते यथासुखम् ॥
translation: शंकारहित और मुक्त मन वाला पुरुष मुक्तिकारी योग को आग्रह के साथ नहीं ग्रहण करता है लेकिन वह देखता हुआ, सुनता हुआ, स्पर्श करता हुआ, सूँघता हुआ, खाता हुआ सुखपूर्वक रहता है।
english_translation: The one free of doubt and with a liberated mind does not cling to liberation practices but lives joyfully while seeing, hearing, touching, smelling, and eating.
essence: True freedom is joyful presence without clinging to liberation efforts.
simple_meaning: A mind free from doubt and craving does not cling to practices for liberation but enjoys life fully through all senses.
insight: It shifts focus from grasping freedom as a goal to embracing joyful, unattached experience in everyday life.
modern_relevance: You stop obsessing over achieving an ideal state and instead savor the simple moments of life with calm and joy.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
वस्तुश्रवणमात्रेण शुद्धबुद्धिर्निराकुलः ।
नैवाचारमनाचारमौदास्यं वा प्रपश्यति ॥
translation: यथार्थ ज्ञान के सुनने मात्र से शुद्ध बुद्धि और स्वस्थ चित्त हुआ पुरुष न आचार को, न अनाचार को, न उदासीन को देखता है ।
english_translation: By merely hearing true knowledge, the intellect becomes pure and the mind serene; the person no longer sees right or wrong, or indifference.
essence: Pure knowledge alone calms the intellect, ending judgment of right, wrong, or apathy.
simple_meaning: Listening to genuine knowledge purifies your intellect and calms your mind, so you stop labeling things as right or wrong or feeling indifferent.
insight: It shifts your mind from reactive judgment to stable, clear awareness beyond dualities.
modern_relevance: You listen to a truth that quiets your restless mind, so you stop reacting with approval, disapproval, or detachment to every situation.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
यदा यत्कर्तुमायाति तदा तत्कुरुते ऋजुः ।
शुभं वाप्यशुभं वापि तस्य चेष्टा हि बालवत् ॥
translation: धीर पुरुष जब कुछ शुभ या अशुभ करने को आ पड़ता है तो उसे सहजता के साथ करता है, क्योंकि उसका व्यवहार बालवत् होता है।
english_translation: When a steady person has to do something, whether good or bad, they do it simply, for their action is like that of a child.
essence: Act simply and naturally without judging your actions as good or bad.
simple_meaning: You do what needs to be done straightforwardly, without hesitation, whether it seems good or bad.
insight: It shifts your mind from moral hesitation to straightforward action without inner conflict.
modern_relevance: You face a necessary task you dislike but still do it clearly and simply, without getting stuck in judgment.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
स्वातन्त्र्यात्सुखमाप्नोति स्वातन्त्र्याल्लभते परम् ।
स्वातन्त्र्यान्निर्वृतिं गच्छेत्स्वातन्त्र्यात् परमं पदम् ॥
translation: धीर पुरुष स्वतंत्रता से सुख को प्राप्त होता है, स्वतंत्रता से परम को प्राप्त होता है, स्वतंत्रता से नित्यसुख को प्राप्त होता है और स्वतंत्रता से परमपद को प्राप्त होता है।
english_translation: The steady person attains happiness through freedom, attains the supreme through freedom, attains eternal bliss through freedom, and attains the highest state through freedom.
essence: Complete inner freedom is the source of all joy, liberation, and highest fulfillment.
simple_meaning: You find happiness, eternal bliss, and the highest state through your own inner freedom.
insight: It teaches you to recognize freedom as the foundation for all lasting happiness and the ultimate state of being.
modern_relevance: You feel joy and relief when you stop being controlled by fears or expectations and live with true personal freedom.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
अकर्तृत्वमभोक्तृत्वं स्वात्मनो मन्यते यदा ।
तदा क्षीणा भवन्त्येव समस्ताश्चित्तवृत्तयः ॥
translation: जब मनुष्य अपनी आत्मा के अकर्त्तापन और अभोक्तापन को मानता है तब उसकी सम्पूर्ण चित्तवृत्तियों का नाश हो जाता है।
english_translation: When a person realizes their true self is neither the doer nor the enjoyer, all mental fluctuations cease.
essence: Recognizing you are neither doer nor enjoyer dissolves all mental fluctuations.
simple_meaning: You are not the one who acts or the one who experiences results; recognizing this stops all mental turmoil.
insight: Shift your identity from the doer/enjoyer to the silent observer; this calms mental turbulence.
modern_relevance: When you stop blaming yourself or taking credit for every outcome, your mind stops spinning in worry and doubt.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
उच्छृङ्खलाप्यकृतिका स्थितिर्धीरस्य राजते ।
न तु सस्पृहचित्तस्य शान्तिर्मूढस्य कृत्रिमा ॥
translation: धीर पुरुष की स्वाभाविक उच्छ्रंखल स्थिति भी शोभती है लेकिन स्पृहायुक्त चित्त वाले मूढ़ की बनावटी शान्ति भी नहीं शोभती।
english_translation: The natural restless state suits the steady person, but the artificial peace of a covetous mind does not.
essence: Natural restlessness reflects steady wisdom; artificial calm hides a restless, covetous mind.
simple_meaning: A steady person’s natural restless energy looks good, but a restless mind’s fake calm never does.
insight: It shifts how you see restlessness — not as a flaw but as a sign of authentic inner steadiness.
modern_relevance: You feel anxious and unsettled, but when your core steadiness holds, your energy is genuine — unlike pretending to be calm when inside you’re stormy.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
विलसन्ति महाभोगैर्विशन्ति गिरिगह्वरान् ।
निरस्तकल्पना धीरा अबद्धा मुक्तबुद्धयः ॥
translation: कल्पना-रहित, बन्धन-रहित और मुक्त बुद्धि वाले धीर पुरुष कभी बड़े-बड़े भोगों के साथ क्रीड़ा करते हैं और कभी पहाड़ की कन्दराओं में प्रवेश करते हैं।
english_translation: The wise, free from imagination and bondage, sometimes delight in great pleasures and sometimes enter mountain caves.
essence: True freedom lets you move freely between joy and solitude without attachment.
simple_meaning: A wise person with a free and clear mind can enjoy both great pleasures and peaceful solitude without losing inner freedom.
insight: It teaches you to hold experiences lightly, allowing full enjoyment without losing your sense of freedom.
modern_relevance: You might find yourself celebrating loud moments with friends or seeking quiet alone time—and both can coexist without disturbing your inner freedom.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
श्रोत्रियं देवतां तीर्थमङ्गनां भूपतिं प्रियम् ।
दृष्ट्वा सम्पूज्य धीरस्य न कापि हृदि वासना ॥
translation: धीर पुरुष के हृदय में पण्डित, देवता और तीर्थ का पूजन करके तथा स्त्री, राजा और प्रियजन को देखकर कोई भी वासना नहीं होती।
english_translation: A steady person feels no desire in the heart after worshipping scholars, deities, shrines, women, kings, or loved ones.
essence: True steadiness lets you honor all without stirring desire inside.
simple_meaning: A steady person can see and honor respected people and places without feeling desire inside.
insight: It teaches you to honor and respect without letting your heart be swayed by desire or attachment.
modern_relevance: You attend a gathering full of admired people and places but remain calm, without craving or distraction pulling your heart.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
भृत्यैः पुत्रैः कलत्रैश्च दौहित्रैश्चापि गोत्रजैः ।
विहस्य धिक्कृतो योगी न याति विकृतिं मनाक् ॥
translation: योगी नौकरों से, पुत्रों से, पत्नियों से, दोहित्रों और बान्धवों द्वारा हँसकर धिक्कारे जाने पर भी विकार को प्राप्त नहीं होता है ।
english_translation: A yogi does not undergo disturbance of mind even when servants, sons, wives, daughters-in-law, and relatives mock and insult him.
essence: A steady mind stays undisturbed despite mockery from even close relations.
simple_meaning: You can stay calm and undisturbed in your mind even if close people insult or mock you.
insight: It teaches you to build inner resilience so others' words cannot disrupt your mental balance.
modern_relevance: When someone close ridicules you in front of others, you can keep your mind steady without reacting or losing peace.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
सन्तुष्टोऽपि न सन्तुष्टः खिन्नोऽपि न च खिद्यते ।
तस्याश्चर्यदशां तां तां तादृशा एव जानते ॥
translation: धीर पुरुष सन्तुष्ट होकर भी सन्तुष्ट नहीं होता है और दुःखी होकर भी दुःखी नहीं होता है । उसकी इस आश्चर्यमय दशा को वैसे ही ज्ञानी जानते हैं।
english_translation: The steady person is not truly pleased even when content, nor truly distressed even when upset; the wise recognize this wondrous state as it is.
essence: True steadiness means not being defined by feeling content or distressed.
simple_meaning: A truly steady person does not get caught up in feeling happy or upset. Their inner state remains unchanged, and wise people understand this surprising quality.
insight: It shifts your understanding from identifying with emotions to seeing them as passing states that don’t define your true self.
modern_relevance: You might smile after good news yet still feel a calm inside, or face hardship without being overwhelmed. This verse explains that true steadiness doesn’t depend on outer feelings.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
कर्तव्यतैव संसारो न तां पश्यन्ति सूरयः ।
शून्याकारा निराकारा निर्विकारा निरामयाः ॥
translation: कर्तव्य ही संसार है, उसे शून्याकार, निराकार, निर्विकार और निरामय ज्ञानी नहीं देखते हैं।
english_translation: Those who act see the world; the wise see it as empty, formless, changeless, and free from disease.
essence: The world appears real to those acting, but the wise see it as empty and unchanging.
simple_meaning: People who focus on doing see the world as real and active. The wise understand it as empty, without form or change.
insight: This verse shifts your view from identifying with actions to recognizing the world as a passing appearance without lasting reality.
modern_relevance: You rush through your day reacting to tasks and problems, but deeper insight comes when you step back and see situations as temporary shapes in a vast silent space.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
अकुर्वन्नपि सङ्क्षोभाद् व्यग्रः सर्वत्र मूढधीः ।
कुर्वन्नपि तु कृत्यानि कुशलो हि निराकुलः ॥
translation: अज्ञानी कर्मों को नहीं करता हुआ भी सर्वत्र विक्षोभ के कारण व्याकुल रहता है और ज्ञानी सब कर्मो को करता हुआ भी शान्तचित्त वाला ही होता है।
english_translation: The ignorant remains restless everywhere, even without acting, disturbed by turmoil; the wise performs all actions yet remains calm and untroubled.
essence: Peace of mind doesn’t depend on doing or not doing—it comes from clear wisdom.
simple_meaning: Restlessness comes from confusion, even when not acting. Wisdom is acting while staying calm and clear.
insight: It teaches you to separate your sense of peace from your outer activity or lack of it.
modern_relevance: When your phone won’t stop buzzing but you stay calm, you show the wisdom of this teaching.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
सुखमास्ते सुखं शेते सुखमायाति याति च ।
सुखं वक्ति सुखं भुङ्क्ते व्यवहारेऽपि शान्तधीः ॥
translation: शान्त बुद्धि वाला ज्ञानी व्यवहार में भी सुखपूर्वक बैठता है, सुखपूर्वक आता है और मर जाता है, सुखपूर्वक बोलता है और सुखपूर्वक भोजन करता है।
english_translation: The calm-minded wise one lives with ease, comes and goes in peace, speaks and eats joyfully.
essence: A calm mind brings peace and joy to all daily actions and moments.
simple_meaning: A wise person with a calm mind lives peacefully in all actions—sitting, speaking, eating, arriving, and leaving with joy.
insight: It teaches you to maintain inner calm so your actions embody peaceful joy, regardless of circumstances.
modern_relevance: You come home tired but find stillness in your voice and meals, living calmly despite the day's chaos.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
स्वभावाद्यस्य नैवार्तिर्लोकवद् व्यवहारिणः ।
महाहृद इवाक्षोभ्यो गतक्लेशः सुशोभते ॥
translation: जो ज्ञानी स्वभाव से व्यवहार में भी सामान्यजन की तरह नहीं व्यवहार करता है और महासरोवर की तरह क्लेशरहित है, वही शोभता है।
english_translation: A true knower naturally behaves beyond the common world and shines free of suffering like a great lake.
essence: True wisdom shines through natural calmness untouched by worldly suffering.
simple_meaning: A true knower lives naturally and calmly, unaffected by common worldly troubles, shining like a peaceful vast lake.
insight: It teaches you to embody calmness so deeply that external troubles no longer disturb your inner peace.
modern_relevance: When others around you get caught in stress and reactions, you feel steady and clear, untouched by the chaos.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
निवृत्तिरपि मूढस्य प्रवृत्ति रुपजायते ।
प्रवृत्तिरपि धीरस्य निवृत्तिफलभागिनी ॥
translation: मूर्ख मनुष्य की निवृत्ति भी प्रवृत्तिरूप हो जाती है । किन्तु धीर पुरुष की प्रवृत्ति भी निवृत्ति के समान फल देती है।
english_translation: A fool's renunciation becomes a form of desire, but a wise person's desire yields the fruit of renunciation.
essence: Letting go can still be craving, and craving can sometimes lead to letting go.
simple_meaning: Sometimes, what looks like giving up is actually still wanting, and what looks like desire can bring true freedom.
insight: It teaches you to examine your inner motives honestly, distinguishing true freedom from disguised craving.
modern_relevance: You might quit a habit but secretly cling to it, or pursue goals that actually bring peace—recognizing this helps you see your true motives.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
परिग्रहेषु वैराग्यं प्रायो मूढस्य दृश्यते ।
देहे विगलिताशस्य क्व रागः क्व विरागता ॥
translation: मूढ़ पुरुष का वैराग्य परिग्रह से देखा जाता है । लेकिन देह में गलित हो गयी है आशा जिसकी, ऐसे ज्ञानी को कहाँ राग है, कहाँ वैराग्य।
english_translation: A foolish person shows detachment by giving up possessions, but a wise one whose desires have dissolved in the body has neither attachment nor detachment.
essence: True detachment is the absence of both desire and resistance, not just renouncing possessions.
simple_meaning: Detachment shown by giving up possessions is shallow and belongs to the confused. True detachment means desires have dissolved completely, so no attachment or aversion remains.
insight: It shifts your understanding from outer actions of renouncing to inner dissolution of desire and aversion.
modern_relevance: You might quit a habit or stop chasing things, but real freedom comes when you no longer feel pulled or pushed by desires inside you.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
भावनाभावनासक्ता दृष्टिर्मूढस्य सर्वदा ।
भाव्यभावनया सा तु स्वस्थस्यादृष्टिरूपिणी ॥
translation: मूर्ख पुरुष की दृष्टि सदा भावना और अभावना में लगी रहती है । जबकि स्वस्थित पुरुष की दृष्टि भावना-अभावना से युक्त रहकर भी उनके प्रति अदृष्टि रूप ही रहती है।
english_translation: The foolish mind is always caught up in thoughts and their absence, but the steady mind remains as the unseen watcher, even amidst thoughts and their absence.
essence: True awareness stays steady as the silent watcher beyond all thoughts and their absence.
simple_meaning: A confused mind is always stuck in thinking or not thinking, but a steady mind observes both without getting involved.
insight: It shifts your mind from being lost in thoughts to becoming the clear observer of them.
modern_relevance: When your mind races between worries and blankness, this teaches you to stand apart as the calm observer inside.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
सर्वारम्भेषु निष्कामो यश्चरेद् बालवन् मुनिः ।
न लेपस्तस्य शुद्धस्य क्रियमाणेऽपि कर्मणि ॥
translation: जो मुनि बालक के समान व्यवहार करता है एवं कामना-रहित रूप से सभी कर्मों का आरम्भ करता है, उस शुद्ध स्वरूप को क्रियमाण कर्म भी लिप्त नहीं करते हैं।
english_translation: One who acts without desire like an innocent child remains untouched by any action, even while performing duties.
essence: You can act with pure innocence and desireless intent, staying untouched by your actions.
simple_meaning: You can start all your actions without craving or expectation, like a child, and remain pure and unaffected by them.
insight: It shifts your mindset to act from innocence and detachment, dissolving the sense of binding results.
modern_relevance: You begin a project or task with curiosity and no pressure, staying light-hearted and unaffected by the outcome.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
स एव धन्य आत्मज्ञः सर्वभावेषु यः समः ।
पश्यन् श‍ृण्वन् स्पृशन् जिघ्रन्न् अश्नन्निस्तर्षमानसः ॥
translation: वही आत्मज्ञानी धन्य है जो मन का निस्तरण कर गया है और जो देखता हुआ, सुनता हुआ, स्पर्श करता हुआ, सूँघता हुआ, खाता हुआ सब भावों में एकरस है।
english_translation: That self-knower is truly blessed who, having transcended the mind, remains equal while seeing, hearing, touching, smelling, and eating all feelings.
essence: Freedom comes from a mind that stays equal amid all sensory experiences.
simple_meaning: You are blessed when your mind is free from craving and remains steady while experiencing all sensations equally.
insight: It teaches you to witness sensations without getting caught in desire or aversion, maintaining steady awareness.
modern_relevance: You face a flood of emotions and sensations daily. Remaining steady and unaffected brings relief and freedom.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
क्व संसारः क्व चाभासः क्व साध्यं क्व च साधनम् ।
आकाशस्येव धीरस्य निर्विकल्पस्य सर्वदा ॥
translation: सदैव आकाश के समान निर्विकल्प ज्ञानी को कहाँ संसार है, कहाँ आभास है, कहाँ साध्य है, कहाँ साधन है।
english_translation: A steady knower, like the sky, has no world, no appearance, no goal, and no means.
essence: A steady mind transcends all worldly forms, goals, and illusions like the vast sky.
simple_meaning: A truly steady mind is like the sky—unchanged by the world, without any appearance, goal, or method.
insight: It teaches you to hold your awareness steady beyond all shifting images and goals, resting in pure presence.
modern_relevance: When chaos swirls around you, like a noisy room or social media storm, you can remain steady and untouched, just like the open sky.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
स जयत्यर्थसंन्यासी पूर्णस्वरसविग्रहः ।
अकृत्रिमोऽनवच्छिन्ने समाधिर्यस्य वर्तते ॥
translation: वही सन्यासी जय को प्राप्त होता है जो पूर्णानन्दस्वरूप है तथा जिसकी समाधि अविच्छिन्न रूप से विद्यमान रहती है।
english_translation: The true renunciant who attains victory is the one who embodies complete bliss and whose absorbed presence remains unbroken.
essence: True victory comes through natural, unbroken blissful presence.
simple_meaning: Victory belongs to the renunciant who naturally embodies complete bliss and whose deep absorption never breaks.
insight: It invites you to cultivate effortless, continuous presence as the real source of victory, not external conquest.
modern_relevance: When your focus stays steady and joyful despite distractions, you succeed beyond external achievements.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
बहुनात्र किमुक्तेन ज्ञाततत्त्वो महाशयः ।
भोगमोक्षनिराकाङ्क्षी सदा सर्वत्र नीरसः ॥
translation: यहाँ बहुत कहने से क्या प्रयोजन है ? तत्त्व-ज्ञानी महाशय भोग और मोक्ष दोनों में निरकांक्षी, सदा और सर्वत्र रागरहित रहता है।
english_translation: What is the use of saying much here? The great knower of truth desires neither pleasure nor freedom and remains always detached everywhere.
essence: True wisdom means desiring nothing and staying detached everywhere always.
simple_meaning: A true knower does not seek pleasure or freedom but stays detached from all desires everywhere at all times.
insight: It shifts your view from craving outcomes to simply being detached and steady everywhere.
modern_relevance: You find yourself restless chasing goals or escapes, yet peace comes only when desire fades and detachment grows.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
महदादि जगद्द्वैतं नाममात्रविजृम्भितम् ।
विहाय शुद्धबोधस्य किं कृत्यमवशिष्यते ॥
translation: महत्तत्व आदि जो द्वैत-जगत है वह नाम मात्र को ही भिन्न है । उसका त्याग कर देने के बाद शुद्ध बोध वाले का कौन सा कार्य शेष रह जाता है।
english_translation: The great primordial universe of duality is only a name and sound; once pure awareness is realized, no action remains to be done.
essence: Pure awareness transcends all duality and leaves no action behind.
simple_meaning: The world of separation and names is only an appearance; once you realize pure awareness, no further action is needed.
insight: It shifts your mind from doing to simply being, recognizing that pure awareness requires no further effort or change.
modern_relevance: After intense effort to control and understand everything, you realize some things simply need no action—they are already whole as they are.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
भ्रमभूतमिदं सर्वं किञ्चिन्नास्तीति निश्चयी ।
अलक्ष्यस्फुरणः शुद्धः स्वभावेनैव शाम्यति ॥
translation: यह समस्त जगत-प्रपञ्च कुछ नहीं है, ऐसा निश्चयपूर्वक जानकर अलक्ष्य की स्फुरण वाला शुद्ध पुरुष स्वभाव से ही शान्त होता है।
english_translation: Knowing with certainty that this entire world of illusion is nothing, the pure being, subtle yet perceptible, naturally rests in peace.
essence: Knowing the world is mere illusion lets your pure self rest naturally in peace.
simple_meaning: Everything you see as the world is an illusion, and the pure true self naturally remains calm once this is understood.
insight: It teaches you to identify the subtle pure self behind illusions and let that awareness bring calm.
modern_relevance: When overwhelming chaos surrounds you, realizing it is just appearance helps you find natural calm within yourself.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
शुद्धस्फुरणरूपस्य दृश्यभावमपश्यतः ।
क्व विधिः क्व च वैराग्यं क्व त्यागः क्व शमोऽपि वा ॥
translation: दृश्यभाव को नहीं देखते हुए शुद्ध स्फुरणरूप का अनुभव करने वाले को कहाँ विधि है और कहाँ वैराग्य है । कहाँ त्याग है और कहाँ शान्ति है।
english_translation: One who experiences the pure shining form without seeing the appearance of forms, where is the rule, where is detachment, where is renunciation, where is peace?
essence: Pure awareness beyond appearances makes rules, detachment, and renunciation unnecessary.
simple_meaning: If you directly experience the pure shining reality beyond appearances, ideas like rules, detachment, renunciation, and peace become irrelevant.
insight: It shifts the mind from relying on external disciplines to recognizing peace already inherent in pure awareness.
modern_relevance: When you deeply see the truth beneath surface distractions, you stop chasing rules or methods to feel calm and free.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
स्फुरतोऽनन्तरूपेण प्रकृतिं च न पश्यतः ।
क्व बन्धः क्व च वा मोक्षः क्व हर्षः क्व विषादिता ॥
translation: और अनन्त रूपों में स्फुरित प्रकृति को नहीं देखते हुए ज्ञानी को कहाँ बन्ध है और कहाँ मोक्ष है । कहाँ हर्ष है और कहाँ शोक है।
english_translation: The wise one who does not see the natural world manifesting in infinite forms is free from bondage, freedom, joy, and sorrow alike.
essence: Seeing the infinite unity of nature dissolves all distinctions of bondage, freedom, joy, and sorrow.
simple_meaning: When you truly see the infinite forms of nature as one, you no longer experience bondage or freedom, joy or sorrow.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing life as a series of opposites to recognizing their shared essence, freeing you from emotional extremes.
modern_relevance: When you stop dividing your experiences into success or failure, pleasure or pain, life feels less chaotic and more peaceful.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
बुद्धिपर्यन्तसंसारे मायामात्रं विवर्तते ।
निर्ममो निरहङ्कारो निष्कामः शोभते बुधः ॥
translation: बुद्धिपर्यन्त संसार में जहाँ माया ही माया भासती है वहाँ ममतारहित, अहंकार-रहित और कामनारहित ज्ञानी ही शोभता है।
english_translation: In the world limited by the discerning mind, where only illusion appears, the wise one shines without attachment, ego, or desire.
essence: True wisdom shines when you release ego, desire, and attachment in an illusory world.
simple_meaning: Where the mind sees only illusion, the wise one stands out by being free from ego, attachment, and desire.
insight: It teaches you to recognize the illusory nature of appearances and to let go of ego and craving to reveal your true clarity.
modern_relevance: You feel overwhelmed by endless distractions and false appearances around you. Freedom comes when you stop identifying with your desires and ego.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
अक्षयं गतसन्तापमात्मानं पश्यतो मुनेः ।
क्व विद्या च क्व वा विश्वं क्व देहोऽहं ममेति वा ॥
translation: अविनाशी और सन्तापरहित आत्मा को देखने वाले मुनि को कहाँ विद्या है और कहाँ विश्व । कहाँ देह है और कहाँ अहंता-ममता है।
english_translation: Where is knowledge or the world for the sage who sees the true self as imperishable and free of suffering? Where is body, ego, or possession?
essence: Seeing yourself as beyond suffering reveals that knowledge, world, and ego are illusions.
simple_meaning: A sage who perceives the true self as eternal and free from suffering sees no need for knowledge, the world, body, or ego.
insight: It shifts your view from identifying with transient things to resting in the unchanging true self.
modern_relevance: When you stop identifying with your struggles or roles, you find a space beyond stress and self-doubt.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
निरोधादीनि कर्माणि जहाति जडधीर्यदि ।
मनोरथान् प्रलापांश्च कर्तुमाप्नोत्यतत्क्षणात् ॥
translation: यदि जड़ बुद्धि मनुष्य निरोध आदि कर्मों को छोड़ता भी है तो वह तत्क्षण मनोरथों और प्रलापों को पूरा करने में प्रवृत्त हो जाता है।
english_translation: Even if a person of dull understanding abandons actions like restraint, they immediately become engaged in fulfilling desires and idle talk.
essence: Stopping action doesn’t free you if the mind still pursues desires and chatter.
simple_meaning: Stopping physical actions alone does not free you if your mind still pursues desires and meaningless chatter.
insight: It shows that true freedom needs calming the mind’s desires, not just stopping outward doing.
modern_relevance: You might quit a bad habit but still replay cravings and chatter inside your head, trapping you in restlessness.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
मन्दः श्रुत्वापि तद्वस्तु न जहाति विमूढताम् ।
निर्विकल्पो बहिर्यत्नादन्तर्विषयलालसः ॥
translation: मन्द बुद्धि उस तत्त्व को सुनकर भी मूढ़ता को नहीं छोड़ता है । वह बाह्य प्रयत्न में निर्विकल्प होकर मन में विषयों की लालसा वाला होता है।
english_translation: Even after hearing that truth, the slow-witted one does not abandon delusion; externally still without thought, yet inwardly craving objects.
essence: External calm without inner freedom is still entangled in desire and delusion.
simple_meaning: Even if you hear a truth, you might not let go of your confusion. You can seem calm outside but still crave things inside.
insight: It teaches you to watch not just your outer stillness but also your hidden cravings to truly see delusion.
modern_relevance: You might look composed in meetings but feel restless craving likes or approval deep inside.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
ज्ञानाद् गलितकर्मा यो लोकदृष्ट्यापि कर्मकृत् ।
नाप्नोत्यवसरं कर्त्रुं वक्तुमेव न किञ्चन ॥
translation: ज्ञान से नष्ट हुआ है कर्म जिसका, ऐसा ज्ञानी लोक-दृष्टि में कर्म करने वाला भी है लेकिन वह न कुछ करने का अवसर पाता है, न कुछ कहने का ही।
english_translation: The one whose actions have dissolved through wisdom still acts in the world but has neither the opportunity to act nor to speak.
essence: You can act without being a doer or having control over actions or speech.
simple_meaning: Even though a wise person appears to act, they no longer truly have the chance to act or speak because their sense of doer has dissolved.
insight: This verse shifts your view from being the doer to witnessing action without ownership or urgency.
modern_relevance: You might keep performing tasks at work or home, yet inside, you feel detached, as if the need to push or claim anything has vanished.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
क्व तमः क्व प्रकाशो वा हानं क्व च न किञ्चन ।
निर्विकारस्य धीरस्य निरातङ्कस्य सर्वदा ॥
translation: सर्वदा निर्भय और निर्विकार धीर पुरुष को कहाँ अन्धकार है, कहाँ प्रकाश है और कहाँ त्याग है । कहीं कुछ भी नहीं है।
english_translation: A fearless, steady person beyond change has no darkness, no light, and no loss at any time.
essence: A fearless steady mind is beyond all opposites like darkness, light, or loss.
simple_meaning: A person who is fearless and steady, not affected by change, experiences no darkness, no light, and no loss ever.
insight: It shifts your focus from chasing outcomes to resting in unshakable inner steadiness.
modern_relevance: In moments of stress or uncertainty, you can find a place inside where fear and confusion vanish, leaving calm steadiness.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
क्व धैर्यं क्व विवेकित्वं क्व निरातङ्कतापि वा ।
अनिर्वाच्यस्वभावस्य निःस्वभावस्य योगिनः ॥
translation: अनिर्वचनीय स्वभाव वाले स्वभावरहित योगी को कहाँ धीरता है, कहाँ विवेकिता अथवा कहाँ निर्भयता है।
english_translation: Where is patience, where is discernment, where is fearlessness for the yogi whose nature is indescribable and without qualities?
essence: The true self is beyond all qualities like patience, discernment, and fearlessness.
simple_meaning: The yogi whose true self is beyond description has no fixed qualities like patience, discernment, or fearlessness.
insight: It shifts your view from trying to cultivate traits to recognizing your true self as free from all qualities.
modern_relevance: When you feel pressured to always stay patient or brave, this reminds you that your deepest self is beyond such demands.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
न स्वर्गो नैव नरको जीवन्मुक्तिर्न चैव हि ।
बहुनात्र किमुक्तेन योगदृष्ट्या न किञ्चन ॥
translation: योगी को न स्वर्ग है, न नरक है, न जीवनमुक्ति ही है । इसमें बहुत कहने से क्या प्रयोजन, योग की दृष्टि से कुछ भी नहीं है।
english_translation: The yogi has neither higher realm nor lower realm, nor is there any inner freedom; from the yoga perspective, none of these exist.
essence: Yoga reveals that realms and freedom are illusions, not realities.
simple_meaning: From the perspective of yoga, the ideas of higher realm, lower realm, and inner freedom do not exist for the yogi.
insight: It shifts your focus from chasing states or labels to resting in the direct experience yoga reveals.
modern_relevance: When you face life’s highs and lows, yoga invites you to see beyond those labels and find peace in what simply is.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
नैव प्रार्थयते लाभं नालाभेनानुशोचति ।
धीरस्य शीतलं चित्तममृतेनैव पूरितम् ॥
translation: धीर पुरुष का चित्त अमृत से पूरित हुआ शीतल है । इसलिए न वह लाभ के लिए प्रार्थना करता है और न ही हानि के लिए कभी चिन्ता करता है।
english_translation: The steady mind is filled with immortality and coolness, so it neither prays for gain nor grieves for loss.
essence: A steady mind filled with timeless calm neither desires gain nor fears loss.
simple_meaning: A person with a steady mind is filled with timeless calm and does not seek gain or fear loss.
insight: It teaches you to rest your mind in its natural fullness, releasing all craving and aversion.
modern_relevance: When your mind stays calm and full inside, you stop chasing results or worrying about setbacks, even during stressful days.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
न शान्तं स्तौति निष्कामो न दुष्टमपि निन्दति ।
समदुःखसुखस्तृप्तः किञ्चित् कृत्यं न पश्यति ॥
translation: निष्काम पुरुष न तो शान्त पुरुष की प्रशंसा करता है, न दुष्ट को देखकर निन्दा करता है । वह सुख-दुःख को समान समझता हुआ तृप्त है।
english_translation: A person without desire neither praises the peaceful nor blames the wicked; content, they see no task in anything.
essence: True calm means no need to praise or blame; contentment sees no separate tasks.
simple_meaning: You don’t praise good people or blame bad ones. You stay content and see no action as necessary.
insight: It shifts your mind from reacting emotionally to others’ behavior toward steady inner contentment.
modern_relevance: You scroll through social media, reading praise and criticism, yet you remain unmoved, steady in your own calm.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
धीरो न द्वेष्टि संसारमात्मानं न दिदृक्षति ।
हर्षामर्षविनिर्मुक्तो न मृतो न च जीवति ॥
translation: धीर पुरुष न संसार के प्रति द्वेष करता है और न आत्मा को देखने की इच्छा करता है । हर्ष और शोक से मुक्त वह, न मरे हुए जैसा है और न जीवित जैसा
english_translation: The steady one neither hates the cycle of change nor seeks the true self; free from joy and sorrow, they are neither dead nor alive.
essence: Steadiness is freedom from hating change or craving the true self, beyond life and death.
simple_meaning: A steady person neither hates the world nor craves to find the true self; free from highs and lows, they exist beyond life and death.
insight: It shifts your mind from reacting to the world or self-searching, to resting in balanced awareness beyond dualities.
modern_relevance: You pause in the middle of a chaotic day, neither rejecting the noise nor chasing elusive answers, simply steady and calm.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
निःस्नेहः पुत्रदारादौ निष्कामो विषयेषु च ।
निश्चिन्तः स्वशरीरेऽपि निराशः शोभते बुधः ॥
translation: पुत्र, स्त्री आदि के प्रति स्नेह न रखता हुआ और विषयों में कामनारहित हुआ, अपने शरीर की भी चिन्ता नहीं करता हुआ ज्ञानी पुरुष सभी आशाओं से मुक्त शोभा देता है।
english_translation: The wise person who holds no attachment to children, spouse, or desires, who is without craving even for the body, and is free from all hopes shines brightly.
essence: True brightness comes from complete freedom from attachment and desire, even toward your own body.
simple_meaning: You become radiant when you let go of attachments to people, desires, and even your own body, living without hope or worry.
insight: It shifts your focus from clinging to release, showing that true dignity arises from freedom from attachments and hopes.
modern_relevance: You notice how much effort you spend worrying about loved ones, desires, or your health—and how much lighter you feel when you stop.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
तुष्टिः सर्वत्र धीरस्य यथापतितवर्तिनः ।
स्वच्छन्दं चरतो देशान् यत्रस्तमितशायिनः ॥
translation: यथाप्राप्य से जीविका चलाने वाला, देशों में स्वच्छन्दता से विचरण करने वाला, जहाँ सूर्यास्त हो वहाँ शयन करने वाला धीर पुरुष सर्वत्र सन्तुष्ट है।
english_translation: The steady person who earns a living suitably, wanders freely across lands, and rests wherever the sun sets, is content everywhere.
essence: Steady freedom creates contentment everywhere, independent of place or circumstance.
simple_meaning: A steady person who lives appropriately, travels freely, and rests wherever needed feels content everywhere.
insight: It teaches you to find inner steadiness and freedom, making external conditions irrelevant to your satisfaction.
modern_relevance: You move from city to city for work or life changes, yet feel grounded and at peace wherever you arrive.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
पततूदेतु वा देहो नास्य चिन्ता महात्मनः ।
स्वभावभूमिविश्रान्तिविस्मृताशेषसंसृतेः ॥
translation: जो निज स्वभाव रूपी भूमि में विश्राम करता है और जिसे संसार विस्मृत हो गया है, उस महात्मा को इस बात की चिन्ता नहीं है कि देह रहे या जाए ।
english_translation: One who rests in the nature of their own true self and has forgotten the entire world has no concern whether the body remains or departs.
essence: Resting in your true self dissolves all worry about the body's impermanence.
simple_meaning: When you rest in your true self and forget the world, you no longer worry if your body lives or dies.
insight: It shifts your focus from bodily survival to abiding as the unchanging true self beneath all change.
modern_relevance: You feel calm when you stop obsessing over aging or health and instead connect with your deeper self.
speaker: Ashtavakra

verse_text:
अकिञ्चनः कामचारो निर्द्वन्द्वश्छिन्नसंशयः ।
असक्तः सर्वभावेषु केवलो रमते बुधः ॥
translation: अकिञ्चन, स्वच्छन्द विचरण करने वाला, द्वन्द्वरहित, संशयरहित, आसक्तिरहित और अकेला बुद्ध पुरुष ही सब भावों में रमण करता है ।
english_translation: The wise person who has nothing, wanders freely, is free of duality and doubt, unattached, and alone, delights in all feelings.
essence: True wisdom is freedom from attachments and doubt while delighting in all feelings.
simple_meaning: A wise person who owns nothing, moves freely without confusion or attachments, and enjoys all feelings equally.
insight: It teaches you to release attachments and doubts so you can fully engage with life without inner conflict.
modern_relevance: You might feel overwhelmed by choices and attachments, but true peace comes when you let go and accept all feelings without clinging.
