speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
जानामि ते परं रूपं प्रत्यक्षं गगनोपमम् ।
यथा परं हि रूपं यन्मरीचिजलसन्निभम् ॥
translation: मैं तेरे परम रूप को जानता हूँ जो प्रत्यक्ष और आकाश के सदृश है। जिस प्रकार जगत का रूप मृगतृष्णा के जल की तरह है वैसा तुम्हारा नहीं है।
english_translation: I know your supreme form, visible and like the sky; unlike the world's form, which is like a mirage's water.
essence: The true self is visible and vast like the sky, unlike the world's shifting illusions.
simple_meaning: The true self is clear and visible like the sky, unlike the world that appears like an illusion or mirage.
insight: Recognize that your true nature is unchanging and clearly visible beneath all illusions and appearances.
modern_relevance: When everything around you feels uncertain or deceptive, remembering your true self is steady, clear, and vast like the sky.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
न गुरुर्नोपदेशश्च न चोपाधिर्न मे क्रिया ।
विदेहं गगनं विद्धि विशुद्धोऽहं स्वभावतः ॥
translation: न तो मेरा कोई गुरु है, न उपदेश ही हैं, न उपाधि है, न क्रिया है। मुझे तू देह से रहित आकाशवत् जान । मैं स्वभाव से ही शुद्ध हूँ।
english_translation: I have no guru, no teachings, no title, no action. Know me as the bodyless sky, pure by nature.
essence: Your true nature is pure and limitless, beyond all teachers and actions.
simple_meaning: You have no teacher, no instruction, no label, and no required action. You are naturally pure and limitless like the sky without a body.
insight: It shifts your mind from seeking external approval to recognizing your innate, limitless purity and freedom.
modern_relevance: When you feel pressured to seek guidance or prove yourself, remember your true nature is already whole and pure, needing no external validation.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
विशुद्धोऽस्य शरीरोऽसि न ते चित्तं परात्परम् ।
अहं चात्मा परं तत्त्वमिति वक्तुं न लज्जसे ॥
translation: तू विशुद्ध है शरीर से रहित है, तू चित्त भी नहीं है। परात्पर है (प्रकृति से भी परे है)। मैं आत्मा हूँ, परम तत्व हूँ, इस प्रकार कहने में तुझे लज्जा नहीं आती है।
english_translation: You are pure, beyond the body and the restless mind; you are the supreme reality. You are the true self; never feel shame in declaring this truth.
essence: You are pure and supreme beyond body and mind; never feel shame in this truth.
simple_meaning: You are not just your body or mind; you are the pure, supreme reality. There is no need to feel ashamed in recognizing this truth about yourself.
insight: It invites you to release identification with body and mind and confidently own your pure, unchanging true self.
modern_relevance: When self-doubt or embarrassment about your deepest nature arises, remember that your true self is beyond body and mind and deserves fearless acceptance.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
कथं रोदिषि रे चित्त ह्यात्मैवात्मात्मना भव ।
पिब वत्स कलातीतमद्वैतं परमामृतम् ॥
translation: हे चित्त ! तू क्यों रूदन करता हैं। निश्चय ही तू आत्म रूप है। यह मानकर स्वयं आत्म-स्वरूप हो जा तथा हे वत्स ! तू कला से अतीत अद्वैत रूपी परम अमृत का पान कर।
english_translation: Why do you weep, mind? You are the self itself. Realize your true self and drink the supreme immortal non-duality beyond time.
essence: Your mind is already the timeless true self; there is no need to weep.
simple_meaning: Your restless mind is already your true self. Recognize this and embrace the timeless, undivided reality beyond all change.
insight: It shifts your view from identifying with restless emotions to recognizing your unchanging true self.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by worry or sadness, realize that your true self is untouched by these feelings and beyond all time.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
नैव बोधो न चाबोधो न बोधाबोध एव च ।
यस्येदृशः सदा बोधः स बोधो नान्यथा भवेत् ॥
translation: न तो तू ज्ञान है और न अज्ञान ही है, न ज्ञान एवं अज्ञान का संयुक्त रूप ही है। जिसे इस प्रकार का सदा ज्ञान है वह ज्ञान स्वरूप ही है। वह हमसे भिन्न नहीं होता।
english_translation: It is neither knowledge nor ignorance, nor a combination of both; what is always that kind of knowledge is pure knowledge itself.
essence: True knowledge is beyond all opposites and is always present as itself.
simple_meaning: True knowledge is not just knowing or not knowing, nor a mix of both. It is always pure and unchanged.
insight: It teaches you to stop identifying with mental labels and rest as the unchanging essence of knowing itself.
modern_relevance: When you struggle between what you know and what you don’t, this verse reminds you that your deepest self is beyond all that confusion.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
ज्ञानं न तर्को न समाधियोगो
न देशकालौ न गुरूपदेशः ।
स्वभावसंवित्तरहं च तत्त्व-
माकाशकल्पं सहजं ध्रुवं च ॥
translation: मैं ज्ञान नहीं हूँ, तर्क नहीं हूँ, समाधि योग भी नहीं हूँ, न देश, काल और गुरु का उपदेश ही हूँ। मैं स्वभाव से ही ज्ञान स्वरूप, यथार्थ वस्तु, आकाश के समान व्यापक और स्वभाव से ही नित्य भी हूँ।
english_translation: I am not knowledge, nor logic, nor meditation or yoga; not teaching of place, time, or teacher. I am naturally knowledge itself, the true essence, as vast as space, and eternally so by nature.
essence: You are naturally the vast, unchanging essence beyond all teachings and concepts.
simple_meaning: You are not limited to knowledge, logic, meditation, or any teaching bound by place, time, or teacher. You are naturally the true, vast, and eternal essence like space itself.
insight: It shifts your understanding from identifying with passing ideas or instructions to resting in your boundless, eternal nature.
modern_relevance: When you feel trapped by endless advice or confusing thoughts, recognize your true self is beyond all these limits—vast and unchanging.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
न जातोऽहं मृतो वापि न मे कर्म शुभाशुभम् ।
विशुद्धं निर्गुणं ब्रह्म बन्धो मुक्तिः कथं मम ॥
translation: न मैं उत्पन्न हुआ हूँ, न मेरी मृत्यु ही है। ये शुभ एवं अशुभ कर्म भी मेरे नहीं हैं। मैं शुद्ध निर्गुण ब्रह्म हूँ। मेरे बन्धन और मुक्ति कैसे कैसे हो सकती है।
english_translation: I was never born, nor will I ever die. These good and bad actions are not mine. I am pure, without qualities, the supreme reality; how can bondage or freedom affect me?
essence: Your true self is beyond birth, death, and all actions; it is pure and free.
simple_meaning: You are not born or dead and are untouched by good or bad actions. You are the pure reality beyond all qualities, unaffected by bondage or freedom.
insight: It teaches you to stop identifying with your actions and realize your true self is always free and unchanged.
modern_relevance: When your mistakes or successes feel overwhelming, remember your true self is untouched by these results and remains pure beyond all change.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
यदि सर्वगतो देवः स्थिरः पूर्णो निरन्तरः ।
अन्तरं हि न पश्यामि स बाह्याभ्यन्तरः कथम् ॥
translation: जब यह आत्मा सर्वत्र व्याप्त है, कभी चलायमान नहीं होता, पूर्ण है, एकरस है तो मैं इसे शरीर के भीतर ही नहीं देखता बल्कि वह बाहर और भीतर सर्वत्र है, उसे कैसे न देखें।
english_translation: When the inner being pervades everywhere, is steady, complete, and unchanging, I do not see it only within the body but everywhere, inside and outside; how could it be unseen?
essence: The true self is steady, complete, and present everywhere, not confined inside the body.
simple_meaning: The true self is unchanging, complete, and present everywhere, not limited to inside your body but all around you.
insight: It shifts your mind from seeing yourself as limited inside the body to recognizing the constant, all-pervading nature of your true self.
modern_relevance: You notice how your awareness flows beyond your body — present in every room, every moment, always steady even when things change.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
स्फुरत्येव जगत्कृत्स्नमखण्डितनिरन्तरम् ।
अहो मायामहामोहो द्वैताद्वैतविकल्पना ॥
translation: निश्चय ही इस सम्पूर्ण जगत का अखण्डित एवं निरन्तर रूप में स्फुरण हो रहा है। खेद है कि माया और महामोह द्वैत और अद्वैत की कल्पना का भी स्फुरण होता है।
english_translation: The entire world continuously shines as an unbroken whole, yet illusion and great delusion also arise as notions of duality and non-duality.
essence: The world is an unbroken radiance; all dualities are illusions of the mind.
simple_meaning: The whole world is always shining as one continuous reality. Illusion causes us to imagine divisions like duality and non-duality.
insight: Recognize that the divisions you perceive are mental constructs; reality itself is seamless and continuous.
modern_relevance: When you face conflicts or divisions in relationships, remember that these separations arise from your mind, not from the true unity beneath.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
साकारं च निराकारं नेति नेतीति सर्वदा ।
भेदाभेदविनिर्मुक्तो वर्तते केवलः शिवः ॥
translation: श्रुति सर्वदा ही साकार और निराकार को ‘नेति-नेति’ (यह सब नहीं हैं, यह सब नहीं है) कहती है। यह ब्रह्म भेद और अभेद से रहित केवल शिव (कल्याण रूप) ही वर्तता है।
english_translation: The revealed truth always denies both form and formlessness. Only Shiva exists beyond difference and non-difference.
essence: True reality cannot be captured as form or formlessness; it simply is beyond both.
simple_meaning: Everything with or without form is denied; only the true self beyond differences truly exists.
insight: It shifts your view from trying to define yourself by any category to simply resting as the undivided reality.
modern_relevance: When you feel pulled between opposing ideas or identities, this reminds you that your true nature is beyond all such limits.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
न ते च माता च पिता च बन्धुः न ते च पत्नी न सुतश्च मित्रम् ।
न पक्षपाती न विपक्षपातः कथं हि संतप्तिरियं हि चित्ते ॥
translation: न तो तेरी माता है, न पिता है, न बन्धु है और न पत्नी है, न पुत्र है, न मित्र है, न पक्षपाती है न विपक्षी है। फिर चित्त में यह सन्ताप कैसे करते हो।
english_translation: You have no mother, no father, no kin, no wife, no son, no friend, no supporter, no opponent; then why does your mind suffer?
essence: Without real attachments, your mind’s suffering is a needless illusion.
simple_meaning: You have no real relationships or enemies in your true self; so why does your mind feel troubled?
insight: It teaches you to question the reality of your attachments and see suffering as rooted in false identification.
modern_relevance: You feel overwhelmed by conflicts and relationships, but beneath it all, your true self is untouched by these roles and pains.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
दिवा नक्तं न ते चित्तं उदयास्तमयौ न हि ।
विदेहस्य शरीरत्वं कल्पयन्ति कथं बुधाः ॥
translation: तेरे चेतन में दिन और रात्रि नहीं है न उदय और अस्त ही है। जो विदेह है (जिसका कोई शरीर नहीं है) उसमें बुद्धिमान लोग शरीर की कैसे कल्पना करते हैं।
english_translation: In your consciousness there is no day or night, no sunrise or sunset; how do the wise imagine a body in the bodiless?
essence: Your true self is timeless and formless beyond all cycles of time and body.
simple_meaning: Your true awareness is beyond day and night, beyond rising and setting. The wise understand that the true self has no body.
insight: It shifts your view from identifying with physical form and time to recognizing your timeless, formless nature.
modern_relevance: When you feel trapped by the passing hours or your physical limits, remember your core awareness is timeless and bodiless.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
नाविभक्तं विभक्तं च न हि दुःखसुखादि च ।
न हि सर्वमसर्वं च विद्धि चात्मानमव्ययम् ॥
translation: आत्मा न तो विभाग वाला है न विभाग रहित हैं। और न सुख-दु:ख आदि वाला ही है, न यह सर्व है और न असर्व है और आत्मा को तू नाश रहित जान।
english_translation: The true self is neither divided nor undivided; it is neither pleasure nor pain, neither all nor none, and is indestructible.
essence: The true self is indivisible, beyond all dualities, and indestructible.
simple_meaning: Your true self cannot be split into parts or limited by feelings like pain or pleasure. It is always complete and cannot be destroyed.
insight: It shifts your perspective from identifying with temporary states to recognizing your unchanging essence.
modern_relevance: When your feelings shift wildly between joy and pain, remember your core remains undivided and steady beneath it all.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
नाहं कर्ता न भोक्ता च न मे कर्म पुराऽधुना ।
न मे देहो विदेहो वा निर्ममेति ममेति किम् ॥
translation: मैं कर्ता नहीं हूँ और भोक्ता भी नहीं हूँ, मेरे पूर्व और वर्तमान के कर्म भी नहीं हैं। मेरा शरीर नहीं है अथवा बिना शरीर के भी नहीं हूँ। मैं ममता से रहित और ममता वाला कैसे हो सकता हूँ।
english_translation: I am neither the doer nor the enjoyer; I have no past or present actions. I am neither embodied nor disembodied. How can I both lack attachment and possess it?
essence: You are beyond doing, enjoying, body, and attachment simultaneously.
simple_meaning: You are not the person who acts or who enjoys the outcomes. You transcend body and attachment.
insight: It shifts your identity from the restless doer and sufferer to the unchanging true self beyond all actions and attachments.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by your roles and desires, remember you are more than what you do or feel.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
न मे रागादिको दोषो दुःखं देहादिकं न मे ।
आत्मानं विद्धि मामेकं विशालं गगनोपमम् ॥
translation: ये रागादिक दोष मेरे नहीं हैं, शरीर के दु:ख आदि भी मेरे नहीं हैं। मुझे एक ही आत्म रूप एवं विशाल आकाश के समान तू जान।
english_translation: I have no faults like attachment; pain and body are not mine. Know me as the one self, vast like the sky.
essence: You are vast, one true self beyond fault, attachment, and pain.
simple_meaning: You are not your attachments, faults, pain, or body. Your true nature is one and vast like the sky.
insight: Shift your identity from temporary flaws and pain to recognizing your boundless true self.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by pain or blame yourself for faults, remember you are more than these passing experiences—vast and free.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
सखे मनः किं बहुजल्पितेन
सखे मनः सर्वमिदं वितर्क्यम् ।
यत्सारभूतं कथितं मया ते
त्वमेव तत्त्वं गगनोपमोऽसि ॥
translation: हे सखे मन ! बहुत कहने से क्या प्रयोजन है, हे सखे मन! यह सम्पूर्ण जगत तर्क करने योग्य है। जो सारभूत था उसे मैंने तुझे कह दिया कि तू ही एक तत्त्व ब्रह्म है जो आकाश के समान निर्लेप, असंग व व्यापक है।
english_translation: Friend mind, what is the use of much talk? This whole world is subject to reasoning. I have told you the essence: you alone are the truth, like the sky—detached, uninvolved, and vast.
essence: You are the vast, detached truth beyond all mental chatter and reasoning.
simple_meaning: The restless mind is told that the entire world can be reasoned about, but at its core, you are the true reality—vast, detached, and all-encompassing like the sky.
insight: It teaches you to see beyond mental chatter and recognize your true self as vast, free, and uninvolved.
modern_relevance: When your mind floods with endless thoughts and worries, remember your true nature is vast and unaffected, like the open sky beyond all noise.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
येन केनापि भावेन यत्र कुत्र मृता अपि ।
योगिनस्तत्र लीयन्ते घटाकाशमिवाम्बरे ॥
translation: जिस किसी भी भाव से योगी (ज्ञानी) को जहाँ कहीं भी मरण होता है वह वहीं ब्रह्म में उसी प्रकार लीन हो जाता है जैसे घटाकाश महाकाश में लीन होता है।
english_translation: Whatever the state, wherever a yogi dies, they merge into the supreme reality like a pot dissolves into space.
essence: A realized being’s death is a seamless merging into infinite reality, beyond form and place.
simple_meaning: No matter the state or place of passing, a realized person merges into the supreme reality just as a pot dissolves into the sky.
insight: It shifts your view from fearing death to seeing it as a natural return to boundless reality.
modern_relevance: When facing loss or change, you can find comfort knowing your essence is always part of something vast and unchanging.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
तीर्थे चान्त्यजगेहे वा नष्टस्मृतिरपि त्यजन् ।
समकाले तनुं मुक्तः कैवल्यव्यापको भवेत् ॥
translation: ज्ञानवान पुरुष (जीवन्मुक्त) तीर्थ में अथवा चाण्डाल के घर में बेहोश हुआ भी, समकाल में शरीर को त्याग कर भी मुक्त हुआ व्यापक ब्रह्मरूप हो जाता है।
english_translation: A wise person who loses memory, even if unconscious in a holy place or a lowly home, becomes liberated at once by leaving the body and is pervaded by the supreme reality.
essence: True freedom arises instantly beyond mind, memory, or place upon leaving the body.
simple_meaning: Even if your mind forgets everything or you are unconscious anywhere, leaving the body frees you instantly and reveals your true nature.
insight: It shifts your view from needing mental clarity or ideal conditions to recognizing freedom as an ever-present state beyond circumstances.
modern_relevance: You might feel lost or disconnected in unfamiliar places or during moments of confusion, yet your essential freedom and true self remain untouched and always accessible.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
धर्मार्थकाममोक्षांश्च द्विपदादिचराचरम् ।
मन्यन्ते योगिनः सर्वं मरीचिजलसन्निभम् ॥
translation: धर्म, अर्थ, काम और मोक्ष तथा द्विपद आदि जितने स्थावर एवं जंगम जीव हैं, ज्ञानी लोग इन्हें मृगतृष्णा के जल के समान मानते हैं।
english_translation: The wise see all things—dharma, wealth, desire, freedom, and all beings, moving or still—as like a mirage's water.
essence: All pursuits and beings appear real but are ultimately illusory like mirage water.
simple_meaning: Everything people seek—duty, money, desires, freedom, and all living beings—is like a mirage, an illusion that seems real but isn't.
insight: It shifts your view from treating all goals as solid realities to seeing them as illusions not worth clinging to.
modern_relevance: You chase success, relationships, and comfort, but sometimes they feel elusive, like something you see but can't grasp.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
अतीतानागतं कर्म वर्तमानं तथैव च ।
न करोमि न भुञ्जामि इति मे निश्चला मतिः ॥
translation: भूत, भविष्यत् तथा वर्तमान कर्मों को भी मैं नहीं करता हूँ न इनके फलों को ही भोगता हूँ। इस प्रकार मेरी स्थिर बुद्धि है।
english_translation: I neither perform past, future, nor present actions, nor do I enjoy their results; such is my steady mind.
essence: A steady mind neither acts nor enjoys any actions from past, present, or future.
simple_meaning: You neither do nor enjoy any actions from past, present, or future because your mind remains steady and unmoved.
insight: It teaches you to hold your attention steady, detaching from the cycle of acting and expecting results across time.
modern_relevance: You notice how your mind clings to past mistakes or future worries; this steadiness frees you from those chains.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
शून्यागारे समरसपूत-
स्तिष्ठन्नेकः सुखमवधूतः ।
चरति हि नग्नस्त्यक्त्वा गर्वं
विन्दति केवलमात्मनि सर्वम् ॥
translation: शून्य मन्दिर में समता रूपी रस से पवित्र हुआ अवधूत (संन्यासी) अकेला ही सुखपूर्वक रहता है। अहंकार का त्याग करके नग्न ही विचरण करता है तथा केवल आत्मा में ही सबको जानता है।
english_translation: The Avadhuta, purified by the essence of equanimity, dwells alone in the empty temple; having abandoned pride, he wanders naked, knowing everything only in the true self.
essence: Abandoning pride and solitude reveal complete knowing in the true self alone.
simple_meaning: Living alone in emptiness, free of pride, you find joy by knowing only your true self.
insight: It teaches you to release pride and social identity to rest fully in your true self's knowing.
modern_relevance: You walk through life stripped of ego and pretense, feeling peaceful and self-knowing even in solitude.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
त्रितयतुरीयं नहि नहि यत्र
विन्दति केवलमात्मनि तत्र ।
धर्माधर्मौ नहि नहि यत्र
बद्धो मुक्तः कथमिह तत्र ॥
translation: जहाँ तुरीय आदि तीनों अवस्थाएँ नहीं हैं, वहाँ केवल आत्मा को ही जानता है। जहाँ धर्म और अधर्म भी नहीं है। वहाँ बद्ध और मुक्त का व्यवहार भी कैसे हो सकता है।
english_translation: Where the three states, including the fourth, do not exist, only the true self is found; where right and wrong do not exist, bondage and freedom cannot occur there.
essence: True self is beyond all states, judgments, and the duality of bondage and freedom.
simple_meaning: You exist beyond all mental and worldly states like waking, dreaming, or deep sleep. Beyond right and wrong, there is only the true self where no bondage or freedom applies.
insight: It teaches you to see yourself beyond mental states and moral labels, recognizing your essential freedom.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by decisions or labels, you can find peace by remembering your true self is beyond all categories and judgments.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
विन्दति विन्दति नहि नहि मन्त्रं
छन्दोलक्षणं नहि नहि तन्त्रम् ।
समरसमग्नो भावितपूतः
प्रलपितमेतत्परमवधूतः ॥
translation: चित्त से शुद्ध हुआ आत्मरस में मग्न अवधूत किसी मन्त्र को नहीं जानता है, न किसी छन्द के रूप व तन्त्र को ही जानता है। यह केवल परब्रह्म का ही कथन करता है।
english_translation: The purified Avadhuta immersed in the essence of the true self knows no mantra, no meter, no sacred text; he only speaks of the supreme reality.
essence: True knowing transcends all mantras, meters, and sacred texts.
simple_meaning: When you are fully pure and immersed in your true self, you don’t rely on mantras, rhythms, or scriptures; you speak only the supreme truth.
insight: It shifts focus from external methods to direct experience of the supreme reality within you.
modern_relevance: You’ve tried following all the rules, formulas, and instructions, but real clarity comes when you drop all that and just connect with your own pure being.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
सर्वशून्यमशून्यं च सत्यासत्यं न विद्यते ।
स्वभावभावतः प्रोक्तं शास्त्रसंवित्तिपूर्वकम् ॥
translation: शास्त्रों ने ज्ञानपूर्वक कहा है कि यह सम्पूर्ण जगत शून्यरूप है और ब्रह्म ही अशून्य है। वह स्वभाव से ही भावरूप है। उसमें सत्य और असत्य भी नहीं है।
english_translation: The scriptures wisely say that the entire world is void, and the supreme reality is beyond void; by nature, it is pure existence without truth or falsehood.
essence: The true self transcends emptiness and the distinction between truth and falsehood.
simple_meaning: All that appears is empty and without true existence; the true self is naturally beyond all opposites like truth and falsehood.
insight: It shifts your view from clinging to appearances as real to recognizing your true nature beyond all dualities.
modern_relevance: When your mind wavers between what’s right or wrong, remember your core is beyond these judgments and remains unchanged.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
बालस्य वा विषयभोगरतस्य वापि
मूर्खस्य सेवकजनस्य गृहस्थितस्य ।
एतद्गुरोः किमपि नैव न चिन्तनीयं
रत्नं कथं त्यजति कोऽप्यशुचौ प्रविष्टम् ॥
translation: इन गुरुओं को बालक का अथवा विषयभोग में रहकर मूर्ख का, सेवक जन का, गृहस्थी का चिन्तन नहीं करना चाहिए (क्योंकि) अपवित्र वस्तु में गिरे हुए रत्न को कोई भी किस प्रकार छोड़ देता है।
english_translation: A true teacher should not be concerned with the childlike, pleasure-seeking, foolish, servant, or household-bound states, just as no one abandons a gem fallen into impurity.
essence: The true self remains priceless despite appearing caught in foolish or distracted states.
simple_meaning: A real teacher does not worry about childish or foolish states because the true self is like a jewel that remains valuable even if surrounded by impurity.
insight: It teaches you to look past surface confusion and recognize the enduring value of your true self.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by distractions or confusion, remember your core worth is untarnished, just like a gem remains valuable despite dirt around it.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
नैवात्र काव्यगुण एव तु चिन्तनीयो
ग्राह्यः परं गुणवता खलु सार एव ।
सिन्दूरचित्ररहिता भुवि रूपशून्या
पारं न किं नयति नौरिह गन्तुकामान् ॥
translation: यहाँ (ज्ञान प्राप्ति में) काव्य गुण (विद्वता) का ही चिन्तन नहीं करना चाहिए, निश्चय ही गुणगान से परम सार वस्तु ही ग्रहण करनी चाहिए। इस संसार में नदी पार जाने की कामना वालों को क्या सिन्दूर की चित्रकारी से रहित रूप से शून्य नाव पार नहीं लगाती है।
english_translation: Here, one should not contemplate just poetic qualities but grasp the ultimate essence; a boatless crossing cannot be aided by mere painted colors.
essence: Surface beauty cannot replace the real means to cross beyond illusions.
simple_meaning: Don’t get caught up admiring poetic qualities; focus on understanding the ultimate truth that truly helps you cross beyond illusions.
insight: It teaches you to distinguish between surface charm and deep substance in your search for understanding.
modern_relevance: You scroll through inspiring quotes but realize only genuine insight helps you move forward, not just beautiful words.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
प्रयत्नेन विना येन निश्चलेन चलाचलम् ।
ग्रस्तं स्वभावतः शान्तं चैतन्यं गगनोपमम् ॥
translation: जिस निश्चल (ब्रह्म) से बिना ही प्रयत्न के यह चल एवं अचल ग्रस्त है वह (ब्रह्म) स्वभाव से ही शान्त एवं गगन के सदृश है।
english_translation: The supreme reality, naturally still and like the sky, is effortlessly present in both the moving and unmoving.
essence: Effortless stillness underlies and embraces all movement and change.
simple_meaning: The true self is naturally peaceful and steady, effortlessly present in everything that moves and doesn't move.
insight: Recognize that your true nature is effortless steadiness beneath all mental activity and life’s flux.
modern_relevance: When your mind races or feels stuck, remember your natural state is calm and steady, holding all changes without strain.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
अयत्नाछालयेद्यस्तु एकमेव चराचरम् ।
सर्वगं तत्कथं भिन्नमद्वैतं वर्तते मम ॥
translation: फिर जो एक ही (ब्रह्म) समस्त चर एवं अचर जगत को बिना ही प्रयत्न के चलायमान करता है। वह सर्वगत है। फिर मझसे भिन्न अद्वैत रूप होकर कैसे वर्तता है।
english_translation: The one who effortlessly moves the entire moving and unmoving world is all-pervading; how then can non-duality be separate from me?
essence: You and all that moves are one effortless, all-pervading presence.
simple_meaning: Everything moving and still flows effortlessly through one presence that fills all; separation from this oneness cannot truly exist.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing yourself as separate to recognizing the seamless oneness moving all things effortlessly.
modern_relevance: When you pause and notice, you see how effortlessly life flows through you and everything around, dissolving the sense of separation.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
अहमेव परं यस्मात्सारात्सारतरं शिवम् ।
गमागमविनिर्मुक्तं निर्विकल्पं निराकुलम् ॥
translation: मैं ही जिससे सूक्ष्म हूँ, सार असार से रहित कल्याण स्वरूप हूँ, गमन आगमन से रहित हूँ, निर्विकल्प तथा कुल से रहित हूँ।
english_translation: I am the supreme beyond the subtle, the essence beyond all essence, pure welfare; free from coming and going, beyond all distinctions and agitation.
essence: You are the changeless essence beyond all movement and disturbance.
simple_meaning: You are the highest reality beyond all subtle forms and changes, free from any disturbance or movement.
insight: It teaches you to identify with the unchanging, silent essence beyond all mental and physical movement.
modern_relevance: When your thoughts race or life feels chaotic, remember your true self remains peaceful and steady beyond all fluctuations.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
सर्वावयवनिर्मुक्तं तथाहं त्रिदशार्चितम् ।
सम्पूर्णत्वान्न गृह्णामि विभागं त्रिदशादिकम् ॥
translation: सो मैं सम्पूर्ण अवयवों से रहित हूँ, देवताओं द्वारा भी पूजित हूँ। सम्पूर्ण होने से देवताओं के विभाग को भी ग्रहण नहीं करता हूँ।
english_translation: I am free from all parts, worshipped by the three realms; being complete, I do not accept division into any realms.
essence: You are whole and beyond any division into parts or realms.
simple_meaning: You are not made up of separate parts or divisions. You are complete and beyond all separate realms or categories.
insight: This verse shifts your view from seeing yourself as fragmented to recognizing your essential unity and completeness.
modern_relevance: When you feel fragmented by roles, labels, or expectations, remembering your completeness beyond parts brings calm and clarity.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
प्रमादेन न सन्देहः किं करिष्यामि वृत्तिमान् ।
उत्पद्यन्ते विलीयन्ते बुद्बुदाश्च यथा जले ॥
translation: अन्त:करण की वृत्तियों को क्या प्रमादवश मैं उत्पन्न करता हूँ? ये जल में बुदबुदे के समान अपने आप ही उत्पन्न होती हैं तथा विलीन हो जाती हैं इसमें सन्देह नहीं है।
english_translation: There is no doubt that I do not cause the inner fluctuations by carelessness; like bubbles in water, they arise and dissolve on their own.
essence: Inner mental movements arise and dissolve naturally without your causing them.
simple_meaning: Your inner mental movements are not caused by your carelessness. They arise and disappear naturally like bubbles in water.
insight: Recognize that mental restlessness is spontaneous, helping you stop blaming yourself for every thought.
modern_relevance: Your mind jumps from one thought to another like bubbles in a stream. You don’t cause this; it happens naturally.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
महदादीनि भूतानि समाप्यैवं सदैव हि ।
मृदुद्रव्येषु तीक्ष्णेषु गुडेषु कटुकेषु च ॥
translation: जिस प्रकार मृदु पदार्थों में मृदुता, तीक्ष्ण पदार्थों में तीक्ष्णता, गुड़ में मिठास एवं कटु पदार्थों में कटुता भिन्न नहीं है उसी प्रकार महतत्त्व आदि भूत पदार्थों की भिन्नता सदा से समाप्त करे।
english_translation: Just as softness is never absent in soft substances, sharpness in sharp ones, sweetness in jaggery, and bitterness in bitter things, similarly the distinctions among the great elements and beings have always ceased.
essence: Apparent differences among things are always resolved in their true unity.
simple_meaning: Just as softness is always present in soft things, and bitterness always in bitter things, the apparent differences among great elements and beings have always ended.
insight: It teaches you to see beyond appearances and recognize the timeless unity behind diversity.
modern_relevance: When you notice how you label people or things as different, you can remember that beneath appearances, unity remains constant.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
कटुत्वं चैव शैत्यत्वं मृदुत्वं च यथा जले ।
प्रकृतिः पुरुषस्तद्वदभिन्नं प्रतिभाति मे ॥
translation: जिस प्रकार जल से उसकी शीतलता एवं कोमलता भिन्न नहीं हैं, मृदु पदार्थों में मृदुता, तीक्ष्ण पदार्थों में तीक्ष्णता, गुड़ में मिठास एवं कटु पदार्थों में कटुता भिन्न नहीं है वैसे ही मुझे तो प्रकृति और पुरुष भी अभिन्न ज्ञात होते हैं।
english_translation: Just as water's coolness and softness are inseparable from itself, similarly, I perceive nature and pure awareness as inseparable.
essence: The true self and nature are inseparably united like water and its qualities.
simple_meaning: You see the true self and the natural world as inseparable, just like water's qualities cannot be separated from water itself.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing yourself as separate to recognizing the unity behind all appearances.
modern_relevance: When you touch water and feel its coolness, you experience a unity that mirrors your own inseparability from the world around you.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
सर्वाख्यारहितं यद्यत्सूक्ष्मात्सूक्ष्मतरं परम् ।
मनोबुद्धीन्द्रियातीतमकलङ्कं जगत्पतिम् ॥
translation: जो आत्मा सम्पूर्ण संज्ञा से रहित है, सूक्ष्म से भी अतिसूक्ष्म, श्रेष्ठ है, मन, बुद्धि तथा इन्द्रियों का विषय नहीं हैं, कलंक से रहित है, जगत का स्वामी है।
english_translation: The true self is beyond all names, subtler than the subtlest, superior, beyond mind, intellect, and senses, free from all stains, and the master of the world.
essence: The true self is beyond mind, senses, names, and is perfectly pure and sovereign.
simple_meaning: You are the true self that no name can capture, finer than anything subtle, beyond mind, intellect, or senses, free from any flaw, and the ruler of all existence.
insight: Shift your attention from fluctuating mind and senses to the unchanging, pure self beneath them.
modern_relevance: When thoughts overwhelm and senses pull you in all directions, remember the part of you that remains pure, untouched, and in control beneath it all.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
ईदृशं सहजं यत्र अहं तत्र कथं भवेत् ।
त्वमेव हि कथं तत्र कथं तत्र चराचरम् ॥
translation: इसी प्रकार के गुण जिसमें स्वभाव से विद्यमान हैं उसमें ‘मैं’ का कथन किस प्रकार बनता है, ‘तू’ का कथन भी कैसे बनता है, चर एवं अचर का कथन भी कैसे बनता है।
english_translation: Where qualities are naturally present like this, how can there be saying 'I' there, how can there be saying 'you', how can there be saying 'moving and unmoving'?
essence: Without mental division, the separate self and other cannot exist.
simple_meaning: When qualities and things exist naturally without separation, there is no real 'I' or 'you' or distinction of moving and unmoving.
insight: It teaches you to question the reality of separation and see that distinctions like 'I' and 'you' arise only from mental labels.
modern_relevance: In moments when you stop labeling yourself and others or things around you, you experience a natural flow without boundaries or conflict.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
गगनोपमं तु यत्प्रोक्तं तदेव गगनोपमम् ।
चैतन्यं दोषहीनं च सर्वज्ञं पूर्णमेव च ॥
translation: जिसे आकाश से सदृश कहा गया है वह आकाश के सदृश ही है। वह चैतन्य, दोष से रहित, सर्वज्ञ और पूर्ण भी है।
english_translation: What is described as like the sky is indeed like the sky—conscious, free of faults, all-knowing, and complete.
essence: Your true self is vast, flawless consciousness, fully complete like the sky.
simple_meaning: Your true self is like the sky—vast, pure, fully aware, without faults, and completely whole.
insight: It changes how you see yourself—from limited and flawed to expansive, pure, and fully aware.
modern_relevance: In moments when you feel small or flawed, remember your true nature is vast, clear, and untouched by mistakes.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
पृथिव्यां चरितं नैव मारुतेन च वाहितम् ।
वरिणा पिहितं नैव तेजोमध्ये व्यवस्थितम् ॥
translation: वह पृथ्वी में गमन नहीं करता, हवा उसको ले नहीं जा सकती, जल उसको आच्छादित नहीं कर सकता, वह तेज के मध्य स्थित रहता है।
english_translation: It does not move in the earth, nor is it carried by the wind, not covered by water; it abides in the midst of fire.
essence: Your true self remains steady and radiant, untouched by changing elements.
simple_meaning: Your true self does not move or get carried away by earth, wind, or water; it stays steady in the midst of radiant fire.
insight: This verse shifts your view from identifying with changing surroundings to recognizing your unchanging radiant core.
modern_relevance: When everything around you seems chaotic or changing, you can recognize a calm, unshakable center inside yourself that stays steady and bright.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
आकाशं तेन संव्याप्तं न तद्व्याप्तं च केनचित् ।
स बाह्याभ्यन्तरं तिष्ठत्यवच्छिन्नं निरन्तरम् ॥
translation: उस (ब्रह्म) से आकाश भी संव्याप्त है, वह किसी से व्याप्त नहीं है, वह बाहर और भीतर एकरस अनिच्छिन्न रूप से सर्वत्र स्थित है।
english_translation: The supreme reality pervades the space yet is not limited by it; it exists everywhere, inside and outside, uninterrupted and uniform.
essence: The true self fills all space yet is beyond all confinement.
simple_meaning: The true reality fills all space but is not limited by it; it is everywhere continuously, inside and outside.
insight: Recognize that your true self transcends all external and internal limits, revealing continuous presence everywhere.
modern_relevance: When you feel boxed in by your circumstances, remember your true nature is unlimited and present beyond all boundaries.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
सूक्ष्मत्वात्तददृश्यत्वान्निर्गुणत्वाच्च योगिभिः ।
आलम्बनादि यत्प्रोक्तं क्रमादालम्बनं भवेत् ॥
translation: योगियों ने जिसके आलम्बन आदि की बात कही है, वह आलम्बन क्रम से ही होता है क्योंकि वह ब्रह्म सूक्ष्म, अदृश्य एवं निर्गुण हैं।
english_translation: The support spoken of by yogis arises sequentially because Brahman is subtle, invisible, and without qualities.
essence: Support from the supreme unfolds gradually because it is subtle and beyond senses.
simple_meaning: Support or foundation described by yogis appears gradually because the supreme reality is subtle, invisible, and without qualities.
insight: It teaches you to trust a gradual, often invisible process of support instead of demanding instant clarity or proof.
modern_relevance: Sometimes you expect quick answers or clear support, but deeper help arrives slowly, unfolding beyond what you can immediately see or name.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
सतताऽभ्यासयुक्तस्तु निरालम्बो यदा भवेत् ।
तल्लयाल्लीयते नान्तर्गुणदोषविवर्जितः ॥
translation: जिस समय सतत अभ्यास से युक्त होकर जब चित्त निरालम्ब हो जाता है जब वह गुण दोष से रहित होता है उसी समय चित्त के लय होने से उसका ब्रह्म में लय हो जाता है। इसके बिना नहीं होता।
english_translation: When the mind is constantly practiced and becomes unattached, free from qualities and faults, it dissolves into the supreme reality; nothing else enables this merging.
essence: Steady practice frees the mind to dissolve and merge into the supreme reality.
simple_meaning: When your mind is steady through practice and becomes free of attachments and faults, it naturally merges into the supreme reality.
insight: It teaches you that consistent practice leads the mind to release all faults and merge with true stillness.
modern_relevance: After persistent effort to calm your restless thoughts, you find a moment when your mind stops clinging and merges into deep stillness.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
विषविश्वस्य रौद्रस्य मोहमूर्च्छाप्रदस्य च ।
एकमेव विनाशाय ह्यमोघं सहजामृतम् ॥
translation: यह विश्व रूपी विष बड़ा भयानक और मोह एवं मूर्छा को देने वाला है। इसके विनाश का एक ही अमोघ सहज अमृत (आत्म-ज्ञान) है।
english_translation: The world, like a fierce poison, causes delusion and unconsciousness; its only destruction is the unfailing, innate nectar of self-knowledge.
essence: The fierce poison of the world is undone only by innate self-knowledge.
simple_meaning: The world acts like a dangerous poison that blinds and confuses you. Only the natural, unfailing knowledge of your true self can destroy this harmful effect.
insight: This verse shifts your focus from outer confusion to recognizing the natural, unfailing clarity within.
modern_relevance: When distractions and illusions overwhelm you, remember that clear self-knowledge is the steady remedy that never fails.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
भावगम्यं निराकारं साकारं दृष्टिगोचरम् ।
भावाभावविनिर्मुक्तमन्तरालं तदुच्यते ॥
translation: निराकार ( ब्रह्म) को भाव (चित्त) से ही जाना जाता है तथा साकार दृष्टि का विषय है। जो भाव और अभाव से ही रहित है उसे अन्तराल कहा जाता है।
english_translation: The formless (Brahman) is known through feeling (mind), and the form is perceived by sight. That which is free from both presence and absence is called the interval.
essence: True reality transcends both sensory presence and absence, existing as a silent interval.
simple_meaning: The supreme reality is sometimes formless and known through feeling, sometimes with form and seen by sight. Beyond both presence and absence lies a deeper state called the interval.
insight: It shifts your focus from what can be sensed to what lies beyond all sensory perception, opening a wider understanding.
modern_relevance: When you cannot find words or images to describe your experience, you are touching what is beyond both presence and absence.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
बाह्यभावं भवेद्विश्वमन्तः प्रकृतिरुच्यते ।
अन्तरादन्तरं ज्ञेयं नारिकेलफलाम्बुवत् ॥
translation: बाहर जितना भी भाव पदार्थ है वह विश्व होता है। इसके भीतर को प्रकृति कहते हैं। इस अन्तर प्रकृति के भी भीतर (ब्रह्म) जानने योग्य हैं जैसे नारियल के फल के भीतर जल होता है।
english_translation: Everything external is called the world; within it is nature, and within nature is the true self, like water inside a coconut.
essence: The true self lies hidden within nature inside the external world.
simple_meaning: The world is everything external. Inside it is nature, and inside nature is the true self, like water inside a coconut.
insight: It teaches you to look beyond visible reality to recognize the true self within nature and the world.
modern_relevance: Like peeling a fruit to find juice inside, you can look beyond surface appearances to find your deeper true self.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
भ्रान्तिज्ञानं स्थितं बाह्यं सम्यग्ज्ञानं च मध्यगम् ।
मध्यान्मध्यतरं ज्ञेयं नारिकेलफलाम्बुवत् ॥
translation: बाहर स्थित ज्ञान भ्रान्ति रूप हैं, मध्य का ज्ञान यथार्थ ज्ञान है, मध्य के भी मध्य नारियल के फल के भीतर के जल के समान जानने योग्य है।
english_translation: Ignorant knowledge exists outside; true knowledge is the middle; deeper still is what is known, like the water inside a coconut fruit.
essence: True knowledge is layered; the deepest reality lies beneath surface appearances.
simple_meaning: Surface-level understanding is confused; true understanding lies deeper, like water inside a coconut fruit, hidden beneath layers.
insight: It teaches you to look beyond surface impressions and value the hidden, deeper truth beneath.
modern_relevance: When you think you understand something, often you're only seeing the surface. Real insight requires looking deeper, beneath distractions and assumptions.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
पौर्णमास्यां यथा चन्द्र एक एवातिनिर्मलः ।
तेन तत्सदृशं पश्येद्द्विधादृष्टिर्विपर्ययः ॥
translation: जिस प्रकार पूर्णमासी में एक ही चन्द्रमा अति निर्मल होता है उसी प्रकार आत्मा को भी उसी के समान देखें। दृष्टि दोष से ही वह दो प्रकार का दिखाई देता है। यह दृष्टि भ्रम है।
english_translation: Just as the full moon is one and perfectly pure, see the true self as the same; the mind's error makes it appear divided.
essence: The true self is always whole; division arises only from mistaken perception.
simple_meaning: Your true self is completely pure and one, but the restless mind creates the illusion of separation.
insight: It teaches you to question how your mind divides and labels what is actually unified and pure.
modern_relevance: You look in the mirror and see many flaws, but beneath it all your true nature is whole and untouched.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
अनेनैव प्रकारेण बुद्धिभेदो न सर्वगः ।
दाता च धीरतामेति गीयते नामकोटिभिः ॥
translation: इसी पूर्वोक्त प्रकार से सर्वगत चैतन्य में ज्ञान का भेद नहीं होता है और इस ज्ञान को देने वाला धीरता को प्राप्त होता है और करोड़ों नामों से उस का गुणगान होता है।
english_translation: In this same way, the supreme consciousness has no distinction of knowledge, and the giver of this knowledge attains steadiness; countless names praise this truth.
essence: True knowledge is unified and steady, praised by countless names.
simple_meaning: The supreme consciousness is without any division in knowledge. Those who give this knowledge become steady and are praised in many ways.
insight: It shifts your focus from fragmented information to embracing one steady, undivided awareness.
modern_relevance: You’ve seen how confusing knowledge can be when divided; this verse invites you to find steadiness in unified understanding beyond scattered facts.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
गुरुप्रज्ञाप्रसादेन मूर्खो वा यदि पण्डितः ।
यस्तु सम्बुध्यते तत्त्वं विरक्तो भवसागरात् ॥
translation: मूर्ख हो अथवा पंडित (शास्त्रज्ञ) हो, जो गुरु के ज्ञान रूपी प्रसाद से आत्म तत्व को ठीक प्रकार से जान लेता है वह संसार रूपी भवसागर से विरक्त हो जाता है (जन्म-मरण से छूट जाता है)॥
english_translation: Whether foolish or learned, one who truly understands the self through the guru's grace becomes detached from the ocean of worldly existence.
essence: True self-knowledge through a teacher’s grace frees anyone, wise or foolish, from worldly attachment.
simple_meaning: Regardless of intelligence, anyone who gains true understanding of the self through a teacher’s grace becomes free from attachment to worldly life.
insight: It shifts focus from intellectual status to experiential understanding as the key to freedom.
modern_relevance: You might doubt your worth or knowledge, yet a genuine insight into who you truly are can liberate you from stress and endless struggles.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
रागद्वेषविनिर्मुक्तः सर्वभूतहिते रतः ।
दृढबोधश्च धीरश्च स गच्छेत्परमं पदम् ॥
translation: जो राग द्वेष से रहित है, सम्पूर्ण भूतों के हित में रत है और दृढ़ बोध वाला है, धीर है वह परमपद को गमन करता है।
english_translation: One who is free from attachment and aversion, devoted to the welfare of all beings, firmly aware and steady, attains the supreme state.
essence: Freedom from craving and hatred, combined with steady care for all, leads to the highest freedom.
simple_meaning: Being free from attachment and hatred, caring for all beings, and having firm awareness leads you to the highest state.
insight: It shifts your focus from reactive emotions to steady, compassionate awareness that moves beyond dualities.
modern_relevance: When you stop clinging to likes and dislikes and care for others without selfishness, your mind settles, guiding you beyond restless struggle.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
घटे भिन्ने घटाकाश आकाशे लीयते यथा ।
देहाभावे तथा योगी स्वरूपे परमात्मनि ॥
translation: जिस प्रकार घड़े के फूटने पर घड़े का आकाश महाकाश में लय हो जाता है उसी प्रकार देह के नाश होने पर योगी परमात्म स्वरूप में लीन हो जाता है।
english_translation: Just as the space inside a broken pot merges into the vast sky, the yogi merges into the supreme self when the body dissolves.
essence: The true self transcends the body and merges with the supreme reality without loss.
simple_meaning: When the body dies, the yogi's true self merges back into the supreme reality, like space inside a broken pot joining the vast sky.
insight: It teaches you to see your self beyond physical limits, recognizing your identity with the infinite.
modern_relevance: When a person you love passes away, remember their true self is not gone but merges with something vast and unchanging.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
उक्तेयं कर्मयुक्तानां मतिर्यान्तेऽपि सा गतिः ।
न चोक्ता योगयुक्तानां मतिर्यान्तेऽपि सा गतिः ॥
translation: ‘अन्त मति सो गति’ अन्त में जैसी मति (बुद्धि) होती है वैसी ही उसकी गति होती है-यह कर्मयुक्त मनुष्यों (अज्ञानियों) के लिए ही कहा गया है। योगयुक्त मनुष्यों के लिए नहीं कहा गया है कि अन्त में जैसी मति होती है वैसी ही उसकी गति होती है।
english_translation: The belief that the end state is determined by the final mindset applies only to those attached to action, not to those united with yoga.
essence: Attachment to action makes final mindset seem decisive; yoga reveals it is not.
simple_meaning: Only those who are attached to their actions believe their final mindset decides their fate; those united with deeper yoga see beyond this.
insight: It shifts your view from believing outcomes depend on your last mental state to seeing beyond reactive attachments.
modern_relevance: You might worry that your last decisions or thoughts define your future, but this teaching reminds you that deeper awareness frees you from that fear.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
या गतिः कर्मयुक्तानां सा च वागिन्द्रियाद्वदेत् ।
योगिनां या गतिः क्वापि ह्यकथ्या भवतोर्जिता ॥
translation: कर्मयुक्त अज्ञानियों की जो गति शास्त्रों में कही गई है वह वाणी तथा इन्द्रियों से कही जाती है और योगियों की गति जो तुमने संग्रह की है वह कहीं भी कथन करने योग्य नहीं है।
english_translation: The state attained by those attached to action is described through speech and senses, but the state of yogis you have collected cannot be expressed anywhere.
essence: The yogi's supreme state cannot be expressed through words or senses.
simple_meaning: The state reached by people focused on action can be described by words and senses, but the yogi's state is beyond any description.
insight: It teaches you to accept that some experiences are beyond explanation and must be directly known.
modern_relevance: You might try to explain your deepest feelings or insights but find words fail to capture their true depth.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
एवं ज्ञात्वा त्वमुं मार्गं योगिनां नैव कल्पितम् ।
विकल्पवर्जनं तेषां स्वयं सिद्धिः प्रवर्तते ॥
translation: जो मार्ग कर्मियों के मार्ग की भाँति कल्पित नहीं है। उस विकल्प रहित मार्ग को जानकर योगी उससे अपने आप सिद्धि में प्रवृत्त होता है।
english_translation: Knowing this, you realize that path is not imagined like that of actors; without alternatives, yogis naturally attain perfection.
essence: The true path is not a choice but a self-realizing journey without alternatives.
simple_meaning: You understand that the true spiritual path is not made up like worldly roles; it has no alternatives and leads yogis naturally to perfection.
insight: This verse shifts your view from seeing the path as a choice to recognizing it as a natural, self-arising process.
modern_relevance: When you stop doubting your direction and trust the path itself, progress happens without forcing or second-guessing.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
तीर्थे वान्त्यजगेहे वा यत्र कुत्र मृतोऽपि वा ।
न योगी पश्यते गर्भं परे ब्रह्मणि लीयते ॥
translation: योगी (ब्रह्मज्ञानी) तीर्थ में अथवा अन्त्यज (चांडाल) के घर में अथवा जहाँ कहीं भी मरे वह गर्भ को नहीं देखता है। वह परब्रह्म में लय हो जाता है।
english_translation: A realized yogi does not see the womb whether dying in a holy place, a lowly home, or anywhere; they dissolve into the supreme reality.
essence: True realization dissolves all distinctions of place and birth into the supreme reality.
simple_meaning: A yogi who knows the supreme reality does not see differences in place or birth at death; they merge into the supreme reality beyond all forms.
insight: It teaches you to see beyond external identities and environments, recognizing your unchanging true self everywhere.
modern_relevance: When facing judgment or exclusion, you can remember your essence does not depend on where you are or who you are with — you remain whole beyond labels.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
सहजमजमचिन्त्यं यस्तु पश्येत्स्वरूपं 
घटति यदि यथेष्टं लिप्यते नैव दोषैः ।
सकृदपि तदभावात्कर्म किंचिन्नकुर्यात्
तदपि न च विबद्धः संयमी वा तपस्वी ॥
translation: फिर जो (ज्ञानी) एक बार भी स्वाभाविक जन्म से रहित, मन एवं वाणी द्वारा उस अचिन्त्य ( ब्रह्म) स्वरूप को देख लेता है यदि वह यथेष्ट कर्म को करता है तो वह दोषों में लिप्त नहीं होता। दोषों का अभाव हो जाने से किंचित् कर्म को न भी करे तो भी संयमी अथवा तपस्वी बद्ध नहीं होता।
english_translation: If someone naturally, without mental effort, perceives the inconceivable true self even once, and acts according to their will, they are not tainted by faults. Even if they do no action after that, they are not bound, restrained, or ascetic.
essence: A natural glimpse of your true self frees you from faults and binding action.
simple_meaning: If you naturally glimpse your true self even once and act freely, you are not stained by faults. After that, even doing no action does not bind you.
insight: It shifts your mindset from fearing consequences to embracing freedom from binding faults through clear recognition.
modern_relevance: You might suddenly understand your worth and purpose clearly, and realize past mistakes no longer define or bind you.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
निरामयं निष्प्रतिमं निराकृतिं
निराश्रयं निर्वपुषं निराशिषम् ।
निर्द्वन्द्वनिर्मोहमलुप्तशक्तिकं
तमीशमात्मानमुपैति शाश्वतम् ॥
translation: ज्ञानी जगत के स्वामी उस शाश्वत आत्मा को प्राप्त होता है जो रोग रहित, आकार रहित, प्रतिमा रहित, निराश्रय, शरीर से रहित, इच्छा से रहित, द्वन्द्व रहित, मोह रहित तथा अलुप्त शक्ति (विद्यमान शक्ति ) वाला है।
english_translation: The wise attain the eternal true self who is free from disease, form, image, shelter, body, desire, duality, delusion, and whose power is never diminished.
essence: Your true self is eternally free and beyond all limitation or desire.
simple_meaning: You are the eternal true self, free from disease, form, desire, duality, and delusion, with unending power.
insight: Recognize that your essence is beyond physical or mental conditions and cannot be diminished by circumstance.
modern_relevance: Even when your body or mind feels weak or confused, your true self remains untouched and powerful beyond measure.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
वेदो न दीक्षा न च मुण्डनक्रिया गुरुर्न शिष्यो न च यन्त्रसम्पदः ।
मुद्रादिकं चापि न यत्र भासते तमीशमात्मानमुपैति शाश्वतम् ॥
translation: ज्ञानी उस ईश्वर स्वरूप शाश्वत आत्मा को प्राप्त होता है जिसमें वेद और दीक्षा नहीं हैं, न मुण्डन क्रिया ही हैं, गुरु और शिष्य भी नहीं है और यन्त्रों की सम्पदा भी नहीं हैं, और मुद्रा आदि भी जिसमें नहीं प्रतीत होते हैं।
english_translation: The knower attains the eternal true self, beyond Vedas, initiation, tonsure, guru, disciple, and ritual objects like seals.
essence: The eternal true self transcends all rituals, teachers, and symbols.
simple_meaning: The eternal true self is beyond scriptures, initiation ceremonies, teachers, disciples, and ritual objects.
insight: It shifts your focus from external practices to recognizing your inherent, unchanging essence.
modern_relevance: You might feel pressured to prove your spirituality by rituals or titles, but your true nature transcends all external symbols.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
न शाम्भवं शाक्तिकमानवं न वा 
पिण्डं च रूपं च पदादिकं न वा ।
आरम्भनिष्पत्तिघटादिकं च नो
तमीशमात्मानमुपैति शाश्वतम् ॥
translation: ज्ञानी उस ईश्वर स्वरूप शाश्वत आत्मा को प्राप्त होता है जिसमें न शाम्भवी, न ही शक्तिचालिनी आदि है, न उसमें पिण्डभाव है, न रूप है, न पाँव आदि ही हैं। न घट के समान आदि व अन्त ही है।
english_translation: The knower attains the eternal true self, which is neither Shambhavi nor Shaktichalini, neither embodied nor having form or feet, neither beginning nor end like a pot.
essence: You are the eternal true self beyond all form, name, and limits.
simple_meaning: The true self you are is eternal and beyond all names, forms, or physical traits. It has no beginning or end.
insight: It shifts your view from identifying with temporary forms to knowing yourself as the timeless essence.
modern_relevance: When you feel limited by your body, role, or identity, remember your true nature is vast and beyond those boundaries.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
यस्य स्वरूपात्सचराचरं जगदुत्पद्यते तिष्ठति लीयतेऽपि वा ।
पयोविकारादिव फेनबुद्बुदास्तमीशमात्मानमुपैति शाश्वतम् ॥
translation: ज्ञानी उस ईश्वर स्वरूप शाश्वत आत्मा को प्राप्त होता है जिसके स्वरूप से समस्त चर अचर ( स्थावर, जंगम) जगत उत्पन्न होता हैं, स्थित रहता है तथा उसी में विलीन होता है जैसे जल के विकार से फेन और बुदबुदे उत्पन्न होते हैं व उसी में विलीन हो जाते हैं।
english_translation: The knower attains the eternal true self from whose nature the entire moving and unmoving world arises, exists, and dissolves, like foam and bubbles arise and vanish from water.
essence: The eternal true self is the source where all things arise and dissolve like bubbles in water.
simple_meaning: You are the eternal true self from which everything in the world comes, stays, and eventually disappears like bubbles on water.
insight: Recognize that what you truly are never changes, even as all forms come and go around you.
modern_relevance: When life feels chaotic and ever-changing, remember you are the steady presence from which all experiences arise and fade.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
नासानिरोधो न च दृष्टिरासनं बोधोऽप्यबोधोऽपि न यत्र भासते ।
नाडीप्रचारोऽपि न यत्र किञ्चित्तमीशमात्मानमुपैति शाश्वतम् ॥
translation: ज्ञानी उस ईश्वर स्वरूप शाश्वत आत्मा को प्राप्त होता है जिसमें नासाग्र भाग में दृष्टि निरोध नहीं है, न आसन ही है, जिसमें ज्ञान और अज्ञान भी नहीं भासता है जिसमें नाड़ी का विस्तार भी नहीं हैं।
english_translation: The knower attains the eternal true self where there is no restraint of the nose-tip, no posture, no knowledge or ignorance shining, and no movement through the channels.
essence: The eternal true self transcends all physical and mental limitations.
simple_meaning: You realize the eternal true self where no physical or mental limitation exists—no posture, no seeing, no knowledge or ignorance, and no subtle movements.
insight: It shifts your experience from identification with body and mind to recognition of timeless awareness.
modern_relevance: When your mind and body feel restless or limited, remember your true self is beyond all these boundaries and remains unchanged.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
नानात्वमेकत्वमुभत्वमन्यता अणुत्वदीर्घत्वमहत्त्वशून्यता ।
मानत्वमेयत्वसमत्ववर्जितं तमीशमात्मानमुपैति शाश्वतम् ॥
translation: ज्ञानी उस ईश्वर स्वरूप शाश्वत आत्मा को प्राप्त होता है जिसमें नानात्व, एकत्व अथवा दोनों नहीं हैं, जो अणुत्व, दीर्घत्व, महत्व एवं शून्यता से रहित हैं तथा मानत्व, मेयत्व एवं समच से रहित है।
english_translation: The wise attain the eternal true self, beyond diversity or unity, free from smallness, vastness, importance, and emptiness, untouched by ownership, possession, or equality.
essence: The true self is beyond all distinctions, ownership, and relative qualities.
simple_meaning: You reach the eternal true self by transcending all differences, ownership, and notions of smallness or greatness.
insight: It teaches you to release all identities and claims to find your unchanging true self.
modern_relevance: When you stop defining yourself by what you have or what you are not, you touch a freedom beyond all comparisons and possessions.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
सुसंयमी वा यदि वा न संयमी सुसंग्रही वा यदि वा न संग्रही ।
निष्कर्मको वा यदि वा सकर्मकस्तमीशमात्मानमुपैति शाश्वतम् ॥
translation: जो ज्ञानी उस ईश्वर स्वरूप आत्मा को प्राप्त हो जाता है वह सुसंयमी हो अथवा असंयमी, संग्रही हो अथवा असंग्रही, निष्कर्मी हो अथवा सकर्मी कोई अन्तर नहीं पड़ता।
english_translation: A true knower who has attained the true self remains the same whether self-controlled or not, attached or not, inactive or active.
essence: The true self remains unchanged by control, attachment, or action.
simple_meaning: You have reached the true self when nothing about your control, attachment, or activity changes your inner being.
insight: It teaches you to see beyond your habits and actions to the steady self beneath all change.
modern_relevance: You might feel pressured to always be in control or productive, but your deepest self stays steady even when you let go or rest.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
मनो न बुद्धिर्न शरीरमिन्द्रियं तन्मात्रभूतानि न भूतपञ्चकम् ।
अहंकृतिश्चापि वियत्स्वरूपकं तमीशमात्मानमुपैति शाश्वतम् ॥
translation: ज्ञानी उस ईश्वर स्वरूप शाश्वत आत्मा को प्राप्त होता है जो न मन है, न बुद्धि हैं, न शरीर है, न इन्द्रिय ही है, न तन्मात्रा है, न पंच महाभूत है, न अहंकार ही है। वह आकाश तुल्य व्यापक है।
english_translation: The knower attains the supreme self who is neither mind nor intellect, nor body, nor senses, nor subtle elements, nor the five great elements, nor ego; that self is vast like space and eternal.
essence: You are the eternal, boundless self beyond mind, body, and ego.
simple_meaning: You are not your mind, body, senses, or ego. Your true self is eternal and as vast as space.
insight: It shifts your sense of identity from limited mental and physical boundaries to the boundless, eternal self.
modern_relevance: When anxiety or self-doubt arises, remember you are more than your fleeting thoughts, feelings, or physical form — you are vast and unchanging.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
विधौ निरोधे परमात्मतां गते न योगिनश्चेतसि भेदवर्जिते ।
शौचं न वाशौचमलिङ्गभावना सर्वं विधेयं यदि वा निषिध्यते ॥
translation: भेद से रहित परम आत्मता ( ब्रह्म) को प्राप्त योगी के चित्त में विधि और निरोध नहीं होते, पवित्रता, अपवित्रता तथा लिंग भावना (चिह्न भावना) भी नहीं होती तथा सम्पूर्ण विषयों का ही निषेध हो जाता हैं।
english_translation: In the mind of a yogi who has attained the supreme reality free from distinctions, there is no sense of method or restraint; purity, impurity, and the sense of distinction also vanish, and all objects are rejected.
essence: Reaching supreme reality dissolves all methods, rules, and distinctions in the mind.
simple_meaning: When you realize the supreme reality without distinctions, your mind no longer follows methods or restrictions, nor judges purity or impurity.
insight: It teaches you to release the need for control and categories, resting in a mind beyond distinctions.
modern_relevance: You know that moment when rules, labels, and judgments feel irrelevant because you simply see things clearly and without separation?
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
मनो वचो यत्र न शक्तमीरितुं नूनं कथं तत्र गुरूपदेशता ।
इमां कथामुक्तवतो गुरोस्तद्युक्तस्य तत्त्वं हि समं प्रकाशते ॥
translation: जिस आत्मा में मन और वाणी द्वारा कथन करने की सामर्थ्य नहीं है वहाँ गुरु का उपदेश कैसे हो सकता है। इस कथन को कहने वाले उस आत्मा से जुड़े हुए गुरु को निश्चय ही एकरस आत्म तत्व प्रकाशमान होता है।
english_translation: Where the mind and speech have no power to speak, how can the teacher's instruction occur? The teacher who utters this is surely established in the same essence of the true self.
essence: True teaching happens only where mind and speech are fully silent.
simple_meaning: When the mind and speech cannot express anything, the true teaching cannot happen. The teacher who speaks from that silent place is aligned with the true self.
insight: It shifts your understanding from relying on external instruction to recognizing the silent source of true wisdom within.
modern_relevance: When your mind is racing and your words feel empty, real guidance comes only when you find quiet inside.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
गुणविगुणविभागो वर्तते नैव किञ्चित् 
रतिविरतिविहीनं निर्मलं निष्प्रपञ्चम् ।
गुणविगुणविहीनं व्यापकं विश्वरूपं
कथमहमिह वन्दे व्योमरूपं शिवं वै ॥
translation: जिस ( आत्मा, ब्रह्म) में किंचित भी गुण एवं निर्गुण का विभाग नहीं हैं, जो रति और विरति से रहित निर्मल एवं प्रपंच से रहित है, उस सगुण निर्गुण से रहित, व्यापक, विश्व रूप की मैं कैसे वन्दना करूँ जो आकाश स्वरूप व कल्याण स्वरूप है।
english_translation: I cannot worship the true self that has no division of qualities or lack of qualities, is free from attachment and aversion, pure and beyond all appearance, all-pervading, cosmic in form, like the sky and the source of all goodness.
essence: The true self is beyond all qualities, vast, pure, and cannot be worshiped as a separate form.
simple_meaning: The true self is beyond all qualities, free from attachment and aversion, pure, and all-pervading like the sky; it cannot be worshiped as a separate object.
insight: It teaches you to release all attempts to fix or worship the self as an object, recognizing its boundless nature.
modern_relevance: When you try to label or control your inner self, you find it resists all categories and definitions, vast and free beyond your grasp.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
श्वेतादिवर्णरहितो नियतं शिवश्च
कार्यं हि कारणमिदं हि परं शिवश्च ।
एवं विकल्परहितोऽहमलं शिवश्च
स्वात्मानमात्मनि सुमित्र कथं नमामि ॥
translation: जो श्वेत आदि वर्गों से रहित नित्य एवं शिव रूप (कल्याण स्वरूप) है, यही कारण एवं कार्य हैं, श्रेष्ठ व शिव ही हैं। तथा विकल्प रहित, परिपूर्ण शिव रूप ही है। हे सुमित्र! फिर मैं अपनी आत्मा को आत्मा में किस प्रकार नमस्कार करूँ।
english_translation: The supreme auspicious reality is beyond all categories like white or others; it is both the cause and the effect, perfectly free from alternatives. How then, friend Sumitra, can I bow to the true self within the true self?
essence: The true self is perfectly complete beyond all forms, needing no separate reverence.
simple_meaning: The true self is beyond all categories and dualities; it is both the source and the result, complete and without alternatives. It cannot be separately saluted because it is perfectly whole within itself.
insight: It shifts attention from seeking an external ideal to recognizing the unchanging completeness within yourself.
modern_relevance: When you face your reflection, you realize there is nothing separate to admire or bow to; your true essence is already perfect and complete.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
निर्मूलमूलरहितो हि सदोदितोऽहं
निर्धूमधूमरहितो हि सदोदितोऽहम् ।
निर्दीपदीपरहितो हि सदोदितोऽहं
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: मैं निर्मूल और मूल से रहित हूँ, निधूम और धूम से रहित हूँ, निर्दीप और दीप से रहित हूँ। मैं सदा ही उदित हूँ, ज्ञानामृत, समरस तथा आकाश की उपमा वाला हूँ।
english_translation: I am without root or origin, without smoke or mist, without lamp or light; I am always radiant, the nectar of wisdom, pure and boundless like the sky.
essence: You are eternally radiant and free, beyond all roots, veils, and light.
simple_meaning: You are not limited by origins, illusions, or appearances. You are always radiant, embodying pure wisdom like the vast sky.
insight: It teaches you to recognize your true self as limitless and unaffected by any passing condition or identity.
modern_relevance: When you feel stuck in your history, doubts, or confusion, remember your true self is free and radiant beyond all those limits.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
निष्कामकाममिह नाम कथं वदामि
निःसङ्गसङ्गमिह नाम कथं वदामि ।
निःसारसाररहितं च कथं वदामि
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: मैं आत्म स्वरूप होने से ज्ञानामृत, समरस एवं आकाश तुल्य हूँ फिर अपने को निकास एवं कामना नाम वाला किस प्रकार कहूँ, निसंग एवं संग वाला भी किस प्रकार कहूँ, और निसार और सार रहित भी किस प्रकार कहूँ।
english_translation: Being the true self, I am the nectar of knowledge, of equal essence, like the sky; how could I be called desireless or attached, or devoid and not devoid?
essence: You are limitless wisdom beyond all opposing qualities like desire and attachment.
simple_meaning: You, as your true self, are pure wisdom like endless sky, beyond desire or attachment or emptiness.
insight: Shift your view from fluctuating desires and aversions to recognizing your unchanging, balanced nature.
modern_relevance: In moments when wants pull you every which way, remember your true nature is vast and steady like the open sky.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
अद्वैतरूपमखिलं हि कथं वदामि
द्वैतस्वरूपमखिलं हि कथं वदामि ।
नित्यं त्वनित्यमखिलं हि कथं वदामि
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: इस सम्पूर्ण जगत को मैं अद्वैत रूप कैसे कहूँ, इस सम्पूर्ण जगत को में द्वैत स्वरूप कैसे कहूँ, इस सम्पूर्ण जगत को नित्य अथवा अनित्य कैसे कहूँ। मैं ज्ञानामृत समरस एवं आकाश तुल्य हूँ।
english_translation: How can I call the whole world non-dual or dual? How can I say it is eternal or not? I am like the nectar of knowledge, pure and vast like the sky.
essence: Your true nature cannot be confined by any dual or fixed description.
simple_meaning: You are not limited by ideas of duality, non-duality, eternal, or temporary. You are like the vast sky—pure and unchanging.
insight: It teaches you to release all rigid identities and see your true nature as boundless and ungraspable by labels.
modern_relevance: You find yourself caught in black-and-white thinking, but this invites you to rest in the freedom beyond all fixed categories about who or what you are.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
स्थूलं हि नो नहि कृशं न गतागतं हि
आद्यन्तमध्यरहितं न परापरं हि ।
सत्यं वदामि खलु वै परमार्थतत्त्वं
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: हमारी आत्मा स्थूल भी नहीं है, न सूक्ष्म है, न गमन आनगमन वाला ही है, यह आदि, अन्त और मध्य से रहित है, पर अपर से भी रहित है। मैं निश्चय ही सत्य कहता हूँ कि मैं परमार्थ तत्व, ज्ञानामृत, एकरस एवं आकाश की उपमा हूँ।
english_translation: Our true self is neither gross nor subtle, neither moving nor stationary; it is beyond beginning, middle, and end, beyond higher and lower. I speak the absolute truth: I am the supreme reality, the nectar of knowledge, one with the vast sky.
essence: Your true self is beyond all limits and is as vast and unchanging as the sky.
simple_meaning: Your true self is beyond physical form, beyond time, beyond movement, and beyond any duality. It is like the vast sky—unchanging and one.
insight: It shifts your view from identifying with transient states to recognizing your boundless, unchanging nature.
modern_relevance: When you feel trapped by your changing thoughts or circumstances, this reminds you that your true self is untouched—vast and unchanging beneath it all.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
संविद्धि सर्वकरणानि नभोनिभानि
संविद्धि सर्वविषयांश्च नभोनिभांश्च ।
संविद्धि चैकममलं न हि बन्धमुक्तं
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: सम्पूर्ण करणों को (इन्द्रियों को) तू आकाश की भाँति शुन्य जान और सम्पूर्ण विषयों को तू आकाश के तुल्य शून्य जान, एक आत्मा को ही मायामल से रहित तू जान जो बन्धन और मुक्ति से रहित है वही मैं हूँ जो ज्ञानामृत, समरस एवं आकाश की उपमा वाला है।
english_translation: Know all senses as empty like space, and all objects like space; know the one self, free of illusion, beyond bondage and freedom — I am that, pure knowledge, the essence, like the sky.
essence: Your true self is like the vast sky—pure, free, and beyond all illusions.
simple_meaning: Everything your senses perceive and all objects are like empty space. Your true self is pure, free of illusion, beyond bondage or freedom, like the vast sky.
insight: It teaches you to see your true nature as beyond all sensory experience and mental labels, untouched and free like space.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by constant input and distractions, remember your true self is like the open sky—vast, pure, and untouched by noise.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
दुर्बोधबोधगहनो न भवामि तात
दुर्लक्ष्यलक्ष्यगहनो न भवामि तात ।
आसन्नरूपगहनो न भवामि तात
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: हे तात ! बोध स्वरूप आत्मा का ज्ञान बड़ा दुर्बोध है तथा गम्भीर है, वह मैं नहीं हूं। वह दुर्लक्ष्य है, इन्द्रियों से दिखाई नहीं देता उसे जानना भी गम्भीर है, सो मैं नहीं हूं। वह अति समीप है फिर भी उसको जानना गम्भीर है, वह मैं नहीं हूं। मैं समरस, ज्ञानामृत एवं आकाश को उपमा वाला हूँ।
english_translation: I am not the deep, obscure knowledge of the true self, nor the elusive perception of it; I am like the sky, the nectar of wisdom in harmony.
essence: You are not the confusing hidden knowledge but the clear, harmonious essence like the sky.
simple_meaning: You are not the confusing, hidden knowledge of the true self. Instead, you are like the open sky—clear, harmonious, and full of the nectar of wisdom.
insight: It teaches you to let go of trying to grasp confusing knowledge and instead rest in the clear awareness that you truly are.
modern_relevance: When your thoughts feel tangled and confusing, remember you are not that mess but the clear space that holds it all.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
निष्कर्मकर्मदहनो ज्वलनो भवामि
निर्दुःखदुःखदहनो ज्वलनो भवामि ।
निर्देहदेहदहनो ज्वलनो भवामि
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: मैं कर्म से रहित हूं फिर भी मैं कर्मों का दाहक अग्नि हूँ, मैं दु:खों से रहित हूँ फिर भी दु:खों का दाहक अग्नि हूँ मैं देह से रहित हूँ फिर भी देह का दाहक अग्नि हूँ। मैं ज्ञानामृत समरस एवं आकाश की उपमा वाला हूँ।
english_translation: I am free from action, yet I burn the fire of actions; free from suffering, yet I burn the fire of sufferings; free from the body, yet I burn the fire of the body. I am the nectar of knowledge, the infinite sky's likeness.
essence: You appear affected by life but remain untouched, vast like the sky of wisdom.
simple_meaning: You are not bound by actions, suffering, or the body, yet you appear to burn through them. Your true nature is like the infinite sky, filled with the nectar of knowledge.
insight: It teaches you to recognize the difference between your true self and the temporary struggles you experience.
modern_relevance: When you face stress or pain, you can remember that beneath all reactions, your true self remains vast and untouched.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
निष्पापपापदहनो हि हुताशनोऽहं
निर्धर्मधर्मदहनो हि हुताशनोऽहम् ।
निर्बन्धबन्धदहनो हि हुताशनोऽहं
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: मैं निष्पाप हूँ, फिर भी पापों को नष्ट करने में मैं अग्नि रूप हूँ, मैं निधर्म हूँ फिर भी धर्म और अधर्म को जलाने में मैं अग्नि रूप हूँ, मैं निर्बन्ध होते हुए भी बन्धनों को जलाने में अग्नि रूप हूँ। मैं एक ही ज्ञानामृत, समरस एवं आकाश के समान हूँ।
english_translation: I am without fault, yet I am the fire that burns away sins; I am beyond law, yet I burn both right and wrong; I am without bonds, yet I burn all attachments. I am the nectar of wisdom, pure and boundless like the sky.
essence: You are pure and free, yet the fire that burns all faults and bonds.
simple_meaning: You are naturally free and pure, yet you have the power to burn away faults, rules, and attachments like a fire. Your true nature is pure wisdom and vast like the sky.
insight: Recognize your dual nature as untouched purity and active force dissolving limits and illusions.
modern_relevance: When you feel weighed down by guilt, rules, or attachments, remember your true nature burns these away effortlessly—like a fire within you.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
निर्भावभावरहितो न भवामि वत्स
निर्योगयोगरहितो न भवामि वत्स ।
निश्चित्तचित्तरहितो न भवामि वत्स
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: हे वत्स! मैं निर्भाव होते हुए भी भाव से रहित हूँ, मैं निर्योग होकर भी योग से रहित नहीं हूँ, मैं बिना चित्त वाला होकर भी चित्त से रहित नहीं हूँ। मैं ज्ञानामृत, एकरस तथा आकाश की उपमा वाला हूँ।
english_translation: I am free from all states yet not without feeling; without effort yet not without union; without mind yet not without consciousness. I am the nectar of knowledge, one taste, like the sky.
essence: You transcend all states yet remain fully aware and unified like the infinite sky.
simple_meaning: You are beyond all changing states but still fully aware and connected. Like the sky, you are steady and one with knowledge.
insight: Shift from identifying with passing feelings or efforts to recognizing your unchanging, unified awareness.
modern_relevance: When your feelings or thoughts feel overwhelming or absent, remember you can be steady and aware beyond all shifting states.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
निर्मोहमोहपदवीति न मे विकल्पो
निःशोकशोकपदवीति न मे विकल्पः ।
निर्लोभलोभपदवीति न मे विकल्पो
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: मुझमें निर्मोह अथवा मोह वाला विकल्प नहीं है, शोक रहित अथवा शोक वाला विकल्प भी मेरे में नहीं हैं, निर्लोभ अथवा लोभ वाला विकल्प भी मुझमें नहीं है। मैं ज्ञानामृत, समरस एवं आकाश को उपमा वाला हूँ।
english_translation: In me, there is no choice between delusion and clarity, nor between sorrow and sorrowless; no choice between greed and greedlessness. I am the nectar of knowledge, perfectly balanced and like the sky.
essence: True self is beyond all opposing inner states and perfectly balanced like the sky.
simple_meaning: You are free from all inner conflicts like confusion, sorrow, and greed. You embody balanced knowledge and vastness like the sky.
insight: It teaches you to see beyond all inner conflicts as illusions, resting instead in unshakable balance.
modern_relevance: You notice how your mind flips between wanting and not wanting, sadness and calm. Recognizing your true self is beyond these swings brings deep relief.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
संसारसन्ततिलता न च मे कदाचित्
सन्तोषसन्ततिसुखो न च मे कदाचित् ।
अज्ञानबन्धनमिदं न च मे कदाचित्
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: संसार की संतति रूपी लता मेरे में नहीं है, सन्तोष रूपी संतति का सुख भी मेरे में नहीं है, ये अज्ञान के बन्धन भी मेरे में नहीं है। मैं एकरस, ज्ञानामृत एवं आकाश की उपमा वाला हूँ।
english_translation: I have never been bound by the vine of worldly existence, nor by the happiness of continual satisfaction; ignorance's bonds never held me. I am like the sky—one-tasting, the nectar of knowledge.
essence: You are never bound by worldly cravings or ignorance but are pure, infinite awareness.
simple_meaning: You are never caught in the endless cycle of worldly attachments or ignorance. Instead, you exist as pure, limitless awareness like the sky.
insight: It shifts your identity from a bound, craving self to one of vast, unconditioned awareness beyond all limitations.
modern_relevance: When life feels overwhelming with endless wants or disappointments, remember your true nature is free and expansive like open sky beyond those chains.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
संसारसन्ततिरजो न च मे विकारः
सन्तापसन्ततितमो न च मे विकारः ।
सत्त्वं स्वधर्मजनकं न च मे विकारो
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: संसार को संतति रज (रजोगुण) हैं यह विकार मेरे में नहीं है, सन्ताप को संतति तम (तमोगुण) हैं वह भी विकार मेरे में नहीं है, स्वधर्म का जनक सत्त्व (सतोगुण) है वह विकार भी मेरे में नहीं है। में ज्ञानामृत, एकरस तथा आकाश की उपमा वाला हूँ।
english_translation: The lineage of the natural world is passion; that flaw is not in me. The lineage of suffering is darkness; that flaw is not in me. The essence of true nature is goodness; that flaw is not in me. I am the nectar of wisdom, of one taste, like the sky.
essence: You are pure wisdom beyond all qualities and flaws of the natural world.
simple_meaning: You are not affected by the flaws of passion, suffering, or confusion. You are pure wisdom, steady and vast like the sky.
insight: It teaches you to recognize your true self as beyond all emotional and mental fluctuations, steady like the sky.
modern_relevance: Even when everything around you feels chaotic or painful, you can remember that your true nature remains steady, clear, and unaffected.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
सन्तापदुःखजनको न विधिः कदाचित्
सन्तापयोगजनितं न मनः कदाचित् ।
यस्मादहङ्कृतिरियं न च मे कदाचित्
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: सन्ताप रूपी दु:ख की जनक जो विधि है वह मैं नहीं हूँ सन्ताप के योग से उत्पन्न हुआ मन भी मैं नहीं हूँ, जिससे यह अहंकार भी मेरा नहीं है। मैं ज्ञानामृत, एकरस तथा आकाश की उपमा वाला हूँ।
english_translation: I am not fate that causes suffering, nor the mind born from suffering; this ego is not mine. I am the nectar of wisdom, steady and like the sky.
essence: You are the steady, unifying wisdom beyond pain, mind, and ego.
simple_meaning: You are not the suffering or the mind created by suffering, nor the ego that appears. You are steady, like the sky, the pure nectar of wisdom.
insight: It shifts your sense of identity away from suffering and ego toward a stable, unifying wisdom within.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by painful thoughts or a restless ego, remember you are not those feelings but the calm, vast wisdom beyond them.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
निष्कम्पकम्पनिधनं न विकल्पकल्पं
स्वप्नप्रबोधनिधनं न हिताहितं हि ।
निःसारसारनिधनं न चराचरं हि
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: मैं कम्पन रहित और कम्पन का नाश करने वाला नहीं हूँ, न संकल्प और विकल्प ही हूँ, स्वप्न और जाग्रत का नाश करने वाला भी नहीं हूँ, न हित और अहित ही हूँ, में नि:सार और सार का नाश करने वाला भी नहीं हूँ तथा चर एवं अचर भी नहीं हूँ। में ज्ञानरूपी अमृत, एकरस एवं आकाश की उपमा वाला हूँ।
english_translation: I am not the unmoving or the destroyer of movement, nor the maker of choices or alternatives. I do not destroy sleep or waking, nor am I benefit or harm. I do not destroy essence or non-essence, nor am I moving or non-moving. I am the nectar of wisdom, undivided and like the sky.
essence: You are unchanging wisdom beyond all pairs of opposites and movement.
simple_meaning: You are not defined by movement, choices, sleep or waking, benefit or harm, or by what changes. You are pure, undivided wisdom, vast like the sky.
insight: This verse shifts your identity from constantly reacting to change towards resting as the unchanging, unified wisdom within.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by decisions, changes, or conflicting feelings, remember you are not those shifts—you are the steady, vast wisdom beneath it all.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
नो वेद्यवेदकमिदं न च हेतुतर्क्यं
वाचामगोचरमिदं न मनो न बुद्धिः ।
एवं कथं हि भवतः कथयामि तत्त्वं
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: यह (आत्मा, ब्रह्म) किसी से नहीं जाना जाता, यह (स्वयं) जानने वाला है। यह तर्क का हेतु भी नहीं है, वाणी का विषय भी नहीं है, दिखाई भी नहीं देता, मन और बुद्धि भी इसे नहीं जान सकती। इसलिए मैं तुम्हे इस तत्व को किस प्रकार कथन करूं। मैं ज्ञानामृत, एकरस एवं आकाश की उपमा वाला हूँ।
