english_translation: The true self is not known by anyone; it is the knower itself. It is beyond logic, speech, mind, and intellect. How can I explain that essence? I am like nectar of knowledge, one taste, and like the infinite sky.
essence: The true self cannot be known; it is the knower beyond mind and speech.
simple_meaning: The true self cannot be known or described by mind, speech, or logic because it is the very source of knowing itself.
insight: It shifts your view from trying to grasp the self as an object to resting as the ever-present knower beyond mind and speech.
modern_relevance: When you struggle to explain who you truly are, remember that your essence cannot be captured in words or thoughts—it simply is, vast and free.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
निर्भिन्नभिन्नरहितं परमार्थतत्त्व-
मन्तर्बहिर्न हि कथं परमार्थतत्त्वम् ।
प्राक्सम्भवं न च रतं नहि वस्तु किञ्चित्
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: यह परमार्थ तत्व भेद और अभेद से रहित है, भीतर और बाहर का भेद भी इसमें नहीं है उस परमार्थ तत्व का कथन किस प्रकार है। यह पूर्व में था ऐसा भी नहीं है न यह किसी में लिप्त है न यह कोई पदार्थ ही है। में स्वयं ज्ञानामृत, एकरस, आकाशतुल्य व्यापक ब्रह्म ही हूँ।
english_translation: The supreme reality is free from difference and non-difference; it is neither inside nor outside. It was never born, nor is it attached to anything. I am that limitless supreme reality—knowledge, nectar, and like the vast sky.
essence: You are the limitless supreme reality beyond all distinctions and attachments.
simple_meaning: The ultimate reality is beyond all differences and divisions. It is not confined inside or outside, nor was it ever created or attached to anything. You are that boundless, pure essence like the vast sky.
insight: It teaches you to see beyond dualities and recognize yourself as the limitless reality that is never bound or limited.
modern_relevance: When your mind tries to split experience into inside or outside, right or wrong, you can remember that your true self is beyond all those divisions—vast, free, and whole.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
रागादिदोषरहितं त्वहमेव तत्त्वं
दैवादिदोषरहितं त्वहमेव तत्त्वम् ।
संसारशोकरहितं त्वहमेव तत्त्वं
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: राग आदि दोषों से रहित मैं ही आत्मतत्व हूँ, दैव आदि दोषों से रहित मैं ही आत्मतत्व हूँ, सांसारिक शोक से रहित मैं ही आत्मतत्त्व हूँ। मैं ज्ञानामृत, समरस एवं आकाश के समान हूँ।
english_translation: I am the true self free from faults like desire and fate, untouched by worldly sorrow; I am the nectar of knowledge, pure and vast like the sky.
essence: The true self is free from all faults and vast like the open sky.
simple_meaning: You are the true self untouched by desires, fate, or worldly sorrow, pure and vast like the sky.
insight: It shifts your view from identifying with passing troubles to resting as the faultless, infinite self.
modern_relevance: When your mind is clouded by anxiety or grief, remember your true self remains untouched and vast like an open sky.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
स्थानत्रयं यदि च नेति कथं तुरीयं
कालत्रयं यदि च नेति कथं दिशश्च ।
शान्तं पदं हि परमं परमार्थतत्त्वं
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: आत्मा में स्थान त्रय (जाग्रत, स्वप्न, सुषुप्ति) नहीं है फिर तुरीय अवस्था कैसे हो सकती है। तीनों काल ( भूत, भविष्यत्, वर्तमान) भी नहीं है फिर दिशाएँ कैसे हो सकती हैं। यह आत्मा (ब्रह्म) शान्त पद वाला, परम परमार्थ तत्व है। मैं ज्ञानामृत, समरस तथा आकाश तुल्य हूँ।
english_translation: If the true self lacks the three states of waking, dreaming, and deep sleep, how can a fourth state exist? If it transcends past, present, and future, how can directions apply? The true self is the supreme peaceful reality, the essence of immortal knowledge, undifferentiated like the sky.
essence: The true self transcends all states, times, and directions, resting as peaceful vastness.
simple_meaning: You are beyond waking, dreaming, deep sleep, time, and space. Your true self is peaceful and unlimited like the sky.
insight: It shifts your view from identifying with changing experiences to recognizing your unchanging, peaceful essence.
modern_relevance: When you feel scattered by changing moods, memories, or future worries, remember your true self remains calm and vast beyond all that.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
दीर्घो लघुः पुनरितीह नमे विभागो
विस्तारसंकटमितीह न मे विभागः ।
कोणं हि वर्तुलमितीह न मे विभागो
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: फिर इस लोक में बड़े और छोटे का विभाग भी मेरे में नहीं हैं, विस्तार और संकोच का विभाग भी मेरे में नहीं है, कोण और गोलाकार का विभाग भी मेरे में नहीं है। मैं ज्ञानामृत, समरस एवं आकाश तुल्य हूँ।
english_translation: In this world, there is no division of big or small in me, no division of expansion or contraction, no division of angle or circle. I am the nectar of wisdom, of one taste, and like the sky.
essence: True self is undivided and limitless, beyond all distinctions and forms.
simple_meaning: You are beyond all divisions like big or small, wide or narrow, angle or circle. You are pure wisdom, all one and vast like the sky.
insight: It shifts perspective from identifying with fragmented forms to recognizing an undivided, vast wisdom within.
modern_relevance: You feel boxed in by labels and roles at work or in social life. This verse reminds you that your true self is beyond all these limits and categories.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
मातापितादि तनयादि न मे कदाचित्
जातं मृतं न च मनो न च मे कदाचित् ।
निर्व्याकुलं स्थिरमिदं परमार्थतत्त्वं
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: मेरे माता पिता आदि तथा पुत्रादि भी नहीं हैं, न मैं उत्पन्न हुआ हूँ, न मरता ही हूँ। मेरा मन भी नहीं है। मैं व्याकुलता से रहित एवं स्थिर यही परमार्थ तत्व हूँ जो ज्ञानामृत, समरस एवं आकाश के तुल्य हूँ।
english_translation: I have never had parents or children; I was never born nor will I die. I have no mind. I am the unshaken, steady supreme reality, the nectar of knowledge, perfectly balanced like the sky.
essence: You are unborn, undying, and steady like the vast sky beyond mind.
simple_meaning: You have no birth, death, or mind. You are the steady, unshaken supreme reality, like the vast sky, full of knowledge and balance.
insight: It shifts your view from identifying with changing body and mind to recognizing your stable, limitless true nature.
modern_relevance: When worries flood your mind about beginnings or endings, remember your true self is steady and unchanging like the vast sky.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
शुद्धं विशुद्धमविचारमनन्तरूपं
निर्लेपलेपमविचारमनन्तरूपम् ।
निष्खण्डखण्डमविचारमनन्तरूपं
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: मैं शुद्ध हूँ, विशुद्ध हूँ, विचार रहित व अनन्त रूप हूँ। निर्लेप होकर भी सबमें लिप्त हूँ, सभी पदार्थों में मैं अखण्ड हूँ। मैं ज्ञानामृत, समरस एवं आकाश की उपमा वाला हूँ।
english_translation: I am pure, supremely pure, without thought and of infinite form. Though unattached, I am involved in all; I am unbroken in all substances. I am the nectar of wisdom, of one taste, and like the sky.
essence: You are infinitely pure and whole, present everywhere yet untouched by division.
simple_meaning: You are pure and limitless, beyond thought, present in everything without being attached, and your nature is like endless sky and nectar of wisdom.
insight: It teaches you to recognize your true self as vast and undivided, beyond mental noise and appearances.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by constant thoughts or divided by life's challenges, remember you are beyond all that—pure and infinite like the open sky.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
ब्रह्मादयः सुरगणाः कथमत्र सन्ति
स्वर्गादयो वसतयः कथमत्र सन्ति ।
यद्येकरूपममलं परमार्थतत्त्वं
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: यदि यह ब्रह्म एक रूप, मल रहित (शुद्ध), एवं परमार्थ तत्व है तो इसमें ब्रह्मा आदि से लेकर देवताओं के समूह किस प्रकार हो सकते हैं। स्वर्ग आदि बस्तियाँ भी इसमें किस प्रकार हो सकती हैं। में एक ही ज्ञानामृत, समरस एवं आकाश को उपमा वाला हूँ।
english_translation: If the supreme reality is pure, one, and without impurity, how can beings like Brahma and the gods or realms like heaven exist within it? I am that single, nectar-like knowledge, perfectly balanced like the sky.
essence: The supreme reality is one pure presence; all multiplicity is appearance.
simple_meaning: The supreme reality is pure and one without parts; beings like gods or heavens cannot exist separately in it. You are that single, balanced presence like the vast sky.
insight: It shifts your mind from seeing yourself as many separate things to recognizing your timeless unified essence.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by roles, identities, or groups, remember your true nature is a vast, unbroken presence beyond all those labels.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
निर्नेति नेति विमलो हि कथं वदामि
निःशेषशेषविमलो हि कथं वदामि ।
निर्लिङ्गलिङ्गविमलो हि कथं वदामि
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: इस विमल को निर्नेति अथवा नेति किस प्रकार मैं कहूँ, इसे नि:शेष और शेष भी किस प्रकार कहूं, इसे निर्लिंग तथा लिंग रूप भी किस प्रकार कहूँ। मैं एक ही ज्ञानामृत, तथा आकाश की उपमा वाला हूँ।
english_translation: How can I say that this pure is 'not this, not that'? How can I say it is without remainder or with remainder? How can I say it is without form or with form? I am the nectar of knowledge, like the sky.
essence: The pure true self cannot be captured by any description or duality.
simple_meaning: The pure true self cannot be limited by any description or form. It is beyond all opposites and is like limitless sky or nectar of knowledge.
insight: It teaches you to release attempts to define yourself or others, opening space for direct experience beyond concepts.
modern_relevance: When you try to explain who you truly are, words fail. This reminds you that your essence cannot be boxed into thoughts or opinions.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
निष्कर्मकर्मपरमं सततं करोमि
निःसङ्गसङ्गरहितं परमं विनोदम् ।
निर्देहदेहरहितं सततं विनोदं
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: मैं कर्म से रहित हूँ फिर भी परमकर्म को निरन्तर करता हूँ मैं नि:संग और संग दोनों से रहित हूँ फिर भी विनोद करता हूँ, मैं निर्देह और देह दोनों से रहित हूँ फिर भी सदा आनन्द में रहता हूँ। मैं ज्ञानामृत, समरस एवं आकाश तुल्य हूँ।
english_translation: I am free from action, yet I constantly perform supreme action; free from attachment and involvement, yet I remain in joy. I am beyond body and non-body, always in bliss. I am the nectar of knowledge, of one taste, like the sky.
essence: You can act fully without attachment, remaining joyfully free and boundless.
simple_meaning: You can engage in action without being attached or bound by it, remaining joyful and free like vast sky.
insight: It shifts your mind from seeing action as binding to experiencing it as free and joyful expression.
modern_relevance: You can work, care, or create without being trapped by stress or identity, staying joyful and free inside.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
मायाप्रपञ्चरचना न च मे विकारः 
कौटिल्यदम्भरचना न च मे विकारः ।
सत्यानृतेति रचना न च मे विकारो
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: मायारूपी प्रपंच की रचना मेरा विकार नहीं है, कुटिलता और दम्भ की रचना मेरी विकार नहीं है, सत्य और सिध्या की रचना मेरा विकार नहीं है। मैं ज्ञानामृत, समरस तथा आकाश की उपमा वाला हूँ।
english_translation: The illusions of the world are not my faults; neither are cunning or deceit; neither truth nor falsehood is my fault. I am the essence of undifferentiated wisdom, like the vast sky.
essence: Your true nature is beyond all faults, forms, and contradictions—like vast, undivided wisdom.
simple_meaning: You are not responsible for the illusions, deceit, or contradictions around you. Your true nature is pure, undivided wisdom, like the open sky.
insight: It shifts your view from identifying with flaws or dualities to recognizing your limitless, faultless essence.
modern_relevance: When you face confusing situations or conflicting truths, remember that your true self is untouched by these contradictions—vast and clear like the sky.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
सन्ध्यादिकालरहितं न च मे वियोगो-
ह्यन्तः प्रबोधरहितं बधिरो न मूकः ।
एवं विकल्परहितं न च भावशुद्धं
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: मैं सन्ध्यादि काल से रहित हूँ फिर भी उनसे वियोग नहीं है, आन्तरिक बोध से रहित हूँ फिर भी मूक और बधिर नहीं हूँ, विकल्प से रहित हूँ फिर भी चित्त से शुद्ध नहीं हूँ। में ज्ञानामृत, समरस एवं आकाश को उपमा वाला हूँ।
english_translation: I am beyond time like dawn and dusk, yet not separate from them; without inner awakening, yet neither mute nor deaf; free of alternatives, yet not pure in feeling. I am the nectar of knowledge, of even essence, like the sky.
essence: You are the timeless, unchanging essence present beyond all dualities and distinctions.
simple_meaning: You exist beyond time and inner senses, free from mental options, yet remain the pure essence like the limitless sky.
insight: It teaches you to see yourself as the vast, unchanging presence beyond time, senses, and mental divisions.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by endless choices and shifting feelings, you can recognize yourself as the steady essence beyond all fluctuations.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
निर्नाथनाथरहितं हि निराकुलं वै
निश्चित्तचित्तविगतं हि निराकुलं वै ।
संविद्धि सर्वविगतं हि निराकुलं वै
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: मेरा कोई स्वामी नहीं है न मैं किसी का स्वामी ही हूँ मेरा कोई कुल भी नहीं है। मैं बिना चित्तवाला हूँ, न मेरा कोई चित्त ही हैं, मैं व्याकुलता से रहित हूँ। निश्चय जान कि मैं सर्व से रहित हूँ फिर भी सर्वगत हूँ। मैं ज्ञानामृत, समरस एवं आकाश तुल्य हूँ।
english_translation: I have no master, nor am I anyone's master; I have no lineage. I am without a restless mind, free from anxiety. Know that I am free from all and yet present everywhere. I am the nectar of wisdom, one with the sky.
essence: Complete freedom from masters and mind creates a vast, unshaken presence like the sky.
simple_meaning: You have no master or lineage and are free from a restless mind and anxiety. Though detached, you are present everywhere, like the vast sky, embodying pure wisdom.
insight: It shows you can realize your true self beyond all control and mental turmoil, resting in vast awareness instead.
modern_relevance: You feel overwhelmed by expectations and restless thoughts, yet a part of you remains calm, vast, and untouched by all that pressure.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
कान्तारमन्दिरमिदं हि कथं वदामि
संसिद्धसंशयमिदं हि कथं वदामि ।
एवं निरन्तरसमं हि निराकुलं वै
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: मैं इस जगत को निर्जन वन का मन्दिर किस प्रकार कहूँ, मैं इसे संशय से युक्त भी किस प्रकार कहूँ तथा इसे निरन्तर, सम तथा निराकुल भी किस प्रकार कहूँ। मैं ज्ञानामृत, समरस एवं आकाश तुल्य हूँ।
english_translation: How can I call this world a deserted forest temple? How can I call it full of doubt? Yet I am the nectar of knowledge, unchanging, and like the vast sky.
essence: Your true self is vast, steady, and beyond all doubt and disturbance.
simple_meaning: You are not the confusing, changing world you see. You are steady, unshaken, and as vast as the sky.
insight: It teaches you to see beyond surface confusion and rest as the unchanging awareness beneath.
modern_relevance: When life feels confusing and full of conflicting thoughts, remember your true nature remains vast, steady, and untouched by doubt.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
निर्जीवजीवरहितं सततं विभाति
निर्बीजबीजरहितं सततं विभाति ।
निर्वाणबन्धरहितं सततं विभाति
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: मुझे बराबर दिखाई देता है कि यह जगत निर्जीव और जीव (जड़ और चेतन) से रहित है, निर्बीज और बीज से रहित है तथा निर्वाण (मोक्ष) एवं बन्धन से रहित है। मैं ज्ञानामृत, समरस एवं आकाश तुल्य हूँ।
english_translation: I always appear as free from lifeless and living beings, free from seed and seedless, free from liberation and bondage; I am the nectar of knowledge, of equal essence, and like the sky.
essence: True self is always free, beyond all dualities, vast like the sky.
simple_meaning: You are constantly beyond all dualities like living and non-living, seed and seedless, freedom and bondage. Your true nature is like the vast, equal sky filled with the nectar of knowledge.
insight: It shifts thinking from identifying with limits or categories to recognizing your limitless, unchanging essence.
modern_relevance: You face moments where you feel divided or stuck in labels. This reminds you that your true self is beyond all these limits, vast and free.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
सम्भूतिवर्जितमिदं सततं विभाति
संसारवर्जितमिदं सततं विभाति ।
संहारवर्जितमिदं सततं विभाति
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: मुझे निरन्तर भान होता हैं कि यह जगत संभूति रहित हैं, संसार से रहित है, नाश से रहित है। मैं ज्ञानामृत, समरस एवं आकाश तुल्य हूँ।
english_translation: I am always aware that this world is unborn, free from the cycle of reactivity, and untouched by destruction. I am the immortal nectar of wisdom, pure and equal, like the sky.
essence: You are an unchanging presence beyond birth, death, and destruction, like the sky.
simple_meaning: You are constantly aware that the world is not truly born, does not destroy itself, and exists beyond the cycle of change. You are like clear, eternal wisdom, vast as the sky.
insight: This verse shifts your view from seeing life as transient to recognizing your true nature as steady and unborn.
modern_relevance: When everything around you feels uncertain or fleeting, you can rest in the unchanging presence that you truly are—beyond all beginnings and ends.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
उल्लेखमात्रमपि ते न च नामरूपं
निर्भिन्नभिन्नमपि ते न हि वस्तु किञ्चित् ।
निर्लज्जमानस करोषि कथं विषादं
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: उल्लेख मात्र भी तेरा नाम और रूप नहीं है, तेरे से भिन्न और अभिन्न भी कोई वस्तु नहीं है। फिर हे निर्लज्ज मन! तू क्यों विषाद करता है। मैं ज्ञानामृत, समरस एवं आकाश तुल्य हैं।
english_translation: Your name and form are only mentioned but do not truly exist; nothing is different from or separate to you. So, fearless mind, why do you grieve? I am the nectar of wisdom, perfectly balanced, and like the vast sky.
essence: You are fearless and undivided, like the infinite sky of wisdom.
simple_meaning: There is no real separate self or thing apart from you. Your mind is fearless and can let go of sorrow, because your true nature is like vast, balanced wisdom.
insight: It teaches you to stop identifying with fleeting names and forms, seeing your mind’s courage in the boundless self.
modern_relevance: When anxiety or sadness arise, remember your true self is vast and undivided, beyond all names and roles that trouble your mind.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
किं नाम रोदिषि सखे न जरा न मृत्युः
किं नाम रोदिषि सखे न च जन्म दुःखम् ।
किं नाम रोदिषि सखे न च ते विकारो
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: हे सखे ! अपने नाम के लिए (प्रसिद्धि के लिए) तू क्यों रूदन करता है क्योंकि तेरा न बुढ़ापा है, न मृत्यु, न तेरा जन्म है, न दु:ख, तेरे कोई विकार भी नहीं हैं। मैं ज्ञानामृत, समरस एवं आकाश तुल्य इन सबसे परे हूँ।
english_translation: Why do you weep, friend? You have no old age, no death, no birth, no suffering, no faults. I am the nectar of wisdom, pure and like the infinite sky beyond all.
essence: You are timeless wisdom, untouched by birth, death, or suffering.
simple_meaning: You do not actually experience birth, death, or suffering. Your true nature is pure, timeless wisdom like the vast sky.
insight: It teaches you to see yourself as the timeless awareness beyond all personal troubles and changes.
modern_relevance: When grief or fear of loss feels overwhelming, remember your true self is untouched by time or hardship, like the vast sky above.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
किं नाम रोदिषि सखे न च ते स्वरूपं
किं नाम रोदिषि सखे न च ते विरूपम् ।
किं नाम रोदिषि सखे न च ते वयांसि
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: हे सखे ! तू किस काम के लिए रूदन करता है, न तेरा कोई स्वरूप है, न तेरा रूप ही नष्ट होने वाला है, तेरी आयु भी नहीं है। मैं ज्ञानामृत, समरस एवं आकाश तुल्य हूँ।
english_translation: Friend, why do you cry? You have no form, no destruction, no age. I am the nectar of wisdom, undivided and like the sky.
essence: Your true self is formless, eternal, and like the vast sky—never lost or aged.
simple_meaning: You have no real form, no destruction, and no age; your true nature is unchanging and like the sky—vast and free.
insight: It shifts your view from identifying with the body and time to recognizing yourself as timeless and unchanging wisdom.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by aging or change, remember your true nature is beyond all physical limits and loss.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
किं नाम रोदिषि सखे न च ते वयांसि
किं नाम रोदिषि सखे न च ते मनांसि ।
किं नाम रोदिषि सखे न तवेन्द्रियाणि
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: हे सखे ! तू किस वास्ते रूदन करता है, न तो तेरी आयु है, न मन है न ये इन्द्रियाँ ही तुम्हारी हैं। मैं ज्ञानामृत, समरस तथा आकाश तुल्य हूँ।
english_translation: Friend, why do you weep? Neither your life, your mind, nor your senses belong to you. I am the nectar of wisdom, the essence, like the vast sky.
essence: You are not your mind, senses, or lifespan but the limitless essence of wisdom.
simple_meaning: You do not truly own your lifespan, mind, or senses. Your true nature is like the vast sky — the pure essence of wisdom.
insight: This verse shifts your view from attachment to transient things toward recognizing your boundless, unchanging self.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by emotions or loss, remember your true self is larger than these passing experiences.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
किं नाम रोदिषि सखे न च तेऽस्ति कामः
किं नाम रोदिषि सखे न च ते प्रलोभः ।
किं नाम रोदिषि सखे न च ते विमोहो
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: हे सखे! तू किसलिए रूदन करता है, तू काम (कामना) भी नहीं है, न तेरा लोभ ही हैं, विमोह भी तेरा नहीं है। मैं ज्ञानामृत, समरस एवं आकाश तुल्य हूँ ऐसा जान।
english_translation: Why do you weep, friend? You have no desire, no greed, no confusion. Know that I am the nectar of wisdom, pure and like the sky.
essence: You are not your desires or confusion; you are the limitless nectar of wisdom.
simple_meaning: You are not bound by desire, greed, or confusion. Your true nature is pure wisdom, vast and clear like the sky.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that your true nature is untouched by fleeting emotions or desires, revealing your limitless essence.
modern_relevance: You catch yourself overwhelmed by worries or cravings, yet realize none truly define you. Your true self is calm and vast beyond them.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
ऐश्वर्यमिच्छसि कथं न च ते धनानि
ऐश्वर्यमिच्छसि कथं न च ते हि पत्नी ।
ऐश्वर्यमिच्छसि कथं न च ते ममेति
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: तू ऐश्वर्य की किस प्रकार इच्छा करता हैं। ये धन तेरा नहीं है, पलि भी तेरी नहीं है, तेरा मेरा ऐसा कहना भी नहीं है। तू ज्ञानामृत, समरस एवं आकाश को उपमा वाला आत्मा है वही में हूँ ऐसा जान।
english_translation: You desire wealth, but the riches are not truly yours; you desire a wife, but she is not yours; you claim 'mine,' but even that is not yours. Know that I am the immortal essence of knowledge, like the sky, unchanging and pure.
essence: You cannot truly own anything; your true self is the limitless, eternal essence.
simple_meaning: You might want wealth or relationships, but nothing truly belongs to you. Your real self is the eternal, pure essence like the vast sky.
insight: It shifts your view from clinging to ownership toward recognizing your self as the vast, unchanging essence.
modern_relevance: When you stress over keeping things—money, partnerships, status—you forget that your true being is untouched by all that comes and goes.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
लिङ्गप्रपञ्चजनुषी न च ते न मे च
निर्लज्जमानसमिदं च विभाति भिन्नम् ।
निर्भेदभेदरहितं न च ते न मे च
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: इस चिह्न रूपी जगत प्रपंच की उत्पत्ति न तुझसे हुई है न मुझसे, किन्तु इस लज्जा रहित मन को यह भिन्न प्रतीत होती है। यह निर्भेद और भेद रहित जगत भी न तेरा है, न मेरा। मैं एक ही ज्ञानामृत, समरस एवं आकाश को उपमा वाला हूँ।
english_translation: This world of forms and appearances is born neither from you nor from me; yet the shameless mind perceives it as different. This world, without distinction or separation, is neither yours nor mine. I am the undivided nectar of wisdom, homogeneous and like the sky.
essence: Separation is an illusion; your true nature is the undivided infinite essence.
simple_meaning: The world of forms does not belong to you or me. The mind wrongly sees separation, but the true essence is one, undivided, and like the vast sky.
insight: It teaches you to see past mental divisions and recognize your identity as the undivided essence beyond form.
modern_relevance: When you face conflict or division, remember that beneath appearances, the true reality is unified and beyond separation.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
नो वाणुमात्रमपि ते हि विरागरूपं
नो वाणुमात्रमपि ते हि सरागरूपम् ।
नो वाणुमात्रमपि ते हि सकामरूपं
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: तेरा अणु मात्र भी विराग रूप नहीं है, तुम्हारा अणु मात्र भी राग रूप नहीं है, तेरा अणु मात्र भी सकाम रूप नहीं है। मैं एक ही ज्ञानामृत, समरस एवं आकाश तुल्य हूँ।
english_translation: Not even your smallest particle is of detachment, attachment, or desire; I am the undifferentiated nectar of wisdom, like the vast sky.
essence: Your true nature is pure, desireless wisdom as vast as the sky.
simple_meaning: Nothing in you, not even the tiniest part, is truly attachment, detachment, or desire. You are the pure, undivided essence of wisdom, like the limitless sky.
insight: This verse shifts your view from identifying with fleeting feelings to recognizing your timeless, desire-free essence.
modern_relevance: When you feel restless with wanting or trying to avoid things, remember you are deeper than all that—a vast, unchanging presence within.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
ध्याता न ते हि हृदये न च ते समाधि-
र्ध्यानं न ते हि हृदये न बहिः प्रदेशः ।
ध्येयं न चेति हृदये न हि वस्तु कालो
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: तेरे हृदय में न कोई ध्याता है, न समाधि और ध्यान ही है। तेरे हृदय में बाह्य प्रदेश भी नहीं है, तेरे हृदय में न ध्येय ही है। न काल जैसी कोई वस्तु ही है। मैं ज्ञानामृत, समरस एवं आकाश की उपमा वाला हूँ।
english_translation: In your heart there is neither meditator nor meditation; no external region exists within it. There is no object of meditation or time there. I am the nectar of knowledge, the essence, and like the infinite sky.
essence: Your heart contains no doer, object, or time—only infinite, unified presence.
simple_meaning: There is no separate meditator or meditation inside your heart. No outer space, object, or time exists there. The true self is like the limitless sky, pure and unified.
insight: It shifts the mind from seeing yourself as a separate actor to recognizing the emptiness where all roles dissolve.
modern_relevance: You notice moments when your mind stops labeling you a doer or thinker, and you feel a vast openness inside.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
यत्सारभूतमखिलं कथितं मया ते
न त्वं न मे न महतो न गुरुर्न न शिष्यः ।
स्वच्छन्दरूपसहजं परमार्थतत्त्वं
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: मैंने जो सम्पूर्ण सारभूत था वह तुझे कह दिया है। किन्तु यह सब न तेरा है, न मेरा है, महतत्व भी नहीं है न गुरु शिष्य ही है। यह सहज स्वच्छन्द रूप परमार्थ तत्व स्वरूप ज्ञानामृत, समरस तथा आकाश तुल्य है। वह मैं हूँ।
english_translation: I have told you the entire essence; yet it is neither yours nor mine, nor of greatness, nor of teacher or student. It is the natural, free, pure reality, the nectar of wisdom, perfectly balanced like the sky — that is what I am.
essence: The true nature is free, beyond all roles and distinctions, naturally pure wisdom.
simple_meaning: The true self is beyond all identities, roles, and distinctions; it is natural, free, and the pure essence of wisdom.
insight: It shifts your perspective from identifying with roles to recognizing your pure, unchanging nature beyond all labels.
modern_relevance: You realize your true worth is not bound by your job title, roles, or achievements—it is simply your natural, free essence.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
कथमिह परमार्थं तत्त्वमानन्दरूपं
कथमिह परमार्थं नैवमानन्दरूपम् ।
कथमिह परमार्थं ज्ञानविज्ञानरूपं
यदि परमहमेकं वर्तते व्योमरूपम् ॥
translation: यदि मैं एक ही परम आकाश रूप हूँ तो उसमें परमार्थ, तत्व एवं आनन्दरूपता कैसे रहती है तथा उसमें परमार्थ एवं आनन्दरूप भी कैसे नहीं रहता है, उसमें ज्ञान-विज्ञान रूप भी कैसे रह सकता है।
english_translation: If I am the one supreme sky form, how can ultimate reality, essence, and bliss exist in it, and yet not exist; how can knowledge and wisdom also be present?
essence: You are the unchanging sky where all truth and its absence coexist.
simple_meaning: You are like the single sky that holds all things and yet remains unchanged. Ultimate reality, bliss, and knowledge appear and disappear but you remain one and whole.
insight: It shifts your view from needing to fix contradictions to embracing the whole paradox as your true nature.
modern_relevance: When life feels full of contradictions, you can remember you are the open space holding all experiences without being defined by any.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
दहनपवनहीनं विद्धि विज्ञानमेक-
मवनिजलविहीनं विद्धि विज्ञानरूपम् ।
समगमनविहीनं विद्धि विज्ञानमेकं
गगनमिव विशालं विद्धि विज्ञानमेकम् ॥
translation: यह आत्मा एक ही विज्ञान रूप है ऐसा तू जान; जो अग्नि और वायु से रहित, पृथ्वी और जल से रहित, आवागमन से रहित है। यह आकाश के समान विशाल है।
english_translation: Know that the true self is the sole form of pure awareness—free from fire and wind, free from earth and water, and free from movement. It is vast like the sky.
essence: Your true self is boundless, motionless pure awareness beyond all elements.
simple_meaning: You are pure awareness, untouched by fire, wind, earth, water, or movement. Your true self is vast and limitless like the sky.
insight: Recognize your inner being as unchanging awareness beyond physical and mental fluctuations.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by constant change or pressure, remember your true self is vast and unaffected, like the open sky beyond the storm.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
न शून्यरूपं न विशून्यरूपं
न शुद्धरूपं न विशुद्धरूपम् ।
रूपं विरूपं न भवामि किञ्चित्
स्वरूपरूपं परमार्थतत्त्वम् ॥
translation: मैं न शून्य रूप हूँ, न शून्य रहित रूप ही हूँ, न शुद्ध रूप हूँ, न विशुद्ध रूप हूँ, मैं किंचित् मात्र भी रूप और विरूप नहीं हूँ। मैं एक ही परमार्थ तत्व अपने ही रूप वाला हूँ।
english_translation: I am neither empty nor non-empty form, neither pure nor impure form; I am not any form or distorted form. I am the supreme reality itself in my own form.
essence: You are not any form but the supreme reality itself beyond all dualities.
simple_meaning: You are not limited to any form—neither empty nor full, pure nor impure. You are the supreme reality itself, beyond all appearances.
insight: It shifts your view from identifying with transient forms to recognizing your unchanging true nature.
modern_relevance: You might feel boxed in by roles or identities, but this teaches you that your true self is beyond all labels and appearances.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
मुञ्च मुञ्च हि संसारं त्यागं मुञ्च हि सर्वथा ।
त्यागात्यागविषं शुद्धममृतं सहजं ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: तू स्वभाव से ही शुद्ध, अमृतरूप एवं नित्य है। इसलिए तू संसार का त्याग कर दे तथा त्याग को भी सर्वदा छोड़ दे तथा त्याग और अत्याग की भावना विष के समान है उसे भी छोड़ दे।
english_translation: You are inherently pure, immortal, and eternal. Therefore, renounce the world, then even renunciation itself, for the feeling of renunciation and non-renunciation is like poison—let it go too.
essence: True self is naturally pure; even renunciation must be released to be free.
simple_meaning: You are naturally pure, immortal, and constant. So first renounce the world, then even the idea of renouncing itself, because holding onto renunciation is like poison.
insight: This verse shifts your focus from renouncing external things to releasing any attachment to the act of renunciation itself.
modern_relevance: You might try to let go of stress or distractions, but sometimes even holding onto the idea of letting go keeps you stuck. True freedom is beyond all that.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
नावाहनं नैव विसर्जनं वा पुष्पाणि पत्राणि कथं भवन्ति ।
ध्यानानि मन्त्राणि कथं भवन्ति समासमं चैव शिवार्चनं च ॥
translation: सर्व व्यापक चेतन आत्मा का न आवाहन है, न विसर्जन, इस पर पुष्प एवं पत्र भी कैसे समर्पित हो सकते हैं, इसके लिए ध्यान और मन्त्र भी किस प्रकार हो सकता है। सर्वत्र समान दृष्टि रखना ही इस शिव रूप चेतन आत्मा का पूजन है।
english_translation: The all-pervading conscious self cannot be called or dismissed; how then can flowers or leaves be offered, or meditation and mantras performed? Seeing everything equally is the true worship of this Shiva-like conscious self.
essence: True worship transcends rituals; it is equal seeing of all as divine.
simple_meaning: The infinite conscious self cannot be called or dismissed like objects; true worship is to see everything equally without rituals.
insight: It shifts your devotion from external acts to a steady inner attitude of equal respect and recognition.
modern_relevance: When you stop trying to perform perfect rituals or prove your devotion, you begin to see the sacred equally in everyone and everything around you.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
न केवलं बन्धविबन्धमुक्तो न केवलं शुद्धविशुद्धमुक्तः ।
न केवलं योगवियोगमुक्तः स वै विमुक्तो गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥
translation: मैं केवल बन्ध और विबन्ध से ही युक्त नहीं हूँ, न शुद्ध विशुद्ध से ही मुक्त हूँ, न योग और वियोग से ही मुक्त हूँ। बल्कि मैं आकाश तुल्य होने से मैं मुक्त ही हूँ।
english_translation: I am not merely free from bondage and separation, nor only from purity and impurity, nor just from union and separation; I am truly free like the sky itself.
essence: True freedom transcends all opposites, like the sky that embraces everything without attachment.
simple_meaning: True freedom is not just escaping opposites like bondage or purity, but being vast and unbounded like the sky.
insight: It shifts your view from escaping conditions to embodying vast, unaffected presence beyond all opposites.
modern_relevance: When you stop labeling yourself by success or failure, right or wrong, you feel a freedom as wide and open as the sky itself.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
सञ्जायते सर्वमिदं हि तथ्यं सञ्जायते सर्वमिदं वितथ्यम् ।
एवं विकल्पो मम नैव जातः स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥
translation: यह सम्पूर्ण जगत सत्य ही उत्पन्न होता है अथवा मिथ्या ही उत्पन्न होता है इस प्रकार का विकल्प मेरे में कभी उत्पन्न ही नहीं हुआ। मैं स्वरूप से ही मुक्त हूँ तथा जन्म मरण के रोग से भी मुक्त हूँ।
english_translation: This entire world either truly arises or falsely arises; such a choice never arose in me. I am free in my nature and free from the disease of birth and death.
essence: You never face doubt about reality because you are inherently free and unchanging.
simple_meaning: Everything either truly exists or does not, but this question never disturbed me. I am naturally free and untouched by birth or death.
insight: It teaches you to let go of dualistic doubts and rest in the certainty of your timeless freedom.
modern_relevance: When faced with endless doubts about what is real, you can find peace in knowing your true self never wavers or suffers.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
न साञ्जनं चैव निरञ्जनं वा न चान्तरं वापि निरन्तरं वा ।
अन्तर्विभन्नं न हि मे विभाति स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥
translation: मैं न तो दोष युक्त हूँ न दोष रहित हूँ, मैं व्यवधान सहित एवं व्यवधान रहित भी नहीं हूँ। मेरे में व्यवधान और भेद भी ज्ञात नहीं होते। मैं स्वरूप से ही मुक्त एवं रोग रहित आकाश तुल्य हूँ।
english_translation: I am neither tainted nor spotless; neither fragmented nor continuous. In me, no divisions or disturbances appear. I am essentially free, like the sky, without disease or limitation.
essence: You are fundamentally whole and undivided, free from all faults or fragmentation.
simple_meaning: You are not flawed or flawless, divided or whole. You are free and undisturbed, like the limitless sky.
insight: Shift your view from seeing yourself as flawed or fragmented to recognizing your inherent wholeness and freedom.
modern_relevance: In moments of self-doubt or inner conflict, remember you are not broken or incomplete — you are vast and whole beyond appearances.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
अबोधबोधो मम नैव जातो बोधस्वरूपं मम नैव जातम् ।
निर्बोधबोधं च कथं वदामि स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥
translation: अबोध ( अज्ञान) का बोध (ज्ञान) भी मेरे में नहीं हुआ है, मैं बोध स्वरूप (ज्ञान स्वरूप) हूँ ऐसा ज्ञान भी मुझे नहीं हुआ है। फिर मैं अपने को निबध (अज्ञानी) अथवा बोध वाला (ज्ञानी) किस प्रकार कहूँ। मैं स्वरूप से ही मुक्त एवं रोग रहित हूँ।
english_translation: Ignorance's knowledge has never arisen in me, nor has knowledge of knowledge; I am the embodiment of knowledge itself. How then can I call myself ignorant or knowledgeable? I am inherently free and without disease.
essence: You are beyond both ignorance and knowledge; your true nature is freedom itself.
simple_meaning: You have never experienced ignorance or even the knowledge of it because you are the very essence of knowledge itself, free and untouched by any limitation.
insight: It shifts your view from identifying with changing knowledge states to resting in unchanging awareness.
modern_relevance: When confusion or self-doubt cloud your mind, remember your true self is untouched by these labels and remains whole and free.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
न धर्मयुक्तो न च पापयुक्तो न बन्धयुक्तो न च मोक्षयुक्तः ।
युक्तं त्वयुक्तं न च मे विभाति स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥
translation: मैं न धर्म से युक्त हूँ, न पाप से युक्त हूँ, न बन्ध से युक्त हूँ और न मोक्ष से ही युक्त हूँ, युक्त और अयुक्त का भान भी मेरे में नहीं होता है। मैं स्वरूप से ही मोक्ष युक्त एवं रोग रहित हूँ।
english_translation: I am not bound by duty, sin, bondage, or freedom; I perceive neither attachment nor detachment. By my true nature, I am free and untouched by illness.
essence: Your true self transcends all attachments, bonds, and freedoms—it simply is.
simple_meaning: You are neither attached to duty, wrongdoing, bondage, nor freedom. Your true self remains free, pure, and untouched by any condition.
insight: Shift your mindset from identifying with roles and conditions toward recognizing your unchanged true nature beyond them.
modern_relevance: When life pulls you between obligations and desires for freedom, you can find calm knowing your true self remains untouched by these struggles.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
परापरं वा न च मे कदाचित् मध्यस्थभावो हि न चारिमित्रम् ।
हिताहितं चापि कथं वदामि स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥
translation: मुझमें पर एवं अपर भाव भी नहीं है, न मध्यस्थ भाव ही है, शत्रु और मित्र भाव भी मेरे में नहीं हैं, फिर मैं हित और अहित किस प्रकार कहूँ। मैं स्वरूप से ही मोक्ष स्वरूप एवं रोग रहित हूँ।
english_translation: In me, there is neither the supreme nor the inferior; no middle state, no enemy or friend. How then can I speak of benefit or harm? I am by nature free and untouched by suffering.
essence: You are naturally free, beyond all dualities of friend, foe, benefit, or harm.
simple_meaning: You are not divided by opposites like friend or enemy, benefit or harm. Your true nature is freedom and health beyond all duality.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing life in opposites to recognizing your unchanging, free nature beyond all labels.
modern_relevance: In moments of conflict or stress, remembering you are beyond friend or enemy can calm your mind and stop endless inner struggle.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
नोपासको नैवमुपास्यरूपं न चोपदेशो न च मे क्रिया च । 
संवित्स्वरूपं च कथं वदामि स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥
translation: न तो मैं उपासक हूँ, न ही उपास्य रूप हूँ न मेरा उपदेश है और न मेरे में क्रिया ही है फिर मैं अपने को ज्ञान स्वरूप भी किस प्रकार कहूँ। मैं स्वरूप से ही मुक्त एवं रोग रहित हूँ।
english_translation: I am neither a worshipper nor an object of worship; I have no teachings and no actions. How then can I say I am the form of knowledge? I am free from form, free from disease.
essence: You are beyond all roles, actions, and forms; you are pure freedom.
simple_meaning: You are not a worshipper or an object to be worshipped. You have no teachings or actions. You are pure freedom, free from any form or disease.
insight: It shifts the mind from identifying with roles or actions to recognizing pure freedom beyond all labels.
modern_relevance: You feel pressured to fit roles—teacher, doer, or follower—but realizing you are beyond these brings a deep sense of freedom.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
नो व्यापकं व्याप्यमिहास्ति किञ्चित् न चालयं वापि निरालयं वा ।
अशून्यशून्यं च कथं वदामि स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥
translation: इस आत्मा (ब्रह्म) में व्यापक व्याप्य भाव किंचित भी नहीं हैं, न आश्रय एवं निराश्रय भाव ही है। मैं इसे शून्य तथा अशून्य भी किस प्रकार कहूँ। यह स्वरूप से ही मुक्त एवं रोग रहित है। वही में हूँ।
english_translation: This true self is neither pervasive nor moving, neither dependent nor independent; it cannot be called empty or not empty. By nature, it is free and without flaw—I am that.
essence: The true self is beyond all dualities and completely free by nature.
simple_meaning: The true self is beyond any description: it is not limited, not moving, not dependent, and cannot be called empty or full. It is naturally free and without any flaw.
insight: It shifts your mind from trying to define yourself by conditions to recognizing your flawless, free nature beyond all labels.
modern_relevance: When you face confusion about your identity or feel torn between extremes, remember that your true nature is beyond such limits and completely free.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
न ग्राहको ग्राह्यकमेव किञ्चित् न कारणं वा मम नैव कार्यम् ।
अचिन्त्यचिन्त्यं च कथं वदामि स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥
translation: आत्मा में ग्राहक (ग्रहण करने वाला) एवं ग्राह्य (जिसे ग्रहण किया जाता है) का थोड़ा सा भी भेद नहीं है, मेरा न तो कोई कारण है और न ही कोई कार्य है। इस अचिन्त्य आत्मा का मन से चिन्तन भी नहीं किया जा सकता उसका मैं कथन कैसे करूँ। मैं स्वरूप से ही मुक्त और रोग से रहित हूँ।
english_translation: In the true self, there is no distinction between the taker and the taken; I have no cause and no action. How can I speak of the inconceivable self, free from form and disease?
essence: The true self is beyond all dualities of taker, taken, cause, and action.
simple_meaning: There is no difference between the one who takes and what is taken in your true nature. You have no cause and no action. This self is beyond thought, free from form and disease.
insight: It shifts your mind from seeing yourself as a doer caught in cause and effect to recognizing you are pure awareness beyond all distinctions.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by choices or blame, remember your true self is beyond these conflicts and completely free.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
न भेदकं वापि न चैव भेद्यं न वेदकं वा मम नैव वेद्यम् ।
गतागतं तात कथं वदामि स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥
translation: न तो कोई भेद करने वाला है और न भेद करने योग्य ही है, न कोई जानने वाला है, न मेरे में कोई जानने योग्य ही है। होने से मेरा कारण एवं कार्य भी नहीं है। हे तात ! न कोई व्यतीत हुआ है, न आने वाला है फिर उसका कथन कैसे करूँ। मैं स्वरूप से ही मुक्त एवं रोग रहित हूँ ।
english_translation: There is neither anything that divides nor anything to be divided, nor any knower or known in me. I have no cause or effect; neither coming nor going exists. I am by nature free and without disease.
essence: You are perfectly whole, beyond division, time, and knowing.
simple_meaning: You are not divided or separate in any way. There is no separate knower or known inside you. You have no cause or effect; you simply are free and whole by nature.
insight: It shifts your understanding from a fragmented self to seeing yourself as an undivided presence beyond time and change.
modern_relevance: In moments when you feel fractured or uncertain, recognize that your true nature is whole, beyond all separation and change.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
न चास्ति देहो न च मे विदेहो बुद्धिर्मनो मे न हि चेन्द्रियाणि ।
रागो विरागश्च कथं वदामि स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥
translation: मेरा शरीर भी नहीं है, न मैं देह रहित ही हूँ, मेरी बुद्धि, मन तथा इन्द्रियाँ भी नहीं हैं इसलिए मैं राग और विराग का किस प्रकार कथन करूं। मैं मुक्तरूप रोग रहित हूँ।
english_translation: I have no body, nor am I bodiless; I have no intellect, mind, or senses. Therefore, how can I speak of desire and non-desire? I am the free form, free of disease.
essence: You are neither body nor mind but the free and whole true self beyond all dualities.
simple_meaning: You are not your body, mind, intellect, or senses; you are beyond desire and non-desire, naturally free and whole.
insight: It shifts your view from identifying with body and mind to recognizing your limitless, unconditioned true nature.
modern_relevance: You might feel overwhelmed by your thoughts, emotions, or physical limits—but your true self is untouched by all these.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
उल्लेखमात्रं न हि भिन्नमुच्चैरुल्लेखमात्रं न तिरोहितं वै ।
समासमं मित्र कथं वदामि स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥
translation: वह (आत्मा) थोड़ा सा भी (ब्रह्म से) भिन्न नहीं है वह उच्च प्रकार के लेखन में भी नहीं है, उससे भी वह छिपा हुआ है। हे मित्र! उसे मैं सम अथवा असम किस प्रकार कहूँ। मैं आत्म रूप युक्त एवं रोग रहित हूँ।
english_translation: The true self is not even slightly different from the supreme reality; it is not present in exalted writings, nor hidden by them. Friend, how can I call it whole or partial? I am the self's form, free from disease.
essence: The true self is entirely one with supreme reality, beyond all division or concealment.
simple_meaning: The true self is entirely the supreme reality, not different or hidden anywhere; it cannot be called partial or whole because it simply is.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing yourself as divided or flawed to recognizing your complete and pure nature as the true self.
modern_relevance: When you feel fragmented or lost, remember that your true being is whole and untouched, beyond any label or limitation.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
जितेन्द्रियोऽहं त्वजितेन्द्रियो वा न संयमो मे नियमो न जातः ।
जयाजयौ मित्र कथं वदामि स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥
translation: मैं जितेन्द्रिय भी नहीं हैं, न अजितेन्द्रिय ही हूँ मेरे में संयम नियम भी उत्पन्न नहीं हुए हैं। हे मित्र! मैं जय और अजय का किस प्रकार कथन करूं। मैं स्वरूप से ही मुक्त एवं रोग रहित हूँ।
english_translation: I am neither one who has conquered the senses nor one who has not; no control or rules arise in me. Friend, how can I speak of victory and defeat? I am by nature free and without disease.
essence: True freedom transcends all control, victory, and defeat—it simply is.
simple_meaning: You are neither controlled by your senses nor free because of effort; your true nature is already free beyond victory and defeat.
insight: It shifts your view from battling impulses to recognizing freedom as your unchanging essence beyond all duality.
modern_relevance: You feel caught between impulses and control, yet your true self is beyond this struggle, naturally free even if your mind tries to fight or win.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
अमूर्तमूर्तिर्न च मे कदाचि दाद्यन्तमध्यं न च मे कदाचित् ।
बलाबलं मित्र कथं वदामि स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥
translation: मैं न कभी मूर्त हूँ, न अमूर्त ही हूँ, मेरा आदि, मध्य और अन्त भी नहीं है। हे मित्र! मैं बलशाली हूँ अथवा निर्बल हूँ। इसका भी किस प्रकार कथन करूं। मैं तो एक ही स्वरूप से ही मुक्त एवं रोग रहित हूँ।
english_translation: I am neither form nor formless, without beginning, middle, or end. Friend, how can I be strong or weak? I am free and untouched in my true nature.
essence: Your true nature is beyond form, time, and all dualities; it is free and whole.
simple_meaning: You are not limited by any shape or form, nor by time or strength; your true self is free and untouched by weakness or disease.
insight: It teaches you to recognize your true self as beyond all change, beyond strength or weakness, freeing you from self-judgment.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by your changing moods or circumstances, remember you are not defined by them but by a deeper freedom within.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
मृतामृतं वापि विषाविषं च सञ्जायते तात न मे कदाचित् ।
अशुद्धशुद्धं च कथं वदामि स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥
translation: मेरा न मरना है, न जीना ही है, मैं विष और अमृत भी नहीं हूँ न मेरे से ये कभी उत्पन्न ही हुए हैं। हे तात! मैं अपने को शुद्ध एवं अशुद्ध भी किस प्रकार कहूँ। मैं मोक्ष स्वरूप एवं रोग रहित हूँ।
english_translation: I am neither born nor do I die; neither poison nor nectar arises from me. How can I be called pure or impure? I am the embodiment of liberation, free from disease.
essence: Your true nature is beyond birth, death, purity, and impurity—always free and whole.
simple_meaning: You are not born and do not die; you are beyond poison or nectar, beyond pure or impure. You are the timeless, disease-free essence of liberation.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that your essence is untouched by life's opposites, freeing your mind from dualistic judgments.
modern_relevance: When you face confusing highs and lows or feel labeled by success or failure, remember your true self is beyond those ups and downs.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
स्वप्नः प्रबोधो न च योगमुद्रा नक्तं दिवा वापि न मे कदाचित् ।
अतुर्यतुर्यं च कथं वदामि स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥
translation: मेरे में न स्वप्न है न जाग्रत अवस्था हैं, योग मुद्रा भी नहीं है। मेरे में रात्रि और दिन भी नहीं है फिर मैं तुरीयावस्था अथवा अतुरीया अवस्था का किस प्रकार कथन करूं। मैं स्वरूप से ही मुक्त एवं रोग रहित हूँ।
english_translation: In me there is neither dream nor waking state, nor yoga posture; neither night nor day. How then can I speak of the fourth or beyond states? I am by nature free and free of ailments.
essence: Your true self is beyond all changing states and naturally free.
simple_meaning: You are not limited by dream, waking, or any yoga posture. You are beyond day and night, naturally free and without sickness.
insight: It shifts your view from identifying with passing states to recognizing your constant, free nature beneath them.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by shifting moods or roles, remember your true self is untouched by these changes and always free.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
संविद्धि मां सर्वविसर्वमुक्तं माया विमाया न च मे कदाचित् ।
सन्ध्यादिकं कर्म कथं वदामि स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥
translation: मैं सर्व एवं सर्व रहित से मुक्त हूँ ऐसा तू जान। मेरे में माया एवं विमाया भी नहीं है। फिर मैं संध्या आदि कर्मों का किस प्रकार कथन करूं। मैं मुक्त स्वरूप एवं रोग रहित हूँ।
english_translation: Know that I am free from everything and nothingness; neither illusion nor its negation is in me. How then can I speak of duties like evening rituals? I am the free, disease-free true nature.
essence: Your true self is beyond all rituals, illusions, and limitations.
simple_meaning: You are completely free from all illusions and rituals. Your true self is pure, free, and untouched by any duties or ceremonies.
insight: It teaches you to see beyond external roles and rituals, recognizing your unchanging, free true nature.
modern_relevance: You might feel pressured by routines or expectations, yet deep inside, you are free of all that and untouched by external demands.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
संविद्धि मां सर्वसमाधियुक्तं संविद्धि मां लक्ष्यविलक्ष्यमुक्तम् ।
योगं वियोगं च कथं वदामि स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥
translation: तू मुझे सर्व समाधि से युक्त जान, मैं लक्ष्य एवं लक्ष्य रहित से मुक्त हूँ ऐसा तू जान । मैं योग और वियोग को किस प्रकार कहूँ मैं स्वरूप से मुक्त एवं रोग रहित हूँ।
english_translation: Know me as united with all absorption; free from both target and targetless. How can I call it yoga or separation? I am free in my own nature, without disease.
essence: True freedom is beyond all goals, efforts, and separations — it simply is.
simple_meaning: You are fully absorbed and free of any goal or separation. You cannot call this yoga or separation because your true nature is already free and healthy.
insight: It shifts your mind from pursuing goals or fearing separation to resting in the natural completeness of your being.
modern_relevance: When you stop chasing goals or fearing being lost, you realize you are already whole and free just as you are.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
मूर्खोऽपि नाहं न च पण्डितोऽहंमौनं विमौनं न च मे कदाचित् ।
तर्कं वितर्कं च कथं वदामि स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥
translation: मैं मूर्ख नहीं हूँ, न पण्डित ही हूँ, मौन एवं बोलना भी मेरे में नहीं है। मैं तर्क और वितर्क को भी किस प्रकार कथन करूं। मैं मोक्ष स्वरूप रोग रहित हूँ।
english_translation: I am neither a fool nor a scholar; I am neither silent nor speaking. How could I speak of argument or counter-argument? I am the disease-free nature of freedom.
essence: You are beyond all dualities and untouched by any condition or argument.
simple_meaning: You are neither foolish nor wise, neither silent nor speaking. You cannot be defined by arguments because your true self is free and untouched by suffering.
insight: It shifts your mind from identifying with roles or debates to recognizing the self as untouched and free.
modern_relevance: You’ve felt the pressure to fit into roles like smart or ignorant, speaking or silent, but your real self is beyond those boxes, quietly whole inside.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
पिता च माता च कुलं न जाति र्जन्मादि मृत्युर्न च मे कदाचित् ।
स्नेहं विमोहं च कथं वदामि स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥
translation: मेरे पिता, माता, कुल और जाति नहीं है, मेरे जन्म और मृत्यु आदि भी नहीं है। मैं स्नेह और विमोह का किस प्रकार कथन करूं। मैं स्वरूप से ही मुक्त एवं रोग रहित हूँ।
english_translation: I have no father, mother, family, caste, birth, or death. How could I speak of attachment or delusion? I am by nature free and without disease.
essence: You are not defined by birth, death, or social ties but are naturally free and whole.
simple_meaning: You are not limited by family, birth, or death. You are naturally free and untouched by attachment or confusion.
insight: It teaches you to recognize yourself beyond all personal and social identities, freeing your mind from attachment and confusion.
modern_relevance: When you feel trapped by your roles or the expectations of family and society, remember your true self is beyond all these labels and limits.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
अस्तं गतो नैव सदोदितोऽहं तेजोवितेजो न च मे कदाचित् ।
सन्ध्यादिकं कर्म कथं वदामि स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥
translation: मैं कभी अस्त नहीं होता ( लय को प्राप्त नहीं होता)। मैं सर्वकाल में उदित ही हूँ। मेरे में तेज और वितेज भी नहीं है फिर सन्ध्यादि कर्म का मैं किस प्रकार कथन करूं। मैं स्वरूप से मुक्त एवं रोग रहित हूँ।
english_translation: I never set nor rise; I am beyond light and brilliance. How can I speak of twilight duties? I am inherently free and without affliction.
essence: Your true self is eternal, beyond all changes and daily rituals.
simple_meaning: You are always present, never changing like sunrise or sunset. You are beyond light and darkness, free from all limitations.
insight: It teaches you to see yourself as beyond changing states, steady and whole no matter external shifts.
modern_relevance: When your mood shifts like the day’s light, remember your true self remains steady and untouched.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
असंशयं विद्धि निराकुलं मां असंशयं विद्धि निरन्तरं माम् ।
असंशयं विद्धि निरञ्जनं मां स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥
translation: मुझे संशय रहित तथा मूल कारण से रहित तू जान, मुझे संशय से रहित नित्य तू जान, मुझे संशय से रहित निर्दोष तू जान। मैं स्वरूप से ही मुक्त एवं रोग रहित हूँ।
english_translation: Know me doubtless as free from confusion and cause, always without doubt; know me as spotless and inherently free and without disease.
essence: Your true self is always pure, free, and beyond all confusion without exception.
simple_meaning: You are inherently without confusion, always pure and free from any flaw or disease. This is your true nature beyond doubt.
insight: This verse shifts your view from seeing yourself as affected by problems to recognizing your essence as eternally pure and free.
modern_relevance: When stress clouds your mind, remember your true self is untouched and free beyond all worries and confusion.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
ध्यानानि सर्वाणि परित्यजन्ति शुभाशुभं कर्म परित्यजन्ति ।
त्यागामृतं तात पिबन्ति धीराः स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥
translation: धीर पुरुष सम्पूर्ण ध्यानों का परित्याग कर देते हैं, शुभ एवं अशुभ सभी प्रकार के कर्मों का त्याग कर देते हैं। वे केवल त्याग रूपी अमृत का ही पान करते हैं। मैं स्वरूप से ही मुक्त एवं रोग रहित हूँ।
english_translation: Wise beings abandon all meditations and all good and bad actions; they partake only in the nectar of renunciation. I am inherently free and free from disease.
essence: True wisdom is complete renunciation, revealing your natural, effortless freedom.
simple_meaning: Wise people let go of all meditation techniques and all kinds of actions, good or bad. They simply embrace the sweetness of complete renunciation and recognize their natural freedom.
insight: It teaches you to release all effortful practices and moral judgments, shifting your focus to the effortless state of innate freedom.
modern_relevance: You might feel overwhelmed by endless self-improvement techniques and moral choices. This verse reminds you that true peace arises when you stop clinging to all efforts and simply rest in your natural freedom.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
विन्दति विन्दति न हि न हि यत्र छन्दोलक्षणं न हि न हि तत्र ।
समरसमग्नो भावितपूतः प्रलपति तत्त्वं परमवधूतः ॥
translation: परम अवधूत ( श्रेष्ठ संन्यासी) एकरस आत्मा में ही मग्न रहता है तथा पवित्र हुआ आत्म तत्व का ही कथन करता है। जिस चेतन ब्रह्म में छन्द और लक्षण नहीं है उसमें प्राप्त होता है।
english_translation: The supreme Avadhuta remains absorbed in the singular true self and speaks only of the pure essence, which is beyond all forms and qualities.
essence: The true self is pure, formless, and always present within you.
simple_meaning: The highest sage stays fully immersed in the one true self and speaks only about this pure, formless reality.
insight: It teaches you to recognize your identity beyond all changing qualities, resting in pure awareness alone.
modern_relevance: When your mind quiets, you realize your core is untouched by labels or moods—it’s a steady, pure presence.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
ॐ इति गदितं गगनसमं तत् न परापरसारविचार इति ।
अविलासविलासनिराकरणं कथमक्षरबिन्दुसमुच्चरणम् ॥
translation: ‘ॐ’ इस प्रकार जो उच्चारण किया जाता है वह आकाश तुल्य (व्यापक) है। वह पर और अपर (ब्रह्म) के सार का विचार नहीं है। उसमें जगत के विलास एवं अविलास का अभाव है। फिर अक्षर एवं बिन्दु रूप ‘ॐ’ शब्द का उच्चारण किस प्रकार हो सकता है।
english_translation: 'Om' as pronounced is vast like the sky; it is not a concept of the supreme reality beyond or within. It lacks all play and display of the world. How then can the sound 'Om' be formed from the imperishable point and letters?
essence: The ultimate reality is beyond all sounds, words, and concepts, including 'Om'.
simple_meaning: The true self is vast and beyond all forms, sounds, or concepts. The sacred sound 'Om' cannot fully express this limitless reality.
insight: It teaches you to release any attempt to define the ultimate through concepts or sounds, freeing your mind from limits.
modern_relevance: When you try to describe your deepest self in words, you find language falls short—this reveals how vast you truly are.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
इति तत्त्वमसिप्रभृतिश्रुतिभिः प्रतिपादितमात्मनि तत्त्वमसि ।
त्वमुपाधिविवर्जितसर्वसमं किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥
translation: इस प्रकार श्रुतियों ने जिस आत्मा को ‘तत्वमसि’ (यह तू ही हैं) कहकर प्रतिपादित किया है वह आत्मा तू ही हैं। इसलिए तू उपाधि से रहित सर्वत्र समरूप है। हे मन! तू सर्व में समान रूप है फिर किस वास्ते रूदन करता है।
english_translation: The self proclaimed as 'You are that' by scriptures is indeed you; free of all limiting conditions and equal everywhere. So why does your mind weep, when you are the same in all?
essence: Your true self is unlimited and equal everywhere; your mind’s sorrow is unfounded.
simple_meaning: You are the true self described as 'You are that' by scriptures, free from all limiting identities and equal everywhere. So your mind should not sorrow.
insight: It shifts your perspective from identifying with the restless mind to recognizing your limitless self beyond sorrow.
modern_relevance: When your mind feels overwhelmed or sorrowful, remember that your true self is untouched by those feelings and is the same everywhere.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
अध ऊर्ध्वविवर्जितसर्वसमं बहिरन्तरवर्जितसर्वसमम् ।
यदि चैकविवर्जितसर्वसमं किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥
translation: हे मन! तू ऊपर और नीचे से रहित सब में सम है, बाहर और भीतर से रहित सबमें सम है और यदि एक से रहित सब में सम है तो तू किस वास्ते रूदन करता है।
english_translation: O mind! You are equal in all, free from up and down, free from inside and outside, and if you are equal in all without even one, then why do you weep?
essence: The mind is already balanced beyond all opposites; sorrow lacks foundation.
simple_meaning: Your mind is naturally equal everywhere, above and below, inside and outside. If this is true, then why do you feel sorrow?
insight: It shifts your awareness to see that sorrow arises from false separations, helping you embrace your inherent wholeness.
modern_relevance: When emotions overwhelm you, remembering your natural balance can quiet your inner storms and reduce needless suffering.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
न हि कल्पितकल्पविचार इति न हि कारणकार्यविचार इति ।
पदसन्धिविवर्जितसर्वसमं किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥
translation: हे मन! तू न तो कल्पित है, न कल्प आदि विचार ही है, न तु कारण एवं कार्यरूपी विचार ही है। तेरे में पद एवं सन्धि भी नहीं है बल्कि सबमें सम ही है। फिर किस वास्ते रूदन करता है।
english_translation: O mind, you are neither imagined nor a product of imagination, nor a cause or effect; you are beyond all divisions and equal in everything. Why then do you weep?
essence: The mind is not fractured or caused; it is fundamentally whole and equal everywhere.
simple_meaning: Your mind is not a mere thought or cause-effect chain. It is undivided and equal everywhere. So why are you upset?
insight: It shifts your view from seeing the mind as fractured to recognizing its fundamental unity, calming inner conflict.
modern_relevance: When your thoughts spiral and you feel fragmented, remember your mind is whole beneath the chaos. There's no need to suffer over illusions.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
न हि बोधविबोधसमाधिरिति न हि देशविदेशसमाधिरिति ।
न हि कालविकालसमाधिरिति किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥
translation: हे मन! तू ज्ञान एवं अज्ञान रूपी समाधि नहीं है, न देश, विदेश एवं काल विकाल रूपी समाधि ही है। तू सर्वत्र समरूप है फिर किस वास्ते रूदन करता है।
english_translation: O mind! You are neither the state of knowledge nor ignorance, nor the union of place and time. You are the same everywhere; why then do you weep?
essence: Your true self is always equal and unchanged; the mind’s suffering is unnecessary.
simple_meaning: Your mind is neither knowledge nor ignorance, neither bound by place nor time. It is always the same everywhere, so there’s no reason to suffer or cry.
insight: It shifts your awareness from identifying with fluctuating thoughts and feelings to recognizing your unchanging true nature.
modern_relevance: When your thoughts swirl anxiously over changing situations or past mistakes, this verse reminds you that your true being is untouched by these shifts—and you can choose peace instead of pain.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
न हि कुम्भनभो न हि कुम्भ इति न हि जीववपुर्न हि जीव इति ।
न हि कारणकार्यविभाग इति किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥
translation: हे मन! न तो तू घटाकाश है न घट ही हैं, न तू जीव का शरीर है न जीव ही है, तेरे में कारण एवं कार्य का विभाग भी नहीं है फिर तू किस वास्ते रूदन करता है। तू सर्वत्र सम रूप है।
english_translation: O mind! You are neither the pot's space nor the pot; neither the living body nor the living being; there is no division of cause and effect in you. So why do you cry? You are equal everywhere.
essence: You are not divided parts but an equal, undivided whole beyond cause and effect.
simple_meaning: You are not the body or the mind, nor divided into cause and effect. You are equally whole everywhere. So, why do you suffer?
insight: It shifts your view from identifying with limited parts to recognizing your undivided, whole nature.
modern_relevance: When your thoughts spiral in blame or fear, remember you are not broken parts but a complete whole beyond cause and effect.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
इह सर्वनिरन्तरमोक्षपदं लघुदीर्घविचारविहीन इति ।
न हि वर्तुलकोणविभाग इति किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥
translation: यह आत्मा सर्व, एकरस एवं मोक्ष पद वाला है। यह लघु, दीर्घ आदि विचार से रहित है। इसमें गोल एवं कोण का विभाग भी नहीं है। फिर हे मन तू किस कारण से रूदन करता है। तू सर्वत्र समरूप हैं।
english_translation: This true self is all, uniform, and the state of freedom; it is beyond short or long thoughts. It has no divisions like circle or angle. So, mind, why do you weep? You are the same everywhere.
essence: The true self is completely uniform and free beyond all distinctions and thoughts.
simple_meaning: The true self is complete, unchanging, and beyond concepts like length or shape. It has no divisions or differences inside it. So the restless mind should not grieve.
insight: It shifts your perspective from seeing yourself as divided or limited to recognizing your essential wholeness without distinctions.
modern_relevance: When you feel fragmented or overwhelmed by worries and comparisons, this reminds you that your true self is uniform and unbroken beneath all thoughts.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
इह शून्यविशून्यविहीन इति इह शुद्धविशुद्धविहीन इति ।
इह सर्वविसर्वविहीन इति किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥
translation: इस (आत्मा) में शून्य एवं विशून्य विहीन, शुद्ध एवं विशुद्ध विहीन, सर्व एवं विसर्व विहीन आदि का व्यवहार नहीं होता है। हे मन! तू सर्व में सम है फिर किस वास्ते रूदन करता है।
english_translation: The true self is free from emptiness and fullness, purity and impurity, existence and non-existence; your mind is equal in all, so why do you weep?
essence: The true self is beyond all pairs of opposites, so the mind has no reason to suffer.
simple_meaning: The true self is beyond all dualities like empty or full, pure or impure, existent or nonexistent. Your mind is equal in everything, so it has no reason to cry.
insight: It teaches you to see your mind's fluctuations as separate from your true self, which stays steady beyond all dualities.
modern_relevance: When your thoughts swing between highs and lows, remember your true self is constant and untouched by these ups and downs.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
न हि भिन्नविभिन्नविचार इति बहिरन्तरसन्धिविचार इति ।
अरिमित्रविवर्जितसर्वसमं किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥
translation: इस (आत्मा) में भिन्न एवं विभिन्न का विचार भी नहीं हो सकता, बाहर, भीतर और सन्धि का विचार भी इसमें नहीं हो सकता। शुद्ध एवं मित्र से रहित यह सर्व में सम है। फिर हे मन! तू किस वास्ते रूदन करता है। तू सर्व में सम है।
english_translation: The true self has no distinctions or divisions, no inner or outer separations. It is pure, free from friends or enemies, and equal in all. So why does your mind weep? You are equal in everything.
essence: Your true self is undivided, equal everywhere, beyond all inner conflicts.
simple_meaning: Your true self is not split or divided; it has no inner or outer boundaries. It is pure and equal everywhere. So your mind need not suffer or cry.
insight: It shifts your view from identifying with the restless mind's divisions to recognizing your unchanging, equal true self.
modern_relevance: When your mind feels overwhelmed by conflicts and divisions, this reminds you that your true self is whole and equal beyond all that turmoil.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
न हि शिष्यविशिष्यस्वरूप इति न चराचरभेदविचार इति ।
इह सर्वनिरन्तरमोक्षपदं किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥
translation: यह आत्मा शिष्य एवं अशिष्य स्वरूप भी नहीं है, न इसमें चर एवं अचर जगत के भेद का विचार ही है। यह सर्वरूप, निरन्तर एवं मोक्ष पद वाला है. इसलिए हे मन! तू किस वास्ते रूदन करता है तू सर्व में सम आत्मा है।
english_translation: The true self is neither teacher nor student, nor is there a distinction between moving and non-moving; it is all-pervading, eternal, and the state of freedom. So why do you weep, mind? You are the self that is one with all.
essence: You are the undivided, eternal self in which all distinctions dissolve.
simple_meaning: You are not a separate learner or teacher, nor divided into moving or still; you are the unchanging freedom present everywhere. So do not grieve, because you are one with everything.
insight: It shifts the mind from feeling isolated to recognizing unity with all existence.
modern_relevance: When anxiety overwhelms you, remember you are not separate or fragmented but completely whole and free within.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
ननु रूपविरूपविहीन इति ननु भिन्नविभिन्नविहीन इति ।
ननु सर्गविसर्गविहीन इति किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥
translation: निश्चय ही यह (आत्मा) रूप एवं विरूप से विहीन हैं, निश्चय ही यह भिन्न एवं विभिन्न रूपों से विहीन है, निश्चय ही यह उत्पत्ति एवं प्रलय से भी रहित है फिर हे मन! तू किस वास्ते रूदन करता है। तू आत्मरूप होने से सर्व में सम है।
english_translation: The true self is certainly free from form and formlessness, free from difference and diversity, free from creation and dissolution—why then does the mind cry? It is the same in all.
essence: You are the unchanging self, present equally in all, beyond all forms and changes.
simple_meaning: You are the true self that never changes, is beyond all forms, differences, creation, or destruction. So your mind need not suffer or cry.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that your essential nature remains steady despite mental turmoil, reducing suffering.
modern_relevance: When your worries and fears overwhelm you, remember that your true being is unchanging and present everywhere, untouched by shifting life circumstances.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
न गुणागुणपाशनिबन्ध इति मृतजीवनकर्म करोमि कथम् ।
इति शुद्धनिरञ्जनसर्वसमं किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥
translation: गुण एवं निर्गुण के पाश का बन्धन उसमें ( आत्मा से) नहीं है इसलिए वह मृत एवं जीवन के कर्म किस प्रकार करता है। वह शुद्ध, निर्दोष, सर्वरूप एवं सम है फिर हे मन! तू किस कारण से रूदन करता है। तू वही आत्मा है जो सर्व में सम है।
english_translation: The true self is not bound by qualities or their absence, so how can it perform the deeds of death and life? It is pure, spotless, and equal in all forms; why then does your mind weep? You are that self, present in all.
essence: The true self is untouched by qualities and beyond all sorrow.
simple_meaning: You are not tied to qualities or their opposites, so you don't truly act in life or death. You are pure and equal in everything. Your mind’s sorrow is unnecessary.
insight: It teaches you to see sorrow as a product of the restless mind, not the pure self, helping you detach from emotional pain.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by ups and downs or personal failures, remember your true self is untouched and equal in all situations.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
इह भावविभावविहीन इति इह कामविकामविहीन इति ।
इह बोधतमं खलु मोक्षसमं किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥
translation: यह आत्मा भाव एवं विभाव से रहित हैं, यह काम एवं विकाम से रहित है। यह ज्ञान स्वरूप एवं निश्चय ही मोक्ष स्वरूप हैं इसलिए हे मन! तू किस कारण से रूदन करता है, तू सर्व में सम है।
english_translation: The true self is without emotions or their opposites, without desire or aversion. It is knowledge itself and truly the state of freedom. So, O mind, why do you cry? You are one with everything.
essence: Your true self is untouched by emotions and desires and is one with all.
simple_meaning: Your true self is beyond all emotions, desires, and opposites. It is pure knowledge and true freedom. So your mind need not suffer or cry.
insight: It shifts your view from identifying with transient emotions to recognizing your unchanging true nature.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by mood swings or cravings, remember your deeper self is steady and beyond these changes.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
इह तत्त्वनिरन्तरतत्त्वमिति न हि सन्धिविसन्धिविहीन इति ।
यदि सर्वविवर्जितसर्वसमं किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥
translation: इसमें (आत्मा में) तत्व अथवा नित्य तत्व का व्यवहार नहीं हैं, न ही इसमें सन्धि और विसन्धि विहीन का विचार ही है। यदि यह सर्व से रहित सर्व में सम है तो फिर हे मन! तू किस कारण से रूदन करता है। तू आत्मा होने से सर्व में सम हैं।
english_translation: The true self has no constant or changing parts, no junctions or separations; if it is complete beyond all, why does your mind weep?
essence: Your true self is whole and unchanged; your mind’s sorrow is unfounded.
simple_meaning: The true self is unchanging and undivided; if you are complete, your restless mind should not grieve.
insight: It teaches you to notice the contrast between the mind’s sorrow and the unbroken completeness of your true self, encouraging detachment from mental suffering.
modern_relevance: After a long day filled with stress and conflict, the restless mind still feels upset, yet deep down, your essential self remains whole and untouched.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
अनिकेतकुटी परिवारसमं इहसङ्गविसङ्गविहीनपरम् ।
इह बोधविबोधविहीनपरं किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥
translation: एकान्त कुटी में रहे अथवा परिवार में रहे सब समान है क्योंकि वह (आत्मा) संग एवं विसंग से रहित है। वह ज्ञान एवं अज्ञान से भी रहित है तथा वही श्रेष्ठ है फिर हे मन! तू किस कारण रूदन करता है। तू वही आत्मा है जो सर्व में सम है।
english_translation: Whether living alone in a hut or within a family, all is the same because the inner being is free from attachment and aversion. It is beyond knowledge and ignorance and is supreme; so why do you grieve, mind? You are the true self present in all.
essence: Your true self is beyond all attachments and is equally present everywhere.
simple_meaning: Your true self does not depend on being alone or with others; it is beyond attachments, knowledge, and ignorance. So, your mind need not grieve.
insight: This verse shifts your perspective from outer conditions to the unchanging self, easing emotional turmoil caused by attachments or aversions.
modern_relevance: When you feel restless or overwhelmed by relationships or isolation, remember your true self remains steady and whole beyond these feelings.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
अविकारविकारमसत्यमिति अविलक्षविलक्षमसत्यमिति ।
यदि केवलमात्मनि सत्यमिति किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥
translation: अविकार आत्मा का यह विकार युक्त जगत है यह असत्य है। जो अदृश्य है उसका यह दृश्य जगत असत्य है। जबकि केवल आत्मा ही सत्य रूप है इस लिये हे मन! तू किस कारण से रूदन करता है। तू आत्मा होने से सर्व में सम है।
english_translation: The world of change is false; the changeless self is real. The visible is untrue; only the true self is real. So, mind, why do you grieve? You are equal with all as the true self.
essence: You are the unchanging true self beyond the false world of change and sorrow.
simple_meaning: The changing world around you is not real; only the unchanging true self is real. Your mind is equal with all through this true self, so there is no need to grieve.
insight: Shift your perspective from identifying with change to recognizing your unchanging true self beyond appearances.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by constant change and loss, remembering your true self is unchanging can bring calm and relief.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
इह सर्वसमं खलु जीव इति इह सर्वनिरन्तरजीव इति ।
इह केवलनिश्चलजीव इति किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥
translation: इस संसार में निश्चय करके जीव ही सर्व एवं सम हैं, इस संसार में निश्चल केवल जीव ही है। हे मन! तू किस कारण से रूदन करता है। तू सर्व में सम हैं।
english_translation: In this world, certainly, the living being is the same in all; in this world, the living being alone is unchanging. O mind, why do you weep? You are the same in all.
essence: You are the same unchanging being present equally in all things.
simple_meaning: Your true self is the same unchanging presence in everyone and everything; the mind’s sorrow is unfounded.
insight: It shifts your view from separation and suffering to recognizing your shared, constant essence.
modern_relevance: When you feel isolated or upset, remember your true nature is the same as everyone else’s—unchanging and whole.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
अविवेकविवेकमबोध इति अविकल्पविकल्पमबोध इति ।
यदि चैकनिरन्तरबोध इति किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥
translation: अविवेक और विवेक दोनों अज्ञान है, अविकल्प और विकल्प भी अज्ञान हैं यदि वही एक नित्य बोध है। फिर हे मन! तू किस कारण से रूदन करता है। तू सर्व में सम है।
english_translation: Both ignorance and discernment are ignorance; both choice and non-choice are ignorance. If constant oneness-awareness is present, then why does your mind weep? It is equal in everything.
essence: True awareness is beyond all choices and confusions; your mind is already whole in everything.
simple_meaning: Both lack of discernment and discernment itself are forms of confusion. True constant awareness is beyond all choices. Your mind is already equal in everything, so there is no need to weep.
insight: This shifts your view from valuing mental distinctions to recognizing underlying unity beyond all dualities.
modern_relevance: When your mind is overwhelmed by indecision or doubt, remember that these are just mental states, not your true self.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
न हि मोक्षपदं न हि बन्धपदं न हि पुण्यपदं न हि पापपदम् ।
न हि पूर्णपदं न हि रिक्तपदं किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥
translation: न मोक्ष पद, न बन्ध पद है, न पुण्य पद है, न पाप पद है, न पूर्ण पद है, न रिक्त पद है। हे मन! तू सर्व में सम है फिर किस कारण से रूदन करता है।
english_translation: There is no state of liberation, no state of bondage, no state of merit, no state of fault, no state of fullness, no state of emptiness. O mind, you are equal in all; why then do you weep?
essence: All states are illusions; your true self remains equal and untouched.
simple_meaning: There is no real difference between liberation, bondage, merit, fault, fullness, or emptiness. Your mind is always the same everywhere, so there is no reason to suffer or cry.
insight: It shifts your awareness from identifying with changing conditions to recognizing your unchanging, equal nature beyond them.
modern_relevance: When your emotions swing wildly between success and failure, this verse reminds you that your true self is untouched by those ups and downs.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
यदि वर्णविवर्णविहीनसमं यदि कारणकार्यविहीनसमम् ।
यदिभेदविभेदविहीनसमं किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥
translation: यदि यह आत्मा वर्ण एवं विवर्ण से रहित और सम है, यदि यह कारण एवं कार्य से रहित और सम है, यदि यह भेद और विभेद से रहित और सम है तो हे मन! तू किस कारण से रूदन करता है। तू आत्मा होने से सर्व में सम है।
english_translation: If the true self is without color or colorlessness, without cause or effect, without difference or distinction, then why do you, mind, weep? The true self is equal in all.
essence: The true self is equal in all; the mind’s sorrow is without cause.
simple_meaning: Your true self is beyond all distinctions like color, cause, and effect. It is equal and whole everywhere, so your mind has no reason to suffer.
insight: This verse shifts your attention from the mind’s divisions to the equal, undivided nature of your true self.
modern_relevance: When you feel upset about differences or causes beyond your control, remember your true self is unchanged and equal everywhere.
speaker: Dattatreya

verse_text:
इह सर्वनिरन्तरसर्वचिते इह केवलनिश्चलसर्वचिते ।
द्विपदादिविवर्जितसर्वचिते किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥
