english_translation: I see you wearing a crown, holding a mace and discus, blazing everywhere, hard to behold, and immeasurable — like fire and the sun in brilliance.
essence: What is most real cannot be fully held by sight.
simple_meaning: Arjuna sees Krishna in a radiant cosmic form, crowned and armed, blazing like fire and the sun, impossible to measure or fully look at.
insight: It shifts the mind from trying to grasp the whole picture to yielding before what exceeds comprehension.
modern_relevance: You stand before a decision that strips away all comfort: the relationship, the job, the truth you have avoided. Suddenly the situation feels larger than your plans, and your control looks small.
speaker: Arjuna

verse_text: त्वमक्षरं परमं वेदितव्यंत्वमस्य विश्वस्य परं निधानम् । त्वमव्ययः शाश्वतधर्मगोप्तासनातनस्त्वं पुरुषो मतो मे ॥
translation: आप ही जाननेयोग्य परम अक्षर अक्षरब्रह्म हैं, आप ही इस सम्पूर्ण विश्वके परम आश्रय हैं, आप ही सनातनधर्मके रक्षक हैं और आप ही अविनाशी सनातन पुरुष हैं  ऐसा मैं मानता हूँ ॥
english_translation: You are the imperishable supreme reality, the highest support of this world, the guardian of eternal dharma, and the eternal person.
essence: What appears overwhelming is actually the world’s deepest support.
simple_meaning: Arjuna recognizes Krishna as the highest imperishable reality, the universe's support, the protector of eternal dharma, and the eternal person.
insight: It shifts the mind from seeing power as force to seeing it as the ground that holds all order.
modern_relevance: You stand before a decision that could reshape your life, and the usual markers fail. In that moment, the mind reaches for something unshakable to trust.
speaker: Arjuna

verse_text: अनादिमध्यान्तमनन्तवीर्यमनन्तबाहुं शशिसूर्यनेत्रम् । पश्यामि त्वां दीप्तहुताशवक्त्रम्स्वतेजसा विश्वमिदं तपन्तम् ॥
translation: आपको मैं आदि, मध्य और अन्तसे रहित, अनन्त प्रभावशाली, अनन्त भुजाओंवाले, चन्द्र और सूर्यरूप नेत्रोवाले, प्रज्वलित अग्निके समान मुखोंवाले और अपने तेजसे संसारको संतप्त करते हुए देख रहा हूँ ॥
english_translation: I see you as beginningless, middleless, and endless; of infinite power, with infinite arms, with eyes like the moon and the sun, with mouths blazing like fire, and scorching this world with your own radiance.
essence: What overwhelms the mind can also dissolve its resistance.
simple_meaning: Arjuna sees Krishna as beyond beginning, middle, and end, with limitless power and terrifying cosmic features that burn the world with their own brilliance.
insight: It shifts the mind from trying to control reality to yielding before what exceeds it.
modern_relevance: You finally face the truth you kept avoiding, and it is bigger than your fear. The mind cannot contain it; only surrender can.
speaker: Arjuna

verse_text: द्यावापृथिव्योरिदमन्तरं हिव्याप्तं त्वयैकेन दिशश्च सर्वाः । दृष्ट्वाऽद्भुतं रूपमुग्रं तवेदंलोकत्रयं प्रव्यथितं महात्मन् ॥
translation: हे महात्मन्  यह स्वर्ग और पृथ्वीके बीचका अन्तराल और सम्पूर्ण दिशाएँ एक आपसे ही परिपूर्ण हैं ।  आपके इस अद्भुत और उग्ररूपको देखकर तीनों लोक व्यथित व्याकुल हो रहे हैं ॥
english_translation: The space between heaven and earth and all directions are filled by You alone. Seeing Your wondrous and fierce form, the three worlds tremble, O great one.
essence: One vision can overwhelm every boundary you thought was real.
simple_meaning: Arjuna sees that Krishna fills every direction and every space. The sight of Krishna's vast and fierce form makes all three worlds tremble.
insight: It shifts the mind from seeing reality as manageable to seeing it as vast, living, and beyond personal control.
modern_relevance: You open a message expecting a normal reply, and instead you see the full weight of what you’re dealing with. The room, the plan, the future — everything suddenly feels larger than your control.
speaker: Arjuna

verse_text: अमी हि त्वां सुरसङ्घाः विशन्तिकेचिद्भीताः प्राञ्जलयो गृणन्ति । स्वस्तीत्युक्त्वा महर्षिसिद्धसङ्घाःस्तुवन्ति त्वां स्तुतिभिः पुष्कलाभिः ॥
translation: वे ही देवताओंके समुदाय आपमें प्रविष्ट हो रहे हैं ।  उनमेंसे कई तो भयभीत होकर हाथ जोड़े हुए आपके नामों और गुणोंका कीर्तन कर रहे हैं ।  महर्षियों और सिद्धोंके समुदाय कल्याण हो  मङ्गल हो  ऐसा कहकर उत्तमउत्तम स्तोत्रोंके द्वारा आपकी स्तुति कर रहे हैं ॥
english_translation: The hosts of the radiant beings enter into you. Some, frightened, join their palms and sing your names and qualities. Great seers and perfected beings praise you with abundant hymns, saying, “May all be well.”
essence: Even the highest beings bow when the vast form appears.
simple_meaning: Even the radiant beings are drawn into Krishna’s cosmic form. Some are afraid and pray, while seers and perfected beings praise him with rich hymns.
insight: It shifts attention from human rank to cosmic reverence, showing that even greatness bows before what is vast.
modern_relevance: You open a message that changes everything, and the room goes quiet. Some people panic, some bow their heads, and the ones with wisdom respond with respect.
speaker: Arjuna

verse_text: रुद्रादित्या वसवो ये च साध्याविश्वेऽश्िवनौ मरुतश्चोष्मपाश्च । गन्धर्वयक्षासुरसिद्धसङ्घावीक्षन्ते त्वां विस्मिताश्चैव सर्वे ॥
translation: जो ग्यारह रुद्र, बारह आदित्य, आठ वसु, बारह साध्यगण, दस विश्वेदेव और दो अश्विनीकुमार, उनचास मरुद्गण, सात पितृगण तथा गन्धर्व, यक्ष, असुर और सिद्धोंके समुदाय हैं, वे सभी चकित होकर आपको देख रहे हैं ॥
english_translation: The eleven Rudras, the twelve Adityas, the eight Vasus, the twelve Sadhyas, the Visvedevas, the two Ashvins, the forty-nine Maruts, the ancestors, and the hosts of Gandharvas, Yakshas, Asuras, and Siddhas all gaze at you in wonder.
essence: Even the highest beings stand astonished before Krishna's vastness.
simple_meaning: Arjuna says that every class of celestial and powerful beings is astonished and looking at Krishna's cosmic form.
insight: It shifts attention from human rank to the overwhelming scale of the divine presence.
modern_relevance: You walk into a room and realize the whole hierarchy has gone quiet. The moment is bigger than anyone's status, and everyone can feel it.
speaker: Arjuna

verse_text: रूपं महत्ते बहुवक्त्रनेत्रंमहाबाहो बहुबाहूरुपादम् । बहूदरं बहुदंष्ट्राकरालंदृष्ट्वा लोकाः प्रव्यथितास्तथाऽहम् ॥
translation: हे महाबाहो आपके बहुत मुखों और नेत्रोंवाले, बहुत भुजाओं, जंघाओं और चरणोंवाले, बहुत उदरोंवाले, बहुत विकराल दाढ़ोंवाले महान् रूपको देखकर सब प्राणी व्यथित हो रहे हैं तथा मैं भी व्यथित हो रहा हूँ ॥
english_translation: O mighty-armed one, seeing your great form with many mouths and eyes, many arms, thighs, and feet, many bellies, and terrible fangs, all beings are shaken, and so am I.
essence: A vision of total vastness can shake every observer at once.
simple_meaning: Arjuna sees Krishna’s cosmic form and feels overwhelmed. The sight shakes not only him, but all beings around him.
insight: It captures the mind’s shock when confronted with something larger than its frame of reference.
modern_relevance: You open a message expecting clarity, and instead one sentence changes the whole room inside you. Some revelations do not comfort first; they overwhelm before they reveal.
speaker: Arjuna

verse_text: नभःस्पृशं दीप्तमनेकवर्णंव्यात्ताननं दीप्तविशालनेत्रम् । दृष्ट्वा हि त्वां प्रव्यथितान्तरात्माधृतिं न विन्दामि शमं च विष्णो ॥
translation: हे विष्णो  आपके अनेक देदीप्यमान वर्ण हैं, आप आकाशको स्पर्श कर रहे हैं, आपका मुख फैला हुआ है आपके नेत्र प्रदीप्त और विशाल हैं ।  ऐसे आपको देखकर भयभीत अन्तःकरणवाला मैं धैर्य और शान्तिको प्राप्त नहीं हो रहा हूँ ॥
english_translation: O Vishnu, seeing you touching the sky, blazing with many colors, with mouths spread wide and bright, vast eyes, my inner being is shaken. I cannot find steadiness or peace.
essence: A true vision can shatter the mind before it can steady it.
simple_meaning: Arjuna is overwhelmed by Krishna's cosmic form. The sight shakes his inner being so deeply that he cannot find calm or steadiness.
insight: It shifts the reader from trying to master the sacred to admitting helplessness before it.
modern_relevance: You open a message and realize the decision in front of you is bigger than you wanted. The old confidence drops away, and all you can feel is the weight of it.
speaker: Arjuna

verse_text: दंष्ट्राकरालानि च ते मुखानिदृष्ट्वैव कालानलसन्निभानि । दिशो न जाने न लभे च शर्मप्रसीद देवेश जगन्निवास ॥
translation: आपके प्रलयकालकी अग्निके समान प्रज्वलित और दाढ़ोंके कारण विकराल भयानक मुखोंको देखकर मुझे न तो दिशाओंका ज्ञान हो रहा है और न शान्ति ही मिल रही है ।  इसलिये हे देवेश  हे जगन्निवास  आप प्रसन्न होइये ॥
english_translation: Seeing your flaming, terrible mouths with their fangs, I can no longer find directions or peace. Be gracious, Lord of the divine beings, dwelling place of the world.
essence: True awe ends control and turns the heart toward surrender.
simple_meaning: Arjuna is overwhelmed by Krishna's terrifying cosmic form. He cannot orient himself or find peace, and he begs Krishna to soften and show mercy.
insight: It shifts the mind from control to surrender when the scale of reality becomes too large to manage.
modern_relevance: You open a message and realize your words have already changed everything. For a second, you cannot tell what to do next. That stunned silence is where this verse lives.
speaker: Arjuna

verse_text: अमी च त्वां धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्राःसर्वे सहैवावनिपालसङ्घैः । भीष्मो द्रोणः सूतपुत्रस्तथाऽसौसहास्मदीयैरपि योधमुख्यैः ॥
translation: हमारे मुख्य योद्धाओंके सहित भीष्म, द्रोण और वह कर्ण भी आपमें प्रविष्ट हो रहे हैं ।  राजाओंके समुदायोंके सहित धृतराष्ट्रके वे ही सबकेसब पुत्र आपके विकराल दाढ़ोंके कारण भयंकर मुखोंमें बड़ी तेजीसे प्रविष्ट हो रहे हैं ।  उनमेंसे कईएक तो चूर्ण हुए सिरोंसहित आपके दाँतोंके बीचमें फँसे हुए दीख रहे हैं ॥
english_translation: Bhishma, Drona, Karna, and all the sons of Dhritarashtra, along with the hosts of kings and our own chief warriors, are rushing into your fearful mouths. Some are seen caught between your teeth, with crushed heads.
essence: Even the greatest warriors are swallowed by what exceeds them.
simple_meaning: Arjuna sees the great warriors and kings being pulled into Krishna's terrible cosmic mouth, where some are crushed between the teeth.
insight: It shifts the mind from seeing events as manageable to seeing them as forces larger than personal control.
modern_relevance: You watch a situation collapse faster than anyone can stop it: a breakup, a lawsuit, a family conflict. Suddenly, all the planning looks tiny beside what is already in motion.
speaker: Arjuna

verse_text: वक्त्राणि ते त्वरमाणा विशन्तिदंष्ट्राकरालानि भयानकानि । केचिद्विलग्ना दशनान्तरेषुसंदृश्यन्ते चूर्णितैरुत्तमाङ्गैः ॥
translation: हमारे मुख्य योद्धाओंके सहित भीष्म, द्रोण और वह कर्ण भी आपमें प्रविष्ट हो रहे हैं ।  राजाओंके समुदायोंके सहित धृतराष्ट्रके वे ही सबकेसब पुत्र आपके विकराल दाढ़ोंके कारण भयंकर मुखोंमें बड़ी तेजीसे प्रविष्ट हो रहे हैं ।  उनमेंसे कईएक तो चूर्ण हुए सिरोंसहित आपके दाँतोंके बीचमें फँसे हुए दीख रहे हैं ॥
english_translation: Your blazing, terrible mouths swallow them in haste. Some are seen caught between your teeth, with crushed heads.
essence: All fighters are already being consumed by time.
simple_meaning: Arjuna sees warriors rushing into Krishna's terrible mouths. Some are trapped between the teeth, with their heads crushed.
insight: It shifts perception from human struggle to irreversible cosmic force.
modern_relevance: You watch a decision spiral past the point of return: the argument, the breakup, the resignation letter already in motion. What looked controllable is already closing its jaws.
speaker: Arjuna

verse_text: यथा नदीनां बहवोऽम्बुवेगाःसमुद्रमेवाभिमुखाः द्रवन्ति । तथा तवामी नरलोकवीराविशन्ति वक्त्राण्यभिविज्वलन्ति ॥
translation: जैसे नदियोंके बहुतसे जलके प्रवाह स्वाभाविक ही समुद्रके सम्मुख दौड़ते हैं, ऐसे ही वे संसारके महान् शूरवीर आपके प्रज्वलित मुखोंमें प्रवेश कर रहे हैं ॥
english_translation: As many streams of water rush naturally toward the sea, so these great warriors of the world enter your blazing mouths.
essence: All motion is already rushing toward its end.
simple_meaning: The great warriors are rushing into Krishna’s blazing mouths just as rivers rush toward the sea.
insight: It shifts the mind from resistance to recognition of inevitability.
modern_relevance: You watch a situation swallow everything you hoped to control: a breakup, a resignation, a diagnosis. Some forces do not negotiate; they carry everything toward their end.
speaker: Arjuna

verse_text: यथा प्रदीप्तं ज्वलनं पतङ्गाविशन्ति नाशाय समृद्धवेगाः । तथैव नाशाय विशन्ति लोकास्तवापि वक्त्राणि समृद्धवेगाः ॥
translation: जैसे पतंगे मोहवश अपना नाश करनेके लिये बड़े वेगसे दौड़ते हुए प्रज्वलित अग्निमें प्रविष्ट होते हैं, ऐसे ही ये सब लोग भी मोहवश अपना नाश करनेके लिये बड़े वेगसे दौड़ते हुए आपके मुखोंमें प्रविष्ट हो रहे हैं ॥
english_translation: As moths rush with great speed into a blazing fire to their destruction, so these people rush with great speed into your mouths to their destruction.
essence: Blind desire runs straight into its own ruin.
simple_meaning: Arjuna sees people rushing helplessly into Krishna's blazing mouths, like moths flying into fire and destroying themselves.
insight: It shifts the mind from seeing destruction as accidental to seeing how blindness can carry people straight into it.
modern_relevance: You keep walking toward the thing you know will burn you: a toxic relationship, a lie you can no longer sustain, a choice that feels inevitable and wrong.
speaker: Arjuna

verse_text: लेलिह्यसे ग्रसमानः समन्ताल्लोकान्समग्रान्वदनैर्ज्वलद्भिः । तेजोभिरापूर्य जगत्समग्रंभासस्तवोग्राः प्रतपन्ति विष्णो ॥
translation: आप अपने प्रज्वलित मुखोंद्वारा सम्पूर्ण लोकोंका ग्रसन करते हुए उन्हें चारों ओरसे बारबार चाट रहे हैं और हे विष्णो  आपका उग्र प्रकाश अपने तेजसे सम्पूर्ण जगत् को परिपूर्ण करके सबको तपा रहा है ॥
english_translation: You lick up all the worlds from every side with your blazing mouths. Your fierce radiance fills the whole universe and burns it, O Vishnu.
essence: Total power leaves no room for control.
simple_meaning: Arjuna sees the cosmic form as all-consuming and unbearable. The blazing mouths and fierce radiance show that this vision is not gentle, but overwhelming and world-devouring.
insight: It shifts the mind from trying to manage the vast to yielding before it.
modern_relevance: You open a message and realize a decision has already outgrown your comfort. The situation is no longer negotiable, only larger than your fear.
speaker: Arjuna

verse_text: आख्याहि मे को भवानुग्ररूपोनमोऽस्तु ते देववर प्रसीद । विज्ञातुमिच्छामि भवन्तमाद्यंन हि प्रजानामि तव प्रवृत्तिम् ॥
translation: मुझे यह बताइये कि उग्ररूपवाले आप कौन हैं हे देवताओंमें श्रेष्ठ  आपको नमस्कार हो ।  आप प्रसन्न होइये ।  आदिरूप आपको मैं तत्त्वसे जानना चाहता हूँ क्योंकि मैं आपकी प्रवृत्तिको नहीं जानता ॥
english_translation: Tell me who You are in this fierce form. Salutations to You, best of the radiant beings; be gracious. I wish to know You, the primal one, for I do not understand Your purpose.
essence: Fear bows first, then asks to know what stands before it.
simple_meaning: Arjuna bows in fear and asks Krishna to reveal who this terrible form is. He wants to understand the primal source behind the overwhelming vision.
insight: It shifts the mind from panic to reverent inquiry before judgment.
modern_relevance: You are staring at a message that changes everything, and your first reaction is fear. Before you can act, you have to ask the honest question: what is really happening here?
speaker: Arjuna

verse_text: श्री भगवानुवाचकालोऽस्मि लोकक्षयकृत्प्रवृद्धोलोकान्समाहर्तुमिह प्रवृत्तः । ऋतेऽपि त्वां न भविष्यन्ति सर्वेयेऽवस्थिताः प्रत्यनीकेषु योधाः ॥
translation: श्रीभगवान् बोले  मैं सम्पूर्ण लोकोंका क्षय करनेवाला बढ़ा हुआ काल हूँ और इस समय मैं इन सब लोगोंका संहार करनेके लिये यहाँ आया हूँ ।  तुम्हारे प्रतिपक्षमें जो योद्धालोग खड़े हैं, वे सब तुम्हारे युद्ध किये बिना भी नहीं रहेंगे ॥
english_translation: The Blessed Lord said: I am Time, the great destroyer of worlds, here to end all beings. Even without you, the warriors standing in the opposing ranks will not survive.
essence: What is ending was never in your hands to preserve.
simple_meaning: Krishna reveals that the force of ending is already at work. Arjuna is not being asked to cause death; he is being asked to take part in a battle whose outcome is already decided.
insight: It shifts the mind from personal control to humble participation in a larger order.
modern_relevance: You are standing outside a hospital room, about to hear news that will change everything. The moment has already moved beyond your control, and the only honest task left is to face it without pretending otherwise.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: तस्मात्त्वमुत्तिष्ठ यशो लभस्वजित्वा शत्रून् भुङ्क्ष्व राज्यं समृद्धम् । मयैवैते निहताः पूर्वमेवनिमित्तमात्रं भव सव्यसाचिन् ॥
translation: इसलिये तुम युद्धके लिये खड़े हो जाओ और यशको प्राप्त करो तथा शत्रुओंको जीतकर धनधान्यसे सम्पन्न राज्यको भोगो ।  ये सभी मेरे द्वारा पहलेसे ही मारे हुए हैं ।  हे सव्यसाचिन्  तुम निमित्तमात्र बन जाओ ॥
english_translation: Therefore, rise and win fame. Conquer your enemies and enjoy a prosperous kingdom. They have already been slain by me; become only the instrument, Arjuna.
essence: Act fully, but let the larger order carry the result.
simple_meaning: Krishna tells Arjuna to stand up, fight, and claim the kingdom, but without ego. The enemies are already defeated in the larger order; Arjuna must only act as the instrument.
insight: It shifts action from self-importance to right participation in what is already unfolding.
modern_relevance: You’re about to send the message that will change a family forever, and your hands shake. This verse says: do the necessary act cleanly, without pretending you control everything it will unleash.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: द्रोणं च भीष्मं च जयद्रथं चकर्णं तथाऽन्यानपि योधवीरान् । मया हतांस्त्वं जहि मा व्यथिष्ठायुध्यस्व जेतासि रणे सपत्नान् ॥
translation: द्रोण, भीष्म, जयद्रथ और कर्ण तथा अन्य सभी मेरे द्वारा मारे हुए शूरवीरोंको तुम मारो ।  तुम व्यथा मत करो और युद्ध करो ।  युद्धमें तुम निःसन्देह वैरियोंको जीतोगे ॥
english_translation: Drona, Bhishma, Jayadratha, Karna, and the other great warriors have already been slain by Me. Do not falter; fight, and you will surely conquer your enemies in battle.
essence: The battle is already decided; your task is only to act.
simple_meaning: Krishna tells Arjuna that the great warriors are already defeated in the larger order of events. Arjuna should stop trembling, keep fighting, and trust that victory is already assured.
insight: It shifts action from personal doubt to trust in a larger order already at work.
modern_relevance: You are about to send the message, end the relationship, or walk into the hearing that changes everything. The body shakes, but the decision is already made.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: सञ्जय उवाचएतच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं केशवस्यकृताञ्जलिर्वेपमानः किरीटी । नमस्कृत्वा भूय एवाह कृष्णंसगद्गदं भीतभीतः प्रणम्य ॥
translation: सञ्जय बोले  भगवान् केशवका यह वचन सुनकर भयसे कम्पित हुए किरीटी अर्जुन हाथ जोड़कर नमस्कार करके और अत्यन्त भयभीत होकर फिर प्रणाम करके गद्गदं वाणीसे भगवान् कृष्णसे बोले ॥
english_translation: Sanjaya said: Hearing Krishna's words, Arjuna trembled, folded his hands, bowed again and again, and spoke to Krishna in a choked voice, filled with fear.
essence: Awe can break speech before it becomes prayer.
simple_meaning: Arjuna is overwhelmed by Krishna's cosmic revelation. He trembles, bows, and can only speak with fear.
insight: It shows the collapse of ego before overwhelming reality, setting up Arjuna's prayer of awe.
modern_relevance: You hear a truth that strips away your excuses. Your mouth goes dry, your body tightens, and all you can do is bow to what is real.
speaker: Sanjaya

verse_text: अर्जुन उवाचस्थाने हृषीकेश तव प्रकीर्त्याजगत् प्रहृष्यत्यनुरज्यते च । रक्षांसि भीतानि दिशो द्रवन्तिसर्वे नमस्यन्ति च सिद्धसङ्घाः ॥
translation: अर्जुन बोले  हे अन्तर्यामी भगवन्  आपके नाम, गुण, लीलाका कीर्तन करनेसे यह सम्पूर्ण जगत् हर्षित हो रहा है और अनुरागप्रेम को प्राप्त हो रहा है ।  आपके नाम, गुण आदिके कीर्तनसे भयभीत होकर राक्षसलोग दसों दिशाओंमें भागते हुए जा रहे हैं और सम्पूर्ण सिद्धगण आपको नमस्कार कर रहे हैं ।  यह सब होना उचित ही है ॥
english_translation: Arjuna said: O Hrishikesha, by chanting Your names and glories, the whole world rejoices and becomes devoted. By that chanting, frightened beings flee in all directions, and all the perfected ones bow to You. This is only fitting.
essence: The divine name can turn fear into devotion and disorder into reverence.
simple_meaning: Arjuna says that praising Krishna fills the world with joy and love, drives fearful forces away, and makes perfected beings bow in respect.
insight: It shifts attention from fear to reverence, showing that praise can reorder experience.
modern_relevance: You walk into a room where fear has spread through everyone, and one steady voice names what is true. The tension shifts at once; panic loses its grip.
speaker: Arjuna

verse_text: कस्माच्च ते न नमेरन्महात्मन्गरीयसे ब्रह्मणोऽप्यादिकर्त्रे । अनन्त देवेश जगन्निवासत्वमक्षरं सदसत्तत्परं यत् ॥
translation: हे महात्मन्  गुरुओंके भी गुरु और ब्रह्माके भी आदिकर्ता आपके लिये वे सिद्धगण नमस्कार क्यों नहीं करें क्योंकि हे अनन्त  हे देवेश  हे जगन्निवास  आप अक्षरस्वरूप हैं आप सत् भी हैं, असत् भी हैं, और सत्असत् से पर भी जो कुछ है, वह भी आप ही हैं ॥
english_translation: O great one, why would the perfected beings not bow to you, the greatest teacher, the first maker even of Brahma? Endless Lord of radiant beings, abode of the world, you are the imperishable, the real and the unreal, and beyond both.
essence: What exceeds all categories naturally draws surrender.
simple_meaning: Arjuna asks why anyone would not bow to Krishna, who is greater than even Brahma and beyond all categories of existence and nonexistence.
insight: It shifts the mind from naming reality to bowing before what exceeds every name.
modern_relevance: You stand before a truth that breaks your categories — a diagnosis, a betrayal, a calling you cannot ignore. The mind reaches for labels and fails; reverence begins where certainty ends.
speaker: Arjuna

verse_text: त्वमादिदेवः पुरुषः पुराणस्त्वमस्य विश्वस्य परं निधानम् । वेत्तासि वेद्यं च परं च धामत्वया ततं विश्वमनन्तरूप ॥
translation: आप ही आदिदेव और पुराणपुरुष हैं तथा आप ही इस संसारके परम आश्रय हैं ।  आप ही सबको जाननेवाले, जाननेयोग्य और परमधाम हैं ।  हे अनन्तरूप  आपसे ही सम्पूर्ण संसार व्याप्त है ॥
english_translation: You are the first divine presence, the ancient person, the supreme refuge of this universe. You are the knower, the knowable, and the highest abode. O infinite one, the whole world is pervaded by you.
essence: The one you seek is the ground that already holds everything.
simple_meaning: Arjuna sees Krishna as the first source, the ancient being, the highest refuge, and the one who pervades everything. Krishna is both the knower and the known.
insight: It shifts devotion from admiration to recognition: the sacred is not elsewhere, but already permeating all experience.
modern_relevance: You stand before a decision that could change your life, and the room feels too small for it. This verse speaks to the moment when you realise the thing you seek is also what holds the whole scene together.
speaker: Arjuna

verse_text: वायुर्यमोऽग्निर्वरुणः शशाङ्कःप्रजापतिस्त्वं प्रपितामहश्च । नमो नमस्तेऽस्तु सहस्रकृत्वःपुनश्च भूयोऽपि नमो नमस्ते ॥
translation: आप ही वायु, यमराज, अग्नि, वरुण, चन्द्रमा, दक्ष आदि प्रजापति और प्रपितामह ब्रह्माजीके भी पिता हैं ।  आपको हजारों बार नमस्कार हो नमस्कार हो   और फिर भी आपको बारबार नमस्कार हो  नमस्कार हो ॥
english_translation: You are air, Yama, fire, Varuna, the moon, Prajapati, and the great ancestor. I bow to you a thousand times, and again and again.
essence: All powers and forces bow inside the one you face.
simple_meaning: Arjuna sees Krishna as the source behind all cosmic powers and offers repeated bowing. The response is not argument but reverence.
insight: It shifts the mind from trying to contain reality to reverently acknowledging its vast source.
modern_relevance: You stand before something too large to control — a diagnosis, a confession, a loss you cannot undo. The mind stops bargaining and simply bows.
speaker: Arjuna

verse_text: नमः पुरस्तादथ पृष्ठतस्तेनमोऽस्तु ते सर्वत एव सर्व । अनन्तवीर्यामितविक्रमस्त्वंसर्वं समाप्नोषि ततोऽसि सर्वः ॥
translation: हे सर्व  आपको आगेसे भी नमस्कार हो  पीछेसे भी नमस्कार हो  सब ओरसे ही नमस्कार हो  हे अनन्तवीर्य  अमित विक्रमवाले आपने सबको समावृत कर रखा है अतः सब कुछ आप ही हैं ॥
english_translation: Salutations to you from the front, from behind, and from every side. You are endless power and immeasurable might; you pervade all and therefore are all.
essence: Total awe ends the illusion of separation.
simple_meaning: Arjuna bows to Krishna from every direction, recognizing that Krishna pervades everything and is beyond ordinary limits.
insight: It shifts the mind from self-importance to reverent surrender before what exceeds control.
modern_relevance: You stand speechless after a moment that dwarfs your pride — a hospital corridor, a funeral, a birth, a breakup. Some encounters leave only one honest response: bowing inwardly.
speaker: Arjuna

verse_text: सखेति मत्वा प्रसभं यदुक्तंहे कृष्ण हे यादव हे सखेति । अजानता महिमानं तवेदंमया प्रमादात्प्रणयेन वापि ॥
translation: आपकी महिमा और स्वरूपको न जानते हुए मेरे सखा हैं ऐसा मानकर मैंने प्रमादसे अथवा प्रेमसे हठपूर्वक बिना सोचेसमझे हे कृष्ण  हे यादव  हे सखे  इस प्रकार जो कुछ कहा है और हे अच्युत  हँसीदिल्लगीमें, चलतेफिरते, सोतेजागते, उठतेबैठते, खातेपीते समयमें अकेले अथवा उन सखाओं, कुटुम्बियों आदिके सामने मेरे द्वारा आपका जो कुछ तिरस्कार किया गया है वह सब अप्रमेयस्वरुप आपसे मैं क्षमा माँगता हूँ ॥
english_translation: Thinking of you as a friend, I addressed you carelessly: “O Krishna, O Yadava, O friend.” Not knowing your greatness, I spoke in negligence or affection. I ask forgiveness from your immeasurable form for every disrespect I showed in laughter, play, walking, sleeping, sitting, eating, alone or before companions and relatives.
essence: Familiarity without recognition becomes disrespect; awe restores the right relation.
simple_meaning: Arjuna apologizes for treating Krishna casually as a friend, not knowing his true greatness. He asks forgiveness for every disrespectful word and act.
insight: It shifts devotion from familiarity to humility, teaching the reader to recognise greatness before speaking lightly.
modern_relevance: You joke too freely with someone until one moment reveals how much they carry. Then embarrassment arrives first, and respect becomes honest.
speaker: Arjuna

verse_text: यच्चावहासार्थमसत्कृतोऽसिविहारशय्यासनभोजनेषु । एकोऽथवाप्यच्युत तत्समक्षंतत्क्षामये त्वामहमप्रमेयम् ॥
translation: आपकी महिमा और स्वरूपको न जानते हुए मेरे सखा हैं ऐसा मानकर मैंने प्रमादसे अथवा प्रेमसे भी हठपूर्वक बिना सोचेसमझे हे कृष्ण  हे यादव  हे सखे  इस प्रकार जो कुछ कहा है और हे अच्युत  हँसीदिल्लगीमें, चलतेफिरते, सोतेजागते, उठतेबैठते, खातेपीते समयमें अकेले अथवा उन सखाओं, कुटुम्बियों आदिके सामने मेरे द्वारा आपका जो कुछ तिरस्कार किया गया है, वह सब अप्रमेस्वरूप आपसे मैं क्षमा करवाता हूँ ॥
english_translation: Whatever disrespect I showed you in jest, while walking, resting, sitting, eating, alone or before others, I ask your immeasurable forgiveness.
essence: Familiarity can hide greatness until awe breaks through.
simple_meaning: Arjuna asks Krishna to forgive every careless or disrespectful thing he said or did, in private and in public.
insight: It shifts the mind from familiarity to reverence, and from embarrassment to honest repair.
modern_relevance: You realize, too late, how casually you spoke to someone who was carrying more than you knew. The apology is no longer about saving face; it is about seeing clearly.
speaker: Arjuna

verse_text: पितासि लोकस्य चराचरस्यत्वमस्य पूज्यश्च गुरुर्गरीयान् । न त्वत्समोऽस्त्यभ्यधिकः कुतोऽन्योलोकत्रयेऽप्यप्रतिमप्रभाव ॥
translation: आप ही इस चराचर संसारके पिता हैं, आप ही पूजनीय हैं और आप ही गुरुओंके महान् गुरु हैं ।  हे अनन्त प्रभावशाली भगवन्  इस त्रिलोकीमें आपके समान भी दूसरा कोई नहीं है, फिर अधिक तो हो ही कैसे सकता है ॥
english_translation: You are the father of all moving and unmoving beings, the highest object of reverence, and the greatest teacher. In the three worlds, no one equals you, much less surpasses you.
essence: Recognition of the highest power dissolves all comparison.
simple_meaning: Arjuna recognizes Krishna as the father, teacher, and highest object of reverence for all beings. No one in the three worlds is equal to him.
insight: It shifts the mind from familiarity and ego to reverence and surrender.
modern_relevance: You stand before someone whose wisdom exposes your smallness — a mentor, a parent, a truth you can no longer argue with. The only honest response is reverence.
speaker: Arjuna

verse_text: तस्मात्प्रणम्य प्रणिधाय कायंप्रसादये त्वामहमीशमीड्यम् । पितेव पुत्रस्य सखेव सख्युःप्रियः प्रियायार्हसि देव सोढुम् ॥
translation: इसलिये शरीरसे लम्बा पड़कर स्तुति करनेयोग्य आप ईश्वरको मैं प्रणाम करके प्रसन्न करना चाहता हूँ ।  जैसे पिता पुत्रके, मित्र मित्रके और पति पत्नीके अपमानको सह लेता है, ऐसे ही हे देव  आप मेरे द्वारा किया गया अपमान सहनेमें समर्थ हैं ॥
english_translation: Therefore, bowing down my body, I seek to please You, the worthy Lord of praise. Like a father bearing a son’s fault, a friend bearing a friend’s, or a lover bearing a beloved’s, You should forgive what I have done.
essence: True reverence asks forgiveness without excuses.
simple_meaning: Arjuna bows fully to Krishna and asks for forgiveness, saying Krishna should bear his disrespect the way loved ones bear each other’s faults.
insight: It shifts the response from self-protection to humble repair.
modern_relevance: You realize, halfway through a harsh message, that you crossed a line. Pride wants to defend itself; humility lets you own the harm and ask forgiveness plainly.
speaker: Arjuna

verse_text: अदृष्टपूर्वं हृषितोऽस्मि दृष्ट्वाभयेन च प्रव्यथितं मनो मे । तदेव मे दर्शय देव रूपंप्रसीद देवेश जगन्निवास ॥
translation: मैंने ऐसा रुप पहले कभी नहीं देखा ।  इस रूपको देखकर मैं हर्षित हो रहा हूँ और साथहीसाथ भयसे मेरा मन अत्यन्त व्यथित हो रहा है ।  अतः आप मुझे अपने उसी देवरूपको सौम्य विष्णुरूपको दिखाइये ।  हे देवेश  हे जगन्निवास  आप प्रसन्न होइये ॥
english_translation: I have never seen this form before. Seeing it, I am filled with joy, yet my mind is troubled by fear. Show me again your gentle divine form; be pleased, O Lord of lords, O dwelling of the world.
essence: A vision can awaken joy and fear at once.
simple_meaning: Arjuna is overwhelmed by Krishna's cosmic form. He asks to see the familiar, gentle form again because the vast vision fills him with both awe and fear.
insight: It shows that revelation must be met with humility, and that surrender can include asking for a form the mind can bear.
modern_relevance: You finally hear the brutal truth you asked for, and it lands harder than expected. Part of you is grateful; part of you wants the conversation to return to something human again.
speaker: Arjuna

verse_text: किरीटिनं गदिनं चक्रहस्तमिच्छामि त्वां द्रष्टुमहं तथैव । तेनैव रूपेण चतुर्भुजेनसहस्रबाहो भव विश्वमूर्ते ॥
translation: मैं आपको वैसे ही किरीटधारी, गदाधारी और हाथमें चक्र लिये हुए देखना चाहता हूँ ।  इसलिये हे सहस्रबाहो  हे विश्वमूर्ते  आप उसी चतुर्भुजरूपसे हो जाइये ॥
english_translation: I want to see you again in your crowned form, with mace and discus in your hands. O Thousand-Armed One, O Universal Form, return to that four-armed shape.
essence: The infinite can overwhelm; devotion asks for a form the heart can bear.
simple_meaning: Arjuna asks Krishna to return to the familiar four-armed form with crown, mace, and discus. The overwhelming cosmic form has moved him, but he longs for a shape he can meet with devotion.
insight: It teaches you that reverence can include a need for limits, and that love may ask for a form the mind can bear.
modern_relevance: You finally see the full truth of a situation, and it leaves you trembling. After the shock, you want something familiar enough to hold without breaking.
speaker: Arjuna

verse_text: श्री भगवानुवाचमया प्रसन्नेन तवार्जुनेदंरूपं परं दर्शितमात्मयोगात् । तेजोमयं विश्वमनन्तमाद्यंयन्मे त्वदन्येन न दृष्टपूर्वम् ॥
translation: श्रीभगवान् बोले  हे अर्जुन  मैंने प्रसन्न होकर अपनी सामर्थ्यसे यह अत्यन्त श्रेष्ठ, तेजोमय, सबका आदि और अनन्त विश्वरूप तुझे दिखाया है, जिसको तुम्हारे सिवाय पहले किसीने नहीं देखा है ॥
english_translation: Krishna said: O Arjuna, I have shown you this supreme, radiant, endless, original form through my grace. No one except you has seen it before.
essence: What is most sacred is seen only by grace.
simple_meaning: Krishna tells Arjuna that he has revealed this radiant, original, endless form through his own power, and no one else has seen it before.
insight: It shifts the mind from ownership of insight to gratitude for revelation.
modern_relevance: You finally understand something that had been hidden for years — not because you forced it, but because the moment was given to you.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: न वेदयज्ञाध्ययनैर्न दानैर्न च क्रियाभिर्न तपोभिरुग्रैः । एवंरूपः शक्य अहं नृलोकेद्रष्टुं त्वदन्येन कुरुप्रवीर ॥
translation: हे कुरुप्रवीर मनुष्यलोकमें इस प्रकारके विश्वरूपवाला मैं न वेदोंके पढ़नेसे, न यज्ञोंके अनुष्ठानसे, न दानसे, न उग्र तपोंसे और न मात्र क्रियाओंसे तेरे कृपापात्रके सिवाय और किसीके द्वारा देखा जाना शक्य हूँ ॥
english_translation: I cannot be seen in this form in the human world by study of the Vedas, sacrifice, charity, severe austerity, or ritual acts—except by you, Arjuna.
essence: The highest vision cannot be forced; it arrives only through grace.
simple_meaning: Krishna says his cosmic form cannot be seen through rituals, study, gifts, or harsh austerity. Only Arjuna, by divine grace, has that vision.
insight: It shifts the mind from achievement to receptivity, showing that the deepest vision cannot be forced.
modern_relevance: You can read every book, follow every rule, and still miss what matters most. The moment of real seeing often arrives only after the grip of control finally loosens.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: मा ते व्यथा मा च विमूढभावोदृष्ट्वा रूपं घोरमीदृङ्ममेदम् । व्यपेतभीः प्रीतमनाः पुनस्त्वंतदेव मे रूपमिदं प्रपश्य ॥
translation: यह इस प्रकारका मेरा घोररूप देखकर तेरेको व्यथा नहीं होनी चाहिये और मूढ़भाव भी नहीं होना चाहिये ।  अब निर्भय और प्रसन्न मनवाला होकर तू फिर उसी मेरे इस चतुर्भुज रूपको अच्छी तरह देख ले ॥
english_translation: Do not be distressed or confused by this fierce form of mine. Free from fear and calm-minded, look again upon this very form of mine.
essence: Fear must drop before the deeper vision can be seen.
simple_meaning: Krishna tells Arjuna not to panic after seeing the terrifying form. Fear and confusion should fall away, and Arjuna should look again with a calm, glad mind.
insight: It shifts the response from panic to composed seeing, so the mind can receive what is being shown.
modern_relevance: You read a message that changes everything, and your chest tightens before you can think. The first task is not analysis — it is to steady the mind enough to see clearly.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: सञ्जय उवाचइत्यर्जुनं वासुदेवस्तथोक्त्वास्वकं रूपं दर्शयामास भूयः । आश्वासयामास च भीतमेनंभूत्वा पुनः सौम्यवपुर्महात्मा ॥
translation: सञ्जय बोले  वासुदेवभगवान् ने अर्जुनसे ऐसा कहकर फिर उसी प्रकारसे अपना रूप देवरूप दिखाया और महात्मा श्रीकृष्णने पुनः सौम्यवपु द्विभुजरूप होकर इस भयभीत अर्जुनको आश्वासन दिया ॥
english_translation: Sanjaya said: After speaking thus to Arjuna, Vasudeva revealed his own form again. The great one then reassured the frightened Arjuna, taking once more a gentle form.
essence: A vision can shake you; compassion brings you back.
simple_meaning: After speaking to Arjuna, Krishna showed his gentler form again and calmed Arjuna’s fear.
insight: It shows that revelation must be followed by reassurance when the listener is overwhelmed.
modern_relevance: You finally say the hard truth, and the other person goes quiet. Then you soften your voice, steady your face, and help them breathe again.
speaker: Sanjaya

verse_text: अर्जुन उवाचदृष्ट्वेदं मानुषं रूपं तवसौम्यं जनार्दन । इदानीमस्मि संवृत्तः सचेताः प्रकृतिं गतः ॥
translation: अर्जुन बोले  हे जनार्दन  आपके इस सौम्य मनुष्यरूपको देखकर मैं इस समय स्थिरचित्त हो गया हूँ और अपनी स्वाभाविक स्थितिको प्राप्त हो गया हूँ ॥
english_translation: Arjuna said: Seeing your gentle human form, Janardana, I am calm again and restored to my natural state.
essence: Gentleness restores the mind after overwhelming awe.
simple_meaning: Arjuna feels settled again after seeing Krishna’s gentle human form. The terrifying cosmic vision has passed, and his mind returns to normal.
insight: It shows how reassurance can restore clarity after overwhelm.
modern_relevance: You finally hear the softer voice after a brutal confrontation. The body unclenches first, and only then does the mind remember how to breathe.
speaker: Arjuna

verse_text: श्री भगवानुवाचसुदुर्दर्शमिदं रूपं दृष्टवानसि यन्मम । देवा अप्यस्य रूपस्य नित्यं दर्शनकाङ्क्षिणः ॥
translation: श्रीभगवान् बोले  मेरा यह जो रूप तुमने देखा है, इसके दर्शन अत्यन्त ही दुर्लभ हैं ।  इस रूपको देखनेके लिये देवता भी नित्य लालायित रहते हैं ॥
english_translation: Krishna said: The form you have seen is very hard to behold. Even the radiant beings long forever to see it.
essence: The vision Arjuna saw is beyond ordinary access, even for radiant beings.
simple_meaning: Krishna says Arjuna has seen a form that is extremely rare to behold. Even the radiant beings always long to see it.
insight: It shifts the mind from taking sacred experience for granted to recognising its rarity and value.
modern_relevance: You catch a glimpse of something that changes you — a raw truth, a deep love, a moment of awe — and later realize most people never see it at all.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: नाहं वेदैर्न तपसा न दानेन न चेज्यया । शक्य एवंविधो द्रष्टुं दृष्टवानसि मां यथा ॥
translation: जिस प्रकार तुमने मुझे देखा है, इस प्रकारका चतुर्भुजरूपवाला मैं न तो वेदोंसे, न तपसे, न दानसे और न यज्ञसे ही देखा जा सकता हूँ ॥
english_translation: I cannot be seen in this form through the Vedas, austerity, charity, or sacrifice, as you have seen me.
essence: The deepest vision comes through devotion, not mere accomplishment.
simple_meaning: Krishna says that this divine form cannot be fully reached through scripture, austerity, charity, or ritual alone. Arjuna has seen it because a deeper devotion has opened the way.
insight: It shifts the seeker from achievement to receptivity, showing that devotion opens what effort alone cannot.
modern_relevance: You can read every book, follow every practice, and still miss what matters. In the moment you finally admit you cannot force understanding, a deeper seeing can arrive.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: भक्त्या त्वनन्यया शक्यमहमेवंविधोऽर्जुन । ज्ञातुं दृष्टुं च तत्त्वेन प्रवेष्टुं च परंतप ॥
translation: परन्तु हे शत्रुतापन अर्जुन  इस प्रकार चतुर्भुजरूपवाला मैं अनन्यभक्तिसे ही तत्त्वसे जाननेमें, सगुणरूपसे देखनेमें और प्राप्त करनेमें शक्य हूँ ॥
english_translation: But only through undivided devotion can I be truly known, seen, and entered, Arjuna.
essence: Undivided devotion reaches what effort cannot.
simple_meaning: Krishna says that his true form can be known, seen, and entered only through single-pointed devotion, not by ordinary effort alone.
insight: It shifts the mind from mastery by force to access through wholehearted devotion.
modern_relevance: You can read every book, gather every technique, and still miss what matters. The moment you stop trying to control everything and give yourself fully, understanding begins.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: मत्कर्मकृन्मत्परमो मद्भक्तः सङ्गवर्जितः । निर्वैरः सर्वभूतेषु यः स मामेति पाण्डव ॥
translation: हे पाण्डवन  जो मेरे लिये ही कर्म करनेवाला, मेरे ही परायण और मेरा ही भक्त है तथा सर्वथा आसक्तिरहित और प्राणिमात्रके साथ निर्वैर है, वह भक्त मेरेको प्राप्त होता है ॥
english_translation: O Pandava, the devotee who works for Me alone, takes Me as the highest goal, is devoted to Me, is free from attachment, and bears no enmity toward any being, comes to Me.
essence: Devotion matures into freedom when attachment and hostility are gone.
simple_meaning: The one who serves Krishna with full devotion, without attachment or hostility toward any being, reaches him.
insight: It shifts devotion from feeling alone to a whole way of living: action, priority, detachment, and goodwill.
modern_relevance: You keep replaying the argument in your head after the meeting ends. The verse points to a cleaner way to live: act from devotion, stop gripping the result, and let resentment fall away.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: अर्जुन उवाचएवं सततयुक्ता ये भक्तास्त्वां पर्युपासते । येचाप्यक्षरमव्यक्तं तेषां के योगवित्तमाः ॥
translation: जो भक्त इस प्रकार निरन्तर आपमें लगे रहकर आपसगुण भगवान् की उपासना करते हैं और जो अविनाशी निराकारकी ही उपासना करते हैं, उनमेंसे उत्तम योगवेत्ता कौन हैं ॥
english_translation: Arjuna said: Those devotees who worship You with constant devotion, and those who worship the imperishable, unmanifest reality—who among them are the most accomplished in yoga?
essence: Devotion can face the divine as form or as formless reality.
simple_meaning: Arjuna asks whether devoted worship of Krishna or worship of the imperishable, formless reality is the higher yoga.
insight: It frames devotion as a real choice between personal love and abstract contemplation, preparing Krishna's answer.
modern_relevance: You stand between two paths: a relationship that feels alive, and a principle that feels pure. The question is not weak — it is the mind trying to find the deepest way to give itself.
speaker: Arjuna

verse_text: श्री भगवानुवाचमय्यावेश्य मनो ये मां नित्ययुक्ता उपासते । श्रद्धया परयोपेतास्ते मे युक्ततमा मताः ॥
translation: मेरेमें मनको लगाकर नित्यनिरन्तर मेरेमें लगे हुए जो भक्त परम श्रद्धासे युक्त होकर मेरी उपासना करते हैं, वे मेरे मतमें सर्वश्रेष्ठ योगी हैं ॥
english_translation: Those who focus their mind on me, worship me with unwavering devotion, and are filled with supreme trust are, in my view, the highest yogis.
essence: Full trust and steady remembrance make devotion complete.
simple_meaning: Krishna says that the people who keep their mind on him, worship him steadily, and approach him with the highest trust are the best yogis.
insight: It shifts devotion from ritual performance to sustained inner focus and trust.
modern_relevance: You are standing outside a hospital room, phone in hand, about to hear news that could change everything. In that moment, scattered attention falls away; what remains is the one thing you truly place your heart upon.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: ये त्वक्षरमनिर्देश्यमव्यक्तं पर्युपासते । सर्वत्रगमचिन्त्यं च कूटस्थमचलं ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: जो अपनी इन्द्रियोंको वशमें करके अचिन्त्य, सब जगह परिपूर्ण, अनिर्देश्य, कूटस्थ, अचल, ध्रुव, अक्षर और अव्यक्तकी उपासना करते हैं, वे प्राणिमात्रके हितमें रत और सब जगह समबुद्धिवाले मनुष्य मुझे ही प्राप्त होते हैं ॥
english_translation: Those who worship the unchanging, the indefinable, the unmanifest, the all-pervading, the unthinkable, the unmoving, the eternal, the imperishable—restraining the senses—reach Me alone.
essence: The deepest devotion reaches what never changes.
simple_meaning: People who worship the imperishable, unmanifest reality by controlling their senses and seeing it everywhere ultimately reach Krishna.
insight: It shifts devotion from visible forms to steady awareness of what is everywhere and unchanged.
modern_relevance: You close the app after another day of chasing names, images, and reactions. Something deeper in you is tired of surfaces and wants what does not flicker.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: संनियम्येन्द्रियग्रामं सर्वत्र समबुद्धयः । ते प्राप्नुवन्ति मामेव सर्वभूतहिते रताः ॥
translation: जो अपनी इन्द्रियोंको वशमें करके अचिन्त्य, सब जगह परिपूर्ण, अनिर्देश्य, कूटस्थ, अचल, ध्रुव, अक्षर और अव्यक्तकी उपासना करते हैं, वे प्राणिमात्रके हितमें रत और सब जगह समबुद्धिवाले मनुष्य मुझे ही प्राप्त होते हैं ॥
english_translation: Those who restrain the senses, remain even-minded everywhere, and delight in the welfare of all beings reach me alone.
essence: Reach the divine by mastering yourself and caring for everyone.
simple_meaning: Control the senses, stay even-minded with everyone, and care for the good of all beings. That is the way to reach Krishna.
insight: It shifts devotion from personal feeling to disciplined, universal goodwill.
modern_relevance: You are angry at one person, but the room is full of people who will feel it. This verse asks for the harder move: steady yourself first, then act from care instead of reaction.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: क्लेशोऽधिकतरस्तेषामव्यक्तासक्तचेतसाम् । अव्यक्ता हि गतिर्दुःखं देहवद्भिरवाप्यते ॥
translation: अव्यक्तमें आसक्त चित्तवाले उन साधकोंको अपने साधनमें कष्ट अधिक होता है क्योंकि देहाभिमानियोंके द्वारा अव्यक्तविषयक गति कठिनतासे प्राप्त की जाती है ॥
english_translation: For those whose minds cling to the unmanifest, the struggle is greater. The unmanifest path is hard to reach for embodied beings.
essence: The subtlest path is hardest for a body-bound mind.
simple_meaning: Holding the unmanifest as your focus is harder than it looks. For people still identified with the body, that subtle path is difficult to reach.
insight: It shifts the mind from forcing a lofty practice to choosing the method that fits your current capacity.
modern_relevance: You sit in silence trying to “just empty the mind,” and the harder you try, the tighter everything feels. Some practices are subtle enough to become a struggle before they become a refuge.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: ये तु सर्वाणि कर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्पराः । अनन्येनैव योगेन मां ध्यायन्त उपासते ॥
translation: परन्तु जो कर्मोंको मेरे अर्पण करके और मेरे परायण होकर अनन्ययोगसे मेरा ही ध्यान करते हुए मेरी उपासना करते हैं ॥
english_translation: But those who surrender all actions to Me, take Me as their highest aim, and worship Me with single-pointed devotion, meditating on Me alone.
essence: Total devotion turns every action into worship.
simple_meaning: People who give all their actions to Krishna, make him their highest aim, and worship him with single-minded devotion are described here.
insight: It shifts action from self-ownership to offering, so effort becomes worship instead of control.
modern_relevance: You finish a hard conversation, then stop replaying it for approval. The action was yours to give; the burden of ownership can be laid down.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: तेषामहं समुद्धर्ता मृत्युसंसारसागरात् । भवामि नचिरात्पार्थ मय्यावेशितचेतसाम् ॥
translation: हे पार्थ  मेरेमें आविष्ट चित्तवाले उन भक्तोंका मैं मृत्युरूप संसारसमुद्रसे शीघ्र ही उद्धार करनेवाला बन जाता हूँ ॥
english_translation: I quickly become the one who lifts those whose minds are fixed on me from the ocean of mortal existence, O Partha.
essence: A mind fixed on Krishna is met by Krishna's saving presence.
simple_meaning: Those who place their minds fully on Krishna are not left to struggle alone. He becomes the one who rescues them from the cycle of repeated death and return.
insight: It shifts devotion from effort alone to a relationship of rescue and trust.
modern_relevance: You are sitting in the car after a breakup, staring at the steering wheel, unable to move. This verse speaks to the relief of letting a steadier presence carry what your grip cannot.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: मय्येव मन आधत्स्व मयि बुद्धिं निवेशय । निवसिष्यसि मय्येव अत ऊर्ध्वं न संशयः ॥
translation: तू मेरेमें मनको लगा और मेरेमें ही बुद्धिको लगा इसके बाद तू मेरेमें ही निवास करेगा  इसमें संशय नहीं है ॥
english_translation: Fix your mind on me alone. Place your discerning mind in me, and you will live in me beyond doubt.
essence: A divided mind settles when both thought and feeling rest in the divine.
simple_meaning: Keep your mind and discerning mind fixed on Krishna. Then you will abide in him, with no doubt about the result.
insight: It shifts attention from divided thinking to wholehearted devotion, so the mind stops scattering its power.
modern_relevance: You are staring at your phone before sending a message that could change a relationship. Half of you wants control, half wants escape. This verse asks for one center, not two.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: अथ चित्तं समाधातुं न शक्नोषि मयि स्थिरम् । अभ्यासयोगेन ततो मामिच्छाप्तुं धनञ्जय ॥
translation: अगर तू मनको मेरेमें अचलभावसे स्थिर अर्पण करनेमें समर्थ नहीं है, तो हे धनञ्जय  अभ्यासयोगके द्वारा तू मेरी प्राप्तिकी इच्छा कर ॥
english_translation: If you cannot steadily fix your mind on me, then, Dhananjaya, seek me through practice yoga.
essence: Practice can lead the mind where stillness cannot yet go.
simple_meaning: If steady devotion feels too hard, begin with practice. Keep returning to the divine again and again until the mind learns to stay.
insight: It shifts devotion from a single perfect act to a trainable habit of returning.
modern_relevance: You sit down to pray, meditate, or simply stay with one hard truth, and your mind runs off in ten directions. Start again without drama. Repetition can carry you where force cannot.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: अभ्यासेऽप्यसमर्थोऽसि मत्कर्मपरमो भव । मदर्थमपि कर्माणि कुर्वन् सिद्धिमवाप्स्यसि ॥
translation: अगर तू अभ्यासयोग में भी असमर्थ है, तो मेरे लिये कर्म करनेके परायण हो जा ।  मेरे लिये कर्मोंको करता हुआ भी तू सिद्धिको प्राप्त हो जायगा ॥
english_translation: If you are unable even to practice, then be devoted to working for Me. By doing actions for My sake, you will attain perfection.
essence: Offered action can succeed where practice still fails.
simple_meaning: If steady practice is too hard, dedicate your actions to Krishna instead. Even ordinary work offered with devotion can lead to fulfillment.
insight: It shifts devotion from a private feeling into a way of acting.
modern_relevance: You sit at the edge of a hospital bed, too shaken to pray properly, too tired to think clearly. Still, you can wash the cup, make the call, and offer the next act with care.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: अथैतदप्यशक्तोऽसि कर्तुं मद्योगमाश्रितः । सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं ततः कुरु यतात्मवान् ॥
translation: अगर मेरे योगसमता के आश्रित हुआ तू इसपूर्वश्लोकमें कहे गये साधन को भी करनेमें असमर्थ है, तो मनइन्द्रियोंको वशमें करके सम्पूर्ण कर्मोंके फलका त्याग कर ॥
english_translation: If you still cannot do even this while taking refuge in my yoga, then, self-controlled, renounce all fruits of action.
essence: Let go of the result; the action itself is the practice.
simple_meaning: If even devotion-filled practice feels too hard, give up the need to own the results of your actions. Stay controlled and let the work be enough.
insight: It shifts attention from owning results to releasing them after sincere effort.
modern_relevance: You sent the message, then kept checking for a reply that could save or ruin your day. This verse asks you to stop feeding on the outcome and return to the act itself.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: श्रेयो हि ज्ञानमभ्यासाज्ज्ञानाद्ध्यानं विशिष्यते । ध्यानात्कर्मफलत्यागस्त्यागाच्छान्तिरनन्तरम् ॥
translation: अभ्याससे शास्त्रज्ञान श्रेष्ठ है, शास्त्रज्ञानसे ध्यान श्रेष्ठ है और ध्यानसे भी सब कर्मोंके फलका त्याग श्रेष्ठ है ।  कर्मफलत्यागसे तत्काल ही परमशान्ति प्राप्त हो जाती है ॥
english_translation: Knowledge is better than practice; meditation is better than knowledge. Renouncing the fruits of action is better than meditation, and peace follows at once from renunciation.
essence: Peace begins when you stop clinging to what your action produces.
simple_meaning: Practice, study, and meditation all help, but letting go of personal reward is even higher. That release brings immediate calm.
insight: It shifts the mind from managing outcomes to releasing them after sincere action.
modern_relevance: You send the hard message, then keep checking your phone for the reaction. The mind burns in that waiting. This verse points to the relief of doing what is right and leaving the outcome alone.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च । निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः समदुःखसुखः क्षमी ॥
translation: सब प्राणियोंमें द्वेषभावसे रहित, सबका मित्र प्रेमी और दयालु, ममतारहित, अहंकाररहित, सुखदुःखकी प्राप्तिमें सम, क्षमाशील, निरन्तर सन्तुष्ट, योगी, शरीरको वशमें किये हुए, दृढ़ निश्चयवाला मेरेमें अर्पित मनबुद्धिवाला जो मेरा भक्त है, वह मेरेको प्रिय है ॥
english_translation: One who hates no being, is friendly and compassionate, free from possessiveness and ego, equal in pleasure and pain, and forgiving.
essence: Devotion shows up as friendliness, forgiveness, and emotional steadiness.
simple_meaning: A devoted person does not hate anyone, treats everyone as a friend, stays compassionate, and does not cling to possessions or ego. Such a person remains steady through joy and sorrow and forgives easily.
insight: It shifts devotion from ritual alone to a transformed way of relating to every person and every feeling.
modern_relevance: Someone cuts you off in traffic, and the old heat rises instantly. This verse asks for a different reflex: no hatred, no inflated self, no need to keep score.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: सन्तुष्टः सततं योगी यतात्मा दृढनिश्चयः । मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः ॥
translation: सब प्राणियोंमें द्वेषभावसे रहित, सबका मित्र प्रेमी और दयालु, ममतारहित, अहंकाररहित, सुखदुःखकी प्राप्तिमें सम, क्षमाशील, निरन्तर सन्तुष्ट,योगी, शरीरको वशमें किये हुए, दृढ़ निश्चयवाला, मेरेमें अर्पित मनबुद्धिवाला जो मेरा भक्त है, वह मेरेको प्रिय है ॥
english_translation: The devoted yogi is always content, self-controlled, and steady in resolve. One whose mind and discerning mind are offered to Me is dear to Me.
essence: Real devotion is a steady mind already placed beyond itself.
simple_meaning: A true devotee stays content, controls the body and mind, keeps firm resolve, and places both mind and discernment in Krishna.
insight: It shifts devotion from emotion alone to a disciplined, inwardly gathered life.
modern_relevance: You are exhausted, but you still choose not to spiral, not to blame, not to scatter yourself. Something in you stays gathered, and that quiet steadiness is its own devotion.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: यस्मान्नोद्विजते लोको लोकान्नोद्विजते च यः । हर्षामर्षभयोद्वेगैर्मुक्तो यः स च मे प्रियः ॥
translation: जिससे किसी प्राणीको उद्वेग नहीं होता और जिसको खुद भी किसी प्राणीसे उद्वेग नहीं होता तथा जो हर्ष, अमर्ष ईर्ष्या, भय और उद्वेगसे रहित है, वह मुझे प्रिय है ॥
english_translation: The one who disturbs no one and is disturbed by no one, and who is free from delight, envy, fear, and agitation, is dear to me.
essence: True devotion leaves no wake of disturbance.
simple_meaning: A beloved devotee does not unsettle others and is not easily unsettled by others. Freedom from excitement, envy, fear, and agitation is part of true devotion.
insight: It shifts the mind from reactive emotion to settled presence that does not spread agitation.
modern_relevance: Someone cuts you off in traffic, then flips you off through the window. The old reflex rises fast. This verse points to a steadier way: no inner spike, no need to pass the disturbance onward.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: अनपेक्षः शुचिर्दक्ष उदासीनो गतव्यथः । सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः ॥
translation: जो आकाङ्क्षासे रहित, बाहरभीतरसे पवित्र, दक्ष, उदासीन, व्यथासे रहित और सभी आरम्भोंका अर्थात् नयेनये कर्मोंके आरम्भका सर्वथा त्यागी है, वह मेरा भक्त मुझे प्रिय है ॥
english_translation: One who has no expectation, is pure, skilled, detached, free from anxiety, and has given up all undertakings is dear to me, my devotee.
essence: True closeness releases craving, anxiety, and compulsive beginning.
simple_meaning: Krishna says his beloved devotee has no craving, stays inwardly clean, acts skillfully, remains detached, and drops anxious new beginnings.
insight: It shifts devotion from emotional dependence to steady, uncluttered presence.
modern_relevance: You keep opening new tabs, new plans, new fixes because stillness feels unbearable. This verse points to a calmer strength: do what is needed, but stop feeding anxiety with constant beginnings.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: यो न हृष्यति न द्वेष्टि न शोचति न काङ्क्षति । शुभाशुभपरित्यागी भक्ितमान्यः स मे प्रियः ॥
translation: जो न कभी हर्षित होता है, न द्वेष करता है, न शोक करता है, न कामना करता है और जो शुभअशुभ कर्मोंमें रागद्वेषका त्यागी है, वह भक्तिमान् मनुष्य मुझे प्रिय है ॥
english_translation: One who neither rejoices, hates, grieves, nor craves, and who has given up attachment to both good and bad actions, is dear to me.
essence: Devotion becomes steady when liking and disliking no longer rule the heart.
simple_meaning: A devoted person stays free from excitement, hatred, sorrow, and craving. They do not cling to outcomes or label actions as personally theirs.
insight: It teaches you to stop feeding emotional reactions with attachment and aversion.
modern_relevance: You read a message that praises your work and another that criticizes it. If your mood rises and crashes with each one, you are still captive. This verse points to steadiness that does not depend on applause.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: समः शत्रौ च मित्रे च तथा मानापमानयोः । शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु समः सङ्गविवर्जितः ॥
translation: जो शत्रु और मित्रमें तथा मानअपमानमें सम है और शीतउष्ण अनुकूलताप्रतिकूलता तथा सुखदुःखमें सम है एवं आसक्तिसे रहित है, और जो निन्दास्तुतिको समान समझनेवाला, मननशील, जिसकिसी प्रकारसे भी शरीरका निर्वाह होनेमें संतुष्ट, रहनेके स्थान तथा शरीरमें ममताआसक्तिसे रहित और स्थिर बुद्धिवाला है, वह भक्तिमान् मनुष्य मुझे प्रिय है ॥
english_translation: One who is equal to enemy and friend, honor and dishonor, heat and cold, pleasure and pain, and is free from attachment is dear to Me.
essence: Real devotion stays even when life feels hostile or kind.
simple_meaning: A devoted person stays steady through praise and blame, comfort and discomfort, friendship and hostility, without clinging to either side.
insight: It shifts attention from emotional reactions to steady presence under changing treatment.
modern_relevance: A message lands as criticism, then another person praises you five minutes later. Your mood swings with both. This verse trains you to stay unchanged when attention turns warm or cold.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: तुल्यनिन्दास्तुतिर्मौनी सन्तुष्टो येनकेनचित् । अनिकेतः स्थिरमतिर्भक्ितमान्मे प्रियो नरः ॥
translation: जो शत्रु और मित्रमें तथा मानअपमानमें सम है और शीतउष्ण अनुकूलताप्रतिकूलता तथा सुखदुःखमें सम है एवं आसक्तिसे रहित है, और जो निन्दास्तुतिको समान समझनेवाला, मननशील, जिसकिसी प्रकारसे भी शरीरका निर्वाह होनेमें संतुष्ट, रहनेके स्थान तथा शरीरमें ममताआसक्तिसे रहित और स्थिर बुद्धिवाला है, वह भक्तिमान् मनुष्य मुझे प्रिय है ॥
english_translation: Equal in praise and blame, silent, content with whatever comes, homeless, steady-minded—the devoted person is dear to me.
essence: Praise and blame lose power over the one who stands steady.
simple_meaning: A devoted person stays steady through praise and blame, remains quiet, accepts whatever comes, feels no possessiveness about home, and keeps a firm mind.
insight: It shifts attention from managing approval to holding inner steadiness in every response.
modern_relevance: You post something vulnerable, then watch the comments. Praise inflates, criticism stings, and your day tilts. This verse asks for a steadier center than public reaction.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: ये तु धर्म्यामृतमिदं यथोक्तं पर्युपासते । श्रद्दधाना मत्परमा भक्तास्तेऽतीव मे प्रियाः ॥
translation: जो मेरेमें श्रद्धा रखनेवाले और मेरे परायण हुए भक्त पहले कहे हुए इस धर्ममय अमृतका अच्छी तरहसे सेवन करते हैं, वे मुझे अत्यन्त प्रिय हैं ॥
english_translation: Those devotees who trust, take refuge in Me, and faithfully live this nectar-like teaching are exceedingly dear to Me.
essence: Faithful practice turns devotion into closeness.
simple_meaning: People who trust Krishna, hold him as their highest aim, and faithfully practice this teaching are very dear to him.
insight: It shifts devotion from emotion alone to faithful, repeated practice grounded in trust.
modern_relevance: You keep returning to the same hard promise you made to yourself, even when no one applauds. That quiet loyalty changes your relationship to the thing you serve.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: अर्जुन उवाचप्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव क्षेत्रं क्षेत्रज्ञमेव च । एतद्वेदितुमिच्छामि ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं च केशव ॥
translation: श्रीभगवान् बोलेहे कुन्तीपुत्र अर्जुन  यहरूपसे कहे जानेवाले शरीरको क्षेत्र कहते हैं और इस क्षेत्रको जो जानता है, उसको ज्ञानीलोग क्षेत्रज्ञ नामसे कहते हैं ॥
english_translation: Arjuna said: O Keshava, I wish to understand nature, the field, the knower of the field, wisdom, and what is to be known.
essence: Real knowing starts by separating the seen from the seer.
simple_meaning: Arjuna asks Krishna to explain nature, the body as the field, the knower of that field, wisdom, and the object of knowledge.
insight: It shifts attention from confusion to discrimination: what is observed, what observes, and what can be truly known.
modern_relevance: You sit in a parked car after a hard conversation, replaying every word. Something in you asks: what part of this was the event, and what part was your reaction?
speaker: Arjuna

verse_text: श्री भगवानुवाचइदं शरीरं कौन्तेय क्षेत्रमित्यभिधीयते । एतद्यो वेत्ति तं प्राहुः क्षेत्रज्ञ इति तद्विदः ॥
translation: श्रीभगवान् बोले  हे कुन्तीपुत्र अर्जुन  यह  रूपसे कहे जानेवाले शरीरको क्षेत्र कहते हैं और इस क्षेत्रको जो जानता है, उसको ज्ञानीलोग क्षेत्रज्ञ नामसे कहते हैं ॥
english_translation: The body is called the field, O Arjuna. Those who know it call the knower of the field the field-knower.
essence: The body is observed; the knower is something else.
simple_meaning: The body is the field where life unfolds. The one who knows the body is called the knower of the field.
insight: It shifts identity from the changing body to the awareness that can notice it.
modern_relevance: You catch yourself saying, “my body is tense,” or “my mind is spiraling.” That small sentence already shows two things: what is being observed, and the awareness observing it.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: क्षेत्रज्ञं चापि मां विद्धि सर्वक्षेत्रेषु भारत । क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोर्ज्ञानं यत्तज्ज्ञानं मतं मम ॥
translation: हे भरतवंशोद्भव अर्जुन  तू सम्पूर्ण क्षेत्रोंमें क्षेत्रज्ञ मेरेको ही समझ और क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञका जो ज्ञान है, वही मेरे मतमें ज्ञान है ॥
english_translation: Know Me as the knower in all fields, Arjuna. In my view, true knowledge is knowing the field and the knower of the field.
essence: Knowing the field is incomplete without knowing the knower.
simple_meaning: Know Krishna as the knower present in every field. Real knowledge is understanding both the field and the one who knows it.
insight: It shifts attention from identifying with changing conditions to recognizing the witnessing presence behind them.
modern_relevance: You stare at your reflection after a brutal argument and think, 'I am this mess.' The verse interrupts that collapse: what changes is the field; awareness is deeper than the damage.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: तत्क्षेत्रं यच्च यादृक् च यद्विकारि यतश्च यत् । स च यो यत्प्रभावश्च तत्समासेन मे श्रृणु ॥
translation: वह क्षेत्र जो है, जैसा है, जिन विकारोंवाला है और जिससे जो पैदा हुआ है तथा वह क्षेत्रज्ञ भी जो है और जिस प्रभाववाला है, वह सब संक्षेपमें मेरेसे सुन ॥
english_translation: Listen to the field, its nature, its changes, its source, and the knower of the field, along with that knower's powers, in brief.
essence: Clear seeing begins by separating the field from the one who knows it.
simple_meaning: Krishna is about to explain, in brief, what the field is like, how it changes, where it comes from, and what the knower of the field is like.
insight: It shifts the mind from vague reaction to careful discrimination between what is changing and what is aware of it.
modern_relevance: You are staring at a decision that keeps changing shape: the facts, your mood, and your motives all blur together. This verse says to slow down and examine each layer clearly before you act.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: ऋषिभिर्बहुधा गीतं छन्दोभिर्विविधैः पृथक् । ब्रह्मसूत्रपदैश्चैव हेतुमद्भिर्विनिश्िचतैः ॥
translation: यह क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञका तत्त्व ऋषियोंके द्वारा बहुत विस्तारसे कहा गया है तथा वेदोंकी ऋचाओंद्वारा बहुत प्रकारसे कहा गया है और युक्तियुक्त एवं निश्चित किये हुए ब्रह्मसूत्रके पदोंद्वारा भी कहा गया है ॥
english_translation: This truth about the field and the knower has been sung in many ways by sages, in varied Vedic hymns, and in the reasoned, conclusive verses of the Brahma Sutras.
essence: Ancient sources converge on one disciplined way of seeing.
simple_meaning: Sages, Vedic hymns, and the Brahma Sutras all point to the same understanding of the field and the knower.
insight: It shifts the mind from treating wisdom as opinion to seeing it as a tested, cross-verified understanding.
modern_relevance: You hear the same hard truth from a mentor, a book, and your own quiet reflection. The repetition matters: some realities deserve to be confirmed from every angle before you act.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: महाभूतान्यहङ्कारो बुद्धिरव्यक्तमेव च । इन्द्रियाणि दशैकं च पञ्च चेन्द्रियगोचराः ॥
translation: मूल प्रकृति, समष्टि बुद्धि महत्तत्त्व, समष्टि अहंकार, पाँच महाभूत और दस इन्द्रियाँ, एक मन तथा पाँचों इन्द्रियोंके पाँच विषय   यह चौबीस तत्त्वोंवाला क्षेत्र है ॥
english_translation: The five great elements, ego, intellect, the unmanifest, the ten senses, the one mind, and the five sense-objects: this is the field in brief.
essence: What you call “me” is a changing system, not a single thing.
simple_meaning: The body-mind world is made of many parts: elements, ego, intellect, senses, mind, and sense-objects. Krishna is naming the field so Arjuna can see it clearly.
insight: It trains the mind to dissect experience into components instead of collapsing everything into a single identity.
modern_relevance: You sit in a therapist’s office after saying, “I don’t know what’s wrong with me.” The first relief is naming the parts: body, thoughts, impulses, roles, reactions. Clarity starts there.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: इच्छा द्वेषः सुखं दुःखं सङ्घातश्चेतनाधृतिः । एतत्क्षेत्रं समासेन सविकारमुदाहृतम् ॥
translation: इच्छा, द्वेष, सुख, दुःख, संघात, चेतना प्राणशक्ति और धृति  इन विकारोंसहित यह क्षेत्र संक्षेपसे कहा गया है ॥
english_translation: Desire, aversion, pleasure, pain, the body, consciousness, and steadiness: this field, together with its changes, is briefly described.
essence: Your reactions belong to the field, not to the knower.
simple_meaning: The field includes the body, feelings, impulses, and the mind's steadiness. All of these are part of what changes, not the knower behind them.
insight: It shifts attention from identifying with reactions to observing them as changing contents of the field.
modern_relevance: You feel a surge of attraction, then irritation, then numbness, and call it your identity. This verse asks you to see those shifts as passing states, not your core.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: अमानित्वमदम्भित्वमहिंसा क्षान्तिरार्जवम् । आचार्योपासनं शौचं स्थैर्यमात्मविनिग्रहः ॥
translation: मानित्वअपनेमें श्रेष्ठताके भाव का न होना, दम्भित्वदिखावटीपन का न होना, अहिंसा, क्षमा, सरलता, गुरुकी सेवा, बाहरभीतरकी शुद्धि, स्थिरता और मनका वशमें होना ॥
english_translation: Absence of pride, absence of pretence, nonviolence, forgiveness, simplicity, service to the teacher, purity, steadiness, and self-control.
essence: True strength is quiet discipline, not self-display.
simple_meaning: A disciplined life is marked by humility, honesty, nonviolence, forgiveness, simplicity, respect for the teacher, cleanliness, steadiness, and self-mastery.
insight: It shifts attention from image-building to character-building, showing that inner discipline prepares the mind for truth.
modern_relevance: You are about to send the message that could end a friendship, and your chest tightens. This verse asks whether you can stay honest, clean in motive, and steady instead of performing or striking out.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: इन्द्रियार्थेषु वैराग्यमनहङ्कार एव च । जन्ममृत्युजराव्याधिदुःखदोषानुदर्शनम् ॥
translation: इन्द्रियोंके विषयोंमें वैराग्यका होना, अहंकारका भी न होना और जन्म, मृत्यु, वृद्धावस्था तथा व्याधियोंमें दुःखरूप दोषोंको बारबार देखना ॥
english_translation: Dispassion toward sense objects, absence of ego, and constant seeing of the fault in birth, death, old age, and disease.
essence: Freedom begins when desire stops dressing suffering as reward.
simple_meaning: Let go of craving for sensory pleasures, drop ego, and keep seeing how birth, death, old age, and illness bring suffering.
insight: It trains you to weaken attachment by repeatedly noticing impermanence and the cost of clinging.
modern_relevance: You scroll past another perfect-looking life, then feel the pull to compare. This verse asks you to see through the shine: pleasure fades, bodies change, and ego makes everything heavier.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: असक्ितरनभिष्वङ्गः पुत्रदारगृहादिषु । नित्यं च समचित्तत्वमिष्टानिष्टोपपत्तिषु ॥
translation: आसक्तिरहित होना पुत्र, स्त्री, घर आदिमें एकात्मता घनिष्ठ सम्बन्ध न होना और अनुकूलताप्रतिकूलताकी प्राप्तिमें चित्तका नित्य सम रहना ॥
english_translation: Freedom from attachment to sons, wife, home, and the like; and constant evenness of mind in desired and undesired events.
essence: Clinging fades; the mind stays level.
simple_meaning: Do not cling to family and possessions, and keep your mind steady whether things go your way or not.
insight: It trains you to loosen possessiveness and keep the mind balanced through gain and setback.
modern_relevance: You refresh your phone after a hard conversation, hoping for reassurance, then spiral when it does not come. This verse asks for a steadier center than approval, loss, or family pressure.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: मयि चानन्ययोगेन भक्ितरव्यभिचारिणी । विविक्तदेशसेवित्वमरतिर्जनसंसदि ॥
translation: मेरेमें अनन्ययोगके द्वारा अव्यभिचारिणी भक्तिका होना, एकान्त स्थानमें रहनेका स्वभाव होना और जनसमुदायमें प्रीतिका न होना ॥
english_translation: Undivided devotion to me, a love that does not waver, delight in solitude, and no attraction to crowds.
essence: True devotion stays with one center and loses interest in the crowd.
simple_meaning: Steady devotion to Krishna, a love that does not drift, grows with a taste for solitude and little interest in crowds.
insight: It shifts devotion from performance to inward steadiness, where attention stops scattering into social noise.
modern_relevance: You leave a loud gathering and feel your mind settle only after the car ride home. Some parts of you come alive in silence, not in constant company.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: अध्यात्मज्ञाननित्यत्वं तत्त्वज्ञानार्थदर्शनम् । एतज्ज्ञानमिति प्रोक्तमज्ञानं यदतोन्यथा ॥
translation: अध्यात्मज्ञानमें नित्यनिरन्तर रहना, तत्त्वज्ञानके अर्थरूप परमात्माको सब जगह देखना  यह पूर्वोक्त साधनसमुदाय तो ज्ञान है और जो इसके विपरीत है वह अज्ञान है  ऐसा कहा गया है ॥
english_translation: Constant awareness of the inner reality, and seeing the supreme reality as the meaning of true understanding—this is called knowledge; whatever is contrary to this is ignorance.
essence: Knowledge is seeing reality steadily; everything else is confusion.
simple_meaning: Real knowledge means staying aware of the inner reality and seeing the supreme reality everywhere. Anything that misses this is ignorance.
insight: It shifts the mind from collecting information to seeing what truly matters beneath appearances.
modern_relevance: You keep chasing labels, opinions, and surface facts in a tense conversation, but the deeper issue is what is actually real. This verse pulls attention back to that.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: ज्ञेयं यत्तत्प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ज्ञात्वाऽमृतमश्नुते । अनादिमत्परं ब्रह्म न सत्तन्नासदुच्यते ॥
translation: जो ज्ञेय है, उसपरमात्मतत्त्व को मैं अच्छी तरहसे कहूँगा, जिसको जानकर मनुष्य अमरताका अनुभव कर लेता है ।  वह ज्ञेयतत्त्व अनादि और परम ब्रह्म है ।  उसको न सत् कहा जा सकता है और न असत् ही कहा जा सकता है ॥
english_translation: I will now tell you what is to be known. Knowing it, one attains freedom. It is beginningless supreme reality, beyond existence and nonexistence.
essence: The highest reality frees you precisely because it outgrows every label.
simple_meaning: Krishna says he will explain the highest reality that can be known. Knowing it brings freedom. It is beginningless, supreme, and beyond ordinary ideas of real and unreal.
insight: It shifts the mind from arguing about appearances to seeking direct understanding of what underlies them.
modern_relevance: You are trying to name something that changes your whole life — but every label feels too small. Some truths are not objects you can pin down; they must be known directly.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: सर्वतः पाणिपादं तत्सर्वतोऽक्षिशिरोमुखम् । सर्वतः श्रुतिमल्लोके सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठति ॥
translation: वे परमात्मा सब जगह हाथों और पैरोंवाले, सब जगह नेत्रों, सिरों और मुखोंवाले तथा सब जगह कानोंवाले हैं ।  वे संसारमें सबको व्याप्त करके स्थित हैं ॥
english_translation: The supreme reality has hands and feet everywhere, eyes, heads, and faces everywhere, and ears everywhere. It pervades all things and stands within all things.
essence: What seems separate is already filled with the supreme reality.
simple_meaning: The supreme reality is not limited to one form or place. It is present everywhere, expressed through all beings and all senses.
insight: It shifts attention from a distant divine object to a presence that already pervades experience.
modern_relevance: You sit alone in a crowded train after a hard conversation, feeling separate from everyone around you. This verse says the deeper reality has never left the room.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: सर्वेन्द्रियगुणाभासं सर्वेन्द्रियविवर्जितम् । असक्तं सर्वभृच्चैव निर्गुणं गुणभोक्तृ च ॥
translation: वे परमात्मा सम्पूर्ण इन्द्रियोंसे रहित हैं और सम्पूर्ण इन्द्रियोंके विषयोंको प्रकाशित करनेवाले हैं आसक्तिरहित हैं और सम्पूर्ण संसारका भरणपोषण करनेवाले हैं तथा गुणोंसे रहित हैं और सम्पूर्ण गुणोंके भोक्ता हैं ॥
english_translation: The supreme reality has no senses, yet illumines every sense-object. It is detached, supports all beings, beyond the three qualities, and yet experiences the qualities.
essence: What sustains everything is beyond the senses that perceive it.
simple_meaning: The supreme being has no senses, yet makes all perception possible. It is free from attachment, sustains everything, stands beyond the three qualities, and still experiences them all.
insight: It shifts attention from visible form to the unseen presence that makes all form possible.
modern_relevance: You sit in a hospital corridor, unable to fix the outcome. Something larger than your control is still holding the whole scene together.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: बहिरन्तश्च भूतानामचरं चरमेव च । सूक्ष्मत्वात्तदविज्ञेयं दूरस्थं चान्तिके च तत् ॥
translation: वे परमात्मा सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंके बाहरभीतर परिपूर्ण हैं और चरअचर प्राणियोंके रूपमें भी वे ही हैं एवं दूरसेदूर तथा नजदीकसेनजदीक भी वे ही हैं ।  वे अत्यन्त सूक्ष्म होनेसे जाननेका विषय नहीं हैं ॥
english_translation: The supreme reality is inside and outside all beings, moving and unmoving. Because it is subtle, it cannot be known; it is far away and near at hand.
essence: What seems distant is already within everything.
simple_meaning: The supreme reality fills everything, inside and outside all beings. It is both moving and still, yet too subtle to grasp directly. It feels far away and also very near.
insight: It shifts attention from physical distance to direct recognition of what is already present.
modern_relevance: You can sit in a crowded train and still feel utterly cut off, or sit alone and feel deeply held. This verse points to a presence that is closer than your own searching.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: अविभक्तं च भूतेषु विभक्तमिव च स्थितम् । भूतभर्तृ च तज्ज्ञेयं ग्रसिष्णु प्रभविष्णु च ॥
translation: वे परमात्मा स्वयं विभागरहित होते हुए भी सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंमें विभक्तकी तरह स्थित हैं ।  वे जाननेयोग्य परमात्मा ही सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंको उत्पन्न करनेवाले, उनका भरणपोषण करनेवाले और संहार करनेवाले हैं ॥
english_translation: Undivided among beings, it appears divided. Know it as the one who bears, devours, and creates all beings.
essence: Separation is only appearance; the many are held by one.
simple_meaning: The supreme reality seems split into many beings, but it is actually one. It is the source, support, and end of all life.
insight: It shifts perception from isolated parts to one reality expressing itself through many forms.
modern_relevance: You look across a family table after an ugly argument and see only sides. This verse says the deeper truth is still one shared field, even when everyone appears divided.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: ज्योतिषामपि तज्ज्योतिस्तमसः परमुच्यते । ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं ज्ञानगम्यं हृदि सर्वस्य विष्ठितम् ॥
translation: वह परमात्मा सम्पूर्ण ज्योतियोंका भी ज्योति और अज्ञानसे अत्यन्त परे कहा गया है ।  वह ज्ञानस्वरूप, जाननेयोग्य, ज्ञानसाधनसमुदाय से प्राप्त करनेयोग्य और सबके हृदयमें विराजमान है ॥
english_translation: It is the light of all lights, beyond darkness. It is knowledge, the knowable, reached through knowledge, and abiding in every heart.
essence: What illumines everything is already nearest to you.
simple_meaning: The supreme reality is brighter than all light, beyond ignorance, and present in every heart. It is both what is known and the means of knowing it.
insight: It shifts the mind from chasing truth outside to recognising the source of knowing within experience itself.
modern_relevance: You sit in a silent room after a painful argument, replaying every word and wondering what is true. The answer is not somewhere far away; clarity is already closer than your panic.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: इति क्षेत्रं तथा ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं चोक्तं समासतः । मद्भक्त एतद्विज्ञाय मद्भावायोपपद्यते ॥
translation: इस प्रकार क्षेत्र, ज्ञान और ज्ञेयको संक्षेपसे कहा गया ।  मेरा भक्त इसको तत्त्वसे जानकर मेरे भावको प्राप्त हो जाता है ॥
english_translation: Thus, field, knowledge, and the knowable have been explained briefly. My devotee, understanding this, attains my state.
essence: Clear understanding becomes transformation when devotion receives it.
simple_meaning: Krishna summarizes the teaching on the body, knowledge, and the object of knowledge. He says that a devotee who truly understands this reaches his own state.
insight: It turns understanding into a doorway: clear seeing becomes a change in identity and devotion.
modern_relevance: You finally understand a pattern in your relationships after years of repeating it. The insight matters, but the real shift is that you stop living from confusion and start living from alignment.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव विद्ध्यनादी उभावपि । विकारांश्च गुणांश्चैव विद्धि प्रकृतिसंभवान् ॥
translation: प्रकृति और पुरुष  दोनोंको ही तुम अनादि समझो और विकारों तथा गुणोंको भी प्रकृतिसे ही उत्पन्न समझो ।  कार्य और करणके द्वारा होनेवाली क्रियाओंको उत्पन्न करनेमें प्रकृति हेतु कही जाती है और सुखदुःखोंके भोक्तापनमें पुरुष हेतु कहा जाता है ॥
english_translation: Know both Prakriti and Purusha to be beginningless, and know the modifications and qualities to arise from Prakriti.
essence: Change belongs to nature; awareness is not caught in it.
simple_meaning: Both nature and the conscious knower are without beginning. All changes and qualities come from nature, not from the knower.
insight: It shifts attention from identifying with changing traits to seeing their source in nature.
modern_relevance: You feel moods, impulses, and labels shifting all day, then call them “me.” This verse cuts that confusion and points to the deeper awareness beneath the churn.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: कार्यकारणकर्तृत्वे हेतुः प्रकृतिरुच्यते । पुरुषः सुखदुःखानां भोक्तृत्वे हेतुरुच्यते ॥
