english_translation: One who has become Brahman, serene in mind, grieves not and desires not. Equal toward all beings, that person attains supreme devotion to Me.
essence: Freedom from craving makes room for the highest devotion.
simple_meaning: A person who has reached a steady, clear state no longer grieves or chases after things. Seeing all beings equally, that person reaches the highest devotion to Krishna.
insight: It shifts the mind from grasping and comparison to equal seeing and wholehearted devotion.
modern_relevance: You finally stop checking your phone after sending the hard message. The chest unclenches, the need for reassurance fades, and something steadier than anxiety begins to move you.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: भक्त्या मामभिजानाति यावान्यश्चास्मि तत्त्वतः । ततो मां तत्त्वतो ज्ञात्वा विशते तदनन्तरम् ॥
translation: उस पराभक्तिसे मेरेको, मैं जितना हूँ और जो हूँ  इसको तत्त्वसे जान लेता है तथा मेरेको तत्त्वसे जानकर फिर तत्काल मेरेमें प्रविष्ट हो जाता है ॥
english_translation: Through devoted love, one truly knows Me as I am. Knowing Me in truth, one enters into Me at once.
essence: Devoted love turns understanding into immediate nearness.
simple_meaning: Devoted love lets a person know Krishna truly, beyond surface ideas. That true knowing leads straight into closeness with him.
insight: It shifts devotion from emotion alone to a mode of direct knowing that changes relationship into union.
modern_relevance: You can study someone for years and still miss them. Then one act of wholehearted love cuts through every theory and makes them unmistakably real.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: सर्वकर्माण्यपि सदा कुर्वाणो मद्व्यपाश्रयः । मत्प्रसादादवाप्नोति शाश्वतं पदमव्ययम् ॥
translation: मेरा आश्रय लेनेवाला भक्त सदा सब कर्म करता हुआ भी मेरी कृपासे शाश्वत अविनाशी पदको प्राप्त हो जाता है ॥
english_translation: A devotee who takes refuge in me, while always doing all actions, attains the eternal, imperishable state through my grace.
essence: Continuous action and complete refuge can lead to the same unchanging state.
simple_meaning: Keep doing all your work, but rely on Krishna rather than your own control. That surrender leads to an eternal, unchanging state.
insight: It shifts action from self-reliance to surrendered participation, where effort continues but ownership of the result is released.
modern_relevance: You send the hard message, sign the painful form, or walk into the difficult room anyway. The body acts; the grip on control loosens.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: चेतसा सर्वकर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्परः । बुद्धियोगमुपाश्रित्य मच्चित्तः सततं भव ॥
translation: चित्तसे सम्पूर्ण कर्म मुझमें अर्पण करके, मेरे परायण होकर तथा समताका आश्रय लेकर निरन्तर मुझमें चित्तवाला हो जा ॥
english_translation: With your mind, surrender all actions to Me. Take refuge in the discipline of clear understanding and remain constantly focused on Me.
essence: Hand over the action, and let the mind stay gathered there.
simple_meaning: Give every action to Krishna, rely on clear understanding, and keep your mind steadily on the divine.
insight: It shifts attention from self-protection to steady alignment with the highest aim.
modern_relevance: You are about to send the message that changes everything, and your hand hovers over the button. Instead of spiraling, you place the whole act in something larger than fear and stay centered.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: मच्चित्तः सर्वदुर्गाणि मत्प्रसादात्तरिष्यसि । अथ चेत्त्वमहङ्कारान्न श्रोष्यसि विनङ्क्ष्यसि ॥
translation: मेरेमें चित्तवाला होकर तू मेरी कृपासे सम्पूर्ण विघ्नोंको तर जायगा और यदि तू अहंकारके कारण मेरी बात नहीं सुनेगा तो तेरा पतन हो जायगा ॥
english_translation: Centered in me, you will cross all obstacles through my grace. But if you do not listen because of ego, you will fall.
essence: Grace opens the way; ego closes it.
simple_meaning: Keep your attention fixed on the divine, and you can cross every obstacle through grace. Refuse that guidance out of ego, and you will fall.
insight: It shifts you from self-protection to receptive surrender, where guidance can actually reach you.
modern_relevance: You are about to send the message that could end a relationship, and your pride keeps rewriting the words. Stay open enough to hear what is true, or the same ego will trip you into the wrong choice.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: यदहङ्कारमाश्रित्य न योत्स्य इति मन्यसे । मिथ्यैष व्यवसायस्ते प्रकृतिस्त्वां नियोक्ष्यति ॥
translation: अहंकारका आश्रय लेकर तू जो ऐसा मान रहा है कि मैं युद्ध नहीं करूँगा, तेरा यह निश्चय मिथ्या झूठा है क्योंकि तेरी क्षात्रप्रकृति तेरेको युद्धमें लगा देगी ॥
english_translation: Relying on ego, you think, 'I will not fight.' That resolve is false; your nature will drive you into battle.
essence: Ego cannot veto what your nature has already chosen.
simple_meaning: Refusing your duty out of pride will not hold. Your deeper nature will still push you toward the action that fits you.
insight: It shifts the mind from self-protective refusal to honest alignment with one's real duty.
modern_relevance: You sit in the car outside the house, rehearsing the text you do not want to send. The longer you delay, the more obvious it becomes: avoidance is not the same as freedom.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: स्वभावजेन कौन्तेय निबद्धः स्वेन कर्मणा । कर्तुं नेच्छसि यन्मोहात्करिष्यस्यवशोऽपि तत् ॥
translation: हे कुन्तीनन्दन  अपने स्वभावजन्य कर्मसे बँधा हुआ तू मोहके कारण जो नहीं करना चाहता, उसको तू क्षात्रप्रकृतिके परवश होकर करेगा ॥
english_translation: Bound by your own nature-born duty, you will do what you do not want to do in confusion. Even against your will, you will act.
essence: Resistance cannot cancel what your nature is already set to do.
simple_meaning: Your own nature pushes you toward certain actions. Confusion may make you resist them, but you may still end up doing them anyway.
insight: It shifts you from self-deception to honest recognition of the forces already moving your behavior.
modern_relevance: You keep saying you won't send the message, quit the job, or tell the hard truth. Hours later, the same pressure inside you pushes you to do it anyway.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: ईश्वरः सर्वभूतानां हृद्देशेऽर्जुन तिष्ठति । भ्रामयन्सर्वभूतानि यन्त्रारूढानि मायया ॥
translation: हे अर्जुन  ईश्वर सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंके हृदयमें रहता है और अपनी मायासे शरीररूपी यन्त्रपर आरूढ़ हुए सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंको उनके स्वभावके अनुसार भ्रमण कराता रहता है ॥
english_translation: O Arjuna, the Lord abides in the heart of all beings and, by His maya, causes all beings mounted on a body-machine to revolve according to their nature.
essence: The deeper mover is not your ego, and surrender begins there.
simple_meaning: The divine lives in every being’s heart and moves all beings through maya, as if they were riding a body-machine and turning according to their nature.
insight: It shifts responsibility from egoic control to humble surrender to the deeper order already at work.
modern_relevance: You keep replaying the same argument in your head, certain you are choosing freely, yet your fears and habits keep steering you back. This verse points to the deeper forces already moving the machine.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: तमेव शरणं गच्छ सर्वभावेन भारत । तत्प्रसादात्परां शान्तिं स्थानं प्राप्स्यसि शाश्वतम् ॥
translation: हे भरतवंशोद्भव अर्जुन  तू सर्वभावसे उस ईश्वरकी ही शरणमें चला जा ।  उसकी कृपासे तू परमशान्तिसंसारसे सर्वथा उपरति को और अविनाशी परमपदको प्राप्त हो जायगा ॥
english_translation: Surrender to the divine with your whole being, Arjuna. By that grace, you will reach supreme peace and the eternal abode.
essence: Wholehearted surrender opens the door to lasting peace.
simple_meaning: Give yourself entirely to the divine, and you will receive deep peace and the eternal home beyond change.
insight: It shifts the mind from self-managed strain to wholehearted surrender, trusting grace to complete what effort cannot.
modern_relevance: You are standing at a hospital corridor, unable to fix what is happening inside the room. At some point, clenched control becomes exhaustion; this verse points to the release of handing the burden over.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: इति ते ज्ञानमाख्यातं गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं मया । विमृश्यैतदशेषेण यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु ॥
translation: यह गुह्यसे भी गुह्यतर शरणागतिरूप ज्ञान मैंने तुझे कह दिया ।  अब तू इसपर अच्छी तरहसे विचार करके जैसा चाहता है, वैसा कर ॥
english_translation: Thus I have explained to you the most secret wisdom. Reflect on it fully, and then do as you wish.
essence: True guidance ends by returning choice to you.
simple_meaning: Krishna says he has given Arjuna the deepest teaching. Arjuna should think it through completely and then decide what to do.
insight: It shifts the mind from pressure to responsibility: understand fully, then decide without inner coercion.
modern_relevance: You’ve heard every side of a painful decision and still feel pulled apart. The clearest voice may not be the loudest one — it may be the one that leaves room for honest choice.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: सर्वगुह्यतमं भूयः श्रृणु मे परमं वचः । इष्टोऽसि मे दृढमिति ततो वक्ष्यामि ते हितम् ॥
translation: सबसे अत्यन्त गोपनीय वचन तू फिर मेरेसे सुन ।  तू मेरा अत्यन्त प्रिय है, इसलिये मैं तेरे हितकी बात कहूँगा ॥
english_translation: Listen again to My most secret word. You are dear to Me, so I will speak for your good.
essence: The deepest teaching is spoken as care, not command.
simple_meaning: Krishna asks Arjuna to hear one more secret teaching. Because Arjuna is dear to him, Krishna will speak only what is truly beneficial.
insight: It shifts the listener from passive hearing to trusting that the next instruction is meant for their good.
modern_relevance: A friend stops you before you make the wrong call and says, 'Hear me out once more — I’m telling you this because I care.' That moment can change everything.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु । मामेवैष्यसि सत्यं ते प्रतिजाने प्रियोऽसि मे ॥
translation: तू मेरा भक्त हो जा, मेरेमें मनवाला हो जा, मेरा पूजन करनेवाला हो जा और मेरेको नमस्कार कर ।  ऐसा करनेसे तू मेरेको ही प्राप्त हो जायगा  यह मैं तेरे सामने सत्य प्रतिज्ञा करता हूँ क्योंकि तू मेरा अत्यन्त प्रिय है ॥
english_translation: Fix your mind on me, become my devotee, worship me, and bow to me. You will come to me; I promise you this truly, because you are dear to me.
essence: Wholehearted devotion becomes the shortest path home.
simple_meaning: Krishna asks Arjuna to keep his mind on him, love him, worship him, and show reverence. He promises that this wholehearted devotion leads to union with him.
insight: It shifts devotion from sentiment to commitment: attention, love, action, and humility all point in one direction.
modern_relevance: You are standing outside a hospital room, about to say the one honest sentence that could change everything. This verse asks for a single-hearted turn toward what is highest, even when fear is loud.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: सर्वधर्मान्परित्यज्य मामेकं शरणं व्रज । अहं त्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः ॥
translation: सम्पूर्ण धर्मोंका आश्रय छोड़कर तू केवल मेरी शरणमें आ जा ।  मैं तुझे सम्पूर्ण पापोंसे मुक्त कर दूँगा, चिन्ता मत कर ॥
english_translation: Abandon all duties and take refuge in Me alone. I will free you from all wrongdoing; do not grieve.
essence: Total refuge ends the burden of fear.
simple_meaning: Let go of every lesser support and place yourself fully in Krishna's care. He promises freedom from all wrongdoing and asks Arjuna not to grieve.
insight: It shifts the mind from self-managed control to complete reliance on the divine.
modern_relevance: You are standing outside a hospital room, phone in hand, after the call that changed everything. At some point, control runs out. This verse speaks to the moment you stop bargaining and finally place the burden down.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: इदं ते नातपस्काय नाभक्ताय कदाचन । न चाशुश्रूषवे वाच्यं न च मां योऽभ्यसूयति ॥
translation: यह सर्वगुह्यतम वचन अतपस्वीको मत कहना अभक्तको कभी मत कहना जो सुनना नहीं चाहता, उसको मत कहना और जो मेरेमें दोषदृष्टि करता है, उससे भी मत कहना ॥
english_translation: Never speak this to one without discipline, one without devotion, one unwilling to listen, or one who finds fault with me.
essence: Deep truth must be shared only with those ready to receive it.
simple_meaning: Keep this deepest teaching away from people who are unreceptive, undisciplined, or hostile to Krishna.
insight: It teaches discernment in sharing wisdom: protect what is sacred from contempt and unreadiness.
modern_relevance: You finally say something honest and life-changing, but the room is wrong for it. Some people want a debate, not transformation; some ears are simply not open yet.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: य इमं परमं गुह्यं मद्भक्तेष्वभिधास्यति । भक्ितं मयि परां कृत्वा मामेवैष्यत्यसंशयः ॥
translation: मेरेमें पराभक्ति करके जो इस परम गोपनीय संवादगीताग्रन्थ को मेरे भक्तोंमें कहेगा, वह मुझे ही प्राप्त होगा  इसमें कोई सन्देह नहीं है ॥
english_translation: Whoever shares this supreme secret among my devotees, with devoted love for me, will surely come to me without doubt.
essence: Devotion deepens when sacred truth is passed on.
simple_meaning: Anyone who shares this deepest teaching with devoted love will reach Krishna without doubt.
insight: It shifts devotion from private feeling to shared transmission.
modern_relevance: You finally understand something life-changing after a long crisis, and your first instinct is to keep it private. The verse says the truth ripens when you pass it on with reverence.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: न च तस्मान्मनुष्येषु कश्िचन्मे प्रियकृत्तमः । भविता न च मे तस्मादन्यः प्रियतरो भुवि ॥
translation: उसके समान मेरा अत्यन्त प्रिय कार्य करनेवाला मनुष्योंमें कोई भी नहीं है और इस भूमण्डलपर उसके समान मेरा दूसरा कोई प्रियतर होगा भी नहीं ॥
english_translation: Among all human beings, no one does what is more dear to me than he does. On this earth, no one will ever be dearer than he is.
essence: Sharing this teaching becomes the highest form of devotion.
simple_meaning: Anyone who passes on this sacred teaching becomes especially dear to Krishna. No one on earth can surpass that devotion.
insight: It shifts the reader from private ownership of wisdom to generous transmission of it.
modern_relevance: You explain a hard-earned lesson to someone who is ready to hear it, not to impress them. The act of passing on what truly helped you becomes its own offering.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: अध्येष्यते च य इमं धर्म्यं संवादमावयोः । ज्ञानयज्ञेन तेनाहमिष्टः स्यामिति मे मतिः ॥
translation: जो मनुष्य हम दोनोंके इस धर्ममय संवादका अध्ययन करेगा, उसके द्वारा भी मैं ज्ञानयज्ञसे पूजित होऊँगा  ऐसा मेरा मत है ॥
english_translation: Whoever studies this sacred dialogue of ours will also worship me through the sacrifice of knowledge; that is my view.
essence: Sincere study of this dialogue becomes worship itself.
simple_meaning: Reading and studying Krishna and Arjuna’s sacred dialogue is itself a form of worship through knowledge.
insight: It turns study into practice, and learning into an act of reverence rather than information gathering.
modern_relevance: You open a book late at night because a hard decision is waiting tomorrow. The reading is not escape; it becomes an offering that steadies your mind before you act.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: श्रद्धावाननसूयश्च श्रृणुयादपि यो नरः । सोऽपि मुक्तः शुभाँल्लोकान्प्राप्नुयात्पुण्यकर्मणाम् ॥
translation: श्रद्धावान् और दोषदृष्टिसे रहित जो मनुष्य इस गीताग्रन्थको सुन भी लेगा, वह भी सम्पूर्ण पापोंसे मुक्त होकर पुण्यकारियोंके शुभ लोकोंको प्राप्त हो जायगा ॥
english_translation: Even a person who listens to this with trust and without fault-finding becomes free and reaches the auspicious realms earned by noble action.
essence: Trustful listening can open the door to freedom.
simple_meaning: A person who listens with trust and without criticism is lifted free and reaches a better state earned by good action.
insight: It shifts the reader from judging teaching to receiving it, making openness itself the first practice.
modern_relevance: You hear a hard truth in a quiet room and feel the urge to dismiss it. The verse says the turning point is not brilliance — it is listening without defensiveness.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: कच्चिदेतच्छ्रुतं पार्थ त्वयैकाग्रेण चेतसा । कच्चिदज्ञानसंमोहः प्रनष्टस्ते धनञ्जय ॥
translation: हे पृथानन्दन  क्या तुमने एकाग्रचित्तसे इसको सुना और हे धनञ्जय  क्या तुम्हारा अज्ञानसे उत्पन्न मोह नष्ट हुआ ॥
english_translation: O Partha, have you heard this with one-pointed mind? O Dhananjaya, has the delusion born of ignorance been destroyed in you?
essence: True listening should end confusion, not just collect words.
simple_meaning: Krishna asks whether Arjuna has listened carefully and whether his confusion has been cleared away.
insight: It shifts attention from passive hearing to whether understanding has actually taken root.
modern_relevance: After a hard conversation, you pause and ask yourself: did I really listen, or just hear the words? That moment decides whether confusion is still running the show.
speaker: Krishna

verse_text: अर्जुन उवाचनष्टो मोहः स्मृतिर्लब्धा त्वत्प्रसादान्मयाच्युत । स्थितोऽस्मि गतसन्देहः करिष्ये वचनं तव ॥
translation: अर्जुन बोले  हे अच्युत  आपकी कृपासे मेरा मोह नष्ट हो गया है और स्मृति प्राप्त हो गयी है ।  मैं सन्देहरहित होकर स्थित हूँ ।  अब मैं आपकी आज्ञाका पालन करूँगा ॥
english_translation: Arjuna said: By your grace, O Achyuta, my delusion is destroyed and memory restored. I stand free of doubt and will do what you say.
essence: Grace ends confusion and turns insight into obedience.
simple_meaning: Arjuna says Krishna's grace has removed his confusion. His doubt is gone, and he is ready to follow Krishna's instruction.
insight: It shifts you from paralysis and second-guessing into clear, committed action.
modern_relevance: You finally make the call after days of avoidance. The knot in your chest loosens, not because the choice became easy, but because you know what you must do.
speaker: Arjuna

verse_text: सञ्जय उवाचइत्यहं वासुदेवस्य पार्थस्य च महात्मनः । संवादमिममश्रौषमद्भुतं रोमहर्षणम् ॥
translation: सञ्जय बोले  इस प्रकार मैंने भगवान् वासुदेव और महात्मा पृथानन्दन अर्जुनका यह रोमाञ्चित करनेवाला अद्भुत संवाद सुना ॥
english_translation: Sanjaya said: Thus I heard this wondrous, hair-raising dialogue between Vasudeva and the great-souled Partha.
essence: A true dialogue can leave the listener shaken and changed.
simple_meaning: Sanjaya closes by saying he heard this astonishing exchange between Krishna and Arjuna.
insight: It frames the Gita as a witnessed transformation, not a detached lecture.
modern_relevance: You sit in a silent car after a life-changing conversation, still feeling the words in your body. Some exchanges are not just heard; they rearrange you.
speaker: Sanjaya

verse_text: व्यासप्रसादाच्छ्रुतवानेतद्गुह्यमहं परम् । योगं योगेश्वरात्कृष्णात्साक्षात्कथयतः स्वयम् ॥
translation: व्यासजीकी कृपासे मैंने स्वयं इस परम गोपनीय योग गीताग्रन्थ को कहते हुए साक्षात् योगेश्वर भगवान् श्रीकृष्णसे सुना है ॥
english_translation: By Vyasa's grace, I heard this supreme secret yoga directly from Krishna, the Lord of yoga, as he spoke it himself.
essence: The deepest teaching is received, not invented.
simple_meaning: Sanjaya says he heard the highest secret teaching directly from Krishna, by Vyasa's grace.
insight: It shifts attention from secondhand opinion to direct transmission of what matters most.
modern_relevance: You replay a conversation that changed everything and realise its force came from how directly it was spoken. Some guidance lands only when it is heard without distortion.
speaker: Sanjaya

verse_text: राजन्संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य संवादमिममद्भुतम् । केशवार्जुनयोः पुण्यं हृष्यामि च मुहुर्मुहुः ॥
translation: हे राजन्  भगवान् श्रीकृष्ण और अर्जुनके इस पवित्र और अद्भुत संवादको याद करकरके मैं बारबार हर्षित हो रहा हूँ ॥
english_translation: O King, remembering again and again this wondrous, holy dialogue between Krishna and Arjuna, I rejoice again and again.
essence: A sacred conversation keeps giving joy each time it is remembered.
simple_meaning: Sanjaya tells Dhritarashtra that he keeps remembering Krishna and Arjuna's sacred, astonishing conversation and feels joy each time.
insight: It shifts attention from the event itself to the lasting transformation a true teaching leaves behind.
modern_relevance: You replay a conversation that changed you — a teacher's words, a hard truth, a moment of clarity — and the memory still steadies you.
speaker: Sanjaya

verse_text: तच्च संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य रूपमत्यद्भुतं हरेः । विस्मयो मे महान् राजन् हृष्यामि च पुनः पुनः ॥
translation: हे राजन्  भगवान् श्रीकृष्णके उस अत्यन्त अद्भुत विराट्रूपको याद करकरके मेरेको बड़ा भारी आश्चर्य हो रहा है और मैं बारबार हर्षित हो रहा हूँ ॥
english_translation: Remembering that astonishing form of Krishna again and again, I feel great wonder, O King, and I rejoice again and again.
essence: Remembering Krishna's vast form still overwhelms the mind with wonder.
simple_meaning: Sanjaya says that remembering Krishna's astonishing cosmic form fills him with wonder and repeated joy.
insight: It turns memory into reverence, showing that real vision keeps renewing awe.
modern_relevance: You replay a moment that changed you — a funeral, a birth, a breakup, a sudden act of grace — and it still stops you cold. Some experiences keep unfolding long after they end.
speaker: Sanjaya

verse_text: यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः । तत्र श्रीर्विजयो भूतिर्ध्रुवा नीतिर्मतिर्मम ॥
translation: जहाँ योगेश्वर भगवान् श्रीकृष्ण हैं और जहाँ गाण्डीवधनुषधारी अर्जुन हैं, वहाँ ही श्री, विजय, विभूति और अचल नीति है  ऐसा मेरा मत है ॥
english_translation: Where Krishna, the master of yoga, is present, and where Arjuna, the bow-bearer, is present, there are prosperity, victory, glory, and firm justice. This is my conviction.
essence: Right action carries its own victory.
simple_meaning: Sanjaya says that wherever Krishna and Arjuna are together, success, prosperity, and right order are assured.
insight: It shifts attention from fear of outcome to alignment with what is right and steady.
modern_relevance: You are about to send the message that will change everything. The room is tense, but you know the decision is aligned. This verse names that strange calm: when principle and courage stand together, the path opens.
speaker: Sanjaya

verse_text:
गुरो ! वेदान्ततत्त्वज्ञ ! वेदार्थद्योतकान्यहो।
अनेकानि पुराणानि कृपातः श्रावितानि मे ॥
translation: हे वेदान्त के तत्त्व जानने वाले गुरो ! वेदार्थ प्रतिपादक अनेक पुराण अहो ! आपने कृपापूर्वक मुझे सुनाये हैं
english_translation: O teacher, knower of Vedanta truth, revealer of Vedic meaning! By your grace, I have heard many ancient stories.
essence: Grateful listening to a teacher's many ancient Vedanta stories brings profound wisdom.
simple_meaning: I have gratefully listened to many ancient stories from my kind teacher who understands Vedanta and reveals Vedic teachings.
insight: It highlights the value of a patient teacher whose sharing opens the listener to profound understanding through stories.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अनेकोपनिषत्साररूपा गीताश्च कीर्तिताः ।
जातोऽस्म्यहं ततो देव ! कृतकृत्यो न संशयः ॥
translation: और उपनिषत्सार रूप अनेक गीताएँ भी कही हैं हे देव ! जिससे मैं निसन्देह कृतकृत्य होगया हूँ
english_translation: Many songs that embody the essence of the Upanishads have been sung; from them, O divine, I am undoubtedly fulfilled.
essence: Many teachings together bring a deep sense of fulfillment and clarity.
simple_meaning: Many songs capturing the heart of the Upanishads have been told, and from them I feel completely fulfilled.
insight: Recognize that wisdom is often a tapestry of many teachings rather than a single source.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
आश्रौपञ्च भवत्तोऽहं पुराख्यानप्रसङ्गतः।
जगत्कर्ता जगद्धाता जगज्जन्मादिकारणम् ॥
translation: पूर्व कथाप्रसङ्ग में मैंने आपसे सुना है कि जगजन्मादि कारण जगत्कर्ता जगद्धाता
english_translation: I am the ancient cause of the world, its creator, protector, and the source of birth and existence.
essence: There is an ancient, underlying source responsible for creation, protection, and birth of the world.
simple_meaning: I am described as the ancient cause, creator, and protector of all existence with its origins.
insight: It shifts attention to a foundational source behind all change and existence, inviting reflection on origins beyond surface events.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
जगत्पिता जगद्वन्धुर्भगवान विश्वपालकः । 
परे बुद्धे: स्थितो बुद्धिमधिष्ठाय कृपावशात् ॥
translation: जगद बंधू जगत्पिता जगत्पालक श्रीभगवान् बुद्धि के परे स्थित हैं और वह शरणागतवत्सल कृपावश बुद्धि में अधिष्ठान करके
english_translation: The revered one, father and friend of the world, protector of all, dwells beyond the discerning mind, compassionately abiding within it like a refuge.
essence: A compassionate divine presence dwells beyond the mind yet abides within it as refuge.
simple_meaning: The revered divine being is beyond the mind but compassionately abides within it as a refuge for all beings.
insight: It invites you to sense support beyond mental struggles by resting in compassionate presence beyond thought.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
मुक्तिं ददाति जीवेभ्यः शरणागतवत्सलः । 
अतः सम्प्रोच्यते धीश आम्नायैरखिलैरसौ ॥
translation: जीवों को मुक्तिप्रदान करते हैं इस कारण उनको सब वेदों ने धीश कहा है
english_translation: The divine grants freedom to living beings who seek refuge; therefore, all scriptures call the divine the wise lord.
essence: The divine grants freedom and protection to all who sincerely seek refuge.
simple_meaning: The divine lovingly frees those who come for protection, so all scriptures call the divine the wise lord.
insight: It shifts your trust toward seeking support, knowing that surrender leads to real inner freedom.
modern_relevance: When life feels overwhelming and you reach out for help, this reminds you that true refuge brings freedom from suffering.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
इत्यप्याकणितं नाथ ! भवतो वदनाम्बुजाद । 
यत्पुरा दिव्यमासाद्य धीशलोकं महर्षयः ॥
translation: हे नाथ ! मैंने आपके मुखकमल से यह भी सुना है कि पुराकाल में महर्षिगण ने दिव्य धीशलोक में उपस्थित होकर
english_translation: O Lord! I have also heard from your lotus mouth that in ancient times the great sages assembled in the divine realm of wisdom.
essence: Ancient sages once gathered in a divine realm of wisdom, as told by the teacher.
simple_meaning: Someone says they have heard from the teacher's mouth that ancient sages once gathered in a divine realm of wisdom.
insight: It highlights the tradition of passing wisdom through revered teachers and ancient gatherings.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
श्रीमद्गणपतेर्देवाच्छ्रतवन्तो हिताच्छभान् ।
अनेकोपनिषत्सारोपदेशान्मुक्तिदायकान् ॥
translation: श्रीगणपतिदेव से मुक्तिप्रद उपनिषत्सार रूप हित और शुभ अनेक उपदेशों का श्रवण किया था
english_translation: They listened to many beneficial and auspicious teachings from Shri Ganapati, the giver of liberation, which are the essence of the Upanishads.
essence: Listening to Shri Ganapati reveals many liberating teachings from the Upanishads.
simple_meaning: They heard many good and freeing teachings from Shri Ganapati, which summarize the Upanishads.
insight: Recognize that deep teachings often come through trusted guides who connect you to essential truths.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
तवासीमकृपाराशिर्मय्यास्ते या तयैव माम् । 
दिव्यां धीशार्षिसम्बादरूपां पुण्यमयीमतः ॥
translation: अतः मेरे ऊपर जो आपकी अपार कृपाराशि है है कृपासागर ! आप उससे ही मुझे धीश और महर्षि सम्वाद रूप
english_translation: Because of your immense ocean of compassion, I have received this divine dialogue with sages and the wise.
essence: Compassion opens the way for receiving sacred wisdom.
simple_meaning: Your great compassion has given me this sacred dialogue with wise beings.
insight: Recognize that deep wisdom often comes through the compassionate support of others or the divine.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
ज्ञानदा मुक्तिदां श्रव्यां धीशगीतां सुधोपमाम्। 
कुरुष्व श्रावयित्वा मां कृतकृत्यं कृपार्णव! ॥
translation: ज्ञान और मुक्ति देनेवाली श्रवणीय-अमृतरूप पवित्र दिव्य धीश-गीता को सुनाकर कृतकृत्य कीजिये
english_translation: Listen to the divine Dheesh Gita, the sacred nectar that grants wisdom and freedom, and feel fulfilled with gratitude.
essence: True wisdom and freedom inspire heartfelt gratitude through attentive listening.
simple_meaning: Listening to the sacred Dheesh Gita brings wisdom and freedom, leading to a deep sense of gratitude.
insight: It encourages embracing teachings with an open heart, allowing gratitude to deepen your connection to wisdom.
modern_relevance: You find a moment of calm and clarity reading something that truly enlightens you, naturally filling you with thankfulness.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
कस्मान्महर्षिभिर्धीशलोकः प्राप्तः पुरा प्रभो ! 
क वासो धीशलोकोऽस्ति कथम्बा तत्र गम्यते ॥
translation: हे प्रभो ! पुराकाल में, महर्षिगण किस कारण से धीशलोक में पहुंचे थे और वह धीश लोक कहां पर है, किस प्रकार से वहां जाना होता है
english_translation: O Lord! In ancient times, why did the great sages reach the realm of the wise, and where is that realm located, how does one go there?
essence: The verse poses a question about the nature and access to the realm of the wise.
simple_meaning: The verse asks why great sages in ancient times reached the realm of the wise, where it is, and how to get there.
insight: It encourages questioning and seeking understanding about higher states of wisdom and existence.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
कान्यध्यात्मरहस्यानि धीशदेवेन प्रोचिरे । 
श्रावयित्वा च तत्सर्वं व्यासतो मां कृतार्थय ॥
translation: और गणपतिदेव ने किन अध्यात्म रहस्यो का वर्णन किया था उन सबको विस्तार पूर्वक सुनाकर मुझे कृतार्थ करें
english_translation: And after the lord of wisdom spoke all the secrets of the self, having narrated them fully, Vyasa made me satisfied.
essence: Complete spiritual teachings bring deep fulfillment and satisfaction.
simple_meaning: The narrator describes that the lord of wisdom spoke spiritual secrets, and Vyasa made the narrator feel fulfilled after hearing them all.
insight: It shows how receiving complete teachings brings clarity and a sense of wholeness.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
येन श्रौतरहस्यं तत्मचार्याहं पुनः पुनः । 
मुमुक्षूणां कृते लोके धन्यः स्यां हि स्वयं ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: जिससे मैं उन वेद रहस्यो को मुमुक्षु व्यक्तियों के लिये जगत में बारम्बार प्रचारित करके निश्वय ही स्वयं धन्य होऊँ
english_translation: By which I repeatedly reveal the secret teachings of the Vedas for those seeking freedom, I myself become truly blessed in this world.
essence: Sharing profound wisdom with seekers brings true and certain blessing to the teacher.
simple_meaning: You become truly blessed by repeatedly sharing the hidden wisdom of the Vedas with those seeking liberation.
insight: It shifts the focus from hoarding knowledge to generously sharing it, which brings inner blessing.
modern_relevance: You feel truly fulfilled when you share your hard-earned knowledge to help others who are searching for meaning.
speaker: Teacher

verse_text:
सूत ! ते धर्मजिज्ञासाप्रवृता जन्मसिद्धया। 
भक्तया गुरोश्व सदुद्धया विश्वकल्याणसक्तया ॥
translation: हे सूत तुम्हारी गुरुभक्ति, जन्मसिद्ध धर्म जिज्ञासा प्रवृत्ति और जगत कल्याण में तत्पर सद्बुद्धि से
english_translation: O Suta, your devotion to the guru, born of innate inquiry into dharma, and your wise mind eager for the welfare of the world,
essence: True devotion and wise inquiry arise naturally from a heart committed to universal welfare.
simple_meaning: Suta’s devotion to his guru comes from his natural desire to understand dharma and a wise mind focused on helping the world.
insight: It shows how genuine devotion and wisdom arise from heartfelt concern for what is right and beneficial for all.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
प्रसन्नोऽस्म्यहमत्यन्तं सौम्यात्ते च स्वभावतः। 
यत्वं जिज्ञाससे तात ! यत्त्वं वा शंकसे ह्यतः ॥
translation: एवं सौम्य स्वभाव से मैं अति प्रसन्न हूँ इसी कारण हे तात! तुम जो जिज्ञासा करते हो और तुम जो शंका करते हो
english_translation: I am extremely pleased by your gentle nature, dear son; your questions and doubts are welcome.
essence: Gentle questioning and doubt are welcomed as signs of sincere engagement and trust.
simple_meaning: The speaker expresses happiness because the listener's gentle nature shows in their sincere questions and doubts.
insight: It teaches you to see doubts and questions as a natural and respected part of growth, not weakness.
modern_relevance: You find yourself hesitating to ask questions at work or with a mentor, worried about judgment—here is reassurance that honest curiosity is valued.
speaker: Shri Dheesh

verse_text:
तत्समाधानदानेन नितान्तं मोदमावहे । 
यतो में प्रियशिष्योऽसि मत्कृपापुञ्जभाजनम् ॥
translation: उसका समाधान करने से मैं अत्यन्त, आनन्दित होता हूँ, क्योंकि तुम मेरे प्रिय शिष्य और अति कृपापात्र हो
english_translation: I am extremely pleased by your resolution, because you are my dear disciple and very deserving of my kindness.
essence: A teacher's joy comes from a disciple's readiness and worthiness of kindness.
simple_meaning: The speaker feels great joy because their dear disciple has resolved something important and is worthy of their kindness.
insight: Recognize that a trusted teacher or mentor finds joy in your progress and readiness to receive guidance.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
जिज्ञासुप्राणिवृन्देभ्यः शिक्षादानं निरन्तरम्। 
मुमुक्षुसाधकेभ्यश्च तत्त्वज्ञानोपदेशनम् ॥
translation: जिज्ञासु प्राणियो को निरन्तर उपदेश प्रदान, मुमुक्षु साधको को तत्त्वज्ञानोपदेश
english_translation: Continuously teach those who seek knowledge and instruct earnest seekers in the true nature of reality.
essence: Teaching must be continuous and sincere for those genuinely seeking truth.
simple_meaning: Always offer teaching to those curious about truth and guide sincere seekers toward understanding reality deeply.
insight: It encourages a steady, compassionate commitment to support others’ journey toward deeper understanding.
modern_relevance: You find yourself patiently helping friends or colleagues who ask deep questions, sharing insights without holding back.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
वेदानां ज्ञानरूपाणां विश्वस्मिंश्च प्रचारणम् ।
तेषां प्रकाशञ्चास्ति जीवनस्य व्रतं मम ॥
translation: और ज्ञानमय वेदों का जगत में प्रचार एवं उनका प्रकाश करना मेरे जीवन का व्रत है
english_translation: Spreading the knowledge-filled Vedas and their illumination in the world is my life's vow.
essence: Committing your life to spreading enlightening knowledge defines your true purpose.
simple_meaning: Your life's calling is to share and spread the knowledge and wisdom contained in ancient teachings.
insight: It teaches you to see your purpose as sharing knowledge beyond yourself, making your actions meaningful.
modern_relevance: You find yourself compelled to share a valuable insight or idea that could help others grow and understand life better.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सूत ! विश्वेशमाहात्म्यप्रचारः पुण्यवर्द्धनः।
स्वभावाद्रोचते मह्यं तत्रासि त्वं सहायकः ॥
translation: हे सूत! पुण्य वर्द्धक भगवत महिमा प्रचार में मेरी स्वाभाविक रुचि है और जगत में भगवत महिमा प्रचार कार्य में तुम सहायक हो इस कारण
english_translation: O Suta! I naturally take interest in spreading the divine glory that increases virtue, and you assist in this work of spreading the divine glory in the world.
essence: Natural attraction to spreading divine glory finds support in helpers.
simple_meaning: There is a natural interest in spreading the divine glory that enhances goodness, and Suta supports this work in the world.
insight: It shows how natural enthusiasm and teamwork support spreading positive influence.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सानन्दं पूरयिष्येऽतः प्रार्थनायुत्तमामिमाम् ।
समाहितमना बुद्धया युक्तः श्रद्धान्वितः शृणु ॥
translation: मैं आनन्द पूर्वक इस उत्तम प्रार्थना को पूर्ण करूंगा, समाहितमन बुद्धियुक्त और श्रद्धान्वित होकर सुनो।
english_translation: I will joyfully fulfill this excellent prayer; listen with a calm mind, discerning intellect, and trust.
essence: Calm, clear, and trusting attention opens the way for true understanding.
simple_meaning: You can fully engage with a prayer or teaching by listening calmly, using your clear mind, and trusting with faith.
insight: It teaches you to prepare your mind and heart to truly receive and engage with wisdom.
modern_relevance: You face difficult advice or news; calming your mind and trusting the process helps you receive it fully.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
ब्रह्माण्डमेतत्सप्ताधः सप्तोर्दध्वश्चैव विद्यते।
चतुर्दशमितेष्वेवं विभक्तं भुवनेत्रहो ॥
translation: यह ब्रह्माण्ड अहो ! सात ऊपर और सात नीचे इसी प्रकार चतुर्दश भुवनों में विभक्त है
english_translation: This universe, oh, is divided into fourteen worlds: seven above and seven below.
essence: The universe is structured into fourteen distinct realms arranged above and below.
simple_meaning: The universe is described as divided into fourteen worlds: seven above and seven below.
insight: Recognizing many layers of existence invites you to see beyond surface reality.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
चतुर्दशमितान्येतद्धवनान्येव कोविदाः ।
उद्धर्वलोकानधोलोकान् सप्त सप्त वदन्ति च ॥
translation: इन्हीं चौदह भुवनों को ही पण्डितगण सप्त उर्द्ध्वलोक और सप्त अधोलोक कहते हैं
english_translation: These fourteen worlds alone are called by the wise as the seven upper and seven lower realms.
essence: The universe is understood as fourteen distinct realms: seven higher and seven lower.
simple_meaning: The wise define the universe as consisting of fourteen worlds: seven above and seven below.
insight: It introduces a multi-layered view of reality, encouraging exploration beyond the apparent physical world.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
स्वाभाविक्यमुरावासभूरधस्ताद् भवेत्तयोः ।
सप्तलोक्यां तथोर्दध्वस्था सप्तलोकी च देवभूः ॥
translation: उनमे से सप्त अधोलोक असुरो की स्वाभाविक आवास भूमि है और सप्त उर्द्ध्वलोक देवभूमि है
english_translation: Among them, the seven lower realms naturally belong to beings of shadow, and the seven upper realms are the dwelling of radiant beings.
essence: The universe has seven lower realms of shadow beings and seven upper realms of radiant beings.
simple_meaning: There are seven lower realms naturally inhabited by beings of shadow and seven upper realms inhabited by radiant beings.
insight: It helps you see existence as layered worlds reflecting different qualities of beings and states of being.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
चतुर्दशमितानाञ्च भुवनानां विराजते ।
मध्यसन्धिस्थितोमृत्युलोको मर्त्यनिवासभूः ॥
translation: एवं मृत्युलोक चतुर्दश भुवनों की मध्यसन्धि में मे स्थित होकर शोभायमान है जो मनुष्यों की आवासभूमि है
english_translation: The mortal world shines splendidly, situated at the junction of fourteen worlds, serving as the dwelling place for humans.
essence: The human world shines centrally among many worlds as the place where humans live.
simple_meaning: The mortal world is shown as shining, located between fourteen worlds, and is the home of human beings.
insight: It helps you see your life as part of a vast cosmic order centered in the human realm.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
असौ सूत ! किल प्राज्ञैभूलोकोऽपि निगद्यते ।
 पार्थिवो मृत्युलोकोऽस्य पितृलोकोऽस्ति दैविकः
translation: हे सूत ! विद्वान जन उसको भूलोक भी कहते हैं इसका पितृलोक दैवीलोक और मृत्युलोक पार्थिवलोक है।
english_translation: O Suta! The wise call this world the realm of error; its earthly realm is mortal, and its ancestral realm is divine.
essence: The world appears flawed, but it holds both mortal and divine aspects.
simple_meaning: The wise call this world a place of error, where the earthly part is mortal and the ancestral part is divine.
insight: It invites you to see beyond the visible world to a higher, less obvious reality.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
युद्धे देवासुरे जाते क्याचित्केऽपि कदाचन ।
त्योनिर्वासभूम्योः स्यात् कादाचित्को विपर्यायः ॥
translation: कभी देवासुर संग्राम होने पर इसका सामयिक रूप से कहीं कहीं विपर्याय भी होता है।
english_translation: In battles between radiant beings and shadow beings, sometimes a temporary reversal occurs in their dwelling places.
essence: Conflicts can cause temporary reversals in usual roles or places.
simple_meaning: Sometimes in battles between radiant and shadow beings, their usual places get temporarily switched.
insight: It reveals that conflict dynamics can change suddenly, and situations are not fixed.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
हे सूताध्यात्मराज्यस्य चालका ऋपयो यतः।
तच्चतुर्दशलोकेषु गतिस्तेषामबाधिता ॥
translation: हे सूत ! ऋषिगण अध्यात्मराज्य के संचालक हैं इसलिये उनकी गति चतुर्दश भुवन में अवाधित है
english_translation: O Suta! The sages are the leaders of the kingdom of spiritual knowledge, so their movement is unhindered in the fourteen worlds.
essence: Sages lead the spiritual realm and move freely through all worlds.
simple_meaning: The sages guide the spiritual realm and move freely across all fourteen worlds without restriction.
insight: Recognize that true wisdom allows freedom beyond worldly limits and obstacles.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
वासस्थानानि तेषान्तु लोकाः सप्तोर्दध्ववर्तिनः।
श्रेण्योऽनेका महर्षीणामूर्द्ध्वलोकेषु सन्त्यतः ॥
translation: परन्तु उनका निवासस्थल सप्त उद्धर्व लोक है । ऋषियों की श्रेणियां अनेक हैं इस कारण उद्धर्वलोकों में
english_translation: Their abodes are the seven higher worlds. Many groups of sages reside in these upper realms.
essence: Seven higher realms house many groups of great sages.
simple_meaning: There are seven higher worlds where many groups of great sages live.
insight: It introduces the idea of multiple elevated spiritual planes inhabited by advanced beings.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
तेषां निवासभूमीनां नाना भेदा निरूपिताः।
अधोलोका यथा सप्तासुरभावप्रधानकाः ॥
translation: उनके वासस्थान के अनेक भेद निरूपित है। जिस प्रकार सप्त अधोलोक सुरभाव प्रधान होने से
english_translation: Their dwelling places are described in many ways, just as the seven lower realms are dominated by asuric qualities.
essence: Existence includes many distinct realms shaped by dominant qualities.
simple_meaning: Different places where beings live are described, like the seven lower realms ruled by negative qualities.
insight: It shows that existence has many levels influenced by qualities, pointing to the complexity of the inner and outer worlds.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
भवन्समुरराजेण विस्तरानियमेन च ।
सर्वदा सर्वथा नूनं नितान्तमनुशासिताः ॥
translation: वह असुर राज के द्वारा सर्वदा नियम से विस्तारपूर्वक सर्वथा अत्यन्त ही अनुशासित हैं
english_translation: They have always been thoroughly disciplined in every way under the strict rule of the asura king.
essence: Complete discipline can result from strict external control.
simple_meaning: They have been completely disciplined all the time under the detailed control of the asura king.
insight: Shows how external authority can impose strict discipline on a group, but does not teach a universal principle.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
तथा नैवोर्दवलोकेषु देवराजानुशासनम् ।
आवश्यकं वर्तते ते यतः सत्त्वप्रधानकाः ॥
translation: उसी प्रकार सप्त उद्धर्व ध्वलोकों में देवराज के अनुशासनको आवश्यकता नहीं है क्योंकि वे देवलोक समूह सत्व प्रधान हैं
english_translation: Similarly, among the seven higher realms, the command of the deva king is not necessary because they are groups dominated by sattva.
essence: Higher realms ruled by harmony do not need strict governance.
simple_meaning: The higher spiritual realms are naturally ordered and harmonious, so they don't need strict commands from a ruler.
insight: It shows that environments ruled by harmony and goodness require less external control.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
ऋषीणां नितरां तत्र सुलभांप्यस्ति सङ्गतिः ।
यस्मान्न पुनरावृत्तिः सत्यलोकस्त्वसौ सदा ॥
translation: वहां ऋषियोका समागम भी अत्यन्त सुलभ है। अपुनरावृत्ति भावको धारण करनेवाला, सत्यलोक तो सदा
english_translation: Among sages, true connection is very rare; only one who holds non-return attains the eternal realm.
essence: Rare true connection with the wise leads only those free from rebirth to eternal truth.
simple_meaning: It is very rare to truly connect with wise beings. Only those who maintain freedom from rebirth reach the eternal realm.
insight: This verse teaches you to value rare spiritual connection and maintain focus on freedom beyond repeated cycles.
modern_relevance: You meet many people, but deep, lasting bonds that transform your being are rare and precious, leading you beyond repeated cycles of suffering.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
मुक्तात्मभिस्तपोनिष्ठैर्योगयुञ्जानमानसैः ।
ब्रह्मसद्भावसंयुक्त ऋषिभिः पूरितोऽस्त्यलम् ॥
translation: मुक्तात्मा ब्रह्मसदभावयुक्त तपोनिष्णात और योगाभ्यास परायण ऋषियों से अत्यन्त पूर्ण है
english_translation: The world is completely fulfilled by liberated beings devoted to austerity and yoga, united with the supreme reality and sages.
essence: The world feels complete when sincere devotion and disciplined yoga unite with supreme reality.
simple_meaning: The entire world feels complete and fulfilled when people devoted to serious spiritual practice and connected to the supreme reality are present.
insight: It shows how devotion and disciplined inner effort together nourish a sense of wholeness beyond ordinary experience.
modern_relevance: You notice a sense of peace and balance in places where people dedicate themselves fully to deep practice and higher understanding.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
सम्भवः पुनरायत्तेः सगुणाखिललोकतः।
सर्वेऽतः सगुणा लोका उर्दध्वस्थानाधिवर्तिन: ॥
translation: सब सगुणलोको से पुनरावृत्ति सम्भव है इस कारण सब सगुण उद्धर्वलोक
english_translation: All worlds with qualities inevitably lead to repeated existence; all these worlds are governed by the higher realm.
essence: Worlds defined by qualities keep beings trapped in repeated cycles under higher realm's governance.
simple_meaning: Worlds full of qualities cause beings to be reborn repeatedly, all controlled by a higher reality.
insight: It teaches you to recognize how external qualities and environments influence repeated cycles in life, urging awareness beyond appearances.
modern_relevance: You might feel stuck in repeating patterns because your surroundings and experiences shape cycles beyond your immediate control.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
लोकयोः सन्धिमध्यस्थास्तपःसत्याभिधानयोः ।
नात्र त्वं विस्मयं कुर्य्याः सूत ! दर्भागधीषण ! ॥
translation: तप और सत्यलोक की सन्धि में स्थित हैं, हे कुशाग्रबुद्धि सूत ! इसमें तुम विस्मय न करो
english_translation: The austerity and the realm of truth meet in the middle, sharp-minded Suta! Do not be surprised by this.
essence: Austerity and truth naturally unite; this should not surprise you.
simple_meaning: Austerity and truth meet at their boundary. You, Suta, should not be surprised by this union.
insight: It encourages openness to unexpected connections between effort and truth without disbelief.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
उर्दध्वलोकेषु सर्वेषु निश्चितं निवसन्त्यहो ।
यथाधिकारसँल्लब्धि यथास्थानं महर्षयः ॥
translation: अहो यथायोग्य अधिकार के ऋषि सब उद्धर्व लोकों में ही यथास्थान निवास करते हैं
english_translation: Indeed, the great sages dwell securely in all higher realms according to their rightful position and attainment.
essence: Great sages inhabit higher realms fitting their true spiritual status.
simple_meaning: Great sages reside securely in higher realms according to their true status and spiritual attainment.
insight: Recognize that spiritual growth aligns you with your rightful place in the vast order beyond ordinary perception.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
निर्जरा निखिलाः भूत ! लब्ध्वा येषां सुसंङ्गतिम् ।
पारयन्ते स्वधर्मस्य पालनं कर्तुमुत्तमम् ॥
translation: हे सूत ! जिनके सत्संग को प्राप्त होकर सव देवतागण उत्तम रीति से स्वधर्म के पालन करने में समर्थ होते हैं
english_translation: Those who gain good company and association cross over and excel in fulfilling their own true purpose.
essence: Good company empowers you to cross obstacles and fulfill your true purpose excellently.
simple_meaning: Being with good people supports you to live your true purpose well and move beyond difficulties.
insight: It shifts your focus to nurturing your environment so your true purpose can flourish.
modern_relevance: You notice how staying close to encouraging friends helps you face challenges and stay true to your goals.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
एकदा मिलिता नैके पुराकाले महर्षयः ।
अध्यात्मतत्त्वजिज्ञासा सद्वाञ्छाभिश्च प्रेरिताः ॥
translation: पुराकाल में एक समय अनेक ऋषि एकत्रित होकर अध्यात्म तत्त्व जिज्ञासा की सद्वासना से प्रेरित और
english_translation: In ancient times, many sages gathered, inspired by a noble desire to inquire into spiritual truths.
essence: Many sages once gathered, driven by a pure desire to explore spiritual truth.
simple_meaning: Long ago, many wise sages came together, motivated by a pure wish to explore spiritual truths.
insight: It highlights the power of collective sincere inquiry as a foundation for spiritual exploration.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
एकाग्रमानसाः श्रद्धाभक्तिभावसमन्विताः ।
एकतत्त्वयुताः शान्ता धीशलोकमधिश्रिताः ॥
translation: एकाग्र चित्त हो श्रद्धा भक्तिभाव और एकतत्त्व से युक्त एवं शान्त होकर धीश लोक में पहुंचे
english_translation: Focused mind, combined with trust and devoted love, united in oneness, peacefully rests in the realm of supreme wisdom.
essence: Focused trust and love unite the mind in peaceful supreme wisdom.
simple_meaning: When your mind is fully focused and supported by trust and devoted love, united in oneness, you become peaceful and dwell in the highest wisdom.
insight: It teaches you to blend focused attention with trust and love, creating a peaceful presence rooted in higher understanding.
modern_relevance: When your thoughts settle, and you bring trust with love into your focus, you find calm even amidst daily chaos.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
श्रीमद्गणपतिं देवं सज्ज्ञानानन्दविग्रहम् ।
तत्रत्य भगवन्तं तं प्रार्थयामासुरादराव ॥
translation: उन्होंने यहां पहुंचकर उन सचिदानन्दमय श्रीभगवान् गणपति देव से आदरपूर्वक प्रार्थना की
english_translation: Having arrived here, they respectfully prayed to the revered Ganapati, embodiment of pure knowledge and bliss.
essence: Respectful prayer honors the divine embodiment of knowledge and bliss.
simple_meaning: They arrived and respectfully prayed to Ganapati, who represents knowledge and bliss.
insight: Shows the importance of beginning with respect and openness to higher wisdom.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
भगवन् ! धीश ! सर्वज्ञ ! जगन्मान्य ! जगद्गुरो !।
कृपातो भवतो वेदान प्राप्तवन्तो वयं पुरा ॥
translation: हे जगन्मान्य ! दे सर्वाज्ञ! हे जगद्गुरो ! हे भगवन् धीश ! हमने पुराकाल में आपकी कृपा से वेदो को प्राप्त करके
english_translation: O revered lord, all-knowing teacher of the world, by your grace we once received the Vedas.
essence: Ancient wisdom was received through the compassion of a revered, all-knowing teacher.
simple_meaning: Long ago, by the grace of this revered all-knowing teacher, we received the Vedas.
insight: Recognize the value of guidance and kindness that opens access to deep knowledge.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
तेषामर्यानुसन्धाने कृतकार्या अभूम च।
तवास्माभिः परं नैव ज्ञातं रूपं यथार्थतः ॥
translation: उनके अर्थानुसन्धान में भी कृतकार्यता प्राप्त की है परन्तु  हे प्रभो ! आपका यथार्थ स्वरूप हमें परिज्ञात न होने से ही
english_translation: We have understood the actions required regarding their meanings, but your true form remains unknown to us.
essence: Knowing what to do doesn’t guarantee knowing the true nature behind it.
simple_meaning: You have grasped what actions to perform by investigating their meaning, yet the true nature of the divine remains unknown to you.
insight: It teaches you to differentiate between knowing the next steps and knowing the ultimate truth behind them.
modern_relevance: You’ve learned the steps to take in a project, but the full purpose or impact still feels unclear.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अतो नेवाभवच्छान्तिरस्माकं चेतसि प्रभो!।
वयं शरणमापन्ना भवल्लोकमुपस्थिताः ॥
translation: हमारे चित्त में शान्ति प्राप्त नहीं हुई है। अब हम आपके लोक में उपस्थित होकर आपके शरणागत हुए हैं
english_translation: There is still no peace in our mind, O Lord! Now having come to your realm, we have taken refuge in you.
essence: Restlessness in the mind can be met by surrendering to a refuge beyond it.
simple_meaning: When your mind is not peaceful, you can still find protection and comfort by surrendering to a higher refuge.
insight: It teaches you to seek support beyond your restless thoughts instead of trying to force peace directly.
modern_relevance: When anxiety keeps you awake at night, knowing you have a safe place to turn offers deep comfort and hope.
speaker: Devotees

verse_text:
अध नः कृपया देहि स्वरूपज्ञानमात्मनः ।
तत्वज्ञाननिधे सारं ज्ञानं तच्छाक्यामृतम् ॥
translation: कृपया आप अपने स्वरूप का ज्ञान हमें प्रदान कीजिये और तत्वज्ञानो का सार वह अमृतरूपी ज्ञान सुनाइए
english_translation: Please, with kindness, grant us knowledge of our own true nature and reveal the essence of the wisdom of reality, that nectar-like knowledge.
essence: Gentle asking invites the precious knowledge of your true self and deepest reality.
simple_meaning: Ask with kindness for knowledge of your true self and the core wisdom of reality like a sweet nectar.
insight: It teaches you to approach learning and self-discovery with gentle openness and trust, inviting wisdom rather than demanding it.
modern_relevance: You feel stuck and uncertain, so you quietly ask a trusted guide or your inner self for clarity about who you really are.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
यत्स्याच्चोपनिषद्रूपमस्मन्नी:श्रेयसप्रदम् ।
चिरशान्तिकरं देव ! ब्रह्मानन्दप्रदायकम् ॥
translation: जो उपनिप रूप होकर हमारे लिये निःश्रेयसप्रद हो और है देव ! जो हमें चिरस्थायी शान्ति और ब्रह्मानन्द प्रदानकारी हो।
english_translation: That which, like the Upanishads, grants us highest well-being, O divine one! That which gives lasting peace and the bliss of the supreme reality.
essence: Lasting peace and bliss come from knowing the supreme reality beyond appearances.
simple_meaning: Something like the teachings of the Upanishads brings you the highest good, lasting peace, and deep bliss connected to the supreme reality.
insight: It invites you to recognize that true peace and bliss come from connecting with what never changes beneath life's surface.
modern_relevance: When your mind races with worries, remember that deep peace and joy are available beyond all distractions and temporary troubles.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
पारङ्गतोऽस्म्यलं विप्रा: ! स्वसप्तज्ञानभूमितः ।
सच्चिदानन्दरूपेण विराजे चाहमव्यय: ॥
translation: हे विप्रो ! मैं अपनी सप्त ज्ञानभूमियों के ऊपर सचिदानन्द रूप से अविनाशी होकर भलीभांति विराजमान हूँ
english_translation: O wise one, I am beyond the seven realms of knowledge, shining as eternal consciousness and bliss.
essence: You are eternal consciousness shining beyond all knowledge realms.
simple_meaning: You exist beyond all levels of knowledge as unchanging consciousness and bliss.
insight: This shifts your focus from accumulating knowledge to resting in your unchanging inner presence.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by what you must learn or understand, remember you are deeper than any knowledge or achievement.
speaker: Shambhu Dheesh

verse_text:
विभुं मामप्यहो भक्ता भावुकाः स्वेच्छया द्विजाः।
नानारूपेषु पश्यन्ति कृतकृत्या भवन्ति च ॥
translation: हे ब्राह्मणो ! मेरे विभु होनेपर भी अहो ! भावुक भक्तगण अपनी इच्छा के अनुसार अनेकों रूप में मेरा दर्शन पाते हैं और कृतकृत्य होते हैं
english_translation: O Brahmins! Even though I am the all-pervading one, devoted followers see me in many forms by their own choice and feel fulfilled.
essence: Devoted hearts perceive the divine in many forms and feel fulfilled by their own choice.
simple_meaning: Devoted followers see the divine in many different forms according to their own desire, and this brings them a sense of fulfillment.
insight: This verse encourages embracing personal devotion as a valid way to perceive and connect with the divine through forms meaningful to you.
modern_relevance: When you connect deeply with something, your own feelings shape how you experience it, making that connection uniquely fulfilling.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
रूपहीनोऽस्म्यहं विप्राः ! श्रद्धावन्तस्तथापि मे ।
भक्ता मां स्थूलरूपे वा ज्योतीरूपे निरीक्ष्य च ॥
translation: हे विप्रो ! मैं रूपरहित हूं तथापि मेरे श्रद्धावान् भक्तगण मेरा स्थूल रूप अथवा ज्योतीरूप में दर्शन करके
english_translation: O wise ones! I am formless, yet my devoted followers with faith perceive me in gross or luminous forms.
essence: The formless true self is perceived differently by devoted faith.
simple_meaning: The true self is beyond any shape or form, yet those with trust and devotion can perceive it in various ways.
insight: It teaches you to accept that the true self transcends form, yet personal faith personalizes that experience with meaningful images.
modern_relevance: When you can't fully grasp something invisible, your trust creates images or symbols that help you feel connected and real.
speaker: Divine Teacher

verse_text:
सानन्दाः कृतकृत्याः स्युर्नात्र कार्या विचारणा ।
स्युः प्रपञ्चमयादस्मात् स्थूलाद्वै विषयात्परे ॥
translation: आनन्दित और कृतकृत्य होते हैं इसमें विचार की कोई बात नहीं है। इस स्थूलप्रपञ्चमय विषय से परे
english_translation: Those who are joyful and fulfilled have no need to question this; they have surpassed the gross, worldly realm.
essence: Joy and fulfillment arise when you move beyond the heavy worldly realm and stop doubting.
simple_meaning: You feel truly joyful and complete when you stop questioning and move beyond the heavy, material world.
insight: It teaches you to rest in fulfillment beyond the noisy, unstable material world instead of chasing endless questions.
modern_relevance: After exhausting yourself worrying about material concerns, you finally feel a calm joy when you stop overthinking and accept what is beyond.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
इन्द्रियौघास्ततः सन्ति तन्मात्राण्याखिलानि च ।
तन्मात्रेभ्यः परे पारे वृत्तयश्च भवन्त्यहो ॥
translation: इन्द्रियां है, इन्द्रियो से परे सभी तन्मात्राएँ हैं, अहो ! तन्मात्राओं से परे वृत्तियां हैं,
english_translation: There are the senses, beyond them are the subtle elements, and beyond those are the functions.
essence: Your senses reveal only the surface; subtler layers and mental activities lie beyond.
simple_meaning: Your senses are only the outermost layer; beyond them lie subtler elements and deeper mental functions.
insight: It shifts your attention from just physical sensation to recognizing subtler influences behind perceptions.
modern_relevance: You notice how your immediate senses only catch part of what’s happening, while your feelings and thoughts reveal deeper layers influencing you.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
ताभ्यः पारं गता भावा भावेभ्योऽपि पर महत् ।
महतोऽपि परं नित्यं कुर्वते दर्शनं मम ॥
translation: वृत्तियों से परे भाव है, भाव से भी परे महत् है और महत से परे मेरा दर्शन
english_translation: Beyond thoughts are feelings, beyond feelings is the great principle, and beyond the great is my vision.
essence: Your deepest vision transcends thoughts, feelings, and even the great cosmic principle.
simple_meaning: Your experience goes beyond thoughts and feelings to a greater, eternal vision beyond all mental layers.
insight: It teaches you to look past surface experiences toward the eternal vision that underlies them.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by your swirling thoughts and emotions, remember there is a deeper awareness beyond them all waiting to be seen.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
ज्ञानिनो योगनिष्णाता भक्ता मे तत्त्वचिन्तकाः।
एतद्रपं परं ज्ञात्वा चिरं शान्तिमवाप्तुत ॥
translation: तत्त्वचिन्तक योगनिष्णात मेरे ज्ञानी भक्त नित्य करते हैं। इस परम रूप को जानकर आप लोग चिरकाल तक शान्ति मान कर
english_translation: My wise devotees, skilled in yoga and devoted seekers of truth, having known this supreme form, attain lasting peace.
essence: Knowing the supreme truth with devotion and skill leads to lasting peace.
simple_meaning: Those who are wise, devoted, and skilled in yoga understand the supreme truth and find lasting peace.
insight: It teaches you to integrate wisdom, devotion, and practice to settle the mind permanently.
modern_relevance: After long searching, you finally grasp a deep truth that quiets your restless mind and fills you with lasting calm.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अहमेवास्मि सद्रूपश्चिद्रूपोऽपि महर्षयः !
अहमानन्दरूपोऽस्मि नृनमत्र न संशयः ॥
translation: हे महर्षियों ! मैं ही सतरूप हूँ, मैं ही चित रूप भी है और मैं ही आनन्दरूप हूँ इसमें सन्देह नहीं हैं ।
english_translation: O great sages! I am the true self, the pure consciousness, and the very form of bliss beyond doubt.
essence: Your true self is pure consciousness and bliss without any doubt.
simple_meaning: You are the true self who is pure consciousness and the essence of joy without any doubt.
insight: Recognize your identity as pure consciousness and joy rather than your changing thoughts or feelings.
modern_relevance: When stress clouds your mind, remember you are more than thoughts—you are pure awareness and innate joy.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
विभुश्च निविकारोऽहं निराकारश्च निर्गुणः ।
द्वान्दातीतश्च निर्लिप्तो ज्ञानरूपोऽप्यदं ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: मैं विभु, निर्विकार, निर्गुण निराकार, निर्लिप्त,  द्वन्द्वातीत और निश्चय ही ज्ञानस्वरूप हूँ
english_translation: I am all-pervading, unchanging, formless, beyond qualities, unattached, beyond duality, and the certain form of knowledge.
essence: The true self is the unchanging, formless knowledge beyond all opposites and attachments.
simple_meaning: You are the all-present, unchanging essence without form or qualities, free from attachment and beyond all opposites, the true form of knowledge.
insight: It teaches you to recognize your identity beyond changing feelings, roles, and thoughts, as the unchanging knowing presence.
modern_relevance: When everything around you shifts—opinions, moods, situations—remember that your true self remains steady, formless, and free of attachment.
speaker: Shri Dheesh

verse_text:
स्वरूपावास्थितौ मूल-प्रकृतिमें महर्षयः ।
मल्लीना भावमद्वैतमाविर्भावयतेतराम ॥
translation: हे महर्षि गण ! मेरी मूल प्रकृति स्वरुप अवस्था में मुझमें ही लीन रहकर अद्वैतभाव को अवश्य उत्पन्न करती है।
english_translation: O great sages, my original nature, in its true state, remains absorbed in me and surely manifests the non-dual reality.
essence: Your original nature is fully absorbed and naturally reveals the unity beyond division.
simple_meaning: Your original nature stays fully absorbed within itself and reveals the non-dual reality beyond apparent differences.
insight: This verse shifts your view from fragmented identity to seeing the self as an indivisible whole beneath all appearances.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by conflicting thoughts or roles, remember your true self is always quietly whole and undivided beneath the noise.
speaker: Shri Dhish

verse_text:
सा व्युत्थानदशायान्तु स्तं रूपं त्रिगुणात्मकम् ।
धृत्वा दृश्य प्रपञ्भस्य सृष्टिस्थितिलयक्रियाः ॥
translation: किन्तु हे विप्रो ! यह व्युत्थान दशा में अपने त्रिगुणात्मक रूप को धारण करके दृश्य प्रपंञ्च की सृष्टि, स्थिति, और लयक्रिया को
english_translation: But, O wise one, in the state of dissolution, it takes on its three-gunic form, sustaining the visible world’s creation, maintenance, and dissolution.
essence: The visible world cycles through creation, maintenance, and destruction under three fundamental qualities.
simple_meaning: In the state of dissolution, the natural world holds its three fundamental qualities and carries out the processes of creation, maintenance, and destruction.
insight: It reveals that change and transformation are continuous cycles governed by underlying qualities, not random events.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
कुर्वाणाऽऽस्ते सदा विप्राः ! मदाज्ञायशवर्तिनी।
मत्मक्रित्याश्च भो विप्रा: ! तमस्सत्वरजोगुणाः ॥
translation: मेरी आज्ञा के वशवर्तिनी होकर सदा करती रहती है। हे ब्राह्मणों ! मेरी प्रकृतिक सत्व रज तम यह तीनों गुण
english_translation: O Brahmins, you always act under my command. You are the forces of nature — sattva, rajas, and tamas.
essence: Your actions always flow from the divine command through nature's three qualities.
simple_meaning: You always act by following the divine command, shaped by the three qualities of nature: sattva, rajas, and tamas.
insight: This verse shifts your view from seeing actions as isolated choices to understanding them as expressions of underlying natural qualities.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by choices, know that your actions are influenced by deeper qualities within you, guiding your behavior naturally.
speaker: Shri Dheesh

verse_text:
ज्ञायन्ने सचिदानन्दरूपैस्त्रिाभिर्मम ।
नवध्यात्माधिदैवाधिभूतभावैरहो त्रिभिः ॥
translation: मेरे सञ्चिदानन्दमय त्रिभावों से जाने जाते हैं। अहो ! मैं ही अध्यात्म अधिदेव और अधिभूत इन तीनों भावों से ही प्रकट होकर
english_translation: My true self is known by three states: spiritual, divine, and material nature; I manifest through these three aspects.
essence: The true self reveals itself through spiritual, divine, and natural states simultaneously.
simple_meaning: You are the true self recognized through three states: spiritual, divine, and natural. You show yourself through all these aspects together.
insight: Recognize the threefold nature of your experience as unified expressions of your true self, dissolving inner division.
modern_relevance: When you feel pulled between your thoughts, feelings, and surroundings, remember they are all parts of your true self expressing differently.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
आविर्भयात्मभक्तेभ्यो ज्ञानिभ्यः सत्वरं ध्रुवम ।
अहमेव प्रयच्छामि तत्त्वज्ञान न संशयः ॥
translation: अपने ज्ञानी भक्तों को निश्चय ही शीघ्र सत्वज्ञान प्रदान करता हूँ इसमें सन्देह नहीं
english_translation: I certainly grant the knowledge of truth quickly to devoted seekers and wise ones; there is no doubt about this.
essence: Devoted and wise seekers are swiftly granted clear knowledge without doubt.
simple_meaning: If you seek truth with devotion and wisdom, you will be granted clear understanding swiftly and without doubt.
insight: It encourages combining heartfelt devotion with clear thinking to receive knowledge quickly and confidently.
modern_relevance: When you genuinely commit your heart and mind to learning, answers often arrive sooner than expected.
speaker: Shri Dheesh

verse_text:
तदा मे ज्ञानिनो भक्ता भावत्रय्याश्रयादध्रुवम् ।
अघट्यघटनायां या प्रकृति, पटीयसी ॥
translation: तब मेरे ज्ञानी भक्त त्रिभाव की सहायता से ही मेरी त्रिगुणमयी प्रकृति का
english_translation: Then my wise devotees, relying on the threefold attitude, firmly master my three-guṇa nature, unaffected by events.
essence: Steadfast devotion rooted in threefold attitude overcomes nature’s shifting influence.
simple_meaning: You can stay steady and unshaken through life’s changes by relying on devoted love expressed in three attitudes.
insight: It teaches you to rely on heartfelt devotion to remain unshaken by external changes or outcomes.
modern_relevance: When life tosses you between ups and downs, your sincere devotion can anchor you firmly beyond all fluctuations.
speaker: Shri Dheesh

verse_text:
तस्यास्त्रैगुण्यमय्या हि कृत्वा तात्त्विकदर्शनम् ।
मामकीनां लभन्तेऽन्ते मुक्ति सायुज्यनामिकाम् ॥
translation: यथार्थ रूप में दर्शन करके अन्त मेरी सायुज्य मुक्ति को प्राप्त होते हैं
english_translation: By realizing the true nature through that threefold mode, my followers ultimately attain liberation called union with me.
essence: Complete true seeing through all qualities leads to final union and freedom.
simple_meaning: Fully understanding the true nature through all its qualities leads followers to ultimate freedom called union.
insight: It shifts focus from partial knowledge to full realization as the key to lasting inner freedom.
modern_relevance: After years of searching through life's ups and downs, you finally glimpse your true self, feeling a deep freedom arise inside.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
त्रिभावात्मकमेवास्ति तटस्थज्ञानमद्भुतम् ।
मत्स्वरूपावबोधाय सूपायः सर्ववोत्तमः ॥
translation: मेरे स्वरूप ज्ञान की प्राप्तिके लिये सब प्रकारसे उत्तम त्रिभावात्मक अद्भुत तटस्थ ज्ञान ही श्रेष्ठ उपाय है
english_translation: For realizing my true nature, the supreme method is the wondrous, detached knowledge involving three attitudes.
essence: Realizing your true nature requires a detached knowledge embracing three complementary attitudes.
simple_meaning: To understand your true self, the best way is to use a special kind of knowledge that is detached and looks at things from three different attitudes.
insight: It teaches shifting from a single biased view to a spacious, detached awareness that holds multiple attitudes simultaneously.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by conflicting thoughts and feelings, stepping back with calm, varied perspectives helps you see who you really are.
speaker: Shri Dheesh

verse_text:
मत्कारणदशायां वै सच्चिदानन्दरूपिणः
त्रिभावा अवतिष्ठन्तेऽद्वैतरूपे न संशयः ॥
translation: मेरी कारणदशा में सत् चित् और आनन्दरूप तीनों भाव निस्सन्देह अद्वैतरूप में ही रहते हैं
english_translation: In my causal state, the forms of existence, consciousness, and bliss surely dwell as the non-dual reality.
essence: Existence, consciousness, and bliss exist inseparably as one non-dual reality within you.
simple_meaning: Existence, consciousness, and bliss are not separate but united in the deepest reality of the true self.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing parts to recognizing a seamless unity in your experience of self.
modern_relevance: In moments of deep calm or meditation, you might glimpse that your sense of separate self dissolves into simple being, pure awareness, and joy as one.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
नन्नध्यात्माधिदैवाधिभूतभावस्त्रिभिध्रुवम् ।
प्रकृतेर्मे प्रजातस्य कार्यब्रह्मण एव हि ॥
translation: मैं ही अध्यात्म अधिदैव और अधिभूतरूपी तीनों मेरी ही प्रकृति से उत्पन्न
english_translation: I am the unchanging reality behind the self, the divine, and the material nature; the cause of all beings is the creative power within me.
essence: One unchanging reality underlies self, divine, and nature as their true source.
simple_meaning: There is one unchanging reality underlying the self, the divine, and the material world; all beings arise from this creative power.
insight: Recognize the unity behind apparent diversity, shifting your view from separation to oneness.
modern_relevance: When you feel fragmented by your thoughts, emotions, or surroundings, remember they all come from one steady source within you.
speaker: Shambhu Dheesh

verse_text:
अङ्गोपाङ्गानि सर्वाणि व्याप्नुवन्नु पृथक् पृथक्।
विश्व प्रकाशये सर्वमहं वैचित्र्यसङ्कुलम् ॥
translation: कार्यब्रह्म के सभी अंगो उपांगों में पृथक पृथक् भावों से अवश्य ही व्यापक रहकर नाना वैचित्र्य पूर्ण सम्पूर्ण जगत को प्रकाशित करता हूँ
english_translation: I pervade all the limbs and parts individually, illuminating the entire world with diverse manifestations.
essence: One presence fills all parts, shining through all diverse forms.
simple_meaning: The presence is spread throughout every part separately, shining through all the world's diverse forms.
insight: It reveals how the true self manifests uniquely everywhere while remaining one presence.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
स्थानं तन्नास्ति विश्वास्मिन् व्याप्तं यन्न विभावतः।
यदब्रह्मेविराडरूपैः पश्यन्तो ज्ञानिनो हि माम् ॥
translation: इस जगत में ऐसा स्थान नहीं है जो त्रिभाव से व्याप्त न हो, मेरे ज्ञानी भक्त जो ब्रह्म ईश और विराट रूप में मेरा दर्शन
english_translation: There is no place in this world untouched by the threefold nature; my wise devotees perceive me as Brahman, the supreme being, and as the cosmic form.
essence: The divine fully pervades all places and appears as both supreme being and cosmic form.
simple_meaning: Every part of the universe is filled with the divine presence, and those who understand this see the divine both as the supreme being and as the cosmic form.
insight: It encourages you to recognize the divine in all places and forms, strengthening your sense of unity and devotion.
modern_relevance: When you feel isolated, remember that everything around you is connected through the divine presence, seen or unseen.
speaker: Shri Deesh

verse_text:
उन्मजन्ति निमजनन्ति भक्ता मे भक्तिसागरे ।
तत्रापि कारणं वित्त नित्यभावत्रयं खलु ॥
translation: भक्ति सागर में उन्मजन और निमजन करते हैं यहां भी नित्य भाव त्रय को ही कारण जानो
english_translation: In the ocean of devotion, some immerse themselves deeply while others dive shallowly; even there, the reason is always the three constant states.
essence: The depth of your devotion depends on three steady inner states shaping your experience.
simple_meaning: Devotees in the ocean of devotion dive deeply or shallowly, but the true cause is always three constant inner states.
insight: Recognize that lasting devotion arises from steady emotional states, not just external acts.
modern_relevance: When you feel close or distant in your heartfelt commitments, it often depends on consistent feelings inside you that shape your connection.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
यत्तद्ब्रह्म मनोवाचामगोचरमितीरितम् ।
तत सर्वकारणं वित्त साध्यात्मिकमित्यपि ॥
translation: जो मन और वाणी के अगोचर कहे गये हैं वह ब्रह्म हैं उनको सबका कारण और सबका अध्यात्म जानो॥
english_translation: That which is beyond the reach of mind and speech is Brahman; know it as the cause of all and the essence of spirituality.
essence: The deepest reality is beyond mind and speech yet causes all that exists.
simple_meaning: The supreme reality is beyond what your mind can grasp or your words can express. It is the cause behind everything and the core of spiritual truth.
insight: It shifts your focus from trying to grasp with mind or words to acknowledging a reality beyond conceptual limits.
modern_relevance: When language and thoughts fail to capture your deepest experiences, you glimpse something greater that underlies everything you face.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अनाद्यन्तमनं दिव्यमजरं ध्रुवमव्ययम् ।
अप्रतय॑मविक्षेयं ब्रह्माग्रे समवर्तते ॥
translation: अनादि, अनन्त, अजन्मा, दिव्य, अजर, अमर, नाशरहित, अनूह्य और अज्ञेय ब्रह्म प्रथम है
english_translation: The supreme reality is without beginning or end, infinite, unborn, divine, imperishable, eternal, indestructible, untraceable, and beyond all understanding.
essence: The supreme reality is infinite, eternal, and beyond all comprehension or decay.
simple_meaning: The supreme reality is infinite, eternal, without beginning or end, and cannot be fully understood or destroyed.
insight: It shifts your perspective from fleeting events to the eternal presence beneath all change.
modern_relevance: When life feels chaotic and everything changes, remembering the timeless and unchanging source within offers deep calm and stability.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
स्वेच्छया मायया यत्तजगजन्मादिकारणम् ।
ईश्वराख्यं तु तत्तत्वमधिदैवमिति स्मृतम् ॥
translation: अपनी इच्छारूपिणी माया से जो जगत की सृष्टि स्थिति और लय के कारण हैं ईश्वर हैं। वह ईश्वर तत्त्व अधिदेव कहलाते हैं
english_translation: The supreme being called Ishvara is the principle behind creation, sustenance, and dissolution, arising from the divine power called maya.
essence: A supreme willful power called Ishvara governs all creation, preservation, and dissolution.
simple_meaning: The world’s birth, existence, and end arise from a divine power called maya, which is governed by the supreme being Ishvara.
insight: This teaches you to see the universe as a purposeful whole, not fragmented random events.
modern_relevance: When life feels unpredictable or chaotic, recognizing a greater organizing force can bring calm and trust in the natural flow.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
सर्वज्ञः सदगुरुनित्यो ह्यांतर्यामी कृपानिधिः ।
सर्वसद्गुणसारात्मा दोषशन्यः परः पुमान ॥
translation: सर्वज्ञ, सद्गुरु, नित्य, अन्तर्यामी, कृपासागर, सब सद्गुणों के साररूप, दोषशून्य पुरूषोत्तम है
english_translation: The supreme being is all-knowing, the eternal true teacher, the inner witness, an ocean of compassion, the essence of all virtues, free from faults.
essence: The supreme being is the flawless, compassionate, eternal inner teacher.
simple_meaning: The supreme being is all-knowing, always present within, full of compassion, the source of all good qualities, and completely free from faults.
insight: It invites you to recognize an unchanging, compassionate presence within that guides and supports without error.
modern_relevance: When everything feels uncertain, you can remember a perfect inner presence that knows all, cares deeply, and is completely without flaw.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
यत्कार्यव्रह्म विश्वस्य निधानं प्राकृतात्मकम् ।
विराडाख्यं स्थूलतरमधिभूतं तदुच्यते ॥
translation: और जो विश्व के निधान, प्राकृतात्मक, स्थूलतर और विराटरूप कार्य्यब्रहम हैं, वह अधिभूत कहे जाते हैं।
english_translation: The cause called the highest matter or primal nature, the support and foundation of the entire universe, is known as the 'Adhibhuta'.
essence: All visible reality arises from a fundamental primal matter called Adhibhuta.
simple_meaning: The universe is supported by a primal, physical cause called the 'Adhibhuta', which is the foundation of all matter and forms the natural world.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing things as separate to recognizing the natural world’s unity as one primal source.
modern_relevance: When you look around, everything you touch or see shares a common material origin, reminding you of the unity behind diversity.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
पुनर्वः सम्प्रवक्ष्येऽहं श्रूयतां तत्त्वमुत्तमम् ।
नन्वध्यात्माधिदैवाधिभूतभावत्रयानुगम् ॥
translation: अध्यात्म अधिदैव और अधिभूतरूप भावत्रय सम्बन्धी उत्तम तत्त्व फिर मैं आपलोगों से ही कहता हूँ सुनो
english_translation: Again I will explain the supreme truth related to the threefold nature of the self, the divine, and the natural world; listen carefully.
essence: A supreme truth connects self, divine, and natural world as a threefold reality.
simple_meaning: I will now explain the supreme truth about the threefold nature of self, the divine, and the natural world. Listen carefully.
insight: It opens your mind to seeing self, divine, and nature as interconnected realms to explore.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
यथाध्यात्माधिदैवधिभूतभावत्रयं द्विजाः ।
विद्यते कारणे नूनं कार्येष्वपि तथैव तत् ॥
translation: हे ब्राह्मणो ! अध्यात्म अधिदेव और अधिभूत ये तीनों भाव जिस प्रकार कारण में हैं उसी प्रकार वह कार्य में भी अवश्य हैं
english_translation: O Brahmins, just as the three aspects—spiritual, divine, and material—exist in the cause, they also exist in the effect.
essence: The threefold reality within the cause also pervades the effect without exception.
simple_meaning: The three aspects—spiritual, divine, and material—are present both in the origin and in what results from it.
insight: It shifts your view to see cause and effect as inseparable, sharing the same essential nature.
modern_relevance: When you create or start something, remember its essence remains present in the outcome, connecting beginning and end deeply.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
विस्तरात्सम्प्रवक्ष्येऽहं तत्स्वरूपं निशम्यताम् ।
अहमेव स्वकीयां तां महामायामुपाश्रितः ॥
translation: उनका विस्तार से स्वरूप मैं कहता हूँ सुनो। हे महर्षियों! मैं ही अपनी उन महामाया का आश्रय करके
english_translation: I will now explain their true nature in detail. Hear this, great sages: I take refuge in that great illusion myself.
essence: The true self exists while residing within and depending on the great illusion.
simple_meaning: The speaker declares they will explain the true nature of things and reveals that they themselves depend on the great illusion shaping the world.
insight: It invites recognizing that the true self engages with illusion, prompting deeper inquiry beyond surface reality.
