modern_relevance: When you take a moment to question what you truly are, you realize even your deepest beliefs rest on appearances and assumptions.
speaker: Shri Dheesh

verse_text:
विभ्राणोऽध्यात्मभावेन ऋषिरूपं सदोत्तमम् ।
तथाधिदैवभावेन देवतारूपमादधत् ॥
translation: सर्वदा अध्यात्मभाव से ऋषि, अधिदैव भाव से देवता और
english_translation: The sage always appears as the highest seer through spiritual presence, and as a deity through transcendent essence.
essence: One being can show spiritual insight and transcendent presence simultaneously.
simple_meaning: A person can appear as a great seer by their spiritual nature and as a divine being by their transcendent qualities.
insight: It invites seeing that people or teachers can have multiple layers — inner wisdom and elevated presence — beyond the surface.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
तथाधिभूतभावेन पितृरूपमधिश्रयन् ।
नानाब्रह्माण्डसंघातं संरक्षामि महार्षयः ॥
translation: अधिभूत भाव से पितृरूप उत्तमता से धारण करके अनेक ब्रह्माण्ड समूह का संरक्षण करता हूँ
english_translation: I, the great sage, embody the supreme form of the ancestors through the constitutive nature and protect countless clusters of universes.
essence: A supreme ancestral form sustains and protects countless universes through cosmic nature.
simple_meaning: The speaker claims to embody a supreme ancestral form and protect countless universes through a fundamental cosmic nature.
insight: Recognize the vast interconnectedness and protection operating beyond what you can see or control.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
आकाशं प्रथमं भूतं श्रोत्रमध्यात्ममुच्यते !
आधिभूतं तथा शब्दो दिशस्तनाधिदैवतम् ॥
translation: पञ्च महाभूतों में प्रथम भूत आकाश है, वहां श्रोत्र अध्यात्म, शब्द अधिभूत और दिशाएँ अधिदेव कही गई है
english_translation: Among the five great elements, the first is space; it is called the ear or inner self. Sound is the intermediate element, and directions are the presiding deities.
essence: Space is the first element, symbolizing the inner faculty that hears beyond physical sound.
simple_meaning: The first of the five great elements is space, which represents the inner faculty of hearing. Sound is the next element, and directions are the powers governing them.
insight: Recognize that hearing is not just a sense but a symbol for your inner receptive nature, linking outer and inner worlds.
modern_relevance: When you listen deeply, you realize your awareness is more than just physical hearing—it’s a spacious inner presence connecting all things.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
द्वितीय मारुतं भूतं त्वगध्यात्म च विश्रुतम् ।
स्पष्टव्यमधिभूतञ्च विद्युत्तत्राधिदैवतम् ॥
translation: द्वितीय भूत वायु है, यहां वक् अध्यात्म, स्पर्श अधिभूत और विद्युत् अधिदेव कहे गये हैं
english_translation: The second elemental being is the wind, here referred to as the inner essence of speech, the element of touch, and the divine presence of lightning.
essence: Wind embodies body, speech, and divine energy simultaneously in layered reality.
simple_meaning: This verse identifies wind as the second elemental force, linked to the inner essence of speech, the sense of touch, and the divine presence symbolized by lightning.
insight: It teaches you to see ordinary elements as bridges between body, mind, and the divine energy.
modern_relevance: When you feel the breeze or touch something, you're experiencing a subtle connection to deeper energies that shape your communication and sensing.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
तृतीयं ज्योतिरित्याहुश्चक्षुरध्यात्ममुच्यते ।
अधिभूतं ततो रूपं सूर्यस्तत्राधिदैवतम् ॥
translation: तृतीय भूत ज्योति अर्थात् अग्नि है, यहां चक्षु अध्यात्म, रूप अधिभत और सूर्य अधिदेव कहे गये हैं।
english_translation: The third element is light, called fire; the spiritual eye is called sight; the form is called the material element; the sun is called the presiding deity.
essence: True sight perceives the spiritual light beyond material form and physical eyes.
simple_meaning: Light is the third element and symbolizes fire. The spiritual eye means inner vision. The physical form belongs to the material world, and the sun represents the divine presence overseeing all.
insight: It teaches you to distinguish between physical perception and spiritual insight, opening a clearer inner vision.
modern_relevance: When you look at something, you can become aware of the difference between what your eyes see and what your deeper awareness senses.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
चतुर्थमापो विज्ञेयं जिहा चाध्यात्ममुच्यते ।
अधिभूत रसश्चात्र सोमस्तत्राधिदैवतम् ॥
translation: चतुर्थ भूत जल है वहां जिह्व़ा अध्यात्म, रस अधिभूत और सोम अधिदैव कहे गये है
english_translation: The fourth element is water; the tongue is the inner self, taste is the physical essence, and soma is the celestial deity.
essence: Your tongue and taste connect physical reality with your inner self and the divine.
simple_meaning: Water is the fourth element, the tongue represents the inner self, taste is the physical experience, and soma symbolizes the divine aspect.
insight: It teaches you to recognize sensory experience as a bridge between the physical world and your inner being.
modern_relevance: When you savor food or drink, your tongue is not just sensing flavor but connecting your body and deeper self to something beyond.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
पृथिवी पञ्चमं भूतं घ्राणभाध्यात्ममुच्यते ।
अधिभूतं तथा गन्धों वायुस्तत्राधिदैवतम् ॥
translation: पंचम भूत पृथिवी है. यहां प्राण अध्यात्म, गन्ध अधिभूत और वायु अधिदैव कहे गये हैं
english_translation: Earth is the fifth element, called the body perceived by smell; Prana is the inner being, smell is the physical element, and air is the divine presence in it.
essence: Earth is body sensed by smell, breath is inner life, air is divine presence within.
simple_meaning: Earth is the fifth element, experienced through smell. It includes the physical body, the breath inside, and the divine presence represented by air.
insight: It teaches you to recognize the unity of body, breath, and spirit within the natural world you experience.
modern_relevance: When you breathe deeply and notice the scents around you, you connect to your body, your breath, and something greater beyond them.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
पादावध्यात्ममित्याहुब्रहाह्मणास्तत्त्वदर्शिनः ।
अधिभूतं तु गन्तव्यं विष्णुस्तत्राधिदैवतम् ॥
translation: तत्वदर्शी ब्राह्मण कहते है कि पाद ( पैर) अध्यात्म है, गन्तव्य अधिभूत है और वहां विष्णु अधिदैव हैं
english_translation: The wise brahmins say the foot represents the spiritual self, the destination is the physical world, and Vishnu is the presiding divinity there.
essence: Every part of reality symbolizes a deeper spiritual aspect and divine presence.
simple_meaning: The foot symbolizes the spiritual self, the physical world is the place to go, and Vishnu presides there.
insight: It invites you to see everyday things as symbols for deeper realities beyond what you normally perceive.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अवागूगानरपानश्च पायुरध्यात्ममुच्यते ।
अधिभूतं विसर्गश्च मित्रस्तत्राधिदैवतम् ॥
translation: निम्न गतिशील अपान है, वहां पायु अध्यात्म, विसर्ग अधिभून और मिन अधिदेव है।
english_translation: The downward-moving breath is called apana; the upward-moving breath is prana; the external vital force is visarga; among these, the friend is the higher being.
essence: Your breath flows in dual currents held and guided by a higher inner presence.
simple_meaning: Breath moves in two directions: downward called apana and upward called prana. The external vital force is visarga, and the higher being governs these forces as a friend.
insight: It teaches you to sense the inner presence harmonizing dual forces of breath beyond conscious effort.
modern_relevance: When you notice your breath rushing or slowing, there's a subtle inner presence balancing these flows beyond your control.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
प्रजनः सर्वभूतानामुपस्योऽध्यात्ममुच्यते ।
अधिभूतं तथा शुक्रं देवतञ्च प्रजापतिः ॥
translation: सब जीवों का उत्पादक उपस्थ अध्यात्म है, शुक अधिभूत और प्रजापति अधिदैव है
english_translation: The origin of all beings is called the inner self; the physical is the external, and the divine lord is the supreme controller.
essence: Your true origin is the inner self beyond body and nature.
simple_meaning: All living beings come from the inner self. The body is the physical form, and a higher divine force governs beyond that.
insight: It shifts your view from identifying as just a body to recognizing your inner self as the true source of life.
modern_relevance: When you feel limited by your body or circumstances, remember you come from a deeper source beyond physical things.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
हस्तावध्यात्ममित्याहुरध्यात्मदिनो जनाः ।
अधिभूतं च कर्माणि शकस्तत्राधिदैवतम् ॥
translation: अध्यात्म शस्त्र के पण्डितगण दोनों हाथों को अध्यात्म कहते हैं, कर्म अधिभूत और शक्र वहां अधिदैव है
english_translation: Scholars of spiritual knowledge call the two hands spirituality; actions belong to the physical realm, and Shakra governs the divine realm there.
essence: Physical action, inner spirituality, and divine influence are distinct, interconnected realms.
simple_meaning: Spiritual scholars say the two hands represent spirituality; physical actions belong to the natural world, and Shakra rules the divine aspect.
insight: It clarifies that action involves physical effort, inner spirituality, and a higher influence working together.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
वैश्वदेवी ततः पूर्वा वागध्यात्ममिहोच्यते ।
वक्तव्यमधिभूतञ्च बह्निस्तत्राधिदैवतम् ॥
translation: विश्वेदेव से उत्पन्न प्रथम वाणी अध्यात्म है, वक्तव्य अधिभूत और वहां वह्यी अधिदेव है
english_translation: From the supreme being Vaishvadevi arose the first speech, representing the spiritual; the spoken word relates to the material, and the fire there represents the presiding divine force.
essence: Speech arises from the spiritual and links material and divine forces.
simple_meaning: The first speech that came from Vaishvadevi is spiritual; the words spoken connect to the physical world, and fire there symbolizes the divine presence.
insight: It reveals that communication is a bridge uniting inner spirit, outer matter, and divine force.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अहङ्कारस्तथाऽध्यात्म सर्वसंसारकारकम् ।
अभिमानोऽधिभूतञ्च रुद्रस्तत्राधिदैवतम् ॥
translation: समस्त संसार का कर्ता अहंकार अध्यात्म है, अभिमान अधिभूत और रुद्र वहां अधिदैव है
english_translation: The sense of separate self is the maker of the entire world; ego governs the physical realm, and Rudra presides as the divine force there.
essence: Your sense of separate self creates the world, ego governs the body, and divine power rules the physical realm.
simple_meaning: The sense of being a separate self creates the whole world. Ego controls the physical body, and a divine power like Rudra governs that realm.
insight: Recognize that your sense of self and ego build your perceived world, shifting focus from external events to internal processes.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by your body's needs or emotions, remember that your ego is shaping that experience, while a higher force guides the deeper flow.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
बुद्धिरध्यात्ममित्याहुर्यथावदभिदर्शिनः।
बोद्धव्यमधिभूतं तु क्षेत्रज्ञश्चाधिदैवतम् ॥
translation: यथार्थ देखनेवाले विद्वद गण बुद्धि को अध्यात्म, ज्ञेय को अधिभूत और क्षेत्रज्ञ को अधिदैव कहते हैं।
english_translation: Scholars say intellect is about the inner being, the known is the material, and the knower is beyond nature.
essence: Intellect is the inner self; what is known is material; the knower transcends nature.
simple_meaning: Intellect relates to your inner being, what is known is the material world, and the knower is beyond material nature.
insight: It teaches you to identify intellect as the inner guide, separate from what you perceive and from your deeper awareness.
modern_relevance: When you analyze your thoughts, feelings, and surroundings, you can sense a difference between your mind, the things you experience, and a deeper part of you watching it all.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अध्यात्म मन इत्हासु पञ्चभूतात्मवारकम् ।
अधिभूतञ्च संकल्पश्चन्द्रमांश्चाधिदैवतम् ॥
translation: पञ्चभूतों से आत्मा को आवृत करनेवाला मन अध्यात्म है, संकल्प अधिभूत और चन्द्रमा अधिदैव है
english_translation: The inner science is the mind that covers the true self with the five elements; intention is the physical nature, and the moon represents the higher divine.
essence: Your mind and intentions veil your true self with layers of nature and higher influence.
simple_meaning: The mind covers the true self with the five elements. Intention connects to physical nature, and the moon symbolizes the higher divine aspect.
insight: It teaches you to see your mind and intentions as layers over your true self, inviting you to look beyond them.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by your thoughts and feelings, remember they are coverings over your deeper self, shaped by your intentions and higher awareness.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
वेदः शब्दमयं ज्ञेयं मत्स्वरूपं न संशयः।
मन्त्रास्तत्राधिभूतं स्यादीश्वरश्चाधिदैवतम् ॥
translation: वेद को निःसन्देह मेरा शब्दमय स्वरुप जानना चाहिये। वेद विज्ञ कहते हैं कि वहां श्रुतियां अधिभूत, ईश्वर,अधिदेव
english_translation: The Vedas are undoubtedly my word-based nature. The Vedas declare that there are layers: the physical, the divine ruler, and the celestial beings.
essence: The Vedas are my word-rooted nature layered with physical, divine, and celestial realities.
simple_meaning: The Vedas are not just texts; they are the word-expression of the speaker’s true nature, containing physical, divine, and celestial layers.
insight: It teaches you to perceive sacred or profound teachings as multi-layered realities, not just literal words.
modern_relevance: When you read a complex text or listen to someone wise, you can discover layers of meaning—what seems simple holds deeper levels if you look closely.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
ज्ञानमध्यात्ममित्याहुर्वेदनिष्णातबुद्धयः।
सरस्वत्याश्च गायत्र्याः सावित्र्याश्च तथैव हि ॥
translation: और ज्ञान अध्यात्म है। हे विप्रो ! मेरी शक्ति ही सरस्वती गायत्री और सावित्री
english_translation: Knowledge is the essence of the inner self. O learned one, my power is Saraswati, Gayatri, and Savitri.
essence: Knowledge is not outside but the inner essence that empowers you.
simple_meaning: True knowledge is the essence of your inner being, the core of your existence and power.
insight: It shifts your view from seeking knowledge externally to recognizing your inner self as the source of true wisdom.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by information, remember that your deepest wisdom comes from within, not just from outside voices.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
मच्छक्तिरेव वेदेषु त्रीणि रूपाणि विभ्रंती ।
ज्ञानशक्तिः क्रियाशक्तियज्ञशक्तिस्तथा द्विजाः ॥
translation: ये तीन रूप धारण, करके वेदों में ज्ञानशक्ति, क्रियाशक्ति और यज्ञ शक्ति
english_translation: The three powers you possess manifest in the Vedas: wisdom power, action power, and ritual power.
essence: You embody three essential powers: knowing, acting, and offering sacredly.
simple_meaning: You have three core powers expressed in teachings: the power to understand, the power to act, and the power to perform sacred practices.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing knowledge, action, and ritual as separate to recognizing them as interconnected powers you already possess.
modern_relevance: You juggle learning facts, taking meaningful steps, and honoring deeper values in your daily choices — all three are your natural strengths.
speaker: Shri Dheesh

verse_text:
एतन्छक्तित्रय नून समुत्पादयतेतराम् ।
नात्र कश्चन सन्देहो विद्यते विमपुङ्गवाः ॥
translation: इन तीन शक्तियों को अवश्य ही उत्पन्न करती है है ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठो! इसमें कुछ सन्देह नहीं
english_translation: The supreme being certainly produces these three powers; there is no doubt about this.
essence: The supreme being unquestionably produces the three fundamental powers without any doubt.
simple_meaning: The supreme being definitely brings forth three fundamental forces; there is no doubt about this fact.
insight: It teaches you to accept certain foundational forces as real and unquestionable, providing a stable base for further inquiry.
modern_relevance: When you face confusion about where your strength and energy come from, remember some forces behind you are certain and reliable.

verse_text:
गमागमयोरेक्यान्छास्त्रेऽपि वेदसम्मते ।
सादृश्यं तु त्रिभावानामेवमेवास्त्यसंशयम् ॥
translation: वेद और वेदसम्मत शास्त्र एक ही हैं इस कारण उन वेदसम्मत शास्त्रों में भी त्रिभावों का निःसन्देह ऐसा ही सादृश्य है।
english_translation: The scriptures accepted by the Vedas are one and the same; among them, the three modes certainly share the same resemblance.
essence: All Vedic-approved scriptures reveal the same three fundamental modes.
simple_meaning: All scriptures accepted by the Vedas are essentially the same and clearly show the same three fundamental qualities.
insight: It helps you see beyond surface differences to the shared structure beneath diverse teachings.
modern_relevance: When you explore different teachings or traditions, you discover the same core principles repeating, no matter the source.

verse_text:
अन्तःकरणमेवास्ति कारणं बन्धमोक्षयोः।
अहंहकारो मनो बुद्धिश्चित्तश्चैतचतुष्टयम ॥
translation: अन्तःकरण ही बन्ध और मोक्ष का कारण है, यहां मन बुद्धि चित्त और अहंकार यह चारों ही
english_translation: The inner instrument alone is the cause of bondage and freedom; the mind, intellect, inner state, and sense of self are its four parts.
essence: Your own mind, intellect, inner state, and ego create your bondage or freedom.
simple_meaning: Your inner faculties—the mind, intellect, inner feelings, and ego—are the cause of feeling trapped or free.
insight: It teaches you to observe and refine your inner instruments to move from limitation to freedom.
modern_relevance: When you feel stuck or free in life, it’s often your own thoughts, choices, and sense of self shaping that experience.

verse_text:
तत्राधिभूतमेशस्ति मा तत्राधिदेवतम् ।
ममानन्दविलासश्च तत्राध्यात्म समुच्यते ॥
translation: अधिभूत, ब्रह्मा अधिदैव और मेरा आनन्द विलास अध्यात्म कहा जाता है।
english_translation: There, the supreme lord of the physical realm is called Adhibhuta; the supreme deity of the divine realm is called Adhidaiva; and my joyful play is called Adhyatma.
essence: The true self is the joyful presence beyond physical and divine realms.
simple_meaning: The verse names three aspects of reality: the physical world’s supreme controller, the divine realm’s supreme being, and the joyful inner self called the true self.
insight: It shifts focus from external powers to the joyful inner being as your true identity.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by your body or beliefs, remember your true self is a joyful presence beyond all appearances.

verse_text:
जगद्धारधर्मस्याधिभूतं कर्म प्रोच्यते ।
उपासनाधिदैवं स्यादध्यात्मं ज्ञानमुच्यते ॥
translation: जगदधारक धर्म का अधिभूत कर्म अधिदेव उपासना और अध्यात्म जानकार है
english_translation: The foundation of the duty that sustains the world is called action; worship is the higher divine aspect, and spiritual knowledge is the highest.

simple_meaning: True duty begins with action, rises through devoted worship, and culminates in spiritual knowledge.
insight: It teaches you to see your everyday actions as the first step toward higher devotion and inner clarity.
modern_relevance: You finish your work, feel a connection beyond yourself, then begin to understand your deeper purpose.

verse_text:
धर्माङ्गेप्वपि सर्वेषु प्रत्येक विद्यते द्विजाः ।
सम्बन्धी दि त्रिभावानां संशयो नात्र कश्चन ॥
translation: हे ब्राह्मणो! सब ब्रह्मांडों में से प्रत्येक धर्मांगो के साथ भी भावत्रय का सम्बन्ध है इसमें कुछ संशय नहीं
english_translation: O Brahmin, in every part of the cosmic order, the three states of being are undoubtedly connected.
essence: Every part of existence is inseparably connected through three fundamental states.
simple_meaning: Every part of the universe is connected with three fundamental states of existence without any doubt.
insight: It teaches you to see unity in diversity by recognizing three essential qualities underlying all parts of existence.
modern_relevance: When you notice how different parts of your life are connected by common feelings or states, it reminds you that everything shares deeper bonds.

verse_text:
वेद एवास्ति भो विप्राः ! मदाज्ञायाः प्रकाशकः।
वेदसम्मतशास्त्राणि तस्य व्याख्यानिमानि च ॥
translation: हे ब्राह्मणों ! वेद ही मेरी आज्ञा का प्रकाशक है और वेदसम्मत शास्त्रसमूह उसकी व्याख्यारूप है
english_translation: O Brahmins! The Vedas are the source revealing my command, and the scriptures aligned with the Vedas are their explanation.
essence: Foundational texts reveal divine commands, explained by accepted scriptures.
simple_meaning: The Vedas reveal the divine command, and the scriptures accepted by the Vedas explain it.
insight: It shows the importance of foundational texts and their accepted interpretations for clear guidance.

verse_text:
अहमेवासम्यतो वेदे शास्त्रेषु तत्परेषु च।
लौकिकी परकीया च समाधिनामिका तथा ॥

english_translation: Because I alone am the measure in the Vedas and scriptures, in worldly and transcendental speech, and in the language of absorbed presence.

एतत्रयेण धृत्वाऽहं त्रिभावं भामि सन्ततम् ।
अधिभूतञ्च विद्यानां सर्वासां शास्त्रमुच्यते ॥

सचितोर्नित्यमानन्दविलासोऽध्यात्ममुच्यते ॥

english_translation: The supreme being is indeed the entire cosmos, and the true self is the eternal, blissful play of pure awareness.

अनन्तकोटिब्रह्माण्ड-कारणं यच्च प्रोच्यते ।

प्राहुरज्ञाश्च यं मृत्यु जीवानां रोमहर्पणम् ।

जीवस्यावरणं नूनं बन्धकारणमुच्यते ॥
translation: और अध्यात्म प्रलय जीवों के मत्सायुज्य प्राप्त होने को कहते है। पाश अर्थात् आवरण ही जीव के बन्धन का कारण कहा जाता है ।
english_translation: Spirituality is the union of the self with the supreme at dissolution; the covering of the self is indeed the cause of bondage.
essence: Bondage arises from the hidden layers that veil your true self from itself.
simple_meaning: True spirituality is joining with the supreme reality when the false coverings around the self fall away. These coverings cause bondage.
insight: Recognize that removing false beliefs and identifications reveals your natural freedom and connection to the supreme.
modern_relevance: When you feel stuck or limited, it’s often because you’re hiding your true self behind fears and false identities.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अधिभूतं हि यस्यास्ति कोषाणां पञ्चकं बुधाः ।
अधिदैवमविद्या मे सत्सत्ताऽध्यात्ममुच्यते ॥
translation: हे  विज्ञो! जिसका पञ्चकोष अधिभूत अविद्या अधिदेव और मेरी सत सत्ता अध्यात्म है
english_translation: The wise say the five sheaths belong to the physical world, ignorance, the divine, and my true being is the inner self.
essence: You are a layered being: body, ignorance, divine aspect, and your true self at the core.
simple_meaning: You consist of five layers: the physical body, ignorance, the divine presence, and at the core, your true inner self.
insight: This verse helps you distinguish between fleeting layers of existence and your unchanging true self, improving self-awareness.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by your body's needs and confusing thoughts, remember there is a clear, unchanging inner self beneath it all.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सामञ्जस्यसुरक्षार्थ सृष्टेरुत्पद्यते तु यः।
देवासुराख्यसंग्रामः पूर्णः सोऽपि त्रिभावतः ॥
translation: सृष्टि के सामञ्जस्य की रक्षा के लिये जो देवासुर संग्राम हुआ करता है वह भी त्रिभाव से पूर्ण है
english_translation: The conflict known as the divine and shadow beings' battle arises to protect creation's harmony and is fulfilled in three modes.
essence: Conflict between radiant and shadow beings preserves creation’s harmony through three modes.
simple_meaning: The battle between divine and shadow beings happens to protect the harmony of creation and involves three fundamental modes.
insight: Recognize that apparent conflicts can maintain deeper balance and are part of natural order.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
विज्ञा महर्षयो नात्र काचित् कार्या विचारणा।
धर्माधर्ममयीनां यदवृत्तीनां द्वन्द्वसङ्गरम् ॥
translation: हे विज्ञ ब्राह्मणों ! यह निःसन्देह है। धर्मा-धर्म वृत्तियों का जो द्वन्द्ध युद्ध
english_translation: O wise sages, there is certainly a conflict of opposing duties and unrighteousness in these activities.
essence: Some actions inherently involve a conflict between right and wrong duties.
simple_meaning: Sometimes, your actions involve a real struggle between what is right and what is wrong.
insight: It helps you recognize and accept that some actions naturally involve conflicting duties, requiring clear discernment and balance.
modern_relevance: You hesitate, unsure if the task before you is fully right or if some part feels off or unfair.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अन्तः करणमासाध जायते नित्यमदभुतम् ।
देवासुराख्ययुद्धस्य तदेवाध्यात्ममुच्यते ॥
translation: अन्तःकरण में नित्य होता है वही उसका अध्यात्म है
english_translation: The inner instrument that constantly arises is called the true self in the war between radiant and shadow beings.
essence: An inner instrument constantly arises and is the true self amid conflict.
simple_meaning: Inside you, a constant inner instrument arises that guides your awareness; this is called your true self during the struggle of radiant and shadow forces.
insight: It teaches you to recognize an ever-present inner awareness that witnesses conflict without being overwhelmed.
modern_relevance: When you face inner conflicts or tough choices, a constant inner awareness arises to guide you through the struggle.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
देवासरं देवलोके युद्ध नैमित्तिकं तु यद ।
भवेतदेव भो विमा आस्ते खल्वपिदैवतम् ॥
translation: हे ब्राह्मणो ! देवलोक के नैमित्तिक देवासुर संग्राम ही अधिदेव हैं
english_translation: O Brahmin! The occasional battles between devas and asuras in the divine realm are the supreme divine acts.
essence: Occasional divine battles are themselves supreme expressions of cosmic order.
simple_meaning: Battles between divine and shadowy beings happen sometimes in the divine realm and are considered supreme divine acts.
insight: Recognize that even apparent conflicts in higher realms serve a greater purpose in cosmic balance.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
दैवीनामासुरीणाञ्च सम्पत्तीनां प्रभावतः।
जायते मृत्युलोके यदमहायुद्धं परस्परम् ॥
translation: और मृत्युलोक में देवी और आसुरी सम्पत्ति के प्रभाव से जो परस्पर महासंग्राम होता है ।
english_translation: In the mortal realm, a great conflict arises between the forces of divine and shadowy energies.
essence: A great battle erupts in the mortal world between opposing cosmic forces.
simple_meaning: A massive battle occurs in the mortal world between divine and shadowy forces due to their influence.
insight: Recognize that much conflict comes from the clash of opposing influences beyond individual control.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
अधिभूतं तदेवास्ति तस्य युद्धस्य निश्चितम् ।
ममैव प्रकृतिनमाश्रयेण ममैव तु ॥
translation: वही उसका अधिभूत है यह निश्चय है। हे विप्रो! मेरी ही प्रकृति मेरे ही आश्रय से
english_translation: The natural world is surely the field of that battle; it depends on my own nature and support.
essence: The battle occurs within the natural world sustained by the speaker's own nature.
simple_meaning: The battle takes place in the natural world, which is controlled and supported by the speaker's own nature.
insight: Recognize that your challenges arise within the natural order shaped by your own nature and conditions.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
आविर्भावयते सष्टि-प्रपञ्चं सन्ततं द्विजाः ।
कारणं बन्धनस्यातः प्रकृतेर्मे गुणत्रयम् ॥
translation: सृष्टिप्रपञ्च निरन्तर प्रकट करती है इस कारण मेरी प्रकृति के तीन गुण बंधन के हेतु होते हैं
english_translation: The continuous manifestation of creation happens because my nature's three qualities are the cause of bondage.
essence: Three qualities of nature cause the endless cycle of creation and bondage.
simple_meaning: Creation keeps unfolding endlessly because the three qualities of nature cause the cycle of bondage.
insight: It teaches you to recognize how these three qualities shape your experience and bind you, so you can start to loosen their hold.
modern_relevance: You notice how your habits and moods keep repeating, pulling you back into the same patterns again and again.
speaker: Shri Dheesh

verse_text:
ये त्रिभावाश्रयान्मे तु पश्यन्ति प्रकृति मम ।
त्रिभिर्गुणैर्न वध्यन्ते प्रकृतेस्ते कदाचन ॥
translation: परन्तु जो मेरे तीनों भावों का आश्रय ग्रहण करके मेरी प्रकृति को देखते हैं वह प्रकृति के तीनों गुणो से कभी बन्धन प्राप्त नहीं होते
english_translation: Those who see my nature through my three aspects are never bound by the three qualities of nature.
essence: Seeing your true nature beyond its qualities frees you from their binding influence.
simple_meaning: If you understand your true nature through its three aspects, you won’t be trapped by nature’s changing qualities.
insight: It teaches you to recognize your true self beyond temporary traits, freeing your mind from reactive patterns.
modern_relevance: When you notice your moods, habits, and reactions but see them as parts of you—not all of you—you gain freedom from their grip.
speaker: Shri Dheesh

verse_text:
मामकीनं स्वकीयञ्च गृहीत्वाऽऽदर्शमुत्तमम् ।
ममैषा प्रकृतिविषा: ! संसारेऽपारसीमाने ॥
translation: हे विप्रो ! मेरे और अपने उदाहरण को लेकर मेरी यह प्रकृति अपार संसार में
english_translation: O wise one! Taking my example and your own, this nature of mine is the poison that limits the boundless world.
essence: Your own nature can act like poison that limits the boundless world.
simple_meaning: Your own nature can act like poison, limiting the vastness of existence around you.
insight: It shifts your view to see your natural tendencies as the real limits, not the outside world.
modern_relevance: When you feel stuck or limited, it often comes from your own habits and reactions narrowing your experience.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
नारीधारां नृधाराश्च प्रोत्पाद्य विश्वमश्नुते ।
अतो धाराद्वयेऽस्मिश्च बन्धमोक्षदशाद्वयम् ॥
translation: स्त्रीधारा और पुरुषधारा को उत्पन्न करके जगत को परिव्याप्त करती है इस कारण इन दोनों धाराओ में बन्धन दशा और मुक्तदशा इन दोनों की चरितार्थक विचार से
english_translation: By manifesting the feminine and masculine currents, the universe is pervaded; thus these two currents embody the states of bondage and liberation.
essence: Two fundamental forces underlie existence—one binds, the other frees.
simple_meaning: The universe is shaped by two forces, often understood as feminine and masculine currents, which represent the states of being bound and being free.
insight: It helps you see your life as a balance of forces: some that restrict and others that release, shifting your perspective from struggle to flow.
modern_relevance: You might feel torn between pressures that keep you stuck and impulses urging you toward freedom and growth.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
कर्तुं सार्थकमेवास्ति द्विधा भावत्रयं खलु ।
स्पृष्ठेर्दशायां दम्पत्योः क्षेत्रवीजे महर्षयः ! ॥
translation: निश्चय ही त्रिभाव के दो भेद हैं। हे महर्षिगण ! सृष्टि दशा में स्त्री और पुरुष में क्षेत्र और बीज
english_translation: There are indeed two distinctions in the threefold states: in the state of creation, between the female and male as field and seed, O great sages!
essence: Creation unfolds through two complementary principles: the receptive field and the active seed.
simple_meaning: The three states of existence have two distinct forms, especially seen in creation as female and male, symbolized as field and seed.
insight: It invites you to recognize dual complementary roles in creation as fundamental to all life processes.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अधिभूतं तथा चास्ते पितरस्त्वाधिदैवतम् ।
भूतभावोद्भवकरो विसर्गः कर्मसंज्ञितः ॥
translation: अधिभूत, पितृगण अधिदैव और वहां भूतभावोद्भवकर विसर्गरूपी कर्म
english_translation: There is the physical nature, the ancestors as the presiding spirits, and the karmic energy that arises from the state of beings.
essence: Actions arise from the physical world, ancestral forces, and living energy combined.
simple_meaning: Actions come from three sources: the physical world, inherited influences from ancestors, and the energy born from the state of all beings.
insight: It teaches you to see your actions as the result of interconnected layers beyond just yourself, broadening perspective on responsibility.
modern_relevance: When you act, your choices reflect who you are physically, your inherited background, and the invisible energy of your environment.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अध्यात्म प्रोच्यते तत्र नात्र कश्चन संशयः ।
मुक्तेदशायां दम्पत्योमल्लिङ्गं प्रकृतिश्च मे ॥
translation: अध्यात्म कहा जाता है इसमें कुछ संदेह नहीं और मुकिदशा में स्त्री और पुरुष में मेरी प्रकृति और मेरा लिंगरूप
english_translation: There is no doubt that this is called spiritual knowledge, and in the state of freedom, my nature and my form are like the union of male and female.
essence: True freedom reveals your nature as a harmonious union beyond duality.
simple_meaning: Spiritual knowledge is certain and clear, showing that in freedom, the true nature is a union like male and female together.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing identity as divided to recognizing wholeness beyond opposites.
modern_relevance: When you feel torn between conflicting parts of yourself, remember your true nature is a balanced union beyond any division.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अधिभूतं तथास्ते सच्चिद्भावावधिदैवतम् ।
परमानन्द एवास्ति तत्राध्यात्म न संशयः ॥
translation: अधिभूत, मेरा सत् और चिदभाव अधिदैव और वहाँ  निःसन्देह परमानन्द ही अध्यात्म है
english_translation: The supreme reality in you is the natural world, pure consciousness, and the divine principle; beyond doubt, supreme bliss is the inner truth.
essence: You are fundamentally the natural world, pure awareness, and supreme bliss without doubt.
simple_meaning: You are made of the natural world, pure consciousness, and the divine principle, and your true self is supreme joy without doubt.
insight: It shifts your view from separation to seeing yourself as a unified presence of nature, awareness, and bliss.
modern_relevance: When life feels fragmented, remembering you are nature, awareness, and joy can restore balance and clarity.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
ब्राह्मणा: !  इत्यमेवाहं त्रिभावैर्दैशकालयोः।
पात्रेऽपि दर्शनं दत्त्वा स्वभक्तान ज्ञानिनो ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: हे ब्राह्मणों! मैं इसी प्रकार सब देश काल और पात्रो में त्रिभावों से दर्शन देकर प्रकृति के धन से अपने ज्ञानी भक्तों को
english_translation: O Brahmins! In all lands, times, and forms, I reveal myself through three modes, granting true knowledge to my devoted seekers.
essence: The divine reveals itself in many forms to guide devoted seekers to true knowledge.
simple_meaning: The divine appears in all places, times, and forms through three modes to grant true knowledge to devoted seekers.
insight: It shows that the divine presence is accessible in many ways, tailored to the seeker’s readiness.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
प्रकृतेर्वन्धनान्नूनं मोचयामि न संशयः।
एतद्गहरहस्यं यः कथितं विमपुङ्गवाः ॥
translation: निश्चय ही बचाया करता हूँ इसमें सन्देह नहीं ! हे ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठो ! मैंने आपलोगों से यह गूढ रहस्य कहा है
english_translation: I certainly liberate from the bonds of nature, there is no doubt. O best of Brahmins, I have revealed this profound secret to you.
essence: Freedom from nature’s bonds is certain and this profound secret has been revealed.
simple_meaning: There is no doubt that I free you from the bonds of the natural world. I have shared this deep secret with you.
insight: It shifts your view from feeling stuck in nature’s cycles to knowing liberation is accessible and assured.
modern_relevance: When you feel trapped by your habits or circumstances, this verse reminds you true freedom beyond those limits is possible and certain.
speaker: Teacher

verse_text:
शुद्धभावमयो यश्च पूर्णशक्तिप्रकाशकः ।
ओतत्सदिति मन्त्रों हि मद्भावत्रयवाचकः ॥
translation: शुद्ध भावमय पूर्ण शक्ति प्रकाशक जो मेरे तीनों भावों का पाचक ॐ ततसत मन्त्र है
english_translation: The pure state filled with complete power that illuminates is the sacred Om Tat Sat mantra representing my three aspects.
essence: Om Tat Sat mantra embodies and reveals pure power in three unified aspects.
simple_meaning: The sacred Om Tat Sat mantra expresses the pure and complete power of my threefold nature.
insight: It invites you to recognize how a simple mantra can hold vast, unified power beyond surface appearances.
modern_relevance: When you chant or hear Om Tat Sat, you connect to a deep source of pure power that integrates many parts of yourself.
speaker: Shambhu Dheesh

verse_text:
भावनाभिस्तदर्थानां तपश्च निरन्तरम् ।
मद्भक्तैज्ञाननिष्णातैर्मन्त्रतत्वपरायणैः ॥
translation: उसका निरन्तर जप और उसके अर्थी की भावना द्वारा ज्ञान निष्णात और मन्त्रतत्व परायण मेरे भक्तो को
english_translation: The continuous disciplined practice and heartfelt understanding of meaning by my devoted followers who are skilled in knowledge and dedicated to mantra essence.
essence: Continuous disciplined effort with heartfelt meaning leads to mastery and deep understanding.
simple_meaning: Steady, continuous effort combined with sincere feeling leads to deep mastery and understanding.
insight: It teaches you to combine consistent effort with sincere feeling to unlock deeper wisdom and skill.
modern_relevance: You keep returning to your practice, even when results seem slow, because you trust that steady effort and heartfelt focus will deepen your understanding.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अविभक्तज्ञानपूर्णा तैरन्तदृष्टिराप्यते ।
ममैव सच्चिदानन्द भावत्रयसमाश्रयात् ॥
translation: अविभक्त ज्ञान पूर्ण अन्तर्दृष्टि प्राप्त होती है। मेरे ही सत् चित् और आनन्द इन तीनों भावों को आश्रय करके
english_translation: Undivided, full knowledge arises from the unity of my truth, consciousness, and bliss.
essence: Complete insight arises from embracing truth, awareness, and joy as one.
simple_meaning: Complete and undivided insight arises when truth, awareness, and joy are experienced as one within you.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that true wisdom comes from experiencing truth, awareness, and joy as inseparable.
modern_relevance: When you connect your authentic self with clear awareness and genuine joy, you naturally see your life and choices with clarity and completeness.
speaker: Shri Dheesh

verse_text:
नन्नध्यात्माधिदेवाधिभूतरूपं महर्षयः ।
भावत्रयं हि सर्वस्मिन् कार्यव्रह्मणि भासते ॥
translation: हे महर्षियों ! अध्यात्म अधिदैव और अधिभूतरूपी त्रिभाव सम्पूर्ण कार्य ब्रह्म में निश्चय ही प्रकट हैं
english_translation: O great sages, the three aspects of self, divine, and nature are indeed revealed in the complete supreme reality of action.
essence: Self, divine, and nature reveal themselves as one in the supreme reality of action.
simple_meaning: The three fundamental aspects—your true self, the divine presence, and the natural world—are all expressed in the supreme reality behind every action.
insight: It teaches you to see your actions as expressions of an integrated reality beyond separation.
modern_relevance: When you act, recognize that your true self, the divine, and the natural world are not separate but interwoven in what you do.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
दृश्य नातो भवेद किश्चिच्छून्यं भावत्रयेण वै ॥
प्राप्य भक्ते पराकाष्ठां ज्ञानयोगान्तिमस्थलीम् ॥
translation: इस कारण त्रिभाव से रहित कोई दृश्य हो ही नहीं सका । मेरे ज्ञानी भक्त जब ज्ञानयोग की अन्तिम स्थलरूपा भक्ति की पराकाष्ठा को प्राप्त करके
english_translation: Therefore, nothing can be seen without the threefold nature; my wise devotees reach the highest peak of devotion, the final stage of Jnana Yoga.
essence: True wisdom culminates in the highest devotion beyond mere knowledge.
simple_meaning: Nothing can be truly seen without the threefold nature of existence. The wisest devotees reach the highest devotion, which is the final stage of wisdom practice.
insight: It shifts how you see wisdom—from pure intellect to a fullness completed by devoted love.
modern_relevance: You might master a skill or study deeply, but without heartfelt commitment and love, your understanding feels incomplete.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
यदा मे ज्ञानिनो भक्ता मां द्रष्टुं शक्नुवन्ति ह ।
सर्वेषु देशकालेषु तदा भावत्रयं मम ॥
translation: मेरे दर्शन करने में समर्थ होते हैं तब वह सब देश और काल में मेरे त्रिभाव का
english_translation: When the wise devotees can truly see me everywhere and at all times, then my threefold nature is revealed.
essence: True devotion reveals the divine's presence across all places and times.
simple_meaning: When wise devotees truly perceive the divine, they see the divine's presence everywhere and at every time, revealing its threefold nature.
insight: It invites you to recognize the divine's constant presence beyond limits of place or time, deepening your devotional connection.
modern_relevance: You notice a moment when your love or faith makes you feel connected everywhere you go and at every time, as if nothing is separate.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
भवन्त्यनुभवन्तस्ते मच्चिता नात्र संशयः ।
अघट्यघटनायां या प्रकृति पटीयसी ॥
translation: अनुभव करते हुए निःसन्देह मद्गतचित्त हो जाते हैं। उस समय अघटन घटना पटीयसी
english_translation: Those who experience become undoubtedly absorbed in me; during the unfolding of events, that nature prevails.
essence: True trust arises naturally when your heart fully experiences the divine without doubt.
simple_meaning: When you deeply experience your connection with the divine, your mind becomes free of doubt and fully trusting.
insight: The verse teaches you to let lived experience build your trust in the divine, moving beyond intellectual doubts.
modern_relevance: You’ve faced uncertainty but found moments when your trust felt rock solid, even without proof—this is that trust growing.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सा त्रैगुण्यमयी देवी तमःसत्त्वरजोऽभिधैः ।
त्रिभिगुणैस्तदा नालं बद्धं भक्तान मम प्रियान् ॥
translation: त्रिगुणमयी मेरी प्रकृति देवी सत्त्व रज और तमरूपी तीनों गुणों से मेरे भक्तों को बन्धन करने में असमर्थ हो जाती है।
english_translation: My nature, composed of the three qualities—goodness, passion, and ignorance—cannot bind my devoted followers.
essence: Devoted love transcends the three qualities and cannot be bound by nature’s forces.
simple_meaning: Your devoted love goes beyond the three qualities of nature and cannot be held back or bound by them.
insight: It shifts your focus from being trapped by fluctuating moods to trusting the steady power of devotion.
modern_relevance: When you commit fully to something meaningful, distractions and doubts lose their grip and cannot stop your progress.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अहो मत्प्रकृतिश्चैव विद्यारूपं समाश्रिता।
नयते ज्ञानिनो भक्तान् मत्सायुज्यं न संशयः ॥
translation: अहो ! मेरी प्रकृति ही विद्यारूप धारण करके ज्ञानी भक्तो को मत्सायुज्य प्राप्त कराती है, इसमें सन्वेह नहीं
english_translation: Ah! My nature itself, assuming the form of knowledge, leads wise devotees to union with me without doubt.
essence: Your nature as inner wisdom naturally guides devoted seekers to assured union without doubt.
simple_meaning: Your true nature takes the form of knowledge and leads devoted seekers to assured union with the divine.
insight: It teaches you to trust your own knowledge as the reliable path to deep connection and fulfillment.
modern_relevance: When you follow your inner wisdom, even amidst confusion, it steadily brings you closer to what you truly seek without second-guessing.
speaker: Shri Dheesh

verse_text:
ज्ञात्वा लोकोत्तरं दिव्यं तत्त्वातीतं कृपानिधे!।
परतत्वात्मकं सम्यक् स्वरूपं ते यथार्थतः ॥
translation: हे कृपानिधे ! आपके लोकोत्तर दिव्य और तत्त्वातीत परम तत्त्वरूपी स्वरुप को यथार्थ रूप से
english_translation: Knowing your divine, transcendental nature beyond all worlds, the true supreme reality as it is.
essence: Your true nature transcends all worlds and is the supreme reality itself.
simple_meaning: You can recognize your true self as divine and beyond all worldly limitations, the supreme reality itself.
insight: It guides you to see beyond surface distractions and identify with your highest, unchanging truth.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by daily chaos, remembering your deeper, unchanging nature can bring calm and perspective.
speaker: Guru

verse_text:
दृश्यमप्रपञ्चनजाञ्च परिव्याप्नुवतोऽखिलम् ।
त्रिभावात्मकरूपस्य रहस्यं परमाद्भुतम् ॥
translation: भलीभांति जानकर और सम्पूर्ण दृश्य प्रपञ्च समूह में परिव्याप्त आपके त्रिभावात्मक स्वरुप का परम अद्भुत रहस्य
english_translation: Fully understanding and pervading all that is visible, the supreme wondrous secret is the threefold nature of your true self.
essence: Your true self is a wondrous secret fully present in three interwoven forms.
simple_meaning: Your true self has three aspects that fully pervade all visible reality, revealing a supreme and wondrous secret.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing yourself as separate parts to knowing the unified, threefold nature of your being.
modern_relevance: When you recognize your mind, body, and deeper awareness as one whole, you find a richer, more wondrous sense of who you truly are.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
समाकर्ण्य वयं जाताः कृतकृत्या न संशयः ।
किन्त्यन्यदेव नो जातं परं कौतूहलं ह्रदि ॥
translation: सुनकर हम निस्सन्देह कृतकृत्य हुए है; परन्तु हमारे हृदय में एक अन्य ही महान् कौतूहल (आश्चर्य) उत्पन्न हुआ है
english_translation: Hearing this, we are surely fulfilled; yet another great wonder has arisen in our hearts.
essence: Satisfaction with understanding can coexist with fresh, deeper curiosity.
simple_meaning: We have heard and feel satisfied, but a new, deeper curiosity has appeared in our hearts.
insight: Recognize that learning often opens new questions instead of closing them, inviting ongoing exploration.
modern_relevance: You finish reading something that answers a question, but suddenly a new deeper question emerges inside you.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
पश्यामः साम्प्रतं सप्त-ज्ञानभूमेरुपर्यो ।
भवन्तं सुखमासीनं सुरम्ये कमलासने ॥
translation: अहो ! इस समय हम देख रहे हैं कि सप्त ज्ञानभूमि के ऊपर सुरम्य कमल पर आप सुखपूर्वक आसीन है
english_translation: Behold now, we see you peacefully seated on the beautiful lotus above the seven realms of knowledge.
essence: A serene presence above profound realms draws focused attention now.
simple_meaning: We are currently seeing you sitting comfortably on a beautiful lotus above the seven realms of knowledge.
insight: This verse invites you to recognize moments of calm and elevated perspective before deep teaching begins.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
धीश सर्वज्ञ ! सर्व्वात्मन्नासितस्यास्य ते विभो ।
सौन्दर्य कमलस्यास्ते वांगमनोबुद्धयगोचरम् ॥
translation: हे सर्वात्मन् ! हे। विभो! सर्वज्ञ धीश ! जिस पर आप बैठे हुए हैं, उस कमल का सौन्दर्य वाक्, मन और बुद्धि से अतीत है
english_translation: O all-knowing lord! The beauty of the lotus on which you sit is beyond speech, mind, and intellect.
essence: True beauty of the divine's seat transcends mind, speech, and intellect.
simple_meaning: The beauty of the lotus where the divine sits cannot be fully expressed by words, mind, or intellect.
insight: It shows that some experiences or truths are beyond conceptual or verbal grasp.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
शरीरं भवतो धीश ! रक्तवर्णमपि प्रभो!।
अतीतं सर्ववर्णेभ्यो रक्तादिभ्योऽधुनात्यलम् ॥
translation: हे प्रभो धीश ! आपके शरीर का वर्ण रक्त होने पर भी वह रक्त आदि सब रंगों से अतीत होकर
english_translation: O wise lord, your body, though of red color, surpasses all colors including red itself.
essence: The visible form can transcend its ordinary colors and point to a higher reality.
simple_meaning: Your body is red, yet it goes beyond all colors, including red itself.
insight: It invites seeing beyond surface appearances to the deeper essence that surpasses physical traits.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
तर्पयत्यस्मदीयां वै रूपदर्शनलालसाम् ।
चक्रपद्मत्रिशूलैस्तु मोदकेन च भूपितैः ॥
translation: हमारी रूपदर्शन तृष्णा को इस समय भलीभांति तृप्त कर रहा है। अपने चक्र, पद्म, त्रिशूल और मोदकरूप दिव्यास्त्रो से विभूषित
english_translation: Right now, my desire to see forms is fully satisfied by the divine weapons adorned with the discus, lotus, trident, and mace.
essence: Seeing sacred symbols can satisfy a deep yearning for connection and meaning.
simple_meaning: At this moment, the speaker's desire to see divine forms is fully fulfilled by the sight of the divine weapons.
insight: It highlights how visual symbols can momentarily fulfill a deep desire for connection or understanding.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
करैदिव्यैरेभिरस्वैर्भवान् नित्यं चतुर्भुजः ।
कैवल्याभ्युदयौ दातुमिवाश्वासयते च नः ॥
translation: आप चतुर्भुज होकर इन हाथो से अभ्युदय और निःश्रेयस प्रदान करने के लिये मानो हमको नित्य अशान्वित कर रहे हैं।
english_translation: You, with your four arms, act as if constantly assuring us of liberation and ultimate well-being.
essence: A steady, divine presence acts constantly to assure your freedom and well-being.
simple_meaning: You appear as a four-armed being who constantly acts to assure us of freedom and the best outcome.
insight: It invites you to trust in the steady support working beyond your view, easing your burden.
modern_relevance: When life feels overwhelming, sensing a steady force working for your true freedom can bring calm and trust.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
समाधत्ते च नो बुद्धिं भवान् भूत्वा गजाननः ।
उपदिष्टा वयं पूर्व भवता यत्ततस्तव ॥
translation: और आप गजवदन होकर हमारी बुद्धि को समाहित कर रहे हैं । आपने पहले जो हमें उपदेश दिया है उसके द्वारा
english_translation: And you, as Gajanan, are uniting our intellect; through your previous teachings.
essence: The divine unites our intellect through past teachings already received.
simple_meaning: The divine Gajanan is uniting our intellect through the teachings you have given us before.
insight: It highlights how prior guidance shapes current mental clarity and focus.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
ईशा ज्ञातुं स्वरूपस्य रहस्य यत्किमप्यहो ।
सुन्दरी लोहिताङ्गीन्तु भवद्वामाङ्कवत्तिनीम् ॥
translation: अहो ! हम आपके स्वरुप के रहस्य को तो यत्किञ्चित् समझने में समर्थ हुए हैं परन्तु आपके वाम-अंक-वर्तिनी
english_translation: Alas! We have somewhat understood the secret of your true nature, but your left side—adorned with a beautiful reddish form—remains unknown.
essence: Partial understanding of the true self reveals mysteries that remain hidden and beautiful.
simple_meaning: Someone claims to have partly understood the secret of your true nature but is still puzzled by your left side's beautiful reddish form.
insight: It teaches that even deep understanding can leave some truths hidden, inviting humility and ongoing inquiry.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
शंखक्त्यब्जचक्रातिीवभूषितचतुर्भुजाम् ।
यां विश्वमोहिनी देवीं षोडशी शक्तिशालिनीम् ॥
translation: शंख,चक्र शक्ति और पद्म से अति विभूषित चतुर्भजा लोहितवर्णांगी और शक्ति शालिनी षोडशी जगत् मोहिनी
english_translation: The sixteenth Shakti, adorned with conch, disc, and lotus, four-armed, radiant red, enchants the entire world.
essence: A radiant divine power captivates the universe through symbolic adornment and presence.
simple_meaning: A powerful divine figure, the sixteenth Shakti, is described as richly adorned and captivating the whole world.
insight: Recognize that symbols convey deeper qualities of power and presence beyond the physical form.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
पश्यामो वयमेतस्याः स्वरूपस्याधुनावधि।
नाज्ञासिष्म रहस्यं तत् कृपां कृत्वैव साम्प्रतम् ॥
translation: जिस देवी को हम लोग देखते हैं उनके स्वरुप का रहस्य अभी तक हमारे समझ में नहीं आया, इसलिये इस  समय कृपा करके ही
english_translation: We see this divine form, but its true nature remains unknown; only now has grace allowed some understanding.
essence: Some truths reveal themselves only when grace opens the way to understanding.
simple_meaning: We have seen the divine form, but its secret nature was not understood until now, only revealed through grace.
insight: Recognize that some deeper truths require openness and grace, not just personal effort, to become clear.
modern_relevance: You encounter something profound that feels beyond your full understanding, yet a moment of openness or kindness reveals new meaning.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
"कास्तेऽसौ? तत्स्वरुपं कि तद्रहस्यञ्च विस्तृतम् ।
व्यस्तो वर्णयित्वैतव कृतकृत्यान कुरुप्व नः ॥
translation: वे कौन हैं ? उनका स्वरूप क्या है? और उनका विस्तारित रहस्य क्या है ? सो विस्तार पूर्वक वर्णन करके हमको कृतकृत्य कीजिये।
english_translation: Who are they? What is their true nature? And what is their vast mystery? Please describe all this fully so we may be grateful.
essence: Asking clearly about unknown beings and their deep nature opens the way to understanding.
simple_meaning: This verse asks who these beings are, what their true nature is, and requests a full explanation of their mystery with gratitude.
insight: It encourages honest inquiry and openness before knowing, highlighting the value of clear explanation and gratitude.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
शक्तिरेषा ममैवास्ते सर्वकार्यसहायिका।
सिद्धि नाम्ना च यामाहुब्राह्मणा वेदपारगाः ॥
translation: मेरे सब कार्यों में सहायिका ये देवी मेरी ही शक्ति है, वेदज्ञ ब्राहण गण जिनका सिद्धि नाम से अभिहित करते हैं
english_translation: This power that assists me in all tasks is indeed mine; the wise who have transcended the Vedas call it Siddhi (accomplishment).
essence: The power that aids all your actions is truly your own inner strength.
simple_meaning: There is a power that helps you in every action, and it is truly yours. Wise teachers call this power 'Siddhi' or accomplishment.
insight: Recognize that the force enabling your success is your own power, not something external.
modern_relevance: When you face a challenge, remember the strength you rely on is your own inner power supporting you throughout.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
ममैव प्रकृतिविप्रा: ! सदा त्रैगुण्यशोभिता।
अत्यन्तं सा प्रसीदन्ती सिद्धिरूपञ्च विभ्रती ॥
translation: हे विप्रवृन्द ! मेरी त्रिगुणशोभित प्रकृति ही सिद्धिरूप धारण करके सदा मेरी सेवा में अति प्रसन्न होकर
english_translation: O wise ones! My nature, adorned by the three qualities, always serves me joyfully, embodying perfection.
essence: Your nature joyfully serves the divine, embodying perfection through three qualities.
simple_meaning: Your nature, shaped by three qualities, naturally serves the divine with joy and perfection.
insight: Recognize and trust your natural tendencies as expressions of joyful, devoted service rather than resisting them.
modern_relevance: When your work or actions arise naturally from who you are, they feel joyful and fulfilling without struggle.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सेवायां में रता निखं मामुपाश्रित्य राजते ।
पूर्णाङ्गललिता रम्या षोडशी सर्वसुन्दरी ॥
translation: रत रहती हुई निरन्तर मेरा आश्रय करके शोभायमान है। पुर्ण अवयव सुशोभित षोड़शी सर्व सौन्दर्य समन्विता
english_translation: She remains delighted in service, shining by taking refuge in me; a perfectly formed, charming sixteen-year-old, adorned with all beauty.
essence: True beauty shines when you delight in devoted service and take refuge in the divine.
simple_meaning: When you find joy in serving and rely on the divine, you naturally radiate beauty and grace.
insight: It teaches you to root your actions in trust and devotion, letting your natural grace emerge through service.
modern_relevance: You feel truly yourself and radiant when you serve others wholeheartedly without hesitation or doubt.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
चक्राब्जशंखशक्तीनां धारिणी शक्तिरूपिणी ।
सिद्धिर्विच्यातते नैव सेवातो मे कदाचन ॥
translation: मनोहारिणी शहद चक्र शक्ति पद्म धारिणी शक्तिरूपिणी सिद्धि किसी समय भी मेरी सेवा से च्युत नहीं होती है
english_translation: The power that holds the discus, conch, and mace, the form of power itself, never abandons me because of my service.
essence: Steadfast devotion never lets the sustaining power abandon you.
simple_meaning: The divine power that carries mighty weapons never leaves you when you serve faithfully.
insight: It teaches you to maintain steady devotion, knowing that true power remains with those who serve sincerely.
modern_relevance: When you consistently support your team or loved ones, the strength you rely on stays with you, never abandoning your efforts.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अपि चन्निरपक्षोऽहं तत्सेवाऽऽदानकर्मणि ।
शुश्रूपते तथाप्येपा धृत्वा रूपं चतुर्विधम् ॥
translation: यद्यपि मैं इसकी सेवा ग्रहण करने में निरपेक्ष रहता हूँ तो भी यह चतुर्विध रूप धारण करके मेरी सेवा की इच्छा करती है
english_translation: Although I remain impartial in receiving that service, it desires to serve me in four distinct forms.
essence: Devotion reaches out to you persistently in many forms, even without your bias.
simple_meaning: Even if you remain neutral and do not favor any service, the divine expresses devotion to you in four distinct ways.
insight: It shifts your view from needing to choose or desire devotion to recognizing it arrives regardless of your preferences.
modern_relevance: You might feel indifferent or unsure about spiritual practices, yet you still experience caring or support coming to you in unexpected ways.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
नन्वध्यात्माधिदेवाधिभूतानि सहजं तथा ।
सिद्धरस्या हि रूपाणि चत्वारि ब्राह्मणोत्तमाः ॥
translation: इसी कारण हे ब्राह्मण श्रेष्ठो! इस सिद्धि के चार भेद हैं यथा-अधिभूतसिद्धि, अधिदेवसिद्धि, अध्यात्मसिद्धि और सहजसिद्धि
english_translation: Indeed, O best Brahmin, the four types of mastery are: mastery over the physical realm, mastery over the divine realm, mastery over the self, and innate mastery.
essence: Mastery appears in four forms: physical, divine, self, and innate effortlessly.
simple_meaning: There are four kinds of mastery: control over the physical world, the divine realm, the inner self, and natural, effortless skill.
insight: This verse teaches you to see mastery beyond effort, including natural ease and deep inner control.
modern_relevance: When you excel in your work, your relationships, your inner growth, and also in moments when things come naturally, you experience these four types of mastery.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
ऐश्वर्य्यस्य चिता यद्वत् वलस्य च सता यथा ।
सम्बन्धः कर्मणः शक्तया रूपस्य तेजसा सह ॥
translation: जिस प्रकार चित् के साथ ऐश्वर्य का सम्बन्ध है, सत् के साथ बल का सम्बन्ध है, शक्ति के साथ कर्म का सम्बन्ध है और तेजके साथ रूप का सम्बन्ध है
english_translation: Just as prosperity is connected with the mind, strength with existence, action with power, and form with brilliance.
essence: Prosperity, strength, action, and form are linked to mind, existence, power, and brilliance.
simple_meaning: Prosperity, strength, action, and form are each connected to specific aspects of our inner and outer nature like mind, existence, power, and brilliance.
insight: It teaches you to see qualities like strength and prosperity as expressions of deeper inner connections, not separate things.
modern_relevance: You notice how your mental focus energizes your efforts, shaping your strength and the outcomes you create.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
तथैवास्ते च सम्बन्धः सिद्धेः सार्द्धे मया ध्रुवम् ।
सम्बन्धोऽयमपूर्वोऽस्ति नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥
translation: उसी प्रकार मेरे साथ सिद्धि का नित्य सम्बन्ध है । यह सम्बन्ध अलौकिक है, इसमें विचार नहीं  करना चाहिए।
english_translation: Just as the supreme success is always with me, this connection is extraordinary and should not be questioned.
essence: Steady connection with true success exists beyond doubt and questioning.
simple_meaning: You share a steady, extraordinary connection with true success that requires no doubt or questioning.
insight: Encourages you to trust steady, extraordinary connections without overanalyzing or doubting them.
modern_relevance: When you feel uncertain about your efforts, remember some connections—like your true purpose—are steady and need no second-guessing.

verse_text:
विष्णोः प्रिया यथा लक्ष्मीः प्रिया श्यामा शिवस्य च ।
ब्रह्ममय्या महाशक्ते प्रिय आस्ते यथा पुनः ॥
translation: हे विज्ञो ! जिस प्रकार विष्णु को लक्ष्मी प्रिय है, शम्भु को श्यामा प्रिय है और पुनः जिस प्रकार ब्रह्मरूपिणी महाशक्ति को
english_translation: Just as Lakshmi is dear to Vishnu, and Shyama is dear to Shambhu, similarly the great power in the form of Brahman is dear.
essence: Deep love and devotion connect great powers and their beloveds, revealing the nature of true connection.
simple_meaning: Certain powerful beings are deeply loved by their divine counterparts, showing a pattern of devotion and connection.
insight: It invites you to recognize your own worthiness of deep, devoted love and connection.
modern_relevance: You might notice the quiet, unspoken love in your closest relationships — this verse reflects that profound connection.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
चिद्विलासात्मको भावः स्वकार्यब्रह्मणः खलु ।
अरुणोऽस्ति यथा विज्ञाः ! सूर्यदेवस्य च प्रियः ॥
translation: स्वकार्य ब्रह्म का चिद विलास रूप भाव प्रिय है, एवं जिस प्रकार सूर्यदेव को अरुण प्रिय है
english_translation: The nature of the supreme reality is to delight in its own work, just as the sun god loves the reddish dawn.
essence: The supreme reality naturally delights in its own spontaneous activity.
simple_meaning: The supreme reality naturally enjoys its own actions, just like the sun loves the red dawn every day.
insight: It teaches you to see your true work as a source of joy, not as a burden or obligation.
modern_relevance: You might notice how some moments of your work or creativity feel effortless and deeply satisfying, just like dawn’s quiet beauty.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
महार्षयस्तथैवास्ते सिद्धिरेपा हि मे प्रिया।
परन्तु निर्विकारं मां निर्लिप्त ज्ञानरूपिणम् ॥
translation: उसी प्रकारसे हे महर्षि गण ! मुझको यह सिद्धि ही प्रिय है, परन्तु निर्लिप्त निर्विकार और ज्ञान स्वरुप  मुझको
english_translation: O great sages, I also cherish this perfection, but I prefer the unchanging, detached form of knowledge.
essence: True perfection is the steady, detached knowledge beyond all change.
simple_meaning: You value perfection, but you especially prefer knowledge that is steady, detached, and beyond change.
insight: It shifts your focus from valuing external success to embracing an inner, detached clarity of understanding.
modern_relevance: You might feel proud of your accomplishments but find deeper satisfaction when your understanding remains calm and unaffected by external ups and downs.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
स्वप्रेमावरणे सिद्धिर्नासज्जयितुमस्त्यलम् ।
अलौकिकोऽस्ति सम्बन्धः सिद्धयैवं मे महर्षयः ! ॥
translation: सिद्धि अपने प्रेम आचरण से फंसा नहीं सकती। हे महर्षिगण ! इस प्रकार का सिद्धि के साथ मेरा अलौकिक सम्बन्ध है
english_translation: Perfection cannot be conquered when covered by self-love. O great sages, this is how my supernatural connection with perfection is.
essence: Self-love conceals perfection, blocking true conquest or realization.
simple_meaning: Perfection or true accomplishment cannot be overcome or truly attained when it is hidden beneath self-centered love or ego. The speaker shares a unique, higher connection to such perfection.
insight: It teaches you to see self-love as a barrier to true mastery and to cultivate detachment to connect with deeper accomplishment.
modern_relevance: When your success feels tied to your ego or self-image, true mastery remains elusive, no matter how much you achieve.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
मन्त्रसिद्धिस्तपासिद्धिर्योगसिद्धिस्तथैव च ।
एवं नानाविधा लोके विख्याता याश्च सिद्धयः ॥
translation: जगत में जो, मन्त्रसिद्धि तपसिद्धि और योगसिद्धि, इस प्रकार नानाविध सिद्धियां प्रचलित हैं
english_translation: In the world, various types of accomplishments like mastery of mantras, success in disciplined effort, and perfection in yoga are well known.
essence: Spiritual success is known in many varied forms, each respected and real.
simple_meaning: There are many well-known kinds of spiritual achievements like mastering mantras, disciplined effort, and yoga.
insight: It teaches you to appreciate different kinds of spiritual or personal mastery without needing just one way.
modern_relevance: You notice people succeed in different ways—through focused practice, disciplined habits, or deep connection—and each path has value.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
उत याः सिद्धयो विमा ऐश्यः सन्त्यणिमादयः ।
जैव्यो वा सिद्धयः सन्ति या मेधामतिभादयः ॥
translation: और हे विप्रगण! जगत् में जो अणिमा लघिमा आदि ऐसी  सिद्धियां हैं अथवा जो मेधाप्रतिभा आदि जैवसिद्धियां प्रचलित हैं
english_translation: O scholars, the world contains siddhis like subtlety, lightness, and others, as well as natural gifts like intelligence and brilliance.
essence: Special powers and natural talents both exist in the world.
simple_meaning: There are extraordinary powers like becoming very small or light, and natural talents like intelligence existing in the world.
insight: It invites you to recognize the diverse range of abilities—both mystical and natural—that can arise in human experience.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
ओषधीसिद्धयो याश्च या रसायनमूलिकाः ।
पदार्थसिद्धयो याश्च विश्वस्मिन्मन्त्रदर्शिनः ! ॥
translation: या जगत में जो औषधि. सिद्धि ,रसायनसिद्धि और पदार्थसिद्धि नाम से प्रचलित हैं और हे मन्त्रदर्शि गण!
english_translation: Those in the world who have mastery over herbs, alchemy, and substances are indeed seers of mantras.
essence: Mastery of healing and substances coincides with deep spiritual insight.
simple_meaning: Some people in the world have special knowledge about healing plants, alchemy, and material substances and also understand sacred mantras.
insight: It highlights how specialized practical knowledge can link with spiritual understanding, showing the value of integrated wisdom.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
बलसिद्धिद्रव्यसिद्धिः सिद्भिश्च पुरुषार्थगा।
सम्मोहनादयः ख्याताः सन्ति वा याश्च सिद्धयः ॥
translation: जगत में  जो धनसिद्धि. बलसिद्धि, पुरुषार्थसिद्धि, संमोहिन करने की सिद्धि आदि प्रचलित है और जगत में जो
english_translation: In the world, achievements like wealth, strength, success through effort, and the power to enchant are known and recognized.
essence: Common worldly successes like strength, wealth, and influence are known but not the whole truth.
simple_meaning: Many kinds of worldly successes like power, wealth, and influence are recognized and talked about in the world.
insight: It invites you to notice how many achievements are celebrated but also to question what true success means beyond them.
modern_relevance: You see many people chasing money, power, or social influence, considering these the main markers of success.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
ज्ञानस्य सिद्धयो नाना वेदशास्त्रप्रकाशिकाः ।
सर्वास्तास्न्ति मत्सिद्धेरङ्गभूता न संशयः ॥
translation: वेद  तथा नानाशास्त्र के प्रकाश की जो नाना ज्ञान सम्बन्धीय सिद्धियां हैं वह  सब मेरी सिद्धि की ही अंगभूत हैं इसमें सन्देह नहीं।
english_translation: All the various knowledges revealed by the Vedas and other scriptures are undoubtedly parts of my own perfection.
essence: All genuine knowledge is unified as parts of one perfect whole without doubt.
simple_meaning: All the different insights from the Vedas and other scriptures are parts of a single perfect truth without doubt.
insight: It teaches you to recognize diverse teachings as expressions of one underlying perfection, reducing confusion and fostering integration.
modern_relevance: When you study different ideas or teachings, you can see them as pieces of one larger truth rather than separate, conflicting views.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
जन्मौपधिपदोपास्तितपोमन्त्रसमाधिभिः।
संयमेनापि लभ्यन्ते सिद्धयोऽलौकिका द्विजाः !॥
translation: हे विप्रो! जन्म, पद,औषधि मन्त्र, उपासना, तप, संयम और समाधि के द्वारा अलौकिक सिद्धियां प्राप्त होती हैं
english_translation: O Brahmin! Extraordinary accomplishments are attained through birth, social position, herbs, mantras, worship, austerity, self-restraint, and absorbed presence.
essence: Steady discipline and restraint unlock extraordinary spiritual accomplishments.
simple_meaning: Special spiritual powers come from birth circumstances, rituals, austerity, self-control, and deep meditation.
insight: It teaches that consistent inner discipline and restraint are the path to rare spiritual abilities.
modern_relevance: You notice how steady habits and self-control quietly build your strength, even when results feel distant.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अष्टोपायाः प्रधाना हि सन्तीमे सिद्धिलब्धये ।
सन्ति जातिस्मरत्वादिसिद्धयो जन्मसिद्धयः॥
translation: सिद्धिलाभ के लिये ये ही पाठ उपाय प्रधान हैं। जातिस्मरत्व आदि सिद्धियां जन्म सिद्धियां हैं
english_translation: The eight main methods are essential for attaining accomplishment; achievements like remembering past lives are innate.
essence: True accomplishment arises by practicing eight essential methods, beyond natural abilities.
simple_meaning: There are eight main methods or practices that are necessary to achieve true success; abilities like recalling past lives come naturally.
insight: Focus on mastering core methods rather than waiting for innate talents to appear.
modern_relevance: You feel stuck trying to grow, but focusing on essential proven steps can unlock your progress steadily.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
या सिद्धगुटिका कायकल्पश्चैव रसायनम ।
अन्या चैवंविधा सिद्धिरोषधीसिद्धिरुच्यते ॥
translation: सिद्धगुटि का कायाकल्प रसायन और इस प्रकार को अन्यान्य सिद्धियां ओषधि सिद्धियां कहलाती हैं
english_translation: The perfected elixir that renews the body is called Kayakalpa Rasayana; other such accomplishments are known as medicinal achievements.
essence: Certain rare elixirs renew the body, while others are medicinal achievements.
simple_meaning: There is a special elixir called Kayakalpa Rasayana that rejuvenates the body; other kinds of such accomplishments are known as medicinal achievements.
insight: It highlights that some remedies aim not just to heal but to renew and transform the body's vitality.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
नैमित्तिक्यश्च या देव-शक्तयो राजशक्तयः ।
अन्याश्चैवविधाः सर्वाः शक्तयः पदसिद्धयः ॥
translation: राजशक्ति और नैमित्तिक देवशक्ति और अन्यान्य इस प्रकार को सव शक्तियां पद-सिद्धियां कहलाती हैं
english_translation: The royal power, the occasional divine powers, and all other types of powers are called accomplished powers.
essence: Different kinds of powers are classified as accomplished powers.
simple_meaning: There are different kinds of powers like royal power, divine powers that arise occasionally, and others; all these are called accomplished powers.
insight: It shows the variety of powers operating in the world but offers no direct guidance on how to relate to them.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
उपास्तेः सिद्धयः सन्ति देवतादर्शनादयः।
यासु सिद्धिषु लब्धामु जायतेऽभ्युदयो ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: देवदर्शनादि उपासना सिद्धियां कहलाती हैं जिनके प्राप्त होने पर अवश्य अभ्युदय होता है।
english_translation: The perfections attained through worship like seeing the radiant beings surely bring steady progress.
essence: Sacred devotional experiences naturally create steady and certain progress.
simple_meaning: When you sincerely worship and have sacred experiences like seeing radiant beings, it brings clear and steady growth in your spiritual journey.
insight: It shifts the mind to value devotional experiences as trustworthy markers of spiritual advancement.
modern_relevance: When you feel deeply connected during a heartfelt ritual or moment of devotion, that feeling is a sign of steady inner growth.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
षड़वशीकरणादीनि यानि कर्माणि सन्ति च ।
अन्यान्यन्तर्भवन्त्येवं मन्त्रसिद्रौ न संशयः ॥
translation: वशीकरणादि षट्कर्म तथा उसी प्रकार की और सिद्धियां मन्त्रसिद्धि के अन्तर्गत हैं इसमें सन्देह नहीं है
english_translation: There is no doubt that six types of actions like control rituals and similar accomplishments fall under the power of mantra mastery.
essence: Certain ritual actions clearly belong within mantra mastery without doubt.
simple_meaning: Certain six kinds of ritual actions, including control rituals, are part of mantra mastery, and this is beyond doubt.
insight: Recognize that complex spiritual abilities often come as parts of a larger unified practice.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
नैवास्त्यवाम्वधा सिद्धिदैवी वा कापि लौकिकी।
या संयमसमाधिभ्यां लभ्येत तपसा न वा ॥
translation: तप संयम और समाधि द्वारा दैवी या लौकिकी ऐसी कोई भी सिद्धि नहीं जो प्राप्त न हो सके
english_translation: There is no divine or earthly accomplishment that cannot be attained through discipline, control, and absorbed presence.
essence: All accomplishments are attainable through disciplined effort, self-control, and deep focus.
simple_meaning: Any great success, whether related to the divine or the world, can be reached by sustained effort, self-control, and deep focus.
insight: It teaches you to rely on disciplined, focused effort as the true source of accomplishment, not external factors.
modern_relevance: When you commit to a challenging project or personal goal, consistent focus and self-control become your most powerful tools to succeed.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
चतुर्विधा हि लभ्यन्ते सिद्धयो निश्चितं द्विजाः ।
उपायैरष्टभि: प्रोक्तैनात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥
translation: हे विप्रो ! इन आठ उपायों के द्वारा चतुर्विध ही सिद्धियां निश्चय प्राप्त हुआ करती है इसमें विचार नहीं करना चाहिए
english_translation: O Brahmin, four types of accomplishments are certainly attained through these eight methods; there is no need to doubt this.
essence: Certain successes arise reliably from a defined set of methods without doubt.
simple_meaning: There are four kinds of definite achievements that can be reached by following eight specific methods, without any doubt.
insight: It shifts your mind from uncertainty to confident trust in the methods you follow.
modern_relevance: When you follow proven steps in your work or practice, success becomes certain without second-guessing yourself.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अनन्ताः सिद्धयो याश्च लोके मच्छक्तिसम्भवाः ।
विभक्तास्सन्ति तास्सर्वाश्चतुर्धेव मया पुरा ॥
translation: संसार में मेरी शक्ति से उत्पन्न जो अनन्त प्रकार की सिद्धियां हैं मेरे द्वारा पहले ही से वह सभी चार श्रेणियों में विभक्त हैं
english_translation: The countless powers born from me in the world are previously divided by me into four categories.
essence: Infinite powers arise from the divine, organized into four distinct categories.
simple_meaning: Infinite kinds of powers in the world come from the divine and are grouped into four types.
insight: Recognize that your diverse abilities are not random but belong to distinct groups, helping you understand and focus your potential.
modern_relevance: You may feel overwhelmed by your abilities and options, but underlying them is a clear structure guiding your strengths.
speaker: Shambhu Dheesh

verse_text:
तासाञ्च लब्धये नूनमुपाया अष्ट निर्मिताः ।
तैरेव ताश्च प्राप्यन्ते निश्चितं विप्रपुङ्गवाः ! ॥
translation: और उनकी प्राप्ति के लिये ही आठ उपाय मैंने विधान किये हैं, हे ब्राह्मणो! उन्हीं के द्वारा वह अवश्य प्राप्त होती हैं।
english_translation: I have prescribed eight methods precisely for attaining them, O Brahmins! By these alone, they are surely attained.
essence: Clear, defined methods are essential and sufficient to achieve definite goals.
simple_meaning: There are eight specific methods laid out to achieve certain goals, and only by following these methods can one definitely succeed.
insight: Trust and commit to proven methods rather than guessing; this focus sharpens your path.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by choices, having a clear set of steps can guide your efforts and reduce doubt.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
कुर्वाणा लौकिकं कार्ये सन्ति याः सिद्धयोऽखिलाः ।
ता ज्ञेया निखिला विप्रा आधिभौतिकसिद्धयः ॥
translation: हे विप्रो ! सब लौकिक कार्यकारिणी सिद्धियो को आधिभौतिक सिद्धियां,
english_translation: O wise one, all worldly accomplishments are known as achievements of the physical plane.
essence: Worldly achievements are only physical accomplishments, not true success of the self.
simple_meaning: All achievements in the world are only accomplishments of the physical realm, not ultimate or spiritual success.
insight: It shifts your view to see worldly success as separate from your inner growth or spiritual progress.
modern_relevance: You might celebrate a promotion or award, but these wins belong to the surface world, not your deeper being.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
या देवकार्यकारिण्यः सिद्धयः सम्प्रकीर्तिताः।
ता ज्ञेया आधिदैविक्यः सिद्धयो निखिलाः खलु ॥
translation: देवकार्य कारिणी सभी सिद्धियों को अधिदैविक सिद्धियां और
english_translation: The accomplishments achieved through performing divine tasks are known as transcendental accomplishments; indeed, all accomplishments belong to this higher realm.
essence: True accomplishments arise only from actions aligned with the higher realm.
simple_meaning: Accomplishments that come from performing divine or higher-purpose actions are called transcendental accomplishments, and all true achievements belong to this higher realm.
insight: It shifts your focus from chasing results to aligning your actions with a higher purpose, recognizing true accomplishment as that alignment.
modern_relevance: You gave your time and energy to a cause bigger than yourself and saw results that felt meaningful beyond just personal gain.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सिद्धयो ज्ञानविज्ञान-प्रकाशिन्यश्च या इह ।
आध्यात्मिक्यश्च सर्वास्ताः सिद्धयः प्रोचिरे बुधैः ॥
translation: ज्ञानविज्ञान प्रकाशक सब सिद्धियों को संसार में बुधगण अध्यात्मिक सिद्धियां कहते हैं।
english_translation: All spiritual accomplishments that illuminate wisdom and knowledge are called spiritual achievements by the wise in this world.
essence: True achievement is the clear inner wisdom that shines through knowledge.
simple_meaning: Spiritual achievements are those that bring clear wisdom and knowledge, recognized by wise people everywhere.
insight: It shifts focus from external results to inner illumination as the true mark of achievement.
modern_relevance: When you learn deeply and your understanding lights up, you experience real accomplishment beyond just finishing tasks.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
भवतां मन्त्रद्रष्ट्रणां सिद्धयोऽन्तर्गता इह ।
नैवात्र विस्मयः कार्यों भवद्भिविमपुङ्गवाः ! ॥
translation: मन्त्रद्रष्टा आपलोगों की सिद्धियां हे विप्रश्रेष्ठो! इसी सिद्धि के अन्तर्गत हैं इसमें विस्मय न करो
english_translation: O best of the wise, the accomplishments of those who perceive mantras lie within this very accomplishment; do not be amazed by anything else here.
essence: True accomplishment lies within inner realization, not in external wonders.
simple_meaning: The true accomplishments of those who understand sacred teachings are found within themselves; you should not be amazed by anything external.
insight: It shifts focus from external validation to inner realization as the true mark of accomplishment.
modern_relevance: You may chase achievements or praise, but real mastery quietly grows inside, unnoticed by others.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
सहजाख्या तु था सिद्धिर्वते विज्ञसत्तमाः!।
एताभ्यः सर्वसिद्धिभ्यः सां नितान्तमलौकिकी ॥
translation: परन्तु हे विज्ञवरों ! सहज नाम्नी जो सिद्धि है वह इन सब सिद्धियों से अत्यन्त अलौकिक है
english_translation: But, O best among the learned, the state called Sahaja is supremely transcendent beyond all other attainments.
essence: The natural, effortless state exceeds every other spiritual achievement.
simple_meaning: The natural, innate state called Sahaja is far beyond all other spiritual achievements or powers.
insight: It shifts your focus from chasing many accomplishments to recognizing the supreme value of spontaneous natural being.
modern_relevance: You might strive for certifications or skills, but the simplest natural state within you is the highest achievement.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
ममावतारवृन्देऽसौ स्वत एव प्रकाशते।
तत्वज्ञानमहात्मानो मनोनाशेन वै ध्रुवम् ॥
