translation: मेरे अवतारों में इस सहज सिद्धि का स्वतः ही अत्यन्त विकाश होता है और महापुरुषगण जब तत्ववान वासनाक्षय और मनोनाश के द्वारा
english_translation: Among my incarnations, this natural realization shines forth on its own; great beings attain it through destroying desires and the mind.
essence: True realization naturally arises when desires and restless mind dissolve completely.
simple_meaning: True realization happens naturally in divine incarnations and in great beings who destroy desires and the restless mind.
insight: This verse invites you to see realization as a natural blossoming once desire and mental noise are removed.
modern_relevance: After restless nights and endless wanting, you find clarity emerges naturally when you finally quiet your mind and release craving.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
निर्वासनतया चैवोन्मूलयन्तः स्वजीवताम् ।
शिवरूपीभवन्तश्च समाधौ निर्विकल्पके ॥
translation: अपने जीवभाव को निश्चय नाश करके ही शिवस्वरूप हो निर्विकल्प समाधिस्थ
english_translation: By completely destroying the sense of individual self, one attains the nature of the supreme being and abides in undisturbed, formless absorption.
essence: Uprooting the separate self reveals the supreme being resting in undisturbed absorption.
simple_meaning: You must completely let go of your sense of being a separate self to become like the supreme and rest in undisturbed stillness.
insight: It shifts your focus from identifying with thoughts to resting as pure awareness without distinctions.
modern_relevance: When you stop clinging to your personal identity and stories, you find a calm space beyond all mental noise.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
तिष्ठन्तो यान्ति मय्येव लयमेकान्ततो यदा ।
मदिच्छया तदा तेषु सहजा कहिचिद्भवेत् ॥
translation: रहते हुए मुझ में ही एकदम लीन होते हैं तब उनमें मेरी इच्छा से कभी कभी सहज सिद्धि का विकाश हुआ करता है
english_translation: When they remain completely absorbed in me, then by my will, sometimes a natural perfection arises in them.
essence: Complete absorption in the divine allows natural transformation to arise by divine will.
simple_meaning: When you remain completely absorbed in the divine presence, natural growth or perfection sometimes spontaneously arises by divine will.
insight: It teaches you to let go of control and trust that deep absorption in devotion can naturally transform you.
modern_relevance: You’ve felt moments when simply being present and connected brings unexpected growth without effort or planning.
speaker: Shri Dheesh

verse_text:
उन्नताः सहजा बहव्यः सिद्धयो यद्यपि द्विजाः ।
तास्वहो सन्ति मुख्यास्तु त्रयस्त्रिंशच केवलम् ॥
translation: हे ब्राह्मणों ! यद्यपि उच्चश्रेणी की सहज सिद्धियां अनेक है तो भी अहो! उनमें से केवल तैतीस ही मुख्य हैं।
english_translation: O Brahmins, although there are many natural perfections, only thirty-three are considered principal.
essence: Among many natural perfections, only a select few are truly principal.
simple_meaning: Many natural perfections exist, but only thirty-three are recognized as main or most important.
insight: It encourages focusing on key strengths rather than being overwhelmed by many minor qualities.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
योगिवृन्देऽवतारेषु जीवन्मुक्तमहात्मनु ।
तपस्विषु प्रकाशन्ते त्रयस्त्रिंशच सिद्धयः ॥
translation: अवतारों में, योगियों में और जीवन्मुक्त महापुरुषों तथा तपस्वियों में तैतीस प्रकार की सिद्धियां प्रकट होती हैं
english_translation: Among incarnations, yogis, liberated great beings, and ascetics, thirty-three kinds of perfections appear.
essence: True freedom manifests in many diverse extraordinary abilities across realized beings.
simple_meaning: There are thirty-three types of extraordinary abilities that appear in incarnations, yogis, liberated beings, and ascetics.
insight: It shifts your view to appreciate many forms of mastery beyond common measures, opening curiosity to different spiritual qualities.
modern_relevance: You may see people around you who seem to have unique strengths or calmness that feels beyond ordinary — this verse reminds you these are varied expressions of deep inner freedom.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
समाहितैर्भवद्भिस्ताः श्रूयन्तां वर्णयाम्यहम् ।
तासां नामानि पुण्यानि भवतामन्तिके द्विजाः ! ॥
translation: हे ब्राह्मणो ! उनके पवित्र नामों का वर्णन आपके समीप करता हूँ उनको आप लोग सावधान होकर सुनो
english_translation: O Brahmins, I describe here the sacred names of those who are composed; listen carefully to them.
essence: Careful attention is needed to receive sacred teaching about composed beings.
simple_meaning: The speaker invites the Brahmins to attentively hear a description of the sacred names of composed persons near them.
insight: It shows the importance of focused listening before receiving valuable teachings.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
एताः सर्वाः सिद्धयो हि वेदशास्त्रेषु वर्णिताः ।
अणिमा लघिमा प्राप्तिः प्राकाम्यं महिमा तथा ॥
translation: ये सब सिद्धयां वेद और शास्त्रो में वर्णित है अणिमा, लघिमा, प्राप्ति, प्राकास्य, महिमा,
english_translation: All these perfections are indeed described in the Vedas and scriptures: subtlety, lightness, attainment, prior existence, and greatness.
essence: Ancient wisdom describes subtle, powerful qualities that the true self can attain.
simple_meaning: Ancient teachings describe special subtle qualities like becoming very small, light, powerful, and existing before all else.
insight: It teaches you to recognize and trust the hidden, subtle capacities within your own being.
modern_relevance: When you feel small or powerless, remember subtle strengths like lightness and greatness already dwell within you, described long ago.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
वशित्वं गरिमेशित्वे तथा कामावसायिता ।
दूरश्रवणमेवालं परकायप्रवेशनम् ॥
translation: वशित्व, गरिमा, ईशित्व, कामावसायिता, दूरश्रवण, परकायप्रवेश,
english_translation: Control, prestige, mastery, desire, hearing from afar, and entering another's body are all connected to the restless mind.
essence: Feelings of control, pride, desire, and illusions arise from the restless mind.
simple_meaning: Many feelings like control, pride, desire, and even sensing distant things come from the restless mind.
insight: It teaches you to notice that these feelings and illusions are products of your restless mind, not fixed realities.
modern_relevance: When you feel jealous of others' success or imagine things beyond your reach, your mind is spinning stories that fuel desire and pride.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
मनोयायित्वभेवेति सर्वज्ञत्वमभीप्सितम् ।
बाद्विस्तम्भो जलस्तम्भः चिरजीवित्वमेव वा ॥
translation: मनोयायित्व, अभीप्सित सर्वज्ञत्व, वह्यीस्तम्स, जलस्तम्भ, चिरजी, वित्य,
english_translation: The desire for mastery over the mind, the wish for omniscience, external obstacles, water barriers, or even long life — none of these are truly sought.
essence: True desire is beyond mind control, omniscience, obstacles, and longevity.
simple_meaning: You might think you want to control your mind, know everything, overcome obstacles, or live forever, but these are not your true desires.
insight: It shifts focus from craving external achievements to recognizing deeper, authentic desires beyond surface wishes.
modern_relevance: When you chase total control or perfect knowledge, you often miss what truly matters inside.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
वायुस्तम्भः क्षुतपिपासानिद्रास्तम्भनमेव च ।
कायवसृदश्य वाकसिद्धिमृतानयनमीप्सितम् ॥
translation: वायुस्तम्भ, क्षत्रस्तम्भ, पिपासास्तम्भ, निद्रास्तम्भ, कायव्यूह, वाक् सिद्धि, ईप्सितमृतानयन,
english_translation: The cessation of breath, hunger, thirst, and sleep, along with the dissolution of the body and the perfection of speech, leads to the desired death.
essence: Mastery of bodily urges and speech precedes the wished-for death.
simple_meaning: Stopping natural urges and dissolving the body are steps toward the desired death and perfection.
insight: It shifts focus from physical needs toward mastery over body and speech, but requires broader context to apply.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सृष्टिसंहारवर्तृत्वं प्राणार्पणमेव च ।
प्राणानाञ्च प्रदानञ्च लोभादीनाञ्च स्तम्भनम् ॥
translation: सृष्टिकर्तृत्व, संहारकर्तृत्व, प्रणाकपैण, प्राणप्रदान, लोमादिस्तम्भन,
english_translation: Creation, destruction, sustaining life, offering of life force, and control over desires arise from attachment.
essence: Desire underlies all creation, destruction, life-giving, and self-restraint.
simple_meaning: The cycles of creation and destruction, sustaining life, offering life, and controlling desires all stem from attachment or desire.
insight: It shifts your view to see desire as the root of both action and self-control, not separate forces.
modern_relevance: You notice how your wants drive both your energy and your restraint, shaping your daily choices.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
इन्द्रियाणां स्तम्भनञ्च बुद्धिस्तम्भनमेव च ।
कल्पवृक्षत्वसत्यानुसन्धाने अमरत्वकम् ॥
translation: इन्द्रियस्तम्भन, बुद्धिस्तम्भन, कल्पवृक्षत्व, अमरत्व और सत्यानुसन्धान|
english_translation: The stopping of the senses and the stopping of the discerning mind, the true pursuit of reality, and the state of immortality are all one.
essence: Stopping senses and mind together reveals the timeless reality beneath appearances.
simple_meaning: When your senses and discerning mind stop their activity, you reach true understanding and the experience of timelessness.
insight: It teaches you to simultaneously restrain sensory input and quiet mental activity to access profound stillness.
modern_relevance: You close your phone, silence distractions, and calm your racing thoughts — that's when you touch something beyond time.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अघटयघटनायां या प्रकृतिमे पटीयसी।
जगद्विमोहिनी सैव महामायापराभिधा ॥
translation: जो अघटन घटना पटीयसी जगद्विमोहिनी मेरी प्रकृति है और जिसका दूसरा नाम महामाया है वही
english_translation: The nature that accepts both event and non-event, which deludes the world, is my nature, also called the great illusion.
essence: Your nature embraces all experience, even the illusions that confuse the world.
simple_meaning: Your essential nature accepts everything that happens and does not happen, creating the illusion that confuses the world.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that your nature includes both change and stability, dissolving confusion.
modern_relevance: You feel overwhelmed by life's ups and downs, but your true nature quietly holds all experiences without getting lost.
speaker: Shambhu Dheesh

verse_text:
महतो ज्ञानिनश्चैवं योगिनोऽपि तपस्विनः।
सिद्धिसाथैरनेकैर्ही मोह्यंती निरन्तरम् ॥
translation: तपसियों को योगियों को और बड़े बड़े ज्ञानियों को भी नानासिद्धियों के द्वारा ही निरन्तर विमोहित करके
english_translation: Great sages, yogis, and wise ones are continuously deluded by many mystical powers.
essence: Even the most advanced seekers face continuous illusions from powerful distractions.
simple_meaning: Even the most accomplished wise people, yogis, and ascetics can be constantly misled by various mystical powers.
insight: Recognize that no matter your progress, subtle distractions can cloud your clarity, inviting ongoing vigilance.
modern_relevance: You might have felt confident in your knowledge or discipline, only to find unexpected doubts or distractions pulling you off course.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
आवागमनचक्रेऽस्मिन् स्वविलासात्मके मुहुः ।
मोक्षमार्गञ्च रुन्धना पूर्णयेत समन्ततः ॥
translation: मुक्तिमार्ग को रोकती हुई अपने विलास स्वरुप इस अवागमनचक्र मे चारों ओर बार बार  घुमाया करती है
english_translation: The cycle of coming and going, in its own playful nature, repeatedly obstructs the path to freedom from all sides.
essence: Your own restless nature repeatedly blocks your path to freedom.
simple_meaning: Your own restless habits keep you trapped in cycles that block your path to freedom.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that your own patterns and inner distractions are the real obstacles to freedom.
modern_relevance: You find yourself stuck in repeating the same mistakes or distractions, unable to move toward your deeper goals despite wanting freedom.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
ब्राह्मणाः प्रकृतिमऽसौ महामायापराभिधा ।
किन्तु मे ज्ञानिनो भक्तान मोहितुं न कदाप्यलम् ॥
translation: परन्तु हे ब्राह्मणों! महामायानाम्नी यह मेरी प्रकृति मेरे ज्ञानी भक्तों को कदापि विमोहित नहीं कर सकती
english_translation: O Brahmins! This nature of mine, called great illusion, can never delude my knowledgeable devotees.
essence: Devoted knowledge makes you immune to the illusion of the natural world.
simple_meaning: The divine nature may appear as a great illusion, but it can never confuse those who are devoted with knowledge.
insight: It teaches you to rely on devoted wisdom as a shield against the mind’s confusion and distractions.
modern_relevance: When distractions and doubts cloud your mind, your sincere trust and understanding keep you steady and clear.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
कुलाङ्गनानां साध्वीनामङ्गानाशिव दर्शनम् ।
ज्ञानिनां मम भक्तानां भवेत् सिद्धिप्रकाशनम् ॥
translation: मेरे ज्ञानी भक्तो का सिद्धियो को प्रकाश करना सती कुल कामिनियों के अंग दिखाने के समान होता है
english_translation: For my wise devotees, revealing spiritual accomplishments is like showing the limbs of impure women to virtuous women.
essence: Spiritual accomplishments are precious and must be shared wisely, not carelessly revealed.
simple_meaning: Revealing spiritual achievements carelessly can be harmful, just like exposing private parts to the wrong people.
insight: It teaches you to protect your inner progress by sharing it only with those who understand and respect it.
modern_relevance: You might hesitate to share your inner growth because some people may misunderstand or judge you harshly.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
पुरुषांश्च परान् कांश्चिद् यथा काश्चित् कुलाङ्गनाः।
दर्शनाय निजाङ्गानां न क्षमन्ते कदाचन ॥
translation: जिस प्रकार हे विप्रो! कोई भी कुलकामिनियां कदापि किन्हीं पर-पुरुषों को अपने अंगों को नहीं दिखा सकती
english_translation: Just as no woman attached to her family can ever show her own limbs to other men,
essence: Family loyalty creates natural boundaries that are never crossed.
simple_meaning: Some women devoted to their family never reveal their own bodies to other men.
insight: Recognize that some social boundaries arise from respect and loyalty within close relationships.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
भवन्त्युत्कण्ठिताः किन्तु सर्वथा जनसंसदि।
दर्शनाय निजागानां निर्लज्जाः कुलटा मुहुः ॥
translation: परन्तु निर्लजा कुलटा अर्थात् व्यभिचारिणी स्त्रियां जनसमाज में सब प्रकार से अपने अंगों को बार बार  दिखाने के लिये उत्कण्ठित रहती हैं
english_translation: Yet shameless women, driven by desire, repeatedly expose their bodies openly in public gatherings.
essence: Restless craving can cause shameless, repeated public exposure despite social norms.
simple_meaning: Some women, without shame, repeatedly seek attention by showing themselves openly in public.
insight: It reveals how craving for attention can lead to repeated actions despite social norms.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सर्वसामर्थ्यवन्तोऽपि मद्भक्ता ज्ञानिनस्तथा ।
सिद्धिं स्वां नैव भो विप्रा! द्योतयन्ते कदाचन ॥
translation: उसी प्रकार मेरे ज्ञानी भक्तगण सर्वसमर्थ होने पर भी अपनी सिद्धि को कदापि प्रकट नहीं करते
english_translation: Even though my devoted wise ones possess all power, they never reveal their perfection.
essence: True power is revealed through humble silence, not proud display.
simple_meaning: Devoted and wise people who have achieved great power do not display their accomplishments or seek recognition.
insight: It encourages shifting from showing off achievements to embodying quiet confidence and letting your growth speak for itself.
modern_relevance: You may have skills or insights that impress others, yet you choose to stay humble rather than boast or seek praise.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
योगिनों भक्तिहीनास्तु लक्ष्यहीनास्तपस्विनः ।
साधका उग्रकर्म्माणो ज्ञानहीनास्तथा द्विजाः! ॥
translation: किन्तु हे ब्राह्मणो ! लक्ष्य हीन तप हीन, भक्ति हीन योगी और ज्ञान हीन उनका साधक वाणिक वृत्ति ले
english_translation: But O Brahmin, yogis without devotion, ascetics without purpose, practitioners of harsh acts, and twice-born without wisdom are all misguided.
essence: Effort without devotion, purpose, and wisdom is ineffective and misguided.
simple_meaning: Effort alone is not enough; without devotion, clear purpose, and wisdom, practices fail to bring true growth.
insight: It teaches you to check if your actions have meaning, love, and clear understanding behind them, not just effort alone.
modern_relevance: You might push yourself through tasks, but without clear goals, passion, and understanding, your efforts feel hollow and ineffective.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
स्वीयाः सिद्धीर्वणिग्वृत्त्या सम्प्रकाश्य पतन्सलम् ।
प्रकाश्याः सिद्धयो नैव सर्वथाऽतो महात्मभिः ॥
translation: अपनी सिद्धयो को प्रकट करके अत्यन्त पतित होते हैं; इसलिये सर्वथा महात्माओं को सिद्धियां प्रकाशित नहीं करना चाहिये।
english_translation: Those who reveal their achievements boastfully fall greatly; therefore, truly noble beings should not display their achievements.
essence: Boasting about your achievements leads to downfall; true greatness stays humble and quiet.
simple_meaning: Showing off your accomplishments with pride leads to a downfall; truly great people keep their achievements private.
insight: It teaches you to embrace humility and avoid boasting, preserving your true strength and respect.
modern_relevance: You feel tempted to post every success online, but sometimes holding back protects your peace and respect more than sharing.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
कदाचिभ्रातरः पुत्रा आत्मीयाः स्वजना उत ।
दैवादनिच्छयेक्षेरन यथाङ्गानि कुलस्त्रियाः ॥
translation: जिस प्रकार भ्राता पुत्र आत्मीय और स्वजन अनिच्छा से कभी कभी कुल कामिनी का अंग दर्शन दैवात् कर लेते हैं
english_translation: Just as brothers, sons, and loved ones sometimes unwillingly see parts of the family woman due to fate.
essence: Some experiences happen unwillingly due to forces beyond personal control.
simple_meaning: Sometimes family members unwillingly see parts of a woman in their family because of fate or circumstance.
insight: It reveals how some events or perceptions happen beyond our will, reminding us to accept situations we cannot change.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
ज्ञानिनां मम भक्तानां सिद्धीनां वैभव तथा।
प्रकटत्वं हठादयाति देवाल्लोके कदाचन ॥
translation: उसी प्रकार मेरे ज्ञानी भक्तों का सिद्धिवैभव दैवात् कभी कभी जगत् में हठात् प्रकाशित हो जाता है
english_translation: Just as the perfected wisdom of my devoted followers sometimes suddenly manifests in the world of beings.
essence: Deep devotion and wisdom can suddenly manifest their power in the world.
simple_meaning: Sometimes, the perfected achievements of deeply devoted and wise followers suddenly become visible in the world.
insight: It teaches you to trust that your growth and effort can reveal themselves spontaneously without forcing or timing them.
modern_relevance: At moments you least expect, your quiet dedication and insight can suddenly become clear to others, even if you never sought recognition.
speaker: Shri Dheesh

verse_text:
हस्ताभ्यां मे यथा सिद्धिद्धाभ्यां विप्रा निरन्तरम् ।
मायामोहितजीवेभ्यः शक्त्यर्थो प्रददत्यलम् ॥
translation: हे विप्रो ! मेरी सिद्धि जिस प्रकार दो हाथोंसे मायाविमोहित जीवों को निरन्तर अर्थ और शक्ति को भलीभांति देती हुई
english_translation: O wise one, just as my two hands continuously grant power and purpose to beings deluded by illusion.
essence: You receive steady strength and purpose even when clouded by illusion.
simple_meaning: You are continuously given strength and a meaningful purpose, even when confused by illusion.
insight: It shifts your view from isolation in confusion to trust in ongoing unseen support.
modern_relevance: When doubts cloud your mind and you feel overwhelmed, remember unseen forces keep empowering you steadily.
speaker: Shambhu Dheesh

verse_text:
बध्नात्यस्मिन् हि संसारे कारागारे चिरन्तने ।
तथाऽन्याभ्यां स्वहस्नाभ्यां धर्मार्थों वितरन्त्यहो ॥
translation: चिरन्तन कारागार रूपी संसार में फंसा रखती है, उसी प्रकार अपने अन्य दो हाथों से धर्म और अर्थ देती हुई
english_translation: In this long-lasting prison called the cycle of reactivity, the divine holds you fast with one hand while giving religion and wealth with the other two.
essence: The cycle of reactivity traps you while offering rewards that deepen the hold.
simple_meaning: The endless cycle of reactivity traps you like a prison, but at the same time offers religion and wealth as distractions or promises.
insight: Recognize how attractions to purpose and rewards can also be chains, not just freedoms.
modern_relevance: You feel stuck in routines and pressures but still chase status and purpose that keep you tied down.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
मदत्ते ज्ञानिभक्तेभ्यः कैवल्याभ्युदयो ध्रुवम् ।
साधका मोहिता अज्ञाः कर्मस्वासक्तमानसाः ॥
translation: ज्ञानीभक्तों को अभ्युदय और निःश्रेयस अवश्य प्रदान करती है। मोहित, ज्ञानहीन, कर्मासक्तचित्त साधक
english_translation: For the wise and devoted, liberation surely arises; but for deluded, ignorant, and action-attached seekers, it does not.
essence: True freedom arises only when wisdom and devoted love come together, not from mere action.
simple_meaning: Freedom or liberation definitely arises for those who combine wisdom and devoted love. But seekers who are confused, ignorant, and attached to their actions do not reach it.
insight: It teaches you to combine clear understanding with heartfelt devotion rather than relying only on busy doing.
modern_relevance: You might know people who chase success without deeper understanding or care, staying stuck; this shows how wisdom and heartfelt devotion help break free.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
माययोत्पादिताः सिद्धीः संसारे क्षणभङ्गराः।
परिणामस्वभावा हि लब्ध्वा तत्सेवया मुहुः ॥
translation: क्षणभङ्गर परिणामशील और माया से उत्पन्न सिद्धियो को संसार में प्राप्त करके उनकी सेवा द्वारा बार बार
english_translation: Powers born of illusion are fleeting in the cycle of change; their nature is to transform, so even after gaining them, you will repeatedly serve their results.
essence: Powers born of illusion are fleeting and repeatedly bind those who seek them.
simple_meaning: Powers created by illusion are temporary and always changing. Even after gaining them, you end up serving their effects over and over.
insight: It teaches you to recognize how chasing fleeting achievements only pulls you back into the cycle of desire and service.
modern_relevance: You finally get a promotion or a prized possession, but the satisfaction fades fast, and you find yourself chasing the next thing again.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
नरके स्वर्गलोके च लोकयोः पितृप्रेतयोः ।
नित्यं घूयमानास्ते सन्तप्यन्ते त्रितापतः ॥
translation: नरकलोक, स्वर्गलोक प्रेतलोक और पितृलोक में नित्य घूमते हुए वह त्रिताप से तापित होते रहते हैं
english_translation: Those who wander constantly among the realms of hell, heaven, ancestors, and spirits endure suffering from the threefold pain.
essence: Endless wandering through realms does not end inner suffering.
simple_meaning: Some beings endlessly roam different realms but remain trapped in suffering from threefold pain.
insight: It shows that changing external circumstances alone cannot end inner suffering.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
किन्तु मे ज्ञानिनो भक्ताः परमानन्दसागरम् ।
स्वरूपं तत्त्वतो ज्ञात्वा सचिदानन्दरूपकम् ॥
translation: परन्तु मेरे ज्ञानी भक्तगण परमानन्दसागर सचिदानन्दमय स्वरूप को यथार्थ रूप से जानकर
english_translation: But my wise devotees, having truly known the supreme blissful essence of consciousness and existence,
essence: True devotion arises from deeply knowing your blissful conscious self.
simple_meaning: Those who truly understand their own blissful and conscious true nature become devoted in the deepest way.
insight: It teaches you to connect devotion with direct experience of your true nature rather than just belief.
modern_relevance: When you experience your own deepest joy and true self, your connection to life and love becomes more heartfelt and genuine.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
समस्तसिद्धिसर्वस्वं मामेव प्राप्नुवन्त्यलम् ।
निरापदं पदं श्रेष्ठमधिकुर्वन्ति मे ततः ॥
translation: समस्त सिद्धियों का सर्वस्व अर्थात् परमसिद्धि रूपी मुझको ही भलीभांति प्राप्त करते हैं उसके बाद मेरे परमपद के अनायास अधिकारी हो जाते है
english_translation: All perfections and the highest attainments come to me alone; thereafter, they easily become rightful to my supreme state.
essence: All highest attainments begin within and naturally lead to your supreme state.
simple_meaning: Every highest perfection and attainment comes to the true self first, making the supreme state naturally accessible.
insight: It shifts focus from external achievements to recognizing your inner source as the foundation of all true success.
modern_relevance: When you realize your own inner strength and growth, the path to your fullest potential feels natural and assured.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
मच्छक्तिरूपिणी सिद्धिः प्रभावात्यन्तशोभिनी ।
मद्भक्तोर्विमुखाञ्जीवान मत्तोऽलञ्च  निवर्त्य सा ॥
translation: मेरी शक्तिरूपिणी सिद्धि अति प्रभावशालिनी है।  वह मुझमें भक्तिहीन जीवों को मुझसे अत्यन्त विमुख करके
english_translation: My power called Siddhi is supremely glorious; it turns beings without devotion away from me and returns to me.
essence: Without devotion, even the greatest power turns away and withdraws.
simple_meaning: Power that flows through devotion is radiant and effective; without devotion, beings turn away and the power withdraws.
insight: It teaches you that heartfelt devotion or sincere connection is essential to sustain your strength and influence.
modern_relevance: When you lose passion or heartfelt connection to your purpose, your inner energy and effectiveness fade away.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
संसारापारपाथोधावज्ञानावर्तसम्भ्रमे ।
निपात्य नितरां शश्वत् क्लिश्नातीह महर्षयः ॥
translation: और अज्ञान रूपी आवर्त (जलभंवर) से संकुल इस संसाररूपी अपार समुद्र में निरन्तर गिराकर सर्वदा क्लेशित करती है ।
english_translation: The great sages are constantly overwhelmed by the endless ocean of worldly existence, caught in the whirlpool of ignorance and confusion.
essence: Even great sages are deeply troubled by the confusion within endless worldly existence.
simple_meaning: Great sages suffer continuously, caught in the vast ocean of worldly life and trapped by the whirlpool of ignorance and confusion.
insight: It reveals that confusion and suffering are common even among the wise, highlighting the universal challenge of transcending ignorance.
modern_relevance: You may feel lost in overwhelming confusion, like being stuck in a stormy sea with no clear direction.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
भजतोऽनन्यभक्तया मां भूयोऽसौ साधकान वरान् ।
मत्समीपं समानीय कृतार्थान् कुरुते द्रुतम् ॥
translation: और पुनः वह मुझमें अनन्य भक्ति करनेवाले श्रेष्ठ साधकों को मेरे निकट पहुंचा कर शीघ्र कृतार्थ कर देती है
english_translation: The divine brings those who worship exclusively to the highest seekers near, swiftly fulfilling them completely.
essence: Exclusive devotion draws you near and brings quick, complete fulfillment.
simple_meaning: Those who worship with exclusive devotion are brought near to the divine and quickly become fulfilled.
insight: It teaches you to deepen your devotion, trusting that wholehearted focus invites swift positive transformation.
modern_relevance: When you focus your heart fully on what matters most, support and results tend to come faster than expected.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
यथा स्नेहमयी माता स्वात्मजानतियत्नतः ।
वर्द्धयन्ती प्रसादेन पुष्णन्ती पालयन्त्यपि ॥
translation: जिस प्रकार स्नेहमयी माता अपने पुत्रो को बड़े यत्न से पालती पोसती और प्रसन्नता से बढ़ाती हुई
english_translation: Just as a loving mother carefully knows her own child and lovingly nurtures, nourishes, and protects it with joy.
essence: You are lovingly nurtured and protected just like a child by its mother.
simple_meaning: You are cared for tenderly and joyfully, just like a loving mother cares for her child.
insight: It invites you to receive care openly, trusting that loving support is always present.
modern_relevance: When you feel vulnerable or overwhelmed, remember how a mother's loving care protects and nurtures you unconditionally.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अधिकारयते क्षिप्रं परमं मङ्गलास्पदम् ।
तथा कारुण्यपूर्णाऽसौ सिद्धिर्मातेव सर्वदा ॥
translation: परम मङ्गलमय अधिकार को शीघ्र प्राप्त करा देती है उसी प्रकार करुणामयी यह सिद्धि सदा माता के समान
english_translation: The highest auspicious authority is quickly attained, and similarly, this compassionate perfection is always like a mother.
essence: Compassion grants swift highest blessing like a constant, caring mother.
simple_meaning: You can quickly attain the greatest blessing when you trust in compassion, which is always like a caring mother.
insight: It shifts your trust toward compassion as a nurturing force that swiftly brings blessings.
modern_relevance: When you face difficult moments, feeling compassion like a mother's care can quickly bring you strength and peace.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
आर्त्तानर्थार्थीनो भक्तान जिज्ञासूंस्त्रीनिमान्मम ।
नृनमानन्दसन्दोमुत्साहञ्च  ददत्यलम् ॥
translation: आर्त जिज्ञासु और अर्थार्थी इन मेरे त्रिविध भक्तों को निश्चय ही परम आनन्द समूह और उत्साह भलीभांति देती हुई
english_translation: I surely give my threefold devotees—those in distress, seekers of meaning, and those desiring gain—supreme joy, enthusiasm, and delight.
essence: Devotion blesses seekers, sufferers, and desiring hearts with joy and enthusiasm.
simple_meaning: Devotion brings joy and enthusiasm to three kinds of followers: those in pain, those searching for meaning, and those wanting success.
insight: It teaches you to embrace devotion through any life state—pain, inquiry, or desire—and find joyful strength.
modern_relevance: When you're overwhelmed by hardship, curiosity, or ambition, holding devotion can bring unexpected joy and renewed energy.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
विघतेऽग्रेसरान क्षिप्रमाभिमुख्येन मे च तान ।
मम सेवारतायाश्च स्वरूपं प्रकृतदिधा ॥
translation: उनको शीघ्र मेरी ओर अग्रसर करती है । मेरी सेवा में रत प्रकृति  के स्वरूप दो प्रकार से विभक्त है,
english_translation: The two aspects of my nature swiftly move forward toward me, engaged in my service.
essence: Two parts of my nature move quickly to serve me.
simple_meaning: Two aspects of my nature move quickly toward me, both involved in service.
insight: It hints that the inner nature actively participates in service, suggesting dynamic engagement within.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
विभक्तं वर्तते विज्ञा: ! नात्र कार्या विचारणा।
एका पराभिधा ज्ञेया द्वितीयाऽपरनामिका ॥
translation: हे विज्ञवरों ! इसमें विचारने की कोई बात नहीं है, एक को परा और एक को अपरा जानो
english_translation: O wise ones! There is no need for debate here: one is the supreme, the other is the non-supreme.
essence: Reality divides simply into supreme and non-supreme without confusion.
simple_meaning: There is no confusion: understand that one reality is supreme and the other is not.
insight: It teaches you to stop overcomplicating and recognize the fundamental division in reality.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by complexity, you find peace by seeing the clear difference between what truly matters and what does not.
speaker: Teacher

verse_text:
अपरानामिका जीवान प्रकृतिमेऽखिलानलम् ।
गुणत्रयात्मके जाले स्वस्मिन्नाश्लिष्य मायया ॥
translation: अपरा नाम की मेरी प्रकृति अपने त्रिगुणात्मक जाल में सब जीवों को माया से  फंसा कर
english_translation: The lower nature, made of the three qualities, entangles all living beings in the web of illusion within itself.
essence: The three qualities of nature trap all beings in illusion within themselves.
simple_meaning: Your lower nature, made of three basic qualities, traps all living beings in a web of illusion.
insight: Recognize how your three basic qualities create patterns that trap your awareness in illusion.
modern_relevance: When you notice your moods and impulses pulling you into confusion, that’s your nature’s web of qualities at work.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
इन्द्रस्यानुभवं तैश्च कारयन्ती निरन्तरम् ।
स्वविलासात्मकं लीलामयं जनयते जगत् ॥
translation: उनको द्वन्द्व का अनुभव निरन्तर कराती हुई अपने विलासरूपी लीलामय संसार को प्रकट करती है
english_translation: The duality experienced by Indra continuously causes the playful, self-expressive world to manifest.
essence: The world is a continuous playful expression born from experiencing duality within.
simple_meaning: The world appears as a playful expression arising from the ongoing experience of duality within consciousness.
insight: It teaches you to recognize how your inner dual experiences shape your perception of the world as a creative play.
modern_relevance: When your mind swings between opposing feelings, you create the colorful, ever-changing reality you live in.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
परा में प्रकृनिर्धन्या साधकानां ह्रदम्बुजे।
भ्रद्रावली  पराभक्ति सन्निवेश्य महर्षयः ! ॥
translation: और हे महर्षिगण ! मेरी धन्या परा प्रकृति साधकों के ह्रदय पल में मेरी भक्ति रूपिणी भृंगावली को संनिविष्ट करके
english_translation: O great sages! In the heart-lotus of sincere seekers deprived of higher nature, I reside as devoted loving care.
essence: Devoted love quietly inhabits the heart even when higher nature feels absent.
simple_meaning: Within those who lack higher nature, devoted loving care quietly resides in the heart.
insight: It shifts your view from external lack to recognizing devotion already present within your heart.
modern_relevance: When you feel disconnected or lacking in confidence, a quiet devoted care still lives inside you, ready to guide your heart.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
वीक्षयन्ती त्रयाणाञ्च गुणानां वैभवं मुहुः।
 द्वन्द्वातीतं पदं नीत्वा मामेनान दर्शयत्यहो ॥
translation: त्रिगुणा वैभव को बार बार  दर्शन कराती हुई उनको द्वन्दातीत पद में पहुंचा कर अहो ! मेरा दर्शन करा देती है
english_translation: Repeatedly observing the grandeur of the three qualities, she leads them beyond duality to reveal me.
essence: You can witness the three qualities and still stand beyond all duality.
simple_meaning: The restless mind repeatedly sees the three qualities and is guided beyond all dualities to experience the true self.
insight: It teaches you to observe your changing qualities without being caught, shifting attention beyond dualities to the unchanging self.
modern_relevance: You notice your moods and impulses cycling, but a deeper part of you watches calmly beyond these ups and downs.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अतो विज्ञवरा अत्र प्रकृतेर्मे दशाद्वये ।
ममं सिद्धिस्वरूपस्य विकाशोऽपि द्विधा भवेत् ॥
translation: इसी कारण हे विज्ञवरों! मेरी प्रकृति की इन दो दशाओं में मेरी सिद्धि के स्वरूप का विकास भी द्विविध होता है।
english_translation: Therefore, O wise ones, in these two states of my nature, the manifestation of the true form of my perfection also becomes dual.
essence: True perfection unfolds within nature in two distinct, complementary states.
simple_meaning: Your true perfection develops through two different states of your nature.
insight: Recognize that your growth and realization can manifest through multiple, complementary states rather than a single fixed form.
modern_relevance: When you grow, you may find your progress takes different shapes, not just one fixed path, reflecting complexity in your development.
speaker: Shambhu

verse_text:
अपरा सिद्धिरेकास्ति द्वितीया च परामिधा ! ।
नैकोक्तसिद्धिरूपाणि नानारूपाणि विभ्रती ॥
translation: एक परा सिद्धि और दूसरी अपरा सिद्धि नाम से अभिहित होती है। सिद्धि के जो अनेक रूप पहले कहे गये हैं
english_translation: There is one superior accomplishment and another inferior accomplishment; the various forms of accomplishment mentioned earlier are not singular.
essence: Accomplishments exist in many forms, including higher and lower levels.
simple_meaning: There are different kinds of accomplishments: one higher and another lower; many forms exist rather than just one.
insight: Recognize that achievements differ in quality and depth, helping you focus on what truly matters.
modern_relevance: You notice some achievements feel deeper or more lasting than others, reminding you that not all progress is equal.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
सिद्धिर्मेऽस्त्यपरानाम्नी नात्र वः संशयो भवेत् ।
ज्ञानाधिकारिणो विप्राः ! पूज्या सिद्धिः पराभिधा ॥
translation: वह अनेक रूपधारिणी सिद्धि मेरी अपरा सिद्धि है इसमें आपलोगों को सन्देह नहीं होना चाहिये। हे ज्ञान के अधिकारी ब्राह्मणो ! जो पूज्या परा नाम की सिद्धि है
english_translation: My accomplishment is the supreme among many; there is no doubt about this, O wise Brahmins worthy of knowledge! The revered accomplishment is called the highest.
essence: The highest accomplishment is unmistakably supreme and honored by those who know.
simple_meaning: There are many forms of accomplishment, but the highest one is certain and respected by those who seek true knowledge.
insight: It guides you to honor your ultimate achievements without hesitation or self-doubt.
modern_relevance: When you've worked hard and reached a peak in your field, recognizing that achievement as truly supreme helps you trust your journey and keep moving forward.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
चिन्मयी सात्विकी नित्या हिताऽद्वैतविधायिनी।
स्वरूपानन्दसन्दोहयोतिनी सा प्रकीर्तिता ॥
translation: वह चिन्मयी सात्त्विकी नित्या हिता अद्वैतकारिणी और स्वारूपानन्द सन्दोह प्रकाशिनी कही गई है।
english_translation: She is described as consciousness-filled, pure, eternal, beneficial, leading to non-duality, and illuminating the bliss of true nature.
essence: Your true self is pure, eternal consciousness that reveals bliss beyond all duality.
simple_meaning: The true self is pure consciousness, always present and beneficial, revealing the experience of eternal bliss beyond duality.
insight: It invites you to recognize your essence as pure awareness that naturally reveals deep joy beyond mental noise.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by confusion and conflict, knowing your true nature is a pure, unchanging source of joy can bring calm and clarity.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
ऐश्यो मे सिद्धयो विप्राः ! कामनामन्तरेण मे।
प्रकटत्वं हि संसारे नैव यान्ति कदाचन ॥
translation: हे ब्राह्मणो ! मेरी ऐसी  सिद्धियां मेरी इच्छा के बिना संसार में कदापि प्रकाशित नहीं ही हो सकती
english_translation: O Brahmins! My achievements can never manifest in the world without my desire.
essence: No achievement can manifest in the world without your inner desire.
simple_meaning: Your accomplishments cannot appear without your own desire and intention behind them.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that inner desire is essential to bringing your actions and achievements into reality.
modern_relevance: You hesitate starting a project without full commitment; this reminds you that your desire sparks real progress.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
मामकीना यतः शक्तिर्न स्वेच्छाचारिणी भवेत् ।
अतो ममावतारेषु ज्ञानिष्वपि कदाचन ॥
translation: क्योंकि मेरा शक्ति स्वेच्छाचारिणी नहीं हो सकती, इसी कारण मेरे अवतारों मे  और कभी कभी मेरे ज्ञानी भक्तों में भी
english_translation: Because my power can never act according to its own will, in my incarnations and sometimes even in my wise devotees.
essence: True power never acts from selfish will but always follows higher wisdom.
simple_meaning: My power never acts selfishly or by its own desires, even in my incarnations or wise followers.
insight: It shifts the mind from imagining power as personal control to seeing it as service to a higher order.
modern_relevance: You might feel restless wanting control, but real strength comes from aligning with a greater purpose, not personal whims.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
मद्भक्तेषु प्रकाशेरन्नैश्यो मे सिद्धयः स्वतः।
ममावतारन्दानामाविर्भावो महर्षयः ॥
translation: मेरी ऐसी  सिद्धयों का प्रकाश स्वत: हुआ करता है। हे महर्षिगण ! मेरे अवतार समूह का अविर्भाव
english_translation: My followers' devotion naturally reveals my powers. O great sages, the appearance of my incarnations occurs.
essence: Devotion naturally reveals divine power and the arrival of divine beings.
simple_meaning: True devotion in followers naturally brings forth the divine's power and reveals the appearance of divine beings.
insight: It teaches you that sincere devotion itself is a natural force that brings forth divine manifestations without struggle.
modern_relevance: You notice how genuine care and faith in something greater can naturally inspire strength and transformation around you.
speaker: Shri Dheesh

verse_text:
अथवा ज्ञानिभक्तषु ह्यौश्याः सिद्धेः प्रकाशनम् ।
समष्टेजीववर्गस्य कर्मणो निघ्नमस्त्यहो ॥
translation: अथवा ज्ञानी भक्तों में ऐसी  सिद्धि का विकास अहो ! जीवों के समष्टि कर्माधीन है।
english_translation: Or among the wise and devoted, such perfection unfolds, for the collective of beings remains bound by action.
essence: Wisdom and devotion coexist with being bound by the results of collective actions.
simple_meaning: Even those who are wise and devoted experience progress, but all living beings remain bound by the consequences of their actions.
insight: It shifts your view to accept that wisdom and devotion do not exempt you from acting responsibly within life's laws.
modern_relevance: You might know deeply what is right and love what you do, yet still feel caught in the results of your efforts.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सन्त्यत: सिद्धयो विप्रा ऐश्योऽत्यन्तं सुदुर्लभाः।
स्वरूप मम सिद्धेश्च ज्ञात्वा सम्यङ्महर्षयः ॥
translation: इसी कारण हे ब्राह्मणो ! ऐसी  सिद्धियां अत्यन्त दुर्लभ है। हे महर्षियों ! आप मेरे स्वरूप और मेरी सिद्धि के स्वरूप को भलीप्रकार जानकर
english_translation: Therefore, O Brahmins, such attainments are extremely rare. O great sages, know well my nature and the nature of my attainments.
essence: Truly knowing the true self and its attainments is extremely rare, even among sages.
simple_meaning: Understanding the true nature of the inner being and its achievements is very rare, even for wise people.
insight: It teaches you to value and seek deep understanding of your true self beyond surface knowledge.
modern_relevance: You might meet many who claim insight, but truly understanding your own inner nature and achievements is a rare and precious clarity.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
कदाचिदपरासिद्धेर्माश्लिष्यध्वं हि बन्धने ।
चिन्मच्या मे परासिद्धेमहत्वं परमाद्भुतम् ॥
translation: कभी भी मेरी अपरा सिद्धि के बन्धन-जाल में न फंसो और मेरी चिन्मयी परासिद्धि के परम अद्भुत महत्त्व को
english_translation: Never get caught in the bondage of my lower accomplishments; grasp the supreme, wondrous importance of my supreme, conscious accomplishment.
essence: True value lies beyond small successes in the supreme conscious accomplishment.
simple_meaning: Avoid being trapped by minor achievements and instead understand the supreme, conscious accomplishment's profound importance.
insight: Shift your focus from transient successes to appreciating the profound value of your highest, conscious achievements.
modern_relevance: You might celebrate small milestones but risk missing the deeper meaning and lasting impact of your highest efforts.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
ज्ञात्वोपास्य च तामेवाद्वैतानन्दप्रकाशकम् ।
द्वन्द्वातीतं लभध्वं हि शाश्वतं परमं पदम् ॥
translation: जानकर और उसकी ही उपासना करके इन्द्वातीत अद्वैतानन्द प्रकाशक सनातन परमपद को प्राप्त करो
english_translation: Know and worship that which reveals non-dual bliss; attain the eternal supreme state beyond all dualities.
essence: Knowing and honoring the source beyond all dualities leads to eternal supreme bliss.
simple_meaning: You can realize and honor the source of non-dual bliss to attain the eternal supreme state beyond all opposites.
insight: It shifts focus from external dualities to the inner, unchanging source of bliss and being.
modern_relevance: When facing confusion or conflict, turning inward to what is beyond opposites offers lasting peace and clarity.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
स्थिरं लक्ष्यं विधायैवं द्विजाः ! सिद्धिस्वरूपिणि ।
आयुधे मोदके नूनं त्रिशूले मे त्रितापके ॥
translation: हे ब्राह्मणो! आप इस प्रकार स्थिर लक्ष्य रखकर मेरे त्रिताप रूपी त्रिशूल और सिद्धि रूपी मोदक जो आयुध हैं
english_translation: O Brahmin! Fix your steady aim on me, whose trident is the embodiment of suffering, and whose sweet treat is the embodiment of success.
essence: Steadily aiming at a goal means accepting both its challenges and successes.
simple_meaning: Hold a steady focus on your goal, accepting both the difficulties and the rewards it brings.
insight: It teaches to hold firm to your purpose, welcoming both hardships and rewards as parts of the journey.
modern_relevance: You decide to pursue a challenging goal, knowing it will test you but also bring fulfillment if achieved.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
दृष्टिक्षेपं न कुर्वीरन भवन्तो हि कदाचन।
चक्रपद्मस्वरूपौ हि धर्ममोक्षौ निरन्तरम् ॥
translation: उनकी ओर कभी भी दृष्टि रखो और चक्र और पद्मरूपी धर्म और मोक्ष पर निरन्तर लक्ष्य रखकर
english_translation: Never divert your gaze; continuously fix it on the lotus-like wheel that is Dharma and Moksha.
essence: Unwavering focus on your true purpose leads to lasting freedom.
simple_meaning: Never let your attention wander; always keep your focus on your true purpose and freedom.
insight: It teaches you to train your attention steadily on your deeper goals, resisting momentary distractions.
modern_relevance: You start a project but your phone buzzes constantly. This reminds you to hold your focus on what truly matters.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अग्रेसरेयुः संलक्ष्य बाधां नेयुः कदाचन ।
सत्यमेतद्धि जानीत नात्र कश्चन संशयः ॥
translation: अग्रसर हो, कभी बाधा को प्राप्त नहीं होगे, इसको सत्य जानो, इसमें कुछ संशय नहीं है
english_translation: Advance boldly; you will never encounter obstacles. Know this as truth without any doubt.
essence: True obstacles do not exist; bold forward action meets no real resistance.
simple_meaning: You should move forward courageously because obstacles will never truly stop you. This is certain.
insight: It shifts your mindset to see obstacles as illusions, freeing you to act decisively and without fear.
modern_relevance: You face a tough challenge but realize hesitating only creates imaginary blocks. Taking bold steps clears your way.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सर्वशक्तिमन् ! धीश! भगवन् ! सर्वसिद्धिद!।
हे विभो ! सर्वसिद्धीनां नित्याधारस्वरूपवन् ! ॥
translation: हे सर्वशक्तिमान, विभो ! हे सर्वसिद्धियों के नित्य आधार स्वरुप ! हे सर्वसिद्धिदायिन्! हे भगवन् धीश !
english_translation: O all-powerful Lord! O source of all accomplishments, eternal and unchanging! O bestower of all successes! O revered Lord Dheesh!
essence: The divine Dheesh is the eternal source of all power and success.
simple_meaning: This is a respectful address praising the divine Dheesh as all-powerful, eternal, and the source of all success.
insight: It reminds you to recognize the deeper source behind your achievements and strength.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
परासिद्धे: कृपाप्राप्यतै  पूर्व तद्दर्शनं ध्रुवम् ।
आवश्यकीयमेवास्ति तदुपायानतो वद ॥
translation: परासिद्धि की कृपा प्राप्ति के लिए प्रथम उनके दर्शनलाभ की निश्चय ही आवश्यकता है अतः उसके उपाय कहें
english_translation: To attain supreme accomplishment, first the vision of the divine is absolutely necessary; therefore, explain the means to that.
essence: Clear vision of the divine is the necessary first step toward highest accomplishment.
simple_meaning: To achieve the highest success, you must first have a clear vision or experience of the divine. Without this, the path cannot begin.
insight: It shifts focus to clarifying your goal before taking action, making efforts more grounded and directed.
modern_relevance: Before you can reach your biggest goals, you need a clear picture of what success truly means to you.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
यर्न: स्याद्दर्शनं नूनं परासिद्धभिरापदम् ।
यथा वा नः कतार्थत्वमुपदिश्यामहे तथा ॥
translation: जिनके द्वारा परासिद्धि के दर्शन हमलोगों को अनायास ही हो अथवा जिस प्रकार से हमलोग कृतार्थ हो सो उपदेश कीजिये
english_translation: Teach us in a way that we effortlessly perceive supreme accomplishment or clearly understand what we have achieved.
essence: True understanding can arise effortlessly when shown clearly.
simple_meaning: Ask for guidance to recognize clearly and easily what has been truly accomplished or understood.
insight: It shifts the mind to seek guidance that reveals clear understanding naturally, not through forced effort.
modern_relevance: You wonder if you’re making real progress and long for a clear sign that your efforts are bearing fruit without overthinking.
speaker: Student

verse_text:
विद्यास्वरूपिणी नित्यां परासिद्धिं मदाश्रयाम् ।
तत्वनानसुनिष्णाताः महापौरष् शालिनः ॥
translation: नित्या और विद्यास्वरूपिणी मेरी परासिद्धि का दर्शन
english_translation: My supreme accomplishment is the eternal embodiment of wisdom.
essence: True greatness is living as the eternal embodiment of profound wisdom.
simple_meaning: The highest achievement is to be the eternal embodiment of wisdom, mastering many truths.
insight: Recognize that embodying wisdom means living with grounded clarity beyond temporary knowledge.
modern_relevance: When your knowledge and experience become your steady foundation, you move through life with confidence and grace.
speaker: Shambhu Dheesh

verse_text:
दिव्यदृष्टया निरीक्षन्ते ज्ञानिना ज्ञानभूमिषु।
तत्वज्ञाः शान्तचेतस्काः साधकास्तु यथायथम् ॥
translation: ज्ञान भूमियों में तत्त्वज्ञाननिष्ठ ज्ञानी महापुरुषों को दिव्यदृष्टि से हुआ करता है और इस संसार में शान्तचित्त तत्व ज्ञानी साधक
english_translation: Those deeply rooted in wisdom perceive the realms of knowledge with divine vision, while in the world, calm-minded seekers of truth appear accordingly.
essence: Clear inner vision and calmness together reveal the true nature of knowledge.
simple_meaning: Wise people perceive deeper truths clearly, and sincere seekers maintain calm minds while pursuing those truths.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate calmness while seeking clear understanding, balancing perception with peaceful steadiness.
modern_relevance: When you study complex ideas, your calm focus helps you see the core clearly, while others may only grasp surface details.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
क्रमादग्रेसरन्तीह सप्तसु ज्ञानभूमिषु ।
मम विद्यास्वरूपायाः परासिद्धेस्तथातथम् ॥
translation: क्रमशः जैसे जैसे सप्तज्ञान भूमियों में अग्रसर होते जाते हैं वैसे वैसे मेरी विद्या रूपिणी परासिद्धि के
english_translation: Step by step, as you advance through the seven fields of knowledge, so too does the supreme perfection of my form of wisdom.
essence: Wisdom’s highest form unfolds gradually through steady progress in learning.
simple_meaning: As you progress gradually through different areas of knowledge, your understanding and mastery of wisdom naturally deepen and become more complete.
insight: It teaches you to value steady progress, knowing that wisdom is not instant but builds perfectly over time.
modern_relevance: When you tackle new skills or ideas one step at a time, your confidence and clarity unfold naturally, even if you can't see it immediately.
speaker: Shri Dheesh

verse_text:
उत्तरोत्तरमत्यन्तं स्पष्ट रूपस्य दर्शनम् ।
प्राप्नुवन्तो निमज्जन्ति परमानन्दसागरे ॥
translation: उत्तरोत्तर स्वरूप का अत्यन्त स्पष्ट दर्शन प्राप्त करते हुए परमानन्द सागर में निमग्न होते जाते हैं
english_translation: Gradually, by ever clearer seeing of the true form, they immerse deeper into the ocean of supreme bliss.
essence: Clearer insight naturally draws you deeper into profound joy.
simple_meaning: As your understanding of the true nature becomes clearer and clearer, you immerse yourself more deeply in great joy.
insight: It encourages you to deepen your clarity, showing that clearer understanding naturally leads to profound joy and immersion in peace.
modern_relevance: You notice moments when understanding something fully brings a deep calm and joy that swells within you, like settling into a peaceful sea.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अहं ज्ञानस्वरूपोऽस्मि नूनं विज्ञवरा द्विजाः ।
तटस्थञ्च स्वरूपश्च द्विविध ज्ञानमीरितम् ॥
translation: हे विज्ञवर ब्राह्मणो ! मैं ज्ञानस्वरुप ही हूँ और ज्ञान दो प्रकार का कहा गया है। एक तटस्थज्ञान और दूसरा स्वरुप ज्ञान।
english_translation: O learned Brahmins! I am the embodiment of knowledge, and knowledge is said to be of two kinds: impartial knowledge and knowledge of the true nature.
essence: Knowledge includes both detached clarity and intimate self-understanding.
simple_meaning: Knowledge has two forms: one is unbiased observation, and the other is understanding your true nature.
insight: It teaches you to distinguish between simply noticing things and deeply knowing your own essence.
modern_relevance: When you learn something new, it helps to both see facts clearly and understand what they reveal about who you really are.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
ज्ञाता ज्ञानं तथा ज्ञेयमेषां भानै: समन्वितः।
यत्र त्रिपुटिसम्बन्धो विद्यते विप्रपुङ्गवाः ॥
translation: हे श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणों ! जहां ज्ञाता और ज्ञेयों के भान से युक्त त्रिपुटि का सम्बन्ध है वही
english_translation: O noble Brahmins! Wherever the knower and the known are united in the awareness of the threefold connection, there the wise excel.
essence: True wisdom is the clear unity of knower, known, and knowledge.
simple_meaning: Wisdom arises when the knower, what is known, and the knowledge itself are clearly connected and understood as one.
insight: It teaches you to recognize the inseparability of your awareness, what you observe, and the knowledge gained.
modern_relevance: When you focus and see clearly how you, your thoughts, and the world around connect, understanding flows effortlessly.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
ज्ञानं स्यात्तत्तटस्थाख्यं स्वरूपज्ञानकारणम् ।
ज्ञानेऽस्मिश्च तटस्थाख्ये स्वरूपस्य द्विजोत्तमाः ॥
translation: स्वरूप ज्ञान का कारण भूत तटस्थ ज्ञान है हे ब्राह्मणों ! इस तटस्थशान मे
english_translation: The cause of true self-knowledge is detached knowledge; O Brahmins, the enlightened are those who know this detached awareness of the true self.
essence: Clear self-knowledge arises from calm, detached awareness of your true nature.
simple_meaning: True understanding of your real self comes from steady, detached awareness that does not get caught in distractions.
insight: It guides you to cultivate calm, steady witnessing as the foundation for clear self-understanding.
modern_relevance: When your mind stops chasing every thought or emotion, you begin to see who you really are beyond the noise.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सच्चिदानन्दभावानामनुभूतिः पृथक् पृथक् ।
स्यादतस्तत्र सम्पूर्ण दृश्यजातं प्रतीयते ॥
translation: सत् चित् और आनन्दभावों का स्वरुप पृथक् पृथक् अनुभूत होता है इस कारण उस अवस्था में सम्पूर्ण दृश्यसमूह प्रतीत होता है
english_translation: The nature of existence, consciousness, and bliss are experienced distinctly; thus, in that state, the entire range of phenomena is perceived as complete.
essence: Distinct experiences of existence, consciousness, and bliss reveal the fullness of all phenomena.
simple_meaning: Existence, awareness, and joy can be felt as separate experiences, yet in that awareness, everything appears complete and unified.
insight: It shifts perception from fragmented feelings to a unified experience of reality, revealing hidden wholeness in diversity.
modern_relevance: When you meditate deeply, you might notice different feelings clearly, yet sense a connectedness that holds everything together.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
यत्र त्रिपुटिसम्बन्धलेशमात्रं न विद्यते ।
सच्चिदानन्दभावानामनुभूतिः पृथड्न च ॥
translation: जहां त्रिपुटि सम्बन्ध का लेशमात्र नहीं है, जहां सत् चित् और आनन्द भाव का स्वतंत्र अनुभव नहीं है
english_translation: Where there is not even a trace of the triple bond, there is a direct experience of truth, consciousness, and bliss.
essence: Freedom from all bonds reveals direct experience of truth, consciousness, and bliss.
simple_meaning: When no binding connections remain, you can directly experience truth, consciousness, and bliss.
insight: It teaches you to recognize the conditions that obscure your true self and to release them for direct experience.
modern_relevance: You know that deep moment when distractions and obligations fall away, and you feel fully present and joyful without effort.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
यत्राप्येतत्त्रयं तिष्ठेदावेऽद्धैते निरन्तरम् ।
उदेति निश्चितं तत्र स्वरूपज्ञानमुत्तमम ॥
translation: और जहां यह तीनों ही अद्वैत भाव में निरन्तर स्थित है वहीं उत्तम स्वरूपज्ञान का उदय होता है
english_translation: And where these three continuously exist in non-dual awareness, there surely arises the highest knowledge of true nature.
essence: Continuous non-dual awareness brings forth the highest knowledge of true self.
simple_meaning: When your mind continuously remains in a state of non-dual awareness, the highest understanding of your true self naturally arises.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate continuous non-dual awareness, which opens the door to profound self-knowledge.
modern_relevance: When your thoughts, feelings, and awareness stop dividing experience, a deep clarity about who you really are naturally surfaces.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
यत्तोऽस्तित्वं तटस्थस्याहंमहत्वयोगतः।
तटस्थानमन्त्यस्मानहुभावैः समन्वितम ॥
translation: तटस्थ ज्ञान बहुभावो से युक्त है क्योकि अहंतत्व और महत्तत्व दोनों संयोग से उसका अस्तित्व है
english_translation: I exist as the detached witness, joined with many states, because of the union of ego and grandeur.
essence: You exist as a detached witness combining ego and greatness without being defined by either.
simple_meaning: You exist as a detached observer connected to many states because you unite ego and grandeur without being limited by them.
insight: It teaches you to recognize your true self as the observer beyond ego and inflated self-image.
modern_relevance: When your mind swirls with pride and self-importance, you can still find a calm part of yourself observing it all without getting caught.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
पूर्ण ज्ञानं स्वम्पन्तु शाश्वतञ्चाविकारि च ।
तत्त्वानीते पदेऽस्त्यस्य परमे नित्यसंस्थितिः ॥
translation: परन्तु स्वरूपज्ञान नित्यं अविकारी और पूर्ण है और तत्त्वातीत परमपद में उसकी नित्य स्थिति विद्यमान रहती है
english_translation: Complete knowledge of one's own true nature is eternal and unchanging; its eternal presence remains in the supreme transcendent state.
essence: True self-knowledge is eternal, unchanging, and permanently present in the highest state.
simple_meaning: Your complete understanding of your true self is timeless, unchanging, and always present in the highest reality.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that true wisdom is stable and beyond the flux of daily experience.
modern_relevance: When everything around you feels uncertain or changing, this reminds you that your deepest understanding and being remain steady and unaltered.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
परिणामितटस्याखयाजूब्रानानान्नूनं शनैः शनैः ।
स्वरूपमुदयनज्ञज्ञानं यदास्ते विप्रपुङ्गवाः ॥
translation: हे ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठो ! जब परिणामशील तटस्थज्ञान से ही शनैः शनैः स्वरुप ज्ञान का उदय होने लगता है
english_translation: O best of Brahmins! When steady, result-free knowledge slowly arises, the true self's wisdom begins to dawn.
essence: Steady, detached knowing slowly awakens true self wisdom.
simple_meaning: When your knowledge becomes steady and free from attachment to results, deeper understanding of your true self gradually arises.
insight: It shifts attention from chasing outcomes to cultivating steady, patient awareness that reveals deeper truth.
modern_relevance: You’ve been frustrated chasing results; now your steady focus lets deeper understanding quietly grow.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सर्वेषु प्राणिवृन्देम्वविभक्तं निखिलेषु च।
देगेषु सर्वकालेषु पात्रेषु विविधेषु च ॥
translation: उस समय तत्त्वज्ञानी महात्माओं  में सर्वभूतों में अधिभक्त, सब देश काल और पात्रों में
english_translation: At that time, the great beings who know the truth were present, pervading all living beings, all places, all times, and all roles.
essence: True wisdom pervades all beings and situations without division.
simple_meaning: At that moment, the wise beings who understand reality were present everywhere—in every creature, place, time, and role.
insight: It reveals that true understanding transcends all boundaries and conditions, existing universally.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
विकाररहितं सर्वभूतेप्वेकत्वदर्शकम ।
उन्नतं सात्त्विकं ज्ञानं तत्त्वज्ञेषु महात्मसु ॥
translation: विकार रहित और सर्वभूतों में एक भाव को दिखानेवाला ही उन्नत सात्यिक ज्ञान
english_translation: The highest pure knowledge is free from change and sees the unity in all beings; it shines in great souls who know the truth.
essence: Highest wisdom is unchanging and sees unity in all beings.
simple_meaning: True wisdom is steady and unchanging. It perceives the oneness behind all beings and shines in those deeply enlightened.
insight: It shifts your view from focusing on differences and changes to recognizing an unchanging unity connecting all existence.
modern_relevance: When your mind feels scattered by constant change, this knowledge reminds you there is a steady oneness underneath all distractions.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
तदा प्रकाशते नूनं स्वत्त एव न संशयः ।
तत्प्राभावात्स्वरूपस्य ज्ञानस्यानुभवं किल ॥
translation: स्वतः ही प्रकाशित होता है, इसमें सन्देह नहीं है महर्षिगण ! उसके प्रभाव से ही मुक्तात्मा स्वरूप ज्ञान का अनुभव
english_translation: Then surely the true self shines by itself, without doubt; through its radiance, the experience of self-knowledge arises.
essence: The true self shines on its own, revealing self-knowledge without doubt.
simple_meaning: The true self naturally shines without any doubt, and through that shining, you experience true understanding.
insight: It teaches you to trust the natural clarity that arises from within, beyond mental confusion or external validation.
modern_relevance: When you pause and feel your core being, you realize your deepest truth is always shining, even when your mind doubts.
speaker: Maharshi

verse_text:
कुर्वन्त्येव निरायासं मुक्तात्मानो महर्षयः ।
नैवात्र विस्मयः कार्यः सत्यमेतद्धवामि वः ॥
translation: अनायास ही कर लेते हैं, मैं आपलोगों से सत्य कहता हूँ इसमें विस्मय न करो
english_translation: Great sages act effortlessly; truly, I tell you, do not be amazed by this.
essence: True freedom lets you act naturally without effort, without surprise.
simple_meaning: Some people act without feeling strain because they are free inside. This is normal, not surprising.
insight: It shifts your view from effort as struggle to effort as natural flow when not bound by inner conflict.
modern_relevance: You notice how some people seem calm and effective, handling challenges without stress or struggle.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
यथा शब्दं विनाऽऽकाशो विना स्पर्श समीरणः।
रूपेणैवं विना बहिर्जलं खलु रसंविना ॥
translation: जैसे शब्द् के बिना आकाश, स्पर्श के बिना वायु,रूप के बिना अग्नि, रस के बिना जल और
english_translation: Just as space exists without sound, air without touch, fire without form, and water without taste.
essence: Existence is independent of sensory qualities usually thought essential.
simple_meaning: Some elements exist even though they lack the qualities we commonly associate with them, like space without sound or water without taste.
insight: It shifts the mind from relying on sensory confirmation to accepting existence beyond perception.
modern_relevance: When parts of your life feel empty or lacking, remember that your essence and existence go beyond what you can immediately sense or measure.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
यथा गन्धं विना पृथ्वी नैव तिष्ठेत कदाचन।
तथा तटस्थज्ञानस्य नोदयोऽहङ्गति विना ॥
translation: गन्ध के बिना  पृथिवी का अस्तित्व कभी भी नहीं रह सकता उसी प्रकार अहंकार के विना तटस्थ ज्ञान का उदय नहीं हो सकता
english_translation: Just as the earth cannot exist without smell, neutral knowledge cannot arise without ego.
essence: Neutral knowledge arises only when the ego is present as its foundation.
simple_meaning: Clear, impartial knowledge needs the presence of the ego; without it, such knowledge cannot arise.
insight: It teaches you to see the ego as the foundation for witnessing knowledge, not as something only to reject.
modern_relevance: When you try to be neutral or objective, you realize your sense of self is needed to hold that perspective—it’s not about losing yourself but grounding your view.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
नैव सम्भाव्यते किन्तु स्वरूपे द्वैतमण्वपि।
अतो ज्ञानं स्वरूपाख्यं स्वस्वरूपं ममैव तत् ॥
translation: परन्तु स्वरूपज्ञान में अणुमात्र भी द्वैत की संभावना नहीं है इस कारण वह मेरा ही स्वरूप है।
english_translation: But in the knowledge of true nature, not even a tiny bit of duality is possible; therefore, that true nature is indeed mine.
essence: True knowledge reveals your real nature is entirely unified and belongs fully to you.
simple_meaning: True knowledge reveals that your real nature has no division or duality; it is entirely your own.
insight: It teaches you to see beyond appearances and rest in the indivisible essence that is your own nature.
modern_relevance: When you feel fragmented or pulled in many directions, this verse reminds you that your core self remains undivided and whole beneath it all.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अविद्याजनितं विमा विभक्तज्ञानमस्त्य हो ।
विद्यासम्भूतमेवास्त्यविभक्तज्ञानमुत्तमम् ॥
translation: हे ब्राह्मणो ! अहो विभक्त ज्ञान अविद्यासम्भूत है और उत्तम अविभक्त ज्ञान विद्यासम्भूत ही है
english_translation: O Brahmin, knowledge that is divided comes from confusion, but the highest undivided knowledge arises from clear understanding.
essence: Highest knowledge is whole and arises only from clear understanding, not confusion.
simple_meaning: Confused knowledge divides and separates. The highest knowledge is whole and arises from clear understanding.
insight: It shifts your mind from fragmented thinking to seeing the unity beneath appearances.
modern_relevance: You notice how confusion splits your thoughts, but a clear insight brings everything together at once.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अस्म्यहं ज्ञानरूपत्वाञ्चेज्ज्ञानद्वयमप्यहो ।
अविभक्तं तथाप्येतज्ज्ञानं दत्ते परम्पदम् ॥
translation: अहो ! मैं ज्ञान रूप हूँ इस कारण यद्यपि दोनों ज्ञान में हूँ तथापि यह अविभक्त ज्ञान परम पद की प्राप्ति कराता है
english_translation: Ah! Although I embody both forms of knowledge, this undivided knowledge grants the supreme state.
essence: Unified, undivided knowledge alone grants access to the highest state.
simple_meaning: You may have many types of knowledge, but only the undivided, unified knowledge leads to the highest state of understanding.
insight: It shifts your focus from juggling separate ideas to embracing a seamless, undivided understanding that opens the highest insight.
modern_relevance: When your mind races with conflicting ideas, remember that seeing a unified truth brings clarity and peace beyond confusion.
speaker: Shri Dheesh

verse_text:
मत्तो जीवान् दवयते विभक्तज्ञानमत्यहो।
विभक्तज्ञानतो नीत्वाऽविभक्तज्ञानमन्दिरम् ॥
translation: और अहो ! विभक्त ज्ञान जीवों को मुझसे अत्यन्त अलग स्थित रखता है । मुमुक्षओं को  विभक्त ज्ञान से अविभक्त ज्ञानमन्दिर में पहुंचाकर
english_translation: Separate knowledge keeps beings distinct from me; it leads seekers from divided knowledge to the temple of undivided knowledge.
essence: Divided knowledge separates but also leads seekers toward unified understanding.
simple_meaning: Knowing things as separate keeps beings apart from the whole, but this divided knowledge guides seekers to unity.
insight: It shifts your mind from seeing separateness to recognizing unity beneath division.
modern_relevance: You feel stuck in seeing life as fragmented, but this fragmented view can be the path to deeper wholeness.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
मुमुक्षुन स्वस्वरूपं मे नूनं नेतुं निरापदम् ।
श्रुतिभिर्वर्णिताः पूर्व सप्सैव ज्ञानभूमयः ॥
translation: मेरे स्वस्वरूप में अनायास ही पहुंचाने के लिये वेदों ने पहले ही सात ज्ञानभूमियों का वर्णन किया है
english_translation: To safely lead the seeker to their true nature, the scriptures have already described seven stages of knowledge.
essence: A clear, safe path to your true self has already been laid out in seven stages.
simple_meaning: The scriptures have outlined seven stages of knowledge that safely guide a seeker to their true self.
insight: Recognize that spiritual progress can be structured; following known stages eases uncertainty and fear.
modern_relevance: When you feel lost in self-discovery, knowing a clear step-by-step path can bring calm and direction.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
विश्वबन्धनकत्रीपु समस्वज्ञानभूमिषु ।
अज्ञानान्धाः सदा जीरा आसज्जन्ते विमोहिताः ॥
translation: विश्व को बन्धन प्राप्त कराने वाली सात अज्ञान भूमिकाओं में अन्नानान्ध जीव विमोहित होकर सदा फंसे रहते हैं
english_translation: Beings blinded by ignorance remain trapped in the seven states that bind the world in delusion.
essence: Multiple layers of ignorance keep beings trapped in worldly delusion without awareness.
simple_meaning: Ignorance blinds beings, causing them to remain stuck in seven states that keep them bound to the world.
insight: It teaches you to recognize multiple levels of confusion that keep you locked in reactive patterns.
modern_relevance: You feel stuck in repeated patterns of confusion and habit, unaware of the layers holding you back.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
श्रौतानां कर्मकाण्डानां साहाय्यात्साधकाः खलु ।
पूर्व शरीरसंशुद्धिं मनाशुद्धिं ततः परम् ॥
translation: वेदविहित कर्मकाण्ड की सहायता से साधक प्रथम शरीर की शुद्धि और तदनन्तर मन की शुद्धि सम्पादन
english_translation: By practicing the Vedic rites prescribed for actions, the seeker first purifies the body and then purifies the mind.
essence: Purifying the body through disciplined action sets the stage for purifying the mind.
simple_meaning: Following prescribed rituals helps you cleanse your body first and then purify your mind.
insight: It teaches you to approach purification gradually, starting with the body to support mental clarity.
modern_relevance: You start by creating healthy habits that refresh your body, which naturally calms and clarifies your restless mind.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
कृत्वा पश्चान्ममोपास्त्या चित्तहत्ती प्रशम्य च ।
अधिकारं लभन्तेऽन्ते तत्त्वज्ञानस्य दुर्लभम् ॥
translation: करके तत्पश्चात् मेरी उपासना के द्वारा चित्त की वृत्तियो को शान्त करके अन्त में तत्त्वज्ञान का दुलभ अधिकार प्राप्त करते हैं
english_translation: By acting and then calming the restless mind through devoted practice, one finally attains the rare right to true wisdom.
essence: True wisdom emerges only when restless thoughts are stilled after action.
simple_meaning: When you act and then quiet your restless mind with devoted effort, you eventually gain access to rare true understanding.
insight: It teaches you to follow action with inner calm, as stillness makes deep understanding possible.
modern_relevance: After finishing your work, you sit quietly and still your busy thoughts. That calm moment brings clarity you can’t find otherwise.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
नतश्च क्रमशो विप्राः ! सोपानारोहणं यथा ।
ज्ञानभूमीश्च सप्तवमतिक्रम्य शनैः शनैः ॥
translation: एवं तदन्तर हे ब्राह्मणों ! क्रमशः सातो ज्ञानभूमियों को सोपानारोहण के समान शनैः शनैः अतिक्रमण करके
english_translation: Thus, O Brahmins, step by step, slowly and steadily, one crosses the seven stages of the field of knowledge like ascending steps.
essence: Wisdom unfolds gradually through steady, stepwise progress across stages of understanding.
simple_meaning: You gain deeper understanding gradually, moving step by step through increasing levels of knowledge.
insight: It teaches you to embrace gradual progress, trusting that slow, steady effort unfolds true wisdom.
modern_relevance: When learning something complex, you feel overwhelmed, but steady, patient effort reveals clarity over time.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
ज्ञानपूर्णान्तरात्मानो मामन्ते प्राप्नुवन्ति ते ।
ज्ञानक्रमविकाशैहि पूर्णाः स्वाभाविकैरतः ॥
translation: अन्त में वह पूर्ण ज्ञानी होकर मुझको प्राप्त कर लेते हैं इस कारण स्वाभाव सिद्ध ज्ञान के क्रमविकास से पूर्ण
english_translation: In the end, those who are complete in knowledge reach me through natural, progressive unfolding of true understanding.
essence: Complete wisdom unfolds naturally and leads you to the divine without force.
simple_meaning: Those who develop complete knowledge gradually and naturally come to realize the divine within.
insight: It teaches you to trust gradual, natural growth in wisdom rather than forcing sudden breakthroughs.
modern_relevance: You felt your understanding deepen step by step, not overnight. Trusting that natural growth brings clarity can ease frustration.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सप्तैवा ज्ञानभूम्यो में परासिद्धेः कृपावशात् ।
स्वरूपज्ञानसँल्लव्धर्वहन्ते हेतुतामलम् ॥
translation: यह सातो ज्ञानभूमियां मेरी परासिद्धि की कृपा से मेरे स्वरुप ज्ञान प्राप्ति की अत्यन्त कारणरूपा हैं
english_translation: These seven grounds of knowledge, by the grace of my supreme accomplishment, are the essential causes for attaining self-knowledge.
essence: Seven foundational insights together cause the realization of your true self.
simple_meaning: There are seven main areas of knowledge that, through special grace, lead directly to understanding your true self.
insight: Recognize foundational knowledge areas as essential stepping stones toward self-awareness.
modern_relevance: When you discover the core sources of your understanding, your sense of identity becomes clear and steady.
speaker: श्री धीश

verse_text:
सप्तानां ज्ञानभूमीनां प्रथमा ज्ञानदा भवेत् ।
सन्न्यासदा द्वितीया स्वात्तृतीया योगदा भवेत् ॥
translation: सातों ज्ञान भूमियों में से प्रथमा ज्ञानदा, द्वितीया सन्यासदा. तृतीया योगदा,
english_translation: Among the seven fields of knowledge, the first grants wisdom, the second grants renunciation, and the third grants union.
essence: Different kinds of knowledge grant wisdom, renunciation, and union in sequence.
simple_meaning: There are seven areas of knowledge; the first brings wisdom, the second leads to renunciation, and the third offers union through yoga.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that spiritual growth happens through distinct stages, each with its own focus and benefit.
modern_relevance: You face many learning paths, each offering different rewards—understanding, letting go, or deep connection. Knowing this helps you choose what you need now.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
लीलोन्मुक्तिश्चतुर्थी स्यात्पञ्चमी सत्पदा स्मृता ।
षष्ठयानन्दपदा जेया सप्तमी च परात्परा ॥
translation: चतुर्थी लीलोन्मुक्ति पञ्चमी सत्यदा, षष्ठी आनन्दपदा और सप्तमी परात्परा है।
english_translation: The fourth is playful freedom, the fifth is steady truthfulness, the sixth is the state of bliss, and the seventh is the highest transcendence.
essence: Spiritual progress unfolds through stages from playful freedom to highest transcendence.
simple_meaning: There are four stages described: the fourth is freedom expressed playfully, the fifth is steady truth, the sixth is blissful state, and the seventh is the highest transcendent state.
insight: Recognize spiritual growth as a gradual unfolding through distinct stages, each deeper and more refined than the last.
modern_relevance: Sometimes personal growth feels like moving through phases—from joyful freedom to steady honesty, then deep happiness, and finally reaching a sense of ultimate peace beyond ordinary life.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
यावज्जीवैरनिक्रान्ता न सप्ताऽज्ञानभूमयः ।
तावन्न प्रथमा भूमिर्ज्ञानस्य जानदाऽऽप्यते ॥
translation: जब तक जीवों ने सप्त अज्ञानभूमियों का अतिक्रमण नहीं किया है तब तक प्रथम ज्ञानभूमि ज्ञानदा की प्राप्ति नहीं होती है
english_translation: Until living beings have crossed the seven realms of ignorance, they do not attain the first realm of knowledge, the giver of wisdom.
essence: True wisdom comes only after crossing multiple layers of deep confusion.
simple_meaning: You cannot reach true understanding until you overcome many layers of deep confusion.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that gaining wisdom is a gradual process, requiring patience to move through multiple phases of unknowing.
modern_relevance: You feel stuck in repeating patterns of misunderstanding, unaware that true clarity lies beyond several layers of your confusion.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
उद्भिज्जानां चिदाकाशे प्रथमाऽज्ञानभूमिका ।
स्वेदजानां चिदाकाशे सा द्वितीय प्रकीर्तिता ! ॥
translation: उद्भिजों के चिदाकाश में प्रथम अज्ञानभूमि है. स्वेदजों के चिदाकाश में द्वितीय अज्ञानभूमि कही गई है
english_translation: In the conscious space of plants, the first stage of ignorance arises; in the conscious space of sweat-born beings, the second stage of ignorance is declared.
essence: Consciousness contains evolving layers of ignorance even in living beings.
simple_meaning: Different beings experience stages of ignorance within their conscious spaces, starting from plants to more complex life.
insight: Recognize that awareness does not guarantee full clarity; deeper layers of misunderstanding may still influence your experience.
modern_relevance: You might feel aware yet realize some parts of your mind still carry hidden confusions evolving quietly beneath your surface.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
तृतीयाऽण्डजजतिश्वाज्ञानभूमिश्चिदाश्रिता ।
जगजपशनाभ चिदाकाशे चतुर्य्यसौ॥
translation: अण्डजों के चिदाकाश में तृतीय अज्ञानभूमि है और जरायुज पशुओ के चिदाकाश में चतुर्थ अज्ञानभूमि है
english_translation: The third realm of ignorance is in the conscious space of beings born from eggs, and the fourth realm of ignorance is in the conscious space of womb-born animals.
essence: Different beings carry distinct layers of deep confusion within their conscious space.
simple_meaning: The verse identifies specific levels of ignorance located within the conscious space of different classes of beings based on their birth.
insight: It invites reflection on how our nature and origin influence the kinds of confusion or limitations we carry within our awareness.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
पञ्चकोषपूर्णवाधिकारिष्वेव वै नृपु।
सन्ति शेषा अधिकृतास्तिनस्त्वज्ञानभृमयः ॥
translation: परन्तु पांच कोषों के पूर्णता की अधिकारी मनुष्य योनि में ही शेष तीनों अज्ञानभूमियो का अधिकार है।
english_translation: Only in the human form, which is complete with the five sheaths, do the remaining three realms of deep confusion exist.
essence: Only humans embody all layers where confusion and fullness coexist.
simple_meaning: Only the human body has all five layers of existence, where the other three confusing realms remain.
insight: Recognize your human form as the full field where clarity and confusion coexist, enabling transformation.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by conflicting thoughts and emotions, remember this is part of your unique human capacity to understand and grow.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
निस्रस्ता एव कथ्यन्त उत्तमाधममध्यमाः ।
विशदं ताः प्रचक्षेऽहं श्रृयन्तां विप्रपुङ्गवः ॥
translation: वह ही तीनों उत्तम मध्यन और अधम अज्ञान भूमियां कहाती हैं है श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणो! मैं उनको स्पष्टरूप से कहता है सुनो
english_translation: I will clearly explain the three levels of ignorance: the highest, the middle, and the lowest, O excellent Brahmins, so listen carefully.
essence: Confusion appears in three clear levels, each needing distinct understanding.
simple_meaning: There are three kinds of ignorance or confusion: highest, middle, and lowest. I will explain them clearly for you.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that confusion isn’t uniform but has layers you can identify and work through.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by choices or doubts, knowing there are levels of confusion can help you pinpoint what’s really holding you back.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
एता अज्ञानभूर्मिहि निसरेव समूलतः ।
मूर्तिमन्नः स्वयं वेदा निराकर्तु समुद्ययताः ॥
translation: इन्हीं तीनों अज्ञान भूमियों के समूल निराकरण के लिये वेद स्वयं मूर्तिधारण करके प्रवृत्त हैं
english_translation: The Vedas themselves have taken form here to completely remove these three roots of ignorance.
