essence: Living wisdom appears to completely uproot the deepest ignorance binding you.
simple_meaning: The Vedas have taken a tangible form to completely remove the three fundamental types of ignorance here.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing wisdom as abstract to recognizing it as an active force clearing confusion.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by confusion, imagine a clear source of knowledge arising to dissolve your deepest doubts.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अधमाऽज्ञानभूमौ हि यावन्मर्त्यः प्रसज्जते ।
कृतेऽपराधे दग्दः स्यतिर्य्यग्योनों तदुद्भवः ॥
translation: अधम अज्ञान भृमि में जब तक मनुष्य फंसा रहता है उसको अपराध करने पर तिर्यक योनि की प्राप्ति दण्ड रूप से हुआ करती है
english_translation: As long as a person remains trapped in deep ignorance, committing offenses leads to birth in a lower realm as a consequence.
essence: Ignorance traps you in harmful actions whose consequences follow beyond this life.
simple_meaning: When someone stays stuck in deep confusion and makes mistakes, those actions bring negative consequences beyond this life.
insight: It teaches you to see actions not as isolated but as seeds that grow across lifetimes, urging responsibility now.
modern_relevance: You make a choice that feels small now but shapes your future in ways you can’t yet see.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
मध्यज्ञानभूमेश्च मानवैरधिकारिभिः ।
पितृलोकास्तथा विप्रा: नारकाश्च पुनः पुनः ॥
translation: और हे ब्राह्मणों ! मध्यम अज्ञान भूमि के अधिकारी मनुष्यो को पितृलोक, नरकलोक और
english_translation: And O Brahmins! Humans are the masters of the realm of moderate ignorance, while ancestors and Brahmins repeatedly enter the lower realm.
essence: Different beings occupy distinct realms shaped by their level of awareness or ignorance.
simple_meaning: Humans rule the realm of moderate ignorance; ancestors and Brahmins repeatedly experience the lower realm.
insight: It shifts attention to understanding how different states of awareness or ignorance affect where beings find themselves repeatedly.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
प्राप्यन्ते मृत्युलोकश्च मुखदुःखादिपूरितः ।
ददात्यूद्धर्वभञ्च स्वलांकमुत्तमाऽज्ञानभूमिका ॥
translation: सुखदुःखपूर्ण मृत्युलोक की प्राप्ति बार बार ती है एवं सर्वोन्नत अज्ञानभूमि ऊर्द्ध स्वर्गलोक प्रदानकारी है
english_translation: Beings repeatedly enter the realm of death filled with pain and suffering; the highest ignorance leads to the false pride that claims it grants the highest heavenly realm.
essence: Deep ignorance makes you repeat painful cycles, mistaking them for progress.
simple_meaning: People repeatedly come back to the world of death filled with pain because of deep ignorance that falsely feels like a great achievement.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that clinging to false beliefs about achievement only prolongs suffering.
modern_relevance: You find yourself stuck in harmful patterns, believing each new attempt will finally bring lasting peace or success.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
अधमाज्ञानभमिञ्च प्राप्ता मर्त्या भवन्त्यहो।
देहात्मवादिनाऽनार्या नास्तिकाः शौचवर्जिताः ॥
translation: अधम अज्ञान भूमि प्राप्त मनुष्य अहो ! नास्तिक देहात्मवाही अशुचि और अनार्य होते हैं
english_translation: Those who hold that the body is the self are low in knowledge, impure, unworthy, and lack faith.
essence: Identifying only with the body causes deep ignorance and loss of inner purity.
simple_meaning: Thinking that you are only your body shows deep confusion and leads to impurity and loss of true faith.
insight: It teaches you to look beyond the body and seek the true self within, restoring faith and purity.
modern_relevance: When you reduce yourself to your appearance or health alone, you miss the deeper, enduring part of who you truly are.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
मध्यमाऽज्ञानभूमेस्तु मानवा अधिकारिणः ।
आस्तिकत्वेन भो विप्राः ! सद्विचारपरायणाः ॥
translation: परन्तु हे ब्राह्मणो! मध्यम अज्ञानभूमि के अधिकारी मनुष्य आस्तिक होने से सद्विचार परायण होते हुए
english_translation: But O Brahmin, humans in the middle realm of ignorance, though believers, are devoted to right thinking.
essence: Devotion to right thinking can exist even within partial ignorance.
simple_meaning: Humans caught in confusion can still hold belief and commit to good, wise thinking.
insight: It teaches you to commit your mind to wise reflection even when you don’t have all the answers.
modern_relevance: You might feel unsure about many things, yet still choose to focus your mind on what is good and wise.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
देहात्मनोर्ही पार्थक्यं विश्वसन्तोऽपि सर्वथा ।
इन्द्रियाणां मुखे मना नितरामैहलौकिके ॥
translation: और देह से आत्मा को पृथकता पर सर्वथा विश्वास करते हुए भी एहलौकिक इन्द्रिय सुख में  अत्यन्त मग्न होकर
english_translation: Even while fully believing the true self is separate from the body, the mind remains deeply absorbed in worldly sensory pleasures.
essence: Knowing your true self doesn’t stop your mind from chasing fleeting pleasures.
simple_meaning: You fully accept that your true self is different from your body, yet your mind stays deeply involved in temporary sensory enjoyments.
insight: It teaches you to notice the gap between your clear understanding and your habitual mental patterns, encouraging deeper self-awareness.
modern_relevance: You understand who you really are, yet your attention constantly drifts to distractions like social media, entertainment, or indulgence.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
विस्मरन्ति महामूढा: सुखं ते पारलौकिकम।
उत्तमाऽज्ञानभूमेर्वे पुण्यवन्नोऽधिकारिणः ॥
translation: वे महामूढ़  पारलौकिक सुख को भूले रहते हैं। हे ब्राह्मणों! उत्तम अज्ञानभूमि के ही पुण्यवान् अधिकारी
english_translation: The greatly deluded forget the joy of the higher realm. O Brahmins, only those endowed with noble ignorance possess merit.
essence: Noble confusion can preserve merit even when higher joy is forgotten.
simple_meaning: People lost in deep confusion forget the joy beyond this world. Only those with noble ignorance have true merit.
insight: Recognize that being confused or uncertain can still support your growth toward higher understanding.
modern_relevance: You might chase temporary pleasures and overlook deeper fulfillment, yet even uncertainty in your journey holds hidden value.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
आत्माऽतिरिक्तं मे शक्तेर्मन्वाऽस्तिन्वं द्विजर्षभाः।
स्वर्गीयस्य सुखस्यैव जायन्ते तेऽधिकारिणः ॥
translation: आत्मा से अतिरिक्त मेरी शक्ति का अस्तित्व मानकर वह स्वर्गीय सुख के ही अधिकारी हुआ करते हैं।
english_translation: Those who consider a power beyond the true self become entitled only to fleeting pleasures.
essence: Believing in power beyond your true self binds you to only temporary pleasures.
simple_meaning: If you believe in a power outside your true self, you become attached only to short-lived pleasures.
insight: It shifts your view from external power to inner awareness, reducing attachment to temporary rewards.
modern_relevance: You chase success, thinking it will fulfill you, only to find the happiness fades quickly.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अधमाऽज्ञानभूमि तमोमुरख्या विजृम्भते।
तमोरज:प्रधाना च मध्यमाऽसौ प्रकीतिता ॥
translation: अधम अज्ञानभूमि तमप्रधान, मध्यम अज्ञानभूमि तमरज प्रधान और
english_translation: The lowest state is the realm of ignorance, darkness, and delusion; the middle state is dominated by darkness born of ignorance.
essence: Ignorance exists in layers—from deep delusion to lesser darkness.
simple_meaning: There are levels of ignorance: the lowest is complete darkness and delusion, and the middle is a lesser form of this darkness.
insight: It helps you see ignorance as a spectrum, so you can notice when you’re slipping into deeper confusion or just facing mild doubt.
modern_relevance: Sometimes your mind feels completely lost in confusion; other times, it’s just clouded but not fully dark.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
उत्तमाऽज्ञानभूमिश्च रजःसत्त्वप्रधानिका ।
शुद्धसत्त्वविकाशस्य स्थले नूनं यथाक्रमम ॥
translation: उत्तम अज्ञानभूमि रजसत्त्व प्रधान कही गई है। इसके अनन्तर हे ब्राह्मणो ! शुद्ध सत्त्व के क्रमविकास स्थलरूपी
english_translation: The highest ground of ignorance is dominated by passion and inertia. Then surely comes the sequential unfolding of pure goodness.
essence: Confusion dominated by restlessness and inertia gradually transforms into pure clarity.
simple_meaning: Even the highest state of confusion is filled with passion and inertia, but from there pure goodness gradually unfolds in sequence.
insight: It shifts your view from despair in confusion to trust in gradual unfolding toward clarity.
modern_relevance: When you feel stuck in restless confusion or fatigue, remember that these states naturally give way to clarity and calm over time.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
पुण्यभाजां मनुष्याणां चित्ताकाशे ततो द्विजाः।
सप्तानां ज्ञानभूमीनामधिकाराः क्रमेण हि ॥
translation: पुण्यवान् मनुष्यों के चित्ताकाश में देवदुर्लभ सप्तज्ञान भूमियों के अधिकार क्रमशः
english_translation: In the mind-space of virtuous humans, the twice-born gradually gain mastery over the seven rare fields of knowledge.
essence: Virtue in the mind gradually opens mastery over rare knowledge fields.
simple_meaning: Virtuous people develop mastery over special kinds of knowledge gradually through their inner mind-space.
insight: It teaches you to nurture virtue as a foundation for gradual, ordered growth in wisdom.
modern_relevance: When you dedicate yourself to learning with goodness, your mind gradually unlocks rare, valuable insights step by step.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
समुद्यन्ति ध्रुवं देवदुर्लभानां स्वभावत: ।
ज्ञानभूम्यश्च सप्तैता साधकान्तहृदि क्रमात॥
translation: स्वभाव से ही उदय होते है और क्रमशः ये सातो ज्ञानभूमियाँ साधक के अन्तःकरण में
english_translation: The seven realms of knowledge naturally arise and progressively emerge within the seeker's heart.
essence: Deep knowledge unfolds naturally in ordered stages inside a sincere seeker’s heart.
simple_meaning: Seven levels of deep understanding arise naturally and gradually within a sincere seeker’s heart.
insight: It teaches you to trust the natural, gradual unfolding of deeper understanding within yourself.
modern_relevance: When learning something difficult, insight often comes in phases, not all at once. Your understanding grows steadily if you stay open.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
शुद्धं सत्त्वगुणं सम्यम्वर्द्धयन्त्यो निरन्तरम् ।
निःश्रेयसपदं नित्यं गुणातीतं नयन्त्यलम् ॥
translation: शुद्ध सत्त्व की भलीभांति निरन्तर वृद्धि करती हुई नित्य और गुणातीत कैवल्यपद में निश्चय पहुंचा देती हैं
english_translation: Pure goodness steadily grows and surely leads to the eternal state beyond qualities and to supreme well-being.
essence: Steady growth of pure goodness leads beyond all changing qualities to lasting freedom.
simple_meaning: Pure goodness steadily increases within you and eventually leads to a permanent state beyond all changing qualities.
insight: It teaches you to nurture steady purity of mind, which gradually frees you from all fluctuations of character.
modern_relevance: You notice small acts of kindness growing into lasting habits that transform your character beyond surface changes.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
यत्किञ्चिदासीजज्ञातव्यं ज्ञातं सर्व मयति धीः ।
आद्याया भूमिकायाश्चानुभवः परिकीर्तितः ॥
translation: मुझे जो कुछ जानने योग्य था सो सब कुछ जान लिया है ऐसी बुद्धि होना प्रथम ज्ञान भूमि का अनुभव कहा गया है
english_translation: The intellect that has fully known everything that is knowable is said to have experienced the first ground of knowledge.
essence: Complete understanding of what must be known marks the first true knowledge.
simple_meaning: The mind that understands everything that can be known has reached the first level of true knowledge.
insight: It teaches you to recognize when your understanding is complete enough to move forward confidently.
modern_relevance: You’ve finished learning one chapter fully — that solid understanding feels like stepping onto firm ground.
speaker: Shambhu

verse_text:
त्याज्यं त्यक्तं मयेत्येवं द्वितीयोऽनुभवो मतः।
प्राप्या शक्तिर्मया लब्धानुभवो हि तृतीयकः ॥
translation: मुझे त्यागना था सो त्याग दिया है यह दूसरी ज्ञान भूमि का अनुभव माना गया है। मुझे जो शक्ति प्राप्त करनी थी सो प्राप्त करली है यह तीसरी ज्ञान भूमि का अनुभव है।
english_translation: What I had to renounce, I have renounced; this is the second stage of knowledge. What power I had to gain, I have gained; this is the third stage of knowledge.
essence: True knowledge unfolds as letting go and gaining power, two linked stages.
simple_meaning: You have completed the second stage by releasing what needed to go, and the third stage by gaining the power meant for you.
insight: It teaches you to recognize progress as both release and gain, balancing surrender with empowerment.
modern_relevance: You’ve stopped clinging to old habits and found new strength inside yourself — that’s real progress.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
मायाविलसितं चैतदृश्यते सर्वमेव हि ।
न तत्र मेऽभिलापोऽस्ति चतुर्थोऽनुभवो मतः ॥
translation: यह माया की लीला मुझे सब ही दिखाई देती है मैं उसमें मोहित नहीं होता यह चतुर्थ ज्ञानभूमि का अनुभव है
english_translation: All of this appears as the play of illusion, but I am not deluded by it; this is the experience of the fourth stage of knowledge.
essence: You can fully see illusion without being fooled or attached to it.
simple_meaning: Everything you see is a play of illusion, but you are not confused or trapped by it. This clarity is a deep stage of wisdom.
insight: It shifts your mind from being swept away by appearances to calmly witnessing without confusion.
modern_relevance: You notice social media's endless drama and distractions but remain calm and clear inside, not pulled into the noise.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
जगन्नात्यनुभवः पञ्चमः परिकीर्तितः ।
ब्रह्मैवेदं जगत, षष्ठोऽनुभवः किल कथ्यते ॥
translation: जगत् ही ब्रह्म है यह पञ्चम ज्ञानभूमि का अनुभव कहा गया है। ब्रह्म ही यह जगत् है निश्चय ही यह षष्ठ ज्ञानभूमि का अनुभव कहा गया है
english_translation: The world is Brahman; this is called the fifth experience of knowledge. Certainly, Brahman alone is this world, which is called the sixth experience of knowledge.
essence: The world and the supreme reality are not separate but one and the same.
simple_meaning: The world you experience is not different from the supreme reality called Brahman; they are one and the same.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing the world as separate to seeing it as a direct expression of the supreme reality.
modern_relevance: When you feel isolated or disconnected, realizing your surroundings are part of the supreme reality can bring a profound sense of belonging and unity.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अद्वितीयं निर्विकारं सचिदानन्दरूपकम् ।
ब्रह्माऽहमस्मीति मतिः सप्तमोऽनुभवो मतः ॥
translation: और मैं अद्वितीय निर्विकार सच्चिदानन्दमय ब्रह्म हूँ ऐसी बुद्धि सप्तम ज्ञानभूमि का अनुभव माना गया है
english_translation: I am the unique, unchanging, pure consciousness filled with existence, awareness, and bliss; this realization is called the experience of the seventh stage of knowledge.
essence: The true self is uniquely unchanging existence, awareness, and bliss.
simple_meaning: You are not separate or changing; you are the unique, unchanging reality of pure being, awareness, and joy.
insight: It shifts your understanding from identifying with temporary states to resting in the eternal, blissful self.
modern_relevance: In moments of deep doubt or identity crisis, this reminds you that beneath all change, your core essence remains unshaken and joyful.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
इमां भूमि प्रपद्यैव ब्रह्मसारूप्यमाप्यते ।
नात्र कश्चन सन्देहो विद्यते मुनिसत्तमाः ! ॥
translation: इस भूमि को प्राप्त करके ही साधक ब्रह्म स्वरुप हो जाता है हे मुनिश्रेष्ठो ! इसमें कुछ सन्देह नहीं है।
english_translation: By attaining this land, the seeker attains the essence of Brahman; there is no doubt about this, O best of sages!
essence: Arriving here transforms the seeker instantly into the essence of the supreme reality without doubt.
simple_meaning: When someone reaches this special land, they become one with the essence of the supreme reality without any doubt.
insight: It shifts your view from seeking to embodying, realizing the destination itself transforms your identity.
modern_relevance: You finally arrive at a place or state where your purpose and true nature feel completely clear and certain.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
श्रवणं मननश्चैव निदिध्यासनमेव च ।
पुरुषार्थस्त्रिधा प्रोक्ता एत एव महार्षयः ! ॥
translation: हे महर्षियो! श्रवण, मनन, निदिध्यासनरूप यह ही त्रिविध पुरुषार्थ कहे गये हैं।
english_translation: O great sages! Hearing, reflection, and deep meditation are said to be the threefold means of purposeful effort.
essence: True effort combines listening, reflecting, and deep meditation as one disciplined process.
simple_meaning: Purposeful effort unfolds in three steps: listening carefully, thinking deeply, and meditating fully.
insight: It teaches you to engage fully by combining active learning with deep internal absorption.
modern_relevance: You read an idea, mull it over throughout the day, then quietly sit with it until it settles into you.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
मुमुक्षूणां त्रिभिः सम्यङ्ममसामीप्यलब्धये ।
पुरुषार्थैरुपेतानामतैः साधनशैलयः ॥
translation: मुमुक्षुओं को मेरे पास अच्छी तरह पहुंचने के लिये इन्हीं त्रिविध पुरुषार्थो से युक्त
english_translation: For those seeking liberation, the threefold goals of human effort are the sure means to reach me.
essence: Three purposeful efforts are the reliable means to reach your highest goal.
simple_meaning: You can approach your highest purpose by applying three kinds of human effort as reliable tools.
insight: It teaches you to organize your striving into three purposeful efforts, making progress more tangible and sure.
modern_relevance: When you feel lost about how to grow, knowing three clear efforts can guide your focus and steady your steps.
speaker: Shri Dheesh

verse_text:
सप्तानां ज्ञानभूमीनां सप्त सोपानसनिभाः ।
प्रासादपृष्ठमारोढूँ यथा सोपानपङ्क्तयः ॥
translation: सातो ज्ञानभूमियो की साधन शैलियां सात सोपानरूप हैं। जिस प्रकार किसी राजभवन की छत पर चढ़ने के लिये सीढियां होती है
english_translation: There are seven fields of knowledge and seven corresponding steps; just as a royal palace has stairways leading to its rooftop.
essence: True knowledge is gained gradually, step by step, like climbing palace stairs.
simple_meaning: There are seven main areas of knowledge, each reached by its own step, like stairs leading to a palace rooftop.
insight: It teaches you to value each stage of learning as a necessary step toward fuller understanding.
modern_relevance: When learning a new skill, you don't master everything at once—you advance step by step, building confidence and clarity.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
तथा तटस्थज्ञानस्य सप्तौता ज्ञानभूमयः ।
सप्तसोपानतुल्याः स्युः स्वरूपज्ञानलब्धये ॥
translation: उसी प्रकार स्वरुप ज्ञान में पहुंचने के लिये तटस्थज्ञान की यह  सात ज्ञानभूमियां सात सीढ़ियों के समान है
english_translation: Similarly, for reaching true nature knowledge, the seven stages of detached knowledge are like seven steps.
essence: Reaching true self-knowledge unfolds through seven progressive stages of detachment.
simple_meaning: Reaching true self-knowledge involves progressing through seven stages of detachment, like climbing steps.
insight: It teaches you to approach self-knowledge as a gradual process of releasing attachments in stages.
modern_relevance: You face overwhelming information and feelings daily; growing clarity requires letting go gradually in manageable steps.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
आद्यायां ज्ञानदानाम्न्यां ज्ञानभूम्यां मुमुक्षवः ।
अन्तर्दृष्टिं लभेरंस्ते तत्वजिज्ञासवो द्विजाः॥
translation: हे तत्वजिज्ञासु ब्राह्मणो ! ज्ञानदानाम्नी प्रथम ज्ञानभूमि में वे मुमुक्ष अंतर्दृष्टि प्राप्त करने लगते हैं।
english_translation: O seekers of truth among the Brahmins! In the first field of knowledge called the gift of wisdom, those longing for freedom begin to gain inner insight.
essence: True seekers gain inner clarity by entering the first stage of wisdom.
simple_meaning: When you earnestly seek truth, you start gaining deep inner understanding by entering the path of wisdom.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that sincere inquiry leads to a transformative inner vision beyond surface knowledge.
modern_relevance: When you dive into learning something truly meaningful, your perspective shifts from surface facts to deeper understanding inside yourself.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
तदा जिज्ञासवो नूनं परमाणुस्वरूपतः।
स्थूलान्येव ममाङ्गानि ज्ञात्वा नित्यानि सर्वथा ॥
translation: उस समय जिज्ञासु पण्डितगण मेरे स्थूल अवयवों को ही परमाणु रूप से सर्वथा नित्य जानकर और उन्हीं मेरे स्थूल अवयव रूप विभागों को
english_translation: At that time, the seekers fully understood my gross limbs as eternal in their atomic nature, knowing them thoroughly as always permanent.
essence: Apparent physical forms are truly eternal when seen as atomic realities.
simple_meaning: The seekers realized that my gross body parts are actually eternal in their atomic form, understanding them completely as permanent.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing only surface change to recognizing deeper, unchanging realities beneath appearances.
modern_relevance: When you face something ordinary, you might discover unexpected depths if you look closely beneath the surface.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
षोडशधा विभक्तानि दृष्ट्वा तान्येव मे पुनः ।
वादसाहाय्यतो वापि पर्यालोचनलोचनैः ॥
translation: षोडश संख्या में विभक्त देखकर ही वाद की सहायता से अथवा पर्या लोचना दृष्टि के द्वारा
english_translation: Seeing those same sixteen sections again, either with the help of argument or by careful observation.
essence: Re-examining known parts carefully can reveal deeper understanding.
simple_meaning: I see those same sixteen sections again, either by argument or by close observation.
insight: It encourages returning to familiar concepts with fresh eyes or fresh reasoning to gain new understanding.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सृष्टिं निरीक्ष्य तस्याश्च कर्तारं केवलं हि माम् ।
शक्नुवन्ति बुधा विप्राः ! अनुमातुं कुलालवत् ॥
translation: सृष्टि को देखकर और हे ब्राह्मणों ! मुझ को कुलालक समान केवल उस सृष्टि के कर्तारूप से ही अनुमान करने में समर्थ होते हैं।
english_translation: Observing creation, wise Brahmins can only infer me alone as its creator, like a potter infers from his pot.
essence: You can only infer the creator by deeply observing the creation itself.
simple_meaning: By carefully observing the world, wise people can only guess that I alone created it, like a potter is known through his pot.
insight: It teaches you to trust clues in the world to guide understanding of what lies beyond direct sight.
modern_relevance: You look at a complex project and realize only by its design can you guess who made it and their intent.
speaker: Shri Dheesh

verse_text:
अस्याञ्च ज्ञानभूमौ हि क्षेत्रे तत्त्वज्ञमानसे ।
आत्मज्ञानीयवीजस्य प्ररोहो जायते ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: इसी प्रथम ज्ञान भूमि में तत्वज्ञानी के ह्रदय रूप क्षेत्र में आत्मज्ञानरूप बीज का अंकुर निश्चय उत्पन्न हो जाता है
english_translation: In this primary field of knowledge, within the heart of the knower of truth, the seed of self-knowledge surely sprouts.
essence: True understanding causes the seed of self-knowledge to sprout within the heart.
simple_meaning: Inside a person's heart who truly understands, the seed of knowing the true self begins to grow.
insight: It shifts your attention to nurturing the inner seed of self-awareness that naturally grows with understanding.
modern_relevance: You sit quietly, reflecting deeply, and suddenly a clear sense of who you really are begins to emerge inside you.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
एनां वदन्त्यतो भूमि ज्ञानदां ज्ञानिनो जनाः ।
ददात्येपा यतो भूमिर्जानं नित्यं मुमुक्षवे ॥
translation: इस कारण ज्ञानीलोग इस ज्ञानभूमि को ज्ञानदा कहते हैं क्योंकि यह ज्ञानभूमि मुमुक्ष को नित्य ज्ञान प्रदान करती है
english_translation: For this reason, wise people call this knowledge-ground 'giver of knowledge' because it always grants knowledge to those seeking freedom.
essence: The source of knowledge always grants understanding to those seeking true freedom.
simple_meaning: Wise people call this place the giver of knowledge because it always provides knowledge to those who seek true freedom.
insight: It teaches you to trust that knowledge and clarity are always accessible when you genuinely seek them.
modern_relevance: When feeling lost or stuck, remember there is always a reliable source of insight ready to guide you toward clarity.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
आरुढ़ानां जानभूमावेतस्यां नियमेन च ।
ममोपास्तौ प्रवृत्तानां येन केन प्रकारतः ॥
translation: इस ज्ञान भूमि में पहुंचे हुए और किसी न किसी प्रकार से मेरी उपासना में नियम पूर्वक लगे हुए
english_translation: Those who have reached this field of knowledge and are consistently engaged in my worship by some disciplined method.
essence: Steady, disciplined devotion in any form leads to reaching true knowledge.
simple_meaning: People who have arrived at true understanding are those who consistently worship the divine with some disciplined method.
insight: It teaches that consistent, sincere devotion in any form is the foundation for reaching true wisdom.
modern_relevance: You keep showing up to what matters, in your own way, and that steady care builds your deepest understanding.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
मुमक्षणां ध्रुवं चिते ज्ञानवायुप्रकम्पितम् ।
मूलमज्ञानक्षस्य सर्वथा शिथिलायते ॥
translation: मुमुक्षओं के चित्त में ज्ञानवायु से भलीभांति कंपाया सुश्रा अज्ञानवृक्ष का मूल सर्वथा शिथिल हो जाता है
english_translation: In the mind of the seeker, the breath of wisdom firmly shakes the root of the tree of deep ignorance, which then completely weakens.
essence: True wisdom unsettles and weakens the deep roots of ignorance within the seeker’s mind.
simple_meaning: When you seek truth, your clear understanding disturbs and weakens deep ignorance in your mind.
insight: It teaches you to welcome the unsettling presence of wisdom as it loosens false beliefs.
modern_relevance: When you notice a new insight shaking your old beliefs, it weakens the grip of long-held confusion.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सन्न्यासदाभिधायां हि ज्ञानभूभ्याम्प्रतिष्ठिताः ।
मुगुक्षवः शरीर मे स्थलमल्पसमीपतः ॥
translation: सन्यासदानाम्नी द्वितीय ज्ञानभूमि में स्थित मुमुक्ष ही मेरे स्थूल शरीर को कुछ निकट से
english_translation: Those desiring liberation who are established in the field of knowledge abandon renunciation and come close to my gross body.
essence: True seekers move beyond renunciation by establishing themselves in deep knowledge.
simple_meaning: A true seeker who bases themselves in deep wisdom goes beyond merely renouncing external things and comes closer to understanding the true self beyond the physical body.
insight: It shifts focus from external renunciation to cultivating inner wisdom as the real foundation for freedom.
modern_relevance: You might pause after giving up habits or possessions, realizing that true freedom comes from understanding yourself, not just from what you leave behind.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
सम्पश्यन्तो ममाङ्गेपु स्थूलेप्वेव महर्षयः।
कुर्वन्तः सूक्ष्मशक्तीनामनुमृति निरन्तरम् ॥
translation: देखते हुए हे महर्षियों ! मेरे स्थूल अवयवों में ही सूक्ष्म शक्तियों का निरन्तर अनुभव करते हुए और
english_translation: O great sages, perceiving within my gross limbs, they continuously experience the subtle energies.
essence: Subtle energies flow continuously within the visible, gross body parts.
simple_meaning: Great sages perceive subtle energies continuously within the gross parts of my body.
insight: It invites you to recognize the subtle forces active within the obvious, seen world.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
धर्माधर्मौ च निर्णीय ह्यधर्म त्यक्तुमीशते ।
ज्ञानभूमिद्वितीयाऽत एषा सन्न्यासदोच्यते ॥
translation: धर्माधर्म का निर्णय करके अधर्म के त्याग करने की योग्यता प्राप्त कर ही लेते हैं इसी कारण इस दूसरी ज्ञानभूमि का नाम सन्यासदा कहा जाता है
english_translation: By discerning dharma and adharmas and renouncing adharmas, one attains the second field of knowledge called renunciation.
essence: True growth requires knowing what is right and giving up what is wrong.
simple_meaning: You develop wisdom by clearly distinguishing right actions from wrong and then giving up the wrong.
insight: It teaches you to develop clear judgment and courageously abandon what hinders your growth.
modern_relevance: You face choices daily where you must decide what serves your true purpose and what pulls you away, then let go of what doesn’t.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
योगदायां तृतीयायां ज्ञानभूम्यां मुमुक्षवः।
चित्तवृत्तिनिरोधस्य कुर्वन्तोऽभ्यासमुत्तमम् ॥
translation: योगदा नाम्नी तीसरी ज्ञानभूमि में मुमुक्षु  चित्तवृत्ति निरोध करने का उत्तम अभ्यास करते हुए
english_translation: In the third stage called Yoga, seekers practice the highest discipline of controlling the fluctuations of the mind.
essence: Mastering steady discipline over the restless mind leads to higher knowledge.
simple_meaning: Seekers reach the third stage of yoga by practicing disciplined control over their restless minds.
insight: It teaches you to make calming your restless mind a disciplined daily practice.
modern_relevance: When your thoughts jump from one worry to the next, steady practice to calm them builds real inner strength.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
मच्छक्तिं संयमेनैतां माम्पुनब्राह्मणोत्तमाः ।
अभ्यासेनैकतत्त्वस्य पृथक्त्वेन निरीक्षितुम् ॥
translation: संयम के द्वारा इस मेरी शक्ति को और एक तत्त्वक अभ्यास द्वारा मुझको अलग अलग रूप से देखने में
english_translation: Those of noble Brahmin nature, through control and disciplined practice, can perceive my power distinctly as one principle.
essence: Discipline and control let you clearly perceive the divine power as one unified reality.
simple_meaning: By controlling yourself and practicing steadily, you can clearly perceive the divine power as a single reality.
insight: It teaches you to use disciplined control and steady practice to see unity within diversity.
modern_relevance: You repeat a skill daily with focus and restraint, and slowly the complex begins to make clear sense.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
यस्मिन् काले प्रवर्तन्ते सूक्ष्मदृष्टिस्वरूपकम् ।
साधकेषु तदोदोत प्रत्यक्षं नन्वलौकिकम् ॥
translation: जब  प्रवृत्त होते है उस समय साधकों में सूक्ष्मदृष्टिरूपी अलौकिक प्रत्यक्ष का उदय होता है।
english_translation: When the practice begins, an extraordinary clear inner vision arises in the seekers.
essence: Beginning sincere practice awakens an extraordinary, clear inner vision in seekers.
simple_meaning: Starting a sincere spiritual practice brings a special, clear inner vision that feels beyond ordinary experience.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that beginning effort naturally opens a new, clearer way of seeing yourself and the world.
modern_relevance: The moment you start seriously focusing on growth, you notice insights and clarity that everyday distractions usually hide.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
ज्ञानभूमिमिमां विज्ञा योगदाश्च वदन्यतः।
चित्तवृत्तिनिरोध यद्योगमेषा ददात्यलम ॥
translation: इसी कारण विज्ञलोग इस ज्ञानभूमि को योगदा कहते हैं क्योंकि यह चित्तवृत्ति निरोध रूपी योग को भलीभांति प्रदान करती है
english_translation: Wise people call this field of knowledge 'Yoga' because it perfectly offers the yoga of restraining the fluctuations of the mind.
essence: True yoga is the stilling of the restless mind’s fluctuations.
simple_meaning: Yoga is the practice of stopping the restless changes in your mind to reach calm clarity.
insight: It teaches you to see yoga as mastering your mind’s constant activity, not just physical exercise.
modern_relevance: When your thoughts race during a stressful day, calming them down is your doorway to real focus and peace.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
लीलोन्मुक्तिं चतुर्थी वै ज्ञानभूमि प्रपद्य च ।
अघव्यघटनायां हि पटीयस्या मुमुक्षवः ॥
translation: और हे विज्ञवरों ! लीलोन्मुक्ति नाम्नी , चतुर्थी ज्ञानभूमि में पहुंचकर ही मेरी लीलामयी अघटन घटना पटीयसी
english_translation: And O wise ones, only by reaching the fourth stage of knowledge called līlonmukti can seekers truly manage my playful, unbroken event.
essence: True freedom arises only at the deepest stage of playful knowledge mastery.
simple_meaning: Only by reaching the fourth and deepest stage of knowledge called līlonmukti can seekers truly handle the continuous divine play.
insight: It teaches you that profound wisdom transforms your experience from struggle into graceful acceptance of life’s flow.
modern_relevance: You try to handle complex life situations but only deep understanding lets you flow with their natural rhythm without resistance.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
त्रैगुण्यलीलामय्या मे तत्वम्वै प्रकृतेर्विदुः।
तदा लीलामी स्वस्यां लीलायां प्रकृतिः पुनः ॥
translation: त्रिगुणात्मिका प्रकृति के तत्व को मुमुक्ष निश्चय ही पहचान लेते हैं, उस समय लीलामयी प्रकृति अपनी लीला में उन साधकों का पुनः
english_translation: Seekers surely recognize the true nature of the three-gunas; then the playful nature again enacts its play upon those seekers.
essence: Knowing the three qualities does not end nature’s playful unfolding.
simple_meaning: When seekers understand the true essence behind the three qualities of nature, the playful nature expresses itself again through its cosmic play.
insight: It teaches you to see beyond appearances yet remain gracefully engaged in life’s unfolding drama.
modern_relevance: You might learn a deep truth about yourself, yet life’s challenges and patterns keep unfolding. Recognizing this helps you stay present without frustration.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
नासज्जयितुमीष्टे तान साधकान् विज्ञसत्तमाः ।
लीलोन्मुक्तिं बुधाः प्रोचुर्ज्ञानभूमिमिमामतः ॥
translation: नहीं फंसा सकती, इस कारण इस ज्ञानभूमि को बुधगण ने  लीलोन्मुक्ति कहा है
english_translation: The wise say that this realm of knowledge cannot be conquered and hence call it the play of freedom.
essence: True knowledge is an unconquerable play of freedom beyond all efforts to control it.
simple_meaning: True knowledge cannot be defeated or controlled. The wise call it a playful freedom that cannot be ensnared.
insight: It shifts your view from battling knowledge to embracing it as a free, playful unfolding beyond struggle.
modern_relevance: When you face challenges in learning or self-understanding, remember true wisdom is a freedom that no obstacle can imprison.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
पञ्चमी ज्ञानभूमि ते यदा सम्प्राप्य सत्पदाम्।
अभेद ज्ञानमाप्तुं वै चित्ते स्वस्मिन् मुमुक्षकः ॥
translation: सत्पदा नाम की पञ्चमी ज्ञान भूमि में पहुंचकर वह मुमुक्षु जब अपने ही अन्तःकरण में अभेद ज्ञान को
english_translation: When the seeker reaches the fifth stage called the realm of true knowledge, they attain non-dual knowledge within their own mind.
essence: True non-dual knowledge arises naturally within the mind at a deep stage of seeking.
simple_meaning: When you reach a deep stage of true understanding, you realize non-dual knowledge inside your own mind.
insight: It teaches you to turn inward and recognize non-duality as a natural state within your mind.
modern_relevance: You’ve spent years learning, but the real breakthrough comes when insight arises quietly within your own mind.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
आरभन्ते तदा तेषामनु भूर्तेहि शक्तयः।
विशेषेण विवर्द्धन्ते नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥
translation: प्राप्त करने लगते हैं उसी समय उनकी अनुभव शक्तियां विशेष बढ़ने लगती हैं इसमें विचारने की बात नहीं हैं
english_translation: At that time, their experiential powers begin to develop especially; there is no need for special deliberation here.
essence: Starting activates your natural powers without requiring overthinking.
simple_meaning: When you start acting, your natural abilities grow stronger without needing to overthink.
insight: It teaches you to trust that effort activates your potential without needing endless planning.
modern_relevance: You hesitate before a new project, but once you begin, your confidence and skills expand effortlessly.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अस्त्येकत्लादभेदो यो मन्मत्मकृतिगोचरः।
यो वाऽभेदोऽस्ति में विमाः ! कार्यकारणरूपयोः ॥
translation: हे विप्रों ! एकत्व के कारण मुझमें और मेरी प्रकृति में जो अभेद है अथवा मेरे कारण स्वरूप और कार्य स्वरुप में जो अभेद है
english_translation: O wise ones! There is no difference between me and my nature, nor between cause and effect.
essence: Cause and effect, self and nature are fundamentally one, not separate.
simple_meaning: There is no real difference between the true self and its nature, or between cause and effect.
insight: It shifts your perspective to see cause and effect as aspects of the same reality, dissolving separation.
modern_relevance: When you see your choices and your character as one, you stop blaming external causes and find responsibility within.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
तं वैज्ञानिकनेत्रण विस्पष्ट ज्ञातुमीशते।
ज्ञात्वा सम्यग्रहस्यञ्च विश्वोत्पादककर्मणः ॥
translation: वैज्ञानिक दृष्टि के द्वारा उसको वह स्पष्ट रूप से समझने में समर्थ होते हैं और
english_translation: Those with a scientific vision can clearly understand it and fully grasp the creative action of the universe.
essence: Clear, scientific vision allows full understanding of the universe’s creative action.
simple_meaning: A scientific or clear way of seeing lets you fully understand the universe’s creative activity.
insight: It invites you to cultivate clear observation to understand the natural flow behind all things.
modern_relevance: When you step back and examine life calmly and clearly, you begin to see how events unfold naturally.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
जगदेवास्म्यहमिति मां निरीक्ष्य विचारतः।
कार्यब्रह्मण एतस्य विबुध्यन्ते स्म सत्यताम् ॥
translation: जगदुत्पत्तिकारक कर्म का रहस्य अच्छी तरह समझकर जगत् ही मैं हूँ इस विचार से मुझको देखकर इस कार्य ब्रह्म की सत्यता जान लेते हैं
english_translation: By deeply examining and understanding the cause of creation, the wise realize the truth that I am the world itself, the essence of action.
essence: You are not separate but the true essence behind all action and creation.
simple_meaning: When you carefully study the cause of creation, you understand that you are not separate but the world itself, the true essence behind all action.
insight: It shifts your perspective from seeing yourself as separate to recognizing your essential unity with the world’s forces and actions.
modern_relevance: When you pause to understand the root causes behind your challenges, you might realize you are deeply connected to everything happening around you.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
एनां वदन्ति विद्वांसो भूमि वै सत्पदामतः।
सद्भावस्य यतोऽमुप्या ज्ञानं लोकैरवाप्यते ॥
translation: इसी कारण इस ज्ञानभूमि को ही विद्वान लोग सत्पदा कहते हैं क्योंकि इसके द्वारा सदुभाव का ज्ञान लोगों को प्राप्त होता है।
english_translation: Wise people call this realm the seat of goodness because through it, knowledge of virtuous nature is attained by all.
essence: Wisdom arises from connecting with the realm of virtuous nature.
simple_meaning: The place associated with goodness is called the seat of true knowledge because it helps people gain understanding of virtue.
insight: It teaches you to seek environments and mindsets rooted in goodness to access deeper wisdom.
modern_relevance: When you choose to focus on positive values in your life, you open yourself to clearer understanding and better decisions.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
नन्वानन्दपर्दा पष्ठी ज्ञानभूमि भपच वै ।
एकाधारे तु मत्येव मम भक्ता समक्षवः ॥
translation: आनन्दपद नाम की षष्ठी ज्ञानभूमि में पहुंचकर ही मेरे भक्त मुमुक्षु मुझमें ही
english_translation: My devotees become seekers only when they reach the sixth stage called the blissful ground of knowledge before me.
essence: Devotion becomes true seeking only after joyful knowledge arises near the divine.
simple_meaning: Devotion deepens into genuine seeking only after experiencing a blissful level of knowledge close to the divine.
insight: It shows that devotion matures into active seeking when supported by joyful wisdom.
modern_relevance: You might feel like a follower until a deep joyful insight shifts you into truly seeking your own understanding.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
कर्मराज्यं जडं विप्रा: ! देवराज्यञ्च चेतनम !
शक्नुवन्ति यदा द्रष्ट्र तदा में रससागरे!॥
translation: जड़मय कर्मराज्य और चेतनमय दैव राज्य को एकाधार में जब देखने में समर्थ होते है तब हे विप्रो ! यह  मेरे रससागर में
english_translation: O wise one, when the seer can perceive both the realm of inert actions and the realm of conscious beings as one foundation, then they enter my ocean of bliss.
essence: True clarity is seeing action and consciousness as one foundation.
simple_meaning: When you clearly see that the world of physical actions and the world of conscious beings share the same foundation, you experience deep bliss.
insight: It shifts the mind from seeing separation to recognizing a unified foundation beneath action and awareness.
modern_relevance: You notice how your daily tasks and your inner feelings come from the same source, bringing a calm sense of unity and meaning.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
उन्मजन्तो निमजन्नो जगदित्यहमेव माम ।
समीक्षमाणा अद्वैतनन्दमुक्षुभुन्गते ॥
translation: उन्मजन निमजन करते हुए, मैं ही जगत हूँ, इस प्रकार मुझको देखकर अद्बैत आनन्द का उपभोग करते हैं
english_translation: While entering and immersing, I am indeed the world; witnessing me, beings enjoy non-dual bliss.
essence: You are not separate from the world; you are the joyful whole itself.
simple_meaning: You and the entire world are not separate; you are fully immersed in it, experiencing bliss beyond division.
insight: It shifts your perspective from seeing yourself as isolated to recognizing your presence within all things, unlocking a joyful unity.
modern_relevance: When you realize you are deeply connected to everything, the loneliness and separation you feel start to disappear, replaced by joy.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
बुधाः सम्पोचुरानन्दपदामदां भूमिभिरमावनः ।
आनन्दः साधकार्यस्पादस्यां भूमाववाप्य्ते ॥
translation: इसी कारण इस ज्ञान भूमि को बुधगण आनन्द प्रद करने योग इस भूमि में साधक आनन्द प्राप्त करते है
english_translation: For this reason, the wise who enter this field of knowledge attain joy; seekers find bliss on this ground for fulfilling their purpose.
essence: Joy comes naturally when you enter true knowledge and pursue meaningful purpose.
simple_meaning: Wise people who engage deeply with true knowledge find joy, and those pursuing their purpose experience bliss.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that joy accompanies sincere engagement with your true purpose and learning.
modern_relevance: You begin a new course or project, unsure but eager. As you learn deeply, joy arises simply from meaningful progress.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अन्तिमा ज्ञानभूमि में सप्तमीञ्च परात्पराम ।
सम्प्राप्य ज्ञानिना भक्ताः कार्यकारणोदिर्जा: ॥
translation: हे विप्रो ! परास्परा नाम की सप्तमी और अन्तिम ज्ञान भूमि में मेरे ज्ञानभक्त  पहुंच कर कार्य कारण की
english_translation: O wise one! In the supreme seventh and final field of knowledge, my devotees who understand reach the source of cause and effect.
essence: The highest knowledge reveals the root cause behind all actions and results.
simple_meaning: The wise devotees reach the highest, final field of knowledge where the root causes of action and result are understood.
insight: It shows that true understanding involves grasping the fundamental cause behind all outcomes, not just surface events.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
भेददृष्टिलयं कृत्वा स्वरूपे यान्ति में लयम ।
भेदज्ञानलयेनैव तेषां  शुद्धान्तरात्मि ॥
translation: भेद दृष्टि का लय करके मेरे स्वरुप में लय हो जाते हैं और भेदमान के लय होने ही उनके विशुद्ध अन्त: करण में,
english_translation: Those who dissolve their sense of separation merge into my true nature; by merging the knowledge of separation, they reach the pure inner self.
essence: Letting go of perceived separation reveals your pure, unified true self.
simple_meaning: When you let go of the feeling that you are separate, you unite with your true nature and reach a pure inner state.
insight: This verse shifts your mind from fixating on differences to experiencing an undivided inner unity.
modern_relevance: When you feel isolated or divided from others, recognize that this separation is temporary and can dissolve into a deeper connection with yourself.
speaker: श्री धीश

verse_text:
सर्वेषु प्राणिवृन्देष किलैकन्न प्रदर्शकम ।
अद्वैतभावजनकाऽविभत्ताज्ञानमुत्तमम ॥
translation: सब भूतों में ऐक्य प्रदर्शक अज्ञान अन्धकार नाशक और अद्वैतभाव-उत्पादक अविभक्त ज्ञान का उत्तम रीति से
english_translation: Among all living beings, the supreme wisdom clearly reveals unity, destroys ignorance, and produces undivided oneness.
essence: Supreme wisdom reveals that all beings share an undivided true nature beyond confusion.
simple_meaning: Deep wisdom shows the unity in all living beings, ending confusion and revealing undivided knowledge.
insight: It shifts your focus from separateness to the seamless unity that underlies all existence.
modern_relevance: When distractions and conflicting thoughts cloud your mind, this wisdom helps you see the unity beneath all differences, calming inner turmoil.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
उदेति नात्र सन्देहोऽज्ञानवान्नापनोदकम ।
तदा मे ज्ञानिभक्तषु मयि भेदश्च नश्यति ॥
translation: उदय होता है इसमें सन्देह ही नहीं है  उस समय मेरे ज्ञानी भक्तों में और मुझमें  भेदभाव नष्ट हो जाता है
english_translation: There is no doubt that the dawn is certain; then the distinction between my wise devotees and myself disappears.
essence: True knowledge dissolves separation between the seeker and the source.
simple_meaning: When true understanding arises, all separation between the teacher and the devoted wise ones vanishes.
insight: It teaches you to recognize unity beyond surface differences when genuine knowledge is present.
modern_relevance: You experience moments when barriers between you and your trusted friends dissolve during shared understanding or deep connection.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
लीयन्ते मत्स्वरूपे ते स्वरूपज्ञानसंश्रयात ।
अतो वदन्ति विद्वांस इमां भूमि परात्पराम् ॥
translation: वह मेरे स्वरूप में स्वरूपज्ञान के अंवलम्बन से विलीन हो जाते हैं इसी कारण इस भूमि को विद्वान् लोग परात्परा कहते हैं
english_translation: Those who rest in my nature through the support of self-knowledge merge into me; thus, wise ones call this realm the highest.
essence: Resting in clear self-knowledge merges you into the highest true nature.
simple_meaning: When you rely on clear understanding of your true self, you merge with that nature. This merging is why wise people call this realm the highest.
insight: It shifts your focus from seeking outside to resting securely in your own true self through knowledge.
modern_relevance: When you fully trust your own clarity about who you are, you experience a powerful sense of unity and peace beyond ordinary struggles.
speaker: Shri Dheesh

verse_text:
एतासां ज्ञानभूमीनां केचित्तत्वबुभुत्सवः।
स्थूलदृष्ट्या विरोधं यच्छकन्ते तत्र साम्प्रतम् ॥
translation: साधारण दृष्टि से इन सातो ज्ञान भूमियों में कोई कोई तस्वजिज्ञासु जो विरोध भाव की शंका करते है वह ठीक नहीं है
english_translation: Some seekers mistakenly see conflict in these seven fields of knowledge when viewed superficially.
essence: Apparent contradictions in knowledge arise only from a superficial view.
simple_meaning: Sometimes, when you look at knowledge superficially, it seems contradictory, but that doubt is mistaken.
insight: It teaches you to look beyond initial appearances and keep exploring for true clarity.
modern_relevance: You read a complex topic and feel confused by contradictions, but deeper study reveals a unified understanding.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
हे विज्ञानविदो विप्रा: ! नन्वज्ञानस्य सप्तभि।
प्रपूर्ण सप्तभि: सम्यक् तथा ज्ञानस्य भूमिभिः॥
translation: हे विज्ञानविद् ब्राह्मणो! सप्त अज्ञान भूमि और सप्त ज्ञानभूमि से ही
english_translation: O knowledgeable Brahmins! Indeed, ignorance has seven roots, and true knowledge also has seven solid foundations.
essence: Both ignorance and true knowledge have seven foundational roots shaping their existence.
simple_meaning: Ignorance and true knowledge each have seven fundamental bases or roots that define their nature.
insight: It shifts your view to see knowledge as an equally complex and stable structure as ignorance.
modern_relevance: You realize your confusion has clear causes—and your understanding can be built just as firmly.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
नूनमास्ते महाकाश-गोलक परमाद्भुतम् ।
तस्य निम्नस्तराः सप्त सप्तच्छायाप्रपूरिताः ॥
translation: भलीभांति पूर्ण परमाद्भत महाकाश गोलक है, उसं गोलक के नीचे के सात स्तर सप्त छाया से पूर्ण हैं
english_translation: Indeed, the supreme cosmic sphere is fully complete, and beneath it are seven lower levels filled with layers of shadows.
essence: The supreme cosmic sphere has seven shadowy lower layers beneath it.
simple_meaning: There is a vast supreme cosmic sphere, and below it lie seven lower layers filled with shadows.
insight: This verse invites awareness that reality has multiple hidden layers beyond what meets the eye.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
उच्चैः सप्तस्तराः सप्तज्योतिर्मिश्चैव पूरिताः।
अधः छायास्तराः सन्ति चत्वारो हि समष्टितः ॥
translation: और ऊपर के सात स्तर सप्त ज्योति से ही पूर्ण हैं, नीचे के चार छाया स्तर
english_translation: Above are seven levels fully filled with seven lights; below are four shadow levels making eleven in total.
essence: Existence is composed of seven luminous and four shadowy levels, totaling eleven.
simple_meaning: There are seven higher levels filled with light and four lower shadow levels, making eleven levels altogether.
insight: It invites you to see reality as layered, with clear and obscure parts coexisting.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
चतुर्धा भूतसंघाना चिदाकाशेन पूरिताः।
स्तरा अज्ञानभूमीनां तत उर्ध्व गतास्त्रयः ॥
translation: चतुर्विध भूतसङ्घ के समष्टि चिदाकाश से पूर्ण हैं। उसके ऊपर की तीन अज्ञान भूमियों के स्तर
english_translation: The four groups of elemental beings are filled with conscious space; above them lie three levels of ignorance.
essence: Clear conscious space exists beneath three ascending layers of ignorance.
simple_meaning: There are four groups of beings filled with conscious space, and above them are three higher levels characterized by ignorance.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that clear awareness exists beneath multiple layers of mental confusion.
modern_relevance: When you look at your thoughts, you might notice clear moments overshadowed by layers of confusion and doubt.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
ज्ञानभूमिस्तराः सप्त तथा दशविधानमून् ।
घृत्वाऽधिकारान सम्पूर्णान पिण्डान दैवांश्च मानवान्॥
translation: तथा सात ज्ञान भूमियों के स्तर यह दस स्तर दशविध अधिकारो को धारण करके समस्त मानव और दैवपिण्ड में
english_translation: There are seven levels of the knowledge realm, each encompassing ten types of authority, embracing all human and divine beings completely.
essence: Knowledge unfolds in seven levels, each fully embracing human and divine authority.
simple_meaning: There are seven knowledge realms, each with ten types of authority covering all human and divine forms.
insight: It reveals that understanding comes in layered levels, each governing different aspects of life and existence.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
व्याप्नुवन्ति न सन्देहस्तस्माद्विज्ञानवित्तमाः!।
एतद्दशविधेष्वेवाधिकारेप्वखिला हिताः ॥
translation: व्याप्त है। इस कारण हे विज्ञान विद्वरो! इन दो अधिकार में ही
english_translation: There is no doubt; the wise know that all well-being lies solely in these two paths.
essence: All true benefit comes from two essential, doubt-free paths known by the wise.
simple_meaning: The wise understand without doubt that all true benefit comes from these two main paths.
insight: It helps you focus on the essential paths that bring real benefit, filtering out distractions.
modern_relevance: When faced with many confusing options, you find peace knowing that only a couple of clear ways truly lead to well-being.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
निम्नानिम्नतरा एवमुच्चैरुच्चतमास्तथा ।
दार्शनिकाधिकारा हि सन्ति सम्मिलिता ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: निम्न से निम्नतर और सबसे उच्चतम सब हितकर दार्शनिक अधिकार सम्मिलित है यह निश्चय है।
english_translation: Among the low, there are those even lower; among the high, the highest; the authority of the philosophers is surely united.
essence: True authority arises when philosophical insights unite beyond all ranks.
simple_meaning: There are levels among the low and the high, but true authority comes when philosophical insights are united and certain.
insight: It teaches you to look beyond surface ranks and value the united clarity of deep understanding.
modern_relevance: You notice debates where many opinions clash, yet the real power lies in the shared insight that brings clarity beyond status or position.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अघन्यघटनायां सा प्रकृतिमे पटीयसी।
मत्तो व्यक्ता महाकाश-गोलकेऽत्र प्रकाशते ॥
translation: मेरी वह अघटनघटनापटीयसी प्रकृति मुझसे व्यक्त होकर इस महाकाशगोलक में प्रकाशित है।
english_translation: My unchangeable nature has revealed itself through me and shines in this vast cosmic sphere.
essence: A steady, unchanging nature reveals itself through the cosmic play of existence.
simple_meaning: Your constant, unchanging true nature expresses itself through your existence and lights up the entire cosmos.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing change as all there is to recognizing a constant essence shining through.
modern_relevance: Like recognizing your core values shining through every challenge, this verse reminds you that a steady inner nature persists beyond all life’s changes.
speaker: Shambhu Dheesh

verse_text:
अदर्ध्वगाः सप्तभूमीवै सा विद्यारूपतोऽनुते ।
अविद्यारूपतो विप्रा: ! सप्तभूमीश्च निम्नगाः ॥
translation: हे विप्रो ! वहीं विद्यारूप से ऊपर की सप्त भूमिकाओं में और अविद्यारूप से नीचे की सप्त भूमिकाओं में परिव्याप्त है
english_translation: O wise one! The seven higher realms are filled with forms of knowledge, and the seven lower realms with forms of ignorance.
essence: Existence is layered into realms of knowledge above and ignorance below.
simple_meaning: There are seven higher levels filled with knowledge and seven lower levels filled with ignorance.
insight: Recognize that your awareness fluctuates between understanding and unawareness, shaping how you see the world.
modern_relevance: Your thoughts and feelings shift between clarity and confusion, like moving through higher and lower realms.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सप्तच्छायाभिरेताभिज्योतिर्भिः सप्तभिस्तथा ।
परिपूर्ण महाकाश-गोलकं मे जड़ात्मिका ॥
translation: इन सप्त छाया और सप्त ज्योतियों से पूर्ण महाकाश गोलक को अधार रूप से मेरी जडा
english_translation: The entire great cosmic sphere is filled with my seven shadows and seven lights, representing my insentient aspect.
essence: The cosmic sphere is fully formed by the insentient aspects expressed as seven shadows and lights.
simple_meaning: The vast cosmic sphere is completely filled with seven shadows and seven lights, symbolizing my insentient nature.
insight: It invites you to recognize that beneath the changing world lies a vast, unfeeling foundation that supports everything.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
बिभर्ति प्रकृतिनित्यं नूनमाधाररूपतः।
अहं तस्योपरिष्ठाच सन्तिष्ठे शुद्धचिन्मयः ॥
translation: प्रकृति नित्य ही धारण कर रही है और मैं शुद्ध चिन्मय होकर उसके ऊपर स्थित हूँ
english_translation: The natural world endures forever as its foundation, while I, pure consciousness, remain established above it.
essence: Your true self is pure awareness established beyond the eternal natural world.
simple_meaning: You are pure consciousness that exists beyond and above the natural world, which continues without end.
insight: It shifts your perspective from identifying with constant change to recognizing your stable, conscious nature beyond it.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by endless changes around you, remember your true self remains steady and unchanged beyond it all.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
ज्ञानिनः स्याद्धि यस्यादोऽध्यात्मगोलकदर्शनम् ।
मद्दर्शनं ध्रुवं कर्तुं शक्नुयात्सर्वथैव सः ॥
translation: इस अध्यात्मगोलक का दर्शन जिस ज्ञानवान को ही होता है वह निश्चय ही मेरे दर्शन करने सर्वथा समर्थ होता
english_translation: The knower who has the vision of this spiritual sphere is surely capable in every way of perceiving me.
essence: Clear spiritual insight enables complete perception of the divine presence.
simple_meaning: If you gain deep understanding of the spiritual realm, you become fully able to perceive the divine presence.
insight: It teaches you that developing spiritual clarity expands your capacity to perceive the divine fully and without limitation.
modern_relevance: When you develop clear insight into your deeper self or spiritual reality, you unlock your full ability to connect with the divine presence in your life.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
वैदिकैदर्शनैरूक्तं ज्ञानमेवास्ति लोचनम् ।
एतदर्थ न सन्देहः सत्यं सत्यं ब्रवीमि वः ॥
translation: वैदिक दर्शनोक्त ज्ञान ही इसके लिये नेत्र स्वरूप हैं निःसन्देह मैं सत्य सत्य कहता हूँ
english_translation: Knowledge alone is the eye through which Vedic philosophies are seen; this is certain, I tell you the truth.
essence: True understanding comes only through knowledge acting as the eye to all teachings.
simple_meaning: Only knowledge lets you truly see the deep teachings of the Vedas. There is no doubt about this.
insight: It shifts your focus to valuing knowledge as the essential way to perceive truth clearly.
modern_relevance: When you seek clarity amid conflicting information, knowledge acts as your clear lens to see what really matters.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सप्तानां ज्ञानभूमीनामतो दर्शनसप्तके ।
विरोधं येऽनुकल्पन्ते ते भक्ता ज्ञानिनो न मे ॥
translation: अतः जो सप्त ज्ञान भूमियों के सप्त दर्शनशास्त्रों में विरोध कल्पना करते हैं वे मेरे ज्ञानी भक्त नहीं है
english_translation: Those who imagine conflict among the seven fields of knowledge and seven paths of vision are neither my devotees nor my wise ones.
essence: True wisdom and devotion never see conflict between different knowledge paths.
simple_meaning: If you see conflict between different kinds of knowledge or paths to truth, you are not truly devoted or wise.
insight: It teaches to embrace diverse ways of knowing without forcing conflict, blending devotion and wisdom as complementary.
modern_relevance: You notice people arguing online about which belief or method is best, missing that multiple perspectives can coexist and enrich each other.
speaker: Shri Dheesh

verse_text:
ज्ञानीभक्ता भवन्तो म भवन्तो मे द्विजोत्तमाः ।
अद्वैतविभक्तञ्च विकारराहितं तथा ॥
translation: हे श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणो ! आपलोग मेरे ज्ञानी भक्त होते हुए अविभक्त, विकारहीन और अद्वैत
english_translation: O best Brahmanas, you become my wise devotees, undivided, free from change, and non-dual.
essence: Devotion unites you into a steady, unchanging, and non-divided being.
simple_meaning: You become devoted followers who are steady, whole, and free from inner change or division.
insight: It shows that true devotion stabilizes your inner state, dissolving division and change.
modern_relevance: When you commit to a cause with steady devotion, you find inner unity beyond daily ups and downs.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
ज्ञानं प्राप्य परासिद्धेः कृपादृष्टयानुतोषिताः।
मत्सायुज्यं समासाद्य लभेरन् कृतकृत्यताम् ॥
translation: ज्ञान को प्राप्त करके परासिद्धि की कृपादृष्टि से आश्वासित हो मत्सायुज्य को प्राप्त करके कृतकृत्यता को प्राप्त हों
english_translation: Having attained knowledge and assured by the grace of the supreme being, one reaches union with me and gains a sense of fulfilled completeness.
essence: True fulfillment comes when knowledge and divine grace bring union with the divine.
simple_meaning: When you gain true knowledge and feel assured by the supreme being’s grace, you reach union and a deep sense of completeness.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that true fulfillment arises when knowledge is combined with trust in the divine’s guidance.
modern_relevance: After a long journey of learning and doubt, you finally grasp a truth that connects you deeply and leaves you quietly fulfilled.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
रहस्यं ज्ञानभूमीनां हे सर्वज्ञ ! महाद्भुतम् ।
तथाऽविभक्तज्ञानस्य शैलीं श्रुत्वा प्रकाशिकाम् ॥
translation: हे सर्वज्ञ ! ज्ञान भूमियों का महान् अद्भुत रहस्य और अविभक्तज्ञान के प्रकाश करने वाली शैलो को सुनकर
english_translation: O All-Knowing One! Hear the great wondrous secret of the realms of knowledge and the illuminating path of undivided wisdom.
essence: A wondrous secret reveals the unified and illuminating nature of true wisdom.
simple_meaning: There is a great and wondrous secret about the realms of knowledge and the clear path of undivided wisdom that the listener is invited to hear.
insight: It shifts your curiosity from fragmented understanding to seeking the seamless, illuminating whole of wisdom.
modern_relevance: You stand at the edge of a new insight, ready to uncover the hidden unity behind scattered facts and ideas.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अस्माकं संशयाः सर्वे दूरीभूता न संशयः ।
अस्मानुपदिशैतञ्च कृपां कृत्वाऽधुना प्रभो ! ॥
translation: हमारी सब शंकाएं दूर हो गई हैं इसमें सन्देह नहीं। अब हे प्रभो । कृपा करके
english_translation: All our doubts have been dispelled without a doubt. Now, O Lord, please show your grace.
essence: Complete clarity removes all doubt and opens the way for compassionate support.
simple_meaning: All doubts have completely vanished. Now the speaker asks the divine for grace.
insight: It encourages embracing clarity with gratitude and openness to further guidance or support.
modern_relevance: You finish a difficult conversation or learning with relief and quietly ask for support to move forward.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
को नन्वज्ञानभूमीनां प्रभावादूरक्षयन् मुदा ।
मुमुक्षून साधकासीवानयते ज्ञानभूमिकाः ॥
translation: हमको यह भी आज्ञा कीजिये कि अज्ञानभूमियों के प्रभाव से बचाकर मुमुक्षु साधक जीवों को आनन्दपूर्वक ज्ञानभूमियों में कौन पहूँचाता है ?
english_translation: Who, protecting seekers from the influence of ignorance, joyfully leads them to the grounds of knowledge?
essence: Joyful guidance protects seekers from ignorance and leads them to knowledge.
simple_meaning: Someone joyfully protects seekers from ignorance and leads them into the realm of knowledge.
insight: It shifts your focus from struggling alone to trusting in guidance that joyfully removes confusion.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by doubt and confusion, having someone who cheerfully supports your learning makes all the difference.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अतीत्याज्ञानभूमीश्च कैरुपायैर्मुमुक्षवः ।
लभन्ते ज्ञानभूमिर्हि साधकाः सत्त्वरं ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: किन उपायों द्वारा मुमुक्षु साधक अज्ञान भूमियों को अतिक्रमण करके शीघ्र ही ज्ञान भूमियों को प्राप्त करते हैं।
english_translation: By which means do seekers quickly overcome the lands of ignorance and attain the land of knowledge, which is steadfast reality?
essence: Seekers cross confusion using specific means to gain steady, true knowledge.
simple_meaning: Seekers use certain methods to leave behind confusion and reach steady, clear knowledge.
insight: It shifts focus to discovering practical means to escape confusion and find firm knowledge.
modern_relevance: You feel stuck in doubt, unsure how to find clarity. This reminds you there are clear ways forward to steady understanding.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
क्रमादग्रेसरन्तश्च सप्तमु ज्ञानभूमिषु ।
भवन्तं प्राप्नुवन्त्यन्ते सच्चिदानन्दरूपिणम् ॥
translation: और सातों ज्ञानभूमियों में क्रमशः अग्रसर होते हुए अन्त में सच्चिदानन्द स्वरूप आप को प्राप्त होते हैं
english_translation: Progressing step by step through the seven stages of knowledge, you ultimately reach the state of pure existence, consciousness, and bliss.
essence: True understanding unfolds gradually, culminating in pure being, awareness, and joy.
simple_meaning: You progress through seven levels of knowledge and finally realize your true nature as pure existence, consciousness, and bliss.
insight: It teaches you to trust gradual growth in understanding rather than expecting instant enlightenment.
modern_relevance: When you learn something new step by step, you build confidence and clarity until everything feels deeply meaningful and joyful.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
ब्राह्मणा: ! नयते नूनं सर्वलोकहितप्रदः।
ब्रहमाण्डपिण्डस्पायाः सृष्टेश्च धारको महान् ॥
translation: ब्राह्मणो ! सर्व लोक हितकर, ब्रह्माण्ड पिण्डात्मक सृष्टि का धारक और अभ्युदय और मुक्ति विधायक यह महान्
english_translation: The brahmana is indeed the great supporter of the cosmic creation, the benefactor of all worlds' welfare, and the establisher of growth and freedom.
essence: The brahmana supports creation and advances welfare and freedom for all worlds.
simple_meaning: The brahmana is described as the great supporter of the cosmic creation and the one who benefits all worlds with growth and freedom.
insight: It highlights the importance of a sustaining force that upholds welfare and growth beyond individual concerns.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
मानवान धर्म एवायं कैवल्याभ्युदयप्रदः।
संरक्ष्याज्ञानभूमिभ्यो ज्ञानभूमीनिरन्तरम् ॥
translation: धर्म ही मनुष्यों को अज्ञान भूमियों से बचाकर ज्ञान भूमियों में निरन्तर ही पहुंचा देता है।
english_translation: Dharma alone continuously protects humans from the realms of ignorance and leads them to realms of knowledge.
essence: Your true purpose continually shields you from ignorance and leads to wisdom.
simple_meaning: Your true purpose protects you from confusion and keeps leading you toward clear understanding.
insight: It teaches you to see your purpose as a protective force that keeps moving you beyond confusion toward lasting knowledge.
modern_relevance: When you feel lost or overwhelmed by doubts, your purpose is the steady guide that draws you toward clarity and confidence.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
ददञ्चभ्युदयं सम्यक सम्प्राप्य्यान्तिमा क्रमात ।
ज्ञानभूर्मि ततो दत्ते निःश्रेयसमहो परम ॥
translation: और क्रमशः अभ्युदय को सम्यक् प्रदान करता हुआ अन्तिम ज्ञानभूमि में पहुंचाकर अहो ! तदनन्तर कैवल्य प्रदान करता है
english_translation: Gradually, it grants proper progress, reaching the final field of knowledge, then bestows supreme freedom.
essence: True freedom unfolds only after gradual, proper progress to final knowledge.
simple_meaning: Progress happens gradually and properly, leading you to the deepest knowledge and then to ultimate freedom.
insight: It teaches you to trust gradual progress; deep freedom comes only after steady, proper growth.
modern_relevance: You have been learning and growing slowly, and though it might feel slow sometimes, you are moving toward your deepest clarity and freedom.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अहमेवास्मि धर्मस्य स्थितिस्थानं द्विजर्षभाः ।
धर्माकृतिर्ममैवास्ते शक्तिरेव सनातनी ॥
translation: हे विप्रो ! धर्म का मैं ही स्थिति स्थान हूँ और धर्मरूपा मेरी ही सनातनी शक्ति
english_translation: O Brahmin, I alone am the foundation and abode of dharma; my eternal power is the very form of dharma.
essence: True purpose is inseparable from an eternal, unchanging power that sustains it.
simple_meaning: Your true purpose is supported by an eternal power that forms its very essence and foundation.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing purpose as fragile to recognizing it as inherently stable and eternally grounded.
modern_relevance: When you doubt your direction, remember your deepest purpose is supported by a power beyond time and circumstance.
speaker: Shambhu

verse_text:
विराटसृष्टे: प्रवाहस्य धारणं कृतवत्यहो।
ममेव सात्त्विकी शक्तिर्नूनं धम्मों महर्षयः !॥
translation: अहो ! विराट् सृष्टि के प्रवाह को निश्चय ही धारण किये हुए हैं। हे महर्षिगण! निश्चय मेरी ही सत्त्वगुणमयी शक्ति धर्म है ।
english_translation: Ah! The great sages surely uphold the flow of the vast creation. Indeed, my power is the quality of goodness that sustains the laws.
essence: A steady power of goodness sustains the flow and laws of the vast creation.
simple_meaning: There is a power of goodness that supports the flow of the entire vast creation and upholds its laws.
insight: It shifts your view from random chaos to a flow held by an underlying power of goodness.
modern_relevance: When everything around you feels chaotic, knowing a steady power of goodness holds all things can ground your trust and calm your mind.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
मात्र कश्चन सन्देहो विद्यते द्विजसत्तमाः ।
विद्ययते विप्रशार्दूला: ! शक्ति मे त्रिगुणात्मिका ॥
translation: हे ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठो ! इस विषय में कोई सन्देह नहीं है है विप्रपुन्ग्वों! मेरी शक्ति त्रिगुणात्मिका है
english_translation: O best of Brahmins! There is no doubt in this matter: my power is composed of the three qualities.
essence: The divine power clearly consists of three fundamental qualities without doubt.
simple_meaning: There is no doubt that the divine power is made up of three qualities.
insight: It helps you to recognize that complex qualities arise from three fundamental forces, simplifying your understanding.
modern_relevance: When facing complex situations, it helps to remember that underlying forces are often composed of basic, understandable parts.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
आकर्षणविशिष्टा या सा शक्तीराजसी मता ।
विकर्षणेन सम्पृक्ता शक्ति तामसी तथा ॥
translation: आकर्षणशक्ति विशिष्ठ राजसिक शक्ति कहलाती है और विकर्षण शक्ति विशिष्ट तामसिक कहलाती है
english_translation: The power of attraction is classified as rajasic energy, and the power of repulsion is classified as tamasic energy.
essence: Energy moves you either by attraction or repulsion, shaping your inner drive.
simple_meaning: Two kinds of energy shape your actions: attraction draws you forward, repulsion holds you back.
insight: Recognize when attraction or repulsion drives your choices, helping you act with clearer awareness.
modern_relevance: When you want something deeply, you feel energized; when you resist or avoid, you feel drained or stuck.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
सामञ्जस्य प्रकुर्वाणा तयोः शत्योद्वयोरिह ।
सात्विकी सैव धम्मोऽस्ति शक्तिमें नात्र संशयः ॥
translation: और उन दोनों शक्तियों का इस संसार में समन्वय करने वाली मेरी जो सात्विक शक्ति है वही धर्म है इसमें सन्देह नहीं है
english_translation: The harmonious coordinating power of these two energies in this world is my sattvic energy; this is certainly dharma without doubt.
essence: True purpose arises from the harmony of two fundamental inner energies.
simple_meaning: Your true purpose is the harmony created by the balanced interplay of your inner energies in the world.
insight: It teaches you to see your purpose as the natural balance of your inner drives and energies, not separate or conflicting forces.
modern_relevance: You feel torn between competing desires or responsibilities; finding your purpose means harmonizing these forces within you.
speaker: Shri Dheesh

verse_text:
परिव्याप्नोति धर्मस्य शक्तिरेषैव धारिका ।
परमाणुभ्य आ नूनं पूर्णां ब्रह्माण्डविस्तृतिम् ॥
translation: यही धर्म की धारिका शक्ति परमाणु से लेकर ब्रह्माण्ड के विस्तार पर्यन्त में परिव्याप्त है
english_translation: The power that upholds dharma pervades everything from the smallest particle to the vast expanse of the universe.
essence: The power supporting your purpose extends from the tiniest atom to the whole universe.
simple_meaning: The force that sustains your true purpose exists everywhere—from the tiniest particle to the vast universe.
insight: It shifts your focus from isolated actions to seeing your purpose as part of a universal flow that supports all existence.
modern_relevance: When you feel small or disconnected, remembering your purpose links you to something vast and powerful beyond immediate surroundings.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
शक्ते:  संधारिकाया मे धर्मस्यैव प्रभावतः ।
सूयेन्द्वादिग्रहाः सर्वे तथा नक्षत्रमण्डलम् ॥
translation: धर्म की धारिका शक्ति के प्रभाव से ही सब सूर्य चन्द्र आदि ग्रह उपग्रह आदि और नक्षत्र मण्डल
english_translation: By the power that sustains dharma, all the planets like the sun, moon, and their satellites, along with the constellation, exist.
essence: All celestial bodies exist due to the sustaining power of dharma.
simple_meaning: The power that upholds dharma is also the force behind the existence of the sun, moon, planets, and stars.
insight: It shows that the universe’s harmony depends on one sustaining force, inviting trust in the natural order.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
उपग्रहादयोऽप्येवं विराड्देहे ममानिशम् ।
स्वस्वकक्षामुपाश्रित्य भ्रमन्ते हि समन्ततः ॥
translation: मेरे विराट् देह में चौतरफ अपनी अपनी कक्षा में निरन्तर परिभ्रमण करते है
english_translation: In my cosmic body, various beings constantly move around within their own realms.
essence: Many beings move continuously in their own realms within the vast cosmic body.
simple_meaning: Various beings move continuously within their own areas inside the vast cosmic body.
insight: It invites you to see yourself as part of a larger system, each element moving in its own role without confusion.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सृष्टरक्षाञ्च कुर्वन्ति साहाय्यं ददतो मिव:।
देवासुरेण युद्धेन देव्याः सृष्टेः पवित्रताम् ॥
translation: और परस्पर को सहायता देकर सृष्टि की रक्षा करते हैं। धर्म की उत्तम धारिका शक्ति देवासुर संग्राम के द्वारा दैवी सृष्टि की पवित्रता
english_translation: The beings protect creation by helping each other; through the conflict of devas and asuras, the divine world's purity is maintained.
essence: Creation’s protection depends on mutual support and cosmic struggle preserving purity.
simple_meaning: Creation is protected because beings help one another, and the conflict between divine and shadow forces keeps the divine world pure.
insight: It shows that cooperation and conflict together maintain balance, not just peace alone.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
सम्पादयन्ती धर्मस्य धारिका शक्तिरुत्तमा।
प्रतिष्ठापयते देवान् स्वस्वलोकेऽसुरांस्तथा ॥
translation: सम्पादन करती हुई देवताओं और असुरो को अपने अपने लोको में सुप्रतिष्ठित रखती है
english_translation: The highest power upholds dharma by establishing the radiant beings and the shadow beings firmly in their own realms.
essence: Supreme power maintains cosmic order by holding all beings in their places.
simple_meaning: A supreme power maintains order by placing radiant and shadow beings firmly in their own worlds.
insight: It shifts the mind to see that balance depends on respecting roles and boundaries in a complex system.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
निश्चितं मातृभावेन विज्ञाः ! धर्ममयेण मे।
प्रकृतेः पालिता जीवाः पोपिताश्च निरन्तरम् ॥
translation: हे विज्ञो! मेरी प्रकृति के धर्ममय मातृभाव के द्वारा ही निरन्तर पालित पोषित होकर जीव
english_translation: Certainly, O wise one! The beings are continuously nurtured and cared for by my nature's inherent nurturing disposition.
essence: Life is continuously nurtured by the caring nature of the divine principle.
simple_meaning: All beings are constantly cared for and nurtured by the natural, sustaining power of the divine nature.
insight: Recognize that life is supported by an inherent nurturing force beyond your control or effort.
speaker: Shri Dheesh

verse_text:
उद्भिजात्स्वेदजं गत्वा स्वेदजादण्डजं तथा ।
ततो गच्छन्त्यदो विप्रा: ! अण्डजाञ्च  जरायुजम् ॥
translation: हे विप्रों  ! उद्भिज से स्वेदज, स्वेदज से अण्डज, अण्डज से जरायुज और
english_translation: O wise ones! From the sprout comes the sweat-born; from the sweat-born comes the egg-born; from the egg-born comes the birth from the womb.
essence: Life emerges through successive natural forms from plants to womb-born beings.
simple_meaning: Life develops in stages: from plants to sweat-born beings, then to egg-born, and finally to womb-born creatures.
insight: It shifts focus from human distinctions to understanding life as a continuous natural process.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
जरायुनाद्योनितो हि मर्त्ययोनि गताः पुनः।
भवन्ति मोक्षमार्गस्य नूनमतेऽधिकारिणः ॥
translation: जरायुज योनि से मनुष्य योनि में पहुंचकर अवश्य ही वह कैवल्यमार्ग अर्थात् मोक्षमार्ग के अधिकारी धन जाते हैं।
english_translation: Those born in mortal forms from parents like Jarayu certainly qualify for the path of freedom.
essence: Human birth uniquely qualifies you for the path to inner freedom.
simple_meaning: Being born as a human gives you the opportunity and eligibility to pursue inner freedom.
insight: Recognize your human life as a precious chance to engage actively with spiritual freedom.
modern_relevance: You may feel stuck or ordinary, but your human experience is a rare opportunity to awaken beyond limitations.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
ज्ञानं हि धर्माधर्मस्य मानवेभ्यो हि केवलम् ।
कृतास्ते मोक्षमार्गस्य पथिका ददता मया ॥
translation: मैंने केवल मनुष्यों को ही धर्म अधर्म का मान प्रदान करके उनको कैवल्य मार्ग का पथिक बना दिया है
english_translation: I have given humans the sense of right and wrong, making them travelers on the path to freedom.
essence: Knowing right and wrong makes humans travelers on the path to freedom.
simple_meaning: Humans receive the sense of right and wrong to become travelers on the path to inner freedom.
insight: Recognize that your moral awareness is a tool guiding you beyond confusion toward clarity and freedom.
modern_relevance: When facing a tough choice, your inner sense of right and wrong points you toward true freedom.
speaker: Teacher

verse_text:
धारिका शक्तिरेवासौ धर्मस्य विभपुड्वा: ! ।
क्रमादुन्नमयन्ती वै मानवानुत्तरोत्तरम् ॥
translation: हे विप्र  श्रेष्ठो! यह धर्म की  धारिका शक्ति ही मनुष्यों की क्रमशः उत्तरोत्तर उन्नति
english_translation: O noble one! It is the sustaining power of dharma that gradually elevates humans step by step.
essence: Steady support from right principles lifts humans progressively upward.
simple_meaning: The steady power that upholds what is right guides humans to improve gradually over time.
insight: It teaches you to trust slow, steady progress rooted in right action, not rushing but consistent uplift.
modern_relevance: When you feel stuck in your growth, remember your values are the steady power helping you improve step by step.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
कृत्वाऽधिकारिणो ज्ञानभूमेरन्ते च तानहो ।
कैवल्यपदवी तेभ्यः प्रदत्ते च शनैः शनैः  ॥
translation: कराकर ही और अहो ! अन्त में उनको ज्ञान भूमि का अधिकारी बनाकर शनैः शनैः कैवल्य पद प्रदान करती है।
english_translation: By performing their rightful actions, they gradually become entitled to the land of knowledge and are gently granted the state of complete freedom.
essence: Steady, rightful action gradually leads to knowledge and complete freedom.
simple_meaning: When you do your rightful duties sincerely, you slowly gain knowledge and eventually reach complete inner freedom.
insight: This verse shifts your focus from rushing results to consistent, patient action as the path to freedom.
modern_relevance: You keep showing up and doing your part, even when results aren’t immediate, trusting that growth will come over time.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सर्वेषां रक्षको धर्मः सर्वजीवहितमदः।
निखिलव्यापकश्चास्ति सव्यभ्योऽभ्युदयमदः ॥
translation: धर्म सर्वव्यापक, सजीव हितकारी सर्व रक्षक सबको अभ्युदयप्रद
english_translation: Dharma is the protector of all and the benefactor of all living beings; it is all-pervading and brings welfare to everyone.
essence: True purpose is universal protection and care for the welfare of all beings.
simple_meaning: Your true purpose is to protect and benefit all living beings everywhere without exception.
insight: It shifts your focus from personal gain to acting for the welfare of all life around you.
modern_relevance: You wake up knowing your work affects many, not just yourself, inspiring care beyond your immediate circle.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सर्वेषां मानसे नूनं मत्स्वरूपप्रकाशकः।
साधकानां हि जीवानां शिवत्वस्य विधायकः ॥
translation: और सबके हृदय में मेरे स्वरुप का प्रकाश करनेवाला एवं साधक जीवों को शिवत्वप्रदानकारक है
english_translation: In every mind, I illuminate the true nature; for seekers, I grant the state of auspiciousness.
