modern_relevance: When you notice how your choices and feelings affect others subtly, you glimpse this shared existence beyond individual boundaries.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
यथा पञ्चीकृताकाशे नस्याऽपञ्चीकृतस्य नु।
अर्द्धमस्सपरेपाश्च भूतानां हे महर्षयः ! ॥
translation: हे महर्षियो ! जैसे पञ्चीकृत आकाश में अंपञ्चीकृत आकाश का आधा भाग और दूसरे प्रत्येक अपञ्चीकृतभूतो के अर्द्ध भाग का चतुर्थांश
english_translation: O great sages! Just as half of the space is measured and the unmeasured space is the other half, similarly the beings are divided accordingly.
essence: Existence includes both measured and unmeasured parts inseparably.
simple_meaning: Measured and unmeasured space are halves; beings are similarly divided in parts.
insight: It invites seeing existence as a mixture of known and unknown, measured and unmeasured aspects.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
नन्वपञ्चीकृतानाम्दै अष्टमांशो न संशयः।
एवमन्येषु भूतेषु बोद्धव्यं मिश्रणं ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: अर्थात् अपर प्रत्येक भूतो का अष्टमांश मिला हुआ है इसमें सन्देह नहीं, इसी प्रकार प्रत्येक भूत में मिश्रण जानना चाहिये
english_translation: There is no doubt that every element contains an eighth part of the supreme; similarly, every being is surely a mixture of these.
essence: Every being is a definite mixture including an essential eighth element.
simple_meaning: Every being is definitely a mixture of essential parts, including an eighth part of the supreme element.
insight: Recognize yourself as a complex mixture rather than a single, fixed identity, opening space for deeper self-understanding.
modern_relevance: When you look in the mirror, remember you’re not just one thing but a blend of many essential parts working together.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
एतैः पञ्चीकृतैः पञ्चमहाभूतैर्हि जायते ।
ब्रह्माण्डं सततं स्थूलं प्रसेकं नात्र संशयः ॥
translation: इन पञ्चीकृत पञ्च महाभूतो से ही प्रत्येक स्थूल ब्रह्माण्ड निरन्तर उत्पन्न होता है इसमें सन्देह नहीं
english_translation: From these five great elements composed of the five subtle elements, the entire gross universe is continuously born; there is no doubt about this.
essence: The gross universe continually arises from five great elemental forces without doubt.
simple_meaning: The entire physical universe is constantly created from the five great elements made of the five subtle elements.
insight: It helps you see the universe as a constantly changing composition of fundamental elements, grounding you in natural reality.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
ब्रह्माण्डमापि प्रत्येकमधश्चोद्धे  विभज्यते ।
तचतुर्दशलोकेषु नानाश्चर्यमयेष्वहो ॥
translation: प्रत्येक ब्रह्माण्ड भी उद्धर्वधोरूप से अनेकों आश्चर्यमय चतुर्दश भुवनों में विभक्त है
english_translation: Each universe is divided into many wondrous fourteen worlds, arranged from lower to higher.
essence: Every universe contains fourteen distinct wondrous realms arranged from lower to higher.
simple_meaning: Every universe is split into fourteen different wondrous realms arranged from lower to higher levels.
insight: Recognizing there are many levels beyond our ordinary experience helps expand perspective beyond immediate surroundings.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
ब्रह्माण्डे तत्र प्रसेकमुद्भिजस्वेदजाण्डजाः।
जरायुजाश्च जायन्ते चतुर्धा स्थूलदेहकाः ॥
translation: उन प्रत्येक ब्रह्माण्डो मे उद्भिज स्वेदज अण्डज और जरायुज, यह चार प्रकार के स्थूल शरीर उत्पन्न होते हैं
english_translation: In every universe of mine, four types of gross bodies arise: born from plants, sweat, eggs, and birth from decay.
essence: Four different physical bodies naturally arise in each universe by distinct origins.
simple_meaning: Four kinds of physical bodies arise in each universe: from plants, sweat, eggs, and decay.
insight: Recognize that all physical forms arise from nature's processes, shaping life's diversity.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
दैव्यास्तव्यतिरिक्तं वै सृष्टवैचित्र्यमुत्तमम्।
किमप्यपूर्वमेतेभ्यो विद्यते विप्रपुङ्गवाः ! ॥
translation: हे विप्र श्रेष्ठो! इनके अतिरिक्त दैवी सृष्टि की उत्तम विचित्रता इनसे कुछ विलक्षण ही है
english_translation: O best of the wise! Beyond these, the divine creation's supreme variety is unlike any other.
essence: Nothing surpasses the supreme wonder of the divine and demonic creation combined.
simple_meaning: There is no creation more wondrous or diverse than the divine and demonic worlds combined.
insight: It shifts the mind to appreciate the extraordinary diversity and mystery beyond what is commonly known.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
जीवास्तत्तच्छरीराणामभिमानिन आसते ।
ईश्वरोऽनन्तब्रह्माण्डाभिमानी विद्यते खलु ॥
translation: शरीरों का अभिमान रखने वाले जीव और अनन्त ब्रह्माण्डों के अभिमान रखने वाले ही ईश्वर है
english_translation: Beings who identify with their bodies are limited, but the divine is the one who identifies with infinite universes.
essence: Identifying with the body limits you; true self identification is infinite and unbounded.
simple_meaning: You are not just your physical body. The true self connects with the endless universe beyond form.
insight: It shifts your perspective from limited bodily identity toward embracing your boundless, formless true self.
modern_relevance: When you feel trapped by your appearance or roles, remember your true self extends far beyond your body and current identity.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
ब्रह्माण्डपिण्डयोरैक्यमेवं जातं महर्षयः।
नैवात्र विस्मयः कार्यों भवद्भिर्विमपुङ्गवाः ! ॥
translation: हे महर्षिगण ! इस प्रकार से पिण्ड और ब्रह्माण्ड की एकता प्रतिपन्न हुई, हे विप्रवरो! आपलोगों को इसमें विस्मय नहीं करना चाहिए
english_translation: O great sages, thus the unity of the microcosm and the macrocosm is established; you should not be surprised by this, O distinguished ones.
essence: The small and the vast are one; this unity is natural and unsurprising.
simple_meaning: The great sages recognize that the small and the vast are one; this unity is natural and not surprising.
insight: It shifts your view from feeling separate to recognizing your essential oneness with everything that exists.
modern_relevance: When you feel isolated or small in a big world, remember that you are part of the whole universe, not apart from it.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
ईश्वरस्य च जीवस्य भेदो ब्रह्मणि कल्प्यते ।
मायाऽविद्यात्मकान्नूनं क्रमादावरणादद्विजाः ॥
translation: हे ब्राह्मणो ब्रह्म में ही अविद्या और मायारूप आवरण के द्वारा जीव और ईश्वर का भेद कल्पना किया गया है।
english_translation: O Brahmin, the distinction between the true self and the divine is imagined due to the veil of illusion and ignorance.
essence: Separation between the true self and the divine exists only as an imagined veil of ignorance.
simple_meaning: The difference you perceive between your true self and the divine is created by ignorance and illusion covering your vision.
insight: It teaches you to see past illusions and recognize that separation is a mistaken perception created by confusion.
modern_relevance: When you feel disconnected or separate from something greater, it's often because confusion clouds your understanding, not because separation is real.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
ब्रह्मणः प्रतिविम्ब हि जीवो देहाभिमानकः ।
स्वस्मात्वभावतो भिन्न ईश्वरस्तेन मन्यते ॥
translation: शरीर का अभिमान रखने वाला जीव ब्रह्म का प्रतिबिम्ब है, यह जीव  स्वभाव से ही ईश्वर को अपने से भिन्न समझता है
english_translation: The living being who identifies with the body is a reflection of Brahman and by nature considers the supreme being as separate from itself.
essence: You are a reflection of the supreme reality but mistakenly see it as separate from you.
simple_meaning: You are essentially a reflection of the supreme reality, but because you identify with your body, you wrongly see the supreme being as different from you.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing yourself as separate to recognizing you are a reflection of the supreme reality, obscured by body identification.
modern_relevance: When you judge yourself by your appearance or roles, you forget your deeper connection to something greater, feeling isolated and alone.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
ईश्वरस्य च जीवस्य भेदो यावदुपाधितः ।
तिष्टेत तावत्क्षणं विप्राः ! कथञ्चिच्च कदाचन ॥
translation: हे विप्रो ! उपाधि के भेद से जीव और ईश्वर में भेददृष्टि जब तक रहती है तब तक कभी और किसी प्रकार
english_translation: O wise one, as long as the distinction between the divine and the living being persists because of limiting conditions, it remains forever in some way.
essence: Separation between the divine and you lasts only while limiting identities remain.
simple_meaning: You perceive a difference between the divine and yourself as long as limiting conditions or false identities remain.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that perceived separation is due to temporary conditioning, not reality.
modern_relevance: When you feel separate or distant from your best self, it’s often because of self-imposed limits or false beliefs.
speaker: Teacher

verse_text:
जन्ममृत्युप्रवाहोऽसौ संसारो न निवर्त्तते।
ईश्वरे चैव जीवे च भेदबुद्धिः कदाप्यतः ॥
translation: जन्ममरण प्रवाहरूप यह संसार  निवृत्त नहीं होता है इस कारण से हे द्विजश्रेष्ठों ! जीव और ईश्वर में भेददृष्टि
english_translation: The flow of birth and death, called samsara, never ceases; therefore, the perception of difference between the living being and the supreme being is never removed.
essence: Endless rebirth continues as long as you see yourself as separate from the supreme reality.
simple_meaning: The endless cycle of birth and death continues because you see yourself as separate from the supreme reality.
insight: It teaches you to see through the false divide between your true self and the supreme reality to end endless reactivity.
modern_relevance: When you feel isolated or alone, that sense of separation keeps you stuck in repetitive patterns of suffering.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
न कर्तव्या द्विजश्रेष्ठाः ! तत्त्वरात्मवेदिभिः ।
मङ्गलं जायते तेषामतो नूनं महर्षयः ! ॥
translation: तत्त्वज्ञ आत्म ज्ञानियों को कदापि नहीं करनी चाहिये । हे महर्षियों! इससे उनका अवश्य मंगल होता है।
english_translation: Those who truly know the essence of the self should never act; such sages surely attain auspiciousness.
essence: Deep self-knowledge dissolves the need for compulsive action and brings true well-being.
simple_meaning: Those who deeply understand their true self do not need to act, and this brings them genuine well-being.
insight: It shifts your mind from feeling compelled to act to embracing stillness as a sign of deep wisdom.
modern_relevance: You’ve mastered your craft so well that you no longer feel restless to prove or do more; your calm knowing itself brings success.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
साहंकारस्य जीवस्य किचिज्ज्ञस्य हि कोविदाः ।
सर्वज्ञनेश्वरेणाहो निरहङ्कारिणा सह ॥
translation: हे विंज्ञों ! अहंकार वान् और अल्पज्ञ जीव को निराकार और सर्वज्ञ ईश्वर के साथ
english_translation: Who are the wise among living beings? Those who, along with the all-knowing supreme being, are free from ego.
essence: True wisdom arises when ego dissolves alongside the all-knowing reality.
simple_meaning: The truly wise are those living beings who, without ego, exist in harmony with the all-knowing supreme reality.
insight: It teaches shifting from partial self-importance to humble unity with full knowledge, opening deeper clarity.
modern_relevance: You feel overwhelmed by your limited knowledge and ego-driven judgments; recognizing wisdom means stepping beyond ego to a broader understanding.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
तत्त्वमस्यादिभिर्वाक्यरेतयोन्निधर्मयोः।
कथं त्वभेदबुद्धिः स्याच्छझ्यते चेन्निशम्यताम् ॥
translation: "तत्वमसि" आदि महावाक्यों के द्वारा, अहो! इन दोनों विरुद्धधमियों में अभेदबुद्धि कैसे हो सकती है। यदि ऐसी शङ्का करते हो तो सुनो
english_translation: "O! How can there be non-difference in these two opposing statements like 'You are That'? If you have such doubt, listen carefully."
essence: Apparent contradictions invite you to listen more deeply, not reject the unity beneath.
simple_meaning: You are confused how two opposing statements can both be true as one. This doubt is natural and invites deeper listening.
insight: It shifts your mind from rejecting contradictions to embracing them as a prompt for deeper inquiry.
modern_relevance: You face conflicting advice or truths in life and wonder how both can be right. That confusion invites you to explore more deeply.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अर्थद्वयं द्विजश्रेष्ठाः ! स्यात्तत्त्वपदयोर्द्धो:।
वाच्यार्थश्चैव भो विज्ञाः ! लक्ष्यार्थश्च न संशयः ॥
translation: हे विज्ञ विप्रवरो! तत् और त्वं इन दोनों पदों के वाच्यार्थ और लक्ष्यार्थ रूप दो दो अर्थ होते हैं इसमें सन्देह नहीं
english_translation: O best among the knowledgeable Brahmins! The two terms, tat and tvam, have two meanings each: the literal meaning and the intended meaning, without any doubt.
essence: Words have both a clear surface meaning and a deeper intended sense without doubt.
simple_meaning: The words 'tat' and 'tvam' each have two kinds of meanings: their plain literal meaning and a deeper intended meaning.
insight: It teaches you to listen beyond the surface, seeking the fuller meaning behind words.
modern_relevance: When reading or hearing advice, you notice how words might mean more than just what you first understand.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अविद्यावांश्च तत्कार्यकर्तृत्वादिगुणयुतः ।
जीवो देहाभिमानीति वाच्याऽर्थस्त्वम्पदस्य दि ॥
translation: अविद्या, उसका काव्य और कर्तुत्वादि गुण वाला और शरीर का अभिमानी जीव यही त्वंपद का वाच्यार्थ है
english_translation: The living being, attached to ignorance, its effects, and the sense of doership, identifies with the body and is called the individual self.
essence: The individual self is the living being misidentified with body and doership due to ignorance.
simple_meaning: The individual self is the living being that mistakenly identifies with the body, ignorance, and the sense of doership.
insight: It shifts your view from identifying with body and actions to recognizing your deeper true self beyond ignorance.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by stress, you might feel trapped by your roles and actions, forgetting your deeper true self beyond them.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अविद्योपाधिनिर्मुक्तं समावेश्च दशां गतम् ।
अविद्यया च नत्काय रहित प्रतिभान्विताः ॥
translation: हे प्रतिभाशालियो ! अविद्यारूप उपाधि से निर्मुक्त, समाधि दशा प्राप्त, अविद्या और उसके कार्य से रहित
english_translation: O brilliant ones! Freed from the limiting veil of deep confusion, having attained the state of absorbed presence, they are free from deep confusion and its effects.
essence: True clarity arises when you are freed from deep confusion and its effects.
simple_meaning: You can be free from the limiting confusion that binds you and reach a state of deep inner stillness.
insight: It teaches you to recognize and release the limiting confusion that blocks your clarity and presence.
modern_relevance: When your mind feels overwhelmed by doubt and distraction, you can find a centered stillness beyond all that noise.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
चिन्मात्रं शुद्भचतन्यं लक्ष्यार्थस्त्वम्पदस्य वै।
वाच्यार्थश्चैव लक्ष्यार्थस्तत्पदस्यापि कथ्यते ॥
translation: चिन्मान और शुद्ध चैतन्य ही त्वंपद का लक्ष्यार्थ है। अब तत्पद का भी वाच्यार्थ और लक्ष्यार्थ कहता हूँ
english_translation: Pure consciousness alone is the true meaning of the state of you. Now, I also declare the spoken and intended meanings of that state.
essence: Your true state is pure consciousness beyond all spoken or intended meanings.
simple_meaning: The true meaning of your state is pure, unchanging consciousness beyond any words or ideas.
insight: It shifts your focus from confusing ideas about yourself to recognizing your essence as pure awareness.
modern_relevance: When thoughts overwhelm you, remember the core of who you are is simple, clear awareness itself.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
मायातत्कार्य्यासर्वज्ञभावादिगुणसंयुतः।
ईश्वरस्तत्पदस्यास्ति वाच्यार्थो नात्र संशयः ॥
translation: माया और उसका कार्य एवं सर्वज्ञत्व आदि गुणों वाला ईश्वर तत्पद का वाच्य अर्थ है इसमें सन्देह नहीं है
english_translation: The divine, endowed with maya and its effects, omniscience, and other qualities, is the intended meaning of that term without doubt.
essence: The divine is the unified source of all qualities, actions, and omniscience without doubt.
simple_meaning: The term refers to the divine who has all qualities like illusion, action, and omniscience united without any doubt.
insight: It shifts your view from fragmented traits to seeing the divine as the unified source of all qualities and actions.
modern_relevance: When you face confusing traits or conflicting feelings in yourself or others, remember they are part of a larger unity beyond appearances.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
मायातकार्यतः शून्यं मायोषाधिविजितम् ।
चिन्मात्रं शुद्धचैतन्य लक्ष्यार्थस्तत्पदस्य वै ॥
translation: मायारूप उपाधि से शुन्य शुद्ध चैतन्य, माया और उसके कार्य से रहित और चिन्मात्र ही तत्पद का लक्ष्य अर्थ है
english_translation: The true goal is pure consciousness, untouched by the illusion and its effects.
essence: Pure consciousness beyond illusion is the true spiritual goal.
simple_meaning: The ultimate aim is to realize pure consciousness that is free from illusion and its effects.
insight: It teaches you to shift focus from illusory distractions to the pure awareness beneath them.
modern_relevance: When your thoughts and worries feel overwhelming, remember your true nature is clear and untouched beneath them all.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
ईश्वरस्य च जीवस्य शुद्धचैतन्यरूपतः ।
अभेदे वाधकामावः स्यादेवं ब्राह्मणोत्तमाः ! ॥
translation: हे विप्रश्रेष्ठो! इस प्रकार से जीव और ईश्वर में चैतन्यरूप से अभेद होने में कोई बाधक नहीं है
english_translation: O best of Brahmins! There is no obstacle to the indivisible nature of pure consciousness between the divine and the living being.
essence: Pure consciousness unites the divine and living beings without any barrier.
simple_meaning: The living being and the divine share the same pure consciousness without any real division or obstacle.
insight: It shifts your understanding from seeing yourself as separate to recognizing your true self as unified with the supreme reality.
modern_relevance: When you feel isolated or separate, remember your awareness is fundamentally the same as the divine's pure consciousness.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अहं ब्रह्मास्मि' चेत्यादिमहावाक्यैरापि द्विजाः!
विज्ञायते तयोरैक्यमुभयोर्नात्र संशयः ॥
translation: हे विप्रों ! उन दोनों की एकता ‘अहं ब्रह्माऽस्मि’ इत्यादि महावाक्यों से भी जानी जाती है इसमें सन्देह नहीं
english_translation: O Brahmins! Even the great sayings like 'I am Brahman' reveal the unity of both without doubt.
essence: 'I am Brahman' reveals the undeniable unity of your true self with the supreme reality.
simple_meaning: The statement 'I am Brahman' clearly shows that the individual self and the supreme reality are one without doubt.
insight: It shifts your thinking to recognize your true identity as inseparable from the supreme reality, dissolving separation.
modern_relevance: When you hear a phrase that connects your deepest self to everything around, it can clear confusion and bring a sense of belonging.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
ब्रह्म सत्यं जगन्मिथ्या जीवो ब्रह्मैव केवलम् ।
इति शास्त्रोपदेशेन श्रीगुरोरुपदेशतः ॥
translation: हे विज्ञ  विप्रवरो ! जो सुसाधक ब्रह्म सत्य है, जगत् मिथ्या है और जीव केवल ब्रह्म ही है ऐसा शास्त्रोपदेश से श्रीगुरूपदेश से
english_translation: O wise one! The scripture and the revered teacher declare: Brahman alone is real, the world is illusory, and the true self is Brahman alone.
essence: Your true self alone is real; the world you see is an illusion.
simple_meaning: Only Brahman is truly real; the world is an appearance, and your true self is Brahman alone.
insight: Recognize the difference between the eternal true self and the temporary changing world to shift your understanding of existence.
modern_relevance: When your mind is overwhelmed by constant change and confusion, knowing your true self is beyond it brings deep calm and clarity.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
स्वानुभृत्याऽथवा विज्ञाः ! ये विदन्ति सुसाधकाः।
यपाञ्च प्राणिमात्रेषु सर्वेषु ब्राह्मणोत्तमाः ! ॥
translation: और अपने अनुभव से जानते हैं एवं जिनकी सब प्राणिमात्रों पर
english_translation: Those who understand through their own experience and see all living beings as supreme Brahman are the best among Brahmins.
essence: Wisdom arises from experiencing the divine in all living beings.
simple_meaning: The highest wisdom comes from personally realizing that every living being reflects the divine.
insight: It shifts your view from separation to unity, deepening empathy and wise action.
modern_relevance: When you meet someone different, remembering their shared divinity fosters respect and breaks down barriers.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
ब्रह्मबुद्धिः समुत्पन्ना ज्ञानयोगेन सर्वथा ।
त एव ज्ञानिनो भक्ता जीवन्मुक्ता भवन्ति मे ॥
translation: ज्ञानयोग से सर्वथा ब्रह्मबुद्धि उत्पन्न हुई है वही मेरे ज्ञानी भक्त जीवन्मुक्त हैं।
english_translation: Pure understanding of the supreme reality arises through the path of wisdom; those wise devotees become free while alive.
essence: Devotion combined with true wisdom frees you while alive.
simple_meaning: True understanding of the supreme reality comes through wisdom, and those who combine this wisdom with devotion achieve freedom while still living.
insight: It teaches you to root your devotion in wisdom, making liberation a present reality instead of a future hope.
modern_relevance: When your clear understanding guides your love and commitment, you can experience freedom and peace in your daily life, not just in some distant future.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
एतद्वेदान्तसिद्धान्ततात्पर्य हि निशम्यताम् ।
अविद्योपाधिसम्भ्रान्तिर्यदा दूरीभविष्यति ॥
translation: इस वेदान्त के सिद्धान्त  का तात्पर्य सुनो। जब अविद्यारूप उपाधि भ्रम दूर हो जायगा
english_translation: Hear the essence of this Vedanta teaching: when the confusion caused by the veil of ignorance disappears.
essence: True understanding arises only when ignorance-based confusion disappears.
simple_meaning: The core teaching is that when the confusion caused by ignorance is removed, the true meaning of Vedanta is understood.
insight: This verse shifts your mind from confusion to clear understanding by removing false assumptions.
modern_relevance: You’ve wrestled with confusing doubts about your purpose; suddenly, clarity breaks through the fog.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
ब्रह्मसत्तैव लक्ष्यार्थरूपेणैवावशिष्यते ।
मायोपाधैमहत्त्वञ्च तत्त्वज्ञानेन वेत्स्यते ॥
translation: तो ब्रह्मसत्ता लक्ष्यार्थरूप से अवशेष रहेगी। उसी प्रकार जब मायारूप उपाधि का महत्व तत्वज्ञान के द्वारा ज्ञात होगा
english_translation: Only the essence of the supreme reality remains as the purpose; the importance of the veil of appearance is known through true understanding.
essence: Only the supreme reality remains after seeing through illusion with true understanding.
simple_meaning: Only the core supreme reality truly remains when you understand the illusion's role and importance deeply.
insight: It teaches you to distinguish between temporary appearances and the lasting reality beneath them.
modern_relevance: When you uncover the distractions and false images around your goals, you see what really matters underneath.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
ततश्च ब्रह्मरूपो हि लक्ष्यार्थः परिशिष्यते ।
जीवन्मुक्ता महात्यानस्तत्त्वज्ञानाधिपारगाः ॥
translation: तब भी लक्ष्यार्थरूप ब्रह्म ही अवशेष रह जायगा। इस प्रकार से तत्वज्ञानी जीवन्मुक्त महात्मा
english_translation: Then even the subtle residue remains as the form of Brahman; thus, the great souls liberated in life who have mastered true knowledge.
essence: Even the finest residue of experience is the supreme reality itself.
simple_meaning: After liberation, even the smallest remaining impression is understood as the supreme reality by those who have mastered true knowledge.
insight: It shifts your view to recognize that all subtle impressions are integral to the supreme reality, dissolving divisions.
modern_relevance: When you let go fully, even the smallest worries or remnants of doubt seem to be part of a greater whole, freeing you from separation.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
जीवेशयोरित्यमेतमभेदमनुभूय च ।
ब्रह्मानन्दे निमज्जन्तः कृतकृत्या भवन्ति ते ॥
translation: जीव और ईश्वर दोनों की यह अमेद सत्ता अनुभव करके वे ब्रह्मानन्द में निमग्न होते हुए कृतकृत्य होते हैं
english_translation: Experiencing the non-difference between the individual and the divine, they immerse themselves in supreme bliss, feeling fulfilled and complete.
essence: Realizing no separation from the supreme brings immersive bliss and fulfillment.
simple_meaning: When you realize there is no true difference between your inner self and the supreme reality, you naturally feel immersed in deep bliss and complete fulfillment.
insight: It teaches you to see beyond separation, shifting your identity from isolated self to unified being, leading to lasting joy.
modern_relevance: In moments when you overcome the feeling of being alone or separate, a deep joy and peace naturally arise within you.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
जड़ैजीवंगणर्विश्वं विषयात्मकमीक्ष्यते ।
अज्ञानिजीवजातन सुखरूपं निरीक्ष्यते ॥
translation: इस संसार को जड़ जीवगण विषय के रूप में देखते हैं, अज्ञानी जीव गण सुख रूप से देखते हैं
english_translation: The entire world of inert and living beings is seen as objects, while ignorant beings perceive it as a form of pleasure.
essence: Ignorance makes you see everything only as pleasure, hiding the world’s true nature.
simple_meaning: The world and all beings are objects, but ignorance makes us see them only as sources of pleasure.
insight: It teaches you to recognize the mind’s habit of confusing transient pleasure for true understanding.
modern_relevance: You scroll through joyful moments online, mistaking fleeting pleasure for lasting fulfillment, missing the fuller reality beneath.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
जगत्प्रपञ्चजातन्तु ज्ञानवद्भिविवेकिभिः।
परिणामीति विज्ञाय दुःखरूपं प्रतीयते ॥
translation: ज्ञानवान् विवेकिजन सम्पूर्ण संसारप्रपञ्च को परिणामी जानकर दुखमय रूप में अनुभव करते हैं
english_translation: Those with true wisdom and discernment see the entire world as changing and thus experience its painful nature.
essence: True discernment reveals that constant change in the world causes unavoidable pain.
simple_meaning: Wise and discerning people recognize that everything in the world changes and that this causes suffering.
insight: It teaches you to recognize impermanence as the root of emotional struggle, opening the way to acceptance.
modern_relevance: You notice how relationships, jobs, and plans shift unexpectedly, bringing discomfort despite your hopes.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
किन्तु मे ज्ञानिनो भक्ता जीवन्मुक्तगणाः खलु ।
संसारमेतं पश्यन्ति स्वरूपे काऽप्यलौकिके ॥
translation: परन्तु मेरे ज्ञानीभक्त जीवन्मुक्तगण इस संसार को कुछ और ही अलौकिक रूप में देखते हैं
english_translation: But my wise devotees, the liberated beings, see this world as something beyond the ordinary.
essence: Those free and devoted perceive the world beyond ordinary appearances.
simple_meaning: Those who are wise and devoted, and free from all bindings, see the world as beyond normal appearances.
insight: It shifts your perspective from seeing things as merely external to experiencing their deeper, unseen nature.
modern_relevance: When you feel truly free inside, everyday situations reveal unexpected depth and meaning beyond surface appearances.
speaker: श्री धीश

verse_text:
संसारं मे प्रकृत्यैतं प्रसूतं सर्वथाऽद्भुतम् ।
आकाश इव गान्धर्व पश्यन्तो नगरं मुहुः ॥
translation: हे विप्रवरो! ये मेरी प्रकृतिप्रसूत सर्वथा अद्भुत इस संसार को आकाश में गन्धर्व नगर के समान बार बार देखकर
english_translation: O best of the wise, these wondrous worlds born of my nature are like the Gandharva city in the sky, seen again and again.
essence: The world is a wondrous, repeated vision born from nature’s creative power.
simple_meaning: These worlds born from my nature are extraordinary and repeatedly seen like the Gandharva city in the sky.
insight: It invites you to see the world’s marvel and recurring illusions as nature’s creative expression.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
मिथ्यैव तत्स्वरूपञ्च जानन्तोऽपि द्विजोत्तमाः।
दर्श दर्श प्रमोदन्ते तद्रूपं कौतुकप्रदम् ॥
translation: और उसके स्वरुप को मिथ्या ही जानते हुए भी उस कौतुकप्रद रूप को देख देखकर आनन्दित होते हैं
english_translation: Even the best of the twice-born know that its nature is false, yet they delight in that fascinating form.
essence: Knowing that something is false does not stop you from enjoying its appealing form.
simple_meaning: Even those who understand that something is not truly real can still enjoy its attractive appearance.
insight: It teaches you to accept that knowing something is illusory doesn't stop natural attraction or delight in its appearance.
modern_relevance: You might understand a story or image is fictional, yet you still get caught up in its excitement and beauty.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
मृगतृष्णासमं विश्वं भ्रान्तिस्तोमसमाकुलम ।
दृष्ट्वेन्द्रजालवन्मिथ्या-प्रपञ्चावलिमूलकम् ॥
translation: वह इस संसार को मृगमरीचिकापवत् अनेक भ्रमयुक्त, इन्द्रजालवत् मिथ्या प्रपञ्चो का मूल
english_translation: The entire world is like a mirage, full of illusions and false wonders, rooted in unreal appearance.
essence: The world appears real but is fundamentally an illusion of false appearances.
simple_meaning: The world you perceive is like a mirage—full of illusions and false appearances that do not hold true reality.
insight: It shifts your view from trusting surface appearances to questioning their reality and seeking deeper truth.
modern_relevance: You scroll through endless social media images that promise joy but feel empty—this verse reminds you to see beyond such illusions.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
मम शक्तेर्गुणानाञ्च परिणामस्वरूपकम् ।
तत्र नैव प्रसज्जन्ते पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसि ॥
translation: और मेरी शक्ति के ही गुणौ का परिणाम स्वरूप देखकर उसमें फंसते ही नहीं। जल में पद्म पत्र के समान
english_translation: The lotus leaf does not stick to water, similarly my power's qualities do not adhere to it.
essence: True inner power remains untouched by the qualities and effects it produces.
simple_meaning: Your inner power's qualities do not cling to you, just as water does not stick to a lotus leaf.
insight: It teaches you to observe qualities and situations without letting them stick or disturb your inner balance.
modern_relevance: You face criticism and challenges daily, yet you can stay clear and unaffected, like water sliding off a lotus leaf.
speaker: Shambhu

verse_text:
तिष्ठन्तोऽपि प्रपञ्चेषु पृथग्भूतास्ततो ध्रुवम् ।
भवितुं ह्येतदेवाऽहर्ये लक्ष्यमुच्चपदं हितम् ॥
translation: यह इस प्रपञ्च में रहकर भी  उससे अलग ही रहते हैं।
english_translation: Even while remaining in this world, they remain distinct and steady, destined to reach the highest goal.
essence: You can live fully in the world yet remain steady and separate from its changes.
simple_meaning: Some beings live in the world but remain steady and separate from it, aiming for a higher goal.
insight: It teaches you to remain steady and separate in your inner being, even amidst external turmoil.
modern_relevance: You sit in a busy café, surrounded by chatter and movement, yet your mind stays calm and untouched by the noise.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
श्रेष्ठानां ब्राह्मणानां हि सर्वत्रैव सुखावहम् ।
परीवारोपमास्तेषां संसारा अखिला अमी। ॥
translation: श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणों का यही सर्वत्र ही सुखप्रद हितकर उच्चपद लक्ष्यरूप होना चाहिये । उनके लिये यह समस्त संसार परिवार के समान है
english_translation: The highest Brahmins should be a source of happiness everywhere; for them, the entire world is like family.
essence: True greatness is bringing happiness by seeing all as family everywhere.
simple_meaning: The best people should bring happiness everywhere and treat the whole world like their own family.
insight: It shifts your view from separation to unity, encouraging you to act with universal care and joy.
modern_relevance: When you treat coworkers, neighbors, or strangers as part of your family, your daily interactions become kinder and more meaningful.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
देवर्षिपितृसङ्घाश्च तदर्थ बान्धवोपमाः ।
साज्यं वाऽऽदेयमप्यस्ति तेषां नैवेह किञ्चन ॥
translation: देवता ऋषि और पितृगण उनके लिये बान्धव हैं। उनके लिये इस संसार में  गृहणीय भी कुछ नहीं ही है और त्याग करने योग्य भी कुछ नहीं ही है
english_translation: The devas, sages, and ancestral spirits are like relatives to them; for these beings, nothing in this world is truly to be taken or abandoned.
essence: Some beings relate closely but do not claim or reject anything in the world.
simple_meaning: Devas, sages, and ancestors are like family to some, but for them, nothing in this world is truly owned or discarded.
insight: Recognize that attachment and rejection are constructs not binding to higher beings or your deeper self.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
पितरौ च कुलं जाति स्थूलदेहेन कुर्वते ।
निखिलां पृथिवीं धन्यां मातृभूमि विशेषतः ॥
translation: वह स्थूल शरीर से माता पिता कुल जाति और समस्त पथिवी को और विशेषतः जन्म भूमि को धन्य करते हैं।
english_translation: Parents bless their family, lineage, and the entire earth, especially their birth land, through their physical body.
essence: Parents bless family, lineage, and land through their physical existence.
simple_meaning: Parents bless their family, lineage, and the whole earth especially their birth land through their physical existence.
insight: It highlights how our embodied presence supports and honors our connections to family and place.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
दैवीच जगतीं सूक्ष्मां सूक्ष्मदेहेन कुर्वते ।
सर्वदा सर्वथा धन्यां ते विमा नैव संशयः ॥
translation: हे विप्रो! वे सूक्ष्मशरीर से सूक्ष्मदैवी जगत् को सब प्रकार से सर्वदा धन्य कहते हैं इसमें सन्देह नहीं है
english_translation: O wise one! The subtle divine being always blesses the subtle world in every way without doubt.
essence: The subtle divine continuously and unquestionably blesses the subtle world in every way.
simple_meaning: The subtle divine presence continuously blesses the subtle world in every way without any doubt or interruption.
insight: This verse shifts your view to recognize unseen, continuous support beyond the obvious, grounding trust in subtle reality.
modern_relevance: Even when things feel invisible or intangible, you can trust that subtle forces support and bless your life continuously.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
ब्रह्मानन्दसुसन्दोहसविलासस्वरूपतः।
धन्यं धन्यं पुनर्धन्यं कुर्वते मामसंशयम् ॥
translation: और ब्रह्मानन्द सुसन्दोह के सम्यक् विलास स्वरूप से नि:सन्देह मुझे धन्य धन्य करते हैं
english_translation: And the supreme bliss, perfectly manifested, undoubtedly makes me truly blessed again and again.
essence: Pure joy in devotion makes you unquestionably blessed.
simple_meaning: The deep, perfect joy of the divine presence fills you with clear, undeniable blessing.
insight: It shifts your attention from external achievements to the inner joy that blesses your whole being.
modern_relevance: When you pause and feel a moment of pure joy and connection, it reminds you how blessed you truly are beyond any doubt.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
हे सर्वज्ञ ! जगन्निवास ! भगवन् ! देवादिदेव ! प्रभो !
हे सर्वादिगुरो ! दयार्णव ! विभो ! विश्वेश ! विश्वम्भर ।
अस्माकं भवतामपारकृपया नूनं तृतीय वरमद्यान्तनयनात्मकं
सुविमलं ज्ञानाक्षि प्रोन्मीलितम् ॥
translation: हे प्रभो ! हे भगवन् ! हे सर्वज्ञ ! हे दयार्णव ! हे विश्वेश! हे देवादिदेव ! हे जगन्निवास ! हे सब गुरुओं के आदिगुरु ! हे विश्वम्भर ! हे विभो ! आपकी अपार कृपा से आज हमारा अन्तर्नेत्र रूपी ज्ञाननेत्र जो श्रेष्ठ  निर्मल तृतीय नेत्र है सो निश्चय ही खुल गया है
english_translation: O Lord! O divine! O all-knowing! O ocean of mercy! O lord of the universe! O highest of gods! O world-resident! O primordial teacher of all gurus! O sustainer of the world! By your boundless grace, today our inner eye of knowledge, the pure and supreme third eye, has surely opened.
essence: Boundless grace opens the pure inner eye of knowledge within you.
simple_meaning: By the boundless grace of the divine teacher, our pure inner eye of knowledge has opened today.
insight: Acknowledging the role of compassionate guidance helps you recognize moments of sudden clarity and growth.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
पश्यामोऽद्य भवद्दयोदयवशाद्वारे मणीनां गणान
सूत्रं प्रोतमिवान्तरेण निखिलब्रह्माण्डपिण्डवज्रे।
सर्वेषां कुरुते सदैकविधिनाऽनुस्यूततामाप्तवान
चैतन्यास्तितयोर्विधानमाखिलं शश्वद्भवानित्यहो ॥
translation: आप की कृपा के उदय से अब हम देखते हैं कि आप जैसे माला में मणिगण के बीच पिरोया हुआ सूत्र रहता है उसी प्रकार सब पिण्ड और सब ब्रह्माण्डों में एकरूप से सदा अनुस्यूत रहकर अहो! सबके अस्तित्व और सबके चैतन्य का सम्पूर्ण विधान निरन्तर करते हैं
english_translation: By your grace rising now, we see that just as a string holds together a garland of jewels, similarly all individual beings and all universes remain eternally united and sustained by one continuous order of existence and consciousness.
essence: All existence is eternally connected and sustained like jewels strung on one thread.
simple_meaning: Everything that exists—every being and universe—is connected and continuously sustained like jewels strung on one thread.
insight: It teaches you to sense the invisible unity behind all diversity, feeling connected beyond separation.
modern_relevance: You see how your relationships, work, and life connect in unseen ways, all held together by one steady presence.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
पश्यामस्तरतो गृहेऽपरिमितान् भूयो यथाऽनन्त ! हे
रन्ध्रद्वारनिविष्टसूर्यकिरणस्तोमेष्वणूनां गणान् ।
ब्रह्माण्डानि तथा तरन्ति च विराडदेहाश्रितानि प्रभोनधिन्ते
विपुलेऽमितानि वियति प्रोद्योतयन्ति ह्यमुम् ॥
translation: पुनः हे अनन्त ! जिस प्रकार घर में छिद्ररूप मार्ग से, प्रविष्ट सूर्य किरणों में तैरते हुए अपरिमित अणु समूह को हम देखते हैं उस प्रकार आदि अन्त रहित महाकाश में अनन्त ब्रह्माण्ड समूह आपके विराट देह को आश्रय करके तैर रहे हैं और शोभा को निश्चय ही बढ़ा रहे हैं
english_translation: Again, O infinite one, just as countless atoms float in sun rays entering through holes in a house, similarly, countless universes swim in the infinite space, residing in your cosmic form, surely enhancing its radiance.
essence: Infinite universes reside within the cosmic form, like atoms in sun rays.
simple_meaning: Infinite universes exist within the cosmic form, like countless atoms floating in sun rays through house holes.
insight: It expands your sense of scale, inviting awe at the infinite within and beyond you.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
पश्यामश्च पुनर्वयं तव विरारूपं हि यत्राधना भात्यन्तो
हरितां न चादिरपि तद्देशस्य सन्दश्यते ।
पच्यामश्च पुनर्वयं तब महादेहे महाकौतुकम्
व्याप्तश्वाऽगणितविराड्वपुपि ते सूर्यग्रहोपग्रहैः ॥
translation: हम पुनः देख रहे हैं कि आपका विराटरूप जहां इस समय प्रकाशित हो रहा है उस देश की दिशाओं का न आदि और न अनन्त ही दिखाई देता है। हे महाकाल! हम पुनः आपके विराट् देह में महाकौतुक देख रहे हैं। आपके उस विराट् वपु में अनन्त सूर्य और अनन्त ग्रह उपग्रह द्वारा
english_translation: We see again that your cosmic form illuminates a realm with no beginning or end, filled with countless suns and planets.
essence: The cosmic form reveals an infinite universe filled with countless suns and planets.
simple_meaning: You are showing a vast cosmic form where no direction or end can be seen, filled with countless suns and planets.
insight: It invites you to grasp the infinite complexity beyond everyday perception, expanding your sense of scale and wonder.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सडघात प्रतिघाततः परिणमन् ब्रह्माण्डमाण्डव्रजः
हान्योऽन्यं परमाणुल्पनिचयेऽनन्तो महाकाल है।
जायन्ते परमाणवश्च निखिला ब्रह्माण्डरूपाः पुनः
नानाकारयुताः प्रभो ! बहुविधाः प्रत्येकमेव क्षणम् ॥
translation: परिव्याप्त अनन्त ब्रह्माण्डसमृह आपस के घात प्रतिघात से परमाणुपुञ्ज सम्यक रूप से  परिणत हो रहे हैं और हे प्रभो! कहीं सभी परमाणुपुञ्ज सम्यकय रूप से पुन: घनीभूत होकर
english_translation: The infinite cosmos forms and transforms through countless collisions of atoms; all atoms continuously emerge and dissolve in diverse forms every moment.
essence: The universe is an endless flow of atoms forming and dissolving varied forms every moment.
simple_meaning: The entire universe is constantly changing as atoms collide and recombine, creating endless new forms every moment.
insight: It shifts your view from clinging to permanence toward embracing constant transformation as natural and universal.
modern_relevance: You watch a city skyline change over years, buildings rise and fall, reminding you that nothing truly stays the same.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
नक्षत्रावलिभिश्च नूनमखिलः क्वापि ग्रहोपग्रहैः
सूर्याद्योर्ही समावृताः सुमधनाः सन्तः परीणामतः ।
ब्रह्माण्डव्रजसम्भवक्षयविधिर्यत्र प्रभो ! भासते
काले तस्य न दृश्यते कथमपि त्वादिर्न चान्तः परम् ॥
translation: नक्षत्रसमूह और सूर्यादि अखिल ग्रहोपग्रहो से आवृत अनेक प्रकार के और अनेक आकृति वाले ब्रह्माण्ड रूपों में अनुक्षण ही परिणत हो रहे हैं। परन्तु हे प्रभो! इन ब्रह्माण्डसमूह की उत्पत्ति और लय का कार्य जिस काल में प्रतिभासित होता है उस काल का किसी प्रकार भी न आदि और न अन्त हमें दिखाई पड़ता है
english_translation: Countless cosmic forms, covered by clusters of stars and planets, continually arise and dissolve; yet the time of their creation and destruction shows no beginning or end.
essence: Time contains all change yet itself has no beginning or end.
simple_meaning: Many universes appear and disappear continuously, but the time they happen in has no visible beginning or end.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing change as linear to perceiving time as an endless, unmeasurable flow.
modern_relevance: Watching a clock tick endlessly, you realize moments pass but time itself feels infinite and ungraspable.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सार्द्धञ्चव  विरा्डइनन्तवपुपा प्रोतौतयोस्ते तयोः
नान्तो नादिरवेक्ष्यते किमपि चेद्देशस्य कालस्य च ।
द्रष्टुं तर्हि विराडनन्तपुपः शक्तः कथं कोऽप्यहो
आदि चान्तमशेषतः किमुत वै मूढा वताऽस्मादृशाः ॥
translation: आपके विराट रूप असीम देह के साथ ही ओतप्रोत उन देश और काल का जब आदि और अन्त कुछ भी हमें दिखाई नहीं पड़ता है तब अहो ! आपके विराटरूप असीम देह का आदि और अन्त निःशेषरूप से देखने में कोई भी किस प्रकार समर्थ हो सकता है और हमारे जैसे मूर्खों की तो बात ही क्या है
english_translation: Your cosmic form pervades all space and time, with no beginning or end; how could anyone, especially we fools, fully see its endlessness?
essence: The infinite cosmic form has no boundaries; full comprehension is beyond anyone.
simple_meaning: The divine form fills all space and time without edges or limits, and no one can fully grasp its infinite nature.
insight: This verse shifts your mind to embrace humility before the infinite, opening awareness beyond finite limits.
modern_relevance: Standing beneath a vast night sky, feeling the infinite universe overwhelm your mind, you glimpse how little you can truly grasp.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
भूतस्रष्टरु ! भूतपालक! सदा हे भूतहारिन ! विभो !
अस्माभिनिखिलैरितीक्ष्यत इहानन्तानि भूयोऽपि ते।
ब्रह्माण्डानि पृथक् प्रकट्य प्रकृते: कर्मप्रवाहे पृथक
लीयन्ते प्रकृती स्वयं तव मुहुः सद्यो निविष्टानि च ॥
translation: हे सदा भूतस्रष्टा ! भूतः पालक ! भूतहारी विभो ! हम सब यहां फिर भी यह देखते हैं कि अनन्त ब्रह्माण्डसमूह पृथक पृथक रूप में आपकी प्रकृति से कर्म स्त्रोत में अपने आप ही प्रकट होकर अपने आप ही आपकी प्रकृति में सद्यः प्रवेश करके बारबार लय को प्राप्त होते हैं।
english_translation: O eternal creator, protector, and remover of beings, we see countless universes emerge separately from your nature, then dissolve back into it repeatedly within the flow of natural action.
essence: Countless worlds arise and dissolve repeatedly within the natural flow governed by the divine principle.
simple_meaning: We observe countless universes arising independently from the natural flow of action and dissolving back repeatedly into the original nature.
insight: It shifts your view from fixed outcomes to seeing reality as ongoing cycles of emergence and dissolution within nature's flow.
modern_relevance: You notice how systems around you—like markets or ecosystems—constantly change, emerging and dissolving without your control.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
जायन्ते प्रकृतहि पिण्डनिवहास्ते भूतभावोद्भव
कृद्रूपेण चितो जड़ेन सह यो ग्रन्थिविसर्गेण वै ।
तद्रूपाः परमाणुतो हयगणिताः प्रत्येकतो हि स्वतः
कर्मस्रोतसि ते प्रविश्य प्रकृतौ लीयन्त एवं ततः॥
translation: उसी कर्म स्रोत में अपने आप ही प्रत्येक परमाणु से भूतभावोद्भवकर विसर्ग द्वारा आपकी ही प्रति से चिजडग्रन्धिरूपी अनन्त पिण्ड प्रकट होते हैं और दूसरी ओर अपने आप ही आप की प्रकृति में प्रवेश करके लय को प्राप्त होते हैं
english_translation: From that same source of action, infinite material particles emerge by spontaneous release, each bound by inert knots, then dissolve back into nature.
essence: All forms arise naturally from action and return to nature without your interference.
simple_meaning: Endless forms arise from the flow of action by natural release and then dissolve back into nature on their own.
insight: It shifts your focus from grasping results to witnessing the natural flow of arising and dissolving.
modern_relevance: Like watching bubbles form and pop in a stream, you can see how situations arise and dissolve beyond your control.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
पश्यामश्च भवाननन्तनयनो हे विश्वचक्षुः ! क्रमात
पिण्डौघस्य गति प्रपश्यति सदा ब्रह्माण्डपुञ्जस्य च ।
आकृप्याभिमुखं निजस्य नयने धर्मस्य शक्तया
च तं दृष्ट्वा सर्वपलौकिकं हि चकिता बुद्धिर्न पताशम ॥
translation: हे विश्वचक्षु ! हम लोग पुनः देखते हैं कि आप अनन्त नेत्र होकर पिण्डसमूह और ब्राह्माण्डसमूह की गति को निरन्तर देखते हो और अपनी धर्मशक्ति के द्वारा क्रमशः उनको अपनी ओर आकर्षित करते जाते हो। इस प्रकार के सब चमत्कारों को देखकर हमारी बुद्धि चकित हो रही है ॥
english_translation: O all-seeing one! We see you with infinite eyes constantly observing the movements of the individual and cosmic realms, drawing them toward yourself by the power of your dharma. Witnessing such wonders, our minds are astonished.
essence: A presence with infinite vision observes and draws all worlds, inspiring awe.
simple_meaning: The verse describes a divine presence with infinite vision who continuously watches and draws the movements of individual and cosmic realms, leaving the observer's mind amazed.
insight: It invites you to acknowledge a larger order that quietly guides complex systems beyond your usual awareness.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
पश्याम पुनरप्पनन्ननिखिलब्रह्माण्डपिण्डावले:
श्रोत्रानन्ययुनः शृणोनि सततं भूयो भवान प्रार्थनाम ।
चिच्छतया चितिसंयुताभ विदधना विश्वचेतः क्रमान
सान्निध्यं च यथोचरं निजमहोनस्य दिशन् राजते ॥
translation: हे विश्वचेता ! हम फिर भी देखते हैं कि आप अनन्तकर्ण होकर सब अनन्त ब्रह्माण्ड और सब अनन्त पिण्डो  की प्रार्थना निरन्तर श्रवण करते हैं और चितिशति द्वारा उनको क्रमशः उत्तरोत्तर चेतनायुक्त करते हुए और अहो ! उनको आप अपना सानिध्य देते हुए विराजमान हैं
english_translation: O universal consciousness, you eternally listen to the endless prayers of all infinite worlds, progressively enlivening them with consciousness and graciously granting your presence to each.
essence: Universal consciousness eternally listens and enlivenes all infinite worlds with its presence.
simple_meaning: The universal consciousness listens to endless prayers from all worlds, enlivening them and giving them its presence constantly.
insight: It invites recognizing a continuous, conscious connection between all existence and the supreme awareness, beyond time and space.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
पश्यामश्च भवानन्तरमनायुक्तः मुहत्त्वं गतः
बुद्धे रूपमधिधितो रसमय ! ब्रमाण्डपिण्डावलंः ।
मध्येऽध्यान्मपदे विविच्य परमानन्दान्मकं प्राणिनः
सर्वान दर्शयते गुरो ! निजकृपालेशन लोकाश्रय ! ॥
translation: हे रसमय ! हम पुनः देखते हैं कि आप अनन्त रसनायुक्त होकर ब्रह्माण्डसमूह और अनन्त पिण्डसमूह में  बुद्धिरूप से सुह्रद्भाव में रहकर हे लोकाश्रयगुरो! आप सब प्राणियो को अपने कृपाकण से विवेकपूर्वक परमानन्दमय अध्यात्मपद दिखा देते हो
english_translation: O Rasamaya, you are infinite and inseparable, residing as wisdom within the cosmic and individual universes. You discern and reveal the supreme blissful spiritual state to all beings with compassionate grace, O refuge of the world, O Guru.
essence: Infinite compassionate wisdom reveals supreme blissful truth to every being.
simple_meaning: You exist as infinite wisdom within all things and kindly show every being the highest joyful spiritual state.
insight: It shifts your trust from external certainty to the compassionate unfolding of wisdom within all experience.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by complexity, there's a quiet inner wisdom patiently guiding you toward peace and joy, even if unseen.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
हे तेजोमय ! तेजसाञ्च निवहाना हे खने ! दृश्यत
त्वं स्पर्शेन्द्रियपुज्जकुजनिकरै: स्पृष्ट्वा हानन्तैर्युतः ।
स्वैस्तेजोनिवहैरनन्तगणितब्रह्माण्डपिण्डावर्ली
सर्वा स्वाभिमुखं प्रकृप्य पतनाच्छश्वद्रिभा ! रक्षारी ॥
translation: हे सकल तेजों के खनिरूप तेजोमय ! हम पुन: देखते हैं कि आप अनन्त स्पर्शन्द्रिय समूह से युक्त होकर अगणित और अनन्त ब्रह्माण्ड और पिण्डसमूह को अपने तेजों के द्वारा स्पर्श करके सबको अपनी ओर निरन्तर खींच कर हे विभो ! उनका पतन होने नहीं देते हो
english_translation: O radiant one who is the mine of all light! We see you touching countless worlds and beings with your endless rays, drawing all toward yourself and preventing their fall.
essence: A radiant source continuously upholds and draws countless worlds, preventing their fall.
simple_meaning: The radiant being is described as the source of all light, touching countless worlds with endless rays, drawing them to itself and preventing their downfall.
insight: It shows the sustaining power that connects and supports all things, reminding you of unseen forces holding life together.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
विश्वाधार ! च नामिकाभिरमिताभिस्त्वं युतो दृश्यस
जिघ्रन पुण्यसमूहगन्धममलं ब्रह्माण्डपिण्डावलेः ।
अस्तित्वञ्च विलीनमैव सततं कत्तं हि तस्या निजे
केवल्याभ्युदयौ प्रयच्छसि यथायोग्याधिकारं प्रभो ! ॥
translation: हे विश्वाधार ! हम पुनः देखते हैं कि आप अनन्त नासिकायुक्त होकर ब्रह्माण्ड और पिण्डसमूहक के पुण्य पुञ्ज का शुभ आघ्राण ग्रहण करके उनके अस्तित्व को अपने में ही विलीन करने के लिये हे प्रभो! उनको उनके यथायोग्य अधिकारक अनुसार अभ्युदय और निःश्रेयस निरन्तर प्रदान करते रहते हो
english_translation: O foundation of the universe, you unite with infinite nostrils to inhale the pure fragrance of the cosmos and its bodies of virtue, absorbing their existence into yourself, continuously granting their rise and ultimate good according to their rightful merit.
essence: The cosmic foundation absorbs all pure existence and grants appropriate progress endlessly.
simple_meaning: The universe's foundation continuously absorbs the pure essence of all beings and grants them progress and ultimate good according to what they deserve.
insight: It shows how the universe supports and nurtures all beings impartially based on their rightful merit.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
भावातीत ! विभो ! गदा त्रिगुणतोऽनीन ! प्रमोऽनुसण
मस्मात्पूर्वमलौकिक गुणमयं भावस्वरूपं नव।
रूपं सर्वमनोहरं सुविमलं दशन्द्रियाप्यायक
मस्माकं हि मनो व्यलीयत तदा सम्पश्यतां सत्वरम ॥
translation: हे त्रिगुणातीत ! सदा हे भावातीत ! हे विभो ! हे प्रभो ! इससे पूर्व जब हम दर्शनेन्द्रियो को तृप्त करनेवाले निर्मल और सर्व मनोहर आप के गुणमय और भावमय अलौकिक रूप का दर्शन करते थे तब हमारा मन शीघ्र लयावस्था को प्राप्त हो गया था
english_translation: O transcendental one beyond the three qualities, before this we saw your pure, delightful, and divine form that satisfies the senses; then our mind quickly dissolved in bliss.
essence: Seeing pure divine beauty dissolves the mind into bliss beyond qualities.
simple_meaning: Before this moment, we saw a pure, beautiful form beyond the three qualities that pleased all senses, and our mind quickly dissolved in bliss.
insight: It shows how encountering something truly beautiful and pure can quickly calm and absorb the restless mind.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अद्यत्वे तु विरादस्वरूपममुकं दृष्ट्वा विशालं तव
बुद्धिर्न: स्थगिता च याति चकिताऽवस्थां विलीनां पुनः।
रूपं नः परिदर्शयाध कृपया ह्येवम्विधं स्वं यतः
सान्निध्य भवतामनुक्षणमहो लब्धुं वयञ्चेश्महे ॥
translation: अब तो आपके इस विशाल विराट् स्वरुप का दर्शन करके हमलोगों की बुद्धि भी चकित और थकित होकर लयावस्था को प्राप्त हो रही है। अब कृपा करके आप ऐसे अपने रूप में हमें दर्शन दे कि जिसके अवलम्वन से हम हर समय अहो! आपके सान्निध्य को भी प्राप्त कर सकें
english_translation: Now, seeing your vast cosmic form, our minds grow stunned and exhausted, fading away. Kindly show us your form in a way we can always feel your presence.
essence: Overwhelming presence can exhaust the mind; steady connection needs a gentler form.
simple_meaning: Seeing the vast cosmic form overwhelms and exhausts our minds. We ask to see a form that helps us always feel your presence.
insight: It shows the need to find accessible ways to experience overwhelming realities steadily, not lose oneself in awe.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
हे सर्वेश्वर ! भक्तकल्पलतिकारूप ! प्रभो ! पालक !
रूपेणापि विवर्जितो विभुरहो भव्याय भक्तावलेः ।
भक्तानां प्रकृतिप्रतिजनितां स्वीकृत्य वै प्रार्थनां
कल्याणं सगुणं स्वरूपममितं साध्नोति विभदभवान् ॥
translation: हे सर्वेश्वर! हे भक्तवाञ्छा कल्पतरु! हे प्रभो हे पालक! आप रूपरहित और विभु होने पर भी अहो! अपने भक्तों के कल्याण के लिये उनकी प्रकृति और प्रवृत्ति जनित प्रार्थना को स्वीकार करके ही नाना सगुणरूप धारण करके उनका कल्याण साधन करते हैं
english_translation: O Lord of all, wish-fulfilling tree for devotees, protector! Though formless and vast, you accept the prayers arising from your devotees' nature and take countless forms to bless them.
essence: The formless divine takes many forms to lovingly respond to sincere devotion.
simple_meaning: The divine is beyond form but lovingly accepts devotees' natural prayers and appears in many forms to bless them.
insight: It teaches you to trust that genuine care can take many shapes and that your true expressions are always received.
modern_relevance: When you feel unseen or unheard, this reminds you that your true self is acknowledged and supported in ways beyond your view.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
विभ्राणो रविरूपमेव सवितः! भक्तान भवांस्तेजसा
आकर्षत्यनिशं विभो ! यतितरां कैवल्यभूमौ ध्रुवम ।
हे नारायण ! विष्णुरूपमभितः स्वीकृस चिद्भावतो ।
ब्रमीभावामिमान निरीक्ष्य नयते तेषां क्रमेणोन्नतिम् ॥
translation: हे सवितः! आप ही सूर्य रूप धारण करके तेज द्वारा हे विभो ! भक्तों को कैवल्य भूमि में निरन्तर ही अतिशय आकर्षित करते हैं। हे नारायण ! आप विष्णु रूप धारण करके चिद्भाव द्वारा उनकी क्रमोन्नति का पर्यवेक्षण करके उनको ब्रह्म सभाव प्राप्त कराते हो
english_translation: O Savita, you who take the form of the sun, constantly attract devotees with your light toward the steady land of freedom. O Narayana, taking the form of Vishnu, you oversee their gradual progress through pure consciousness, leading them to the state of Brahman.
essence: A radiant presence steadily draws and guides sincere seekers toward lasting inner freedom.
simple_meaning: The divine appears as radiant light that constantly draws devotees toward steady inner freedom and watches their gradual spiritual progress.
insight: It teaches you to trust the steady, unseen guiding light that supports gradual spiritual progress.
modern_relevance: When you feel pulled by a steady inner light amid life’s chaos, it’s a sign your deeper growth is unfolding, even if slowly.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
देवीरूपमही धरन हि नयते धर्मस्य शक्त्या भवान
सर्वेषां ह नियामकं परपदं हे शक्तिमन ! तान्सदा ।
अस्तित्वस्य विधायकं च बहु सद्भावेन भक्तान्निजान
हे शम्भो ! शिवरूपतो गमयते निःश्रेयसं निर्भयम ॥
translation: हे शक्तिमान् ! अहो ! आप ही देवीरूप धारण करके धर्मशक्ति द्वारा सबके नियामक परमपद में सदा उनको पहुंचा देते हैं। हे शम्भो: आप ही शिवरूप धारण करके सदभाव द्वारा सबके अस्तित्व विधानकारी निर्भय निःश्रेयस पद में अपने भक्तो को अवश्य पहुंचा देते हैं
english_translation: O Shaktiman, you take the form of the divine feminine and by the power of dharma guide everyone to the supreme state. O Shambho, you take the form of Shiva and lead your devotees with goodwill to fearless ultimate freedom.
essence: A loving divine presence guides all to fearless ultimate freedom through many forms.
simple_meaning: The divine takes forms of feminine and Shiva to lovingly guide all beings to their highest fearless freedom.
insight: It teaches you to surrender fear and trust a guiding presence that leads toward true fearless freedom.
modern_relevance: When life feels uncertain and fear grips you, remember a loving force works through many forms to guide you safely to freedom.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
स्वं भक्तांश्च धिया स्वरूपमानिशं सन्दर्य सिद्धेः पते !
दत्ते मुक्तिपदं पर गणपतेधृत्वा स्वरूपं भवान ।
सर्वेषामिह वर्त्तते खलु गुरो ! ह्याद्यो गुरुणां गुरुदेशादस्ति
भवान् हि शश्वदपरिच्छिन्नस्तथा कालत: ॥
translation: और हे सिद्धिपते ! आप ही गणपति का स्वरुप धारण करके बुद्धि द्वारा भक्तों को स्वस्वरूप दिखाकर निरन्तर परममुक्तिपद प्रदान करते हैं । हे गुरो ! इस संसार में आप ही सब गुरुओं के आदिगुरु है क्योकि आप सकल देशकाल से निरन्तर अपरिच्छिन्न
english_translation: O Lord of accomplishment, you embody Ganapati and continuously grant liberation by revealing the true nature to devotees through wisdom. O Guru, you are the original teacher of all gurus, eternally present beyond all realms of time and space.
essence: An eternal teacher reveals your true self and grants continuous liberation beyond time and space.
simple_meaning: You embody Ganapati and continuously show devotees their true nature through wisdom, granting them liberation. You are the original and eternal teacher of all teachers.
insight: This verse invites you to recognize and trust the continuous presence of a guiding wisdom that reveals your true nature and grants liberation.
modern_relevance: When you feel lost or alone in your search for meaning, remember there is an ever-present guide who reveals your true self and leads you to lasting freedom.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
त्वं सर्वादिगुरुविभासि सकलालज्ञानस्वरूपे
सदा आदायपिंगणा वयं तव विभो ! ज्ञानाधिविमुइलवमः ।
ब्रह्माण्डेषु प्रवाहयाम इह वै ज्ञानप्रवाहं तथा
सर्वप्वत्र विचक्षणा द्विजगणाः स्नात्वैव मुक्ति ययुः ॥
translation: और सर्वादिगुरु होकर ज्ञानस्वरूप में सदा विराजमान रहते हैं और सब ब्रह्माण्डों में हम ऋषिगण हे विभो ! आपके ही ज्ञानसागर की विप्रट कणिका को लेकर ज्ञान स्रोत को इस विश्व में प्रवाहित करते है। इसमें विद्वान् ब्राह्मणगण स्नान करके ही मुक्ति को प्राप्त हुए है
english_translation: You are the original teacher, always shining as pure knowledge. We, the sages, carry a particle of your wisdom and spread the flow of knowledge across the cosmos. Wise Brahmins attain freedom through purification in this stream.
essence: Wisdom flows from the divine through sages, guiding the wise to freedom.
simple_meaning: The divine is the original source of all knowledge. Sages carry a spark of this wisdom and spread it through the world. Wise ones achieve freedom by immersing themselves in this knowledge.
insight: Recognize that wisdom is a shared flow originating beyond yourself; purification and dedication enable access to freedom.
modern_relevance: You might feel inspired by mentors or teachers who ignite your understanding, helping you share wisdom that transforms others and yourself.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
धारोत्पद्य हि देवनायक ! विभो ! सर्गस्थितिध्वंमकृ
द्विश्वव्यापककर्मणोऽपि भवतस्त्वय्येव संलीव्रते ।
सर्वे देवगणाः सदैव भवतामङ्गीभवन्तो मुदा
प्रत्येकं जानिरक्षणक्षयविर्धे ब्रह्माण्डपुञ्जेऽनिशम् ॥
translation: हे देवनायक विभो ! सृष्टि स्थिति प्रलय कारिणी विश्व व्यापक कर्म की धारा आप से उत्पन्न होकर भी आप में ही विलीन होती है और सब देवतागण सदा आपके ही अङ्गरूप होकर अहो ! प्रत्येक ब्रह्माण्डों में प्रसन्नता से
english_translation: O divine leader, the cosmic cycle of creation, maintenance, and destruction arises from you and dissolves back into you; all divine beings always exist as your parts, joyfully pervading every universe.
essence: All cosmic actions arise from and merge back into the one source, whose parts joyfully pervade all universes.
simple_meaning: The endless cycle of creation, preservation, and destruction arises from and merges back into the divine source. All divine beings exist as parts of this source, joyfully present in every universe.
insight: It invites you to see all change as expressions of one underlying source, dissolving separation and fostering unity.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सामञ्जस्यमहो प्रभो ! विदधते कर्मव्यवस्थारताः
उद्भित्स्वेदजरायुजाण्डजगणा भूतत्रजाः सन्ति ये।
सर्व ते च चतुर्विधा हि मनुजानां हे प्रजानां पते !
देवानां त्रिविधास्ताऽसुरगणानां ये च लोका अहो ॥
translation: कर्म की व्यवस्था अहर्निश करते हुए हे प्रभो! सृष्टि स्थिति और लय की व्यवस्था का सामञ्जस्य विधान करते हैं। हे प्रजापते ! उद्भिज स्वदेज अण्डज और जरायुज समूह रूपी जो चतुर्विधभूत सङ्घ है वह सब और अहो! जो दैवी मानवी और आसुरीरूपी त्रिविध लोक सृष्टियाँ हैं
english_translation: O Lord, those engaged day and night in the order of action also govern the harmony of creation, maintenance, and dissolution. O Lord of creatures, all beings born from plants, sweat, eggs, and wombs form fourfold groups. These include the threefold worlds of divine, human, and shadow beings.
essence: The universe is sustained by continuous action balancing creation, maintenance, and destruction across many beings.
simple_meaning: Those who manage all actions continuously also maintain the balance of creation, existence, and destruction. All beings come in four types born from nature, and they belong to three worlds: divine, human, and shadow.
insight: Understand that life and the universe operate through continuous, interconnected cycles involving diverse beings and realms.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
त्वत्तो बुबुदवन्महार्णव इह त्वय्येव प्रोद्भय ते लीयन्ते
पितरोऽपि शक्तिमतुलां त्वत्तो गृहीत्वैव च ।
कृत्वा मर्त्यगणोन्नति क्रमगतां साहाय्यमातन्वते
भूतौघस्य चतुर्विधस्य नियमे लोकव्रजस्याप्यलम् ॥
translation: वे सब महासमुद्र में बुद्धवत् आप से ही यहां उत्पन्न होकर आप में ही लय को प्राप्त होती हैं और पितृगण आप से ही अतुल शक्ति को लेकर मनुष्यों की क्रमोनन्ति विधान करके चतुर्विधभूतसङ्घ और लोकसमूह की व्यवस्था में भलीभांति सहायता करते हैं
english_translation: All beings arise from you like the vast ocean, and into you they return; the ancestors draw immense power from you to guide humans’ progress and uphold the order of the fourfold beings and the world’s cycles.
essence: All life flows from and returns to a vast source that sustains cosmic order.
simple_meaning: Everything emerges from you like a great ocean and returns to you. The ancestors take great power from you to help humans grow and keep the world’s order.
insight: It shows how unseen forces continuously support growth and balance in life’s complex systems.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
तत्त्वेभ्योऽपि भवानतीतविभवो नूनं चतुर्विशते
यद्यप्यस्ति तथापि धीश ! नु महत्तत्त्वेऽन्तिमे प्राणिनः।
नित्योऽनिर्वचनो विकाररहितो ज्ञानस्य शक्तया स्थितः
सर्वानभ्युदयस्य दर्शयति वै मोक्षस्य मार्ग तथा ॥
translation: हे धीश ! यद्यपि चतुर्विंशति तत्व से भी अतीत विभव ही आप हो तथापि आप अन्तिम तत्व बुद्धि में ज्ञानशक्ति रूप से अविकारी अनिर्वचनीय और नित्य स्थित रहकर जीवमात्र को अभ्युदय और निःश्रेयस का मार्ग प्रदर्शन कराते हो
english_translation: O wise one, though you surpass even the twenty-four principles, you remain the final principle—unchanging, eternal, and indescribable, established in the power of knowledge, showing all beings the path of growth and ultimate freedom.
essence: An unchanging, indescribable wisdom beyond all principles guides every being toward liberation.
simple_meaning: You are beyond many principles yet remain the final, eternal truth that guides all beings toward growth and freedom.
insight: It invites shifting focus from transient details to the underlying eternal wisdom that directs growth and freedom.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by complex systems or endless rules, remember there is a simple, unchanging wisdom guiding your true progress.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
ये स्वातन्त्र्यमदेन मोहिततमा जीवाः प्रमादेन वे
मूढ़ा ज्ञाननिधेस्तवेङ्गितमहो निसं तिरस्कुर्वते ।
भ्रान्ता दुःखदजन्ममृत्युगहने संसारचक्रे ध्रुवम
शंयोरभ्युदयाध्वनो हि पतिता दुःखान्यलं भुञ्जते ॥
translation: स्वाधीनता के मद से विमोहित जो मूढ़ जीव प्रमाद वश ही ज्ञाननिधि आपके इङ्गित की अहो ! नित्य अवहेलना करते हैं वह अवश्य कल्याणकारी अभ्युदय के मार्ग से व्युत होकर ही दुःखदायी जन्म मृत्युओ के गहन संसारचक्र मे अतिशय घूर्णायमान होकर दुःख भोगते रहते हैं
english_translation: Those fools, intoxicated by their sense of independence, ignorantly scorn the wisdom you indicate. Lost in error, they stray from the path of true well-being and suffer endlessly in the painful cycle of birth and death.
essence: Pride in independence blinds you, causing endless suffering away from true well-being.
simple_meaning: Some beings, proud and unaware, ignore true wisdom and suffer repeatedly in the cycle of life and death.
insight: Recognize that pride can blind you to valuable guidance, prolonging unnecessary suffering.
modern_relevance: You might dismiss advice or insight out of pride, only to find yourself stuck repeating painful patterns again and again.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
भर्गो विश्वसमर्चितं यदिह ते ह्यास्ते दयासागर !
तन्नो बुद्धिमहर्निशं गणपते ! शक्तचा स्वया सत्वरम ।
संरक्ष्यासत एव कर्मनिवहात् सत्कर्मणि प्रेरयेत्
सियाऽलङ्कृतवामपार्श्व ! भगवस्त्वां सन्नमामो वयमा ॥
translation: हे दयासागर! आपका ही जो इस संसार में जगत्पूज्य भर्ग (तेज) है वह हे सिद्धिदेवी से अलङ्कतवाम पार्श्व भगवन् गणपते ! हमारी बुद्धि को अपनी शक्ति के द्वारा असत् कर्म समूह से बचाकर सत्कर्म में शीघ्र प्रेरणा करे। आपको हम अनन्यभाव से प्रणाम करते हैं
english_translation: O ocean of compassion! The radiant energy worshipped by the world is yours. O Ganapati, adorned by the goddess of accomplishment, protect my intellect swiftly with your power from unwholesome actions and inspire me toward right actions. We bow to you with devoted hearts.
essence: Asking for inner protection and swift guidance helps your mind stay on the right path.
simple_meaning: You can pray for your mind to be protected from harmful impulses and inspired toward good actions by a higher compassionate power.
insight: It teaches you to seek and rely on protective inner strength to keep your mind focused on positive, skillful actions.
modern_relevance: When your thoughts spiral into negativity, you can silently ask for inner strength to protect your mind and guide you toward constructive choices.
speaker: Devotees

verse_text:
उक्त्वर्पयस्तस्थुरिति क्षणं ते रोमाञ्चिता गद्गदकण्ठशब्दाः।
सानन्दजाताश्रुमुखाः स्थिराश्च विहस्य धीशो मधुरं तदोचे ॥
translation: इतना कहकर वे ऋषिगण कुछ देर तक आनन्दाश्रयुक्त मुख गद्र गदकंठस्वर रोमाञ्चित और निःस्तब्ध होकर रहे। तदनन्तर भगवान् गणपति जी ने मुस्कराकर मधुर स्वर से कहा
english_translation: After speaking thus, the sages stood still for a moment, their hair standing on end, voices trembling with emotion, faces filled with joyful tears; then the divine spoke sweetly with a smile.
essence: Profound teaching can evoke silent awe and joyful reverence before continuing.
simple_meaning: The sages reacted deeply with joy and silence after hearing the teaching, then the divine spoke kindly with a smile.
insight: It shows how powerful teaching can create a moment of silent awe and heartfelt connection before continuing conversation.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
दशायां योगयुक्तायां रूपं मे सगुणं द्विजाः !।
आत्मयुक्तदशायाञ्च विराटरूपं महाद्भुतम् ॥
translation: हे भक्त द्विजगण ! योगयुक्त अवस्था में मेरा सगुणरूप, आत्मयुक्त अवस्था में मेरा महदद्भुत विराटरूप और
english_translation: O devoted twice-born ones! In the state united with yoga, my form is with qualities; in the state united with the true self, I reveal a magnificent, cosmic form.
essence: Devotion reveals the divine both as a personal form and as an infinite cosmic presence.
simple_meaning: When you unite with focused devotion, you perceive the divine's gentle form. When you unite with your true self deeply, you perceive the divine's vast cosmic form.
insight: It teaches you to embrace devotion both as a personal relationship and as recognition of the vastness within all.
modern_relevance: When your heart is open in love, you see the familiar in others; when you connect deeply with yourself, you sense a vast, shared existence beyond appearances.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
कर्मयुक्तदशायान्तु ममोपास्तौ सहायकम् ।
मद्विभूतिमयं रूपं भक्ताः ! स्याच्छ्रतिरित्यहो! ॥
translation: कर्मयुक्त अवस्था में मेरा विभूतिमय रूप मेरी उपासना में सहायक होता है। अहो ! यही श्रुति है
english_translation: In the state of being engaged in selfless action, my divine form of manifestations assists in your worship. This is what the sacred teaching declares.
essence: Devoted action invites the divine form to support and empower your worship.
simple_meaning: When you engage in action with devotion, the divine manifestations help support your worship and efforts.
insight: It shifts focus to seeing your devoted actions as supported and strengthened by a higher presence, making effort feel less alone.
modern_relevance: When you put your heart into your work or care, you sense an encouraging presence helping you along.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
स्वाधीनः प्राकृतश्चैव विविधो जीव ईरितः।
गजोऽहं प्राकृते जीव स्वाधीने मानवस्तथा ॥
translation: जीव प्राकृत और स्वाधीनरूप से दो प्रकार का कहा गया है। प्राकृत जीवों में मैं हस्ती हूँ और स्वाधीन जीवों  में मैं मनुष्य हूँ
english_translation: Living beings are of two kinds: natural and self-governed. Among natural beings, I am the elephant; among self-governed beings, I am the human.
essence: Living beings differ by nature and self-governance, represented by elephant and human.
simple_meaning: Living beings exist mainly as natural or self-governed types. Among natural beings is the elephant; among self-governed beings is the human.
insight: It shifts perspective to see some beings as naturally driven and others as capable of self-direction or choice.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अतोऽहं भक्तवृन्देभ्यो मर्त्यदहो गजाननः।
दर्शन एवं प्रयच्यामि प्रादुर्भूय निरन्तरम् ॥
translation: इसी कारण हस्ती के सदृश मुख और मनुष्य सदृश शरीर होकर मैं  भक्तों को निरन्तर प्रकट होकर अपना दर्शन देता हूँ
english_translation: Therefore, with an elephant-like face and a human-like body, I continuously manifest before my devotees to grant them my vision.
essence: The divine appears in forms meaningful to devotees to reveal itself continuously.
simple_meaning: The divine takes a special form like an elephant-headed being and appears constantly to those who love and trust it.
insight: It invites you to recognize the divine’s personal presence as a source of comfort and connection.
modern_relevance: When you feel unseen or alone, remember that the divine can appear in forms and ways just for you, offering guidance and presence.
speaker: Elephant-faced Deva

verse_text:
राजयोगोऽस्मि योगानामहमेवंविधोऽपि सन।
चतुर्विधेषु ध्यानेषु पञ्चोपास्तेरहं ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: मैं योग में राजयोग हूँ परन्तु हे द्विजश्रेष्ठो ! ऐसा होकर भी मैं चतुर्विध ध्यानों में से पञ्चोपासना के
english_translation: Among yogas, I am the royal yoga; yet among the four types of meditation, I am surely the fifth worship.
essence: The highest yoga transcends known meditation forms into a supreme fifth devotion.
simple_meaning: There are many yogas and meditations, but the highest is the royal yoga, and beyond four meditations, there is a supreme fifth form of worship.
insight: It shifts your view from following fixed methods to embracing a supreme, all-encompassing devotion beyond techniques.
modern_relevance: When you think you have mastered one method, there's always a deeper, richer way to connect and grow beyond what you knew.
speaker: श्रीभगवान्

verse_text:
पञ्चध्यानयुतं स्थूल-ध्यानमास्मि द्विजोत्तमाः ।
नैवात्र संशयः कश्चित् सत्यं सत्यं ब्रवीमि वः ॥
translation: पाँच ध्यान युक्त स्थूल ध्यान ही हूँ इसमें कुछ सन्देह नहीं है मैं आपलोगो से सत्य सत्य कहता हूँ
english_translation: O best of the twice-born, I am the gross meditation combined with the fivefold meditations; there is no doubt in this. Truly, I speak to you the truth.
essence: Deep, layered meditation embodies undeniable truth without any doubt.
simple_meaning: Meditation that includes five layers is the gross form I embody, and this truth is certain without doubt.
insight: It encourages you to embrace meditation as a trustworthy path to clarity and certainty.
modern_relevance: When you focus deeply on your practice with many layers, you realize some truths become undeniable and clear.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
नरेषु नरनाथोऽस्मि राज्ये तु सचिवाभिधः।
मन्त्रिणां मण्डलं यस्माज्ञानस्यास्ते सहायकम् ॥
translation: नरों में मैं राजा हूँ परन्तु राज्य में मैं मन्त्रीरूप हूँ क्योकि मंत्रिमण्डल ज्ञान सहायक है
english_translation: Among men, I am king; in the kingdom, I am called the minister because the council of ministers aids knowledge.
essence: True leadership acknowledges the power of those who assist knowledge.
simple_meaning: I am the king among people, but in the kingdom, I am called a minister because the council of ministers supports knowledge.
insight: It teaches you to recognize leadership also means honoring those who support your wisdom and decisions.
modern_relevance: You might lead a team but rely on advisors to guide important decisions and bring insight.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
शक्तिष्वहं देवशक्तिरीदृशोऽहन्तु सन्नपि ।
लौकिक शक्तिपुञ्जेऽस्मि सशक्तिमहर्षयः॥
translation: शक्तियों में मैं दैवी शक्ति हूँ परन्तु ऐसा होकर भी हे महर्षियो! मैं लौकिक शक्तियो में मै सङ्घशक्ति हूँ
english_translation: Among powers, I am the divine power, yet among worldly powers, I am the collective power.
essence: The true self is both the highest divine power and the collective worldly force.
simple_meaning: The true self is the divine power beyond all, yet also present as the sum of worldly forces.
insight: It shifts your view to recognize the self as both transcendent essence and active worldly presence simultaneously.
modern_relevance: When you face challenges, you are not just one force but a combination of deep inner strength and practical worldly power working together.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
आध्यात्मिक्याधिदैव्याधिभौतिक्यः शक्तयोऽखिलाः ।
सङ्घशक्तौ प्रकाशन्ते स्वयमेव यतो ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: क्योंकि संघ शक्ति में आध्यात्मिक आधिदैविक और आधिभौतिक इन तीनों शक्तियों का विकास अपने आप ही अवश्य हो जाता है।
english_translation: Because in collective power, spiritual, divine, and physical energies naturally develop inevitably on their own.
essence: Collective strength naturally brings together spiritual, divine, and physical powers effortlessly.
simple_meaning: Spiritual, divine, and physical energies naturally emerge and grow together within collective strength.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that combining different energies leads to spontaneous growth without forced effort.
modern_relevance: When you collaborate with others, your combined efforts spark growth in many unseen ways naturally and automatically.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
वर्णेषु ब्राह्मणश्चाहमाश्रमेवान्तिमाश्रमः।
वृद्धत्त्वेनैव पृज्येषु सर्ववृद्धेप्वहं द्विजाः ॥
translation: मैं वर्णों में ब्राह्मण हूँ और आश्रमों में मैं सन्यासाश्रम हूँ । हे ब्राह्मणो ! वृद्धत्वरूप से पूजनीय सब प्रकार के वृद्धों में
english_translation: Among the classes, I am the Brahmin; among the stages of life, I am the renounced stage. O Brahmins, among all who are venerable, I am the elder honored for age.
essence: The divine represents the highest wisdom and renunciation among castes and life stages.
simple_meaning: The divine identifies as the highest in caste and stage: the wise Brahmin and the renounced elder respected for age.
insight: It teaches to see the highest value in inner wisdom and mature renunciation beyond social roles.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सर्वथा ज्ञानवद्रोऽस्मि नात्र कार्य्या विचारणा ।
अध्यात्मलक्ष्यसंयुक्त आर्योंऽहं मानवेपु च ॥
translation: सर्वथा में ज्ञानवृद्ध ही है; इसमें कुछ विचार न करो और मनुष्यश्रेणी में मैं अध्यात्म लक्ष्य युक्त आर्य हूँ
english_translation: I am entirely a knower of knowledge; do not doubt this. Among humans, I am an honorable one united with the goal of spiritual realization.
essence: You are already fully connected to true knowledge and spiritual purpose.
simple_meaning: You are fully knowledgeable and connected to your spiritual goal. There is no need to doubt this truth about yourself.
insight: It teaches you to trust your inner knowledge without second-guessing or overthinking.
modern_relevance: When you hesitate before a big decision, remember your inner wisdom already holds the answers you need.
speaker: Shri Dheesh

verse_text:
भक्तेषु ज्ञानिभक्तोऽस्मि वेदानां सामनामकः।
किन्तु वेदविभागेपनिषद्रुपभागहम् ॥
translation: भक्तगण में मैं ज्ञानीभक्त हूँ। वेदों के बीच में मैं सामवेद हूँ किन्तु वेदविभागों में उपनिषद हूँ
english_translation: Among devotees, I am a wise devotee; among the Vedas, I am the Sama Veda; among the divisions of the Vedas, I am the Upanishads.
essence: Devoted love and deep wisdom can coexist harmoniously within you.
simple_meaning: You can be a devoted person who is also wise. Among sacred teachings, some are songs, others deep philosophy; you can embody both.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that devotion and wisdom are complementary, not opposing, qualities you can integrate.
modern_relevance: You might feel torn between your emotional commitments and intellectual pursuits, but you can hold both with equal authenticity.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
मन्याहारञ्च  योगानामद्रेप्स्मि परन्व्ह्म।
समधिर्निवीकाल्योऽपि निखिलेषु समाधिषु ॥
translation: योग के अंगों में मैं प्रत्याहार हूँ परन्तु सब समाधियों में मैं निर्विकल्प समाधि हूँ
english_translation: Among the limbs of yoga, I am withdrawal of the senses; among all types of samadhi, I am the undivided, formless absorption.
essence: True self is the undivided stillness beyond all sensory withdrawal and mental states.
simple_meaning: You represent the yogic practice of withdrawing the senses, and at the deepest level, you are the pure, undivided state of complete inner stillness.
insight: It shifts your focus from scattered senses to the unified stillness that underlies all experience.
modern_relevance: When distractions pull your attention in every direction, remember your true nature is quiet, unified, and untouched by the chaos.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
मन्त्रयोगेषु मन्त्राऽम्मि प्राणायामो हठे द्विजाः ।
लयप्रिया नयेयोगे राज्योगे विवेचनम ॥
translation: हे ब्राह्मणों ! मन्त्रयोग में मैं मन्त्र हूँ, हठयोग में मैं प्राणायाम हूँ, लययोग में मैं लयक्रिया हूँ और राजयोग में मैं विवेचन हूँ
english_translation: O Brahmins, in mantra yoga I am the mantra, in hatha yoga I am the breath control, in laya yoga I am the absorption practice, and in raja yoga I am the discernment.
essence: The core power behind all yogas is one essence expressed differently in practice.
simple_meaning: Each form of yoga has a core practice, and you can embody that essence: mantra in mantra yoga, breath control in hatha yoga, absorption in laya yoga, and clear seeing in raja yoga.
insight: Recognize that diverse spiritual practices share a common essence you can directly experience through focused engagement.
modern_relevance: When you practice meditation, breathwork, or reflection, you are connecting with the core energy of ancient yogas, uniting diverse techniques through their shared essence.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
ब्रह्मदानञ्च दानेषु तपस्यास यमस्तथा ।
ज्ञानप्रकाशकन्वाञ्च  कर्मयज्ञेषु भो द्विजा: ॥
translation: हे ब्राह्मणों ! दानधर्म में मैं ब्रह्मदान हूँ, तपधर्म में मैं यम हूँ, कर्मयज्ञ में ज्ञानप्रकाशक होने से
english_translation: O Brahmins! Among donations, I am the gift of the supreme reality; among disciplines, I am restraint; among sacrificial actions, I am the illumination of wisdom.
essence: The highest gift, discipline, and action are rooted in truth, restraint, and wisdom respectively.
simple_meaning: Among all gifts, the highest is giving the supreme reality. Among disciplines, restraint is the best. Among actions done as sacrifice, wisdom shining through is the most important.
