insight: This verse shifts focus from external acts to the inner quality that makes actions sacred: wisdom and self-restraint.
modern_relevance: When you share your deepest truth, control impulses calmly, and act with clear insight, your efforts become meaningful beyond effort alone.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
नित्यकर्म्मास्महं नून नात्र कचिद्विवेचना ।
उपस्तियज्ञज्ञानेषु पराभक्तया समन्विता  ॥
translation: नित्य कर्म ही  हूँ  इसमें कोई विवचना नहीं है । हे विज्ञ ब्राह्मण श्रेष्ठो ! उपासना यज्ञों मे
english_translation: I am the constant action itself; there is no question about it. O learned Brahmin, worship and sacrifices are inseparable from devoted knowledge.
essence: You are inseparable from constant action united with devoted knowledge and worship.
simple_meaning: You are always engaged in action combined with devoted knowledge; this is a fundamental truth without question.
insight: It shifts your view from separating action and devotion to seeing them as one seamless whole.
modern_relevance: You move through your daily tasks not as separate from purpose or devotion, but as a living expression of both.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
ब्रहमोपास्तिरह्यो विज्ञा अस्महं ब्राह्मणोंत्मा: !।
मननं ज्ञानयज्ञेषु महायज्ञेप्वकं  तथा ॥
translation: मैं अहो ! पराभक्तियुक्त ब्रहमोपासना हूँ , ज्ञानयज्ञों में मैं मनन हूँ और
english_translation: I am the supreme devotion-filled worship of Brahman, the reflection in acts of wisdom and the essence of the great sacrifice.
essence: Devotion is the living force at the heart of true worship and wise reflection.
simple_meaning: The deepest form of devotion is what powers true worship and thoughtful wisdom, uniting action with inner dedication.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing devotion as only emotion to understanding it as the energizing source of wise, meaningful action.
modern_relevance: When you focus deeply on your work or study with heartfelt commitment, that devotion transforms ordinary effort into something meaningful and wise.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
ब्रह्मयज्ञोऽमि प्रयाग भी विप्रा: ! सर्वयज्ञशिरोमणिः ।
वृक्ताऽरम्यहं सभामध्ये  आचार्य: शिक्षकेषु च ॥
translation: हे विप्रों ! महायज्ञों में मैं सर्वयज्ञ शिरोमणि ब्रह्मयज्ञ हूँ। सभा के बीच में मैं वक्ता हूँ और शिक्षकों के बीच में आचार्य हूँ
english_translation: O learned ones! Among great sacrifices, I am the supreme sacrifice of Brahman. In the assembly, I am the speaker, and among teachers, I am the preceptor.
essence: The speaker claims to be the highest sacrifice and leader among teachers.
simple_meaning: I am the highest of all sacrifices among great rituals. In gatherings, I speak, and among teachers, I lead as a guide.
insight: It encourages embracing your highest role confidently when among peers or experts.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
उपदेशकवृन्देषु जगत्ययोऽम्यहं गुरुः ।
आत्माऽमस्मि भो विप्रा: ! भृतवृन्देप्ववस्थितः ॥
translation: उपदेशकों के बीच मैं जगत्पूज्य गुरु हूँ। हे विप्रो ! भूतगण के अन्तर में अवस्थितम मैं आत्मा हूँ
english_translation: Among the teachers, I am the revered guru of the world. O wise one, I am the true self present within all beings.
essence: The true self is the highest teacher present within all beings and teachers.
simple_meaning: The true self is the supreme presence found within all beings and is honored as the highest teacher.
insight: Recognize your connection to the true self within all beings, shifting identity from isolated self to shared presence.
modern_relevance: When you feel separate or lost, remember that the same true self connects you to everyone and every teacher around you.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
प्राणिपुञ्जेषु चैतन्यमहमेव न संशयः ।
नादः शब्दसमूहेषु वाक्येप्योङ्कार एव च ॥
translation: सब प्राणियों में मैं ही निःसन्देह चेतना रूप हैं। मैं शब्दसमूह में नाद और वाक्यसमूह में ओंकार ही हूँ
english_translation: I am undoubtedly the consciousness in all living beings; in sounds, I am the primal vibration and the sacred syllable.
essence: Your true self is the universal consciousness and sacred vibration in all life and sound.
simple_meaning: You are the consciousness present in all living things and the sacred vibration that underlies all sounds.
insight: Recognize your true self as the universal consciousness and sacred essence behind all existence, beyond individual form.
modern_relevance: When you feel separate or alone, remember you share the same awareness and sacred vibration with all life and every sound you hear.
speaker: Shri Dheesh

verse_text:
इन्द्रोऽहं देववृन्देषु भृगुरस्मि  महर्षिषु ।
यमो नियामकेप्वस्मि पितृमध्येऽर्यमाभिधः ॥
translation: मैं देवताओं में इन्द्र, महर्षियों में भृगु, पितरों में  अर्यमा और नियामकों में यम हूँ
english_translation: Among the deities, I am Indra; among the great sages, I am Bhrigu; among the ancestors, I am Aryama; and among the regulators, I am Yama.
essence: The true self manifests uniquely in every noble and guiding role.
simple_meaning: The true self expresses itself as powerful figures in different spheres: as leader among deities, sage among seers, noble among ancestors, and regulator among enforcers.
insight: It teaches you to recognize your inner power as diverse and present in many roles you play.
modern_relevance: In your life, you wear many hats—leader, wise friend, respected family member, and rule keeper—each reflecting a part of your true strength.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
असुरेषु बलिर्यज्ञो जाहव्यस्मि सरित्सु च।
जलाशयेषु सर्वेषु सागरोऽस्मि न संशयः ॥
translation: असुरो में मुझको बलि जानो, मैं सरिताओं में जाहनवी और सब जलाशयों में निःसन्देह सागर हूँ
english_translation: Among the shadowed beings, I am the sacrifice; among rivers, I am the Ganges; among all water bodies, I am surely the ocean.
essence: You are the power behind every sacrifice and the vastness in every water.
simple_meaning: You are the essence present in every sacrifice, river, and ocean—powerful and all-pervading.
insight: It shifts your view to see every action and environment as infused with a deeper, unifying power.
modern_relevance: When you face challenges or feel small, remember you hold the power behind every effort and the vastness that connects all things.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
पुष्पमानन्ददेवस्मि पदार्थेषु महार्षयः!
पवित्रं परमं विप्राः ! तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम् ॥
translation: हे महर्षिगण आनन्दप्रद पदार्थों में मैं पुष्प हूँ। हे विप्रो! तेजस्वियों में मैं परम पवित्र तेजरूप हूँ
english_translation: O great sages, among blissful substances I am the flower; among the wise, I am the supreme pure light.
essence: True brilliance and purity stand out like a flower and a supreme light.
simple_meaning: Among all joyful things, you are like the most beautiful flower; among wise people, you are the purest bright light.
insight: Recognize your own inner brightness and purity as a unique strength among others.
modern_relevance: When you feel ordinary in a crowd, remember your unique light and purity that shines quietly yet powerfully.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
बलं बलवत्तामस्मि कामरागविवर्जितम्।
धर्माविरुद्धो भूतेषु कामोऽस्मि जननाय च ॥
translation: बलवानों में मैं कामरागविवर्जित बल हूँ और उत्पत्ति के लिये प्राणियों में मैं धर्म विरुद्ध काम हूँ
english_translation: Among the powerful, I am the strength free from desire and attachment; among beings, I am desire opposed to dharma that causes birth.
essence: True strength is freedom from desire; craving opposes right purpose and causes rebirth.
simple_meaning: True strength is acting without desire or craving. Desire that opposes right purpose causes repeated birth.
insight: It teaches you to see strength as freedom from craving, not mere force or control.
modern_relevance: You’ve felt powerful when your actions come from clear purpose, not from craving or neediness.
speaker: Shri Dheesh

verse_text:
विद्यास्वध्यात्मविद्याऽस्मि विद्वांसो ब्राह्मणोत्तमाः!।
सत्यमकाशकश्चास्मि वादो वादिगणेप्वहम् ॥
translation: हे विद्वान् विप्रवरो ! मैं विद्यासमूह में अध्यात्मविद्या हूँ और वादिगण में मैं सत्य प्रकाशक वाद हूँ
english_translation: O noble scholar! Among all knowledge, I am the knowledge of the self, and among debates, I am the truth-revealing argument.
essence: True knowledge and powerful argument come from understanding the self and revealing truth.
simple_meaning: The highest form of knowledge is understanding the true self, and the strongest argument reveals truth clearly.
insight: It teaches you to prioritize self-awareness and honest truth over surface arguments or external knowledge.
modern_relevance: When you face conflicting opinions or confusion, grounding yourself in your true nature and valuing truth can guide you steadily.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
नारीप्वहं तपोरूपो यज्ञरूपों नरेषु च।
गुणत्रयेष्वहं विप्राः ! गुणाः सत्त्वाभिधानकः ॥
translation: स्त्रियों में मैं तपोरूप हूँ और परुषों में मैं यज्ञ रूप हूँ । हे विप्रों ! मैं त्रिगुण में सत्वगुण हूँ
english_translation: Among women, I am the form of disciplined effort; among men, I am the form of sacred action; and among the three qualities, I am the quality called goodness, O learned ones.
essence: The divine expresses as effort, action, and goodness across different roles and qualities.
simple_meaning: The divine expresses itself differently: as disciplined effort in women, sacred action in men, and as the quality of goodness among the three qualities.
insight: It teaches you to see the divine qualities expressed uniquely in your character and actions, transcending gender or surface differences.
modern_relevance: You notice how your steady effort, purposeful actions, and wholesome nature shape who you really are, beyond labels or roles.
speaker: Shri Dheesh

verse_text:
भावत्रयेऽध्यात्मभावः शीलेषु विनयोऽस्म्यहम् ।
सदाचारेषु वृद्धानां प्रणतिः पादपद्मयोः ॥
translation: त्रिभावों में मैं अध्यात्मभाव हूँ, मैं शील में विनय और सदाचारो में वृद्धो के चरणकमलों में प्रणामरूप हूँ।
english_translation: Among the three attitudes, I am the spiritual attitude; in virtues, I am humility; in good conduct, I am the respectful bow at the feet of the elders.
essence: Humility and respect for elders reveal the spiritual attitude in your virtues and conduct.
simple_meaning: Among different attitudes, the spiritual attitude is humility; in virtues, it is modesty; in good conduct, it is showing respect to elders.
insight: It teaches you to recognize humility and respect as expressions of your highest inner attitude, shaping your character and behavior.
modern_relevance: You pause to listen carefully and respectfully to someone wiser, feeling the strength of humility in a world that often demands loudness.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
कारणब्रह्मरूपेण हयेकोऽद्वैतोऽप्यहं द्विजाः।
अनन्तोऽस्मि महाविज्ञाः ! सैत्यमेतन संशयः ॥
translation: हे महाविज्ञ ब्राह्मणो! में कारणब्रह्मरूप से एक अद्वितीय होकर भी अनन्त हूँ यह सत्य है. सन्देह नहीं  है
english_translation: O great knower among brahmins! Though I am one without a second as the cause Brahman, I am infinite; this truth has no doubt.
essence: You are uniquely one and infinite simultaneously without any doubt.
simple_meaning: You are fundamentally one and unique, yet infinite; this is an unquestionable truth.
insight: It shifts perception from seeing yourself as limited and separate to recognizing your boundless unity and uniqueness.
modern_relevance: When you feel small or fragmented, remember your true self is both unique and endlessly vast beyond any doubt.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अनन्तत्वात्संख्यया मे कार्यब्रह्मस्वरूपतः।
सङ्खयातुं नैव शक्नोति विभूतीः कश्चिदप्यहो॥
translation: कार्यब्रह्मरूप से संख्या से अनन्त होने के कारण मेरी विभूतियों की अहो ! कोई भी संख्या नहीं कर सकता।
english_translation: Because the divine is infinite and the nature of action is absolute, no one can count its manifestations.
essence: The infinite power within you cannot be captured or counted by any number.
simple_meaning: The true self is infinite and its expressions cannot be counted or limited by any number.
insight: It shifts your mind from trying to limit or quantify your inner potential to embracing its boundless nature.
modern_relevance: When you try to list or measure all your talents, strengths, or potential, you realize they are too many to count.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
भवतां विप्रवर्याणां कल्याणार्थ हि केवलम।
दिग्दर्शनस्त्ररूपेण किञ्चिद्वो वर्णितं मयाः॥
translation: केवल आप विप्रवरों के कल्याणार्थ ही दिग्दर्शन रूप से आपलोगों से यह कुछ वर्णन किया है
english_translation: I have described this briefly for your welfare, O best among the wise, as a guidance.
essence: Brief guidance is given solely for the welfare of the best among the wise.
simple_meaning: This is a brief description given as guidance for your welfare, addressed to the best among the wise.
insight: Recognize that some teachings are shared briefly and intentionally for the listener's welfare, not for exhaustive explanation.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
उपदेशश्च में हृद्यं धृत्वा स्त्रहृदयेऽनिशम् ।
ममोपास्तौ रताः सन्तो भजध्वं मोक्षमुत्तमम् ॥
translation: आप मेरे हृदयग्राही उपदेश को अपने हृदय में निरन्तर रखकर मेरी उपासना मे रत होकर उत्तम मोक्षपद को प्राप्त हो
english_translation: Keep my heartfelt teaching constantly in your heart, devoted to my worship, and attain the highest freedom.
essence: Steady devotion to heartfelt teaching leads you to the highest freedom.
simple_meaning: Keep this teaching deeply in your heart and stay devoted in worship to reach the highest freedom.
insight: It invites you to root the teaching in your heart and cultivate devotion as a practice to experience freedom.
modern_relevance: When you remember a trusted guide’s advice and stay committed to your values, it helps you find true ease and freedom in life.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
श्रद्धा वः सात्त्विकी विप्राः ! प्रकृतौ मे चिरं वसेत् ।
ममैव प्रकृतिधृत्वा स्त्रीभावं कामदायिनी ॥
translation: हे विप्रों ! मेरी प्रकति पर आपकी  सात्विक श्रद्धा चिरकाल तक बनी रहे। मेरी प्रकृति ही स्त्रीभाव कों धारण करके कामदा,
english_translation: O wise ones, may your pure faith in me endure long; my nature itself, embodying the feminine aspect, grants desire.
essence: Lasting pure faith in the nurturing divine nature sustains your deepest longing.
simple_meaning: You are encouraged to keep sincere and pure trust in the divine nature, which expresses as a nurturing, desire-giving feminine aspect.
insight: It teaches you to nurture a lasting, heartfelt trust that supports your hopes and desires.
modern_relevance: When you face uncertainty, relying on steady trust in your inner nature can provide calm and help your deepest wishes grow.
speaker: Shri Dheesh

verse_text:
विभ्राणा भगिनीभावार्थसिद्धिप्रदायिनी ।
धरन्ती मातृभावञ्च शक्तिधर्मपदा सदा ॥
translation: भगिनी भाव को धारण करके अर्थ और सिद्धि प्रदा और मातृभाव धारण करके सदा धर्म और शक्तिप्रदा
english_translation: The earth, embodying the spirit of a sister, grants wealth and accomplishment; embodying the spirit of a mother, she always grants dharma and power.
essence: The earth nurtures both material success and moral strength like a sister and a mother.
simple_meaning: The earth is described as having qualities like a sister who helps achieve wealth and success, and like a mother who always supports righteousness and strength.
insight: It teaches you to see support beyond the obvious, recognizing both practical help and deeper moral strength.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
भूत्वा मे ज्ञानिनो भक्तान् प्रकृतिस्थान समन्ततः ।
तेभ्यो मुक्तिप्रदं दत्ते विदधाना सुदुर्लभम् ॥
translation: होकर मेरे ज्ञानीभक्तो को सब ओर से प्रकृतिस्थ करती हुई उनको सुदुर्लभ मुक्तिपद प्रदान करती है
english_translation: When my wise devotees remain established in nature from all sides, I grant them the rare state of liberation.
essence: Steadiness in your true nature invites rare freedom from the divine.
simple_meaning: Wise devotees who remain steady and natural from all sides receive rare freedom from the divine.
insight: It teaches you to remain stable in your natural being, trusting that freedom will come without forcing it.
modern_relevance: You keep calm and authentic in a chaotic world, and gradually a rare kind of inner freedom begins to emerge.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
श्रद्धान्वितानां मच्छतौ भक्तानां सुलभो भवेत ।
चतुर्वर्गों न सन्देहो विद्यतेऽत्र द्विजोत्तमाः ॥
translation: मेरी शक्ति पर श्रद्धान्वित भक्तों को चतुर्वर्ग सुलभ हो जाता है हे विप्रवरो ! इसमें सन्देह नहीं है
english_translation: For those devoted to my power with trust, the four goals of life become easily accessible, O best of Brahmins; there is no doubt about this.
essence: Trust in divine power makes life’s highest goals easily reachable without doubt.
simple_meaning: If you sincerely trust the divine power, the four important life goals become easy to achieve without doubt.
insight: It teaches you to open your heart with trust, which clears doubts and makes your goals attainable.
modern_relevance: You feel stuck trying to reach your life goals, but when you truly trust the process beyond your control, things begin to align naturally.
speaker: श्री धीश

verse_text:
अत्यन्तं गोपनीया वः श्रावितोपनिपन्मया ।
धीशगीताभिधानेन लोकेष्वेपा प्रचार्यताम् ॥
translation: यह मैंने अति गोपनीय उपनिषद् आप लोगो को सुनाया है आप इसको धीशगीता नाम से प्रचार करो
english_translation: I have taught you a deeply confidential Upanishad; spread it in the world by the name Dheesh Gita.
essence: A secret teaching is revealed to be shared openly by name for the world's benefit.
simple_meaning: A secret teaching has been shared. It is instructed to spread this teaching called Dheesh Gita.
insight: Recognize the value of sacred knowledge and the responsibility to share it wisely.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
यया मे निखिला भक्ताश्चतुर्वर्गमवाप्नुयुः ।
एषा नैव प्रदातव्या नास्तिकेभ्यः कदाचन ॥
translation: जिससे मेरे सब भक्त चतुर्वग प्राप्त करें। हे विप्रवरो ! अभक्त, नास्तिक
english_translation: Through which all my devotees attain the fourfold class; this must never be given to the irreverent or deniers.
essence: Only sincere devotion opens the full spiritual path; denial closes it.
simple_meaning: True devotion leads all sincere followers to their complete spiritual fulfillment. This devotion is not to be granted to those who reject or deny it.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that devotion requires openness; without it, the benefits cannot reach you.
modern_relevance: When you give your full heart to a cause or belief, it transforms your life, but skepticism or rejection blocks that transformation.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
पापिभ्योऽश्रद्दधानभ्यः प्राणिभ्यो ब्राह्मणोत्तमाः ।
अभक्तेभ्यः कृतघ्नेभ्यो गुरुद्रोहिभ्य एव च ॥
translation: श्रद्धाहीन, गुरु विरोधी, कृतघ् और पापात्मा व्यक्तियों को इसको कदापि नहीं ही देना
english_translation: The highest Brahmins are never given to those who lack trust, are ungrateful, hostile to their Guru, or harmful to living beings.
essence: Trust and respect are essential for receiving true spiritual knowledge.
simple_meaning: True spiritual knowledge is never granted to those who lack trust, are ungrateful, hostile to their teacher, or harm others.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate trust and gratitude as prerequisites to accessing deep wisdom and support.
modern_relevance: You hesitate to open your heart to guidance because past disappointments made you skeptical, but growth needs trust first.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
श्रद्धा श्रीगुरुवाश्येषु येषां शास्त्रगणेष्वपि ।
विश्वासः परलोकेषु लक्ष्यमाध्यात्मिकं तथा ॥
translation: गुरु और शास्त्रों में जिनकी श्रद्धा है, पर लोकपर जिन का विश्वास है, जिनका लक्ष्य आध्यात्मिक है
english_translation: Those who have trust in the revered Guru and scriptures, faith in the higher realms, and a spiritual goal.
essence: Trust in your teacher, scriptures, and higher purpose grounds your spiritual journey.
simple_meaning: Having trust in the revered teacher and scriptures, faith in higher realms, and a spiritual goal is essential.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate trust before certainty, anchoring your path in faith toward the true self.
modern_relevance: When doubts crowd your mind, trusting a wise guide and focusing on your deeper purpose can steady you.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
मत्परायणता पुण्या वर्तते च निरन्तरम् ।
इयं तेभ्यः प्रदातव्या धीशगीता ध्रुवं द्विजाः ! ॥
translation: और जिनमें पवित्र मत्परायणता निरन्तर है हे द्विजो ! उनको यह धीशगीता अवश्य देनी चाहिये
english_translation: Those who have pure, constant devotion to me should definitely be given this Dheesh Gita, O twice-born.
essence: Pure, constant devotion naturally invites the gift of transformative teaching.
simple_meaning: People who have steady and pure devotion should receive this teaching without fail.
insight: It shows that sincere, ongoing devotion creates the perfect ground to receive profound wisdom.
modern_relevance: When you feel deeply committed and open-hearted, the right guidance naturally finds you and supports your growth.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
धीशगीतामिमां पुण्यां पाठयन्ति पठन्ति ये ।
क्लेशकर्मविषाकेभ्यो रहिता आशयेन च ॥
translation: इस पवित्र धीशगीता को जो अध्ययन और अध्यापन करते हैं, क्लेश कर्मविपाक और आशय से रहित होकर
english_translation: Those who study and teach this sacred Dheesh Gita do so free from painful karma and attachment.
essence: Studying and teaching this sacred text works best without pain or attachment.
simple_meaning: People who study or teach this holy text do so without pain from past actions or personal attachment.
insight: It encourages approaching learning and teaching with openness, free from personal baggage or expectations.
modern_relevance: You share or learn something deeply meaningful when you let go of past burdens and personal agendas.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
भजन्ते मेऽखिला भक्ता मत्सायुज्यमसंशयम् ।
न च तान् बाधते कश्चित्तापो लोके कथञ्चन ॥
translation: वह मेरे सब भक्त मत्सायुज्य को अवश्य प्राप्त होते हैं और उनको इस संसार में किसी प्रकार भी कोई ताप बाधा नहीं देता है।
english_translation: All my devotees surely attain union with me; no suffering in the world can harm them.
essence: Complete devotion creates an unbreakable shield against all suffering.
simple_meaning: Those who fully devote themselves to the divine reach a deep union and remain free from worldly suffering.
insight: It teaches you to anchor your heart in devotion, which protects you from being shaken by external troubles.
modern_relevance: Even when life feels overwhelming and pain seems constant, your devotion can create an unshakable sanctuary inside you.
speaker: Shri Dheesh

verse_text:
कल्याणजननीमेतां श्रद्धयैव पठन्ति ये।
एनया येऽथवा यागं गाणपत्यं प्रकुर्वते ॥
translation: श्रद्धा के साथ ही इस कल्याण कारिणी गीता का जो पाठ करते हैं अथवा जो इसके द्वारा
english_translation: Those who read this benevolent teaching with trust, or perform rituals using it,
essence: Trust is the essential starting point that brings the teaching its real benefit.
simple_meaning: Reading this teaching with sincere trust or performing rituals with it brings benefit.
insight: It shows that trust is the key that activates the deeper power of spiritual teaching and practice.
modern_relevance: You open a book or start a practice unsure, but trust invites positive change beyond immediate proof.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
हवनात्मकमाहोस्वित केवलं पाठरूपकम् ।
तेषा नश्यन्ति भक्तानामाधयो व्याधयोऽखिलाः ॥
translation: केवल पाठात्मक वा हवनात्मक गणपतियाग का अनुष्ठान करते हैं उन मेरे भक्तो की सब आधि और व्याधियां नष्ट हो जाती हैं
english_translation: Those devotees who perform only the ritualistic or textual Ganapati sacrifice have all their ailments and sufferings destroyed.
essence: Sincere devotional ritual, even if formal, can heal all ailments and suffering.
simple_meaning: Performing devoted rituals, even if only formal or textual, can remove all suffering and illnesses from a devotee.
insight: It teaches that the heart behind the action matters more than perfection; sincere ritual can heal deeply.
modern_relevance: When you follow a meaningful tradition or practice with sincere heart, even if you do it mechanically, it can bring unexpected relief from stress and pain.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
संयता ये तपोनिष्ठा भक्तिभावेन कुर्वते ।
पाठस्य श्रवणं सम्यगेतस्याः सार्थक द्विजाः ! ॥
translation: हे द्विजो ! जो भक्तिभाव से संयत और तप परायण होकर भलीभांति इसका सार्थक पाठ श्रवण
english_translation: O twice-born, those who are disciplined, devoted, and dedicated to tapas listen carefully and make this study meaningful.
essence: Devoted discipline transforms listening into meaningful learning.
simple_meaning: Listening to teachings with devotion and disciplined effort makes learning meaningful and effective.
insight: It teaches you to combine steady effort with heartfelt devotion to deepen your understanding.
modern_relevance: You approach a new skill with focused attention and heartfelt care, making every lesson count.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
गाणपत्यस्य यागस्यानुष्ठानं वैतया सदा ।
काचिद्वाधा न तेषां स्याद्विपत्तिः माणिनां तथा ॥
translation: अथवा इसके द्वारा गणपतियाग का अनुष्ठान सदा करते हैं उन जीवों के ऐसे कोई बाधा, विपत्ति
english_translation: Those who always perform the ritual of Ganapati suffer no obstacles or misfortunes in life.
essence: Consistent Ganapati ritual prevents obstacles and misfortunes.
simple_meaning: Those who regularly perform the ritual for Ganapati do not face obstacles or troubles.
insight: It shows the value placed on committed ritual practice as a safeguard against challenges.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
तादृशी विघ्नशिर्वा नश्येदया नैव सत्वरम् ।
नात्र कश्चन सन्देहो विद्यते ब्राह्मणोत्तमाः ॥
translation: और विधनसमूह नहीं हैं जो शीघ्र ही दूर न हो सके, हे विप्रवरो ! इसमें कुछ सन्देह नहीं है।
english_translation: There are no obstacles that cannot be quickly removed, O best of Brahmins! There is no doubt about this.
essence: No obstacle is truly permanent when met with determined action.
simple_meaning: Any obstacle you face can be removed quickly if you act with determination. There is no doubt about this truth.
insight: It shifts your mindset from fearing obstacles to trusting your ability to overcome them quickly through focused effort.
modern_relevance: You face a sudden problem at work or in life. This verse reminds you that with decisive effort, even big roadblocks can be cleared swiftly.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
आर्ता जिज्ञासवो भक्तास्तथाऽर्थार्थिन एव वै ।
त्रिविधा एव मे भक्ता एतद्गीताश्रयेण हि ॥
translation: मेरे आर्त जिज्ञासु और अर्थार्थी तीनों प्रकार के भक्त ही इस गीता के आश्रय से ही
english_translation: My distressed, curious, and desire-driven followers are all three types of devotees who take refuge in this Gita.
essence: All kinds of seekers find refuge in this teaching without exclusion.
simple_meaning: This teaching embraces all kinds of devotees—those who suffer, those who seek knowledge, and those who seek material gain.
insight: Recognize that devotion can arise from many motives—all are valid starting points on the path.
modern_relevance: Whether you come from pain, curiosity, or practical needs, you can find guidance and belonging here.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
स्वमनोरथसाफल्यं लभेरन्नात्र संशयः।
तथैवास्याश्च गीतायाः श्रवणान्मननात्तथा ॥
translation: निःसन्देह सफल मनोरथ होंगे और उसी प्रकार मेरे ज्ञानीभक्त भी इस गीता के श्रवण मनन और
english_translation: There is no doubt that one attains the fulfillment of their own desires, just as my wise devotees do, through listening and reflecting on this Gita.
essence: Focused listening and reflection bring the fulfillment of your true desires without doubt.
simple_meaning: You will surely achieve your true desires by listening carefully and reflecting on this teaching.
insight: It teaches you to trust the process of listening and reflecting as a way to realize your inner aspirations.
modern_relevance: You feel stuck, wishing for things to change. This reminds you that deep listening and honest reflection can bring your goals closer.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
निदिध्यासनतो नूनं ज्ञानिभक्ताश्च मामकाः।
अपरोक्षानुभूत्या में दर्शन कर्त्तुमीशते ॥
translation: निदिध्यासन द्वारा अपरोक्षानुभूति से मेरे दर्शन करने में अवश्य समर्थ होंगे
english_translation: Those devoted to me through deep meditation and direct experience surely become capable of perceiving me.
essence: Deep meditation and devotion unlock direct experience of the divine presence.
simple_meaning: You become able to perceive the divine by practicing deep meditation and devotion that leads to direct experience.
insight: It teaches you to value sustained devotion and direct personal experience as the path to truly perceiving the divine.
modern_relevance: When you quiet your mind and stay devoted to your purpose, you begin to sense deeper truths beyond words or concepts.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
चतुर्वर्णाश्रमस्थानां स्वधर्मासक्तचेतसाम्।
जीवानां किनु  वक्तव्यं श्रद्धालूनां मयि ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: चारों वर्ण और चारों आश्रमो के स्वधर्मानुरत जीवों की तो बात ही क्या है मुझमें अटल श्रद्धा रखनेवाले
english_translation: For those devoted to their own duties in the four classes and stages of life, what need is there to speak? For the faithful, I am always steadfast.
essence: Faith deepens naturally when you stay devoted to your own true duties.
simple_meaning: Those who are devoted to their own duties in life’s classes and stages do not need extra proof. For those with firm trust, the divine is always steady.
insight: It encourages you to build trust by engaging sincerely with your own responsibilities, deepening your inner steadiness.
modern_relevance: You feel grounded when you focus fully on your own role instead of comparing yourself to others or doubting your place.
speaker: Shri Dheesh

verse_text:
सर्वेषामेव जीवानां चतुर्वर्गफलमदा!
वर्त्तते धीशगीतेयं सत्यं सत्यं न संशयः ॥
translation: जीवमात्र को ही यह धीशगीता चतुर्वर्ग फलप्रद है। यह सत्य है सत्य है, इसमें सन्देह नहीं है
english_translation: The Dheesh Gita truly grants the four goals of life to all living beings; this is the truth beyond doubt.
essence: This teaching universally offers all beings the four essential goals of life without doubt.
simple_meaning: This teaching promises to fulfill the four main aims of life for every living being without any doubt.
insight: It reassures that the teachings can universally guide one's pursuit of meaningful goals in life.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text:
सत्यं दमं क्षमां प्रज्ञां प्रशंसन्ति पितामह ।
विद्वांसो मनुजा लोके कथमेतन्मतं तव ॥
translation: पितामह ! संसार में बहुत से विद्वान् सत्य, इन्द्रिय-संयम, क्षमा और प्रज्ञा (उत्तम बुद्धि)-की प्रशंसा करते हैं। इस विषय में आपका कैसा मत है?
english_translation: Grandfather, many wise people in the world praise truth, self-control, forgiveness, and wisdom. What is your view on this?
essence: The question opens the path to discern which virtues truly matter.
simple_meaning: Many wise people praise qualities like truth, self-control, forgiveness, and wisdom. Yudhishthira asks Bhishma for his opinion.
insight: It opens a space for questioning common values rather than giving direct advice.
modern_relevance: You overhear many people valuing honesty, patience, and wisdom—wondering what truly matters most.
speaker: Yudhishthira

verse_text:
अत्र ते वर्तयिष्येऽहमितिहासं पुरातनम् ।
साध्यानामिह संवादं हंसस्य च युधिष्ठिर ॥
translation: युधिष्ठिर! इस विषय में साध्यगणों का हंस के साथ जो संवाद हुआ था, वही प्राचीन इतिहास मैं तुम्हें सुना रहा हूँ
english_translation: Yudhishthira, I will now tell you the ancient history of the dialogue between the sages and the Hamsa.
essence: Ancient wisdom dialogues prepare the ground for deep spiritual teaching.
simple_meaning: I will tell you the old story of the conversation between the sages and the Hamsa.
insight: Recognizing the value of foundational stories helps open the mind for deeper learning.
speaker: Bhishma

verse_text:
हंसो भूत्वाथ सौवर्णस्त्वजो नित्यः प्रजापतिः ।
स वै पर्येति लोकांस्त्रीनथ साध्यानुपागमत् ॥
translation: एक समय नित्य अजन्मा प्रजापति सुवर्णमय हंस का रूप धारण करके तीनों लोकों में विचर रहे थे। घूमते-घामते वे साध्यगणों के पास जा पहुँचे
english_translation: Once, the eternal unborn Prajapati took the form of a golden swan and wandered through the three realms, eventually arriving among the perfected beings.
essence: The eternal takes form and journeys to meet the perfected beings across all realms.
simple_meaning: The eternal, unborn Prajapati took the form of a golden swan and traveled through the three worlds to reach the perfected beings.
insight: Transformation and presence in diverse realms open paths to deeper wisdom and connection.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
शकुने वयं स्म देवा वै साध्यास्त्वामनुयुज्महे ।
पृच्छामस्त्वां मोक्षधर्मं भवांश्च किल मोक्षवित् ॥
translation: हंस! हम लोग साध्य देवता हैं और आपसे मोक्षधर्म के विषय में प्रश्न करना चाहते हैं; क्योंकि आप मोक्ष-तत्त्व के ज्ञाता हैं, यह बात सर्वदा प्रसिद्ध है
english_translation: Hamsa, we are the accomplished deities and wish to ask you about the path of liberation, for you are known as the knower of liberation.
essence: True seekers approach the wise to understand the path to freedom.
simple_meaning: A group of accomplished beings respectfully asks the wise Hamsa about the path to liberation, recognizing his deep understanding.
insight: Recognize when to seek guidance from true wisdom beyond yourself to move toward freedom.
speaker: Bhishma

verse_text:
श्रुतोऽसि नः पण्डितो धीरवादी साधुशब्दश्चरते ते पतत्रिन् ।
किं मन्यसे श्रेष्ठतमं द्विज त्वं कस्मिन्मनस्ते रमते महात्मन् ॥
translation: महात्मन्! हमने सुना है कि आप पण्डित और धीर वक्ता हैं। पतत्रिन्! आपकी उत्तम वाणी का सर्वत्र प्रचार है। पक्षिप्रवर! आपके मत में सर्वश्रेष्ठ वस्तु क्या है? आपका मन किसमें रमता है?
english_translation: Great soul, we have heard you are wise and calm in speech. O supreme bird, your noble words spread everywhere. What do you consider the highest? Where does your mind delight?
essence: The greatest wisdom is revealed by what the mind truly delights in.
simple_meaning: Someone respectfully asks what the wise and calm teacher considers the highest and what brings joy to their mind.
insight: It invites shifting focus from external reputation to the inner source of joy and highest value.
modern_relevance: You meet someone known for calm wisdom and ask them directly what they value most and where their mind finds peace.
speaker: Yudhishthira

verse_text:
तन्नः कार्यं पक्षिवर प्रशाधियत्कर्मणां मन्यसे श्रेष्ठमेकम् ।
यत्कृत्वा वै पुरुषः सर्वबन्धैर्विमुच्यते विहगेन्द्रेह शीघ्रम् ॥
translation: पक्षिराज! खगश्रेष्ठ! समस्त कार्यों में से जिस एक कार्य को आप सबसे उत्तम समझते हों तथा जिसके करने से जीव को सब प्रकार के बन्धनों से शीघ्र छुटकारा मिल सके, उसी का हमें उपदेश कीजिये
english_translation: O king of birds, greatest among all, please teach me that one action you consider the best, which frees a person quickly from all bonds.
essence: The one best action can swiftly free a person from all bonds.
simple_meaning: You ask the divine Swan to share the single best action that quickly frees a person from all attachments and bondage.
insight: It invites you to focus on the most effective practice that releases you from cycles of reactivity and limitation.
speaker: Yudhishthira

verse_text:
इदं कार्यममृताशाः श‍ृणोमि तपो दमः सत्यमात्माभिगुप्तिः ।
ग्रन्थीन् विमुच्य हृदयस्य सर्वान् प्रियाप्रिये स्वं वशमानयीत ॥
translation: अमृतभोजी देवताओं! मैं तो सुनता हूँ कि तप, इन्द्रियसंयम, सत्यभाषण और मनोनिग्रह आदि कार्य ही सबसे उत्तम हैं। हृदय की सारी गाँठे खोलकर प्रिय और अप्रिय को अपने वश में करे अर्थात् उनके लिये हर्ष एवं विषाद न करे
english_translation: Those who seek immortality, hear this: austerity, sense control, truthful speech, and mind mastery are the highest practices; freeing all knots of the heart, controlling likes and dislikes without causing joy or sorrow.
essence: Discipline and truth free the heart from emotional bondage to likes and dislikes.
simple_meaning: The best practice is to discipline yourself with austerity, control your senses, speak truth, and master your mind, freeing your heart from attachment to likes and dislikes.
insight: It teaches you to release emotional reactivity by mastering self-discipline and truthfulness, calming your inner fluctuations.
modern_relevance: You find yourself overwhelmed by emotional ups and downs, craving approval or fearing criticism; learning to steady your heart brings peace.
speaker: Hamsa

verse_text:
नारुन्तुदः स्यान्न नृशंसवादीन हीनतः परमभ्याददीत ।
ययास्य वाचा पर उद्विजेत न तां वदेद्रुषतीं पापलोक्याम् ॥
translation: किसी के मर्म में आघात न पहुँचाये। दूसरों से निष्ठुर वचन न बोले। किसी नीच मनुष्य से अध्यात्मशास्त्र का उपदेश न ग्रहण करे तथा जिसे सुनकर दूसरों को उद्वेग हो, ऐसी नरक में डालनेवाली अमङ्गलमयी बात भी मुँह से न निकाले॥
english_translation: Do not hurt anyone's heart. Do not speak harsh words to others. Do not learn spiritual teachings from a low-minded person. Do not utter words that disturb others and lead them to the lower realm.
essence: Kind speech and wise learning protect both yourself and others from harm.
simple_meaning: You should not hurt others with harsh words, avoid learning spiritual teachings from unworthy people, and never say things that disturb or harm others deeply.
insight: It teaches you to guard your speech and learning sources to protect yourself and others from harm and confusion.
modern_relevance: You send a message that unintentionally hurts a friend, or find misleading advice online and wonder how to protect your heart and mind.
speaker: Hamsa

verse_text:
वाक्सायका वदनान्निष्पतन्ति यैराहतः शोचति रात्र्यहानि ।
परस्य नामर्मसु ते पतन्ति तान् पण्डितो नावसृजेत्परेषु ॥
translation: वचनरूपी बाण जब मुँह से निकल पड़ते हैं, तब उनके द्वारा बींधा गया मनुष्य रात-दिन शोक में डूबा रहता है; क्योंकि वे दूसरो के मर्मपर आघात पहुँचाते हैं, इसलिये विद्वान् पुरुष को किसी दूसरे मनुष्य पर वाग्बाण का प्रयोग नहीं करना चाहिये
english_translation: Words are like arrows shot from the mouth that cause pain day and night; the wise do not use verbal arrows to hurt others.
essence: Words can pierce others like arrows; true wisdom avoids causing pain with speech.
simple_meaning: Words can cause lasting pain like arrows. A wise person avoids hurting others with speech.
insight: It teaches you to restrain harmful speech and practice thoughtful, compassionate communication.
modern_relevance: After a harsh message sent in anger, you notice the lasting hurt it caused and wish you'd held back.
speaker: Hamsa

verse_text:
परश्चेदेनमति वादबानैर्भृशं विध्येच्छम एवेह कार्यः ।
संरोष्यमाणः प्रतिहृष्यते यः स आदत्ते सुकृतं वै परस्य ॥
translation: दूसरा कोई भी यदि इस विद्वान् पुरुष को कटुवचन रूपी बाणों से बहुत अधिक चोट पहुँचाये तो भी उसे शान्त ही रहना चाहिये। जो दूसरों के क्रोध करने पर भी स्वयं बदले में प्रसन्न ही रहता है, वह उसके पुण्य को ग्रहण कर लेता है
english_translation: If others fiercely attack this wise person with harsh words, he remains calm; one who stays pleased despite others' anger inherits their goodness.
essence: Calmness in the face of harsh attack transforms others' anger into your own good.
simple_meaning: You should remain calm and peaceful even if others insult or attack you harshly. Staying pleased despite anger around you brings you goodness.
insight: It shifts your response from reacting to others' anger to peacefully accepting it, turning hostility into a source of your own strength.
modern_relevance: When someone criticizes or attacks you online or in person, choosing calmness lets you stay above the conflict and receive unexpected goodwill.
speaker: Hamsa

verse_text:
क्षेपाभिमानादभिषङ्गव्यलीकं निगृह्णाति ज्वलितं यश्च मन्युम् ।
अदुष्टचेता मुदितोऽनसूयुः स आदत्ते सुकृतं वै परेषाम् ॥
translation: जो जगत् में निन्दा करानेवाले और आवेशमें डालनेके कारण अप्रिय प्रतीत होनेवाले प्रज्वलित क्रोधको रोक लेता है, चित्तमें कोई विकार या दोष नहीं आने देता, प्रसन्न रहता और दूसरोंके दोष नहीं देखता है, वह पुरुष अपने प्रति शत्रुभाव रखनेवाले लोगोंके पुण्य ले लेता है
english_translation: One who restrains the blazing anger caused by insult and provocation, keeps a pure mind without faults, stays joyful, and does not see faults in others, inherits the merit of those hostile to him.
essence: Mastering anger and faultfinding turns hostility into your own merit.
simple_meaning: Stopping angry outbursts caused by insult, keeping a peaceful and joyful mind, and not criticizing others brings great merit.
insight: It shifts your response from reaction to mastery, turning enemies' energy into your own gain.
modern_relevance: When someone pushes your buttons at work or home, holding back anger and staying kind earns respect and peace you can't see immediately.
speaker: Hamsa

verse_text:
आक्रुश्यमानो न वदामि किंचित् क्षमाम्यहं ताड्यमानश्च नित्यम् ।
श्रेष्ठं ह्येतत् यत् क्षमामाहुरार्याः सत्यं तथैवार्जवमानृशंस्यम् ॥
translation: मुझे कोई गाली दे तो भी बदले में मैं कुछ नहीं कहता हूं। कोई मार दे तो उसे सदा क्षमा ही करता हूँ; क्योंकि श्रेष्ठ जन क्षमा, सत्य, सरलता और दया को ही उत्तम बताते हैं
english_translation: If anyone insults me, I do not respond in kind; if struck, I always forgive, for the noble value forgiveness, truth, simplicity, and compassion above all.
essence: True strength is shown by forgiving insults and harm with truth and compassion.
simple_meaning: You choose not to fight back when insulted or hurt but respond with forgiveness, truth, simplicity, and compassion because these qualities are the highest virtues.
insight: It teaches you to pause and respond with forgiveness rather than escalation, shifting your reaction from reactivity to calm dignity.
modern_relevance: When someone snaps at you at work or home, you don't lash out but hold to quiet forgiveness and honesty instead.
speaker: Hamsa

verse_text:
वेदस्योपनिषत्सत्यं सत्यस्योपनिषद्दमः ।
दमस्योपनिषन्मोक्षं एतत्सर्वानुशासनम् ॥
translation: वेदाध्ययन का सार है सत्यभाषण, सत्यभाषण का सार है इन्द्रियसंयम और इन्द्रियसंयम का फल है मोक्ष। यही सम्पूर्ण शास्त्रों का उपदेश है
english_translation: The essence of the Vedas and Upanishads is truthfulness; the essence of truthfulness is self-control; the essence of self-control is liberation. This is the teaching of all the scriptures.
essence: Truthfulness leads to self-control, and self-control leads to freedom.
simple_meaning: Truthfulness is the core of sacred teachings. Speaking truth leads to controlling your senses, and controlling your senses brings freedom.
insight: It teaches you to see truthfulness as the foundation for discipline, which in turn opens the door to freedom.
modern_relevance: When you choose honesty in your words, it strengthens your ability to resist distractions and unhealthy impulses, which leads to real personal freedom.
speaker: Hamsa

verse_text:
वाचो वेगं मनसः क्रोधवेगं विवित्सा वेगमुदरोपस्थ वेगम् ।
एतान् वेगान् यो विषहदुदीर्णांस्तं मन्येऽहं ब्राह्मणं वै मुनिं च ॥
translation: जो वाणी का वेग, मन और क्रोध का वेग, तृष्णा का वेग तथा पेट और जननेन्द्रिय का वेग-इन सब प्रचण्ड वेगों को सह लेता है, उसी को मैं ब्रह्मवेत्ता और मुनि मानता हूँ
english_translation: I consider a person a true knower of the supreme reality and a sage who endures the fierce impulses of speech, mind, anger, desire, and the urges of the body and senses.
essence: Mastery comes from enduring your strongest impulses without losing yourself.
simple_meaning: A true sage is one who can calmly endure the strongest impulses of speech, mind, anger, desire, and bodily urges.
insight: It teaches you to meet strong internal urges with steady endurance, building lasting self-mastery.
modern_relevance: When your anger flares or your desires pull hard, you feel the power to stay calm is freedom itself.
speaker: Hamsa

verse_text:
अक्रोधनः क्रुध्यतां वै विशिष्टस्तथा तितिक्षुरतितिक्षोर्विशिष्टः ।
अमानुषान्मानुषो वै विशिष्टस् तथा ज्ञानाज्ज्ञानवान्वै प्रधानः ॥
translation: क्रोधी मनुष्यों से क्रोध न करनेवाला मनुष्य श्रेष्ठ है। असहनशील से सहनशील पुरुष बड़ा है। मनुष्येतर प्राणियों से मनुष्य ही बढ़कर है। तथा अज्ञानी से ज्ञानवान् ही श्रेष्ठ है।
english_translation: A person who does not get angry at angry people is superior. The tolerant one surpasses the intolerant. Among beings beyond humans, the human is superior. Likewise, the wise surpass the ignorant.
essence: True superiority lies in calmness amid anger and wisdom over ignorance.
simple_meaning: You are better when you don't get angry at angry people. Being patient is greater than being impatient. Humans are higher than non-humans, and wise people are above the ignorant.
insight: It teaches you to pause before responding, choosing patience over reactive anger and valuing wisdom over ignorance.
modern_relevance: When someone snaps at you during a stressful day, you can choose calm instead of reacting, showing true strength in patience.
speaker: Hamsa

verse_text:
आक्रुश्यमानो नाक्रोशेन्मन्युरेव तितिक्षतः 
आक्रोष्टारं निर्दहति सुकृतं चास्य विन्दति ॥
translation: जो दूसरे के द्वारा गाली दी जाने पर भी बदले में उसे गाली नहीं देता, उस क्षमाशील मनुष्य का दबा हुआ क्रोध ही उस गाली देनेवाले को भस्म कर देता है और उसके पुण्य को भी ले लेता है
english_translation: A patient person does not retaliate when insulted; their restrained anger burns the offender and claims their merit.
essence: Resisting anger when insulted quietly protects your virtue and weakens the offense.
simple_meaning: When you don’t respond to insults with anger, your self-control protects your good actions and overcomes the harm done.
insight: It teaches you to replace reactive anger with steady patience, shifting your power from conflict to composure.
modern_relevance: When someone snaps at you during a stressful meeting, staying calm protects your integrity and quietly diffuses the tension.
speaker: Hamsa

verse_text:
यो नात्युक्तः प्राह रूक्षं प्रियं वा यो वा हतो न प्रतिहन्ति धैर्यात् ।
पापं च यो नेच्छति तस्य हन्तुस्तस्मै देवाः स्पृहयन्ते सदैव ॥
translation: जो दूसरों के द्वारा अपने लिये कड़वी बात कही जाने पर भी उसके प्रति कठोर या प्रिय कुछ भी नहीं कहता तथा किसी के द्वारा चोट खाकर भी धैर्य के कारण बदले में न तो मारने वाले को मारता है और न उसकी बुराई ही चाहता है, उस महात्मा से मिलने के लिये देवता भी सदा लालायित रहते हैं
english_translation: One who, when harsh or kind words are spoken to him, does not respond with harshness or favoritism, and who, even when harmed, does not retaliate but remains patient and wishes no harm on the attacker, such a great being is always desired by the divine.
essence: True strength is patient calm that refuses to harm even when harmed.
simple_meaning: You can face harsh words or harm without reacting in anger or revenge. Staying patient and wishing no harm brings respect even from the divine.
insight: It shifts your response from reacting in anger to embracing patience and non-retaliation, which changes your whole presence.
modern_relevance: When someone insults you or treats you unfairly at work or home, staying calm and not retaliating can protect your peace and inspire respect.
speaker: Hamsa

verse_text:
पापीयसः क्षमेतैव श्रेयसः सदृशस्य च ।
विमानितो हतोऽऽक्रुष्ट एवं सिद्धिं गमिष्यति ॥
translation: पाप करनेवाला अपराधी अवस्था में अपने से बड़ा हो या बराबर, उसके द्वारा अपमानित होकर, मार खाकर और गाली सुनकर भी उसे क्षमा ही कर देना चाहिये। ऐसा करनेवाला पुरुष परम सिद्धि को प्राप्त होगा
english_translation: One who is sinful should forgive even those equal or greater who insult, strike, or abuse them; such a person attains supreme perfection.
essence: Forgiving harm from equals or superiors leads to supreme spiritual perfection.
simple_meaning: You should forgive even those who are equal or greater than you if they insult or harm you. Forgiveness leads to the highest spiritual attainment.
insight: It shifts the mind from reacting with resentment to responding with forgiveness, which purifies your heart and opens the way to inner growth.
modern_relevance: You face criticism or harsh words from a colleague or stranger, yet choosing forgiveness frees your heart rather than chaining you to anger.
speaker: Hamsa

verse_text:
सदाहमार्यान्निभृतोऽप्युपासे न मे विवित्सा न चमेऽस्ति रोषः ।  
न चाप्यहं लिप्समानः परैमि न चैव किंचिद्विषयेण यामि ॥
translation: यद्यपि मैं सब प्रकार से परिपूर्ण हूँ (मुझे कुछ जानना या पाना शेष नहीं है) तो भी मैं श्रेष्ठ पुरुषों की उपासना (सत्सङ्ग) करता रहता हूँ। मुझपर न तृष्णा का वश चलता है न रोष का। मैं कुछ पाने के लोभ से धर्म का उल्लङ्घन नहीं करता और न विषय की प्राप्ति के लिये ही कहीं आता-जाता हूँ
english_translation: Although I am complete in every way, I still worship the noble ones. I am free from desire and anger; I do not violate dharma out of greed nor pursue worldly objects.
essence: True fulfillment includes humble respect without craving or anger.
simple_meaning: You may be fulfilled and lack nothing, yet you continue to respect and follow noble people without craving or anger and without breaking your true purpose.
insight: It teaches you to keep humility and respect alive, even when you feel complete, avoiding desire and anger.
modern_relevance: You’ve achieved your goals but still seek inspiration from mentors without jealousy or frustration, acting with respect and no selfish motives.
speaker: Hamsa

verse_text:
नाहं शप्तः प्रतिशपामि किंचिद् दमं द्वारं ह्यमृतस्येह वेद्मि ।
गुह्यं ब्रह्म तदिदं वा ब्रवीमि न मानुषाच्छ्रेष्ठतरं हि किंचित् ॥
translation: कोई मुझे शाप दे दे तो भी मैं बदले में उसे शाप नहीं देता। इन्द्रियसंयम को ही मोक्ष का द्वार मानता हूँ। इस समय तुम लोगों को एक बहुत गुप्त बात बता रहा हूँ, सुनो। मनुष्य योनि से बढ़कर है
english_translation: Even if someone curses me, I do not curse back. I consider control of the senses as the door to freedom. Now I reveal a very secret truth: the human birth is supreme.
essence: True freedom comes from mastery over your senses, not from returning harm.
simple_meaning: You should not repay harm with harm. Controlling your senses is the way to true freedom. Human life is precious and highest in value.
insight: It teaches you to pause before reacting and use self-discipline as your path to freedom.
modern_relevance: You face criticism or harsh words but choose not to respond in kind. Instead, you focus on steadying your impulses to stay centered.
speaker: Hamsa

verse_text:
विमुच्यमानः पापेभ्यो धनेभ्य इव चन्द्रमाः ।
विरजाः कालमाकाङ्क्षन् धीरो धैर्येण सिध्यति ॥
translation: जिस प्रकार चन्द्रमा बादलों के औट से निकलने पर अपनी प्रभा से प्रकाशित हो उठता है, उसी प्रकार पापों से मुक्त हुआ निर्मल अन्त:करण वाला धीर पुरुष धैर्यपूर्वक काल की प्रतीक्षा करता हुआ सिद्धि को प्राप्त हो जाता है
english_translation: Just as the moon shines brightly after emerging from behind clouds, a pure-hearted, patient person freed from faults attains success by calmly awaiting time.
essence: Pure patience waiting calmly for time leads to true success like the moon emerging from clouds.
simple_meaning: Like the moon brightens after clouds clear, a patient and pure person achieves success by waiting calmly for the right time.
insight: Shift from anxious rushing to steady trust in timing; patience itself prepares you for success.
modern_relevance: You finished a tough project but the results aren’t visible yet. Holding steady and patient will bring the recognition you deserve.
speaker: Hamsa

verse_text:
यः सर्वेषां भवति ह्यर्चनीय उत्सेधनस्तम्भ इवाभिजातः ।
यस्मै वाचं सुप्रशस्तां वदन्ति स वै देवान्गच्छति संयतात्मा ॥
translation: जो अपने मन को वश में रखनेवाला विद्वान् पुरुष ऊँचे उठाने वाले खम्भे की भाँति उच्चकुल में उत्पन्न हुआ सबके लिये आदर के योग्य हो जाता है तथा जिसके प्रति सब लोग प्रसन्नतापूर्वक मधुर वचन बोलते हैं, वह मनुष्य देवभाव को प्राप्त हो जाता है
english_translation: The wise person who masters the mind becomes revered by all like a noble pillar and is spoken of with respect; such a one attains the state of the divine.
essence: Mastering your mind brings respect and leads to the divine state.
simple_meaning: Controlling your mind makes you respected by everyone, like a noble pillar, and leads you to the divine state.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate mental discipline so others naturally honor and trust you.
modern_relevance: In a noisy world, when you calm your mind, people notice your steadiness and treat you with respect.
speaker: Hamsa

verse_text:
न तथा वक्तुमिच्छन्ति कल्याणान् पुरुषे गुणान् ।
यथैषां वक्तुमिच्छन्ति नैर्गुण्यमनुयुञ्जकाः ॥
translation: किसी से ईर्ष्या रखनेवाले मनुष्य जिस तरह उसके दोषों का वर्णन करना चाहते हैं, उस प्रकार उसके कल्याणमय गुण का बखान करना नहीं चाहते हैं
english_translation: Those who envy a person do not want to describe their good qualities but focus on their faults.
essence: Envy makes you ignore good qualities and fixate only on faults.
simple_meaning: When you feel envy, you focus on someone's faults instead of their good qualities.
insight: Recognize envy as a filter that shifts attention from positive to negative, clearing it reveals balance.
modern_relevance: When scrolling social media, you might catch yourself focusing on others' flaws instead of their strengths, driven by envy.
speaker: Hamsa

verse_text:
यस्य वाङ्मनसी गुप्ते सम्यक्प्रणिहिते सदा ।
वेदास्तपश्च त्यागश्च स इदं सर्वमाप्नुयात् ॥
translation: जिसकी वाणी और मन सुरक्षित होकर सदा सब प्रकार से परमात्मा में लगे रहते हैं, वह वेदाध्ययन, तप और त्याग- इन सबके फल को पा लेता है
english_translation: One whose speech and mind are always securely devoted to the supreme being attains the fruit of the Vedas, austerity, and renunciation.
essence: Steady devotion of mind and speech brings the full fruit of spiritual disciplines.
simple_meaning: If your mind and speech are always devoted steadily and securely to the supreme being, you receive the full benefits of sacred knowledge, disciplined practice, and renunciation.
insight: It shows that steady, secure devotion in both what you say and think is more fruitful than scattered effort or ritual alone.
modern_relevance: You speak kindly and keep your focus on what truly matters; over time, this steady devotion brings results beyond mere effort or knowledge.
speaker: Hamsa

verse_text:
आक्रोशनावमानाभ्यां नाबुधान् गर्हयेद् बुधः ।   
तस्मान्न वर्धयेदन्यं न चात्मानं विहिंसयेत् ॥
translation: अतः समझदार मनुष्य को चाहिये कि वह कटुवचन कहने या अपमान करने वाले अज्ञानियों को उनके उक्त दोष बताकर समझाने का प्रयत्न न करे। उसके सामने दूसरे को बढ़ावा न दे तथा उस पर आक्षेप करके उसके द्वारा अपनी हिंसा न कराये
english_translation: A wise person should not insult the ignorant who speak harsh words or insults. They should neither encourage such behavior nor harm themselves through retaliation.
essence: Responding to harshness with calm preserves your peace and dignity.
simple_meaning: A wise person does not insult or retaliate against those who speak harshly or insult them and avoids encouraging such negativity.
insight: It teaches you to break the cycle of conflict by refusing to escalate insults and protecting your own well-being.
modern_relevance: When someone sends you a harsh message online or in person, you feel the urge to respond sharply but holding back protects your peace and dignity.
speaker: Hamsa

verse_text:
अमृतस्येव सन्तृप्येदवमानस्य वै द्विजः ।  
सुखं ह्यवमतः शेते योऽवमन्ता स नश्यति ॥
translation: विद्वान् को चाहिये कि वह अपमान पाकर अमृत पीने की भाँति संतुष्ट हो; क्योंकि अपमानित पुरुष तो सुख से सोता है, किंतु अपमान करने वाले का नाश हो जाता है
english_translation: A wise person should be satisfied like drinking nectar even when insulted; the insulted one sleeps happily, but the insulter is destroyed.
essence: Peaceful acceptance of insult protects you, while the insulter harms themselves.
simple_meaning: Being insulted can be endured with calm satisfaction like tasting nectar. Those insulted remain peaceful, while those who insult lose their strength or standing.
insight: It shifts your response from reactive pain to calm acceptance, showing insult harms the insulter more than you.
modern_relevance: You receive harsh criticism or disrespect at work or in social life, yet you remain calm and composed, unaffected by others’ negativity.
speaker: Hamsa

verse_text:
यत्क्रोधनो यजते यद्ददाति यद्वा तपस्तप्यति यज्जुहोति ।
वैवस्वतस्तद्धरतेऽस्य सर्वं मोघः श्रमो भवति हि क्रोधनस्य ॥
translation: क्रोधी मनुष्य जो यज्ञ करता है, दान देता है, तप करता है अथवा जो हवन करता है, उसके उन सब कर्मो के फल को यमराज हर लेते हैं। क्रोध करने वाले का वह किया हुआ सारा परिश्रम व्यर्थ जाता है
english_translation: When a person who is angry performs sacrifice, gives charity, fasts, or offers oblations, all their efforts are taken by the ruler of death and become fruitless.
essence: Anger turns even your best actions into wasted effort.
simple_meaning: If you perform rituals or give charity while angry, your efforts lose their effect and become wasted.
insight: It teaches you to calm anger before acting so your efforts truly benefit others and yourself.
modern_relevance: You worked hard to help someone but snapped in frustration, leaving the impact of your kindness diminished.
speaker: Hamsa

verse_text:
चत्वारि यस्य द्वाराणि सुगुप्तान्यमरोत्तमाः ।
उपस्थमुदरं हस्तौ वाक्चतुर्थी स धर्मवित् ॥
translation: देवेश्वरों! जिस पुरुष के उपस्थ, उदर, दोनों हाथ और वाणी-ये चारों द्वार सुरक्षित होते हैं, वही धर्मज्ञ है
english_translation: The person whose four gates—genitals, abdomen, both hands, and speech—are well guarded, is truly wise in dharma.
essence: True wisdom is shown by self-control over body and speech.
simple_meaning: A person who carefully controls their body parts and speech lives in true discipline and understands right conduct.
insight: It teaches you to practice self-restraint consistently in what you say, do, and even desire.
modern_relevance: You pause before speaking or acting, knowing your words and deeds shape your life and relationships.
speaker: Hamsa

verse_text:
सत्यं दमं ह्यार्जवमानृशंस्यं धृतिं तितिक्षामभिसेवमानः ।   
स्वाध्यायनित्योऽस्पृहयन्परेषाम्  एकान्तशील्यूर्ध्वगतिर्भवेत्सः ॥
translation: जो सत्य, इन्द्रिय-संयम, सरलता, दया, धैर्य और क्षमा का अधिक सेवन करता है, सदा स्वाध्याय में लगा रहता है, दूसरे की वस्तु नहीं लेना चाहता तथा एकान्त में निवास करता है, वह ऊर्ध्वगति को प्राप्त होता है
english_translation: One who practices truthfulness, self-restraint, simplicity, compassion, patience, and forgiveness, constantly studies the scriptures, does not covet others' possessions, and dwells in solitude, attains the highest state.
essence: Living with truth, self-control, compassion, and solitude leads to spiritual advancement.
simple_meaning: By practicing truth, self-control, kindness, patience, forgiveness, constant learning, not desiring others' things, and loving solitude, you reach a higher state of being.
insight: This verse guides you to replace craving with steady habits of integrity and calm study, shaping your character upward.
modern_relevance: After a long day of distractions, you choose to unplug, read quietly, and release envy, feeling a lightness that lifts you beyond stress.
speaker: Hamsa

verse_text:
सर्वानेताननुचरन् वत्सवच्चतुरः स्तनान् ।  
न पावनतमं किंचित्सत्यादध्यगमं क्वचित् ॥
translation: जैसे बछड़ा अपनी माता के चारों स्तनों का पान करता है, उसी प्रकार मनुष्य को उपर्युक्त सभी सद्गुणों का सेवन करना चाहिये। मैंने अबतक सत्य से बढ़कर परम पावन वस्तु कहीं किसी को नहीं समझा है
english_translation: Just as a calf drinks from all four teats of its mother, you should embrace all the virtues mentioned; I have found nothing purer than truth anywhere.
essence: Taking in all virtues fully leads you closest to the purest reality: truth.
simple_meaning: You should take in all good qualities completely, just like a calf drinks from all teats of its mother, because nothing is purer than truth.
insight: It shifts your practice from selective virtue to embracing all goodness, recognizing truth as the ultimate purifier.
modern_relevance: You face choices about which values to adopt. Taking in all positive qualities without picking and choosing helps you grow genuinely and steadily.
speaker: Hamsa

verse_text:
आचक्षेऽहं मनुष्येभ्यो देवेभ्यः प्रतिसञ्चरन् ।
सत्यं स्वर्गस्य सोपानं पारावारस्य नौरिव ॥
translation: मैं चारों ओर घूमकर मनुष्यों और देवताओं से कहा करता हूँ कि जैसे जहाज समुद्र से पार होने का साधन है, उसी प्रकार सत्य ही स्वर्गलोक में पहुँचने की सीढ़ी है
english_translation: I tell humans and devas everywhere that truth is the ladder to the higher realm, just as a ship is the means to cross the ocean.
essence: Truth is the essential vehicle to cross from the ordinary to the higher realm.
simple_meaning: Truth is the essential means to reach a higher state, just like a ship helps cross an ocean.
insight: It shifts your focus from fleeting methods to relying on truth as the reliable vehicle for transformation.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by challenges, recognizing truth as your steady guide helps you navigate through uncertainty and reach your goals.
speaker: Hamsa

verse_text:
यादृशैः संनिवसति यादृशांश्चोपसेवते ।
यादृगिच्छेच्च भवितुं तादृग्भवति पूरुषः ॥
translation: पुरुष जैसे लोगों के साथ रहता है, जैसे मनुष्यों का सेवन करता हैं और जैसा होना चाहता है, वैसा ही होता है
english_translation: A person associates with those like themselves, serves similar people, and becomes what they desire.
essence: You become like those you associate with and what you deeply desire.
simple_meaning: You tend to live with and help people like yourself, and you become what you deeply want.
insight: It shifts attention to choosing your company and desires wisely, knowing they form your character.
modern_relevance: You notice how your close friends and daily interactions slowly mold your attitudes and choices.
speaker: Hamsa

verse_text:
यदि सन्तं सेवति यद्यसन्तं तपस्विनं यदि वा स्तेनमेव ।
वासो यथा रङ्गवशं प्रयाति तथा स तेषां वशमभ्युपैति ॥
translation: जैसे वस्त्र जिस रंग में रँगा जाय, वैसा ही हो जाता है, उसी प्रकार यदि कोई सज्जन, असज्जन, तपस्वी अथवा चोर का सेवन करता है तो वह उन्हीं-जैसा हो जाता है अर्थात् उसपर उन्हीं का रंग चढ़ जाता है
english_translation: Just as a cloth takes the color it is dyed in, a person becomes like the company they keep, whether noble or corrupt.
essence: You become like those whose company you keep, absorbing their qualities.
simple_meaning: Your character changes to match those you spend time with, whether good or bad.
insight: It teaches you to choose your associations carefully because they shape your habits and character.
modern_relevance: You notice how spending time with certain friends changes your mood, thoughts, and even habits over weeks.
speaker: Hamsa

verse_text:
सदा देवाः साधुभिः संवदन्ते न मानुषं विषयं यान्ति द्रष्टुम् ।
नेन्दुः समः स्यादसमो हि वायुर्उच्चावचं विषयं यः स वेद ॥
translation: देवतालोग सदा सत्पुरुषों के सङ्ग - उन्हीं के साथ वार्तालाप करते हैं; इसीलिये वे मनुष्यों के क्षणभङ्गर भोगों की ओर देखने भी नहीं जाते। जो विभिन्न विषयों के नश्वर स्वभाव को ठीक-ठीक जानता है, उसकी समानता न चन्द्रमा कर सकते हैं न वायु
english_translation: The divine realms always converse with the virtuous; they do not turn to fleeting human desires. One who truly knows the transient nature of all objects is as equal as the moon and the wind.
essence: True knowledge of impermanence makes you steady like the moon and wind.
simple_meaning: The divine speak only with the virtuous and ignore fleeting human desires. Knowing the transient nature of all things keeps you steady and equal like the moon and wind.
insight: It teaches you to see desires as passing phenomena, which keeps your mind steady and unaffected.
modern_relevance: You notice how chasing every passing craving leaves you restless, but understanding their temporary nature brings calm and balance.
speaker: Hamsa

verse_text:
अदुष्टं वर्तमाने तु हृदयान्तरपूरुषे ।
तेनैव देवाः प्रीयन्ते सतां मार्गस्थितेन वै ॥
translation: हृदयगुफा में रहने वाला अन्तर्यामी आत्मा जब दोषभाव से रहित हो जाता है, उस अवस्था में उसका साक्षात्कार करनेवाला पुरुष सन्मार्गगामी समझा जाता है। उसकी इस स्थिति से ही देवता प्रसन्न होते हैं
english_translation: When the inner self dwelling in the heart is free from faults, the divine beings delight in the one who walks the path of truth.
essence: Inner faultlessness draws the divine's pleasure toward those on the true path.
simple_meaning: When your inner self is free from faults, divine beings are pleased with your steady commitment to the true path.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate inner purity, as this steadies your path and attracts positive support beyond yourself.
modern_relevance: You notice how people naturally trust and appreciate you when your heart is sincere and free of blame.
speaker: Hamsa

verse_text:
शिश्नोदरे येऽभिरताः सदैव  स्तेना नरा वाक्परुषाश्च नित्यम् ।
अपेतदोषानिति तान् विदित्वा दूराद्देवाः सम्परिवर्जयन्ति ॥
translation: किंतु जो सदा पेट पालने और उपस्थ इन्द्रियों के भोग भोगने में ही लगे रहते हैं तथा जो चोरी करने एवं सदा कठोर वचन बोलनेवाले हैं, वे यदि प्रायश्चित्त आदि के द्वारा उक्त कर्मो के दोष से छूट जायँ तो भी देवतालोग उन्हें पहचान कर दूर से ही त्याग देते हैं
english_translation: Those who are always attached to bodily pleasures, stealing, and harsh speech, even if freed by penance, are rejected by the divine from afar.
essence: Harmful habits keep you distant from the divine, despite outward attempts to atone.
simple_meaning: People who are always attached to bodily pleasures, stealing, and harsh speech remain rejected by the divine, even if they try to atone.
insight: It teaches you that superficial fixes don’t rebuild trust; genuine transformation comes from changing harmful tendencies.
modern_relevance: You might apologize repeatedly after hurting others, but without true change, people still keep their distance from you.
speaker: Hamsa

verse_text:
न वै देवा हीनसत्त्वेन तोष्याः सर्वाशिना दुष्कृतकर्मणा वा ।
सत्यव्रता ये तु नराः कृतज्ञा धर्मे रतास्तैः सह सम्भजन्ते ॥
translation: सत्त्वगुण से रहित और सब कुछ भक्षण करनेवाले पापाचारी मनुष्य देवताओं को संतुष्ट नहीं कर सकते। जो मनुष्य नियमपूर्वक सत्य बोलने वाले, कृतज्ञ और धर्मपरायण हैं, उन्हीं के साथ देवता स्नेह-सम्बन्ध स्थापित करते हैं
english_translation: Beings devoid of goodness and indulging in all harmful deeds cannot please the radiant beings. Only those who are truthful, grateful, and devoted to dharma form affectionate bonds with the radiant beings.
essence: True affection from the radiant beings comes only through honesty, gratitude, and dharma.
simple_meaning: Only people who act with goodness, speak truth, feel grateful, and follow dharma form loving bonds with the divine.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate truthfulness, gratitude, and righteous conduct as the foundation for deeper bonds beyond appearances.
modern_relevance: You notice who truly supports you: those honest and grateful, not those who harm or take without care.
speaker: Hamsa

verse_text:
अव्याहृतं व्याकृताच्छ्रेय आहुः सत्यं वदेद्व्याहृतं तद्द्वितीयम् ।
धर्मं वदेद्व्याहृतं तत्तृतीयं प्रियंवदेद्व्याहृतं तच्चतुर्थम् ॥
translation: व्यर्थ बोलने की अपेक्षा मौन रहना अच्छा बताया गया है, (यह वाणी की प्रथम विशेषता है) सत्य बोलना वाणी की दूसरी विशेषता है, प्रिय बोलना वाणी की तीसरी विशेषता है। धर्मसम्मत बोलना यह वाणी की चौथी विशेषता है (इनमें उत्तरोत्तर श्रेष्ठता है)
english_translation: Remaining silent is better than speaking meaningless words, speaking truth is second, speaking kindly is third, and speaking in accordance with dharma is fourth.
essence: Choosing silence or speech guided by truth, kindness, and dharma leads to wise communication.
simple_meaning: It's best to remain silent rather than speak meaningless words. Speaking truth is better, then speaking kindly, and finally speaking in a way that follows dharma is best.
insight: It shifts your communication from impulsive speech to mindful, value-based expression or silence.
modern_relevance: You find yourself tempted to reply with harsh words but pause, realizing silence or kind truth serves better.
speaker: Hamsa

verse_text:
केनायमावृतो लोकः केन वा न प्रकाशते ।
केन त्यजति मित्राणि केन स्वर्गं न गच्छति ॥
translation: हंस! इस जगत् को किसने आवृत कर रखा है? किस कारण से उसका स्वरूप प्रकाशित नहीं होता है? मनुष्य किस हेतु से मित्रों का त्याग करता है? और किस दोष से वह स्वर्ग में नहीं जाने पाता ?
english_translation: Hamsa! Who has veiled this world? By what cause is its nature not revealed? Why does a person abandon friends? What fault stops them from reaching the higher realm?
essence: Questioning who or what conceals reality and breaks bonds reveals the roots of confusion.
simple_meaning: This asks who causes the world to seem hidden and why people abandon friends and miss the higher realm.
insight: It invites you to investigate what veils reality and causes disconnection, opening space for deeper clarity.
modern_relevance: You pause, wondering why some truths stay hidden and why close bonds sometimes break without clear reason.
speaker: Yudhishthira

verse_text:
अज्ञानेनावृतो लोको मात्सर्यान्न प्रकाशते ।
लोभात्त्यजति मित्राणि सङ्गात्स्वर्गं न गच्छति ॥
translation: देवताओं! अज्ञान ने इस लोक को आवृत कर रखा है। आपस में डाह होने के कारण इसका स्वरूप प्रकाशित नहीं होता। मनुष्य लोभ से मित्रों का त्याग करता है। और आसक्तिदोष के कारण वह स्वर्ग में नहीं जाने पाता
english_translation: Ignorance covers the world; envy hides its true light. Greed makes one abandon friends, and attachment stops one from reaching the higher realm.
essence: Envy, greed, and attachment blind you and block your true progress.
simple_meaning: Ignorance, envy, and greed hide the world's true nature. Attachment causes separation and blocks progress to higher states.
insight: Recognize how envy and greed fracture your relationships and cloud your perception, preventing inner freedom.
modern_relevance: When jealousy spreads in your circle, and you hold on tightly to possessions or people, you lose connection and clarity.
speaker: Hamsa

verse_text:
कः स्विदेको रमते ब्राह्मणानां कः स्विदेको बहुभिर्जोषमास्ते ।
कः स्विदेको बलवान् दुर्बलोऽपि कः स्विदेषां कलहं नान्ववैति ॥
translation: हंस! ब्राह्मणों में कौन एकमात्र सुख को अनुभव करता है? वह कौन ऐसा एक मनुष्य है, जो बहुतों के साथ रहकर भी चुप रहता है? वह कौन एक मनुष्य है, जो दुर्बल होने पर भी बलवान् है तथा इनमें कौन ऐसा है, जो किसी के साथ कलह नहीं करता?
english_translation: Among Brahmins, who alone experiences true joy? Who stays silent among many? Who is strong though weak? Who avoids conflict with others?
essence: True strength is silent peace amid many voices and no conflict.
simple_meaning: True happiness among people comes from being quietly present, strong inwardly even if weak outwardly, and avoiding fights.
insight: This verse shifts focus from external power to inner calm and conflict avoidance as true strength.
modern_relevance: In a noisy meeting where everyone argues, you find calm strength by listening quietly and not joining conflicts.
speaker: Hamsa

verse_text:
प्राज्ञ एको रमते ब्राह्मणानां प्राज्ञश्चैको बहुभिर्जोषमास्ते ।
प्राज्ञ एको बलवान् दुर्बलोऽपि प्राज्ञ एषां कलहं नान्ववैति ॥
translation: देवताओं! ब्राह्मणों में जो ज्ञानी है, एकमात्र वही परम सुख को अनुभव करता है। ज्ञानी ही बहुतों के साथ रहकर भी मौन रहता है। एकमात्र ज्ञानी दुर्बल होने पर भी बलवान् है और इनमें ज्ञानी ही किसी के साथ कलह नहीं करता है।
english_translation: Among the wise Brahmins, only the true sage experiences supreme joy. The wise remain silent even among many, are strong though weak, and do not quarrel with anyone.
essence: Quiet wisdom holds strength and peace, even amid many and in weakness.
simple_meaning: A truly wise person enjoys deep joy, stays silent among crowds, is strong despite weakness, and avoids quarrels.
insight: It teaches you to find power in silence and peace, not in loudness or force.
modern_relevance: You sit in a noisy meeting, but inside you hold calm strength and choose peace over argument.
speaker: Hamsa

verse_text:
किं ब्राह्मणानां देवत्वं किं च साधुत्वमुच्यते ।
असाधुत्वं च किं तेषां किमेषां मानुषं मतम् ॥
translation: हंस ब्राह्मणों का देवत्व क्या है? उनमें साधुता क्या बतायी जाती है? उनके भीतर असाधुता और मनुष्यता क्या मानी गयी है?
english_translation: What is the divine nature of brahmins? What is said about their goodness? What is understood as their lack of goodness and their humanity?
essence: True goodness and failure in others are questions, not fixed answers.
simple_meaning: It asks what true divine qualities and goodness mean for brahmins, and what counts as their failures and human traits.
insight: It shifts your thinking from labels and roles to questioning the true nature behind others' actions and character.
modern_relevance: You might judge someone by their role or reputation but wonder what truly makes them good or flawed beneath it all.
speaker: Hamsa

verse_text:
स्वाध्याय एषां देवत्वं व्रतं साधुत्वमुच्यते ।
असाधुत्वं परीवादो मृत्युर्मानुष्यमुच्यते ॥
translation: साध्यगण! वेद-शास्त्रों का स्वाध्याय ही ब्राह्मणों का देवत्व है। उत्तम व्रतों का पालन करना ही उनमें साधुता बतायी जाती है। दूसरों की निन्दा करना ही उनकी असाधुता है और मृत्यु को प्राप्त होना ही उनकी मनुष्यता बतायी गयी है
english_translation: For the wise, study of the scriptures is the mark of the divine; observing noble vows is true goodness. Speaking ill of others is considered wrongdoing, and leads to a fallen state.
essence: True nobility grows from study and virtue, not from blaming others.
simple_meaning: True goodness comes from studying sacred texts and keeping noble promises. Criticizing others shows bad character and leads to downfall.
insight: Shift your focus from judging others to deepening your own learning and integrity.
modern_relevance: You notice how focusing on your growth and commitments builds respect, while criticizing coworkers only isolates you.
speaker: Hamsa

verse_text:
इत्युक्त्वा परमो देव भगवान् नित्य अव्ययः ।
साध्यैर्देवगणैः सार्धं दिवमेवारुरोह सः ॥
translation: युधिष्ठिर! ऐसा कहकर नित्य अविनाशी परमदेव भगवान् ब्रह्मा साध्य देवताओं के साथ ही ऊपर स्वर्गलोग की और चल दिये
english_translation: Yudhishthira, having spoken thus, the eternal, imperishable supreme divine Brahman ascended to the heavenly realm along with the deities.
essence: The supreme eternal divine departs to the higher realm after completing the teaching.
simple_meaning: The supreme eternal divine being, after finishing the teaching, ascended to the heavenly realm accompanied by divine beings.
insight: The moment of completion in teaching is also a passage to a higher realm beyond ordinary experience.
speaker: Bhishma

verse_text:
एतद् यशस्यमायुष्यं पुण्यं स्वर्गाय च ध्रुवम् ।
दर्शितं देवदेवेन परमेणाव्ययेन च ॥
translation: सर्वश्रेष्ठ अविनाशी देवाधिदेव ब्रह्माजी के द्वारा प्रकाश में लाया हुआ यह पुण्यमय तत्त्वज्ञान यश और आयु की वृद्धि करनेवाला है तथा यह स्वर्गलोग की प्राप्ति का निश्चित साधन है।
english_translation: This glorious, eternal wisdom revealed by the supreme being grants fame, long life, and certain access to the higher realm.
essence: Timeless wisdom from the highest source guarantees lasting growth and certain access to the higher realm.
simple_meaning: This eternal wisdom revealed by the supreme being increases your fame and lifespan and guarantees reaching the higher realm.
insight: It shifts your view from temporary gains to embracing enduring wisdom that supports lasting growth and transcendence.
modern_relevance: When you discover a truth that feels timeless and unchanging, it can strengthen your confidence to persist beyond short-term struggles.
speaker: Hamsa

verse_text:
ततो जगन्मङ्गलमङ्गलात्मना विधाय रामायणकीर्तिमुत्तमाम् ।
चचार पूर्वाचरितं रघूत्तमो राजर्षिवर्यैरभिसेवितं यथा  ॥
translation: हे पार्वति! तदनन्तर, रघु श्रेष्ठ भगवान् राम, संसार के मङ्गल के लिये धारण किये अपने दिव्यमङ्गल देह से रामायण रूप अति उत्तम कीर्ति की स्थापना कर पूर्वकाल में राजर्षि श्रेष्ठों ने जैसा आचरण किया है वैसा ही स्वयं भी करने लगे
english_translation: Then the supreme Raghava Rama, with his divine auspicious body, established the highest fame of the Ramayana for the world's welfare, following the ancient conduct of the best royal sages.
essence: Greatness arises by embodying noble traditions for the welfare of all.
simple_meaning: The supreme Rama took a divine form and followed ancient royal sages to establish the highest fame of the Ramayana for the world's benefit.
insight: It reminds you that honoring noble traditions can inspire your own meaningful actions.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सौमित्रिणा पृष्ट उदारबुद्धिना रामः कथाः प्राह पुरातनीः शुभाः ।
राज्ञः प्रमत्तस्य नृगस्य शापतो द्विजस्य तिर्यक्त्वमथाह राघवः ॥
translation: उदार बुद्धि लक्ष्मणजी के पूछने पर वे प्राचीन उत्तम कथाएँ सुनाया करते थे। इसी प्रसङ्ग में श्रीरघुनाथजी ने, राजा नृग को प्रमादवश ब्राह्मण के शाप से तिर्यग्योनि प्राप्त होने का वृत्तान्त भी सुनाया
english_translation: When Lakshmana asked with a generous mind, Rama told ancient auspicious stories, including the tale of King Nriga cursed by a Brahmin due to negligence.
essence: Rama begins teaching by recounting ancient stories with important moral and spiritual lessons.
simple_meaning: Rama told Lakshmana ancient stories including how King Nriga was cursed and reborn due to a Brahmin's curse.
insight: Stories can reveal how neglect or carelessness can cause lasting consequences beyond what we see.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
कदाचिदेकान्त उपस्थितं प्रभुं रामं रमालालितपादपङ्कजम् ।
सौमित्रिरासादितशुद्धभावनः प्रणम्य भक्त्या विनयान्वितोऽब्रवीत् ॥
translation: किसी दिन भगवान् राम, जिनके चरण कमलों की सेवा साक्षात् श्रीलक्ष्मीजी करती हैं, एकान्त में बैठे हुए थे। उस समय शुद्ध विचार वाले लक्ष्मणजी ने (उनके पास जा) उन्हें भक्तिपूर्वक प्रणाम कर अति विनीतभाव से कहा-
english_translation: One day, Lord Rama, whose feet are lovingly served by Goddess Lakshmi, was sitting alone. At that moment, the pure-minded Lakshmana approached, bowed with devotion, and spoke with great humility.
essence: Lakshmana humbly approaches Rama with devotion to begin sacred teaching.
simple_meaning: Lakshmana respectfully approaches Lord Rama sitting alone and greets him with humility and devotion.
insight: It shows the importance of respectful, humble approach before receiving profound wisdom.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
त्वं शुद्धबोधोऽसि हि सर्वदेहिनामात्मास्यधीशोऽसि निराकृतिः स्वयम् ।
प्रतीयसे ज्ञानदृशां महामते पादाब्जभृङ्गाहितसङ्गसङ्गिनाम् ॥
translation: “हे महामते ! आप शुद्धज्ञानस्वरूप, समस्त देहधारियों के आत्मा, सबके स्वामी और स्वरूप से निराकार हैं। जो आपके चरणकमलों के लिये भ्रमररूप हैं, उन परमभागवतों के सहवास के रसिकों को ही आप ज्ञानदृष्टि से दिखलायी देते हैं “
english_translation: You are pure consciousness, the inner ruler of all beings, formless beyond shape. Only to those devoted to your lotus feet do you reveal yourself through the vision of knowledge.
essence: Pure awareness is formless and only reveals itself to those with clear knowledge and devotion.
simple_meaning: You are pure consciousness beyond form, the inner ruler of all beings. Only those devoted in knowledge truly perceive you.
insight: It shifts your view from identifying with fleeting forms to recognizing your sovereign, unchanging awareness.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by roles and appearances, remember your true self is formless and beyond all labels.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
अहं प्रपन्नोऽस्मि पदाम्बुजं प्रभो भवापवर्गं तव योगिभावितम् ।
यथाञ्जसाज्ञानमपारवारिधिं सुखं तरिष्यामि तथानुशाधि माम् ॥
translation: हे प्रभो! योगिजन जिनका निरन्तर चिन्तन करते हैं, संसार से छुड़ाने वाले उन आपके चरण कमलों की मैं शरण हूँ, आप मुझे ऐसा उपदेश दीजिये जिससे मैं सुगमता से ही अज्ञानरूपी अपार समुद्र के पार हो जाऊँ
english_translation: O Lord! I surrender to your lotus feet, which yogis constantly meditate upon and which liberate from the world. Please teach me so I may easily cross the vast ocean of ignorance.
essence: Complete surrender and trust in wise guidance can carry you beyond deep ignorance.
simple_meaning: You can surrender yourself to the divine presence meditated on by yogis and ask for teachings that help you easily overcome ignorance.
insight: It teaches you to let go of self-reliance and open to guidance that helps you move beyond confusion.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by confusion and doubt, asking for help and trusting a wise guide can open a path forward.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
श्रुत्वाथ सौमित्रवचोऽखिलं तदा प्राह प्रपन्नार्तिहरः प्रसन्नधीः ।
विज्ञानमज्ञानतमःप्रशान्तये श्रुतिप्रपन्नं क्षितिपालभूषणः ॥
