translation: श्रीलक्ष्मणजी की ये सारी बातें सुनकर शरणागतवत्सल भूपालशिरोमणि भगवान् राम, सुनने के लिये उत्सुक हुए लक्ष्मण को उनके अज्ञानान्धकार का नाश करने के लिये प्रसन्नचित्त से ज्ञानोपदेश करने लगे
english_translation: Hearing all of Lakshmana's words, the compassionate lord, the jewel of kings, pleased to teach, began to dispel the darkness of ignorance in the eager listener.
essence: The teacher welcomes sincere seekers to dispel their darkness of ignorance.
simple_meaning: Lakshmana spoke his doubts, and Rama, pleased to teach, began to share knowledge to remove his ignorance.
insight: It shows the importance of openness to learning and a teacher’s readiness to share wisdom with care.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
आदौ स्ववर्णाश्रमवर्णिताः क्रियाः कृत्वा समासादितशुद्धमानसः ।
समाप्य तत्पूर्वमुपात्तसाधनः समाश्रयेत्सद्गुरुमात्मलब्धये ॥
translation: सबसे पहले अपने-अपने वर्ण और आश्रम के लिये (शास्त्रों में) बतलायी हुई क्रियाओं का यथावत् पालनकर चित्त शुद्ध हो जाने पर उन कर्मो को छोड़ दे और शम दमादि साधनों से सम्पन्न हो आत्मज्ञान की प्राप्ति के लिये सद्गुरु की शरण में जाय
english_translation: First, perform the prescribed duties of your own class and stage; when your mind is purified, give up those actions and, accomplished in self-restraint, seek the true teacher for self-realization.
essence: Purify the mind through duty, then renounce action and seek true guidance.
simple_meaning: Begin by faithfully doing the duties assigned to your social role until your mind becomes pure, then give up those actions and seek a true teacher for self-knowledge.
insight: It teaches you to honor your present obligations fully while preparing the mind for deeper spiritual learning.
modern_relevance: You focus fully on your current responsibilities until you feel mentally clear, then you seek guidance to grow beyond them.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
क्रिया श्रीरोद्भवहेतुरादृता प्रियाप्रियौ तौ भवतः सुरागिणः ।
धर्मेतरौ तत्र पुनः शरीरकम् पुनः क्रिया चक्रवदीर्यते भवः ॥
translation: कर्म देहान्तर की प्राप्ति के लिये ही स्वीकार किये गये हैं, क्योंकि उनमें प्रेम रखने वाले पुरुषों से इष्ट-अनिष्ट दोनों ही प्रकार की क्रियाएँ होती हैं। उनसे धर्म और अधर्म दोनों ही की प्राप्ति होती है और उनके कारण शरीर प्राप्त होता है जिससे फिर कर्म होते हैं। इसी प्रकार यह संसार चक्र के समान चलता रहता है
english_translation: Actions are accepted only to obtain another body, because those who care experience both wanted and unwanted actions. From these arise right and wrong, leading again to bodies and actions, thus the cycle of existence continues.
essence: Desire and aversion drive actions, which bind beings to repeated existence cycles.
simple_meaning: You perform actions because you want another life; desires and dislikes cause both good and bad actions, which bring new bodies and more actions, creating a continuous cycle.
insight: It teaches you to see how desire and aversion cause actions that keep you bound to repeated experiences.
modern_relevance: You keep chasing what feels good and avoiding what feels bad, unaware this cycle keeps pulling you back again and again.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
अज्ञानमेवास्य हि मूलकारणं तद्धानमेवात्र विधौ विधीयते ।
विद्यैव तन्नाशविधौ पटीयसी न कर्म तज्जं सविरोधमीरितम् ॥
translation: संसार का मूल कारण अज्ञान ही है। और इन (शास्त्रीय) विधिवाक्यों में उस (अज्ञान) का नाश ही (संसार से मुक्त होने का) उपाय बतलाया गया है। अज्ञान का नाश करने में ज्ञान ही समर्थ है, कर्म नहीं, क्योंकि उस (अज्ञान) से उत्पन्न होने वाला कर्म उसका विरोधी नहीं हो सकता
english_translation: The root cause of the cycle of reactivity is deep confusion. The scriptural teachings prescribe its removal. Only clear understanding can remove deep confusion; action born from confusion cannot oppose it.
essence: Only clear understanding can remove deep confusion that causes the endless cycle of reactivity.
simple_meaning: The root cause of repeated suffering is deep confusion. Only true knowledge can remove this confusion, not actions born from that confusion.
insight: Shift focus from trying harder to seeking clear understanding; true change comes from knowledge, not more action.
modern_relevance: You might try solving problems by more doing, but sometimes only seeing clearly can truly end your struggle.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
नाज्ञानहानिर्न च रागसंक्षयो भवेत्ततः कर्म सदोषमुद्भवेत् ।
ततः पुनः संसृतिरप्यवारिता तस्माद्बुधो ज्ञानविचारवान्भवेत् ॥
translation: कर्मद्वारा अज्ञान का नाश अथवा राग का क्षय नहीं हो सकता बल्कि उससे दूसरे सदोष कर्म की उत्पत्ति होती है। उससे पुनः संसार की प्राप्ति होना अनिवार्य है। इसलिये बुद्धिमान् को ज्ञानविचार में ही तत्पर होना चाहिये
english_translation: Ignorance is not destroyed, nor attachment diminished, by action; instead, action causes further flawed karma. Thus, rebirth in the cycle continues. Therefore, the wise should focus on knowledge and reflection.
essence: Action alone cannot end confusion; only knowledge and reflection can free you.
simple_meaning: You cannot remove deep confusion or attachment through action alone; it only leads to more flawed actions and continued rebirth. Wisdom and reflection are needed.
insight: It teaches you to shift from reactive doing to thoughtful understanding to break repeated patterns.
modern_relevance: You keep trying to fix problems by doing more tasks, but without understanding, you only create more stress and complications.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
ननु क्रिया वेदमुखेन चोदिता तथैव विद्या पुरुषार्थसाधनम् ।
कर्तव्यता प्राणभृतः प्रचोदिता विद्यासहायत्वमुपैति सा पुनः ॥
translation: कुछ वितर्क वादी ऐसा कहते हैं कि-जिस प्रकार वेद के कथनानुसार ज्ञान पुरुषार्थ का साधक है वैसे ही कर्म वेदविहित हैं;  और प्राणियों के लिये कर्मो की अवश्य कर्तव्यता का विधान भी है इसलिये वे कर्म ज्ञान के सहकारी हो जाते हैं।
english_translation: Some argue that just as the Vedas declare knowledge as the means to achieve the goal, so too are actions prescribed by the Vedas; therefore, actions become cooperative with knowledge because living beings must perform their duties.
essence: Duty-bound actions support and cooperate with the pursuit of true knowledge.
simple_meaning: Actions are prescribed by sacred teachings and must be done as duty; these actions support and cooperate with gaining true knowledge.
insight: It shifts your view to see duty and wisdom as partners, not opposites, aligning action with learning.
modern_relevance: When you follow your responsibilities, you’re not just doing tasks — you’re supporting your growth in understanding and purpose.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
कर्माकृतौ दोषमपि श्रुतिर्जगौ तस्मात्सदा कार्यमिदं मुमुक्षुणा ।
ननु स्वतन्त्रा ध्रुवकार्यकारिणी विद्य न किञ्चिन्मनसाप्यपेक्षते ॥
translation: साथ ही श्रुति ने कर्म न करने में दोष भी बतलाया है; इसलिये मुमुक्षु को कर्म सदा ही करते रहना चाहिये, और यदि कोई कहे कि ज्ञान स्वतन्त्र है। एवं निश्चय ही अपना फल देने वाला है उसे मन से भी किसी और की सहायता की आवश्यकता नहीं है
english_translation: The scriptures say that even inaction has fault; therefore, a seeker must always perform action. Knowledge is independent and certain to yield results without any mental expectation.
essence: A true seeker must keep acting because even inaction is flawed.
simple_meaning: You should always act because even not acting is considered wrong. True knowledge works on its own and needs no mental expectations.
insight: It teaches you to commit to consistent action without relying on mental outcomes or doubts.
modern_relevance: You hesitate to act because you fear doing nothing might be safer, but growth comes from steady effort even when results seem unclear.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
न सत्यकार्योऽपि हि यद्वदध्वरः प्रकाङ्क्षतेऽन्यानपि कारकादिकान् ।
तथैव विद्या विधितः प्रकाशितैर्विशिष्यते कर्मभिरेव मुक्तये ॥
translation: तो उसका यह कहना ठीक नहीं, क्योंकि जिस प्रकार (वेदोक्त) यज्ञ सत्य कर्म होने पर भी अन्य कारकादि की अपेक्षा करता ही है, उसी प्रकार विधि से प्रकाशित कर्मों के द्वारा ही ज्ञान मुक्ति का साधक हो सकता है। (अत: कर्मों का त्याग उचित नहीं है)
english_translation: It is not correct to say that even true actions do not expect other causes; similarly, one attains knowledge and freedom only through prescribed actions.
essence: Freedom and knowledge arise through prescribed action, not by abandoning action.
simple_meaning: Even true actions depend on other causes. Likewise, knowledge and freedom arise through properly prescribed actions, so abandoning them is not correct.
insight: It teaches you to see disciplined action as the vehicle for wisdom and freedom, not something to reject.
modern_relevance: You might think stepping back from responsibilities leads to peace, but real growth happens by fully engaging with your rightful duties.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
केचिद्वदन्तीति वितर्कवादिनस्तदप्यसदृष्टविरोधकारणात् ।
देहाभिमानादभिवर्धते क्रिया विद्या गताहङ्कृतितः प्रसिध्द्यति ॥
translation: (सिद्धान्ती-) ऐसा जो कोई कुतर्की कहते हैं उनके कथन में प्रत्यक्ष विरोध होने के कारण वह ठीक नहीं है, क्योंकि कर्म देहाभिमान से होता है और ज्ञान अहंकार के नाश होने पर सिद्ध होता है
english_translation: Some argue illogically, but their view is flawed because actions arise from identification with the body, while true knowledge arises when the sense of separate self is destroyed.
essence: Actions arise from body-identification; true knowledge arises when ego dissolves.
simple_meaning: Actions happen because you identify with your body, but true understanding comes when the sense of separate self disappears.
insight: Recognize that your action urges arise from body attachment; wisdom requires dissolving ego fixation.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by your roles or appearance, remember your actions come from that identification—not your deeper awareness.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
विशुद्धविज्ञानविरोचनाञ्चिता विद्यात्मवृत्तिश्चरमेति भण्यते ।
उदेति कर्माखिलकारकादिभिर्निहन्ति विद्याखिलकारकादिकम् ॥
translation: (वेदान्तवाक्यों का विचार करते-करते) विशुद्ध विज्ञान के प्रकाश से उद्भासित जो चरम आत्मवृत्ति होती है उसी का नाम विद्या (आत्मज्ञान) है। इसके अतिरिक्त कर्म सम्पूर्ण कारकादि की सहायता से होता है, किन्तु विद्या समस्त कारकादि का (अनित्यत्व की भावनाद्वारा) नाश कर देती है
english_translation: The highest self-activity revealed by pure knowledge is called wisdom; all actions depend on causes, but wisdom destroys the sense of impermanence in all causes.
essence: Pure wisdom reveals the unchanging self and destroys all illusions of impermanence.
simple_meaning: Wisdom is the highest pure self-awareness that shines clearly and ends deep confusion about impermanence, unlike actions which depend on causes.
insight: It teaches you to shift attention from the changing causes to the unchanging self-awareness that reveals true clarity.
modern_relevance: When everything around you feels uncertain and you grasp for stability, realizing that pure awareness dissolves all doubts brings deep calm.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
तस्मात्त्यजेत्कार्यमशेषतः सुधीर्विद्याविरोधान्न समुच्चयो भवेत् ॥
आत्मानुसन्धानपरायणः सदानिवृत्तसर्वेन्द्रियवृत्तिगोचरः ॥
translation: इसलिये समस्त इन्द्रियों के विषयों से निवृत्त होकर निरन्तर आत्मानुसन्धान में लगा हुआ बुद्धिमान् पुरुष सम्पूर्ण कर्मों का सर्वथा त्याग कर दे। क्योंकि विद्या का विरोधी होने के कारण कर्म का उसके साथ समुच्चय नहीं हो सकता
english_translation: Therefore, a wise person, detached from all sense objects and constantly engaged in self-inquiry, should completely renounce all actions because actions cannot coexist with knowledge that opposes them.
essence: True self-inquiry requires fully letting go of all action and sense distractions.
simple_meaning: A truly wise person stops all actions and distractions to focus fully on self-inquiry, because action conflicts with deep knowledge.
insight: It teaches you to choose inner exploration over external doing, recognizing that one blocks the other.
modern_relevance: You’ve been caught in endless busywork, but real clarity comes when you stop acting and look deeply within.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
यावच्छारीरादिषु माययात्मधीस्तावद्विधेयो विधिवादकर्मणाम् ।
नेतीति वाक्यैरखिलं निषिध्य तत्ज्ञात्वा परात्मानमथ त्यजेत्क्रियाः ॥
translation: जबतक माया से मोहित रहने के कारण मनुष्य का शरीरादि में आत्मभाव है तभी तक उसे वैदिक कर्मानुष्ठान कर्तव्य है। ‘नेति नेति’ आदि वाक्यों से सम्पूर्ण अनात्मवस्तुओं का निषेध करके अपने परमात्मस्वरूप को जान लेने पर फिर उसे समस्त कर्मो को छोड़ देना चाहिये।
english_translation: As long as the mind is deluded by illusion and identifies with the body, one must perform Vedic rituals. But knowing the supreme self through 'not this, not this,' rejecting all non-self, one should then abandon all actions.
essence: True self-knowledge ends illusion-based doing and frees you from all ritual actions.
simple_meaning: You must perform ritual actions while caught in illusion identifying with the body. But when you truly know your supreme self by rejecting all that is not it, you should give up all actions.
insight: This verse shifts the mind from acting out of false identity to resting in true self-awareness, freeing you from compulsive doing.
modern_relevance: You keep pushing through routines and roles driven by a false sense of who you are. But realizing your true self invites you to rest and release those efforts.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
यदा परात्मात्मविभेदभेदकं विज्ञानमात्मन्यवभाति भास्वरम् ।
तदैव माया प्रविलीयतेऽञ्जसा सकारका कारणमात्मसंसृतेः ॥
translation: जिस समय परमात्मा और जीवात्मा के भेद को दूर करने वाला प्रकाशमय विज्ञान अन्त:करण में स्पष्टतया भासित होने लगता है उसी समय आत्मा के लिये संसार-प्राप्ति की कारण माया अनायास ही कारकादि के सहित लीन हो जाती है
english_translation: When the illuminating knowledge that removes the distinction between the supreme being and the individual self clearly shines within the heart, then the cause of the soul’s entanglement in the world, Maya, naturally dissolves along with its causes.
essence: Clear inner knowledge that reveals oneness dissolves the root cause of illusion effortlessly.
simple_meaning: When you clearly see no real difference between the supreme being and yourself, the illusion that causes your entanglement in the world naturally fades away.
insight: It shifts your mind from seeing separation to recognizing unity, dissolving the root cause of confusion.
modern_relevance: You’ve struggled feeling separate and stuck; suddenly, a clear understanding dawns that you and the universe are deeply connected, and your worries begin to loosen.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
श्रुतिप्रमाणाभिविनाशिता च सा कथं भविषत्यपि कार्यकारिणी ।
विज्ञानमात्रादमलाद्वितीयतस्तस्मादविद्या न पुनर्भविष्यति ॥
translation: श्रुति-प्रमाण से उसके नष्ट कर दिये जाने पर फिर वह किस प्रकार अपना कार्य करने में समर्थ हो सकती है? इसलिये उस एकमात्र ज्ञानस्वरूप निर्मल और अद्वितीय बोध की प्राप्ति होनेपर फिर अविद्या उत्पन्न नहीं हो सकती
english_translation: When the source of knowledge is destroyed, how can ignorance still perform any action? Once you attain pure, unique knowledge, ignorance cannot arise again.
essence: True knowledge, once fully attained, permanently ends the power of ignorance.
simple_meaning: If the original source of true knowledge is gone, ignorance cannot function. Pure and unique knowledge stops ignorance from arising again.
insight: It shifts your approach from fighting ignorance repeatedly to cultivating unshakable, pure knowledge that prevents confusion from arising.
modern_relevance: When you fully understand something deeply, old doubts and confusion lose their grip and can't trick you again.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
यदि स्म नष्टा न पुनः प्रसूयते कर्ताहमस्येति मतिः कथं भवेत् ।
तस्मात्स्वतन्त्रा न किमप्यपेक्षते विद्य विमोक्षाय विभाति केवला ॥
translation: जब एक बार नष्ट हो जाने पर अविद्या का फिर जन्म ही नहीं होता तो बोधवान्को मैं कर्ता हूँ ऐसी बुद्धि कैसे हो सकती है? इसलिये ज्ञान स्वतन्त्र है, उसे जीव के मोक्ष के लिये किसी और (कर्मादि) की अपेक्षा नहीं है, वह स्वयं अकेला ही उसके लिये समर्थ है
english_translation: If ignorance, once destroyed, never arises again, how can there be the idea that I am the doer? Therefore, knowledge is independent; it requires nothing else for liberation and alone is capable of it.
essence: True knowledge alone is self-sufficient and fully frees without needing anything else.
simple_meaning: When ignorance is completely gone and never returns, the idea of ‘I am the doer’ cannot arise. True knowledge is self-sufficient and alone liberates.
insight: It teaches you to trust that true understanding alone is enough for inner freedom without relying on external actions or results.
modern_relevance: When you deeply understand something, you realize you don’t need to cling to external validation or control to feel whole and free.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
सा तैत्तिरीयश्रुतिराह सादरं न्यासं प्रशस्ताखिलकर्मणां स्फुटम् ।
एतावदित्याह च वाजिनां श्रुतिर्ज्ञानं विमोक्षाय न कर्म साधनम् ॥
translation: इसके सिवा तैत्तिरीय शाखा की प्रसिद्ध श्रुति भी स्पष्ट कहती है कि समस्त कर्मों का त्याग करना ही अच्छा है, तथा ‘एतावत्’ इत्यादि वाजसनेयी शाखा की श्रुति भी कहती है कि मोक्ष का साधन ज्ञान ही है कर्म नहीं
english_translation: Besides this, the famous Taittiriya tradition respectfully teaches that giving up all actions is best, and the Vajasaneyi tradition clearly states that knowledge, not action, is the means to freedom.
essence: Freedom is gained through knowledge, not through performing all actions.
simple_meaning: The best teaching is to give up all actions because true freedom comes from knowledge, not from doing.
insight: It shifts focus from striving through actions to seeking clear understanding as the true path to freedom.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by endless tasks, remember that clarity and understanding can bring freedom beyond doing more.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
विद्यासमत्वेन तु दर्शितस्त्वया क्रतुर्न दृष्टान्त उदाहृतः समः ।
फलैः पृथक्त्वाद्बहुकारकैः क्रतुः संसाध्यते ज्ञानमतो विपर्ययम् ॥
translation: और तुमने जो ज्ञान की समानता में यज्ञादि का दृष्टान्त दिया सो ठीक नहीं है, क्योंकि उन दोनों के फल अलग-अलग हैं। इसके अतिरिक्त यज्ञ तो (होता, ऋत्विक, यजमान आदि) बहुत-से कारकों से सिद्ध होता है और ज्ञान इससे विपरीत है (अर्थात् वह कारकादि से साध्य नहीं है)
english_translation: Your example of sacrifice to show equality in knowledge is incorrect because their results differ; sacrifice requires many factors, but knowledge cannot be achieved through such means.
essence: Knowledge and sacrifice differ fundamentally; knowledge isn't attained through external factors.
simple_meaning: You cannot compare knowledge to sacrifice because their purposes and outcomes are different; knowledge is not achieved by external rituals or many factors like sacrifice is.
insight: It shifts your mind from expecting knowledge as an outcome of external effort to realizing it as an inner, self-contained truth.
modern_relevance: You might notice how some achievements require many steps and helpers, but true understanding comes from within and can't be forced by external means.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
सप्रत्यवायो ह्यहमित्यनात्मधीरज्ञप्रसिद्धा न तु तत्त्वदर्शिनः ।
तस्माद्बुधैस्त्याज्यमविक्रियात्मभिर्विधानतः कर्म विधिप्रकाशितम् ॥
translation: (कर्म के त्याग करने से) मैं अवश्य प्रायश्चित्तभागी होऊँगा-ऐसी अनात्म-बुद्धि अज्ञानियों को हुआ करती है, तत्त्वज्ञानी को नहीं। इसलिये विकाररहित चित्तवाले बोधवान् पुरुष को विहित कर्मों का भी विधिपूर्वक त्याग कर देना चाहिये
english_translation: Those ignorant in false self think 'I surely suffer from abandoning action,' not the wise who see reality. Therefore, the wise with steady mind must rightly renounce prescribed actions.
essence: True wisdom knows renouncing action rightly causes no harm to the self.
simple_meaning: Only those confused by false identity think they lose by abandoning action. The wise with steady minds renounce prescribed actions properly.
insight: It shifts focus from fear of losing by stopping to trust in steady inner wisdom beyond action.
modern_relevance: You worry stopping a routine task will cause failure, but deep calm comes when you trust wisdom beyond constant doing.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
श्रद्धान्वितस्तत्त्वमसीति वाक्यतो गुरोः प्रसादादपि शुद्धमानसः ।
विज्ञाय चैकात्म्यमथात्मजीवयोः सुखी भवेन्मेरुरिवाप्रकम्पनः ॥
translation: फिर शुद्धचित्त होकर श्रद्धापूर्वक गुरु की कृपा से ‘तत्त्वमसि’ इस महावाक्य के द्वारा परमात्मा और जीवात्मा की एकता जानकर सुमेरु के समान निश्चल एवं सुखी हो जाय
english_translation: By pure mind and trust, through the teacher's grace, knowing 'You are that'—the unity of supreme and individual self—you become stable and happy like Mount Meru.
essence: Trusting the teaching reveals your unshakable unity with the true self.
simple_meaning: With trust and a pure mind, through the teacher's blessing, you understand that the supreme self and individual self are one, becoming stable and happy like a mountain.
insight: It shifts your mind from doubt and restlessness to steady trust and joyful stability in your true nature.
modern_relevance: After doubting yourself, you finally trust the guidance that reveals your inner strength and feel steady and peaceful despite life's storms.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
आदौ पदार्थावगतिर्हि कारणं वाक्यार्थविज्ञानविधौ विधानतः ।
तत्त्वम्पदार्थौ परमात्मजीवकावसीति चैकात्म्यमथानयोर्भवेत् ॥
translation: यह नियम ही है कि प्रत्येक वाक्य का अर्थ जानने में पहले उसके पके अर्थ का ज्ञान ही कारण है। इस ‘तत्त्वमसि’ महावाक्य के ‘तत्’ और ‘त्वम्’ पद क्रम से परमात्मा और जीवात्मा के वाचक हैं और ‘असि’ उन दोनों की एकता करता है
english_translation: The principle is that understanding the true meaning of each sentence requires knowing its mature sense first; in the phrase 'You are that,' 'You' and 'That' refer to the supreme being and the true self, and 'are' unites them as one.
essence: Understanding 'You are that' reveals the supreme and true self as one reality.
simple_meaning: To understand a sentence’s full meaning, you must grasp its mature sense first; 'You are that' reveals the unity of your true self with the supreme being.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing yourself as separate to recognising your essential unity with the supreme reality.
modern_relevance: When reading something complex, you often need to understand the big picture before the details make sense; similarly, seeing your true self as one with the supreme changes everything.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
प्रत्यक्परोक्षादि विरोधमात्मनोर्विहाय सङ्गृह्य तयोश्चिदात्मताम् ।
संशोधितां लक्षणया च लक्षितां ज्ञात्वा स्वमात्मानमथाद्वयो भवेत् ॥
translation: इन दोनों (जीवात्मा और परमात्मा) में जीवात्मा प्रत्यक (अन्त:करण का साक्षी) है और परमात्मा परोक्ष (इन्द्रियातीत) है, इस (वाच्यार्थरूप) विरोध को छोड़कर और लक्षणावृत्ति से लक्षित उनकी शुद्ध चेतनता को ग्रहण कर उसे ही अपना आत्मा जाने और इस प्रकार एकीभाव से स्थित हो
english_translation: Discarding the apparent opposition between the individual self and the supreme self, grasp their pure consciousness and realize your true self as one with it.
essence: Releasing apparent opposition reveals your true self as pure, unified consciousness.
simple_meaning: You can let go of the seeming difference between your individual self and the supreme self, and realize both are one pure awareness.
insight: It teaches you to notice apparent conflicts in your identity and step beyond them into non-dual awareness.
modern_relevance: When your mind feels torn between who you think you are and a deeper truth, this teaches you to see beyond that conflict and find unity within.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
एकात्मकत्वाज्जहती न सम्भवेत्तथाजहल्लक्षणता विरोधतः ।
सोऽयम्पदार्थाविव भागलक्षणा युज्येत तत्त्वम्पदयोरदोषतः ॥
translation: इन ‘तत्’ और ‘त्वम्’ पदों में एकरूप होने के कारण जहतीलक्षणा नहीं हो सकती और परस्पर विरोध होने के कारण अजहल्लक्षणा भी नहीं हो सकती। इसलिये ‘सोऽयम्’ (यह वही है) इन दोनों पदों के अर्थ की भाँति इन ‘तत्’ और ‘त्वम्’ पदों में भी भागत्यागलक्षणा ही निर्दोषता से हो सकती है
english_translation: Because 'that' and 'you' are one, they cannot have negation by difference or contradiction; thus, 'That same' rightly indicates non-partition between them without fault.
essence: True oneness means no contradiction or division can exist between what is one.
simple_meaning: When two terms refer to the exact same reality, they cannot be truly different or contradictory. Saying 'that same' shows they are united without any division or error.
insight: It shifts your mind from seeing separation to recognizing unity beneath difference.
modern_relevance: You might feel torn between who you appear to be and who you truly are. This teaching shows these identities are not opposing but one and the same.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
रसादिपञ्चीकृतभूतसम्भवं भोगालयं दुःखसुखादिकर्मणाम् ।
शरीरमाद्यन्तवदादिकर्मजं मायामयं स्थूलमुपाधिमात्मनः ॥
translation: पृथिवी आदि पञ्चीकृत भूतों से उत्पन्न हुए, सुख-दुःखादि कर्म-भोगों के आश्रय और पूर्वोपार्जित कर्मफल से प्राप्त होने वाले इस मायामय आदि-अन्तवान् शरीर को विज्ञजन आत्मा की स्थूल उपाधि मानते हैं
english_translation: The body, born from earth and other elements, is the mind's gross covering formed by the fruits of past actions and is the dwelling for experiencing pleasure and pain.
essence: The body is a temporary, illusory covering formed by past actions for experience.
simple_meaning: The body is a temporary, illusory form made from earth and past actions that houses experience of pleasure and pain.
insight: This verse shifts focus from identifying with the body to seeing it as a transient vessel shaped by past karma and illusion.
modern_relevance: When you feel trapped by your body’s limits or moods, remember it is a temporary place shaped by past causes, not your true self.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
सूक्ष्मं मनोबुद्धिदशेन्द्रियैर्युतं प्राणैरपञ्चीकृतभूतसम्भवम् ।
भोक्तुः सुखादेरनुसाधनं भवेत् शरीरमन्यद्विदुरात्मनो बुधाः ॥
translation: और मन, बुद्धि, दस इन्द्रियाँ तथा पाँच प्राण (इन सत्रह अङ्गों) से युक्त और अपञ्चीकृत भूतों से उत्पन्न हुए सूक्ष्म शरीर को जो भोक्ता के सुख-दुःखादि अनुभव को साधन है, आत्मा का दूसरा देह मानते हैं
english_translation: The subtle body, composed of mind, intellect, ten senses, and five vital breaths born of unmodified elements, is known by the wise as the second body of the true self, serving as the instrument for experiencing pleasure and pain.
essence: Pleasure and pain happen in the subtle body, not in your true self.
simple_meaning: You have a subtle body made of mind, senses, and vital breaths that experiences pleasure and pain, but this is not your true self.
insight: It shifts your understanding from identifying with fluctuating sensations to recognizing the deeper, unchanging self behind them.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by emotions or sensations, remember these arise in a subtle part of you, not your true self.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
अनाद्यनिर्वाच्यमपीह कारणं मायाप्रधानं तु परं शरीरकम् ।
उपाधिभेदात्तु यतः पृथक्स्थितं स्वात्मानमात्मन्यवधारयेत्क्रमात् ॥
translation: (इनके अतिरिक्त) अनादि और अनिर्वाच्य मायामय कारणशरीर ही जीव का तीसरा देह है। इस प्रकार उपाधि-भेद से सर्वथा पृथक् स्थित अपने आत्मरूप को क्रमशः (उपाधियों का बाध करते हुए) अपने हृदय से निश्चय करे
english_translation: The eternal, indescribable cause here is the body made of illusion; by distinguishing these coverings, one should gradually recognize the true self within the heart, separate from all identities.
essence: Your true self is distinct from the illusory body and its coverings.
simple_meaning: Your body is a temporary, illusory covering. By seeing through these layers, you can realize your true self beyond all identities.
insight: It teaches you to separate your sense of self from changing outer conditions and identities.
modern_relevance: You may feel defined by your appearance or roles, but beneath these lies your unchanged true self waiting to be seen.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
कोशेष्वयं तेषु तु तत्तदाकृतिर्विभाति सङ्गात्स्फतिकोपलो यथा ।
असङ्गरूपोऽयमजो यतोऽद्वयो विज्ञायतेऽस्मिन्परितो विचारिते ॥
translation: स्फटिकमणि के समान यह आत्मा भी (अन्नमयादि) भिन्न-भिन्न कोशों में उनके सङ्ग से उन्हीं के आकार का भासने लगता है। किन्तु इसका भली प्रकार विचार करने से यह अद्वितीय होने के कारण असङ्गरूप और अजन्मा निश्चित होता है
english_translation: Like a crystal shining with the colors of different vessels, the true self appears shaped by associations but is actually unborn and without attachments when deeply examined.
essence: The true self appears many ways but is actually unborn, free, and without attachments.
simple_meaning: The true self looks like it takes on many forms depending on surroundings, but when you examine it deeply, it is actually unborn and not attached to any form.
insight: It shifts your understanding from identifying with external roles or appearances to recognizing your unchanging inner reality.
modern_relevance: When you feel defined by your roles or circumstances, this verse reminds you that your essence is beyond all changing forms and untouched by external labels.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
बुद्धेस्त्रिधा वृत्तिरपीह दृश्यते स्वप्नादिभेदेन गुणत्रयात्मनः  ।
अन्योन्यतोऽस्मिन्व्यभिचारितो मृषा नित्ये परे ब्रह्मणि केवले शिवे ॥
translation: त्रिगुणात्मिका बुद्धि की ही स्वप्न, जाग्रत् और सुषुप्ति भेद से तीन प्रकार की वृत्तियाँ दिखायी देती हैं, किन्तु इन तीनों वृत्तियों में से प्रत्येक का एक-दूसरी में व्यभिचार होने के कारण, ये (तीनों ही) एकमात्र कल्याणस्वरूप नित्य परब्रह्म में मिथ्या हैं (अर्थात् उसमे इन वृत्तियों का सर्वथा अभाव है)
english_translation: The discerning mind appears in three forms—like dream, waking, and deep sleep—but all are false and intermingled; only in the supreme reality, the pure blissful, are they absent.
essence: The mind’s three shifting states are intertwined illusions absent only in the supreme reality.
simple_meaning: The mind shows itself in three shifting states like waking, dreaming, and deep sleep, but these are mixed illusions. Only the highest reality is free from these false appearances.
insight: Recognize that your changing mental states are temporary illusions, freeing your awareness to rest in the unchanging supreme.
modern_relevance: When your thoughts confuse and shift constantly, remember that your true self is beyond these restless states.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
देहेन्द्रियप्राणमनश्चिदात्मनां  सङ्घादजस्त्रं परिवर्तते धियः ।
वृत्तिस्तमोमूलतयाज्ञलक्षणा यावद्भवेत्तावदसौ भवोद्भवः ॥
translation: बुद्धि की वृत्ति ही देह, इन्द्रिय, प्राण, मन और चेतन आत्मा के संघातरूप से निरन्तर परिवर्तित होती रहती है। यह वृत्ति तमोगुण से उत्पन्न होने वाली होने के कारण अज्ञानरूपा है और जबतक यह रहती है तबतक ही संसार में जन्म होता रहता है
english_translation: The activity of the discerning mind continuously changes due to the union of body, senses, life-force, mind, and conscious self; born from the root of darkness it causes ignorance, and as long as it persists, the cycle of birth continues.
essence: Restless mental activity born of ignorance keeps the cycle of rebirth alive.
simple_meaning: Your discerning mind keeps changing because it mixes with body, senses, life-force, and mind, creating ignorance that traps you in cycles of rebirth.
insight: Recognize that the restless mind's constant changes are the root cause of your repeated cycles of reaction and becoming.
modern_relevance: When your thoughts endlessly shift, reacting to every sensation and impulse, you feel stuck in repeated habits and patterns you can’t break free from.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
नेतिप्रमाणेन निराकृताखिलो हृदा समास्वादितचिद्घनामृतः ।
त्यजेदशेषं जगदात्तसद्रसं पीत्वा यथाम्भः प्रजहाति तत्फलम् ॥
translation: नेति-नेति’ आदि श्रुति-प्रमाण से निखिल संसार का बाध करके और हृदय में चिङ्घनामृत का आस्वादन करके सम्पूर्ण जगत् को, उसके साररूपा सत् (ब्रह्म) को ग्रहण करके त्याग दे, जैसे नारियल के जल को पीकर मनुष्य उसे फेंक देते हैं
english_translation: Reject all of the world by 'not this, not this' reasoning and, having tasted the nectar of pure consciousness in your heart, renounce everything as a man discards a coconut's water after drinking it.
essence: Fully embrace your true self, then effortlessly release all else like discarded water.
simple_meaning: Use clear reasoning to reject everything that is not your true self, fully experience your pure inner being, then let go of all worldly attachments like discarding empty water.
insight: It teaches you to discern and fully experience your true self before releasing all that does not serve that truth.
modern_relevance: You’ve learned the truth about yourself deeply; now it’s time to let go of old attachments that no longer serve you.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
कदाचिदात्मा न मृतो न जायते न क्षीयते नापि विवर्धतेऽनवः ।
निरस्तसर्वातिशयः सुखात्मकः स्वयम्प्रभः सर्वगतोऽयमद्वयः ॥
translation: आत्मा न कभी मरता है न जन्मता । है; वह न कभी क्षीण होता है और न । बढ़ता ही है। वह पुरातन, सम्पूर्ण विशेषणों से रहित, सुखस्वरूप, स्वयंप्रकाश, सर्वगत और अद्वितीय है
english_translation: The true self is never dead, never born, never diminished, never increased; it is ancient, free of all qualities, blissful, self-illuminated, all-pervading, and unique.
essence: Your true self is eternal, unchanging, blissful, and uniquely whole beyond all qualities.
simple_meaning: The true self never dies or is born, never loses or gains anything. It is ancient, pure happiness, self-lit, everywhere, and one of a kind.
insight: It shifts your focus from fleeting events to recognizing your unchanging essence beneath all change.
modern_relevance: When fears of loss or change overwhelm you, remember your deepest self remains untouched and whole regardless of life’s shifts.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
एवंविधे ज्ञानमये सुखात्मके कथं भवो दुःखमयः प्रतीयते ।
अज्ञानतोऽध्यासवशात्प्रकाशते ज्ञाने विलीयेत विरोधतः क्षणात् ॥
translation: जो इस प्रकार ज्ञानमय और सुखस्वरूप है उसमें (ज्ञान होने के बाद) यह दु:खमय संसार कैसे प्रतीत हो सकता है? यह तो अध्यास के कारण अज्ञान से ही प्रतीत होता है, ज्ञान से तो एक क्षण में ही लीन हो जाता है, क्योंकि ज्ञान और अज्ञान का परस्पर विरोध है
english_translation: How can that which is made of knowledge and is the essence of happiness appear sorrowful? It seems so only because of ignorance and superimposition; knowledge dissolves it instantly as they are opposed.
essence: Sorrow appears only from ignorance; true knowledge removes it instantly.
simple_meaning: Something made of pure knowledge and happiness cannot really seem sorrowful. Suffering appears only because of ignorance and confusion, and true knowledge quickly removes that illusion.
insight: It shifts the mind from accepting suffering as real to seeing it as a mistaken overlay removable by clear understanding.
modern_relevance: You might feel overwhelmed by sadness or stress, but this teaches that those feelings come from confusion, not your true self.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
यदन्यदन्यत्र विभाव्यते भ्रमादध्यासमित्याहुरमुं विपश्चितः ।
असर्पभूतेऽहिविभावनं यथा रज्ज्वादिके तद्वदपीश्वरे जगत् ॥
translation: भ्रम से जो अन्य में अन्य की प्रतीति होती है उसी को विद्वानों ने अध्यास कहा है। जिस प्रकार असर्परूप रज्जु में सर्प की प्रतीति होती है, उसी प्रकार ईश्वर में संसार की प्रतीति हो रही है
english_translation: Scholars call the illusion of seeing one thing as another 'adhyasa'; just as a snake is perceived in a rope, the world is perceived in the supreme being.
essence: The world is a mistaken perception superimposed on the supreme reality, like a snake seen in a rope.
simple_meaning: Sometimes your mind mistakes one thing for another, like seeing a snake in a rope. Similarly, the world appears as something real but is actually a superimposed illusion.
insight: This verse teaches you to question what you perceive and recognize how your mind overlays false images on reality.
modern_relevance: When you panic seeing a shadow that looks like a threat, it’s like this—your mind’s quick mistake creates needless fear.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
विकल्पमायारहिते चिदात्मकेऽहङ्कार एष प्रथमः प्रकल्पितः ।
अध्यास एवात्मनि सर्वकारणे निरामये ब्रह्मणि केवले परे ॥
translation: जो विकल्प और माया से रहित है। उस सबके कारण निरामय, अद्वितीय और चित्स्वरूप परमात्मा ब्रह्म में पहले इस ‘अहंकार’ रूप अध्यास की ही कल्पना होती है
english_translation: The first manifestation is ego, free from alternatives and illusion, existing as pure consciousness in the supreme reality, untouched by causes.
essence: Ego is the first false identity appearing in pure consciousness beyond all cause.
simple_meaning: Ego is the first false sense of self that appears in pure consciousness, free from illusion and causes.
insight: It shifts your view from identifying as ego to seeing ego as a temporary, cause-free illusion within pure awareness.
modern_relevance: When you feel a strong 'I' or separate self, remember this sense is a first false image, not your true being.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
इच्छादिरागादि सुखादिधर्मिकाः सदा धियः संसृतिहेतवः परे ।
यस्मात्प्रसुप्तौ तदभावतः परः सुखस्वरूपेण विभाव्यते हि नः ॥
translation: सबके साक्षी आत्मा में इच्छा, अनिच्छा, राग-द्वेष और सुख-दुःखादिरूप बुद्धि की वृत्तियाँ ही जन्म-मरणरूप संसार को कारण हैं; क्योंकि सुषुप्ति में इनका अभाव हो जाने पर हमें आत्मा का सुखरूप से भान होता है
english_translation: Desires, aversions, attachments, and feelings of pleasure and pain in the mind are the causes of the cycle of birth and death; because in deep sleep, their absence reveals to us the blissful nature of the true self.
essence: The absence of desires reveals the blissful true self beyond the restless mind.
simple_meaning: Your desires, dislikes, attachments, and feelings of pleasure and pain create the cycle of rebirth. When these disappear in deep sleep, you experience the bliss of your true self.
insight: This verse teaches you to recognize that the restless mind’s cravings are not your true nature, which is peaceful and blissful.
modern_relevance: After a long, busy day filled with cravings and worries, the relief you feel in deep rest hints at a deeper joy beyond your thoughts.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
अनाद्यविद्योद्भवबुद्धिबिम्बितो जीवप्रकाशोऽयमितीर्यते चितः ।
आत्माधियः साक्षितया पृथक्स्थितो बुध्द्यापरिच्छिन्नपरः स एव हि ॥
translation: अनादि अविद्या से उत्पन्न हुई बुद्धि में प्रतिबिम्बित चेतन का प्रकाश ही ‘जीव’ कहलाता है। बुद्धि के साक्षीरूप से आत्मा उससे पृथक् है, वह परात्मा तो बुद्धि के परिच्छेद से रहित है
english_translation: The living being is the light of consciousness reflected in intellect born from beginningless ignorance; the true self is separate from intellect as its witness and beyond its distinctions.
essence: Your true self is the unchanging watcher beyond intellect and its illusions.
simple_meaning: The living being is consciousness shining through intellect, which comes from endless ignorance. The true self is separate, watching intellect without being affected by its changes.
insight: It teaches you to shift from identifying with your thoughts to recognizing yourself as their impartial observer.
modern_relevance: When your thoughts overwhelm you, remember there's a quiet part of you observing it all, untouched and steady.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
चिद्बिम्बसाक्ष्यात्मधियां प्रसङ्गतस्त्वेकत्र वासादनलाक्तलोहवत् ।
अन्योन्यमध्यासवशात्प्रतीयते जडाजडत्वं च चिदात्मचेतसोः ॥
translation: अग्नि से तपे हुए लोहे के समान चिदाभास, साक्षी आत्मा तथा बुद्धि के एकत्र रहने से परस्पर अन्योन्याध्यास होने के कारण क्रमश: उनकी चेतनता और जडता प्रतीत होती है। (अर्थात् जिस प्रकार अग्नि से तपे हुए लोहपिण्ड में अग्नि और लोहे का तादात्म्य हो जाने से लोहे का आकार अग्नि में और अग्नि की उष्णता लोहे में दिखायी देने लगती है उसी प्रकार बुद्धि और आत्मा का तादात्म्य हो जाने से आत्मा की चेतनता बुद्धि आदि में और बुद्धि आदि की जडता आत्मा में प्रतीत होने लगती है। इसलिये अध्यासवश बुद्धि से लेकर शरीरपर्यन्त अनात्म वस्तुओं को ही आत्मा मानने लगते हैं)
english_translation: Like fire-heated iron, the reflection of consciousness, the witnessing self, and the discerning mind, when dwelling together, mutually superimpose qualities, causing their distinctness and dullness to appear.
essence: Your true self and mind mix, creating illusions of difference and dullness.
simple_meaning: When the true self, mind, and awareness stay together, they mix their qualities, making you see dullness and difference where there is none.
insight: It teaches you to see the mind’s qualities as overlays on your true self, not as your real nature.
modern_relevance: Like when your thoughts and feelings blend so much you can’t tell what’s really you, this verse shows how mind and true self confuse each other’s qualities.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
गुरोः सकाशादपि वेदवाक्यतः सञ्जातविद्यानुभवो निरीक्ष्य तम् ।
स्वात्मानमात्मस्थमुपाधिवर्जितं त्यजेदशेषं जडमात्मगोचरम् ॥
translation: गुरु के समीप रहने से और वेदवाक्यों से आत्मज्ञान का अनुभव होने पर अपने हृदयस्थ उपाधिरहित आत्मा का साक्षात्कार करके आत्मारूप से प्रतीत होने वाले देहादि सम्पूर्ण जड पदार्थों का त्याग कर देना चाहिये
english_translation: When the knowledge born from being near the Guru and studying the Vedas is experienced, one should abandon all inert matter perceived as the body by realizing the self within the heart, free from all attachments.
essence: True knowledge arises by realizing the self beyond all attachments and rejecting what is not you.
simple_meaning: By learning from the Guru and sacred texts, you realize the true self free from all limits and give up identifying with the body and inert things.
insight: It guides you to shift focus from outer identifications to the inner self free of attachments.
modern_relevance: After reading or hearing wise advice, you begin to feel who you truly are beyond your job, belongings, and body—and you start letting go of those identifications.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
प्रकाशरूपोऽहमजोऽहमद्वयोऽसकृद्विभातोऽहमतीव निर्मलः ।
विशुद्धविज्ञानघनो निरामयः सम्पूर्ण आनन्दमयोऽहमक्रियः ॥
translation: मैं प्रकाशस्वरूप, अजन्मा, अद्वितीय, निरन्तर भासमान, अत्यन्त निर्मल, विशुद्ध विज्ञानघन, निरामय, क्रियारहित और एकमात्र आनन्दस्वरूप हूँ
english_translation: I am the embodiment of light, unborn, unique, ever shining, supremely pure, dense with pure knowledge, free from disease, actionless, and the sole source of bliss.
essence: Your true self is an unborn, pure light that is always free and joyful.
simple_meaning: You are the eternal light that never began, perfectly pure, full of true knowledge, free from illness, without any action, and the source of complete joy.
insight: This verse shifts focus from your changing body and mind to your unchanging, radiant true self beyond all action.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by illness, mistakes, or constant doing, remember your core being is untouched, pure, and always peaceful beneath it all.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
सदैव मुक्तोऽहमचिन्त्यशक्तिमानतीन्द्रियज्ञानमविक्रियात्मकः ।
अनन्तपारोऽहमहर्निशं बुधैर्विभावितोऽहं हृदि वेदवादिभिः ॥
translation: मैं सदा ही मुक्त, अचिन्त्यशक्ति, अतीन्द्रिय, अविकृतरूप और अनन्तपार हूँ। वेदवादी पण्डितजन अहर्निश मेरा हृदय में चिन्तन करते हैं
english_translation: I am always free, of inconceivable power, beyond the senses, immutable, infinite and transcendent. The wise scholars constantly contemplate me in their hearts through the Vedas.
essence: Your true self is eternally free, beyond senses, infinitely powerful, and unchanging.
simple_meaning: You are forever free, beyond what the senses perceive, unchanging and infinitely vast. Wise people realize this truth through deep reflection.
insight: It teaches you to recognize your inner being as vast, constant, and beyond sensory fluctuations.
modern_relevance: When stress tries to shake you, remember your true self is unchanging and beyond any challenge you face.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
एवं सदात्मानमखण्डितात्मना विचारमाणस्य विशुद्धभावना ।
हन्यादविद्यामचिरेण कारकै रसायनं यद्वदुपासितं रुजः ॥
translation: इस प्रकार सदा आत्मा का अखण्ड वृत्ति से चिन्तन करने वाले पुरुष के अन्त: करण में उत्पन्न हुई विशुद्ध भावना तुरन्त ही कारकादि के सहित अविद्या का नाश कर देती है, जिस प्रकार नियमानुसार सेवन की हुई ओषधि रोग को नष्ट कर डालती है
english_translation: Thus, a person who constantly contemplates the true self with an undivided mind develops a pure inner state that quickly destroys ignorance and its causes just like medicine cures disease when properly taken.
essence: Steady, undivided focus on your true self quickly dissolves ignorance like medicine cures illness.
simple_meaning: When you steadily focus on your true self, a pure feeling arises inside that quickly removes ignorance and its causes, like medicine curing disease.
insight: It teaches you to maintain steady attention on your true self, enabling clarity to dissolve deep confusion naturally.
modern_relevance: You sit quietly, focusing fully on your core self despite distractions, and soon confusion about who you are begins to lift like a fever breaking.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
विविक्त आसीन उपारतेन्द्रियो विनिर्जितात्मा विमलान्तराशयः ।
विभावयेदेकमनन्यसाधनो विज्ञानदृक्केवल आत्मसंस्थितः ॥
translation: (आत्मचिन्तन करने वाले पुरुष को चाहिये कि) एकान्त देश में इन्द्रियों को उनके विषयों से हटाकर और अन्त:करण को अपने अधीन करके बैठे तथा आत्मा में स्थित होकर और किसी साधन का आश्रय न लेकर शुद्धचित्त हुआ केवल ज्ञानदृष्टिद्वारा एक आत्मा की ही भावना करे
english_translation: One who reflects on the true self should sit alone, withdraw the senses from their objects, control the mind, remain pure within, focus on the self alone without other support, and be established in pure knowledge.
essence: True self-knowledge arises when you sit alone, control senses, and focus solely on the self.
simple_meaning: To understand your true self, sit alone, withdraw your senses, control your mind, and focus only on the self with clear knowledge.
insight: It teaches you to practice withdrawing attention from external distractions and resting steadily in self-awareness alone.
modern_relevance: When your phone is off and the world is quiet, you finally hear your own thoughts clearly and know who you really are.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
विश्वं यदेतत्परमात्मदर्शनं विलापयेदात्मनि सर्वकारणे ।
पूर्णश्चिदानन्दमयोऽवतिष्ठते न वेद बाह्यं न च किञ्चिदान्तरम् ॥
translation: यह विश्व परमात्मस्वरूप है, ऐसा समझकर इसे सबको कारणरूप आत्मा में लीन करे; इस प्रकार जो पूर्ण चिदानन्दस्वरूप से स्थित हो जाता है उसे बाह्य अथवा आन्तरिक किसी भी वस्तु का ज्ञान नहीं रहता
english_translation: Understand that this entire world is the supreme reality; merge it into the true self as the cause of all; one established in full consciousness and bliss knows nothing external or internal.
essence: The whole world is the supreme reality within you, beyond inside or outside.
simple_meaning: The entire world is the supreme reality, and by recognizing it as the cause within your true self, you abide in complete consciousness and bliss, beyond knowing any external or internal object.
insight: It shifts your perception from seeing separation to recognizing unity, freeing you from inner and outer conflict.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by distractions inside and outside, this teaching invites you to realize all is one, calming restless thoughts and bringing deep inner joy.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
पूर्वं समाधेरखिलं विचिन्तयेदोङ्कारमात्रं सचराचरं जगत् ।
तदेव वाच्यं प्रणवो हि वाचको विभाव्यतेऽज्ञानवशान्न बोधतः ॥
translation: समाधि प्राप्त होने के पूर्व ऐसा चिन्तन करे कि सम्पूर्ण चराचर जगत् केवल ओंकारमात्र है। यह संसार वाच्य है। और ओंकार इसका वाचक है। अज्ञान के कारण ही संसार की प्रतीति होती है, ज्ञान होने पर इसका कुछ भी नहीं रहता
english_translation: Before achieving complete stillness, reflect that the entire moving and unmoving world is only the sound Om. That alone is spoken of; Om is the speaker. Due to ignorance, the world appears; with knowledge, it ceases.
essence: The entire world appears as one sound due to ignorance, revealed as one in knowledge.
simple_meaning: Before reaching deep inner stillness, realize that the whole world, living and non-living, is just the sound Om. The world is what Om expresses. Ignorance makes this world seem real; knowledge reveals it as empty.
insight: It shifts your understanding from seeing many things to recognizing a single essence behind all appearances.
modern_relevance: When your mind chases endless distractions, remember all those seem real only because you haven’t found your still center yet.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
अकारसंज्ञः पुरुषो हि विश्वको ह्युकारकस्तैजस ईर्यते क्रमात् ।
प्राज्ञो मकारः परिपठ्यतेऽखिलैः समाधिपूर्वं न तु तत्त्वतो भवेत् ॥
translation: (ओंकारमें अ, उ और में ये तीन वर्ण हैं; इनमें से) अकार विश्व (जागृति के अभिमानी का) वाचक है, उकार तैजस (स्वप्नका अभिमानी) कहलाता है और मकार प्राज्ञ (सुषुप्ति के अभिमानी) को कहते हैं; यह व्यवस्था समाधिलाभ से पहले की है, तत्त्वदृष्टि से ऐसा कोई भेद नहीं है
english_translation: The true self is called the syllable 'A'; the universe arises from 'U' and 'M' sounds in order. These represent waking, dreaming, and deep sleep states but ultimately are not distinct in reality.
essence: The waking, dreaming, and deep sleep states appear different but are one in the true self.
simple_meaning: The sounds A, U, and M symbolize waking, dreaming, and deep sleep states, but these states are ultimately unified in the true self beyond all distinctions.
insight: It teaches you to see mental states as temporary forms within one continuous awareness, not separate realities.
modern_relevance: When your mind jumps between alertness, daydreaming, and deep rest, remember these are just appearances masking your unchanging true self.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
विश्वं त्वकारं पुरुषं विलापयेदुकारमध्ये बहुधा व्यवस्थितम् ।
ततो मकारे प्रविलाप्य तैजसं द्वितीयवर्णं प्रणवस्य चान्तिमे ॥
translation: नाना प्रकार से स्थित अकाररूप विश्व पुरुष को उकार में लीन करे और ओंकार के द्वितीय वर्ण तैजसरूप उकार को उसके अन्तिम वर्ण मकार में लीन करे
english_translation: The universe, shaped like the sound 'A', is absorbed into the sound 'U', which often manifests in many forms; then the radiant second part of the sacred syllable 'Om', the 'U' sound, dissolves into its final part, the 'M' sound.
essence: All forms arise and dissolve within the cosmic sound of Om, revealing radiant unity.
simple_meaning: The entire universe is like the sound 'A' that merges into 'U' in many forms, and then this 'U' dissolves into the final sound 'M' of the sacred syllable Om, symbolizing the cosmic unity.
insight: It shifts your view to see all diverse experiences as stages of one continuous, radiant reality.
modern_relevance: When you witness a complex process, like a project unfolding step by step, you can see how each phase merges into the next, forming a unified whole beyond the parts.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
मकारमप्यात्मनि चिद्घने परे विलापयेत्प्राज्ञमपीह कारणम् ।
सोऽहं परं ब्रह्म सदा विमुक्तिमद्विज्ञानदृङ् मुक्त उपाधितोऽमलः ॥
translation: फिर कारणात्मा प्राज्ञरूप मकार को भी चिङ्घनरूप परमात्मा में लीन करे; (और ऐसी भावना करे कि) वह नित्यमुक्त विज्ञानस्वरूप उपाधिहीन निर्मल परब्रह्म मैं ही हूँ
english_translation: Even the ego, in the wise, merges into the supreme reality as pure awareness; I am that supreme being, always free, beyond all limiting identities.
essence: The ego merges into pure awareness as the always free supreme reality.
simple_meaning: The sense of separate self (ego) can dissolve into the supreme reality as pure consciousness. I am that supreme being, always free and without limiting identities.
insight: It invites you to see your ego as a temporary layer that can be released into pure awareness and freedom.
modern_relevance: When your ego feels stuck or defensive, remember it can dissolve into a larger freedom beyond labels and limits.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
एवं सदा जातपरात्मभावनः स्वानन्दतुष्टः परिविस्मृताखिलः ।
आस्ते स नित्यात्मसुखप्रकाशकः साक्षाद्विमुक्तोऽचलवारिसिन्धुवत् ॥
translation: इस प्रकार निरन्तर परात्मभावना करते-करते जो आत्मानन्द में मग्न हो गया है तथा जिसे सम्पूर्ण दृश्य प्रपञ्च विस्मृत हो गया है वह नित्य आत्मानन्द का अनुभव करने वाला जीवन्मुक्त योगी निस्तरंग समुद्र के समान साक्षात् मुक्तस्वरूप हो जाता है
english_translation: One who constantly dwells in the supreme self, absorbed in bliss and forgetting all worldly appearances, becomes a liberated yogi shining with eternal self-happiness, like a still ocean fully free.
essence: Total absorption in blissful self-awareness leads to complete freedom like a calm ocean.
simple_meaning: By always focusing on your supreme true self and its bliss, forgetting all distractions, you become truly free and peaceful like a calm ocean.
insight: This verse shifts your mind from restless engagement with distractions to steady absorption in inner bliss.
modern_relevance: When your mind stops chasing every distraction and settles in contentment, you experience a calm freedom like a still ocean in a noisy world.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
एवं सदाभ्यस्तसमाधियोगिनो निवृत्तसर्वेन्द्रियगोचरस्य हि ।
विनिर्जिताशेषरिपोरहं सदा दृश्यो भवेयं जितषड्गुणात्मनः ॥
translation: इस प्रकार जो निरन्तर समाधियोग का अभ्यास करता है, जिसके सम्पूर्ण इन्द्रियगोचर विषय निवृत्त हो गये हैं तथा जिसने काम क्रोधादि सम्पूर्ण शत्रुओं को परास्त कर दिया है, उस छहों इन्द्रियों (मन और पाँच ज्ञानेन्द्रियों) को जीतने वाले महात्मा को मेरा निरन्तर साक्षात्कार होता है
english_translation: Thus, one who constantly practices yoga in complete absorption, whose senses have withdrawn from all objects, and who has conquered all enemies like desire and anger, I am always seen by that self-controlled great being.
essence: Mastery over senses and desires reveals the constant presence of your true self.
simple_meaning: When you practice deep absorption and control your senses and desires, you become aware of your true self constantly.
insight: It teaches you to turn your attention inward by mastering the senses and emotions, revealing your true self.
modern_relevance: You notice your calm deepen when you resist distractions and impulses, letting your true nature emerge quietly.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
ध्यात्वैवमात्मानमहर्निशं मुनिस्तिष्ठेत्सदा मुक्तसमस्तबन्धनः ।
प्रारब्धमश्नन्नभिमानवर्जितो मय्येव साक्षात्प्रविलीयते ततः ॥
translation: इस प्रकार अहर्निश आत्मा का ही चिन्तन करता हुआ मुनि सर्वदा समस्त बन्धनों से मुक्त होकर रहे तथा (कर्ता भोक्तापन के) अभिमान को छोड़कर प्रारब्धफल भोगता रहे। इससे वह अन्त में साक्षात् मुझही में लीन हो जाता है
english_translation: By constantly meditating on the true self, the sage remains always free from all bonds, renounces pride in results, and endures the consequences without ego, ultimately merging directly into me.
essence: True freedom arises by meditating on your true self and letting go of pride in results.
simple_meaning: Constantly focusing on your true self helps you stay free from all attachments and accept consequences without ego, leading to union with the divine.
insight: It teaches you to focus inward, dropping ego about results, which cleans your experience and opens union.
modern_relevance: After a long day of effort, you accept whatever comes next without boasting or blaming, finding peace in simply being yourself.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
आदौ च मध्ये च तथैव चान्ततो भवं विदित्वा भयशोककारणम् ।
हित्वा समस्तं विधिवादचोदितं भजेत्स्वमात्मानमथाखिलात्मनाम् ॥
translation: संसार को आदि, अन्त और मध्य में सब प्रकार भय और शोक का ही कारण जानकर समस्त वेदविहित कर्मो को त्याग दे तथा सम्पूर्ण प्राणियों के अन्तरात्मारूप अपने अत्मा का भजन करे
english_translation: Knowing that fear and sorrow are the cause of the world’s beginning, middle, and end, abandon all prescribed actions and worship your own inner being as the true self of all beings.
essence: Fear and sorrow underlie all of existence; true refuge is devotion to your own inner self.
simple_meaning: Fear and sorrow cause all suffering through life’s phases. Let go of all ritual duties and connect with your own inner self, which is the true self of all beings.
insight: It shifts focus from external religious duties to inner devotion, freeing you from fear-driven actions.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by anxiety and sadness that seem endless, you realize that external efforts aren’t enough; turning inward to your true self brings relief.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
आत्मन्यभेदेन विभावयन्निदं भवत्यभेदेन मयात्मना तदा ।
यथा जलं वारिनिधौ यथा पयः क्षीरे वियद्व्योम्न्यनिले यथानिलः ॥
translation: जिस प्रकार समुद्र में जल, दूध में दूध, महाका शमें घटाकाशादि और वायु में वायु मिलकर एक हो जाते हैं उसी प्रकार इस सम्पूर्ण प्रपञ्च को अपने आत्मा के साथ अभिन्नरूप से चिन्तन करने से जीव मुझ परमात्मा के साथ अभिन्नभाव से स्थित हो जाता है
english_translation: Just as water merges into the ocean, milk into milk, space into space, and air into air, similarly, by realizing the entire universe as inseparable from your true self, you become one with the supreme reality.
essence: Recognizing all things as inseparable from your true self reveals your oneness with reality.
simple_meaning: When you understand that everything in the world is not separate from your true self, you realize unity with the supreme reality.
insight: It shifts your view from separation to unity, helping you see yourself as part of a greater whole.
modern_relevance: When you feel isolated or disconnected, remember how rivers flow into the ocean — all parts of one vast whole.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
इत्थं यदीक्षेत हि लोकसंस्थितो जगन्मृषैवेति विभावयन्मुनिः ।
निराकृतत्वाच्छ्रुतियुक्तिमानतो यथेन्दुभेदो दिशि दिग्भ्रमादयः ॥
translation: यह जो जगत् है वह श्रुति, युक्ति और प्रमाण से बाधित होने के कारण चन्द्रभेद और दिशाओं में होने वाले दिग्भ्रम के समान मिथ्या ही है-ऐसी भावना करता हुआ लोक (व्यवहार) में स्थित मुनि, इसे देखे
english_translation: A sage established in the world sees the world as false, like the moon’s phases or directional illusions, due to its dependence on scriptures, logic, and perception.
essence: The world appears real but is shaped by shifting illusions and limited knowledge.
simple_meaning: A wise person understands that the world appears unreal, like illusions caused by changing moon phases or confusing directions, because it depends on limited knowledge and perception.
insight: It teaches you to question appearances and recognize how your mind constructs reality from imperfect sources.
modern_relevance: You’ve felt confused by shifting opinions or unreliable information, realizing much of what seems real is shaped by your mind’s filters.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
यावन्न पश्येदखिलं मदात्मकं तावन्मदाराधनतत्परो भवेत् ।
श्रद्धालुरत्यूर्जितभक्तिलक्षणो यस्तस्य दृश्योऽहमहर्निशं हृदि ॥
translation: जबतक सारा संसार मेरा ही रूप दिखलायी न दे, तबतक निरन्तर मेरी आराधना करता रहे। जो श्रद्धालु और उत्कट भक्त होता है उसे अपने हृदय में मेरा रात-दिन साक्षात्कार होता है
english_translation: As long as everything appears as my own self, one should continuously worship me; a devoted person with deep faith sees me day and night in their heart.
essence: Deep, unwavering devotion makes the divine continuously present in your heart.
simple_meaning: When you constantly see everything as connected to the divine, your deep devotion makes the divine visible in your heart day and night.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate unwavering faith so that the divine presence becomes a living reality in your daily experience.
modern_relevance: You find yourself drawn to a cause or person so deeply that their presence feels alive within you every moment.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
रहस्यमेतच्छ्रुतिसारसङ्ग्रहं मया विनिश्चित्य तवोदितं प्रिय ।
यस्त्वेतदालोचयतीह बुद्धिमान् स मुच्यते पातकराशिभिः क्षणात् ॥
translation: हे प्रिय! सम्पूर्ण श्रुतियों के साररूप इस गुप्त रहस्य को मैंने निश्चय करके तुमसे कहा है। जो बुद्धिमान् इसका मनन करेगा वह तत्काल समस्त पापों से मुक्त हो जायगा
english_translation: Dear one, I have definitely revealed to you this secret that is the essence of all scriptures. The wise who reflect on it are instantly freed from all wrongdoing.
essence: Reflecting on the secret essence of scriptures instantly frees you from wrongdoing.
simple_meaning: I have told you the hidden essence of all scriptures. Anyone who wisely reflects on this will immediately be freed from all wrongdoing.
insight: It teaches you that deep reflection on core truths can dissolve past mistakes without delay.
modern_relevance: You just uncovered a simple truth that can lift your heaviest regrets almost immediately.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
भ्रातर्यदीदं परिदृश्यते जगन्मायैव सर्वं परिहृत्य चेतसा ।
मद्भावनाभावितशुद्धमानसः सुखी भवानन्दमयो निरामयः ॥
translation: भाई! यह जो कुछ जगत् दिखायी देता है वह सब माया है। इसे अपने चित्त से निकालकर मेरी भावना से शुद्धचित्त और सुखी होकर आनन्दपूर्ण और क्लेशशून्य हो जाओ
english_translation: Brother! Everything that appears in the world is an illusion; remove it from your mind, become pure in my feeling, happy, full of bliss, and free from suffering.
essence: Illusion clouds the world; clearing the mind reveals pure bliss and freedom.
simple_meaning: Everything you see in the world is illusion. Remove it from your mind and become pure, happy, and free from suffering through connecting with my feeling.
insight: It teaches you to recognize appearances as temporary and to deepen connection with what is pure and joyful within.
modern_relevance: You notice your mind overwhelmed by worries and distractions that feel real but aren't the truth of who you are. Letting them go opens space for lasting joy.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
यः सेवते मामगुणं गुणात्परं हृदा कदा वा यदि वा गुणात्मकम् ।
सोऽहं स्वपादाञ्चितरेणुभिः स्पृशन् पुनाति लोकत्रितयं यथा रविः ॥
translation: जो पुरुष अपने चित्त से मुझ गुणातीत निर्गुण का अथवा कभी-कभी मेरे सगुण स्वरूप का भी सेवन करता है वह मेरा ही रूप है। वह अपनी चरण-रज के स्पर्श से सूर्य के समान सम्पूर्ण त्रिलोकी को पवित्र कर देता है
english_translation: Whoever serves me as the transcendent beyond qualities, or sometimes in my qualified form, is truly my own; by touching my feet, they purify the three worlds like the sun.
essence: True service embraces the divine beyond form and purifies everything it touches.
simple_meaning: When you serve the divine beyond qualities or sometimes in form, you are truly connected and purify all around you.
insight: It shifts your focus from superficial traits to a deeper essence, allowing your actions to have a purifying, expansive effect.
modern_relevance: When you sincerely honor what lies beyond appearances—whether a person, idea, or challenge—you bring clarity and healing to yourself and your surroundings.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
विज्ञानमेतदखिलं श्रुतिसारमेकं वेदान्तवेदचरणेन मयैव गीतम् ।
यः श्रद्धया परिपठेद्गुरुभक्तियुक्तो मद्रूपमेति यदि मद्वचनेषु भक्तिः ॥
translation: यह अद्वितीय ज्ञान समस्त श्रुतियों  का एकमात्र सार है। इसे वेदान्तवेद्य भगवत्पाद मैंने ही कहा है। जो गुरुभक्तिसम्पन्न पुरुष इसका श्रद्धापूर्वक पाठ करेगा उसकी यदि मेरे वचनो में प्रीति होगी तो वह मेरा ही रूप हो जायगा
english_translation: This unique knowledge is the single essence of all scriptures, spoken by me as the Vedantic teacher. Whoever studies it with devotion to the teacher, and has love for my words, becomes one with me.
essence: Faithful devotion to this teaching makes you one with its truth and the teacher.
simple_meaning: This knowledge is the essence of all scriptures, revealed by me as the Vedantic teacher. Studying it with faith and devotion makes you one with the teaching.
insight: It teaches you to approach knowledge with faith and devotion, making it a living, personal experience.
modern_relevance: When you deeply trust a mentor and engage with their teaching wholeheartedly, it can transform your understanding of yourself.
speaker: Rama

verse_text:
गुरुदेव ! त्वया मोक्तं पुराणान्यखिलानि यत् ।
विद्यन्ते स्मृतयो नूनं श्रुतितत्त्वप्रकाशिकाः ॥
translation: हे गुरुदेव ! आपने कहा था कि पुराण सभी वेदों के तात्पर्यप्रकाशक स्मृतियाँ हैं
english_translation: O Guru, you said that the Puranas are all the remembered texts that illuminate the true meaning of the Vedas.
essence: The Puranas reveal the deeper meaning behind the Vedas as remembered teachings.
simple_meaning: The Puranas are described as texts that explain the true meaning found in the Vedas.
insight: Recognize that some teachings serve as bridges to deeper understanding rather than standalone knowledge.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
नैकोपनिषदश्चापि पुराणनिचये ननु।
गीतानाम्ना च विख्यातास्सन्ति तत्राऽपि भूरिशः ॥
translation: और पुराणों में गीता नाम से विख्यात अनेक उपनिषद् भरे हुए हैं
english_translation: Many Upanishads, famous by the name Gita, are also found in the Puranas.
essence: Many scriptures contain Gita-named Upanishads within the Puranas.
simple_meaning: Many Upanishads named Gita are found within the Puranas as well.
insight: It encourages openness to diverse expressions of spiritual knowledge beyond a single text.
modern_relevance: You realize that wisdom is spread across many sources, not just one book or teacher.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
आदिष्टञ्चाऽपि मे देव ! विबुधानां च सन्निधौ ।
प्रादुरासीन्महादेवी स्वयं ब्रह्ममयी पुरा ॥
translation: हे देव ! आपने यह भी आज्ञा की थी कि पुरा काल में ब्रह्ममयी महादेवी देवताओं के सन्मुख प्रकट हुई थीं
english_translation: O Devi! You also commanded that in ancient times, the great goddess, embodying the supreme reality, appeared before the enlightened beings.
essence: The great goddess once appeared before enlightened beings as the supreme reality.
simple_meaning: The great goddess, who is the supreme reality, appeared long ago before enlightened beings as you had commanded.
insight: It highlights the sacred moment when deeper truths reveal themselves to prepared awareness.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
रहस्यं शक्तिरूपस्य शक्तिमब्रह्मणो बहु ।
श्रावयित्वा महादेवी देवान साध्वकृतार्थयत् ॥
translation: और उन्होंने शक्तिमान् ब्रह्म के शक्तिमय स्वरुप के अनेक रहस्य उनको भलीभाँति सुनाकर कृतकृत्य किया था
english_translation: The great Goddess revealed many secrets of the powerful form of the supreme being, satisfying the gods and the sages.
essence: Revealing many secrets of the supreme being fulfilled the gods and sages.
simple_meaning: The great Goddess shared many mysterious teachings about the powerful form of the supreme being, pleasing the gods and sages.
insight: It shows the importance of revealing deep wisdom to those ready to receive it, fostering understanding and gratitude.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
त्रिलोकपावनी दिव्यां शक्तिगीतां सुदुर्लभाम् ।
अतो मां श्रावयेदानी ज्ञानानन्ददयानिधे ! ॥
translation: अत: कृपा करके हे ज्ञान आनन्द और दया के निधि गुरुदेव ! त्रिलोक पवित्र कर, सुदिव्य और दुर्लभ शक्तिगीता मुझे सुनाइये
english_translation: Therefore, O revered Guru, the treasure of knowledge, bliss, and compassion, please graciously recite to me the divine, rare Shakti Gita that purifies the three worlds.
essence: Rare, divine teachings that uplift all worlds are sought from a compassionate teacher.
simple_meaning: A humble request is made to the revered teacher to recite the rare and divine Shakti Gita that purifies all worlds.
insight: It shows the importance of seeking guidance from a trusted source to access profound and transformative wisdom.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
त्वद्भक्सा सूत ! सद्बुद्धे ! प्रसन्नोऽस्मि न संशयः ।
विशेषतश्च ते मसा विश्वकल्याणसक्तया ॥
translation: हे सुबुद्धि सूत ! मैं तुम्हारी भक्ति से और विशेषतः तुम्हारी जगत्कल्याण में लगी हुई बुद्धि से अत्यंत प्रसन्न हूँ
english_translation: O wise Suta! I am pleased by your devotion and especially by your wisdom devoted to the welfare of the world.
essence: Devotion combined with wisdom focused on universal welfare brings divine delight.
simple_meaning: The goddess expresses her happiness at Suta's devotion and his keen wisdom focused on helping the world.
insight: Recognizing the divine's pleasure encourages aligning devotion with wisdom aimed at collective good.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
अतः सूत ! समीहेऽहं तुभ्यं श्रावयितुं शनैः ।
पुराणशास्त्रं परमं वेदार्थप्रतिपादकम् ॥
translation: इसलिये शनैः शनैः वेदार्थ प्रतिपादक पुराण शास्त्र तुम्हें सुनाने की मैं इच्छा रखता हूँ
english_translation: Therefore, Suta said: I wish to slowly recount to you the supreme Purana that explains the meaning of the Vedas.
essence: Deep wisdom requires patient, gradual sharing to be truly understood.
simple_meaning: Suta expresses his wish to slowly narrate the supreme Purana that reveals the meaning of the Vedas.
insight: It reminds you that deep wisdom unfolds best with patience and gradual explanation.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
यतस्त्वमेव तच्छास्त्रं नृणामभ्युदयाय वै ।
निःश्रेयसकृते चैव लोके ख्यापयितुं प्रभुः ॥
translation: क्योंकि तुम उन शास्त्रों को मनुष्यों के अभ्युदय और निःश्रेयस के लिये जगत में प्रकट करने में समर्थ हो
english_translation: Because you alone are capable of manifesting the scriptures among humans for their welfare and ultimate freedom.
essence: Only you can manifest teachings that bring true welfare and ultimate freedom to humanity.
simple_meaning: You alone have the power to bring the teachings to people that lead to their well-being and highest freedom.
insight: It teaches you to appreciate your unique role in sharing wisdom that serves others' highest welfare and freedom.
modern_relevance: You might feel overwhelmed wondering who can truly help others thrive; this reminds you that your unique insight can illuminate lasting good for those around you.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
श्रावये शक्तिगीतां नामिदानीं श्रूयतां खलु ।
महादेवीपदाम्भोजचञ्चरीकदा त्वया ॥
translation: इस समय शक्तिगीता मैं तुम्हें सुनाता हूँ सुनो, क्योंकि तुम्हारा चित्तरूपी भ्रमर महादेवी के पदरूपी कमल में सदा लीन रहता है
english_translation: Now I tell you the Shakti Gita; listen well, for your mind-like bumblebee always dwells in the lotus feet of the great goddess.
essence: The mind naturally dwells in devotion to the divine, inviting attentive listening now.
simple_meaning: The speaker announces telling the Shakti Gita and asks to listen, describing the listener's mind as always absorbed in the goddess's lotus feet.
insight: Recognize how your mind often clings to what holds your deepest attention, inviting deliberate focus.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
गीतेयं सारभूताऽस्ति सर्वोपनिषदां हिता।
निष्कर्षः सर्ववेदानां जननी ज्ञानवर्चसाम् ॥
translation: यह सब उपनिषदों की साररूपा, वेदों का निष्कर्ष और ज्ञानज्योति की जननी है
english_translation: This is the essence of all the Upanishads, the conclusion of all the Vedas, and the source of the light of knowledge.
essence: The deepest wisdom and clarity of all sacred texts comes together here as one source.
simple_meaning: This teaching contains the core truth of all ancient sacred texts and is the source of clear understanding.
insight: Recognize that profound knowledge can be distilled into a clear, guiding essence that lights your path.
modern_relevance: When you study a complex subject, you look for the key insight that unlocks everything else—this teaching is that key.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
पुरा देवासुरे युद्धे साक्षाब्रह्मस्वरूपिणीम्।
जगदम्वां महादेवीं समाराध्य दिवौकसः ॥
translation: पुरातन काल में देवताओ ने देवासुर संग्राम में जब साक्षात् ब्रह्म स्वरुपिणी जगन्मात रूपधारिणी महादेवी की
english_translation: In ancient times, during the war between devas and asuras, the divine beings worshipped the great goddess, the mother of the world, who is the very form of Brahman.
essence: The great goddess embodies supreme reality and is honored by all in cosmic struggle.
simple_meaning: Long ago, the divine beings worshipped the great goddess who is the mother of the world and the very form of the supreme reality during a battle with the shadow forces.
insight: Recognize the source of strength and support beyond conflict and division in your own life.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
विविधैविधिभिः सूत ! विजयं लमिरे यदा ।
अम्बायज्ञमनुष्ठाय ततस्ते विधिपूर्वकम् ॥
translation: अनेक प्रकार से उपासना करके जय प्राप्त किया था और इस जयलाभ के पश्च्यात विधिपूर्वक अम्बायज्ञ का अनुष्ठान कर
english_translation: O Suta, after gaining victory through many diverse methods, the sacred ritual dedicated to the Mother was then performed according to proper procedures.
essence: Victory gained by many means leads to proper ritual honoring the Mother.
simple_meaning: Victory was achieved through many varied methods, and afterward a sacred ritual honoring the Mother was performed properly.
insight: Recognize that success often results from multiple efforts and deserves respectful acknowledgment.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
दिक्षाचक्रिरे देवीं विधूतकल्मपास्तदा।
तस्मिन् काले तु देवनारदस्योपदेशतः ॥
translation: विधूतफल्मष होकर महादेवी के दर्शन लाभ करने की उन्होंने इच्छा की थी, उस समय देवर्षि नारद के उपदेश द्वारा उनको
english_translation: Having removed all faults, they desired to see the Great Goddess then, prompted by sage Narada's teaching.
essence: Purification and sage's advice prepare one to meet the Great Goddess.
simple_meaning: They purified themselves and wished to see the Great Goddess, guided by sage Narada's advice.
insight: It shows that preparation and wise guidance are needed before a true spiritual experience.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
विविदुर्विबुधाः सर्वे यन्मणिद्वीपमुनमम।
तैयद्यप्यम्बिकालोकं समासाद्य महेश्वरी ॥
translation: यह विदित हुआ था कि यद्यपि देवी लोकरूपी मणिद्वीप में जाकर जगन्माता का
english_translation: It is known that even the wise attain the divine light of Ambika upon reaching the jeweled island of the sage.
essence: Even the wisest are illuminated by the Goddess's divine light upon approach.
simple_meaning: Even the most learned reached the divine light of the Goddess upon arriving at the sacred jeweled island.
insight: It shows that spiritual experience surpasses intellectual knowledge and can illuminate anyone who approaches with openness.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
द्रष्टुं शक्या तथाऽप्येते सर्वे गन्तुं न शक्नुयुः।
तत्र देवाः कियन्तस्तु किंयन्मात्रर्पयस्तथा ॥
translation: दर्शन प्राप्त हो सकता है परन्तु वहां सब देवता पहुंच नहीं सकते, केवल कुछ देवता और कुछ ऋषिगण ही
english_translation: All can see there, but not all can reach; only some deities and sages can go there.
essence: Many can witness the sacred, but only few can truly enter it.
simple_meaning: Many can see that place, but only a few divine beings and sages can actually reach it.
insight: Recognize that not all visible opportunities or truths are accessible to everyone; some require special readiness or purity.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
क्षमन्ते गन्तुमेवाऽहो सूत ! तत्राऽप्यपेक्ष्यते ।
महादेव्या दयादृष्टिस्तां विना नैतुमीशते ॥
translation: पहुँचने का सामर्थ्य रखते हैं, तो भी महादेवी की कृपा सापेक्ष है
english_translation: Even if one has the ability to reach, without the compassionate gaze of the Great Goddess, it is not possible to attain her.
essence: Compassion from the divine is essential to truly reach the highest goal, beyond mere ability.
simple_meaning: No matter how capable you are, reaching the divine presence requires her compassionate grace.
insight: It teaches to open the heart to receive compassion as a vital part of progress, not just rely on personal effort.
modern_relevance: You might have all the skills for a goal, but without support or kindness from others, success remains out of reach.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
एवं सुविदिते तात ! भगवान देवनायकः ।
विष्णुरूचे तदानीन्तु देवान् सम्बोध्य तानिदम् ॥
translation: ऐसा विदित होने पर देवनायक भगवान् विष्णु ने सब देवताओ को समझाकर कहा
english_translation: Having thus understood, the divine leader Vishnu then addressed all the deities to explain this matter.
essence: Clear understanding prompts sharing knowledge with others.
simple_meaning: After understanding the situation clearly, Vishnu, the leader of the divine beings, spoke to explain it to the other deities.
insight: Recognize when understanding calls for sharing and guiding others with clarity.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
प्रभवो न यदा गन्तुं निखिलास्तत्र निर्जराः!
शक्नुवन्त्यपि ये गन्तुं देवीलोकं हि तेऽपि च ॥
translation: जब सब देवतागण देवी लोक में नहीं पहुंच सके और जिनकी वहां पहुंचने की सामर्थ्य भी है वे भी
english_translation: When all radiant beings cannot reach the realm of the Goddess, even those capable of reaching it cannot go there.
essence: Some realms of the divine remain unreachable even to those capable of reaching them.
simple_meaning: Sometimes, the realm of the divine is unreachable even for those who seem capable of entering it.
insight: It shifts perspective from relying solely on ability toward recognizing unseen barriers in spiritual or personal growth.
modern_relevance: You might face situations where your skills or efforts can’t open certain doors, reminding you that some things are beyond control.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
क्षमन्ते स्वेच्छया नैतुं जगदम्वादयामृते ।
यदा तु जगदम्बायाः सर्वथाऽपेक्षिता कृपा ॥
translation: अपनी इच्छा से नहीं पहुंच सकते, अत: जब जगन्माता की कृपा ही सब प्रकार से अपेक्षित है
english_translation: You cannot reach by your own will; thus, the universal mother’s grace is always needed in every way.
essence: Your own will can’t reach the sacred; only grace guides fully.
simple_meaning: You cannot reach the divine merely by trying on your own; you always need the universal mother’s grace in every way.
insight: It shifts your mindset from relying solely on self-will to opening to grace as a necessary companion.
modern_relevance: You’ve pushed hard but feel stuck—this reminds you that some support beyond effort is essential to move forward.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
सर्वैरागम्यतां तहिं ब्रह्मचक्रमनुत्तमम् ।
अस्माभिमिलितद्देवैरिहाऽनुष्ठीयतां हितम् ॥
translation: तो आओ हम सब मिलकर हितकारी और सर्वोत्तम ब्रह्मचक्र का अनुष्ठान करें
english_translation: Come, let us all together perform the beneficial and supreme Brahma-cycle ritual.
essence: The highest beneficial ritual is performed together with unity and devotion.
simple_meaning: Everyone should come together to perform the highest and most beneficial Brahma-cycle ritual.
insight: It highlights the power of collective effort in sacred or meaningful undertakings.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
वयञ्चेद् ब्रह्मचक्रेऽस्मिन् कृतकृत्या भवेम ह ।
अर्मुना ब्रह्मचक्रेण सर्वोत्कृष्टतमेन च ॥
translation: यदि ब्रह्मचक्र में हम लोग सफल काम होंगे और यदि इस सर्वोत्तम चक्र द्वारा
english_translation: If we become perfect through the supreme Brahmachakra, then indeed we attain completeness.
essence: Perfection through the supreme spiritual cycle leads to complete fulfillment.
simple_meaning: Becoming perfect through the highest spiritual practice leads to full completeness.
insight: It encourages committing fully to the highest spiritual discipline to realize your true purpose.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
सर्वेऽभिन्नान्तरात्मानः स्वीयाभिः कम्पशक्तिभिः ।
स्वज्ञानेन स्वभक्त्या च जगन्मातुः पदाम्बुजे ॥
translation: हम लोग सब एक अन्तःकरण होकर अपनी क्रियाशक्ति, भक्ति और ज्ञान से जग माता के चरणों में
english_translation: All beings are one inner self, united by their power of action, devotion, and wisdom at the feet of the world mother.
essence: All beings share one inner self united by action, devotion, and wisdom toward the world mother.
simple_meaning: All beings share the same inner self and are connected through their own action, devotion, and wisdom to the world mother.
insight: This verse invites you to recognize your shared inner nature with others, shifting your view from separation to connection.
modern_relevance: When you feel isolated, remember your inner self connects you deeply to others through your choices and care.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
शक्नुयाम वयं लब्धुमेकाग्रत्वं परं यदि।
तदा मे दृढविश्वासो वर्तते-विबुधर्षभाः॥
translation: एकाग्रता प्राप्त कर सकेंगे तो मेरा स्थिर विश्वास है कि
english_translation: If we can attain complete focus, then my firm confidence remains, O best of the wise.
essence: Complete focus creates the steady confidence needed to face any challenge.
simple_meaning: When you can focus your mind fully, a strong confidence naturally arises within you.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate single-pointed attention as the root of enduring inner trust.
modern_relevance: When your thoughts scatter during work or study, remember real confidence comes from steady focus, not just wishing for success.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
यन्नूनं सा महादेवी स्वयमाविर्भविष्यति ।
स्वदर्शनोपदेशाभ्यामत्रैवाऽनुग्रहीप्यति ॥
translation: महादेवी अवश्य यहां ही स्वयं आविर्भूत होकर दर्शन और उपदेश द्वारा हम लोगों को कृतकृत्य करेंगी
