english_translation: The great Goddess herself will surely manifest here and graciously bless through her vision and teachings.
essence: The divine will manifest here and bless through direct vision and teaching.
simple_meaning: The great Goddess will appear here in person and bless us by showing herself and giving teachings.
insight: It encourages opening your heart to trust that guidance and blessings can come directly, not just through distant or indirect means.
modern_relevance: When you feel alone or uncertain, trust that a guiding presence can appear anytime to support and teach you.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
एतच्छुत्वा वचो विष्णोस्तदानीं निखिलाः मुराः ।
विष्णुं चक्रेश्वर कृत्वा भगवन्त रमापतिम् ॥
translation: इतना भगवान् विष्णु का वचन सुनकर उस समय समस्त देवतागण भगवान विष्णु को
english_translation: Hearing these words of the supreme being Vishnu, at that moment all the radiant beings bowed to Vishnu, the lord of the discus, the divine consort of Lakshmi.
essence: Clear, authoritative words inspire natural respect and unity among radiant beings.
simple_meaning: After hearing Vishnu's words, all the radiant beings respectfully acknowledged him as the lord of the discus and Lakshmi's consort.
insight: It reveals the power of words to inspire respect and alignment among a community when spoken with clarity and authority.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
पुण्येन ब्रामचक्रेण सर्वश्रेष्ठत्वमंजुषा ।
उपास्तै महादेव्याः प्रवृत्ताः सुसमाहिताः ॥
translation: चक्रेश्वर बनाकर ब्रह्मचक्र के द्वारा महादेवी की उपासना में सावधान होकर प्रवृत्त हुए
english_translation: By the sacred Brahma-disc, the foremost devotees engaged in worship of the great goddess with full concentration.
essence: Focused, careful worship honors the great goddess with full concentration.
simple_meaning: The best worshippers carefully used the sacred Brahma-disc to focus deeply on worshiping the great goddess.
insight: It reminds you that focused, respectful attention deepens any sacred practice.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
तनो विहारिणी निसं भक्तमानसमन्दिरे।
आद्या सैव महादेवी करुणैकनिकेतनम् ॥
translation: भक्त मनोमन्दिर विहारिणी वही करुणामयी आद्या महादेवी
english_translation: The primal great goddess dwells in the temple of the devoted heart, filled with compassion.
essence: The primal goddess lives within the compassionate, devoted heart.
simple_meaning: The primal goddess resides within the heart filled with devotion and compassion.
insight: Recognize that opening your heart with devotion allows the divine presence to be experienced directly.
modern_relevance: When you feel compassion deeply for someone, you experience a sacred presence within yourself.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
देवग्नुष्टिते तस्मिन् ब्रह्मचक्रे सुदुर्लभे।
देवासिगोचरीभूय दिव्यं तेजस्वितमयम ॥
translation: सब देवताओं के द्वारा अनुष्ठित ब्रह्मचक्र में  देवताओं के दर्शनेन्द्रियगोचर होकर दिव्य तेजोमय और
english_translation: In the rare sacred circle performed by all the radiant beings, the divine brilliance becomes visible to the senses of the divine beings.
essence: A rare sacred ritual reveals divine brilliance visible only to divine beings.
simple_meaning: A rare sacred ritual performed by divine beings reveals a heavenly brilliance visible to divine senses.
insight: It hints that some profound experiences require special readiness or presence to be perceived.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सर्वसौन्दर्य शोभाढन्यं परमाद्भुतदर्शनम् ।
विभ्राणाऽलौकिक रूपमाविर्भाविमवाप ह ॥
translation: सब सौन्दर्यों से शोभित अद्भुत रूप में प्रकट हुई
english_translation: She appeared in a form adorned with all beauty, wondrous and supernatural.
essence: The divine manifests as a form beyond ordinary beauty and wonder.
simple_meaning: She appeared in an extraordinary form, shining with all kinds of beauty and wonder.
insight: Seeing the divine form shows how appearances can express immense power and inspire devotion.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
दिवौकसोऽखिला अमी पुरस्तदा
व्यलोकयनंखण्डमण्डलाकृति विभिद्य त्रै तमन्ततिम् ।
अखण्डमण्डलात्मकं मुदिव्यमेकमद्भुतं यहः
किमप्यहो परं प्रकाशते स्म दुःसहम् ॥
translation: उस समय इन सब देवताओं ने देखा कि अन्धकार को भेदन करके एक सुदिव्य, अद्भुत, दुःसह और अखण्ड मण्डलाकार ज्योति उनके सामने प्रकाशित हुई
english_translation: At that time, all the radiant beings saw an unbroken, wondrous, unbearable light shining before them, piercing through the darkness.
essence: A single radiant light can break through the deepest darkness, revealing the supreme.
simple_meaning: All the radiant beings witnessed a single, bright, continuous light that broke through complete darkness.
insight: It shows that even the deepest darkness can be pierced by a single, intense clarity.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अनन्तकोटिसूर्यतेज ओघमोघताकरं 
विभासते स्म तन्महः समुज्ज्वलं मनोहरम् ।
महरततोऽन्तरा गलद्विधरण्यपुञ्जसन्निभा 
समाविरास्त षोडशी समस्तविश्वमोहिनी ॥
translation: वह ज्योति अनन्त कोटि सूर्यों की तेजोराशि को भी पराभूत करने वाली, समुज्ज्वल, मनोहर और शोभायमान थी। उस ज्योति के बीच से एक गलितकाञ्चन के सदृश और जगत को मुग्धं करने वाली षोडशी स्त्रीमूर्ति प्रकट हुई
english_translation: That radiant light outshone the brilliance of infinite millions of suns, dazzling and beautiful. From within that light appeared a molten-golden form, the enchanting sixteen-armed goddess who captivates the entire world.
essence: A radiant light reveals the captivating sixteen-armed form that enchants all.
simple_meaning: A light brighter than millions of suns appeared, revealing the sixteen-armed goddess who captivates the whole world with her golden form.
insight: It invites you to notice when something in your life shines so brightly it captures your full attention.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अपूर्वमूतिरम्विकाऽवलास्वरूपधारिणी 
वभौ समस्तविश्वनव्यभास्वरप्रभाकरा।
सुदिव्यवस्नभूषणैविभूषिता चतुर्भुजैः 
सुपाशमशंक  तथाऽभयं वरंच विभ्रती ॥
translation: जो स्त्रीरूप धारण करने वाली अपूर्व मूर्ति देवी संसार की नवीन देदीप्यमान सब शोभाओं की छवि रूप से विराज रही है, जो दिव्य वस्त्र और अलंकारों से भूषित है, जो चार हाथों में पाश, अंकुश, अभय और वर को धारण किये हुई
english_translation: The Goddess, in the form of a unique woman, shines as the radiant image of all new glories in the world, adorned with divine garments and ornaments, holding the noose, goad, fearlessness, and boon in her four hands.
essence: The Goddess appears as a radiant woman holding symbols of power, protection, and blessing.
simple_meaning: The Goddess is described as a unique woman shining beautifully with divine clothes and ornaments, holding four symbolic items in her hands.
insight: The verse invites you to recognize the divine presence through its symbolic expressions of protection and grace.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
असौ जगद्भवस्थितिप्रणाशकारिणीश्वरी
शिवात्मनः परात्परस्य नाभिपद्यमास्थिता।
शिवोऽपि दिव्यमञ्चमतस्यधिस्वपंस्त्रिदेवयुक्
पितृवज्रपिनिर्जरा यदीयपादरूपिणः ॥
translation: जगत की उत्पत्ति स्थिति लय करने वाली जगदीश्वरी शिव रूप धारी परमब्रह्म के नाभि कमल पर आसीना है, शिव दिव्य मंच पर सोये हुए हैं जिस मंच के ब्रह्मा, शिव और विष्णु के सहित अनेक पितृ ऋषि और देवता स्वरुप हैं
english_translation: The sovereign lady who causes the creation, preservation, and destruction of the world sits on the navel lotus of the supreme Shiva, the highest true self. Shiva himself rests on her divine throne, surrounded by the three gods, ancestors, sages, and radiant beings.
essence: The divine source of all existence rests beyond even the highest true self at the universe's center.
simple_meaning: At the center of the universe sits the divine mother who creates, sustains, and destroys all, with the supreme consciousness resting upon her.
insight: Recognize that your inner being is the foundational source beyond even your highest sense of self, shifting your sense of identity and power.
modern_relevance: In moments when you feel overwhelmed by life's changes, remember that your true self holds the power to create, sustain, and transform everything around you.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
गभीरमप्यहोऽम्बिकामुखं सुचारुदर्शनं
जगद्विमोहकारकस्वमन्दहास्यशोभितम् ।
अवाचि संसपि स्वतस्तदाननादुदेति च
जगद्विमोइसाधकः स ओंध्यनिर्निरन्तरम् ॥
translation: देवी का मुख सुचारु दर्शन और गम्भीर होने पर भी जगन्मुग्धकर मन्द हास्य से सुशोभित है, निर्वाक होने पर भी उनके मुख से जगत् को मुग्ध करने वाली ओंकार ध्वनि स्वतः ही निकल रही है
english_translation: The face of Devi is deeply profound yet beautifully clear, adorned with a gentle smile that enchants the world; though silent, from her mouth flows the captivating Om sound that mesmerizes all beings continuously.
essence: Profound quietness can naturally radiate enchanting power and presence.
simple_meaning: Devi's face is deeply profound and beautifully clear with a gentle smile that enchants the world. Though she is silent, a captivating Om sound flows naturally from her mouth, mesmerizing everyone.
insight: It reveals how presence and subtle expression can influence and captivate without needing words or noise.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
समस्ततत्त्वतो ध्रुवं बहिर्गताऽप्यसौ शिवा
जगत्स्यदिव्यशक्तिभिश्च येविषयथाऽखिलम् ।
ददाति विश्वशङ्करं परं निरन्तरं मुहुः
प्रसादमात्मनो जगन्निवासिनीवजातये ॥
translation: वे सर्वतत्त्वातीत होने पर भी अपनी दैवी शक्ति से जगत् में परिव्याप्त होकर संसार के कल्याण कारी उत्कृष्ट अपने प्रसाद को जगनिवासी जीवसमूह को निरन्तर बारम्बार प्रदान कर रही हैं
english_translation: Although transcending all elements, She pervades the world with divine power, continuously granting her grace for the welfare of all beings.
essence: The divine pervades all and endlessly offers grace to sustain life.
simple_meaning: She is beyond all elements but fills the world with her divine power, continuously giving grace to support all beings.
insight: Recognize that divine power is not distant but actively present, continuously offering support and grace in every moment.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by the world's challenges, remember there is a constant, unseen power supporting and blessing life around you.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
सदात्मिका चिदात्मिका रसात्मिकाऽद्याऽप्यसौ
 प्रपद्य सच्चीदात्मकं हि भावमात्मनैव तु ।
प्रपंचरूपधारिणी महेश्वरी द्वयात्मिका 
रसात्मकस्वसत्तया समस्तविश्वमाश्नुत ॥
translation: वह अद्वैत सच्चिदानंदमयी होने पर भी सत् और चित् भाव के आश्रय से द्वैतरूप धारण करती हुई आनन्द भाव से जगत को परिव्याप्त किये हुई हैं
english_translation: Though she is non-dual, composed of existence, consciousness, and bliss, she takes a dual form through the feelings of truth and consciousness and pervades the world with the emotion of bliss.
essence: The divine blends unity and duality, filling everything with blissful presence.
simple_meaning: The divine is fundamentally one, made of pure existence, consciousness, and bliss, yet she appears as many through feelings of truth and awareness, filling the entire world with bliss.
insight: It invites you to see unity beneath apparent differences, embracing complexity without losing your inner wholeness.
modern_relevance: Like feeling completely yourself while embracing all your roles and emotions, you can be whole inside yet express many sides, filling your life with joy.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
देवीं ब्रह्ममयीं समीक्ष्य पुरतस्त्वेवंविधा निर्जरा 
निप्पन्दा अगिरोऽभवन्निव कियन्मूढा: क्षणं संस्थिताः । 
पश्चान्मोहतयोविमुक्तमतयश्चैतन्यपूर्णाशयाः. शान्ता 
देवगणाः कृताञ्जलिपुटा देवी परां तुष्टुवुः ॥
translation: देवतागण इस रूप में ब्रह्ममयी देवी का दर्शन करके थोडी देर तक निस्पन्द और निर्वाक् हो विमोहित हो गए, तत्पश्चात् मोहमुक्त होकर पूर्ण चेतनता को प्राप्त होते हुए कृताञ्जलि हो स्तुति करने लगे
english_translation: The divine beings, upon seeing the Goddess as the supreme reality, became still and speechless for a moment; then freed from delusion and full of consciousness, they bowed with joined hands and praised her.
essence: Encountering the supreme reality brings silent awe followed by awakened praise.
simple_meaning: The divine beings saw the Goddess as the supreme reality, became still and silent briefly, then freed from confusion, fully aware, and praised her with respect.
insight: Experiencing profound truth can temporarily still the mind, then inspire heartfelt gratitude.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
देवि ! प्रपन्नात्तिहरे ! शिवे ! त्वं वाणीमनोबुद्धिभिरप्रेम्या ।
यतोऽस्यतो नैव हि कश्चिदीशः स्तोतुं स्वशब्दैर्भवनी कदाचित ॥
translation: हे महादेवी ! आप वाणी मन और बुद्धि से अगोचर हैं इस कारण इस संसार में ऐसा कोई भी नहीं है जो शब्द द्वारा आपकी स्तुति कर सकता हो
english_translation: O great Devi! You are beyond speech, mind, and intellect; therefore, no one in this world can truly praise you with words.
essence: The deepest reality cannot be fully expressed or praised through words or thought.
simple_meaning: The Devi is beyond all forms of expression like speech, mind, and intellect, so no one can fully praise her with words.
insight: It teaches you to embrace the limits of language and trust what cannot be fully described or captured.
modern_relevance: When you feel words fail to express your deepest feelings or the vastness of something, this reminds you that some realities lie beyond language.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
परं मनोवेगविमोदिता वयं भावं भवत्या अपि वांगमनोधियाम ।
अगोचरं द्योतयितुं समुद्यताः क्षमस्व नो दोषममुं दयानिधे ! ॥
translation: परन्तु हम मन के आवेग से आपके मन, वचन और बुद्धि से अगोचर भाष को शब्दों के द्वारा प्रकट करने में प्रवृत्त हुए हैं, हे दयानिधे ! इस अपराध को आप क्षमा करें
english_translation: But we, overwhelmed by the impulses of the mind, have arisen to express the invisible speech of your mind, words, and intellect; O treasure of compassion, please forgive this fault.
essence: Restless mind can push you to reveal what is beyond words; humility asks forgiveness.
simple_meaning: We got carried away by our restless mind and tried to express your invisible thoughts and words. Please forgive this mistake.
insight: It teaches you to recognize when your mind pushes you beyond limits and to approach with humility and ask forgiveness.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अत्र क्षमाप्तावपि कारणं ते महत्यपारास्ति कृपैव मातः! ।
ब्रह्मस्वरूपे ! जगदम्बिकेऽलं दयामयीं तवां  सततं नमामः ॥
translation: इस क्षमाप्राप्ति में आपको महती अपार करुणा ही कारण है। हे ब्रह्ममयी जगदम्बिके ! आप दयामयी को प्रणाम है
english_translation: Even in forgiveness, the great boundless compassion of the mother is the cause. O Brahman-formed World-Mother, we constantly bow to your merciful nature.
essence: Forgiveness flows from the mother’s boundless compassion, the supreme reality embodied.
simple_meaning: Forgiveness arises from the vast, limitless compassion of the mother, who embodies the supreme reality. We honor her merciful nature always.
insight: It teaches you to connect forgiveness with the compassionate nature within and around you, deepening your capacity to forgive.
modern_relevance: After someone hurts you, remembering that forgiveness springs from deep compassion can soften your heart and open space for peace.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
परात्परा त्वं परतत्त्वरूपिणी  स्वतीय तत्त्वान्यखिलानि राजसे। 
सच्चिचसाहाय्यत आत्मना पुनदाम्पसरूपं युगलञ्च विभ्रती ॥
translation: आप तत्त्वातीत परमतत्त्व रूपिणी है, पाप ही पुनः एक ओर से पुरुष और दूसरी ओर से स्त्री रूप धारण करके अपने चित् और सत्भाव की सहायता से युगल दाम्पत्य रूप
english_translation: You are beyond the highest; embodying supreme form, you manifest all your own principles. Through the support of consciousness and existence, you take the paired forms of male and female.
essence: The supreme reality transcends form yet manifests as unified opposites.
simple_meaning: You are the supreme reality beyond all forms, expressing all your principles as the union of male and female energies supported by consciousness.
insight: It invites you to see beyond surface dualities and recognize the unified source behind diversity.
modern_relevance: You meet people whose identities and energies blend traditionally opposing traits, reminding you that unity can hold what seems divided.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
तनोषि शृङ्गारमयीं समन्ता ल्लीलाललामान्वितसृष्टिमेताम् ।
स्वानन्दसन्दोहभरमकाशामनाधनन्तां जगदम्बिकेऽलम् ॥
translation: धारण करती हुई हे जगदम्बिके अपने परमानन्द की प्रकाशक श्रृंगार लीलामयी अनाद्यनन्त सृष्टि लीला का प्रवाह प्रवाहित करती हैं
english_translation: O Mother of the universe, you sustain this infinite, eternal creation filled with bliss and adorned by the playful flow of divine beauty.
essence: The infinite universe is sustained as a joyous, playful expression of the divine's bliss.
simple_meaning: The divine mother supports and fills the entire infinite creation with joyful, beautiful energy that flows like a playful dance.
insight: This verse invites you to see the world as a living expression of boundless joy and beauty, held by the divine source.
modern_relevance: When life feels overwhelming, imagine it as a vast dance of joyful energy held by a loving presence sustaining it all.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
लीलोदयास्ते भवतो भवत्या अक्षीङ्गितै: केवलमेव मातः!।
नानाविधस्यामितसङ्ख्यकस्य, ब्रह्माण्डसङ्घस्य च देवि ! मन्ये ॥
translation: लीला का उदय और अस्त आपके नेत्र के इंगित मात्र से हुआ करता है, एक मुहूर्त में अनन्त ब्रहाण्डों की
english_translation: The rise and fall of all creation happens at the mere gesture of your eyes, Devi, in a single moment countless universes come into being.
essence: Infinite worlds arise and dissolve by the slightest movement of your divine gaze.
simple_meaning: Everything that exists arises and fades away by your mere glance, Devi, creating countless universes instantly.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing life as random to recognizing the unified source behind all change.
modern_relevance: When you realize how a small action can ripple vast effects, you glimpse the immense power within subtle moments.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
सर्गस्थितिमयवहारकार्य भवद्विलासस्य तरंगमात्रम्।
कर्त्तेु क्षणेनाखिलमस्यलं त्वं नमोऽस्त्वतस्तेऽखिलशक्तिरूपे ! ॥
translation: सृष्टि स्थिति और प्रलय कर देना आपके विलास का एक तरंग मात्र है, एक ही क्षण में सब कुछ कर सकती हो इसलिये हे सर्वशक्तिमयी ! आपकों प्रणाम है
english_translation: Creation, preservation, and destruction are but waves of your play; in a moment, you can do everything. Salutations to you, embodiment of all power!
essence: The entire cosmic cycle is effortless play by the all-powerful divine.
simple_meaning: All creation, preservation, and destruction are expressions of the divine's playful power, done effortlessly in an instant.
insight: This shifts your view from seeing life as heavy duty to recognizing it as spontaneous, creative play beyond personal effort.
modern_relevance: When you face overwhelming tasks or change, remember it’s like waves in the ocean—flowing effortlessly from a deeper source beyond your control.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
वं निर्गुणाकारविवर्जिताऽपि त्वं भावराज्याच्च वहिर्गताऽपि ।
सर्वेंद्रिययागोचरतां गताऽपि त्वेका ह्यखण्डा विभुरद्वयाऽपि ॥
translation: आप आकाररहित, भवातीत, गुणातीत, अखण्ड, अद्वितीय, विभु और सब इन्द्रियों से अग्राह्य होने पर भी
english_translation: You are formless, beyond existence, beyond qualities, indivisible, unique, and supreme, yet beyond all the senses.
essence: You are an indivisible, formless presence beyond all qualities and senses.
simple_meaning: You exist beyond all forms, qualities, and senses. You are indivisible and uniquely supreme beyond anything the senses can perceive.
insight: It shifts your view from identifying with appearances to recognizing an indivisible and boundless essence beyond all senses.
modern_relevance: When you feel limited by how others see you or by your own labels, remember your true nature is vast, indivisible, and beyond any surface impression.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
स्वभक्तकल्याणविवर्द्धनाय धृत्वा स्वरूपं सगुणं हि तेभ्यः।
निःश्रेयसं यच्छसि भावगम्या विभावरूपे ! भवतीं नमामः ॥
translation: अपने भक्तों के कल्याण के अर्थ ही सगुणरूप धारण करके भावगम्य होकर उनको निःश्रेयस प्रदान करती हैं, हे त्रिभावरूपिणी! आपको प्रणाम है
english_translation: To bless her devotees, she takes a form with qualities and approachable emotions, granting them the highest good; we bow to the threefold-formed Devi.
essence: The divine adopts a caring, approachable form to guide her devotees to their highest good.
simple_meaning: The divine shows herself with qualities and feelings to help her devotees and guide them to their highest good.
insight: It teaches you to accept that divine care adapts to your needs, meeting you personally to help you thrive.
modern_relevance: When you feel lost or alone, imagine a presence that understands you deeply and supports your well-being with care and love.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
नास्यम्ब ! सीमा तव सत्कृपायाः शक्ता न ये भक्तगणास्त्वदीयाः।
तत्त्वप्रबोधस्य प्रपूर्त्यभावाद्रष्टुं हि ते भावमयस्वरूपम् ॥
translation: आप की कृपा का पार नहीं है, आपका जो भक्त तत्त्वज्ञान की पूर्णता के अभाव से आपके भावमय रूप के दर्शन करने में असमर्थ है परन्तु
english_translation: Your grace has no limits; those who cannot perceive your expressive form due to incomplete awakening of wisdom still remain your devotees.
essence: Grace has no limits even when understanding is incomplete.
simple_meaning: Your kindness is limitless. Even if some devotees can’t fully understand your true form because their wisdom is not complete, they are still connected to you.
insight: It encourages holding trust in divine grace despite incomplete understanding or spiritual clarity.
modern_relevance: When you feel unsure or unclear about your path, remember that support and kindness can still reach you deeply.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
स्वाभाविकैरेव कृपाकटाक्षैः समीहमाना ह्यनुकम्पितुं तान्।
गुणाश्रयायच्छसि दर्शनं स्वं मुक्तिञ्च तेभ्योऽभ्युदयं ददासि ॥
translation: आप अपनी स्वाभाविक करुणा से उसको कृतकृत्य करना चाहती हैं, उस अपने कृपापात्र भक्त को आप अपने गुणों के आश्रय से दर्शन देकर अभ्युदय और निःश्रेयस प्रदान करती हैं,
english_translation: By your natural compassion and gracious glance, you wish to bless those devoted to you; through your qualities, you reveal yourself and grant their liberation and upliftment.
essence: Natural compassion reveals the divine’s qualities, granting vision and liberation to devoted ones.
simple_meaning: You naturally feel compassion for your devoted ones and show yourself through your qualities, helping them grow and find freedom.
insight: It invites you to trust in the natural compassion of the divine and to receive its vision and upliftment without resistance.
modern_relevance: When someone offers you kindness without conditions, it feels like a light guiding you through hard times toward growth and freedom.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
ज्ञातुं न शक्तास्तव देवि ! तत्त्वं वयं न दैत्या अपि मानवाः के।
परात्परे ! त्वाञ्च दयाम्बुराशे !  वयं नमामस्त्रिगुणस्वरूपे ! ॥
translation: हे देवि ! आपके तत्त्व को हम देवगण तथा असुर कुछ भी नहीं समझ सकते तो मनुष्यों का तो कहना की क्या है, हे परात्परे! हे दयाम्बुराशे हे त्रिगुणमयी! आपको प्रणाम है
english_translation: O Devi! Neither the gods nor the demons can truly understand your essence, so how can humans? O supreme one, full of compassion and the three qualities, we bow to you.
essence: Devi's true nature is beyond all beings' understanding, inspiring humble reverence.
simple_meaning: Neither gods nor demons can fully understand the true essence of Devi, so humans certainly cannot. She is supreme, compassionate, and embodies the three qualities; we bow to her.
insight: It teaches humility before realities that exceed all knowledge, inviting respect rather than certainty.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
कि वर्णनं तेऽस्ति कृपाम्बुराशे र्येऽज्ञानपाशैर्जड़िता विमुग्धाः।
मातमहत्त्वं परमाद्भुतं ते किमप्यहो नैव विदन्ति भक्ताः ॥
translation: हे जगन्मातः!आपकी कृपा का कहां तक वर्णन किया जाय, जो आपका अज्ञान पाश से  विजडित विमूढ़ अज्ञ भक्त आप के महत्त्व को कुछ भी नहीं समझता है
english_translation: O Mother of the world! How can your grace be described, when devotees confused by the bonds of ignorance do not truly understand your supreme greatness?
essence: True devotion often struggles to see the divine’s greatness through the fog of confusion.
simple_meaning: Your grace is limitless, but many devotees fail to grasp your supreme greatness because their minds are clouded by confusion.
insight: Recognize that confusion can hide the divine’s presence, but it does not diminish it.
modern_relevance: You may struggle to feel the support or love meant for you, but that doesn’t mean it’s absent or small.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
अनन्यभक्सैव तु केवलं हि भृङ्गायमाणास्तव पादपद्यमे।
विच्योतयस्यम्ब ! न तानपि त्वं स्वदर्शनान्मोक्षखनेः कदापि ॥
translation: परन्तु आपके चरणकमलों में अनन्य भक्ति से भ्रमर जैसा प्रेम रखता है उसको भी आप मोक्ष-प्रद अपने दर्शन देने से विमुख नहीं रखती
english_translation: But the bees that hold exclusive devotion to your lotus feet, you never deny them liberation by withholding your vision.
essence: Exclusive devotion naturally draws the liberating vision; it is never denied.
simple_meaning: Those who love you with exclusive devotion are never refused your liberating presence or vision.
insight: It teaches you that wholehearted devotion invites liberating presence rather than pushing it away.
modern_relevance: When you commit yourself fully to someone or something you trust, you find their support and freedom come to you naturally.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
श्रीविष्णुगौरीशिवधीशसूर्यरूपामु पञ्चात्मकदेवतासु।
यथारुचि तवं प्रकटत्वमेत्य स्थूलासु तान्वै कुरुपे कृतार्थान् ॥
translation: और विष्णु, सूर्य, गौरी, धीश और शम्भु रूपी पञ्चमूर्तियों में से जैसी उसकी रुचि हो उसी स्थूलमूर्ति में प्रकट होकर उसको कृतकृत्य करती हो।
english_translation: She appears in whichever gross form among the five deities Vishnu, Gauri, Dhisha, Shiva, and Surya pleases, fulfilling their desires.
essence: The divine manifests in forms aligned with each being’s unique needs and preferences.
simple_meaning: The divine reveals herself in the form that each of the five great deities prefers, satisfying their needs.
insight: It teaches you to adapt your expression to meet others where they are, fulfilling their needs without losing your essence.
modern_relevance: When you connect with others, showing up in the way they best understand you creates deeper trust and fulfillment.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
देवेषु राज्येषु यदा कदाचिद् घोरेण देवासुरसङ्गरेण । 
उत्तिष्ठते धार्मिकविप्लवोघो दयामाये ! लञ्च तदैव नूनम् ॥
translation: जब कभी घोर देवासुरसंग्राम द्वारा दैवीराज्य में धर्मविप्लव उपस्थित होता है तब आप
english_translation: Whenever a severe battle between radiant beings and shadow beings arises in divine realms, then surely the upheaval of righteousness occurs.
essence: Severe conflict between opposing cosmic forces disrupts righteousness in divine realms.
simple_meaning: At times, when a fierce conflict happens between radiant and shadow beings in divine realms, the natural order and righteousness are disrupted.
insight: It shows that conflict can disrupt even the most sacred orders, highlighting the need for vigilance and restoration.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
मातर्जगन्मङ्गलमाशु कर्त्तुमाकृष्य तेजांस्यमलानि नोऽलम् ।
तैरेव सन्दीपितदिक्समूहै: स्थूल स्वरूपं विमलं दधाना ॥
translation: जगत के कल्याण के लिये हम सभी के निर्मल तेज को आकर्षण करके दिशाओं को दीपित करनेवाले उस तेज से अपना स्थूल रूप धारण करती हुई,
english_translation: For the welfare of the world, I draw the pure lights of all beings to illumine the directions, assuming my gross form.
essence: You manifest as a radiant form by gathering pure energies to illuminate the world.
simple_meaning: You gather the pure energies of all beings to illuminate the world, taking on a visible form for its welfare.
insight: It teaches you to see your everyday presence as a channel for collective energy, not just personal identity.
modern_relevance: When you step up to share your talents widely, you become a visible source of light for many who need it.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
हत्वाऽमुरांस्तान कुरुपे व्यवस्थां देवाधिराज्यस्य विशालसीनः।
एवं कदाचित्किल मर्त्यलोके धर्मस्य जाते बहु विप्लवे हि ॥
translation: असुरो का निधन करके देवीराज्य की सुव्यवस्था करती है,उसी प्रकार जब कभी मृत्युलोक धर्म विप्लव उपस्थित होता है
english_translation: By killing the Asuras, the great ruler of the divine establishes order; similarly, whenever dharma declines in the mortal world.
essence: Order is restored by removing destructive forces whenever righteousness declines.
simple_meaning: The divine ruler restores order by defeating evil beings whenever moral decline happens in the world.
insight: Recognize that restoring balance sometimes requires confronting and removing destructive influences.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
विभिन्नजीवेष्ववतीर्य मात ईठादसाधूनिखिलानिहत्य।
साधूनवन्ती पुनरेव धर्म राज्यं सुसंस्थापय से तदा त्वंम् ॥
translation: तो आप विभिन्न जीव शरीर में अवतीर्ण होकर असाधुओ का विनाश और साधुओं को सुख प्रदान द्वारा धर्म का पुनः संस्थापन करती हो,
english_translation: You incarnate in various beings, destroy the wicked, protect the virtuous, and re-establish dharma firmly.
essence: You incarnate to destroy wrongdoing and firmly restore righteousness.
simple_meaning: You take form among many beings to remove harm and protect goodness, restoring order and righteousness.
insight: It teaches you to see your actions as part of restoring balance by opposing harm and supporting virtue.
modern_relevance: When you face injustice or wrongdoing, your true purpose is to stand for what is right and protect those who do good.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
देशो यदा हासमुपैति तं त्वं नेतस्वरूपे ह्यवतीर्य पासि ।
विष्ण्वादिपञ्चात्मकदेवरूपे ! वयं नमामो रणचण्डिके ! त्वाम् ॥
translation: उसी प्रकार जब देश की अवनति होने लगती है तब नेता रूप में अवतार लेकर उसकी रक्षा करती हो, हे पञ्चदेवमयी ! हे रणचण्डिके ! आपको प्रणाम है
english_translation: Just as a nation declines, you incarnate as a leader to protect it, O embodiment of the five deities! Salutations to you, fierce warrior goddess!
essence: True protection arises when the divine takes leader form to restore what declines.
simple_meaning: When a nation falls into decline, you appear as a leader to protect it. You embody the power of five divine forms and fierce courage.
insight: It reveals how true leadership arises naturally in crisis, embodying courage and multiple strengths to protect what matters.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
त्वं सचिदानन्दमये स्वकीये ब्रह्मस्वरूपे निजविज्ञभक्तान् ।
तथेशरूपे च विधाप्य मातरुपासकान दर्शनमात्मभक्तान् ॥
translation: आप अपने ज्ञानी भक्तों को सच्चिदानन्दमय ब्रह्मरूप में दर्शन देकर, उपासक भक्तों को ईश्वरी रूप से दर्शन देकर
english_translation: You reveal yourself as the blissful supreme reality to your wise devotees, and as the divine mother to the worshipping devotees.
essence: The divine reveals herself uniquely to each devotee according to their devotion and wisdom.
simple_meaning: You reveal yourself differently to your devotees: as the blissful supreme reality to wise seekers, and as the divine mother to those who worship you.
insight: It teaches you to trust that your inner being connects with you uniquely, meeting you where you are on your path.
modern_relevance: You might experience guidance differently from mentors or loved ones, each offering what your heart truly needs to grow or feel safe.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
निष्कामयज्ञावलिनिष्ठसाधकान् विराटस्वरूपे च विधाप्य दर्शनम्।
श्रुतेर्महावाक्यमिदं मनोहर करोष्यहो “तत्त्वमसीति" सार्थकम् ॥
translation: और निष्काम यश निष्ठभक्तो को विराट्मूर्ति दर्शन देकर तत्त्वमसि महावाक्य को चरितार्थता करती हैं,
english_translation: And by granting the vision of the cosmic form to practitioners dedicated to selfless sacrifice, the great saying 'That you are' becomes fulfilled.
essence: Selfless dedication reveals your true cosmic nature and fulfills the truth 'You are that'.
simple_meaning: When you act without craving personal gain, you can experience your true cosmic nature and realize the truth 'You are that'.
insight: This verse shifts focus from craving outcomes to embracing selfless dedication, opening the heart to recognize your cosmic identity.
modern_relevance: When you give your best without chasing rewards, you discover a deeper connection to something vast and real beyond yourself.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
मन्त्रावलीनां सहसेतुभूते ! सृष्टयादिजाते ! प्रभवे ! श्रुतीनाम् ।
अनाद्यनन्तेऽखिलगे ! प्रणम्ये ! नमो भवत्यै प्रणवस्वरूपे ! ॥
translation: हे मन्त्रों के सेतु! हे सृष्ट्यादिजात! हे श्रुतिप्रभवे ! हे सर्वपूज्ये! हे प्रणवरूपिणी ! आपको प्रणाम है
english_translation: O bridge of mantras! Origin of creation! Source of sacred sounds! Infinite and eternal! I bow to you, embodiment of the primal sound Om!
essence: The divine is the infinite source and bridge of all sacred sounds and creation.
simple_meaning: You are honored as the timeless source connecting all sacred sounds and the origin of creation itself.
insight: It invites you to recognize the power behind words and sounds as a living bridge to the infinite source.
modern_relevance: When you hear a meaningful song or chant, you can feel a connection to something greater beyond words and time.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
ज्ञानस्य साम्राज्यमृषिप्रकाण्डैरस्माभिरम्बाखिलकर्मराज्यम् ।
स्थूलं स्वराज्यं पितृभिश्च नूनं दत्त्वाथ संरक्षयसे स्वशक्तिम् ॥
translation: आप ही अपनी शक्ति प्रदान करके ऋषियों के द्वारा ज्ञानराज्य का संरक्षण, हम लोगों के द्वारा कर्म राज्य का संरक्षण और पितरों के द्वारा स्थूलराज्य का  संरक्षण कराती हो,
english_translation: You grant your power to the sages who protect the kingdom of knowledge, to us who uphold the kingdom of action, and to the ancestors who guard the physical realm.
essence: One divine power supports knowledge, action, and the physical world through different protectors.
simple_meaning: The divine grants power to sages to protect wisdom, to people to uphold action, and to ancestors to guard the physical world.
insight: Recognize your power as part of a vast system sustaining thought, deed, and matter simultaneously.
modern_relevance: When you rely on your inner strength, you support your learning, your work, and your environment all at once.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
अव्यक्तरूपेऽखिलशक्तिशोभे! व्यक्तेऽगुणे! सगुणेऽसि मातः !।
विमोहिनी जीवततेरविद्या विद्यापि कैवल्यपदा त्वमेव ॥
translation: हे सर्वशक्तिमयी ! हे व्यक्ताव्यक्त रूपिणी ! हे निर्गुणासगुणा ! आप ही जीवों को मोहित करनेवाली अविद्या, जीवमुक्ति दात्री विद्या और
english_translation: O all-powerful one, who appears both manifest and unmanifest, without qualities and with qualities, you alone are the ignorance that deludes living beings, the knowledge that liberates them, and the state of absolute freedom.
essence: The one power is both the cause of confusion and the source of liberation.
simple_meaning: You are the power that both confuses and frees living beings. You appear in many forms, with and without qualities.
insight: Recognize that what confuses you and what frees you come from the same source within.
modern_relevance: In moments of confusion and clarity, you embody both the problem and the solution within yourself.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
नित्यं तुरीयास्पदसम्प्रतिष्ठा विधायिनी ब्रह्ममयी त्वमेव।
स्वाहास्वधाकारवषटस्वरूपे ! हे देवमातर्भवतीं नमामः ॥
translation: आप ही तुरीयपद-प्रतिष्टितकारिणी ब्रह्ममयी हैं, हे स्वाहास्वधावषट रूपिणी ! हे देवजननी ! आपको प्रणाम है
english_translation: You alone establish the state beyond the three, embodying the supreme reality. O Swaha-Svadha-Ashat form! O divine mother, we bow to you.
essence: The supreme divine mother alone embodies the transcendent state beyond all experience.
simple_meaning: You are the supreme being who exists beyond all three states of consciousness, embodying ultimate reality. We honor you as the divine mother in this form.
insight: It invites you to see beyond your restless mind and emotions to the unchanging reality within, inspiring devotion and surrender.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by shifting moods and challenges, remember your true self exists beyond all changing states, steady and whole.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
त्वमेव मातः ! प्रतिकल्पमेव सरस्वतीरूपमहो दधाना।
स्वाध्यात्मशक्यर्पिप्रशान्तचित्त माविविधत्से च प्रणोद्य वेदान् ॥
translation: प्रतिकल्प में आप सरस्वती रूप धारण करती हुई अपनी अध्यात्मशक्ति के द्वारा ऋषियों के अन्तःकरण को प्रेरणा करके
english_translation: You alone, as the mother, take the form of Saraswati in imagination, inspiring the sages' inner hearts with your spiritual power and calming their restless minds.
essence: The divine inspires and calms the sages’ inner hearts through imagined forms.
simple_meaning: You appear as Saraswati in imagination, using your spiritual power to inspire sages and calm their restless minds.
insight: It shows how inspiration and calm come from deeper spiritual power beyond the restless mind.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
वेदेषु संस्थापयसेज्य मन्त्रशक्तिं हि गायत्रयाधिरूपतस्त्वम् ।
त्वमेव सावित्र्यधिरूपतश्च यज्ञक्रियाशक्तिमथो वितन्य ॥
translation: वेद का आविर्भाव करती हैं, गायत्री रूप से वेदों में मन्त्रशक्ति प्रदान करती हैं और सावित्री रूप से यज्ञ की क्रियाशक्ति विस्तार करके
english_translation: You manifest in the Vedas, granting mantra power as Gayatri and expanding ritual power as Savitri.
essence: The divine manifests as mantra and ritual power within the Vedas.
simple_meaning: You are the power behind the Vedas, giving them life as Gayatri and expanding the energy of ritual actions as Savitri.
insight: Recognize that sacred knowledge and ritual power come from the same source of living energy.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
तत्साधकेभ्यो मनुजेभ्य आशु निःश्रेयसञ्चाऽभ्युदयं ददासि ।
अतो वयं ज्ञानप्रदेऽतिनम्रा हे वेदमातर्भवतीं नमामः ॥
translation: मनुष्यों को अभ्युदय और निःश्रेयस प्रदान करती हैं। हे वेद जननी ! हे ज्ञानदे ! अति नम्रता पूर्वक आपको प्रणाम है
english_translation: To those who seek, you swiftly grant prosperity and ultimate well-being. Therefore, we humbly bow to you, O Mother of the Vedas.
essence: Sincere seekers quickly receive support toward their highest good from the divine.
simple_meaning: If you sincerely seek, the divine quickly grants you prosperity and your highest well-being.
insight: It encourages trusting the process of sincere seeking, knowing that progress and well-being follow naturally.
modern_relevance: When you reach out honestly for help or growth, support often arrives faster than expected, guiding you toward your best outcome.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
अनुष्ठितेन युष्माभिर्ब्रह्मचक्रेण निर्जराः।
युष्माकञ्चैव सदंक्सा प्रसननाऽस्मि न संशयः ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! आपके ब्रह्मचक्र के अनुष्ठान और आप सभी की भक्ति से मैं प्रसन्न हुई हूँ
english_translation: O celestial beings! By your steadfast practice of the Brahma cycle and your devotion, I am truly pleased without doubt.
essence: Consistent, heartfelt devotion naturally pleases the divine without doubt.
simple_meaning: The divine expresses joy and trust because of your continuous practice and sincere devotion.
insight: It teaches you that sincere, consistent devotion naturally earns the divine's trust and pleasure.
modern_relevance: After weeks of daily care for a loved one, you finally feel your effort is truly noticed and valued.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
पूर्ण कर्त्तुमहं देवा भवतां यदभीप्सितम् ।
सगुणं रूपमास्थाय प्रादुर्भताऽस्मि साम्प्रतम् ॥
translation: मैं आपकी शुभ इच्छा पूर्ण करने को सगुण रूप में प्रकट हुई हूँ
english_translation: I have manifested in a form with qualities to fulfill your cherished desire.
essence: The divine manifests in forms with qualities to fulfill sincere desires.
simple_meaning: The divine takes a form with qualities to fulfill the wishes of those who seek her.
insight: It teaches you that the divine meets you where you are, taking forms you can relate to.
modern_relevance: When you deeply long for something, sensing a presence ready to meet your need brings comfort and trust.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
वर्तते भवतां देवा यत्किञ्चिद्वाञ्छितं शुभम् ।
व्याहरन्तु भवन्तस्तव पूरयिष्याम्यहं ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: आपकी जो इच्छा हो सो प्रकट करें मैं उसको पूर्ण करूंगी
english_translation: Whatever auspicious desire you have, express it; I will surely fulfill it.
essence: Express your heartfelt wishes without fear; they will surely be fulfilled.
simple_meaning: You are invited to express any positive wish you hold, and it will definitely be fulfilled.
insight: It teaches you to trust in expressing your true wishes without hesitation, knowing they are valued and will be fulfilled.
modern_relevance: You hesitate to ask for help or to express your hopes, fearing they might be ignored. This reveals that your true needs deserve clear expression and will be met with care.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
महादेवि ! प्रभो ! मातभक्तमानसमन्दिरे।
विहारिणि ! प्रसन्ने ! हे दयापूरिततमानसे ! ॥
translation: हे जगजननी ! हे भक्त मनोमन्दिर विहारिणी । हे करुणामयी !
english_translation: O great Goddess! O beloved refuge of devoted hearts! O compassionate one, dwelling in the temple of devotees' minds!
essence: The divine lovingly dwells within the devoted heart as compassion itself.
simple_meaning: The divine presence lovingly dwells within the hearts of those devoted to her, full of compassion and grace.
insight: It teaches you to recognize the divine as an intimate, loving presence within your own heart and mind.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed, remembering a compassionate presence within you can bring calm and reassurance.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
विबुधासुरसंग्रागे ह्यसुराणां पराजयः।
अभून्नो विजयो देवि ! तत्वेऽपारकृपाफलम् ॥
translation: देवासुर संग्राम में दुर्जेय असुरों का पराजय और हमारा जय होना आपकी ही अपार कृपा का फल है।
english_translation: In the battle between the divine and the ego beings, the undefeatable defeat of the ego beings and our victory is the fruit of your boundless grace.
essence: Victory over ego forces is the result of boundless divine grace.
simple_meaning: The victory over the ego beings in the battle is entirely due to the immeasurable grace of the Goddess.
insight: Recognize that true victory over inner struggles depends on receiving grace beyond personal effort.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अथवा भक्तवात्सल्यपरिणामोऽस्वयं तव।
इच्छामः साम्प्रतं त्वेतद्वाङ्मनोबुद्धयगोचरम् ॥
translation: अथवा आपके भक्त वात्सल्य का फल है। अब हम लोगों की यही इच्छा है कि हमारे मन वचन और बुद्धि से अतीत
english_translation: Or, your devotees’ affection is the cause. Now we desire that this be reflected in our speech, mind, and intellect.
essence: Divine love inspires and shows itself in the devotee’s mind, speech, and intellect.
simple_meaning: Devotees’ loving care comes from the divine. We now want that love to be clear in our thoughts, words, and mind.
insight: Recognize that divine affection can visibly influence your thoughts and communication, deepening your devotion.
modern_relevance: When you feel cared for deeply, you want that warmth to shape how you think and speak with others.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
भवत्या यात्स्वरूपं हि वर्चते परमाद्भुतम् ।
ज्ञानं तस्य प्रयच्छ त्वमुपदेशं तथेदृशम् ॥
translation: जो आपका स्वरूप है उसका ज्ञान हमको प्रदान कीजिये और ऐसे उपदेश दीजिये जिससे हम सब
english_translation: Please grant us the knowledge of your true nature and teach us such instruction.
essence: Trusting openness invites clear knowledge of your true self and transformative teaching.
simple_meaning: Ask sincerely for knowledge of your true nature and for teachings that reveal it clearly.
insight: It teaches you to approach the path with trust, opening yourself to receive wisdom beyond doubt.
modern_relevance: When you feel lost or confused, simply asking for clear guidance invites the clarity you need.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
तव सानिध्यसम्पातिर्यन विन्देम सच्चरम्।
अमङ्गलं कदाचिनो न भवेच महेम्वार ! ॥
translation: आपके सानिध्य को प्राप्त कर सके जिससे हे महेश्वरी ! हमारा अमल न हो
english_translation: May I never be deprived of your presence, O Great Goddess! May I never fall into misfortune.
essence: The presence of the Great Goddess ensures you never fall into misfortune.
simple_meaning: Being close to the Great Goddess protects me from harm and misfortune at all times.
insight: It teaches you to anchor your trust in the divine presence as a source of resilience and protection.
modern_relevance: When you feel vulnerable or overwhelmed, sensing a protective presence can help you feel safe and supported.
speaker: Devotee

verse_text:
अहं हि कारणब्रह्म कार्य्यब्रह्मास्मि चाप्यहम् ।
देवाः ! कारणरूपेण सच्चिदानन्दमय्यहम् ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! मैं ही कारणब्रह्म हूँ और मैं ही कार्यब्रह्म हूँ। कारण रूप से मैं ही सञ्चिदानन्द मयी होकर
english_translation: O radiant beings! I am the cause Brahman and I am also the effect Brahman. As the cause, I am the supreme reality full of existence, consciousness, and bliss.
essence: The true self is both the origin and the manifestation of all that exists, full of existence, consciousness, and joy.
simple_meaning: You are the origin and the result of everything; the source and the manifestation of reality full of existence, awareness, and joy.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing self and world as separate to recognizing their inseparable identity as one whole reality.
modern_relevance: When you feel split between who you are and what you become, remember you are both the root and the unfolding together.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
भूत्वैकाद्वैतसत्तायां भासमाना भवामि वै।
सत्सत्तापरिविस्तृसा बहमेव पुनः सुराः!॥
translation: एक अद्वैत सत्ता में प्रकाशित होती हूँ। पुन: मैं ही मेरी सत्सत्ता के विस्तार द्वारा
english_translation: I shine as one non-dual reality. Again, I am many through the expansion of my true being.
essence: One reality shines as many without losing its true oneness.
simple_meaning: The true self is one indivisible reality that appears as many through its own expansion.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing yourself as separate parts to embracing your essential unity with all expressions.
modern_relevance: You are complex and multifaceted, yet underneath, you remain a single whole, not fractured or divided.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
अहंममोतिवद्वैतभावञ्चैव विमर्म्यहो।
तदा ममैव चित्सत्ता पुरुषे प्रकृतौ तथा ॥
translation: अहंममेतिवत् द्वैतभाव को  धारण करती हूँ । उस समय मेरी ही चित्सत्ता पुरुष रूप में और प्रकृति रूप में
english_translation: I embody the sense of 'I am' and the perception of duality; at that time, my consciousness exists as Purusha and Prakriti.
essence: Your true being includes both the sense of self and the experience of duality together.
simple_meaning: You hold the feeling of 'I exist' and the experience of separation, yet your true self includes both pure awareness and the natural world.
insight: It teaches you to recognize your identity as both the changeless observer and the ever-changing world simultaneously.
modern_relevance: When you feel torn between your pure awareness and your everyday experiences, remember both coexist within your true self.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
सत्सत्ता मकटीभूय निश्चितं विबुधर्षभाः ।
जगदानन्दसत्ताया विलासं सृजतः स्वयम् ॥
translation: मेरी ही सत्सत्ता प्रकाशित होकर आनन्द सत्ता के विलासरूपी इस जगत की स्वयं प्रगट करती है, हे देवगण! यह निश्चय है
english_translation: My true being manifests as the playful delight of blissful existence itself, creating this world on its own, O exalted beings.
essence: True being freely and joyfully creates all existence by itself.
simple_meaning: Your true self naturally expresses as joyful existence, creating the world effortlessly and delightfully.
insight: It shifts your view from feeling separate to recognizing yourself as the creative energy behind experience.
modern_relevance: When you feel stuck or powerless, remember that your deepest self is a joyful source capable of creating new possibilities effortlessly.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
तदाहमेव भूत्वा वै पुरुषो वीजदस्तथा ।
प्रकृतिः क्षेत्ररूपाऽस्मि कार्यब्रह्मणि भासिता ॥
translation: उस समय मैं ही बीजदाता पुरुष और मैं ही क्षेत्ररूपी प्रकृति वनकर कार्यब्रह्म रूप में प्रकाशित होती हूँ
english_translation: At that time, I alone was the seed-giver Purusha, and I am the nature in the form of the field, shining as the Brahman of the effect.
essence: You are simultaneously the source and the field where creation arises and shines.
simple_meaning: You are the source that plants the seed and the field where everything grows, shining as the cause behind all effects.
insight: This verse shifts your view from seeing yourself as separate parts to embracing your unified role as both initiator and space of growth.
modern_relevance: When you realize you are both the intention and the environment shaping your life, you gain deep confidence and creative power.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
कार्यब्रह्मस्वरूपेत्र विश्वास्मिन जङ्गमे मम ।
वर्त्तते चिद्विलासस्तु स्थावरे सद्विलासिता ॥
translation: कार्यब्रह्मरूपी इस जगत में, जंगम में मेरा चिद्विलास और स्थावर में मेरा सद्विलास रहता है।
english_translation: In this universe shaped as action and the supreme being, my conscious play exists in the moving and my true presence in the unmoving.
essence: True self is present as conscious energy in movement and stable presence in stillness.
simple_meaning: The divine presence is expressed as conscious activity in all moving things and as true, stable presence in all unmoving things in the universe.
insight: Recognize your nature as inseparable from both change and stability; this balance frees you from feeling fragmented.
modern_relevance: When your day brings chaos and calm in turns, you can remember your true self is both the energy in action and the stillness beneath it.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
ममानन्दविलासोऽसौ व्याप्नुवन् सच्चिदन्तरम् ।
ममैव परमानन्द सत्तां समनुभावयेत् ॥
translation: मेरा आनन्द विलास दोनों में व्याप्त रह कर मेरी ही परमानन्द सत्ता का अनुभव कराता है
english_translation: My blissful play pervades pure consciousness and reveals the supreme blissful existence as my own.
essence: Your bliss is inseparable from the supreme reality pervading all existence.
simple_meaning: Your true joy flows through pure being and shows the highest bliss as your own nature.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing joy as temporary to recognizing it as a constant, supreme presence within you.
modern_relevance: When you experience moments of deep joy, recognize they are not just fleeting feelings but a glimpse of your true, unchanging nature.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
अहमेवास्मि भो देवाः ! सर्बेवामीश्वरी परा।
उत्पद्यन्ते निभावाश्च त्रिगुणा मत्त एव हि ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! मैं ही सबकी परमेश्वरी हूँ, तीनों भाव और तीनों गुण मुझसे ही उत्पन्न होते हैं
english_translation: O divine beings! I alone am the supreme sovereign; the three states and three qualities arise from me.
essence: All states and qualities arise from one supreme source that is the foundation of everything.
simple_meaning: The supreme divine power alone is the source of all qualities and states of being experienced in the world.
insight: Recognizing the unity behind diverse experiences helps you see yourself as connected to a vast, unchanging reality.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by changing moods or traits, remember these arise from one unchanging source within you.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
सृष्टिस्थितिलयांश्चैव त्रिगुणैरहमेव वै।
करोमि सततं देवाः ! जगतां नात्र संशयः ॥
translation: तीनों गुणों से ब्रह्माण्डौ का सृष्टि स्थिति लय कार्य मैं ही करती हूँ हे देवगण ! इसमें कुछ सन्देह नहीं है
english_translation: I alone perform the creation, preservation, and destruction of the universe through the three qualities; there is no doubt about this, O divine beings!
essence: One constant power alone enacts all creation, maintenance, and destruction without doubt.
simple_meaning: The divine power alone causes the universe to come into being, to exist, and to dissolve through three qualities without any doubt.
insight: Recognize that all phases of change are expressions of one continuous, underlying power.
modern_relevance: When you face constant change around you, remember that a single steady force underlies all beginnings and endings.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
मन्येवानुभवस्तेषां विभावैभवति ध्रुवम् ।
नानाब्रह्माण्डसंघ हि स्वगर्भ चाहमेव तम् ॥
translation: और तीनों भाव द्वारा उनका अनुभव मुझ में ही होता है, हे देवगण ! मैं ही अपने गर्भ में अनन्त कोटि ब्रह्माण्डों को
english_translation: I believe the experiences of the three states arise within me; indeed, I hold countless universes within my womb.
essence: The true self contains all experiences and infinite universes within itself.
simple_meaning: All experiences and countless universes arise and exist within the true self, which is the source and container of all.
insight: Shift your view from feeling small or separate to recognizing your vast inner space where all experiences occur.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by external chaos or internal confusion, remember that all experience arises within you, showing your immense inner capacity.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
सन्धार्य सततं देवाः ! देशकालस्वरूपतः ।
अनाद्यानन्तसत्तायाः कारयेऽनुभवं खलु ॥
translation: धारण करके देश और कालरूप में अपनी अनादि और अनन्त सत्ता का निरन्तर अनुभव कराती हूँ
english_translation: By sustaining constantly, O gods, I manifest my endless and eternal being in forms of place and time for experience.
essence: Infinite being sustains itself continuously through all time and place for experience.
simple_meaning: Your infinite and eternal nature is always present, taking shape through every place and time to be experienced.
insight: It invites you to see your essential nature as always present and unfolding through changing circumstances.
modern_relevance: When life changes around you, you can remember that your core presence flows through every moment and place, unbroken and infinite.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
ब्रह्माण्डानान्तु सर्वेषां प्रत्येकं प्रभवस्थिती।
विधातुं प्रलयश्चापि जनये निजगर्भतः ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! प्रत्येक ब्रह्माण्ड में प्रत्येक ब्रह्माण्ड की सृष्टि, स्थिति और लय क्रिया सुसम्पन्न करने के लिये
english_translation: O divine beings! In every universe, the creation, preservation, and destruction processes happen from its own womb.
essence: Each universe carries its own cycle of birth, existence, and dissolution within itself.
simple_meaning: Each universe independently undergoes creation, maintenance, and destruction from its own source.
insight: It shifts understanding from external control to recognizing self-contained natural cycles in any system.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेशाख्यास्त्रीन्देवानन्वनेकशः।
ब्राह्मीञ्च वैष्णवी रौद्री स्वांशरूपां सुरर्षभा:! ॥
translation: अपने गर्भ से ब्रह्मा, विष्णु और महेशरूपी अनेक त्रिदेवों को उत्पन्न करती हूँ और अपनी ही अंशरूप ब्राह्मी, वैष्णवी और रौद्री
english_translation: From my womb, I generate Brahma, Vishnu, Mahesha and many other Trimurti gods; I am also Brahmi, Vaishnavi, and Raudri as my own aspects.
essence: The divine source creates all gods and embodies their essential energies as one.
simple_meaning: The Goddess says she creates the three main gods Brahma, Vishnu, and Mahesha from herself and is also present as their divine feminine forms.
insight: It teaches you that the ultimate source contains all forms and energies within itself, not separate from its manifestations.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
एता अनेकशस्तिस्रः शक्तीस्तेभ्यो वितीर्य्य वै।
ब्रह्माण्डसङ्घप्रत्येकसृष्टिस्थितिलयक्रियाः॥
translation: ये अनेक त्रिविध शक्तियाँ उनको यथाक्रम देकर प्रत्येक ब्रह्माण्ड की सृष्टि, स्थिति और लय क्रिया का
english_translation: These three diverse powers pass from them to perform creation, preservation, and dissolution of each universe.
essence: Three fundamental powers from the divine enable every universe’s creation, sustenance, and dissolution.
simple_meaning: Three fundamental powers come from the divine to create, preserve, and dissolve every universe.
insight: Recognize your connection to the cosmic rhythms of beginning, sustaining, and ending.
modern_relevance: When you face change and cycles in life, remember you embody the same forces that shape the cosmos.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
त्रिभिर्देवैर्यथातथ्यं साधयामि यथाक्रमम्।
यूयं सर्वे च भो देवा भावमाश्रित्य मामकम् ॥
translation: ठीक ठीक साधन कराती हूँ।  देवतागण ! आप सभी मेरे अधिदेव भाव को आश्रय करके
english_translation: I guide you correctly and sequentially, O divine beings! You all should rely on my supreme nature.
essence: A clear, stepwise teaching depends on relying on the supreme nature.
simple_meaning: I teach you step by step with care. You all should depend on my supreme nature.
insight: It highlights the value of relying on a clear guide or inner support when navigating complex paths.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
आधिदैवमजायन्ताध्यात्मिकं च महर्षयः।
आधिभौतिकमाश्रित्य पितरश्चापि जज्ञिरे ॥
translation: मुझ से ही प्रकट हुए हो । ऋषिगण मेरे आध्यात्म के आश्रय से प्रकट हुए हैं और पितृगण मेरे अधिभूतभाव से उत्पन्न हुए हैं
english_translation: The great sages arose from my spiritual essence, and the ancestors from my material nature.
essence: Your spiritual self births wisdom; your material self births lineage.
simple_meaning: Your spiritual nature gives rise to wise insight, while your material nature gives rise to your lineage and heritage.
insight: It teaches you to see your inner being as a union of pure awareness and natural existence, each giving birth to different aspects of life.
modern_relevance: You realize your clear thoughts and your inherited habits both shape who you are, each from a different source inside you.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
असुरा अपि भो देवा वर्तन्ते मद्विभूतयः।
अहमादिश्च सर्वेषां व्यासा चास्मि दिवौकसः ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! असुरगण भी मेरी ही विभूति हैं। मैं सबकी आदि हूँ।
english_translation: O divine beings, the beings of shadow are also my manifestations. I am the origin of all.
essence: Light and shadow beings both arise as manifestations of the same divine source.
simple_meaning: All beings, whether radiant or shadow, are manifestations of the divine's power, and the divine is the source of everything.
insight: It invites you to embrace all parts of yourself as arising from the same divine origin, dissolving inner division.
modern_relevance: You sometimes feel divided between your light and shadow sides, but both come from the same source within you.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
सर्वत्र शक्तिरूपेण निखिलं हि चराचरम् ।
नित्याद्वैतदशायान्तु शाश्वतं सुरसत्तमाः ! ॥
translation: मैं ही शक्तिरूप से सब जगह व्याप्त हूँ। मेरे स्वरूप में मेरी शक्ति नित्य अद्वैत दशा में सदा स्थित है।
english_translation: I pervade everything everywhere as the divine power; my nature is eternally established in the state of non-dual existence.
essence: The divine power is everywhere and always present in an unchanging unity.
simple_meaning: The divine power fills everything everywhere, always present in an unchanging, non-dual state.
insight: This teaching shifts attention from separation to unity, inviting you to recognize the divine presence everywhere.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by chaos, remember the unchanging power that flows through all things and holds everything together.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
स्वस्वरूपे च मे देवा मच्छक्तिरवतिष्ठते।
स्वरूपे स्वे च मे देवास्तुरीयाया ममैव हि ॥
translation: मेरे स्वस्वरूप में मेरी ही तुरीया शक्ति
english_translation: In my own true nature, my supreme power resides; in my own form, the supreme reality is indeed mine.
essence: Your true self is inseparable from the supreme power and ultimate reality.
simple_meaning: Your true self contains the highest power and the supreme reality within itself.
insight: Recognize your identity as inseparable from the supreme power, shifting from separation to unity.
modern_relevance: When you face self-doubt, remember your true nature holds deep strength and connection to something greater.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
शक्तेर्वलाद्धि जागर्ति सर्वदानुभवः किल।
सच्चिदानन्दरूपस्य त्रिभावस्य न संशयः ॥
translation: के बल से सत चित्त और आनन्दरूपी तीनों भावों का अनुभव बना रहता है इसमें कुछ सन्देह नहीं
english_translation: By the power of Shakti, the experience of truth, consciousness, and bliss remains awake without doubt.
essence: Your experience of truth, awareness, and bliss remains constantly alive by Shakti’s power.
simple_meaning: The power of Shakti keeps the experience of truth, awareness, and bliss continuously active without doubt.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that your true self’s experience of awareness and bliss is always active beyond mental fluctuations.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed, remember your inner awareness and joy remain steady by a power beyond your mind.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
दशाऽद्वैताऽनुभूयेत मच्छक्तयैव तुरीयया।
तस्या एव तुरीयाया मच्छक्तेर्वलतः खलु ॥
translation: मेरी तुरीयशक्ति से ही अद्वैत दशा का अनुभव होता है। हे देवगण ! उसी तुरीय शक्ति के बल से
english_translation: Only through my supreme power can the state of non-duality be experienced; O divine beings, it is indeed by that supreme power.
essence: True non-duality is experienced only through the supreme power of the divine feminine.
simple_meaning: The experience of complete non-duality or true oneness is possible only through the supreme power of the divine feminine.
insight: Recognize that realizing profound unity requires connecting with a supreme, transcendent power beyond ordinary perception.
modern_relevance: When facing overwhelming complexity or division, remember that a deeper, unifying power within can reveal connectedness beyond apparent differences.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
निर्विकल्पसमाधिस्थैरात्मारामैर्महात्मभिः।
जीवन्मुक्तैः प्रतीयेऽहमाद्यन्तरहिते विभौ ॥
translation: मैं निर्विकल्प समाधि में स्थित आत्माराम जीवन्मुक्त महात्माओं को आदि अन्तरहित विभु
english_translation: I am the supreme being, the beginning and the end, beyond all differences, dwelling in the blissful state of those great liberated beings absorbed in undifferentiated stillness.
essence: The supreme presence is timeless bliss dwelling within fully liberated beings.
simple_meaning: The divine resides as the supreme presence within those who have attained full liberation and blissful union beyond all distinctions and time.
insight: It teaches you to recognize the limitless, unchanging presence within your own deepest stillness as your true nature.
modern_relevance: When you find moments of deep inner calm where everything else fades, you touch the timeless presence that connects you to something vast and free.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
अद्वैते निर्विकारे हि स्वरूपे चिन्मये सुराः।
ममैव विबुधा नूनं शक्तिः कारणरूपिणी ॥
translation: निर्विकार अद्वैत चिन्मय रूप में प्रतीत होती हूँ । मेरी कारण शक्ति
english_translation: The radiant beings perceive me as the unchanging, non-dual essence; indeed, I am their causal power.
essence: The true self is the unchanging causal power behind all conscious knowing.
simple_meaning: The divine is the unchanging, non-dual essence that wise beings recognize as the cause and power behind all things.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing yourself as changing phenomena to the unchanging power that enables change.
modern_relevance: In moments when everything feels unstable, recognizing yourself as the steady cause beneath all change brings deep calm and strength.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेशानां जननी नात्र संशयः ।
मत्सूक्ष्मशक्तिरेवाहो देवी शक्तिं प्रयच्छति ॥
translation: ब्रह्मा, विष्णु, महेश की जननी है इसमें सन्देह नहीं है और मेरी सूक्ष्म शक्ति ही नाना देवी रूप धारण करके
english_translation: There is no doubt that I am the mother of Brahma, Vishnu, and Mahesha, and my subtle power manifests in various forms of the Goddess.
essence: The divine mother is the subtle source manifesting all forms of divine power without doubt.
simple_meaning: The divine mother is the source of the three great divine beings, and her subtle power expresses itself through many forms of the Goddess.
insight: It shifts your view to see all diverse energies and expressions as rooted in one subtle, dynamic source within you.
modern_relevance: When you recognize the source within yourself that animates many parts of your life, you feel a deeper connection to your own inner power.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
पितृदेवषिटन्देभ्यो नानादेवीस्वरूपिणी।
जगत्सूथूलपपञ्चोऽयं स्थूलशक्तेर्ममैव हि ॥
translation: ऋषि देवता पितरों को दैवी शक्ति प्रदान करती है।
english_translation: The divine power manifests as many forms of godly beings, the ancestors, and all creation; this gross power is indeed mine.
essence: The entire physical world and divine beings are manifestations of the same one power.
simple_meaning: The divine power expresses itself through many forms like gods, ancestors, and the entire physical world; this power belongs to me.
insight: Recognize that the variety you see in the world is not separate from your own inner power.
modern_relevance: When you see the diversity of people, traditions, and nature around you, remember they all arise from the same creative source within you.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
नानाभेदान समाश्रित्य नानारूपेषु जायते ।
स्थूलप्रपञ्चरूपं हि जगदयस्य स्थ रक्षकाः ॥
translation: जगत का स्थूल प्रपञ्च मेरी ही स्थूल शक्ति के अनन्त भेदों को आश्रय करके अनन्तरूप में प्रकट हुआ करता है। यह स्थूल प्रपञ्चमय जगत् जिसके रक्षक
english_translation: The gross world arises from my countless diverse aspects and manifests in infinite forms; its protectors belong to this gross realm.
essence: The diverse physical world arises from one divine source expressing infinite forms.
simple_meaning: The physical world appears because of the Goddess's many aspects, manifesting endlessly in various forms protected within this realm.
insight: Recognize that diversity is not separation but many faces of one underlying reality, shifting how you relate to differences.
modern_relevance: When you look at the complexity around you—people, nature, culture—it all flows from one shared source expressing itself in endless ways.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
यूयं देवगणाः सर्वे स्थूलशक्तेममैव च ।
परिणामस्वरूपं तज्जानीत सुरसत्तमाः !॥
translation: आप सब हो मेरी ही स्थूल शक्ति का परिणाममात्र हैं हे देवगण! इसको आप जाने
english_translation: You all, O gods, are merely the manifestation of my gross power; know this well, O best of gods!
essence: All divine beings are manifestations of one great power expressing itself.
simple_meaning: All gods are manifestations of the Goddess's gross power; they arise as her expressions.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing yourself as separate to understanding yourself as a living expression of a larger power.
modern_relevance: When you feel fragmented or isolated, remember you are part of a greater force expressing through you.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
अविद्यारूपमाश्रित्य ह्यमेव जगत्सुराः।
उत्पादये पुनश्वाहं विद्यारूपमधिश्रिता ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! मैं ही अविद्यारूप से जगत को प्रकट करती हूँ और मैं ही विद्यारूप धारण करके
english_translation: O divine beings! I manifest the world in the form of ignorance, and I also sustain it by embodying knowledge.
essence: The same power creates the world through confusion and sustains it through knowledge.
simple_meaning: The divine power appears as the world through confusion and also supports it through knowledge.
insight: It shifts how you see experience—not as just confusion or clarity but as both working together.
modern_relevance: When you face confusion and clarity inside yourself, remember both shape your reality and growth.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
जगतोऽस्य लयस्थानं बोधयामि दिवौकसः!।
अहं द्रष्टी च दृश्या च शक्तिः शक्तिमती तथा ॥
translation: जगत के लय-स्थान को लक्ष्य कराती हूँ।  मैं ही दृश्य हूँ और मैं ही द्रष्टा हूँ। मैं ही शक्ति हूँ  मैं ही शक्तिमान् हूँ
english_translation: I reveal the ultimate dissolution point of the world. I am the seer and the seen. I am the power and the possessor of power.
essence: You are simultaneously the witness, the witnessed, the power, and the possessor of power.
simple_meaning: The divine reveals that she is the ultimate reality behind the world’s end, the one who sees and is seen, the power itself and its possessor.
insight: This verse shifts your view to see yourself as both the presence observing life and the source of its energy and transformation.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by chaos or endings, remember you hold the power and witness within you — both creator and observer of your life’s changes.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
शक्तिशक्तिमतोभेंद तत्वज्ञानविवर्जिताः।
बालिशा एव पश्यन्ति न तत्त्वज्ञानिनो जनाः ॥
translation: शक्ति और शक्तिमान में भेद तत्त्व ज्ञानविहीन मूर्ख जीव ही समझते हैं परन्तु ज्ञानिगण नहीं समझते हैं
english_translation: Only fools see a difference between the divine power and the powerful; the wise see no distinction.
essence: True wisdom sees no divide between divine power and the powerful being.
simple_meaning: Fools without true understanding think the divine power and the powerful are different, but the wise know they are one.
insight: This verse teaches you to shift from seeing separation to recognizing underlying unity in apparent differences.
modern_relevance: When you see conflict or separation between leadership and action, realize this division often comes from misunderstanding deeper unity.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
अभेदज्ञानसम्पन्नाः शक्तः शक्तिमतस्तथा।
तत्त्वज्ञाननदीष्णाता ज्ञानाधिपारदर्शिनः ॥
translation: शक्ति और शक्तिमान में अभेदज्ञान करनेवाले ज्ञान पारंगत तत्वज्ञानी महापुरुष
english_translation: Those established in non-dual knowledge are the powerful and the possessor of power, deeply immersed in the river of true knowledge, supreme seers of wisdom.
essence: Power and the possessor of power are one through non-dual knowledge.
simple_meaning: True power comes from knowing that the power and the one who has it are not separate. Such people deeply understand reality and wisdom.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing power as outside you to recognizing it within your own being.
modern_relevance: When you fully own your abilities without separating yourself from your strength, you move with confidence and clarity in life.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
सात्त्विकाभेदसज्ज्ञान-बलान्मां प्राप्नुवन्त्यहो।
अहमेव पराभक्तया ज्ञानिनो विबुधर्षभाः !॥
translation: सात्त्विक अभेद ज्ञान के बल से मुझको ही प्राप्त होते हैं। हे देवगण ! मैं ही
english_translation: The wise and the best of the learned reach me alone through the power of pure, undivided knowledge.
essence: Only pure knowledge combined with supreme devotion truly reaches the divine.
simple_meaning: Only those who have pure, undivided knowledge and the highest devotion truly reach the divine.
insight: It shifts your focus from fragmented knowledge or lukewarm faith to integrated, devoted understanding as the key to connection.
modern_relevance: When you deeply understand and care with full sincerity, you connect to what truly matters beyond distractions.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
सन्निधौ भक्तवर्गस्य प्रादुर्भावमवाप्नुयाम् ।
ब्रह्मेश्वरविरारूप-त्रिभावेषु न संशयः ॥
translation: ज्ञानी भक्त के सम्मुख पराभक्ति के द्वारा ब्रह्म ईश विराटरूपी त्रिभाव में प्रगट होती हूँ इसमें सन्देह नहीं
english_translation: I certainly appear before the devoted through the three forms of Brahman, Ishvara, and Virat without any doubt.
essence: Devotion reveals the divine unmistakably through three cosmic forms without any doubt.
simple_meaning: The divine appears clearly to devoted people in three great forms without any doubt.
insight: It teaches you to trust that devotion itself invites the divine’s presence in many forms beyond your imagining.
modern_relevance: When you truly open your heart with love and trust, something vast and powerful shows up to meet you in ways you couldn’t expect.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
ते तत्त्वज्ञानिनो भक्ता ज्ञानिनो ये परात्परम् ।
तत्त्वातीतंच में तत्त्वं बुध्यन्ते साधु निर्जराः ! ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! वे तत्वज्ञानी ज्ञानी भक्त जो मेरे तत्त्वातीत परम तत्त्व को भलीभांति जान जाते हैं
english_translation: O divine beings! Those who are wise, devoted, and know the supreme beyond essence truly understand me, the timeless truth.
essence: True understanding arises when wisdom and devotion unite to perceive the timeless supreme.
simple_meaning: Those who combine deep wisdom and devoted love truly recognize the supreme, timeless truth that I embody.
insight: It teaches you to integrate clear understanding with devoted openness to experience the eternal truth beyond concepts.
modern_relevance: When your thoughtful understanding blends with heartfelt devotion, you recognize timeless truths that guide beyond fleeting appearances.
speaker: Shakti

verse_text:
मां कदाचिदनाद्यन्तविराहूपस्य धारिणीम्।
निरीक्षन्ते कदाचित्तु नानाशृंगारमास्वरम् ॥
translation: मुझे कभी अनादि अनन्त विराट रूप धारिणी देखते हैं, कभी मेरे अनेकों श्रृंगारमय
english_translation: Sometimes they see me as the eternal, infinite, cosmic form; sometimes adorned in many beautiful aspects.
essence: You can be both the infinite whole and many beautiful forms without contradiction.
simple_meaning: You are sometimes seen as the endless cosmic presence and sometimes as many beautiful forms adorned differently.
insight: It teaches you to accept your changing appearances while recognizing your unchanging essence beneath.
modern_relevance: You shift between feeling like a vast presence and a collection of many roles and expressions in your life and relationships.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
सगुणं मेऽद्भुतं रूप-मुपासीना निरन्तरम् ।
देवा अनुभवन्त्येव ब्रह्मानन्दमलौकिकम् ॥
translation: अद्भुत सगुण रूप में मेरी उपासना करते हुए, अलौकिक ब्रह्मानन्द को निरन्तर अनुभव करते हैं
english_translation: The radiant beings continuously worship my wondrous form and experience the supreme bliss beyond the world.
essence: Devoted worship of the divine form leads to experiencing bliss beyond the world.
simple_meaning: Radiant beings worship the divine form continuously and feel a bliss that is beyond the ordinary world.
insight: It teaches you that devoted love opens your experience to joy beyond ordinary limits.
modern_relevance: When you focus your heart deeply on what moves you, you can touch a joy that feels beyond daily struggles.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
समाधिस्थाः कदाचित्तु तत्त्वातीतं परात्परम् ।
महात्मानश्च मे तत्त्वं सम्प्रत्येतुं समीशते ॥
translation: और कभी वह महात्मा समाधिस्थ होकर मेरे तत्त्वातीत परमतत्त्व के अनुभव में समर्थ
english_translation: And sometimes that great soul, established in absorbed presence, can realize my supreme reality beyond all truth.
essence: Deep inner stillness allows experience of the supreme beyond all truths.
simple_meaning: Great souls who reach deep inner stillness can experience the supreme reality beyond ordinary truth.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate deep inner stillness so you can access truths beyond intellectual grasp.
modern_relevance: When your mind finally quiets in meditation, you can experience something beyond your usual thoughts and beliefs.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
अचिन्त्यं केवलाद्वैतज्ञानलोचनगोचरम्।
दशामेतां समासाद्य मद्दता ज्ञानिनोऽमराः ! ॥
translation: केवल अद्वैत ज्ञानविषयक अचिन्त्य परमतत्त्व के अनुभव में समर्थ होते हैं। इस दशा में पहुंचकर हे देवतागण!
english_translation: Only those with nondual wisdom can experience the inconceivable supreme reality; having reached this state, O radiant beings!
essence: Only nondual wisdom can experience the inconceivable supreme reality beyond thought.
simple_meaning: Only those with pure nondual wisdom can experience the supreme reality that cannot be conceived by the mind.
insight: It teaches you to accept that the deepest reality lies beyond mental concepts and direct experience.
modern_relevance: You’ve studied hard and glimpsed a truth too vast to fully explain—this is the moment your insight deepens beyond words.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
स्वरूपं मेऽधिगच्छन्ति परमानन्दसागरम् ।
नात्र कश्चन सन्देहो विद्यते विबुधर्षभाः ! ॥
translation: मेरे ज्ञानी भक्तगण मेरे ही परमानन्द सागर रूप स्वरूप को प्राप्त होते हैं इसमें कुछ भी सन्देह नहीं है
english_translation: My wise devotees attain my own form, the ocean of supreme bliss; there is no doubt about this among the best of the wise.
essence: True devotion and wisdom inevitably lead to experiencing the divine as supreme bliss without doubt.
simple_meaning: Those who are truly wise and devoted reach the form of the divine that is an ocean of supreme joy without any doubt.
insight: It teaches you to fully trust your devotion as a sure path to experiencing profound bliss and truth.
modern_relevance: When your heart fully trusts your path, the deepest joy you seek becomes clearly reachable, removing all hesitation.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
देवमातर्जगन्मातज्ञारनदे ! ब्रह्मरूपिणि !।
नैवासीद्विदितं किञ्चित्स्वरूपं ते यथार्थतः ॥
translation: हे देवजननी ! हे जगजननी ! हे ब्रह्मरूपिणी! हे ज्ञानदे ! हम लोगों को आपका यथार्थवरूप कुछ भी विदित नहीं था
english_translation: O divine mother, mother of the universe, embodiment of supreme reality and wisdom, your true nature was never truly known to us.
essence: The true nature of the divine mother remains beyond what we have known so far.
simple_meaning: We did not truly know the divine mother’s real form or essence before this moment.
insight: It teaches you to embrace not-knowing as the beginning of true trust and devotion.
modern_relevance: You may feel you understand a person or idea deeply, only to realize there is always more beyond your grasp.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
महामान्ये ! महादेवि ! महाहङ्कारमोहिताः ।
किंकर्तव्यविमूढा वै अत आस्म पुरा वयम् ॥
translation: इस कारण हे परममाननीया महादेवी ! हम अहंकार विमोहित होकर पहले किंकर्तव्यविमूढ़ हुआ करते थे
english_translation: O most revered Mahadevi! Because of great ego and delusion, we were once bewildered and confused about what to do.
essence: Ego and delusion once clouded us, leaving us uncertain about our actions.
simple_meaning: Once, we were confused and lost because of strong ego and delusion, not knowing what to do.
insight: Recognize how ego-driven confusion blocks clear choice and action, inviting humility and openness.
modern_relevance: You might feel stuck, unsure what to do, when your pride or self-importance clouds your clarity.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अखण्डच तवाद्वैतं  स्वरूपं त्वन्मुस्वाम्बुजाद।
निशम्याध वयं मातः। शक्तिशक्तिमतोस्तथा ॥
translation: हे मातः! आज आपके अखण्ड अद्वैत स्वरूप को आपके मुखारविन्द से, सुनकर तथा शक्ति और शक्तिमान में
english_translation: O Mother! Today we have listened to your indivisible non-dual nature from your lotus mouth, realizing both power and the powerful.
essence: The divine nature is indivisible non-duality, both power and the powerful together.
simple_meaning: We have heard today from your own mouth about your indivisible non-dual nature as both power and the powerful.
insight: Recognizes the inseparability of source and force but requires more context to understand fully.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अभेदं ननु विज्ञाय तं तत्त्वज्ञानमूलकम्।
तत्त्वज्ञानप्रसूं दिव्यामन्तदृष्टिमवाप्नुम ॥
translation: जो तत्वज्ञानमूलक अभेद है उसको जानकर हमने तत्त्वज्ञान जननी दिव्य अन्तर्दृष्टि प्राप्त की है।
english_translation: Knowing the non-duality that is the root of true wisdom, one attains the divine inner vision born of that wisdom.
essence: Understanding fundamental oneness awakens a divine inner vision beyond ordinary sight.
simple_meaning: When you understand that everything is fundamentally one without separation, you gain a divine inner insight born from that understanding.
insight: It shifts your mind from seeing separation to recognizing unity, opening a deeper inner vision.
modern_relevance: When you stop seeing divisions everywhere and recognize unity beneath differences, you unlock a clarity that helps you navigate life with calm and confidence.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
साम्प्रतं सफलं विद्यो निजास्तित्वं न संशयः।
इदानीं दयया देवि ! स्वकलावर्णनं कुरु ॥
translation: अब हम निःसन्देह अपने अस्तित्व को सफल समझते हैं - हे जगन्मातः ! हे देवी! अब आप कृपा कर अपनी कलाओं का वर्णन करें
english_translation: Now we are certain that our true self is accomplished—O Mother of the world! Please graciously describe your divine arts.
