essence: Certainty in your true self opens the way to receive the divine's full expression.
simple_meaning: You have become sure of your true self and now ask the divine mother to reveal her powers.
insight: It encourages moving from personal certainty to open-hearted trust in a higher wisdom beyond oneself.
modern_relevance: You’ve reached a moment of clarity about who you truly are and feel ready to learn more from a higher source.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
येन चानुभवं कर्तुं भवत्याः सर्वथा वयम् ।
शक्नुयाम जगन्मातः ! कलारूपेण सर्वतः ॥
translation: जिससे हम सर्वत्र कलारूप से आपको अनुभव करने में सर्वथा समर्थ हो सके
english_translation: By which we can fully experience you everywhere in the form of energy.
essence: You can fully experience the divine everywhere as vibrant creative energy.
simple_meaning: We seek the power to experience the divine everywhere as vibrant energy in all things.
insight: It encourages shifting from seeing the world as separate to feeling the divine energy permeating all things.
modern_relevance: You pause and notice the energy behind every moment — the hum of life in every detail.
speaker: Devotees

verse_text:
दृश्यमपञ्चजातेऽस्मिन्निखिले सचराचरे।
अभिव्यक्ताऽस्मि भो देवाः ! कलारूपेण सर्वतः ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! मैं ही कलारूप से इस सारे चराचर दृश्य प्रपञ्च समूह में व्यापक रूप से  प्रकट हूँ ।
english_translation: O radiant beings! I am widely manifest in all this moving and unmoving visible world as the form of energy.
essence: The divine manifests as energy pervading all visible moving and still things.
simple_meaning: The divine says she manifests as energy in all visible things, both moving and still, filling everything.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing things as separate objects to recognizing the universal energy uniting all visible existence.
modern_relevance: You notice energy flowing through your body, nature, and machines—this verse reminds you that energy animates all visible things around you.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
परं दृश्यमपञ्चस्तु नैवास्ते मयि निर्जराः।
मय्यास्ते पूर्णसद्भावः कलाषोडशकान्वितः ॥
translation: परन्तु मुझमें दृश्यप्रपञ्च नहीं है। मुझमे हे देवगण सोलह कलाओं से पूर्ण सद्भाव
english_translation: But in me, there is no visible world; I alone embody the full essence of the sixteen arts.
essence: True self is complete and unchanged beyond any visible world or change.
simple_meaning: The divine presence contains no visible world or decay but fully embodies perfect essence and all skills within.
insight: It teaches you to look beyond appearances and recognize your untouched, full essence as your true nature.
modern_relevance: When everything outside feels unstable or changing, you can find unshakable wholeness inside yourself that no change affects.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
चिद्भावानन्दभावौ स्तः कलापूर्णो च मय्यतः।
कलाषोडशकोपेतसच्चिदानन्दमय्यहम् ॥
translation: सोलह कलाओं से पूर्ण चिद्भाव और सोलह कलाओं से पूर्ण आनन्दभाव विद्यमान है; इसलिये मैं षोडशकलाओं से युक्त सच्चिदानन्द स्वरूप हूँ
english_translation: I embody sixteen aspects of pure consciousness and sixteen aspects of bliss; thus, I am the embodiment of truth, consciousness, and bliss endowed with sixteen perfections.
essence: Complete consciousness and bliss coexist in you as sixteen perfect qualities united.
simple_meaning: The divine presence is full of sixteen perfect qualities of consciousness and bliss, making her the pure truth and joy itself.
insight: Recognize your inner completeness as the fullness of consciousness and bliss beyond appearances.
modern_relevance: When you feel fragmented or incomplete, remember you hold within you the full spectrum of awareness and joy, perfectly whole as you are.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
यतोऽहं सचिदानन्दभावैः पूर्णैश्च पूरिता।
अन्तःपूर्णा बहिःपूर्णा पूर्णाऽतोऽस्मि च सर्वथा ॥
translation: मुझमें पूर्ण सच्चिदानन्दभाव विद्यमान है इसलिये मैं अन्तःपूर्ण बहिःपूर्ण तथा सब प्रकार से पूर्ण हूँ
english_translation: I am filled with complete consciousness, bliss, and existence; I am full within, full without, and completely full in every way.
essence: Complete consciousness and bliss make you fully whole inside and out.
simple_meaning: You are completely filled with consciousness, bliss, and existence. Inside and outside, you are whole and complete.
insight: Shift your view from scarcity to fullness by recognizing you already embody all that is needed.
modern_relevance: In moments of self-doubt, remember you already hold inner completeness and do not need to seek outside yourself.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
सचिदानन्दभावानां नन्वेकैककलाश्रयः।
दृश्यप्रपञ्चपुञोऽयं समुद्भतोऽखिको मम ॥
translation: मेरी सद्भाव की एक कला, चिद्भाव की एक कला और आनन्दभाव की एक कलामात्र से ही यह सारा दृश्य प्रपञ्च उत्पन्न हुआ है
english_translation: This entire visible world has arisen from just one aspect each of my existence as consciousness, bliss, and pure being.
essence: All visible creation arises from one unified essence of consciousness, bliss, and being.
simple_meaning: The whole visible world comes from just one creative aspect each of my consciousness, bliss, and pure existence.
insight: It shifts perception from seeing separation to recognizing unity as the foundation of all experience.
modern_relevance: When you feel alone or fragmented, remember all your experiences share a single source that unites consciousness, joy, and being.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
एतास्तिस्रास्त्रिभावानां विश्वं व्याश्नुवते कलाः।
आधिदैविकमाध्यात्म रूपं धृत्वाऽधिभौतिकम् ॥
translation: ये ही तीन कलाएँ अध्यात्म, अधिदैव और अधिभूत रूप धारण करके जगत में व्याप्त हैं
english_translation: These three energies—spiritual, divine, and material—pervade the entire universe.
essence: Three fundamental energies—spiritual, divine, and material—underlie and sustain all existence.
simple_meaning: The whole universe exists through three energies: spiritual, divine, and material, each shaping reality.
insight: Recognize reality as layered energies; this helps you see beyond surface appearances to deeper connections.
modern_relevance: When you notice your thoughts, feelings, and the world around you, you're sensing these three energies shaping your experience.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
आध्यात्मिक्या कलाः सर्वा मम षोडशसंख्या काः ।
प्रपूर्य्यन्ते शिवेऽतोऽसौ महादिर्जगद्गुरुः ॥
translation: मेरी आध्यात्मिक षोड़श कलाओं की पूर्णता शिव में प्रकाशित होने से यह सब ऋषियों के आदि और जगत के गुरु हैं
english_translation: All my sixteen spiritual arts are perfected by Shiva; thus he is the primal sage and the world's teacher.
essence: A primal source perfects all spiritual arts as the universal teacher.
simple_meaning: The sixteen spiritual skills or arts reach their full perfection through Shiva, who is the original sage and teacher of the world.
insight: Recognizing a primal source unifies diverse spiritual skills, helping you see your own learning as part of a greater whole.
modern_relevance: When you master different skills or disciplines, it helps to remember they all stem from a deeper source of wisdom beyond yourself.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
मत्कला आधिदैविक्यः प्रपूयन्ते यतो हरौ।
अतो देवादिदेवोऽयं विश्वस्मिन् विष्णुरुच्यते ॥
translation: मेरी अधिदैव कलाओं की पूर्णता विष्णु में होने से यह संसार में देवादिदेव कहे जाते हैं
english_translation: The fullness of my supreme divine arts flows into Hari; thus Vishnu is called the lord of all gods in this universe.
essence: The supreme divine power fully manifests as Vishnu, the highest lord in the universe.
simple_meaning: The supreme divine power expressed through the Goddess fully flows into Vishnu, making him the highest lord in the universe.
insight: It teaches you to see the divine power as present and complete within the supreme presence, inspiring trust and devotion.
modern_relevance: When you recognize that the greatest creative power flows through a presence greater than yourself, you find grounding and trust in life's unfolding.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
ममावतारसङ्घोऽपि विष्ण्वंशैरेव जायते।
विधौ पोड़श पूर्य्यन्ते ह्यधिभूतकला मम ॥
translation: इसीलिये मेरे अवतारसमूह विष्णु के अंश से ही प्राविर्भूत होते हैं। मेरी अधिभूत कलाओं की पूर्णता ब्रह्मा में है
english_translation: Therefore, my incarnations arise as portions of Vishnu's lineage. The fullness of my manifested powers is realized in Brahma.
essence: Divine forms arise from a shared lineage, while creative power reaches cosmic completion.
simple_meaning: All my incarnations come as parts of Vishnu’s line, and my manifested powers reach fullness in Brahma.
insight: It shifts your view from isolated identity to understanding your powers as expressions of a shared cosmic source.
modern_relevance: When you recognize your origins and the full range of your strengths, you see yourself as part of a vast creative flow beyond yourself.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
अतः मजापतीनाश्चाऽसावस्त्यादिः पितामहः ।
ममाध्यात्मकलानाञ्च पोड़शानां पुराऽमराः ! ॥
translation: इस कारण ये प्रजापतियों के आदि और पितामह कहे जाते हैं । हे देवगण! मेरी अध्यात्म षोड़श कलाओं का
english_translation: Therefore, these are called the first progenitors and grandfathers. O divine beings! My sixteen spiritual arts...
essence: The first ancestors embody the sixteen spiritual arts of the divine.
simple_meaning: These beings are called the first ancestors and grandfathers because of their connection to my sixteen spiritual skills.
insight: It shows how foundational spiritual qualities underlie all creation and lineage.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
भूत्वा सप्तर्षिवर्गेषु विकाशो याति हेतुताम् ।
अनेकेषां महर्षीणां ज्ञानविस्तारकारिणाम् ॥
translation: विकास प्रथम सप्तर्षियों में होकर ज्ञान के चालक नाना ऋषियों का कारण बनता है
english_translation: The unfolding passes first through the group of seven sages and becomes the cause for many great sages who expand knowledge.
essence: Knowledge unfolds through a primary group, then spreads widely by many sages.
simple_meaning: Unfolding knowledge first spreads through the seven sages, then leads many great sages to expand wisdom further.
insight: It shows how foundational teachers spark wider learning that shapes generations.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
कलाविशेषमेतासां सन्दधाना वितन्वते ।
अवतीर्य्यर्पयो ज्ञानं लोकानेत्य चतुर्दश ॥
translation: ऋषियों के अवतार गण मेरी इन कलाओं मे से विशेष विशेष कलाओं को धारण करके चतुर्दश भुवन में ज्ञान का विस्तार करते हैं
english_translation: The incarnations of sages spread knowledge across the fourteen worlds by embodying these special arts.
essence: Special abilities allow incarnations to spread knowledge throughout all worlds.
simple_meaning: Certain incarnations hold special arts that spread knowledge throughout all fourteen realms.
insight: Recognize your unique skills as vehicles to share understanding widely and meaningfully.
modern_relevance: You have talents that can influence many people if you use them fully and wisely.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
समासाद्याऽधिदैवीमें कलाः पोड़शसङ्ख्यकाः । 
वसवोऽष्टौ यमेन्द्रौ च रुद्रा एकादशामराः ! ॥
translation: हे । देवगण ! मेरी अधिदैव षोडश कलाश्री को प्राप्त करके अष्टवसु, एकादश रुद्र, यम और इन्द्र
english_translation: O divine beings! Having attained my sixteen divine arts, there are the eight Vasus, the eleven Rudras, Yama, and Indra.
essence: Lists divine groups embodying Devi's sixteen divine arts.
simple_meaning: Devi lists divine beings associated with her sixteen divine arts, naming groups of powerful celestial entities.
insight: It highlights the interconnectedness of cosmic powers without teaching a universal principle.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
द्वादशादित्यसम्मिश्रा देवास्त्रिंशत्रयस्तथा ।
प्रादर्भवन्त्यमी सर्वे नित्या नैमित्तिकास्ततः ॥
translation: द्वादश आदित्य, यह तैंतीस देवता तथा अनेक नित्य, नैमित्तिक देवता प्रकट होकर
english_translation: Twelve Adityas, thirty-three deities, and many eternal and occasional divine beings manifest.
essence: Many divine beings manifest, showing the vastness of divine presence.
simple_meaning: Many divine beings appear, including twelve Adityas, thirty-three deities, and various eternal and occasional ones.
insight: Recognize the vastness and diversity of divine expression beyond a single form or idea.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
व्यवस्था कर्मराज्यस्य प्रादुर्भूय प्रकुर्वते।
अनेके पितरश्चैवं ये प्रजापतयो दश ॥
translation: कर्मराज्य की सुव्यवस्था करते हैं। इसी प्रकार दस प्रजापति और नाना पितृगण
english_translation: The realm of action is established with order by many ancestors and the ten Prajapatis.
essence: Orderly action arises from many foundational beings working together.
simple_meaning: Many ancestors and ten Prajapatis establish the orderly realm where actions take place.
insight: It shows that complex systems of action depend on many foundational influences working in harmony.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
षोशालम्ब्य कुर्वन्ति तेऽधिभूतकला मम ।
नानावैचित्र्यपूर्णायाः सृष्टेरस्या व्यवस्थितिम् ॥
translation: मेरी अधिभूत षोड़शकलाओं को अवलम्बन करके प्रकट होकर नाना विचित्रता पूर्ण सृष्टि को सुव्यवस्था करते हैं
english_translation: They support my sixteen elemental powers to manifest and orderly arrange this diverse creation.
essence: A multitude of elemental powers uphold and organize the diverse creation in perfect order.
simple_meaning: The divine uses sixteen fundamental powers to support and organize the vast variety in creation.
insight: It teaches you to see complexity and diversity as expressions of an underlying unified power organizing everything.
modern_relevance: When life feels chaotic, remember countless unseen forces are working to keep everything in balance and harmony.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
अन्तिकं नृंश्च्  मे नेतुं नितरामग्रगामिनः।
व्याप्ताप्यस्यां कलारूपाजगंर्त्य  सर्वतः सुराः ! ॥
translation: और मनुष्यों को मेरी ओर निरन्तर अग्रसर करते हैं। हे देवतागण ! मैं कलारूपिणी होकर इस जगत में व्याप्त होने पर भी
english_translation: And humans keep moving constantly toward me. O divine beings! Though I pervade this world as the form of time,
essence: Life constantly moves toward the divine who pervades all as time.
simple_meaning: Humans are always moving toward me, the divine who pervades the world as time.
insight: It shows the natural, constant movement of life toward the divine presence embodied as time itself.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
अद्वितीयाऽहमेकास्मि शुद्धा बुद्धा च शाश्वती ।
सीमा नास्त्येव भो देवा ! कलाविश्लेषणस्य मे ॥
translation: एक अद्वितीय शुद्ध बुद्ध और नित्य हूँ । मेरी कलाओं के विश्लेषण का पार नहीं है
english_translation: I am the unique, pure, eternal wisdom. No gods can define the limits of my powers.
essence: Pure, unique wisdom is eternal and cannot be confined by any limits.
simple_meaning: You are the one pure and eternal wisdom that cannot be limited or fully defined by anything.
insight: Recognize your true self as boundless wisdom beyond all external definitions or limits.
modern_relevance: You may feel pressure to fit into fixed roles or limits, but your true nature is beyond all boundaries.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
शक्तेर्मव्यवतिष्ठन्ते कलाः षोड़श सर्वदा ।
अतोऽहं सर्वशक्तीनामस्म्याधारस्वरूपिणी ॥
translation: मुझमें शक्ति की षोडश कला सर्वदा विद्यमान है इसलिये मैं सब शक्तियों की आधारस्वरूप हूँ
english_translation: The sixteen arts always reside in Shakti; therefore, I am the foundation and essence of all powers.
essence: All powers continuously dwell in you as their essential foundation.
simple_meaning: All sixteen special arts or powers continuously exist in Shakti, making her the basis and form of all powers.
insight: It teaches you to recognize your inner source of endless potential rather than seeing abilities as separate or external.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by your tasks, remember you have many hidden strengths always supporting you from within.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
कलारूपैः कलापूर्णा शक्तिः सा मेऽश्नुते जगत् ।
तस्यास्तासां कलानान्तु विच भेदाननेकशः ॥
translation: कलाओं से पूर्ण वही मेरी शक्ति कलारूप से जगत में परिव्याप्त है। उस शक्ति की उन कलाओं के अनेक भेद हैं सो जानो
english_translation: My power is full of arts and pervades the world in many forms; know that those arts have many distinctions.
essence: One divine power expresses itself through countless unique creative forms across the world.
simple_meaning: The divine power is complete with many creative arts and fills the entire world in diverse forms, each with its own unique qualities.
insight: It teaches you to recognize the unity behind diverse expressions, seeing all forms as facets of one creative source.
modern_relevance: Look around and notice the endless variety in nature, art, and life — all expressions of one creative energy shaping the world uniquely.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
ममैवैका कला शक्तरुद्भिज्जेषु विकाशते।
स्वेदजेषु कलाद्वैतमण्डजेषु कलात्रयम् ॥
translation: मेरी शक्ति की एक कला का उद्भिज में, स्वेदज में दो कलाओं का, अण्डज में तीन कलाओं का
english_translation: In me alone, the power manifests as one art in sprouts, two arts in sweat, and three arts in eggs.
essence: A single divine power unfolds in increasing complexity through all life forms.
simple_meaning: The divine power within me appears in different ways: once in sprouts, twice in sweat, and thrice in eggs, showing increasing complexity.
insight: It shifts your view to see yourself and life as expressions of a single unfolding power with many forms.
modern_relevance: Think of how one idea grows into many layers in your work or life, each stage richer and more complex than the last.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
चतस्रश्च कला भान्ति जरायुजगणेऽखिले।
पञ्चकोषमपूर्णत्वान्मत्र्येषु प्रायशोऽमराः । ॥
translation: और सब जरायुजों में चार कलाओं का विकास होता है। हे देवगण ! पञ्चकोष के पूर्ण अधिकारी होने के कारण
english_translation: In all beings born of birth and decay, four faculties manifest; immortals usually possess the complete five sheaths.
essence: Mortals manifest four faculties; immortals embody complete five sheaths of being.
simple_meaning: All beings born and dying show four faculties, but immortals have the full five layers of being.
insight: It teaches you to see beyond current limitations by understanding the deeper layers that define immortal wholeness.
modern_relevance: You notice how your awareness and capacities feel limited compared to moments when you feel fully alive or connected beyond usual limits.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
आकलापञ्चकादष्ट कला नूनं चकासति ।
नवारभ्य कला यावत्षोड़शं ये यथायथम् ॥
translation: मनुष्यों में पांच कलाओं से लेकर आठ कलाओं तक का विकास होता है और साधारणतः अनेक केन्द्रों से आविर्भूत मेरे अवतारों में नव से लेकर सोलह कलाओं का
english_translation: Humans develop from five to eight arts, while my incarnations manifest from nine to sixteen arts in various forms.
essence: Divine forms manifest a wider range of arts than ordinary humans develop.
simple_meaning: Humans can develop five to eight arts, but divine incarnations show from nine to sixteen arts in many forms.
insight: Recognize the broader creative potential in divine manifestations compared to common human skills.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
सम्बिकाश्यावतारेषु नानाकेन्द्रोद्भवेषु च ।
कुत्रचिन्मे प्रपूर्य्यन्तेऽवतारे पूर्णसंज्ञके ॥
translation: यथा आवश्यक विकास  होकर किसी पूर्णावतार में सोलह कलाएँ पूर्ण विकसित होती हैं
english_translation: Just as all sixteen arts fully develop in a necessary incarnation of Sambika.
essence: Certain divine incarnations fully embody all aspects of creative mastery.
simple_meaning: In some incarnations of the Goddess Sambika, all sixteen traditional arts become fully realized and complete.
insight: Recognize that some expressions of the divine or your talents manifest in complete, full forms, not partial.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
मच्छक्ते: षोड़शानान्तु कलानामस्ति पूर्णता।
मदाज्ञारूपधर्मेऽतो ज्ञेयो धर्मः सनातनः ॥
translation: मेरी शक्ति की षोडश कलाओं की पूर्णता मेरी आज्ञारूपी धर्म में विद्यमान है इसी कारण धर्म को सनातन जानना उचित है।
english_translation: The completeness of my sixteen arts resides in my command-like dharma; this is why dharma is rightly known as eternal.
essence: True purpose is the complete, eternal power expressed through inner command.
simple_meaning: Your true purpose is the complete expression of a powerful inner command that never ends.
insight: It shifts focus from fragmented efforts to recognizing your inner command as the source of lasting strength.
modern_relevance: When you feel scattered or unsure, remember your core purpose holds a complete and enduring power guiding you steadily.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
अस्म्यतः सर्वधर्माणामाश्रयस्थलमुत्तमम् ।
स्थूलसूक्ष्मात्मकं विश्वं समस्तं सचराचरम् ॥
translation: इसीलिये मैं सभी धर्मों की उत्तम आश्रयस्थल हूँ और इसी से मेरी आज्ञा रूपी धर्म ही स्थूल सूक्ष्मात्मक तथा स्थावर जंगमात्मक
english_translation: Therefore, I am the supreme refuge of all dharmas, and my command is the dharma that pervades the gross and subtle, the moving and the unmoving universe.
essence: The divine is the supreme refuge supporting all true purpose in every form and motion.
simple_meaning: The divine says she is the highest shelter for all true purposes and rules that govern everything, both visible and invisible.
insight: It shifts your trust from scattered external goals to a single, reliable inner refuge that upholds all your paths.
modern_relevance: When life feels scattered between many roles and challenges, you can rest in a single steady source that supports every part of your being.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
मदादेशात्मको धर्मो नियमेव विभर्ति सः।
धर्मशक्तेहि मे पूर्णाः कलाः षोडशसंख्यकाः ॥
translation: समस्त जगत की सर्वदा धारक है। मेरी धर्म शक्ति की पूरी षोड़श कलाएँ
english_translation: My law is inherently myself; it is always sustained by rules. My dharma powers are complete with sixteen arts.
essence: Your true law is the divine power complete in sixteen sustaining arts.
simple_meaning: The true law that governs everything is inseparable from the divine's power, complete in sixteen distinct arts.
insight: Recognize your inner being as the source of a complete and sustaining power that guides your purpose.
modern_relevance: When you feel scattered or uncertain, remember your inner strength is complete and firmly grounded in many skills and powers.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
आर्य्यजातीयधर्मेषु विद्यन्ते विवुधर्षभाः.!
आर्यजातिरतोऽन्यासामस्त्याधः शिक्षको गुरु ॥
translation: आर्य जाति के स्वधर्म में विद्यमान हैं, इसलिये आर्य जाति जगत को अन्यान्य जातियों की आदि शिक्षक तथा गुरु है
english_translation: The noble class excels in their true duties and thus serves as the original teacher and guru to other classes.
essence: Devotion to your true duty makes you a teacher and guide to others.
simple_meaning: Those devoted to their true purpose naturally become teachers and guides for others.
insight: It encourages you to embrace your true purpose fully, knowing your example leads others.
modern_relevance: When you focus fully on your real work or calling, you influence and guide those around you without needing to teach explicitly.
speaker: Shakti

verse_text:
आर्यधर्मोऽन्यधर्माणां जनकः पालकोऽस्ति च ।
नात्र कश्चन सन्देहो विव्रतेऽदितिनन्दनाः !॥
translation: और आर्य धर्म अन्यान्य धर्मों का जनक तथा पालक है, हे देवतागण ! इसमें कुछ सन्देह नहीं है
english_translation: The noble Dharma is the origin and protector of all other dharmas; there is no doubt about this, O divine beings!
essence: Your highest purpose is the origin and protector of all other actions.
simple_meaning: The highest or noble purpose is the foundation and protector of all other purposes or duties without any doubt.
insight: It teaches you to recognize your deepest purpose as the guiding force behind all your actions and roles.
modern_relevance: When you feel pulled in many directions, remember your core purpose is the foundation that holds everything else together.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
यज्ञो दानं तपश्चेति धर्माङ्गत्रयमेव हि ।
मोक्षदं स्यातत्प्रपूर्ण सदद्धयत् क्रमशः कलाः ॥
translation: यद्यपि यज्ञ, तप और दान यह ही धर्म के तीन अंग क्रमशः धर्मकलाओ की अभिवृद्धि करते हुए पूर्णता को प्राप्त होकर मुक्तिप्रद होते हैं
english_translation: Sacrifice, charity, and disciplined effort are the three parts of dharma that gradually perfect the arts of virtue and lead to freedom.
essence: Sacrifice, charity, and disciplined effort together perfect virtue and lead to freedom.
simple_meaning: The three main parts of true duty are sacrifice, giving, and disciplined effort. Together they gradually improve your virtues and lead to inner freedom.
insight: It teaches you to see sacrifice, giving, and effort as interconnected steps that gradually cultivate freedom and moral excellence.
modern_relevance: When you consistently give your time, resources, and effort to what matters, you build a foundation that frees you from inner struggle.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
धर्मः किन्तु कलानाञ्च साहाय्यात्सम्बिभज्यते ।
नैकाङ्गोपाङ्गपुंजेषु सम्प्रदायव्रजेष्वपि ॥
translation: किन्तु धर्म अपनी कलाओं की सहायता से अनेक अंग, उपांग और सम्प्रदायों में विभक्त होकर
english_translation: Dharma is divided into many parts, limbs, and traditions, supported by its various skills.
essence: True purpose is many parts working together through diverse skills and traditions.
simple_meaning: Your true purpose includes many skills and traditions, each part supporting the whole.
insight: Recognize your purpose as a complex whole made of diverse skills and roles, not just one task.
modern_relevance: Your job, hobbies, and relationships each reflect a part of your purpose, all working together even if they seem separate.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
विधत्तेऽभ्युदयश्चैप नृणां नानाधिकारिणाम् ।
धारिकाया द्विधा भिन्ना धर्मशक्तेः कलाः सुराः ॥
translation: विभिन्न प्रकार के अधिकारियों का अभ्युदय करता है । हे देवतागण ! धर्म की धारिका शक्ति की पूर्णकला दो भागों में
english_translation: Different kinds of authorities arise among humans. O divine beings! The full power of dharma is divided into two parts.
essence: The power of dharma divides into two parts, giving rise to diverse human authorities.
simple_meaning: Various authorities or powers arise among people. The full power of dharma is split into two parts.
insight: It reveals that the power sustaining order manifests in different forms and roles, shaping how people act.
speaker: Shakti

verse_text:
सत्मप्रवृत्त्यात्मकं नूनं निवृत्त्यात्मकमेव च।
नारीधर्म नृधर्मश्च न्यस्यन्तीह पृथक्तया ॥
translation: विभक्त होकर प्रवृत्ति तथा निवृत्ति मूलक पुरुषधर्म और नारी धर्म को अलग अलग स्थापित करती है।
english_translation: The duties of men and women are distinctly established based on their active and inactive natures.
essence: Men's and women's duties differ based on their inherent active or inactive nature.
simple_meaning: Men's and women's duties are set apart here according to their distinct active and inactive tendencies.
insight: Recognize that duties can arise from natural tendencies without implying superiority or limitation.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
प्रवृत्त्यात्मकधर्मस्य संस्थाप्यादर्शमुत्तमम्।
नन्वहं विष्णुरूपेण धर्मान वर्णाश्रमाभिधान् ॥
translation: मैं ही विष्णुरूप से प्रवृत्तिधर्म का उत्तम आदर्श स्थापित करके मनुष्यों  को स्वर्णाश्रम धर्म का
english_translation: I, in the form of Vishnu, have established the highest ideal of engaged duty, the dharma of the varna and ashrama systems, for humanity.
essence: Your present duties embody a highest ideal established for your life’s purpose.
simple_meaning: The highest example of acting according to your role and stage in life is established as a guide for humans.
insight: It teaches you to see your current duties as expressions of a greater ideal, giving deeper motivation.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by choices, remembering your specific responsibilities can anchor your efforts with clear purpose.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
मानवैः पालयन्तीह मुक्तेस्तानास्पदं नये ।
भूयः शम्भुस्वरूपेण यथावर्णाश्रमं शनैः ॥
translation: पालन कराती हुई उनको कैवल्यपद की ओर अग्रसर करती हूँ और मैं ही पुनः शिवरूप से वर्णाश्रम धर्म के अनुसार शनैः शनैः
english_translation: I protect those who seek liberation and gently guide them step by step in the form of Shiva according to the duties of varna and ashrama.
essence: Freedom comes gently through steady adherence to your true roles and duties.
simple_meaning: You are protected and slowly guided toward freedom by following your rightful duties and roles.
insight: This teaches you to trust gradual transformation through consistent, responsible action instead of rushing results.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by big changes, remember steady progress through your daily roles brings true growth.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
निवृत्त्यात्मकधर्मस्य सत्यध्वपरिदर्शिका ।
पन्थानं दुगम मुक्तेः कुर्वेऽहं सुगमं द्रुतम् ॥
translation: निवृत्तिधर्म की पथप्रदर्शक बनकर कठिन मुक्ति पथ को शीघ्र सरल करती हूँ
english_translation: Becoming the guide of the path of renunciation, I swiftly make the difficult path of liberation easy.
essence: Sincere renunciation guided well turns the difficult path to freedom into an easy one.
simple_meaning: I show the way to renounce attachments, making the hard path to freedom quicker and easier.
insight: It teaches you that clear guidance and sincere renunciation can speed your progress toward freedom.
modern_relevance: When you decide to let go of old burdens, what once felt overwhelming can suddenly seem manageable and fast.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
उपदिष्टे अतो वेदैरुपास्तिर्ध्यानमप्यहो।
मज्जगद्गुरुरूपस्य शिवविष्णुस्वरुपयोः ॥
translation: इसी कारण मेरे जगद्गुरुस्वरूप की उपासना और ध्यान इन्हीं विष्णु और शिवरूप में करने की आज्ञा वेद ने दी है
english_translation: Therefore, the Vedas have instructed worship and meditation on my form as the world teacher, in the forms of Shiva and Vishnu.
essence: The Vedas guide worship of the divine as both Shiva and Vishnu, the world teacher.
simple_meaning: The Vedas instruct you to worship and meditate on the divine appearing as both Shiva and Vishnu, the universal teacher.
insight: It invites you to embrace diverse expressions of the divine for your spiritual connection and meditation.
modern_relevance: When you feel scattered, remembering that the divine can be seen in different ways helps you connect deeply in your own unique way.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
नारीधर्मार्थमप्येवं मत्स्वरूपत्रयं सुराः ।
ग्राह्यमादर्शरूपेण विश्वकल्याणसम्पदे ॥
translation: हे देवतागण नारीधर्म के लिये भी मेरे तीन स्वरुप आदर्श रूप से जगत्कल्याण के लिए अवलम्बनीय हैं
english_translation: O divine beings, even for the purpose of woman’s duty, my three forms are to be taken as ideal for the welfare of the world.
essence: Ideal forms of the divine guide personal duty toward universal welfare.
simple_meaning: The divine three forms act as perfect examples for women’s duties, supporting the well-being of the entire world.
insight: This verse shifts focus from isolated duty to seeing personal roles as part of a larger, world-benefiting pattern.
modern_relevance: You may look to role models who embody your values, guiding your actions toward contributing to greater good beyond personal goals.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
अहमेव महामाया प्रोच्ये भेदविवज्जिता।
गौरी प्रेमप्रधानाऽहं दुर्गा शक्तिमधानिका ॥
translation: भेद रहित रूप से मैं ही महामाया, प्रेम प्रधाना, मैं ही गौरी और शक्ति प्रधाना मैं ही दुर्गा कही जाती हूँ
english_translation: I am the great illusion without division, full of love as Gauri, and full of power as Durga.
essence: The divine is one indivisible presence of love and power within you.
simple_meaning: The divine reveals itself as one without separation, full of love as Gauri and full of power as Durga.
insight: Recognize that love and power coexist within you as inseparable aspects of the true self.
modern_relevance: When you feel divided between your gentle kindness and inner strength, remember they are one expression of your true self.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
एतद्रूपत्रयं नूनं सती नारी विभर्त्यहो।
पुण्ये भारतवर्षेऽस्मिन्यायजातौ प्रजायते ॥
translation: जो सती नारी पवित्र भारतवर्ष और आर्यजाति में उत्पन्न होती है, वह इन तीनो स्वरूपों को अवश्य धारण करती है
english_translation: A virtuous woman born in pure Bharata and noble lineage certainly embodies these three forms.
essence: A virtuous woman born in pure land carries three inherent forms.
simple_meaning: A virtuous woman born in pure Bharata and noble lineage carries these three forms.
insight: Recognizing qualities attributed to heritage and virtue requires understanding cultural context.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
आर्यजातौ हि नारीणामादर्शः परमः सती।
जगन्माता महामाया ब्रह्मशक्तिः सनातनी ॥
translation: आर्यजाति में स्त्रियों की परम आदर्शरूपा जगन्माता महामाया सनातनी ब्रह्मशक्ति सती देवी हैं
english_translation: Among noble women, the supreme ideal is Sati, the eternal great mother, Mahamaya, the Brahman power.
essence: The highest ideal for noble women is the eternal divine mother embodying supreme power.
simple_meaning: The highest example for noble women is the eternal mother figure who is the great divine power behind everything.
insight: It invites you to see yourself as a living expression of the eternal divine force that nurtures and sustains all life.
modern_relevance: You can recognize your own inner strength as a timeless source of care and power, beyond fleeting roles or appearances.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
परब्रह्मणि सा नित्यमेवं लीना यतोऽस्तिता।
तस्या भाति पृथङ्नातोऽद्वितीयं ब्रह्म निर्गुणम् ॥
translation: वे इस प्रकार से परब्रह्म में लीन रहती हैं कि, उनका अस्तित्व अलग नहीं विदित होता है इसी कारण ब्रह्म निर्गुण और अद्वितीय हैं
english_translation: She remains eternally absorbed in the supreme reality, so her existence is not separate; thus, the supreme reality is without qualities and unique.
essence: Your true self is eternally united with the unique, quality-free supreme reality.
simple_meaning: She is always completely absorbed in the supreme reality so that her existence is not separate from it. This shows the supreme reality is unique and without qualities.
insight: It shows you how to see yourself not as a separate entity but as inseparable from the supreme reality beyond all attributes.
modern_relevance: When you feel isolated or fragmented, remember your true self is inseparable from the vast unchanging reality that shines within you.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
शक्तिशक्तिमर्तोभेदं वदन्ति परमार्थतः ।
अभेदश्चानुपश्यन्ति योगिनस्तत्त्वदर्शिनः ॥
translation: शक्तिमान् ब्रह्म और ब्रह्मशक्ति महामाया, इन दोनों में भेद यद्यपि कहा जाता है परन्तु वस्तुतः तत्त्वदर्शी योगी लोग दोनों में अभेद देखते हैं
english_translation: Though power and the empowered are said to be distinct, truly the discerning yogis see no difference between them.
essence: True insight reveals no difference between the power and the one empowered.
simple_meaning: People often say power and the one with power are different, but wise yogis see they are actually the same.
insight: It shifts your understanding from seeing power as external to recognizing it as your own true nature.
modern_relevance: When you feel powerless or disconnected from your ability, this teaching reminds you that the power you seek is not outside but within you.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
सत्प्रेम्णैव सती नारी यथा ब्रह्मण्यहं तथा।
पत्यौ तन्मयतामेस पुरुषत्वं प्रपद्यते ॥
translation: जिस प्रकार ब्रह्मशक्ति ब्रह्म में अभेदभाव से लीन रहती है, उसी प्रकार सत्ती स्त्री उत्तम प्रेम के द्वारा पति में तन्मयता प्राप्त होकर पुरुषत्व को प्राप्त हो जाती है
english_translation: Just as the supreme power remains inseparably absorbed in the supreme reality, a devoted wife attains true manhood by becoming fully absorbed in her husband through pure love.
essence: Pure love merges two beings so fully that it transforms their true nature.
simple_meaning: A devoted wife who loves purely and fully merges her being with her husband, gaining true identity through that union.
insight: It teaches you to see love as a transformative union that reshapes your identity, not just an emotion.
modern_relevance: When you truly dedicate yourself to someone with pure love, your identity and strength grow beyond what you imagined.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
प्रेम्णोऽस्ति त्रिविधो भेदस्तत्रायः स ममेत्ययम् ।
अहं तस्येत्ययं मध्यः सोऽहमस्मीति चान्तिमः ॥
translation: प्रेम के तीन भेद हैं। उनमें से पहला " वह मेरे हैं " यह है, "मैं उनकी हूँ  " यह मध्यम अर्थात् द्वितीय है और " वह मैं हूँ " अर्थात् वह और मैं एक ही हूँ  यह अन्तिम है
english_translation: Love has three kinds: 'They belong to me,' 'I belong to them,' and the highest, 'They and I are one.'
essence: Love unfolds from possession through belonging to unity with the beloved.
simple_meaning: Love appears in three stages: first, seeing someone as mine; second, feeling I belong to them; and third, realizing we are one.
insight: It invites you to shift from holding to merging in love, dissolving boundaries between self and other.
modern_relevance: You notice how your feelings change from wanting to control someone, to belonging to them, to truly feeling inseparable in connection.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
इहाद्वैतदशायां हि स्वानुभूत्येकगोचरः।
ब्रह्मणस्तस्य शक्तेश्च भेदाभावः प्रसिध्यति ॥
translation: इस अन्तिम प्रेम में अद्वैत दशा होती है, जिसमें स्वानुभवमात्रगम्य ब्रह्म और उनकी शक्ति का भेदाभाव (अभिन्नता) सिद्ध होता है
english_translation: In this final state of non-duality, Brahman and its power are revealed as inseparable through direct experience.
essence: The supreme reality and its power are one in direct experience of non-duality.
simple_meaning: When you reach the highest state of oneness, you directly experience that the supreme reality and its power are not separate but one.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing yourself as divided into static self and separate energy, to recognizing an inseparable unity.
modern_relevance: In moments of deep clarity, you may sense that your true self and your creative energy are not two but one seamless flow.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
दाम्पत्यप्रेम्ण एवैषा दशा सर्वोत्तमा मता।
द्वैतसंकुलसंसारे प्रेमाऽयमतिदुर्लभः ॥
translation: यही दाम्पत्य प्रेम की सर्वोत्तम दशा मानी गई है। द्वैतभावपूर्ण संसार में यह प्रेम अति दुर्लभ है
english_translation: This is considered the highest state of marital love. Such love is very rare in a world full of duality.
essence: The highest marital love is rare amid a world full of division.
simple_meaning: The highest form of love between partners is very rare in a world full of separation and difference.
insight: It encourages you to cherish and recognize rare, true marital love despite common conflicts and separations.
modern_relevance: You notice how hard it is to maintain deep, united love in relationships amid everyday misunderstandings and differences.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
परमज्ञानजननी महामायैव सर्वथा।
सर्वोत्तमपतिप्रेम्ण आदर्शो विद्यते स्वतः ॥
translation: परमज्ञान की जननी महामाया ही सब प्रकार से सर्वोत्तम पति-प्रेम की स्वतः आदर्शरूपा है
english_translation: The great illusion, mother of supreme knowledge, is naturally the perfect model of highest devoted love for the true self.
essence: The source of highest knowledge naturally embodies perfect devoted love for the true self.
simple_meaning: The great creative power that gives rise to true knowledge also naturally embodies the highest form of devoted love for the true self.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing knowledge and love as separate to recognizing their inseparable unity in your inner being.
modern_relevance: When you feel divided between head and heart, know that deep within you, wisdom and love are one and the same.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
सती द्वैतदशायां हि शिवहृदासिनी शिवा।
नार्यादर्शोऽस्ति तददुर्गा देवीषु परमा मता ॥
translation: दाम्पत्य प्रेम में यह ही तीन रीतियाँ प्रेम की सर्वोत्तम कही गई हैं- शिवह्रदयवासिनी सती शिवा, द्वैतदशा में नारी जाति की आदर्श रूपा है, इसी कारण देवियों में दुर्गा श्रेष्ठ मानी गई हैं
english_translation: In the state of duality, Sati Shiva, who dwells in Shiva's heart, is the ideal woman; therefore, Durga is considered the highest among the goddesses.
essence: Sati embodies the ideal woman in duality, making Durga supreme among goddesses.
simple_meaning: Sati, who lives in Shiva's heart, is the ideal woman in duality, so Durga is the highest goddess.
insight: Recognize an ideal of devotion and strength embodied in feminine form as inspiration rather than a fixed standard.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
स ममेत्यहमस्यति परिशुद्धे उभे दशे ।
चरित्रे विमले तस्याः शिवायाः पूर्णतां गते ॥
translation: " वह मेरे हैं " और " मैं उनकी हूँ " अह  दोनों परिशुद्ध दशाएं उन शिवा के विमल चरित्र में पूर्णता को प्राप्त हुई हैं
english_translation: "'She is mine' and 'I am hers'—both pure states reach perfection in the spotless character of that Shiva."
essence: Perfect belonging arises when mutual love becomes purely flawless and complete.
simple_meaning: The pure feeling of 'she is mine' and 'I am hers' reaches complete perfection in the flawless nature of Shiva.
insight: It shows that true devotion is a balanced, pure relationship of mutual belonging without ego or confusion.
modern_relevance: When you feel deeply connected and fully accepted by someone, the sense of belonging becomes pure and perfect, free of doubt or fear.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
अहमस्य भवामीति विज्ञानस्यानुसारतः।
सतीभावे सदा गौरी विद्यारूपैव विद्यते ॥
translation: "मैं उनकी हूँ " इस विज्ञान के अनुसार सतीभाव में गौरी सदा विद्यारूपा ही है
english_translation: "According to true knowledge, Gauri is always the form of wisdom in the state of being devoted to 'I am theirs'."
essence: True belonging is the living form of your inner wisdom.
simple_meaning: When you truly feel devoted and connected, your inner being is always the form of wisdom itself.
insight: It invites you to see devotion as a path that reveals your true wisdom, not just an emotion.
modern_relevance: You may feel lost in identity struggles, but when you find a deep sense of belonging, your inner clarity naturally shines.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
अत एव च सा देवी पतिनिष्ठा पतिव्रता ।
पत्युर्निंन्दां निशम्यैव स्वकीयं वपुरसजत् ॥
translation: इसी कारण उन पतिनिष्ठा पतिव्रता देवी ने पति की निन्दा सुनते ही अपना शरीर त्याग कर दिया था
english_translation: Therefore, that devoted and faithful goddess, hearing her husband's criticism, immediately gave up her own body.
essence: Deep loyalty can prompt immediate and intense self-sacrifice upon hearing criticism.
simple_meaning: The goddess, devoted and faithful to her husband, gave up her body as soon as she heard his criticism.
insight: It shows how attachment to others' opinions can trigger extreme emotional responses and actions.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अनन्यप्रणयेनैव शिवे ब्रह्ममये शिवा।
विद्यास्वरुपा सा देवी वर्तते विमलाशया ॥
translation: ब्रह्ममय शिव में अनन्य प्रेम से ही परम पवित्रा विद्यास्वरूपा वह शिवा देवी विद्यमान रहती हैं
english_translation: Devi Shiva, embodying supreme purity and the form of wisdom, dwells in Shiva with exclusive devoted love.
essence: Pure wisdom arises from exclusive devoted love within the supreme being.
simple_meaning: The Goddess Shiva exists purely as wisdom, living in the supreme being Shiva through exclusive devoted love and pure heart.
insight: It teaches you to unite exclusive devotion with wisdom to experience the divine fully.
modern_relevance: When you focus your love on your highest values, your inner wisdom shines clearly and purely.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
सर्वशक्तिमयी दुर्गा स ममास्तीति बोधतः ।
ब्रह्मणो निखिला शक्तिः स्वतस्तत्र प्रकाशते ॥
translation: "वह मेरे हैं” इस ज्ञान से दुर्गा ब्रह्मशक्तिमयी है। उनमें ब्रह्म की सकल शक्तियां स्वतः प्रकाशित होती हैं।
english_translation: "Durga is mine"—this knowledge reveals her as the embodiment of all divine power; in her, the entire power of Brahman shines forth naturally.
essence: Believing Durga is yours reveals her as the full power of the supreme reality shining in you.
simple_meaning: When you realize Durga belongs to you, you see she embodies all the power of the supreme reality shining naturally.
insight: This verse shifts your view from seeing the divine as separate to feeling its full power alive within your own trust and belonging.
modern_relevance: When you feel a deep connection to a source of strength, you begin to sense that power flowing through you naturally, not as something distant.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
कार्तिकेयो वलेशोऽतो गणेशो बुद्धयधीश्वरः ।
लक्ष्मीर्घनेश्वरी विद्याधीश्वरी च सरस्वती ॥
translation: इसी कारण बलाधीश कार्तिकेय, बुद्धयधीश्वर गणेश, धनेश्वरी लक्ष्मी और विद्याधीश्वरी सरस्वती
english_translation: For this reason, Kartikeya is the lord of strength, Ganesha the lord of wisdom, Lakshmi the goddess of wealth, and Saraswati the goddess of knowledge.
essence: Strength, wisdom, wealth, and knowledge each have their own guiding power.
simple_meaning: Kartikeya rules strength, Ganesha rules wisdom, Lakshmi rules wealth, and Saraswati rules knowledge.
insight: Recognize the distinct qualities that support different areas of your life, each requiring its own focus.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
तस्यास्सन्ति सुतास्तस्यां राजन्ते सर्वशक्तयः ।
बलबुद्धिधनज्ञानरूपापत्यप्रभावतः ॥
translation: उनकी सन्तान हैं बल, बुद्धि, धन और ज्ञानरूपी अपत्यों के प्रभाव से उनमें सब शक्तियां विराजमान हैं
english_translation: From him come offspring like strength, intellect, wealth, and knowledge; through these descendants, all powers reign within him.
essence: All powers arise as offspring of fundamental qualities within a source.
simple_meaning: He has children who are strength, intellect, wealth, and knowledge, and through them all powers exist in him.
insight: It shows how different abilities and resources are interconnected aspects emerging from a single source.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
सती गौरी पृथक् पत्युः सत्ताशून्याऽस्ति तन्मयी।
दुर्गा तु पतिसम्बन्धात् सर्वशक्तिमयी स्थिता ॥
translation: सती गौरी पति से पृथक अपनी सत्ता नहीं रखतीं, वह तन्मयी हैं अर्थात् पति में तन्मयता को प्राप्त हैं, परन्तु दुर्गा देवी पति के सम्बन्ध से सर्वशक्तिमयी होकर स्थित हैं
english_translation: Sati Gauri does not exist separately from her husband; she is absorbed in him. But Durga, in relation to her husband, remains fully endowed with all power.
essence: Connection with the beloved does not diminish your complete power and presence.
simple_meaning: True devotion means being united with the beloved without losing your own full power and presence.
insight: It teaches you to embrace connection without sacrificing your own fullness or power.
modern_relevance: You may feel deeply connected in relationships but worry about losing your own voice—this shows you can belong and still be fully yourself.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
एषा गौरी च दुर्गा च धर्मादशौ यतस्ततः ।
आर्यनारीगणादर्शो जगन्मान्यो न चान्यथा ॥
translation: यह ही गौरी और दुर्गा नारी धर्म की आदर्श रूपा हैं इसी कारण आर्यनारियों का आदर्श ही जगत में माननीय है
english_translation: She is both Gauri and Durga, the ideal of feminine virtue, honored by noble women everywhere.
essence: The highest feminine ideal combines strength and virtue, honored by noble women worldwide.
simple_meaning: She is the embodiment of both Gauri and Durga, representing the ideal qualities noble women aspire to and are respected for worldwide.
insight: It invites you to see your own virtues as part of a respected, universal ideal of strength and goodness.
modern_relevance: When you see women admired for their strength and character, you recognize this timeless ideal reflected in everyday life.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
नृणां प्रवृत्तिधर्मस्य गार्हस्थ्ये पूर्णता यथा।
एवं निवृत्तिधर्मस्य सन्न्यासाश्रम उज्ज्वले ॥
translation: जैसे मनुष्यों के प्रवृत्तिधर्म को पूर्णता गृहस्थाश्रम में और निवृत्ति धर्म की पूर्णता उज्ज्वल सन्यास आश्रम में होती है।
english_translation: Just as active duty finds completeness in the householder stage, so does the path of renunciation find its fullness in the radiant renounced life.
essence: Active duty completes in engaged life; renunciation completes in radiant letting go.
simple_meaning: People fulfill their active responsibilities best during family life, while the path of letting go reaches its full brightness in the renounced life.
insight: Recognize when to engage fully in action and when to embrace letting go; honoring both phases creates balance.
modern_relevance: You may feel torn between pushing hard in your career and stepping back to recharge; knowing each phase has its time brings peace.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
तथैव गृहिणीधर्मे प्रवृत्तेः पूर्णता स्थिता ।
एवं निवृत्तिधर्मस्य नारीणां विधवाव्रते ॥
translation: वैसे ही गृहिणी धर्म में स्त्रियों के प्रवृत्ति धर्म की पूर्णता स्थित है और स्त्रियों के निवृत्ति धर्म की पूर्णता विधवा व्रत में होती हैं
english_translation: Just as the full completeness for women active in household duties is found in that role, the full completeness for women in their retired phase is found in the vow of widowhood.
essence: Women find completeness in their life roles, active or retired, through dedicated duties.
simple_meaning: Women find their full role and completeness either in household duties or, when retired, in observing the widow's vow.
insight: It highlights how different life stages can carry distinct meaningful roles, inviting respect for transitions and changes in purpose.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
न्यूनाधिक्येन सर्वत्र कला यद्यपि मे सुराः।
सर्वेषामेव धर्माणामङ्गोपाङ्गेषु जाग्रति ॥
translation: हे देवगण यद्यपि मेरी कला थोड़ी बहुत सब धर्मके अङ्गाउपांगो में स्थित है
english_translation: O divine beings, though my power appears in parts of all duties and their branches.
essence: The divine power permeates every aspect of all duties, large or small.
simple_meaning: The divine power is present in every part, big or small, of all duties and their details.
insight: Recognize that every part of your duty, no matter how minor, holds significance and presence beyond the obvious.
modern_relevance: When you do routine tasks, you might overlook their meaning—but even small efforts carry deeper power and purpose.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
तामसेऽङ्गबजे न्यूना राजसे तु ततोऽधिका ।
कला धर्मस्य विद्यन्ते पूर्य्यन्ते सात्विके स्वतः ॥
translation: किंतु धर्म के तामसिक अंग उपायों में मेरी थोड़ी कला विद्यमान है, राजसिक अंग उपांगो में उससे अधिक कला विद्यमान है और सात्विक अंग उपांगों में
english_translation: My skill is least in the tamasic parts of dharma, more in the rajasic parts, and greatest naturally in the sattvic parts.
essence: Your skill in righteous action grows as your nature becomes clearer and purer.
simple_meaning: Skill in doing what is right grows as your nature moves from darkness to clarity and balance.
insight: It shifts your view to notice how your inner state directly influences the quality of your actions.
modern_relevance: When you face tasks while tired or stressed, your effectiveness dips; when calm and clear, your best skills show naturally.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
पूर्णा धर्मकला नूनं धार्मिकेभ्यो दिवौकसः !।
पुनरातिशून्यं तत्कैवल्यं दातुमीशते ॥
translation: मेरी पूर्ण षोडशकला पूर्ण होकर धार्मिकों को हे देवगण ! पुनरावृत्तिशून्य मुक्ति देने में अवश्य समर्थ होती है
english_translation: My complete sixteenfold power, perfected, surely grants liberation free from rebirth to the righteous ones, O devas.
essence: Perfected divine power grants liberation beyond all rebirth to the righteous.
simple_meaning: A complete and perfected divine power grants liberation that ends the cycle of rebirth to those who live rightly.
insight: It reveals that liberation is not distant but available through perfected inner power aligned with righteous living.
modern_relevance: Imagine realizing you carry within you a power that can end all repeated struggles and fresh starts, offering true freedom beyond endless cycles.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
तिथिष्वन्यासु सर्वासु द्वितीयादिपु निर्जराः!।
विवर्द्धयन कलाः स्वीयाः शुक्लपक्षे यथा शशि॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! जिस प्रकार शुक्लपक्ष में चन्द्रमा द्वितीया आदि अन्य सब तिथियों में अपनी कलाओं को बढ़ाता हुआ
english_translation: O divine beings! Just as the moon grows its phases during the bright fortnight, increasing its brilliance on the second and other lunar days,
essence: Growth unfolds steadily and naturally through phases over time.
simple_meaning: The moon steadily grows its phases during the bright half of the month, increasing its brightness from the second day onward.
insight: Recognize that growth is a gradual process unfolding in its own time and rhythm.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
पूर्यते पौर्णमास्यां हि कलाषोडशकेन च। ।
नारीरूपे तथा देवाः ! कला पोडशका मम ॥
translation: पूर्णिमा के दिन सोलह कलाओं से पूर्ण हो जाता है उसी प्रकार मेरी सोलह कलाएं स्त्रियों में
english_translation: On the full moon day, completeness is achieved by sixteen arts; likewise, my sixteen arts are present in women.
essence: The divine's sixteen qualities make women a complete expression of sacred fullness.
simple_meaning: The divine says her sixteen special qualities complete women just as sixteen arts complete the full moon day.
insight: It invites recognizing the fullness and sacred qualities inherent in women as expressions of the divine.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
विकाशं क्रमशो लब्ध्वा षोड़श्यां हि प्रपूर्यते ।
अस्त्येवं सात्त्विको धर्मों विशिष्टः सर्वशक्तितः ॥
translation: क्रमशः विकास प्राप्त करती हुई षोडशी में (सोलह वर्ष की स्त्री में) पूर्ण हो जाती हैं सात्त्विक धर्म भी उसी प्रकार समस्त शक्तियों से पूर्ण है।
english_translation: By gradual development, at sixteen the pure qualities fully mature; similarly, the true nature is complete with all powers.
essence: Pure qualities mature naturally over time, completing with all powers united.
simple_meaning: Pure qualities develop gradually and reach full maturity at the right moment, just as true nature is complete with all its powers.
insight: It teaches you to trust gradual growth rather than forcing quick change, letting your qualities mature in their own time.
modern_relevance: You watch a child slowly grow into their own strength and character, understanding that true maturity takes time and steady development.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
वर्णधर्मे प्रपूर्णत्वे प्रतिरोधके सति ।
धार्मिकस्वकलानां मे साधिभौतिकशुद्धिकम् ॥
translation: प्रवृत्ति रोधक वर्णधर्म में मेरी धार्मिक कलाओं का पूर्ण विकास हो जाने पर ब्राह्मणवर्ण में आधिभौतिक शुद्धि के साथ साथ
english_translation: When the duties of each class are fully perfected and the opposition is removed, then in the Brahmin class, my religious arts attain the highest purity related to the higher realm.
essence: Fully embracing your role without resistance allows your deeper qualities to purify and mature.
simple_meaning: When you fully perform your rightful duties without resistance, your deeper qualities reach full purity.
insight: It teaches you to identify and remove inner or outer resistance so your true potential can unfold in your role.
modern_relevance: You feel stuck in your role because of resistance or conflicting priorities. When you clear these, your best skills and values emerge naturally.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
आत्मज्ञानाधिकारित्वं ब्राह्मणेषूपजायते ।
एवमाश्रमधर्मेऽपि निवृत्तेः पोषके शुभे ॥
translation: आत्मज्ञान का अधिकार प्राप्त हो जाता है। उसी प्रकार निवृत्ति पोषक पवित्र आश्रम धर्म में मेरी षोडश कलाओं का
english_translation: The right to self-knowledge arises among Brahmins; similarly, withdrawal is nurtured by the pure duties of the ashramas.
essence: Self-knowledge arises naturally from living purely and retreating wisely within life’s stages.
simple_meaning: You gain the right to self-knowledge by living a pure, disciplined life and by practicing wise withdrawal in stages of life.
insight: It teaches you to see disciplined withdrawal and pure living as essential steps toward awakening your true self.
modern_relevance: You feel overwhelmed by constant demands, but setting clear boundaries and stepping back with integrity helps you reclaim clarity and deeper self-understanding.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
विकाशं क्रमशो गत्वा कलापोडशकं मम ।
सत् सन्न्यासाश्रमे पूर्ण योगिनस्तत्त्ववेदिनः ॥
translation: क्रमशः विकास होते होते अंत में संन्यास आश्रम में जीवन मुक्ति पद को प्राप्त कराकर तत्त्वज्ञानी योगी को
english_translation: By gradually unfolding, ultimately reaching the renunciation stage, the perfected yogi attains the state of true realization.
essence: True freedom comes only after a gradual unfolding and renunciation process.
simple_meaning: Growth happens step by step until a yogi reaches renunciation and true understanding of reality.
insight: It teaches you to trust gradual inner growth leading to profound transformation and freedom.
modern_relevance: You’ve experienced small changes over time that prepared you for a big shift in your life’s meaning and freedom.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
जीवन्मुक्त्यास्पदं नीत्वा नयते मत्स्वरूपताम् ।
वर्णधर्मे ममैवाथ गौरीदुर्गास्वरूपयोः ॥
translation: मेरे स्वरूप को प्राप्त करा देता है। वर्ण धर्म में मेरे ही गौरी और दुर्गा के स्वरूपों का
english_translation: Attaining liberation in life leads directly to my true nature, just as the forms of Gauri and Durga are inseparable from their roles in caste and duty.
essence: True freedom means living your deepest self fully within your life roles.
simple_meaning: Reaching true freedom in life brings you into your real nature, just like the forms of Gauri and Durga fully express their roles.
insight: It teaches you that true freedom is not separate from living your nature fully in your responsibilities.
modern_relevance: When your work or role feels aligned with who you truly are, you experience a sense of freedom and completeness.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
आदर्शः प्रकटीभूय नारीदेहेषु मानवान्।
विधत्ते नितरां देवाः ! कृतकृत्यान्न संशयः॥
translation: आदर्श नारीरूप में प्रकट होकर मनुष्यों को कृतकृत्य करता है, हे देवगण ! इसमें सन्देह नहीं है
english_translation: The ideal appears in the form of woman and surely makes humans fulfilled, O radiant beings! There is no doubt about this.
essence: The ideal manifests as woman and surely fulfills humans without doubt.
simple_meaning: The ideal appears as a woman among humans and certainly makes them fulfilled without any doubt.
insight: Recognize how ideals or inspirations appearing in familiar forms can deeply satisfy human longing.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
एवमाश्रमधर्मेऽपि विद्यारूपधरा ह्यहम्।
प्रादुर्भूय प्रयच्छामि शान्ते मानसमन्दिरे ॥
translation: उसी प्रकार आश्रम धर्म में भी मैं ही विद्यारूप से मनुष्यों के शान्त मानस मंदिर में प्रकट होकर
english_translation: In the duties of the hermitage too, I manifest as knowledge, appearing in the peaceful temple of the mind.
essence: The divine manifests as knowledge within the peaceful mind during spiritual duty.
simple_meaning: The divine reveals itself as knowledge within your calm and peaceful mind, even during your spiritual duties.
insight: It teaches you to recognize the divine knowledge present within your calm mental space during all duties.
modern_relevance: When your mind feels overwhelmed by tasks, remember that quiet wisdom dwells inside you, ready to guide your next step.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
निश्रेयसं मनुष्येभ्योऽभ्युदयश्च निरन्तरम् ।
जीवन्मुक्ता महात्मानः सन्न्यासाश्रमवर्तिनः ॥
translation: उनको निरन्तर अभ्युदय और निःश्रेयस प्रदान करती हूँ । हे देवगण ! सन्यास आश्रम में जीवन्मुक्त
english_translation: I constantly grant the highest good and prosperity to humans; the great souls in the renounced order are liberated while living.
essence: Pure surrender opens the door to continual highest good and freedom while living.
simple_meaning: The divine continuously bestows the highest well-being and success to those who live in renunciation and have attained liberation while alive.
insight: It teaches you to embrace surrender as a source of continuous support and freedom in life.
modern_relevance: When you let go of clinging to outcomes and live with trust, you find ongoing success and inner freedom even in difficult times.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
विश्वमेव स्वरूपं से ज्ञात्वति प्रथमं सुराः ।
सद्भावस्य निमज्जन्ति सम्पूर्णासु कलास्वहो ॥
translation: महापुरुष प्रथम जगत को ही मेरा स्वरूप, जानकर मेरे सद्भाव की पूर्ण कलाओं में निमजन करता हैं।
english_translation: The great beings first realize that the entire world is my form, then immerse themselves in the complete arts of my true nature.
essence: Recognizing the world as the divine invites full immersion in its complete true nature.
simple_meaning: Great beings recognize that the entire world is a form of the divine and fully immerse themselves in its complete true nature.
insight: Shift from seeing the world as separate to recognizing it as a unified expression of the divine, inspiring wholehearted devotion.
modern_relevance: You meet someone who sees every part of life as connected and sacred, inspiring you to embrace your work and creativity with full presence.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
विश्वरूपाञ्च मामेव विदित्वा तदनन्तरम् ।
कलाषोड़शकोपेतं परमानन्दसागरम् ॥
translation: तदन्तर मुझको ही जगद्रप जानकर षोड़शकला पूर्ण परमानन्दसागर में
english_translation: After knowing that I am the cosmic form itself, then the sixteenfold complete vessel of supreme bliss.
essence: Recognizing yourself as the cosmic form reveals your fullness as limitless bliss.
simple_meaning: You realize that your true nature is the cosmic form itself, filled completely with supreme bliss.
insight: It teaches you to recognize your boundless nature as the true self, filled with infinite joy beyond ordinary experience.
modern_relevance: When you suddenly see yourself as part of the vast universe, you feel connected and deeply joyful beyond ordinary happiness.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
नितान्तमवगाहन्ते सायुज्यं यन्ति मे ततः ।
मत्सायुज्यदशामेत्य पूर्ण चिद्भावमाश्रिताः ॥
translation: अवगाहन करता रहता है और अन्त में मेरी सायुज्य दशा को प्राप्त करके मेरे पूर्ण चिद्भाव के आश्रय से
english_translation: They fully immerse themselves and finally attain union with me, resting in my complete conscious nature.
essence: Complete immersion in devotion leads to resting in the divine's full conscious nature.
simple_meaning: Those who completely immerse themselves reach union with the divine and rest in its full conscious nature.

modern_relevance: When you deeply commit to your inner devotion or love, you can find complete peace resting in that connection beyond all distractions.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
सम्पाप्य ब्रह्मसायुज्यं कृतकृसा भवन्ति ते ।
स्वकलानां रहस्यम्बै प्रोक्तं गृढतमं मया ॥
translation: ब्रह्म सायुज्य को प्राप्त करके कृतकृत्य हो जाता है। हे देवतागण ! मैंने अतिगूढ़ तम अत्यन्त विचित्रतापूर्ण अपनी कलाओं का रहस्य
english_translation: By uniting with the supreme reality, they become fulfilled; I have revealed the profound secret of my powers.
essence: Complete fulfillment arises from union with the supreme reality beyond all actions.
simple_meaning: When someone unites with the supreme reality, they become completely fulfilled and free from all obligation. The goddess reveals the deepest secret of her powers here.

speaker: Devi

verse_text:
अन्तिके भवतां देवाः ! नानावैचित्र्यसंकुलम्।
अतीव यदि दुयं गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं तथा ॥

english_translation: Near you, O radiant beings, is a secret complex with many mysteries, even more hidden than the deepest secrets.

verse_text:
भवतस्नेहवशाद्देवाः ! साम्प्रतं सम्प्रकाशितम् ।
एतच्छ्रुत्वा विदित्वा च लप्स्यन्ते सांधकाः शिवम् ॥
translation: आपके स्नेह से मैंने इस समय इसका प्रकाश किया है। इसको सुन और जानकर साधक परम कल्याण प्राप्त करेंगे
english_translation: By your affection, I have now revealed this. Hearing and understanding it, practitioners will attain supreme well-being.

modern_relevance: When someone you trust shares a valuable truth, it feels easier to embrace and brings real relief and hope.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
वेदमातर्जगन्मातर्महायोगेश्वरेश्वरि !।
विज्ञानं ते समाकर्ण्य चित्कलागोचरं ननु ॥
translation: हे जगन्मातः! हे वेदजननि ! हे महायोगेश्वरी की ईश्वरि ! आपकी चित कला का विज्ञान सुनकर
english_translation: O Mother of the world, O mother of the Vedas, O great sovereign of yoga! Hearing your subtle knowledge of consciousness, indeed,

simple_meaning: This verse praises the divine mother as the source of all knowledge and the subtle art of consciousness, acknowledging the profoundness of her teaching.
insight: It invites recognizing the depth and subtlety behind teachings that may initially seem intangible or hidden.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
दृष्टिरुन्मीलिताऽस्माकं दिव्या दार्शनिको द्रुतम् ।
साम्पतं ते महादेवि ! वाह्याऽभ्यन्तरतो वयम् ॥
translation: हमारे दार्शनिक नेत्र एकाएक खुल गये हैं। अब हम आपको भीतर और बाहर देखने की इच्छा से
english_translation: Our visionary eyes have suddenly opened. Now we desire to see you both within and without.
essence: A sudden awakening sparks the desire to see both within and without clearly.
simple_meaning: Our eyes of insight have suddenly opened, and now we want to see you both outside and inside.
insight: It encourages shifting from passive perception to active inner and outer awareness simultaneously.
modern_relevance: You suddenly find yourself curious to explore both your outer world and your inner feelings with fresh eyes.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
श्रोतुं दिदृश्येच्छामो वेदकाण्डत्रयस्य वै।
विज्ञानं दुर्गम योग-रहस्य दुर्लभं तथा ॥
translation: वेद के काण्डत्रय का दुर्गम विज्ञान और योग का दुर्लभ रहस्य सुनने की इच्छा करते हैं
english_translation: I desire to hear the difficult knowledge of the three Vedas and the rare secret of yoga.
essence: True seekers long to hear the rare, difficult knowledge behind spiritual practice.
simple_meaning: There is a strong wish to learn the difficult knowledge of the Vedas and the rare secret of yoga.

modern_relevance: You feel drawn to uncover the hidden, challenging truths behind complex spiritual teachings.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
को योगो वेदविज्ञानैस्तत्सम्बन्धश्च कीदृशः।
विस्तरावर्णयित्वैतत्कृतकृत्यान् कुरुष्व नः ॥
translation: योग किसको कहते हैं ? और 'वेदविज्ञान के साथ उसका क्या सम्बन्ध है ? इसको विस्तार से वर्णन करके हमको कृतकृत्य कीजिये
english_translation: What is yoga? And what is its relation to the knowledge of the Vedas? Please explain this in detail and make us grateful.
essence: Understanding yoga requires exploring its connection to deep Vedic knowledge.
simple_meaning: Someone asks what yoga is and how it connects with Vedic knowledge, requesting a detailed explanation to feel grateful.

modern_relevance: You wonder what true yoga is and how it links to ancient wisdom, hoping to grasp it clearly and appreciate its value.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अस्म्यहं शक्तिरूपेण योगशक्तिः सुरोत्तमाः ।
सो कर्मोपासनाज्ञान-काण्डत्रयविधानतः ॥
translation: हे देवश्रेष्ठ गण ! मैं ही शक्तिरूप से योगशक्ति हूँ। त्रिविध अधिकार भेद से कर्म, उपासना और ज्ञानकाण्ड के अनुसार
english_translation: O best among the divine beings! I am the power manifested as yoga power, according to the threefold divisions of karma, worship, and knowledge.
essence: The true power manifests simultaneously through action, devotion, and wisdom.
simple_meaning: The divine power expresses itself as yoga power through three ways: action, devotion, and wisdom.

modern_relevance: When you face different challenges, remember your inner power expresses through doing, loving, and understanding, all harmonizing your journey.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
त्रिविधैरधिकारैहि योगशक्तित्रिधा मता।
यदेतल्लक्षणं गीत योगः कर्मसु कौशलम् ॥
translation: वह योगशक्ति  तीन प्रकार की है। सुकौशल पूर्ण कर्म को योग कहते हैं,
english_translation: Yoga power is understood in three types: yoga is skill in action.
essence: True yoga is skillful, focused action in everything you do.

speaker: Devi

verse_text:
तन्नूनं कर्मकाण्डीय-योगलक्षणमीरितम् ।
चित्तवृत्तिनिरोधो वै योग एताद्ध लक्षणम् ॥
translation: यह कर्मकाण्ड का लक्षण है; चित्तवृत्ति निरोध करने को योग कहते है।
english_translation: The characteristic of ritualistic action is different; yoga is the restraint of the fluctuations of the mind.
essence: Yoga is the inner stilling of the mind, not mere ritual action.
simple_meaning: Yoga is not just performing rituals; it is the practice of stopping the restless movements of the mind.

speaker: Devi

verse_text:
विज्ञेयं सर्वथोपास्ति-काण्डयोगस्य निर्जराः!।
अज्ञानजनितोपाधि नि:शेषमपनोद्य हि ॥
translation: हे देवतागण! यह लक्षण सर्वथा उपासना काण्ड का जानो और अज्ञानजनित उपाधि को निःशेष हटाकर
english_translation: Know that the chapter on worship is flawless in every way; it completely removes all impurities born of ignorance.
essence: True wisdom on worship removes all confusion caused by ignorance.
simple_meaning: This teaching on worship is perfect and completely clears away all confusion caused by ignorance.
insight: It shows you that wisdom can completely dissolve the false layers that block clear understanding.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by unclear thoughts or confusion, this teaching promises full clarity and relief from mental clutter.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
एकत्वप्रतिपत्तिर्या योगः स्याच्छिवजीवयोः।
अस्त्यतज्ज्ञानकाण्डीय-योगलक्षणमद्भुतम् ॥
translation: जीवात्मा और परमात्मा को एकीकरण करने को योग कहते हैं, यह ज्ञानकाण्ड का अद्भुत लक्षण है।
english_translation: Yoga is the unity that merges the true self and supreme being; it is a wondrous mark of knowledge.
essence: Yoga is the realization that your true self and the supreme reality are one.
simple_meaning: Yoga is the process of realizing the oneness of your true self and the supreme reality, a profound sign of wisdom.

verse_text:
त्रयाणामिह काण्डानामुक्तानामनुरोधतः।
त्रैविध्यं धारणायाश्च जानीत सुरसत्तमाः ! ॥
translation: हे देवश्रेष्ठौ ! इसी कारण इन तीनों काण्डों के अनुसार मेरी धारणा भी तीन प्रकार की जाननी चाहिए
english_translation: O best of the devas! Therefore, according to these three sections, my understanding should also be known in three types.

verse_text:
भावयन्तः कर्मतत्त्वं पराभक्त्यधिकारिणः।
अस्त्येवतज्जगद्ब्रह्म धारणामी्दृशी मम ॥
translation: हे देवश्रेष्ठों ! कर्म के तत्वदर्शी मेरी पराभक्ति के अधिकारी कर्मयोगी गण "जगत् ही ब्रह्म है" मेरी ऐसी धारणा
english_translation: O best of the divine beings! The karma yogis who understand the essence of action and are devoted to me hold the view that the entire world is Brahman.

verse_text:
सर्वथा सर्वदा देवाः ! कुर्वते कर्मयोगिनः ।
मत्पराभक्तिनिष्णाता मद्भक्ता योगिनां वराः ॥
translation: सर्वदा सर्वथा करते हैं, ऐसी धारणा से मेरी पराभक्ति में निष्णात योगिश्रेष्ठ
english_translation: The supreme yogis, devoted to me, always perform Karma Yoga in every way and at all times.
essence: True devotion is perfected through constant, skillful action in every moment.
simple_meaning: Those who are deeply devoted to the divine perform selfless action constantly and in all ways.
insight: It shifts your view of devotion from feeling to doing, making every act an expression of your inner dedication.
modern_relevance: You keep showing up and doing the work because you believe in something greater, even when no one watches.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
ब्रह्मैवास्ते जगत्सर्वमिति धारणयाऽनिशम् ।
महात्मानो निरीक्षन्ते विश्वास्मिन सुरसत्तमाः !॥
translation: महात्मा भक्तगण अहर्निश "ब्रह्म ही जगत् है" इस जगत् में मुझे देखते हैं
english_translation: Great souls constantly perceive that the entire world is Brahman, the supreme reality.
essence: Great souls see the entire world as the supreme reality itself without doubt.
simple_meaning: Great devotees continuously hold the belief that everything in the world is the supreme reality itself.
insight: It teaches you to hold a steady faith that the world you experience is not separate from the divine reality.
modern_relevance: You notice the beauty and sacredness in everyday life when you trust everything has deeper meaning.
speaker: Shakti

verse_text:
अहं ब्रह्मास्मि' भो देवाः इति या धारणाऽस्ति मे।
जीवन्मुक्ता महात्मानस्तदा तां प्राप्तुमीशते ॥
translation: "मैं ही ब्रह्म हूँ " ऐसी धारणा को जीवन्मुक्त महापुरुष तब प्राप्त करने में समर्थ होते हैं
english_translation: "The belief 'I am Brahman' is attained by great liberated beings."
essence: Complete freedom comes when you realize your true self is the supreme reality.
simple_meaning: Great liberated souls come to fully believe and realize that their true self is the supreme reality.
insight: It shifts your view from feeling isolated to recognizing your unity with the supreme reality.
modern_relevance: When you finally see yourself as part of the vast whole, worries about identity and separation begin to fade.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
यदैकत्वं मया साद्ध लभन्ते ज्ञानयोगतः।
यः प्रति निवृत्तिञ्च द्वे फले सम्प्रयच्छति ॥
translation: जब ज्ञानयोग से मेरे साथ तदाकार भाव को ग्रहण करते हैं। जो प्रवृत्ति और निवृत्ति फल देनेवाला
english_translation: When through the yoga of wisdom, the unity with me is attained, it grants the fruits of both engagement and withdrawal.
essence: True wisdom unites you with the divine, offering both active and restful fruits together.
simple_meaning: By practicing the yoga of wisdom, you can unite fully with the divine and receive the benefits of both active involvement and peaceful withdrawal.
insight: The verse shifts your view from choosing between doing or withdrawing to embracing both as part of your growth through wisdom.
modern_relevance: When you learn to see clearly and deeply, you can both act with purpose and rest without guilt, finding balance in a busy life.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
स द्विधा कर्मयोगोऽयं विभक्तोऽस्ति दिवौकसः !।
अन्तर्ग कर्मयोगस्य हवस्थाद्वयमेव तत् ॥
translation: कर्मयोग है, हे देवतागण,  वह दो भागों में विभक्त है। दोनों ही अवस्थाएँ कर्मयोग के अन्तर्गत हैं
english_translation: Karma yoga, O divine beings, is divided into two parts; both states belong to karma yoga.
essence: Action unfolds in two forms that together make the complete path of karma yoga.
simple_meaning: Karma yoga, the path of action, has two aspects, but both are part of the same practice.
insight: Recognize that different modes of action still belong to one continuous practice of engaged living.
modern_relevance: You face tasks that require different approaches—both are part of your ongoing work and growth.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
सकामासक्तिवीजन कर्मयोगेन चैकतः।
जायते जगदश्वत्थ-वृक्षो द्वन्द्वात्मकः क्षयी ॥
translation: एक सकामासक्ति रूपी बीज से कर्मयोग के द्वारा द्वन्द्व मूलक नाशवान् जगद्वपी अश्वत्थ वृक्ष उत्पन्न करता है
english_translation: From the seed of desire and attachment, the karmayoga alone produces the dualistic, perishable banyan tree of the world.
essence: Desire plants the seed; only action grows the world of duality and decay.
simple_meaning: Desire and attachment plant a seed that karmayoga alone grows into the world of duality and decay.
insight: It teaches you to see that your desires start problems, but your actions decide their growth.
modern_relevance: You feel a craving that pulls you toward conflict, and your choices either feed or starve that urge.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
यः परीणामशीलोऽपि ददात्यभ्युदयं फलम् ।
निष्कामत्वस्वरूपेण वीजेन कर्मयोगतः ॥
translation: जो परिणामी होने पर भी अभ्युदय रूपी फल को देता है। दूसरा निष्काम भाव रूपी बीज से कर्मयोग के द्वारा
english_translation: One who remains constant in transformation yet delivers the fruit of progress, sowing the seed of selfless action through karma yoga.
essence: Selfless effort through change naturally produces meaningful progress.
simple_meaning: Even when circumstances change, you can act selflessly and still bring about positive results through karma yoga.
insight: It teaches you to focus on selfless effort regardless of changing outcomes, trusting growth will come.
modern_relevance: You face shifting demands at work but keep doing your part without craving reward — gradually, real progress follows.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
परमानन्दभावस्य द्योतकोऽनश्वरोऽन्यतः।
जायते मधुरोदर्कः प्रबोधः कल्पपादपंः ॥
translation: परमानन्द भाव प्रकाशक अपरिणामी प्रबोध रूपी मधुर कल्पवृक्ष को उत्पन्न करता है,
english_translation: The supreme blissful nature, radiant and eternal, produces the sweet awakening like the wish-fulfilling tree.
essence: Unchanging bliss naturally brings forth a sweet, awakening clarity.
simple_meaning: The eternal blissful essence shines and brings forth a sweet awakening like a magical tree granting wishes.
insight: It teaches you that a stable, radiant joy within can spontaneously awaken your mind to higher understanding.
modern_relevance: In moments when you feel a deep, peaceful joy arise from within, it can gently awaken your sense of true purpose and inner freedom.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
यस्मानिःश्रेयसं देवाः ! फलमुत्पद्यतेऽमृतम् ।
कर्मयोगविभागाभ्यामाभ्यां द्वाभ्यां निरन्तरम् ॥
translation: हे देवतागण !  जिससे निःश्रेयसरूपी अमृत फल की उत्पत्ति होती है। कर्मयोग के इन दो विभागों से निरन्तर
english_translation: O devas, from which the immortal fruit of highest good continuously arises from these two divisions of karma yoga.
essence: Lasting highest good arises continuously from two complementary ways of acting.
simple_meaning: Highest lasting benefit, like immortal fruit, comes continuously from two types of karma yoga practice.
insight: Recognize that lasting fulfillment requires engaging both active and selfless aspects of action.
modern_relevance: When you balance doing your work with right intention and detachment, lasting benefit naturally follows.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
द्वै फले फलतो नूनं कैवल्याभ्युदयाविति ।
हित मद्वचनं भूयो देवाः ! सर्वेनिशम्यताम् ॥
translation: अभ्युदय और निःश्रेयसरूपी दो फल अवश्य प्रकट होते हैं। देवतागण ! पुनः आप लोग मेरी हित की बात सुनो
english_translation: Two fruits surely appear: progress and ultimate freedom. O radiant beings, hear my well-wishing words again.
essence: True wisdom brings both personal growth and lasting inner freedom together.
simple_meaning: Two results always come from true understanding: progress in life and ultimate inner freedom. The Goddess invites her listeners to hear this important teaching again.
insight: It shifts your view to see progress and freedom not as opposites, but as coexisting results of following wisdom.
modern_relevance: You may feel stuck between growing and finding peace. This reminds you both are possible at once.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
शक्तौ हि कर्मयोगस्यानुस्यूता सर्वथा सती ।
सकामकर्मयोगिभ्यो नूनमभ्युदयं ददे ॥
translation: मैं कर्मयोग की शक्ति में सर्वथा अनुस्यूत रहकर सकाम कर्मयोगी को अभ्युदय और
english_translation: The power of Karma Yoga is always present in her; she surely grants success to those attached to action with desire.
essence: Sincere action with desire activates a power that ensures success.
simple_meaning: The power connected to action always supports those who act with desire, granting them success.
insight: Recognize that sincere desire and focused action activate a supportive power that helps bring results.
modern_relevance: You commit fully to a project that matters to you, and despite uncertainty, you sense an inner momentum pushing you forward.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
निष्कामकर्मयोगिभ्यस्तथा निःश्रेयसं पदम् ।
बोध्यैपोपनिपत्कर्म-काण्डयोगस्य शाश्वती ॥
translation: निष्काम कर्मयोगी को नि:श्रेयस अवश्य प्रदान करती हूँ। यही कर्मकाण्ड योग की सनातनी उपनिषत है।
english_translation: I surely grant the highest good to those devoted to selfless action yoga. This is the eternal Upanishad of ritualistic yoga.
essence: Selfless action yoga is the eternal path to the highest good.
simple_meaning: Those who act without craving the result are granted the highest good. This teaching is the timeless truth behind ritualistic action.
insight: It teaches you to focus on pure action itself rather than on outcomes or recognition.
modern_relevance: You work tirelessly on tasks without expecting praise or reward, yet deep down you know this selfless effort shapes your growth.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
प्रतिमूलकं देवाः ! सकामं कर्म वर्तते ।
नानाधिकारभेदेभ्यो बहुशाखासमन्वितम् ॥
translation: हे देवतागण! प्रवृत्तिमूलक सकाम कर्म अनेकों अधिकार भेद के कारण अनेक शाखाओं से युक्त है।
english_translation: O divine beings! Action driven by desire has many branches due to various differences in rights and roles.
