essence: Desire-driven action naturally multiplies into many varied forms based on differing roles.
simple_meaning: Actions that arise from desire are many and varied because people have different roles and rights.
insight: Recognize how desire combined with differing roles multiplies the variety of actions you take.
modern_relevance: You notice how your wants pull you in many directions, shaped by your unique responsibilities and freedoms.
speaker: Shakti

verse_text:
अत एव च पुण्यानां यथाकालमहं हृदि ।
ऋषीणां सम्पविश्यैव वेदांत्रगुण्यगोचरान् ॥
translation: इसी कारण मैं समय समय पर पवित्र ऋषियों के अन्तःकरण में प्रवेश करके त्रिगुणात्मक वेदों को
english_translation: That is why, from time to time, I enter the hearts of the pure sages, who perceive the Vedas through the three qualities.
essence: The divine reveals wisdom in pure hearts at appointed times through the qualities.
simple_meaning: The divine enters the hearts of pure sages at the right time to reveal the Vedas influenced by the three qualities.
insight: Recognize that profound wisdom comes in moments when your inner being is receptive and aligned with natural cycles.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
प्रकाशयाम्यनेकाभिः शाखाभिः समलकृतान्।
सम्प्रदायविभिन्नत्वमहमाश्रित्य नैकशः ॥
translation: अनेक शाखाओं में प्रकट करती हूँ  और इसी कारण हे देवतागण ! मैं ही धर्म के अनेक सम्प्रदाय बनकर
english_translation: I manifest through countless branches, and for this reason, O radiant beings, I am the origin of many diverse paths of dharma.
essence: The divine reveals itself in many forms, making all paths valid expressions of truth.
simple_meaning: The divine reveals itself through many different branches and traditions, showing that all paths are connected to the same source.
insight: It encourages you to embrace diversity in spiritual paths as expressions of the same divine reality, fostering openness and trust.
modern_relevance: When you see people following different spiritual or ethical paths, you can feel assured that all sincere ways connect back to the same deeper truth.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
नानाधिकारिमृत्येभ्योऽभ्युदयं प्रदेऽमराः! ।
व्यवसायात्मिका बुद्धिरेकैव वर्तते खलु ॥
translation: विभिन्न अधिकार के मनुष्यों को अद्भुदय प्रदान करती हूँ। व्ययसायात्मिका (निष्काम कर्मयोग रूपा) बुद्धि एक प्रकार की ही होती है परन्तु
english_translation: I grant wondrous rise to humans with different rights; yet the diligent, selfless intellect is always one.
essence: Focused, selfless effort is the single source of all true advancement despite diverse roles.
simple_meaning: People have many different roles and rights, but the focused, selfless mind that acts without craving is always the same.
insight: It shifts your view from external roles to inner dedication as the real source of progress.
modern_relevance: You see coworkers with different jobs and titles, but the focused, selfless effort you bring is what truly moves things forward.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
बहुशाखा ह्यनन्ताश्च बुद्धयोऽव्यवसायिनाम् ।
निवृत्तिमूलकस्त्वेको निष्कामकर्मयोगकः ॥
translation: सकाम कर्मिमयों की बुद्धि बहु शाखाओं से युक्त अनन्त होती हैं । इसलिए निवृत्ति मूलक निष्काम कर्मयोग
english_translation: The minds of those attached to results are endlessly scattered, but the wisdom rooted in renunciation is singular and devoted to selfless action.
essence: Restless minds scatter; selfless action rooted in renunciation brings steady wisdom.
simple_meaning: Minds attached to results are restless and scattered, but selfless action rooted in renunciation brings steady wisdom.
insight: It teaches you to focus on your action itself, not the results, calming restless thoughts.
modern_relevance: When your mind races through endless worries about outcomes, choosing to act without craving brings clarity and calm.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
निर्विकारोऽभयोऽद्वैतो निर्विकल्पोऽस्त्यसंशयम् ।
वासनायाश्चञ्चलत्वं किञ्चिन्नैवात्र विद्यते ॥
translation: निस्सन्देह एक, अद्वैत, निर्विकार, निर्भय और विकल्परहित है इसमें वासना की चञ्चलता कुछ भी नहीं है
english_translation: The true self is without change, fearless, non-dual, free from doubt and mental fluctuations, and completely beyond restless desires.
essence: The true self is changeless, fearless, non-dual, and free from restless desires.
simple_meaning: Your true self never changes, has no fear or doubt, and is free from restless desires.
insight: It shifts your view from identifying with restless desires to resting in the unshakable nature of your true self.
modern_relevance: When your mind jumps anxiously between worries and cravings, remember your true self is steady, fearless, and beyond that turmoil.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
नेहामिक्रमनाशोऽस्ति प्रत्यवायो न विद्यते ।
स्वल्पमप्यस्य धर्मस्य त्रायते महतो भयात् ॥
translation: इसमें अभिक्रम का नाश भी नहीं है और न कोई प्रत्यवाय ही है, इस धर्म का थोड़ा भी अंश महाभय से रक्षा करता है
english_translation: There is no destruction of this undertaking, nor is there any failure; even a small part of this dharma protects greatly from fear.
essence: Even a small part of your true duty protects deeply from fear without risk of failure.
simple_meaning: Your true duty can never fail or be destroyed; even a small effort in it protects you from great fear.
insight: It teaches you to value every small right effort as a powerful shield against fear and doubt.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by anxiety about results, knowing that even small steps toward your true purpose offer real protection can bring calm and strength.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
यद्यप्यस्मि प्रतिष्ठात्री धर्मयोरुभयोरहम् ।
प्रवृत्तिमूलकस्याथ निवृत्तिमूलकस्य च ॥
translation: यद्यपि मैं प्रवृत्ति धर्म और निवृत्ति धर्म दोनों की प्रतिष्ठा की स्थान हूँ
english_translation: Although I am the foundation of both the path of action and the path of renunciation.
essence: The inner being grounds both action and renunciation as one unified source.
simple_meaning: You are the foundation behind both the ways of acting and the ways of withdrawing.
insight: It teaches you to see action and renunciation as complementary expressions of your true self, not opposing forces.
modern_relevance: When you face choices between pushing forward or stepping back, remember both come from the same inner source within you.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
मामेव प्राप्नुतो देवाः! द्विविधौ कर्मयोगिनौ।
पार्थक्यं नापि किञ्चिच द्वयोर्वाह्ये प्रतीयते ॥
translation: और हे देवगण ! दोनो श्रेणी के कर्मयोगि गण मुझको ही प्राप्त होते हैं और बहिःस्वरूप में दोनों की कुछ भी पृथक्ता प्रतीत नहीं होती
english_translation: O divine beings! Both kinds of karma yogis reach only me, and externally there is no difference between the two.
essence: Different kinds of dedicated action lead to the same divine destination without real external difference.
simple_meaning: Both types of karma yogis, regardless of their external differences, ultimately reach the same divine source.
insight: Recognize that outward differences in approach do not change the shared essence of sincere action.
modern_relevance: You see different people taking different approaches to work or service, but all sincere effort connects to the same deeper purpose.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
वासनानोदितः कर्मी यथैव कुरुतेऽवशः।
अधिकारी सकामस्य कर्मयोगस्य कर्म यत् ॥
translation: क्योंकि सकामी अधिकारी जिस कर्म को वासना की प्रेरणा से अवश होकर करता है,
english_translation: Because the person desiring results performs the action driven by desire,
essence: Acting from desire is compulsion, not true action from the self.
simple_meaning: When you act driven by desire, you are not free but compelled by impulses.
insight: It shifts your awareness to see how desire motivates your actions, helping you step back and choose freedom.
modern_relevance: You find yourself chasing rewards at work or in relationships, feeling trapped by wanting outcomes.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
तनिष्कामत्रतस्नातः कर्मयोगी स्वभावतः।
विधत्ते लोकशिक्षार्थ ज्ञानानुस्यूतमानसः ॥
translation: निष्कामव्रत दीक्षित कर्मयोगी उसी कर्म को स्वाभाविक रूप से ज्ञान में अनुस्यूत रहकर लोक शिक्षा के लिये करता है।
english_translation: A karma yogi, naturally free from desire, performs actions for the world's teaching with a mind united in wisdom.
essence: Acting without desire while your mind stays united with wisdom benefits all around you.
simple_meaning: You naturally perform your actions without craving results, guided by wisdom to teach others.
insight: It teaches you to act from your natural state of desirelessness, letting wisdom guide your purpose beyond personal gain.
modern_relevance: You finish your work calmly, without clinging to praise or reward, letting your clear understanding shape your efforts.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
भावासक्तिपृथग्भावादत्यन्तात्तु द्वयोरहम् ।
साधारणविशेपाख्यौ धौ संस्थापये क्रमात ॥
translation: परन्तु उन अधिकारियों में आसक्ति और भाव की अत्यन्त पृथक्ता होने के कारण मैं उनमें यथाक्रम विशेष और साधारण धर्म को स्थापित करती हूँ ॥
english_translation: Because the officials differ greatly in attachment and emotion, I establish special and general duties for them in order.
essence: Different feelings require tailored duties; general rules alone don’t fit everyone.
simple_meaning: People differ in how attached or emotional they are, so different duties suit them better; both general and special responsibilities exist.
insight: It teaches you to embrace your current feelings as clues to your proper role and responsibilities.
modern_relevance: At work, some colleagues feel deeply connected to tasks while others stay distant; recognizing this helps assign roles that fit each person's style.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
नैके विशेषधर्मस्य ह्यधिकारा भवन्त्यतः।
नास्ति साधारणे धर्मे त्वधिकारविभिन्नता ॥
translation: यही कारण है कि विशेष धर्म में अधिकार अनेक हैं और साधारण धर्म में अधिकार विभिन्नता नहीं है
english_translation: The reason is that special duties have many rights, while common duties have no difference in rights.
essence: Special duties carry many rights; common duties share equal rights without difference.
simple_meaning: Some roles or duties have many specific rights and responsibilities, while others share the same rights without difference.
insight: It teaches you to recognize when your role carries special authority versus when duties are shared equally.
modern_relevance: At work, your unique role may give you specific freedoms or responsibilities unlike general tasks everyone shares.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
यथा रोचेत वो देवाः ! कर्मयोग तथाविधम् ।
निःश्रेयसं समाश्रित्याऽभ्युदयं वाप्यवानुत ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! आपलोगों की जैसी रुचि हो उसी प्रकार के कर्मयोग का आश्रय करके अभ्युदय या निःश्रेयस प्राप्त करें
english_translation: O celestial beings! Pursue the path of action that suits your nature to attain progress or the highest good.
essence: Progress and highest good come from choosing the action path that suits your nature.
simple_meaning: You should follow the kind of action that feels natural and appealing to you to gain progress or the highest benefit.
insight: It shifts your focus from copying others to discovering and following your own authentic way of acting.
modern_relevance: You face many choices about how to act—when you pick the way that feels right for you, growth and success come more naturally.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
तिम्रो यद्यपि जीवानामस्म्यहं गतयो ध्रुवम् ।
कृष्णशुक्ले तथापि स्तः प्रवृत्तिमूलिके गती ॥
translation: यद्यपि जीवों की त्रिविध गति मैं ही हूँ  तथापि कृष्ण और शुक्ल गति  प्रवृत्तिधर्म मूलक है
english_translation: Though I am the threefold path of living beings, Krishna and Shukla paths are based on active duty.
essence: Life follows many paths, some rooted in active doing and duty.
simple_meaning: The divine is the source of all three ways life moves, but some paths are based on action and duty.
insight: Recognize that not all paths you follow are the same—some require active engagement, others deeper reflection.
modern_relevance: You juggle many roles and directions in life; some demand active work while others ask for inner awareness.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
सहजाख्यगतेरस्ति ह्यधिकारस्तु केवलम् ।
योगस्थानां सुशान्तानां निष्कामवतशालिनाम् ॥
translation: और सहजगति के अधिकारी शान्त निष्काम कर्मयोगी ही केवल हो सकते हैं।
english_translation: Only those who have attained natural progression, are established in yoga, peaceful, and act without desire are fit for true authority.
essence: True authority arises only from peaceful, desireless, naturally flowing action.
simple_meaning: Only those who naturally progress, stay calm in yoga, and act without craving can truly have authority.
insight: It shifts your aim from controlling outcomes to mastering peaceful, selfless action.
modern_relevance: You lead best when your actions come from calm focus, not from chasing results or approval.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
सुखानन्दस्वरूपाभ्यामहमेव निरन्तरम।
निखिलोपासकान देवाः ! कर्मयोगे प्रवर्तये ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! मैं ही सुख और आनन्दरूप से उपासकों को कर्मयोग में निरन्तर प्रवृत्त कराती हूँ
english_translation: O divine beings! I continuously inspire all devotees with the nature of bliss and joy to engage in the yoga of action.
essence: Joy can continuously inspire you to act fully without attachment to outcomes.
simple_meaning: You are continuously inspired by the feeling of joy to act without attachment to results.
insight: It teaches you to let joy be the driver of your actions, freeing you from craving results.
modern_relevance: You wake up feeling a quiet happiness that pushes you to do your work fully, regardless of recognition or reward.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
सुस्वमेतद्धि जानीत विपयानन्दमूलकम् ।
आनन्दो विद्यते नूनं मत्स्वरूपं न संशयः ॥
translation: सुख को विषयानन्दमूलक जानो और आनन्द मेरा ही स्वरुप है इसमें संदेह नहीं
english_translation: Know well that happiness arises from external pleasures; true bliss is my own nature beyond doubt.
essence: True bliss is your unchanging nature, not the fleeting happiness from external things.
simple_meaning: Happiness from outside things is temporary, but true and lasting joy is your own real nature without any doubt.
insight: Shift your focus from chasing external pleasures to recognizing the joy already present within your true self.
modern_relevance: You chase notifications, praise, or possessions for happiness, but real joy lives inside you, untouched by those things.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
ये ममोपासकास्सन्तो योगिनो मद्विभूतिषु ।
मच्छक्तिष्वपि मुह्यन्ति दक्षिणास्सन्ति तेऽपि च ॥
translation: मेरे उपासक योगिगण जो मेरी विभूति और शक्तियों में ही मुग्ध रहते हैं वह भी उदार हैं
english_translation: Those who worship me but become attached to my manifestations and powers are deluded, though they are devoted.
essence: Devotion focused only on divine powers can still be sincere yet confused.
simple_meaning: Some who worship the divine focus only on her powers and forms and get confused, even though they are devoted.
insight: It teaches you to look beyond surface qualities in devotion and seek the deeper connection.
modern_relevance: You might deeply admire someone's skills or achievements but miss the deeper person behind them.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
मद्विभूतिमनिच्छंस्तु शक्तिमप्यैश्वरीं मम।
योग साध्यो प्नोति यो नित्यं केवलं मदवाप्तये ॥
translation: परन्तु जो मेरी विभूति और ऐशी शक्तियों की इच्छा न रख कर केवल मेरी ही प्राप्ति के लिये योगसाधन नियमित करते हैं
english_translation: But those who do not desire my manifestations or my sovereign powers, and practice yoga constantly solely to attain me.
essence: Only those who seek the source itself, not its powers, achieve true union.
simple_meaning: True devotion means focusing only on connecting with me, not chasing my powers or special forms.
insight: Shift your focus from external benefits to the inward connection with your true self.
modern_relevance: You may feel tempted to chase achievements or status, but real fulfillment comes from seeking your deepest source, not its rewards.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
निष्कामयोगनिष्ठोऽसौ ज्ञानी स्वात्मैव मे मतम् ।
आर्तो जिज्ञामुरार्थी भक्ता मे त्रिविधा इमे ॥
translation: वह निष्काम योगनिष्ट ज्ञानी मेरी आत्मा ही है। आर्त, जिज्ञासु और अर्थार्थी यह तीन प्रकार के मेरे भक्त
english_translation: The one established in selfless action is the knower, truly my own self; my devotees are of three kinds: the distressed, the seeker, and the desirous.
essence: Acting without craving reveals your true self and embraces all kinds of devotion.
simple_meaning: You become truly wise and connected to your true self when you act without wanting personal gain. The divine sees three kinds of devotees: those in pain, those searching, and those who desire.
insight: It teaches you to embrace selfless action as a path to inner knowing and recognize varied devotional states without judgment.
modern_relevance: When you work without expecting rewards, you align with your true self. Whether you feel lost, curious, or driven, that openness connects you to deeper meaning.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
अध्वनीनाः सकामस्य भक्तियोगस्य सन्ति हि।
चतुर्थो ज्ञानिभक्तस्तु मत्स्वरूपो न संशयः ॥
translation: सकाम भक्तियोग के पथिक हैं और चतुर्थ ज्ञानी नामक भक्त मेरा ही स्वरूप है इसमें सन्देह नहीं
english_translation: Those who act with desire belong to the path of devotion through action, and the fourth type of devotee called the knower of wisdom is indeed my true form, without doubt.
essence: Devotion appears both as eager action and as wise knowing, each a true form of the divine.
simple_meaning: Some devotees act with desire and follow the path of devoted action. Others, called knowers, embody devotion through wisdom and represent the divine form without doubt.
insight: Recognize that devotion isn’t one shape — it can be active desire or quiet wisdom, each valid and divine.
modern_relevance: You may find yourself devoted either by passionately doing or by understanding deeply; both ways connect you to your true nature.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
सर्वास्वभ्युदयस्यापि बीजेपु योगसिद्धिषु।
मत्सायुज्यदशाप्राप्तौ वाधिकास्ता न साधिकाः ॥
translation: सभी योगसिद्धियां अभ्युदय की मूल होने पर भी वे मेरी सायुज्य दशा प्राप्ति कराने में बाधक हैं साधक नहीं है।
english_translation: Even though all accomplishments arise from their own seeds, they hinder the practitioner's union with me and are not true attainments.
essence: Not all spiritual achievements lead to true union with the divine; some block it.
simple_meaning: Many achievements come from actions, but they can block true union with the divine and are not the real goal.
insight: It teaches you to look beyond visible achievements and seek deeper union beyond superficial success.
modern_relevance: You might rack up successes, certifications, or milestones yet feel something essential is missing—real connection and fulfillment.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
पराभक्तेविरोधिन्यो विद्यन्तेऽत्यन्तमेव च।
ऐशीनां खलु सिद्धीनां शक्तीनामपि सर्वशः ॥
translation: और पराभक्ति की अत्यन्त - विरोधिनी हैं। हे देवश्रेष्ठों ! ऐसी सिद्धियों और विभिन्न शक्तियों को
english_translation: And they are utterly opposed to excessive devotion. O best of the divine, such perfections and various powers do not exist at all.
essence: Excessive devotion actually blocks true spiritual powers and achievements from arising.
simple_meaning: Too much devotion actually blocks the presence of real powers and spiritual achievements.
insight: It shifts your mind to see that healthy devotion includes trust without overwhelming fixation or craving.
modern_relevance: You’ve ever felt overwhelmed by your own efforts to be perfect or deeply faithful, only to feel stuck or powerless instead.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
हेतुतवं बहते प्रासः संयमो विबुधर्षभाः!।
मदवाप्तचेकतत्त्वाभ्यासः कारणतां व्रजेत् ॥
translation: प्राप्त कराने में संयम कारण है और मुझको प्राप्त कराने में एकतत्त्वाभ्यास कारण है
english_translation: Discipline is the cause of attaining causes, and practice of unity is the cause of attaining Me.
essence: Discipline creates causes; focused unity practice leads to the divine itself.
simple_meaning: Discipline creates the conditions to reach your goals, and focused practice on unity with the divine brings you to the divine itself.
insight: It teaches you to value both consistent discipline for progress and focused unity practice to connect beyond results.
modern_relevance: You stick to your daily habits and practices, building momentum that opens new possibilities, while deep focus on your core values or purpose brings profound meaning.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
योगः स्वरूपतो नूनमष्टाङ्गेषु विभज्यते ।
यमश्च नियमश्चैव तथैवासनमेव च ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! योग स्वरूपतः आठ अंगों में ही विभक्त है, यथा-यम, नियम, आसन,
english_translation: O divine beings! Yoga by its nature is divided into eight limbs: restraint, observance, posture, and so on.
essence: Yoga is naturally structured into eight essential limbs guiding disciplined practice.
simple_meaning: Yoga naturally divides into eight parts, including restraint, observance, and posture.
insight: It teaches you to approach personal growth as a gradual, disciplined process with distinct stages.
modern_relevance: You prepare for a challenging project by breaking it down into clear, manageable steps, just like yoga’s eight limbs guide progress.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
प्राणायामस्तथा देवाः ! प्रत्याहारश्च धारणा।
ध्यानं समाधिरित्यष्टौ योगस्याङ्गानि सन्ति ह ॥
translation: प्राणायाम, प्रत्याहार धारणा, ध्यान और समाधि यही योग के आठ अंग है
english_translation: Pranayama, withdrawal of the senses, concentration, meditation, and samadhi are the eight limbs of yoga.
essence: Yoga is a path of eight interlinked practices leading to deep inner mastery.
simple_meaning: Yoga consists of eight parts including breath control, sensory withdrawal, concentration, meditation, and deep absorption.
insight: It teaches you to build inner control progressively through focused breath and mind exercises.
modern_relevance: When stress floods your mind, slowing your breath and drawing your attention inward can steady your whole day.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
एकतत्त्वैकमूलस्सन्नन्यः संयममूलकः।
अयमष्टाङ्गयोगो हि षोड़शाङ्गैः प्रपूर्यते ॥
translation: यही अष्टांग योगसंयम और एकतत्त्व मूलक होकर षोडश अंगों से पूर्ण होता है
english_translation: This eightfold yoga, based on unity and restraint, is perfected by sixteen limbs.
essence: Discipline unites focus and restraint, perfected by many supporting parts.
simple_meaning: Discipline is a practice rooted in unity and self-control, completed by many interrelated steps.
insight: It teaches you to build discipline by grounding efforts in unity and expanding through detailed practices.
modern_relevance: When you commit to a new habit, your success depends on steady self-control and integrating many small practices.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
मन्त्रो हठो लयो राजयोग एते चतुर्विधाः।
क्रियासिद्धांशभेदा वै सन्ति योगस्य निर्जराः !॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! योग के क्रिया सिद्धांश के चार भेद हैं, यथा-मन्त्रयोग, हठयोग, लययोग और राज योग
english_translation: O divine beings! Yoga has four types based on perfected practices: mantra yoga, hatha yoga, laya yoga, and raja yoga.
essence: Yoga divides into four timeless paths based on perfected methods.
simple_meaning: Yoga has four main branches based on different perfected methods: mantra, hatha, laya, and raja yoga.
insight: Recognize that spiritual practice can take many forms, each suited to different temperaments and goals.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
निरोधश्चित्तवृत्तीनां नामरूपावलम्बनात् ।
साध्यते साधकैर्यत्र मन्त्रयोगः स उच्यते ॥
translation: नाम और रूप की सहायता से साधकों के द्वारा चित्त वृत्तियों का निरोध जिसमें किया जाता है उसको मन्त्रयोग कहते हैं
english_translation: Mantra yoga is practiced by seekers to restrain the fluctuations of the mind through support of name and form.
essence: Focusing on sacred names and forms restrains the restless mind through mantra yoga.
simple_meaning: You can control your restless mind by focusing on specific sounds and images; this practice is called mantra yoga.
insight: It teaches you to anchor your attention on a mantra or form to reduce mental restlessness.
modern_relevance: Your mind races with distractions; repeating a meaningful word or focusing on an image can help you regain calm and focus.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
नैकासाश्चैव मूर्तीनामध्यात्मभावसंयुजाम्।
आश्रयाद्ध्यायमाना हि मन्त्रयोगविधानतः ॥
translation: विभिन्न अध्यात्म भाव युक्त मूर्तियों के द्वारा ध्यान करते हुए मन्त्रयोग में
english_translation: Meditating on various forms united with spiritual essence through the practice of mantra yoga.
essence: Meditation deepens by uniting mantra practice with spiritually meaningful forms.
simple_meaning: You can meditate using different images or forms that embody spiritual qualities through mantra practice.
insight: It teaches you to use meaningful forms as anchors in your meditation, enriching your focus and presence.
modern_relevance: When your mind wanders, focusing on a meaningful image or symbol helps you return to calm and purpose.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
मन्त्रयोगपरा धीराः साधका मामुपासते ।
साहाय्यात्स्थूलदेहस्य चित्तत्तिनिरोधनम् ॥
translation: प्रवीण धीर साधक गण मन्त्रयोग की सहायता से मेरी उपासना करते हैं। धीर व्यक्तियों के द्वारा स्थूल शरीर की सहायता से चित्तवृत्तियों का निरोध
english_translation: Skilled and steady practitioners worship me through mantra yoga, using the gross body to control the restless mind.
essence: Steady practice using the body supports controlling the restless mind through mantra yoga.
simple_meaning: Steady and skilled practitioners use mantra yoga and their physical body to calm and control the restless mind.
insight: It teaches you to engage your body deliberately as an ally in calming mental restlessness through steady practice.
modern_relevance: You sit quietly repeating a calming phrase, using your breath and posture to settle your busy thoughts into stillness.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
यत्र संसाध्यते धीरैर्हठयोगः स ईर्यते । 
ज्योतिर्मयस्य रूपस्य कल्पितस्यावलम्बनात् ॥
translation: जिसमें किया जाता है उसको हठयोग कहते हैं। हठयोगी गण कल्पित ज्योतिर्मय रूप की सहायता से
english_translation: The forceful yoga is when the steadfast one uses the imagined radiant form as support.
essence: Steady effort uses a created radiant image as a support to focus the mind.
simple_meaning: Steady effort, called forceful yoga, uses an imagined radiant image as support to focus the mind.
insight: It teaches you to use a clear mental focus—even imagined—to steady your effort and willpower.
modern_relevance: You focus on a clear goal or image to keep your effort steady when distractions try to pull you away.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
ध्यायमानाश्च मां सिद्धार्लभन्ते हठयोगिनः । 
शक्तीर्जड़त्वमापन्नाः प्रमुप्तास्ता वियोध्य हि ॥
translation: मेरा ध्यान करते हुए सिद्धियों को लाभ करते हैं। समष्टि और व्यष्टि शक्तियों की सहायता से
english_translation: Those who meditate on me attain powers; however, those who gain the powers of the collective and individual forces become deluded and fall away.
essence: Powers gained through effort can cause you to lose true progress if you cling to them.
simple_meaning: Meditating with strong effort can bring special powers, but becoming attached to these powers leads to confusion and loss.
insight: Shift focus from acquiring powers to steady practice without attachment to results or abilities gained.
modern_relevance: You push hard to master a skill and gain recognition, but fixating on that status can cloud your original purpose and stall your growth.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
समष्टिव्यष्टिशक्तीनां साहाय्यादयत्र साध्यते।
चित्तवृत्तिनिरोधोऽसौ लययोगो निगद्यते ॥
translation: जड़भाव प्राप्त प्रसुप्त शक्तियों को जगाकर चित्तवृत्ति निरोध करने को लययोग कहते हैं।
english_translation: The practice of awakening dormant and scattered energies to still the fluctuations of the mind is called the yoga of dissolution.
essence: Awakening scattered inner energies stills the restless mind through the yoga of dissolution.
simple_meaning: You awaken both the hidden and scattered energies inside to stop the restless movements of your mind. This quieting practice is called the yoga of dissolution.
insight: It teaches you to unite fragmented inner energies to quiet the restless mind and access deeper stillness.
modern_relevance: When your mind races with scattered thoughts, focusing and activating your inner resources can bring deep calm and clarity.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
साक्षादाध्यात्मिकं विन्दु-मयं मे रूपमद्भुतम् ।
दृष्ट्वा कृतार्थतां यान्ति तत्क्षणं लययोगिनः ॥
translation: लययोगी मेरे आध्यात्मिक बिन्दुमय अद्भत रूप का प्रत्यक्ष दर्शन करके उसी समय सफल मनोरथ होते हैं
english_translation: Those absorbed in complete union immediately achieve fulfillment upon directly seeing my wondrous spiritual form composed of the spiritual point.
essence: Directly seeing your divine spiritual core brings instant fulfillment without delay.
simple_meaning: When you directly see the divine spiritual core, you instantly reach your deepest fulfillment.
insight: It teaches that direct, clear spiritual awareness can bring immediate transformation and fulfillment.
modern_relevance: You have a sudden moment of clarity about your true purpose, and everything you long for seems within reach.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
नित्यानित्यस्वरूपाणां पदार्थानां विवेकतः।
त्रिगुणानां त्रिभावानामपि नित्यं विमर्शतः ॥
translation: नित्यानित्य-वस्तुविवेक और त्रिगुण तथा त्रिभावों के सर्वदा विचार द्वारा
english_translation: Constantly discern the true nature of eternal and non-eternal things, and reflect on the three qualities and three states.
essence: Wisdom grows by constantly discerning what lasts, what changes, and how qualities shift.
simple_meaning: You should constantly examine what is permanent and what changes, including the three qualities and their three states.
insight: It encourages you to shift from fixed assumptions to active, ongoing reflection on changing qualities and experiences.
modern_relevance: You catch yourself judging situations as fixed or permanent, but then realize feelings and traits also shift constantly.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
शक्तिमाध्यात्मिकी यत्र हितां प्राप्नुवतां स्वतः।
निरोधश्चित्तवृत्तीनां जायते योगिनां सताम् ॥
translation: हितकारिणी आध्यात्मिक शक्ति लाभ करते हुए श्रेष्ठ योगियों की चित्तवृत्तियों का निरोध स्वतः हो जाने को
english_translation: Where the spiritual power that benefits is attained, the fluctuations of the minds of the best yogis are naturally restrained.
essence: True spiritual power naturally quiets the restless mind without struggle.
simple_meaning: When you gain spiritual power that truly helps, your restless mind naturally becomes calm without force.
insight: This verse shifts the mind from forcing calm to allowing stillness to arise through spiritual connection.
modern_relevance: After a hectic day, you might find moments of calm come easiest when you deeply connect with a source of inner strength, not by trying harder.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
कथितो राजयोगोऽसौ सर्वयोगशिरोमणिः ।
पराभक्त्यधिकारं मे भक्ताश्च ज्ञानिनो गताः ॥
translation: राजयोग कहते हैं जो सब योगों में शिरोमणि है। मेरी पराभक्ति के अधिकारी राजयोगी ज्ञानी भक्त गण
english_translation: The royal yoga is called the crown jewel of all yogas. Those devoted to me with utmost devotion, the royal yogis, are the wise and the devotees.
essence: The highest yoga blends devoted love and wisdom as its crowning achievement.
simple_meaning: The highest yoga is called royal yoga, uniting deep devotion and wisdom in those who follow it.
insight: It teaches you to value both heartfelt devotion and discerning wisdom as equal parts of your spiritual journey.
modern_relevance: You may admire people who balance deep love for their purpose with clear, wise understanding — this path honors both.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
साहाय्याद्राजयोगस्य लभन्ते राजयोगिनः।
ममाध्यात्मस्वरूपं हि साक्षावकृत्यान्ततश्च माम् ॥
translation: राजयोग की सहायता से मेरे अध्यत्मस्वरूप का साक्षात्कार करके अन्त में मुझको प्राप्त होते हैं
english_translation: By the aid of royal yoga, royal yogis ultimately realize my spiritual nature and attain me.
essence: Dedicated yoga practice reveals your true spiritual nature and leads to union with the divine.
simple_meaning: Through the practice of royal yoga, dedicated practitioners directly experience their spiritual nature and ultimately connect with the divine.
insight: It teaches you to trust that disciplined inner work unveils your true spiritual identity and deeper connection.
modern_relevance: When you commit to a steady inner practice, you discover your truest nature beyond distractions and connect with something greater inside.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
एताश्चतुर्विधा एव मोक्ताः साधनरीतयः ।
ममोपास्तेः सदा देवा मूलभित्तय ईरिताः ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! यह ही उक्त चार प्रकार की साधन शैली सदा मेरी उपासना की मूलभित्ति कही गई है
english_translation: O divine beings! These four types of practice are always the foundation of my worship.
essence: Four core practices are the steady foundation of true devotion.
simple_meaning: There are four main ways to practice devotion, and they form the foundation of true worship.
insight: Recognize that devotion is not random but built on clear, established methods that support steady growth.
modern_relevance: When you feel scattered in your spiritual effort, remembering these core practices can help you find steady ground.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
चतुर्णाश्चैव योगानामेतेषां निखिलाः क्रियाः।
विद्यन्ते विबुधश्रेष्ठाः ! योगाङ्गाष्टकमूलकाः ॥
translation: और हे श्रेष्ठ देवगण ! इन चार योगों की सब क्रियाएँ ही अष्टांग योगमूलक हैं
english_translation: O best of the enlightened beings! All actions of these four yogas are based on the eight limbs of yoga.
essence: All four yogas are grounded in the eight fundamental limbs of yoga practice.
simple_meaning: All activities in the four main yogas arise from the foundational eight limbs of yoga.
insight: It shifts your view to see different spiritual paths as expressions of one underlying framework.
modern_relevance: You notice many approaches aim for growth but find they share basic principles at their core, like habits or mindsets that sustain any deep practice.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
संयमश्चैकतत्त्वञ्च द्वयोः सम्बन्धसंजुषाम् ।
विभेदेन प्रयोगाणामेतद्योगचतुष्टयम् ॥
translation: ये चारों योग संयम और एकतत्त्व से सम्बन्ध युक्त प्रयोगों के विभेद से
english_translation: These four types of practice are connected by restraint and unity of essence, distinguished by their different applications.
essence: Different spiritual practices share restraint and unity but differ in their specific applications.
simple_meaning: Four types of spiritual practice share a foundation of self-control and oneness but differ in how you apply them.
insight: Recognize that restraint and unity are the foundation beneath varied spiritual efforts, simplifying your focus.
modern_relevance: You juggle different habits to grow, yet all need self-control and a shared intention to truly transform.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
विभुर्त्ते क्षमते देवाः ! कलापोडशकं मम ।
नैवात्र विस्मयः कार्यों युष्माभिर्देवसत्तमाः ॥
translation: मेरी षोडश कलाओं को धारण कर सकते हैं, हे देवश्रेष्ठों ! आप लोगों इसमें कुछ भी आश्चर्य नहीं करना चाहिए
english_translation: O best of the devas, you can embody my sixteen arts; there is nothing here to wonder about.
essence: You can naturally embody extraordinary qualities without surprise.
simple_meaning: The devas are told they can manifest the sixteen arts of the speaker and should not be surprised by this.
insight: It shifts the mind from doubt to acceptance of your own hidden capabilities.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
विकाशो ज्ञानिभक्तेषु कलाषोड़शकस्य मे।
स्वभावसिद्ध एवास्ते ज्ञानिभक्ता: परन्त्वमी ॥
translation: मेरे ज्ञानिभक्तों में पूर्ण षोड़श कलाओं का विकाश होना स्वभावसिद्ध है परन्तु वे ज्ञानी भक्त
english_translation: Among my wise devotees, the full development of sixteen arts is natural, but they are foremost as wise devotees.
essence: Natural talents grow in the wise and devoted, but devotion remains supreme.
simple_meaning: Among those who are both wise and devoted, developing a wide range of skills happens naturally, but their devotion is what makes them exceptional.
insight: It shifts focus from valuing only abilities to honoring devotion as the highest form of excellence.
modern_relevance: You may have many skills or talents that come easily, but what truly stands out is your sincere dedication to what matters most.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
अनन्यभक्तियोगन ध्यायन्ते मां सदा ध्रुवम् ।
अतः सदाऽवतिष्ठन्ते वासनारहिता इमे ॥
translation: मुझमें अनन्य भक्ति युक्त हो सदा ध्यान करते हैं अतः वह सदा वासनाओं से रहित रहते हैं।
english_translation: Those who always meditate on me with exclusive devotion remain forever free from desires.
essence: Exclusive devotion to the divine removes all desire and attachment.
simple_meaning: If you meditate on the divine with exclusive devotion, you become free from all desires.
insight: It teaches you to steady your attention on devoted love, which weakens desire’s grip and brings calm.
modern_relevance: You keep returning your attention to what truly matters, and slowly the endless wants that trouble you begin to fade away.
speaker: Shakti

verse_text:
मच्चिता मद्दतमाणा मदध्याना मत्परायणाः।
मयर्पितात्मसर्वस्वा मद्गतात्मधियोऽमलाः ॥
translation: वह मुझमें अनुरक्त, मद्तचित्त, मद्गतप्राण, मेरे ध्यान में तत्पर, मत्परायण, मुझ में ही अपना सर्वस्व अर्पित करने वाले
english_translation: Those who are devoted to me, absorbed in me, with minds fixed on me, fully surrendered and pure in understanding, having entrusted their entire self to me.
essence: Complete surrender in devotion brings a pure and unwavering clarity of mind.
simple_meaning: You become devoted and fully absorbed when your mind and heart are fixed on the divine, surrendering everything with pure understanding.
insight: It shifts your focus from scattered thoughts to devoted presence, purifying your understanding through surrender.
modern_relevance: You find peace when you fully commit to what matters most, letting go of distractions and doubts.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
अपि मय्यनुरक्ताश्च जायन्ते सर्वदैव ते ।
ज्ञानिनां मम भक्तानां नास्ति भेदो मया सह ॥
translation: और मुझ में ही अपनी बुद्धि लगाये हुए सर्वदा निर्मल चित्त होते हैं । मेरे ज्ञानी भक्तों में और मुझ में भेद नहीं है।
english_translation: Those who are devoted to me with wisdom always have pure minds. There is no difference between me and my wise devotees.
essence: Wise devotion creates pure unity with the divine, removing all separation.
simple_meaning: Those who devote themselves to the divine with wisdom keep their minds pure and become inseparable from the divine.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate devotion with clear understanding, which removes the sense of separation from the divine.
modern_relevance: When you focus your mind on what truly matters with understanding and love, you feel deeply connected and inseparable from that source.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
त एवाहमहो देवाः ! अहमेव च ते मताः।
नात्र कश्चन सन्देहः सत्यं सत्यं वदाम्यहम् ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! वह ही मैं और मैं ही वह हूँ। मैं सत्य सत्य कहती हूँ  इसमें कुछ सन्देह नहीं है
english_translation: O divine beings! I am that, and that I am. There is no doubt in this; I speak the truth.
essence: You and the divine are fundamentally one without any separation or doubt.
simple_meaning: The divine reveals that it and the beings it addresses are one and the same without any doubt.
insight: It shifts your view from separation to unity, dissolving the feeling of being apart from the divine or others.
modern_relevance: When you feel isolated or separate, remember that your true self is deeply connected with everything around you.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
जीवभूमेः समारोढुं ब्रह्मभूमि मुखं सुराः।
अष्टसोपानतुल्यानि योगाङ्गान्यष्ट सन्त्यलम् ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! जीवभूमि से ब्रह्मभूमि पर सुखपूर्वक चढ़ने के लिये अष्टांग योग ही आठ सीढियां हैं
english_translation: O divine beings! The eightfold yoga limbs are the eight steps to ascend from the realm of living beings to the realm of the supreme reality with ease.
essence: The eight limbs of yoga are the essential steps to rise from ordinary life to supreme reality.
simple_meaning: There are eight parts of yoga that act like steps to help you rise from ordinary existence to the highest, unchanging reality.
insight: It teaches you to see spiritual growth as a gradual, structured process through specific practices.
modern_relevance: When you feel stuck or overwhelmed, breaking growth into clear, manageable steps can help you reach a higher state of well-being.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
समाधिरन्तिमं येषामारोहणमुदाहृतम् ।
सोपानमादिमं देवाः ! येषां हि विद्यते यमः ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! जिनमें अन्तिम सोपान समाधि और प्रथम सोपान यम है
english_translation: O divine beings! For those whose final step is absorption in stillness, the first step is restraint.
essence: Deep inner stillness requires starting with conscious self-restraint.
simple_meaning: Those who reach complete inner stillness begin by practicing restraint over themselves.
insight: It teaches you to see restraint not as restriction but as the foundation for profound inner peace.
modern_relevance: Before you can find deep calm, you first need to pause impulses and set healthy limits in daily choices.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
स्थूलदेहस्य सम्बन्धाच्छुद्धिराध्यात्मिकी तु या।
साध्यते साधकैर्देवाः ! आहुस्तं योगिनो यमम् ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! स्थूल शरीर-सम्बन्ध से साधकों के द्वारा आध्यात्मिक शुद्धि सम्पादन करने को योगीजन यम कहते हैं।
english_translation: O divine beings! The spiritual purity achieved by sages through connection with the gross body is called Yama by yogis.
essence: Disciplining your body is the gateway to spiritual purity and inner transformation.
simple_meaning: Spiritual purity comes when you control and discipline your physical body. Yogis call this practice Yama.
insight: It teaches you to focus on disciplined control of the body as the foundation for spiritual progress.
modern_relevance: When your restless body craves comfort, remembering that control over it deepens your inner clarity can steady your effort.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
ब्रह्मचर्य बहि:शौचो ह्याहिंसा सत्यमुत्तमम् ।
सर्वभूतदयाऽस्तेयं मिताहारोऽपरिग्रहः ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! ब्रह्मचर्य, बहिःशौच. अहिंसा, सत्य, सब जीवों पर दया, अस्तेय , मिताहार, अपरिग्रह,
english_translation: O divine beings! Celibacy, external purity, non-harming, truthfulness, compassion for all beings, non-stealing, moderation in eating, and non-possessiveness are the highest virtues.
essence: True discipline arises from kindness, truth, and moderation in all actions.
simple_meaning: Living with self-control, cleanliness, kindness, honesty, respect for others' possessions, moderate eating, and no greed are the best virtues to follow.
insight: This verse shifts your focus from external success to cultivating inner virtues through disciplined habits.
modern_relevance: You notice how small choices—what you eat, how you treat others—shape your calmness and clarity each day.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
शारीरिकं तपो देवा दानं तु सात्विकन्तथा ।
प्रधानान्येवमादीनि साधनानि यमस्य हि ॥
translation: शारीरिक तप और सात्विक दान इत्यादि यम के प्रधान साधन हैं
english_translation: Physical austerity and pure giving are the main practices of Yama.
essence: Self-restraint grows strongest through disciplined body and pure giving.
simple_meaning: Self-restraint (Yama) is mainly practiced through physical discipline and pure, sincere giving.
insight: It teaches you to root ethical discipline in concrete bodily care and sincere generosity, not just abstract ideals.
modern_relevance: You decide to take care of your body and give without expecting anything back—these acts strengthen your self-control and integrity.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
नियमो योगसोपानं द्वितीयं सम्प्रकीर्तितम् ।
सूक्ष्मदेहाश्रयायैस्तु साधनैः साधकैध्रुवम् ॥
translation: नियम योग का दूसरा सोपान कहा गया है। हे देवगण ! सूक्ष्म शरीर के सम्बन्ध से
english_translation: Discipline is declared the second step of yoga, especially for those residing in the subtle body.
essence: Discipline is the steady second step that supports progress in yoga practice.
simple_meaning: Discipline is the second important stage in yoga practice, especially for those working with the subtle body.
insight: It teaches you to value steady, disciplined effort as the foundation that supports deeper practice and growth.
modern_relevance: You start a new habit and know that consistent daily effort is the key to making it real and lasting.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
लभ्यतेऽध्यात्मसंशुद्धिस्तमाहुनियमं सुराः ।
अन्तःशौचश्च सन्तोपः स्वाध्यायो मानसं तपः ॥
translation: आध्यात्मिक-शुद्धि प्राप्ति के साधनो को नियम कहते हैं। अन्तःशौच, सन्तोष, स्वाध्याय, मानसिक तप,
english_translation: The divine beings call the means to attain spiritual purity 'rules': inner cleanliness, contentment, self-study, and mental discipline.
essence: Spiritual purity is achieved by disciplined inner cleanliness, contentment, self-study, and mental effort.
simple_meaning: Spiritual purity comes from following certain practices: keeping your mind clean, being content, studying yourself, and practicing mental discipline.
insight: It teaches you to shape your character by daily inner habits that purify and strengthen your mind and heart.
modern_relevance: When stress piles up, taking time to calm your mind, appreciate what you have, reflect honestly, and focus deeply can restore your balance.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
आस्तिक्यमार्जवं ह्रीश्च क्षमा चापि धृतिस्तथा ।
देवपिपितृभक्तिश्च नियमस्यापि निर्जराः ॥
translation: आस्तिकता, आर्जव, लज्जा, क्षमा, धैर्य और देवता ऋषि पितरों में भक्ति इत्यादि नियम के
english_translation: Faith, straightforwardness, modesty, forgiveness, patience, and devotion to divine beings, sages, and ancestors are the timeless rules.
essence: Steady qualities like faith, modesty, and devotion form timeless discipline.
simple_meaning: Certain qualities like faith, honesty, modesty, forgiveness, patience, and devotion are timeless guidelines to live by.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate core qualities that sustain consistent, trustworthy action over time.
modern_relevance: When facing difficult people or stressful days, holding on to patience, honesty, and respect keeps you steady and grounded.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
प्रधानान्येवमादीनि विद्यन्ते साधनान्यहो ।
तृतीयारोहणं विज्ञा आसनम्परिचक्षते ॥
translation: प्रधान साधन हैं। विद्वान लोग आसन को तृतीय सोपान कहते हैं
english_translation: The primary practices alone exist as means; the wise call posture the third step.
essence: True spiritual progress begins with fundamental practices before posture or form.
simple_meaning: The main spiritual practices are the most important; sitting posture is only the third step in the process.
insight: It teaches you to value foundational practices over external appearances or later stages like posture.
modern_relevance: When you start a new skill, the basics matter most; perfecting posture or form comes only after core habits are in place.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
यत्र संस्थापयेदेवं शरीरं सुखपूर्वकम् ।
यतः स्यान्मनसः स्थैर्य वायोश्चापि सुरर्षभाः ! ॥
translation: हे देवश्रेष्ठौ ! शरीर को इस प्रकार सुखपूर्वक स्थापित किया जाए  जिससे मन और वायु का स्थैर्य उत्पन्न हो
english_translation: O best of the gods, establish the body comfortably so that the mind and vital air become steady.
essence: A comfortable body steadies both mind and breath for inner balance.
simple_meaning: You should create a comfortable and steady posture for your body so your mind and breath become calm and steady.
insight: It teaches you to prioritize physical comfort to naturally steady your mind and breath in practice.
modern_relevance: You sit down after a long day; your body aches and your mind races. Finding a comfortable posture helps you finally breathe and think clearly.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
आसनं तद्विजानीत साधनेषु मुखावहम् ।
आसनस्य वहून्भेदान् योगाचार्याः प्रचक्षते ॥
translation: और जो साधन में सुखदायी हो उसको आसन कहते हैं । योगवित् आचार्यगण आसन के अनेक भेद बतलाते हैं
english_translation: A seat in practice is what brings comfort; yoga teachers describe many kinds of seats.
essence: Comfort in your seat is essential for steady spiritual practice.
simple_meaning: A seat in spiritual practice is one that feels comfortable and steady. Yoga teachers explain many types of such seats.
insight: Choose a posture that supports comfort and steadiness to deepen your practice without distraction.
modern_relevance: When you sit down to meditate or focus, your seat can make or break your experience—comfort helps you stay present longer.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
निखिलास्तेऽवगन्तव्याः पूज्यन्ग्घ्रे  श्रीगुरोर्मुखात्।
किश्चिदनापि वक्ष्येऽहं श्रूयतां देवपुङ्गवाः !॥
translation: उन सबको पूज्यपाद श्रीगुरुदेव के मुखसे जानना चाहिये। मैं यहां भी कुछ कहती हूँ, हे देवश्रेष्ठ! आप लोग सुने।
english_translation: All of them must be known through the revered feet of the noble Guru. I also speak something here; listen, O best of the divine beings!
essence: True understanding comes through revering and learning from the noble Guru.
simple_meaning: Everything important should be understood through the guidance of the respected Guru. Here, I also say something—please listen carefully.
insight: It shifts attention from scattered knowledge to the focused wisdom of a trusted teacher.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by many teachings, returning to a trusted mentor’s guidance clarifies your path.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
सिद्धं पद्मासनं देवाः ! स्वस्तिकासनमेव च ।
आसनानि प्रधानानि त्रीण्येतानि नियोधत ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! सिद्धासन, पद्मासन और स्वस्तिकासन, इन्हें प्रधानतः आसन के तीन भेद जानना चाहिए
english_translation: O divine beings! Consider siddhasana, padmasana, and swastikasana as the three principal types of seats.
essence: Three main seated postures serve as foundational meditation seats.
simple_meaning: There are three main types of seats used for sitting in meditation and yoga: siddhasana, padmasana, and swastikasana.
insight: It highlights the importance of choosing a stable, appropriate seat to support meditation and discipline.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
प्राणायामश्चतुर्थं वै योगारोहणमुत्तमम् ।
विधारणेन प्राणानां तथा प्रच्छद्यनेन च ॥
translation: प्राणायाम उत्तम चतुर्थ सोपान है । प्रच्छह्रन और विधारण द्वारा प्राण को
english_translation: The fourth and highest step of yoga is pranayama, controlling the breath through retention and release.
essence: Deliberate breath control through holding and releasing is yoga’s highest practice step.
simple_meaning: The highest stage of yoga practice is controlling your breath by holding it and then letting it go.
insight: It teaches you to regulate energy flow through deliberate breath control, deepening your discipline.
modern_relevance: When stress tightens your chest, learning to hold and release your breath calms your whole system.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
"यदवंशीकरणं नूनं प्राणायामः स उच्यते ।
अनेकभेदसत्त्वेऽपि भेदा अष्ट प्रधानतः ॥
"
translation: वशीभूत करने का नाम प्राणायाम है। हे देवगण ! प्राणायाम के अनेक भेद होने पर भी योगाचार्यों ने प्रधानतः उसके आठ भेद, किये हैं;
english_translation: Control of the breath is called pranayama. Though there are many types, yogis chiefly recognize eight kinds.
essence: Breath control has many forms, but eight are essential for disciplined practice.
simple_meaning: Breath control is called pranayama. Though many forms exist, yogis focus on eight main types.
insight: It teaches you to focus on essential breath control methods to build steady discipline in practice.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed, focusing on a few key breathing techniques can bring calm and control.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
सहितः सूर्यभेदी च तथोज्जायी च शीतली ।
भ्रामरी भस्त्रिका मूर्छा केवली च सुरर्षभा: ! ॥
translation: यथा-सहित, सूर्यभेदी, उज्जायी, शीतली, भ्रामरी, भस्त्रिका, मूर्छा और केवली।
english_translation: There are seven types of breath: Sahita, Suryabhedi, Ujjayi, Sheetali, Bhramari, Bhastrika, Moorchha, and Kevali.
essence: Breath comes in seven forms, each guiding your body's energy and calm.
simple_meaning: There are seven special kinds of breathing techniques that influence your energy and calm.
insight: Recognize breath as a tool to influence your energy and mental clarity through varied techniques.
modern_relevance: When stress tightens your chest, exploring different breathing styles can quickly shift your mood and focus.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
प्राणायामस्य तत्त्वज्ञैर्योगाचायः कृता इति ।
एतदुक्तं तु योगस्य यमाग्रङ्गचतुष्टयम् ॥
translation: योग के पूर्वोक्त यमादि चार अङ्ग बहिराज्य से सम्बन्ध रखने वाले हैं।
english_translation: The four limbs starting with Yama, known to the masters of breath control, belong to external disciplines of yoga.
essence: Yoga's first four limbs are external disciplines taught by breath-control masters.
simple_meaning: Yoga begins with four outer practices called Yama and others, taught by breath-control masters as foundational steps.
insight: Recognize that external restraint and ethical practice prepare the ground for deeper inner yoga.
modern_relevance: Before mastering your inner calm, you need to establish clear outer habits and rules in daily life.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
बाह्यराज्यसुसम्बन्धि वर्तते विबुधर्षभाः ।
अन्ताराज्यमुसम्बन्धियोगाङ्गान्यधुना ब्रुवे ॥
translation: अब अन्तर राज्य से सम्बन्ध रखनेवाले चार अङ्गों का वर्णन करती हूँ
english_translation: Now I describe the four parts connected with the inner kingdom.
essence: Four parts connected to the inner kingdom are now introduced.
simple_meaning: The goddess begins to explain four parts related to the inner kingdom she governs.
insight: It signals a shift in focus from outer concerns to inner structures shaping experience.
modern_relevance: You prepare to explore deeper aspects of yourself after mastering the outer challenges.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
प्रत्याहारं हि जानीत पञ्चमारोहणं सुराः!।
यथा कूर्मो निजाङ्गानि स्वस्यैव पृष्ठकोटरे ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! प्रत्याहार को पञ्चम सोपान जानो। कछुआ जिस प्रकार अपने अङ्गो को
english_translation: O divine beings, know that withdrawal of the senses is the fifth step, like a tortoise withdrawing its limbs into its shell.
essence: Withdrawing the senses inward is a key disciplined step toward self-mastery.
simple_meaning: Pulling back your senses from distractions is an important step, like a tortoise hiding its limbs for protection.
insight: It teaches you to consciously retreat your senses from external chaos to build inner resilience.
modern_relevance: When distractions crowd your mind, you can protect your focus by gently pulling your attention inward like a tortoise withdrawing its limbs.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
प्रत्याहरति रक्षार्थे तथैव योगिनो वराः।
अभ्यस्यन्ति समाकष्टु प्रवृत्ति विषयानुगाम् ॥
translation: अपनी रक्षा के लिये अपने पृष्ठकोटर में छिपाता है, उसी प्रकार श्रेष्ठ योगिगण अपनी विषयवती प्रवृत्ति को
english_translation: Just as a person withdraws into their shell for protection, the best yogis withdraw from impulses that follow the senses.
essence: Withdrawing from impulsive urges is how the strongest yogis protect themselves.
simple_meaning: To protect yourself, turn your attention inward like a turtle withdrawing its limbs. The best yogis practice restraining urges that follow the senses.
insight: It teaches you to build inner discipline by consciously holding back urges before they lead to reactive action.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by distractions or cravings, taking a moment to step back and resist acting on them shields your focus and peace.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
स्त्रीयां यद्विषयान्नूनं प्रत्याहारः स उच्यते ।
एनं वदन्ति विद्वांसो योगपकनभास्करम् ॥
translation: विषयों से खींचने का अभ्यास करते हैं उसको प्रत्याहार कहते हैं । विषयों में अनर्गल रूप से प्रवृत्त
english_translation: The practice of withdrawing from sensory objects is called withdrawal (pratyahara). Wise ones speak of it as the sun of the yogic path.
essence: Withdrawing attention from distractions is a luminous step on the yogic path.
simple_meaning: You practice pulling your attention away from external distractions; this is called withdrawal or pratyahara.
insight: It teaches you to intentionally redirect your attention away from sensory noise towards inner steadiness.
modern_relevance: When your phone buzzes endlessly, learning to pause and turn away helps your mind shine with calm focus.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
इन्द्रियाणां विचरतां विषयेषु निरर्गलम् ।
बलादाहरणं तेभ्यः प्रत्याहारोऽभिधीयते ॥
translation: इन्द्रियों को विषयों से हठात् खींचने का नाम प्रत्याहार है । यह साधन योगपंकज के लिये सूर्य रूप है
english_translation: For the senses that wander over objects, forcibly withdrawing them is called withdrawal (pratyahara). This practice is like the sun for the lotus of yoga.
essence: You can forcibly withdraw your senses from distractions to steady your mind.
simple_meaning: When your senses get distracted, you can deliberately pull them back. This controlled withdrawal is a key yoga practice.
insight: It teaches you to actively redirect your restless senses away from distractions toward calm focus.
modern_relevance: Your phone buzzes with notifications pulling your focus away. You can intentionally step back and reclaim your attention, like drawing your senses inward.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
बाह्यालम्बनसाहाय्यात् तथान्तरबलम्बनात ।
प्रत्याहारो द्विधा प्रोक्तो बाह्याऽभ्यन्तरभेदतः ॥
translation: बहिरबलम्बन और अन्तरबलम्बन भेद से वह प्रत्याहार दो प्रकार का है
english_translation: Withdrawal is explained in two types based on external and internal support.
essence: Withdrawal from distractions arises either through outer aid or inner strength.
simple_meaning: Withdrawal, the act of turning the senses away, happens in two ways: by depending on something outside or by relying on your inner strength.
insight: Recognize that restraint can be cultivated both by adjusting your surroundings and by strengthening your inner resolve.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed, you might take a break by changing your environment or by calming your own restless mind.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
धारणा षष्ठसोपानं योगस्य समुदाहृतम् ।
यदा धृत्या तु भो देवाः योगिनो योगयुक्तया ॥
translation: धारणा षष्ट सोपान कहा गया है। जब  योगी योग युक्त धृति द्वारा
english_translation: Concentration is described as the sixth step of yoga; when the gods attain steadiness through the yogi's focused determination.
essence: Steady, concentrated focus is a crucial stage in the path of yoga.
simple_meaning: Focused concentration is the sixth stage of yoga, achieved by steady determination of the practitioner.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate steady inner focus as a disciplined step toward deeper awareness.
modern_relevance: You lock onto a task with calm determination, and everything else fades away, making progress effortless and deep.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
चित्तमान्तरिके राज्ये स्वीयं संयमपूर्वकम् ।
प्रतिष्ठापयितु सम्यगभ्यस्यन्ति निरन्तरम् ॥
translation: अपने अन्तःकरण को अन्तर राज्य में संयमपूर्वक स्थापित करने का अभ्यास सम्यक्तया निरन्तर करते हैं
english_translation: One who steadily and properly practices establishing their inner being in the inner kingdom achieves continuous control.
essence: Lasting inner control grows from steady, focused practice within your own mind.
simple_meaning: You develop lasting self-control by consistently practicing focused calm within your own inner self.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate self-control by gently and consistently focusing inward, shaping lasting calm.
modern_relevance: You sit quietly each morning, gently guiding your thoughts instead of reacting, building steady calm over time.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
धारणा सैव विज्ञेया योगाधारस्वरूपिणी।
धारणायास्तु भेदौ द्वौ व्याहतौ योगवित्तमैः ॥
translation: उसको धारणा कहते हैं। वह योग की आधार स्वरुप है, श्रेष्ठ योगिगण धारणा के दो भेद कहते हैं
english_translation: That is called Dharana, the foundation of yoga; the greatest yogis distinguish two types of Dharana.
essence: Concentration is yoga’s foundation, and it unfolds in two distinct ways.
simple_meaning: Concentration, called Dharana, is the foundation of yoga, and great yogis recognize two distinct types of it.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that concentration isn’t one fixed thing but has distinct modes to cultivate.
modern_relevance: When you try to focus on a task, you might notice two ways your attention can hold steady—this awareness can improve your mental control.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
विषयालम्विनी ह्येका त्वपरात्मावलम्बिनी।
विषयालम्बनादेवाः ! जायते या तु धारणा ॥
translation: एक विषयावलम्बन से धारणा और दूसरी आत्मावलम्बन से धारणा। हे देवतागण ! विषयावलम्बन से जो धारणा होती है
english_translation: There are two kinds of support for perception: one based on external objects, and the other based on the true self. O radiant beings, perception that depends on external objects arises from attachment.
essence: Perception arises either from attachment to things or from connection to your true self.
simple_meaning: Perception can arise from attachment to external things or from relying on the true self within you.
insight: It shifts your view from chasing outside causes to grounding perception in your inner being.
modern_relevance: When you notice your feelings shift with every message or opinion, you’re seeing perception cling outside instead of resting in your true self.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
केवलं साधकानां सा भवेत्सिद्धिप्रदायिनी ।
आत्मावलम्बनाया तु धारणोत्पद्यतेऽपरा ॥
translation: वह साधकों को केवल सिद्धिप्रद है और आत्मावलम्बन से जो दूसरी धारणा होती है
english_translation: She is only the giver of success to sincere practitioners; other beliefs arise from self-dependence.
essence: True success arises only from sincere devotion, not from mere self-reliance.
simple_meaning: Only sincere practitioners receive true success from the divine; other ideas come from relying solely on oneself.
insight: It teaches you to shift from relying just on your own effort to embracing trust in a higher support.
modern_relevance: You’ve tried to solve a problem alone but found real progress only after asking for help or guidance.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
योगयुंजनचित्तेभ्यो मुक्तिं मा सम्प्रयच्छति ।
सोपानपुंज सत्त्वेऽपि ध्यानदा धारणैव हि ॥
translation: वह योगाभ्यासियों को मुक्तिप्रद है। अनेक सोपान होने पर भी धारणाभ्यास से ही ध्यान होता है
english_translation: The practice of holding the mind steady grants liberation, even when many stages remain in yoga.
essence: Steady mental holding grants freedom even when many yoga stages remain unfinished.
simple_meaning: Even if you haven't mastered all stages of yoga, steady practice of holding your mind leads toward freedom.
insight: Focus less on reaching all steps perfectly and more on steady, consistent mind-holding practice.
modern_relevance: You’ve tried to master every step perfectly, but steady focus on your daily practice is what truly moves you forward.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
सोपानं सप्तमं ध्यानं सर्वस्वं योगिनामिदम् ।
ध्येयमात्राश्रयादयत्तु प्रतिष्ठां लब्धुमात्मनि ॥
translation: योगियों का सर्वस्व सप्तम सोपान ध्यान है । आत्मा में प्रतिष्ठा लाभ करने के लिये जो एकमात्र ध्येय के अवलम्बन से
english_translation: The seventh step for yogis is meditation, their entire being; through focused meditation on a single goal, they attain firm establishment in the true self.
essence: Focused meditation on one goal grounds your entire being in the true self.
simple_meaning: Meditation is the seventh and highest step for yogis, focusing on one goal to firmly establish themselves in their true self.
insight: It teaches you to use concentrated meditation as a tool to root your awareness firmly in your true self.
modern_relevance: When distractions pull you in many directions, focusing deeply on one intention helps you find inner stability and clarity.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
चित्तस्यैय्यै विधीयेत तदध्यानमभिधीयते।
समावेधर्यानमेवेदमेकमात्रन्तु कारणम ॥
translation: चित्त का स्थैर्य उत्पन्न किया जाय उसको ध्यान कहते हैं। ध्यान ही समाधि का एकमात्र कारण है
english_translation: Steadiness of the mind is created; that is called meditation. Meditation alone is the sole cause of absorbed presence.
essence: Steadying the mind through meditation is the only cause of deep absorbed presence.
simple_meaning: Meditation means making your mind steady. This steady mind brings about deep absorbed presence.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate mental steadiness as the key to achieving absorbed presence.
modern_relevance: When your mind races among many distractions, practicing steady focus leads to moments of deep calm and clarity.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
ध्यानसिद्धिं विना योगी न कदाचित्कथञ्चन।
लब्धुम्ह्रति कुत्रापि कृतार्थत्वं कुतश्चन ॥
translation: ध्यानसिद्धि के बिना योगी कहीं भी, किसी प्रकार, कदापि, कृतकृत्य' नहीं हो सकता
english_translation: Without mastery in meditation, a yogi can never truly feel fulfilled anywhere or in any way.
essence: Fulfillment is impossible without mastering meditation and inner discipline.
simple_meaning: True fulfillment for a yogi cannot happen without gaining control through meditation.
insight: It shifts your focus from external results to cultivating steady inner awareness through meditation.
modern_relevance: You might finish many tasks but still feel empty; this shows that without inner calm from meditation, success feels hollow.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
ध्येयवैचित्र्यतो नूनं ध्यानं ज्ञेयं चतुर्विधम्।
मन्त्रयोगिगणाः स्थूल-ध्यानं हि हठयोगिनः ॥
translation: ध्येय के वैचित्र्य के विचार से ध्यान चार प्रकार का होता है। मन्त्रयोगी स्थूलध्यान, हठयोगी
english_translation: Due to the diversity of objects of concentration, meditation is of four kinds; mantra yogis practice gross meditation, and hatha yogis practice gross meditation.
essence: Meditation’s form depends on what you focus your mind upon.
simple_meaning: Meditation can take four forms depending on what you concentrate on. Different yogis practice different types based on their methods.
insight: It shifts your view from one fixed meditation style to appreciating diverse approaches based on your focus.
modern_relevance: When you try to meditate, you might wonder why others do it differently. This verse reminds you that meditation adapts to your focus and method.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
ज्योतिर्धायनं तथा बिन्दु-ध्यानन्तु लययोगिनः ।
राजयोगिगणा देवाः ! ब्रह्मध्यानं प्रकुर्वते ॥
translation: ज्योतिर्ध्यान, लययोगी बिन्दुध्यान और राजयोगिगण ब्रह्मध्यान के द्वारा
english_translation: Meditators on the light, meditators on the point, and royal yogis perform meditation on the supreme reality.
essence: Meditation can take many forms, all leading toward the supreme reality.
simple_meaning: Meditators use different methods—focusing on light, a point, or the supreme reality—to deepen their practice.
insight: Recognize meditation is flexible; picking a focus aligned with you deepens your inner calm.
modern_relevance: When your mind wanders during meditation, choosing a focus like light, a point, or big truth helps steady your attention.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
स्वध्येयानां प्रकुर्वाणा ध्यानन्ते विधिपूर्वकम् ।
ध्यायमानास्तु मामेव कृतकृत्या भवन्त्यहो ॥
translation: अपने अपने ध्येयों का विधिपूर्वक ध्यान करके मेरा ही ध्यान करते हुए कृतार्थता को लाभ करते हैं
english_translation: Those who meditate on their own goals with proper discipline ultimately reach fulfillment by focusing solely on me.
essence: Disciplined meditation on personal goals leads to true fulfillment only when focused on the divine.
simple_meaning: You can meditate on your personal goals in a disciplined way, but true fulfillment comes when your focus rests on the divine.
insight: Shift your disciplined focus from just your goals to the divine to achieve true fulfillment.
modern_relevance: You set goals and work hard, but lasting satisfaction comes when you connect your efforts to a deeper purpose beyond yourself.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
समाधिरन्तिमं देवाः ! योगारोहणमष्टमम् ।
एकतश्चित्तवृत्तीनां निरोधोऽशेपतो भवेत् ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! समाधि अष्टम और अन्तिम सोपान है। एक ओर चित्तवृत्ति का पूर्ण निरोध और
english_translation: O divine beings! The eighth and final stage of yoga is samadhi, the complete cessation of all fluctuations of the mind.
essence: Ultimate yoga is the complete stillness of the restless mind’s waves.
simple_meaning: The last step in yoga is reaching samadhi, where all mental activity stops completely.
insight: It teaches you to recognize and move toward a mental state free from all disturbance.
modern_relevance: After endless distractions, you find a moment when your mind is fully silent and peaceful.
speaker: Shakti

verse_text:
द्वितीयतस्तु भो देवाः ! प्रकाशो द्रष्टुरात्मनः ।
यया साधनया नूनं जायते स्वस्वरूपतः ॥
translation: दूसरी ओर द्रष्टा आत्मा का अपने स्वस्वरूप में प्रकाश जिस साधन के द्वारा हो
english_translation: On the other hand, the seer’s own true self shines forth by a certain means.
essence: Your true self shines forth through the right inner spiritual means.
simple_meaning: Your inner true self becomes visible through a proper inner practice or method.
insight: It teaches you to use disciplined inner practices to witness your true nature clearly.
modern_relevance: When you quiet distractions and focus your mind correctly, your deeper self naturally reveals itself.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
प्रचक्षते समाधि त योगतत्वविशारदाः।
सविकल्पः सुपर्वाणः ! निर्विकल्पस्तथैव च ॥
translation: योगतत्त्वज्ञ उसको समाधि कहते हैं। समाधि के दो भेद योगिश्रेष्ठ कहते हैं, यथा-सविकल्प समाधि और निर्विकल्प समाधि।
english_translation: Those who understand the essence of yoga call that state samadhi. The greatest yogis say there are two types: samadhi with concepts and samadhi without concepts.
essence: Samadhi can include subtle mental concepts or transcend all concepts entirely.
simple_meaning: Samadhi is the deep yoga state of absorbed presence. There are two kinds: one where the mind still holds subtle concepts, and one where all concepts dissolve.
insight: It teaches you to recognize different depths of mental absorption, easing judgment about your meditation experience.
modern_relevance: Sometimes you find calm while still thinking clearly; other times you reach silence beyond thought, both valuable in managing stress and focus.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
समाधोद्विविधो भेदो भण्यते योगकोविदः।
पुनरावर्तते योगी सविकल्पसमाधितः ॥
translation: सविकल्प समाधि से योगी की पुनरावृत्ति होती है
english_translation: The learned yoga practitioner says there are two kinds of samadhi; the yogi with conceptual absorption repeats.
essence: Some mental stillness holds concepts and repeats, not breaking free.
simple_meaning: There are two types of deep meditative absorption: one where the mind still holds concepts, which causes the yogi to repeat the experience.
insight: It teaches you to notice when mental stillness is incomplete and to seek deeper awareness beyond concepts.
modern_relevance: You sit quietly, thinking you are calm, but your mind keeps replaying the same worries or ideas, trapping you in repetition.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अमाधिः शाश्वती मुक्ति निर्विकल्पस्तु यच्छति ।
अतो वदन्ति विद्वांसो योगतत्वानुचिन्तकाः ॥
translation: परन्तु निर्विकल्प समाधि शाश्वत मुक्ति देने वाली है। इस कारण योगतत्त्वज्ञ विद्वान्
english_translation: But samadhi without distinctions grants eternal freedom; therefore, the wise who contemplate yoga truths say so.
essence: Eternal freedom arises when your mind is free of all distinctions in samadhi.
simple_meaning: Complete samadhi without any mental divisions leads to lasting freedom beyond change.
insight: It shifts your focus from chasing fragmented experiences to resting in unified, undivided awareness.
modern_relevance: When your mind stops splitting into endless thoughts and judgments, you feel a deep, lasting freedom.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
निर्बीजं  निर्विकल्पन्तु सविकल्पं सवीजकम् ।
शुक्लगत्या यया लभ्य ऊर्द्धवलोकव्रजोखिलः॥
translation: सविकल्प को सबीज और निर्विकल्प को निर्बीज भी कहते है । सब उधर्वलोकों की प्राप्ति
english_translation: Everything with distinctions is called seeded; everything without distinctions is seedless; through pure consciousness, all higher realms are attained.
essence: Pure awareness beyond distinctions reveals all higher realms.
simple_meaning: Things with distinctions have seeds; things without distinctions do not. Through pure consciousness beyond thought, all higher realms can be reached.
insight: It shifts your focus from conceptual thinking to pure awareness, enabling access to subtler realms of experience.
modern_relevance: Your mind labels and divides experience constantly. When you let go of these distinctions, you open to deeper understanding and higher possibilities.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
सैव शुक्ला गतिर्देवा एति तेषामधीनताम् ।
सविकल्पसमाधौ ये तस्थिवांसो हि योगिनः॥
translation: जिस शुक्ल गति के द्वारा होती है, वह गति सविकल्प समाधिस्थ योगियों के अधीन है
english_translation: The divine movements that arise through pure consciousness belong to yogis absorbed in meditative samadhi with mental activity.
essence: Pure movements arise from yogis absorbed in samadhi with subtle mental activity.
simple_meaning: The purest movements or flows come from yogis who remain in samadhi with the mind still active.
insight: It teaches you that deep absorption can include subtle inner mental activity, combining stillness with attentive presence.
modern_relevance: When you focus deeply yet remain mentally alert, your actions flow with clarity and power rather than dullness or distraction.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
जीवन्मुक्ताः परा भक्ता ज्ञानिनः सहजां गताः।
प्रभवन्यधिकर्तु मे समाधि निर्विकल्पकम ॥
translation: परन्तु सहजगति प्राप्त जीवन्मुक्त मेरे ज्ञानी भक्त निर्विकल्प समाधि के अधिकारी होते हैं।
english_translation: The liberated beings who have attained natural effortless union are supreme devotees and wise ones qualified for the undifferentiated state of absorbed presence.
essence: Effortless liberation blends devotion and wisdom into deep undistracted presence.
simple_meaning: Those who are naturally free and united with the divine are both devoted and wise, able to enter deep absorbed presence without distraction.
insight: It shifts focus from striving to surrendering into natural effortless presence as the highest state.
modern_relevance: You’ve reached a point where spiritual effort feels natural, and your mind rests deeply without struggle.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
स्वदेहं नीचगेहे ते जह्युर्वा जाह्नवीतटे ।
विप्र्भेद्दा विदेहा वा मामेव प्राप्नुवन्ति ते ॥
translation: वह चाहे नीचों के गृह में शरीर त्याग करें अथवा गङ्गा के तट पर शरीर त्याग करें, वह शरीर रहते भी मुझको प्राप्त है और शरीर त्याग करने पर भी मुझको ही प्राप्त होते हैं
english_translation: Whether someone gives up the body in a lowly home or on the banks of the Ganges, they reach me both while living and after death.
essence: Your connection to the divine transcends body, place, and status at all times.
simple_meaning: Wherever and however you leave your body, your true self connects with the divine beyond physical form or place.
insight: It shifts focus from external conditions to the inner continuity of connection with the divine, freeing you from attachment to place or status.
modern_relevance: You might feel stuck by your current situation or background, but your inner connection to what matters is always beyond those limits.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
निर्विकल्पसमाधिस्थैयोगिराजै: सहास्ति में।
काचिद्विभिन्नता नैव सत्यमेतद्रवीमि वः ॥
translation: निर्विकल्प समाधिप्राप्त योगिराजों में और मुझमें कोई भेद नहीं है इसको मैं तुमसे सत्य कहती हूँ
english_translation: There is no difference between the yogic kings in the state of undisturbed absorption and me; this I tell you as truth.
essence: Complete absorbed presence reveals there is no separation between you and the highest yogic beings.
simple_meaning: In the deepest state of complete stillness, there is no difference between the highest yogis and the divine presence speaking here.
insight: Recognize that the highest states of awareness are accessible and shared, not exclusive or distant.
modern_relevance: When you experience moments of complete focus and calm, you touch the same deep unity that great yogis have reached, dissolving separation.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
संयमश्चैकवत्वं च शक्तिद्वयमलौकिकम् ।
पुरो यो वासुतं देवाः ! मया सम्यकतयाऽनघाः! ॥
translation: हे निष्पाप देवगण ! मैंने जो पहले संयम और एकतत्त्वरूपी अलौकिक दो शक्तियों का वर्णन तुमसे सम्यक्तया किया है।
english_translation: O sinless gods! I have clearly described to you earlier the two divine powers: restraint and unity.
essence: Two extraordinary powers, restraint and unity, were clearly explained earlier.
simple_meaning: I have already explained clearly two extraordinary powers: restraint and unity, to you pure divine beings.
insight: Recognize the importance of disciplined restraint and unified focus as foundational powers previously introduced.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
जायते संयमस्तत्र धारणाभृमितो ध्रुवम् ।
ध्यानभूम्यास्तु भो देवाः ! एकतत्त्वं प्रजायते ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! उनमें संयम धारणाभूमि और एकतत्व ध्यानभूमि से निश्चय प्रकट होता है
english_translation: O divine beings! From restraint arises a steady focus, and from the ground of meditation, unity emerges with certainty.
essence: Steady restraint and meditation together bring certain experience of unity.
simple_meaning: When you practice restraint, your focus becomes steady, and through meditation, you realize oneness with certainty.
insight: It teaches you to use restraint to steady your mind, enabling meditation to reveal unified awareness.
modern_relevance: When you pause distractions and hold steady attention, your mind naturally clarifies, revealing deeper connection and certainty.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
अयं हि धारणाध्यान-समाधनि क्रियात्मकम् ।
दृश्याश्रयात्मयुक्तं सनिर्जराः ! संयमो भवेत् ॥
translation: धारणा ध्यान और समाधि इन तीनों की क्रियाएँ जब इस दृश्य के अवलम्बन से प्रयुक्त होती हैं तब उसको संयम कहते हैं
english_translation: When the practices of concentration, meditation, and absorbed presence are united with the support of what is seen, that is called self-restraint.
essence: Discipline arises when focused inner practices are rooted in what you actually see.
simple_meaning: Discipline means practicing concentration, meditation, and absorbed presence all grounded in what you actually perceive.
insight: It teaches you to anchor your mental practices in present experience, not just abstract effort.
modern_relevance: When distractions pull you away, discipline is the steady attention you bring back to what’s right in front of you.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
यदा त्वावत्मानमुद्दिश्य त्रयमेतत् प्रयुज्यते।
एकतत्त्वं तदोदेति ह्योपा वैदान्ति की श्रुतिः ॥
translation: और जब केवल आत्मा के लक्ष्य से प्रयुक्त होती है तब एकतत्त्व का उदय होता है। यही उपनिषद का रहस्य है
english_translation: When the three are united with the true self alone, then the one essence arises; this is the secret of the Upanishads.
essence: True unity arises when all parts focus solely on the true self.
simple_meaning: When your mind, body, and inner self are focused on your true self, a single unified essence appears.
insight: Shift your attention from fragmented distractions to the unified presence of your true self; this brings clarity and peace.
modern_relevance: When your thoughts, feelings, and actions all focus on your deepest true self, life feels whole and clear.
speaker: Devi

verse_text:
प्रोद्धोधयति जीवेषु नानाशक्तीहि संयमः।
ऐशीनैवात्र  सन्देहो नाऽलं मोचयितुं त्वसौ ॥
translation: संयम अनन्त ऐशी शक्तियों को जीवों में प्रकट करता है यह निःसन्देह है परन्तु
english_translation: Control surely awakens many powers within living beings, but it cannot liberate them.
