english_translation: Having listened well to many ancient texts, I feel deeply grateful. You yourself once spoke to me before.
essence: True gratitude arises when teachings come from a trusted, familiar source.
simple_meaning: I am deeply thankful after hearing many ancient stories. You once told me the same yourself.
insight: Acknowledging past guidance strengthens trust and opens the mind to deeper learning.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
आवागमनचक्रस्य गति यश्चावबुध्यते ।
मुक्तः स एव कैवल्यं पदं प्राप्तुमलं त्विति ॥
translation: जो आवागमनचक्र की गति को जान जाता है वही उससे मुक्त होकर कैवल्यपद का अधिकारी हो सकता है
english_translation: One who understands the cycle of coming and going is freed and attains the pure state of complete freedom.
essence: Knowing the cycle of coming and going reveals complete inner freedom beyond it.
simple_meaning: When you clearly perceive that life moves in endless cycles, you become free and can reach complete inner freedom.
insight: It shifts your mind from feeling trapped by repetitive patterns to recognizing your freedom beyond them.
modern_relevance: You notice how your thoughts and emotions repeat, yet you are not those patterns—they don't define or limit you.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अतो मां कृपया नाथ ! शाखमेवंविधं हितम् ।
निशामयस्व येनाहं ज्ञातुं शक्नोमि सत्वरम् ॥
translation: अतः हे नाथ ! कृपया मुझे ऐसा हितकर शास्त्र इस समय सुनाइए जिससे मैं अवश्य अधिकारी बन सकू
english_translation: Therefore, O Lord, please kindly reveal to me such beneficial teaching now by which I may quickly become capable of understanding.
essence: Asking for clear, beneficial teaching opens the way to quick understanding.
simple_meaning: Please show me a helpful teaching now that I can quickly understand and benefit from.
insight: It shifts your attitude from confusion to openness, inviting precise guidance that helps you move forward.
modern_relevance: You’ve hit a wall and ask a mentor for clear advice that will finally make sense of your confusion.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
आवागमनचक्रस्य रहस्यं साम्प्रतं गते: ।
अधिकुर्य्याञ्च मोक्षाख्यं यथा नूनं परम्पदम् ॥
translation: आवागमनचक्र की गति के रहस्य को  शीघ्र समझ सकूँ और जिससे मुकिरूप उत्तम पद का अवश्य अधिकारी बन सकू
english_translation: May I quickly understand the secret of the cycle of coming and going, and thereby certainly become worthy of the highest state called liberation.
essence: Longing to grasp the mystery that frees from repeated cycles.
simple_meaning: The speaker wishes to quickly understand the secret of the cycle of birth and death to gain the highest freedom.
insight: It encourages cultivating earnest longing and openness to profound understanding as the first step on a spiritual journey.
modern_relevance: You may feel eager to understand patterns that keep repeating in your life, hoping for a breakthrough to lasting freedom.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
प्रियशिष्य ! प्रसन्नोऽहं तत्र ज्ञानपिपासया ।
जगत्कल्याणसम्पत्त्यै प्रवृत्या चानिशं परम् ॥
translation: हे प्रिय शिष्य ! मैं तुम्हारी ज्ञान पिपासा और अहर्निश जगत कल्याण वृद्धि की परम प्रवृत्ति से प्रसन्न हूँ
english_translation: Dear disciple, I am pleased by your thirst for wisdom and your constant commitment to the welfare of the world.
essence: Joy arises when deep learning and world welfare unite in constant effort.
simple_meaning: The speaker expresses joy at the disciple's eagerness to learn and dedication to improving the world without pause.
insight: It teaches you that sincere curiosity and selfless commitment are themselves sources of fulfillment.
modern_relevance: You feel recognized when your eagerness to grow and help others is noticed and valued.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अतस्तुभ्यमहं सूतोपनिषत्साररूपिणीम् ।
अपूर्वो महतीं गीतां श्रावयिप्ये महामते ! ॥
translation: अतः हे महामते सूते!. मैं तुमको उपनिषदों की साररूप एक अत्यन्त अपूर्व गीता सुनाऊंगा
english_translation: Therefore, O great-minded Suta, I will now recite to you a most extraordinary song that embodies the essence of the Upanishads.
essence: A unique, profound teaching will now be shared embodying the Upanishads' essence.
simple_meaning: I will now share a unique and important song that captures the core teachings of the Upanishads.
insight: This moment marks the beginning of a deep teaching by framing it as a rare and essential truth.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
यथा ज्ञानपिपासा ते शान्ता सामयिकी भवेत् ।
तापतप्तपिपासेव शीतलैगाङ्गिवारिभिः ॥
translation: जिससे तुम्हारी इस समय की ज्ञानपिपासा इस प्रकार तृप्त हो जायगी जिस प्रकार ताप से सन्तप्त प्राणी की पिपासा शीतल गंगाजल से तृप्त हो जाती है
english_translation: Just as a being burning from heat is quenched by cool Ganges water, your current thirst for knowledge will be satisfied.
essence: A burning thirst for knowledge will be naturally quenched by the right wisdom.
simple_meaning: Your current strong desire to understand will be satisfied just like a thirsty, overheated person quenches thirst with cool water.
insight: It teaches you to trust that intense yearning for understanding will naturally resolve with patience and openness.
modern_relevance: You’ve been restless, craving answers late into the night. Soon, clarity will come and ease that burning need.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
पूर्वमेव मया प्रोक्तं तुभ्यं सूत ? महामनः !।
प्रधानसृष्टिरुपिण्या मर्त्यसप्टेर्नियामकः ॥
translation: हे महामना ! सृत ! मैंने तुमको  पहले ही कहा है कि प्रधान सृष्टि रूपी मनुष्य सृष्टि का नियामक
english_translation: O great-minded Suta, I have already told you that the primal creation is the regulator of the sevenfold human creation.
essence: A primal source governs the complex layers of mortal existence.
simple_meaning: The primal creation controls the sevenfold mortal creation, as previously explained to Suta.
insight: Recognize that underlying complex systems is a fundamental source organizing them.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
आस्ते वार्णाश्रमो धर्मो नात्र काचिद्विचारणा ।
वर्णाश्रमाणां धर्माणां साहाय्यात पितरोऽखिलाः ॥
translation: वर्णाश्रमधर्म है, इसमें कुछ विचारने की बात नहीं है । वर्णाश्रमधर्म की सहायता से
english_translation: The duty of the social orders and stages of life exists; there is no question about it. All ancestors have supported the duties of the social orders and stages of life.
essence: The duties of social orders and life stages are established and supported by all ancestors.
simple_meaning: The duties assigned by social orders and life stages are established and unquestioned, supported by all ancestors.
insight: It shows how inherited social frameworks can provide stability but also warns that unquestioned duties may not always suit individual growth.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
गतेः क्रमोद्धर्व गामिन्याः मानवानां विधायकाः। 
वर्णाश्रमाख्यधर्मस्य ह्रासे जाते कदाचन ॥
translation: मनुष्य की क्रमोद्धर्व गति के विधायक सब पितृगण हैं। किसी समय वर्णाश्रम धर्म में शिथिलता हो जाने से
english_translation: The ancestors are the makers of the upward progress of human beings. Sometimes, decline occurs in the duties of the caste and stage system.
essence: Human progress flows from ancestors, yet social duties can decline over time.
simple_meaning: Ancestors guide the progress of humanity. Sometimes the traditional social duties weaken or decline.
insight: Recognize that the foundations set by previous generations influence progress, but systems can falter without upkeep.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
पितृणां लोकसाधिन्यां व्यवस्थायामुपस्थिता ।
बाधना सर्वथा तात! लोकानां मुहृदस्तदा ॥
translation: पितरो की लोक हितकर व्यवस्था में सर्वथा बाधा हुई थी। हे तात ! उस समय सर्वलोकसुहृत्
english_translation: The ancestors' arrangement for the welfare of the world was completely obstructed. O father, at that time, the friend of all worlds was present.
essence: A vital world-supporting order was completely blocked at a critical time.
simple_meaning: The system set by the ancestors to support the world was fully blocked at that moment.
insight: Recognize that even strong, established systems can face complete disruption, requiring new understanding.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
देवर्पेनारदस्यैव सत्परामर्शतश्चिरम्।
तपस्तप्तं हि तैघोरं लोककल्याणकांक्षया ॥
translation: देवर्षि नारद जी के ही सत्परामर्श से पितरों ने बहुत दिनों तक लोगों के कल्याण की इच्छा से ही घोर तप किया था
english_translation: The ancestors performed severe austerities for a long time, inspired by the blessed advice of the sage Narada, desiring the welfare of the world.
essence: Inspired advice can lead to enduring, intense effort for the world's welfare.
simple_meaning: The ancestors did intense austerities for a long time, motivated by sage Narada's good advice and a wish for the world's welfare.
insight: It shows how sincere guidance and care can fuel sustained disciplined effort for the greater good.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
प्रसन्नस्तपसा तेषां शम्भुः श्रीभगवान स्वयम ।
सगुणेनाऽथ रूपेण प्रादुर्भुयोपदिष्टवान् ॥
translation: अनन्तर उनके तप से प्रसन्न होकर श्रीभगवान् शम्भु ने उनके सम्मुख स्वयं सगुणरूप में आविभूत होकर जो उपदेश दिया था
english_translation: Pleased by their disciplined effort, the divine Shambhu himself appeared before them in a manifest form and gave teachings again.
essence: Disciplined effort brings the divine presence to reveal teachings directly.
simple_meaning: After they showed disciplined effort, the divine Shambhu appeared before them in a visible form and gave teachings.
insight: It shows that consistent effort can invite clear guidance or breakthrough moments in your practice.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
उपदेशं तमेवाद्य त्वामहं वच्मि शाम्भवम् ।
शम्भुगीताभिधानेन ते लोकेषु प्रचारय ॥
translation: उसी शाम्भव उपदेश को अभी तुमसे मैं कहता हूँ । तुम जगत में उसको शम्भुगीता, नाम से प्रचार करो
english_translation: I now speak to you the teaching of Shambhu; spread it in the world as the Shambhu Gita.
essence: The teaching called Shambhu Gita is now given and must be spread.
simple_meaning: This verse announces the start of the teaching called the Shambhu Gita and instructs to spread it.
insight: Recognize when important knowledge is beginning and feel invited to share it widely.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अस्ति दैवासुरी सृष्टिर्लोकानां सुहृदेकतः।
चर्तुधा भूतसङ्घानां प्राकृती सृष्टिरन्यतः ॥
translation: हे लोकसुहृत् ! एक ओर देवासुर-सृष्टि और दूसरी ओर चतुर्विध भूतसंघ की प्राकृत सृष्टि है
english_translation: O friend of the world, there is on one side the divine and asura creation, and on the other side the natural creation of the fourfold beings.
essence: Existence includes two distinct creations: one divine and one natural fourfold.
simple_meaning: There are two main creations: one of divine and shadow beings, the other natural, made up of four types of beings.
insight: It encourages seeing the world as composed of both spiritual and material dimensions influencing life.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
स्वाधीना चैतयोर्मध्ये सृष्टिः पूर्णाङ्गसंयुता ।
कर्माधिकारिणी याऽऽस्ते सृष्टिः सैवास्ति मानवी ॥
translation: और इन दोनों के बीच में पूर्णा वयच और कर्म की अधिकारिणी जो स्वाधीन सृष्टि है वही मनुष्य सृष्टि है
english_translation: Among the two, the complete and independent creation that holds the authority of action is the human creation itself.
essence: Humans are the complete creation empowered with independent authority to act.
simple_meaning: Humans are the complete, independent creation that has the right and power to perform actions.
insight: Recognize your unique role as the independent doer with the authority to choose action.
modern_relevance: When you decide how to respond to challenges, you realize you alone hold the power to act and shape your path.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
यद्धर्मातिप्रभावेण मर्त्यसृष्टेगतिर्बुवम ।
क्रमोर्दध्वगामिनी तिष्ठेन्मानवानाञ्च योनितः ॥
translation: जिस धर्म के अत्यन्त प्रभाव से मनुष्य सृष्टि की कर्मो उद्धर्व गामिनी गति निश्चय बनी रहती है और
english_translation: When the overwhelming power of dharma firmly establishes the natural course of all beings in the world, both men and women abide by it.
essence: Strong dharma creates a steady, natural order for all human lives.
simple_meaning: The natural order of life and human paths become steady and certain when strongly guided by dharma.
insight: It shifts focus from resisting life’s flow to trusting and moving with the natural order dharma creates.
modern_relevance: When you commit to what is right and true, your life’s path gains a steady, reliable flow, easing confusion and doubt.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
प्राणिनः एतनाद्रक्षेद्धर्मो वर्णाश्रमोऽस्त्यसौ ।
नात्र कश्चन सन्देहो विद्यते मृत ! तात ! भोः ॥
translation: जीवों को मनुष्ययोनि से  पतन होने नहीं देता वह वर्णाश्रम धर्म है, हे तात सूत ! इसमें कुछ सन्देह नहीं है
english_translation: The dharma of varna and ashrama protects beings from falling into the human birth; there is no doubt about this, dear Suta.
essence: Living according to your life role prevents falling into lower states of existence.
simple_meaning: The system of varna and ashrama keeps beings from falling into a lower state by guiding their life roles; this is certain.
insight: It teaches you to respect your natural place and duties to maintain balance and avoid inner or outer downfall.
modern_relevance: When you commit to your responsibilities and life roles, you create stability and protect yourself from confusion or feeling lost.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
वर्णाश्रमाख्यधर्मेण पितरो वर्द्धिता भृशम् ।
जीवेभ्योऽभ्युदयं शश्वद्ददते नेह संशयः ॥
translation: वर्णाश्रम धर्म से अत्यन्त संवर्द्धित होकर पितृगण जीवों को सर्वदा अभ्युदय प्रदान किया करते हैं इसमें सन्देह नहीं है
english_translation: The ancestors, greatly nurtured by the duties of classes and stages of life, always grant well-being to living beings without doubt.
essence: Ancestors empowered by social duties continuously support the prosperity of living beings.
simple_meaning: Ancestors, supported by the system of social duties, always bring prosperity and well-being to all living beings.
insight: It highlights the sustaining role of inherited duties and traditions in supporting life and community well-being.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
वर्णाश्रमाख्यधर्मेषु शैथिल्य समुपस्थिते ।
कर्तुं कर्मोपयुक्तासु स्वाधीनास्वपि सृष्टिषु ॥
translation: हे सूत ! वर्णाश्रमधर्म के शिथिल हो जाने से कर्म करने की उपयोगिनी स्वाधीन सृष्टि में
english_translation: O Suta, when the duties of the social orders and stages of life become lax, even the acts fit for performing become unstable in the created world.
essence: Weakening clear duties destabilizes even the right actions in the world.
simple_meaning: When the clear duties of social roles and life stages weaken, even suitable actions become unstable in the world.
insight: Recognize that weakening your commitment to clear duties disrupts your ability to act effectively and confidently.
modern_relevance: You feel uncertain when your roles at work or home become unclear, making your efforts feel unstable or ineffective.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
जायते मानवानां भोः सूत  ! नून विषर्ययः ।
स्वाधीनसृष्टिपुजेषु ध्रुवं जाते विषर्यये ॥
translation: मानव दृष्टि में भी अवश्य निर्यय होता है, हे सूत ! स्वाधीनसृष्टि समूह में विपर्यय होने से ही सब प्रकार की
english_translation: O Suta, in human perception, change surely occurs; in the free natural world, change is constant and certain.
essence: Change is certain both in human perception and in the free natural world.
simple_meaning: Human perception always involves change; in the free natural world, change is constant and inevitable.
insight: It teaches you to recognize impermanence as a fundamental truth, easing attachment to fixed outcomes.
modern_relevance: You realize your thoughts, feelings, and surroundings never stay the same, no matter how much you want stability.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
विप्लवः सृष्टिषु प्राज्ञ ! भवेत्सर्वविधास्वपि। 
भीषणोदर्कमेवैतदृदृष्ट्वा पितृगणैः खलु ॥
translation: सृष्टि में भी विप्लव होने की अवश्य सम्भावना रहती है; हे प्राज्ञ इसी भीषण परिणाम को देखकर ही पितरों ने
english_translation: In creation, upheaval is always possible; seeing this terrible consequence, the ancestors indeed...
essence: Upheaval is always possible in creation and demands awareness.
simple_meaning: Upheaval or disruption can occur in any form of creation; the ancestors recognized this serious danger.
insight: It teaches you to expect change and prepare for difficult consequences in any situation.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
तपस्तप्तं पुरा घोरं विश्वकल्याणसम्पदे।
स्वतपस्याप्रभावेण तोपितो भगवांश्च तैः ॥
translation: विश्वकल्याण-संम्पादन के लिये युग काल में घोर तपस्या की थी और अपनी तपस्या के प्रभाव से उन्होंने
english_translation: In ages past, intense austerities were undertaken to achieve universal well-being, and by the power of those austerities, the divine was honored.
essence: Intense austerity for universal welfare honors the divine through its power.
simple_meaning: Long ago, powerful austerities were done to bring about universal welfare, and by their power, the divine was honored.
insight: It shows how dedicated effort focused on the greater good influences the world beyond immediate results.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
सर्वशक्तयालयः शम्भुः सर्वलोकहितमदः।
अन्वभावि तदा तात ! सर्वैः पितृगणैश्च तैः ॥
translation: सर्वशक्तिमान् सर्वलोकहितकर भगवान् शम्भु को प्रसन्न किया था। हे तात! उस समय उन सब पितरो ने अनुभव किया कि
english_translation: Shambhu, the all-powerful and benefactor of all worlds, was pleased. Then, O father, all the forefathers experienced that.
essence: The divine's pleasure is felt by all connected ancestral beings.
simple_meaning: Shambhu, the all-powerful divine being who cares for all worlds, became pleased, and then all the forefathers experienced that joy.
insight: It shows how a vital presence's harmony influences the entire community connected to it.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
सप्तानां स्वरसङ्घानां स्वरूपस्य समष्टितः ।
ओङ्कारध्वनितो दिव्यं कोटिमूर्याधिकप्रभम ॥
translation: सप्त स्वरों के रूप की समष्टि रूप ओंकार ध्वनि से एक दिव्य कोटि सूर्य से भी अधिक प्रभावान्
english_translation: The collective essence of the seven musical notes, in their true form, shines as the divine Om sound, brighter than a million suns.
essence: The seven notes unite as Om, a sound surpassing even immense cosmic radiance.
simple_meaning: The seven musical notes together form a divine sound, Om, which shines more brightly than millions of suns.
insight: It reveals that ordinary elements like sound can symbolize vast cosmic power and presence.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
एकं प्रादुरभूज्ज्योतिरुज्ज्वलं सुमनोहरम ।
तज्ज्योतिरन्तरा शम्भुरासीनः प्रणवासन ॥
translation: एक समुज्वल सुमनोहर ज्योतिः प्रकट हुई। उस ज्योति के अन्तर्गत प्रणावासनालीन लोक शंकर महादेव भगवान्
english_translation: A single radiant and beautiful light appeared. Beneath that light sat Shambhu, the lord of the sacred syllable.
essence: A radiant light reveals Shambhu seated within the sacred cosmic sound.
simple_meaning: A bright, beautiful light appeared, and under it sat Shambhu, the divine being connected with the sacred sound.
insight: It invites you to recognize that profound presence often shines quietly beneath all appearances.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
प्रादुर्भूतो महादेवो भगवाँल्लोकशङ्करः।
शुभैस्तदङ्गवर्णैस्तु गिरयो राजता अलम् ॥
translation: शम्भु प्राविभूत हुए। उनके शुभ्र अंग वर्णों से अगणित रजत गिरि अत्यन्त तिरस्कृत हो रहे थे।
english_translation: Mahadeva, the revered Lord of the world, manifested; countless silver mountains were utterly shamed by his radiant white limbs.
essence: Shiva's radiant form surpasses even countless shining mountains.
simple_meaning: Shiva appeared in his glorious form, so radiant that countless silver mountains seemed humbled by his brightness.
insight: Recognize that true greatness shines from within and overshadows external grandeur.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अमिता अव्धीर्यन्ते त्रिभिनेत्ररलङ्कृतः ।
विभ्रदिव्यं जटाजूटं भस्मभृपितविग्रहः ॥
translation: तीन नेत्रों से सुशोभित थे, दिव्य जटा जूटधारी भस्मभूषितकलेवर
english_translation: He was adorned with three eyes, divine matted hair, and a body smeared with sacred ash.
essence: The divine appears with three eyes, sacred ash, and matted hair as signs of power.
simple_meaning: He is described visually by his three eyes, divine matted hair, and a body covered with sacred ash.
insight: The verse invites seeing the divine as beyond ordinary form, marked by powerful symbols.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
त्रिशूलं खर्परं शृङ्गीं दधानो डमरुन्तथा ।
चतुभिर्दिव्यहस्तैः स्वैः नागयज्ञोपवीतवान ॥
translation: अपने चारों दिव्य हाथों में डमरू खप्पर त्रिशूल और सींग धारण किये हुये हैं, अनन्त नाग जिनके यज्ञोपवीत है
english_translation: He holds a drum, a skull, a trident, and a horn in his four divine hands, wearing the sacred thread of the infinite serpent.
essence: The divine's power and mystery are shown through sacred symbols held and worn.
simple_meaning: Shiva is described holding four sacred objects in his four divine hands, wearing the serpent as a sacred thread.
insight: Symbols can convey deep meaning and presence beyond words or direct description.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
व्याघ्रचर्माम्बरं दिव्यं वसानः शोभते भृशम् ।
तदवामांके समासीना षोडशी सर्वमुन्दरी ॥
translation: दिव्य व्याघ्रचर्म रूपी वस्त्र को पहने हुए हैं जिससे बहुत ही सुशोभित हो रहे हैं। उनके वाम अंक पर बैठी हुई सर्वसुन्दरी
english_translation: He shines brightly wearing the divine tiger-skin garment; on his left arm sits the most beautiful woman.
essence: Shiva’s divine presence shines adorned with tiger skin and a beautiful companion.
simple_meaning: He wears a divine tiger-skin garment and looks radiant; a beautiful maiden sits on his left arm.
insight: The verse invites recognition of divine majesty through symbolic imagery rather than direct teaching.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
पूर्णशक्तिमयी श्यामा तस्य वैभवपूर्णताम्।
सम्पादयन्ती सततं मनोज्ञा राजतेतराम् ॥
translation: पूर्णशक्तिमयी मनोहारिणी षोडशी श्यामा उनके वैभव की पूर्णता को निरन्तर सम्पादित करती हुई अत्यन्त सुशोभित है।
english_translation: The sixteen-armed dark goddess, full of complete power, continuously manifests the fullness of his splendor, shining beautifully beyond the mind.
essence: The divine’s radiant power and beauty continuously shine beyond the limits of the mind.
simple_meaning: A powerful, beautiful divine figure continuously expresses fullness beyond what your mind can grasp.
insight: It invites you to open beyond mental limits and appreciate the divine’s fullness as a living presence.
modern_relevance: You see someone radiating calm strength and beauty that feels beyond what you can fully understand or explain.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
पाशाङ्कुशौ च विभ्राणा 'लोचनत्रयभूषिता ।
कल्याणं जंगतां कर्त्तु मन्दस्मितमनोरमा ॥
translation: वह पाश और अंकुश को धारण किये हुई हैं, त्रिलोचन से सुशोभित हैं और जगत का कल्याण करने के लिये ईषत् हास्य से शोभायमान है।
english_translation: She holds a noose and a goad, adorned with three eyes, and with a gentle smile, shines to protect the world.
essence: Power and kindness combine to protect and guide the world.
simple_meaning: She wears a noose and a goad, has three eyes, and smiles gently to protect the world.
insight: Symbolic tools represent control over forces; gentle presence balances power with compassion.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
दिव्यमेवंविधं रूपं सगुणं पितरस्तदा ।
आलोक्याऽऽशान्विताः सन्तो बद्धहस्ताः ययाचिरे ॥
translation: उस समय ऐसे दिव्य सगुण रूप को देखकर पितृगण आशान्वित होकर हाथो को जोड़कर प्रार्थना करने लगे।
english_translation: At that time, seeing such a divine form with qualities, the ancestors, hopeful, joined their hands and began to pray.
essence: Seeing a divine form naturally inspires hopeful reverence and prayer.
simple_meaning: Ancestors saw a divine form and, filled with hope, folded their hands to pray.
insight: It shows how recognition of something greater naturally invites reverence and hope.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
विश्वेश्वर ! वयं भाविविश्वदुःखेन कातराः ।
निराकां हि तदुःखमापन्नाः शरणं तव ॥
translation: हे विश्वेश्वर ! हम जगत् के भावी दुःख से कातर हो उसके निराकरण के लिये ही आपके शरणागत हुए हैं
english_translation: O Lord of the universe! We are distressed by the future sufferings of the world and have taken refuge in you to remove that distress.
essence: Distress over future suffering leads to seeking refuge in the divine.
simple_meaning: They express deep worry about the world's future suffering and seek refuge in the divine for relief.
insight: It teaches you to seek support when faced with fears about the future beyond your control.
modern_relevance: You feel overwhelmed by the world's problems and seek comfort by connecting to something greater than yourself.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
साम्प्रतं मानवे लोके करुणावरुणालय !।
धर्मे विप्लवसद्भावात् प्रभो ! धर्मस्य तात्त्विकम् ॥
translation: हे करुणावरुणा लय प्रभो! इस समय मनुष्य लोक में धर्म विप्लव हो जाने से धर्म का यथार्थ
english_translation: O Lord of compassion and cosmic law! At this time, in the human world, the true nature of dharma is disturbed by confusion and decline.
essence: Confusion in the human world disrupts the true nature of dharma right now.
simple_meaning: Right now, in the human world, confusion has disturbed the true meaning of dharma, the natural order and purpose.
insight: It highlights how confusion about core values leads to uncertainty and distress in any society or life.
modern_relevance: You see news and social media filled with conflicting values, leaving you unsure about what really matters.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
सार्वभौमस्वरूपं वै लुप्तमायं प्रजास्वभूत् ।
वर्णाश्रमाख्यधर्मेभ्यः प्रजाश्रद्धोपसंहृतेः ॥
translation: सार्वभौमस्वरूप प्रजा प्रायः लुप्त ही हो गया है और 'वर्णाश्रम धर्म की ओर से प्रजा की श्रद्धा उठ जाने से ही
english_translation: The universal nature is lost among beings because the people have lost faith in the duties of caste and stage of life.
essence: Losing faith in your natural duties causes your sense of universal wholeness to vanish.
simple_meaning: When people lose faith in their natural duties and roles, their sense of universal order and unity disappears.
insight: It teaches you to restore trust in your role and duties to regain a sense of unity and purpose.
modern_relevance: You feel lost when you ignore the responsibilities tied to your role, breaking the balance within yourself and others.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
आर्यजातेः किलार्य्यत्वं लुसमायोऽभवञ्च तत् ।
भयभीता वयं जाता अतः शम्भो ! दयार्णव ! ॥
translation: आर्य जाति का आर्यत्व लुप्तप्राय हो गया है इस कारण हे दयार्णव शम्भो ! हम भयभीत हुए हैं ।
english_translation: The noble nature of the noble birth is nearly lost; therefore, O compassionate Shambhu, we have become fearful.
essence: Losing noble qualities rooted in birth causes fear that calls for compassionate help.
simple_meaning: The noble qualities connected with noble birth are nearly gone, causing us to feel afraid.
insight: It highlights how loss of core values triggers fear and calls for seeking compassionate support.
modern_relevance: You notice fear rising when the traditions or values you trusted seem to be disappearing around you.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
कस्मिंश्चित्समये दैव्यां सृष्टौ हि विप्लवे सति ।
यदि देवाप्सरे युद्धेऽसुराणां विजयो भवेत् ॥
translation: कालान्तर में दैवी सृष्टि में विप्लव होने पर यदि देवासुर संग्राम में असुरों की विजय हो जाय
english_translation: At some point in the divine creation, during a great upheaval, if in battle the Asuras were to win against the Devas,
essence: A battle where shadow beings triumph over radiant beings is a moment in cosmic upheaval.
simple_meaning: At some moment during the divine creation, if in a battle the forces of shadow were to win against the radiant beings,
insight: Recognize that conflict and upheaval are part of larger cycles and do not fully determine the outcome.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
तदा शम्भो ! भवत्यष्टौ भवेन्नूनं विपर्ययः ।
अतस्त्वच्छरणापन्ना वयं भीता अभूम ह ॥
translation: तो हे शम्भो! आपकी सृष्टि में अवश्य विपर्याय होगा इस कारण हम भयभीत होकर आपके शरणागत हुए हैं।
english_translation: O Shambhu! Your creation will surely face disorder; therefore, we have come to your refuge, fearful and helpless.
essence: Fear of inevitable disorder leads to seeking refuge in the divine.
simple_meaning: The speaker expresses fear because they believe that disorder will arise in Shambhu's creation, so they seek refuge in him.
insight: It highlights how awareness of inevitable challenges motivates turning to support beyond oneself.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
उपदिश्य, यथायोग्यमस्मानिः साध्वसान कुरु ।
एषा नः प्रार्थना नाथ ! साअलि त्वत्पदाम्बुजे ॥
translation: हमको यथायोग्य उपदेश देकर निर्भय करें, हे नाथ ! यही आपके चरणकमलों में हमारी साञ्जलि प्रार्थना है।
english_translation: Teach us appropriately and make us fearless, O Lord! This is our humble prayer at your lotus feet.
essence: Asking for teaching that removes fear is a humble, powerful prayer.
simple_meaning: You ask the divine to teach you properly so you become fearless. This humble request is made at the divine's feet.
insight: It invites you to approach learning and growth with humility and to seek guidance that builds courage.
modern_relevance: You feel stuck and unsure, so you quietly ask a trusted mentor for advice that helps you move forward without fear.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अपनोदयत स्वीयं चित्तस्थं भयमुल्वणम् ।
उपदेशेषु मे भूयः श्रद्धां कुरुत सत्तमाः ! ॥
translation: हे महानुभावो! अपने चिर के उत्कट भय को आप दूर करो और मेरे उपदेशों पर श्रद्धान्वित हो।
english_translation: O noble ones! Remove the intense fear within your own mind and deepen your trust in my teachings.
essence: Deep fear within can be eased by cultivating trust in wise guidance.
simple_meaning: You are asked to overcome your strong inner fear by placing sincere trust in these teachings.
insight: It teaches you to replace internal fear with faith in reliable wisdom, calming the restless mind.
modern_relevance: When anxious thoughts flood your mind, grounding yourself in trusted guidance can calm your inner storm.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
दूरीभूते भये वश्व जगद्गीतिर्विनचति ।
भवन्तो हि यतस्सन्ति स्थूलसृष्टेनियामकाः ॥
translation: आपका भय दूर होने पर जगत का भी भय दूर होगा क्योंकि आप लोग ही स्थूल सृष्टि के नियामक हैं ।
english_translation: When your fear disappears, the world's fear also vanishes because you are the controllers of the gross creation.
essence: Your freedom from fear shapes the fear experienced in the world you govern.
simple_meaning: When you let go of your fear, the fear in the world also lessens because you influence the physical world around you.
insight: It teaches you to see your inner state as a source of wider influence, inspiring responsibility for your emotional balance.
modern_relevance: You notice tension rising around you when you feel anxious; calming yourself can ease the atmosphere for everyone nearby.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
स्थूलसृष्टेश्च धात्रयस्ति सूक्ष्मप्टिन संशयः ।
प्राणिनः स्थूलदेहं हि प्राप्तवन्तो यथाविधम ॥
translation: स्थूलसृष्टि निःसन्देह सूक्ष्मसृष्टि की धात्री है, जिस प्रकार के स्थूल शरीर को जीव प्राप्त होते हैं
english_translation: The subtle elements are undoubtedly the source of the gross creation, just as living beings acquire gross bodies in due course.
essence: The visible world emerges from subtle elements just as bodies arise naturally.
simple_meaning: Subtle elements are the foundation of the visible world, just as living beings naturally acquire their physical bodies.
insight: It shows the connection between unseen subtle causes and visible effects, helping you see beyond appearances.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
तांद्दगेव प्रकुर्वन्ति कर्मेह पिनरो ध्रुवम् ।
नात्र कश्चन सन्देहः सत्यं सत्यं वदामि वः ॥
translation: पितृगण ! निश्चय उसी श्रेणी के कर्म वह यहां किया करते हैं इसमें कुछ सन्देह नहीं मैं आपलोगों से सत्य कहता हूँ।
english_translation: Ancestors certainly perform the same kind of actions here; there is no doubt in this, I tell you the truth.
essence: Ancestors unquestionably perform the same kinds of actions in their realm.
simple_meaning: Ancestors definitely perform the same kinds of actions here; there is no doubt about this.
insight: It reassures that certain patterns of action persist reliably, grounding understanding of cycles beyond immediate perception.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
भवत्स्वतः प्रसीदत्सु मानवानां निरन्तरम् ।
स्थूलदेहा जनिप्यन्ते नूनं धर्मसहायकाः ॥
translation: अतः आप सभी के प्रसन्न होने से निरन्तर ही मनुष्यों के स्थूलशरीर धर्म सहायक उत्पन्न होंगे।
english_translation: When you remain pleased, humans continually generate gross bodies that support dharma.
essence: Your inner joy helps life continuously create bodies that support the natural order.
simple_meaning: Your steady inner happiness helps humans keep forming bodies that support their true purpose.
insight: It teaches you that your inner state influences the ongoing creation and maintenance of life aligned with dharma.
modern_relevance: When you feel calm and content, your actions and presence contribute to stability and purpose around you, even beyond what you see.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
पितरो निश्चितं लोके धर्मगाम्भीर्यलोषतः ।
धार्मिको विप्लवो घोर उपातिष्ठत साम्प्रतम् ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! संसार में इस समय धर्म का गंभीरता के लोप होने से निश्चय घोर धर्मविप्लव उपस्थित हुआ है
english_translation: O ancestors, in this world, the severe loss of dharma has surely caused a terrible upheaval of unrighteousness at present.
essence: Loss of seriousness about dharma inevitably leads to deep societal chaos.
simple_meaning: When people stop taking dharma seriously, severe disorder and unrighteousness arise in the world.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that collective respect for ethical order is crucial to avoid societal collapse.
modern_relevance: You notice how a small lapse in shared values can quickly turn a community chaotic and untrustworthy.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
धार्मिके विप्लवे जाने धम्मै गौणं विदन्त्यहो।
अहम्मन्या जनाः सर्वे पापण्डे पण्डिता भृशम् ॥
translation: और धर्मविप्लव उपस्थित होने से यहाँ धर्म को अहम्मन्य और पाखण्ड में पण्डित सभी लोग अत्यन्त गौण समझने लगे हैं
english_translation: When the collapse of dharma occurs, all the learned who are arrogant consider dharma to be insignificant and hypocritical.
essence: Arrogance makes even the wise dismiss dharma as meaningless and false.
simple_meaning: When dharma collapses, even learned people become arrogant and see dharma as unimportant and hypocritical.
insight: It teaches you to watch how arrogance can distort your view of what truly matters.
modern_relevance: You might notice how when core values weaken, even smart people defend harmful shortcuts out of pride.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
शाश्वतस्य च धर्मस्य सार्वभौमस्वरूपकम् ।
जानीयुर्मानवाः किं नु धर्माचर्य्यगणा अपि ॥
translation: और शाश्वत धर्म के सार्वभौम स्वरूप को मनुष्य तो, क्या जाने धर्माचार्यों ने भी
english_translation: Even the dharma teachers do not truly know the universal nature of eternal dharma, so how would ordinary humans?
essence: Even the most learned cannot fully know the eternal, universal dharma.
simple_meaning: The true, universal nature of eternal dharma is so vast that even those who teach it cannot fully understand it, let alone ordinary people.
insight: It shifts your perspective from expecting certainty to embracing ongoing inquiry and humility.
modern_relevance: When you think you’ve mastered a life principle, remember even experts don’t hold all the answers. It invites patience with yourself.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अज्ञात्वा तत्स्वरूपं हि पथो निमिरे पृथक् ।
कुमार्गमवलम्बन्ते भ्रान्ता यैरेव मानवाः ॥
translation: उसके स्वरूप को न समझकर स्वतन्त्र पन्थ निर्माण किये हैं जिनसे ही भ्रान्त होकर मनुष्य कुपथगामी बनते हैं।
english_translation: Not knowing the true nature of that, humans create separate paths and, confused by them, stray onto wrong ways.
essence: Confusion arises when you ignore true nature and build false separate paths.
simple_meaning: Without understanding the true nature of reality, people create their own separate paths and get confused, leading them away from the right way.
insight: It teaches you to question and seek the true nature behind appearances before choosing your path.
modern_relevance: You might find yourself juggling conflicting advice or beliefs, feeling stuck because you haven't yet seen the core truth that would unify your direction.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
धर्मगाम्भीर्यनाशेन मानवानाञ्च बुद्धयः।
बहिर्मुखीनाः सम्वृत्ता इन्द्रियेषु परायणाः ॥
translation: और धर्म की गंभीरता का नाश होने से ही मनुष्यों की बुद्धि बहिर्मुखीन और इन्द्रियपरायण हो गई है
english_translation: When the seriousness of dharma is lost, human intelligence turns outward and becomes enslaved to the senses.
essence: Losing respect for dharma makes the mind restless and enslaved to the senses.
simple_meaning: When people stop taking their true purpose seriously, their intelligence turns outward and becomes controlled by their senses.
insight: This verse shifts your focus from external temptations back to honoring your deeper responsibilities and discipline.
modern_relevance: You scroll endlessly on your phone, losing sense of purpose as your attention surrenders to fleeting distractions.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
निमज्जेयुर्यथा पूर्णे सुगभीरे जलाशये ।
अनेकेऽपि गजाः सम्यक् किन्तु तस्य जलं यदि ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! जिस प्रकार जलपूर्ण सुगंभीर जलाशय में अनेक हस्ती भी अच्छी तरह डूबी जा सकते हैं परन्तु उस जलाशय का जल यदि
english_translation: Just as many elephants can be fully submerged in a deep, full lake, but the water of that lake...
essence: External pressures can be many, yet the true nature remains unchanged beneath them.
simple_meaning: Many large elephants can be fully submerged in a deep, full waterbody, yet the water itself remains unaffected.
insight: It teaches that external circumstances, no matter how overwhelming, do not alter the underlying essence.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
क्षेत्रे प्रसारयेत्कापि महासीम्नि पितृवजा:।
शशकोऽपि तदा तत्र निमज्जेन्नैव कहिर्चित्त ॥
translation: किसी बड़े मैदान में फैला दिया जाय तो उसमें खरगोश भी कभी भी नहीं डूब सकता
english_translation: If spread over a large field, even a hare would never drown in it.
essence: Vastness offers safety so even the smallest are never overwhelmed.
simple_meaning: If something is spread wide enough, even a small creature cannot be overwhelmed or trapped by it.
insight: It teaches you to see that expanding your space or resources can prevent harm or overwhelm.
modern_relevance: When problems feel overwhelming, remember that expanding your perspective can make even tough challenges manageable.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
आसीज्जलाशये यावत्तावदेव जलन्तु तत् ।
किन्तु शक्तौ विपर्यासो भवेदगाम्भीर्यनाशतः ॥
translation: वह जल जितना जलाशय में था उतना ही तो रहता है परन्तु उसकी गम्भीरता नष्ट होने से उसकी शक्ति में फेर पड़ जाता है
english_translation: The water in the lake remains the same in quantity, but its power changes when its depth is lost.
essence: Losing inner depth changes your power even when your external presence stays constant.
simple_meaning: The amount of water stays the same, but losing depth changes its power.
insight: It teaches you to value inner depth as the source of lasting strength, not just external presence.
modern_relevance: You seem fine on the surface, but skipping reflection leaves you drained and less effective.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
समष्टिव्याष्टिरूपाभ्यां स्रष्टेः सन्धारिका मम ।
शक्तिनियामिका सैव ध्रुवं धर्मः सनातनः ॥
translation: समष्टि और व्यष्टिरूप से, सृष्टि के धारण करने वाली जो मेरी नियमाका शक्ति है उसी को सनातन धर्म कहते हैं
english_translation: The eternal dharma is the regulating power of my creation that sustains both the collective and the individual forms.
essence: Your true purpose is the eternal power sustaining both the universe and yourself.
simple_meaning: The eternal dharma is the power that sustains both the whole universe and each individual form within it.
insight: It shifts your view from feeling isolated to seeing yourself as part of an enduring, sustaining order.
modern_relevance: When life feels chaotic, remember you are part of a timeless power that holds everything steady, both your world and the larger whole.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
तत्सनातनधर्मस्य पादाश्चत्वार आसते ।
साधारणविशेषौ हि तथाऽसाधारणापदौ ॥
translation: उस सनातन धर्म के चार पाद है, यथा-साधारण धर्म, विशेष धर्म, असाधारण धर्म और आपद्धर्म
english_translation: That eternal dharma has four parts: common dharma, special dharma, extraordinary dharma, and emergency dharma.
essence: Eternal dharma includes four distinct ways to act depending on the situation.
simple_meaning: Eternal dharma is divided into four types: common, special, extraordinary, and emergency duties or codes.
insight: It encourages recognizing that ethical living adapts to circumstances, not just one fixed standard.
modern_relevance: You face many roles and challenges; knowing that different situations require different kinds of responsibility can ease confusion.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सार्वभौमो यतो धर्मः सर्वलोकहितप्रदः।
ददासभ्युदयं नित्यं सुखं निःश्रेयसन्तथा ॥
translation: धर्म सार्वभौम और सर्वलोकहितकर होने से यह निरन्तर अनायास, अभ्युदय और निःश्रेयस प्रदान करता है
english_translation: When dharma is universal and benefits all worlds, it continuously grants effortless prosperity and true welfare.
essence: Dharma that benefits all brings effortless and lasting prosperity and true welfare.
simple_meaning: When your actions follow dharma that is universal and benefits all, they naturally bring continuous prosperity, happiness, and true welfare.
insight: It shifts your motivation from personal gain to universal benefit, making your actions naturally fruitful and fulfilling.
modern_relevance: You volunteer your time at a community event, not for reward but because it helps everyone; that effort creates real, ongoing good.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
निखिलं धर्मशक्तचैव विश्वमेतञ्चराचरम्।
क्रमेणाभ्युदयं लब्ध्वा सरत्यग्रे हि माम्प्रति ॥
translation: यह स्थावर-जंगमात्मा समस्त विश्व धर्म को शक्ति से ही क्रमशः अभ्युदय प्राप्त करके ही मेरी ओर अग्रसर होता है
english_translation: The entire universe, moving and unmoving, advances step by step through the power of dharma toward me.
essence: All existence steadily moves toward the divine by following dharma's power.
simple_meaning: Everything in the world, living or not, moves forward gradually with the power of dharma toward the divine presence.
insight: It shows that all aspects of life progress through dharma's power toward harmony and purpose.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
ज्ञानिनो मम भक्ताश्च धर्मशक्तयैव सत्त्वरम्।
तत्त्वज्ञानस्य साहाय्याल्लभन्ते मुक्तिमुत्तमाम् ॥
translation: और मेरे ज्ञानी भक्तगण धर्म की ही शक्ति द्वारा तत्त्वज्ञान की सहायता से उत्तम निःश्रेयस को शीघ्र प्राप्त होते हैं
english_translation: My wise devotees swiftly attain the highest freedom through the power of dharma aided by true knowledge.
essence: True devotion combined with wisdom and dharma power leads quickly to highest freedom.
simple_meaning: Those who are devoted and wise gain the greatest freedom quickly by following the power of dharma and true understanding.
insight: It teaches you to unite heartfelt devotion with clear knowledge to move swiftly toward inner freedom.
modern_relevance: You feel stuck between heart and head—this reminds you that combining your sincere care with clear understanding accelerates your growth.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
शाश्वतस्यास्य धर्मस्य यावत्प्रादुर्भविष्यति ।
सार्वभौमस्वरूपं हे पितरो भाग्यशालिनः! ॥
translation: हे भाग्यशाली पितृगण ! इस सनातन धर्म का सार्वभौम स्वरूप जितना प्रकट होगा
english_translation: O fortunate ancestors! As long as this eternal dharma exists, its universal nature will manifest.
essence: The eternal dharma reveals its universal nature as long as it exists.
simple_meaning: The universal form of the eternal dharma will show itself as long as it exists, says the speaker to the ancestors.
insight: Recognize that the enduring principles of right conduct reveal themselves continuously through time.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
जनानां क्षुद्रता लोके तावत्येव विनक्षंयति ।
साधारणस्य धर्मस्य तत्त्वतो हृदयङ्गमम् ॥
translation: संसार में मनुष्यों की क्षुद्रता उतनी ही नष्ट होगी। तत्त्वतः. साधारण धर्म का
english_translation: In the world, the pettiness of humans will be destroyed just as much as the essence of ordinary dharma reaches the heart.
essence: True dharma's presence in the heart dissolves human pettiness.
simple_meaning: Human pettiness decreases as the true essence of simple dharma deeply touches the heart.
insight: It teaches you to focus on the core of your dharma to naturally overcome petty thoughts and behaviors.
modern_relevance: When you genuinely follow your basic values, the trivial grudges and small worries that cloud your mind begin to vanish.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
सार्वभौमस्वरूपं हि कर्त्तुमह्यै  न संशयः ।
पालनीयाः सदाचारा आर्यजातीयमानवै: ॥
translation: सार्वभौम स्वरूप निःसन्देह  हृदयंगम करने योग्य है सदाचार भी आर्य जातीय मनुष्यों से पालन कराने योग्य हैं
english_translation: There is no doubt that the universal nature can be acted upon by me; righteous conduct must be upheld even by noble people.
essence: You must act on universal truth and uphold noble conduct without hesitation.
simple_meaning: You can and should act according to what applies universally. Even noble people must follow righteous conduct.
insight: It shifts your focus from narrow self-interest to embracing universal responsibility and moral standards.
modern_relevance: You face choices that affect more than yourself. Remember that acting rightly is a responsibility shared by all with integrity.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
वर्णाश्रमीयधर्मस्य विशेषस्य तथैव च ।
यतो वर्णाश्रमैधर्मेविहींना सर्वथा ननु ॥
translation: उसी प्रकार वर्णाश्रम सम्बन्धी विशेष धर्म के सदाचार पालन कराने योग्य हैं; क्योकि  वर्णाश्रम धर्म रहित
english_translation: Similarly, the particular duties related to varna and ashrama ensure proper conduct; without them, complete disorder follows.
essence: Clear roles and duties are essential to maintain order in conduct and life.
simple_meaning: Specific duties related to social and life stages guide proper behavior; without these duties, disorder arises.
insight: It teaches you to recognize how defined responsibilities organize your choices and keep your life steady.
modern_relevance: When your daily roles and responsibilities are unclear, life feels chaotic and your actions lose meaning.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
असौं सृष्टिर्मानवानां कालिकायाः प्रभावतः ।
प्रकृतर्मे लयं याति कुत्रचित्समये स्वतः ॥
translation: यह मनुष्य सृष्टि स्वतः मेरी प्रकृति काली के प्रभाव से किसी समयान्तर में सर्वथैव लय को प्राप्त हुआ करती है
english_translation: This human creation of mine naturally dissolves at some time under the influence of the dark power of time.
essence: All that arises from nature must dissolve naturally under the influence of time.
simple_meaning: All human creation arises from my nature and will naturally dissolve eventually because of the power of time.
insight: It shifts your mind to accept impermanence as a natural and unavoidable part of all things.
modern_relevance: You watch a favorite moment fade or a project end, realizing nothing lasts forever despite your efforts.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
धत्ते रूपान्तरं वासौ नात्र कार्या विचारणा ।
वर्णाश्रमाणां धर्माणां बीजरक्षामभावतः ॥
translation: अथवा वह रूपान्तर को धारण कर लिया करती है। इसमें कोई विचार की बात नहीं है। वर्णाश्रम धर्म को बीजरक्षा के प्रभाव से
english_translation: The inner being adopts different forms without deliberation due to the absence of the seed protection of varna-ashrama dharma.
essence: The true self changes forms unconsciously when the root of duty and order is absent.
simple_meaning: The true self naturally takes on different forms without thinking when the foundation of social and spiritual duties is missing.
insight: It teaches you to recognize how losing your grounding in purpose leads to reactive shifts in identity and action.
modern_relevance: When you lose your core values or sense of purpose, you might find yourself changing roles or behaviors without clarity or control.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
मर्त्यानां रक्षितः पन्थाः स्यात् क्रमाभ्युदयपदः ।
शाश्वतस्य हि धर्मस्य ज्ञान स्यात्तेन कहिचित् ॥
translation: मनुष्यों की अभ्युदय देनेवाली शैली की रक्षा होती है, उससे किसी समय सनातन धर्म का ज्ञान होता है।
english_translation: The protected path of humans leads to their prosperity and grants knowledge of the eternal dharma.
essence: A steady, protected path leads to lasting growth and eternal understanding.
simple_meaning: If your path is protected and steady, it will lead you to growth and lasting understanding of your true purpose.
insight: It shifts focus from fleeting actions to sustaining a protected, steady path that reveals deeper purpose over time.
modern_relevance: When you commit to a clear and steady course, even amidst distractions, growth and deeper meaning naturally follow.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
वर्णधर्म यतो विज्ञाः प्रवृत्ते रोधकं जगुः ।
निवृत्तेः पोषकञ्चैव धर्ममाश्रमगोचरम् ॥
translation: क्योंकि हे विज्ञ पितृगण ! वर्ण धर्म प्रवृत्तिरोधक और आश्रम धर्म निवृत्तिपोषक कहा जाता है।
english_translation: Learned ancestors say that social duties activated support order, while withdrawal duties nourish renunciation.
essence: Active duties maintain order; withdrawal duties nourish inner growth.
simple_meaning: Active social duties maintain order, while duties in withdrawal support personal growth in stages of life.
insight: It teaches you to recognize when to engage with society and when to step back for personal nourishment.
modern_relevance: You juggle work and family roles, then need time away to recharge and grow beyond daily tasks.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अतो वर्णाश्रमाख्यस्य धर्मस्यैव सुरक्षणात् ।
रक्षिता पितरो वो हि शक्तिः सम्पत्स्यते शुभा ॥
translation: इसलिये हे पितृगण ! वर्णाश्रम धर्म की रक्षा के द्वारा ही तुम्हारी ही शुभशक्ति रक्षित होगी।
english_translation: Therefore, O ancestors, your own auspicious power will be protected only by preserving the dharma of the social orders and stages of life.
essence: Protecting your true duty is the way to preserve your auspicious power.
simple_meaning: Your true power and wellbeing depend on protecting your rightful role and duty in life.
insight: It teaches you to see your duty as a source of authentic power, not a burden to resist.
modern_relevance: When you commit to your responsibilities at work or home, you preserve your inner strength and positive influence.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
साधारणस्य धर्मस्य विशेषस्य तथैव च ।
कियन्तीवर्णयाम्यद्य वृत्तीयुषकमन्तिके ॥
translation: अब साधारण धर्म और विशेष धर्म की कुछ वृत्तियों का वर्णन आपलोग के सामने करता हूँ
english_translation: Now I describe some behaviors of ordinary dharma and special dharma to you all.
essence: Introducing distinctions between ordinary and special dharma behaviors.
simple_meaning: A description of some common and special duties or behaviors is about to be given.
insight: Recognizing different categories of duty sets the stage for practical guidance.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
श्रयन्तां ता भवद्भिस्तु दत्तचित्तैः शनैः शनैः ।
धृतिः क्षमा दमोऽस्तेयं शौचमिन्द्रियनिग्रहः ॥
translation: आपलोग दत्तचित्त होकर उनको  शनैः शनैः सुने, धृति, क्षमा, दम, अस्तेय, शौच, इन्द्रियनिग्रह
english_translation: You all should listen to them with a willing heart, slowly and steadily, cultivating endurance, forgiveness, self-control, non-stealing, purity, and control of the senses.
essence: Willing, patient listening slowly builds lasting self-discipline and inner strength.
simple_meaning: Listening patiently and with willingness helps develop endurance, forgiveness, self-control, honesty, purity, and control over your senses.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate inner qualities through deliberate, patient, and willing attention to guidance.
modern_relevance: When you take time to listen fully and openly to feedback or advice, your patience and self-control naturally improve.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
धीर्विद्या सत्यमक्रोध औदार्य समदर्शिता ।
परोपकारनिप्कामभावप्रभृतयः शुभाः ॥
translation: धी, विद्या, सत्य, अक्रोध, उदारता, समदर्शिता, परोपकार, निष्कामभाव आदि
english_translation: Patience, knowledge, truthfulness, absence of anger, generosity, impartiality, selfless service, and desirelessness are all good qualities.
essence: True strength comes from patient, generous, and selfless qualities within you.
simple_meaning: Good character is made of patience, honesty, generosity, fairness, and helping others without wanting rewards.
insight: Focus on cultivating patience and generosity in daily life to act with steady purpose and clear intent.
modern_relevance: You stay calm in difficult conversations, give without expecting thanks, and treat everyone fairly at work.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text: साधारणस्य धर्मस्य विद्यन्ते वृत्तयो ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: साधारण धर्म की ही शुभ वृत्तियां हैं।
english_translation: The virtuous actions belong only to ordinary dharma.
essence: Steady, virtuous actions arise from following ordinary, common dharma.
simple_meaning: Most good actions come from following ordinary, common principles of right conduct.
insight: It teaches you to recognize and value simple, consistent duties as the basis of ethical behavior.
modern_relevance: You rely on regular habits and common sense to guide your daily choices, forming the backbone of your integrity.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
ब्रह्मचर्यश्च दाम्पत्यं निवासी निर्जने बने ।
त्यागो ह्यध्यापनश्चैव याजनञ्च प्रतिग्रहः ॥
translation: और ब्रह्मचर्य, दाम्पत्य, निर्जनवनवास, त्याग, पाठन, याजन, प्रतिग्रह, प्रजापालन
english_translation: Celibacy, married life, living in a solitary forest, renunciation, study, sacrifice, and acceptance of gifts.
essence: Spiritual life includes multiple valid paths and practices.
simple_meaning: This verse lists different life stages and practices, including celibacy, marriage, forest dwelling, renunciation, study, sacrifice, and accepting gifts.
insight: Recognize that spiritual life can take many forms, each valid in its context.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
धर्मयुद्धं प्रजारक्षा वाणिज्यं सेवनादयः ।
विशेषस्यापि धर्मस्य सन्तीमाः खलु वृत्तयः ॥
translation: धर्मयुद्ध, वाणिज्य, सेवा आदि, विशेष धर्म की यह ही वृत्तियां हैं
english_translation: Protecting the people through righteous war, trade, and service are indeed the main forms of special dharma.
essence: Protecting, trading, and serving are essential expressions of your special duty.
simple_meaning: Certain actions like protecting people, trading, and serving are important forms of special duty you must uphold.
insight: Recognize your unique duties as meaningful ways to live dharma through action and service.
modern_relevance: You stand up for your community, keep your business honest, and help those around you — these are your real responsibilities.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
साधारणस्य धर्मस्यावयवाः कीर्तिता यथा ।
विशेषस्यापि धर्मस्य तथाङ्गानि पृथक् पृथक् ॥
translation: जिस प्रकार साधारण धर्म के अंग कहे गये हैं उसी प्रकार विशेष धर्म के भी अलग अलग अंग हैं
english_translation: Just as the parts of common duty are described, similarly the parts of special duty are also distinct.
essence: Both common and special duties have distinct, separate parts to fulfill.
simple_meaning: Both general duties and special duties have their own specific parts or aspects that must be recognized.
insight: Recognize that your unique roles require distinct actions alongside general responsibilities.
modern_relevance: You juggle everyday tasks but also have unique responsibilities that require your specific attention and care.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
उपाङ्गान्यपि धर्मस्य वर्तन्ते भूरिशो ध्रुवम् ।
देशकालादिवैचित्र्यादुपाङ्गं ह्येकमेव च ॥
translation: धर्म के उपांग भी अनेक ही हैं और देशकाल पात्र की विचित्रता के अनुसार एक ही उपांग
english_translation: Many subsidiary parts of dharma exist, but due to differences in place, time, and context, only one is chosen.
essence: Only one part of dharma fits your unique place and time.
simple_meaning: Dharma includes many parts, but only one part applies to you based on your situation.
insight: Focus your effort on the duty that fits your present context instead of trying to do everything.
modern_relevance: When choices overwhelm you, remember your true responsibility depends on your current situation—not every option available.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अङ्गानां नन्वनेकपामुपाङ्गं स्याइसंशयम् ।
अत्यन्तं वर्त्तते विज्ञाः ! धर्मस्य गहना गतिः ॥
translation: अनेक अंगों का निःसन्देह ही उपांग हो सकता है। हे विज्ञों! धर्म की गति अति गहन है।
english_translation: Without many parts, a part cannot exist; surely the path of dharma is very profound.
essence: No part stands alone; dharma’s path is deeply interconnected and profound.
simple_meaning: A single part cannot stand alone; the way of dharma is deeply complex and interconnected.
insight: It teaches you to see your role as part of a larger whole, not in isolation.
modern_relevance: You notice how a team’s success depends on all members working together, not just one person’s effort.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
जायते भावसाहाय्याभूतिदाः ! अन्तरं बहु ।
सर्वधर्मस्वरूपेषु सत्यं सत्यं ब्रवीमि वः ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! भाव की सहायता से सब धर्मों के स्वरूपो में अनेक अन्तर हो जाया करता है, यह मैं आप लोगों को सत्य कहता हूँ
english_translation: O ancestors! With the support of emotions, many differences arise in the forms of all dharmas; this I tell you truly.
essence: Emotions create many differences in how people perceive the true nature of their duties.
simple_meaning: Emotions influence how people understand the true nature of their duties and paths, causing many differences.
insight: It teaches you to notice when emotions influence your judgment and to seek deeper clarity beyond feelings.
modern_relevance: You notice how your mood changes your view of rules or expectations at work or home, making things seem clearer or confusing.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
भावतत्त्वस्य विज्ञानं पूर्णरूपेण वेदितुम् ।
अंत:करणविज्ञानस्वरूपं वच्मि वोऽग्रतः ॥
translation: भाव तत्त्व के विज्ञान को पूर्ण रूप से स्पष्ट करने के अर्थ अन्तःकरण विज्ञान का स्वरूप आप लोगों के समीप कहता हूँ
english_translation: I speak to you closely about the inner mind's nature to fully reveal the essence of feeling's knowledge.
essence: Understanding feelings deeply requires knowing the true nature of the inner mind.
simple_meaning: The deepest understanding of feeling comes from knowing the nature of your inner mind.
insight: It teaches you to explore your inner mind as the foundation for understanding your feelings completely.
modern_relevance: When emotions feel overwhelming, turning inward to understand your mind helps you see feelings clearly.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
मनो बुद्धिरहङ्कारश्चित्तमेतच्चतुर्विधम् ।
अन्तःकरणमस्तीति वित्त यूयं पितृव्रजाः ! ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! अन्तःकरण के चार भेद हैं, ऐसा आपलोग जाने, यथा-मन बुद्धि चित्त और अहङ्कार।
english_translation: O ancestors, know that the inner instrument has four parts: mind, intellect, sense of I, and inner state.
essence: The inner instrument has four distinct parts shaping your experience.
simple_meaning: The inner instrument consists of four parts: the mind, intellect, ego, and inner state. This is a foundational classification of how your inner self works.
insight: It teaches you to see your mind’s different layers, helping separate thinking from feeling and self from inner awareness.
modern_relevance: When you reflect on your feelings, thoughts, and self-identity, recognizing these as distinct parts helps you manage your reactions and decisions.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
मनसोऽन्तविभागोऽस्ति चित्तञ्चाहकतिधियः।
मायापाशैदृढैवद्ध्या योषित संसारगोचरम् ॥
translation: चित्त मन का अन्तर्विभाग है और अहंकार बुद्धि का अन्तर्विभाग है। संसारी जीवों को जिस प्रकार स्त्री दृढ माया रस्सियों से बांधकर
english_translation: The inner part of the mind is the inner state, and the sense of separate self is the inner part of the discerning mind; just as worldly beings are firmly bound by the strong ropes of illusion.
essence: The sense of separate self tightly binds the mind in strong illusion.
simple_meaning: Your inner state is part of your mind, and the sense of being separate comes from your discerning mind. This sense traps you like strong ropes of illusion.
insight: It teaches you to notice how the sense of 'I' traps your mind and to begin loosening that grip.
modern_relevance: When your mind fixates on 'me' and 'mine,' you feel trapped by worries and confusion that pull you away from calm.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
यथा संसारिभिर्जीवैः कार्य कारयतेऽनिशम् ।
तथा चित्तं मनो बुद्धिमहंकारो नियम्य च ॥
translation: उनसे अहर्निश संसार का कार्य कराती है उसी प्रकार चित्त मन को और अहङ्कार बुद्धि को नियमन करके
english_translation: Just as the natural world constantly causes beings to act, similarly the mind, intellect, and sense of self must be controlled.
essence: Controlling mind, intellect, and ego is as essential as nature’s constant driving of action.
simple_meaning: The world naturally causes beings to act constantly. Similarly, you must control your mind, intellect, and sense of separate self.
insight: It teaches you to treat your mind and ego like natural forces that need consistent regulation for balanced action.
modern_relevance: When distractions constantly pull your attention, steadying your mind and sense of self helps you stay focused and effective.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
कार्य कारयते शश्वनानावैचित्र्यसङ्कुलम् ।
संस्कारानुचरा जीवा वर्तन्ते सर्वथा खलु ॥
translation: निरन्तर माया वैचित्र्यपूर्ण काम कराया करते हैं। जीव सर्वथा ही संस्कारों के दास हैं
english_translation: The mind constantly compels action full of diverse illusions. The living being is entirely bound by impressions.
essence: Your actions are driven by a restless mind shaped by countless impressions.
simple_meaning: Your mind is always active, driven by many illusions. Your true self is bound by past impressions shaping your actions.
insight: It teaches you to recognize how deep impressions steer your reactions, inviting you to cultivate discipline to change them.
modern_relevance: You notice how your habits and past experiences push you to act automatically, even when you want to choose differently.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
वासनोत्पन्नसंस्कारा अभिवघ्नन्ति प्राणिनः ।
आसक्तिरेव मूलञ्च बन्धनस्यास्य कारणम् ॥
translation: वासना से उत्पन्न संस्कार जीवों को जकड़ रखते हैं, आसक्ति ही इस बन्धन का मूल कारण है
english_translation: Impressions born from desire bind living beings; attachment is the root cause of this bondage.
essence: Attachment born from desire creates the mental bonds that trap living beings.
simple_meaning: Desires create mental impressions that bind living beings, and attachment is the main cause of this bondage.
insight: Recognize attachment as the source of mental patterns that limit your freedom and start loosening your hold.
modern_relevance: You notice how craving something creates habits and patterns that keep you stuck, even when you want freedom.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
संस्कारो वासनाजन्यः संस्कारात्कर्म जायते ।
वासनोत्पद्यते भूयः कर्मणो नात्र संशयः ॥
translation: वासना से संस्कार होता है, संस्कार से कर्म होता है, कर्म से पुनः वासना उत्पन्न होती है.
english_translation: Desires give rise to impressions; impressions lead to action; and action again produces desires without doubt.
essence: Desire creates impressions, impressions cause actions, and actions regenerate desire endlessly.
simple_meaning: Desires create mental impressions, impressions lead to actions, and these actions create more desires, forming a continuous cycle.
insight: This verse teaches you to see how your actions are not isolated but part of a repeating cycle fueled by desire and impression.
modern_relevance: You notice how one craving leads to habits, which prompt more cravings, making it hard to break free from repeating patterns.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
वासनायाः पुनर्विज्ञाः ! संस्कारों जायते ध्रुवम् ।
सदैवं वासनाचक्रं जीवानाञ्च गतागतम् ॥
translation: हे विज्ञो ! वासना से पुनः संस्कार ही उत्पन्न होता है । इस संसार में इस प्रकार से वासना का चक्र और जीव का आवागमन
english_translation: O wise one, from desire arises habit again; thus the cycle of desire and the soul's coming and going continues in this world.
essence: Desire continuously produces habits that keep the soul cycling through life.
simple_meaning: Desire creates habits, and these habits keep the cycle of the soul's movement continuing endlessly.
insight: It teaches you to see desire not as isolated but as the seed of habits that sustain your cycle.
modern_relevance: You notice how one craving leads to repeated behaviors, trapping you in familiar ups and downs you want to escape.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
पूर्णायमानमस्तीह चक्रानेमियथा रथे ।
पूर्वजन्मार्जिता यादृक् कर्मसंस्कारसन्ततिः ॥
translation: रथ चक्रनेमि के समान सदा घूर्णायमान रहता है । पूर्व जन्मार्जित कर्मसंस्कार समूह अथवा
english_translation: Just like the wheel of a chariot always keeps turning, the continuous flow of impressions from past actions keeps moving.
essence: The impressions of past actions keep turning endlessly like a chariot wheel.
simple_meaning: Your past actions create a continuous flow of impressions that keep influencing your present, like a chariot's wheel always turning.
insight: Recognize how past actions keep driving present habits, so you can consciously change the cycle.
modern_relevance: When you find yourself reacting habitually, it’s the momentum of past choices spinning like a wheel beneath your awareness.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
एतजन्मकृतानां वा कर्मणां यादृशी स्मृतिः ।
अङ्किता जीवचित्तं स्यादासक्तिः स्याद्धि तादृशी ॥
translation: इस जन्म के कर्म की स्मृति जैसी जीव के वित्त में अङ्कित रहती है उसी प्रकार उसको आसक्ति हुआ करती है।
english_translation: Just as the memory of actions from this life is imprinted on the mind, so too attachment arises accordingly.
essence: Your attachments arise naturally from memories imprinted by your past actions.
simple_meaning: Your mind remembers your actions from this life, and that memory creates your attachments.
insight: It teaches you to see attachment as a natural imprint of past actions, not a fixed identity.
modern_relevance: When you replay past mistakes or successes in your mind, you feel drawn to or repelled by them, shaping your attachments today.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
तदासक्त्यनुरूपेषु विश्येर्षु निरन्तरम् ।
प्रसज्जन्तेऽभितो जीवाः तदासक्त्यनुसारतः ॥
translation: उसी आसक्ति के अनुसार जीव उसी आसक्ति सम्बन्धीय विषयों में निरन्तर चारों ओर से जकड़े रहते हैं
english_translation: Living beings, bound by their attachments, remain constantly entangled in objects corresponding to those attachments.
essence: Attachments bind living beings continuously to matching objects all around them.
simple_meaning: You get caught up in things that match your attachments, unable to break free.
insight: Recognize how your attachments create repetitive patterns that keep your mind restless and reactive.
modern_relevance: You find yourself repeatedly distracted by the same habits or desires, unable to focus because your attachments pull you in every direction.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
आसक्तिश्चित्तसाहाय्यान्मनस्युत्पद्यते ध्रुवम् ।
दम्पत्योः सङ्गमाल्लोके मनश्चित्तस्वरूपयोः ॥
translation: आसक्ति चित्त की सहायता से मन में ही उत्पन्न होती है। मन और चित्तरूपी स्त्री पुरुष के संगम से संसार में
english_translation: Attachment arises certainly in the mind with the help of the mind and consciousness, born from the union of the mind and consciousness in the world.
essence: Attachment arises inside your mind from the union of mind and consciousness.
simple_meaning: Attachment arises in your mind when the restless mind and inner consciousness come together.
insight: It teaches you to observe that attachment is a product of your own mind mixing with inner awareness, not an external force.
modern_relevance: You notice how your worries and desires arise when your busy mind clings to fleeting thoughts and feelings.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
आसक्तेजीयते जन्म नात्र कार्या विचारणा ।
प्रजातन्तुं यथा पुत्रः संरक्षँसल्लभते पितुः ॥
translation: आसक्ति का जन्म होता है। इसमें विचार नहीं करना चाहिये। पुत्र जिस प्रकार पिता के प्रजातन्तु की रक्षा करके
english_translation: Attachment arises naturally and should not be overanalyzed; just as a son instinctively protects his father's lineage.
essence: Attachment arises naturally and cannot be undone by mere reasoning.
simple_meaning: Attachment naturally arises in the mind and cannot be controlled by reasoning, just as a son instinctively protects his father's family.
insight: Accept attachment as a natural impulse instead of battling it intellectually, freeing your energy for wiser action.
modern_relevance: You feel drawn to something or someone, and trying to analyze or control that feeling only makes it stronger.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
तस्याधिकारमासक्तिविभ्राणा विषयाँस्तथा।
सृष्टिं वर्द्धयते शश्वदिह दैवीश्च मानवीम् ॥
translation: पिता के अधिकार को प्राप्त होता है उसी प्रकार आसक्ति इस संसार में विषयों को धारण करती हुई देवी और मानवी सृष्टि को विशेष रूप से अग्रसर करती है
english_translation: Attachment to rightful authority continuously nurtures both divine and human creation in this world.
essence: Attachment to rightful responsibility is the force that nurtures all creation.
simple_meaning: When you hold on to your rightful role with dedication, it supports both divine and human life to grow and thrive.
insight: Recognize that embracing your rightful responsibilities energizes not only your life but also the wider environment around you.
modern_relevance: You feel the pressure to take responsibility at work or home, and holding steady there creates growth beyond just yourself.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
बुद्धिराज्यस्य सिद्धान्तमपरं वित्त किन्त्त्व हो ।
बुद्धयहङ्कारसंयोगादभावतत्त्वोदयो भवेत् ॥
translation: अहो! किन्तु बुद्धिराज्य का सिद्धान्त और है ऐसा जानो अहङ्कार और बुद्धि के संगम से भावतत्व का उदय होता है
english_translation: Know that the foundation of the kingdom of the discerning mind is different: it arises from the union of the sense of separate self and discernment, producing the essence of feeling.
essence: Clarity arises as feeling when the separate self and discernment unite.
simple_meaning: True understanding comes from the union of your sense of self and your discerning mind, creating the essence of feeling or experience.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that clear understanding arises from the interplay between your self-perception and discriminating mind.
modern_relevance: When you fully engage both your identity and your thoughtful mind, your insights become more meaningful and felt deeply, not just known abstractly.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
भावोऽपि द्विवियो ज्ञेयः शुद्धाशुद्धप्रभेदव:।
भावोऽशुद्धस्तयोबुद्धिं विधत्ते विषयाकृतिम् ॥
translation: शुद्ध और अशुद्ध भेद मे भाव भी द्विविध हैं सो जानो। उनमें से अशुद्ध भाव वुद्धि को विषयवत् कर देता है
english_translation: Feelings too are of two kinds: pure and impure; impure feelings distort the discerning mind like objects do.
essence: Impure feelings distort the discerning mind just as distracting objects do.
simple_meaning: Feelings come in two types: pure ones that support clear understanding, and impure ones that confuse the mind like distractions.
insight: It teaches you to observe which feelings clarify your mind and which ones confuse it, improving your discernment.
modern_relevance: In a tense conversation, your feelings may either help you listen clearly or distract you with bias and confusion.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
शुद्धो भावः क्रमाचित्तं कुर्वाणो निर्मलं तथा ।
बुद्धिं ब्रह्मपदं नूनं नयच्छान्ति प्रयच्छति ॥
translation: और शुद्ध भाव क्रमशः अन्तःकरण को मल रहित करता हुआ बुद्धि को ब्रह्मपद में पहुंचाकर ही शान्ति प्रदान करता है
english_translation: A pure attitude gradually cleanses the inner consciousness, leading the discerning mind to the supreme reality and granting peace.
essence: A pure attitude gradually cleanses your mind and leads your wisdom to peace.
simple_meaning: A pure and sincere attitude slowly cleanses your inner mind, helping your discerning mind reach the supreme reality and find peace.
insight: It teaches you to nurture purity in your inner state so your discernment naturally leads to peace.
modern_relevance: When you steadily clear your mental clutter and emotional noise, your mind can settle into clarity, bringing calm and true peace.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
नन्दासक्तेर्वशा जीवा अथवा भावनोदिताः।
एतत्तत्त्वद्रयस्यैव साहाय्यात्कर्म कुर्वते ॥
translation: जीव या तो आसक्ति के वशीभूत हो या भावप्रणोदित होकर ही, इन्हीं दो तत्वों की सहायता से ही कर्म करते हैं।
english_translation: Living beings act either compelled by attachment or driven by emotion, performing actions supported only by these two forces.
essence: All actions arise from either attachment or emotional impulse as their foundation.
simple_meaning: You act because you are either caught by attachment or moved by emotion; these two forces support all your actions.
insight: It teaches you to observe whether your actions arise from craving attachment or emotional impulse, helping you gain control over your choices.
modern_relevance: You notice how many times your decisions come from wanting something or feeling strongly, even when you don’t realize it.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
कायिकं याचिकञ्चैव तथा मानसमेव च ।
आसक्तौ किन्तु वैवश्यं भावे स्वातन्त्र्यमस्ति ह ॥
translation: शरीरिक, वाचनिक और मानसिक कर्म करते हैं। आसक्ति में विवशता है परन्तु भाव में स्वाधीनता है
english_translation: The body, speech, and mind perform actions. Attachment creates compulsion, but your inner feelings remain free.
essence: Your actions may feel forced but your inner feelings can stay free.
simple_meaning: Your body, speech, and mind carry out actions. Though attachment makes you feel forced, your inner feelings can stay free.
insight: Notice that your inner feelings can stay independent of the compulsions your body and mind face.
modern_relevance: You might feel trapped by daily routines or expectations, but your inner attitude can remain untouched and free.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
आनन्याद्विषयाणान्तु बहुशाखासमन्विता ।
आसक्तिर्विद्यते नूनं शुद्धो भावो न तादृशः ॥
translation: आसक्ति बहु शाखा युक्त ही है क्योंकि विषय अनन्त हैं परन्तु शुद्धभाव वैसा नहीं है
english_translation: Attachment indeed has many branches because the objects are countless, but pure feeling is not like that.
essence: Attachment multiplies with desires; pure feeling remains singular and undivided.
simple_meaning: Attachment arises because desires are many, but pure feeling is simple and undivided.
insight: You learn to recognize that many cravings create scattered attachments, but cultivating a pure feeling lets you stay unified and steady.
modern_relevance: You scroll through endless distractions, feeling pulled in every direction, yet a calm, pure feeling can remain untouched by this flood.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
एकाद्वैतदशां नेतुभीष्टेऽसौ नात्र संशयः।
यतो ब्रह्मपदं विज्ञाः ! विद्यनेऽद्वैतमेव हि ॥
translation: वह एक अद्वैत दशा को प्राप्त करा सकता है, इसमें सन्देह नहीं; क्योंकि हे विज्ञों! ब्रह्मपद अद्वैत ही है
english_translation: There is no doubt that one who attains the non-dual state reaches the supreme reality; know, O wise ones, that the supreme reality is indeed non-dual.
essence: The supreme reality is nothing other than the non-dual state itself.
simple_meaning: The highest state you can reach is complete oneness without division, the supreme reality itself.
insight: It shifts your view from fragmented self to recognizing an undivided, unified reality.
modern_relevance: When your mind stops dividing experience into 'me' and 'other,' you glimpse the whole, dissolving inner conflict.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
आसत्त्या कार्यकर्त्तारो जीवाः प्रारब्धयोगतः।
श्रीगुरोर्देवतानां वा प्रमादादेव सर्वथा ॥
translation: आसक्ति से काम करनेवाले जीव सर्वथा प्रारब्ध की सहायता, श्रीगुरुदेव की कृपा अथवा देवताओं की कृपा से ही
english_translation: Beings attached to their actions succeed only through past karma, the grace of the revered teacher, or divine beings' favor.
essence: Attachment to action means results depend on past karma or grace beyond your control.
simple_meaning: When you act with attachment, your results depend on past karma, the teacher’s kindness, or divine favor.
insight: You shift from expecting full control to recognizing the wider influences shaping your results.
modern_relevance: You push hard on a project but realize success also depends on past work, mentors’ support, or unseen factors.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
पाशतुल्याद्धि विषयात स्वान्निवर्तयितुं क्षमाः।
अन्यथा विषये तेषां प्रक्तिसत्व  निश्चिता ॥
translation: पाशतुल्य विषय से अपने को बचा सकते हैं, नहीं तो उसमें उनका फंसना निश्चित है
english_translation: Those who are like a noose can free themselves from sense objects; otherwise, their nature surely remains attached to those objects.
essence: Only firm self-restraint frees you from attachment; otherwise, your nature remains bound.
simple_meaning: You can only free yourself from attachment to desires by firmly restraining yourself; otherwise, your nature remains caught in them.
insight: It teaches you to hold firm mental boundaries against distractions to detach from craving.
modern_relevance: You try to stop scrolling but your mind keeps drifting back to distractions unless you firmly decide to resist.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
किन्तु शुद्धस्य भावस्य साहाय्यात्कार्यकारिणः।
भाग्यवन्तो न सज्जन्ते विषयेषु कदाचन ॥
translation: परन्तु शुद्ध भाव की सहायता से कर्म करने वाले भाग्यवान को  विषयों में कदापि नहीं फंसना चाहिए
english_translation: However, the fortunate who act with pure intention should never become entangled in worldly things.
essence: Acting with pure intention protects you from being caught in worldly distractions.
simple_meaning: Acting with a pure heart and clear intention protects you from being caught in desires or distractions.
insight: It teaches you to anchor your actions in purity of intent, which prevents distraction and entanglement with passing desires.
modern_relevance: You start a project with honest purpose, and even when challenges arise, your focus keeps you from getting overwhelmed by irrelevant distractions.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
उत्तरोत्तरमेतेषां सर्वथोर्दध्वगतिर्भवेत् ।
संगृहीता हि संस्काराः पूर्वजन्माने यादृशाः ॥
translation: उत्तरोत्तर उनकी सर्वथा अवगति होती रहती है। जीव ने पूर्व जन्म में जैसे संस्कार संग्रह किये हैं
english_translation: The impressions from past lives keep accumulating and deeply influence the present.
essence: Past-life impressions continuously build and shape present experience.
simple_meaning: Impressions from previous lives build up continuously and shape the present experience.
insight: Recognize that many present tendencies come from accumulated past impressions beyond current awareness.
modern_relevance: Your habits, fears, and preferences may stem from deep past patterns you never consciously noticed.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
आसक्तिस्तादृशी जीवे प्रादुरेप्यनि निश्चितम्।
तस्या एवानुसारेण जीववर्गे जनिप्यते ॥
translation: उसी के अनुसार उसमें आसक्ति प्रकट होगी और उसी आसक्ति के अनुसार जीवों में
english_translation: Attachment definitely arises in a living being according to that same attachment present in its kind.
essence: Attachments arise naturally by reflecting the attachments in the environment you belong to.
simple_meaning: Attachment in a living being arises following the type of attachment it observes or absorbs from its surroundings or kind.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that your attachments are influenced by your environment, helping you question and possibly reshape them.
