modern_relevance: You notice how your cravings and attachments often echo what people around you value or seek, shaping your desires unconsciously.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
हेयोपादेयताज्ञानं नास्ति कोऽप्यत्र संशयः ।
आसक्तिमूलके चैवमसद्भाचे प्रसज्य वै ॥
translation: हेय और उपादेय का विचार उत्पन्न होगा। इसमें कुछ सन्देह नहीं है और इस प्रकार से आसक्ति मूलक असदुभाव में फंसकर ही
english_translation: There is no doubt that knowledge must be rejected and avoided here, for it arises from attachment and leads to false existence.
essence: Knowledge rooted in attachment creates falsehood and must be abandoned.
simple_meaning: Knowledge that arises from attachment should be rejected because it leads to false understanding and illusion.
insight: It teaches you to question knowledge that deepens attachment and to seek understanding that frees you.
modern_relevance: You notice how some beliefs or ideas you cling to only confuse you and keep you stuck in worry or false hopes.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
जीवो वन्धदशातः स्वं रक्षितुं नैव शक्ष्यति ।
सम्बद्धेन मया साई सद्भावेन तु संयुतः ॥
translation: जीव बन्धन दशा से अपने को बचा नहीं सकेगा। परन्तु हे विज्ञों! सत्भाव जिसका सम्बन्ध मेरे साथ है उसके साथ युक्त होकर
english_translation: A living being cannot free itself from the state of bondage; but one united with me in true nature is connected through goodness.
essence: You cannot escape bondage alone; true connection with the divine changes that.
simple_meaning: No one can free themselves alone from the cycle of bondage, but those joined in true nature with the divine find connection beyond it.
insight: It teaches you to seek support beyond your isolated efforts, embracing connection with something greater.
modern_relevance: You might feel stuck in harmful patterns or struggles you can't escape alone; finding a connection beyond yourself brings real support.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
यत्कर्म कुरुते जीवः सततं भावशुद्धित: ।
हेतुतां बहते विज्ञाः ! मुक्तेस्तत्कर्म निश्चितम् ॥
translation: निरन्तरं भावशुद्धि द्वारा जो कर्म जीव करता है वह कर्म अवश्य ही मुक्ति का कारण होता है।
english_translation: Any action performed by a being with constant purity of mind surely leads to freedom.
essence: Constant purity of mind ensures every action leads to freedom.
simple_meaning: When you act with a mind that is always pure and clear, your actions naturally bring you freedom.
insight: It shifts your focus from external results to maintaining a pure inner state, making every action a step toward freedom.
modern_relevance: You show up to your work or relationships with clear intentions and a calm mind; this steadiness transforms what you do into a source of personal freedom.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
पापकर्माप्यतः पुण्यं सद्भावेन समन्वितम् ।
एष मे निश्चयो विज्ञाः ! एषा ये धारणाऽस्त्यलम् ॥
translation: इस कारण सद्भावसे युक्त पापकर्म भी पुण्य हो जाता है हे विज्ञो ! यह मेरा निश्चय है।  और मेरी यही धारणा है।
english_translation: Therefore, even sinful actions joined with good intention become virtuous, learned one! This is my certainty and firm belief.
essence: Sincere good intention can turn even wrong actions into virtuous ones.
simple_meaning: Actions that seem wrong can become good if done with sincere, positive intention.
insight: It shifts your focus from judging acts to understanding the intentions behind them, encouraging compassionate self-reflection.
modern_relevance: You made a choice that felt wrong but meant well; this shows your true character, not just the mistake.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
धर्मोऽस्ति मम सूक्ष्मातिसूक्ष्मशक्तिः पितृव्रजाः !।
नाऽयं स्थूलपदार्थोऽस्ति निखिलेन्द्रियगोचरः ॥
translation: हे पितृवृन्दो ! धर्म मेरी सूक्ष्माति सूक्ष्म शक्ति है, यह सभी इन्द्रियो से जानने योग्य स्थूल पदार्थ नहीं है।
english_translation: O ancestors, my dharma is an extremely subtle power; it is not a gross object perceived by the senses.
essence: True purpose is a subtle power beyond physical perception.
simple_meaning: Your true purpose is a very subtle force, not something physical or detectable by the senses.
insight: It teaches you to look beyond surface appearances and sense-based judgments to recognize your true calling as subtle and profound.
modern_relevance: You might feel lost measuring your worth by visible achievements, but your deepest purpose is beyond what anyone can see or touch.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
नास्य स्थूलपदार्थेन सम्बन्ध स्थूल इप्यते ।
भावेन हि यदाऽधर्मे धर्मेण परिणम्यते ॥
translation: और न इसका स्थूल पदार्थ से स्थूल सम्बन्ध है । जब भाव से ही धर्म अधर्म में
english_translation: There is no gross connection with gross objects here; when the inner attitude turns from dharma to adharma, that is the real change.
essence: Moral change happens in your inner attitude, not through physical things.
simple_meaning: The real shift from right to wrong happens in your inner attitude, not in physical things.
insight: It shifts your focus from external conditions to the inner attitude as the source of ethical change.
modern_relevance: You might blame your environment for your struggles, but real change happens when your inner feelings shift, not when things around you change.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अधर्मस्यापि धर्मे वै परिणामो यदा भवेत् ।
एष एव तदा धर्म-सूक्ष्मत्वपरिचायकः ॥
translation: और अधर्म धर्म में निश्चय ही परिणत होता है तो यही धर्म के सूक्ष्म स्वरूप का परिचायक है।
english_translation: When even unrighteousness inevitably transforms into righteousness, this reveals the subtle nature of dharma.
essence: Even apparent wrong leads naturally back to right, revealing dharma’s subtle nature.
simple_meaning: Sometimes what looks like wrong action naturally turns into right action, showing dharma’s subtle, guiding presence.
insight: It teaches you to see that apparent mistakes can serve the deeper purpose of your life’s path.
modern_relevance: After making a tough decision that felt wrong, you see its consequences lead to something good you hadn’t expected.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
मम शक्तिर्दिधा भिन्ना विद्याऽविद्यामभेदतः। 
धर्माधर्मसुसम्बन्धस्ताभ्यां सार्द्ध  हि विद्यते ॥
translation: मेरी शक्ति के विद्या और अविद्या नामी, दो भेदों के साथ ही धर्म और अधर्म का सम्बन्ध है
english_translation: My power appears divided as knowledge and ignorance, just as dharma and adharma are closely linked.
essence: True power includes both knowing and not knowing, inseparably linked.
simple_meaning: The divine power is not simply knowledge or ignorance but holds both closely connected like right and wrong.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing knowledge and ignorance as enemies to seeing them as parts of a unified power.
modern_relevance: Sometimes your mind feels torn between clarity and confusion, but both are part of your inner strength working together.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
एतस्यानुभवं सम्यगधर्मज्ञा एवं कुर्वते ।
संवर्द्धयत आसक्तिर्नन्वसद्भावमलिका ॥
translation: इसका धर्मज्ञ व्यक्ति ही सम्यक् अनुभव करते हैं । संसार में असद्भाव  मूलक आसक्ति
english_translation: Only those who truly know dharma fully experience this; attachment rooted in falsehood grows in the world.
essence: True understanding of dharma reveals and dissolves attachments born of falsehood.
simple_meaning: Only those who deeply understand what is right truly experience this; attachments based on falsehood grow in the world.
insight: It teaches you to recognize attachments rooted in illusion and dissolve them through true understanding.
modern_relevance: When you face desires that pull you forward, knowing your true values helps you see which attachments are just illusions you can let go.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अविद्यायाः सदा विज्ञाः ! प्रभावं भृरिशो भवे।
किन्तु मद्युक्तसद्भावात्मकं कर्म निरन्तरम् ॥
translation: हे विज्ञो ! सदा अविद्या के प्रभाव को अत्यन्त ही बढ़ाती है किन्तु मुझसे युक्त सद्भावात्मक कर्म निरन्तर
english_translation: O wise one! Ignorance always greatly increases its influence, but actions connected to me with true attitude continue steadily.
essence: True, sincere action connected to the divine persists even as ignorance spreads.
simple_meaning: Ignorance tends to increase its power, but actions done with true connection to the divine continue steadily without stopping.
insight: It teaches you to maintain steady, sincere effort despite increasing confusion or obstacles.
modern_relevance: You notice distractions and doubts growing around your work, yet keeping steady and true to your values carries you through.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अल वर्द्धयते विद्याप्रभाव जगतीतले।
भावप्रभाव एतावान्महानस्ति पितृव्रजाः ! ॥
translation: जगत में विद्या के 'प्रभाव को ही वृद्धि करते हैं । हे पितृगण ! भाव का प्रभाव इतना महान् है
english_translation: The influence of knowledge alone grows on the world's surface. O ancestors, the power of emotion is even greater.
essence: Emotions influence the world more deeply than knowledge alone.
simple_meaning: Knowledge changes the world, but emotions influence it even more deeply.
insight: It shifts focus from intellect alone to the profound impact of emotional energy on perception and action.
modern_relevance: You notice how your mood colors your day more than what you know or plan.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
वलादयस्य जड़ो याति चैतन्यं महदद्भुतम् ।
जड़ायामपिमूर्तौ  वै येनैवाविर्भवाम्यहम् ॥
translation: कि उसके बल से जड़ महाभुत चैतन्य को प्राप्त होता है जिस कारण से ही मैं जड़ मूर्ति में भी निश्चय प्रकट होता हूं
english_translation: By that power, the inert great element attains consciousness, through which even in inert form I certainly manifest.
essence: Consciousness exists even within what appears lifeless, revealing unity of all forms.
simple_meaning: The power behind all things brings consciousness even to what appears lifeless, and through that power, I appear in all forms.
insight: Recognize that awareness underlies all appearances, shifting how you relate to the world’s forms.
modern_relevance: You might see something ordinary and lifeless, but underneath, it holds potential and awareness you don’t immediately notice.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अससमापि सत्यं स्यात् क्तं जीवहिताय वै ।
अधर्मों जायते धर्मः पशुहिंसा यथाऽवरे ॥
translation: मिथ्या भी सत्य हो जाता है जो कि जीवों के हित के लिये ही कहा गया हो । अधर्म धर्म हो जाता है, यथा-यश में पशुहिंसा
english_translation: Falsehood becomes true when said for the welfare of living beings. Wrong becomes right, just as harming animals is seen as a sin.
essence: Truth and wrongness depend on whether actions serve the welfare of living beings.
simple_meaning: Sometimes what seems false can be true if it helps living beings. Similarly, what seems wrong can be right depending on how it affects others.
insight: It shifts your mind from fixed rules to evaluating actions by their impact and intention.
modern_relevance: You notice someone bending strict rules to protect a friend or family member, challenging your ideas of right and wrong.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
यात्येवं भावसम्बन्धञ्चितन्यं जड़तामिह ! ।
सत्यं मिथ्या भवेद्धर्मो जायतेऽधर्मरूपभाक् ॥
translation: इस प्रकार इस संसार में भाव के सम्बन्ध से  चैतन्य जड़ सत्य असत्य और धर्म अधर्म हो जाता है
english_translation: In this world, through attachment to feelings, consciousness becomes inert, truth becomes false, and dharma appears as adharma.
essence: Attachment to feelings clouds awareness, reversing truth and right action.
simple_meaning: When you get caught in your feelings, your awareness dulls, and what is true and right can seem false and wrong.
insight: It teaches you to notice how feelings can distort your perception of truth and ethics.
modern_relevance: You react strongly to a situation, and suddenly your clear judgment feels clouded, making good choices seem impossible.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
भावशुद्धिसमायुक्तमसत्कर्म्मोप्यतो ध्रुवम् ।
आपद्ध्रमें भजत्येव सद्धर्मत्वं न संशयः ॥
translation: इसी करण भावशुद्धियुक्त असत् कर्म भी आसद्धर्म में निःसन्देह सद्धर्मरूप में परिणत होकर ही
english_translation: Even actions that seem wrong, when done with pure intention, surely transform into right conduct without doubt.
essence: Pure intention transforms even seemingly wrong actions into unquestionably right conduct.
simple_meaning: If you act with a pure heart, even actions that seem wrong become right and aligned with true purpose.
insight: It shifts your focus from judging actions by their appearance to valuing the purity of your motivation.
modern_relevance: You made a mistake but acted sincerely. That honesty can change the meaning of your choice, making it right in deeper ways.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
विधत्तेऽदश्च जीवानां मङ्गलं परमं सदा ।
गतिः सूक्ष्मास्ति धर्मस्य भवन्तोऽतः पितृवजाः!॥
translation: जीवों के लिये सदा परम मङ्गल विधायक होता है। धर्म की गति सूक्ष्म है अतः हे पितृगण!
english_translation: The highest auspiciousness is always appointed for living beings. The path of dharma is subtle, therefore, O ancestors!
essence: Your highest good is always present, though dharma’s path is subtle and requires trust.
simple_meaning: There is always a highest good appointed for all living beings. The path of dharma is delicate and not always obvious.
insight: It shifts your focus from needing clear signs to trusting subtle guidance toward your highest good.
modern_relevance: When life feels confusing or uncertain, remember that your deepest good is quietly being arranged, even if you can’t yet see how.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
कुर्युश्चेत् कर्मा मचित्ता भावशुद्धिपुरस्सरम् ।
अधिकुर्युस्तदावश्यं पूर्ण धर्म सनातनम् ॥
translation: आप सब भावशुद्धि पूर्वक भगतचित्त होकर यदि कर्म करोगे तो अवश्य सनातन धर्म के पूर्णाधिकार को प्राप्त कर सकोगे।
english_translation: If you all act with a pure heart devoted to the divine, you will certainly attain the full rights of eternal dharma.
essence: Pure, devoted action leads to complete fulfillment of eternal duty.
simple_meaning: When you act with a sincere and devoted heart, you fulfill your true, eternal purpose completely.
insight: It shifts your approach from mechanical doing to sincere, heartfelt action, aligning you with your greater purpose.
modern_relevance: You take on a task fully committed and sincere, knowing your genuine effort aligns with your deeper purpose.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
मन्त्राणां प्रणवः सेतुर्यथा मन्त्रच्युति किल ।
अपनोद्याशु सम्पूर्णो दत्ते मन्त्राधिकारिताम्॥
translation: जिस प्रकार प्रणव मन्त्रों का सेतु है, वह मन्त्रों में कोई त्रुटि रहने से उस को शीघ्र ही दूर करके मन्त्र का पूर्णाधिकार प्रदान करता है
english_translation: Just as the sacred syllable connects mantras, it quickly removes any flaw and grants full mastery over the mantra.
essence: The sacred sound bridges and quickly corrects flaws, granting full mastery.
simple_meaning: The sacred syllable works like a bridge for mantras, quickly fixing any mistake and giving full control over the mantra.
insight: It shifts your view from fearing mistakes to trusting the essential power that corrects and completes.
modern_relevance: When you feel your efforts or intentions fall short, remember the core essence can swiftly restore and complete them.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
तथैव भावसंशुद्ध्या शक्तिधर्मास्य धारिका ।
सन्तिष्ठते सदाऽक्षुण्णा नितरामूर्दध्वगामिनी ॥
translation: उसी प्रकार भावशुद्धि द्वारा सदा धर्म की उद्धर्व गामिनी धारिका शक्ति सम्पूर्ण रूप से अक्षुण्ण बनी रहती है
english_translation: Similarly, by the purity of inner state, the sustaining power of dharma remains ever whole and unbroken.
essence: Pure inner feelings keep your power to fulfill dharma whole and alive.
simple_meaning: When your feelings and inner state are pure, your power to uphold your true purpose remains steady and unbroken.
insight: It teaches you to maintain purity in your emotions to sustain unwavering strength in your actions.
modern_relevance: Before a challenging conversation, your calm and clear feelings keep your resolve strong and steady throughout.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
कदाचिदत एवाऽलमापद्धर्मस्य निर्णये।
अधर्मेणापि धर्मस्य स्वरूपे परिणम्यते ॥
translation: इसी कारण आपद्धर्म के निर्णय करने में कभी कभी अधर्म भी धर्मरूप में ही परिणत हो जाता है
english_translation: Sometimes, in deciding an emergency duty, what seems wrong transforms into the true nature of right action.
essence: In emergencies, apparent wrongs can embody the true nature of right action.
simple_meaning: In urgent or emergency situations, actions that normally seem wrong may become the right thing to do.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that moral decisions depend on context, and sometimes unconventional actions serve your true duty.
modern_relevance: When you face a sudden crisis and must choose quickly, what feels like breaking rules may actually fulfill your deeper responsibilities.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
यदा कश्चिद्विशेषस्तु धर्मः शक्तिमवाप्नुयात् ।
अधिकां भावसंशुद्धया कोटिं साधारणस्य सः ॥
translation: और जब कोई विशेष धर्म भावशुद्धि के द्वारा अधिक शक्ति लाभ करे तब वह साधारण धर्म की कोटि में पहुंचकर
english_translation: When someone attains greater power through the purity of their devotion to a particular dharma, they reach a level beyond ordinary dharma.
essence: Pure, heartfelt commitment to your purpose empowers you beyond ordinary action.
simple_meaning: When your devotion to your duty becomes pure and sincere, you gain greater power than usual.
insight: It teaches you to deepen your commitment with sincerity to unlock greater inner strength and impact.
modern_relevance: You notice how your work shines and feels stronger when your motivation is clear and truly aligned with your values.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
असाधारणधर्मास्याधिकारं लभते वहन् ।
एतावन्ननु दुर्गेयं रहस्यं धर्मगोचरम् ॥
translation: असाधारण धर्म के अधिकार को प्राप्त करता है। धर्म का रहस्य इतना दुर्ज्ञेय है कि
english_translation: Only the extraordinary one attains the right to extraordinary dharma; its secret is so difficult to grasp.
essence: Only the exceptional can truly claim the highest dharma and its hidden depth.
simple_meaning: Extraordinary duties and truths are accessible only to those with exceptional qualities.
insight: It shifts your view to see some responsibilities require rare strength and dedication.
modern_relevance: When a complex challenge arises, you sense it’s meant for those ready to rise beyond ordinary effort.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
आस्ते पितृव्रजाः ! कोऽपि यन्न शक्नोति वेदितुम् ।
धर्माधर्मौ सुनिर्णेतुं नैव कश्चिदयथार्थतः ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! जिसको कोई भी नहीं जान सकता। कोई भी यथार्थ रूप से धर्म अधर्म का निर्णय नहीं कर सकता
english_translation: O ancestors! No one can truly know or judge what is right and wrong.
essence: No one can truly and perfectly judge what is right or wrong.
simple_meaning: No one can fully understand or rightly decide what is truly right or wrong.
insight: It encourages acceptance of uncertainty in moral judgments and restraint from absolute conclusions.
modern_relevance: When faced with complex moral dilemmas, you might realize that clear-cut answers often elude you, inviting careful reflection.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
समीष्टे वा गति वेत्तुं धर्मस्यास्य कथञ्चन ।
ऋते पूर्णावतारं हि भक्तान वा ज्ञानिनो बिना ॥
translation: मेरे ज्ञानी भक्त और मेरे पूर्णावतारो के अतिरिक्त न किसी प्रकार धर्म की गति को जानने वाला ही हो सका है
english_translation: No one except my wise devotees and my complete incarnations can truly know the course of dharma.
essence: Only the devoted and fully realized can truly understand dharma’s course.
simple_meaning: Only my wise followers and full incarnations truly understand how dharma unfolds; others do not.
insight: It teaches that deep understanding of one’s true purpose requires insight beyond ordinary knowledge, gained through devotion or embodiment.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
याथार्थ्यान्निर्णय कर्त्तु धर्माधर्मव्यवस्थितेः ।
अतो वेदाः प्रमाणानि तन्मता आगमास्तथा ॥
translation: इसी कारण धर्म अधर्म की व्यवस्था के यथार्थ निर्णय करने में वेद और वेदसम्मत शास्त्र ही प्रमाण हैं
english_translation: Therefore, the Vedas and scriptures accepted by the Vedas are the authority for making true judgments about what is dharma and adharma.
essence: Real judgments about right and wrong come from trusted ancient teachings.
simple_meaning: True decisions about what is right or wrong should be based on the Vedas and scriptures accepted by them.
insight: It teaches you to trust established and respected sources as your foundation for moral decisions.
modern_relevance: When you face tough ethical choices, turning to reliable, time-tested principles can help you decide with confidence.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
सर्वे विशेषधर्मा स्युः प्रायशोऽभ्युदयप्रदाः।
तथा साधारणो धमों निःश्रेयसकरोऽखिलः ॥
translation: साधारणतः सभी विशेषधर्म अभ्युदयप्रद और सभी साधारण धर्म निःश्रेयसप्रद हैं
english_translation: Generally, all special duties lead to prosperity, and all universal duties lead to ultimate well-being.
essence: Special duties bring success; universal duties lead to lasting well-being.
simple_meaning: Some duties bring material success, but universal duties lead to true and lasting well-being.
insight: It shifts focus from short-term achievements to embracing duties that support long-term true welfare for all.
modern_relevance: You might chase tasks that bring quick rewards, but focusing on what benefits everyone creates deeper, lasting fulfillment.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
किन्तु साधारणो धर्मों दुर्गेयोऽज्ञानिभिः सदा ।
आस्ते विशेषधर्मस्तु सर्वथा भीतिवर्जित: ॥
translation: परन्तु अज्ञानियों के निकट साधारण धर्म सदा दुर्ज्ञेय है और विशेष धर्म सर्वथा भयरहित है
english_translation: For those lost in ignorance, ordinary duties are always hard to follow; special duties are completely free of fear.
essence: Confusion makes normal duties feel impossible; clear purpose removes fear from special duties.
simple_meaning: When someone is confused and unaware, regular duties feel very hard to do, but special duties are fearless and clear.
insight: Recognize when ordinary duties feel heavy because of confusion, and shift focus toward fearless, purposeful action.
modern_relevance: You face daily tasks that seem impossible when you're overwhelmed or confused, but stepping into clear purpose removes that fear.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
धर्मात्मा वै यदा धर्मे विशेषं पालयन मुहुः।
नूनमस्य पराकाष्ठां धर्मस्य लभते हिताम् ॥
translation: विशेष धर्म का पालन करते करते जब धर्मात्मा विशेष धर्म की हितकारी पराकाष्ठा को अवश्य प्राप्त कर लेता है
english_translation: When a person devoted to dharma repeatedly practices a special righteous duty, they surely attain the highest benefit of that dharma.
essence: Steadily practicing your special duty leads to its highest benefit.
simple_meaning: By repeatedly performing your specific righteous duty with dedication, you achieve its highest benefit.
insight: It teaches you to honor your specific responsibilities consistently to unlock their greatest benefits over time.
modern_relevance: You keep showing up for what matters most to you, and gradually, the full value of your efforts becomes clear and rewarding.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
साधारणस्य धर्मस्य निखिलव्यापकं तदा ।
स्वरूपं ज्ञातुमीप्टेऽसौ सर्वजीवहितमदम् ॥
translation: तब वह साधारण धर्म के सर्वव्यापक और सर्वजीव हितकारी स्वरूप को समझने में समर्थ होता है
english_translation: Then one becomes able to understand the universal and all-living beneficial nature of ordinary dharma.
essence: Ordinary dharma is universally beneficial to all living beings.
simple_meaning: You come to see that ordinary dharma is all-encompassing and benefits every living being.
insight: This shifts your view from seeing duty as small or isolated to seeing it as a universal force benefiting all life.
modern_relevance: You hesitate before a small task, doubting its worth, then realize even simple acts contribute to the well-being of everyone.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
तदन्तिके तदा सर्वे धर्ममार्गा भजन्सहो ।
वात्सल्यं हि यथा पुत्राः पौत्राश्च सन्निधौ पितुः॥
translation: अहो ! तब उसके निकट सब धर्ममार्ग ऐसे ही वात्सल्य को प्राप्त होते हैं जैसे पिता के सम्मुख उसके पुत्र पौत्र वात्सल्य को प्राप्त हुआ करते हैं।
english_translation: At that moment, all paths of dharma come together like the affection children and grandchildren show before their father.
essence: True purpose arises naturally where warm affection is present and unites all duties.
simple_meaning: All paths of true purpose unite naturally when surrounded by loving care like a family's affection for their father.
insight: It shifts your view from isolated duties to seeing them as expressions of love and connection.
modern_relevance: When your loved ones gather around you, you sense how your responsibilities and values come together naturally.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
ममैव ज्ञानिनो भक्ता धर्मे साधारणं किल।
अधिकुर्त्तं क्षमन्ते वै पूर्णतो नात्र संशयः ॥
translation: मेरे ज्ञानी भक्त ही साधारण धर्म के पूर्ण अधिकारी निश्चय ही हो सकते हैं इसमें सन्देह नहीं है
english_translation: Only my wise devotees are truly qualified to fully uphold ordinary dharma; there is no doubt about this.
essence: Only the wise and devoted are fully capable of living ordinary dharma without doubt.
simple_meaning: Only those who combine wisdom and devoted love to the divine can completely fulfill ordinary righteous duties without doubt.
insight: Recognize that true wisdom paired with sincere devotion empowers you to act with full confidence in your duties.
modern_relevance: When you feel unsure about your everyday responsibilities, remember that deep understanding combined with heartfelt devotion makes you fully capable.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
मद्गता ज्ञानिनो विज्ञाः ! धर्मज्ञानाब्धिपारगाः।
सार्द्ध केनापि धर्मेण विरोध नैव कुर्वते ॥
translation: हे विज्ञों! मेरे धर्मज्ञान रूप समुद्र के पारगामी ज्ञानी भक्त किसी भी धर्म के साथ विरोध नहीं करते हैं
english_translation: Those who have reached me, the wise who have crossed the ocean of dharma knowledge, do not oppose any dharma.
essence: True wisdom rooted in the divine accepts all dharmas without opposition.
simple_meaning: Those who have fully realized the divine and crossed the vast knowledge of dharma do not oppose any righteous way.
insight: It shifts your mind from defending one path to embracing respectful acceptance of all sincere dharmas.
modern_relevance: You see people with different beliefs around you, yet true understanding helps you honor all paths without judgment or conflict.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
साधारणे विशेषे च धर्मेऽसाधारणे तथा ।
सम्प्रदायेषु सर्वेषु भक्ता ज्ञानिन एव मे ॥
translation: हे पितरो! मेरे ज्ञानी भक्त ही विशेष धर्म, साधारण धर्म और असाधारण धर्म तथा समस्त धर्मसंप्रदायों में
english_translation: O ancestors! My devoted wise ones alone are the special, common, and extraordinary dharma in all traditions.
essence: Devoted wisdom alone is the true dharma across all spiritual traditions.
simple_meaning: Devoted wise ones embody the true essence across all kinds of dharma and traditions.
insight: Recognize that devotion combined with wisdom is the core that transcends all external forms and traditions.
modern_relevance: You meet people from different beliefs and practices, yet your sincere devotion and insight connect you deeply beyond labels and differences.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
ममैवेच्छास्त्ररूपिण्या धर्मशक्तेः स्वधाभुजः!।
सर्वव्यापकमद्वैतं रूपं नन्वीक्षितुं क्षमाः ॥
translation: मेरी ही इच्छारूपिणी धर्मशक्ति का एक सर्वव्यापक अद्वैतरूप दर्शन करने में समर्थ होकर
english_translation: I alone, as the will-shaped power of dharma, pervade all and embody non-duality; none can fully perceive my form.
essence: The all-pervading will of dharma cannot be fully seen or understood by anyone.
simple_meaning: The divine power of dharma, shaped by will, pervades everything in a non-dual way, and no one can fully see its true form.
insight: Recognize that the true essence behind your actions and life is vast and cannot be fully grasped by the mind.
modern_relevance: Sometimes you sense a greater force guiding your life that feels beyond your understanding or control, yet it shapes everything around you.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
संसारेऽत्राभिधीयन्ते श्रीजगद्गुरवो ध्रुवम् ।
लोकाभ्युदयसिद्धयर्थ कल्याणार्थश्च व सदा ॥
translation: इस संसार में निश्चय ही जगद्गुरु नाम से अभिहित होते हैं। मैंने समस्त संसार के अभ्युदय और आप लोगों के सदा कल्याणार्थ
english_translation: In this world, they are always surely called the world teachers, for the welfare and prosperity of all beings.
essence: True teachers exist always to guide and uplift all beings.
simple_meaning: In this world, the supreme teachers are always known for guiding beings toward their success and well-being.
insight: It highlights the ongoing presence of guiding wisdom dedicated to collective well-being in the world.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अंतिगुह्यं रहस्यं वो वेदतात्पर्य्यबोधकम् ।
भवद्भक्त्या प्रसन्नेन पितरो वर्णितं मया ॥
translation: वेद के तात्पर्यो का बोधक अतिगुह्य रहस्य आपकी भक्ति से प्रसन्न होकर आपसे वर्णन किया है। हे पितृगण !
english_translation: The profound secret meaning of the Vedas is revealed to you, described by me pleased with your devotion, O ancestors.
essence: Devotion reveals the deepest hidden meaning of sacred knowledge.
simple_meaning: The deepest secret meaning of the Vedas is explained here because of your devoted attitude, shared by me with the ancestors.
insight: It shows that devotion creates a receptive state in which profound wisdom can be shared and understood.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
संवर्द्धन्तां चिरं विज्ञाः ! भवत्कल्याणसम्पदः ।
धर्मवद्धिश्च संसारे जायतां नितरां मुदे ॥
translation: हे विज्ञों ! आप लोगों की कल्याण सम्पत्ति चिरकाल बढ़े और संसार में प्रसन्नता के लिये निरन्तर धर्म की वृद्धि हो
english_translation: O wise ones! May your wealth of well-being increase forever, and may the growth of dharma in the world bring constant joy.
essence: True well-being and dharma growing together create lasting joy in the world.
simple_meaning: May the wise ones' well-being grow forever, and may dharma increase in the world bringing continuous happiness.
insight: It encourages seeing well-being and right conduct as sources of lasting joy beyond personal gain.
modern_relevance: You hope that the good in yourself and your community grows steadily, bringing lasting happiness to everyone around.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
एतद्धर्मरहस्यं हि पुष्णीत हृदये सदा।
एवं कृते मनुष्याणामार्यदृष्टावपि द्रुतम् ॥
translation: आप इसी धर्म रहस्य का सदा हृदय में पोषण करो, ऐसा करने पर मनुष्यों की आर्य सृष्टि में भी
english_translation: Constantly nurture this secret of dharma in your heart; by doing so, even in noble creation, humans advance swiftly.
essence: Consistently nurturing your inner dharma speeds your growth in any noble pursuit.
simple_meaning: Always keep the secret of your true duty alive in your heart; this helps you grow quickly even in challenging circumstances.
insight: It teaches you to nurture your inner sense of purpose consistently, enabling swift progress even amid complexity.
modern_relevance: You face a tough challenge, and instead of rushing or losing focus, you quietly remind yourself of your core purpose—this steady inner nourishment fuels your growth.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
रहस्य पुनरेतद्वै प्रकाशं स्वयमेप्यति ।
वर्णाश्रमाख्यधर्मेऽस्मिन प्रायो लुप्ते भवसपि ॥
translation: यह रहस्य शीघ्र पुनः स्वयं ही प्रकाशित होगा। वर्णाश्रम धर्म के लुप्तप्राय हो जाने पर भी हे पितृगण!
english_translation: This secret will soon reveal itself again on its own, even when the duties of caste and stage of life have nearly disappeared, O ancestors!
essence: Essential truth reveals itself again even when familiar social duties fade.
simple_meaning: The core secret of life will reveal itself again naturally, even if traditional social duties nearly disappear.
insight: It shifts focus from clinging to old roles toward trusting that fundamental truth will emerge on its own.
modern_relevance: When social structures or roles you relied on change or fade, the deeper truth about your purpose will still find a way to appear.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
बीजञ्चेद्रक्षितं तर्हि सम्यक् कालप्रभावतः।
अनार्यत्वेन युक्तायां सत्यां सृष्टावपि ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: यदि उसका बीज काल प्रभाव से सुरक्षित होगा तो मनुष्य सृष्टि के अनार्यभाव धारण करने पर भी
english_translation: If its seed is properly protected over time, then even when bearing the qualities of the non-noble, the truth of creation remains firm.
essence: Protecting your inner seed keeps truth steady despite outer flaws.
simple_meaning: If the essential core inside you is well protected over time, then even when you have imperfect qualities, your true nature remains stable and truthful.
insight: It teaches you to prioritize safeguarding your core integrity over getting distracted by external imperfections or judgments.
modern_relevance: You feel overwhelmed by flaws or mistakes, but by protecting your core values and intentions, your true self stays grounded no matter what shifts around you.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
कालवेगप्रभावेण मानवानां स्वाभुजः !।
आर्यवीर्यसुरक्षातः प्रजातन्तुः सुरक्षितः ॥
translation: सृष्टि के कालवेग के प्रभाव से आर्यवीर्य की सुरक्षा रहने से प्रजातन्तु की सुरक्षा होगी और
english_translation: The rapid flow of time affects humans, but with the protection of noble strength, the community will be safeguarded.
essence: Noble strength shields the community amid time's swift changes.
simple_meaning: Time moves quickly and affects humans, but if noble strength protects them, the whole community stays safe.
insight: Understand that external forces like time affect everyone, but inner strength or collective integrity can preserve what matters.
modern_relevance: You see how fast time passes and changes things, yet strong values or support can protect your family or community.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
वर्णाश्रमेण धर्मेण युक्तः शुद्धो भविष्यति ।
यथाकालं यथादेशं यथापात्रं कदाचन ॥
translation: वर्णाश्रम धर्मयुक्त शुद्ध प्रजातन्तु की अवश्य सुरक्षा होगी और यथाकाल, यथादेश और यथापात्र किसी समय
english_translation: One who follows the duties of caste and stage of life, at the right time, place, and with the proper means, will remain pure.
essence: Purity arises when you perform your duties rightly in time, place, and manner.
simple_meaning: You become pure and steady by performing your duties according to your role, time, place, and means.
insight: It teaches you to honor the natural order of your responsibilities by timing and method, which grounds your actions and keeps you aligned.
modern_relevance: You keep your integrity when you handle your responsibilities thoughtfully, respecting context and resources, rather than rushing or forcing outcomes.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
सर्वाऽविरुद्धं सर्वेषां मङ्गलायतनं हितम् ।
सार्वभौमं पुनर्लोके धर्मज्ञानं प्रकाशयेत् ॥
translation: सर्वाविरुद्ध, सर्वमङ्गलालय हितकर और सार्वभौम धर्मज्ञान का पुनः जगत में प्रकाश होगा
english_translation: One should reveal universal, auspicious, and beneficial dharma knowledge that opposes nothing and is sovereign in the world.
essence: True dharma knowledge benefits all and opposes no one universally.
simple_meaning: You should share knowledge of dharma that benefits everyone and opposes nothing, spreading it widely.
insight: It teaches you to communicate with respect and inclusivity, focusing on what benefits everyone rather than creating conflict.
modern_relevance: You have a chance to share ideas or values that bring people together, not push them apart, even in heated discussions.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
भावशुद्धे रहस्यं यत् पुरा युष्मभ्यमुक्तवान् ।
कालप्रभावतो जाते भय आर्यप्रजास्वहो ! ॥
translation: मैंने जो भावशुद्धि का रहस्य पहले तुम से कहा है, अहो कालप्रभाव से आर्य प्रजा में
english_translation: I have previously revealed to you the secret of pure devotion; alas, it has been lost among noble beings due to the power of time.
essence: Even vital spiritual knowledge can fade away under time’s influence.
simple_meaning: The secret of pure devotion was taught before, but time has caused it to be forgotten even by noble people.
insight: Recognize that valuable spiritual insights need continual renewal or they risk being lost to time.
modern_relevance: You may have learned important truths that fade as life’s distractions and time pull you away from them.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
वर्णाश्रमाख्यधर्मस्य क्षतेरतिमहसपि ।
आपद्धर्मस्य साहाय्याभावशुद्धचैव सत्तमाः ॥
translation: वर्णाश्रमधर्म की हानि का अत्यन्त महान् भय उत्पन्न होने पर भी हे महानुभावो ! भावशुद्धि द्वारा ही
english_translation: O noble ones, even when there is great fear of losing the duties of caste and stage of life, the highest are purified only by the absence of support for improper duties.
essence: Highest purity comes from refusing to support improper duties despite fear of loss.
simple_meaning: Even if you deeply fear losing your rightful duties, your highest purity comes from not supporting improper actions.
insight: It shifts your focus from clinging to roles to maintaining purity by rejecting unethical support.
modern_relevance: You might fear losing your role or status and be tempted to take shortcuts, but true integrity means not supporting what feels wrong.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
सर्वथा निश्चितं सम्यक् तस्य रक्षा भविष्यति ।
अतः पितृगणाः ! यूयं निर्भयास्तत्पराः खलु ॥
translation: आपकी सहायता से उसकी सभी प्रकार से अवश्य सुरक्षा होगी। इस कारण हे पितृगण ! तुम सभी भयरहित और तत्पर होकर ही
english_translation: With your support, his protection is certain in every way. Therefore, ancestors, be fearless and ready.
essence: Fearless readiness and support assure complete protection.
simple_meaning: When you support someone fully, their safety is assured. So be fearless and prepared to help.
insight: It teaches you to embrace your role as a steadfast protector, releasing fear and staying prepared to act.
modern_relevance: You stand by a friend in crisis, knowing your steady support is the anchor they need to feel safe.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
पालयचं निजं नूनं कर्त्तव्यं हितसाधकम् ।
भवतां मंगलं येन लोकस्यापि भविष्यति ॥
translation: अपने हितकर कर्तव्य का अवश्य पालन करो जिससे तुम्हारा और समस्त संसार का भी मंगल होगा
english_translation: Always perform your beneficial duty, which will bring welfare to you and the entire world.
essence: Doing your beneficial duty brings welfare to yourself and the whole world.
simple_meaning: You should always perform your own duty that benefits both you and the world.
insight: It shifts focus from self-centered action to recognizing how your duty supports wider harmony.
modern_relevance: You choose to complete a task that helps others too, realizing your actions ripple beyond yourself.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
पूर्णस्वरूपं धर्मस्य जगत्यां जगदीश्वर !।
सार्वभौम प्रचार्येत लोककल्याणदं कथम् ॥
translation: हे जगदीश्वर ! धर्म का लोककल्याणकारी सार्वभौम पूर्ण स्वरुप जगत में कैसे प्रचारित हो सकता है
english_translation: O Lord of the universe! How can the universal, complete form of dharma that brings welfare to the world be propagated?
essence: The question of how to spread universal dharma for the world's benefit.
simple_meaning: How can the complete, universal form of dharma that benefits all be spread throughout the world?
insight: It invites reflection on how to effectively share and live by universal principles that benefit everyone.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
भोः सर्वेश्वर ! भक्तानां जीवानां हे त्रितापहृत् । 
धर्मास्यैवंविधोदारमूर्तेश्च दर्शनं कथम् ॥
translation: और हे भक्तजीव त्रितापहारी ! हे सर्वेश्वर ! हे महेश्वर ! धर्म की ऐसी उदार मूर्ति का दर्शन कैसे
english_translation: O Supreme Lord, remover of the threefold sufferings of devotees, how can one behold the generous embodiment of Dharma?
essence: A devotee wonders how to behold Dharma's generous form that removes suffering.
simple_meaning: This verse is a respectful question asking how one can see the generous form of Dharma, who removes the three kinds of suffering from devotees.
insight: It invites curiosity about recognizing the generous nature of righteous conduct embodied by the divine.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
शक्नुयाजीवपिण्डेषु भवितुंवा महेश्वर!।
वर्णाश्रमाख्यधर्मास्य सम्भाव्यताऽथवा कथम् ॥
translation: जीव पिण्ड में हो सकता है। अथवा हे शोकविमोचन ! वर्णाश्रम धर्म का यथार्थ प्रचार
english_translation: O Great Lord, is it possible to exist within the individual living being? Or how is the true teaching of the duties of varna and ashrama possible?
essence: Can the true self exist within the body, and how do social duties truly arise?
simple_meaning: The verse questions whether it is possible for the true self to exist within the living body or how the duties of social order can be truly established.
insight: It encourages questioning how identity relates to social roles and inner reality.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
यथावत्सम्प्रचारोऽस्मिँलोके शोकविमोचन !।
तास्मिन वर्णाश्रमे धर्मे वाधनोपस्थितौ ननु ॥
translation: इस लोक में कैसे सम्भव है और यदि उस वर्णाश्रम धर्म में बाधा पहुंचने लगे तो
english_translation: How is it possible in this world, and if obstruction arises in the duties of the varna and ashrama system?
essence: Obstacles in social duties raise doubt about finding relief from grief in this world.
simple_meaning: It questions how grief can be released in this world, especially if duties based on social order are obstructed.
insight: It invites you to question whether rigid social expectations limit your freedom to find ease and meaning.
modern_relevance: You might feel stuck when your expected roles or responsibilities seem to block your personal growth or peace.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
बीजंवा तस्य धर्मस्य रक्षितं स्यात् कथं विभो ।
उपस्थिते सुकालेऽस्य येन वृद्धिर्भवेत्पुनः ॥
translation: हे विभो ! उस धर्म की बीजरक्षा कैसे हो सकती है जिससे सुसमय उपस्थित होने पर पुनः उसकी वृद्धि हो सके
english_translation: O Vibhava! How can the seed of that dharma be protected if, when the right time comes, it can increase again?
essence: True dharma’s seed never requires repeated growth at the right time.
simple_meaning: Real dharma’s seed is safe only if it does not need to grow again when the right moment arrives.
insight: It shifts your view from dharma as a temporary effort to dharma as a steady, self-sustaining principle.
modern_relevance: You notice how some values or habits feel shaky because they need constant restarting instead of steady presence.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
जीवसृष्टिरहस्ये वा मानवानाञ्च किंविधम् ।
जन्ममृत्युगतं नाथ ! वैलक्षण्यं सुगोपितम् ॥
translation: और हे नाथ ! जीव सृष्टि रहस्य में मनुष्यों की जन्ममृत्यु की कैसी विचित्रता रखी गई है
english_translation: O Lord, what is the mysterious peculiarity placed in the birth and death of humans within the secret of living creation?
essence: Human birth and death hold a deep mystery hidden within life's secret creation.
simple_meaning: This asks about the mysterious nature of human birth and death hidden within the secret of life’s creation.
insight: It invites curiosity to explore the hidden patterns behind human life cycles beyond surface appearances.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सहायकाः कथं स्याम मानवानां क्रमोन्नतौ ।
सामञ्जस्यं भवत्दसृष्टेन रक्षितुमीश्महे ॥
translation: मनुष्यों  की क्रमो उन्नति में हम कैसे सहायक हो सक्ते हैं जिससे आपकी सृष्टि का सामञ्जस्य हम रक्षा करने में समर्थ हो
english_translation: How can we assist humans in their gradual progress to uphold harmony in your creation?
essence: Helping steady progress supports the harmony that holds creation together.
simple_meaning: We seek ways to help humans progress steadily while maintaining harmony in the world.
insight: It teaches you to balance encouragement of growth with preserving harmony in relationships and systems.
modern_relevance: You notice a team struggling to improve while keeping peace among members—you wonder how best to support both growth and unity.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
भावत्रयगतं ह्येतद्रहस्यं सर्वमुत्तमम्।
उपदिश्य प्रभो ! सम्यगम्मानय कृतार्थय ॥
translation: हे प्रभो! इस समय त्रिविध भागवत उक्त सर्वोतम रहस्यों का हमें भलीभांति, उपदेश देकर कृतार्थ कीजिये
english_translation: O Lord! Please teach us fully and clearly the supreme secrets found in the threefold devotion.
essence: Complete guidance is needed to understand devotion's highest mysteries fully.
simple_meaning: This verse asks the Lord to clearly teach the highest mysteries within the threefold devotion so the seekers may be fulfilled.
insight: It shows the importance of clear guidance to deeply understand complex spiritual devotion.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
पितरो का शुभाकाङ्क्षां जगत्कल्याणकारिणीम् ।
आलोक्यातिप्रसन्नोऽहं भवन्तो मे प्रिया यतः ॥
translation: हे पितृगण! जगत्कल्याणकारिणी आपकी शुभ कामना को देखकर मैं अति प्रसन्न हुआ है क्योंकि आपलोग मेरे प्रिय हैं
english_translation: O ancestors! Seeing your good wishes for the welfare of the world, I am very pleased because you are dear to me.
essence: Joy arises from feeling the heartfelt goodwill of those you cherish.
simple_meaning: The speaker feels happy because the ancestors wish well for the world and they are dear to him.
insight: It shows how recognizing support and goodwill around you can uplift your spirit and strengthen resolve.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
सानन्दं पूरयिष्येऽतोऽमिलापं व: शुभावहम ।
नवाधिभौतिकं ज्ञानं कल्याः! स्थूलजगद्दतम् ॥
translation: इसलिये मैं आनन्दपूर्वक आपकी शुभकामना को पूर्ण करूंगा। हे पितृगण !जब तक स्थूल जगत सम्बन्धीय आधिभौतिक ज्ञान
english_translation: Therefore, I will joyfully fulfill your auspicious wishes, O ancestors! Until the knowledge of the nine levels of the physical world and the gross universe is complete.
essence: Joyful commitment arises from fulfilling auspicious wishes through deep knowledge of the physical world.
simple_meaning: I will gladly fulfill your auspicious wishes until the complete knowledge of the physical universe is achieved.
insight: It shows commitment to fulfilling spiritual wishes through thorough understanding of the physical and cosmic realities.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
तथाऽऽधिदैविकं ज्ञान सूक्ष्मदैवजगद्गतम ।
अध्यात्मराज्यसम्बद्धमात्मज्ञानं तथैव च ॥
translation: सूक्ष्म देवी जगत्सम्बन्धीय अधिदैविक ज्ञान और उसी प्रकार अध्यात्म राज्यसम्बन्धीय आत्मज्ञान
english_translation: Subtle divine knowledge relates to the world, and similarly, spiritual knowledge pertains to the realm of the true self.
essence: Knowledge binds the unseen divine world and the realm of your true self.
simple_meaning: There are two subtle kinds of knowledge: one that connects to the divine world, and another that connects to understanding your true self.
insight: This verse invites you to explore both external divine truths and inner self-awareness as complementary dimensions of wisdom.
modern_relevance: You sense the difference between learning facts about the world and truly understanding who you are inside.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
प्रोक्तमेवं विधं ज्ञानं त्रिविध न प्रकाशते ।
मानवानां समाजेऽलं युगपदयावदेव ह ॥
translation: इस प्रकार के उक्त त्रिविधज्ञान का विकास एक ही काल में सम्यक् रूप से मनुष्य समाज मे नहीं होता है तब तक
english_translation: Such threefold knowledge does not arise fully at the same time in human society.
essence: Threefold knowledge unfolds gradually, never all at once in society.
simple_meaning: Three types of knowledge do not fully appear together at the same time in human society.
insight: It shifts the mind to accept gradual growth rather than expecting sudden full understanding.
modern_relevance: You notice different insights in yourself and others appear at different times, never all at once.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
ज्ञानज्योर्तिन जागर्ति तावत्पूर्णञ्च सात्त्विकम् ।
मत्यार्न्त: करणे नूनमिति में दृढनिश्चयः ॥
translation: पूर्ण सात्विक ज्ञान की ज्योति मनुष्य अन्तःकरण में प्रतिभासित नहीं ही होती है यह मेरा दृढ़ निश्चय है
english_translation: The light of complete sattvic knowledge surely does not shine within the human inner instrument; this is my firm conviction.
essence: Complete clear knowledge often remains hidden inside the human mind.
simple_meaning: Complete pure knowledge does not always reveal itself clearly within a person's mind.
insight: Recognize that wisdom often grows unseen inside before it becomes obvious; patience with inner growth matters.
modern_relevance: You might study or seek truth deeply but still feel the clarity hasn’t fully dawned within your mind.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
यावन्निखिलभूतेष्वविभक्तञ्चैक्यदर्शकम् ।
सदा पूर्ण प्रकाशेताधिकं ज्ञानं न सात्त्विकम् ॥
translation: जब तक सर्वभूतों में अविभक्त और सब भूतों में ऐक्यभाव को दिखाने वाला, सब दशा में पूर्ण रहने वाला सात्विक ज्ञान
english_translation: True wisdom is that which always reveals the undivided unity in all beings, shining fully in every condition; anything beyond this is not pure wisdom.
essence: Wisdom is complete only when it always perceives unity in all beings.
simple_meaning: True wisdom always sees the oneness that underlies all beings and shines fully in every state.
insight: It shifts your perspective from seeing separation to recognizing oneness in diversity, refining your inner clarity.
modern_relevance: When you notice the connection beneath differences—whether at work or in relationships—your understanding deepens beyond surface divisions.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
मानवानां समाजेषु सार्वभौमं विराडलम् ।
नावन्नैवावबुध्येत स्वरूपं धर्मगोचरम् ॥
translation: मनुष्य समाज में अधिक रूप से प्रकाशित नहीं होता है तब तक धर्म के सार्वभौम विराट् स्वरुप का सम्यक् अनुभव मनुष्यसमाज नहीं ही कर सकता है
english_translation: Until humanity fully understands the universal vast form of dharma, it cannot truly experience its essence.
essence: True experience of dharma requires fully seeing its universal vastness.
simple_meaning: People cannot truly experience dharma’s universal nature until they fully understand its vast and universal form.
insight: It shifts your focus from isolated duties to embracing a universal purpose that connects everything.
modern_relevance: You might follow rules or roles but still feel disconnected until you sense the larger purpose behind them all.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
कायविद्या चिकित्सा च शल्यविद्या रसायनम् । 
उद्भित्स्वेदाण्डजानां हि तत्त्वविद्या तथैव च ॥
translation: मेरे अधिभौतिक ज्ञान में शारीरिक विद्या, चिकित्सा विद्या, शल्यविद्या, रसायनविद्या, उद्भिज तत्त्वविद्या, स्वेदज तत्वविद्या, अण्डज तत्वविद्या
english_translation: My superior knowledge includes physical science, medicine, surgery, alchemy, and the knowledge of plant, sweat-born, and egg-born elements.
essence: Superior knowledge includes many worldly sciences but is not the ultimate truth alone.
simple_meaning: The speaker describes various branches of superior, worldly knowledge that he possesses, including physical sciences and medical arts.
insight: Recognize that mastery of multiple practical sciences enriches understanding but differs from spiritual wisdom.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
पाशवी तत्वविद्या च तत्त्वाविद्या च मानवी । 
क्षिखपूतेजोमरुदव्योमतत्त्वविद्या तथैव च ॥
translation: पशु तत्वविद्या, मनुष्य तत्वविद्या, भूत तत्वविद्या, आकाश तत्त्वविद्या, जल तत्त्वविद्या, वायु तत्त्वविद्या, अग्नि तत्वविद्या
english_translation: There is knowledge of the nature of beasts, knowledge of the nature of humans, knowledge of the nature of beings, knowledge of the nature of space, water, air, and fire.
essence: Knowledge covers the nature of beings and elements across life and matter.
simple_meaning: There are different kinds of knowledge about the nature of animals, humans, and the basic elements like air and fire.
insight: Recognize that knowledge spans many levels—from living beings to natural elements—broadening how you understand existence.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
नाना पदार्थविद्या मे सन्ति नूनं सहायिकाः ।
आधिभौतीशक्तिविद्या ज्ञानेखल्वाधिभौतिके ॥
translation: आधिभौतिक शक्तिविद्या, ये अनेक पदार्थ विद्याएँ अवश्य सहायक हैं
english_translation: The knowledge of the fundamental material energy is supported by many different material sciences.
essence: Deep understanding of fundamental material energy depends on many supporting sciences.
simple_meaning: Understanding the basic material energy depends on many different material sciences that help explain it.
insight: It teaches you to appreciate how broad knowledge supports core understanding, encouraging you to integrate many perspectives.
modern_relevance: You might see a complex system at work, like your phone or body, and realize it depends on many smaller fields of knowledge coming together.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
आविष्कारस्तथा ज्ञानलामो वै वर्तते ध्रुवम् ।
आसां पदार्थविद्यानां सुलभो नात्र संशयः ॥
translation: इन पदार्थ विद्याओं का आविष्कार और ज्ञान लाभ करना अवश्य ही सहजसाध्य है इसमें सन्देह नहीं
english_translation: The discovery and gaining of knowledge about material substances is certainly easy and without doubt.
essence: Understanding material things is naturally easy and free from doubt.
simple_meaning: Gaining knowledge about the physical world and its substances is straightforward and clear, without confusion.
insight: This verse shifts your view from fearing complexity to trusting that tangible knowledge is within your grasp.
modern_relevance: When you study something concrete, like how your devices work or how food is made, you realize that practical knowledge is usually simpler than it seems.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
आसाद्यन्ते यतो नून पुरुषार्थेस्तु केवलेः।
लौकिकैरेच लोकेषु विद्या उक्ता इमा द्रुतम् ॥
translation: क्योकि उक्त यह सभी विद्याएँ केवल लौकिक पुरुषार्थ से ही संसार में अवश्य ही शीघ्र प्राप्त होती हैं
english_translation: Because all these knowledges are indeed quickly attained in the world only through worldly effort.
essence: Worldly knowledge arises swiftly only through sincere, focused effort.
simple_meaning: You can only gain worldly knowledge quickly by putting in dedicated effort in this world.
insight: It teaches you to trust that sincere effort directly leads to practical learning and skills.
modern_relevance: You’ve studied hard for a certification or skill—your effort is the surest way to get results fast.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
दुर्ज्ञेयैः पितरः ! किन्तु सूक्ष्मराज्यविभूतिभिः । 
पूर्णाऽधिदैवविद्याऽत्तिगुह्या दुर्जेयत्रैभवा ॥
translation: परन्तु हे पितृगण! दुर्गेय सूक्ष्म राज्य की विभूतियों से पूर्ण अधिदेव विद्या प्रतिगुह्य और दुर्गेय वैभवा है
english_translation: But, O ancestors, the supreme divine knowledge is subtle, profound, and invincible, filled with the powers of the subtle realm.
essence: True divine knowledge is subtle, deeply hidden, and invincible against being grasped prematurely.
simple_meaning: The supreme divine knowledge is very subtle, hidden, and protected by powerful forces that make it impossible to conquer.
insight: Recognize that some essential wisdom requires patience and readiness before it can be understood or accessed.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
यस्य किञ्चिद्रहस्यं वः संक्षेपावर्णयाम्यहम् ।
सावधानभवद्भिश्च श्रूयतां पितरोऽधुना ॥
translation: जिसका कुछ रहस्य संक्षेप से मैं आपसे कहता हूँ हे पितृगण ! इस समयं आपलोग सावधान होकर सुनो
english_translation: I briefly reveal a certain secret to you, O ancestors; now listen carefully.
essence: Important knowledge requires focused and careful listening.
simple_meaning: A speaker announces that a brief secret will now be revealed and asks the listeners to pay close attention.
insight: It invites you to focus fully before receiving valuable knowledge, highlighting the power of attention.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
असावेकाऽद्वितीयाऽपि श्यामा में प्रकृतिः सती ।
स्थलात्सूक्ष्मात्तुरीयाच कारणाद्रूपतस्तथा ॥
translation: मेरी प्रकृति श्यामा एक और अद्वितीय होकर भी स्थूल सूक्ष्म कारण और तुरीय रूप से
english_translation: My nature, Shyama, though one and without a second, manifests as gross, subtle, causal, and the fourth state.
essence: One unique nature expresses as gross, subtle, causal, and transcendent forms simultaneously.
simple_meaning: Your true nature is one and unique, yet it shows itself in four forms: gross, subtle, causal, and beyond.
insight: It teaches you to recognize unity within diversity, seeing all experiences as expressions of one true nature.
modern_relevance: When you feel fragmented or scattered, remember your true nature is one, expressing in many ways beyond what you see.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
चतुर्धा संविभक्ताऽलं राजते विश्वमोहिनी ।
सन्देहो नात्र कर्तव्यो विस्मयो वा कदाचन ॥
translation: यह विश्वमोहिनी चतुर्धा विभक्त होकर विराजमान है, इसमें संदेह अथवा विस्मय कभी नहीं करना चाहिये
english_translation: This cosmic illusion shines divided into four parts; in it, doubt or astonishment must never arise.
essence: The cosmic illusion is clearly divided; doubt or surprise is unnecessary.
simple_meaning: The cosmic illusion is divided into four parts and shines clearly; you should never feel doubt or surprise about it.
insight: It shifts your mind from doubting the nature of illusion to accepting its structured presence.
modern_relevance: When faced with confusing or overwhelming experiences, you can trust that the complexity you see is structured and not random or baffling.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
स्थूलायाः प्रकृतेः सप्ताधिकाराः सन्ति सर्वथा। 
तेषामेवाधिकाराणां गूढः शक्तिमयो महान् ॥
translation: स्थूल प्रकृति के सर्वथा सप्त अधिकार हैं उन्हीं सप्त  अधिकारों के शक्तिमय महान्
english_translation: The gross natural world has exactly seven authorities, and the great power resides in those seven alone.
essence: All power in the material world is contained in seven fundamental authorities.
simple_meaning: The material world is governed by exactly seven main forces, and the great power lies hidden within these forces.
insight: It invites you to focus on mastering or understanding the few key forces behind the many changes you see around you.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
रहस्यसङ्घः पितरो वर्त्तते सम्भकाशकः।
आधिभौतिकवोधातिगृहाविज्ञानविस्तृतेः ॥
translation: गहन रहस्यसमूह हे पितृगण ! आधिभौतिक ज्ञान के अतिगुह्य विज्ञान विस्तार के प्रकाशक हैं
english_translation: The ancestors are the secret assembly, the revealers of profound knowledge beyond worldly understanding.
essence: Ancestors form a secret group revealing knowledge beyond the physical world.
simple_meaning: The ancestors form a secret group who reveal knowledge that goes beyond basic worldly understanding.
insight: Recognize that deep wisdom often comes through a hidden lineage beyond surface knowledge.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
सप्तधा शक्तिविज्ञानं स्थूलायाः प्रकृतेरपि ।
जगत्यां प्रायशो नैव सम्भवेत्सम्मकाशितम् ॥
translation: स्थूल प्रकृति के सप्तविध शक्ति विज्ञान का भी जगत में प्रकाशित होना प्रायः सम्भव नहीं ही होता है।
english_translation: The sevenfold knowledge of powers in the gross nature rarely manifests openly in the world.
essence: The deep powers of gross nature rarely reveal themselves clearly in the world.
simple_meaning: The detailed powers of the gross material nature rarely appear clearly or openly in the world.
insight: Recognize that much of reality's deeper forces are subtle and not immediately visible, requiring patient observation.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
सन्सेवातीव गुह्यानि रहस्यान्यपराणि तु ।
नैवात्र संशयः कोऽपि कर्त्तव्यः पितरो धुधाः ! ॥
translation: अन्यान्य रहस्य तो अतिगुह ही हैं, हे विज्ञ पितृगणं! इसमें कुछ भी सन्देह नहीं करना चाहिए
english_translation: Other secrets are indeed deeply hidden; there should be no doubt about this, O wise ancestors!
essence: Some truths are deeply hidden and must be accepted without doubt.
simple_meaning: There are other secrets that are very deeply hidden, and there is no need to doubt this fact.
insight: It teaches you to accept that some knowledge is beyond immediate reach and requires trust in the process.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
सूक्ष्मकारणयोः शक्तयोविज्ञानौघः समुच्यते ।
आधिदैविकसम्बन्धिज्ञानं नैवात्र संशयः ॥
translation: सूक्ष्म शक्ति और कारण शक्ति के विज्ञानसमूह आधिदैविक ज्ञान कहाते हैं इसमें सन्देह नहीं
english_translation: The collective knowledge of subtle power and causal power is called higher divine knowledge; there is no doubt in this.
essence: Higher wisdom arises from knowing both subtle and causal powers without doubt.
simple_meaning: Higher divine knowledge means understanding the combined subtle and causal powers behind reality without any doubt.
insight: It teaches you to integrate both visible causes and subtle forces to grasp reality fully.
modern_relevance: When you explore not just surface causes but also subtle influences behind events, your understanding deepens and doubt fades.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
शक्तेस्तत्त्वं तुरीयाया वाङ्मनोबुद्धयगोचरम् ।
यदास्ते तद्विजानीत ज्ञानमध्यात्मसंज्ञकम् ॥
translation: तुरीय शक्ति का जो मन वचन और बुद्धि से अतीत तत्त्व है उसको अध्यात्म ज्ञान जानना चाहिए
english_translation: The essence of the supreme power is beyond mind, speech, and intellect; this is called spiritual knowledge.
essence: The deepest power is beyond mind, speech, and intellect—it is true spiritual knowledge.
simple_meaning: True spiritual knowledge is about the power that is beyond your mind, speech, and intellect.
insight: This verse shifts your understanding from relying on mental concepts to opening to a reality beyond mental limits.
modern_relevance: When your thoughts and words fail to capture the full truth, you feel the presence of something deeper inside you.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अमीषां ज्ञानपुंजनां त्रिविधानामसंशयम् ।
बोधो रहस्यवर्गस्य सुगमो नैव वर्तते ॥
translation: इन त्रिविध ज्ञानसमूह के रहस्यों को समझना निःसन्देह ही सहज नहीं है
english_translation: Understanding the mysteries of these three types of knowledge is certainly not easy.
essence: Some knowledge’s deepest secrets cannot be easily understood without patient inquiry.
simple_meaning: The mysteries contained in three kinds of knowledge are not easy to understand without effort and patience.
insight: It teaches you to approach deep knowledge with openness and sustained questioning rather than expecting quick answers.
modern_relevance: When you face complex ideas or confusing information, it’s natural to feel stuck. Real understanding unfolds slowly with attention and patience.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
ममैव ज्ञानिनो भक्ताः शक्नुवन्ति मुखं द्रुतम् ।
रहस्यं ज्ञातुमेतेपां पितरो नात्र संशयः ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! मेरे ज्ञानीभक्त ही इनके रहस्य को अनायास शीघ्र समझने में समर्थ होते हैं इसमें सन्देह नहीं है।
english_translation: O ancestors! Only my wise devotees can quickly and effortlessly understand this secret, there is no doubt in this.
essence: Only wise devotion can swiftly reveal hidden spiritual secrets without doubt.
simple_meaning: Only those who combine wisdom and devotion to Shiva can quickly understand this secret without difficulty.
insight: It teaches that devotion alone or wisdom alone is incomplete; together they accelerate deep understanding.
modern_relevance: When you deeply trust and seek wisely, complex ideas become clear faster than you expect.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
श्यामा त्रैगुण्यमव्यास्ते प्रक्रिर्तिर्मे स्वभावतः ।
धर्मोऽस्ति त्रिगुणानाञ्च चाञ्चल्यं श्रुतिसम्मतः ॥
translation: मेरी प्रकृति श्यामा स्वभाव से त्रिगुणमयी है और त्रिगुण का धर्म अस्थिरता है यह श्रुतिसम्मत है
english_translation: My nature is dark and composed of the three qualities; the nature of these three qualities is instability, as the scriptures confirm.
essence: Instability and restlessness arise naturally from the three qualities composing all nature.
simple_meaning: Everything in the natural world is made of three qualities, and these qualities cause constant change and restlessness.
insight: Recognize restlessness as a natural effect of the three qualities, so you stop blaming yourself and begin observing with clarity.
modern_relevance: When your moods and thoughts keep shifting unpredictably, it helps to know this restlessness is built into your nature, not a personal flaw.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
परिणामिन्यतो नित्यं प्रकृतिर्मेऽस्त्यसंशयम् ।
तदा सा पोच्यते विद्या मां यदेवावलोकते ॥
translation: इस कारण मेरी प्रकृति निःसन्देह सदा परिणामिनी रहती है। जब वह मेरी तरफ देखती है तब वह विद्या कहलाती है
english_translation: My nature is certainly always transformative; when it looks upon me, that is called wisdom.
essence: True wisdom is the changing nature recognizing the unchanging true self.
simple_meaning: Your inner nature is always changing. When this changing nature recognizes your true self, that recognition is called wisdom.
insight: It shifts your focus from being lost in constant change to recognizing the stable observer within.
modern_relevance: When your moods shift or circumstances change, wisdom comes from recognizing the steady self beneath those changes.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
यदा बहिर्मुखीनाऽसौ प्रसूते जगद्भतम् ।
तदाऽविद्याभिधानेन नूनमेषाऽभिधीयते ॥
translation: जब वह बहिर्मुखीन होकर अद्भुत जगत् प्रसव करती है तब ही वह अविद्या कहाती है
english_translation: When it turns outward and creates the wondrous world, that is indeed called deep confusion.
essence: Turning outward to the world causes deep confusion that veils true understanding.
simple_meaning: Deep confusion arises when your attention moves outward, creating the appearance of the world.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that confusion arises from focusing outside rather than within, prompting a shift inward.
modern_relevance: When you get lost scrolling endlessly on your phone, your mind turns outward and confusion grows, hiding your true clarity.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
प्रेमसात्प्रकृतेः स्वस्याः स्यामहं विश्ववीजदः।
त्रिविधानां हि देवानां भवेयं जनकोऽपि च ॥
translation: मैं अपनी प्रकृति के प्रेम के वशीभूत होकर जगत का बीजदाता बन जाता हूँ और मैं ही विविध श्रेणी के देवताओं का जनक भी बन जाता हूँ
english_translation: By being immersed in the love of my own nature, I become the seed-giver of the universe and the progenitor of the three classes of deities.
essence: Loving your true nature makes you the source of all creation and divine life.
simple_meaning: By deeply loving my own true nature, I become the source from which everything in the universe arises, including all divine beings.
insight: It teaches you that embracing and loving your true nature unlocks your creative potential.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
त एव त्रिविधा देवा विश्वस्य त्रिविधा गतीः ।
पालयन्ते तथा मृष्टीः सत्यमेतन्न संशयः ॥
translation: वही विविध देवतागण जगत की त्रिविध दृष्टि और गति का संरक्षण करते हैं यह सत्य है इसमें सन्देह नहीं
english_translation: The various radiant beings protect the world’s threefold vision and threefold movement; this truth is beyond doubt.
essence: Multiple radiant beings sustain the world's threefold vision and movement without fail.
simple_meaning: Different divine beings sustain the world’s three types of vision and movement; this is an unquestionable truth.
insight: It highlights the dependable support sustaining the world's complex systems beyond human control.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
भिन्ना त्रिगुणवैचित्र्याच्छक्तिद्वैविध्य आत्मना ।
दृष्टिगोचरतामेति श्यामाऽत्र जगतीतले ॥
translation: श्यामा त्रिगुण वैचित्र्य से दो प्रकार की शक्ति में विभक्त होकर इस जगत में दिखाई देती है
english_translation: The dark energy appears in this world divided by three qualities and two types of power.
essence: The world’s energy appears divided into three qualities and two powers within the self.
simple_meaning: The dark energy that fills the world shows up as divided by three qualities and two kinds of power in the self.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing the world as one thing to recognizing multiple forces shaping experience.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
शक्ती त एव कथ्येते आकर्षणविकर्षणे ।
रागद्वेषौ च पितरो नाऽत्र कश्चन संशयः ॥
translation: उन्हीं शक्तियों को आकर्षण विकर्षण और राग द्वेष कहते हैं हे पितृगण ! इसमें कोई सन्देह नहीं है
english_translation: Those forces are called attraction, repulsion, and attachment and aversion, O ancestors! There is no doubt about this.
essence: Attraction, repulsion, attachment, and aversion are undeniable forces shaping experience.
simple_meaning: These forces are known as attraction, repulsion, attachment, and aversion; there is no doubt about it.
insight: Naming these forces helps you notice when your mind is pulled by desire or pushed by dislike.
modern_relevance: You feel drawn to some things and pushed away from others; knowing this helps you see your emotional patterns clearly.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
आद्ये स्थूलेऽपरौ सूक्ष्मौ विद्यते पितरो ध्रुवम् ।
एतयोर्गुणसम्बन्धः प्रोच्यते साम्मतं मया ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! प्रथम स्थूल और दूसरी सूक्ष्म ही है। अब मैं इन दोनों शक्तियों का गुण सम्बन्ध कहता हूँ
english_translation: O ancestral beings! First is the gross, and second is the subtle. Now I describe the relationship of qualities between these two powers.
essence: Two fundamental powers exist: gross and subtle, linked by qualities.
simple_meaning: There are two fundamental powers: one gross and one subtle. This verse introduces their relationship.
insight: It invites you to notice the layers beneath appearances, distinguishing between what is tangible and what is subtle energy or mind.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अस्ति रागो रजोमूलस्तथाऽऽकर्पणमेव च।
विकर्षणं तथा द्वेषस्तगोमूलश्च विद्यते ॥
translation: आकर्षण और राग रजोमूलक और विकर्षण और द्वेष तमोमूलक हैं
english_translation: Attraction and attachment come from passion; aversion and hatred arise from darkness.
essence: Attachment arises from passion; aversion grows from deep darkness within.
simple_meaning: Attachment and attraction arise from the energy of passion, while aversion and hatred come from deep darkness within.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that your emotional reactions come from underlying qualities, helping you respond more wisely.
modern_relevance: When you find yourself strongly drawn to something or strongly rejecting it, it's often passion or inner darkness shaping your feelings, not just rational choice.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
समन्वये द्वयोः सत्त्वगुणो नूनं विकाशते ।
अतः समन्वयादेव तयोविश्वस्य धारिका ॥
translation: दोनों के समन्वय में ही सत्वगुण का विकास होता है इस कारण आकर्षण विकर्षण के समन्वय से ही जगत की धारक
english_translation: The quality of harmony arises from the union of the two, and this union alone sustains the entire world.
essence: The world exists because harmony grows from the union of opposites.
simple_meaning: Harmony or balance develops when two opposing forces come together, and this union supports the entire world.
insight: It teaches you to see opposing elements not as enemies, but as partners whose union creates strength.
modern_relevance: When conflicting feelings or ideas come together in your life, you create a balance that keeps everything stable.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
विश्वं रक्षति मच्छक्तिः सात्त्विकी धर्मरूपिणी।
नित्या सा वर्तते नित्यं विश्वकल्याणकारिणी ॥
translation: धर्मरूपिणी मेरी सात्त्विक शक्ति जगत की रक्षा करती है। यह नित्या और सर्वदा विश्व का कल्याण करनेवाली है
english_translation: My sattvic power, embodying dharma, protects the world. It always exists and continuously brings welfare to all.
essence: Pure, righteous power always protects and benefits the world without interruption.
simple_meaning: A pure, righteous power that embodies true purpose always protects and benefits the entire world without fail.
insight: This verse invites you to see your true strength as a steady, benevolent force aligned with right purpose.
modern_relevance: When you act with clear, ethical intention, your inner strength naturally supports not just yourself but those around you.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
आरभ्य पितरोऽनेकग्रहोपाहतोऽखिलम् ।
अण्वन्तं स्थितिमादत्ते तस्मादेव समन्वयात् ॥
translation: हे पितरो! उसी समन्वय से अनेक ग्रह उपग्रह से लेकर परमाणु पर्यन्त सब स्थिति भाव को धारण करते हैं
english_translation: O ancestors! From that same union, many planets, their satellites, and even atoms hold their states of being.
essence: All existence from atoms to planets is held by one unified principle.
simple_meaning: All things, from huge planets and their moons to tiny atoms, exist because of one fundamental union.
insight: See the universe as a seamless whole connected by a single underlying principle.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
तथा समन्वयस्यैव दशायां द्वेषरागयोः ।
जीवान्तःकरणे सत्त्वगुणस्यैव प्रकाशतः ॥
translation: उसी प्रकार रागद्वेष के समन्वय की दशा में ही सत्त्वगुण का विकाश जीव के अन्तःकरण में होने से
english_translation: Similarly, in the state of the union of attachment and aversion, the quality of sattva shines forth within the inner being.
essence: Clarity can arise within the inner being even amid mixed feelings of attachment and aversion.
simple_meaning: When attachment and aversion combine inside you, the clear and pure quality of your nature still shines through.
insight: It teaches you to recognize the steady clarity beneath conflicting emotions, anchoring your awareness beyond turmoil.
modern_relevance: You feel torn between wanting and resisting something, yet a quiet clarity still lingers inside, helping you find balance.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
ज्ञानं विकाशते सम्यग् धर्मभाव उदेति च ।
पुण्यः पुण्यप्रवाहो हि बहते नात्र संशयः ॥
translation: ज्ञान का विकास और धर्मभाव का सम्यक् उदय हुआ करता है, पवित्र पुण्य प्रवाह ही बहता रहता है इसमें सन्देह नहीं
english_translation: True wisdom grows and the feeling of righteous purpose arises; a pure flow of virtue always continues without doubt.
essence: True wisdom awakens a clear, doubtless flow of righteous purpose and virtue.
simple_meaning: True wisdom develops clearly, awakening a genuine feeling of righteousness, and a continuous, pure flow of virtue follows without hesitation.
insight: It shifts your view from sporadic effort to trusting a steady, doubt-free flow of right intention and action.
modern_relevance: You notice your understanding deepening, and with it, a natural motivation to do what feels genuinely right flows steadily through your day.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
द्वे एव भवतः शक्ती आकर्षणविकर्षणे ।
नारीधारासु जीवानां नृधारास्वपि सर्चतः ॥
translation: यही दो आकर्षण और विकर्षण शक्तियां जीवों की स्त्री धारा और पुरुष धारा में सर्वत्र वर्तमान हैं
english_translation: There are only two forces of attraction and repulsion present in all beings, both in the female and male streams everywhere.
essence: All life flows through two universal forces: attraction and repulsion.
simple_meaning: Two fundamental forces of attraction and repulsion exist universally in all beings, across both male and female life currents.
insight: Recognizing attraction and repulsion as universal forces helps you see underlying patterns in relationships and nature.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
आकर्षणस्वरूपं हि शरीरं योषितामिह ।
तथा विकर्षण नृणां शरीरं स्यात्स्वरूपतः ॥
translation: इस संसार में स्त्री शरीर आकर्षण रूपी और पुरुष शरीर विकर्षण रूपी ही है
english_translation: In this world, the female body is naturally of the form of attraction, and the male body is naturally of the form of repulsion.
essence: Female and male bodies are described as embodying attraction and repulsion respectively by nature.
simple_meaning: Female bodies are described as naturally drawing in, while male bodies are described as naturally pushing away.
insight: It invites reflection on how we perceive natural tendencies but does not instruct action or inner work directly.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
ब्रह्मानन्दानुभूते: स्याल्लोभाव स्पर्शेन्द्रियेण वै ।
दम्पतीसङ्गमः साक्षात्पवित्रः सात्त्विकः शुभः ॥
translation: स्पर्श-इन्द्रिय द्वारा ब्रह्मानन्द अनुभव के लोभ से ही साक्षात् पवित्र सात्विक और शुभ स्त्री पुरुष का संगम होता है ।
english_translation: The union of a pure, sattvic, and auspicious couple happens directly through the sense of touch fueled by the desire for experiencing bliss of the supreme reality.
essence: Pure touch combined with longing for supreme bliss creates a sacred, harmonious union.
simple_meaning: A truly pure and harmonious union between partners happens through physical touch combined with a sincere desire for the bliss of the supreme reality.
insight: It teaches you to see physical connection as a gateway to shared spiritual experience, not just a casual act.
modern_relevance: You notice how moments of genuine touch with someone you trust can feel deeply meaningful, as if touching a higher joy beyond daily life.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
सत्त्वभावमयः पुण्यो वर्त्तते सङ्गमक्षणः ।
आधिदैविकपीठस्योत्पादको नात्र संशयः ॥
translation: संगम का काल अतिपवित्र सत्त्वभावमय और अधिदेवपीठ-उत्पादक है इसमें सन्देह नहीं है
english_translation: The moment of union is supremely pure, filled with pure nature, and undoubtedly the source of the divine seat.
essence: The moment of union is pure and undeniably the source of divine presence.
simple_meaning: The time of coming together is extremely pure and is clearly the source of the divine presence; there is no doubt about this.
insight: Recognize that certain moments hold a sacred quality that naturally arises without question or effort.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
विष्णुस्वरूपमादाय ब्रह्माण्डस्य स्थितिक्षणे ।
ब्रमाण्डेस्मिन यथाऽऽकृष्टो विष्णुपीठस्वरूपिणि ॥
translation: जैसे है पितृगण ! ब्रह्माण्ड की स्थिति दशा में मैं विष्णुरूप धारण करके विष्णुपीठ रूपी
english_translation: At the moment of the universe's preservation, I assumed the form of Vishnu, the seat of the cosmos, just as the ancestors do.
essence: The supreme manifests as Vishnu to uphold the universe’s stability when needed.
simple_meaning: At the universe's moment of preservation, I took the form of Vishnu, the cosmic seat, like the ancestors do.
insight: It reveals how the supreme takes on different forms to maintain cosmic balance, showing flexible unity.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
सन्तिष्टे पितरो नूनं दम्पतीसङ्गमे तथा ।
आकृष्यन्ते त्रिधा देवाः पीठस्योत्पादके स्वतः ॥
translation: इस ब्रह्माण्ड में आकृष्ट रहता है उसी प्रकार दम्पती की पीठ-उत्पन्नकारी संगम दशा में
english_translation: Just as ancestors remain present, gods are naturally drawn threefold to the union created by a couple's union.
essence: Divine presence naturally surrounds the sacred union of a couple.
simple_meaning: In the world, ancestors and divine beings are naturally attracted to the union formed by a couple.
insight: It reveals that human relationships are embedded in a larger spiritual context beyond immediate perception.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
यथाकालं यथादेशं यथापात्रं तदाऽनयाः ।
भवन्तः पितरस्तत्र रजोवीर्य्याश्रयेण हि ॥
translation: यथाकाल यथादेश यथापात्र त्रिविध देवतागण स्वतः आकृष्ट हुआ करते हैं
english_translation: The three groups of deities naturally gather according to the right time, place, and vessel.
essence: Certain things come together naturally only when time, place, and form are right.
simple_meaning: The three groups of divine beings naturally come together exactly at their right time, place, and form.
insight: It teaches to trust natural timing and conditions rather than forcing outcomes.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
आकृप्यन्ते वपुर्दातुं जीवाय स्थूलमद्रुतम् ।
अन्ये देवगणा नेतुं शरीरैरातिवाहिकैः ॥
translation: हे अनघ पितृगण ! उस समय आपलोग रजवीर्य्य की सहायता से ही यथादेश कालपात्र अद्भुत स्थूल शरीर जीव को प्रदान करने के अर्थ उस पीठ में आकृष्ट होते हो । अत्यान्य देवतागण
english_translation: O sinless ancestors, at that time you gathered on that seat with the aid of Rajaveerya to grant a wondrous, gross, and imperishable body to the living being; many other divine beings came with their bodies in marriage.
essence: Many divine beings come together to grant a special body to a living being.
simple_meaning: Many divine beings gathered together to grant a remarkable physical body to a living being at that time.
insight: Recognizing that complex transformations often require unseen support beyond what we notice.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
युक्ताञ्जीवगणाँस्तत्र सूक्ष्मदेहावलम्बिनः।
पूर्वेभ्यो भोगलोकेभ्य आकृप्यन्ते न संशयः ॥
translation: आतिपाहिक देह युक्त सूक्ष्मदेहधारी जीवों को पूर्वभोग लोको से वहां पहुंचा देने के लिये निःसन्देह आकृष्ट होते हैं
english_translation: There is no doubt that subtle-bodied beings attached to gross-bodied beings are drawn there from their previous worlds.
