essence: Subtle beings linked to gross bodies are inevitably drawn from previous worlds.
simple_meaning: Subtle beings connected to gross-bodied beings are certainly drawn to that place from their earlier worlds.
insight: It highlights how past attachments and subtle connections shape present experiences beyond physical life.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
रज शल्या ततस्तत्र तमःशक्तिः परास्यते ।
तेन पीठे विनष्टे वै रजोजातबलाश्रयात ॥
translation: वहां रजशक्ति तमशक्ति को परास्त कर लेती है उससे पीठ का नाश हो जाने पर ही रजोगुण के बल से
english_translation: There, the quality of passion overcomes the force of darkness; when the base is destroyed, only then does the power of passion persist.
essence: Passion can only arise after the foundation of darkness is destroyed.
simple_meaning: Passion (rajas) overcomes darkness (tamas) only after the foundation that supports darkness is destroyed.
insight: It teaches you to dismantle the root causes of inertia before your motivating energy can fully awaken.
modern_relevance: When you break free from deep-rooted fears or doubts, your drive and energy can finally emerge stronger.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
पतितस्यैव वीर्य्यस्य सहयोगेन सर्वथा ।
नारीदेहे भवन्नूनं गर्भाधानं न संशयः ॥
translation: पतित वीर्य के सर्वथा सहयोग से ही नारीदेह में ही निःसन्देह गर्भाधान हो जाता है
english_translation: Without the full union of vital energy, conception in a woman's body does not happen without doubt.
essence: Complete union is essential for conception; partial effort cannot create new life.
simple_meaning: Conception in a woman's body requires the full union of vital energy; without it, conception will not happen.
insight: It highlights that certain results need full, committed involvement rather than partial or fragmented effort.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
यथायोग्यं तदा यूयं जीवानां सूक्ष्मदेहिनाम् ।
सन्निवासोपयुक्तानि स्थूलदेहगृहाण्यहो ॥
translation: उस समय आपलोग यथायोग्य' सक्ष्म शरीरधारी जीवों के रहने के उपयोगी यथायोग्य गृहरूपी स्थूल शरीर
english_translation: At that time, you should provide appropriate gross bodies as residences suitable for the subtle-bodied living beings.
essence: Living beings receive fitting physical bodies suited to their subtle inner nature at the right time.
simple_meaning: You should give living beings appropriate physical bodies suited to their subtle inner nature at the right time.
insight: Recognize the importance of providing appropriate support aligned with inner nature to enable healthy functioning.
modern_relevance: You notice how people need the right environment or tools to thrive, just like living beings need fitting bodies to live fully.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
संयच्छय नयन्ते च जीवांस्तत्रैव निर्जराः।
पराजितं तमो नैव स्यात्तत्र रजसा यदि ॥
translation: प्रदान करते हो और देवतागण जीवों को वहां ही पहुंचा देते हैं। यदि वहां तम को रज परास्त नहीं कर सके
english_translation: There, the beings are controlled and freed from decay; if darkness is not overcome by passion, it cannot exist there.
essence: A realm without decay exists where darkness fails to overcome passion.
simple_meaning: In that place, living beings are controlled and free from decay; if darkness is not defeated by passion, it does not exist there.
insight: It highlights that overcoming inner darkness requires active energy or passion; without it, ignorance cannot persist.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
रजस्तमोभ्यां पितरो भावशुद्धिपुरस्सरम् ।
अग्रेसरदभ्यां सततं सत्त्वं ज्ञानमयं प्रति ॥
translation: और हे पितरो! रज और तम भावशुद्धि पूर्वक ज्ञानमय सत्व की ओर अग्रसर हो
english_translation: O ancestral beings! Always advance from the qualities of passion and ignorance toward the pure, wisdom-filled quality of goodness.
essence: You can always advance from restless confusion to steady, wise clarity.
simple_meaning: You can shift your nature from passion and confusion toward a pure, steady state full of wisdom.
insight: It teaches you to recognize unstable mental states and intentionally cultivate clarity and wisdom instead.
modern_relevance: When your mind feels restless and clouded with doubt, you can choose to move toward calm clarity and wise understanding.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
नृनारीभेदरूपाच्च द्वन्द्वधर्मप्रभावतः।
लब्ध्वा बहिर्गनाभ्यां हि पराभक्तिं ममोत्तमाम् ॥
translation: और स्त्रीपुरुषभेद रुपी द्वन्द्व धर्म के प्रभाव से बचकर मेरी उत्तम पराभक्ति प्राप्त करके
english_translation: Escaping the dualities of male and female forms, through external groups, one attains my supreme devoted love.
essence: The highest devotion arises when you go beyond gender and social divisions.
simple_meaning: The highest devoted love to Shiva is found when you rise above distinctions like male or female and beyond external social groups.
insight: It shifts your view from identifying with outer categories to embracing devotion that transcends all separations.
modern_relevance: You might notice how social labels or group identities sometimes limit your connection with others or the divine. This teaching invites you to love beyond those boundaries.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
यदि सत्त्वे विलीयेत तह्याकृष्टा महर्षयः ।
रहितं सृष्टिधर्मेण कैवल्यं शाश्वतं, पदम् ॥
translation: यदि सत्व में विलीन हो जाये तो ऋषिगण आकृष्ट होकर सृष्टिधर्म से रहित शाश्वत कैवल्यपद
english_translation: If sages dissolve into pure goodness, they become free from creation’s law and reach eternal freedom.
essence: True freedom is found when you fully merge with pure goodness beyond creation’s laws.
simple_meaning: When you become completely absorbed in pure goodness, you move beyond the rules of creation and reach lasting freedom.
insight: This verse shifts your view from being trapped by external conditions to resting in unchanging inner freedom.
modern_relevance: In moments when you let go of ego and align with your best qualities, you experience freedom beyond everyday struggles and limitations.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अनेनैवाध्वना गम्यमिति संसूचयन्त्यलम् ।
नैवात्र संशयः कोऽपि विद्यते पितृपुङ्गवा ! ॥
translation: इसी मार्ग से प्राप्य है ऐसा भलीभांति बता देते हैं। हे पितृश्रेष्ठो । इसमें कोई संशयं नहीं है
english_translation: They clearly indicate that this very path leads to the goal. There is no doubt in this, O best of ancestors!
essence: This very path unmistakably leads to the goal without any doubt.
simple_meaning: This verse says that the path being taught clearly leads to the goal without any doubt.
insight: It affirms trust in the clear guidance given, eliminating hesitation about the path.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अधिदेवरहस्येन पूर्णस्यास्य पवित्रता।
पीठविज्ञानयोगस्य यावती प्रचरिप्यति ॥
translation: इस संसार में अधिदेव रहस्यपूर्ण इस पीठविज्ञान योग की पवित्रता जितनी प्रचारित होगी
english_translation: In this world, the sacredness of this secret Adhideva Peethavigyana Yoga spreads as far as it is proclaimed.
essence: Sacred knowledge's power depends on how widely it is shared.
simple_meaning: The sacredness of this secret spiritual yoga is known to spread only as much as people share it.
insight: It teaches that sacred or deep wisdom requires proclamation to manifest its true influence and sanctity.
modern_relevance: Hidden knowledge or wisdom only grows meaningful when you share it openly with others who can benefit.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
तावन्मात्रोत्तमणिभुक्तैर्जीवैर्जनिष्यते ।
जगत्यामिह सन्देहो विद्यते न स्वधाभुजः ! ॥
translation: उतना ही उत्तम श्रेणी के जीवों का जन्म हो सकेगा हे पितरो! इसमें सन्देह नहीं है
english_translation: Only that many highest-class beings will be born here, O ancestors! There is no doubt about this.
essence: The birth of highest beings in the world is fixed and certain without doubt.
simple_meaning: Only a limited number of the best beings will be born in this world; there is no doubt about this.
insight: It shows acceptance of natural limits and certainty in cosmic design rather than endless chance.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
उत्तमस्थूलदेहेषु दैवसम्पत्तिधारिणः ।
प्रवेशं कर्तुमर्हन्ति जीवाः सौभाग्यशालिनः ॥
translation: उत्तम स्थूल शरीरों में देवीसम्पत्तिधारी सौभाग्यशाली जीव पहुंच सकते हैं
english_translation: Fortunate beings endowed with divine qualities can enter supreme gross bodies.
essence: Only fortunate beings with divine qualities enter supreme physical bodies.
simple_meaning: Only fortunate living beings who carry divine qualities can enter the best physical bodies.
insight: It highlights that external forms are accessed through inner readiness and qualities, not by chance.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
तत्वज्ञा एव ते देव्याः सम्पत्तेरधिकारिणः।
नूनं धर्मस्य नित्यस्य सार्वभौमस्वरूपकम् ॥
translation: यहां देवीसम्पत्ति के अधिकारी तत्त्वज्ञानी वे जीव ही सनातनधर्म के सार्वभौम स्वरुप को समझने के निःसन्देह अधिकारी हो सकते हैं
english_translation: Only those who truly know reality are rightly qualified to possess the wealth of the divine feminine and understand the eternal, sovereign nature of dharma.
essence: True understanding of reality alone grants rightful claim to eternal dharma’s power.
simple_meaning: Only those who deeply understand reality can truly possess the lasting power of the divine energy and grasp the eternal nature of dharma.
insight: It teaches you to value deep clarity about reality as the foundation for rightful authority and spiritual strength.
modern_relevance: When you seek lasting purpose or power, it comes not from surface actions but from deeply knowing what truly is — your own reality.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
वेदितुं शक्नुवन्तीह नात्र कार्या विचारणा ।
भूयो भेदानराणाञ्च नारीणां वो ब्रवीम्यहम् ॥
translation: इसमें कुछ विचार करने की बात नहीं है, पुनः मैं नर नारियों का भेद आपलोगों से कहता हूँ
english_translation: There is no need to consider this further; again I declare to you the distinctions between men and women.
essence: A restatement of gender distinctions is announced without further discussion.
simple_meaning: I will now again explain the differences between men and women, with no need for further thought.
insight: This verse prepares the listener for a detailed explanation rather than giving a direct teaching.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
त्रिधा ज्ञेया नरा नार्यों भेदात्तैगुण्यगोचरात् ।
भवन्ति पितरस्तेषु सात्त्विका गुणमोहिताः ॥
translation: त्रिगुण सम्बन्धी भेद के अनुसार नर और नारी तीन प्रकार के जानने चाहिये, हे पितरो! उनमें से सात्त्विक गुणमोहित
english_translation: Men and women should be known in three ways, based on the three qualities; among them, the fathers are deluded by the quality of goodness.
essence: Even goodness can blind those who are attached to it among human types.
simple_meaning: People are understood in three types based on qualities, but fathers are confused by the quality of goodness.
insight: It reveals how attachment to a single quality, even a positive one, can distort clear understanding.
modern_relevance: You notice how even the kindest intentions can sometimes cloud judgment, leading to confusion in relationships.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
राजसा रूपमुग्धाश्च तामसाः काममोहिताः ।
मिथुनीभूतकाले हि जायते त्रिविधा दशा ॥
translation: राजसिक रूपमोहित और तामसिक नर नारी काममोहित होते हैं। मिथुनीभूत काल में तीन दशा होती है
english_translation: Men and women are deluded by passion and desire in the mode of passion and by attachment in the mode of ignorance. In the time of pairing, three states arise.
essence: Intimacy often brings three confusing states shaped by passion and attachment.
simple_meaning: People become confused by desire and attachment during times of intimate union, experiencing three different states.
insight: Recognize how passion and ignorance shape your reactions in close relationships, allowing clearer awareness.
modern_relevance: When relationships deepen, you might find your clarity blurred by strong emotions and attachments.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
प्राकृताऽऽद्या दशैवास्ति द्वितीया विकृतात्मिका । 
तृतीयोन्मादरूपैव सत्यमेतन्न संशयः ॥
translation: यथा प्राकृत दशा, विकृत दशा और उन्माद दशा यह सत्य है इसमें सन्देह नहीं
english_translation: There are indeed three states: the natural state, the altered state, and the state of madness; this truth is without doubt.
essence: Experience arises in three fundamental states: natural, distorted, and madness without doubt.
simple_meaning: There exist three clear states of existence: the original natural state, a distorted state, and a state of madness, and this is certain.
insight: It teaches you to recognize the nature of your mental states instead of being caught by them automatically.
modern_relevance: When your mood swings unexpectedly or your thoughts feel wild, you can identify which state of mind you're in and respond wisely.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
प्राकृतस्यैव भावस्य नरा नार्यश्च सात्त्विकाः ।
राजसा विकृतस्यैव ह्युन्मादस्य तु तामसाः ॥
translation: सत्त्वगुण के नरनारी प्राकृत, रजोगुण के विकृत और तमोगुण के
english_translation: Men and women of sattva are natural; those of rajas are distorted; those of tamas are mad.
essence: Your true nature is pure; imbalance causes distortion and madness.
simple_meaning: People who embody sattva (purity) are natural and balanced by nature. Those influenced by rajas (activity) become distorted, and those under tamas (inertia) become confused or mad.
insight: Recognize that your core nature is pure and stable, while moods of confusion or restlessness are temporary and caused by shifting qualities.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed or restless, remember these are temporary states; your true nature remains calm and natural beneath.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
जायन्ते पितरः ! नूनं प्रकृत्या पक्षपातिनः ।
उन्मादरूपाऽवस्था स्यान्नूनं नरकदा तथा ॥
translation: हे पितरो! तमोगुण के स्वाभाव ही से उन्मादभाव के पक्षपाती होते हैं । उन्माद नरक प्रद
english_translation: O ancestors! By their very nature, they are biased toward madness; such madness leads certainly to the lower realm.
essence: Natural bias toward madness leads to suffering and descent into the lower realm.
simple_meaning: Ancestors naturally tend toward a biased state of madness, which leads to suffering in the lower realm.
insight: Recognize how ingrained biases can escalate into harmful mental states and lead to negative consequences.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
स्वर्गदा विकृताऽवस्था प्राकृता मुक्तिदायिनी ।
यतो नास्त्येव सम्बन्धः सृष्टेरुत्पन्नकारिणः ॥
translation: विकृत स्वर्गप्रद और प्राकृत दशा ही मुक्तिप्रद है। क्योंकि विकार और सृष्टि उत्पन्न कारी
english_translation: The altered heavenly state and the natural state both grant freedom, because there is no attachment to the creator of the manifested world.
essence: Freedom exists when you have no attachment to the creator of the manifested world.
simple_meaning: Both an altered divine state and the natural state can bring freedom because freedom comes when you have no attachment to the source of the world.
insight: It teaches you to loosen emotional and mental ties to the origin of your circumstances, opening a space for inner freedom.
modern_relevance: You feel stuck when you cling to the idea that your identity or success depends on forces outside you, but real freedom comes when you release that need.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
नूनमष्टप्रकारस्य मैथुनस्य तथैव च ।
विकारस्यापि तस्यां वै प्राकृतायां न संशयः ॥
translation: अष्ट प्रकार मैथुन का भी सम्बन्ध प्राकृत दशा में नहीं ही रहता है यह निःसन्देह ही है।
english_translation: There is no doubt that the eight types of union and their transformations do not persist in the natural state.
essence: The eight unions and their changes cannot endure in the true natural state.
simple_meaning: The eight kinds of union and their changes do not continue once things return to their natural state.
insight: It shifts your understanding from clinging to changing states toward seeing their impermanence in the natural flow of existence.
modern_relevance: You notice how intense relationships or states that once seemed permanent eventually fade away when life settles into its natural rhythm.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अतो हि पितरो यूयं नूनं देवगणस्तथा ।
चाञ्चल्यरहितं शुद्ध सात्त्विकं देवदुर्लभम् ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! यही कारण है कि देवदुर्लभ चञ्चलतारहित शुद्ध सात्विक
english_translation: Therefore, ancestors and divine beings, you are indeed pure, steady, and rare in your goodness.
essence: Steady purity and goodness are rare and treasured qualities among noble beings.
simple_meaning: Ancestors and divine beings are praised here as pure, steady, and rare in their true goodness.
insight: It teaches the value of steady, unwavering purity as a rare and admirable quality.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
नारीभ्यश्च नरेभ्यश्च ह्याधिकार कथञ्चन ।
कदाचिदेव केभ्यश्चिदीशते दातुमुत्तमम् ॥
translation: उत्तम अधिकार आपलोग और देवतागण किन्हीं नर नारियों को किसा प्रकार कदाचित् ही प्रदान कर सकते हैं
english_translation: Neither men nor women ever truly have the highest authority to grant the supreme.
essence: The highest authority cannot be granted by any human being.
simple_meaning: Neither men nor women can ever grant the supreme highest authority to anyone.
insight: It shifts your view from trying to control ultimate outcomes to accepting limits on human power.
modern_relevance: You might feel pressure to control outcomes or give power, but some things are beyond human authority or influence.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अल्पमैथुनसन्तुष्टौ सात्त्विकौ दम्पती तथा ।
राजसौ कामुकौ किन्तु स्तो विचारसमन्विता ॥
translation: सात्त्विक नरनारी अल्प मैथुन से संतुष्ट, राजसिक गण कामुक परन्तु विचारवान्
english_translation: Sattvic couples are content with little intimacy; Rajasic couples are desire-driven but thoughtful.
essence: Contentment with little intimacy and desire with thought can coexist in a balanced relationship.
simple_meaning: Couples with a pure nature feel satisfied with little intimacy, while those driven by desire still act thoughtfully.
insight: Recognize your natural balance between satisfaction and desire, and act with conscious thought in relationships.
modern_relevance: In relationships, some find joy in simplicity, while others seek more passion but still value respect and thoughtfulness.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अविचारपरौ तौ स्तस्तामसावतिकामुकौ ।
सात्त्विकौ दम्पती नूनं स्यातां ज्ञानरतौ वरौ ॥
translation: और तामसिक गण घोर कामासत और अविचारी होते हैं हे पितरो! श्रेष्ठ सात्त्विक नरनारी ही ज्ञान निरत
english_translation: The tamasic groups are deeply attached to desire and lack discernment. The best couple are the sattvic man and woman, devoted to wisdom.
essence: True strength lies in balanced wisdom, not in blind desire or confusion.
simple_meaning: Some people act without thinking and are lost in strong desires. The best are those who are calm and focused on gaining wisdom together.
insight: It shifts focus from reacting impulsively to cultivating thoughtful, shared wisdom in relationships.
modern_relevance: You see couples lost in impulsive wants and confusion, but those who grow together through understanding show the healthiest bond.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
परस्परार्थिनौ तौ हि जायते पितरः ! सदा ।
राजसौ भोगनिरतौ स्वार्थिनौ भवतश्च तौ ॥
translation: और सदा ही वे परस्परार्थी होते हैं राजसिक गण भोग निरत और स्वार्थी होते हैं तथा
english_translation: The fathers are always mutually self-interested; they are rajasic, indulging in enjoyment and self-centeredness.
essence: Self-interest and desire create constant conflict among those who should support each other.
simple_meaning: The fathers are always involved in selfish desires, driven by enjoyment and self-interest.
insight: It teaches you to identify self-centered motives beneath social roles and not be distracted by surface appearances.
modern_relevance: In family or work, you sometimes meet people focused only on their own benefit, caught up in enjoyment and self-interest.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
तामसौ तौ विचारेण राहतौ च प्रमादिनौ।
अनर्थकारिणौ स्यातां कामभोगपरायणौ ॥
translation: तामसिकगण विचाररहित प्रमादी कामभोगपरायण और अनर्थ कारी होते हैं।
english_translation: Those influenced by tamas are careless and lose clarity; they become devoted only to desire and cause harm.
essence: Carelessness born from darkness fuels desire and leads to harmful outcomes.
simple_meaning: When the mind is clouded by tamas, you lose clear thinking, become careless, and get caught up only in chasing desires that cause harm.
insight: This verse teaches you to notice when dullness clouds your mind and to restore clarity to avoid careless harm.
modern_relevance: When you're tired, distracted, or stuck in bad habits, you might act without thinking and chase short-term pleasures that hurt your well-being.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
रोचते सात्त्विकाभ्यां हि पवित्रं ज्ञानकौशलम्।
तथैव राजसाभ्याञ्च क्रियाकौशलमद्भुतम् ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! सात्त्विक नरनारी पवित्र ज्ञान कौशल, राजसिक अद्भुत क्रिया कौशल
english_translation: Pure wisdom skill pleases the true beings of sattva; wonderful skill in action pleases those of rajas.
essence: Different natures delight in either pure wisdom or skillful action.
simple_meaning: Clear, pure understanding pleases the calm and steady nature; skillful, effective action pleases the active and restless nature.
insight: Recognize whether your nature seeks wisdom or action, then cultivate skill accordingly to find fulfillment.
modern_relevance: When your mind is calm, you appreciate thoughtful clarity; when restless, you find satisfaction in well-done tasks.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
पितरस्तामसाभ्यान्तु भावः पाशविकः सदा ।
नैवात्र विस्मयः कार्यः सन्देहो वा कदाचन ॥
translation: और तामसिक पाशवभाव के सदा पक्षपाती होते हैं, इसमें कभी विस्मय अथवा सन्देह नहीं करना चाहिये
english_translation: Those with a dull, animalistic nature are always biased; there is never cause for wonder or doubt about this.
essence: Dull, instinct-driven minds are always biased without cause for surprise or doubt.
simple_meaning: People dominated by dullness and base instincts always act with bias; it’s natural and no cause for doubt or surprise.
insight: Recognize bias rooted in dullness as a fixed inner tendency, reducing frustration and misplaced expectations.
modern_relevance: You notice some people always react with stubborn bias and never seem to question their views—it’s just how their mind works.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
सात्त्विकाः स्युर्नरा नार्यो ध्रुवं धीराः स्वभावतः
राजसाश्चञ्चला एवमुन्मादा इव तामसाः ॥
translation: सात्त्विक नरनारी स्वभाव से ही धीर, राजसिक चञ्चल और तामसिक उन्मादप्राय होते हैं
english_translation: People and women of sattva nature are naturally steady, those of rajas are restless, and those of tamas are prone to madness.
essence: People's behavior flows naturally from their dominant quality: steadiness, restlessness, or confusion.
simple_meaning: People naturally show qualities of steadiness, restlessness, or madness depending on their dominant nature.
insight: Recognizing your dominant nature helps you understand your habitual responses and work with them rather than fight them.
modern_relevance: You notice some people stay calm under pressure, others fidget constantly, while some seem overwhelmed and confused.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
प्रेमिकाः सात्त्विका नित्यं राजसाः कुटिलाः स्मृताः । 
निर्लज्जास्तामसा ज्ञेयाः सत्यमेतद्रवीमि वः ॥
translation: सात्त्विक नरनारी नित्य प्रेमिक, राजसिक कुटिल और तामसिक निर्लज्ज होते हैं। यह मैं आपलोगों से सत्य कहता हूँ
english_translation: Sattvic men and women are always devoted lovers; rajasic ones are deceitful; tamasic ones are shameless. This I declare to you as truth.
essence: True devotion reflects pure clarity; deceit and shamelessness arise from restless or dull natures.
simple_meaning: People with pure qualities love genuinely and constantly; those with restless or dull qualities tend to be deceitful or shameless.
insight: It teaches you to see love’s quality as a reflection of inner clarity or confusion, helping you choose sincere connections.
modern_relevance: You notice how some people love openly and honestly, while others hide motives or behave without respect, reflecting their inner state.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
सात्त्विकाः सङ्गमेऽध्यात्मलक्ष्यकाश्च परस्परम् ।
आनन्ददा राजसास्तु कामसौख्यैकलक्ष्यकाः ॥
translation: सात्त्विक नरनारी को संगम दशा में अध्यात्म लक्ष्य और एक दूसरे के आनन्द में तत्परता, और राजसिक गण को एकमात्र कामज सुख लक्ष्य और भोग में तत्परता
english_translation: In the union of a sattvic man and woman, the focus is on spiritual goals and mutual joy, while rajasic groups seek only sensual pleasure and gratification.
essence: Union can be for deep shared joy or merely fleeting sensual pleasure.
simple_meaning: When two people connect with a pure heart, they share spiritual joy and mutual care, unlike those who focus only on physical pleasure.
insight: It teaches you to distinguish relationships that foster lasting joy from those based solely on desire.
modern_relevance: You might notice relationships around you that either deepen your growth or just chase momentary excitement without lasting meaning.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
रता भोगे तामसास्तु स्वस्वलक्ष्याः प्रमादिनः।
सात्त्विकानां नराणां हि नारीणामपि तादृशाम् ॥
translation: और तामसिक गण को केवल अपना अपना लक्ष्य और प्रमाद जनित सुख में तत्परता रहती है। हे पितृगण! सात्विक नरनारियों के चित्त में ही
english_translation: Those influenced by darkness are absorbed only in their own goals and careless pleasures; even in the minds of pure men and women, such tendencies arise.
essence: Even pure minds can fall into careless attachment to selfish pleasures.
simple_meaning: Some people get caught up in selfish goals and careless pleasures, even good men and women sometimes fall into this.
insight: Recognize careless desires early so you can return focus to your true purpose and avoid slipping into distraction.
modern_relevance: You planned your day well but found yourself distracted by social media and cravings, losing sight of what matters.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
चित्तेष्वेव प्रकाशेत ह्यात्मज्ञानं तथैव च ।
पूर्णस्वरूपं धर्मस्य नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥
translation: आत्मज्ञान और धर्म का पूर्ण स्वरूप प्रकाशित हो सकता है। इसमें विचार नहीं करना चाहिये
english_translation: Self-knowledge and the complete nature of dharma shine only in the heart; they should not be subjected to intellectual speculation.
essence: True self-knowledge and dharma reveal themselves within, beyond mental speculation.
simple_meaning: Self-knowledge and the full meaning of your purpose arise clearly in your heart, beyond intellectual thought.
insight: Shift from overanalyzing to sensing your inner truth directly without mental interference.
modern_relevance: You sit quietly, trying to solve your life's purpose by thinking hard, but the real answer comes from a calm inner awareness, not mental chatter.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
दम्पत्योर्वर्तते नूनं नराणां हि प्रधानता ।
अतो हि पितरः ! सर्वगुणानां संविकाशने ॥
translation: स्त्रीपुरुष में पुरुष का ही सर्वथा प्राधान्य है इस कारण हे पितृगण ! सवगुणों के विकास में विद्वानों के द्वारा
english_translation: Among a married couple, the man holds primary importance for the full development of all virtues, O ancestral beings.
essence: This verse claims men are foremost in developing virtues within marriage.
simple_meaning: In a marriage, this verse says the man is considered primarily responsible for the growth of virtuous qualities.
insight: It shows how social roles can shape expectations about who nurtures virtues, encouraging reflection on these assumptions.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
कर्त्तव्यं पुरुषाणां वै मन्यतेऽभ्यधिकं बुधैः ।
प्रकृया चं, प्रवृत्त्या च तुल्या धर्मेण चेत्पुनः ॥
translation: पुरुष का दायित्व ही अधिक माना गया है। स्त्री, और पुरुष यदि समान प्रकृति, प्रवृत्ति और धर्मवाले होकर
english_translation: The duty of a person is regarded as supreme by the wise; when nature, disposition, and purpose are equal, duty is the measure.
essence: When nature, disposition, and purpose are equal, duty is the supreme guide for action.
simple_meaning: When a person's nature, inclination, and purpose are alike, their duty is considered most important by the wise.
insight: It teaches you to recognize when your inner qualities align, making your current duty the highest priority.
modern_relevance: You face a choice where your skills, desires, and values align perfectly. Now choosing what to do feels natural and right.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
प्रभवेर्युनरा नार्यो धर्तु सात्त्विकलक्षणम् ।
तदर्थ सुलभा मुक्ति का कथाभ्युदयस्य वै ॥
translation: सात्विक लक्षणों को धारण कर सके तो उनके लिये अभ्युदय की तो बात ही क्या है मुक्ति भी अति सुलभ है
english_translation: If one can embody the qualities of sattva, then liberation is extremely easy, and the rise to prosperity is assured.
essence: Embodying pure qualities makes freedom naturally simple and inevitable.
simple_meaning: Living with pure, sattvic qualities makes liberation very accessible, even effortless.
insight: It shifts focus to cultivating inner purity as the foundation for effortless spiritual progress.
modern_relevance: You notice how staying calm and clear helps you overcome challenges with less resistance and stress.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
समानधर्मप्रकृतिप्रवृत्ती दम्पती परम् ।
जगत्यां नैव जायते विशिष्टां मत्कृपां बिना ॥
translation: परन्तु समान प्रकृति प्रवृत्ति और धर्म के दम्पती संसार में मेरी विशेष कृपा बिना नहीं हो सकता
english_translation: Still, a couple united by similar nature and duty cannot arise in the world without my special grace.
essence: Even natural unions rely on a special grace beyond nature and duty.
simple_meaning: A couple sharing similar nature and duty cannot come into the world without Shiva's special grace.
insight: Recognize that meaningful relationships often depend on unseen support beyond personal effort.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
प्राप्नुतो जन्म चेत्सन्तौ ज्ञानिभक्ताबुभावपि ।
तदैवैवविधो योगो लोकातीतः प्रजायते ॥
translation: यदि दोनों ही मेरे ज्ञानी भक्त होकर जन्मग्रहण करें तब ही ऐसा लोकातीत मेल हो सकता है
english_translation: Only when one is born both a wise person and a devotee does the transcendental union arise.
essence: Highest freedom arises only when wisdom and devotion unite within you.
simple_meaning: True spiritual freedom happens only when a person embodies both deep wisdom and devoted love at once.
insight: It shifts your practice from focusing on just knowing or just feeling to integrating both for true inner freedom.
modern_relevance: When you balance clear understanding with heartfelt care, your sense of freedom and peace deepens beyond everyday concerns.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
यतश्चैवंविधे योगेऽनेक विघ्ना भवन्त्यलम् ।
किञ्चिदत्रापि वक्ष्येऽहं श्रूयतां पितृभिर्बुधैः ॥
translation: क्योंकि ऐसे मेल में विघ्न बहुत ही होते हैं इस विषय में मैं कुछ वर्णन करता हूँ विद्वान् पितृगण सुनें
english_translation: Because in such a union many obstacles arise, I will now describe some; let the wise ancestors hear.
essence: Many obstacles arise in this practice; recognizing them prepares you to face them.
simple_meaning: In this kind of union or practice, many difficulties occur. I will explain some of them now for the wise ancestors to hear.
insight: It teaches you to expect and prepare for challenges when pursuing deeper practice or union.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
नराणां पितरः ! सन्ति भेदाः षोडशसङ्ख्यकाः ।
तथा भेदाश्च नारीणां षोडशैव प्रचिकीर्ता: ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! पुरुष और स्त्री के सोलह सोलह भेद कहे गये हैं
english_translation: O ancestors, sixteen distinctions have been described for men and sixteen for women.
essence: Traditional texts describe sixteen distinctions each for men and women.
simple_meaning: There are sixteen types of distinctions described for men and sixteen for women.
insight: This verse highlights the presence of detailed classifications but does not teach a universal principle itself.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
शशो मृगो वराहोऽश्वो नृणामेताश्चतुर्विधाः।
जातयः खलु वर्तन्ते नात्र कार्योऽतिविस्मयः ॥
translation: शश, मृग, वराह और अश्व ये पुरुष की चार जातियां हैं इसमें अति विस्मय न करें
english_translation: The four classes of men are the hare, the deer, the boar, and the horse; do not be overly surprised by this.
essence: Men naturally fall into different types symbolized by animals; this is not surprising.
simple_meaning: There are four types of men symbolized by animals; this classification is normal and not surprising.
insight: It teaches to accept natural human differences as normal rather than shocking or strange.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
प्रत्येकमेव प्रत्येकान्तर्भावेनैव जातयः ।
षोडशधा प्रजायन्ते पुरुषाणां न संशयः ॥
translation: प्रत्येक जाति में ही प्रत्येक का अन्तर्भाव होने से ही पुरुष की  सोलह प्रकार को जाति होती है यह निःसन्देह है
english_translation: Each type exists within every other type, so the sixteen types arise in people without doubt.
essence: Every person fully contains all sixteen types within themselves without exception.
simple_meaning: Every person includes all sixteen types within themselves completely and without exception.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing yourself or others as fixed types to recognizing complex, simultaneous inner diversity.
modern_relevance: You meet someone who seems one way, but inside, many qualities and contradictions coexist quietly together.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
पद्मिनी चित्रिणी चैव शङ्खिनी हस्तिनी तथा ।
 एवं चतुर्विधा गीता जातयो योषितामपि ॥
translation: पद्मिनी, चित्रिणी शंखिनी  और हस्तिनी स्त्रियों की भी ये चार जातियां प्रसिद्ध हैं
english_translation: There are also four well-known classes of women: Padmini, Chitrini, Shankhini, and Hastini.
essence: Ancient texts classify women into four named categories.
simple_meaning: Four types of women named Padmini, Chitrini, Shankhini, and Hastini are known and recognized.
insight: This verse provides a cultural classification without direct guidance or insight for present-day action.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अन्तर्भावेन प्रत्येकं जायन्ते ताश्च षोड़श ।
सामानानां समानासु दाम्पत्यप्रेमबन्धनम् ॥
translation: प्रत्येक में अन्तर्भाव होने से प्रत्येक के चार चार भेद होकर स्त्री की सोलह जातियां होती हैं यदि इन सोलह प्रकार को पुरुषजाति और सोलह प्रकार की स्त्रीजाति में ठीक ठीक समान श्रेणी में दाम्पत्य प्रेम सम्बन्ध सृष्टि में
english_translation: Each contains a subtle essence that divides it into sixteen kinds; similarly, sixteen types of women arise, and when matched properly with men, these form harmonious marital love bonds.
essence: Subtle inner qualities divide beings into types that form natural love bonds when matched.
simple_meaning: Each type contains a subtle essence dividing it into sixteen kinds; when men and women match these types, marital love forms.
insight: Recognize that relationships can involve complex inner compatibilities beyond surface appearances.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
स्थापितं त्याज्जगत्याचेत्स्तो मोक्षाभ्युदयौ तयोः । 
नारीणामुच्चजाति भवेद्यधुभयोस्तदा ॥
translation: स्थापित हो तो दोनों के अभ्युदय और निःश्रेयस होते हैं। दोनो में से यदि स्त्री को जाति उच्च हो तो
english_translation: If a woman attains a higher caste, then both worldly prosperity and ultimate freedom are established.
essence: Social caste is linked here to worldly and spiritual success, but this is context-bound.
simple_meaning: If a woman belongs to a higher social class, then both her worldly success and spiritual progress are established.
insight: It reveals how social hierarchy can influence perceived spiritual and worldly advancement, though this is culturally specific and not a universal principle.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
एतासां प्रकृतिः सप्तश्रेण्यन्तं हि यथाक्रमम् ।
सामञ्जस्यं ध्रुवं रक्षेत्क्रममभ्युदयस्य च ॥
translation: सात श्रेणी तक नारी की प्रकृति यथाक्रम सामञ्जस्य की अवश्य रक्षा करती है और अभ्युदय का क्रम बना रहता है
english_translation: The nature of women follows seven levels in order, always preserving harmony and the sequence of growth.
essence: Growth unfolds in seven harmonious stages that must be preserved in order.
simple_meaning: There is a natural progression through seven stages that preserves harmony and the order of growth.
insight: Recognize and respect natural sequences that maintain harmony and enable progress.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
ततोऽशान्तिश्च दुःखञ्च जायते रोग एव च । 
नराणामुच्चजातिश्चेत्सामञ्जस्यं यथाक्रमम् ॥
translation: तदनन्तर अशान्ति दुःख और रोग होता है। यदि पुरुष की जाति उच्च होतो अभ्युदय का यथाक्रम
english_translation: Then unrest, suffering, and disease arise; if a man's birth is high, his progress follows accordingly.
essence: Unrest and suffering arise, but your inherent nature directs your progress.
simple_meaning: Unrest, suffering, and disease naturally arise in life, but a person's inherent nature guides their progress.
insight: Recognize that hardship is natural, but your inner nature shapes your response and growth.
modern_relevance: You wake up feeling overwhelmed by stress or pain, yet your character and values decide how you navigate the day.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
सम्यगभ्युदयस्यास्ते तर्हि श्रेणीत्रयावधि ।
सामन्जस्यस्य रक्षायां सृष्टेर्वाधा ततो भवेत् ॥
translation: सामञ्जस्य तीन श्रेणी तक भलीभांति रहता है तदनन्तर सृष्टि की सामञ्जस्य रक्षा में बाधा होती है
english_translation: Harmony is well maintained through three levels; after that, obstacles arise in preserving harmony in creation.
essence: Harmony holds well within three levels; exceeding them brings obstacles.
simple_meaning: Harmony or balance in creation is well maintained within three stages or levels; beyond that, difficulties arise in keeping this harmony intact.
insight: It teaches you to recognize natural limits of harmony and act to protect balance before problems grow.
modern_relevance: You notice how your team works smoothly in a few clear steps, but adding more complexity soon causes friction and confusion.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
स्वधर्मतश्च्युता नारी स्वधर्मादविच्युतो नरः ।
भवेद्यदि तदा सृष्टेः सामञ्जस्यं न तिष्ठति ॥
translation: नारीगण यदि नारी धर्म से च्युत हों और पुरुषगण पुरुषधर्म से च्युत हो तो सृष्टि का सामञ्जस्य नहीं रहता है
english_translation: If women abandon their own dharma and men abandon theirs, then harmony in creation cannot remain.
essence: Abandoning one's natural duty disrupts the harmony of the whole creation.
simple_meaning: When women and men leave their natural duties, the balance of the world breaks.
insight: It teaches you to recognize the importance of fulfilling your role for collective harmony.
modern_relevance: When individuals ignore their responsibilities in families or communities, relationships and social balance suffer.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
तपःप्रधानतामति नारीधर्मों यतः सदा ।
यज्ञमधानतामेवं नृणां धर्म इति श्रुतिः ॥
translation: क्योंकि सदा नारीधर्म तपः प्रधान है और पुरुषधर्म यज्ञ प्रधान है यही श्रुति है
english_translation: Because women’s duty is primarily austerity, and men’s duty is primarily sacrifice, so the scriptures say.
essence: Ancient texts assign austerity to women and sacrifice to men as their main duties.
simple_meaning: Tradition says women's main duty involves austerity, while men's main duty involves sacrifice.
insight: Recognize how ancient teachings often assigned different duties based on gender, which may conflict with modern views.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
हीश्च श्रीर्मधुरा वाणी त्रिविधा च पवित्रता।
निःस्वार्थश्च सतीभावो वात्सल्यं सेवनादरः ॥
translation: नारी के लिये ही, श्री, मधुर वचन, विविध पवित्रता, स्वार्थरहित पातिव्रत्य, वात्सल्यभाव, सेवापरायणता
english_translation: For a woman, the divine is sweet speech, threefold purity, selfless chastity, motherly love, and devoted service.
essence: This verse lists traditional feminine virtues without broader philosophical claim.
simple_meaning: A woman embodies sweet speech, three kinds of purity, selfless chastity, motherly affection, and devoted service.
insight: This verse reflects cultural ideals rather than a universal insight applicable beyond gender roles.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
पुरुषोचितभावानामङ्गीकारे सदाऽचिः ।
नारीणां हि गुणा अष्टावुत्तमाः कीर्तिता इमे ॥
translation: और पुरुषों के उपयोगी भावों में भावित होने में सदा अरुचि ये आठ ही उत्तमगुण कहे गये हैं
english_translation: Men are always averse to embracing these eight excellent qualities praised in women.
essence: Resistance to noble qualities doesn’t diminish their true value or praise.
simple_meaning: Sometimes people resist accepting noble qualities, even when those qualities are praised and valuable.
insight: It teaches you to notice your resistance to valuable qualities and open to their true worth.
modern_relevance: You may notice yourself or others resisting qualities like patience or gentleness, even though these traits bring real strength and harmony.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
पुरुषाणान्तु सर्वेषां पितरः! सन्ततं भृशम् । 
स्वस्ववर्णाश्रमाचारपालनं गुण उत्तमः ॥
translation: और हे पितृगण ! सब पुरुषों के लिये सर्वदा अपने अपने वर्णाश्रमाचार का पालन ही उत्तमगुण कहा गया है।
english_translation: And O ancestors, for all people, always following their own duties and social roles is considered the highest virtue.
essence: True virtue arises from faithfully living your own life duties and roles.
simple_meaning: Always following your own duties and social roles is considered the best quality for every person.
insight: This verse teaches to focus fully on your own path and responsibilities, not to imitate or envy others.
modern_relevance: You feel the pressure to compare yourself or live someone else’s life, but your true strength lies in embracing your own responsibilities fully.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
योषितां पुरुषाणाश्च परीक्षाऽतीव दुर्गमा ।
ऋतम्भरायुता भक्ता ज्ञानिनो मे यथार्थतः ॥
translation: स्त्री और पुरुष परीक्षा बहुत ही कठिन है । ऋतम्भरा युक्त मेरे ज्ञानी भक्त ही यथार्थ रूप से
english_translation: Testing women and men is extremely difficult; only my true wise devotees who uphold truth endure it fully.
essence: True devotion and wisdom make enduring difficult tests possible.
simple_meaning: Testing men and women is very hard, but those who are truly devoted and wise overcome these challenges by upholding truth.
insight: It teaches you to meet life's toughest challenges with steady devotion and unwavering commitment to truth.
modern_relevance: You might feel overwhelmed when life tests your character through relationships and responsibilities, but staying true and devoted helps you stand firm.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
पितरः ! दम्पती नूनं शक्नुवन्ति परीक्षितुम् ।
अन्यः कोऽपि न शक्नोति सत्यमेतद्भवीमि वः ॥
translation: हे पितृगण! स्त्री परीक्षा , और पुरुष परीक्षा करने में समर्थ हैं और कोई भी समर्थ नहीं हो सकता। यह मैं अपलोगों से सत्य कहता हूँ
english_translation: O ancestors! Couples alone are capable of true testing; no one else can truly test you. This I speak to you with truth.
essence: Only couples have the unique power to truly test and reveal each other.
simple_meaning: Only couples have the real ability to truly test and understand each other; no one else can do this for them.
insight: Recognize that deep personal challenges and growth often happen uniquely within intimate partnerships, not from external judgments.
modern_relevance: You might notice only your partner truly sees and challenges who you are in ways no one else can.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
सामुद्रिकैस्तथा ज्योति शास्त्रैश्चैव स्वरोदयैः।
एवं बहुविधैांगैः परीक्ष्येतेऽत्र दम्पती ॥
translation: इस जगत में सामुद्रिक विद्या, स्वरोदयविद्या और ज्योतिष विद्या से और इस प्रकार के नेक मार्गों से स्त्री पुरुष परीक्षा की जाती है
english_translation: In this world, couples are tested by palmistry, voice science, astrology, and many such noble methods.
essence: Couples are examined through many external traditional methods.
simple_meaning: Couples are evaluated through various traditional sciences like palmistry, voice analysis, and astrology.
insight: It shows how external measures are often used to assess inner qualities, prompting reflection on where true understanding lies.
modern_relevance: You might notice how people look for signs or tests to judge relationships or personalities before committing.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
कर्त्तु दाम्पससम्बन्धं कैवल्याभ्युदयेच्छुभिः ।
तेषां नामानि कथ्यन्ते येषाम्हर्या विचारणा ॥
translation: दाम्पत्य सम्बन्ध करने के लिये अभ्युदय और कैवल्येच्छुओं को जिन बातों का विचार करना चाहिये उनके नाम कहे जाते हैं
english_translation: The names of considerations for those seeking marriage and those desiring liberation are described.
essence: Choosing marriage or liberation requires understanding specific important considerations.
simple_meaning: This verse lists topics to consider for those wanting marriage or liberation.
insight: It signals the need to understand key factors before committing to major life paths like marriage or spiritual freedom.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
कुलं देहो गणो योनिग्रहो राशिदिनन्तथा ।
स्त्रीदीर्घश्चैव माहेन्द्रो राशीशो रज्जुवश्यकौ ॥
translation: कुल शरीर, गण, योनि, ग्रह, राशि, दिन, माहेन्द्र, स्त्री दीर्घ, राशि का अधिपति, रज्जु. वश्य
english_translation: The body, family, groups, origin, planets, constellations, lunar mansions, the lord of constellations, and the bond of control.
essence: A list of physical, social, and celestial categories without a teaching.
simple_meaning: Lists various concepts like body, family, groups, origins, planets, constellations, and control mechanisms, without teaching or narrative.
insight: No direct teaching or insight; the verse is descriptive or classificatory.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
वेधश्च वर्णकूटञ्च भूतलिङ्गाख्यकूटकम् ।
नाड़ी च योगिनीगोत्रं जातिश्च पक्षिकूटकम् ॥
translation: वेध, वर्णकूट, नाडी, भूतलिङ्गायकूट योगिनी गोत्र, जाति, पाक्षि कूटक
english_translation: Vedha, Varnakuta, Nadi, Bhutalingakuta, Yogini gotra, Jati, Pakshi kutakam.
essence: This verse names various classifications without explanation or teaching.
simple_meaning: This verse lists various names or categories without further explanation or teaching.
insight: Recognize that not all verses carry direct teachings; some set the stage or catalog concepts.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
तारा तथा भकूटश्च प्रवृत्तिवृद्धिरेव च ।
इन्द्रियाणां तथा दाढयं भावश्च पञ्चविंशकः ॥
translation: तारा, भकूट, प्रवृत्ति, इन्द्रिय दाय, बुद्धि और पच्चीसा भाव
english_translation: Tara, Bhakoota, Pravrtti, the strength of the senses, intellect, and the twenty-five states.
essence: Many subtle inner energies and faculties combine to shape experience.
simple_meaning: This verse lists various subtle energies or states, including Tara, Bhakoota, activity, senses' strength, intellect, and twenty-five elements.
insight: Recognize that your mind and senses involve many interacting layers and states influencing your actions and awareness.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अधिकारे समाने चेत्स्थापितः पितरो भवेत् ।
सौम्यो दाम्पससम्बन्धोऽभ्युदयस्य तु का कथा ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! यदि समान अधिकार में कल्याणकारी दाम्पत्य सम्बन्ध स्थापित हो तो अभ्युदय की तो बात ही क्या है
english_translation: O ancestors, if a beneficial marital bond is established with equal rights, then what is there to discuss about prosperity?
essence: Equal and kind relationships naturally lead to shared prosperity.
simple_meaning: If a fair and kind marital relationship exists with equal rights, prosperity naturally follows without any doubt.
insight: It encourages valuing equality and kindness in relationships as foundations for collective well-being.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
मोक्षोऽपि सुलभस्ताहि नैव कार्योऽत्र विस्मयः ।
एवंविधै हि दाम्पसे सञ्जते जायते ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: निःश्रेयस भी सुलभ है इसमें, विस्मय नहीं ही करना चाहिये। ऐसा दम्पति सम्बन्ध होने पर ही
english_translation: Freedom from rebirth is also easy here; there is no need to be surprised. This is certain when such a marital relationship exists.
essence: Lasting inner freedom naturally arises from a devoted marital relationship.
simple_meaning: True freedom from the cycle of rebirth is easy to attain through a stable, devoted marital relationship. There is no reason to be surprised by this.
insight: It shifts your view to see that spiritual freedom can grow through healthy, loving relationships, not just solitary practice.
modern_relevance: You notice how deep trust and commitment with your partner creates a calm space where old worries lose their grip and genuine freedom feels possible.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
मत्सधानाविभूतीनां देवानां भवतां तथा ।
ऋषीणाञ्चैव सर्वेषां सर्वथैव प्रसन्नता ॥
translation: मेरे प्रधान विभूतिरूपी आप लोगों की सब देवताओं की और सब ऋषियों की भी सब प्रकार से ही प्रसन्नता होती है
english_translation: As the supreme being, I am the cause of all gods' and sages' complete happiness in every way.
essence: The supreme being is the source of all beings' complete happiness in every way.
simple_meaning: You are the supreme presence who brings happiness to all divine beings and sages in every way.
insight: It shifts the view to see yourself as a source of joy and inspiration, not just a separate individual.
modern_relevance: When you recognize that your presence can uplift those around you deeply, you feel more connected and responsible for shared well-being.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
जन्मभूमिमैवेद्धन्या पवित्रञ्च कुलं तयोः !।
तौ स्वयं ज्ञानिनी सन्ता स्तः सार्वभौमधर्मिणौ ॥
translation: उनका कुल पवित्र होता है, जन्मभूमि धन्य होती, है और या तो वे स्वयं शानवान् होकर सार्वभौम धर्म के अधिकारी बनते हैं
english_translation: Their lineage is pure and their birthplace blessed; they themselves become wise and uphold universal righteousness.
essence: A pure origin naturally leads to wisdom and rightful conduct.
simple_meaning: Those with a pure birthplace and lineage become wise and uphold universal righteousness.
insight: Recognize how your background influences your sense of duty and encourages living by universal principles.
modern_relevance: You feel grounded and confident when your upbringing and roots support values that guide your choices rightly.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अथवा सन्तति लब्ध्वा पूर्णज्ञानरलकृताम् ।
विश्वमेतत् प्रकुर्वन्तौ धन्यं धन्यौ च तो स्वयम् ॥
translation: नहीं तो पूर्ण ज्ञान से अलंकृत सन्तति को प्राप्त करके वह इस जगत् को धन्य करते हुए स्वयं भी धन्य होते हैं।
english_translation: Or by attaining a lineage adorned with complete knowledge, they bless this entire world and themselves become blessed.
essence: Wisdom in your descendants blesses the world and returns blessing to you.
simple_meaning: If you gain descendants filled with full understanding, you bless the world and yourself through them.
insight: Shift your focus from personal gain to nurturing wisdom that benefits generations and the wider world.
modern_relevance: You see your family's values and wisdom shaping the world around you, knowing your influence carries beyond your lifetime.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
क्षेत्ररूपतया नारी पूर्णा धैर्यगुणैः सदा ।
कन्यायाः पितरौ नस्पाद धव्य यौ त्रिविधं सदा ॥
translation: नारी क्षेत्र रूपा होने से सदा धैर्यगुणों से पूर्ण है इस कारण जो पिता माता सदा ही कन्या के त्रिविध धैर्य की
english_translation: A woman is like a field, always full of patience; her parents always honor her threefold patience.
essence: Patience in a woman is likened to fertile ground honored by her parents.
simple_meaning: A woman is compared to a field, always full of patience, and her parents honor her enduring patience in three ways.
insight: It shows how patience is seen as a valued virtue within family relationships, but does not present a universal teaching beyond that.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
रक्षितुं शक्नुतो नूनं तथा कत्तुं समुन्ननम् ।
स्वामिनो ये निजस्त्रीणां धैव्यैवा त्रिविधं सदा ॥
translation: रक्षा और उन्नति में समर्थ होते हैं अथवा जो पति सदा अपनी स्त्री के विविध धैर्य को
english_translation: A husband is always capable of protecting and uplifting his wife through her threefold qualities of endurance.
essence: Protection and upliftment arise from honoring a partner’s enduring qualities.
simple_meaning: A husband can protect and raise his wife by recognizing and supporting her three kinds of endurance.
insight: It shifts the focus from control to honoring the partner’s inner strengths in relationships.
modern_relevance: In partnerships, understanding and supporting your partner’s resilience builds strength and growth together.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
स्वयं संयमिनः सन्तो नष्टं कर्तुं न चोद्यताः।
ते सदा प्राप्नुवन्सेव सदगान देवदुर्लभाम् ॥
translation: स्वयं संयमी रहते हुए नष्ट करने में उद्यत नहीं होते हैं वे सदा देवदुर्लभ सदगति को ही प्राप्त होते हैं।
english_translation: Those who control themselves do not engage in destruction and always attain the rare, divine good state.
essence: Self-control prevents destructive acts and leads to rare lasting well-being.
simple_meaning: If you keep control over yourself, you won’t act to destroy what matters and will reach a rare and precious state of well-being.
insight: It teaches you to hold back destructive impulses and cultivate steady self-control for lasting benefit.
modern_relevance: You pause instead of reacting in frustration or anger, avoiding damage to your relationships or goals and preserving your well-being.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
भवन्तः पितरः ! तेभ्यः स्ववाञ्छितगुणान्विताम् ।
सन्ततिञ्च बलं स्वास्थ्यं प्रयच्छन्ति स्वयं सदा ॥
translation: हे पितृगण! आपलोग उनको अपने वांछित गुणवाली सन्तति, बल और स्वास्थ्य सदा स्वत: प्रदान करते हो।
english_translation: O ancestors! You always grant them offspring with desired qualities, strength, and health by yourselves.
essence: Ancestors naturally and continuously bestow desired qualities and vitality on descendants.
simple_meaning: Ancestors naturally provide their descendants with desired qualities, strength, and health without effort.
insight: Recognize the effortless continuity of qualities and life through natural lineage and care.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
गर्भाधानस्वरूपस्य यौ तु पीठस्य दम्पती ।
स्मरतः पितरः ! नित्यं मर्यादाच पवित्रताम् ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! जो दम्पती गर्भाधान रुपी पीठ की मर्यादा और पवित्रता को सदा स्मरण रखते हैं
english_translation: O ancestors! Those couples who always remember the sanctity and dignity of the act of conception.
essence: Couples who honor the sacredness of conception uphold dignity and purity.
simple_meaning: Couples who always keep in mind the sacredness and dignity of conception honor its true value.
insight: It urges mindful awareness and respect for the origins of life in relationships.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
तथा दैव्यां जगत्यां हि श्रद्धालू यौ निरन्तरम् ।
यौ स्वयोश्च सदा सत्त्वगुणलक्षणमीप्सितम ॥
translation: दैव जगत् पर निरन्तर श्रद्धालु होते हैं और जो सदा अपने मे सत्वगुण के लक्षण
english_translation: In the divine world, those who are devoted continuously and who always possess the qualities of sattva within themselves are desired.
essence: Steady devotion rooted in inner purity is what the divine truly values.
simple_meaning: Those who are consistently devoted and embody pure qualities within themselves are truly valued in the divine realm.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate steady devotion grounded in your natural purity rather than forced effort.
modern_relevance: When your commitment comes from your authentic kindness and clarity, others naturally value and trust you deeply.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
प्राप्तुं यत्नं प्रकुर्वाते सन्ततौ हि तयोर्भुवम् ।
उच्चाधिकार एतादृक् सम्भकाशेत येन सा ॥
translation: प्राप्त करने का प्रयत्न करते हैं उनकी सन्तति मे अवश्य ही ऐसे उच्च अधिकार प्रकट होते हैं कि
english_translation: Those who make continuous effort to attain it certainly manifest such higher authority in their lineage.
essence: Steady effort creates lasting higher authority beyond the self.
simple_meaning: When you keep trying steadily, you build a lasting and higher influence over time.
insight: It teaches you to focus on consistent effort, trusting it will create durable influence and authority.
modern_relevance: You keep practicing a skill daily, and slowly you build trust and respect that lasts beyond yourself.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
ज्ञातुमीष्टे प्रजा पुण्या पूर्णधर्माधिकारिताम् ।
नात्र कश्चन सन्देहो विद्यते पितृपुङ्गवाः ॥
translation: जिससे वह प्रजा धर्म के पवित्र पूर्ण अधिकार को जान सकती है, हे पितृवरो ! इसमें कुछ सन्देह नहीं है।
english_translation: There is no doubt, O best of ancestors, that the people can know their pure and full right to dharma.
essence: There is no doubt people can fully know their pure dharma rights.
simple_meaning: People certainly have the right to fully understand their pure dharma, without any doubt.
insight: It highlights that clarity and confidence in one's purpose and duties eliminate confusion and hesitation.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
उक्तज्ञानप्रचारेण कृपातो भवतां तथा ।
एतच्छुभं फलं लोक आविर्भवितुमर्हति ॥
translation: जगत में उक्त ज्ञान के प्रचार द्वारा और आप लोगों की कृपा से यह शुभ फल प्रकट हो सकता है
english_translation: By spreading the taught wisdom and through your kindness, this auspicious result can manifest in the world.
essence: Wisdom shared with kindness brings positive change to the world.
simple_meaning: Sharing wise knowledge and your kindness together can bring about a positive outcome in the world.
insight: It shows that for good results to emerge, both knowledge-sharing and compassionate support are essential.
modern_relevance: When you share helpful ideas and receive support from others, positive changes can happen beyond your immediate efforts.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
वर्णाश्रयाणां मर्यादा-रक्षणेनैव निश्चितम् ।
मर्त्यजातिषु प्राप्यन्तेऽधिकारा इस्थमुन्नताः ॥
translation: वर्णाश्रम मर्यादा को सुरक्षा के द्वारा ही मनुष्यजाति में ऐसे उन अधिकार निश्चय प्राप्त हो सक्ते हैं।
english_translation: By protecting the limits of the social orders and stages of life, established roles and rights arise among humans.
essence: Respecting role boundaries creates firm, rightful authority among people.
simple_meaning: Your rightful place and authority arise only when you respect and protect the limits of your social and life roles.
insight: It teaches you to honor the limits of your responsibilities as the foundation for recognized authority and respect.
modern_relevance: You find trust and respect at work or in family by staying true to your responsibilities and not overstepping your role.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
धर्मा वर्णाश्रमाः सन्तः प्रवृत्ते रोधकाः क्रमात् ।
निवृत्तेः पोषकाश्चैव मान्तःकरणे मम ॥
translation: वर्णाश्रमधर्म यथा क्रम प्रवृत्ति रोधक और निवृत्ति पोषक होकर ही मनुष्य के अन्तः करण में मेरी
english_translation: The duties of varna and ashrama act as obstacles in action and as nurturers in renunciation within the mind.
essence: Social duties both obstruct action and nurture renunciation within your mind.
simple_meaning: Your social and life-stage duties sometimes prevent you from acting freely, but they help you grow when you turn inward and renounce.
insight: Recognize that what limits your doing can also support your letting go; this shifts how you relate to obligations.
modern_relevance: You might feel stuck by your responsibilities during busy times, yet those same roles can guide your mind when you choose to step back and reflect.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
पराभक्तेः प्रजायन्ते आत्मज्ञानस्य वै पुनः।
विकाशका न सन्देहो विद्यते पितरो ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: पराभक्ति और आत्मज्ञान का विकासक होते हैं हे पितरो ! इसमे सन्देह ही नहीं है।
english_translation: From deep devotion arises self-knowledge; there is no doubt about this, O ancestors.
essence: Deep devotion inevitably unfolds clear self-knowledge without any doubt.
simple_meaning: True self-knowledge arises naturally from deep devotion; this connection is certain and undeniable.
insight: It shifts your focus to nurture devotion as a reliable path that naturally reveals your true self.
modern_relevance: When you commit your heart fully to something meaningful, your deeper understanding naturally grows without hesitation or doubt.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
वर्णाश्रमानुकूलस्य सदाचारस्य रक्षया ।
मनुष्याणां पयो रोधः स्यात् क्रमाभ्युदयस्य न ॥
translation: वर्ण और आश्रम धर्म के अनुकूल सदाचार की सुरक्षा के द्वारा मनुष्यजाति के क्रमाभ्युदय के पथ का अवरोध नहीं होता है
english_translation: By protecting virtuous conduct aligned with class and stage duties, there is no obstruction to humanity's orderly progress.
essence: Right conduct aligned with your role removes obstacles to steady progress.
simple_meaning: Living rightly according to your social and life stage duties prevents obstacles in your personal and collective progress.
insight: It teaches you to focus on fulfilling your authentic roles and uphold their values to avoid unnecessary resistance.
modern_relevance: You feel stuck when you ignore your responsibilities, but honoring your core duties keeps your life moving forward smoothly.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
नासौ निर्विजतामेत्य मर्त्यजातिः प्रणश्यति ।
यथाकालन्तु तस्यां हि धर्मस्य शाश्वतस्य वै ॥
translation: वह मनुष्यजाति  निर्बीज होकर नष्ट नहीं हो जाती है और उसमें यथासमय सनातन धर्म के
english_translation: The human lineage does not perish without seed; at the appointed time, the eternal dharma manifests within it.
essence: True purpose never disappears; it arises at the right time within life.
simple_meaning: The human lineage does not vanish without continuation; the eternal purpose or dharma always arises at its proper time.
insight: It shifts your view from fearing loss to trusting in the natural timing of your purpose unfolding.
modern_relevance: You may feel stalled or that your efforts go nowhere, but your deeper purpose is quietly preparing to emerge when the moment is right.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
सार्वभौमस्वरूपस्य ह्यात्मज्ञान प्रकाशकम् ।
असंशयं विकाशेत कदाचिन्नात्र विस्मयः ॥
translation: सार्वभौमरूप प्रकाशक आत्मज्ञान का विकाश भी हो ही जाता है इसमें आश्चर्य नहीं है
english_translation: The self-knowledge that reveals the universal form naturally unfolds here; there is no surprise in that.
essence: True self-knowledge naturally reveals the universal nature without surprise.
simple_meaning: Self-knowledge reveals the universal nature by itself; this unfolding is natural and not surprising.
insight: It shifts your expectation from surprise to acceptance that deep understanding will come naturally.
modern_relevance: When insight about your deeper nature arises, it feels natural rather than strange, easing your journey of self-understanding.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
आर्य्यजातेबीजरक्षाऽऽध्यात्मिकी च क्रमोन्नतिः ।
पितॄणां वर्द्धनाऽनल्पा तत्कृपाप्राप्तिरेव च ॥
translation: आर्यजाति की बीज रक्षा, आध्यात्धिक क्रमोन्नति, पितरों का संम्बर्द्धन और उनकी विशेष कृपा प्राप्ति,
english_translation: The seed protection of the noble lineage, spiritual progression, nurturing of ancestors, and receiving their special grace.
essence: Protecting lineage and advancing spiritually invites ancestral blessings.
simple_meaning: There is care to protect noble lineage, advance spiritually, and honor ancestors to receive their special blessings.
insight: It encourages valuing heritage and spiritual progress as foundations for receiving lasting support.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
सहोच्चैदेवलोकैश्च सम्बन्धस्थापनं भृशम् ।
विबुधानां प्रसादश्च विश्वमङ्गलसाधकः ॥
translation: दैवी ऊद्धर्व लोकों के साथ अतिशय सम्बन्ध स्थापन, विश्वमंगलकारिणी देवताओं की प्रसन्नता,
english_translation: The divine establishes deep connections with the higher realms, gaining the favor of enlightened beings and bringing welfare to the world.
essence: The divine’s deep bonds with higher beings enable universal well-being.
simple_meaning: The divine forms strong bonds with higher realms and wins the favor of enlightened beings, helping the whole world prosper.
insight: It highlights how unseen supportive connections uplift the larger whole beyond individual perception.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
तथा स्वभावससिद्धसंस्कारोदयसाधनम् ।
बीजरक्षाऽऽत्मवोधस्य कैवल्याधिगमोऽपि च ॥
translation: स्वाभाविक संस्कारों का उदय करना, आत्मज्ञान की बीज रक्षा और कैवल्याधिगम
english_translation: The natural rising of perfected impressions, the seed protection of self-knowledge, and the attainment of complete freedom.
essence: Natural perfected impressions protect self-knowledge and enable complete freedom.
simple_meaning: Your natural, perfected habits awaken to guard your self-knowledge and help you reach full freedom.
insight: Recognize that your inherent qualities nurture your awareness and support your journey beyond limitations.
modern_relevance: When your good habits align with your true understanding, they quietly protect your clarity and guide you through challenges.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
वर्णाश्रमाणां धर्माणामष्टावेतानि मुख्यतः ।
प्रयोजनानि सम्पाहुः कर्मतत्वाब्धिपारगाः ॥
translation: ये वर्णाश्रम धर्म के आठ प्रधान प्रयोजन कर्मतत्व पारगो ने कहे हैं
english_translation: The eight primary purposes of the duties of the varna and ashrama systems have been explained by those proficient in the nature of action.
essence: Eight main purposes define duties across social and life stages.
simple_meaning: The main eight purposes of the duties related to social orders and life stages are presented by experts who understand action deeply.
insight: It points to the importance of knowing why duties exist, not just performing them blindly.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
रजोवीर्यविशुद्धयैव भवत्येव सुरक्षितम् ।
आधिभौतिकसंशुद्धबीर्ज नु पितरो ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! रजवीर्य की शुद्धि से ही आधिभौतिक शुद्धि का बीज, निश्चय ही सुरक्षित होता है।
english_translation: O ancestors, only through the purity of vital energy does the seed of physical purity surely remain protected.
essence: Only pure vital energy can securely preserve physical purity’s root.
simple_meaning: The purity of your vital life force is what truly preserves the foundation of your physical well-being.
insight: It shifts the focus from external cleanliness to nurturing your vital energy as the root of physical purity.
modern_relevance: When you take care of your core energy through rest and nourishment, you protect your overall health from within.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
विदित्वा पीठमर्यादा संस्कारशुद्धिपूर्विकाम ।
भवताश्च कृपापुज्जैः पितरो रक्षितं भवेत् ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! संस्कार शुद्धिपूर्वक पीठ मर्यादा को जानकर और आप लोगों की कृपा से
english_translation: O ancestors! Knowing the seat of honour and purity of impressions, and by your kindness, may it be protected.
essence: Respect for tradition and the kindness of ancestors protect your place.
simple_meaning: By understanding the respectful place of tradition and the purity of impressions, and through the kindness of ancestors, protection is granted.
insight: It teaches you to recognize the unseen support from past influences that help protect your path.
modern_relevance: When you feel uncertain, remember the support and kindness from those who came before you uphold your place in life.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
आधिदैविकसंशुद्धबीर्ज  नूनं चिरन्तनम् ।
सत्त्वलक्षणसंघो वै स्वस्मिञ्च्छश्वद्रिकाशितः ॥
translation: अधिदैव शुद्धि का चिरन्तन बीज अवश्य बना रहता है और अपने में सत्त्वगुण के लक्षणसमूह सर्वदा विकसित
english_translation: The eternal seed of transcendental purification remains always, inherently developing the cluster of sattva qualities within itself.
essence: A pure, eternal seed within you continuously nurtures clarity and calm qualities.
simple_meaning: Inside you is an eternal pure seed that constantly develops qualities of clarity, calmness, and balance.
insight: It invites you to connect inwardly with your natural capacity to nurture calm and clear qualities continuously.
modern_relevance: When stress overwhelms and mind feels scattered, remember you carry a timeless source of calm and clarity growing inside.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
क्रियमाणैः प्रयत्नैश्चेदभवेदीजं सुरक्षितम् ।
नूनमध्यात्मसंशुद्धेनात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥
translation: करने के प्रयत्न द्वारा अध्यात्मशुद्धि की बीज रक्षा अवश्य होती है। इसमें विचार न करें
english_translation: The seed of inner purification is surely preserved by efforts in action; there is no need for further doubt here.
essence: Effort alone reliably protects and nurtures the seed of inner purification.
simple_meaning: Your efforts in action protect the beginnings of your inner purification. You don’t need to question this truth.
insight: It teaches you to stop doubting your efforts and trust that consistent action nurtures your inner transformation.
modern_relevance: You’ve started a new habit or practice and wonder if it’s really helping. This verse comforts you that your efforts are already protecting that change.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
त्रिविधानां हि वीजानां रक्षयैवंविधैः क्रमैः ।
वर्णाश्रमाख्यधम्मस्य बीजं स्याद्राक्षितं ध्रुवम् बीर्ज ॥
translation: इस प्रकार के क्रम से त्रिविध-बीज की, सुरक्षा द्वारा ही वर्णाश्रमधर्म के बीज की अवश्य सुरक्षा होती है
english_translation: The seed of the threefold Vedas is surely protected by following proper orderly methods, just as the seed of the caste and stage duties is firmly guarded.
essence: Protecting what is vital requires following proper, orderly methods without skipping steps.
simple_meaning: The essential teachings of the three Vedas and the duties of caste and stage are preserved only by protecting their core principles through proper, ordered practice.
insight: It shows you to respect the process and sequence behind lasting preservation of important principles or systems.
modern_relevance: When you build a skill or nurture a relationship, following the right sequence and care protects what you've invested in from falling apart.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
स्याद्देशकालपात्राणां सत्येवं परिवर्तनात् ।
वर्णाश्रमाख्यधर्मस्य प्रचारः समये ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: ऐसा होने पर देश काल और पात्र के परिवर्तन से वर्णाश्रम धर्म का प्रचार यथासमय होना अवश्य सम्भावी है
english_translation: With changes in place, time, and individuals, the proper practice of varna-ashrama dharma naturally varies accordingly.
essence: Duties naturally change as your place, time, and role change.
simple_meaning: Your duties depend on where you are, when you are, and who you are with. They naturally change with these factors.
insight: It teaches you to see duty as flexible, encouraging you to respond wisely to the situation instead of clinging to rigid rules.
modern_relevance: You might find yourself in new roles or environments where the right way to act feels different. This verse reminds you to embrace the change and adjust your responsibilities accordingly.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अनेकासु हि बाधासूपस्थितास्वपि सर्वथा ।
भवन्तः स्युः सचेष्टाश्चेन्नारीषु च तथा भृशम् ॥
translation: हे विज्ञ पितृगण ! अनन्त बाधाओं के सर्वथा, उपस्थित होने पर भी यदि आप लोग अत्यन्त सचेष्ट रहें
english_translation: O wise ancestors! Even when faced with countless obstacles, you must remain fully active and engaged.
essence: True effort means staying fully active even when obstacles are everywhere.
simple_meaning: Even when many obstacles appear, you should remain fully active and engaged in your efforts.
insight: It teaches you to maintain steady effort even when circumstances feel impossible.
modern_relevance: You hit roadblock after roadblock in your project, but the real test is to keep pushing without losing focus.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
सतीधर्मस्य संशुद्धीरजोवीर्यस्य पुंव्रजे ।
भवेदभोः पितरो विज्ञाः ! भक्तिर्मयि च संस्थिता ॥
translation: और नारी में सतीत्वधर्म और पुरुषों में रजवीर्य की शुद्धि और मेरी भक्ति बनी रहे तो
english_translation: If the purity of devoted conduct in women and the valor of passion in men remain, and devotion to me is established, then all ancestors will be honored.
essence: Devotion and courage rooted in purity honor your ancestors and connect you to the divine.
simple_meaning: When women keep devoted purity and men maintain courageous passion, and devotion to me remains firm, the ancestors are honored.
insight: It teaches you to balance inner devotion with active courage, strengthening ties to your lineage and your true self.
modern_relevance: When you stay committed to your values with purity and courage, you honor your heritage and deepen your connection to your roots.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
धर्मास्यास्य तदा नूनं भवेद्रीनं सुरक्षितम् ।
श्रुतिरेषा वरीयत्ति पितरो नात्र संशयः ॥
translation: इस धर्म की बीज रक्षा अवश्य होती है । हे पितृगण ! यही श्रुति है । इसमें सन्देह नहीं
english_translation: The seed of this dharma is surely protected; ancestors, this is the revealed truth with no doubt.
essence: The fundamental principle of dharma is eternally preserved without any doubt.
simple_meaning: The essential principle of this dharma is always preserved, as confirmed by sacred teachings and ancestors.
insight: It reassures you to rely on foundational principles as stable guides amid shifting circumstances.
modern_relevance: When traditions or values feel uncertain, remember that their core purpose has a lasting protection beyond doubt.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
चिज्जड़ग्रन्थिसाहाय्याजीवा उत्पद्य भूरिशः ।
उद्भिज्जं लक्षविंशं हि स्वेदजं रुद्रलक्षकम् ॥
translation: चिज्जड़ग्रंथि की सहायता से अनेक जीव उत्पन्न होकर हे पितृ गण !
english_translation: With the help of the knot of the mind, many beings arise, O ancestors.
essence: The restless mind’s knot births countless beings in vast multiplicity.
simple_meaning: Many living beings arise from the complex knot of the restless mind, multiplied in vast numbers.
insight: It highlights how mental knots or confusions give rise to countless experiences and identities, shaping your perception of reality.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
एकोनविंशलक्षच नूनमण्डंजमद्भुतम् ।
जरायुजं चतुस्त्रिशल्लक्षकं पितरस्तथा ॥
translation: २० लाख उद्भिज्जयोनि ११ लाख स्वेदजयोनि १९ लाख ही अद्भुत अण्डजयोनि ३४ लाख जरायुजयोनि और
english_translation: There are 2 million born of earth, 1.1 million born from sweat, 1.9 million wondrously born from eggs, and 3.4 million born from decay.
essence: The verse enumerates different birth types and their vast numbers in creation.
simple_meaning: This verse lists various categories of beings by their origins and numbers, describing types of birth processes.
insight: This verse catalogs life forms without inviting action or reflection; it's descriptive, not directive.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अनार्यमानवानाञ्च लक्षद्वयमनुक्षणम् ।
अशीतिः षट् च लक्षाणि योनिर्भ्रान्त्वा मुहुर्मुहुः ॥
translation: २ लाख अनार्य मनुष्य योनि इन ८६ लाख योनियों में प्रतिक्षण बारम्बार भ्रमण करके
english_translation: Two hundred thousand non-noble beings continuously wander among eighty-six million species, repeatedly confused in birth.
essence: Countless confused beings endlessly cycle through forms of life.
simple_meaning: Many beings stuck in confusion keep wandering endlessly through countless species of life.
insight: It shows how confusion causes restless movement without progress or clarity.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
विशालं तत्पथं दुर्गमतिक्रम्यैव निश्चितम् ।
आर्यभावं लभन्तेऽन्ते नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥
translation: उस विशाल पथ को अतिक्रमण करते हुए ही अन्त में निश्चय आर्यभाव को प्राप्त करते है इसमें विचार नहीं करना चाहिये
english_translation: By crossing that vast path of difficulty, one ultimately attains the noble state without any need for doubt.
essence: Enduring hardship fully brings sure transformation into nobility without doubt.
simple_meaning: You must face and overcome a difficult path completely to finally reach a noble state of being without doubting the process.
insight: It teaches you to trust the difficulty itself as an essential part of growth, not something to avoid or second-guess.
modern_relevance: You stay committed through a tough project or life challenge, even when progress seems slow, trusting the struggle shapes you deeply.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
चतुर्णी भूतसङ्घानां गतिरास्त निरापदा ।
धारावाहिकशीला च नितान्तं सरला तथा ॥
translation: चतुर्विध भूतसंघ की गति निरापद नितान्त सरल और धारावाहिक है
english_translation: The movement of the fourfold groups of beings is secure, continuous, and completely simple.
essence: The fundamental movements of nature are steady, safe, and simply continuous.
simple_meaning: The natural flow of the four groups of beings is safe, ongoing, and entirely straightforward.
insight: Recognize that fundamental natural cycles proceed effortlessly and securely without your interference.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
तत्र प्रत्येकजीवानां वर्गान रक्षन्सलं सुराः।
तेषां त एव कथ्यन्तेऽधिदेवाश्च स्वधाभुजः ! ॥
translation: उनमें प्रत्येक जीव श्रेणियों की देवतागण पूर्णरूप से रक्षा करते हैं और हे पितृगण ! वे ही उनके अधिदैव कहाते हैं
english_translation: Among them, the gods fully protect each class of living beings, and O ancestors, they are called their presiding deities.
essence: Specific gods fully protect each class of living beings as their guardians.
simple_meaning: Different gods protect different groups of living beings. These gods are known as their presiding deities.
insight: Recognize that different aspects of life have distinct protectors or supports responsible for their care.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
त एव क्रमशो जीवान स्वाधिकाराप्तयोनितः ।
नयन्त्युच्चैस्तरां योनि पिण्डनाशादनन्तरम ॥
translation: और वे ही क्रमशः जीवों को अपने अधिकार से प्राप्त योनि से उन्नततर योनि में पिण्ड के नाश के अनन्तर पहुंचा दिया करते हैं
english_translation: They guide beings step by step from their current existence to a higher existence after the destruction of the body.
essence: Life advances through stages by your own rightful progression beyond the body’s end.
simple_meaning: Beings naturally progress through stages of life according to their own actions and rights, moving to higher states after the body ends.
insight: This verse shifts focus to trusting your own natural growth process through life’s changes without rushing or resisting.
modern_relevance: When you face changes or losses, you can trust your own inner unfolding to lead you to a better stage.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
सम्पूर्णावयवा जीवा मर्त्यपिण्डं गतास्ततः।
भूतिदाः ! भवंतां नूनं साहाय्यं प्राप्तुमीशते ॥
translation: हे पितृगण! अन्त में जीव पूर्णावयव होकर मनुष्य पिण्ड को प्राप्त करके आपलोगों की सहायता को प्राप्त कर सकते हैं
english_translation: O ancestors, in the end the living beings become complete entities and attain the human body to receive your support.
essence: Living beings complete their journey by taking human form to receive ancestral support.
simple_meaning: Living beings finally become whole and take a human form to receive help from their ancestors.
insight: It shows the importance of lineage and unseen support but does not teach a practical step for personal growth.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
क्रमशो वस्तु साहाय्यं समासाद्योत्तरोत्तरम् ।
गच्छन्ससंशयं पुण्यामार्यकोटि समुन्ननाम ॥
translation: और क्रमशः आपलोगो को सहायता उत्तरोत्तर प्राप्त करते हुए निश्चय ही आर्यकोटि में पहुंच जाते हैं।
english_translation: Gradually, by gaining support step by step, you surely reach the realm of countless noble ones.
essence: Steady support leads you stepwise to the highest noble realms.
simple_meaning: By steadily receiving help and advancing, you will eventually reach the high realm of noble beings.
insight: Trust the process of gradual support and steady progress toward your goals.
modern_relevance: You slowly gain trust and support at work or in life, building your way toward a big goal over time.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
ततोऽप्यार्यपदं प्राप्ताः शुद्धयोश्चक्रपीठयोः ।
अधिकारीभवन्तो हि साहाय्याच्छुद्धयोस्तयोः ॥
translation: आर्यपदवी को प्राप्त कर तदनन्तर भी चक्रशुद्धि और पीठशुद्धि के अधिकारी बनकर उन शुद्ध चक्र और शुद्ध पीठों की सहायता से
english_translation: Then, having attained the noble state, the purified ones become eligible for the pure chakras and pure seats and assist them.
essence: Spiritual progress qualifies you to support and assist higher purified centers.
simple_meaning: Those who reach the noble level become qualified to assist the pure energy centers and seats with their support.
insight: It shows that spiritual progress involves readiness to support higher realms, not just personal elevation.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
प्राप्य मामधिगच्छन्ति मत्सायुज्यं न संशयः ।
जीवत्वं हि तदा तेषां जीवानां नश्यति स्वयम् ॥
