translation: मुझको प्राप्त करके निःसन्देह मन्सायुज्य को लाभ करते हैं तब उन जीवों का जीवत्व स्वतः ही नष्ट हो जाता है
english_translation: Those who reach me undoubtedly attain union with me; then their individual existence naturally ceases.
essence: True union with the divine dissolves the separate self naturally and without doubt.
simple_meaning: When you reach the divine fully, your individual sense of separate self naturally disappears.
insight: It shifts your focus from clinging to a separate self toward embracing unity with the whole.
modern_relevance: When you feel deeply connected to something larger, your usual worries about 'me' and 'mine' start to fade away naturally.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अनुभूतमिदं त्वास्ते युप्माभिः पितरो ध्रुवम् ।
मर्त्ययोनि समासाद्य जीवाः सर्वे समन्ततः ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! यह तो आपलोगों के अनुभव में है ही कि मनुष्ययोनि को प्राप्त करके सब जीव सब ओर से
english_translation: O ancestors, it is certainly your experience that all beings, having taken birth in the mortal realm, come from everywhere.
essence: All beings enter the mortal realm from every direction; this is common experience.
simple_meaning: All living beings come into the mortal world from many directions; this is well known to the ancestors.
insight: Recognize that life appears in many forms, emerging into the mortal world universally.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
आवागमनचक्रेषु प्रविशन्ति न संशयः ।
पश्यन्ति किन्तु वै चक्रं भाग्यवन्तो न केऽप्यदः ॥
translation: आवागमन रुपी चक्र प्रवेश करने हैं। परन्तु कोई भी भाग्यवान उस चक्र को नहीं ही देखते हैं
english_translation: In the cycle of coming and going, all enter without doubt; yet no fortunate ones truly see the cycle.
essence: Most people move through life's cycles unaware; only a few truly perceive them.
simple_meaning: Everyone goes through life's repeating cycles without hesitation, but very few aware people actually understand or perceive these cycles clearly.
insight: It teaches you to notice the repeating cycles you move through and seek to perceive them consciously.
modern_relevance: You keep repeating the same mistakes or patterns, unaware most people don’t see these cycles clearly either.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
परिधिस्तस्य चक्रस्य द्विधा भिन्नोऽस्त्यसंशयम् ।
तत्रैकः प्रेनलोकोऽस्ति मृत्युलोकोऽपरस्तथा ॥
translation: उस चक्र की निःसन्देह दो परिधि होती है एक को प्रेतलोक कहते हैं और दूसरे को मृत्युलोक कहते हैं
english_translation: That wheel certainly has two boundaries; one is called the realm of spirits, the other the realm of death.
essence: A fundamental cycle divides into two distinct realms: spirits and death.
simple_meaning: The wheel has two clear edges; one is the realm of spirits, the other the realm of death.
insight: It invites you to recognize that some experiences or cycles have sharply different phases or boundaries.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
असौ चक्रस्य परिधिः पितृलोकावधि क्रमात ।
विस्तीर्य प्रथमं पश्चान्नरके स्वरपि ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: चक्र की वह परिधि प्रथम क्रमशः पितृलोक तक विस्तार होती है तदनन्तर नरकलोक में विस्तार होती है और यह परिधि स्वर्ग लोक में भी
english_translation: The perimeter of that wheel first extends to the realm of ancestors, then gradually expands to the lower realm of the dead, and finally reaches the higher realm of the divine beings.
essence: The cycle of existence expands through ancestral, lower, and higher realms in order.
simple_meaning: The circle or boundary described grows step by step from the ancestors' realm to the lower and then higher realms.
insight: It reveals how different states or realms connect in a vast cycle beyond immediate perception.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
विस्तृणाति तपोलोक पर्यन्तं नात्र संशयः ।
नैवात्र विस्मयः कार्यों भवद्भिर्विश्वभूतिदाः! ॥
translation: विस्तार होकर ही तपलोक तक पहुंच जाती है इसमें सन्देह नहीं है । हे पितृगण ! आपलोगों को इस विषय में आश्चर्य नहीं करना चाहिये
english_translation: The heat of tapas expands fully up to the realm of austerity without doubt; O ancestors, you should not be surprised by this.
essence: Focused effort naturally expands its power without causing surprise.
simple_meaning: Focused effort grows naturally and reaches far without doubt. You shouldn't be surprised by how far disciplined effort can extend.
insight: Recognize that disciplined effort has a natural momentum that unfolds without needing constant doubt or surprise.
modern_relevance: When you commit deeply to a practice or goal, its impact grows beyond what you might expect, even if the results seem slow.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
तम: प्रधानं प्रथमं चक्रमेतदनन्तरम् ।
तमोरज:प्रधानञ्च रजःसत्त्वप्रधानकम् ॥
translation: यह आवागमन चक्र प्रथम तमः प्रधान तदनन्तर तम-रज प्रधान तदनन्तर रज-सत्त्व प्रधान ही हो जाता है
english_translation: This cycle begins with tamas (darkness), then moves to tamas-rajas (darkness and activity), and then to rajas-sattva (activity and harmony).
essence: All change flows through stages: inertia, mixed energy, then balanced harmony.
simple_meaning: Everything in nature progresses through stages starting with inertia, then mixed energy, and finally balanced clarity.
insight: It teaches you to see difficult or stagnant moments as the start of a natural progression toward clarity and balance.
modern_relevance: When you feel stuck or dull, remember that energy and balance will come in time as natural phases unfold.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
शुद्धसत्त्वप्रधानं हि जायते तदनन्तरम् ।
उद्धर्व लोकं ततो मृत्युलोकं व्याप्नोति केवलम् ॥
translation: तदनन्तर उस चक्र की परिधि केवल उद्धर्व लोक और मृत्युलोक व्यापी ही रहती है
english_translation: From pure goodness arises the next realm, which encompasses only the higher and mortal worlds.
essence: A realm born of pure goodness covers only the higher and mortal worlds.
simple_meaning: A realm dominated by pure goodness arises next, covering only the higher and mortal worlds.
insight: It teaches to recognize different levels or phases of experience, each with its own nature and reach.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
परिधिस्तस्य चक्रस्य ततोऽन्ते मयि लीयते ।
मृत्युलोके गतिस्तस्य स्वतो हि सहजा सती ॥
translation: और अन्त में वह चक मुझ में लय को प्राप्त होता है। उस समय ही उस चक्र को गति शीघ्र स्वतः ही सहज होकर या तो मृत्युलोक में ही शान्त होती है
english_translation: At the end, that wheel merges into me; its movement naturally ceases in the realm of death.
essence: All cycles of movement naturally dissolve into stillness within the true self.
simple_meaning: All activity or cycles eventually come to rest by merging into the true self, where movement naturally stops.
insight: It teaches you to see cycles and movement as temporary, inviting your attention to the stillness at their end.
modern_relevance: When your day’s busyness finally quiets and you sit alone, you glimpse how all restlessness dissolves into your inner calm.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अथवाऽसाद्य शुक्लत्वं सत्यलोकावधि ध्रुवम् ।
गत्वा तत्र तदैवाशु सर्वथैव प्रशाम्यति ॥
translation: अथवा शुक्लता को प्राप्त करके सत्यलोक तक ही पहुंच कर वहां सर्वथा हो शान्त होती है।
english_translation: Or by attaining pure whiteness, one reaches the realm of truth and there becomes completely peaceful.
essence: Complete purity leads directly to the realm of truth and instant peace.
simple_meaning: By achieving complete purity or clarity, you enter the realm of truth where full peace naturally arises.
insight: It teaches you that deep clarity naturally dissolves turmoil, shifting your inner state to peace.
modern_relevance: After clearing mental clutter and confusion, you suddenly feel calm and grounded, as if arriving home to your true self.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अत्यन्त दुःशमं हीदमावागमनचक्रकम् ।
भत्तुमेनमलं सन्ति मद्भक्ता एव केवलम् ॥
translation: इस आवागमनचक्र का शान्त होना बहुत ही कठिन है केवल मेरे भक्तगणं ही इस चक्र को भेदन करने में समर्थ होते हैं
english_translation: It is extremely difficult to still this cycle of coming and going; only my devotees alone can break through it.
essence: Only devoted love can break the difficult cycle of endless coming and going.
simple_meaning: The endless cycle of coming and going is very hard to stop. Only those who have devoted love can truly break free from it.
insight: This verse teaches you to rely on devoted love as the power to overcome repetitive patterns and inner restlessness.
modern_relevance: When you feel trapped in repetitive struggles or habits, it can seem impossible to change. But committing your heart fully to what matters can give you the strength to break free.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
परिधिष्वत्र जीवान हि कृतकर्मानुसारतः।
एकतोऽन्यत्र भूम्यां वै भिन्ना देवा नयन्त्यलम् ॥
translation: जीवों के कृतकर्मों के अनुसार उनको इस चक्र की इन परिधियों में एक जगह से दूसरी जगह पहुंचाने का कार्य विभिन्न देवतागण किया करते हैं
english_translation: According to their performed actions, beings are moved by different deities through the peripheries of this cycle from one place to another.
essence: Your past actions set forces in motion that move you through life’s stages.
simple_meaning: Beings are moved from place to place within this cycle by different divine beings according to their past actions.
insight: It teaches you to see your current circumstances as shaped by past actions beyond immediate control.
modern_relevance: When life feels like it's moving you from one situation to another beyond your control, this reveals how past choices shape present movement.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
शुक्ला कृष्णा च सहजा त्रिविधा वर्तते गतिः।
एतास्तिस्रोऽपि सन्त्येव देवसाहाय्यसास्कृताः ॥
translation: गति तीन प्रकार की होती है उनके नाम रुपण शुक्ल और सहज हैं और ये तीनों भी गतियां देवताओं की सहायता के अधीन ही हैं
english_translation: Movement occurs in three forms: rupa (form), shukla (pure), and sahaja (natural), all under the guidance of the devas' support.
essence: All movement has three forms and depends on higher supportive forces.
simple_meaning: There are three types of movement or progress—form, clarity, and natural—and all depend on the support of radiant beings.
insight: Recognize that all change or movement you see has layers and support beyond what appears.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
धूमो रात्रिस्तथा कृष्णः पण्मासा दक्षिणायनम्।
चतुर्धा सविभक्तोऽस्ति क्रमः कृष्णगतेरिति ॥
translation: कृष्ण गति का क्रम धूम रात्रि कृष्णपक्ष और छः मास दक्षिणायन इस प्रकार से चतुर्धा विभक्त है।
english_translation: The cycle of the dark phase follows this order: smoke, night, dark fortnight, six months of the southern course, divided into four parts.
essence: The dark phase of the lunar cycle divides into four ordered phases.
simple_meaning: The dark phase of the lunar cycle is divided into four parts: smoke, night, dark fortnight, and six months of the southern course.
insight: It highlights how natural cycles are organized into phases to help understand time and change.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
क्षमन्ते नैव ये भेत्तुं क्रममेतं चतुर्विधम् । 
जीवास्तीवशरीराधासक्तियुक्तास्त एव हि ॥
translation: हे पितृगण! जो इस चतुर्विध क्रम का भेदन करने में समर्थ नहीं होते, वह ही तीव्र देहादद्या सक्तिविशिष्ट जीव
english_translation: Those who cannot discern the fourfold order remain deeply attached to the body and its impulses.
essence: Not seeing the natural order keeps you stuck in body-based attachment.
simple_meaning: If you cannot understand the fourfold natural order, you stay strongly attached to your body and impulses.
insight: This verse teaches you to identify the hidden patterns behind your attachments, opening the way to freedom.
modern_relevance: You struggle to move beyond habits because you haven't recognized the deeper structure guiding your life.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
मूर्छिता यान्ति पितरः ! प्रेतलोकं न संशयः।
नैवात्र विस्मयः कार्यो भवद्भिः संशयोऽथवा ॥
translation: मूर्छित होकर निःसन्देह प्रेतलोक को प्राप्त होते हैं इस विषय में आपलोगों को संशय और विस्मय नहीं ही करना चाहिये
english_translation: Ancestors depart unconscious to the lower realm; you should have no doubt or surprise about this.
essence: Death leads ancestors unconscious to the lower realm; doubt and surprise are unnecessary.
simple_meaning: Ancestors go unconscious to the lower realm after death; you should not feel doubt or surprise about this fact.
insight: It shifts the mind from fear and confusion about death to calm acceptance of natural processes.
modern_relevance: When someone passes unexpectedly, you may feel shocked or uncertain about what happens next; this verse offers clarity to reduce that fear.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
पारयन्ते तु ये भेत्तुं गतरुक्तं चतुष्क्रमम् ।
कपूयांचरणास्ते चेभिरकानाप्नुवन्त्यहो ॥
translation: जो कृष्ण गति के उक्त चतुष्कम को भेदन करने में समर्थ होते हैं वह अहो, अधमकर्मा होने से नरकलोक
english_translation: Those who can understand the fourfold path of liberation described by Krishna do not fall into the lower realm due to bad actions.
essence: Understanding the fourfold path prevents falling into harmful states despite past wrongs.
simple_meaning: Understanding the four steps to liberation protects you from falling into harmful states caused by wrongful actions.
insight: It teaches you to seek and hold onto clear guidance to avoid harmful cycles.
modern_relevance: When you understand a clear way out of your struggles, you avoid falling into despair or harmful habits.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
मध्यमाचरणा यान्ति पितृलोकं न संशयः।
गच्छन्त्युत्तमकर्माणः स्वलोकं पितरः ! ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: मध्यमकर्मा होने से निःसन्देह पितृलोक और उत्तम कर्मा होने से हे पितृगण' ! निश्चय ही स्वर्गलोक को प्राप्त होते हैं
english_translation: Those who perform moderate actions go to the realm of ancestors without doubt; those who perform superior actions certainly attain the heavenly realm.
essence: The nature of your actions shapes the realm you move to beyond this life.
simple_meaning: Moderate actions lead to the ancestors' realm, while superior actions lead to the heavenly realm without doubt.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that the quality of your actions influences your deeper journey after life.
modern_relevance: When you act with care or excellence, you shape the lasting impact your life leaves behind.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
पुण्येन महता लभ्या गतिः शुक्ला स्वधाभुजः !।
अग्निज्योर्तिरहः शुक्ल: षण्मासा उत्तरायणम् ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! ये उसके क्रम के चार भेद हैं, यथा-ज्योतिः, दिन, शुक्लपक्ष और छः मास उत्तरायण
english_translation: O ancestors! The four divisions of its course are: light, day, the bright lunar fortnight, and the six-month northward movement.
essence: Natural cycles divide time into meaningful phases connected to ancestral tradition.
simple_meaning: The verse describes four parts of a cycle related to ancestors: light, day, the bright half of the lunar month, and the six-month northward path of the sun.
insight: It shows how natural cycles shape spiritual and ritual time, grounding human life in cosmic rhythms.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
चतुर्धा संविभक्तो हि क्रमः शुक्लगतेरयम् ।
अदोऽभिमानिनो देवा जीवाञ्च्छुक्लगतिं गतान् ॥
translation: जो शुक्लगति उग्र पुण्य से प्राप्त होती है । इनके अभिमानी देवतागण, इस गतिशील जीवों को स्वर्गलोक से
english_translation: The divine beings proud of their superior status regard those souls who have attained the white path of intense virtue as moving toward the higher realm.
essence: Prideful divine beings see virtuous souls as moving upward but remain attached to status.
simple_meaning: Some divine beings are proud and look at souls who follow the white path of virtue as moving toward the higher realm.
insight: It highlights how pride can influence perception of others' growth, suggesting humility is needed in spiritual judgement.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
उच्चैः स्वर्लोकतः पूर्व नीत्या लोकाननन्तरम् ।
आवागमनचक्रे हि शान्ते सत्यं नयन्त्यहो ॥
translation: उच्च लोकों में प्रथम पहुंचाकर तत्पश्चात् आवागमनचक्र के शान्त होने पर ही अहो ! सत्यलोक में पहुंचाते हैं
english_translation: After first reaching the highest realms, then, when the cycle of coming and going is at rest, one attains the realm of truth.
essence: Ultimate truth comes only after restless cycles have ceased following higher attainments.
simple_meaning: One first reaches the highest worlds, then, only after the cycle of returning and going ends, does one enter the true realm.
insight: It highlights that ultimate peace or truth comes only after cycles of reactivity and return end.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
तत्र ते श्रेष्ठकर्माणः प्राणिनः सूर्य्यमण्डलम्।
विभिद्य प्राप्नुवन्त्येव मत्सायुज्यं न संशयः ॥
translation: वहां से सूर्यमण्डल भेदन करके वह श्रेष्ठकर्मा जीव निःसन्देह ही मत्सायुज्य को प्राप्त करते हैं।
english_translation: From there, beings who perform the highest actions pass through the solar sphere and undoubtedly attain union with the fish-born (Matsayujya).
essence: The highest actions lead beyond the solar realm to a certain sacred union.
simple_meaning: Those who perform the best actions pass beyond the solar sphere and certainly reach a special union called Matsayujya.
insight: It shows that pure, highest action moves you beyond visible limits to an elevated state of being.
modern_relevance: When you fully commit to your highest efforts, you move beyond everyday limits toward a deeper sense of unity and purpose.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
सहजाया गतेरास्ते गतिरत्यन्तमद्धता ।
कश्चिन्नैवात्र सन्देहो विद्यते विश्वभूतिदाः ! ॥
translation: सहज गति की गति अति विलक्षण है हे पितृगण ! इसमें कोई भी सन्देह नहीं है
english_translation: The natural movement of the effortless path is supremely unique; there is no doubt about it, O ancestors of the world!
essence: The effortless natural path moves uniquely without any doubt.
simple_meaning: The natural, effortless way of moving through life is uniquely special and beyond doubt.
insight: It invites you to trust the effortless flow rather than force progress.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
गति मे सहजामाप्ता भक्ताः कौलालचक्रवत ।
पिण्डं स्वं ज्ञानिनो नूनं जीवन्मुक्ता हि विभ्रति ॥
translation: सहज गति प्राप्त मेरे जीवन्मुक्त ज्ञानीभक्त कुलाल चक्रवत् अपने पिण्ड को निश्चय ही धारण करते हैं
english_translation: Those naturally established in the supreme path, like devoted potter-wheel workers, surely hold their own embodied self; truly, liberated beings with knowledge wander not.
essence: Natural devotion keeps the true self steady and free, like a potter's steady wheel.
simple_meaning: Those who reach devotion naturally hold their true self firmly and do not lose their freedom.
insight: It teaches to cultivate devotion and wisdom as a natural, steady state that secures your true self.
modern_relevance: When your passion and trust flow naturally, like a skilled craft, you keep your sense of self steady amid life's changes.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
शक्तेः कौलालचक्रस्य भ्रामिकाया लये सति ।
तद्धि चक्रं यथा सद्यः स्वयमेव प्रशाम्यति ॥
translation: जिस प्रकार कुलाल चक्र, भ्रमण कारिणी शक्ति के लय होने पर तत्काल ही स्वयं ही शान्त हो जाता है
english_translation: Just as the potter's wheel immediately stops spinning when the force that moves it ceases.
essence: Restlessness ends naturally when the driving force within disappears.
simple_meaning: When the energy or force that drives something stops, the movement also stops naturally without effort.
insight: It shifts attention from struggling against restlessness to removing the cause of agitation itself.
modern_relevance: Your mind races like a wheel spinning fast. When you stop fueling anxious thoughts, calm arrives effortlessly.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
नष्टे प्रारब्धजे पिण्डे जीवन्मुक्तास्तथैव मे ।
लीयन्ते ज्ञानिनो भक्ता ध्रुवं मय्येव भव्यदाः ॥
translation: हे पितृगण! उसी प्रकार मेरे जीवन्मुक्त भक्त प्रारब्ध जनित पिण्ड के नाश होने पर समुद्र में
english_translation: Just as the body born from past karma perishes, so do the liberated beings and devotees merge surely into me.
essence: Freed from past karma, the true self merges fully with the divine presence.
simple_meaning: When the results of past actions end, liberated beings and devoted ones unite completely with Shiva.
insight: It teaches you that ending attachment to past consequences lets your true nature rejoin the divine presence.
modern_relevance: You’ve let go of old regrets and patterns that once controlled you, and now feel a deep, lasting connection to your true source.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
आकाशपतिता वारिबिन्दवो बारिधाविय ।
वस्तुतः सहजामाप्ता जीवन्मुक्ता हि प्राणिनः ॥
translation: आकाश पतित वारिबिन्दु की भांति मुझमें ही निश्चय लय हो जाते हैं। वस्तुतः सहजगति प्राप्त ही जीवन्मुक्त जीव
english_translation: Like a raindrop fallen from the sky, I merge and dissolve within myself; indeed, beings who attain natural flow are truly liberated in life.
essence: True freedom arises when you flow naturally and dissolve into your deeper being.
simple_meaning: When you surrender naturally, like a raindrop merging into water, you live freely and fully released.
insight: It teaches you to release resistance and merge naturally with your deeper self for freedom.
modern_relevance: You feel stuck struggling against life’s flow, but letting go and moving with ease reconnects you to freedom.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
वासनायाः क्षये जाते तत्त्वज्ञानोदये सति ।
सार्द्धे मनोविनाशेन विमुक्ताः पूर्वमेव ते ॥
translation: वासनाक्षय, तत्त्वज्ञान लाभ और मनोनाश के साथ ही साथ पहले ही मुक्त हैं
english_translation: When desires have ended and true understanding has arisen, and the mind is also destroyed, then you are already liberated.
essence: Freedom is already yours when desires end and the restless mind is stilled by true knowledge.
simple_meaning: Freedom comes when your desires disappear, your true understanding arises, and your restless mind is quieted.
insight: It shifts the mind from craving and mental turbulence to calm understanding, revealing freedom is already here.
modern_relevance: You realize freedom when you stop chasing wants, gain clarity about what truly matters, and quiet your restless thoughts.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
सहजां गतिमाप्तानां जीवन्मुक्तमहात्मनाम् ।
आवागमनचक्रं वै मृत्युलोके हि शाम्यति ॥
translation: आवागमन चक्र की शान्ति सहज गति प्राप्त जीवन्मुक्त के लिये मृत्युलोक में ही निश्चय होती है
english_translation: For those who have attained natural freedom, the cycle of coming and going ceases in the realm of death itself.
essence: Natural liberation ends the cycle of rebirth before death arrives.
simple_meaning: Those who have naturally attained liberation no longer cycle through rebirth; they are free even before death.
insight: It teaches you to understand liberation as a present state, not a future event after death.
modern_relevance: You might feel stuck repeating the same struggles, but freedom can come now, breaking the cycle before life ends.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
शुक्लां गतिमवाप्तानां सतां प्रारब्धशालिनाम् । 
सूर्यमण्डलसम्भेदकाले चक्रन्तु शाम्यति ॥
translation: और शुक्ल गति प्राप्त प्रारब्धवान् महापुरुषों के लिये सूर्यमण्डल भेदन करते समय होती है
english_translation: For noble beings who have attained the pure path, the sun's passage through the zodiac brings calm.
essence: The sun's movement calms those whose path is ripened and pure.
simple_meaning: Noble people who have reached a pure path experience calm when the sun passes through the zodiac.
insight: Recognize that some periods naturally support inner calm, especially for those prepared by steady effort.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
पितरो वर्णयित्वैता जीवानां त्रिविधा गती ।
साम्प्रतं जीवपिण्डानां गतीर्वो वर्णयाम्यहम् ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! इन जीव की विविध गतियों का वर्णन करके अब मैं जीवपिण्ड की गतियां जिनके साथ आपलोगों के अधिकार का
english_translation: O ancestors, having described the threefold paths of living beings, now I describe the paths of the individual beings over whom you have authority.
essence: A new detailed description of individual beings' paths begins after broad categories.
simple_meaning: After explaining the three kinds of paths for living beings, now the speaker will explain the paths of individual beings under ancestral authority.
insight: This verse signals a shift from general to specific teachings about the nature of individual beings and their paths.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
मुख्यं सम्बध्यते याभिर्भवतामधिकारिता ।
सावधानैर्भवद्भिस्ताः श्रूयन्तां वै स्वधाभुजः ! ॥
translation: प्रधान सम्बन्ध है उनका वर्णन आप लोगो से करता हूँ, हे पितृगण! आपलोग इनको सावधान होकर ही सुनें
english_translation: The main connection is described by me to you all, O ancestors! Listen carefully and attentively.
essence: Important teachings require careful and attentive listening.
simple_meaning: I am explaining the most important connection to you, respected ancestors. Please listen carefully and attentively.
insight: It highlights the value of careful attention before receiving important knowledge.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
जीवानां जीवभावाय जीवपिण्डप्रधानता।
सदसत्कर्मणां भोगो बिना पिण्डं न सम्भवेत् ॥
translation: जीवों के जीवत्व के लिये जीवपिण्ड की प्रधानता है क्योंकि बिना पिण्ड के सत् असत् कर्म का फलभोग असम्भव है
english_translation: For the life of beings, the body is primary because without the body, experiencing the results of true and false actions is impossible.
essence: Life depends on the body to experience the results of every action.
simple_meaning: Your physical body is essential for experiencing the consequences of your actions, good or bad.
insight: Recognize your body as the necessary link to understand how your efforts shape your experience.
modern_relevance: When you reflect on a tough decision, your body’s reactions show you the real impact of your choices.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
कर्मस्वातन्त्र्यलाभेऽपि यतस्तन्मुख्यताऽस्ति हि ।
जैवैशसहजानां हि सर्वेषामेव कर्मणाम् ॥
translation: और कर्म करने की स्वाधीनता प्राप्ति में भी जीवपिण्ड का प्राधान्य है चाहे जैव कर्म हो चाहे ऐश कर्म हो
english_translation: Even in gaining freedom to act, the living being's prominence is evident in all actions, whether natural or subtle.
essence: Freedom to act always depends on the living being present in every kind of action.
simple_meaning: Your ability to act freely still depends on the living being that underlies every action, whether obvious or subtle.
insight: Recognize that freedom to act is never separate from your deeper life essence guiding those actions.
modern_relevance: You might feel fully independent in your choices, yet your deeper being always shapes how and why you act.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
साहाय्याज्जीवपिण्डानामेव भोगः प्रजायते ।
नैवात्र विस्मयः कार्यों भवद्भिः पितृपुङ्गवाः !॥
translation: और चाहे सहज कर्म हो सबका ही जीव पिण्ड की सहायता से ही भोग होता है, हे पितृगण ! इस विषय में आपलोगों को विस्मय नहीं ही करना चाहिये
english_translation: Even natural actions produce enjoyment only through the support of the living body; O revered ancestors, you should not be surprised by this.
essence: Your experiences arise only through your living body's support; this is natural, not surprising.
simple_meaning: Everything you experience, even natural actions, happens through the support of your living body. There is no reason to be surprised by this.
insight: It shifts your view to see enjoyment as dependent on physical life’s support, reducing confusion about experience.
modern_relevance: You notice how your feelings and pleasures arise only when your body is alive and functioning—nothing mysterious beyond that.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
सहजो मानवो दैवो जीवपिण्डविधा मतः ।
मर्त्येभ्यश्चतरे निम्ना भूतसङ्घाश्चतुर्विधाः ॥
translation: सहज मानव और दैव रूप से जीव पिण्ड त्रिविध होता है, सहजपिण्ड वह ही हैं जिनके द्वारा मनुष्यों से इतर निम्न श्रेणी के चतुर्विध भूतसंघ
english_translation: The living being is naturally threefold: human, divine, and embodied life; among mortals, there are four lower classes of beings.
essence: Life naturally divides into human, divine, and lower embodied forms.
simple_meaning: Living beings exist in three natural categories: human, divine, and embodied forms; within mortals, there are four lower groups of beings.
insight: Recognizing multiple levels of life shifts your view from self-centered to broader respect for all forms.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
यैस्तु कर्मफलं पिण्डैर्भुञ्जते सहजा हि ते ।
मर्त्योपयुक्तपिण्डा हि कथ्यन्ते मानवाभिधाः ॥
translation: कर्मफल भोग करते हैं। मनुष्य के उपयोगी पिण्डों को मानवपिण्ड कहते हैं
english_translation: Those who enjoy the fruits of their actions are naturally so; the bodies useful to mortals are called human bodies.
essence: Your human body naturally experiences the results of your actions.
simple_meaning: You experience the results of your actions naturally through your human body, which is suited for mortal life.
insight: Recognize your body as the natural medium where the outcomes of your actions unfold without resistance.
modern_relevance: When you feel tired or joyful, remember your body is where your actions' results show up and shape your experience.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
देवपिण्डाश्च ये व्याप्ता भुवनानि चतुर्दश।
वर्तन्ते पितरो दैव-भोगायतनरूपिणः ॥
translation: और हे पितृगण ! चतुर्दश भुवनस्थित देव भोगायतनरूप जो पिण्ड हैं वे देवपिण्ड कहलाते हैं
english_translation: O ancestors! The divine bodies that pervade the fourteen worlds are called divine bodies and serve as the abode for divine enjoyment.
essence: Divine bodies pervade all fourteen worlds as abodes for divine enjoyment.
simple_meaning: The ancestors explain that the divine bodies pervading the fourteen worlds are forms where divine beings enjoy their existence.
insight: It invites seeing all existence as permeated by divine forms, deepening respect for the natural and unseen realms.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
त्रिविधा एव नन्वेते वर्तन्ते पाञ्चभौतिकाः ।
उपादानेषु किन्त्वेषां प्रभेदो वर्तते महान् ॥
translation: यह तीनों पिण्ड ही निश्चय पाञ्चभौतिक हैं परन्तु इनके उपादान में महान् प्रभेद है
english_translation: These three bodies are indeed composed of the five great elements, but there is a significant difference in their material cause.
essence: Three bodies share elements but differ deeply in their material cause.
simple_meaning: Three types of bodies all consist of the five elements but differ greatly in what material they are made from.
insight: It teaches you to look beyond appearances and recognize important differences in the foundation of things.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
रातिभिः सहनाभिर्वे पिण्डास्ते सहजाभिधाः।
निर्मीयन्त उपादानैः पार्थिवैरेव केवलैः ॥
translation: सहजपिण्ड केवल पार्थिव उपादानो से ही सहज रीति से ही निर्मित होते हैं।
english_translation: The natural bodies arise simply from earthly elements combined effortlessly.
essence: Physical bodies arise naturally from earthly elements without complexity.
simple_meaning: Bodies form naturally from earthly materials through basic natural processes.
insight: It shifts focus from mystical origins to the natural world as the basis of physical form.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
सूक्ष्मैदैवैरुपादानैयथायोग्याधिकारतः।
निर्मीयन्ते न सन्देहो देवाः पिण्डाः पृथग्विधाः ॥
translation: नानाविध दैवीपिण्ड सूक्ष्मदैवी उपादानों से यथायोग्य अधिकारानुसार निःसन्देह निर्मित होते हैं
english_translation: Various subtle divine elements are undoubtedly created from subtler divine components according to their proper function.
essence: Subtle divine parts create diverse divine forms without doubt, each by its proper function.
simple_meaning: The divine forms arise naturally and surely from finer divine parts, each fulfilling its proper role.
insight: It teaches you to recognize the natural, ordered emergence of complexity from subtle causes, reducing confusion about origins.
modern_relevance: When you see complex things around you, remember they come from smaller parts working rightly together, offering trust in natural processes.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
प्रकृत्याऽलौकिकी दैवी शक्तिस्तत्र विराजते ।
नैवात्र विस्मयः कश्चित्संशयो वा विधीयताम् ॥
translation: क्योंकि उनमें लोकातीत दैवी शक्ति को विकास स्वभाविक रूप से विद्यमान रहता है, इस विषय में कोई विस्मय अथवा संशय नहीं कर सकते
english_translation: Because in them the transcendental divine power naturally resides, there can be no wonder or doubt about it.
essence: Some beings naturally embody a higher power beyond ordinary reality without doubt.
simple_meaning: Some beings naturally have a special divine power that is beyond the physical world. No one should be surprised or doubtful about this.
insight: It shifts the mind from skepticism to acceptance of extraordinary natural qualities in some beings.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
भवद्विशिष्टसाहाय्यालब्धानां किन्तु भूतिदाः!।
पिण्डानां मानवीयानां वैलक्षण्यं किमप्यहो ॥
translation: परन्तु हे पितृगण ! आपलोगों की विशेष सहायता से प्राप्त जो मानव पिण्ड है अहो ! उनकी विचित्रता कुछ और ही है
english_translation: But O ancestors, the human embodiment obtained through your special help has a unique distinctiveness indeed.
essence: The human form gained with special help has a unique and remarkable nature.
simple_meaning: The human body gained through your special support has a remarkable, unique nature.
insight: It invites reflection on the special potential and uniqueness of human life supported by ancestral and cosmic forces.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
एते शक्तिविशेषाणां वर्तन्ते पितरो ध्रुवम् ।
आकर्षणोपयोगित्वाचतुर्वर्गफलप्रदाः ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! वे विशेष शक्तियों के आकर्षण के उपयोगी होने से ही चतुर्वर्गफलप्रद हैं
english_translation: O ancestors, these special powers exist because their attraction is useful and they grant the fourfold benefits.
essence: Special powers persist because their attraction benefits the four social groups.
simple_meaning: Certain special powers exist because their attractive use brings the fourfold benefits to society.
insight: Understanding that abilities or qualities are sustained by their usefulness shifts focus from status to service.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
निःश्रेयंसफलोत्पन्नकारिणो विटपस्य हि। .
मानवीयो हि पिण्डोऽयं बीजमास्ते न संशयः ॥
translation: यह मानवपिण्ड ही निःश्रेयस फल उत्पन्नकारी वृक्ष का ही निसन्देह बीजस्वरूप है
english_translation: This human body is undoubtedly the seed that produces the tree bearing the highest good.
essence: Your human body is the seed that grows your highest good.
simple_meaning: Your human body is the essential seed that grows into your highest good or ultimate benefit.
insight: It shifts your view of the body from mere form to a powerful source of potential and purpose.
modern_relevance: You wake up feeling ordinary, but every choice you make plants seeds toward your greatest potential.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
एतनिःश्रेयस नूनं वर्तते देवदुर्लभम् ।
यस्मान्न पुनरावृत्तिस्तन्नि:श्रेयसमुच्यते ॥
translation: यह निःश्रेयस देवताओं के लिये भी दुर्लभ है, जिससे पुनरावृत्ति न हो उसको निःश्रेयस कहते हैं
english_translation: True highest good is indeed rare even for the radiant beings; that from which there is no return is called the highest good.
essence: The highest good means reaching a state with no return to lower existence.
simple_meaning: The highest good is very rare, even for radiant beings, because it means reaching a state from which you never return.
insight: It shifts your aim from temporary gains to lasting transformation with no fallback.
modern_relevance: You know a breakthrough is real when it changes you so deeply you don’t fall back into old habits.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
पिण्डानां मानवीयानां मुख्यत्वे पितरो ध्रुवम् ।
भवन्तो हेतवस्सन्ति प्रधाना नात्र संशयः ॥
translation: मानव पिण्डो के प्राधान्य के विषय में हे पितृगण! आपलोग ही प्रधान कारण हैं, इसमें सन्देह नहीं है
english_translation: O ancestral beings, you are surely the primary cause of the human body’s existence.
essence: Ancestors are undeniably the primary cause of the human body’s existence.
simple_meaning: The ancestors are acknowledged as the definite primary cause behind the human body’s existence.
insight: It clarifies the foundational role of lineage and continuity in the formation of human life.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
महत्वद्योतकं नूनमेतदेवास्ति वो यतः।
अतोऽदास्मरणादेव मनुष्याणां क्रमोन्नतौ ॥
translation: क्योंकि यही आपलोगो का निश्चय महत्त्व सूचक है इस कारण इसको स्मरण रखने से ही आपलोग मनुष्यों की क्रमोन्नति में और
english_translation: Because this is your firm conviction indicating importance, remembering it alone advances humans' progress.
essence: Firm conviction about what matters drives human progress.
simple_meaning: Your firm belief about what is important shapes your progress in life.
insight: It teaches you to focus on what you deeply believe to be important, making progress natural and steady.
modern_relevance: You face a tough choice; holding firm to what truly matters keeps you moving ahead despite distractions.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
सहैतु रक्षितुं सृष्टे: सामञ्जस्यं तथा क्षमाः।
यूयमेवाऽनं कर्तव्ये धन्या भवितुमर्हथ ॥
translation: सहेतुक सृष्टि सामज की रक्षा करने में समर्थ होते हुए इस कर्त्तव्य में धन्य हो सकते हैं।
english_translation: Those who endure and protect harmony in creation become truly blessed in their duty.
essence: Enduring challenges to protect harmony in your duty brings true blessing.
simple_meaning: You are blessed when you can patiently endure challenges and protect harmony within your duty.
insight: It teaches you to embrace patience and active protection as noble ways to fulfill your role.
modern_relevance: You stay calm and steady while resolving conflicts in a team, preserving peace and balance, and feel honored for your effort.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
जीवसृष्टिरहस्येषु मानवानाञ्च किंविधम् ।
जन्ममृत्युगतं गुह्यं वैलक्षण्यं हि वर्तते ॥
translation: हे पितृगण! जीव सृष्टि रहस्यों में मनुष्यों के जन्म मृत्यु की कैसी गुह्य विचित्रता है सो अभी कहता हूँ
english_translation: O ancestors! Among the mysteries of creation, the secret and wondrous cycle of human birth and death exists.
essence: The human cycle of birth and death is a secret wonder within creation.
simple_meaning: There is a mysterious and unique cycle of human birth and death within the secrets of creation.
insight: It invites you to recognize the profound mystery behind human existence beyond surface appearances.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
पितरः ! तद्रवीम्यद्य श्रूयतां सुसमाहितै:।
कोष: प्राणमयोऽस्त्यस्य साहाय्यात्पितरो ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: सुसमाहित होकर सुनो। हे पितृगण! प्राणमय कोष की सहायता से ही
english_translation: Listen carefully, ancestors! The vital sheath is always supported by the ancestors.
essence: The vital life energy is sustained through ancestral support.
simple_meaning: The ancestors are addressed to listen carefully, as the vital energy sheath depends on them for support.
insight: It highlights the subtle support systems sustaining life beyond immediate perception.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
देव्याः शाक्तेर्विकाशस्य देवानामासनस्य वा।
उपयोगी जायतेऽसावावर्तः पीठ उच्यते ॥
translation: दैवीशक्ति के विकास के अथवा देवताओं के आसन के उपयोगी जो आवर्त बनता है उसको पीठ कहते हैं
english_translation: The seat formed for the development of the divine power or for the resting place of the deities is called the base.
essence: A base is the foundation for divine energy or deities’ resting place.
simple_meaning: A base or foundation is the place made for the growth of divine power or where the deities rest.
insight: It clarifies that spiritual power and presence need a stable foundation or support to manifest.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
स्वाभाविक्यस्वभावा वा पाठस्योत्पादनाय या ।
विधीयते क्रिया सम्यक् सत्सकौशलपूरिता ॥
translation: पीठ के उत्पन्न करने के लिये जो स्वाभाविक या अस्वाभाविक सत्सुकौशल पूर्ण क्रिया सम्यक रूप से की जाती है
english_translation: An action performed properly, naturally or unnaturally, with skill and care, leads to the arising of the foundation.
essence: Skillful and attentive action builds the foundation for all outcomes.
simple_meaning: Actions done with skill and care, whether natural or not, create the foundation for what follows.
insight: It teaches you to value skill and care in every action as the true source of lasting results.
modern_relevance: You prepare a meal or start a project with focus and care; this effort shapes everything that follows.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
चक्रं तदेव सम्प्राहुर्योगतत्त्वविशारदाः।
नात्र कश्चन सन्देवो विद्यते विश्वभूतिदाः ! ॥
translation: उसी को योग तत्वज्ञ चक्र कहते हैं, हे पितृगण ! इस विषय में कोई सन्देह नहीं है
english_translation: The true experts in yoga call that the wheel; there is no doubt about this, O ancestors!
essence: True experts unanimously recognize yoga as the wheel without any doubt.
simple_meaning: Those who know yoga deeply call it the wheel, and there is no doubt about this among ancestors.
insight: Trust the clear understanding of those deeply familiar with a subject, reducing your own uncertainty.
modern_relevance: When you hear experts agree on something important, trust their clarity instead of doubting.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
पाठोत्पादकसामर्थ्य मपिण्डो विभर्त्युसौ।
आवागमनचंक्रस्याश्रयः स्वाभाविकस्य हि ॥
translation: यह मानवपिण्ड पीठ उत्पन्न करने का सामर्थ्य रखता है और यह मानवपिण्ड स्वाभाविक आवागमन चक्र का आश्रय ही है।
english_translation: This human body has the power to produce knowledge and naturally supports the cycle of coming and going.
essence: The human body naturally supports life's cycle and the creation of knowledge.
simple_meaning: The human body naturally supports the cycle of life and death and has the power to generate knowledge.
insight: Recognize your body as both the ground for your life's flow and your capacity to learn.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अनेकभेदसत्त्वेऽपि पाठस्यास्ति प्रधानतः।
भेदश्चतुर्वियो योऽसौ पोच्यते वः पुरोऽधुना ॥
translation: पीठ के भेद अनेक होने पर भी प्रधानतः पीठ जो चार श्रेणी में विभक्त है उसको अभी आप लोगों के सामने कहता हूँ
english_translation: Although there are many types of seats, primarily the seat is divided into four categories, which I now explain to you.
essence: Complex things can be organized into a few primary categories for clarity.
simple_meaning: There are many types of seats, but mainly they are divided into four kinds, which are now being explained.
insight: Recognizing main categories helps organize and focus your learning effectively.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
प्रथम स्थावर पीठं यथा तीर्थादिगोचरम् ।
द्वितीयं सहज पीठं दम्पतीसङ्गमे यथा ॥
translation: प्रथम स्थावरपीठ, यथा-तीर्थादि, द्वितीय सहजपीठ, जैसा कि नर नारी के सक्षम समय में उत्पन्न होता है,
english_translation: First is the immovable seat, like sacred places; second is the natural seat, like the union of a couple in their fertile time.
essence: Foundations can be steady or arise naturally from intimate union.
simple_meaning: There are two fundamental seats or bases: one fixed like holy places, and one natural arising from a couple's union.
insight: It teaches to honor both steady foundations and natural, life-generated connections as essential supports.
modern_relevance: You recognize some parts of your life are steady and grounded, while others emerge naturally from your closest relationships.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
पीठं तृतीयकं दैवमिन्द्रलोकादिकं यथा ।
चतुर्थ यौगिकं पीठं भगवद्विग्रहोद्भयम् ॥
translation: तृतीय दैवी पीठ, यथा इन्द्रलोकादि और चौथा यौगिक पीठ भगवद विग्रह और यन्त्रादि में होता है
english_translation: The third seat is divine, like Indraloka and others; the fourth seat is yogic, associated with the forms and instruments of the divine.
essence: Spiritual seats differ between divine realms and yogic forms.
simple_meaning: There are different types of seats or levels: one divine like the realm of Indra, another yogic related to divine forms and tools.
insight: It introduces a layered view of spiritual states or practices, distinguishing divine realms from yogic symbolism.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अथवा यन्त्रसम्भूतं पितरों वर्तते यथा।
अनेकभेदसत्वेऽपि चक्रञ्चास्ते चतुर्विधम् ॥
translation: यथा पितृगण! चक्र भी बहु प्रकार के होने पर भी उनकी चार श्रेणी है
english_translation: Just as the ancestors exist as a mechanism with many differences, yet the wheel they have is of four kinds.
essence: Complex diversity can be organized into a few fundamental categories.
simple_meaning: The ancestors are described as having a complex system with many parts, but their guiding wheel has four main types.
insight: Recognize that complexity often holds simple organizing principles beneath it.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
आवागमनचक्रादि तत्राद्यं सहजं जगुः ।
द्वितीयं कीर्तितं चक्रं तद्ब्रह्माण्डनामकम् ॥
translation: प्रथम सहज चक वह कहलाता है, जैसा आवागमनचक्रादि द्वितीय ब्रह्माण्डचक्र यथा
english_translation: The first is called the natural cycle, like the cycle of coming and going; the second is called the cosmic cycle.
essence: Existence unfolds through both natural and cosmic repeating cycles.
simple_meaning: Two cycles are described: the first is the natural cycle of movement; the second is the cosmic cycle of creation and dissolution.
insight: It introduces the idea that reality operates on multiple levels of cycles, from the personal to the universal.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
ग्रहोपग्रहमादीनामधिकार स्थितिर्याथा ।
ज्ञेयं स्वाभाविकं चक्रमेतद्वयमसंशयम् ॥
translation: ग्रह उपग्रह नक्षत्रादि का अधिकार स्थान, यह दोनों निःसन्देह स्वाभाविक चक्र कहलाते हैं।
english_translation: The positions of planets and their satellites are naturally established cycles beyond doubt.
essence: Some natural cycles are certain and beyond question.
simple_meaning: The movements and positions of planets and their satellites follow natural, unquestionable cycles.
insight: Recognize and accept natural patterns instead of resisting what unfolds beyond your control.
modern_relevance: Watching the predictable rise and set of the moon or sun reminds you that some rhythms in life are steady and reliable.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
सगर्भ स्यात्तृतीयं तद्ब्रह्मचक्रादिकं यथा।
अगर्भनामकं चक्रं चतुथै समुदाह्र्म् ॥
translation: तृतीयचक्र सगर्भचक्र कहलाता है, यथा-ब्रह्मचक्र शक्तिचक्रादि और चतुर्थ चक्र का नाम अगर्भ है
english_translation: The third chakra is called the Sagarbha chakra, like the Brahma chakra and Shakti chakra; the fourth chakra is called the Agarbha chakra.
essence: This verse identifies specific names and order of subtle energy centers called chakras.
simple_meaning: The verse names the third chakra as Sagarbha and the fourth as Agarbha, comparing them to other well-known chakras.
insight: It clarifies the structure and naming of subtle energy centers, aiding focused meditation or study.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
मन्त्रशुद्ध्या क्रियाशुद्ध्या रहितश्चैव यद्भवेत् ।
इति वः कीर्तितं चक्र-रहस्यं परमाद्भुतम् ॥
translation: जो मन्त्रशुद्धि और क्रियाशुद्धि से रहित ही होता है यह मैंने आप लोगों को परम अदभुत चक्र का रहस्य कहा है।
english_translation: I have declared to you the supreme wondrous secret of the wheel, which is free from mantra purification and action purification.
essence: The greatest secret transcends all ritual purification and external action.
simple_meaning: The supreme secret of the cosmic wheel I revealed to you is beyond purification by mantras or actions.
insight: It shifts focus from external rituals to recognizing subtler, deeper spiritual truths beyond action and words.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
याथार्थ्यानुष्ठितं चक्रं सगर्भ मुक्तिदं भवेत् ।
अगर्भ पितरः ! तद्वन्ननमभ्युदयप्रदम् ॥
translation: सगर्भ चक्र यथार्थ रूप से अनुष्ठित होने पर मुक्तिपद होता है और हे पितृगण! अगर्भचक्र यथार्थ रूप से अनुष्ठित होने पर ही अभ्युदय प्रद होता है
english_translation: When the manifested cycle of action is truly performed, it leads to liberation; O ancestors, the unmanifested cycle truly performed brings about prosperity.
essence: True external action frees; true subtle action uplifts your life.
simple_meaning: Performing clear, conscious actions leads to inner freedom, while deeper unseen actions bring lasting well-being.
insight: It teaches you to honor both your obvious efforts and your inner growth, seeing both as essential for freedom and prosperity.
modern_relevance: You completed a demanding project and felt relief, but the habits and mindset you build quietly shape your lasting success.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
परन्त्वेवंविधायां हि दशायों चक्रसाधकैः।
भवितव्यं ध्रुवं सम्यगवश्यं मत्परायणः ॥
translation: परन्तु ऐसी दशा में चक्रकारी साधकों को अवश्य ही अच्छी तरह मत्परायण होना उचित है
english_translation: In such a condition, the devotees who work the wheel must certainly be fully devoted to me.
essence: Steadfast devotion is essential when facing difficult conditions.
simple_meaning: In difficult situations, those devoted to the divine must be completely committed to that devotion.
insight: It teaches you to center your focus fully on your devotion during difficult phases, making it your steady foundation.
modern_relevance: When life gets overwhelming and uncertain, your deepest commitment to what grounds you can be your strongest support.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
एतचक्रद्वयं जीवैः सत्सुकौशलपूर्णया।
क्रिययाऽनुष्ठितं यस्मादतोऽस्वाभाविकं जगुः ॥
translation: ये दोनों चक्र सत्सुकौशल पूर्ण क्रिया से जीवों के द्वारा अनुष्ठित होने के कारण अस्वाभाविक कहलाते हैं
english_translation: These two cycles are called unnatural because beings perform them with delicate skillfulness.
essence: Skillful action can still feel unnatural when it is forced or habitual.
simple_meaning: Some actions are called unnatural because living beings carry them out with careful skill.
insight: It shifts your view to notice when your actions, though skillful, do not arise naturally but from habit or pressure.
modern_relevance: You might find yourself doing tasks so carefully and deliberately that they start to feel forced or unnatural.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
उत्तरोत्तरमुक्तासु सप्तसु ज्ञानभूमिषु ।
क्रमांरोहणकृत्यैव जायते पितरो ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! उक्त सप्त, ज्ञानभूमियों में उत्तरोत्तर क्रमशः आरोहण करते रहने से ही
english_translation: O ancestors, by steadily ascending through the seven stages of wisdom, the forefathers are surely born.
essence: True transformation happens by steadily ascending through ordered stages of wisdom.
simple_meaning: Progress happens by steadily moving through seven stages of understanding and wisdom.
insight: It teaches you to trust gradual, sequential learning rather than seeking sudden leaps.
modern_relevance: You face a complex challenge that can’t be rushed — growth requires taking one clear step after another.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
आवागमनचक्रस्याध्यात्मशुद्धिर्न संशयः।
वर्णाश्रमाख्यधर्माणां स्वाधिकारानुसारतः ॥
translation: अवागमनचक्र की अध्यात्म शुद्धि सम्पादित होती है इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। अपने अपने अधिकारानुसार वर्णाश्रम धर्म के
english_translation: There is no doubt that the purification of the inner being occurs through the cycle of coming and going, following the duties prescribed by the social orders and stages of life according to one's own rights.
essence: Purification of the inner being happens by faithfully fulfilling your rightful duties through life's cycles.
simple_meaning: You purify your inner being by following the duties assigned to your social role and life stage without doubt.
insight: It teaches you to trust and engage fully with your own specific duties as a way to deepen your inner clarity and growth.
modern_relevance: You feel overwhelmed by conflicting expectations, but focusing on your own clear responsibilities helps you grow from within.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
जायते पालनेनाऽस्य शुद्धिः खल्वाधिदैविकी।
पितरो वो दयालब्ध्या शुद्ध्या शोणितशुक्रयोः ॥
translation: पालन द्वारा ही उस चक्र की अधिदैव शुद्धि हुआ करती है और हे पितृगण! आपलोगों की कृपा प्राप्त करने से
english_translation: Purification of this cycle indeed occurs through maintenance, O ancestors! It happens by your compassionate grace through purity of blood and seed.
essence: Purity of a cycle arises from careful maintenance and blessings rooted in lineage.
simple_meaning: Purification of this cycle happens through proper care and the compassionate blessing of ancestors, linked to the purity of blood and seed.
insight: It highlights that preservation and respect for the source or origin sustain deeper purity beyond surface actions.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सहजस्यापि पीठस्य क्रमोन्नसा निरन्तरम् ।
आधिभौतिकशुद्धिर्हि नूनमस्य-प्रजायते ॥
translation: सहजपीठ की निरन्तर क्रमोन्नति से और रजवीर्य्य की शुद्धि से भी आवागमन चक्र की आधिभौतिक शुद्धि निश्चय सम्पादित हुआ करती है।
english_translation: Even the natural seat steadily rises; through purification of subtle energy, the cycle of worldly existence is surely purified.
essence: Steady natural growth and subtle purification together cleanse the cycle of existence.
simple_meaning: Your natural inner foundation grows step by step, and purifying your subtle energies cleanses the cycle of experience.
insight: It shifts your focus to honoring gradual growth and subtle purification as the true path of transformation.
modern_relevance: When daily habits improve slowly but surely, your whole life’s patterns begin to shift and clear.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
चक्रमेतद्भवन्तो हि कर्तुमुन्नामि सत्त्वरम् ।
सन्ति चक्रेश्वरा नूनं स्मरणीयं सदेति वः ॥
translation: इस चक्र को शीघ्र उन्नतिशील करने में आप लोग ही निश्चय चक्रेश्वर हैं, यह सदा आप लोगों को स्मरण रखना चाहिये
english_translation: You are indeed the lords of the wheel, destined to swiftly advance this cycle; always remember this.
essence: You are the true masters who can rapidly advance this cycle; never forget your power.
simple_meaning: You are the ones responsible for quickly advancing this cycle. Always remember your role and power.
insight: Recognize your unique power to influence the course of important cycles and act with confidence.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
एवं सर्वेषु चक्रेषु शुद्धित्रैविध्यमुत्तमम् ।
आवश्यकं भवत्येव नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥
translation: सब चक्रों में इसी प्रकार उत्तम त्रिविध शुद्धि को आवश्यकता होती ही है, इसमें विचार करने की आवश्यकता नहीं है।
english_translation: In all cycles, pure threefold cleansing is absolutely necessary; no debate is needed on this.
essence: Every cycle requires essential, pure threefold cleansing without question.
simple_meaning: Every important phase or cycle requires thorough and pure cleansing of body, mind, and spirit without doubt.
insight: Recognize that purification is a non-negotiable step toward growth, not a choice to be debated.
modern_relevance: After major life changes, you naturally feel the need to cleanse your habits, thoughts, and emotions even if you don’t rationalize it.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
आवागमनचक्रस्य साहाय्येनैव वोऽधुना ।
निर्मितस्यास्य संशुद्धिं वर्णयित्वा पितृव्रजाः ! ॥
translation: आपकी सहायता से ही निर्मित इस आवागमनचक्र की शुद्धि का वर्णन करके हे पितृगण!
english_translation: With your help alone, O ancestral beings, describe now the purification of this cycle of coming and going.
essence: Purification of the cycle of movement requires collective explanation and support.
simple_meaning: You are asked to explain how this created cycle of movement is purified, with your help now.
insight: Recognize that understanding complex cycles often requires guidance and shared effort.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
पीठशुद्धे रहस्यं वो ब्रवीमि श्रूयतामिति ।
नानाविधेषु पीठेषु विधायोपासनां मम ॥
translation: अब पीठशुद्धि का रहस्य आप लोगों से कहता हूँ सुनो। नाना प्रकार के पीठो में, मेरी उपासना करके जब मेरे भक्त
english_translation: Now I will reveal the secret of purification of the seat; listen carefully. In various sacred seats, by worshipping me, my devotees...
essence: Purification of the spiritual seat is revealed through diverse worship methods.
simple_meaning: The secret of cleansing the sacred seat through different forms of worship will now be explained.
insight: It invites openness to learning deeper spiritual practices beyond surface rituals.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
निजपिण्डस्थिते पीठे भक्ता नानाविधा यदा।
विभूतीर्मे लभन्तेऽन्ते तेजो मे सर्वथा तथा ॥
translation: निजपिण्ड स्थित पीठ में नाना विभूतियों को प्राप्त करते हैं और उस दशा में वह मेरे तेज की सर्वथा
english_translation: When devotees in their own body-seat attain various divine manifestations, in that state they fully receive my radiance.
essence: Devotion awakens inner divine forms and fills you with radiant presence.
simple_meaning: When you devote yourself sincerely from within, many divine qualities appear in you, and you fully receive Shiva's radiant energy.
insight: It teaches you that sincere devotion transforms your inner state, revealing divine qualities and radiance naturally.
modern_relevance: When you open your heart fully in your daily practice or relationships, you start to notice new strengths and a shining vitality within yourself.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
रक्षितुं पारयन्तेऽलं तदा पीठस्य जायते ।
आधिभौतिक संशुद्धिर्नात्र कश्चन संशयः ॥
translation: रक्षा करने में अच्छी तरह समर्थ होते हैं तब पीठ की आधिभौतिक शुद्धि होती है, इसमें कोई सन्देह नहीं
english_translation: When they become fully capable of protection, then the fundamental purity of the seat arises without any doubt.
essence: True protective ability creates unquestionable fundamental purity and stability.
simple_meaning: When one becomes truly able to protect, the fundamental purity of the foundation naturally arises with no doubt.
insight: It shows that mastery in guarding what matters leads to undeniable inner stability.
modern_relevance: You’ve built skills and strength to defend your values, and now your foundation is solid and unquestionable.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
यदा तु क्रमशो दैवीं शक्तिं लब्धं ममेशते ।
साधकाः पीठसंशुद्धिस्तदा स्यादाधिदैविकी ॥
translation: और क्रमशः जब साधक मेरी देवी शक्तियों को लाभ करने में समर्थ होते हैं हे पितृगण! तब पीठ को आधिदैविक शुद्धि सम्पादित होती है
english_translation: When the seekers gradually attain my divine powers, O ancestors, then the seat gains supreme divine purity.
essence: Gradual attainment of divine powers purifies the sacred spiritual seat.
simple_meaning: Seekers who gradually gain the divine powers of Shiva bring about the highest purity in the sacred seat.
insight: It shows that steady spiritual growth enhances both inner power and the purity of the environment around you.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
तत्त्वज्ञानस्य पुण्यस्य विकाशेन यथाक्रमम् ।
पीठस्याध्यात्मसंशुद्धिर्जायते च स्वथाभुजः ! ॥
translation: और पवित्र तत्त्वज्ञान के यथाक्रम विकास द्वारा पीठ की आध्यात्मिक शुद्धि हुआ करती है।
english_translation: And by the gradual unfolding of pure wisdom of reality, the spiritual purity of the seat naturally arises.
essence: Spiritual purity arises naturally from the gradual unfolding of pure wisdom.
simple_meaning: As your deep understanding of reality grows step by step, your inner spiritual purity naturally develops.
insight: It teaches you to be patient with growth, knowing clarity and purity emerge naturally from deep understanding.
modern_relevance: When you learn something profound step by step, your character and clarity naturally strengthen without force.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
देशकालमनोद्रव्यंक्रियाशुद्धिर्हि पञ्चधा ।
शुद्धिर्मुख्या समाख्याता पीठशुद्धिप्वसंशयम् ॥
translation: पीठशुद्धियों के विषय में निःसन्देह देशशुद्धि, कालशुद्धि. मन की शुद्धि, क्रिया की शुद्धि और द्रव्य शुद्धि यह पांच प्रकार की शुद्धियाँ ही मुख्य कही गई हैं
english_translation: Without doubt, the main five types of purity are purity of place, time, mind, action, and substance.
essence: Purity arises from five key conditions: place, time, mind, action, and substance.
simple_meaning: Purity is mainly five kinds: the purity of where you are, when you act, your mind, your actions, and your material surroundings.
insight: It teaches you to prepare all external and internal conditions carefully to act with clarity and integrity.
modern_relevance: Before starting an important project, you check your environment, timing, mindset, and tools to create the best conditions for success.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
तत्रापि द्रव्यसंशुद्धिः प्राधान्यं वहते खलु।
असौ योगोपयोगित्वादेहस्य जायते ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: उनमें भी द्रव्यशुद्धि ही प्रधान है क्योंकि देह के योग-उपयोगी होने से ही वह होती है
english_translation: Even there, the purity of substance takes precedence, for the body’s true use arises only through its union with yoga.
essence: The body’s true function depends on the purity gained through its union with yoga.
simple_meaning: The true usefulness of the body depends on the purity of what it is made of, which comes through yoga.
insight: It shifts your view to see the body not just as matter but as useful only when purified and engaged with yoga.
modern_relevance: You notice your body feels more alive and effective when your practices clear distractions and connect mind and body.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
एवं मे ज्ञानिनो भक्ताः संशुद्धिं चक्रपीठयोः ।
समासाद्य लभन्तेऽन्ते मत्सायुज्यं न संशयः ॥
translation: इस प्रकार से मेरे ज्ञानी भक्त चक्र और पीठ शुद्धि को प्राप्त करके अन्त में निःसन्देह मत्सायुज्य को प्राप्त कर लेते हैं
english_translation: Thus, my wise devotees, having attained purity of the wheel and seat, ultimately attain union with me without doubt.
essence: Pure, wise devotion naturally leads to certain union with the divine.
simple_meaning: When you purify your inner foundation through devoted wisdom, you will surely unite with the divine.
insight: It teaches that steady devotion purifies your essential being, making union with the divine a natural outcome.
modern_relevance: You polish your values and daily habits deeply, and eventually your connection to what truly matters becomes undeniable.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
किन्त्वेवं पितरो यावज्जीवपिण्डे न सम्भवेत् ।
चाक्रिकी पैठिकी शुद्धिस्तावन्नैव त्रितापतः ॥
translation: परन्तु हे पितृगण ! जब तक जीवपिण्ड में इस प्रकार चक्रशुद्धि और पीठशुद्धि की सम्भावना न हो तब तक अहो ! त्रिताप से
english_translation: But O ancestors, until the cycle of purification and the seat of purity arise in the living being, alas, there is suffering in the three realms.
essence: Suffering persists until inner purification and stable purity arise in the living being.
simple_meaning: Suffering in the three realms continues until the living being attains both cyclical purification and a pure foundation.
insight: It shows that true relief comes only after deep inner cleansing and establishing a stable pure foundation within.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
निस्तरेयुरहो जीवाः कदाचिद्वै कथंचन ।
तावत्कालश्च  ते जीवा आवागमनचक्रके ॥
translation: जीव कभी भी किसी प्रकार निस्तार नहीं ही हो सकते हैं और तब तक वह जीव अवागमनचक्र में
english_translation: Living beings can never be completely freed; as long as they exist, they remain in the cycle of coming and going.
essence: Living beings cannot fully escape the cycle of birth and rebirth while alive.
simple_meaning: Living beings cannot be completely free while they continue to cycle through birth and death.
insight: Recognize that true freedom requires transcending habitual cycles, not just temporary relief.
modern_relevance: You feel stuck repeating patterns or returning to old habits, realizing you aren’t fully free yet.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
भ्रमन्तः खलु तिष्ठन्ति नास्ति कोऽप्यत्र संशयः ।
मनुष्याः पञ्चकोषाणां समासाद्यापि पूर्णताम् ॥
translation: घूमते ही रहते हैं इसमें कोई भी सन्देह नहीं है। मनुष्य पञ्चकोषों की पूर्णता को प्राप्त करके भी
english_translation: There is no doubt that people keep wandering, even after fully experiencing the five sheaths.
essence: Even full self-knowledge does not stop the restless mind from wandering.
simple_meaning: People continue to wander mentally and emotionally, even after understanding the full layers of their being.
insight: Recognize that understanding your layers isn't enough; deeper inner witnessing is needed to calm wandering.
modern_relevance: You might finish reading a self-help book or complete a course, yet your mind still feels restless and unsettled.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
आवागमन चक्रेऽस्मिन्विभ्रमन्तो निरन्तरम् ।
पिण्डेश्वरा भवन्तोऽपि भुभते दुःखमुल्वणम्॥
translation: और पिण्डेश्वर हो जाने पर भी इस आवागमन चक्र में  निरन्तर परिभ्रमण करते हुए असहनीय दुःखों को भोगा करते हैं।
english_translation: Even after becoming the lord of the body, beings continuously wander in this cycle of coming and going, experiencing unbearable suffering.
essence: Mastering the body does not end the endless cycle of suffering and wandering.
simple_meaning: Even those who seem in control of their bodies keep wandering in cycles and suffer deeply.
insight: It teaches you to see that control over external form alone cannot stop inner turmoil or repeated patterns.
modern_relevance: You may feel you have your life under control, yet still face recurring struggles and pain you can't escape.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
नरकप्रेतलोकेषु दुःखमस्त्येव दुःसहम् ।
जीवाः स्वपितृलोकादौ सुखासक्ता अपि ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: प्रेत लोक और नरकलोक में असहनीय दुःख है ही किन्तु पितृलोक और स्वर्गलोक आदि में जीवों के सुखभोग में रत रहने पर भी
english_translation: In the lower realms of spirits and suffering, unbearable pain exists, yet beings remain firmly attached to pleasures in the ancestral and higher realms.
essence: Attachment binds you equally in both suffering and pleasure.
simple_meaning: Beings suffer greatly in lower realms but remain deeply attached even to pleasures in higher realms.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing attachment only in pain to recognizing how it also traps you in pleasure.
modern_relevance: You might suffer deeply or enjoy success, yet find yourself stuck in attachment either way, unable to fully let go.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
परिणामाच तापाच्च संस्काराच्च समुद्भवैः ।
दुःखैः सुदुःसहै: क्लेशमाप्नुवन्ति निरन्तरम् ॥
translation: निश्चय जीव निरन्तर दु:सह परिणाम दुःख तापvदुःख और संस्कार दुःखों से क्लेश पाया करते हैं
english_translation: The true self continuously suffers from difficult-to-bear pain caused by consequences, suffering, and impressions.
essence: Continuous suffering arises from past consequences, pain, and impressions, not the true self.
simple_meaning: The true self experiences ongoing suffering caused by the results of past actions, pain, and mental impressions.
insight: It teaches you to see suffering as caused by old impressions and results, not your true self, opening a path to freedom.
modern_relevance: You replay past mistakes and painful memories, feeling stuck in their weight even when life moves on.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
मृत्युलोके ततो जन्म गृह्णते च यदा तदा।
यूयं यद्यपि तेभ्यो वै स्वस्वकर्मानुसारतः ॥
translation: तदनन्तर जब वे मृत्युलोक मे जन्म लेते हैं तब यद्यपि आपलोग उनके अपने अपने कर्मानुसार ही
english_translation: After leaving the mortal world, you are born again according to your own actions.
essence: Your future births arise inevitably from your past actions.
simple_meaning: After death, you take birth again based on the actions you performed in your previous life.
insight: It teaches you to take responsibility for your present actions, knowing they influence your future existence.
modern_relevance: When you reflect on your habits and choices, you realize they shape your future circumstances beyond immediate consequences.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
उपयुक्तं प्रयच्छेत भोगायतनरूपकम् ।
पित्रोः स्थूलं रजोवीर्यसाहाय्याद्वपुरद्भुतम् ॥
translation: उनके उपयुक्त भोगायतन रूपी अद्भुत स्थूल शरीर उनको माता पिता के रजवीर्य्य की सहायता से प्रदान करते हो
english_translation: Their appropriate body, shaped like a place of enjoyment, is wonderfully given by the parents with the help of the parents' vital fluid.
essence: The body is a natural vessel given by parents for experiencing life.
simple_meaning: A person's physical body is given by their parents through natural biological means as a vessel to experience the world.
insight: Recognize that your physical form is a natural support for your experiences, not your true self.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
परिश्रमेण महता पाञ्चभौतिकमण्डला ।
तत्त्वानि किल सञ्चिस तद्भोग्यान पितरोऽनिशम् ॥
translation: और हे पितृगण ! बड़े परिश्रम से आप पञ्चभूत मण्डल से निरन्तर तत्त्वों को एकत्रित करके ही
english_translation: O ancestors! You constantly gather elements from the five-material world with great effort for enjoyment.
essence: Even exalted beings must continually work to gather what sustains their experience.
simple_meaning: The ancestors work hard to collect elements from the material world continuously for their enjoyment.
insight: It highlights that enjoyment and sustenance require continual effort, even for beings beyond ordinary human life.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
मातृगर्भेषु निर्माय स्थूलदेहान्न संशयः।
लभन्ते मातृगर्भेषु दुःखान्येव तथापि ते ॥
translation: मातृगर्भ में उनके भोग के योग्य स्थूल शरीरों को निःसन्देह बना देते हो तो भी वह मातृगर्भ में दुःखों को ही पाते हैं।
english_translation: Though you create their gross bodies in the wombs without doubt, they still find only suffering in the wombs.
essence: Having a body does not prevent suffering from arising in life.
simple_meaning: Even when physical bodies are formed in the womb, suffering still arises there without fail.
insight: It shifts focus from physical form to the deeper causes of suffering beyond the body.
modern_relevance: You may have everything outwardly in place, yet still feel pain or discomfort inside that no external form can fix.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
गुह्यमेकं रहस्यं वो ब्रवीम्यत्र निशम्यताम् ।
रजस्तमोभ्यां जनिते गुणानां तु प्रभावतः ॥
translation: इस विषय में एक गुप्त रहस्य आप लोगों से कहता हूँ सुनो । गुण प्रभाव से
english_translation: I reveal to you a single secret here: the qualities arise from the influence of rajas and tamas.
essence: The qualities we observe arise from the influence of rajas and tamas.
simple_meaning: There is a hidden secret that qualities come from the influence of the forces called rajas and tamas.
insight: It introduces the idea that our traits and tendencies are influenced by fundamental forces beyond conscious control.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
दम्पत्योद्विविधे शक्ती ह्याकर्पणविकर्षणे ।
भजेते समतां यावत्तावदेव मुधीरयोः ॥
translation: दम्पती की रजतमजनित आकर्षण और विकर्षण शक्ति को समता जब तक रहती है तभी तक धीर दम्पती में
english_translation: As long as the couple maintains balance in the natural forces of attraction and repulsion born of their essence, they remain steady and wise together.
essence: A couple’s wisdom and steadiness come from balancing natural attraction and repulsion with calm.
simple_meaning: A couple stays steady and wise when they balance their natural forces of attraction and repulsion with calm.
insight: It teaches you to welcome opposing feelings as part of your shared strength, not threats to it.
modern_relevance: You feel a push and pull with your partner, yet your relationship thrives when you keep that tension balanced without extremes.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
दाम्पत्यं सात्त्विकं पीठं तिष्ठेन्नैवात्र संशयः ।
दम्पत्योहिं तदा धैर्यज्ञानभक्तिमभावतः ॥
translation: सत्वगुणमय दाम्पत्य पीठ बना रहता है इसमें सन्देह नहीं। उस समय दम्पती के धैर्य, ज्ञान और भक्ति के प्रभाव द्वारा ही
english_translation: A harmonious marriage rests on goodness alone; then patience, wisdom, and devotion arise in the couple.
essence: Goodness as the foundation brings patience, wisdom, and devotion into marriage.
simple_meaning: A marriage based on goodness naturally supports patience, wisdom, and devotion between partners.
insight: It teaches you to build your relationship on pure intentions, which grows inner qualities that sustain partnership.
modern_relevance: When you and your partner act from kindness and clarity, patience and understanding come easily even during conflict.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
तस्मात्पीठात्सन्ततिः स्यात सात्त्विकी ज्ञानिनी तथा ।
यावत्स्यात् सात्त्विकं पीठं तद्वा सत्त्वगुणान्वितम् ॥
translation: उस पीठ से सन्तति सात्विक और ज्ञानवान् होगी। पीठ जितना सात्विक होगा अथवा जितना अधिक सत्त्वगुणमय
english_translation: From that seat, the lineage will be pure and wise; the purer the seat, the more it is filled with goodness.
essence: Pure foundations produce pure and wise descendants or results.
simple_meaning: The qualities of a place or foundation influence the nature of what comes from it; a pure place produces a pure and wise lineage.
insight: It shifts focus to nurturing pure environments to foster wisdom and virtue in what you create or influence.
modern_relevance: The environment you build or choose deeply affects the character and wisdom of what grows from it, whether family, work, or community.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
दम्पत्योर्यत्नतो यावदधिकं योगयुक्तयोः।
स्यात्तावज्ज्ञान सम्पन्ना धार्मिमकी संतातिर्ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: योगयुक्त दम्पती के यत्न से पीठ होगा उतनी ही सन्तति धार्मिक और ज्ञानवान होती हुई
english_translation: The offspring of a couple united in yoga will be as steadfastly virtuous and wise as their devoted effort.
essence: Focused, united effort in relationships creates lasting wisdom and virtue beyond oneself.
simple_meaning: When a couple works together with focused effort and harmony, their children grow up wise and virtuous.
insight: It teaches you to see how your shared commitment influences more than just the present – it creates a legacy of character.
modern_relevance: You and your partner invest time and care, shaping not just your lives but those who come after you.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
गर्भावस्थानकालेऽपि भवेत्सोन्नतिशीलभाक्।
मातृप्रसवकाले हि स्थलदेहातिपेषणैः ॥
translation: गर्भवासदशा में भी वह उन्नतिशील रहेगी। मातृगर्भ से मुक्त होते समय स्थूल शरीर के अतिशय पेषण द्वारा
english_translation: Even during the state of being in the womb, the true self remains elevated; at the time of birth, it departs through the dense body.
essence: The true self remains elevated and beyond the body even before birth.
simple_meaning: Your true self stays elevated and unchanged even inside the womb and when leaving the body at birth.
insight: Recognize your self as continuous and elevated beyond all physical beginnings and endings.
modern_relevance: Before you took your first breath, your true nature was already beyond change and circumstance, untouched by your body’s limits.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
एतावदधिकं दुःखं लभन्ते गर्भप्राणिनः।
जन्मान्तरस्मृतिं येन विस्मरन्ति ह्यशेषतः ॥
translation: गर्भस्थ जीव इतना अधिक दुःख पाते हैं कि जिससे जन्म जन्मान्तर की अपनी स्मृति को पूर्णरूप से भूल जाते हैं
english_translation: The beings in the womb endure so much suffering that they completely forget their memories from past lives.
essence: Suffering in the womb erases all memories of past lives.
simple_meaning: Beings in the womb suffer so much that they fully forget memories from their past lives.
insight: It reveals how deep suffering can cause complete forgetting of past experiences, shaping new beginnings.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
गर्भवासे भवन्तो हि पितरो यद्यपि स्वयम् ।
तेषां सहायका नूनं परमाः स्युस्तथाप्यहो ॥
translation: हे पितृगण! यद्यपि गर्भवास में आप ही स्वयं उनके परम सहायक हो तथापि अहो!
english_translation: O ancestors! Even though you yourselves are the greatest helpers in the womb, alas!
essence: Even supreme helpers in early life face limits that bring sorrow.
simple_meaning: Ancestors are the greatest helpers during fetal life, yet there is a sense of regret or sorrow expressed.
insight: Recognize that support systems, however strong, cannot always change outcomes beyond their realm.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
नेशतेऽनुभवं कर्तुं तद्दशा तत्र का भवेत् ।
कीदृशे दुःखजाले ते महाघोरे पतन्ति च ॥
translation: आप यह नहीं अनुभव कर सकते कि वहां उनकी क्या दशा होती है और कैसे महाघोर दुःखजाल में वह गिरते हैं
english_translation: You cannot experience what their condition is there or how they fall into terrible suffering.
essence: You cannot directly know how others suffer in their deepest hardship.
simple_meaning: You cannot truly know the condition of others or how deeply they suffer in terrible hardship.
insight: Recognize the limits of your understanding about others’ inner struggles and suffering.
modern_relevance: You scroll past someone’s quiet struggle, unaware of the depth of their unseen pain and hardship.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
दाम्पत्यसङ्गरूपेषु पीटेषु सहजेवलम् ।
आकृष्टाः पीठसनाशे पितृवीर्यकणाश्रयाः ॥
translation: दाम्पत्य संघ रूपी सहजपीठ में आकृष्ट होकर पीठ के अन्त होने पर पिता के वीर्यक्रण को आश्रय करके
english_translation: Drawn naturally to the union of marriage, when that bond ends, they seek refuge in the seed of the father.
essence: Natural attraction to union dissolves, leading back to the source of life.
simple_meaning: People naturally seek marital union, but when it ends, they return to their ancestral seed for support.
insight: It shows how endings of close bonds lead to deeper reliance on our roots or origins.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
प्रविष्टा मातृगर्भेषु जायन्ते जीवनातयः ।
पितरः श्रूयतां चित्रा गर्भवासकथाततिः ॥
translation: मातृ गर्भ में जीवगण प्रविष्ट होते हैं। हे पितृगण ! गर्भवास की विचित्र बातें सुने।
english_translation: Living beings enter the mother's womb. O ancestors, listen to the wondrous stories of gestation.
essence: Life begins mysteriously as beings enter the mother's womb.
simple_meaning: Living beings come into the mother's womb. Ancestors are asked to hear the strange stories about life inside the womb.
insight: It invites curiosity about the miraculous process of life's beginning before birth.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
आतिवाहिकदेहस्य सन्त्यागादेव तत्क्षणम् ।
दुर्वलाः क्लेशितास्ते च मूर्छामादौ व्रजन्त्यलम् ॥
translation: उस समय उनके अतिवाहिक देह के त्याग से ही वह दुर्बल और क्लोशित होकर प्रथम पूर्ण मूञ्छित हो जाते हैं
english_translation: At that moment, by abandoning the overly fragile body, they become weak, troubled, and first fall into complete unconsciousness.
essence: Leaving the fragile body causes weakness and the first unconscious state.
simple_meaning: When the fragile body is given up, the person becomes weak, troubled, and first loses consciousness.
insight: It shows the physical body's fragility and how its loss leads to initial unconsciousness.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
आवागमनचक्रस्य परिधावत्र भूतिदाः ।
भवन्तो जीववर्गाथै स्थूल देहं नयन्त्यलम् ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! आवागमन चक्र की इस परिधि में आप लोग जीवों के लिये पञ्चतत्त्व मण्डल की सहायता से स्थूलदेह
english_translation: O ancestors, within the cycle of coming and going, the elements form the gross body for living beings.
essence: The physical body arises from elements within the cycle of life and death.
simple_meaning: The cycle of birth and death involves the elements coming together to form the physical body of living beings.
insight: It reveals that the body is a temporary assembly of elements within ongoing natural cycles.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
साहाय्यात्पञ्चतत्त्वानां नात्र कञ्चन संशयः। 
सूक्ष्मदेहान्वितान्जीवांस्तत्र देवा नयन्ति च ॥
translation: अच्छी तरह पहुंचाते हो इसमें कोई सन्देह नहीं है और देवतागण सूक्ष्म देहविशिष्ट जीवो को वहां पहुंचा देते हैं
english_translation: There is no doubt that the five elements assist in transporting subtle-bodied beings, and the radiant beings guide them there.
essence: Subtle beings are surely guided and transported by elemental forces and radiant beings.
simple_meaning: The five elements clearly help transport subtle beings, with radiant beings guiding them to their destination.
insight: It reveals unseen support systems operating behind subtle transitions in life and consciousness.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
प्रथमे मासि ते जीवा अतिक्लेशेन मूर्च्छिताः।
कलंलानां बुदबुदानामन्येषामपि योगतः ॥
translation: अतिक्लेश से मूर्छित वह जीव प्रथम मास में कलल बुदबुदादि के संयोग से
english_translation: In the first month, beings overwhelmed by excessive suffering become unconscious due to the combination of impurities and bubbles.
essence: Some beings lose awareness early due to intense suffering and impurity.
simple_meaning: In the first month of existence, some beings lose consciousness due to intense suffering mixed with impurities.
insight: Recognize that extreme suffering can overwhelm awareness and cause withdrawal or numbness.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
सन्ततं क्लेशमापन्ना गर्भमध्ये वसन्त्यहो।
साहाय्याद्वस्ततोऽङ्गानि प्रत्यङ्गानि तथैव च ॥
