translation: निरन्तर क्लेश प्राप्त होते हुए अहो! गर्भ में वास करते हैं तत्पश्चात् अङ्ग और प्रत्यंगो को आपलोगों की सहायता से प्राप्त करते हुए
english_translation: Continuously experiencing distress, they dwell in the womb and then obtain limbs and organs with your help.
essence: Life begins in struggle and unfolds gradually with support.
simple_meaning: They continuously suffer and live in the womb, then develop limbs and organs with help.
insight: Recognize that growth often starts with hardship and external support before full development.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
लभमानाश्चतुर्थे तु मासे पूर्णाङ्गसंयुताः।
भग्नमूर्छा बहून क्लेशान् लभन्तेऽत्र निरन्तरम् ॥
translation: चतुर्थ मास में पूर्णावयव होकर मूर्छा के भङ्ग द्वारा अनेकों क्लेशों को वहां निरन्तर प्राप्त होते हैं
english_translation: In the fourth month, fully formed, many sufferings continuously arise there through the breaking of fainting.
essence: A specific time brings continuous sufferings through broken fainting.
simple_meaning: In the fourth month, fully developed fainting breaks and many sufferings constantly occur there.
insight: This verse does not offer a clear behavioural or cognitive shift for readers.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
मातृजग्धान्नपादिरसैर्नानाविधैरलम् ।
क्षुत्पिपासादिकं नित्यं शमयन्तो निजं मुहुः ॥
translation: माता के खाए हुए अनेकों प्रकार के अन्नपानदि के रस से अपने क्षुत् पिपासादि की नित्य बारम्बार सम्यक् प्रकार से शान्ति करते हुए
english_translation: By repeatedly calming their own hunger and thirst with various types of food and drink once eaten by the mother, they continuously satisfy these needs properly.
essence: Your basic needs are repeatedly soothed by what your mother provides through nature.
simple_meaning: You satisfy your hunger and thirst repeatedly by consuming various foods and drinks that come from your mother.
insight: It teaches to recognize and appreciate how your needs are met through continuous natural support, grounding your actions in gratitude.
modern_relevance: You take a sip of water or eat a meal, calming your thirst and hunger again, trusting that your body is cared for by what it receives.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
वर्द्धन्ते किन्तु गर्भेऽत्र दुःखसीमा न वर्त्तते ।
सम्माप्तपूर्णसंज्ञाश्च जीवास्ते मासि सप्तमे ॥
translation: परिवर्द्धित होते हैं, परन्तु इसी गर्भवास में क्लेश को सीमा नहीं रहती है। सप्तम मास में वह जीवपूर्ण संज्ञालाभ करके
english_translation: They grow, but in this womb, the limit of suffering does not exist; in the seventh month, the beings gain full consciousness.
essence: Growth occurs amid undefined suffering until consciousness fully arises.
simple_meaning: Beings grow inside the womb, but their suffering has no clear limit until they gain full consciousness in the seventh month.
insight: It shows that growth can include unclear suffering before reaching a more conscious or defined state.
modern_relevance: You might feel overwhelmed during difficult growth phases, unsure when the struggle will end or clarity will come.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
स्वानेकजन्मकर्माणि द्रष्टुं ज्ञानदृशा क्षमाः।
कुर्वतेऽनुभवं घोरदुःखानां बहुजन्मनाम् ॥
translation: अपने अनेक जन्मों के कर्म को ज्ञानदृष्टि से देखने में समर्थ होकर अनेक जन्मों के दुःखों का अनुभव करते हैं
english_translation: The wise, with clear understanding, can see their many past actions and experience the intense suffering of many lifetimes.
essence: Clear wisdom allows you to see past actions and feel their lasting pain.
simple_meaning: With clear understanding, you can see your past actions across many lives and recognize the deep suffering they caused.
insight: It teaches you to face your past fully, accepting the pain as a step toward understanding.
modern_relevance: You pause and honestly review your past mistakes and their consequences, feeling the weight but gaining clarity.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
यावद्भस्थिति स्वेषां नैकेषां पूर्वजन्मनाम् ।
कर्माणि चिन्तयन्तोऽलं मज्जन्ति क्लेशसागरे ॥
translation: जब तक गर्भ में रहते हैं अपने पूर्व अनेक जन्मो के कर्मों का स्मरण करके दुःखसागर में
english_translation: As long as beings dwell in the womb, lost in remembering the deeds of many past lives, they sink into the ocean of suffering.
essence: Clinging to past actions keeps you trapped in suffering’s ocean.
simple_meaning: Holding on to memories of many past actions keeps you trapped in suffering.
insight: It teaches you to redirect your attention away from past regrets and toward present freedom.
modern_relevance: You replay old mistakes and regrets, sinking deeper into stress instead of living freely.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
भूयोऽपि मूञ्छितानां हि गर्भात्तेषां  विनिस्मृतौ । 
घोरकष्टाकुलानान्तु पूर्वजन्मशतस्मृतिः ॥
translation: अच्छी तरह डूबे रहते हैं गर्भ से मुक्त होते समय घोर क्लेश से क्लेशित हो सैकड़ों पूर्वजन्मो की स्मृति को वे भूल जाते हैं
english_translation: Even after liberation from the womb, those who are deeply deluded suffer great distress and forget the memories of hundreds of past lives.
essence: Freedom from birth alone does not erase deep confusion or suffering.
simple_meaning: Even after being born, many remain deeply confused and suffer severe pain, forgetting their past experiences.
insight: Recognize that release from external constraints doesn't end inner confusion; true clarity requires deeper awareness.
modern_relevance: You might feel free from a tough situation yet still carry old pains and confusion that cloud your clarity.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
विस्मृता जायते तेषां पितरः! नात्र संशयः।
ज्ञेयाऽपारकृपैवेयं प्रकृतेर्मम निश्चितम् ॥
translation: हे पितृगण! इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। यह मेरी प्रकृति की निश्चय अपार कृपा ही जाननी चाहिये कि
english_translation: O ancestors! There is no doubt. This infinite grace is surely the nature of my being.
essence: Infinite compassion is the undeniable nature of the true self.
simple_meaning: There is no doubt that this infinite kindness is the true nature of my being.
insight: It reassures you to recognize infinite compassion as an inherent quality of your true nature.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
दत्त्वा निखिलजीवेभ्यो दुःखान्येवम्बिधान्यपि।
कल्याणं विदधात्येव सर्वथा प्रकृतिहर्यसौ ॥
translation: वह निखिल जीवों को ऐसा दुःख देकर भी उनकी सर्वथा कल्याण ही करती हैं
english_translation: By giving all beings even suffering, she still ensures their complete well-being in every way.
essence: Suffering given to all beings ultimately serves their complete well-being.
simple_meaning: Sometimes, suffering is given to all beings, but through it, their complete good is ultimately arranged.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing suffering as meaningless to recognizing it as woven into a natural support for growth and well-being.
modern_relevance: When life feels painful and unfair, this reminds you that sometimes hardship is part of a deeper process working for your benefit.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
नो चेज्जीवगणेभ्यो हि मृत्युलोका स्वधाभुजः !। 
पूर्वजन्मशतैराप्तसंस्कारस्मृतिसत्तया ॥
translation: नहीं तो हे पितृगण ! जीवों के लिये मृत्युलोक अनेक पूर्व जन्मों के संस्कारो की स्मृति रहने से
english_translation: For beings, the realm of death is not a mere resting place but is marked by memories of countless past lives' impressions.
essence: The realm of death carries the memories of many past lives within beings.
simple_meaning: The realm of death for living beings is not just a resting place; it holds memories from many past lives.
insight: It teaches that what you carry from past experiences influences your current existence deeply.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अधिकक्लेशदायी स्यान्नरकेभ्योऽपि दुःसहः।
धर्मस्य शृङ्खलायाश्च स्याद्वाधोपस्थिताऽधिका ॥
translation: नरकलोक से भी अधिक दुःख दायी होता और धर्म की श्रृंखला मे भी अतिबाधा उत्पन्न होती
english_translation: It causes more suffering than the lower realm and creates greater obstacles in the chain of dharma.
essence: Some struggles cause deeper suffering by blocking your true purpose more than any external hardship.
simple_meaning: Some difficulties cause more pain than the worst places and block your true purpose.
insight: It teaches you to recognize and respect inner obstacles as serious challenges, not just external troubles.
modern_relevance: You might feel stuck when your core values or purpose get blocked, causing deeper pain than any external hardship.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
नूनमभ्युदये तेषां भवेवाधाऽप्यनेकधा ।
नैवात्र विस्मयः कार्यो भवद्भिर्विश्वभूतिदा ॥
translation: और उनके अभ्युद्य में अनेक बाधाएं भी होती हैं, हे पितृगण ! इसमें आपलोगों को विस्मय नहीं ही करना चाहिये
english_translation: Indeed, their rise involves many obstacles, O ancestors! You should not be surprised by this.
essence: Progress always includes obstacles; surprise at them is unnecessary.
simple_meaning: Rising or progress often comes with many difficulties, and you should not be shocked by these challenges.
insight: It shifts your mindset to expect obstacles as normal, reducing frustration when they appear.
modern_relevance: When you embark on a new project, unexpected problems often arise. Knowing this helps you stay calm and focused.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
नृदेहं जीवृन्देभ्यो दद्ध्वे यूयं यदा तदा।
पित्रोनूनं शरीरेण वीर्यांश पितरोऽधिकम् ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! जब पुरुषशरीर जीवौ को आप प्रदान करते हो तब वीर्य का अंश अधिक
english_translation: O ancestors, whenever you grant a living being a human body, you give more energy than that of the ancestors.
essence: Life grants living beings more energy than ancestors possess.
simple_meaning: You, the ancestors, give living beings a human body and more energy than you have.
insight: It shifts the view to see life’s energy as abundant and gifted beyond prior limits.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
नारीदेह यदा दत्य तदाशं रजसोऽधिकम् । 
क्लीवदेहाप्रदित्सायामुभयोः समतां किल ॥
translation: जब स्त्री शरीर प्रदान करते हो तब  रज का अंश अधिक और जब नपुंसक शरीर प्रदान करते हो तब  उभय की समानता
english_translation: When a female body is given, the quality of passion is predominant; when a neuter body is given, there is equality of both qualities.
essence: Body types correspond to different proportions of natural qualities influencing behavior.
simple_meaning: The verse notes that giving a female body involves more passion, while giving a neuter body involves balance between qualities.
insight: It shifts focus from identity to natural qualities influencing behavior and experience.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
दापयध्वे न सन्देहः सत्यमेतब्रवीमि वः।
पितरो वोऽनुकम्पातो लोके पुत्रादिसम्भवः ॥
translation: आप दिलाते हो इसमें सन्देह नहीं है, यह आप लोगो को मैं सत्य कहता हूँ। और शरीरों में सत्त्व आदि गुणों का
english_translation: You grant this without doubt, I tell you this truth: Your ancestors came into the world out of compassion for their children.
essence: Our ancestors arose from compassion to bring forth new life in the world.
simple_meaning: Your ancestors came into this world out of compassion for their children; this is a truth without doubt.
insight: It reminds you that your existence is rooted in a chain of caring actions beyond your control.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
विकाशमपि देहेषु सच्चादेः कुरुथ स्वतः।
तात्कालिकमनोवृत्तेः पित्रोः साहाय्यतो ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: विकास भी आप लोग माता पिता की उस समय की मनोवृत्ति की सहायता से ही स्वतः किया करते हो
english_translation: Even your growth in these bodies happens naturally with the help of your parents' immediate mental states.
essence: Your growth naturally depends on your parents' present mental support.
simple_meaning: Your development in the body naturally occurs because of your parents' immediate mental states and support.
insight: Recognize how immediate emotional and mental support from caregivers impacts natural growth processes.
modern_relevance: A child’s progress often reflects the moods and attention of their parents in the moment, shaping growth beyond obvious actions.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अतश्चेत्पितरौ तत्त्वज्ञानसाहाय्यतः खलु ।
एतत्सहजपीठस्य रहस्यं हृदयङ्गमम् ॥
translation: अतः हे पितृगण ! यदि मात पिता तत्त्वज्ञान को सहायता से  ही इस सहज पीठ के रहस्य को हृदयंगम कर सके
english_translation: Therefore, O ancestors, if your parents through the help of true knowledge can truly realize the secret of this natural seat within the heart.
essence: True knowledge shared by predecessors reveals the heart's natural secret.
simple_meaning: If your parents can help you understand the secret of the natural, inner seat through true knowledge, then you will realize it in your heart.
insight: It highlights the importance of support and true understanding to realize inner truths deeply.
modern_relevance: Sometimes, the deepest insights require guidance from those who know and true understanding, not just effort alone.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
शक्नुयातां सदा कर्तु तपसा दैहिकेन च । 
आसंयतमन:प्रामाणावनुरक्तौ च मय्यलम् ॥
translation: और शारीरिक तप और प्राण तथा मन का संयम करके तथा मुझमें यथावत् अनुरक्त होकर
english_translation: One should always be able to act with bodily discipline and control of vital energies and mind, fully devoted to me.
essence: True discipline integrates body, mind, and devotion into steady, skillful action.
simple_meaning: You should cultivate steady discipline of your body, breath, and mind while staying devoted to the divine.
insight: It teaches you to link physical and mental discipline with heartfelt devotion, making practice sustainable and alive.
modern_relevance: When your mind races and your body feels restless, bringing steady focus through daily habits can restore calm and purpose.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
गर्भाधानं प्रकुर्यातामुन्नतां सन्तति वराम् ।
यथेष्टं पितरः ! नूनमुत्पादयितुमर्हतः ॥
translation: गर्भाधान करें तो जैसी उन्नत और श्रेष्ठ प्रजा वह चाहे वैसी ही उत्पन्न कर सकते हैं
english_translation: If you perform conception, you can produce the offspring as exalted and superior as you desire.
essence: Conscious effort in creation results in outcomes matching your highest intentions.
simple_meaning: Performing conception properly leads to producing offspring as noble and excellent as desired.
insight: It highlights how deliberate and mindful effort shapes the quality of what we create or nurture.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सम्पाद्य त्रिविधा शुद्धि योगयुक्तौ निरन्तरम् ।
तिष्टतां चेत्तदा तौ हि विमुक्तौ सृष्टिबन्धनात् ॥
translation: यदि त्रिविध शुद्धि सम्पादन करके वह सदा योगयुक्त रहे तो सृष्टि बन्धन से मुक्त होकर
english_translation: When you consistently cultivate the threefold purity and remain united with yoga, you become free from the bonds of creation.
essence: Consistent threefold purity with yoga leads to freedom from life's bonds.
simple_meaning: You become free from worldly bonds by continuously practicing purity in three ways and staying connected with yoga.
insight: It teaches you to maintain continuous purity and yoga practice to loosen life's binding patterns.
modern_relevance: After a stressful day, you cleanse your thoughts, words, and actions, and return to your inner calm to feel truly free.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
लब्धुं निःश्रेयसं क्षिप्रं शक्नुयातां न संशयः।
यावत्प्रकाशनं लोके ज्ञानस्यास्य भविष्यति ॥
translation: शीघ्र निःश्रेयस प्राप्त कर सके हैं इसमें सन्देह नहीं। इस ज्ञान का जितना प्रकाश जगत में होगा
english_translation: There is no doubt that supreme well-being can be attained quickly as long as the illumination of this knowledge remains in the world.
essence: Supreme well-being can be quickly attained while this knowledge shines in the world.
simple_meaning: You can quickly reach the highest good as long as the light of this knowledge spreads in the world.
insight: It shifts your view from slow progress to immediate possibility when knowledge is active and spreading.
modern_relevance: When you see helpful ideas still shared and alive, you realize your own growth toward freedom can happen sooner than you expect.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
तावान क्रमविकाशः स्यात्सत्त्वाख्यस्य गुणस्य वै ।
पूर्ण ज्ञानश्च धर्मस्य संसारेऽत्र जनिष्यते ॥
translation: उतना ही सत्त्वगुण का क्रमविकाश होगा और धर्म का पूर्णज्ञान इस संसार में उत्पन्न होगा
english_translation: The orderly development of the quality of goodness leads to full understanding of dharma in this world.
essence: Growing inner goodness naturally leads to full understanding of your true purpose.
simple_meaning: When the quality of goodness develops steadily, full knowledge of your true purpose arises in life.
insight: It teaches you to nurture goodness patiently, trusting that clear understanding of your purpose will follow.
modern_relevance: You notice small acts of kindness and clarity growing inside you, opening new understanding about why you do what you do.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
आसुरी शक्तिरप्येव पराभूति समेष्यति ।
भवन्तो निर्भयाः सन्तो लप्स्यन्तेऽभ्युदयं तथा ॥
translation: इसी प्रकार असुरों की शक्ति भी पराभूत होगी और आपलोग निर्भय होकर अभ्युदय प्राप्त करोगे
english_translation: In the same way, the power of the shadow beings will be defeated, and you all will be fearless and attain prosperity.
essence: Fear fades as shadow powers lose, opening the way for growth.
simple_meaning: The power of ego-driven shadow beings will be overcome, and you will become fearless and successful.
insight: This verse encourages letting go of fear by trusting that negative forces will be overcome, empowering fearless action.
modern_relevance: When facing overwhelming challenges or negative influences, trust that these obstacles will fade, allowing you to move forward without fear.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
शान्तिमन्दाकिनी दैवे राज्ये नित्यं प्रवक्ष्यति ।
सामञ्जस्यं तथा सृष्टे रक्षितं च भविष्यति ॥
translation: दैवराज्य नित्य शान्तिमय होगा और सृष्टि का सामञ्जस्य सुरक्षित होगा
english_translation: The divine realm will always be peaceful, and the harmony of creation will be preserved.
essence: Peace within the divine realm continuously sustains creation's harmony.
simple_meaning: The divine realm is always peaceful, and this peace protects the harmony of all creation.
insight: It invites you to rest in the trust that harmony is sustained beyond visible turmoil.
modern_relevance: When everything feels chaotic, remember an unshakable peace quietly holds the deeper order of life.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
इह सर्वे भविष्यन्ति परानन्दाधिकारिणः।
समृद्धाः सुखसम्पन्नाः सम्पत्स्यन्ते च प्राणिनः ॥
translation: इस संसार में सब परमानन्द के अधिकारी होंगे और सब जीवगण समृद्ध और सुखसम्पन्न होंगे
english_translation: In this world, all beings will attain the right to supreme bliss and become prosperous and fulfilled.
essence: All beings will attain supreme happiness and become prosperous in this world.
simple_meaning: Everyone in this world will have the right to supreme happiness and will become prosperous and joyful.
insight: It encourages holding a vision where all beings are destined for fulfillment and joy, inviting optimism beyond present struggles.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
हे विन्धनाथ ! सर्वेश ! लोकपालक ! हे विभो !।
त्वदयातो दयासिन्धो ! सर्वलोकहितमदम् ॥
translation: हे सर्वेश्वर! हे लोकपालक ! हे विश्वनाथ ! हे विभो ! हे दयासिन्धो! आपकी कृपा से हमने
english_translation: O Lord of Vindhya! Master of all! Protector of the worlds! O Viśvanātha! Ocean of compassion! By your grace, all beings find welfare.
essence: The compassionate protector Shiva supports the welfare of all beings through his grace.
simple_meaning: This verse is a respectful invocation praising Shiva by many of his great names and acknowledges that by his compassion, all beings are cared for.
insight: It invites you to remember a compassionate force watches over all existence, providing a foundation for trust.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अशृण्म खलु धर्मस्य रहस्यं परमाद्भुतम् ।
पिण्डोत्पत्तेश्च विज्ञानं तन्नियामकमप्यहो ॥
translation: धर्म का परम अद्भुत सर्वलोक हितकर रहस्य, पिण्डोत्पत्ति विज्ञान और अहो !
english_translation: The supreme, wondrous secret of dharma is the knowledge of the origin of the embodied, and even the controller is absent.
essence: The secret of true purpose is the wondrous, uncontrolled origin of embodied life.
simple_meaning: The deepest secret of dharma is the wondrous knowledge of how embodied life arises, beyond any external controller.
insight: It shifts your mind from searching for a controller to embracing the mystery of existence’s origin.
modern_relevance: When things feel out of control, knowing that life’s origin is a wondrous mystery beyond any controller can bring peace and curiosity.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
रहस्यं गहनं वर्णाश्रममूलकमुत्तमम् ।
अद्य नो निश्चयो जातः प्रजोत्पत्त्या विधानतः ॥
translation: वर्णाश्रम धर्ममूलक उसका नियामक उत्तम और गहन रहस्य सुना और अब हमें निश्चय हो गया है कि विधिपूर्वक प्रजा की उत्पत्ति होने से
english_translation: The profound secret rooted in the system of class and stage of life is supreme; today we have certainty that the orderly birth of beings is established by this.
essence: A deep secret in life’s social order ensures beings arise in rightful sequence.
simple_meaning: There is a deep, supreme secret connected to the system of social classes and life stages, and today we are certain it regulates how beings are born in order.
insight: It shifts the mind to see social order and life stages as part of a deeper, purposeful natural structure.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
बाधा नः सुव्यवस्थायां भवेन्नैव कदाचन ।
अज्ञासिष्म वयञ्चैतदिदानी हे जगदगुरो !॥
translation: कदापि हमारी सुव्यवस्था में बाधा नहीं ही होगी। हे जगद्गुरो ! अब हमें यह भी विदित हो गया है कि
english_translation: Obstruction will never arise in our well-ordered state. Now, O world teacher, this is also known to us.
essence: No obstacle can disturb a truly well-ordered system.
simple_meaning: There will never be any obstruction in our well-organized situation. Now we understand this clearly.
insight: It invites you to trust in the stability of your current structure, easing doubt and hesitation.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
किविध ज्ञानसम्पन्ने जीवपिण्डे समुन्नते । 
स्याद्धर्मसार्वभौमात्मोदारमृतोर्हि दर्शनम् ॥
translation: धर्म की सार्वभौम उदार मूर्ति का दर्शन किस प्रकार के उन्नत ज्ञानसम्पन्न जीवपिण्ड मे हो सकता है
english_translation: How can the universal, generous form of dharma be perceived by a living being endowed with elevated knowledge?
essence: Dharma’s universal, generous nature is visible only through elevated knowledge.
simple_meaning: Only a living being with deeply elevated knowledge can truly perceive the vast and generous nature of dharma.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate elevated knowledge as the key to perceiving dharma fully.
modern_relevance: When you deepen your understanding beyond surface facts, you begin to see the bigger, generous purpose behind your actions.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
वर्णाश्रमाणां धर्माणां महत्त्वं हृदयङ्गमम् ।
कीदृशाः प्राणिनः कर्तुं शक्नुयुस्तु समुन्नताः ॥
translation: और वर्णाश्चमधर्म का महत्व कैसे उन्नत जीव हृदयंगम कर  सकते हैं
english_translation: How can elevated beings deeply understand the importance of the duties and duties of the social orders?
essence: Deep understanding of duties comes only with noble growth and inner awareness.
simple_meaning: As you become wiser and more developed, you can deeply understand the true importance of your social and life duties.
insight: It teaches you that understanding your role deeply requires growth and inner reflection, not just following rules.
modern_relevance: When you gain experience in your work or family, you begin to see why your responsibilities truly matter, beyond surface tasks.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
दिग्दर्शनञ्च धर्मस्य कारितं यद्दयावशात् ।
तेनावश्यं वयं शम्भो ! धर्मास्याभ्युदयाय वै ॥
translation: आपने जो कृपा करके हमारे धर्म का दिग्दर्शन कराया है, हे शम्भो ! जिसके द्वारा हम अवश्य ही धर्माभ्युदय के लिये
english_translation: The guidance of dharma you have graciously shown, O Shambhu, surely leads us to the flourishing of dharma.
essence: Gracious guidance leads to the sure flourishing of dharma.
simple_meaning: You have kindly shown us the way of dharma, Shambhu, which will surely help dharma to rise and thrive.
insight: It encourages trust that wise guidance leads to positive growth beyond immediate control.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अलं कृतं  हि मानन्याः सृष्टेः साहाय्यमद्भुतम् ।
प्राकृतायास्तथा दैव्याः सृष्टेः सन्तः सहायकाः ॥
translation: मानवी सृष्टि की अद्भुत सहायता करने में समर्थ होंगे और साथ ही साथ प्राकृत सृष्टि और देवी सृष्टि के सहायक बनकर
english_translation: The beings of the human creation are capable of wonderful support, and likewise, the beings of the natural and divine creations are helpers.
essence: Multiple realms of beings all assist creation in wondrous ways.
simple_meaning: Beings from human, natural, and divine creations all help in supporting the world in remarkable ways.
insight: It encourages recognizing support beyond just what is obvious or human-made, expanding awareness of interconnected help.
modern_relevance: You notice how your friends, nature around you, and your inner values all support you in different, often surprising ways.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सामञ्जस्यं भवत्सृष्टिलीलाविस्तारगोचरम् ।
अवन्नस्ते प्रसादस्य हेतवः सम्भवेम च ॥
translation: आपकी सृष्टि लीला विस्तार सम्बन्धी सामञ्जस्य की रक्षा करते हुए आपकी प्रसन्नता का कारण हो सकेंगे
english_translation: Your creation's playful expansion maintains harmony and can be the cause of your delight.
essence: Harmony in creation's unfolding supports and causes delight.
simple_meaning: The harmony in your playful creation and its unfolding can bring the cause for your happiness.
insight: It invites recognizing that harmony in natural growth and creativity supports joy rather than struggle.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
दैव्याः सृष्टेः समासेन श्रीवयित्वा रहस्यकम् ।
अद्य नस्तर्पय ज्ञानपिपासां हे कृपानिधे ! ॥
translation: अब हे कृपानिधे! दैवी सृष्टि का संक्षेप रहस्य हमको सुनाकर हमारी ज्ञान पिपासा को तृप्त कीजिये
english_translation: O treasure of compassion, please reveal the secret summary of the divine creation today to satisfy our thirst for knowledge.
essence: A heartfelt request for the secret summary of divine creation to satisfy deep knowledge thirst.
simple_meaning: We ask the compassionate teacher to share the secret summary of the divine creation to satisfy our deep thirst for knowledge.
insight: It highlights the importance of asking for clear, essential knowledge when curiosity is strong.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
प्राकृतायाः समासाद्य सृष्टरेच यथाक्रमम् ।
विकाशं मानवी सृष्टिर्जायते नात्र संशयः ॥
translation: प्राकृत सृष्टि से ही क्रमविकाश होकर मानवी सृष्टि उत्पन्न होती है इसमें सन्देह नहीं
english_translation: Human existence emerges in order from the natural world's unfolding without doubt.
essence: Human life unfolds naturally in sequence from the original creation.
simple_meaning: Human life develops step-by-step from the natural world's prior creation in a clear sequence.
insight: Recognize that complex outcomes arise only after simpler stages have naturally occurred first.
modern_relevance: Your own growth and experiences build gradually from earlier stages, like how nature unfolds in order.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
उभयोरेतयोर्ज्ञानं सम्यगस्माकमस्यतः।
अस्मल्लोकादतीतानां देवानां नास्ति किन्त्वलम् ॥
translation: इस कारण इन दोनों सृष्टियों का ज्ञान हमको अच्छी तरह ज्ञात है परन्तु हमारे लोक से अतीत जो अन्यान्य देश लोक है
english_translation: Therefore, we have perfect knowledge of both these worlds, but there is no other beyond our world among the gods.
essence: Our knowledge covers these two worlds; no gods exist beyond them.
simple_meaning: We fully understand these two worlds, but there are no gods beyond our known world.
insight: It highlights the limits of known existence, inviting humility about what lies beyond perception.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
स्वरूपं लोकवृन्दानां विदितं नः किमप्यहो।
तदोषान्नः सदा दृष्टिः कैवल्याभ्युदयमदे ॥
translation: उनका स्वरूप अहो ! हमको कुछ भी विदित नहीं है, उनका ज्ञान हमें हो जाने से अभ्युदय
english_translation: Their true nature is unknown to us; our vision has never perceived it, yet freedom arises from this.
essence: Not fully knowing the true nature allows freedom to arise unexpectedly.
simple_meaning: We have never truly seen the real nature of the world or beings, yet this lack of complete knowledge leads to emerging freedom.
insight: This verse shifts your focus from demanding certainty to embracing the openness of not fully knowing, which allows inner freedom to emerge.
modern_relevance: When you face something mysterious or unclear, the urge to control can fade, opening space for unexpected freedom and growth.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
गतिद्वयेऽवतिष्ठेत सर्वथैव यथार्थतः।
वयं शरणमापन्ना यथा स्याच्छं तथा कुरु ॥
translation: और निःश्रेयसकारिणी उभयगति पर सब प्रकार से ही हमारी दृष्टि यथार्थतः सदा रहेगी। हम आपके शरणागत हैं, जिससे कल्याण हो  कृपा वैसा कीजिये
english_translation: Our vision must always remain truly on both paths that lead to highest good. We are surrendered to you; please grant the grace that brings welfare.
essence: Complete surrender with unwavering trust holds both paths to true welfare.
simple_meaning: You should keep your focus truly on both ways that lead to well-being. Having taken refuge, ask for the help that brings good.
insight: It encourages you to hold steady faith in surrender and trust simultaneously, balancing active seeking with peaceful acceptance.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by choices, feeling lost, you lean into trust that both effort and surrender will bring what you truly need.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
कल्याः ! स्थूलजगन्नृनं सूक्ष्मदैवजगतम् । 
सृष्टेरस्त्यधिभूतायाश्चालकं धारकं तथा ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! स्थूल जगत सूक्ष्म देव जगत के आधार पर ही स्थित है, अधिभूत सृष्टि का चालक और धारक
english_translation: O ancestors! The gross world stands supported by the subtle divine world; it is the driver and sustainer of the manifested nature.
essence: The physical world exists because of a deeper, sustaining subtle realm.
simple_meaning: The visible physical world depends on a subtle divine world that supports and governs all creation.
insight: It invites you to see beyond appearances and recognize the subtle foundation beneath all things.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
आधिदैविकराज्यं हि नास्ति कोऽप्यत्र संशयः ।
ससमेतन्न सन्देहः कर्त्तव्योऽत्र कदाचन ॥
translation: अधिदैवराज्य ही है इसमें कुछ सन्देह नहीं है यह सत्य है इसमें कभी सन्देह न करना चाहिये
english_translation: There is no doubt that the higher divine kingdom exists; never hesitate to act accordingly here.
essence: The higher divine order is certain; hesitation has no place in action.
simple_meaning: The higher divine order or kingdom truly exists without any doubt, so you should never hesitate to act accordingly.
insight: It teaches you to replace hesitation with trust in a higher order, empowering decisive action.
modern_relevance: When you face uncertainty about big choices, remember some truths are certain and can guide your steps confidently.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
विनाऽधिदेवमाहाय्यं जगतो भवितुं क्षमाः।
न स्थूलहश्यमानस्य सृष्टिस्थितिलयक्रियाः ॥
translation: बिना अधिदैव सहायता के स्थूल परिदृश्यमान जगत की न सृष्टि हो सकती है, न स्थिति हो सकती है और न लय हो सकता है
english_translation: Without the help of the supreme divine, the manifest world cannot be created, sustained, or dissolved.
essence: The manifest world depends entirely on the supreme divine’s sustaining power.
simple_meaning: The visible world cannot come into being, exist, or disappear without the support of the supreme divine.
insight: It shifts the mind to recognize dependence on an unseen support beyond appearances.
modern_relevance: When life feels unstable, remembering that a deeper source sustains everything can provide calm and perspective.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
विधा विभक्तं पितरः ! देवं राज्यं हि वर्तते ।
आध्यात्मिकाधिदैवाधिभूतरूपं न संशयः ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! दैवीराज्य अध्यात्म, अधिदैव और अधिभूतरूप से तीन भागों में ही निस्सन्देह विभक्त है
english_translation: O ancestors! The divine kingdom is undoubtedly divided into three parts: spiritual, divine-ordained, and material.
essence: The divine realm naturally divides into spiritual, ordained, and material parts.
simple_meaning: The divine realm is clearly divided into three parts: spiritual, divine-ordained, and material aspects.
insight: It invites you to see reality as multi-dimensional, encouraging a broader perspective beyond the obvious.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
आधिभौतिककार्यस्य यूयं विश्वस्य चालकाः । 
आध्यात्मिकक्रियायाश्च चालका ऋषयो ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: जगत की आधिभौतिक क्रिया के सञ्चालक आप लोग हैं जगत की अध्यात्म क्रिया के सञ्चालक ऋषिगण ही है
english_translation: You are the directors of all physical activity in the world; the sages are certainly the directors of all spiritual activity.
essence: You direct physical action; sages direct spiritual action.
simple_meaning: You control the physical actions in the world, while sages guide spiritual actions.
insight: Recognize your role in worldly action while valuing spiritual mentorship for inner development.
modern_relevance: You make decisions and take action in daily life, but you can seek wise guidance for your inner growth and purpose.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अधिदैवक्रियायाः सञ्चालकाः सन्ति भूतिदाः!।
देवा नैके न सन्देहो नित्य नैमित्तिकास्तथा ॥
translation: और हे पितृगण! जगत की अधिदैव क्रिया के सञ्चालक अनेक नित्य और नैमित्तिक देवतागण ही हैं
english_translation: And O ancestors! The controllers of the world's higher cosmic functions are many eternal and occasional divine beings.
essence: Many divine beings govern the world's higher cosmic functions eternally and occasionally.
simple_meaning: Many eternal and occasional divine beings control the higher cosmic functions of the world.
insight: It reveals that many unseen forces guide the world's functioning, not just one power.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
देवश्रेण्यो हि मे तिस्त्र एताः सन्ति विभूतयः।
नातः स्याद्रक्षिता सृष्टिरासां साहाय्यमन्तरा ॥
translation: यह तीनो ही देवश्रेणी मेरी विभूति हैं, इस कारण इन तीनों ही की सहायता बिना सृष्टि की रक्षा नहीं हो सकती
english_translation: These three divine qualities are my powers; without their support, the protection of creation is impossible.
essence: Creation depends on the combined support of three essential divine powers.
simple_meaning: Three divine powers are essential supports without which the world cannot be sustained or protected.
insight: Recognize that complex systems rely on multiple essential forces working in harmony for stability.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
देवानामेव किन्त्वस्ति नूनं शक्तिविचारतः। 
सर्वाधिकारतस्तेपामधिकारः समुन्नतः ॥
translation: परन्तु शक्ति के विचार से देवतागण का अधिकार ही सब अधिकारों से उन्नत है
english_translation: Among all beings, only the radiant beings have authority arising from their power, which is higher than all other authorities.
essence: Real authority is power-based and superior to all other claims of control.
simple_meaning: Only the radiant beings have authority that comes from their true power, which is higher than any other kind of authority.
insight: It teaches you to recognize true authority as emerging from genuine power and capability, not superficial roles.
modern_relevance: In any group or team, real influence comes from your capability and strength, not just your job title or rank.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अस्त्येतद्धि जगत्सर्वं पितरः ! कर्ममूलकम् ।
जड़त्वात्कर्मवर्गस्य तत्सञ्चालनकर्मणि ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! यह सम्पूर्ण जगत् कर्म मूलक है, कर्मों के जड़ होने से कर्म के संञ्चालन में देवताओं की
english_translation: O ancestors, this entire world is rooted in action; due to the inertness of the realm of action, gods carry out those actions.
essence: All existence is based on action, even divine beings act due to its inert foundation.
simple_meaning: Everything in the world exists because of action, and even divine beings act because action is fundamental and inert by nature.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that action is the fundamental force behind all change and movement around you.
modern_relevance: When you notice how every part of your life depends on doing something, you understand that action is the foundation beneath all outcomes.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
आवश्यकत्वाद्देवानां तत्प्राधान्यं परं स्मृतम।
नैवात्र संशयः कार्यो विस्मयो वा कदाचन ॥
translation: आवश्यकता रहने से देवताओं की परम प्रधानता मानी गई है, इसमें सन्देह अथवा  विस्मय कभी नहीं ही करना चाहिये
english_translation: Because of their necessity, the supreme importance of the deva beings is acknowledged; there is never cause for doubt or surprise about this.
essence: The supreme importance of the deva beings is never doubtful due to their necessity.
simple_meaning: The supreme importance of the deva beings is accepted because they are necessary; there is no reason to doubt or be surprised by this.
insight: It clarifies that accepting the essential role of something removes hesitation or surprise about its status.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अहं चतुर्दशानां हि भुवनानां स्वधाभुजः !।
पञ्चानाञ्चैव कोषाणां सम्बन्धादद्य वो ब्रुवे ॥
translation: हे पितृगण' ! अब मैं चतुर्दश भुवन और पञ्चकोष के सम्बन्ध से आपको कहता हूँ
english_translation: O ancestors! Now I will speak to you about the fourteen worlds and the five sheaths.
essence: Introducing the relation between the fourteen worlds and the five sheaths.
simple_meaning: I am about to explain the connection between the fourteen worlds and the five sheaths to you.
insight: It introduces the framework for understanding layers of existence and self beyond the physical.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
प्राधान्यं देववृन्दस्य श्रूयतां सुसमाहितै: ।
देवसृष्टिरहस्यं स्याज्जातं येन यथार्थतः ॥
translation: देवताओं की प्रधानता ध्यान देकर सुनो जिससे आपको देवी संधिशा यशार्थ रहस्य विदित हो जायगा
english_translation: Listen attentively to the supremacy of the divine assembly, through which the secret of creation is truly revealed.
essence: Focused attention reveals the true secret behind the divine origin of creation.
simple_meaning: Listen carefully to the highest status of the divine assembly, through which the true secret of creation is revealed.
insight: It encourages focused presence to grasp deeper truths that remain hidden without attention.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेशाख्यं त्रिमूर्ति त्रिगुणात्मकम् ।
यदाऽहं पितरो धृत्वा स्वशक्तेरवलम्बनात् ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! जब मैं ब्रह्मा विष्णु और महेश रूपी त्रिगुणात्मक त्रिमूर्ती को धारण करके अपनी शक्ति की सहायता से
english_translation: O ancestors, when I manifested as the threefold form of Brahma, Vishnu, and Mahesh, embodying the three qualities through my own power.
essence: One power manifests as many forms embodying fundamental qualities.
simple_meaning: I took the form of the three divine beings—Brahma, Vishnu, and Mahesh—through my own power when addressing the ancestors.
insight: It reveals the unity behind diverse forms, showing one source expressing multiple aspects through its power.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
आददे सगुणं रूपं तिस्रस्ता एव मूर्तयः ।
प्राधान्यं सर्वदेवेषु धरन्योऽलं भवन्ति ते ॥
translation: सगुण होता हूँ तो वही मेरी त्रिमूर्ति सर्वदेव प्रधान होकर निस्सन्देह प्रधान देवता कहलाते हैं
english_translation: When I manifest with qualities, I am the Trimurti—the supreme presence among all deities, undeniably the foremost divine being.
essence: The divine manifests primarily as the three supreme forms recognized above all others.
simple_meaning: The divine appears in three main forms called the Trimurti, which are recognized as supreme among all radiant beings.
insight: It helps you see that the divine's many forms are different expressions of the same supreme essence.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
ब्रह्माण्डे किल प्रत्येकं मुख्या देवा न संशयः ।
आवहन्तस्त्रिदेवाख्यां प्राशस्त्यं यानि सर्वथा ॥
translation: प्रत्येक ब्रह्माण्ड में और त्रिदेव नाम को धारण करके सर्वथा प्रसिद्ध होते हैं।
english_translation: In every universe, the primary radiant beings, known as the three gods, are entirely celebrated everywhere.
essence: Every universe features three main divine beings known everywhere.
simple_meaning: Each universe has main divine beings called the three gods, who are famous everywhere.
insight: It highlights the presence of common divine archetypes across different realms but lacks direct practical application.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अस्य मूर्तित्रयस्यास्ते प्रतिब्रह्माण्डवर्तिन:।
नैव भेदो मया सार्द्ध वस्तुनः कश्चिदप्यणुः ॥
translation: वास्तव में प्रत्येक ब्रह्माण्ड के इन त्रिमूर्तियों में और मुझमें कोई भी भेद नहीं है
english_translation: Indeed, there is no difference between these three forms of the universe and me.
essence: The apparent many and the self are fundamentally one without any separation.
simple_meaning: There is no real separation between the three universal forms and Shiva; all are one in essence.
insight: It shifts your view from separation to unity, helping you see yourself as part of a seamless whole.
modern_relevance: When you feel isolated or disconnected, remember that all things and you share the same fundamental nature, dissolving loneliness.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
एतदेवाधिदैवं हि मुख्यं मूर्तित्रयं मम ।
प्रोच्यते पितरो विज्ञै प्रतिब्रह्माण्डमीश्वरः ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! यह तीनों प्रधान अधिदेव मूर्ति ही प्रत्येक ब्रह्माण्ड में ईश्वर कहलाते हैं
english_translation: O ancestors, these three principal supreme divine forms are called the rulers of each universe.
essence: Three supreme divine forms govern every universe as cosmic rulers.
simple_meaning: The three main divine forms mentioned here are recognized as rulers of every universe by the ancestors.
insight: It shows the importance of acknowledging guiding forces beyond immediate perception in life and the cosmos.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
ब्रमण्यध्यात्मशक्ति में ह्याधिदैव्यपि भाति वै ।
लोकसष्टत्वतो वोऽयं नायकोऽस्ति तथाप्यहो ॥
translation: ब्रह्माजी में मेरी अध्यात्मशक्ति और अधिदेवशक्ति का पूर्ण विकास रहने पर भी वे लोकसृष्टा होने के कारण आपलोगों के नायक कहलाते हैं
english_translation: Even though Brahma’s spiritual power and divine power are fully developed, he is called your leader because he is the creator of the worlds.
essence: Being leader depends on the role you play, not just your inner power.
simple_meaning: Brahma has both spiritual and divine powers fully developed, yet he is called leader because he created the worlds.
insight: It teaches that leadership or responsibility often comes from the role one plays, not just from personal power or ability.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
तथा शिवेऽधिभूतायामाधिदैव्याश्च पूर्णतः।
शक्तौ विकाशितायां हि सत्यामपि स्वधाभुजः ! ॥
translation: उसी प्रकार हे पितृगण! शिव में अधिभूतशक्ति और अधिदेव शक्ति का पूर्ण विकास रहने पर भी
english_translation: Just as in Shiva, even when the power of the natural world and the power of the supreme being are fully manifested, the true self remains unchanged.
essence: The true self remains whole and unchanged despite all manifest powers.
simple_meaning: No matter how fully the powers of the natural world and supreme being show themselves in Shiva, the true self stays unchanged and whole.
insight: Recognize that your essential nature is unmoved by external changes or powerful forces.
modern_relevance: When your emotions or circumstances surge intensely, remember your true self stays steady and complete underneath it all.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
नायको ज्ञानदातृत्वाद्दपीणामेप मन्यते ।
संविकाशितयौ शक्तयोः पूर्णाऽध्यात्माधिभूतयोः ॥
translation: वह ज्ञान दाता होने के कारण ऋषियों के नायक माने जाते हैं। और उसी प्रकार विष्णु में अधिभूत शक्ति और अध्यात्म शक्ति का पूर्ण विकास रहने पर भी
english_translation: Sages are considered leaders because they grant wisdom; likewise, Vishnu is regarded as complete with the full development of the external and spiritual powers.
essence: True leadership arises from fully developed wisdom and powers together.
simple_meaning: Sages are respected as leaders because they give wisdom. Similarly, Vishnu is seen as complete when both his spiritual and external powers are fully developed.
insight: It shows the value placed on combining knowledge and power to be truly complete or influential.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
विष्णौ सत्योस्तथाप्येष वर्त्तते देवनायकः।
देवशक्तिकदम्बस्य केन्द्रीभूतो यतोऽस्त्ययम् ॥
translation: वह विष्णु देवी शक्ति समूह के केन्द्र होने से देवताओ के नायक हैं
english_translation: Vishnu is the leader of the devas because he is the center of the goddess Shakti group.
essence: Leadership arises from being the center of powerful divine energy.
simple_meaning: Vishnu is called the leader of the devas because he is the central figure in the goddess Shakti group.
insight: It highlights that true leadership arises from being the focal point of strength and support.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
पितरः ! वोऽधिकारोऽस्ति स्थूले जगति केवलम् ।
पिण्डपुञजेऽपि मर्त्र्यानां पिण्डेष्वेव विशेषतः ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! आप लोगों का अधिकार केवल स्थूल जगत् और पिण्डों में मनुष्य पिण्डों पर ही विशेषरूप से है
english_translation: O ancestors, your authority exists only in the gross world and especially over the bodies of humans.
essence: Ancestral authority is confined to the physical, especially human bodies.
simple_meaning: The ancestors’ influence is limited to the physical world and especially over human bodies.
insight: Recognize that certain influences belong only to the physical world, freeing you from unseen pressures beyond it.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
केवलं ज्ञानिनीवेषु त्वधिकारस्तथास्यलम् ।
ऋषीणां नात्र सन्देहः किन्तु देवगणस्य वै ॥
translation: ऋषियों का अधिकार केवल ज्ञानी जीवों में ही है इसमें सन्देह नहीं परन्तु देवताओं का
english_translation: Only those who are wise have this right; there is no doubt about this among sages, but it is different for the radiant beings.
essence: The right belongs clearly to the wise, but not necessarily the radiant beings.
simple_meaning: Only the wise have this right, and sages have no doubt about it, but the radiant beings experience it differently.
insight: Recognize that understanding or authority may be clear to some but experienced differently by others.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
ब्रह्माण्डानां हि सर्वेषां भागेप्यास्तेऽखिलेषु च ।
अधिकारोऽस्त्यतस्तेषां देवानां सर्वमान्यता ॥
translation: अधिकार प्रत्येक ब्रह्माण्ड के सभी विभागों पर होने के कारण वह सर्वमान्य हैं
english_translation: The divine beings are universally recognized because each has authority over parts of all universes.
essence: Universal respect arises from authority over all parts of existence.
simple_meaning: Each divine being is acknowledged everywhere because they have authority over parts of every universe.
insight: Understand that influence comes from how widely and deeply you engage, not just from presence.
modern_relevance: In a team, your unique influence over certain areas earns respect from everyone involved.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
पितरः ! पञ्चकोपाश्च भुवनानि चतुर्दश ।
समष्टिव्यष्टिरूपायां पिण्डब्रह्माण्डसंहतौ ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! पञ्चकोष और चतुर्दश भुवन समष्टि और व्यष्टिरूप ब्रह्माण्ड और पिण्डसमूह में
english_translation: O ancestors! The five sheaths and fourteen worlds are the collective and individual forms in the cosmic whole and parts.
essence: The cosmos is formed of layered selves and multiple worlds, both collective and individual.
simple_meaning: The ancestors are addressed as the five layers of being and fourteen worlds seen as both collective and individual forms within the cosmic totality.
insight: It invites seeing reality as a complex system of overlapping layers and scales, both united and diverse.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
ओतप्रोतस्वरूपेण सन्तिष्ठन्ते न संशयः ।
मम ब्रह्माण्डरूपस्य विराटदेहस्य कल्यदाः !॥
translation: निस्सन्देह ओत प्रोत हैं । ब्रह्माण्ड रूपी मेरे विराट् शरीर के,
english_translation: There is no doubt that all beings are pervaded by my cosmic body.
essence: All beings live within and are inseparable from the cosmic body.
simple_meaning: Everything exists within and is intimately connected to the vast cosmic body that I embody.
insight: It shifts your view from separation to belonging within a greater whole.
modern_relevance: When you feel small or isolated, remember you are woven into the vastness of everything around you.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
लोकाः सप्तोर्दधवगा नाभिमुपुर्यीरि सन्त्यहाँ ।
अधोऽधः सप्त वर्तन्ते ध्रुवं नाभिश्च संस्थिताः ॥
translation: नाभि से ऊपर सात उद्धर्व लोक और नाभि के नीचे सात अधोलोक स्थित है।
english_translation: Above the navel are seven upper worlds, and below the navel are seven lower worlds.
essence: Existence is structured in multiple worlds arranged above and below a central point.
simple_meaning: There are seven worlds above the navel and seven worlds below it, arranged steadily in the body or cosmos.
insight: It hints at a layered model of existence but does not teach a direct practice or insight.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अतः समाष्टरूपेऽस्मिन् ब्रह्माण्डे वै चतुर्दश ।
भुवनानि प्रधानानि विद्यन्ते नात्र संशयः ॥
translation: इस कारण समष्टिरूपी ब्रह्माण्ड में चतुर्दश भुवन प्रधान हैं इसमें सन्देह नहीं
english_translation: Therefore, in the collective form of the universe, there are undoubtedly fourteen primary worlds.
essence: The universe definitely includes fourteen primary worlds forming its structure.
simple_meaning: The universe as a whole contains fourteen main worlds without any doubt.
insight: Recognize that vast systems have defined layers and components, grounding your view of complexity.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
पञ्चकोषास्तु तिष्ठन्ति व्याता गौणतयाऽत्र हि।
जीवदेहस्वरूपेषु कोषा: पिण्डेषु पञ्च च ॥
translation: और पञ्चकोष उनमें गौणरूप से व्याप्त रहते हैं। और उसी प्रकार जीवदेहरूपी पिण्ड में पञ्चकोष
english_translation: Five sheaths subtly pervade the embodied living being, existing within the five bodies of the living entity.
essence: The living being consists of five subtle sheaths that compose and pervade the embodied self.
simple_meaning: You are made up of five layers or sheaths that together form your living body and subtle self.
insight: Recognize the multiple layers of your being to see beyond just your physical or emotional state.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by your mood or body, remember you are more than one surface—you have layers shaping your experience.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
प्रधानास्सन्ति तेषां हि सम्बन्धाच्च चतुर्दश ।
भुवनान्यप्रधानानि सन्तिष्ठन्ते निरन्तरम् ॥
translation: प्रधान और उन पञ्चकोषों के सम्बन्ध से चतुर्दश भुवनों का सम्बन्ध अप्रधान रहता है।
english_translation: The fourteen worlds exist continuously, connected to the primary and the five sheaths, while remaining distinct from the non-primary.
essence: The fourteen worlds continuously connect with the primary and five sheaths yet remain separate from the non-primary.
simple_meaning: The fourteen worlds are linked to the primary principle and the five sheaths but remain separate from the non-primary.
insight: It reveals how complex systems can be interconnected while preserving distinct identities.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अतो मे ज्ञानिनो भक्ता ऐसी  शक्ति समाश्रिताः।
स्वपिण्डेष्वपि तिष्ठन्तः सूक्ष्मैर्नानाविधैर्दुतम् ॥
translation: हे पितरो! यही कारण है कि मेरी ऐसी  शक्ति प्राप्त करने से मेरा ज्ञानीभक्त अपने पिण्ड में रहकर भी नाना सूक्ष्म
english_translation: Therefore, my wise devotees, who have attained such power, remain even within their bodies, subtle in many ways.
essence: Wisdom and devotion create a subtle, hidden power inside you that shapes your being.
simple_meaning: Devotees who combine wisdom and devotion gain a special power that quietly exists within their own bodies in subtle forms.
insight: Recognize that true power from devotion and wisdom is often hidden within, not flashy or obvious.
modern_relevance: You might feel ordinary on the outside, but your focused care and understanding build a quiet inner strength that guides your actions.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
संस्थापयितुमर्हन्ति देवलोकैः सहान्वयम् ।
अन्यान्यसूक्ष्मलोकेषु निवसन्तोऽप्यतस्तथा ॥
translation: देवीलोकों के साथ सम्बन्ध स्थापन कर सका है और इसी कारण  अन्यान्य सूक्षम लोकों में रहने पर भी
english_translation: He must establish connection with the realm of deva, and therefore, even while dwelling in other subtle realms.
essence: Connection to the divine realm sustains presence across subtle worlds.
simple_meaning: The verse explains that someone must create a connection with the divine realm and thus can remain connected even in other subtle worlds.
insight: It shows how maintaining a strong connection to a higher source anchors you across different states of being or consciousness.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
संस्थापयितुमर्हन्ति स्वाधिपत्यं स्वधाभुजः !।
देवासुरगणाः सर्वे जीवपिण्डेष्वनुक्षणम् ॥
translation: देवतागण अथवा असुरगण भी जीवपिण्डो पर अपना अधिकार स्थापन सर्वदा कर सके हैं
english_translation: The leaders of divine and shadow beings must always establish their authority over all living entities.
essence: True leaders must continuously uphold their authority over those they are responsible for.
simple_meaning: Leaders, whether divine or shadow beings, have the constant duty to maintain control over all living beings.
insight: It teaches you to embrace consistent accountability for those relying on your guidance and protection.
modern_relevance: When you're responsible for a team or family, steady leadership means consistently maintaining your role and care, not just occasionally.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
पितरः ! पञ्चकोपा हि सर्वपिण्डप्रतिष्ठिताः ।
आवृण्वन्तो विराजन्ते मत्स्वरूपं न संशयः ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! पञ्चकोष सब प्रकार के पिण्डों में प्रतिष्ठित होकर मेरे स्वस्वरूप को धारण किये हुए रहते हैं
english_translation: O ancestors, the five sheaths are established in all bodies, embodying my true nature without doubt.
essence: All beings carry the five layers that embody Shiva's true nature.
simple_meaning: The five sheaths exist within every body, holding and shining with the true nature that is Shiva's.
insight: It invites you to see beyond surface differences to the shared essence within all beings.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
मध्यमासु निकृष्टासु तथोच्चैर्देवयोनिषु। .
सर्वास्वप्यवतिष्ठन्ते पञ्चकोषा न संशयः ॥
translation: चाहे निकृष्ट योनि हो, चाहे मध्यम मनुष्य योनि हो और चाहे उन्नत देवयोनि हो सबमें अवश्य ही पञ्चकोष विद्यमान हैं
english_translation: Whether in the lowest life-forms, the middle human realm, or the highest divine beings, all certainly possess the five sheaths.
essence: Every being, regardless of form, carries the same five inner layers.
simple_meaning: Every living being, low or high, has five layers or sheaths covering their true self.
insight: It shifts your view from surface differences to shared inner nature among all life.
modern_relevance: In moments of feeling isolated or different, remember your inner structure is shared by all beings around you.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
एतावांस्तत्र भेदोऽस्ति नूनं निम्नासु योनिषु ।
पञ्चकोषा विकाशन्ते नैव सामान्यतोऽखिलाः ॥
translation: भेद इतना ही है कि निकृष्ट योनियों में सब कोषों का समान विकास नहीं होता।
english_translation: The difference is only that in lower beings, all five sheaths do not develop equally.
essence: Lower beings differ by uneven development of their five inner sheaths.
simple_meaning: Lower beings do not have equal development of the five layers that cover the true self.
insight: Recognize that inner development varies naturally among beings; growth is uneven and layered.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
निखिलानान्तु कोषाणां मर्त्यपिण्डेषु निश्चितम् ।
विकाशः सर्वतः सम्यग्जायते नात्र संशयः ॥
translation: मनुष्य पिण्ड में सब कोषों का सम्यक विकास हो जाता है इसमें सन्देह नहीं
english_translation: In the mortal body, all the vessels fully develop without any doubt.
essence: The body's inner vessels naturally and completely develop without any doubt.
simple_meaning: All the inner channels or vessels within the human body develop properly and fully without question.
insight: It teaches you to trust the natural completeness of your inner growth without anxiety or doubt.
modern_relevance: When your body heals or grows, it happens naturally without your interference, showing the power of trusting life's process.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
ततोऽपि देवपिण्डेषु विकाशन्ते हि शक्तयः ।
अधिकं खलु पश्चानां कोषाणां नात्र संशयः ॥
translation: और देवपिण्ड में उसके अतिरिक्त पञ्चकोष की शक्तियों का अधिक विकास हो जाता है।
english_translation: Beyond the divine form, the powers of the five sheaths develop even more, without doubt.
essence: The subtle energies behind the divine form expand beyond what appears.
simple_meaning: The powers within the five sheaths beyond the divine form grow more intensely without any doubt.
insight: It invites you to recognize that what you see is only a surface; deeper layers contain more potential.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
पाञ्चकौषिकभूमीनां समानानां स्वभावतः ।
सम्बन्धः सर्वपिण्डानां भूमिभिः सह वर्तते ॥
translation: परन्तु पञ्चकोष की समान भूमि का सम्बन्ध सब पिण्डो के पञ्चकोषों की भूमियों के साथ स्वाभाविक रूपसे बने रहने से
english_translation: The relationship of the five sheaths' foundation naturally exists with the foundations of the five sheaths of all bodies.
essence: All beings share naturally connected layers beneath their physical forms.
simple_meaning: The natural connection between the layers of energy and consciousness in one being exists similarly in all beings.
insight: It shows you how to see yourself as part of a shared natural system beyond physical form, fostering empathy and unity.
modern_relevance: You sense your feelings, thoughts, and body respond just like everyone else's, showing we share deep common layers beneath our differences.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
ऋषयोऽतो भवन्तश्च ममोपासकयोगिनः।
देवाः शक्तिविशेषैश्च विधातुं शक्नुवन्त्यलम् ॥
translation: मेरे उपासक योगिगण, आपलोग, ऋषिगण अथवा देवतागण विशेष विशेष कोष का कार्य विशेष विशेष शक्ति के द्वारा
english_translation: My devoted yogis, sages, and radiant beings each possess unique powers to shape creation.
essence: Different devoted beings have unique powers to shape the world.
simple_meaning: Sages, yogis, and radiant beings each have special powers to create and influence the world.
insight: Recognize that diverse strengths exist around you, each contributing uniquely to the whole.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
कार्य कोषविशेषस्य पिण्डेध्वन्येषु चैकतः ।
नैवात्र संशयः कश्चित्सत्यं जानीत सत्तमाः ! ॥
translation: एक पिण्ड से दूसरे पिण्ड में कर सके हैं, इसे निःसंशय सत्य जाने
english_translation: The supreme beings undoubtedly know that action performed in one body can affect another.
essence: Actions done in one being affect others; this interconnected impact is certain.
simple_meaning: What you do in your body influences other bodies; this is a known truth for the highest beings.
insight: It teaches you to act with awareness that your deeds reach beyond your immediate experience.
modern_relevance: You send a message or make a choice, unaware that it shifts someone's mood or life far away.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
वसन्ति देवाः पित्तरः ! उर्द्ध लोकेषु सप्तम् ।
सन्तिष्ठन्तेऽसुराः सर्वे ह्यघोलोकेषु सप्तम् ॥
translation: हे पितृगणं ! ऊर्द्ध सप्तलोकों में देवताओं का वास है और अधः सप्तलोकों में असुरों का वास है
english_translation: O ancestors! The gods dwell in the seven upper worlds, and all the asuras dwell in the seven lower worlds.
essence: The cosmos is divided into seven upper worlds of divinity and seven lower worlds of shadow beings.
simple_meaning: The seven higher worlds are home to divine beings, and the seven lower worlds are inhabited by darker forces.
insight: It frames the universe as layered with distinct realms inhabited by different energies, highlighting cosmic balance.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
तमोमुख्यतया सृष्टेरसुराणां हि सप्तमे।
लोकेऽस्त्यमुरराजस्य राजधानी त्वधस्तने ॥
translation: असुरगण की सृष्टि तमःप्रधान होने से असुरराज की राजधानी सप्तम अधोलोक में स्थित है
english_translation: Because the creation of the Asuras is primarily of darkness, the capital of their king lies in the seventh lower realm.
essence: Darkness shapes the Asuras' world, placing their capital deep below the surface.
simple_meaning: The Asuras, beings born of darkness, have their king's capital located in the seventh lower realm.
insight: It shows how opposing forces arise from darkness and dwell in hidden or lower states beyond our usual awareness.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
दैव्याः सत्वप्रधानत्वात्सृष्टे राजानुशासनम् ।
उच्चदैवेषु लोकेषु नैवावश्यकमस्त्यहो ॥
translation: परन्तु दैवी सृष्टि सत्त्वप्रधान होने के कारण और उन्नत दैवलोकों में राजानुशासन की अवश्यकता न रहने से
english_translation: Because the divine creation is dominated by goodness, and in the higher divine realms, royal governance is not necessary.
essence: Higher realms governed by pure goodness need no royal control.
simple_meaning: In realms ruled by the principle of goodness, strict royal control is not needed because harmony prevails naturally.
insight: Recognize where natural balance reduces the need for external control and where effort can be relaxed.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अस्त्यतो देवराजस्य राजधानी तृतीयके ।
उर्द्धव लोके स्थिता नित्यं नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥
translation: देवराज की राजधानी तृतीय ऊर्द्ध लोक में स्थित है, इसमें कोई विचार की बात नहीं है।
english_translation: The divine king's capital is eternally established in the third higher realm; there is no need for doubt about this.
essence: The divine king's capital is eternally fixed in the third higher realm without question.
simple_meaning: The divine king's capital city is permanently located in the third higher realm; nothing further needs to be considered about it.
insight: Recognize when some realities are beyond debate and can serve as steady foundations.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
विशेषतोऽसुराः सर्वे सदा प्राबल्यसञजुप:।
कुर्वाणा विप्लवं दैवे राज्ये सृष्टेः प्रवाधितुम् ॥
translation: विशेषतः हे पितृगण ! असुरगण सदा प्रबलता लाभ करके, दैवी राज्य में विप्लव करके,
english_translation: Especially, the beings of shadow, having gained great strength, cause upheaval in the divine realm created by the supreme.
essence: Shadow beings gain power and disrupt the divine order.
simple_meaning: Beings of shadow often gain power and disturb the divine realm created by the supreme.
insight: It highlights how disruptive forces arise even in stable systems, reminding you to expect challenges when conditions look established.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
सामञ्जस्यं विचेष्टन्ते नितान्तं सन्ततं बहु ।
अतोऽपि देवराजस्य राजधानी तृतीयके ॥
translation: सृष्टिसामञ्ज में बाधा डालने में सचेष्ट रहते हैं इस कारण से भी देवराज की राजधानी सदा तृतीय
english_translation: Those who constantly disturb harmony cause the king of gods' capital to remain in third place.
essence: Persistent disturbance keeps even the highest place diminished.
simple_meaning: Those who repeatedly disrupt harmony cause the divine king's capital to stay in a lesser position.
insight: It teaches that continuous conflict prevents stability and progress, even for the most powerful.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
उर्द्धवलोके स्थिता नित्यं विद्यते पितरो ध्रुवम् ।  
'उन्नतेषूर्द्धवलोकेषु प्रवेशोऽप्यस्त्यसम्भवः ॥
translation: उर्द्ध लोक में ही स्थित रहती है। हे पितृगण ! उन्नत उर्द्ध लोकों में असुरों का प्रवेश भी सम्भव नहीं है।
english_translation: The ancestors reside eternally in the higher realm; even asuras cannot enter the loftier higher realms.
essence: Some elevated realms are eternally reserved for radiant beings beyond ego's reach.
simple_meaning: The ancestors always dwell in the higher realm, and even beings of ego and shadow cannot enter the loftier higher realms.
insight: It teaches the existence of levels of being inaccessible to those bound by ego and shadow.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
असुराणामतोऽप्येषु देवराजानुशासनम् ।
नावश्यकत्वमाप्नोति विशेषेण कदाचन ॥
translation: इस कारण से भी वहां देवराज के राजानुशासन की विशेष आवश्यकता नहीं रहती है।
english_translation: For this reason, even among the beings of ego and shadow, the supreme ruler's governance is not always necessary.
essence: Supreme governance is not always needed among ego-driven beings.
simple_meaning: Even among ego-driven beings, the supreme ruler's control is not always needed.
insight: Recognize when control or intervention is unnecessary, even in challenging environments.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
विभिन्नोपासकेभ्यो हि स्वरूप सगुणं धरन् ।
सालोक्यञ्चैव सामीप्यं सारूप्यं पितरस्तथा ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! मैं सगुणरूप को धारण करके विभिन्न उपासकों को सालोक्य, सामीप्य, सारूप्य और
english_translation: O ancestors! I assume a manifested form and grant various worshipers the experience of co-existence, closeness, and likeness.
essence: The divine adopts many forms to meet the unique needs of each devotee.
simple_meaning: The divine takes a form with qualities to fulfill different devotees' experiences of connection and likeness.
insight: Recognize that connection often requires adopting forms or expressions that others can relate to.
modern_relevance: When you connect with others, sometimes meeting them in their language or experience deepens your bond and understanding.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
दातुं मोक्षश्च सायुज्यं नानारूपहिं सप्तमे ।
उर्द्धवलोके तथा षष्ठे विराजेऽहमनुक्षणम् ॥
translation: सायुज्य मुक्ति प्रदान करने लिये अनेकों रूप से षष्ठ और सप्तम ऊर्द्ध लोक में सदा विराजमान रहता हूँ।
english_translation: To grant union and freedom, I eternally shine in the sixth and seventh higher realms in many forms.
essence: The divine eternally manifests in many forms across higher realms to grant union and freedom.
simple_meaning: The divine shines eternally in the sixth and seventh higher realms in many forms to grant union and freedom.
insight: Realize the divine's infinite presence and forms offer limitless paths to freedom and union.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
उन्नतेपूर्द्धवलोकेषु सात्विकेषु स्वधाभुजः ।
राजानुशासनस्यातः का वार्ता वर्त्तते खलु ॥
translation: इस कारण उन उन्नत लोक समूह में राजानुशासन की तो बात ही क्या है
english_translation: Therefore, in those exalted realms of the pure, the rule of kings holds no meaning at all.
essence: In the highest pure realms, worldly kingship has no relevance.
simple_meaning: In very pure and exalted realms, the authority or rule of kings is irrelevant and does not apply.
insight: It shifts the mind from worldly power to recognizing transcendent states beyond control or hierarchy.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
शब्दानुशासनस्यापि नास्ति तेषु प्रयोजनम् ।
विचित्रो मध्यवर्त्यस्ति मृत्युलोको विभूतिदाः !॥
translation: शब्दानुशासन का भी वहाँ अधिकार नहीं है। हे पितृगण ! मध्यवर्ती मृत्युलोक अति विचित्र है।
english_translation: The power of word-based discipline does not apply there; the mortal world, standing in between, is indeed strange.
essence: The mortal world is too strange for words or rules to fully govern it.
simple_meaning: The mortal world is unusual and cannot be controlled by mere words or rules of speech.
insight: It teaches you to accept that some life experiences defy explanation and control by language or logic.
modern_relevance: You try to explain or fix a chaotic situation with words, but it resists your control and surprises you.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
यथा गहर्स्थयमाश्रिय पुष्टाः स्युः सर्व आश्रमाः।
मृत्युलोकं समाश्रित्य भुवनानि चतुर्दश ॥
translation: जिस प्रकार गृहस्थाश्रम समस्त आश्रमों का पोषक है उसी प्रकार मृत्युलोक ही चतुर्दश भुवनों का पोषक है
english_translation: Just as the householder stage nourishes all other stages of life, the mortal realm nourishes the fourteen worlds.
essence: Foundational support sustains all stages of life and the entire cosmic realms.
simple_meaning: The householder stage supports all other life stages, just as the mortal world supports all fourteen worlds.
insight: It shifts your view to see how foundational roles sustain larger systems, even unseen.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
स्वातन्त्र्यं पूर्णमत्रास्ति कर्मसम्पादने यतः ।
मृत्युलोकप्रतिष्ठाऽतो विद्यते निखिलोपरि ॥
translation: क्योकि मृत्युलोक में कर्म करने की पूर्ण स्वतन्त्रता होने के कारण उसको प्रतिष्ठा सर्वोपरि है
english_translation: Complete freedom exists in performing action; therefore, the world of the mortal is firmly established above all.
essence: Your full freedom in action is what firmly establishes your world.
simple_meaning: You have complete freedom when you act, and this freedom is what makes your life stand firm.
insight: It shifts focus from external control to embracing freedom in your present actions as your true power.
modern_relevance: When you face choices at work or home, remember that your freedom to act fully is what truly shapes your life’s foundation.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
यद्यप्युत्पद्यते मोक्षफलमुद्यान उत्तमे ।
मृत्युलोके न सन्देहस्तद्वीजं किन्तु लभ्यते ॥
translation: मोक्षरूपी फल की उत्पत्ति, मृत्यु, लोकरूपी उद्यान में होने पर भी उसका बीज
english_translation: Even if the fruit of freedom arises in the garden of the mortal world, its seed is not found there without doubt.
essence: Freedom’s fruit can appear, but its true seed is rarely present here.
simple_meaning: Freedom’s result may seem to appear in this world, but its true origin is hard to find here.
insight: It teaches you to look beyond temporary experiences for the foundational cause of true freedom.
modern_relevance: You might feel moments of peace or freedom in daily life, but the deep source of lasting freedom remains elusive in everyday struggles.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
आर्यावर्त्तप्रदेशे हि कर्मभूमिस्वरूपिणि ।
विशुद्धे याज्ञिके रम्ये सर्वर्तुवातशोभिते ॥
translation: विशुद्ध याज्ञिक सब ऋतुओं से सुशोभित कर्मभूमि आर्यवृत में सदा प्राप्त होता है
english_translation: In the pure land of Aryavarta, the field of action shines beautifully, adorned by all seasons and winds.
essence: Life's field of action is always pure and beautifully alive through every change.
simple_meaning: Your life is like a pure, sacred land where every season and wind adds beauty to your actions.
insight: It invites you to see your daily responsibilities as part of a sacred, ongoing process enriched by change.
modern_relevance: You notice how every day brings new challenges and opportunities that shape your work and character in meaningful ways.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
का वार्ताऽतोऽस्ति देवानामवतारीयविग्रहम् ।
आविर्भवितुमिच्छाम्ययार्थ्यावर्तेऽहमाश्रयन् ॥
translation: इस कारण देवतागण की तो बात ही क्या है मैं भी अवतारविग्रह को धारण करके आर्यावर्त में आविर्भूत होने की इच्छा रखता हूँ
english_translation: Why concern ourselves with the radiant beings? I too desire to take form and manifest in Aryavarta.
essence: A wish to embody and act overtakes concern with distant divine forms.
simple_meaning: The speaker expresses a wish to incarnate and appear in Aryavarta, questioning the importance of talking about divine beings.
insight: It reveals a shift from abstract talk to a desire for direct, tangible presence and action.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
मृत्युलोकस्य भूलोकान्तर्गतम्यास्ति विस्तृतिः ।
महती नात्र सन्देहस्तद्विभागश्चतुर्विधः ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! मृत्युलोक भूलोक के अन्तर्गत होने पर भी भूलोक का विस्तार अधिक है। भूलोक के चार विभाग हैं,
english_translation: O ancestors! Even within the mortal world, the realm of the earthly is vast. There is no doubt about it, and it is divided into four parts.
essence: The earthly realm is vast and divided into four distinct parts.
simple_meaning: The earthly world is very large and is divided into four regions.
insight: Recognize that your current environment is only a part of a much larger whole, broadening your perspective.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
एको वः पितृलोकोऽस्ति मृत्युलोको द्वितीयकः। 
प्रेतलोकस्तृतीयोऽस्ति चतुर्थो नरकाभिधः ॥
translation: यथा आपलोगों का पितृलोक, मृत्युलोक, प्रेतलोक और नरकलोक
english_translation: There are four worlds for beings: the ancestors' world, the mortal world, the ghost world, and the realm called lower realm.
essence: Beings exist in four distinct realms beyond just the living world.
simple_meaning: There exist four realms where beings reside: the ancestors' realm, the realm of living beings, the realm of spirits, and the lower realm.
insight: Recognize that experience and existence extend beyond just the physical world you see.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
भूलोके भवतामेत्र लोकः स्वर्गः सुखपदः ।
वस्तुता नात्र सन्देहो विधातव्यः स्वधाभुजः : ॥
translation: वस्तुतः हे पितृगण ! आपलोगों का लोक ही भूलोक में सुख प्रद स्वर्गलोक है।
english_translation: For you ancestors, this world of mortals is truly a blissful higher realm.
essence: The mortal world is the joyful higher realm for ancestors.
simple_meaning: This mortal world is a happy higher realm for you ancestors, with no doubt about it.
insight: Recognize that realms and experiences are relative to perspective and role, shaping how we honor others.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
कर्मभूर्मत्युलोकोऽस्ति कर्मक्षेत्रञ्च यं जगुः ।
प्रेतलोकस्तथैव स्तो लोकोऽपि नरकाभिधः ॥
translation: मृत्युलोक, कर्मभूमि है जिसको कर्म क्षेत्र कहते हैं और प्रेतलोक और नरकलोक
english_translation: The world of the living is called the field of action; similarly, the world of the departed and the lower realm are also worlds.
essence: Life, death, and lower realms are all different worlds of experience.
simple_meaning: The living world is where actions happen, called the field of action; the departed and lower realms are also considered worlds.
insight: It clarifies that life and afterlife are seen as connected realms, expanding our view of existence.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
दुःखदावानलबालापूरितौ भीषणावलम।
प्रेतलोकोऽस्ति संश्लिष्टो मृत्युलोकेन सर्वथा ॥
translation: घोर दुःख-दावानल से पूर्ण लोक हैं । वस्तुत: प्रेतलोक तो मृत्युलोक से ही सर्वथा संश्लिष्ट  है
english_translation: The realm of restless spirits is filled with fierce fires of suffering; it is completely intertwined with the world of the dead.
essence: The realm of restless spirits burns in suffering and is inseparable from death.
simple_meaning: The spirit realm is full of terrible suffering and is completely connected with the world of the dead.
insight: Recognize that suffering tied to death and separation is a state to transcend, not a permanent reality.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
भुवर्लोकादयोऽन्ये वो लोकादूर्द्धवमवस्थिताः । 
अस्यतश्चोर्द्धवलोकानामधोलोकव्रजस्य च ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! भुवर्लोक आदि अन्य लोक आपके लोक से परें स्थित हैं इसी कारण उन ऊर्द्ध लोकों तथा अधोलोकों के
english_translation: O ancestors! The worlds like Bhuvarloka and others are situated beyond your world; thus, those higher and lower worlds exist separately.
essence: Multiple subtle worlds exist beyond the familiar realm, both above and below.
simple_meaning: Worlds like Bhuvarloka lie beyond your world, with higher and lower realms existing separately.
insight: It opens perspective beyond immediate surroundings to a broader cosmic order.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
वैलक्षण्येन सार्ध वः सम्यक् परिचयो न हि ।
यद्यप्यस्याञ्चतुर्लोक्यां धर्मराजानुशासनम् ॥
translation: वैचित्र्य के साथ आपलोगों का विशेषरूप से परिचय नहीं है । हे पितृगण ! यद्यपि धर्मराज का अनुशासन इन चारों लोकों में
english_translation: You do not have a clear understanding, especially concerning difference. O ancestors, though the discipline of Dharma Raja exists in all four worlds.
essence: Lacking clear understanding of difference blocks deeper insight, despite universal order.
simple_meaning: You do not fully understand the nature of difference, even though the discipline of Dharma Raja is present everywhere.
insight: It shows how incomplete understanding limits perception, even when principles are widely accepted.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
वरीवर्त्येव विस्तीर्णं नास्ति कोऽप्यत्र संशयः।
दृढ़ कुर्यात चेदयत्नं पितरो यूयमन्वहम् ॥
translation: विस्तृत है इसमें सन्देह नहीं परन्तु आपलोग यदि दृढ़ प्रयत्न करें तो बिना
english_translation: There is no doubt that this path is vast; if you make a strong effort, ancestors will follow you.
essence: Strong effort on a vast path invites the support of those who came before.
simple_meaning: The path to progress is broad and clear; if you try your best, those who came before will support your journey.
insight: It teaches you to trust that steady effort builds a bridge beyond just yourself, linking past and present.
modern_relevance: You face a big challenge and wonder if your efforts matter. Taking strong steps connects you to those who paved the way.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
यमदण्डस्य साहाय्यमन्तरेणैव तह्यीलम् ।
कृतार्था भवितुं स्रष्टेः सामञ्जस्यस्य रक्षणे ॥
translation: यमदण्ड की सहायता के लिये ही सृष्टि के सामज की सुरक्षा कृत कार्य हो सकते हैं
english_translation: The support of Yama's staff alone ensures that the created world's harmony is preserved and actions bear their due effect.
essence: Meaningful results arise only when justice supports the harmony of creation.
simple_meaning: The world’s harmony and the meaningful result of actions depend on the support of justice, symbolized by Yama's staff.
insight: It teaches you to see your efforts as part of a just order that guarantees their rightful outcome.
modern_relevance: When you face consequences for your choices, know that fairness preserves balance in the larger system around you.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
दण्डेनैव प्रजाः सर्वाः कर्तुं धर्मपरायणाः।
यत्नो यद्यपि वर्तेत निस्सन्देहं शुभावहः ॥
translation: दण्ड के द्वारा प्रजा को धार्मिक बनाने का प्रयत्न तो शुभ ही है इसमें सन्देह नहीं
english_translation: Efforts to guide people toward dharma through discipline are surely beneficial.
essence: Discipline applied with effort reliably leads people toward their true purpose.
simple_meaning: Trying to guide people to live by their true purpose through discipline is helpful and positive.
insight: It teaches you to see discipline not as punishment but as a kind guide toward deeper purpose.
modern_relevance: You set clear boundaries with someone who resists good habits, knowing that steady discipline helps them find their way.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
किन्त्वहो येन यत्नेन प्रजाः सर्वाः कदाचन।
दण्डर्हा एवं नैव स्युः स यत्नो ज्ञानिसन्निधौ ॥
translation: तथापि यदि ऐसा प्रयत्न हो कि प्रजा, दण्डार्हा  बने ही नहीं तो ऐसा प्रयत्न प्रजा कल्याण के लिये
english_translation: If effort is made so that the people never become deserving of punishment, such effort truly benefits them.
essence: The best effort prevents others from becoming harmful or blameworthy.
simple_meaning: Effort is truly good when it prevents people from becoming harmful or deserving punishment.
insight: Shift focus from reacting to harm to preventing conditions that cause harm.
modern_relevance: You intervene early to prevent a conflict at work, sparing everyone from fallout later.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
प्रजाकल्याणरद्धयर्थमधिकं स्यात्सुखप्रदः।
नास्ति कोऽप्यत्र सन्देहः सत्यमेतद्ब्रव्रीमि वः ॥
translation: दण्ड की अपेक्षा अधिक कल्याणप्रद ज्ञानियों के निकट समझा जाता है ! इसमें कोई सन्देह नहीं है आपलोगो से सत्य कहता हूँ
english_translation: Knowledge that brings welfare to all beings is superior to punishment; there is no doubt in this, I speak truth to you.
essence: Wisdom that promotes welfare is more powerful and certain than punishment.
simple_meaning: Helping others through wise knowledge is better than causing harm by punishment. This truth is certain.
insight: It shifts your approach from enforcing consequences to fostering positive growth through wisdom.
modern_relevance: You face a tough choice—correct harshly or guide with understanding. Choosing helpful knowledge leads to true progress.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
मृत्युलोकाधिकारोऽस्ति सर्वलोकहितप्रद:।
यतो देवासुरैः सर्वे: पितरः ! कर्मभूमितः ॥
translation: हे पितृगण! मृत्युलोक का अधिकार सर्वलोक हितकर है क्योंकि देवत और असुर सभी कर्मभूमि
english_translation: O ancestors! The mortal world belongs to all because devas and asuras alike are bound by the field of action for the welfare of all worlds.
essence: All beings share the mortal world through their actions for universal welfare.
simple_meaning: The mortal world is shared by everyone because all divine and shadow beings act here for the good of all.
