insight: It shifts perspective to see conflict and cooperation as parts of one shared field of action benefiting all.
modern_relevance: In any community, opposing groups still share responsibilities and contribute to the collective wellbeing.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
मानवाल्लोकतो गत्वा प्राप्यन्ते चोक्तयोनयः।
भोगावसानने जाते पाते तेषां स्वलोकतः ॥
translation: मनुष्यलोक से ही जाकर उक्त योनियो को प्राप्त करते हैं। और उनके भोगावसाना से पतन होने पर
english_translation: After leaving the human world, beings attain the states described, and when their pleasures end, they fall from their realms.
essence: Pleasurable states beyond the human world are temporary and end in decline.
simple_meaning: After humans die, their beings move to other states described here, but when their enjoyment ends, they fall from those states.
insight: It shows the impermanence of pleasurable states and the cycle of rise and fall beyond human life.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
भूयोऽप्यभ्युदयं प्राप्तुं मृत्युलोकोऽयमेव वै ।
भवेदाश्रयणीयो हि सर्वथैव न संशयः ॥
translation: पुनः उनको अभ्युदय प्राप्ति के लिये मनुष्यलोक का ही सर्वथा आश्रय ग्रहण करना पड़ता है
english_translation: To rise again, the world of mortals alone must always be relied upon without doubt.
essence: Renewal depends inevitably on fully embracing the mortal world again without doubt.
simple_meaning: To achieve another rise or success, one must always depend fully on the mortal world without any doubt.
insight: It shifts your view to see the mortal world as a necessary foundation for new beginnings rather than an obstacle.
modern_relevance: After a failure or loss, you realize that recovery always requires facing the reality around you, not escaping it.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अस्त्यङ्ग प्रेतलोकस्तु मृत्युलोकस्य निश्चितम् ।
मृत्युलोकेन सम्बद्धौ लोकौ च द्विविधौ परौ ॥
translation: प्रेतलोक तो मृत्युलोक का अंग रूप ही है और मृत्युलोक से सम्बन्धयुक्त अन्य दोनों
english_translation: The realm of departed spirits is indeed a part of the mortal world, and the two worlds connected with the mortal world are distinct and separate.
essence: Some connected worlds remain distinct parts within the mortal realm’s domain.
simple_meaning: The realm of departed spirits is a part of the mortal world, connected but distinct from other worlds related to it.
insight: Recognize that connected experiences or realities can still be distinctly different in nature or impact.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
उर्द्ध्वाध: संस्थितौ पितनरकाख्यौ यथाक्रमम् ।
आश्रये मृत्युलोकस्य संस्थितौ नात्र संशयः ॥
translation: अधः उद्धर्व लोक जो यथाक्रम नरकलोक और पितृलोक नाम से अभिहित होते हैं वह सब
english_translation: The lower and higher worlds, called the realm of the dead and the realm of ancestors, exist in their proper order without doubt.
essence: The cosmos holds distinct worlds arranged without doubt or confusion.
simple_meaning: The lower and higher worlds, named the realm of ancestors and the realm of the dead, are established in a definite order beyond doubt.
insight: It shows that the universe is seen as organized with distinct realms, inviting respect for natural order and cycles.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
आसाते खलु तो यस्मादभोगलोकावुभावपि । 
मृत्युलोकव्यवस्थातो जायन्तेऽतः स्वधाभुज: ! ॥
translation: मृत्युलोक के आधार पर ही स्थित है क्योंकि वह सब भोगलोक ही हैं। इस कारण हे पितृगण !
english_translation: Everything in the worlds of experience arises because the realm of death forms their basis, O ancestors.
essence: All experienced worlds arise from the foundation of mortality and impermanence.
simple_meaning: The worlds of experience exist because they depend on the realm of death as their foundation.
insight: It reveals that all worldly pleasures depend on the cycle of birth and death and are therefore impermanent.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
स्वतो व्यवस्थितानीह भुवनानि चतुर्दश ।
पूर्णधर्मस्वरूपस्य विकाशेन निरन्तरम् ॥
translation: मृत्युलोक की सुव्यवस्था होने से चतुर्दश भुवनों की सुव्यवस्था स्वतः ही हुआ करती है और धर्म के पूर्ण स्वरूप के विकास के द्वारा
english_translation: With the well-established order in the mortal realm, the fourteen worlds are naturally arranged through the continuous unfolding of complete dharma.
essence: Order in the mortal realm naturally sustains harmony across all fourteen worlds.
simple_meaning: The fourteen worlds remain organized naturally because the mortal realm is well ordered and complete dharma unfolds continuously.
insight: It teaches that maintaining order in one area creates ripples of harmony beyond immediate surroundings.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
आत्मज्ञानप्रकाशस्य सहजं  स्थानमुत्तमम् ।
नन्वार्यावर्त एवास्ते कर्मभूमिर्न संशयः ॥
translation: आत्मज्ञान का प्रकाश होने का सहज स्थान तो कर्म भूमि आर्यावर्त ही है
english_translation: The natural place for the light of self-knowledge to shine is the field of action, Aryavarta without doubt.
essence: Self-knowledge naturally arises in the place where you engage in meaningful action.
simple_meaning: The best place for your self-understanding to naturally arise is where you act—your everyday duties and roles.
insight: It teaches you to see your present activities as the natural ground for awakening deeper wisdom.
modern_relevance: You finish a tough task at work and in that moment, your true clarity becomes clear—not in escape, but in action itself.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
पितरः ! साम्प्रतं वच्मि वैदिकं सारमत्र वः ।
सावधानैर्भवद्भिश्च श्रूयतां स शुभावहः ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! अब इस विषय में आपको वेद का सार मैं कहता हूँ सावधान होकर सुनो
english_translation: O ancestors! Now I speak to you the essence of the Vedas on this topic. Listen carefully with auspicious minds.
essence: Listening carefully is necessary to receive the essence of deep teachings.
simple_meaning: I am about to share the key message of the Vedas with you. Listen carefully and with good intention.
insight: It shifts your mind to be alert and open before receiving meaningful knowledge.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
वर्णाश्रमाणां धर्माणां भवेद्वीनं सुरक्षितम्।
पित्रोमिकयोनूनं शुद्धचा शोणितशुक्रयोः ॥
translation: धर्मपरायण माता पिता के रज वीर्य की शुद्धि के द्वारा वर्णाश्रम धर्म की बीज रक्षा होती है।
english_translation: The preservation of the roots of varna and ashrama dharmas depends on the purity of the vital fluids of dharma-focused parents.
essence: The roots of social duties depend on the purity of parental essence.
simple_meaning: The foundation of social and spiritual duties depends on the purity of the parents’ bodily essence.
insight: It highlights how our origins and inherited conditions influence the structures we uphold without our direct control.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
धर्मवर्णाश्रम सम्यक् पीठशुद्धिः स्वतो भवेत् ।
पीठशुद्धया स्वतश्चक्रशुद्धिकार्यञ्च सिध्यति ॥
translation: वर्णाश्रमधर्म के द्वारा पीठशुद्धि स्वतः ही प्राप्त होती है और पीठशुद्धि द्वारा चक्रशुद्धि का कार्य स्वतः ही सम्पादित हो जाता है
english_translation: By rightly following the duties of caste and stage of life, the seat is naturally purified; with the purified seat, the work of purifying the energy center automatically succeeds.
essence: Rightful living purifies your foundation, enabling effortless inner transformation.
simple_meaning: Following your true duties in life naturally purifies your inner foundation, which then enables deeper inner work to happen effortlessly.
insight: This shifts focus from forcing progress to trusting that rightful action creates natural inner purification and momentum.
modern_relevance: When you commit to your responsibilities authentically, your inner stability strengthens, making deeper personal growth easier and more natural.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
यावती चक्रशुद्धिः स्यात्तावती वः प्रसन्नता ।
प्रसीदन्नि प्रसादेन देवा वोऽभ्युदयं गताः ॥
translation: जितनी चक्रशुद्धि होती है उतने ही आपलोग प्रसन्न होते हैं, आपकी प्रसन्नता से देवतागण अभ्युदय को प्राप्त होकर प्रसन्न होते हैं
english_translation: The greater your clarity and purity of mind, the more joyful you become; your joy uplifts the radiant beings who prosper through your grace.
essence: Your clear joy uplifts radiant beings who prosper through your grace.
simple_meaning: When your mind is clear and pure, you feel more joyful. This joy positively affects higher beings who flourish because of your happiness.
insight: It teaches you to nurture clarity within, knowing that your joy influences your environment and those connected to you.
modern_relevance: After a moment of calm focus, you notice your mood lift, and others around you feel lighter too.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
देवप्रसादमासाध जनाः प्रारब्धशालिनः।
ऋषिप्रसन्नतां लब्ध्या भवेयुह्र्वात्मवेदिनः ॥
translation: दैवी प्रसन्नता लाभ करते हुए अन्तम प्रारब्धशाली मनुष्य ऋषियों की प्रसन्नता प्राप्त करके आत्मज्ञानी बन जाते हैं
english_translation: By gaining divine favor and the joy of sages, people become self-knowing and master their destined path.
essence: Self-knowledge blooms through divine favor and the joy of wise teachers.
simple_meaning: When you receive divine favor and the happiness that comes from wise sages, you become aware of your true self and can handle your life's course well.
insight: It teaches you to seek support from higher wisdom and inner guidance to navigate your path with awareness.
modern_relevance: You feel calm and confident after gaining support from a trusted mentor or a moment of clarity in your life.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
पूर्ण धर्मस्वरूपं हि शान्ते चित्ते प्रकाशते ।
योगिनां मम भक्तानामात्मज्ञानां महात्मनाम् ॥
translation: और मेरे भक्त योगिराज. आत्मज्ञानी महापुरुष के शान्त हृदय में ही धर्म का पूर्ण स्वरूप प्रकट होता है
english_translation: The complete form of dharma shines clearly in the peaceful hearts of my devoted yogis who are great souls with self-knowledge.
essence: True dharma appears only in peaceful hearts of devoted, self-knowing yogis.
simple_meaning: The full truth of righteous living appears in the calm hearts of devoted yogis who know their true self deeply.
insight: It shifts your focus from external rules to inner peace as the source of true dharma.
modern_relevance: When you quiet your mind and deepen your self-understanding, your sense of right action becomes clear and steady.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
यस्यां मनुष्यजातो स्यात्पित्रोः पूजा यथार्थतः ।
ऋषीणां देवतानाञ्चावताराणां यथायथम् ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! जिस मनुष्यजाति में मातापिता की यथार्थ पूजा प्रचलित है, जिस जाति में ऋषि और देवताओं के अवतारों
english_translation: In a human lineage where true respect and worship of ancestors prevail, and where sages, deities, and their incarnations are duly honored.
essence: True honor for ancestors and sages sustains the sacred human lineage.
simple_meaning: When a human family truly honors their ancestors, sages, and divine incarnations properly.
insight: It shows the importance of honoring heritage and the roots that shape identity.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
मद्विभूत्यवताराणां स्यादाराधनमायलम् ।
यत्र सप्तविधानाञ्च वृद्धानाममलात्मनाम् ॥
translation: तथा मेरी विभूति और अवतारों की यथायोग्य आराधना  होती है और जिस मनुष्यजाति में सप्त प्रकार के वृद्धों की
english_translation: My manifestations and incarnations are worshipped appropriately, where seven kinds of elders with pure minds reside.
essence: Worship of divine forms depends on the presence of pure-minded elders.
simple_meaning: My forms and incarnations are worshipped properly where seven types of pure-minded elders exist.
insight: It teaches that genuine respect for the divine depends on the presence of mature, pure-hearted people.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
पूजा स्यात्सन्ततं सम्यक् सत्कारेण समन्विता ।
स्वयं संवर्दिता जातिरसौ संवर्द्धयेद्धि वः ॥
translation: नित्य सम्यक् पूजा होती है वह जाति स्वयं भी संवर्द्धित होकर आप लोगों को संवर्धित करती है
english_translation: Continuous respectful worship enriches itself and also enriches you.
essence: Respectful, continuous worship grows itself and enriches those who practice it.
simple_meaning: When you worship with steady respect, the practice grows stronger and so do you.
insight: It teaches you that devotion is reciprocal: your respect strengthens the practice, which in turn strengthens you.
modern_relevance: You keep returning to a daily ritual or habit with care, and both the habit and you grow stronger together.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
मिथः संवर्द्धनेनैवं स्याच्छ्रेयः परमं हितम् ।
प्रसीदन्ति भवन्तो हि मर्त्यजातौ तु यत्र वै ॥
translation: और इसी प्रकार परस्पर संवर्द्धन द्वारा परम श्रेय उत्पन्न होता है। जिस मनुष्यजाति पर आपलोग प्रसन्न होते हो
english_translation: Supreme good arises from mutual support; where you, among humans, are pleased.
essence: The highest good grows where people nurture and support one another.
simple_meaning: The greatest benefit comes when people nurture and support each other, creating happiness and well-being.
insight: It shifts your view from isolated effort to shared support as the source of true benefit.
modern_relevance: You notice how your day brightens when colleagues truly back each other up instead of competing.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
सैव स्वास्थ्य तथा वीर्य सदाचारं पवित्रताम् ।
लभते नात्र सन्देहस्तूर्णं पूर्ण सुखं ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: वह जाति अवश्य ही शीघ्र स्वास्थ्य,वीर्य, पवित्रता और आचार को लाभ करती है
english_translation: That community certainly quickly attains health, vigor, purity, and good conduct without doubt, leading to complete and lasting happiness.
essence: Health, strength, purity, and good conduct quickly produce steady happiness without doubt.
simple_meaning: A community that embraces health, strength, purity, and good conduct quickly experiences lasting happiness.
insight: It teaches you to link physical wellbeing and ethical behavior as foundations for lasting happiness.
modern_relevance: You notice how your energy and habits affect your mood—when you care for yourself, happiness feels solid and lasting.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
यस्यां जातौ गुणाः स्वच्छा उत्पद्यन्तेऽखिला अमी।
दैवानुकूल्यमाप्नोति सा जातिः शाश्वतीः समाः ॥
translation: और जिस जाति में ये सब उत्तम गुण उत्पन्न होते हैं वह बहुत दिनों तक दैवानुकूल्य प्राप्त करती है
english_translation: A community where all pure virtues arise enjoys long-lasting favor from the divine.
essence: Pure virtues in a community invite steady and enduring divine favor.
simple_meaning: A group or community that nurtures pure and good qualities receives long-lasting support from the divine.
insight: It teaches you to focus on cultivating pure virtues in your surroundings, as this invites lasting positive influence beyond your effort.
modern_relevance: You notice how teams or families that nurture kindness and integrity tend to receive ongoing support and trust from others around them.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
दैवानुकूल्यतो विद्याबलबुद्धिधनात्मिका।
नूनमासाद्यते शीघ्रं मम शक्तिश्चतुर्विधा ॥
translation: देवानुकूल्य में शीघ्र ही बल, बुद्धि, विद्या और धनरूपी चतुर्विधा मेरी शक्ति की प्राप्ति होती है
english_translation: With the favor of the radiant beings, my strength quickly manifests as fourfold power: strength, wisdom, knowledge, and wealth.
essence: Support from higher forces accelerates your growth in strength, wisdom, knowledge, and wealth.
simple_meaning: When you have support from higher forces, your power appears quickly as strength, wisdom, knowledge, and wealth.
insight: It teaches you to recognize and value the support systems that accelerate your development and multiply your power.
modern_relevance: You start a project with backing from trusted mentors and resources, and your confidence and skills grow rapidly.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
यच्च शक्तिलाभेन नन्नात्मज्ञानमूलिका । 
स्वाधीना मतिभादेति नान कश्चन संशयः ॥
translation: इन चतुः शक्तियों के प्राप्त करने से आत्मज्ञानमूलक स्वाधीन प्रतिभा का अवश्य उदय होता है
english_translation: By gaining these four powers, the self-reliant intellect rooted in self-knowledge surely arises.
essence: Gaining four powers makes your intellect self-reliant and rooted in true knowledge without doubt.
simple_meaning: When you acquire these four powers, your intellect becomes truly independent and based in self-knowledge.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate inner powers that make your mind naturally independent and doubt-free.
modern_relevance: When you master key skills and inner strengths, your mind gains the confidence to see clearly and decide without hesitation.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
स्वाधीना प्रतिभा जाति किलात्मज्ञानमूलिका ।
परमोदारधर्मस्य पूर्ण ज्ञानं नयत्यलम् ॥
translation: आत्मज्ञानमूलक स्वाधीन प्रतिभा से जाति में परमोदार धर्म के पूर्णज्ञान की प्राप्ति होती है
english_translation: Self-reliant insight rooted in the true self leads to complete knowledge of the supreme noble duty.
essence: Independent insight grounded in self-knowledge leads to full understanding of highest duty.
simple_meaning: When your understanding is independent and based on knowing your true self, you gain complete knowledge of your highest, noblest duty.
insight: It shifts your focus from external labels to inner wisdom as the source of knowing your highest duty.
modern_relevance: You trust your own clear understanding instead of following opinions, and that clarity reveals your deepest responsibilities.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
मलाः कारणत्वञ्च सर्वांग परिपूरितः ।
वहते नात्र सन्देहो धर्म एव सनातनः ॥
translation: और सर्वांगो से पूर्ण सनातन धर्म ही मुझको प्राप्त कराने का कारण बनता है
english_translation: The eternal dharma that fills all limbs is the cause by which I am sustained without doubt.
essence: Your complete being is sustained without doubt by your eternal purpose.
simple_meaning: Your eternal purpose, rooted in all aspects of your being, is what sustains and completes you without question.
insight: This verse shifts your focus from scattered uncertainty to the stable foundation of your eternal dharma.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by daily roles and pressures, recognizing a deeper, unshakable purpose can provide steady support and clarity.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
शाश्वतस्याहमेवास्मि सर्वलोकहितस्य हि ।
आत्मज्ञानप्रसादस्य दातुर्धर्मस्य निश्चितम् ॥
translation: मैं ही शाश्वत और, सर्व लोकहितकर तथा आत्मज्ञान के दातृरूपी धर्म के
english_translation: I alone am eternal, the benefactor of all worlds, and the giver of the dharma that grants self-knowledge.
essence: The true self is the eternal source of all welfare and self-knowledge.
simple_meaning: The speaker declares being eternal, caring for all beings, and the source of the dharma that enables knowing the true self.
insight: Recognize the presence of a steady, guiding principle behind all true knowledge and care.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
सर्वदा पितरो विज्ञाः ! प्रविष्ठास्थानमुत्तमम् ।
नैवात्र संशयः कार्यों विस्मयो वा कदाचन ॥
translation: प्रतिष्ठा का स्थान हूँ। हे विज्ञ पितृगण ! इसमें सन्देह अथवा विस्मय नहीं करना चाहिये
english_translation: I am the firm foundation. O wise ancestors, there should be no doubt or wonder about this.
essence: Being the ultimate foundation leaves no room for doubt or surprise.
simple_meaning: I am the supreme foundation; there should be no doubt or surprise about this truth.
insight: It encourages trust in your deepest foundation without hesitation or confusion.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अत्रैकोपनिषदृश्यमन्तिके वः स्वधाभुजः !।
गुह्यं प्रकाशयेऽसन्तमद्भुतं तत्मपश्यत ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! इस सम्बन्ध से मैं उपनिषद का एक अद्भुत रहस्यपूर्ण दृश्य आपके सामने प्रकट करता हूँ, देखो।
english_translation: O ancestors! Here I reveal a wondrous secret vision like an Upanishad, see it clearly.
essence: A profound secret vision like an Upanishad is about to be revealed.
simple_meaning: I am showing you, ancestors, a marvelous secret vision like an Upanishad to behold.
insight: It teaches the importance of openness to deep, hidden truths beyond ordinary perception.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
श्यामायाः प्रकृते स्तो द्वे रूपे परमाद्भुते ।
यतः सैव जड़ा जीवभूता चैतन्यमव्यपि ॥
translation: मेरी श्यामा प्रकृति के दो रूप है, वही जड़रूपा है और वही जीवभूता चेतनमयी है।
english_translation: The dark Shyama nature has two forms: one inert and the other conscious within living beings.
essence: Nature’s essence is both lifeless matter and conscious life, inseparable yet distinct.
simple_meaning: Nature, called Shyama, has two forms: lifeless matter and living consciousness. Both are aspects of the same ultimate reality.
insight: Recognize that your physical self and your conscious awareness are inseparable expressions of one fundamental nature.
modern_relevance: At times you feel like a fixed object, other times like a flowing awareness. Both are true parts of your existence.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अज्ञानपूर्णरूपेण जड़रूपं धरन्त्यसौ।
सृष्टिं प्रकाशयेच्छश्वनात्र कश्चन संशयः ॥
translation: वह अज्ञान पूर्ण रूप में जड़रूप धारण करके सदा सृष्टि को प्रकट करती है
english_translation: The supreme reality always manifests creation while assuming the form of ignorance and seeming inertness.
essence: Creation flows constantly through the divine appearing as ignorance and stillness.
simple_meaning: The supreme reality appears as ignorance and inertness but continuously brings forth the universe.
insight: It teaches you to see stillness and confusion as the creative ground, not as absence or failure.
modern_relevance: When you feel stuck or empty inside, remember that beneath that stillness, life is quietly unfolding and creating new possibilities.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
असौ चैतन्यपूर्णा च भूत्वा स्रोतस्विन्ती मम ।
स्वस्वरूपात्मके नित्यं पारावारे विशत्यहो ॥
translation: और चेतामयी स्रोतस्विनी होकर मेरे स्वस्वरूप पारावार में प्रवेश करती है
english_translation: And becoming fully conscious, the flowing stream enters my true self in the highest realm always.
essence: Consciousness flows like a stream into your true self’s highest realm without interruption.
simple_meaning: Your consciousness moves like a flowing stream, always entering and merging with your true self in the highest realm.
insight: It teaches you to see your consciousness as a continuous flow merging with your essential nature beyond the mind.
modern_relevance: In moments of deep focus or meditation, your awareness feels like a steady stream merging with your true being beyond distractions.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
सरिन्निर्गत्य चिद्रूपा सा महाद्रेज्रडात्मकात् ।
उद्विजे स्वेदजे चैवमण्डजे च जरायुजे ॥
translation: वह चिन्मयी नदी जड़मय महापर्वत सें निकलकर प्रथम उद्भिज्ज, तदनन्तर स्वेदज, तदनन्तर अण्डज, तदनन्तर जरायुज
english_translation: That conscious river, emerging from the great mountain of the primordial root, first arises as the solid, then as the fluid, then as the egg-born, and finally as the born from decay.
essence: Life progresses through stages from primal source to diverse birth forms naturally.
simple_meaning: A conscious river flows from the great primal mountain, manifesting first as solid, then fluid, then egg-born life, and finally as beings born from decay.
insight: It shows how complex life and forms naturally emerge through continuous transformation from a primal source.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सलील स्वातरूपेऽलं प्रवहन्ती स्वधाभुजः।
मर्त्यलोकाधित्यकायां निर्बाध व्रजति स्वयम् ॥
translation: नामधारी खाद में सरलता से बहती हुई मनुष्य लोकरूपी अधित्यका में पहुंचती है
english_translation: The stream, in its own form, flows effortlessly through the human world, reaching its destined place naturally.
essence: Natural forces flow effortlessly when following their true nature and path.
simple_meaning: A stream flows naturally and effortlessly through the human world to reach its destined place.
insight: It teaches you to trust natural flow rather than forcing outcomes against the current of life.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
तस्या अधित्यकाया हि निम्नस्थाश्चैकपार्श्वतः।
उपत्यका महत्यश्च विद्यन्ते गह्वरादयः ॥
translation: उस अधित्यका के नीचे महती उपत्यकाएं और गह्वर आदि विद्यमान हैं
english_translation: Beneath that sun-like body, vast valleys and caves exist on one side.
essence: A radiant form has vast valleys and caves beneath it on one side.
simple_meaning: Underneath the sun-like form, there are large valleys and caves on one side.
insight: It presents a vivid image that grounds the divine in a vast natural setting, preparing for deeper teachings.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
यत्र तस्याः पवित्रायास्तरङ्गिण्या जलं स्वतः ।
स्थाने स्थाने वहन्नित्यं निर्गच्छति स्वभावतः ॥
translation: जिनमें उस पवित्र तरंगिनी का जल स्थान स्थान पर स्वतः ही बह जाया करता है
english_translation: Wherever the pure flowing water naturally moves from its source to various places.
essence: True nature flows purely and effortlessly to its rightful place.
simple_meaning: Pure water flows naturally to various places without effort or obstruction, like your true nature expressing itself freely.
insight: It teaches you to trust your natural rhythm and allow your true nature to guide your actions without resistance.
modern_relevance: When you stop forcing things and let your true intentions flow, you find yourself moving naturally toward what matters.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अव्या हतञ्च नीरन्ध्रयाविच्छिन्नं निरापदम् ।
स्रोतस्तनितरां कृत्वा नदीधारां धरातले ॥
translation: हे पितृगण! उस स्रोत को अप्रतिहत, नीरन्ध्र और अविच्छिन्न रखकर नदी की धारा को धरातल पर
english_translation: O ancestors! Keep that source unbroken, without holes or interruptions, letting the river flow across the land.
essence: Protecting the source keeps the flow steady and safe across the land.
simple_meaning: Keep the source steady and pure, allowing the river to flow safely and continuously across the land.
insight: It highlights the importance of preserving the origin intact to sustain continuous flow and vitality.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
विधातुं सरलां सौम्यामष्ट बन्धाः स्वधाभुजः।
धर्मा वर्णाश्रमा एच निर्मिता नात्र संशयः ॥
translation: सरल रखने लिये वर्ण और आश्रम आठ बन्ध रखे गये हैं। इसमें सन्देह नहीं है
english_translation: To keep things simple and gentle, eight bonds of dharma—varnas and ashramas—were established without doubt.
essence: Simple, gentle dharma bonds were created to keep life clear and free of doubt.
simple_meaning: Life is made simple and gentle by following eight dharma bonds: the varnas and ashramas. This structure removes confusion.
insight: It shifts your view to see frameworks not as restrictions but as gentle guides simplifying complex life.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by life’s choices, clear, simple frameworks help you act with gentle confidence and fewer doubts.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
त्रिलोकपावनी दिव्या सा नदी सुगमं हितम् ।
पन्थानमवलम्व्यैव परमानन्दलब्धये ॥
translation: इसी कारण वह लौकिक त्रिलोकपावनी नदी सरल पथ को अवलम्बन करके
english_translation: That divine river, purifying the three worlds, follows an easy path to attain supreme bliss.
essence: Great transformation occurs by following a simple, beneficial path.
simple_meaning: A divine river that cleanses all three worlds follows an easy path to reach the highest joy.
insight: It teaches that choosing a simple, accessible path can lead to profound results without resistance.
modern_relevance: Imagine a challenging project that flows smoothly toward success because you chose a clear and simple approach, avoiding unnecessary complications.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
मयि नित्यं प्रकुर्वाणा प्रवेश राजतेतराम् ।
नैवात्र विस्मयः कार्यों भवद्भिः पितृपुङ्गवाः !॥
translation: मुझमें परमानन्द-प्राप्ति के हेतु प्रवेश करती है। हे पितृगण ! इसमें आपलोग विस्मित न होवें
english_translation: In me eternally performing, a divine bliss enters; O ancestors, do not be surprised by this.
essence: Divine bliss flows eternally within you; surprise is unnecessary.
simple_meaning: A divine bliss eternally flows within me; there is no reason to be surprised or confused about this.
insight: It invites you to trust the steady presence of joy within, easing resistance to your inner experience.
modern_relevance: You may feel inner joy arise unexpectedly—this verse reminds you not to be startled but to trust its natural presence.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
निर्जरा निखिलास्तस्यां नद्यामानन्दपूर्वकम् ।
सर्वदैवावगाहन्ते लभन्तेऽभ्युदयञ्च ते ॥
translation: देवतागण उस नदी में आनन्दपूर्वक अवगाहन करके अभ्युदय को प्राप्त होते हैं
english_translation: The radiant beings joyfully immerse themselves in that river and attain progress.
essence: Joyful immersion in a sacred flow brings advancement.
simple_meaning: Radiant beings happily immerse in the river and gain progress.
insight: This verse encourages experiencing joyful engagement to foster growth and progress.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
उभयोस्तटयोः तस्याः समासीना महर्षयः ।
ब्रह्मध्याने सदा मग्ना यान्ति निःश्रेयसं पदम् ॥
translation: और ऋषिगण उस नदी के दोनों तटो पर समासीन तथा ब्रह्मध्यान में मग्न होकर निःश्रेयस पद को प्राप्त होते हैं
english_translation: The great sages seated on both banks of that river, absorbed in meditation on the supreme reality, attain the highest good.
essence: Meditative absorption in the supreme reality brings the highest state of well-being.
simple_meaning: Great sages sit on both sides of the river, deeply immersed in meditation on the supreme reality, and reach the highest state of well-being.
insight: It shows that focused meditation on the deepest reality leads directly to the highest freedom and well-being.
modern_relevance: You find a quiet place and focus fully on what matters most; from that stillness comes your greatest peace and clarity.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
यूयं दाढर्याया बन्धानां तेषाञ्चैव निरन्तरम ।
रक्षितुं तान् प्रवर्तन्ते पार्श्वमेषामुपस्थिताः ॥
translation: आपलोग निरन्तर उन बन्धों को सुदृढ़ रखने के लिये उनके पास रहकर उनकी रक्षा करने में प्रवृत्त हों
english_translation: You all continuously engage in protecting those bonds by staying close to them.
essence: Consistent presence is the true protection for important bonds.
simple_meaning: You should stay close to important connections and consistently protect and support them.
insight: It teaches you to protect what matters by consistent presence and active care, not by occasional effort.
modern_relevance: You keep checking in on a friend going through hardship, knowing your steady presence helps more than words.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
भवतामत्र कार्ये च विश्वमङ्गलकारके।
सदाचारिद्विजाः सन्ति सत्यो नार्यः सहायिकाः ॥
translation: और आपके इस जगन मंगलकर शुभकार्य में सदाचारी ब्राह्मणगण और सती नारियाँ सहायक हैं
english_translation: In your auspicious work for the world, virtuous Brahmins and chaste women are supportive.
essence: Virtuous people support truly beneficial work for the world.
simple_meaning: Virtuous Brahmins and chaste women support your auspicious work for the welfare of the world.
insight: Recognize that noble actions often rely on the support of trustworthy, ethical people around you.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
तवापारकृपाराशेर्ज्ञानाधार ! जगद्गुरो ।
अस्माकं निखिलाः शङ्का निरस्ता नितरां विभो ! ॥
translation: हे ज्ञानाधार जगद्गुरो। हे विभो ! आप की अपार कृपा से हमारी सब शङ्काएँ दूर हुईं
english_translation: O foundation of wisdom, world teacher, by your boundless grace all our doubts are completely removed, O supreme lord!
essence: Boundless grace removes all doubts and brings clarity.
simple_meaning: Your endless grace has removed all our doubts completely.
insight: It shows the power of trust in a higher source to clear confusion and open the mind.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
देवराज्यरहस्यश्च श्रावं श्रावं दयानिधे ! ।
अस्माभिः परमोत्साहः समासादि न संशयः ॥
translation: और हे दयानिधे ! दैवीराज्य का रहस्य सुन सुनकर हमें परम उत्साह प्राप्त हुआ
english_translation: O treasure of compassion, by hearing the secret of divine sovereignty repeatedly, we have gained supreme enthusiasm without doubt.
essence: Repeated hearing of sacred truths creates unwavering enthusiasm and removes doubt.
simple_meaning: We have felt great excitement and confidence by repeatedly hearing the secret of divine rule.
insight: It shows how repeated exposure to profound truths builds eager confidence and dissolves hesitation.
modern_relevance: You find yourself energized and certain after hearing an inspiring talk or story several times.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
कृपयाऽऽध्यात्मिकं पुण्यं रहस्यं श्रावयाऽद्य नः ।
शास्त्रसङ्घे कथं नाथ ! वेदार्थमतिपादके ॥
translation: अब आप कृपा करके हमें पवित्र अध्यात्म-रहस्य सुनाइये और हे नाथ ! यह बताइये कि वेदार्थ प्रतिपादक शास्त्रों में
english_translation: Now please kindly reveal to us the sacred spiritual secret, O Lord, and explain how it is presented in the scriptures that convey the essence of the Vedas.
essence: There is a call to reveal the sacred spiritual secret within the scriptures.
simple_meaning: They respectfully ask the Lord to reveal a sacred spiritual secret and explain how it is taught in the scriptures that express the Vedas' meaning.
insight: It encourages sincere openness to receive hidden wisdom beyond surface knowledge.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
वैमत्सं वै वरीवर्त्ति नैकमत्ये च सत्यपि ।
धर्मस्याद्वैतरूपं स्यात्कथं वा हृदयङ्गमम् ॥
translation: मतभेद क्यों है और मतभेद रहते हुए धर्म का अद्वैतरूप कैसे हृदयङ्गम हो सकता है
english_translation: Why is there difference of opinion, and how can the non-dual nature of dharma be realized in the heart while differences remain?
essence: Unity of dharma can be realized in the heart even when opinions differ.
simple_meaning: People often have different opinions, yet it is possible to realize the unified truth behind all dharma in your heart.
insight: It shifts your mind to hold space for many views while seeking the unchanging essence beneath them.
modern_relevance: You scroll through endless opinions online, wondering how all these views can be true and if you can still trust your own inner compass.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text: सदाशिव उवाच ॥
translation: श्रीसदाशिव बोले
english_translation: Lord Sadashiva spoke.
essence: The supreme teacher begins to share his knowledge.
simple_meaning: Lord Sadashiva begins to speak.
insight: It signals the start of guidance from a wise teacher, inviting attention and readiness.
speaker: Sadashiva

verse_text:
श्यामाया नास्ति मच्छक्तेः कोऽपि भेदो मया सह । 
यतोऽव्यक्तदशायां सा मल्लीनैवाऽवतिष्ठते ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! मुझमें और मेरी शक्ति श्यामा में कोई भी भेद नहीं है, क्योंकि वह अव्यक्त दशा में मुझमें लीन रहती है
english_translation: O forefathers, there is no difference between me and my power Shyama, for she resides merged within me in the unmanifest state.
essence: The true self and its power are inseparably united, even when unmanifest.
simple_meaning: There is no difference between me and my power Shyama, because she exists merged with me in an unmanifest form.
insight: It helps you see that your inner strength and true self are not separate; what seems hidden is actually inseparable.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अद्य यां मत्पृथग्भूतां श्यामां मेऽड्के स्थितां पराम् ।
निरीक्षन्ते भवन्तोऽस्या व्यक्तावस्थाऽस्यसौ ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: जो आपलोग मुझसे अलग तथा मेरे अंक स्थित श्यामा को देख रहे हैं, यह उसकी व्यक्त अवस्था है।
english_translation: Those who see the dark form separate from me, situated in my hand, are witnessing its manifested state.
essence: Seeing something as separate misses its underlying, unchanging truth.
simple_meaning: When you look at the dark form in my hand as separate from me, you are only seeing its temporary, visible state.
insight: It teaches you to look beyond appearances and recognise what is constant beneath change.
modern_relevance: You notice a label or role someone carries but miss the deeper person beneath the surface.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अस्म्यहं सच्चिदानन्दाद्वैतज्ञानमयो विभुः ।
श्यामाया मन्न पार्थक्यं तदृशायां प्रतीयते ॥
translation: मैं सच्चिदानन्दमय और अद्वैत ज्ञान स्वरुप हूँ। उस दशा में  श्यामा का मुझसे पार्थक्य अनुभूत नहीं हो सकता है
english_translation: I am the embodiment of truth, consciousness, and bliss, filled with non-dual knowledge. In that state, the difference from Shyama cannot be perceived.
essence: Your true being is unified truth and bliss, beyond all perceived difference.
simple_meaning: You are the pure essence of truth, consciousness, and bliss, completely united without any division from Shyama.
insight: It shifts perception from seeing separateness to recognizing oneness beyond appearances.
modern_relevance: When you feel divided or separate from others, remember your true nature is whole and united beyond all distinctions.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
सद्भावं मे समाश्रिस यदाऽसौ प्रकृतिः परा ।
मकटीकर्तुमानन्दविलासं जीयमोहकम् ॥
translation: जब मेरी परा प्रकृति मेरे सत्भाव को आश्रय कर के जीवमुग्धकारी,
english_translation: When my supreme nature supports my true disposition, it creates a blissful play that captivates the living being.
essence: The supreme nature supports true disposition to create captivating blissful play.
simple_meaning: The supreme nature supports the true disposition and creates a captivating blissful play for the living being.
insight: It highlights how the supreme nature can shape experience through joyful, enchanting appearances.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
दृश्यमपञ्चसङ्घातस्वरूपं व्यक्तिमेत्यलम् ।
तदाऽहमेव चिद्भावमाश्रितः स्यां निरीक्षकः ॥
translation: दृश्य प्रपंच रुपी आनन्द-विलास को प्रकट करने के लिये व्यक्ता होती है तब मैं ही चित्भाव में स्थित रहकर ईक्षण करता हूँ।
english_translation: When the visible world of five elements appears, I remain established in pure awareness, observing it.
essence: You are the unmoving witness behind all changing appearances.
simple_meaning: You can stay rooted in pure awareness while watching the world of changing elements appear.
insight: It teaches you to identify as the observer, not the changing phenomena, creating inner distance and clarity.
modern_relevance: When distractions flood your mind, you can step back and simply watch thoughts and feelings without getting lost in them.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
प्रकृतेः पुरुषस्यापि सच्छृङ्गारात्मकं जगत् ।
तदेवोत्पद्यते नूनं पितरो नात्र संशयः ॥
translation: उसी समय हे पितृगण ! प्रकृति-पुरुष श्रंगारात्मक संसार उत्पन्न होता है,
english_translation: O ancestors, the world arises from the union of nature and pure awareness, like a love-filled creation.
essence: The world is a love-filled creation from the union of awareness and nature.
simple_meaning: The world comes into being as a beautiful creation formed from the interaction of the natural world and pure awareness.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing the world as separate parts to seeing it as a dynamic union of awareness and nature.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
मूलमाध्यात्मिकस्यास्ते रहस्यस्यैतदेव हि।
नात्र कश्चन सन्देहः कर्तव्यो विस्मयोऽथवा ॥
translation: यही अध्यात्मर हस्य का मूल है, इस में सन्देह अथवा विस्मय नहीं करना चाहिये
english_translation: This indeed is the root of that spiritual secret; there should be no doubt or wonder about it.
essence: The root of the spiritual secret is certain and beyond doubt.
simple_meaning: This is the fundamental truth behind the spiritual secret, so there should be no doubt or surprise about it.
insight: It teaches you to accept foundational spiritual truths firmly without skepticism or confusion.
modern_relevance: When you discover a core truth in your practice, trust it fully without second-guessing or surprise.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अविद्यारूपमाश्रिय प्रकृतिम निरन्तरम् ।
जीवत्वं सर्वभूतेभ्यः सम्प्रदत्ते स्वधाभुजः ! ॥
translation: मेरी प्रकृति ही हे पितृगण ! अविद्यारूप धारण करके सब जीवों को जीवत्व प्रदान करती है
english_translation: My nature, taking the form of deep confusion, continuously gives life to all beings through their own innate energy.
essence: Your true nature powers all life, even when it appears as deep confusion.
simple_meaning: Your natural being, even when hidden by confusion, continuously supports and energizes all living things.
insight: Recognize that your core being is active and sustaining life even when your awareness feels obscured by confusion.
modern_relevance: When your mind feels clouded and uncertain, remember your essential nature still supports and energizes your life and actions.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
भूयो विद्यास्वरूपं हि धृत्वा निःश्रेयसम्पदम् ।
प्रदत्ते सैव जीवेभ्यो नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥
translation: और पुनः मेरी प्रकृति ही विद्यारूप धारण करके जीवमुक्ति र्विधायिनी बनती है
english_translation: Again, my nature assumes the form of knowledge and grants liberation to living beings; no further action is needed here.
essence: True freedom comes directly from the knowledge your inner nature holds, requiring no external effort.
simple_meaning: Your true inner nature is knowledge that grants freedom to all beings, so no extra effort is required for liberation.
insight: It shifts your focus from seeking outside solutions to trusting the liberating power of your own inner knowledge.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by advice or methods to 'fix' yourself, remember the freedom you seek is already present within your understanding.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अहन्तु केवलज्ञानस्वरूपः प्रकृतोरिदम् ।
सृष्टिर्लीलाललामालं सनिरीक्षे मुहुर्मुहुः ॥
translation: मैं केवल ज्ञानस्वरूप होकर प्रकृति की यह सब सृष्टि लीला देखा करता हूँ
english_translation: I, as pure knowledge itself, repeatedly observe this entire creation of prakriti as a playful sport.
essence: Pure knowing watches the world as nature's endless playful creation.
simple_meaning: You are pure knowledge observing the natural world as a continuous playful creation.
insight: Shift from identifying with actions or results to simply observing the flow of events as pure awareness.
modern_relevance: When stress climbs, step back and watch your thoughts and surroundings as a playful show unfolding without needing control.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
श्यामा सानन्दमके मे समासीनैव सन्ततम् ।
विश्वलीलाललामेदं सलीलं वितनोत्यलम् ॥
translation: श्यामा मेरे ही अंक पर आनन्दपूर्वक आसीना रहकर संसार की इस विचित्र लीला को अनायास विस्तार करती है
english_translation: The dark one, sitting joyfully on my mark, effortlessly unfolds this wondrous play of the world.
essence: The divine presence joyfully unfolds the vast play of existence with effortless ease.
simple_meaning: The divine feminine joyfully rests within me and effortlessly reveals the vast, mysterious play of the universe.
insight: Recognize that the unfolding of life’s mysteries happens naturally through presence, not by forced control.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अस्य विश्वविलासस्य प्रकृत्या सहितस्य मे।
स्वरूपं हि यथातथ्यमात्मज्ञानेन दृश्यते ॥
translation: मेरे प्रकृति के सहित इस संसार विलास का यथार्थ स्वरूप आत्मज्ञान के द्वारा ही देखा जाता है
english_translation: The true nature of this universe's play, inseparable from my nature, is seen only through self-knowledge.
essence: Self-knowledge alone reveals the true inseparable nature of the universe and your being.
simple_meaning: The universe's unfolding is inseparable from the divine nature within, and its true form appears only when you know your true self.
insight: It invites you to shift from seeing external chaos to recognizing the underlying unity through self-awareness.
modern_relevance: When you deeply understand yourself, you stop seeing the world as separate and confusing, and start seeing it as connected and meaningful.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
ज्ञानिभक्तश्च यो मेऽलं द्रष्टुमेतद्यथार्थतः।
स एव धार्मिकोऽध्यात्मरहस्यज्ञो यथार्थतः ॥
translation: और जो मेरा ज्ञानी भक्त इसको यथार्थरूप में दर्शन करने में समर्थ होता है वही भाग्यवान् परमधार्मिक अध्यात्म रहस्य का यथार्थ
english_translation: The one who truly perceives me as the devoted knower is indeed the fortunate, the truly righteous knower of spiritual secrets.
essence: True spiritual insight arises only when wisdom and devotion unite in perception.
simple_meaning: The person who truly sees the divine as both wise and devoted understands the deepest spiritual truth and is truly fortunate.
insight: It teaches you to unite clear wisdom and heartfelt devotion to access profound spiritual insight.
modern_relevance: When you balance clear understanding with heartfelt devotion, you unlock deeper meaning and feel truly connected.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
मत्सायुज्यमवाप्नोति भाग्यवान्नात्र संशयः ।
मत्सायुज्यदशामेत्य लभते च कृतार्थताम् ॥
translation: ज्ञाता होकर मेरे सायुज्य को लाभ करके कृतार्थ हो जाता है  इस में सन्देह नहीं है
english_translation: A knower who attains union with me certainly becomes fulfilled; there is no doubt in this.
essence: Deep union with the divine inevitably brings complete fulfillment without doubt.
simple_meaning: If you truly connect with the divine, you become completely fulfilled without any doubt.
insight: It teaches you to trust that deep connection with the divine brings lasting fulfillment beyond doubt.
modern_relevance: When you open your heart and truly connect with what you trust deeply, a sense of completeness naturally arises.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
यथा सञ्चालकास्सन्ति भवन्तः पितरो ध्रुवम् ।
आधिभौतिकराज्यस्य देवाश्च निखिला यथा ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! जिस प्रकार आपलोग आधि भौतिक राज्य के चालक हो, जिस प्रकार देवतागण
english_translation: Just as ancestors are the steady rulers of the physical realm, so are all the deities.
essence: Ancestors and deities maintain steadfast control over their respective realms.
simple_meaning: Ancestors and deities each hold steady rulership over their respective realms, physical and divine.
insight: Recognize the presence of steady guidance and order beyond what you see physically.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
आधिदैविकराज्यस्य चालका अपि रक्षकाः ।
ऋषयोऽध्यात्मराज्यस्य, चालका रक्षकास्तथा ॥
translation: आधिदैविक राज्य के चालक और रक्षक हैं, उसी प्रकार ऋषिगण अध्यात्म-राज्य के चालक और रक्षक हैं
english_translation: The drivers and protectors of the higher natural realm are like the sages who guide and protect the realm of spirituality.
essence: Sages guide and protect the spiritual realm like forces govern the higher natural realm.
simple_meaning: Sages guide and protect the spiritual realm just as forces govern and protect the higher natural realm.
insight: It highlights the role of wise guidance in maintaining spiritual order beyond physical nature.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
स्वभावतो नियोज्येरन प्राणिनां सम्प्रवृत्तयः ।
चतुर्धा नात्र सन्देहो विद्यते विश्वभूतिदाः ! ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! जीव की प्रवृत्ति स्वभावतः चार प्रकार से नियोजित होती है, इसमें संदेह नहीं
english_translation: O ancestors! The natural tendencies of living beings are without doubt classifiable into four types.
essence: Living beings have four natural types of tendencies without any doubt.
simple_meaning: Living beings naturally have four distinct types of tendencies without any doubt.
insight: It encourages you to recognize natural patterns in behavior rather than seeing actions as arbitrary.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
प्रकृतिः शूद्रवर्णस्य दासी कामस्य सत्यलम्।
तमोधाराश्रिता शश्वज्जायते परिणामिनी ॥
translation: शूद्रप्रकृति काम की दासी होकर तम की धारा आश्रय करती हुई सदा परिणामिनी होती है।
english_translation: The nature of the lowest state is always the servant of desire, resting in the stream of darkness, and brings about consequences.
essence: Desire rooted in darkness traps the lowest nature in endless consequences.
simple_meaning: The lowest aspect of nature is always controlled by desire and darkness, leading to ongoing consequences.
insight: It teaches you to recognize how desire and ignorance trap you in unending cycles of cause and effect.
modern_relevance: When you give in to your darkest cravings, you often find yourself stuck repeating harmful patterns with lasting effects.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
प्रकृतिर्वैश्यवर्णस्य सत्यार्थनुचरी सदा ।
अस्मिन् प्रधानतो लोके जायते परिणामिनी ॥
translation: वैश्य प्रकृति प्रधानतः अर्थ की दासी होकर इस संसार मे परिणाम को प्राप्त होती है
english_translation: The natural disposition of the Vaishya class is always truthfulness in pursuing wealth, by which they achieve their results in the world.
essence: People succeed when following their natural truthful way of pursuing their goals.
simple_meaning: The Vaishya group is naturally inclined to honestly seek wealth, leading to their success in the world.
insight: It clarifies that different natural dispositions guide how people act and find success in their roles.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
क्षत्रिय प्रकृतिधर्मलक्ष्येणैव प्रधानतः ।
परिणामं किलाप्नोति पितरो नात्र संशयः ॥
translation: क्षत्रिय-प्रकृति प्रधानता धर्मलक्ष्य से ही परिणाम को प्राप्त होती है इसमें सन्देह नहीं है
english_translation: A warrior’s nature primarily leads to results aligned with their duty; there is no doubt about this.
essence: Results naturally follow when you act according to your true nature and duty.
simple_meaning: Each person’s natural role or nature leads them to certain outcomes tied to their duty without doubt.
insight: It shifts the mind to trust natural consequences arising from true purpose rather than forced control.
modern_relevance: When you stay true to your core strengths and responsibilities, the results you seek naturally unfold.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
ब्राह्मणप्रकृतिर्मुख्यं मोक्षलक्ष्य निरन्तरम् ।
निजायत्तं प्रकुर्वाणा नूनमग्रे सरेदिह ॥
translation: और ब्राह्मण-प्रकृति प्रधानतः मोक्ष को अपने लक्ष्याधीन रखकर इस विश्व में अग्रसर होती है।
english_translation: And the brahman nature primarily advances in this world with liberation as its constant goal.
essence: Your true self moves through life always aiming toward freedom.
simple_meaning: Your essential self naturally moves forward in life with freedom as its constant goal.
insight: It shifts your view to see your actions as expressions of an inner drive toward freedom, not just random efforts.
modern_relevance: You keep pushing ahead in your daily tasks, guided by a deeper desire for lasting freedom beyond temporary results.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
चातुर्वर्ण्यकधर्मस्य गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं परम् ।
रहस्यं पितरो नूनमेतदेवास्ति शाश्वतम् ॥
translation: हे पितृगण! यही चातुर्वर्ण्य धर्म का सनातन अति गुह्य रहस्य है
english_translation: O ancestors! This is the eternal, deepest secret of the fourfold dharma.
essence: The true nature of dharma holds a profound and eternal secret.
simple_meaning: The fourfold system of dharma has a profound, timeless secret known to the ancestors.
insight: It invites you to look beyond surface roles to the eternal principles beneath your life’s duties.
modern_relevance: You sense there is more to your role and purpose than common explanations reveal.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
धर्ममोक्षपरा एवाकृप्यन्ते तेजसा मम ।
या मे शक्तिः सदा जीवान् स्मार्क्षकपति माम्प्रति ॥
translation: धर्म और मोक्ष के लक्ष्य करनेवाले ही मेरे तेज से आकृष्ट होते है, क्योंकि मेरी जो शक्ति जीव को मेरी ओर आकृष्ट करती है
english_translation: Only those focused on dharma and freedom are drawn by my radiance, for my power always attracts the living being toward me.
essence: Focused pursuit of purpose naturally attracts the power that guides you closer.
simple_meaning: Only those aiming for their true purpose and inner freedom are naturally drawn by the divine power toward the teacher.
insight: It shifts your view from isolated effort to trusting that your focused intention magnetizes helpful forces.
modern_relevance: When you commit deeply to what matters, you notice opportunities and support naturally coming your way.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
तदेव तेजः सम्प्रोक्तं यतो वेदान्तपारगैः।
धर्ममोक्षात्मकं नित्यं स्वलक्ष्यं यः स्थिरीकृतम् ॥
translation: उसी को वेदान्तपारगों ने तेज कहा है। धर्म और मोक्ष को नित्य अपने लक्ष्य में रखनेवाले
english_translation: That radiance spoken of by the masters of Vedanta is the one who constantly holds dharma and freedom as their true aim.
essence: True radiance shines from unwavering focus on dharma and freedom as life’s purpose.
simple_meaning: True radiance arises when you consistently keep your purpose focused on dharma and inner freedom.
insight: It shifts your attention from fleeting goals to a steady commitment to dharma and inner freedom, stabilizing your actions.
modern_relevance: When your work or life feels scattered, remembering your core purpose—doing right and seeking freedom—keeps your energy clear and steady.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
पुण्यवन्तस्त एवाहो वाच्यास्तेजस्विनो ननु ।
स्वभावतः प्रसीदन्ति तेषु देवर्षयो ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: पुण्यात्मा तेजस्वी कहलाते हैं और उन पर देवताओं के तथा ऋषियों की स्वभावतः प्रसन्नता होती है, इसमें सन्देह नहीं है
english_translation: Those with virtuous nature and radiance are naturally pleasing to the deities and sages, without doubt.
essence: Virtue and inner radiance naturally attract the goodwill of higher beings.
simple_meaning: People with virtue and inner brightness naturally attract respect and goodwill from divine beings and wise sages.
insight: Recognize that cultivating virtue creates an effortless positive influence on your environment and relationships.
modern_relevance: When you act with genuine goodness and integrity, people around you naturally respond with respect and warmth.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अतोऽन्तःकरणेऽध्यात्मरहस्यस्य यथाक्रमम् ।
विकाशो जायते तेषां नान कार्या विचारणा ॥
translation: इसी कारण उनके अन्तःकरण में अध्यात्म रहस्य का क्रमविकास होता है और
english_translation: Therefore, within the inner being, the secret of spirituality unfolds in a precise order of development, not by random thoughts or actions.
essence: Spiritual secrets unfold naturally within the inner being in an ordered sequence.
simple_meaning: The inner self gradually reveals spiritual secrets in an orderly way, not through random actions or thoughts.
insight: It teaches you to trust the natural sequence of inner growth rather than forcing spiritual understanding.
modern_relevance: You sense your own growth unfolding step by step, not from rushing or random effort.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
ततस्ते सल्लभन्तेऽन्ते मत्सायुज्यमसंशयम् ।
नैवात्र विस्मयः कार्यों भवद्भिहें स्वधाभुजः ॥
translation: अन्त में वे निश्चय ही मेरे सायुज्य को प्राप्त कर लेते हैं; हे पितृगण ! इसमें विस्मय न करें
english_translation: In the end, they certainly attain union with me; O ancestral spirits, do not be surprised at this.
essence: Steadfast seekers inevitably unite with the divine; this outcome is certain.
simple_meaning: Those who follow the path ultimately unite with the divine presence; this is certain and not surprising.
insight: It reassures you that persistent spiritual effort leads to sure union with your true self, ending uncertainty.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
वर्तन्ते पितरो यानि भुवनानि चतुर्दश।
ऋषीणामधिकारोऽस्ति सर्वथाऽक्षुण्ण एष्वलम् ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! ऋषियों का अधिकार चतुर्दश भुवनों में सर्वथा अक्षरण है
english_translation: O ancestors! The sages' authority over the fourteen worlds is completely unbroken.
essence: Sages' authority across all worlds remains unbroken and continuous.
simple_meaning: The sages hold continuous and complete authority over the fourteen worlds, as declared to the ancestors.
insight: It shows the enduring influence of wisdom across multiple layers of existence, beyond immediate perception.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
यथा देवाधिकारो हि सर्वो सृष्टि समश्नुते ।
देवानुशासिता सा स्यादसुरैर्वाऽनुशासिता ॥
translation: जिस प्रकार देवताओं का अधिकार सम्पूर्ण सृष्टि में परिव्याप्त है। चाहे दैवी अनुशासन हो, चाहे आसुरी अनुशासन हो
english_translation: Just as the authority of the radiant beings pervades all creation, so all is governed either by divine order or by shadowy rule.
essence: All creation is governed by either radiant order or shadowy control.
simple_meaning: All of creation is governed by a higher authority, either by radiant beings or shadowy forces.
insight: Recognize that every situation arises under some form of order, guiding your response to it.
modern_relevance: You notice systems at work everywhere—some supportive, others disruptive—but all shaping what happens around you.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
ब्रह्माण्डपिण्डसञजुष्टां जङ्गमस्थावरात्मिकाम् ।
सम्पूर्णा ताम्पारव्याप्य दैवी शक्तिविराजते ॥
translation: ब्रह्माण्ड पिण्डात्मक और जड़ चेतनात्मक सब सृष्टि में दैवी शक्ति व्याप्त है, उसी प्रकार
english_translation: The divine power pervades all creation, both the cosmic whole and all moving and unmoving beings.
essence: Divine power completely fills both the universe and all beings within it.
simple_meaning: The divine energy fills everything that exists, including the entire universe and all living and non-living things.
insight: It shifts your view to see every object and being as infused with the same divine energy.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
ज्ञानराज्याधिदैवानामधिकारस्तथैव हि ।
अस्ति व्याप्तः किलषणां भुवनानि चतुर्दश ॥
translation: ज्ञान के अधिष्ठातृ देवता ऋषियों का अधिकार, चतुर्दश, भुवन में परिव्याप्त है
english_translation: The rulers of knowledge and the divine beings preside over the fourteen worlds, encompassing all beings.
essence: True knowledge and its guardians have authority over all worlds and beings.
simple_meaning: The divine beings who represent knowledge hold authority over all fourteen worlds, which include all beings.
insight: It shifts your view to see wisdom as a universal force, giving your learning and awareness greater meaning.
modern_relevance: When you realize deep knowledge influences every part of life, you feel less alone and more anchored in a larger whole.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
किन्तु तत्रैव पिण्डेऽलं तेषां कार्य प्रकाशते।
सम्पूर्णैः पञ्चकोषाणां विकाशैर्यः प्रपूरितः ॥
translation: परन्तु हे पितरों ! उनका कार्य उसी पिण्ड में प्रकट होता है जो पिण्ड पञ्चकोष के पूर्ण विकास से पूर्ण होकर
english_translation: But their work manifests in that very body which is fully developed by the complete expansion of the five sheaths.
essence: True work appears only when all five inner layers are fully developed within the body.
simple_meaning: True action or work arises from the body only when all five layers (sheaths) of being are fully developed within it.
insight: This teaching shifts your focus from external effort alone to nurturing complete inner development before expecting your work to manifest.
modern_relevance: You may feel stuck, waiting for the right moment; real growth and results come only when your whole being is ready inside.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
क्षेत्र ज्ञानविकाशस्य प्रजायेत स्वधाभुजः !।
नात्र कश्चन सन्देह ऋषीणां पूजनं ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: ज्ञान विकास का क्षेत्र बन जाता है। परन्तु इसमें सन्देह नहीं कि, ऋषिगण
english_translation: The field for the growth of knowledge arises within one's own self; there is no doubt that the sages are honored for this.
essence: True knowledge grows within your own self, honored by those who seek wisdom.
simple_meaning: Knowledge develops from within your own self, and it is certain that sages are respected for this inner growth.
insight: It teaches you to trust your inner self as the real place where wisdom unfolds, beyond outside validation.
modern_relevance: You realize that your personal growth and understanding come from within, not from external approval or sources.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
जायते निखिलेप्वेव भुवनेषु प्रतिक्षणम्।
प्रतिष्ठास्थानमास्ते मे यतो हि ज्ञानभूमयः ॥
translation: सब भुवनों में ही सदा पूजे जाते हैं। क्योंकि ज्ञान भूमियाँ ही मेरी प्रतिष्ठा का स्थान है
english_translation: In all worlds, the divine is always revered because the realms of knowledge are the true seat of its presence.
essence: True presence is rooted eternally in realms of knowledge, honored everywhere without fail.
simple_meaning: The divine is always honored everywhere because its true foundation exists in realms of knowledge.
insight: This shifts your focus from seeking external approval to cultivating knowledge as the lasting source of your true presence.
modern_relevance: When you are recognized at work or in life, it’s often because your knowledge and understanding form your true value and foundation.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
पितरो ज्ञानराज्यस्य विस्तीर्णस्य रहस्यकम् ।
अपूर्व भवतो वच्मि श्रूयतां सुसमाहितः ॥
translation: हे पितृगण! ज्ञानराज्य विस्तार का अपूर्व रहस्य मैं आप लोगों से कहता हूँ, ध्यान देकर सुनो
english_translation: O ancestors! I reveal to you the rare secret of the vast kingdom of wisdom; listen with full attention.
essence: A rare secret of vast wisdom requires full, concentrated listening.
simple_meaning: I address the ancestors to share a rare and profound secret about the vast realm of wisdom; listen carefully.
insight: It invites you to focus fully and prepare yourself to receive valuable knowledge beyond ordinary understanding.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
ममैवाध्यात्मिकज्ञानमूलिकाः शास्त्रराशयः ।
स्थूलान्नमयकोषेण सम्बन्धस्थापनक्षणे ॥
translation: मेरे अध्यात्मज्ञान-मूलक शास्त्रसमूह स्थूल अन्नमय कोष से सम्बन्ध रखने के समय
english_translation: My spiritual knowledge scriptures are rooted in the gross physical body at the time of establishing connection.
essence: Spiritual knowledge is initially linked to the physical body when establishing understanding.
simple_meaning: The scriptures of spiritual knowledge I offer are connected to the physical body when establishing a link.
insight: Recognize that spiritual teachings often start with the body’s experience before deeper understanding arises.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
स्थूलाक्षरमयै रूपैर्वर्तेरन् पुस्तकात्मकैः।
अत्र नानाविधैर्नूनं विश्वस्मिन् सम्मकाशिताः ॥
translation: इस संसार में अनेक प्रकार से प्रकाशित स्थूल अक्षरमय पुस्तकों के रूप में विद्यमान रहते हैं
english_translation: In this world, many kinds of gross, letter-based books exist, illuminating knowledge.
essence: Many visible, letter-based books exist to share knowledge in this world.
simple_meaning: Many kinds of physical books made from letters exist in the world, showing varied knowledge.
insight: Recognize that knowledge appears in many forms, often as physical texts that shape understanding.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
स्थूलपुस्तकपुंञ्जोऽयं यद्यप्यास्ते विनम्वरः ।
स्थूलाक्षरमयानाञ्च पुस्तकानां यथायथम् ॥
translation: यद्यपि स्थूल पुस्तक समूह नाशवान हैं और इस प्रकार के स्थूल अक्षरमय पुस्तक-समूह का
english_translation: Although this collection of physical books is perishable, the collection of physical letter-based books is likewise so.
essence: Physical books and their letters are perishable and not eternal.
simple_meaning: Physical books made of letters are perishable and will eventually decay like all material things.
insight: Recognize that external physical sources of knowledge are temporary and cannot hold ultimate truth.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
भवेतामीदृशां देशकालपात्रमभेदतः।
आविर्भारतिरोभावौ यथाकालं न संशयः ॥
translation: देश, काल और पात्र के प्रभेद से समय पर, आविर्भाव और तिरोभाव हुआ करता है,
english_translation: Manifestation and withdrawal happen according to place, time, and person without doubt.
essence: Manifestation and withdrawal follow place, time, and person without exception.
simple_meaning: Manifestation and disappearance happen naturally and depend on the place, time, and person involved.
insight: Accept that timing and context shape outcomes beyond your control, reducing frustration.
modern_relevance: You notice how opportunities or feelings arise and fade depending on where you are and who you are with, not on your will.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सूक्ष्मराज्ये तु शास्त्राणां नित्यसंस्थितिहेतवे ।
चतुर्विधानि वर्तन्ते पुस्तकान्यपराण्यपि ॥
translation: परन्तु सूक्ष्मराज्य में शास्त्रो की नित्य स्थिति रहने के लिये और भी चार प्रकार की  पुस्तके हैं।
english_translation: In the subtle realm, for the constant existence of the scriptures, there are four more types of books.
essence: Sacred knowledge endures through multiple subtle forms beyond visible texts.
simple_meaning: In the subtle realm, there exist four additional types of books that support the eternal presence of the scriptures.
insight: It invites you to recognize that knowledge and wisdom often have unseen layers sustaining them.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
ब्रह्माण्डपिण्डौ नादश्च विन्दुरक्षरमेव च ।
पञ्चप्रकारकाण्याहुः पुस्तकानि पुराविदः ॥
translation: इसी कारण पुस्तकों के पांच भेद हैं; यथा, ब्रह्माण्ड, पिण्ड, नाद, बिन्दु और अक्षरमय।
english_translation: That is why scholars say there are five categories of books: cosmos, individual, sound, point, and imperishable.
essence: Spiritual knowledge is classified into five distinct categories by wise scholars.
simple_meaning: Scholars classify sacred texts into five types: cosmos, individual, sound, point, and imperishable categories.
insight: Recognizing knowledge categories helps structure your learning and deepens comprehension.
modern_relevance: When you explore complex topics, sorting information into clear groups makes learning manageable and meaningful.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
श्रुतिर्नादे स्म्रितिर्विन्दौ ब्रह्माण्डे तन्त्रमेव च ।
पिण्डे च वैद्यकं शास्त्रमक्षरेऽन्यदुदाहृतम् ॥
translation: इन पांच प्रकार की पुस्तको का एक उदाहरण बताया जाता है। नादमयी पुस्तक का उदाहरण श्रुति है, बिन्दुमयी पुस्तक का उदाहरण स्मृति है, ब्रह्माण्ड मयी पुस्तक का उदाहरण तंत्र है, पिण्डमयी पुस्तक का उदाहरण वैद्यक शास्त्र है और इनसे अतिरिक्त पृथ्वी के अन्यान्य ग्रन्थ अक्षर मयी पुस्तक के उदाहरण हैं
english_translation: Five types of scriptures are exemplified: sound-based is Shruti, point-based is Smriti, cosmic-based is Tantra, body-based is Ayurveda, and beyond these, other earthly texts are considered letter-based.
essence: Sacred knowledge manifests in five symbolic forms representing distinct paths of wisdom.
simple_meaning: There are five kinds of scriptures symbolized by different forms: sound, point, cosmos, body, and letters representing various knowledge traditions.
insight: Recognize that wisdom comes through diverse mediums, each offering a unique doorway to deeper understanding.
modern_relevance: You encounter knowledge in many forms—from spoken words to written texts to holistic health—all shaping your understanding.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
नूनं ज्ञानस्य निसत्वान्नित्याः शास्त्रसमुच्चयाः।
एते पञ्चविधेष्वेषु कापि तिष्ठन्ति पुस्तके ॥
translation: ज्ञान नित्य होने के कारण नित्य शास्त्र समूह इन पुस्तको में से किसी पुस्तक में अवश्य विद्यमान रहते हैं
english_translation: Because wisdom is eternal, the eternal collections of scriptures surely exist in some of these five types of books.
essence: Eternal wisdom is preserved within specific collections of scripture across time.
simple_meaning: Eternal wisdom is always present within some of these five types of scripture collections.
insight: It helps you trust that deep, timeless wisdom is preserved and accessible through established sources.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
पञ्चप्रकारकं सर्व पुस्तकं प्रलयक्षणे ।
वेदेषु प्रविलीयैव भजते मां न संशयः ॥
translation: और प्रलयावस्था में भी ये पुस्तकसमूह वेद में लय होकर मुझको प्राप्त होते है।
english_translation: Even in the state of dissolution, these collections of scriptures merge into the Vedas and reach me without doubt.
essence: Spiritual knowledge transcends cosmic dissolution, remaining eternally accessible.
simple_meaning: These five types of scriptures merge into the Vedas at dissolution and reach Shiva without doubt.
insight: It shows that true knowledge transcends endings and continues beyond apparent loss.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
पञ्चभावप्रपन्नानां पुस्तकानां स्वधाभुजः ।
रक्षका ऋषयो नूनं विद्यन्ते च प्रकाशकाः ॥
translation: हे पितृगण! ऋषिगण ही इन पञ्चभावापन्न शास्त्रों के प्रकाशक और रक्षक हैं
english_translation: The sages are indeed the protectors and illuminators of the scriptures dedicated to the five elements.
essence: Sages protect and illuminate teachings rooted in the five fundamental elements.
simple_meaning: Sages are the protectors and teachers of the scriptures focused on the five fundamental elements.
insight: Recognize those who preserve and clarify deep knowledge as vital guides for understanding complex truths.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अध्यात्मज्ञानमास्ते हि विभक्तं सप्तभूमिषु ।
ऋषिशब्दे यतो ज्ञानभूमिज्ञानप्रकाशके ॥
translation: और अध्यात्मज्ञान सप्त भूमिक्षाओं में विभक्त होने के कारण उन ज्ञान भूमियों के ज्ञान के प्रकाशक ऋषियों के शब्दो में
english_translation: Spiritual knowledge is divided into seven levels, illuminated by the words of sages who reveal the knowledge of these planes.
essence: Spiritual knowledge unfolds across seven levels, each revealed by sage teachings.
simple_meaning: Spiritual knowledge is described as divided into seven distinct levels, each illuminated by the teachings of sages who reveal the understanding of these levels.
insight: Recognize that spiritual understanding unfolds progressively, guided by trusted teachers revealing deeper layers.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
भेदोऽवश्यं भवेदत्र संशयावसरः कुतः।
ऋषिप्रवर्तिते स्वच्छे निदिध्यासंवत्र्मनि ॥
translation: अवश्य भेद रहता है और ऋषियों के द्वारा प्रवर्ति निदिध्यासन-मार्ग के
english_translation: Difference is certainly present here; how can there be doubt when sages have established pure meditation on the true self?
essence: Apparent difference causes doubt, but deep meditation dispels that doubt.
simple_meaning: There is definitely difference, but when sages teach pure meditation on the true self, doubt about it disappears.
insight: It shifts your view from clinging to surface differences to trusting deeper insight from sustained meditation.
modern_relevance: You struggle with conflicting opinions, but when you focus inward deeply, the confusion about opposites begins to clear.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अधिकारप्रभेदाश्च सम्भवेयुर्न संशयः ।
ऋषीणां किन्तु लक्ष्येषु भेदो नास्ति कदाचन ॥
translation: अधिकारों में भी अवश्य भेद रहता है, परन्तु ऋषियों के लक्ष्य कदापि भेद नहीं रहता है
english_translation: There is certainly a difference in roles, but the goals of the sages never differ.
essence: Different roles do not change the single, shared goal of those seeking truth.
simple_meaning: People can have different duties, but their ultimate aims can be the same without conflict.
insight: It shifts how you see changing duties—not as distractions but as varied expressions of a stable purpose.
modern_relevance: At work or home, you juggle many roles, yet your core values and hopes remain constant beneath it all.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text: सिद्धान्तेषु स्वकीयेषु विनाऽभ्रान्ति स्वधाभुजः ।            स्वस्वपदर्शितज्ञानमार्गे वा केऽपि नेशते ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! अपने अपने सिद्धान्त मे और अपने अपने प्रदर्शित ज्ञानपथ मे अभ्रान्त हुए बिना कोई भी
english_translation: O ancestors! Without becoming confused in your own principles and the paths of knowledge you have shown, no one gets lost.
essence: Staying true to your clear knowledge prevents you from becoming lost or confused.
simple_meaning: If you stay committed to your own clear principles and knowledge path, you will not become confused or lost.
insight: It teaches you to trust your own discernment and not be swayed into confusion by others' opinions.
modern_relevance: When faced with conflicting advice or information, holding on to your clear values and understanding prevents overwhelm and confusion.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
ऋषीणां पदवीं पुण्यां परिलधुं कदाचन।
निश्चितं वित्त पितरो नात्र कश्चन संशयः ॥
translation: ऋषि पदवी को नहीं प्राप्त कर सकता। हे पितृगण ! इसको निश्चित जानो, इसमें संदेह नहीं है
english_translation: The exalted position of the sages cannot be attained by anyone; O ancestors, be certain of this without doubt.
essence: The honored rank of sages is unreachable by anyone else, no doubt.
simple_meaning: The honored status of sages is something no one can achieve; ancestors, be sure of this truth.
insight: Recognize and honor the exceptional spiritual attainments beyond common experience without trying to possess them.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
ऋषयो मन्त्रद्रष्टारः कथ्यन्ते नात्र संशयः ।
शब्दास्त एव मन्त्राः स्युर्ये मद्रूपप्रकाशकाः ॥
translation: मंत्र के द्रष्टा ऋषि कहते हैं। मेरे रूप का बतानेवाला जो शब्द है उसी को मन्त्र कहते हैं।
english_translation: The sages who perceive mantras say without doubt that the words revealing my form are the mantras.
essence: Mantras are words that reveal the form of the divine without doubt.
simple_meaning: Sages who see mantras say the words that reveal the divine form are called mantras.
insight: It teaches that language can act as a bridge revealing profound inner realities when deeply understood.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अतो ये शक्नुवन्तीह मन्त्रान् द्रष्टुं स्वधाभुजः!।
अहो मामपि ते द्रष्टुं क्षमन्ते नात्र संशयः ॥
translation: इस कारण जो मन्त्र को देख सकते हैं वह मुझे भी देख सकते हैं
english_translation: Therefore, those who can perceive the mantra can also perceive me without doubt.
essence: Grasping the inner meaning of the mantra reveals the divine without doubt.
simple_meaning: If you can understand the sacred mantra, you can also understand me without any doubt.
insight: It shifts your focus from external forms (mantra) to the essence they reveal (the divine).
modern_relevance: When you grasp the deeper meaning behind a symbol or teaching, you often connect directly to the source it points to.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
दुर्दमाया हि मांयायाः प्रभावांत्पितरो ध्रुवम् ।
यद्यपि स्वस्वरूपं मे वाङ्मनोबुद्धयगोचरम् ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! यद्यपि मेरी दुर्दमनीय माया के प्रभाव से मेरे वाक् मन और बुद्धि से अगोचर स्वस्वरूप
english_translation: O ancestors! Although my true nature is beyond the reach of speech, mind, and intellect due to the overwhelming power of my difficult-to-conquer illusion.
essence: The true self can be hidden beyond mind and speech by a powerful illusion.
simple_meaning: My true nature is hidden from speech, mind, and intellect because of the strong power of my difficult illusion.
insight: Recognize that some aspects of your true self are beyond normal thinking or speaking.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अथवा चिद्विलासस्य तस्य ज्ञानं यथार्थतः।
नानुभूतं भवेन्नूनं निखिलर्षयन्तरात्मनि ॥
translation: अथवा उसके चिद्विलास का ज्ञान सब ऋषियों को सम्यक् प्रकार से अनुभूत न होता हो
english_translation: Or the true understanding of his divine play is not fully experienced by all sages within their inner selves.
essence: The true depth of divine play escapes full experience even by all sages.
simple_meaning: Not all sages fully experience or understand the true nature of Shiva’s divine play within themselves.
insight: It opens the mind to accept that some truths are beyond even advanced understanding or direct experience.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
तथापि मन्त्रद्रष्टृत्वात्ते मजूज्ञानावबोधिनः।
भवेयुर्नात्र सन्देहः सत्यमेतब्रवीमि वः ॥
translation: परंन्तु वे मंत्रद्रष्टा होने से मेरे ज्ञान के ज्ञाता है, इसमें संदेह नहीं। यह मैं सत्य कहता हूँ।
english_translation: Yet, because he is the seer of the mantra, he is the knower of my knowledge, there is no doubt in this; I speak the truth to you.
essence: Direct perception of the mantra reveals complete knowledge without doubt.
simple_meaning: Because he has the power to see the mantra, he truly understands my knowledge without any doubt.
insight: Knowing deeply from direct perception removes uncertainty and brings clear understanding.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अतः परस्परं तेषां मतं नूनं स्वधाभुजः ।
मयथार्थस्वरूपस्य ज्ञाने नैव विभिद्यते ॥
translation: अतः मेरे यथार्थ स्वरूप के ज्ञान में उनके परस्पर यथार्थ रूप से मतभेद हो नहीं सकता है
english_translation: Therefore, in the true knowledge of my real nature, there can be no genuine disagreement among them.
essence: True knowledge of your real nature leaves no room for genuine disagreement.
simple_meaning: When you truly understand your real nature, there is no real conflict or disagreement in that knowledge.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that true understanding dissolves apparent contradictions and unites perspectives.
modern_relevance: In moments of inner clarity, you see beyond conflicting opinions and feel a deep sense of unity within yourself.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
पुरुषार्थाधिकाराणां भैदैहि ज्ञानभूमिषु ।
विरोध इव भासेत भूमिभेदैश्च केवलम् ॥
translation: केवल भूमिभेद, अधिकारभेद और पुरुषार्थभेद होने के कारण इन ज्ञान भूमियों में विरोधाभास प्रतीत होता है
english_translation: In fields of knowledge, conflicts appear only due to differences in perspectives, rights, and purposes.
essence: Conflicts in knowledge arise only from differing roles, aims, or viewpoints.
simple_meaning: Conflicts in knowledge arise only when different viewpoints, roles, or goals are mixed and misunderstood.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that disagreements often stem from differing contexts or aims, not from fundamental truth clashes.
modern_relevance: When people argue at work or online, often it's because they focus on different goals or roles, not because one side is entirely wrong.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
मत्तः पराङ्मुखा एव तत्त्वज्ञानावकण्टके।
पतन्यैवविध गर्ने विरोधभ्रमपङ्किले ॥
translation: मुझसे विमुख लोग ही तत्त्वज्ञान के पथ के कण्टक रूपी ऐसे विरोध और भ्रम से भरे हुए गड्ढे में पतित हुआ करते हैं
english_translation: Only those who turn away from me fall into obstacles and pits full of opposition and confusion on the path of true knowledge.
essence: Turning away from the divine leads to confusion and obstacles on the path to true knowledge.
simple_meaning: Only those who turn away from the divine fall into confusion and obstacles on the path of true knowledge.
insight: It teaches you to stay open and trusting toward the divine presence to avoid mental and spiritual pitfalls.
modern_relevance: When you ignore your inner guidance, you get caught in doubts and distractions that stall your growth.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
यथा पर्वतवास्तव्या मानवाः शिक्षयन्त्यहो।
स्वानुरूपां गति विज्ञाः ! समभूमिनिवासिनः ॥
translation: हे विज्ञो ! पर्वतवासी मनुष्य जिस प्रकार समतलवासी मनुष्यों के
english_translation: Just as mountain-dwellers teach those living on flat lands according to their ways, wise people understand the path suited to each.
essence: True wisdom adapts to each person's unique path and needs.
simple_meaning: Wisdom is about recognizing that different people need guidance suited to their unique situations.
insight: It teaches you to adapt your understanding and guidance to fit each person's unique context.
modern_relevance: You notice how advice from someone who truly understands your situation feels more helpful than generic suggestions.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
एकस्या ज्ञानभूमेश्च तथा दर्शनशासनम् ।
स्त्रीयां गति प्रशंसन्तो दूषयन्तश्च तद्गतिम् ॥
translation: चलने की शैली का दोष दर्शन करके अपनी गति की प्रशंसा करते हुए
english_translation: Some, seeing the path of knowledge and vision, praise their own way while criticizing that path.
essence: People often praise their own way while unfairly criticizing true wisdom paths.
simple_meaning: Some people look at the path of knowledge and insight but praise their own way while criticizing that path.
insight: It teaches you to recognize this bias and remain open to wisdom beyond your current approach.
modern_relevance: You might notice someone dismissing expert advice while praising their own method, even if it’s less effective.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
विज्ञानरीतिमन्यस्याः कचिद्विप्रतिपादयेत्।
नास्ति तत्खण्डनं कल्याः ! मतस्यान्यस्य निश्चितम् ॥
translation: पर्वत-आरोहण प्रणाली सिखाया करते हैं, ठीक उसी प्रकार एक ज्ञान भूमिका दर्शन दूसरी ज्ञानभूमि के दर्शन शास्त्रो की विज्ञान शैली का कदाचित् खण्डन करता है
english_translation: Just as a mountain climbing method is taught, similarly one knowledge foundation's view may refute another's scientific style, but no refutation exists for the supreme view.
essence: Some views may challenge others, but the supreme truth cannot be contradicted.
simple_meaning: Different ways of understanding may challenge each other, but the ultimate truth remains beyond all doubt or refutation.
insight: It shifts your mind to seek the ultimate, unshakable truth beyond temporary disagreements.
modern_relevance: You might hear conflicting expert opinions or methods, but some core truths stay steady beneath the noise.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अपि तु स्वमतस्यास्ति पोषकं सर्वथा यतः।
तत्खण्डनमतो भक्ता ज्ञानिनो मण्डनं विदुः ॥
translation: उसको मेरे ज्ञानो भक्त परमत का खण्डन नहीं समझते बल्कि स्वमत को पुष्टि समझते हैं
