english_translation: Even the wise do not see my knowledge as a denial of supreme devotion, but as a confirmation of their own views.
essence: True wisdom confirms, never denies, sincere devotion and personal inner truth.
simple_meaning: True wisdom does not reject devotion as wrong; instead, it supports and confirms each person’s sincere inner faith.
insight: It teaches you to see your devotion and your wisdom as complementary, not contradictory parts of your inner journey.
modern_relevance: When you deeply believe in something and also seek clear understanding, you realize both can coexist and strengthen each other, not clash.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
यदा सुकवयो नैशमाकाशं वर्णयन्त्यहो ।
दिवाकाशस्तदा नूनं स्वत एवावधीर्य्य्ते ॥
translation: कवि जब रात्रि के आकाश का वर्णन करता है तो स्वतः ही दिन के आकाश की निन्दा हो जाती है
english_translation: When poets describe the night sky, the day sky is naturally criticized without effort.
essence: Praising one thing naturally casts its opposite in a lesser light.
simple_meaning: When poets praise the night sky, the day sky automatically seems lesser without anyone trying.
insight: It reveals how comparisons create unspoken judgments, even when praise is sincere.
modern_relevance: You notice how complimenting a friend unintentionally makes someone else feel overlooked or less appreciated.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
दिवाकाशप्रशंसायां कृतायां कविभिः खलु ।
व्योम्नो नैशंस्य जायेत स्वत एव पराभवः ॥
translation: और जब वह दिन के आकाश का वर्णन करता है तो रात्रि के आकाश की निन्दा स्वतः ही हो जाती है,
english_translation: When poets praise the sky of day, criticism of the night sky naturally arises.
essence: Praising one aspect naturally invites criticism of its opposite.
simple_meaning: Praising the sky during the day naturally leads to criticizing the night sky.
insight: It shifts awareness to how praise can unintentionally create judgment of the opposite.
modern_relevance: You post a glowing review of a colleague, and others start pointing out their flaws without you saying a word.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
सप्तानां ज्ञानभूमीनां तथा दर्शनसप्तके।
निन्दकानि चं वाक्यानि स्तवकानि कचित् कचिद् ॥
translation: इसी प्रकार निन्दा स्तुति का सम्बन्ध इन सातो ज्ञानभूमियों के दर्शनशास्त्रोम कहीं कहीं
english_translation: Similarly, among the seven fields of knowledge and the seven systems of philosophy, there are also some statements of criticism and some of praise.
essence: All knowledge systems include both criticism and praise within their teachings.
simple_meaning: Among the seven knowledge fields and philosophical systems, there are some statements that criticize and some that praise.
insight: Recognize that every perspective includes both critique and appreciation, enriching understanding.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
लभ्यन्ते यैर्विमुह्यन्ति मानसान्यल्पमेधसाम् ।
नैवात्र विस्मयः कार्यों भवद्भिः पितृपुङ्गवाः ॥
translation: पाया जाता है, जिससे अल्पबुद्धियों का मन घबरा जाता है। हे पितृगण ! इसमें आपलोग विस्मय न करें
english_translation: That which confuses weak minds is not a cause for wonder for you, O noble ancestors.
essence: Not all confusion deserves your surprise—steady minds remain unaffected.
simple_meaning: You should not be surprised or disturbed by things that confuse those with limited understanding.
insight: It teaches you to recognize your steadiness when others are unsettled by confusion.
modern_relevance: When others around you panic or get confused by complex situations, you can stay calm and not be shaken.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
केवलं पितरो ज्ञानभूमिपार्थक्यतो ध्रुवम् ।
स्वरूपे चिन्मये तैर्न निरीक्ष्येऽहं पृथक् पृथक् ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! केवल ज्ञानभूमियों की पृथक्ता से ही मैं चिन्मय स्वरूप में उनको पृथक् पृथक् दिखाई पड़ता हूँ
english_translation: O forefathers! I appear separate to them only because of their limited knowledge; in reality, I am pure consciousness itself.
essence: Apparent separation arises only from limited knowledge; the true self is pure consciousness.
simple_meaning: You appear separate from pure consciousness only because your knowledge is limited. In truth, everything is of the same conscious nature.
insight: It shifts the mind from seeing division to recognizing underlying unity beyond appearances.
modern_relevance: When you feel isolated or different from others, it’s often your limited perspective, not the true nature of connection.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
पार्थक्याज्ञानभूमीनां तत्पार्थक्यं न तत्त्वतः।
यथा सोपानतो मर्त्य एकस्मादपरं क्रमांद ॥
translation: वह पृथक्ता ज्ञान भूमि के कारण है, तत्त्वतःनहीं है। जिस प्रकार मनुष्य एक सोपान के बाद दूसरा सोपान आरोहण करता हुआ
english_translation: Separation is due to ignorance of distinctions, not true reality; like climbing one step after another.
essence: Separation arises from ignorance, not from the true nature of reality.
simple_meaning: Separation exists only because of ignorance; in truth, everything is connected like steps in a ladder.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing separation as real to seeing it as a temporary, layered experience.
modern_relevance: When you feel divided from others or yourself, remember this feeling is like stepping—it arises from confusion, not from who you truly are.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
प्रासादस्य समारोहन पृष्ठमारोहति ध्रुवम् ।
शास्त्रासक्तास्तथा भक्ता लभन्ते सन्निधि मम ॥
translation: अन्त में छत पर चढ़ ही जाता है, उसी प्रकार शास्त्रनिरत मेरे भक्त मुझ तक पहुंच ही जाते हैं
english_translation: Just as one finally climbs to the roof, so too my devotees absorbed in scripture reach my presence surely.
essence: Steady devotion and study naturally lead to reaching the divine presence.
simple_meaning: Those who are devoted and focused on sacred teachings eventually reach the divine presence like climbing to a rooftop.
insight: It teaches you to trust that persistent devotion and learning naturally bring you closer to the divine presence.
modern_relevance: You keep returning to your studies or spiritual reading, even when it feels slow. Over time, this steady focus brings you deeper connection.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
शास्त्रान्तरमतानाञ्च भेदोऽप्येवं विबुध्यताम् ।
क्रियतां नात्र सन्देहो विस्मयो न विधीयताम् ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! शास्त्रान्तरो का मतभेद भी ऐसा ही जानिये, इसमें सन्देह या विस्मय न करिये
english_translation: O ancestors, understand that differences in other scriptures are similar; do not doubt or be amazed by them.
essence: Differences in scriptures should not cause doubt or astonishment.
simple_meaning: Differences in other scriptures are similar; do not be confused or surprised by them.
insight: It teaches you to accept variation in teachings without losing confidence or becoming unsettled.
modern_relevance: When you encounter conflicting advice online or in books, remember such differences are normal and don't need to shake your trust in your path.
speaker: Suta

verse_text: भावैराध्यात्मिकै: पूर्णः शास्त्रपुञ्जो यतोऽजनि । ऋतम्भराख्यबुद्धेश्चाधिकारिभेदलक्ष्यतः ॥
translation: मेरे अध्यात्मभाव से पूर्ण शास्त्र समूह ऋतम्भरा से उत्पन्न होने के कारण और अधिकारि भेद के लक्ष्य से
english_translation: The entire collection of scriptures, filled with spiritual meanings, arises from the truth and the aim of distinguishing the qualified.
essence: Scriptures emerge from spiritual truth to clarify different qualifications.
simple_meaning: The scriptures come from spiritual understanding and the purpose of clarifying who is qualified.
insight: Recognize that spiritual teachings arise from clear intentions and truths, not arbitrary ideas.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अतो यथार्थतो नास्ति गिधोऽमुष्य विरोधिता।
मत्याऽप्यनादिकां ब्रह्माश्रयीभूताश्च भूतिदाः! ॥
translation: कहे जाने के कारण इनका परस्पर यथार्थ विरोध नहीं है। वेदान्त शास्त्र ने माया को ब्रह्म की आश्रयभूता
english_translation: Therefore, truly, there is no real contradiction between them. Even illusion, which is dependent on the supreme reality, grants existence.
essence: Apparent contradictions vanish when you see that all depends on the supreme reality.
simple_meaning: Apparent conflicts or contradictions between truths do not really exist because everything, including illusion, depends on the supreme reality.
insight: This teaching shifts your view to see apparent opposites as expressions of one underlying reality.
modern_relevance: When you face conflicting ideas or feelings, you can find peace knowing these opposites are connected at a deeper level.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
मायां वैदान्तिकाः सान्तां मन्यन्ते जगतो यतः ।
असत्यत्वं प्रमातुं वै क्षमन्ते स्म न संशयः ॥
translation: अनादि मानकर भी सान्त माना है। इसी कारण यह शास्त्र जगत को मिथ्यारूप प्रमाणित कर सका है
english_translation: Philosophers consider the world as an illusion because they cannot accept its falsehood as real.
essence: The world feels real because you cannot accept its falsehood as true.
simple_meaning: People who study deep philosophy see the world as an illusion because they cannot truly accept that what appears real is actually false.
insight: It reveals why people cling to appearances—they cannot emotionally accept that the world might be unreal.
modern_relevance: You trust your senses so deeply that doubting the reality of what you see feels impossible, even when reason suggests otherwise.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
भक्तिशास्त्रे पुनर्दैवीमीमांसानामके हिते।
मायां तां ब्रह्मणः शक्ति मत्वा भक्तैः प्रकल्प्यते ॥
translation: एवं हे पितृगण ! दैवीमीमांसा रूपी उपासना काण्ड सम्बन्धीय भक्ति शास्त्र ने माया को ब्रह्मशक्ति मानकर
english_translation: Thus, O ancestors, the scripture of devotion considers the illusion as the power of Brahman and presents it to devotees.
essence: Devotion interprets illusion as the sacred power of the supreme reality.
simple_meaning: The teachings of devotion regard illusion not as mere falsehood but as the power of the supreme reality, explaining it to devotees as part of their practice.
insight: It teaches you to view difficult or confusing aspects of life as expressions of a divine power, transforming your relationship with them.
modern_relevance: When confusing or overwhelming experiences arise, you can reframe them as part of a greater power at work, easing resistance and opening your heart.
speaker: Suta

verse_text: अभिन्नत्वं तयोः कल्याः ! उभयोब्रह्ममाययोः ।         शक्तिशक्तिमनार्यस्मात् भेदाभाव: प्रसिध्यति ॥
translation: ब्रह्म और माया अभेद, बताया है; क्योंकि शक्ति और शक्तिमान में अभेद होना प्रसिद्ध है
english_translation: The supreme reality and illusion are ultimately not separate; the distinction between power and the powerful is also unreal.
essence: The supreme reality and its illusion are fundamentally one without real separation.
simple_meaning: The supreme reality (Brahman) and illusion (Maya) are not actually separate. Similarly, the power and the one who holds power are not two different things.
insight: This shifts your view from seeing yourself as fragmented to recognizing unity within your being and abilities.
modern_relevance: When you feel weak or powerless, remember that your true nature and your strength are not separate—they are one whole.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
लोके शक्तेर्यथा नास्ति भेदः शक्तिमता सह ।
ब्रह्मशक्तेस्तथा नास्ति भेदो वै ब्रह्मणा सह ॥
translation: जैसे मैं और मेरी शक्ति, ऐसा कहने में दोनों का अभेद सिद्ध होता है, ऐसे ही ब्रह्म और ब्रह्मशक्ति माया में अभेद है।
english_translation: Just as there is no difference between me and my power, similarly there is no difference between Brahman and its power, the veil of appearance.
essence: The supreme reality and its power are fundamentally one, not two separate things.
simple_meaning: The true self and its power are not separate; they are one and the same, like you and your own ability.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing power as external to recognizing it as an inseparable part of your true self.
modern_relevance: You often feel your abilities are separate from who you are, but this reminds you that your true self and your strength act as one.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text: यथा शक्तिमतः शक्तिस्तत्रैवाऽव्यक्ततां गता।               कदाचिद्व्यक्तिमापन्ना तत्पृथक्त्वेन भासते ॥
translation: जैसे शक्तिमान की शक्ति उसमें कभी अव्यक रहती है और कभी उससे प्रकाशित होकर अलग प्रतीत होती है
english_translation: Just as the power in the powerful sometimes remains unmanifest and sometimes appears separate as manifest,
essence: True power sometimes hides and sometimes appears separate, yet it remains the same.
simple_meaning: Power within you is sometimes hidden and sometimes shows itself as separate, but it is always the same power.
insight: It shifts your view from seeking constant visible power to trusting the underlying unseen energy within you.
modern_relevance: When you feel powerless or distant from your abilities, remember your true strength is always there, just sometimes unseen.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
तथैवोपासनाशास्त्रविधानेन स्वधाभुजः!।
सृष्टेर्दशायां द्वैतत्वं मुक्तावद्वैतता मता ॥
translation: उसी प्रकार उपासना-शास्त्र के अनुसार सृष्टिदशा में द्वैतवाद और मुक्ति दशा में अद्वैतवाद, दोनों ही सिद्ध होते हैं
english_translation: Similarly, according to the scriptures of worship, in the stage of creation duality is established, and in the stage of liberation non-duality is accepted.
essence: Creation shows separation, but true freedom reveals oneness beyond duality.
simple_meaning: During creation, everything appears as separate parts, but in liberation, all separation dissolves into oneness.
insight: It shifts your perspective from seeing life as divided to recognizing the whole beneath appearances.
modern_relevance: When facing conflict or division, you might feel separate and opposed, but deeper understanding shows how connection and unity underlie those differences.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
एतद्विज्ञानतो नूनमद्वैतद्वैतयोर्द्वयोः।
कश्चिद्विरोधो नैवास्त्युपासना सिद्धयति त्वलम् ॥
translation: सुतरां इस विज्ञान के अनुसार द्वैत और अद्वैतवाद का कोई भी विरोध नहीं हो सकता और उपासना की सर्वथा सिद्धि होती है
english_translation: According to this knowledge, there can be no contradiction between duality and non-duality; both paths lead to perfect devotion.
essence: Apparent opposites in spiritual views can harmonize, enabling complete devotion.
simple_meaning: True understanding shows that duality and non-duality do not contradict each other; both support complete devotion.
insight: It shifts your mind from seeing spiritual ideas as conflicting to embracing their complementary power in devotion.
modern_relevance: When you face opposing ideas or beliefs, recognizing their harmony can deepen your commitment instead of dividing your focus.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
तत्त्वजिज्ञासकः कल्याः ! एवमेव समन्वयः ।
साङ्ख्यादिदर्शनैः सार्द्ध वेदान्तस्य भवेदध्रुवम् ॥
translation: हे पितरो ! सांख्य आदि शास्त्रों के साथ वेदान्तशास्त्र का समन्वय भी इसी ढंग पर हो सकता है,
english_translation: O ancestors! The unity of Vedanta can also be established similarly along with the teachings of Sankhya and others.
essence: Vedanta’s truth aligns and unites with other philosophical systems like Sankhya.
simple_meaning: The unity of Vedanta can be understood clearly when combined with Sankhya and other philosophies.
insight: It encourages openness to integrating different perspectives for a clearer understanding of truth.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अतोऽयुक्तास्ति शास्त्रेषु विरोधस्यैव कल्पना।
तस्माद्भवाद्भिः शास्त्रेषु विरोधो नैव दृश्यताम् ॥
translation: इस कारण शास्त्रों में विरोध की कल्पना करना उचित नहीं है। इसलिये आप लोग शास्त्रो में विरोध न देखें
english_translation: Therefore, it is not appropriate to imagine contradiction in the scriptures. Hence, you all should not see contradiction in the scriptures.
essence: Apparent contradictions in scriptures arise from misunderstanding, not actual conflict.
simple_meaning: Imagining contradictions in the scriptures is not right because their true message is consistent and unified.
insight: It teaches you to look beyond surface differences to see underlying unity in teachings.
modern_relevance: When you read conflicting advice or ideas, remember that deeper understanding often reveals unity, not contradiction.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
ज्ञानस्य पितरो नूनं तिस्रः श्रेण्यो भवन्ति ।
तत्राधिभौतिक ज्ञानं शाखानन्त्यसमन्वितम् ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! ज्ञान की तीन श्रेणियां हैं, आधिभौतिक ज्ञान  अनन्त शाखा युक्त होकर
english_translation: O ancestors, there are indeed three categories of knowledge; among them is empirical knowledge, which has countless branches.
essence: Knowledge unfolds in three layers, one vast and endlessly branching.
simple_meaning: Knowledge divides into three types; one is empirical knowledge with countless branches covering the physical world.
insight: It teaches you to appreciate the vastness and complexity of knowledge beyond immediate understanding.
modern_relevance: You scroll through endless articles and videos, realizing no single source can capture all knowledge.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
आद्यं पदार्थविद्यायां परिणामं व्रजत्यलम् ।
नन्वाधिदैविकं ज्ञानं द्वितीयं पितरस्तथा ॥
translation: अनेकों पदार्थ विद्याओं में परिणत  हुआ है; वह प्रथम है। द्वितीय आधिदैविक ज्ञान भी
english_translation: The primal element transforms into many material sciences; that is the first. The second is the higher divine knowledge.
essence: Material knowledge is many; higher divine wisdom is distinct and comes second.
simple_meaning: There are many material sciences that study the world; this is the first kind of knowledge. But beyond that is a higher, divine knowledge that is second.
insight: It shifts your focus from accumulating external knowledge to seeking deeper, transformative understanding.
modern_relevance: You may master many skills or facts, but there is always a deeper wisdom about life that cannot be captured by facts alone.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अनेकाभिश्च शाखाभिरुपेतं विद्यते ध्रुवम्।
यतो दैवं जगन्नूनं विद्यतेऽतीब विस्तृतम् ॥
translation: बहुशाखायुक्त है क्योंकि दैवी जगत् भी अतिविस्तृत है और
english_translation: The supreme reality is steady and has many branches because the divine world is vast and expansive.
essence: The steady supreme reality expresses itself through many branches because the divine world is vast.
simple_meaning: The unchanging supreme reality has many forms because the divine world is extremely vast and diverse.
insight: It shifts the mind to see unity expressed through many diverse forms within the vast divine world.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
स्थूलसृष्टेस्तदेवास्ते कारणं पितरस्तथा ।
परन्त्वन्तिममध्यात्मज्ञानं वै सप्तभूमिषु ॥
translation: दैवजगत् ही स्थूल सृष्टि का कारण है; परन्तु अन्तिम अध्यात्मज्ञान केवल सात भूमियों में ही
english_translation: The cosmic world is the cause of gross creation; but ultimate spiritual knowledge exists only within the seven realms.
essence: True spiritual knowledge transcends the physical world and lives only within inner realms.
simple_meaning: The visible world causes all physical creation, but true spiritual understanding is found only in the deeper inner seven realms.
insight: It teaches you to look beyond surface reality and seek deeper inner wisdom in layers beneath perception.
modern_relevance: You notice how outer appearances shape your life, but the deepest truths and insights come from inner reflection and awareness.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
संविभक्तं वरीवर्त्ति केवलं नात्र संशयः।
तस्यानेकासु शाखामु विद्यमानास्वपि ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: विभक्त है इसमें संदेह नहीं है उसकी अनेक शाखाएँ होने पर भी सभी
english_translation: There is no doubt it divides; even though it has many branches, all are fixed and certain.
essence: Multiplicity can coexist with unchanging certainty beneath.
simple_meaning: It is certain that this divides and flows like water, and even though it has many branches, all are steady and fixed.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing confusion in diversity to recognizing certainty in underlying unity.
modern_relevance: When faced with complexity in life or work, it's reassuring to know that despite many paths, a steady truth underlies everything.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
विभक्ताः स्युश्च ताः सर्वाः सप्तस्वेव हि भूमिषु ।
तदैव ज्ञानमाध्यात्मं प्रपूर्णश्चैव जायते ॥
translation: सात भूमियों में ही विभक्त होती हैं और आध्यात्मिक ज्ञान की पूर्णता तभी होती है
english_translation: All are divided into seven realms of existence, and only then is spiritual wisdom complete.
essence: True spiritual wisdom is complete only by embracing all seven realms of existence.
simple_meaning: Spiritual wisdom becomes complete only when you understand the seven distinct realms of existence.
insight: It teaches you to expand your awareness beyond surface reality to grasp deeper spiritual dimensions.
modern_relevance: When you see only one side of a situation, your understanding feels incomplete; full insight comes from seeing all aspects involved.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
यदा सर्वेषु भूतेष्वविभक्तोऽद्वैत एककः।
ज्ञानदृष्ट्या निरीक्ष्येत भावो नूनं स्वधाभुजः ! ॥
translation: जब सभी भूतों में अविभक्त एक अद्वितीय भाव को ज्ञानदृष्टि से
english_translation: When the same undivided and unique essence is seen in all beings through the eye of wisdom, then the feeling of separateness surely dissolves.
essence: True wisdom dissolves the feeling of separateness by seeing all as one essence.
simple_meaning: Seeing all beings as one without division through wisdom dissolves the sense of separateness.
insight: It shifts your view from separation to unity, breaking down barriers in relationships and self-identity.
modern_relevance: When you stop dividing people into 'us' and 'them,' you experience deeper connection and less conflict in daily life.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
देशे काले च पात्रे च सर्वत्रैवात्मवेदिभिः।
न च कुत्रापि वाध्येत यदा तज्ज्ञानलोचनम् ॥
translation: सब देश कालपात्र में देखा जाए और कहीं वह ज्ञानदृष्टि बाधा को प्राप्त नहीं हो
english_translation: The vision of the true self is seen everywhere—in all places, times, and persons—and never meets obstruction anywhere.
essence: The vision of your true self is always accessible and never obstructed.
simple_meaning: The true self can be seen at all times, places, and in all beings without any obstruction.
insight: It teaches you that the knowledge of your true self is universally present and cannot be hindered.
modern_relevance: You realize that moments of clarity about who you really are can arise anytime, anywhere, without restriction or barrier.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
वेदसम्मतशास्त्रीया शैली सोपानसनिभा।
एतदाध्यात्मिकं ज्ञानं समुत्पाद्यैव प्राणिनः ॥
translation: वेदसम्मत शास्त्रीय सोपान शैली इसी अध्यात्म ज्ञान को उत्पन्न करके जीवों को
english_translation: The scriptural and systematic step-by-step method generates spiritual knowledge within beings.
essence: Spiritual knowledge grows naturally through a clear, stepwise, scriptural method.
simple_meaning: A clear, systematized approach based on scripture helps spiritual knowledge arise naturally within living beings.
insight: It shifts your mindset from expecting sudden insight to trusting a reliable, progressive path of learning.
modern_relevance: When learning something deep, like meditation or philosophy, a clear, gradual approach helps you build understanding without overwhelm.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
पितरः! मापयत्यन्ते मत्सायुज्यं न संशयः ।
मत्सायुज्यदशां नीत्वा कृतार्थत्वं नयत्यलम् ॥
translation: मत्सायुज्य प्राप्त कराती है और मेरे सायुज्य को प्राप्त कराकर कृतार्थ कर देती है ।
english_translation: Union with me grants ultimate fulfillment; attaining this union brings complete contentment.
essence: Complete fulfillment arises from union with the divine without any doubt.
simple_meaning: Joining fully with the divine brings you ultimate fulfillment and a deep sense of completion.
insight: It shifts focus from seeking external achievements to finding wholeness through inner union with the divine.
modern_relevance: When you feel restless or incomplete, remember that deep connection beyond the surface can bring lasting fulfillment.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
वैदिकानां हि शास्त्राणामेषैवास्ति अपूर्णता।
महत्त्वञ्चैतदेवास्ति तेषां नैवात्र संशयः ॥
translation: यही वैदिक शास्त्रो का अवश्य पूर्णत्व और महत्त्व है इसमें संदेह नहीं है
english_translation: There is no doubt that the Vedic scriptures are complete and important.
essence: The Vedic scriptures are unquestionably complete and important.
simple_meaning: The Vedic scriptures are complete and have unquestionable importance.
insight: It teaches you to trust the established foundation of ancient teachings as solid and important.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
नूनमाश्रमधर्मोऽपि ज्ञानस्यास्य सहायकः ।
उत्पादने वरीवर्त्ति परमः पितृपुङ्गवाः ! ॥
translation: और आश्रम धर्म इसी ज्ञान के उत्पन्न करने में परम सहायक है
english_translation: Indeed, the duties of the stages of life greatly assist the arising of wisdom; the noble ancestors follow this path.
essence: Wisdom naturally arises when you faithfully fulfill the duties of your life stage.
simple_meaning: Following the duties appropriate to each life stage helps your wisdom to develop naturally.
insight: It teaches you to honor each phase of life as essential for cultivating true wisdom.
modern_relevance: When you focus on what your current responsibilities call for, you create space for deeper understanding to arise in your life.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
ब्रह्मचर्याश्रमे नूनं गुरुसेवाविधानतः।
लक्ष्यमध्यात्मविद्याया लभ्यते ब्रह्मचारिभिः ॥
translation: ब्रह्मचर्याश्रम में ब्रह्मचारी आत्मविद्या के लक्ष्य को गुरुसेवा से प्राप्त करते हैं।
english_translation: In the stage of celibacy, those who practice self-discipline attain spiritual wisdom through service to the guru.
essence: Dedicated service in disciplined celibacy cultivates spiritual wisdom.
simple_meaning: You gain spiritual knowledge by living a disciplined life of celibacy and serving your teacher faithfully.
insight: It shifts your focus from seeking knowledge alone to embodying discipline and service as the path to wisdom.
modern_relevance: When you commit fully to learning from a mentor or guide, your focus and growth deepen beyond what you can achieve alone.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
लक्ष्यमात्मवलस्यापि गृहस्थैः संयमेन च ।
वानप्रस्थाश्रमस्थैश्च तपसाऽऽत्मधनं ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: गृहस्थाश्रमी आत्मबल के लक्ष्य को संयम के द्वारा प्राप्त करते हैं। वानप्रस्थाश्रमी आत्मधन को तप के द्वारा प्राप्त करते हैं ।
english_translation: Householders attain the goal of inner strength through self-restraint; forest-dwelling ascetics attain the wealth of the self through disciplined austerity.
essence: Inner strength grows by restraint; deeper self-wealth emerges through disciplined austerity.
simple_meaning: Householders gain inner strength through self-control, while ascetics deepen their inner wealth through disciplined austerity.
insight: It teaches you to meet your current capacity with self-restraint and expand inner resources through sustained discipline.
modern_relevance: You hold back impulses to stay steady through daily challenges, while deeper growth requires dedicated, disciplined practice beyond comfort zones.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
सन्यासिभिस्तु त्यागेनैवात्मधर्मोऽधिगम्यते।
सर्वेषां पुरुषार्थानां यदास्ते फलमन्तिमम् ॥
translation: और सन्यासाश्रमी आत्मधर्म को त्याग के द्वारा प्राप्त करते हैं। जो सब पुरुषार्थी का चरम फल है
english_translation: Renunciates attain the true self's purpose only through renunciation; this is the final fruit of all human aims.
essence: True purpose is found only by renouncing attachments; this is the highest human achievement.
simple_meaning: You can realize your true purpose only by giving up attachments; this letting go is the greatest achievement of all human efforts.
insight: It teaches you to shift focus from grabbing results to releasing attachments, revealing true purpose.
modern_relevance: When you stop clinging to outcomes or possessions, you often find clarity about what truly matters in life.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
वर्तते पितरोऽध्यात्मज्ञानस्याऽदः परम्पदम् ।
नात्र कश्चन सन्देहो विधेयो विस्मयोऽथवा ॥
translation: और अध्यात्मज्ञान का परमपद है। हे श्रेष्ठ पितृगण ! इसमे सन्देह या विस्मय न करना चाहिये
english_translation: And it is the supreme goal of spiritual knowledge. O noble ancestors! In this, there should be no doubt or wonder.
essence: The supreme aim of spiritual knowledge is certain and beyond doubt.
simple_meaning: The supreme goal of spiritual knowledge is certain and clear. There should be no doubt or surprise about it.
insight: It teaches you to trust the certainty of spiritual wisdom without hesitation or skepticism.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अतो मे ज्ञानिनो भक्ताः सन्न्यासाश्रमवर्तिनः ।
आत्मधर्मसमायुक्ता मत्सायुज्यं व्रजन्त्यलम् ॥
translation: इसी कारण मेरे ज्ञानी भक्त सन्यासीगण आत्मधर्म युक्त होकर मत्सायुज्य को प्राप्त करते हैं
english_translation: Therefore, my wise devotees who live in renunciation and are united with their true purpose attain union with me.
essence: Devoted renunciants united with their true purpose attain union with the divine.
simple_meaning: Those who live as renunciants and follow their true purpose with devotion reach union with the divine.
insight: It teaches you to combine devoted love with living your true purpose to experience deep union beyond the ego.
modern_relevance: You might feel overwhelmed by distractions, but focusing on your deeper purpose and letting go of attachments opens a path to fulfillment.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
राजानः केऽपि संसारे विविधैश्वर्यशालिनः ।
वाणिजो वित्तपूर्णा वा वस्तुतो धनिका न हि ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! इस संसार में परम ऐश्वर्यवान् राजा अथवा अति धनवान् वणिक वास्तव में धनवान् नहीं है
english_translation: In this world, neither a king with great power nor a merchant full of wealth is truly wealthy.
essence: Material power and riches do not guarantee true wealth or fulfillment.
simple_meaning: Having power or lots of money in the world does not mean you are truly wealthy or fulfilled.
insight: It shifts your view from external status to deeper, lasting fulfillment beyond possessions or power.
modern_relevance: You see someone with a fancy title or big bank account but sense something is missing in their life.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
ऐश्वर्यञ्च धनं तेषां यतः स्यात्क्षणभङ्गुरम् ।
अकिञ्चित्करमप्यास्ते पितरो नात्र संशयः ॥
translation: क्योंकि उनका ऐश्वर्य और धन क्षणभङ्गुर और अकिञ्चित् कर है और तपोधन प्राप्त
english_translation: Because their wealth and power are fleeting and without lasting value, even their ancestors doubt this.
essence: Material wealth is fleeting and unreliable, even those before you knew this.
simple_meaning: Wealth and power are temporary and hold no lasting value, even ancestors recognize this truth.
insight: It shifts your focus from chasing wealth to valuing what lasts beyond temporary gains.
modern_relevance: You watch your bank balance fluctuate and feel unsure about what really matters beyond money and status.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
वस्तुतस्त्विह संसारे वानप्रस्थास्तपोधनाः। .
आत्मधर्म तथैवात्मधनं सन्न्यासिनो गताः ॥
translation: वानप्रस्थ अथवा आत्मधन और आत्म धर्म प्राप्त सन्यासी ही यथार्थ में
english_translation: Truly, renunciates in the world are those who have attained the forest stage, self-wealth, and their true purpose.
essence: True renunciation is embracing your true purpose and inner wealth beyond worldly life.
simple_meaning: Real renunciates are those who have reached the stage of withdrawing to focus on their true purpose and inner wealth.
insight: It teaches you to see renunciation as claiming your essential purpose and inner wealth, not just abandoning life.
modern_relevance: When you step back from constant busyness and connect with your core values and inner strengths, you experience true freedom.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
ऐश्वर्यशालिनः सन्ति धनिकाश्चैव निश्चितम् ।
नैवात्र संशयः कार्यों भवद्भिः पितृपुङ्गवाः !॥
translation: ऐश्वर्यवान् और धनी है इसमें , आपलोग सन्देह न करें
english_translation: The ancestors certainly possess wealth and prosperity; do not doubt this, O noble ones.
essence: Your noble ancestors are certainly wealthy and prosperous; doubt is unnecessary.
simple_meaning: Your noble ancestors definitely have wealth and prosperity; there is no doubt about this.
insight: It encourages trust in the strength and support of your heritage and past foundations.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
आर्यजातौ क्रमान्नूनं शुद्धिः शोणितशुक्रयोः।
पीठशुद्धे: समुत्पत्तौ परमास्ति सहायिका ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! रजवीर्य्य की शुद्धि ही क्रमशः आर्यजाति में पीठ शुद्धि को उत्पन्न करने की परम सहायक है
english_translation: O ancestors, the gradual purification of vital energies ultimately supports the purification of the foundation in the noble lineage.
essence: Step-by-step purification of vital forces leads to true foundation cleansing in noble lineage.
simple_meaning: Purifying the vital energies step by step helps purify the foundational nature of a noble family line.
insight: It shows that deep change requires patient, sequential purification, starting with subtle energies before reaching core identity.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अध्यात्मलक्ष्यद्वारैव चक्रशुद्धिर्यथाक्रमम् ।
लभ्यते नात्र सन्देहो विद्यते पितरो ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: और अध्यात्म लक्ष्य के द्वारा ही क्रमशः चक्रशुद्धि प्राप्त हुआ करती है इसमें सन्देह नहीं है।
english_translation: Without doubt, the purification of the inner cycles is attained progressively through the doors of spiritual focus.
essence: Steady spiritual focus inevitably purifies your inner energies step by step.
simple_meaning: Inner transformation happens gradually by focusing your mind on spiritual goals without doubt.
insight: It teaches you to trust disciplined, progressive spiritual focus as the path to inner purification.
modern_relevance: When you commit to a daily meditation or mindfulness practice, you see your inner restlessness calm down gradually, confirming the process.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अतो वार्णाश्रमा धर्माः प्रवृत्ते रोधकास्तथा ।
निवृत्तेः पोषकाः सन्तो संशुद्धिं पीठचक्रयोः ॥
translation: इसी कारण वर्णधर्म और आश्रमधर्म प्रवृत्ति रोधक और निवृत्ति पोषक होते हुए पीठशुद्धि और चक्रशुद्धि के
english_translation: Therefore, the duties of varna and ashrama, when active, act as inhibitors, and when renounced, they nourish the purity of the seat and the wheel.
essence: Social roles limit growth when clung to but support purity when consciously released.
simple_meaning: Your social duties can limit your inner purity while you follow them, but giving them up supports deeper spiritual clarity.
insight: It shifts your view from clinging to social identity toward embracing renunciation as a path to purer self-awareness.
modern_relevance: You may feel trapped by expectations of your role at work or home, but stepping back can reveal your deeper clarity beyond those roles.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
समुत्पादयितुं नूनं पराः सन्ति सहायकाः।
नात्र कश्चन सन्देहो विद्यते हे स्वधाभुजः ! ॥
translation: परम सहायक बनो करते हैं इसमें कुछ सन्देह नहीं है
english_translation: There is no doubt, O Swadhabhuja, that supreme helpers truly bring things into being.
essence: Highest helpers unquestionably support the arising of all things.
simple_meaning: You can trust that the highest supportive forces help bring everything into existence without doubt.
insight: It teaches you to trust the unseen forces that guide the unfolding of events beyond your control.
modern_relevance: When facing uncertainty, you may feel alone, but this reminds you that powerful, unseen support is always working to bring things into place.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
इच्छाम्यहं निजानन्दे द्वैतभावं निमज्जितुम् ।
आधावस्थेयमेवास्ते पितरो नात्र संशयः ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! मैं अपने आनन्द में मग्न होने के लिये द्वैत की इच्छा करता हूँ यह प्रथम अवस्था है।
english_translation: O ancestors, I desire to immerse myself in duality to enjoy my own bliss; this is the primary state.
essence: Immersing in duality is the initial stage of enjoying personal bliss.
simple_meaning: The speaker wishes to enter the state of duality to enjoy personal bliss; this is described as the first stage of experience.
insight: It reveals that experiencing separation and duality is a natural beginning before moving toward unity.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text: मम शक्तिस्ततः श्यामा मत्त एव प्रकाश्य च।       ब्रह्मानन्दसमुल्लासरूपिणो जगतोऽस्य हि ॥
translation: तत्पश्चात् मेरी शक्ति मुझ ही से प्रकट होकर श्यामा रूपिणी हो
english_translation: Then my power manifests from me as Shyama, the embodiment of supreme bliss illuminating this world.
essence: The divine power arises from the source as blissful presence illuminating the world.
simple_meaning: My power emerges from me as Shyama, shining with the bliss of the supreme reality throughout the world.
insight: Recognize that your essential power and the joy it brings are not separate from your true self.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
निदानं जायते नृनं द्वैतभावे मनोहरे ।
असादेव द्वितीयास्ति नन्यवस्था स्वधाभुजः! ॥
translation: मनोरम द्वैतभाव मे ब्रह्मानन्द विलासरूपी जगत का आदि कारण बनती है, यही द्वितीया अवस्था है
english_translation: The delightful sense of duality in the mind is the original cause of the world’s playful bliss; this is the second state of the true self.
essence: The mind’s joyful sense of separation creates the world’s playful reality.
simple_meaning: Your mind’s joyful sense of 'I and other' is the root cause of the world’s playful appearance. This is a key state of the true self’s experience.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing separation as problem to recognizing it as the creative play of your mind’s duality.
modern_relevance: When you notice how your mind clings to ‘me versus you,’ you glimpse how your own sense of separation colors the whole world’s drama.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
नारीधारा नृधारा च स्वतन्त्रा भुवने ततः ।
बैजीमारभते साष्टिं तृतीया स्यादियं दशा ॥
translation: हे पितृगण! तत्पश्चात् संसार में स्त्रीधारा और पुरुष धारा दो स्वतन्त्र होकर वैजी सृष्टि प्रारम्भ होती है यही तृतीयावस्था है।
english_translation: O ancestors! After that, in the world, the stream of women and the stream of men become independent, and the Vaiji creation begins; this is the third stage.
essence: Creation divides into male and female streams, starting a new phase of evolution.
simple_meaning: After a certain stage, men and women exist separately in the world, and a new kind of creation begins; this marks the third stage.
insight: It shows how diversity and separation arise naturally as creation progresses, leading to complexity.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
नारीधारा प्रपृर्णत्वं सम्प्राता तदनन्तरम् ।
सतीधर्मप्रभावेण नृधारायां विलीयते ॥
translation: तत्पश्चात् जब स्त्री धारा पूर्णतो को प्राप्त होती है तो वह पुनः सतीत्व धर्म के प्रभाव से पुरुषधार लय को प्राप्त होती है
english_translation: After a woman’s cycle is complete, by the power of her devoted nature, she merges back into the male principle.
essence: The female principle completes its cycle and reunites with the male principle by devotion.
simple_meaning: A woman’s natural cycle completes, then through the power of her devoted nature, she reunites with the male principle.
insight: It invites understanding of cycles, completion, and the transcending of duality through natural rhythms.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
इयमेव चतुर्थी स्यादवस्था पितरो ध्रुवम् ।
स्वानुकूलां ततः शक्तिं निजां लब्ध्वा नरर्षभाः ॥
translation: यही चतुर्थ अवस्था है। तत्पश्चात् निज शक्ति को अपने अनुकूल पाकर
english_translation: This is the fourth state, the ancestors' fixed state. Thereafter, having attained their own suitable power, the best of men act.
essence: Growth moves from a fixed ancestral state to gaining personal power suited to oneself.
simple_meaning: After a fixed fourth state related to ancestors, the best people gain a power suited to themselves.
insight: Recognize when a stable phase is reached, then focus on developing your unique strengths.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
शक्तिमन्तः प्रपूर्णत्वं स्वाधीनत्वं च यान्ति वै ।
पञ्चमी विद्यते नूनमवस्थेयं न संशयः ॥
translation: शक्तिमान होकर पुरुष स्वाधीन और पूर्ण बनता है यही पञ्चमावस्था है ।
english_translation: By becoming full of power, the true self attains freedom and completeness; this is the fifth state beyond doubt.
essence: Full inner power leads to freedom and completeness in the fifth state.
simple_meaning: When the true self is fully empowered, it naturally becomes free and complete. This condition is called the fifth state.
insight: Recognize that true freedom arises naturally when you fully embody your inner power and authority.
modern_relevance: You might notice moments when your confidence and inner strength feel complete, and in those moments, you experience a deep sense of freedom.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
आचारवान् वै पुरुषो नूनं स्यात्तदनन्तरम्।
इयं षष्ठी दशा बोध्या भवद्भिः पितृपुङ्गवाः ! ॥
translation: हे पितृवरो ! तत्पश्चात् पुरुष आचारवान होता है, यही षष्ठ अवस्था है।
english_translation: O foremost among ancestors, thereafter a person becomes disciplined; this is the sixth stage to be understood.
essence: Becoming disciplined marks an important stage in personal development.
simple_meaning: After some stages, a person becomes disciplined, which is the sixth stage recognized by the wise ancestors.
insight: It highlights that discipline is a distinct, recognized phase in growth to be cultivated consciously.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
जातिधर्माविकाशस्य पूर्णत्वं जायते ततः।
इयं हि सप्तमी नूनमवस्थाऽऽस्ते स्वधाभुजः! ॥
translation: तत्पश्चात् जातिधर्म का पूर्ण विकास होता है यही सप्तम अवस्था है।
english_translation: After that, the full development of natural qualities occurs; this is indeed the seventh state.
essence: Full maturity of natural qualities marks a distinct seventh stage.
simple_meaning: The complete growth of natural qualities happens next; it is called the seventh stage.
insight: Understand that growth unfolds step-by-step, each stage building on the last.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
ततः शरीरसंशुद्धिः शूद्रधर्मेण जायते ।
इयं वै वर्ततेऽवस्था सर्वथा पितरोऽष्टमी ॥
translation: तत्पश्चात् शुद्रधर्म से शरीर की शुद्धि प्राप्त होती है यही अष्टम अवस्था है।
english_translation: Then the body is purified through disciplined service; this is the eighth state of the ancestors.
essence: Purification of the body arises from dedicated humble service as a key spiritual state.
simple_meaning: The body becomes purified by practicing disciplined service, marking an important spiritual state.
insight: Recognize disciplined humble service as a path to physical and spiritual cleansing.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
इन्द्रियाणां ततः शुद्धिर्वैश्यधर्मेण जायते ।
इयं भोः पितरोऽवस्था नवमी सम्प्रकीर्तिता ॥
translation: तदनन्तर वैश्यधर्म से इन्द्रियों की शुद्धि होती है यही नवम है।
english_translation: Afterwards, the purity of the senses arises through the duties of a merchant; this is called the ninth stage.
essence: Purity of the senses arises through disciplined role-based action at a specific stage.
simple_meaning: Purity of the senses comes through following the merchant's duties; this is known as the ninth stage.
insight: It shows that refinement of the senses and character can develop through dedicated, role-based practice over time.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
मनोराज्यस्य संशुद्धिः स्यात्ततः क्षात्रधर्मतः।
इयमेवास्ति हे कल्याः ! अवस्था दशमी ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: तदनन्तर क्षत्रियधर्म द्वारा मनोराज्य की शुद्धि सम्पादित होती है यही दशम अवस्था है।
english_translation: Next, the purification of the mind's kingdom happens through the duty of the warrior; this is indeed the tenth and final state.
essence: The mind's purification completes through steady, committed action in your true duty.
simple_meaning: Your mind becomes pure and clear when you faithfully perform your warrior duties.
insight: It teaches you to see responsibility as a path to mental clarity, not a burden to avoid.
modern_relevance: When you face tough responsibilities at work or life, holding steady in your role clears your mental chaos and sharpens your focus.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
बुद्धिराज्यस्य संशुद्धया ततो ब्राह्मणधर्मकः।
पुनाति प्राणिनो नूनं दशैपैकादशी मता ॥
translation: तत्पश्चात् बुद्धिराज्य की शुद्धि द्वारा ब्राह्मणधर्म जीव को पवित्र करता है यही ग्याहरवीं अवस्था है।
english_translation: Then the discerning mind, purified by royal clarity, surely cleanses all beings; this is the eleventh state.
essence: A purified discerning mind cleanses all living beings as a sacred transformation.
simple_meaning: A mind purified by clear royal insight cleanses the entire being, reaching a deep sacred state.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate clarity as a purifying power that transforms your inner state.
modern_relevance: When your thoughts become clear and focused, your entire sense of self feels refreshed and purified.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text: नूनमाश्रमधर्मस्य सम्बन्धाद्धि स्वधाभुजः !।            ब्रह्मचर्याश्रमप्राप्तधर्मेण ब्राह्मणोत्तमाः ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! आश्रमधर्म के सम्बन्ध से ब्रह्मचर्याश्रम धर्म के द्वारा  ब्राह्मण को वेद की प्राप्ति होती है,
english_translation: Indeed, from the connection to ashrama dharma, through the dharma of the brahmacharya stage, the Brahmin attains the Vedas.
essence: Structured life stages connect disciplined practice to deep spiritual knowledge.
simple_meaning: The Brahmin attains the Vedas through practicing the duties of the brahmacharya (student) stage connected to the ashrama system.
insight: It highlights the importance of structured stages in life for spiritual learning and growth.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
वेदान सम्माप्नुवन्येषा ह्यवस्था द्वादशी मता।
गार्हस्थ्ये च ततो विभा अध्यात्मज्ञानमूलकम् ॥
translation: यहीं बारहवीं अवस्था है  ततपश्चात् गृहस्थाश्रम में ब्राह्मण अध्यात्म ज्ञान मूलक
english_translation: The twelfth stage concludes the Vedas; thereafter, in the householder stage, the focus is on Brahmin spiritual knowledge.
essence: Life’s phases move from Vedic study to spiritual wisdom in household duties.
simple_meaning: The Vedic teachings end at the twelfth stage; after that, life enters the householder phase focused on spiritual knowledge.
insight: It shows how learning evolves from formal study to lived spiritual practice over time.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
वेदानुष्ठानमाश्रिख दशां यान्ति त्रयोदशीम् ।
वानप्रस्थाश्रमस्याथ धर्मेण ब्राह्मणोत्तमाः ॥
translation: वेदानुष्ठान के द्वारा तेहरवीं अवस्था को प्राप्त करता है । वानप्रस्थ आश्रम धर्म द्वारा श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मण
english_translation: By practicing the Vedas, the best Brahmins reach the thirteenth stage through the forest-dwelling life.
essence: Dedicated practice of spiritual duties leads to the highest Brahmin stage through forest-dwelling.
simple_meaning: Those who diligently perform Vedic practices progress to the thirteenth life stage by following the forest-dweller's dharma, becoming the highest Brahmins.
insight: It shows how steady commitment to spiritual discipline shapes status and growth over time.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
यथार्थोपरति सम्यक् प्राप्नुवन्ति स्वधाभुजः।
अस्या ह्यपरतेनून परवैराग्यमुद्भवेत् ॥
translation: यथार्थ उपरति को प्राप्त करता है यही उपरति पर वैराग्य उत्पन्न करती है
english_translation: Those who fully grasp their own true nature naturally develop detachment from external things.
essence: True self-knowledge naturally leads to detachment from what is not lasting.
simple_meaning: When you clearly understand your true self, you naturally become detached from external distractions.
insight: It shifts focus inward, making detachment an organic result of self-knowledge rather than forced effort.
modern_relevance: You feel overwhelmed by social media noise, but deeper self-understanding helps you let go of that pull effortlessly.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अवस्था पितरो नूनमेपैवास्ते चतुर्दशी।
अतः परे दशे द्वे स्तः श्रूयेतां ते स्वधाभुजः !॥
translation: और यही चौदहवीं अवस्था है। हे पितृगण ! इसके परे दो अवस्थाएं हैं वह सुनो
english_translation: This is indeed the fourteenth stage. O ancestors, beyond this there are two more stages; listen to them.
essence: The journey has stages; after this one, two more await your attention.
simple_meaning: This verse announces the fourteenth stage and that two more stages follow, inviting the ancestors to listen.
insight: It prepares you to expect continuation rather than finality, opening your mind to ongoing growth.
modern_relevance: You finish one chapter in life and realize there are more lessons ahead waiting to unfold.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
ततः सन्न्यासधर्मेण यथार्थात्मरतिध्रुवम्।
लभ्यते साधकैरेषा दशा पञ्चदशी मता ॥
translation: तदनन्तर सन्यासाश्रम धर्म के द्वारा यथार्थ आत्मरति प्राप्त होती है यही पंद्रहवीं अवस्था है
english_translation: Then, through the true practice of renunciation, the realized ones attain this state, which is known as the fifteenth stage.
essence: True renunciation leads to a lasting, steady joy within your true self.
simple_meaning: By truly practicing renunciation, realized people reach a steady and deep enjoyment of their true self, known as the fifteenth state.
insight: It teaches you to practice true renunciation to access lasting inner fulfillment beyond temporary desires.
modern_relevance: You feel restless chasing fleeting pleasures until you try giving up attachments and find calm joy instead.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
ततो यो विषयानन्दे ब्रह्मानन्दो विवर्तितः।
मालिन्यमाप्तवान् पूर्व स्वस्वरूपमसौ पुनः ॥
translation: और अन्त में जो ब्रह्मानन्द विषयानन्द में परिणत होकर मलिनता को प्राप्त हुआ था वह पुनः
english_translation: Then, the bliss of the supreme reality transformed into sensory pleasure and became tainted, losing its original nature once more.
essence: Supreme bliss can transform into fleeting pleasure and lose its original purity.
simple_meaning: The pure joy of the supreme reality can change into sensory pleasure and get clouded, losing its original clarity.
insight: Recognize when your deeper joy is being covered by temporary distractions and refocus on what is lasting.
modern_relevance: You might feel moments of deep peace slip away when distracted by short-lived pleasures or cravings.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
सम्प्राप्य पितरो नूनं सच्चिद्भावसमन्वितम्।
भावमद्वैतमासाद्य परानन्दपदात्मकम् ॥
translation: अपने स्वरुप में पहुंचकर सत् और चित् के माप से युक्त और अद्वितीय भाव को प्राप्त करके परमानन्द पद रूपी
english_translation: Having reached their own true nature, united with existence and consciousness, they attain the supreme state of bliss beyond duality.
essence: Reaching your true nature means resting in a bliss that transcends all duality.
simple_meaning: When you reach your true inner nature that is united with pure existence and awareness, you experience the highest bliss beyond any division.
insight: It teaches you to recognize your true self as inseparable from pure being and joy, shifting focus from outer struggles to inner wholeness.
modern_relevance: After struggling with endless distractions, you finally feel a deep, unshakable peace that comes from knowing your true self beyond all confusion.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
कैवल्यं लभते नित्यमवस्थेयं हि षोडशी।
एष एवास्ति वेदानां सारः श्रेयान स्वधाभुजः ! ॥
translation: कैवल्य को प्राप्त करता है । यही सोलहवीं अवस्था है। हे पितृगण ! यही वेद का सार है
english_translation: The sixteenth state, eternal and unchanging, is where complete freedom is attained; this is the true essence of the Vedas.
essence: Ultimate freedom is the unchanging core behind all sacred knowledge.
simple_meaning: Complete freedom is the highest, unchanging state and the true heart of sacred teachings.
insight: It shifts focus from external change to realizing the unchanging freedom within as true wisdom.
modern_relevance: When everything around you feels unstable, recognizing your inner freedom offers lasting peace beyond change.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
एतदेवास्ति वेदान्तरहस्यञ्चैव दुर्लभम् ।
एतदेव रहस्यञ्च सम्यग्रूपेण सत्वरम् ॥
translation: इसी को वेदान्त का दुर्लभ रहस्य कहते हैं और इस रहस्य को सम्यकरूप से
english_translation: This alone is the rare secret of Vedanta, and this secret must be understood clearly and swiftly.
essence: The rarest truth is the one you must grasp clearly and quickly.
simple_meaning: The rare secret of the highest wisdom is to recognize the truth clearly and without delay.
insight: It teaches you to prioritize clear understanding and swift insight over confusion or delay.
modern_relevance: You suddenly understand a complex idea that others struggle with, and this clarity lights your path forward.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अपरोक्षानुभूति हि कृत्वैवासादयन्त्यलम् ।
जीवन्मुक्तिपदं भक्ता ज्ञानिनो मे न संशयः ॥
translation: परोक्षानुभव करके मेरे ज्ञानी भक्तगण शीघ्र ही जीवन्मुक्त पदवी को प्राप्त करते हैं; इसमें सन्देह नहीं
english_translation: By direct experience, my wise devotees quickly attain the state of freedom in this life; I have no doubt about this.
essence: Freedom arises immediately through direct experience by devoted, wise seekers.
simple_meaning: You can reach true freedom in this life through your own direct experience, without doubt.
insight: Trust your own lived experience as the surest path to freedom, beyond intellectual doubt.
modern_relevance: You’ve felt the shift when a truth clicks inside you, not just from what others say. That inner knowing changes everything.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
देवादिदेव ! सर्वज्ञ ! सर्वज्ञानाश्रयस्थल।
गुरूणां हे गुरो ! नाथ ! कृपया ते कृपाम्बुधे ! ॥
translation: हे देवादिदेव ! हे सब ज्ञानो के आश्रयस्थल ! हे सर्वज्ञ ! हे गुरुओ के गुरु ! हे दयासागर!  हे नाथ ! आपकी कृपा से
english_translation: O Lord of lords! Knower of all! Refuge of all knowledge! Teacher of teachers! Lord! Ocean of compassion! By your grace...
essence: Ultimate compassion and wisdom guide those who seek with humility.
simple_meaning: This is a respectful invocation to Shiva, acknowledging him as the ultimate lord, all-knowing, the support of all wisdom, the teacher of teachers, and a boundless source of compassion.
insight: It invites you to open your heart to guidance beyond your current understanding, fostering trust in the learning process.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
वैदिकज्ञानकाण्इस्य सारं वेदान्तमद्भुतम् ।
गुहातिगृह्यमाकर्ण्य कृतकृत्या अभूम ह ॥
translation: हम वैदिक ज्ञान के साररूप वेदान्त का अद्भुत रहस्य सुनकर कृतकृत्य हुए
english_translation: Hearing the wondrous secret of Vedanta, the essence of Vedic knowledge, I felt deeply grateful.
essence: Hearing the deepest secret of knowledge inspires true gratitude.
simple_meaning: Hearing the profound secret of Vedanta, which is the essence of Vedic knowledge, fills one with deep gratitude.
insight: It shows how receiving deep wisdom invites sincere appreciation beyond words.
speaker: Suta

verse_text: किन्तु यद्भवता प्रोक्तं वेदान्तस्याधिकारिणः ।                 ज्ञानवन्तोऽभिधीयन्ते जीवन्मुक्ता इति प्रभो !॥
translation: परन्तु हे प्रभो ! आपने जो वेदान्त के अधिकारी. ज्ञानी व्यक्ति को जीवन्मुक्त नाम से अभिहित किया है वह जीवन्मुक्त पदवी
english_translation: But, O Lord, the one described by you as the knower of Vedanta is called the truly liberated one.
essence: True liberation is the natural state of those who deeply know the highest truth.
simple_meaning: A person who truly understands the highest teaching of Vedanta is called truly liberated.
insight: It teaches you to link true freedom with deep knowledge rather than external conditions or rituals.
modern_relevance: When you finally grasp the core of your experience, freedom from confusion naturally follows, like a weight lifting.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
सम्भाव्यते कथं होतत्तन्न विद्द्यो वयं विभो !।
अल्पज्ञ ईरितो जीवः सर्वज्ञोऽस्ति भवान् यतः ॥
translation: कैसे सम्भव है ? हे विभो ! इसको हमलोग नहीं जानते हैं क्योंकि हे शम्भो ! आप सर्वज्ञ है जीव अल्पज्ञ है,
english_translation: How can it happen? O Vibhā! We do not know this because, O Shambhu, you are all-knowing while the living being is little-knowing.
essence: Limited beings cannot grasp what the all-knowing divine comprehends.
simple_meaning: The speaker admits not knowing how something can happen, acknowledging that Shambhu is all-knowing while living beings have limited knowledge.
insight: It invites humility to accept that some knowledge is beyond immediate understanding and to trust sources wiser than ourselves.
modern_relevance: You hit a wall trying to understand a complex problem and realize some answers are beyond your current grasp.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
देशकालापरिच्छिन्नस्त्रं जीवश्चैकदेशिकः।
समदर्शी भवानन्ताम्यहङ्कारवजितः ॥
translation: आप देशकाल से अपरिच्छिन्न हैं जीव देश काल से परिच्छिन्न है, आप समदर्शी सबके अन्तर्यामी और अहङ्कारादि से रहित हैं
english_translation: You are beyond all place and time; the individual being is limited by place and time. You are an impartial witness within all, free from ego and other bindings.
essence: Your true self is the limitless, impartial witness beyond ego and temporal limits.
simple_meaning: You exist beyond all limits of place and time. The individual being is tied to specific places and moments. You see everyone impartially and are free from ego.
insight: Shift your perspective from identification with your changing roles to the impartial awareness that watches them all.
modern_relevance: When you feel stuck by circumstances or overwhelmed by your roles, remember your true self is beyond those limits and remains a steady witness.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
जीवोऽहङ्कारवान् स्थूलासक्तश्चासमदर्शनः ।
जीवः स्वार्थी संदा शम्भो ! परार्थे तु परो भवान् ॥
translation: और जीव असमदर्शी दृश्य में आसक्त और अहङ्कारी है, आप परार्थपर हैं और जीव स्वार्थी है,
english_translation: The individual is ego-bound, attached to the gross, and lacks equal vision; the individual is self-centered, while you are concerned with the welfare of others.
essence: Your true self transcends ego and selfish attachment to care for others.
simple_meaning: You, the true self, care for others, but the individual is caught in ego, selfishness, and attachment to the physical world.
insight: This teaching helps shift your perspective from self-centeredness to recognizing your nature as connected and other-oriented.
modern_relevance: When you find yourself caught in selfish thoughts and attachments, remember your true nature cares for others beyond these limits.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
भवान् विश्वगुरुनूनं सर्वज्ञानखनिस्तथा ।
अस्त्यज्ञः सर्वथा जीवः स्वरूपज्ञानवजितः ॥
translation: आप सबके गुरु और सब ज्ञानों की खान है और जीव सर्वथा अज्ञ और स्वरूपज्ञान शून्य है
english_translation: The divine is the universal teacher and the source of all knowledge, while the living being is entirely ignorant and devoid of self-knowledge.
essence: The divine knows everything; you remain completely unaware of your true nature.
simple_meaning: The divine is the teacher of everything and the source of all knowledge, but you do not yet truly know your own essential nature.
insight: This verse shifts your focus from external knowledge to the importance of awakening self-knowledge within.
modern_relevance: You may master many skills or facts, yet still feel disconnected from who you truly are deep inside.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अतो जीवः कथं शैवीमुत्तमां पदवीं गतः।
जीवन्मुक्तोऽभिधीयत ज्ञानानन्ददयार्णव ! ॥
translation: इस कारण हे ज्ञान, आनन्द और दया के सागर ! जीव कैसे उत्तम शिव पदवी को प्राप्त करके जीवन्मुक्त कहा सकता है ?
english_translation: O knowledge, ocean of bliss and compassion! How can the living being be called liberated after attaining the supreme Shiva state?
essence: True liberation is not guaranteed by reaching a supreme state alone.
simple_meaning: Reaching a supreme divine state alone does not guarantee true liberation or freedom for the living being.
insight: It shifts the mind from equating titles or achievements with true inner freedom to questioning what genuine liberation really means.
modern_relevance: You might have achieved a major goal or status, yet still feel restless inside, realizing success alone doesn’t bring true freedom.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
शरीरत्रितयोपेतो भवेज्जीवः कथं गुरो !।
शरीरत्रितयातीतो जीवन्मुक्तो महाजनः ॥
translation: हे गुरो ! जीव के तीनों शरीर रहते हुए. जीवन्मुक्त महात्मा कैसे शरीरातीत हो सकते हैं ।
english_translation: O teacher, how can the liberated great soul be beyond the three bodies while still having them?
essence: You can live fully with your bodies and still be free beyond them.
simple_meaning: It asks how someone can be truly free while still existing with their physical, subtle, and causal bodies.
insight: It invites shifting perspective from being trapped in the bodies to recognizing freedom within them.
modern_relevance: You might wonder how to feel truly free while still carrying your daily burdens and identities.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
चतुर्भिर्दशभिोकैः स्वकोषैः पञ्चभिस्तथा।
सार्द्ध सम्बन्धयुक्तोऽपि तत्मभावान्वितोऽपि च ॥
translation: चतुर्दश भुवन और पञ्चकोश से सम्बन्ध युक्त रहने पर भी और उनका प्रभाव बना रहने पर भी
english_translation: Even while connected with the fourteen worlds and the five sheaths, and influenced by them, the true nature remains.
essence: Your true self remains unchanged despite connections and influences from many worlds and layers.
simple_meaning: Even when you are connected with many worlds and layers of existence, your true nature remains unchanged and present.
insight: It shifts the mind from identifying with external layers to recognizing the unchanging essence within.
modern_relevance: You juggle many roles and influences every day, yet your true self remains steady beneath all that noise and change.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
जीवन्मुक्तः कथं देव ! पदं मुक्तेरवाप्नुयात् ।
अंघटयंघटनायां सा प्रकृतिस्ते पटीयसी ॥
translation: बना रहने पर भी जीवन्मुक्त कैसे मुक्ति पद को प्राप्त कर सकते हैं। आपकी अघटन घटना पटीयसी प्रकृति
english_translation: O divine one, how can one be liberated while still living? Your nature is unchanging amid all changes.
essence: You can be fully alive and already free because your true nature never changes.
simple_meaning: It asks how a person can be free while still alive, pointing out that your true nature remains unchanged despite all changes.
insight: This verse shifts your view from seeing freedom as an after-death state to recognizing freedom in the midst of life’s changes.
modern_relevance: You face constant change and challenges but can still feel steady and free at your core, even as life unfolds around you.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
त्रिगुणैर्मोहयन्सास्ते निजैर्जीवांस्तथाप्यहो ।
जीवन्मुक्तो गुणातीतं पदं लन्धुमलं कथम् ॥
translation: अपने तीनों गुणों से सब जीवों को मोहित करती रहती है अहो ! तो भी जीवन्मुक्त कैसे गुणातीत पदवी को प्राप्त कर सकते हैं
english_translation: The three qualities always delude living beings, yet how can the liberated soul attain the state beyond all qualities?
essence: You can be free even while the three qualities continue to influence others.
simple_meaning: The three qualities always confuse living beings, yet a liberated person can reach a state beyond these qualities.
insight: Shift focus from being caught in moods and influences to witnessing them without being controlled.
modern_relevance: You may feel overwhelmed by influences and moods around you, yet your true self can remain untouched and free.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
भवत्तो व्यतिरिक्तं स्यायत्किञ्चिद्विश्वगोलके ।
तत्सर्वं वर्तते नूनं कर्माधीनं न संशयः॥
translation: आपके अतिरिक्त विश्व में सब कुछ कर्माधीन है
english_translation: Everything in the universe except you is certainly subject to the consequence of action.
essence: Your true self is beyond karma; only the universe is bound by it.
simple_meaning: Everything in the universe except your true self is controlled by the results of actions.
insight: Shift your view to see yourself apart from reactive consequences, reducing worry and increasing calm in your actions.
modern_relevance: When stress rises over outcomes you can't control, remember you are the part that remains free beyond all consequences.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
धर्माधर्मानुसम्बन्धरहितं नैव चास्यहो ।
जीवन्मुक्तो महात्माऽतो दुर्द्दमं कर्मवन्धनम् ॥
translation: और धर्माधर्म सबन्ध से रहित नहीं है अतः जीवन्मुक्त महात्मा कैसे अदमनीय कर्मबन्धन
english_translation: The great liberated being is never free from the connection of right and wrong, so how can the difficult bondage of actions hold him?
essence: Freedom includes acting within right and wrong without being bound by action’s consequences.
simple_meaning: Even a truly free person remains connected to right and wrong actions and is not bound by the consequences.
insight: It shifts your view to see freedom as engaging with action consciously without getting caught in its consequences.
modern_relevance: You might feel stuck between doing what’s right and avoiding mistakes, yet freedom comes when you act without clinging to outcomes.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
धर्माधर्ममुसम्बन्धं छित्वा च क्षमते कथम् ।
स्थूलादिदेहसत्त्वेऽपि गन्तुं ब्रह्मस्वरूपताम् ॥
translation: और धर्माधर्म के सम्बन्ध से रहित होकर स्थूलादि शरीर रहते हुए भी ब्रह्मीभूत होने में समर्थ होते हैं।
english_translation: Even while remaining in the gross body, one can transcend notions of right and wrong and attain the nature of the supreme reality.
essence: Your true self transcends moral dualities even while embodied.
simple_meaning: You can overcome the dual ideas of right and wrong even while living in your physical body and realize your true, divine nature.
insight: It shifts your perspective from being trapped in moral labels to seeing yourself as the unchanging essence beyond them.
modern_relevance: When faced with daily moral judgments or personal conflicts, you can remember that your deeper self is untouched by these opposites and remains free.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
भवानपि यदा भूमाववतीर्णः कदाचन।
कर्माद्यायत्ततामाप्तो भवत्येवाक्षिगोचरः ॥
translation: जब आप भी कभी कभी अवतार धारण करके कर्मादि के अधीन दिखाई पड़ते हैं तो
english_translation: Even when you sometimes take a form and appear bound by action, you remain the one beyond the senses.
essence: You can appear bound by action yet remain beyond all sensory limits.
simple_meaning: You may appear involved in actions as if limited by them, but your true nature is beyond all sensory perception.
insight: This shifts your view from identifying with actions to recognizing your deeper, unchanging presence behind them.
modern_relevance: Sometimes you feel caught up in tasks and roles, but this reminds you that your true self is beyond all those appearances.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
ज्ञानिनस्तार्ह ते भक्ता जीवन्मुक्ताः कृपानिधे ।
शक्नुयुः कथमत्येतुं कर्मप्रभृतिवन्धनम् ॥
translation: हे कृपानिधान! आपके ज्ञानी भक्त जीवन्मुक्तगण कैसे, इन सब कर्मादि बन्धन से अतीत हो सकते हैं
english_translation: O treasure of compassion, how can your wise devotees, who are free while living, transcend all bonds of action?
essence: Living wisely means freedom beyond all binding consequences of action.
simple_meaning: Wise devotees who live fully free themselves from all attachments to actions and their consequences.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing actions as chains to seeing wise living as freedom despite action.
modern_relevance: You wonder how some people seem calm and unburdened despite busy lives full of responsibilities and pressures.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
एवञ्चेत्तेऽवतारेषु ज्ञानिभक्तेषु च प्रभो!।
जीवन्मुक्तेषु को भेदो वर्त्तते भक्तवत्सल ! ॥
translation: यदि ऐसा हो तो हे भक्तवत्सल ! आपके अवतारों में और आपके ज्ञानी, भक्त जीवन्मुक्तो में भेद क्या है ?
english_translation: If that is so, O lover of devotees, what difference is there between your incarnations and your wise, devoted liberated beings?
essence: There may be no real difference between divine incarnations and liberated devotees.
simple_meaning: You ask what the difference is between divine incarnations and wise, devoted beings who are already liberated.
insight: It encourages questioning apparent differences between exemplars and enlightened individuals to see underlying unity.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
एवं विधैश्च नश्चित्तं शङ्कासैर्वीलोड़ितम् ।
तस्मात्सर्वे समाधाय शान्ति तस्मिन् प्रयच्छ नः ॥
translation: इस प्रकार की शङ्काओं से हमारे अन्तःकरण आलोदित हो रहे हैं इसलिये हमारी शंकाओं का समाधान करके
english_translation: Our inner state is troubled by such doubts; therefore, grant us peace by resolving all these doubts.
essence: Peace arises only when doubts disturbing your mind are fully resolved.
simple_meaning: Doubts disturb your mind and inner state. When you clear these doubts, peace naturally arises.
insight: It teaches you to recognize doubts as the source of inner unrest and seek their resolution to restore calm.
modern_relevance: When your mind races with doubts before a big decision, you feel unsettled until clarity brings calm.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
वयं येन कृतार्थत्वं सद्गुरो ! सँल्लभेमहि ।
मनो येन मिलिन्दो नो भवेत्तव पदाम्बुजे ॥
translation: हमें कृतार्थ कीजिये जिससे हमारा मन भ्रमर की तरह आपके चरणकमलों में लग जाय
english_translation: O true teacher, grant us fulfillment so our minds may settle at your lotus feet like a bee.
essence: True fulfillment draws the restless mind gently to devoted stillness.
simple_meaning: You ask the true teacher to give you a sense of fulfillment so your restless mind can peacefully focus on the divine.
insight: This verse invites you to seek fulfillment that naturally draws your attention and calms mental agitation.
modern_relevance: When your mind buzzes with worry and distraction, you long for a place or feeling that settles and centers you completely.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
उत्पत्तिश्च विनाशश्च भूतानामागतिं गतिम् ।
वेत्ति विद्यामविद्याञ्च स ज्ञेयो भगवानिति ॥
translation: हे पितरों जो उत्पति और विनाश को, जीवों की अगति और गति को एवं विद्या और अविद्या को जानते हो उन्हीं को भगवान जानो
english_translation: The one who understands creation and destruction, the coming and going of beings, as well as knowledge and ignorance, is known as the divine.
essence: Understanding birth, death, knowledge, and ignorance reveals the nature of the divine.
simple_meaning: Understanding how life begins and ends, how beings come and go, and how knowledge contrasts with ignorance reveals the true divine nature.
insight: It teaches you to see beyond appearances to the underlying cycles and contrasts that reveal deeper truth.
modern_relevance: When you watch a tree grow, shed leaves, and begin again, or when you learn something new after confusion, you glimpse the deeper pattern behind life.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
भगवच्छन्दवाच्यः स्यामेतैरेवगुणैरहम् ।
ते सर्वे स्म प्रकाशन्ते गुणा भागवते ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: जिन गुणों से मैं भगवान् शब्दवाच्य हूँ वह सब गुण
english_translation: I am the supreme being spoken of by these very qualities; all qualities certainly shine in the supreme reality.
essence: The supreme reality fully embodies and shines through all qualities.
simple_meaning: The qualities that describe the supreme being are exactly those in which I exist and shine fully.
insight: Recognize that what seems like many traits or qualities are expressions of a singular supreme essence.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अतो भागवतस्येह देहिनोऽपि हि तिष्ठतः।
अहो भगवता सार्द्ध कश्चिद्भेदो न विद्यते ॥
translation: भागवत में अवश्य प्रकाशित हो जाते हैं
english_translation: The embodied being who abides in the divine sees no difference from the divine.
essence: Living within the divine removes all sense of separation.
simple_meaning: When you live fully connected with the divine, you no longer feel separate from it.
insight: It teaches you to recognize your shared essence with the divine, dissolving feelings of isolation.
modern_relevance: In moments when you feel deeply connected to something greater, the usual boundaries between you and others fade away.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text: यदा हि ज्ञानिनो भक्ताः सम्माप्ता मत्स्वरूपताम् ।           त्रिभावात्मकरूपस्य सगुणस्य रहस्यकम् ॥
translation: इसलिये भगवान् और भागवत में कोई भी भेद नहीं है। अतः जब मेरे ज्ञानी भक्त मेरे स्वरूप में पहुंचकर मेरे त्रिभावमय सगुण
english_translation: When the devotees who possess knowledge reach the state of unity with my true form, the mystery of my threefold nature manifesting with qualities is revealed.
essence: True knowledge and devotion together reveal the divine’s threefold, mysterious nature within you.
simple_meaning: When knowledgeable devotees unite with the true self, they understand the secret of the divine’s threefold nature with qualities.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing yourself as separate to recognizing a profound, multifaceted unity with the divine.
modern_relevance: You might feel disconnected sometimes, but when insight and love combine, you glimpse the deeper unity behind your experience.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
निर्गुणस्यापि ज्ञात्वैव मद्युक्ता भवितुं सदा ।
शक्नुवन्ति तदा सृष्टेरुत्पत्तिमलयौ ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: निर्गुण रूप का रहस्य जानकर सब समय मुझमे ही युक्त रहने में समर्थ होते हैं उस समय जगत के उत्पत्ति
english_translation: Knowing the secret of the formless, beings can always remain united with me; then they can certainly understand the world's creation.
essence: Understanding the formless lets you stay united and clearly see creation's foundation.
simple_meaning: When you understand the formless essence, you can always stay connected with the divine and then see how the entire world originates.
insight: It teaches you to shift focus from surface changes to the unchanging foundation, revealing the world's origin.
modern_relevance: When you stop clinging to appearances and connect to your inner essence, you gain insight into how everything around you truly arises.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
असेतुं नाहतस्तेषां दृष्टिमार्ग कथञ्चन ।
महात्मानो महामान्यास्ते तदा त्वात्मदर्शिनः ॥
translation: और विनाश उनकी दृष्टि से अतीत नहीं हो सकते। आत्मदर्शी महामान्य महापुरुष तब
english_translation: Those who see the true self do not view others as destroyed or lost.
essence: True seers recognize no one or nothing is ever truly destroyed or lost.
simple_meaning: People who truly see their own inner being do not regard others as destroyed or lost.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing endings to seeing continuity and presence beyond appearances.
modern_relevance: You watch a friendship fade but sense its essence remains, untouched by time or absence.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
नूनं जीवप्रवाहस्य समुत्पत्तिञ्च सर्वतः।
चतुर्धाभूतसङ्घस्य प्रसक्षीकुर्वते गतिम् ॥
translation: जीवप्रवाह की उत्पत्ति और चतुर्विध भूतसङ्घ की गति को सर्वथा प्रत्यक्ष करते हैं और
english_translation: They fully reveal the origin of the flow of living beings and the movement of the fourfold elements.
essence: The origin and motion of life and elements are fully revealed here.
simple_meaning: The origin and movement of all living beings and the four basic elements are fully revealed here.
insight: It emphasizes that seeing the root and movement of life and nature opens understanding beyond surface appearances.
speaker: Suta

verse_text: ज्ञानिभक्तास्तदा ते च प्राप्य मत्प्रकृतेः कृपाम् ।              विद्याऽविद्यास्वरूपे द्वे तस्या दृट्वा मुहुर्मुहुः ॥
translation: हे पितरो ! तब वे ज्ञानीभक्त मेरी प्रकृति की कृपा को पाकर उसके विद्या भौर अविद्या दोनों रूपों का बार बार दर्शन करके
english_translation: O ancestors! Then those wise devotees, having received my nature's grace, repeatedly beheld both its forms: knowledge and ignorance.
essence: Repeatedly seeing both knowledge and ignorance invites the divine's grace into your life.
simple_meaning: Wise devotees receive the divine's grace by repeatedly observing both knowledge and ignorance within existence.
insight: This verse encourages you to open your awareness to both understanding and doubt, allowing grace to unfold naturally.
modern_relevance: You find moments of clarity and confusion in your learning; both together deepen your growth when accepted repeatedly.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
स्वयमेव प्रजायन्ते प्रकृतिस्थाः स्वधाभुजः !।
नास्ति कोऽप्यत्र सन्देहः ससं सत्यं ब्रवीम्यहम् ॥
translation: प्रकृतिस्थ हो जाते हैं इसमें कुछ सन्देह नहीं; मैं सत्य सत्य कहता हूँ
english_translation: Those established in the natural world are born by themselves; there is no doubt in this, I speak the truth.
essence: Natural phenomena arise spontaneously without external cause; this is an undeniable truth.
simple_meaning: Things that belong to the natural world come into existence by themselves without external cause.
insight: It shifts your view to see natural events as self-arising, reducing the urge to control or resist what happens.
modern_relevance: You notice how plants grow and seasons change without your control or effort—life unfolds naturally on its own.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
तस्मिन् काले च ते भक्ता आत्मज्ञानाव्धिपारगाः।
मत्सायुज्यं समापन्ना मद्रूपाः स्युः सुनिश्चितम् ॥
translation: उस समय वह आत्मज्ञानी भक्त मत्सायुज्य को प्राप्त करके मेरे ही रूप बन जाते हैं
english_translation: At that time, those devoted who have crossed the ocean of self-knowledge reach union with me and become firmly established in my form.
essence: Deep devotion and self-knowledge together bring unshakable union with the divine form.
simple_meaning: When you fully realize your true self through deep devotion and knowledge, you unite completely with the divine and become established in that unity.
insight: It teaches that spiritual devotion combined with clear self-understanding leads to unwavering unity with the divine form.
modern_relevance: After long searching and learning about who you truly are, you finally feel fully connected with the highest truth inside you.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
यदा मे ज्ञानिनो भक्ताः संविदन्तीह मामलम् ।
ब्रह्मणोरुभयोरेव कार्यकारणरूपयोः ॥
translation: मेरे ज्ञानीभक्त जब मुझको भलीभांति जान लेते हैं तो कार्यब्रह्म और कारण ब्रह्मा की
english_translation: When my wise devotees truly know me, they realize I am both the supreme reality and the cause of all causes.
essence: True devotion recognizes the divine as both the cause and essence of all existence.
simple_meaning: When devoted seekers truly understand the divine, they see it as both the supreme reality and the cause behind all things.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing the divine as distant to recognizing it as intimately both the source and the substance of all experience.
modern_relevance: You meet someone who inspires you so deeply that you feel they are both the root and the whole of what matters in life.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
तदैक्यं जायते तेषां ध्रुवमेवान्तरात्मनि ।
ब्रह्मरूपा भवन्त्येव तेऽतो नैवात्र संशयः ॥
translation: एकता उनके अन्तःकरण में हो जाने से वह ब्रह्म रूप ही हो जाते हैं
english_translation: When their unity arises within the inner self, they truly become the form of the supreme reality; there is no doubt about this.
essence: Your deepest inner unity is unmistakably the supreme reality itself.
simple_meaning: When all differences dissolve inside your deepest self, you become one with the supreme reality without any doubt.
insight: It invites you to recognize your inner unity as the true foundation beneath all change and conflict.
modern_relevance: When your scattered thoughts and feelings settle into harmony inside, you touch a timeless wholeness beyond stress.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
सर्वेषु प्राणिपुत्रेषु येपामुत्पद्यते ननु ।
ब्रह्मबुर्धिमहात्मानो जीवन्मुक्ता भवन्ति ते ॥
translation: जिनमें सब प्राणीमात्रों पर ब्रह्म बुद्धि उत्पन्न हुई है वह महात्मा जीवन्मुक्त हैं
english_translation: Those in whom the wisdom of the supreme reality arises for all living beings become great souls freed from rebirth.
essence: Freedom arises when you see supreme wisdom present in all living beings.
simple_meaning: When you develop deep understanding that connects all beings, you become a great soul free from life's cycle.
insight: It teaches you to recognize the shared divine wisdom in all life, which frees you from feeling separate.
modern_relevance: You feel connected to everyone around you, and in that connection, your sense of personal limitation begins to dissolve.
