speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अपरोक्षं ध्रुवं येषां ब्रह्मज्ञानं प्रजायते ।
ते महापुरुषा लोके जीवन्मुक्ता न संशयः ॥
translation: जिनको अपरोक्ष रूप से ब्रह्मज्ञान उत्पन्न हुआ है वह महापुरुष संसार में जीवन्मुक्त हैं
english_translation: Those in whom direct, unwavering knowledge of the supreme reality arises are great beings, undoubtedly liberated while alive.
essence: Direct, unwavering knowledge of the supreme reality grants living liberation.
simple_meaning: Direct, unwavering knowledge of the supreme reality makes a person truly free in life.
insight: It teaches you to seek direct, clear understanding instead of relying on indirect beliefs or doubts.
modern_relevance: You realize freedom not after life ends but by seeing clearly what truly is beyond your daily struggles and illusions.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
देहोऽस्मि पुरुषश्चास्मि शूद्रोऽस्मि ब्राह्मणोऽस्मि च ।
यथेत्थं दृढविश्वासस्तथैव पितृपुङ्गवाः ! ॥
translation: जैसे मैं देह हूँ, मैं पुरुष हूँ. मैं ब्राह्मण हूँ, मैं शुद्र हूँ, इस प्रकारसे दृढ़ निश्चय होता है
english_translation: Just as I am the body, I am pure awareness; I am both the highest and the lowest, so firm is the conviction of the forefathers.
essence: Your true self transcends all labels, roles, and distinctions without contradiction.
simple_meaning: You are not just one fixed identity like body or social role; your true self includes all, from highest to lowest.
insight: It shifts your mind from limiting self-identifications to embracing a wider, unified sense of being.
modern_relevance: At work or home, you may feel boxed in by roles or expectations. This teaching reminds you that you are much more than any label others apply.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
नाहं देहो न पुरुषो न शूद्रो ब्राह्मणो न च ।
निजस्वरूपे किन्त्वस्मि सच्चिदानन्दरूपकः ॥
translation: वैसे ही मैं देह नहीं हूँ, न पुरुष हूँ, न ब्राह्मण हूँ, न शूद्र हूँ किन्तु अपने स्वरूप में सत्य ज्ञानानन्द (सच्चिदानन्द) स्वरूप,
english_translation: I am not the body, nor the person, nor the Brahmin, nor the Shudra; in my own nature, I am the form of truth, consciousness, and bliss.
essence: Your true self is beyond body and social identity; it is pure truth and joy.
simple_meaning: You are not your physical body or social identity. Your true nature is pure existence, awareness, and happiness.
insight: This verse invites you to shift from identifying with external roles to recognizing your unchanging inner nature.
modern_relevance: When you feel trapped by labels or roles at work or home, remember your deeper self is free and unbounded.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
प्रकाशरूपः सर्वान्तर्यामी सर्वात्मको विभुः ।
अस्म्यहं सर्वथा नूनं चिदाकाशस्वरूपकः ॥
translation: प्रकाशरूप, अन्तर्यामी, सर्वात्मा, विभु और चिदाकाशरूप हूँ
english_translation: I am the form of light, the inner witness, the all-pervading self, the sovereign, and the nature of conscious space.
essence: The true self is infinite light, inner witness, and pervading conscious space.
simple_meaning: I am the shining presence that fills all, the inner witness, the all-encompassing self, the supreme ruler, and the form of conscious space.
insight: It shifts understanding from a limited self to recognizing the boundless inner presence as your true identity.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
निश्चयो दृढ़ एवं योऽपरोक्षज्ञानमस्ति तत् ।
वोद्धव्यमेतत् पितरोऽपरोक्षज्ञानलक्षणम् ॥
translation: ऐसा दृढ़ निश्चय होना अपरोक्ष ज्ञान कहा जाता है, हे पितृगण ! इसको अपरोक्ष ज्ञान का लक्षण समझो
english_translation: A firm resolve is called direct knowledge; ancestors, recognize this as the mark of direct knowledge.
essence: Firm resolve is the defining sign of direct and clear knowledge.
simple_meaning: Having a strong and unwavering determination is what is called direct knowledge.
insight: It teaches you to recognize direct knowledge by the firmness of your conviction.
modern_relevance: When you make a decision with full confidence and clarity, your mind is free from doubt and hesitation.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text: “अहं ब्रह्मास्मि " इत्येवापरोक्षज्ञानयोगतः ।      सर्वकर्माबलीवन्धनिवृत्तिर्जायते ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: "मैं ब्रह्म ही हूँ" इस प्रकार के अपरोक्ष ज्ञान से सभी कर्म बन्धनों की निश्चय निवृत्ति हो जाती है
english_translation: "I am the supreme reality" — this direct knowledge removes all bondage to actions for sure.
essence: Direct knowledge of your true self ends all bondage to actions.
simple_meaning: Realizing deeply that you are the supreme reality ends all bondage caused by actions.
insight: It shifts your perspective from being controlled by your actions’ results to resting in your true self beyond them.
modern_relevance: When you understand who you truly are beneath your roles and tasks, the pressure from daily responsibilities loses its grip.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
मारब्धं सञ्चितं कल्याः ! आगामीतिप्रभेदतः ।
मोच्यते त्रिविधं कर्म कर्मतत्त्वविशारदैः ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! सञ्चित, प्रारब्ध और आगामि ये तीन प्रकार के कर्म कर्मतत्वज्ञों ने कहे हैं
english_translation: O ancestors! The three types of karma—accumulated, originated, and future—are known by those who understand the essence of karma.
essence: Karma is a threefold process: past accumulated, current active, and future arising actions.
simple_meaning: Karma exists in three forms: what you have done before, what you are doing now, and what you will do in the future.
insight: It shifts your view of karma from a single cause to an ongoing process unfolding in past, present, and future.
modern_relevance: You feel weighed down by past mistakes, caught in current habits, and anxious about choices ahead; knowing karma works in three stages helps you see your life as a continuous flow.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अनन्तकोटिजन्मोघेऽभुक्तानां कृतकर्मणाम् ।
नृनं संस्कारभूतं यदीजवत्कारणान्वयि ॥
translation: जिनका भोग उत्पन्न नहीं हुआ है और जो अनन्त कोटि जन्मो में किये हुए कर्मों के संस्कारभूत हैं
english_translation: For those whose experience has not arisen and who are imprinted with the karmic impressions accumulated over infinite lifetimes.
essence: Unseen karmic impressions from countless past lives shape present experience.
simple_meaning: You carry impressions from countless past actions, even if you don’t consciously experience their effects now.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that unseen past actions influence your present without defining it.
modern_relevance: You may feel stuck by habits or reactions you can’t explain—these come from long-hidden past influences.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अस्ति पूर्वार्जितं कर्मजातं तत्कर्म सञ्चितम् ।
जनकं स्थूलदेहस्य देहेऽस्मिन्नेव च प्रदम् ॥
translation: एवं बीजवत् कारणरूप जो पूर्वार्जित कर्म है वह सञ्चितकर्म कहलाते हैं । स्थूलशरीर के उत्पादक अर्थात् कारण और
english_translation: The actions you have performed before are stored as accumulated karma in this same body, which is the cause of the gross physical form.
essence: Accumulated past actions cause the formation of your present physical body.
simple_meaning: Your past actions accumulate and shape your current physical body and life circumstances.
insight: Recognize that your present condition is influenced by past actions, encouraging responsibility and awareness.
modern_relevance: After years of habits and choices, you notice how your current health and situation reflect your past decisions.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
सुखदुःखादिभोगानामास्ते पूर्वार्जितश्च यत् ।
प्रारब्धं पोच्यते कर्म तदेवाहो स्वधाभुजः ! ॥
translation: इसी देह में सुखदुःख आदि भोगों को देनेवाले जो पूर्वजन्मार्जित कर्म है वह ही प्रारब्ध कर्म कहलाते हैं
english_translation: The pleasures and pains experienced in this body are due to past life's earned karma, called the begun karma.
essence: Present experiences are the unfolding of past earned actions within this body.
simple_meaning: The joys and sufferings you experience now come from actions you performed in past lives, which are now playing out.
insight: Recognize current life events as effects of prior actions, shifting focus from blame to understanding.
modern_relevance: When you face unexpected struggles or joys, it helps to remember some results stem from past choices beyond today’s control.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
जीवदेहकृतं कर्म पापपुण्यात्मकं किल।
आस्ते यन्नूतनं कर्म तदागामि प्रचक्ष्यते ॥
translation: जीव के देह से किये हुए जो पापपुण्यात्मक नये कर्म है वह  अगामी कर्म कहे जाते हैं
english_translation: Actions done by the living body that are new and involve either harm or benefit are called future actions.
essence: New actions performed now become the causes of future experiences.
simple_meaning: New actions performed by your living body, whether good or bad, create future consequences.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that every new action plants a seed for what you will experience later.
modern_relevance: When you decide how to respond in a tense conversation, your choice creates the next moment's reality.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
ब्रह्मैवाऽस्मीसह कल्याः ! निश्चयात्मकताजुपा।
तत्र ज्ञानामिना कर्म सञ्चितं दह्यते ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: इन तीन प्रकार के कर्मों से ज्ञानी के सञ्चितकर्म " ब्रह्म ही मैं हूँ" ऐसे निश्चयात्मक ज्ञान की अग्नि से जल जाते हैं।
english_translation: The accumulated actions of the wise are surely burned by the fire of the certain knowledge 'I am Brahman'.
essence: Certain knowledge of your true self burns away all accumulated actions.
simple_meaning: When you firmly know 'I am the supreme reality,' your past actions no longer bind you.
insight: It shifts your focus from being burdened by past actions to embodying your true nature, freeing your mind.
modern_relevance: You realize that deep self-understanding can free you from past mistakes and regrets weighing you down.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
संस्कारात्मकवीजौघ ग्रास्ते सञ्चितकर्मणाम् ।
चित्ताकाशेपु सर्वेषां प्राणिनां निहितो ननु ॥
translation: सञ्चितकर्मसमूह के संस्कार रूप बीज सब प्राणियों के चित्ताकाशक जमा रहते हैं,
english_translation: The seeds of past accumulated actions dwell in the vast sky of the mind of all beings.
essence: The mind holds seeds of all past actions, shaping every being's inner world.
simple_meaning: All beings carry within their mind the impressions or seeds of their past actions.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that your present mental state is influenced by stored past impressions, not just current events.
modern_relevance: You notice how old habits or memories unconsciously influence your feelings and choices, like invisible seeds growing inside your mind.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
यदा ज्ञानिमहात्मानोऽपरोक्षज्ञानयोगतः।
पञ्चकोशा अहं नैव तेभ्योऽतीतो ह्यसंशयम् ॥
translation: जब ज्ञानी महापुरुष अपरोक्ष ज्ञान से यह जान जाते हैं कि मैं पञ्चकोश नहीं है, मैं पञ्चकोशो से अतीत
english_translation: When wise great beings directly realize through knowledge that the true self is not the five sheaths, they are undoubtedly beyond them.
essence: Your true self is beyond the five layers that seem to define you.
simple_meaning: You are not your body, mind, or senses—the five layers that seem to cover you. The true self is beyond all of them.
insight: It teaches you to look past your identity with body and mind, recognizing the deeper self beyond appearances.
modern_relevance: You might feel overwhelmed by your thoughts, feelings, and physical worries—this verse reminds you that your true self isn't limited by those layers.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
आत्मा तद्रष्टरूपोऽस्मि शुद्धो बुद्धश्च शाश्वतः ।
इत्थमेव विदन्तीह पञ्चकोशस्थितेषु वै ॥
translation: और उनमें द्रष्टा शुद्ध बुद्ध और सनातन आत्मा हूँ तब पञ्चकोश मे स्थित
english_translation: I am the pure seer, the eternal discerning mind, and the true self residing in the five sheaths.
essence: Your true self is the pure, eternal seer residing within all layers of experience.
simple_meaning: You are the pure observer, the eternal discerning mind, and the true self residing within all five layers of your being.
insight: This verse shifts how you view yourself—from being your restless thoughts to recognizing your unchanging inner witness.
modern_relevance: When your emotions and thoughts swirl uncontrollably, remember the quiet, pure presence watching it all from inside you.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
सञ्चिताः कर्मसंस्काराश्चित्ताकाशेषु संस्थिताः।
तिष्ठन्तोऽपि हि तेष्वेव न मुक्तान् बहुमीशते ॥
translation: चित्ताकाश में रहने वाले सञ्चित कर्म संस्कार भी पञ्चकोश में ही रह जाते हैं और उन मुक्त आत्माओं को बाँध नहीं कर सकते
english_translation: Accumulated impressions of past actions reside in the mind's space but cannot bind those who are truly free.
essence: Accumulated mental impressions cannot bind the truly free self.
simple_meaning: Impressions from all past actions stay in the mind but cannot bind those who are truly free.
insight: Recognize that accumulated mental patterns do not limit your inner freedom once you see beyond them.
modern_relevance: You notice old habits or memories lingering but realize they no longer control your choices or freedom.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
ज्ञानिनामिह मुक्तानां प्राणिनां पितृपुङ्गवाः !।
पारब्धकर्मणां नाशो भोगादेव प्रजायते ॥
translation: ज्ञानी मुक्त पुरुषों के प्रारब्ध कर्मों का क्षय भोग से ही होता है
english_translation: For the liberated wise ones, the exhaustion of past deeds happens only through experience.
essence: Past actions end only by fully experiencing their results, even for the wise.
simple_meaning: Your past actions, which still affect you, end only by undergoing their results fully.
insight: It shifts your approach from evasion to engagement, realizing that completion comes from experiencing results, not denial.
modern_relevance: You might wish to avoid the consequences of past choices, but only experiencing them fully frees you from their hold.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
यथा कुलालो दण्डेन चक्रं सङ्घर्ण्य घूर्णितम् ।
तत्त्यक्त्वा कुरुते हस्तौ दण्डञ्चैव पृथक् ततः ॥
translation: जिस प्रकार कुम्हार अपने कुलालचक्र को लकडी से चलाकर पीछे अपने हाथ और लकड़ी को अलग कर लेता है,
english_translation: Just as a potter, after spinning his wheel with a stick, releases the stick and his hand separately,
essence: You can fully use support and still freely let it go afterward.
simple_meaning: Like a potter who spins his wheel with a stick then releases both, you can let go of what helped you once your work is done.
insight: It teaches you to recognize when to release aids or habits that served you, freeing your hands and mind for fresh action.
modern_relevance: You finish a project and stop clutching the tools and worries that pushed you; you feel lighter and free to begin anew.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
पृथग्भूतेऽपि कौलाले चालके शक्तिसञ्चये ।
तच्छक्तिजेन वेगेन कौलालं तत्तु चक्रकम् ॥
translation: तत्पश्चात् कुम्हार के अपने चलाने की शक्ति को अलग करने पर भी वह कुलालचक्र पहली प्रयोग की हुई शक्ति से
english_translation: Even when the potter separates the power that drives the wheel, the potter's wheel continues to turn by the force of that power.
essence: The force that drives action and the action itself are inseparably linked.
simple_meaning: When the potter removes the force that drives the wheel, the wheel still turns because of that very force.
insight: It teaches you to see how your inner power and external actions are one continuous flow, not separate parts.
modern_relevance: You notice how your energy behind a project keeps it moving, even when you feel detached from the results.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
तावधूर्णायमानं स्याद्यावद्वेगो न शाम्यति ।
यावन्नैवान्यवस्तूनां योगो वा तत्र जायते ॥
translation: अपने आप ही तब तक घूमता रहता है जब तक वह शक्ति क्षय न हो जाय, या अन्य वस्तुओं का उसमें योग (स्पर्श) न हो जाय,
english_translation: It keeps revolving on its own until its energy is exhausted or it comes into contact with other objects.
essence: Energy moves freely until it fades or encounters something else.
simple_meaning: Energy or force continues moving by itself until it either runs out or touches something else.
insight: It teaches you to notice how energy flows naturally and stops only when conditions change.
modern_relevance: Your motivation or focus can keep spinning inside you until it wears out or something new grabs your attention.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
तत्त्वज्ञानिमहात्मानस्तात्त्विकज्ञानतस्तथा ।
प्राप्तवन्तोऽपि भो विज्ञाः ! जीवन्मुक्तदशामलम् ॥
translation: उसी प्रकार हे विज्ञों ! तत्त्वज्ञानी महात्मा तत्त्वज्ञान द्वारा जीवन्मुक्त दशा को प्राप्त हो जाने पर भी
english_translation: Similarly, O wise ones, even those great souls who have attained the state of liberation through true knowledge remain established in that liberated state.
essence: True knowledge anchors and sustains lasting freedom beyond initial liberation.
simple_meaning: Great souls who gain true understanding can reach and stay in the state of freedom from reactivity.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing freedom as a fleeting moment to a stable, lived reality grounded in knowledge.
modern_relevance: You may experience a breakthrough or clarity, yet lasting calm comes from holding onto that insight steadily over time.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
यावस्थूलशरीरं वै भोगं प्रारब्धकर्मणाम् ।
भुञ्जना आसते तादभोगात्तेषां क्षयो यतः ॥
translation: अपने स्थूल शरीर-उत्पन्नकारी प्रारब्ध भोग शरीर के अंतपर्यन्त भोगते रहते हैं क्योंकि प्रारब्ध कर्म का केवल भोग से ही क्षय होता है
english_translation: The gross body enjoys the results of past actions, and those results are exhausted only through enjoyment.
essence: Past actions’ effects persist until fully experienced by the body.
simple_meaning: Your physical body experiences the effects of past actions, and these effects end only by being fully experienced.
insight: It teaches you to accept and fully feel past consequences instead of resisting them, allowing natural exhaustion.
modern_relevance: You feel stuck in patterns or consequences from decisions long past, yet only by facing them fully can they dissolve.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
यथा कुलालचक्रस्य कुम्भकारेण कोऽप्यहो।
सार्द्ध घूर्णायमानस्य सम्बन्धो नास्ति तक्षणम् ॥
translation: जिस प्रकार घूमते हुए कुलाल चक्र का उस समय कुलाल के साथ सम्बन्ध नहीं रहता है
english_translation: Just as a potter has no connection with the spinning potter's wheel during its rotation.
essence: Your true self remains untouched by the restless spinning of life.
simple_meaning: Your true self is not caught up in the restless changes around you, like a potter separate from the spinning wheel.
insight: It teaches you to separate your steady inner awareness from the restless flow of external events.
modern_relevance: When chaos whirls around you, like a busy day or stressful news cycle, remember your true self is not caught in the spin.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
निःसङ्गरूपतो भोगात्तत्त्वज्ञे भोगजास्तथा ।
संस्काराः क्रियमाणानां जायन्ते नैव कर्मणाम् ॥
translation: उसी तरह निःसंग रूप से भोग होने के कारण उन कर्मों के भोग से ज्ञानी में क्रियमाण कर्मसंस्कारों की
english_translation: Just as the knower remains detached from pleasures, so the impressions of actions arise from the pleasures experienced, not from the actions themselves.
essence: Impressions arise from attachment to pleasure, not from actions themselves.
simple_meaning: The impressions or tendencies in a wise person arise because of pleasures experienced, not because of the actions themselves, which the wise remain detached from.
insight: It shifts focus from thinking actions alone create habits to understanding that attachment to pleasure forms deeper impressions.
modern_relevance: You might do many tasks without craving their results, but your desires and habits grow from what truly draws your interest or pleasure, not merely from the actions you perform.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
ज्ञानिनां नैव सम्बन्धः पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसा ।
विद्यतेऽसंशयं कल्याः ! सार्द्धमागामिकर्मभिः ॥
translation: उत्पत्ति नहीं होती है, आगामि कर्मों से ज्ञानियों का कमलदल गत जल के समान सम्बन्ध ही नहीं है
english_translation: The wise have no connection with future actions, like a lotus leaf has no bond with water on it.
essence: True wisdom means not being bound by future actions or their results.
simple_meaning: The wise do not cling to or get affected by future actions, just as a lotus leaf stays dry despite water touching it.
insight: It teaches you to recognize your inner freedom by mentally separating yourself from outcomes not yet arrived.
modern_relevance: You face uncertainty about what tomorrow holds, yet you don’t let those worries stick to your sense of self.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अतस्तान्यपि नश्यन्ति ज्ञानयोगेन सुव्रताः ।
सर्वाण्यागामिकर्माणि नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥
translation: इस कारण वह  भी ज्ञान के द्वारा नाश को प्राप्त होते जाते हैं
english_translation: Therefore, all those who are firmly devoted to the path of wisdom destroy all their past actions; no other actions need to be considered.
essence: Steadfast wisdom alone can erase the burden of all past actions.
simple_meaning: Those who firmly follow wisdom gradually free themselves from the effects of all past actions, needing no other effort.
insight: It teaches you to rely on steady wisdom to naturally dissolve past burdens instead of seeking external fixes.
modern_relevance: You’ve tried repeatedly to fix past mistakes, but consistent clear insight frees you without needing more struggle.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
पञ्चकोशा अहं नैव तेषां द्रष्टास्मि केवलम् ।
यदा त्वेवं महात्मानस्तत्त्वज्ञा ज्ञानयोगतः ॥
translation: इस प्रकार जब तत्त्वज्ञानी महापुरुष तत्त्वज्ञान के द्वारा यह समझ जाते हैं कि मैं पञ्चकोश नहीं हूँ
english_translation: When the great souls who know the truth through wisdom realize that I am not the five sheaths, I am only the seer.
essence: You are the pure awareness that sees beyond all bodily and mental layers.
simple_meaning: You are not the body, mind, or emotions; you are the one who observes all these layers.
insight: It shifts your identity from being caught in changing experiences to resting as the unchanging observer.
modern_relevance: When stress arises, you can pause and recognize that you are not your thoughts or feelings but the awareness watching them.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
विदन्ति हि तदा पञ्चकोशरूपवपुः कृता।
वघ्नीयान्नूतना मुक्तानागामिकर्मसन्ततिः ॥
translation: मैं पञ्चकोश का द्रष्टा हूँ तो पञ्चकोश रूपी शरीर का किया हुआ नवीन आगामी कर्मसमूह मुक्तात्माओं को बांध नहीं सकता
english_translation: When one realizes the true self as the five-sheath form, the new upcoming chain of actions cannot bind the liberated beings.
essence: Seeing yourself as five sheaths frees you from binding future actions.
simple_meaning: Recognizing yourself as the five-layered being means new actions cannot bind your liberated self.
insight: It shifts your view from being caught in reactive actions to recognizing your self beyond those actions.
modern_relevance: When you understand your deeper self beyond your daily habits and roles, new challenges no longer trap or limit your growth.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
सञ्चितागामिकर्माणि ज्ञानिनां पितृपुङ्गवाः !।
ब्रह्माण्डप्रकृति नूनमाश्रयन्ते न संशयः ॥
translation: हे पितृवरो! ज्ञानी के सञ्चित कर्म और आगामी कर्म निस्सन्देह ब्रह्माण्ड प्रकृति को आश्रय करने हैं
english_translation: O revered ancestors! The past and future actions of the wise surely rest in the cosmic nature.
essence: All actions of the wise merge into the cosmic natural order without doubt.
simple_meaning: The actions already done and those yet to come of wise people rest safely within the universe's natural order.
insight: It shifts your view from isolated deeds to seeing your actions as part of a universal natural process.
modern_relevance: You realize your efforts and their consequences are part of a larger natural system beyond your control.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
मुक्तात्मानो न वध्यन्ते सञ्चितागामिकर्मभिः ।
इत्ययं निश्चयो जात उक्तविज्ञानतो ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: अतः पूर्वकथित विज्ञान के अनुसार यह निश्चय हुआ कि मुक्त आत्माओं के आगामी और सञ्चित कर्म उनको पुनः बन्धन नहीं कर सकते
english_translation: According to the prior explained knowledge, it is certain that liberated beings are not bound again by their accumulated past and future actions.
essence: Liberated beings cannot be bound again by any past or future actions.
simple_meaning: Liberated beings cannot be tied down again by any actions accumulated before or after liberation.
insight: Recognize that freedom means complete release from the cycle of cause and effect tied to actions.
modern_relevance: You’ve finally let go of old mistakes and future worries; neither can trap you now.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
कर्मणां बीजरूपोऽस्ति संस्कारो यत्र सञ्चितः ।
कर्मतश्च फलोत्पत्तेरवश्यं तत्र सम्भवः ॥
translation: जहां कर्म-बीजरूप संस्कार है वहां कर्म से फलोत्पत्ति होना अवश्य सम्भव है
english_translation: Where the seed form of actions, impressions, is stored, the arising of results from actions inevitably happens there.
essence: Stored impressions within you are the seeds from which action’s results inevitably arise.
simple_meaning: Your past actions leave impressions inside you, and these impressions cause new results to arise from your actions.
insight: Understand that your inner impressions are the root causing the results your actions produce, shifting focus from just the action to what’s stored inside.
modern_relevance: You notice how past habits or experiences shape what happens when you act today, like how old patterns lead to predictable outcomes.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
सञ्चितागामिकर्माणि यतो मुक्तमहात्मनाम् ।
नैव स्पृशन्ति मुक्ताँस्तान ब्रह्माण्डप्रकृति ह्यतः ॥
translation: इस कारण मुक्त आत्मा के आगामी और सञ्चित कर्म मुक्तात्मा को स्पर्श नहीं कर सकते वह ब्रह्माण्ड प्रकृति को
english_translation: Because the liberated great soul is free, the accumulated and future actions do not touch that liberated one, for they belong to the cosmic nature.
essence: Your true self remains untouched by all accumulated and future actions.
simple_meaning: A truly liberated person is not affected by any past or future actions because those actions belong to the changing cosmic nature, not the true self.
insight: It shifts your focus from identifying with your actions to recognizing your unchanging true self beyond them.
modern_relevance: When you reflect on your past mistakes or future worries, remember your true self remains untouched and free beyond those concerns.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
आश्रयन्ते च भुज्यन्ते समष्टयात्मकतो ध्रुवम् ।
ब्रह्माण्डे शोभने यत्र मुक्तात्माऽसावजायत ॥
translation: आश्रय करते हैं। उस ब्रह्माण्ड में समष्टिरूप से वह कर्म भोगे जाते हैं। अर्थात् जिस पवित्र ब्रह्माण्ड में वह मुक्तात्मा
english_translation: The liberated beings rest and fully experience the collective in the splendid universe where they were born.
essence: Liberated beings rest in and fully experience the radiant collective universe.
simple_meaning: Liberated beings find steady rest and experience themselves as part of a magnificent collective universe.
insight: It shifts attention from feeling separate to resting in the collective radiant presence around you.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by isolation, remember you are part of a vast interconnected whole that supports and sustains you.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text: ब्रह्माण्डस्य नु तस्यैव तानि कर्माणि निश्चितम् ।            समष्टयात्मकमारब्धे सम्मिलन्ति स्वधाभुजः ! ॥
translation: उत्पन्न हुआ था उसी ब्रह्माण्ड के समष्टि प्रारब्ध वह  कर्म सम्मिलित हो जाते हैं
english_translation: The collective destiny of the universe arises from the sum of individual actions, all joined in their own sphere of influence.
essence: Individual actions collectively shape the universe's unfolding destiny.
simple_meaning: The universe's fate is formed by the sum of all individual actions joining together.
insight: It teaches you to see your actions as threads weaving into a vast shared destiny, not isolated events.
modern_relevance: Every small choice you make today adds to the bigger patterns shaping your life and those around you.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
समष्टि कर्मभिस्तैर्हि तद्ब्रह्माण्डस्य भूतिदाः ।
समष्टिसुखदुःखानि प्राप्यन्ते प्राणिभिर्बुवम ॥
translation: उन कर्मों के द्वारा उस ब्रह्माण्ड के समष्टि जीवों को समष्टि सुख दुःख प्राप्त होता है
english_translation: The collective beings of the universe experience collective joy and sorrow through collective actions.
essence: Collective actions create shared joys and sorrows among all beings in the universe.
simple_meaning: All beings in the universe share collective happiness and suffering because of their collective actions.
insight: It teaches you to see your actions as part of a larger whole affecting many lives.
modern_relevance: When you decide how to act, remember your choices influence not just you but your community's well-being.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
सत्यत्रेताद्वापराणां कलेश्चैव समुद्भवे ।
सहायकानि जायन्ते काले तानि भविष्यात ॥
translation: एवं भविष्यत् काल में सत्य, त्रेता, द्वापर, कलियुग आदि काल के उत्पन्न होने में वह सहायक होते हैं
english_translation: In the future, the ages of Satya, Treta, Dvapara, and Kali emerge, each bringing its own challenges.
essence: Each age brings its own difficulties that arise naturally over time.
simple_meaning: The four great ages—Satya, Treta, Dvapara, and Kali—each bring difficulties that arise over time.
insight: Recognize that challenges are part of the natural cycles of time and human experience.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
ज्ञानिनां मम भक्तानां भोगो भवति कर्मणाम् ।
अन्येनापि प्रकारेण यथाग्रे वो ब्रवीम्यहम् ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! मेरे ज्ञानी भक्त के कर्मों का प्रकारान्तर से भोग ऐसा भी होता है, जैसा आप लोगों से मैं कहता हूं
english_translation: For my wise devotees, the results of their actions take a different form, as I have already told you.
essence: The results of devoted wise actions can appear in unexpected, subtle forms.
simple_meaning: The results of actions performed by wise and devoted people may appear differently than usual, in unexpected ways.
insight: This teaches you to remain open to unexpected outcomes and trust that your action’s value may show differently.
modern_relevance: You worked hard on a project, but the benefits you receive might come as new opportunities or inner growth, not direct rewards.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
ज्ञानिनो ये भजन्तीह नितरामर्चयन्ति च ।
ज्ञानिभिविहितः पुण्य कर्मशो याति तान्प्रति ॥
translation: कि ज्ञानी की जो सेवा और पूजा करते हैं उनको ज्ञानी के किये हुए पुण्यकर्मों का अंश भोग करना पड़ता है
english_translation: Those who serve and worship the wise must share in the fruits of the wise one's virtuous actions.
essence: Serving the wise links you to the positive effects of their good deeds.
simple_meaning: If you serve or worship a wise person, you share in the positive results of their good actions.
insight: It teaches you that your association and service to wise people bring positive consequences to your life.
modern_relevance: When you support a mentor or a person of integrity, you often find yourself benefiting from their good influence and actions.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
दुःखप्रदानं कुर्वन्ति निन्दन्ति ज्ञानिनश्च ये।
ज्ञानिसम्पादितः पाप कर्माशस्तांस्तु गच्छति ॥
translation: और जो ज्ञानी की निन्दा करते हैं और उनको दुःख देते हैं उनको ज्ञानी के किये हुए पापकर्मों का अंश भोग करना पड़ता है
english_translation: Those who insult and cause pain to the wise must share in the consequences of the unwise actions done by the wise.
essence: Hurting the wise makes you share their mistakes' consequences.
simple_meaning: If you insult or hurt wise people, you share the burden of their wrong actions.
insight: It shifts responsibility from only the doer to also those who harm the doer, urging respect for the wise.
modern_relevance: When you speak harshly to mentors or those who guide you, you may carry the hidden fallout of their errors as well.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
मुच्यन्ते ज्ञानिनो ह्येवं निखिलः कर्मवन्धनैः।
निष्कामा भाग्यवन्तस्ते विचरन्ति महीतले ॥
translation: इस प्रकार से ज्ञानी सब कर्मों के बन्धनों से मुक्त हो जाते हैं और वे भाग्यवान् निष्काम होकर पृथिवी पर विचरते हैं
english_translation: In this way, the wise are freed from all bonds of action and wander the earth as fortunate beings without desire.
essence: Acting without desire frees you from all the bonds that tie your spirit.
simple_meaning: You become free from all the bonds of action when you act without wanting any result. Such wise people live freely and happily in the world.
insight: It teaches you to detach your inner worth from the fruits of your actions, focusing on the action itself.
modern_relevance: You finish a hard task and don’t obsess over the reward or recognition. That calm detachment frees your energy for the next moment.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
संसारापारपाथोधिमुत्तीर्य्यात्मविदो जनाः। 
ब्रह्मानन्दमुसन्दोहमत्रैवासादयन्त्यलम् ॥
translation: आत्मज्ञानी संसार समुद्र को तर कर यहीं ब्रह्मानन्द को प्राप्त होते हैं
english_translation: The wise who know the true self cross the ocean of the world and attain the bliss of the supreme reality right here.
essence: Knowing your true self lets you cross all worldly struggles and find bliss right here.
simple_meaning: Those who truly know their inner self can overcome all worldly challenges and directly experience supreme bliss here and now.
insight: It teaches you to realize that the journey through outer difficulties is also an inward process revealing bliss already present.
modern_relevance: You’ve faced overwhelming challenges and storms in life, yet the peace you seek isn’t far away — it’s already within reach here.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
तरन्त्यात्मविदो भक्ता निश्चितं शोकसागरम् ।
सर्वभूतेषु गूढोऽस्ति देव एको न संशयः ॥
translation: "आत्मज्ञानी सब शोकों को तर जाता है " "एक ही आत्मदेव सब भूतो में व्यापक है"
english_translation: Those who truly know the self certainly cross the ocean of sorrow. The one inner divine presence dwells hidden in all beings without doubt.
essence: True self-knowledge reveals the one divine presence hidden in all, overcoming sorrow.
simple_meaning: If you truly know your inner self, you can overcome all sorrow because the same divine presence exists within everyone, even if hidden.
insight: It shifts your perspective from isolation in pain to recognizing your shared divine essence with all beings.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by grief, remember your inner connection to the divine shared by all beings, which gives strength to endure.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
भिद्यते हृदयग्रन्थिरित्यादिशास्त्रसम्मतेः ।
जीवन्मुक्ता महात्मानः साक्षाब्रह्मस्वरूपिणः ॥
translation: "आत्मज्ञान से हृदय की ग्रंथि खुल जाती है" ये शास्त्रों में कहा है इसलिये जीवन्मुक्त महापुरुष साक्षात् ब्रह्मरूप ही हैं।
english_translation: "The knot of the heart is untied by self-knowledge," the scriptures say; thus, liberated great beings are directly the form of the supreme reality.
essence: Self-knowledge unties the heart’s knot, revealing the liberated as the supreme reality itself.
simple_meaning: Knowing your true self unties the deepest knot in your heart, freeing you from inner bondage.
insight: It teaches you to look within for liberation, shifting focus from external fixes to inner clarity.
modern_relevance: When you face overwhelming stress, this teaching reminds you that clarity about who you are frees you from inner tension.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
चिजड़यन्थिसम्बन्धो योऽभूज्जीवदशोद्भवे ।
छिन्नो मुक्तदशायां स भवेज्जीवः शिवो ह्यतः ॥
translation: जीवदशा में जड़ और चेतन की जो ग्रन्थि बनी थी वह अन्धि मुक्तदशा में खुल जानेसे जीव शिवरूप हो जाता है
english_translation: When the knot binding the inert and the conscious in the state of living breaks in the state of liberation, the living being becomes like Shiva.
essence: Breaking the inner knot between inertness and consciousness reveals your true divine nature.
simple_meaning: The inner bond that ties the lifeless and conscious parts breaks in liberation, making you like Shiva.
insight: It shifts your view from being trapped in inner conflicts to recognizing freedom through breaking internal bonds.
modern_relevance: You’ve felt stuck between your habits and your awareness. Releasing that inner tension frees you to be your fullest self.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
ब्रह्मेशकोटिभेदेन जीवन्मुक्तो द्विधा मतः।
पारब्धकर्मणां तत्र जीवन्मुक्तमहात्मनाम् ॥
translation: जीवन्मुक्त महापुरुष दो श्रेणी के होते हैं। एक ब्रह्मकोटि के जीवन्मुक्त और दूसरे ईशकोटि के जीवन्मुक्त।
english_translation: There are two kinds of liberated great beings: those of the Brahma class and those of the Ishvara class.
essence: Liberation appears in two forms: as pure awareness or as divine embodiment beyond karma.
simple_meaning: There are two types of liberated beings: one who is free as pure consciousness and another who is free while still connected to divine power.
insight: It teaches you to recognize liberation as multiple states: quiet inner freedom or empowered presence beyond karma.
modern_relevance: You might meet people who seem fully free—some calm and detached, others powerfully engaged yet unaffected. Both are valid forms of freedom.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
वैचित्र्यमेव हेतुः स्यात्मभेदे द्विविधे ध्रुवम्।
ब्रह्मकोटि समापन्ना जीवन्मुक्ता भवन्त्यहो ॥
translation: मुक्त दशा में मुक्तात्मा के अवशेष रहे हुए प्रारब्ध कर्मों की विचित्रता ही इन दो भेदो का कारण है ।
english_translation: The difference between the two types of liberated beings arises solely from the variety of remaining past actions in the liberated state.
essence: Inner freedom can manifest differently because subtle past actions remain after liberation.
simple_meaning: There are two types of liberated beings because of differences in the subtle effects of past actions that remain after liberation.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that inner freedom can coexist with subtle influences from past conditioning.
modern_relevance: You might feel free inside, yet old habits or patterns subtly shape how you show up and behave.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
आत्मारामाः सदा मूका जगत्सम्बन्धवर्जिता: ।
ईशकोटि श्रिता ये च जीवन्मुक्ताः स्वदिनः ॥
translation: ब्रह्मकोटि के जीवन्मुक्त मूक और आत्माराम होते हैं । जगत के साथ उनका कोई सम्बन्ध पुनः नहीं रहता है और ईशकोटि के जीवन्मुक्त
english_translation: Liberated beings, delighted in their true self, are always silent and free from all worldly ties; those who dwell in the supreme being are liberated forever.
essence: True liberation is silent freedom beyond all worldly attachments.
simple_meaning: True liberated beings are always quiet and unaffected by worldly connections, living in freedom within the supreme reality.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate inner silence and release attachment to the outer world to experience true liberation.
modern_relevance: In a world full of constant noise and distractions, this reminds you that true freedom comes from silence and detachment from external chaos.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
त ईशप्रतिमाः सन्तो भगवत्कार्य्यरूपतः ।
सरक्ता विश्वकल्याणे सन्तिष्ठन्ते महीतले ॥
translation: ईश्वर प्रतिनिधि रूप होकर भगवत कार्यरूप से जगत् कल्याण में रत रहते हैं ।
english_translation: The divine representatives embody sacred duties and remain engaged in the world's welfare.
essence: True representatives live fully in their sacred role, devoted to the world's welfare.
simple_meaning: You are meant to take on your sacred duty and stay engaged in helping the world.
insight: It shifts your view of duty from burden to meaningful service, inspiring sustained action for others' benefit.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by your responsibilities, remembering your role as a force for good can renew your purpose.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
विश्वमेवंविधैरेव ह्योकमात्रं स्वधाभुजः !।
भवन्त्युपकृतं धन्यं जीवन्मुक्तर्महात्मभिः ॥
translation: केवलमात्र ऐसे ही जीवन्मुक्त महापुरुषों के उपकार से उपकृत होकर जगत् धन्य होता है
english_translation: The entire world is blessed solely by the grace of great liberated beings.
essence: True freedom in great beings alone brings lasting blessing to the world.
simple_meaning: The whole world becomes truly blessed only because of the kindness and presence of great liberated people.
insight: It shifts your view to value inner freedom as the greatest source of positive influence and blessing for the world.
modern_relevance: You see someone who lives with calm and freedom, and you realize how their peace spreads quietly to everyone they touch, making life better beyond words.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
संन्ति भागवता एवं भगवद्भपिणो ध्रुवम् ।
तेषां सततयक्तानां मय्येव पितृपुङ्गवाः ! ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! इस प्रकार से भागवत गण भगवद्गप ही हो जाते हैं। मुझमें ही सदा युक्त रहने से
english_translation: O ancestors, those devoted to the divine always unite with me alone.
essence: Steady devotion binds you permanently to the divine presence.
simple_meaning: Those who are devoted and always connected to the divine remain firmly united with it.
insight: It teaches you to nurture steady devotion as a means to maintain constant inner connection with the divine.
modern_relevance: When you keep your heart focused on what you truly care about, you feel deeply connected and supported.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
चित्ते सर्वज्ञतावीजं भवत्यारोपितं खलु।
मत्कार्यतत्परांस्तांश्च सर्वथा मत्परायणान् ॥
translation: सर्वज्ञता का बीज उनके अन्तःकरण में अरोपित हो जाता है। सर्वथा मत्परायण और मेरे कार्य में तत्पर होने से
english_translation: The seed of omniscience is implanted in the heart of those wholly devoted to me and fully absorbed in my work.
essence: Complete devotion and absorption plant the seed of true knowing in your heart.
simple_meaning: If you are completely devoted and absorbed in the divine's work, deep wisdom naturally arises within your heart.
insight: It teaches you to trust that wholehearted devotion cultivates inner wisdom beyond effort or intellect.
modern_relevance: When you commit fully to a purpose or passion, a deep understanding begins to grow inside you, even if you don’t see it immediately.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
देशकालौ न वाधेते कथञ्चित् किल कहिंचित ।
जीवन्मुक्ता महात्मान ईशकोटिं समाश्रिताः ॥
translation: देश और काल उनको किसी प्रकार कभी बाधा नहीं दे सके। ईशकोटि के जीवन्मुक्त
english_translation: The liberated great souls who belong to the Ishakoti lineage are never obstructed by place or time in any way.
essence: Liberated souls of the Ishakoti group are never limited by place or time.
simple_meaning: Great liberated beings of the Ishakoti group are never blocked or limited by any place or time.
insight: It shows that true freedom means you are not limited by external circumstances like location or era.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
यत्किञ्चनेह संसारे कार्ये कुर्वन्ति सन्ततम् ।
कार्यं ममैव तत्सर्वं कुर्वते पितृपुङ्गवाः ! ॥
translation: इस संसार में जो कुछ कार्य करते हैं सो मेरा ही कार्य करते हैं क्योंकि उस समय
english_translation: All actions performed in this world are ultimately my actions, for the forefathers act as my instruments.
essence: Every action in the world is an expression of a singular divine purpose.
simple_meaning: Everything people do in this world is actually part of a greater purpose that belongs to the divine order.
insight: It shifts your mindset from isolated effort to alignment with a deeper universal purpose.
modern_relevance: When you feel your work is small or unnoticed, remember it contributes to something bigger than you see.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
यतोऽन्तःकरणं तेषां जवाहङ्कारवर्जितम्।
पूर्यते समदर्शित्व-निरासक्तयादिभिस्तदा ॥
translation: उनका अन्तःकरण समदर्शिता और निरासक्ति से पूर्ण होकर जैव अहङ्कार से रहित हो जाता है।
english_translation: Their inner being becomes pure, free from bodily ego, filled with equal vision and detachment.
essence: Purity of inner being arises when bodily ego falls away into equal vision and detachment.
simple_meaning: When your inner being is free of bodily ego and filled with equal vision and detachment, it becomes pure and steady.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate equal vision and detachment to cleanse your inner being from egoic distortions.
modern_relevance: You notice peace when your reactive ego softens and you stop clinging to outcomes or identities tied to your body.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
भगवत्कार्यबुद्धयैव निरीक्ष्यन्ते निरन्तरम् ।
सर्वस्मिन् समये ते च परार्थे केवलं रताः ॥
translation: तब वह सभी अवस्थाओं में भगवान का काम समझकर केवल परार्थ कार्य में ही निरन्तर रत देख पड़ते हैं
english_translation: They constantly observe the divine's work in all situations and remain devoted only to actions for the welfare of others.
essence: True devotion means constantly watching the divine's work and serving others alone.
simple_meaning: You attentively watch the divine's work in every moment and remain dedicated only to helping others.
insight: It teaches you to shift focus from personal desires to selfless service inspired by awareness of the divine.
modern_relevance: You notice how your efforts affect those around you and choose to act for their benefit, not just your own.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
तज्ज्ञानं सर्वभूतेप्ववरोधशून्यतां गतम् ।
अत्रैक्यं खलु संस्थाप्याऽद्वैतभावं प्रपद्यते ॥
translation: उनका ज्ञान तब सर्वभूत में अवरोध शून्य होकर सर्वभूतों में एकता स्थापन करके अद्वैतभाव को प्राप्त करता है
english_translation: That knowledge removes all obstacles in all beings, establishing unity and leading to non-dual awareness.
essence: Removing all inner obstacles reveals the oneness underlying all beings.
simple_meaning: When knowledge removes all obstacles inside beings, it reveals their essential unity and leads to seeing everything as one without division.
insight: This teaches you to recognize and remove mental barriers, shifting from separation to oneness in perception.
modern_relevance: When you overcome mental blocks and judgments, you experience connection and unity with others instead of division.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
यदाऽहं ज्ञानिभक्तेषु प्रसीदामि तदैव ते ।
जीवन्मुक्तिपदं प्राप्तुं शक्नुवन्ति स्वधाभुजः ! ॥
translation: मैं जब अपने ज्ञानी भक्तों पर प्रसन्न होता हूँ वह जीवन्मुक्ति पदवी को प्राप्त कर सकते हैं।
english_translation: When I am pleased with my wise devotees, they are able to attain the state of freedom while living.
essence: Wise devotion that pleases the divine enables freedom while still living.
simple_meaning: If you cultivate wise devotion that pleases the divine, you can gain freedom while still living.
insight: It teaches that combining devotion with clear understanding allows you to transcend limitation without waiting for death.
modern_relevance: You’ve sought meaning with both heart and mind; when your devotion aligns with wise understanding, freedom becomes reachable even in daily life.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
यदाऽऽर्ताऽर्थाणिजिज्ञासुभक्ता मच्छरणागताः।
स्युस्तदा प्रकृतिर्मेऽसौ मातृभावं समाश्रिता ॥
translation: मेरे आर्त्त जिज्ञासु और अर्थार्थी भक्त जब मेरे शरणागत होते हैं तब मेरी प्रकृति मातृभाव धारण करके
english_translation: When my devoted seekers and those in need take refuge in me, my nature embraces the feeling of a mother.
essence: The divine responds to sincere seekers with a nurturing, motherly care.
simple_meaning: When devoted seekers come to Shiva in need, he responds with caring and protective motherly love.
insight: It teaches you to trust that sincere seeking invites compassionate, nurturing support.
modern_relevance: When you reach out honestly for help, you can experience genuine care that feels like a protective embrace.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
तेभ्यो वै बाञ्छिताः सिद्धीर्दत्त्वाऽग्रे सारयेदिमान्।
सर्वतः सर्वथा कल्याः ! नैव कार्योऽत्र विस्मयः ॥
translation: उनको वाञ्छित सिद्धियां प्राप्त कराती हुई मेरी ओर सर्वथा अग्रसर करती है इसमें विस्मय नहीं करना चाहिये
english_translation: The desired perfections arise from them and move fully toward me; there is no need to be surprised by this.
essence: Desired blessings naturally flow toward the divine without cause for surprise.
simple_meaning: What you truly desire will come to you completely and naturally; you don't need to be shocked by this.
insight: Trust that your efforts and the universe’s support are aligned, so you can relax into the process.
modern_relevance: You’ve worked hard toward your goals, and the results are unfolding steadily—there’s no need to doubt or be startled.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
यदा मेऽर्थार्थिनो भक्ताः प्रकृतेर्मे यथार्थतः।
दृष्ट्वा स्वरूपमस्याः स्युरुषास्तौ सिद्धकामनाः ॥
translation: जब मेरे अर्थार्थी भक्त मेरी प्रकृति का यथार्थ स्वरूप देखकर उनकी उपासना में सफलकाम होते हैं
english_translation: When my devoted followers truly see the real nature of my being, they succeed in their devoted practice.
essence: True devotion flourishes only when you clearly see the divine's real nature.
simple_meaning: Devoted followers who clearly perceive the true nature of the divine succeed in their spiritual practice.
insight: It teaches you to seek clear understanding of what you devote yourself to, making your practice genuine and effective.
modern_relevance: You realize your efforts deepen when you understand the true spirit behind your commitment, not just the surface.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
तदा मे प्रकृतिनूनं यथा नारी पतिव्रता ।
पत्युः केवलकल्याणानन्दवर्द्धनतत्परा ॥
translation: तब जिस प्रकार सती स्त्री अपने पति की एकमात्र कल्याण और आनन्द प्रदायिनी ही होती है
english_translation: Then, just as a devoted wife is solely focused on her husband's welfare and joy,
essence: Devotion means fully focusing on the welfare of the beloved.
simple_meaning: A devoted wife focuses only on her husband's well-being and happiness.
insight: It shows how deep commitment involves making someone's wellbeing your priority.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
तानेवाार्थार्थिनो भक्तांस्तथा विश्वविभूतिदाः।
आभिमुख्येन मे नूनं करोत्यग्रेसरान क्रमात् ॥
translation: उसी प्रकार मेरी प्रकृति उन उत्तम अर्थार्थी भक्तों को क्रमशः मेरी ओर अग्रसर करती है
english_translation: Similarly, my nature gradually draws those devoted to the highest meaning closer to me.
essence: Devotion naturally and gradually draws you closer to the divine presence.
simple_meaning: Your inner nature naturally leads devoted seekers closer to the divine presence over time.
insight: It teaches you to trust the natural unfolding of devotion and connection rather than forcing progress.
modern_relevance: You notice how your genuine care and focus on what matters pulls you steadily toward your goals without strain.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
केवलं ज्ञानिनो भक्ताः स्वज्ञानोपास्तिपूर्तितः।
लीना मत्प्रकृतौ सम्यङ्नूनमासादयन्ति माम ॥
translation: केवले ज्ञानी भक्त ही अपने ज्ञान और उपासना की पूर्णता के प्रभाव से मेरी प्रकृति में सम्यक् लय होकर मुझको प्राप्त करते हैं ।
english_translation: Only those who are devoted and wise, perfected in their knowledge and worship, truly merge into my nature and attain me.
essence: Only devotion perfected by knowledge fully unites you with the divine nature.
simple_meaning: Only those who combine devoted love with deep understanding truly unite with the divine nature and reach it fully.
insight: It teaches you to harmonize your heart’s devotion with your mind’s clarity for full spiritual integration.
modern_relevance: When your heartfelt care meets clear understanding, you connect deeply with what truly matters beyond surface appearances.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
उपास्तेरधिकारस्य त्रिविधस्यैतदेव हि ।
रहस्यं विद्यते कल्याः ! सत्यमेतन्न संशयः ॥
translation: यही उपासना विविध अधिकार का रहस्य है । हे पितृगण ! यह सत्य है।
english_translation: The secret of the threefold right of worship is indeed this; O ancestors, this is the truth beyond doubt.
essence: Worship has a threefold secret right that is a certain, auspicious truth.
simple_meaning: There is a secret about the three kinds of rights in worship, and this truth is certain and auspicious.
insight: It invites you to recognize that spiritual practice has nuanced dimensions requiring attentive understanding.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
पश्यन्तो ज्ञानिनो भक्ता मा सर्वत्रैव सर्वदा ।
दिव्याचारस्य जायन्ते सर्वथैवाधिकारिणः ॥
translation: ज्ञानी भक्त ही मुझको सदा सब जगहों में देखते हुए दिव्याचार के अधिकारी बन जाते हैं
english_translation: The wise devotee always sees me everywhere and thus becomes fully qualified in divine conduct.
essence: Seeing the divine everywhere qualifies you for living with sacred conduct.
simple_meaning: Those who are wise and devoted see the divine everywhere and naturally embody sacred conduct.
insight: It shifts your perspective from separation to seeing sacredness everywhere, inspiring consistent ethical living.
modern_relevance: In a world full of distractions, recognizing a sacred presence around you transforms your actions into meaningful conduct.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
जीवन्मुक्तिपदस्यैतद्रहस्यं वित्त सत्तमाः ।
पुरा यद्वणितं कल्याः ! लोककल्याणसम्पदे ॥
translation: ही जीवन्मुक्ति पदवी का रहस्य है, मैने लोककल्याण के लिये जिसका वर्णन पहले किया है
english_translation: This is the secret of the state of liberation that I have previously described for the welfare of the world.
essence: The secret of liberation is key to the well-being of all beings.
simple_meaning: This reveals the secret of liberation that was described earlier for the benefit of all beings.
insight: It shows that true liberation is linked with the well-being of everyone, not just individual freedom.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
जीवन्मुक्तिपदाऽऽरूढान मद्भक्तान ज्ञानिनो वरान् ।
नालं मे प्रकृतेः सक्तान् कर्तुं किमपि वैभवम् ॥
translation: मेरे श्रेष्ठ जीवन्मुक्त पदवी प्राप्त ज्ञानी भक्तों को मेरी प्रकृति का कोई वैभव फंसा नहीं सकता है।
english_translation: My best devotees and wise ones who have attained liberation are not attached to any grandeur of my nature.
essence: True liberation is freedom from attachment to all displays of divine grandeur.
simple_meaning: Those who are truly liberated and devoted are not caught by any display or power of the divine nature.
insight: It teaches you to see beyond surface grandeur and not let external power define your inner freedom.
modern_relevance: You may feel trapped by the impressive status or power around you, but true freedom means not being caught by such appearances.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
देशकालात्मकाः कर्मरूपा अपि विभूतयः।
सन्ति मे प्रकृतेर्मुख्यास्तिस्रस्ताभ्योऽपि मामकाः ॥
translation: काल देश और कर्मरूपी जो मेरी प्रकृति की तीन प्रधान विभूतियां हैं उनसे भी मेरे
english_translation: Among my nature's three principal powers are time, place, and action.
essence: Time, place, and action are the three main powers shaping all existence.
simple_meaning: Your nature is influenced by three main powers: time, place, and the actions you perform.
insight: Recognize how your context and behavior form your experience; this helps you navigate change with clarity.
modern_relevance: When you feel stuck or changed, it’s often the moment, the environment, and your choices shaping you more than you realize.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
भक्ता भवन्त्यतीता हि जीवन्मुक्ता न संशयः।
भूयोऽहं व्यासतो वक्ष्ये सावधाननिशम्यताम् ॥
translation: जीवन्मुक्त भक्त अतीत हो जाते हैं इनको मैं और विस्तारपूर्वक कहता हूं सुनो
english_translation: Devotees who have attained inner freedom have gone beyond all doubts. I will explain this further; listen carefully.
essence: Devotion leads beyond all doubt to a state of inner freedom.
simple_meaning: Devotees who have reached true inner freedom no longer have doubts. This teaching will be explained more fully.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that steady devotion can dissolve uncertainty and bring lasting inner freedom.
modern_relevance: When your trust in your path deepens, your worries and doubts begin to fade, bringing a calm certainty.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
महाकालश्च कालश्च पिता चैव स्वधाभुजः !।
सगुणस्य स्वरूपस्य सन्तीमा मे विभूतयः ॥
translation: हे जिज्ञास्तु पितृगण ! महाकाल, काल और पिता ये मेरी सगुणरूप की विभूतियां हैं
english_translation: O seekers among the ancestors, Mahakala, Kala, and the father are my manifestations with qualities.
essence: Cosmic time and ancestral figures are expressions of the divine's manifested qualities.
simple_meaning: Mahakala, Kala, and the father among ancestors are forms of my manifested qualities.
insight: It reveals how divine qualities manifest through cosmic time and ancestral forms, connecting eternity with lineage.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
देशश्च जन्मभूमिश्च माता चैव बुभुत्सवः !।
मुख्या मत्मकृतेनूर्नमिमाः सन्ति विभूतयः ॥
translation: और देश, जन्मभूमि एवं माता यह  मेरी प्रकृति की प्रधान विभूतियां हैं ।
english_translation: The land, birthplace, and mother are the principal manifestations of my nature.
essence: Your homeland and mother reveal the divine nature through their presence.
simple_meaning: Land, birthplace, and mother are the main expressions of the divine nature described here.
insight: It invites you to see the sacred in your roots and surroundings, recognizing them as expressions of a larger reality.
modern_relevance: The place you come from and your family shape your sense of self and connection to the world around you.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
निजान्तःकरणेप्वेव त्रिविधाऽकाशरूपतः।
सर्वव्यापकदेशोऽयमनुभूयत एव ह ॥
translation: निज अन्तःकरण में ही विविध आकाशरूप से सर्वव्यापक देश का अनुभव होता है
english_translation: Within your own inner being, you directly experience the all-pervading space in its threefold forms.
essence: The infinite, all-encompassing space is directly experienced within your own inner being.
simple_meaning: Inside your own inner being, you experience the vast, all-encompassing space in three forms.
insight: It shifts your focus inward to discover that the infinite and boundless qualities you seek are already within you.
modern_relevance: When you pause and feel deeply inside, you recognize the vast openness and freedom present within you beyond the daily noise.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अतोऽपि स्वशरीराणि मन्यन्ते प्राणिनां कृते ।
योगिनः प्रकृतेर्मुख्यविभूत्यात्मकतः स्वतः ॥
translation: इस कारण निज शरीर भी जीव के लिये मेरी प्रकृति की प्रधान विभूतिरूप से योगिगण मानते हैं।
english_translation: Therefore, yogis naturally regard their own bodies as the primary manifestation of nature for living beings.
essence: Your body is nature’s principal form naturally recognized by those who seek wisdom.
simple_meaning: Those who practice yoga naturally recognize their own body as the main form of nature for living beings.
insight: It shifts attention to seeing your body as a natural, primary expression of the living world rather than a separate object.
modern_relevance: When you feel disconnected from your body during stress, remember it naturally embodies the vital force of life itself.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
प्रकृतेः स्पन्दनं यत्स्यात्सम्बन्धाद्देशकालयोः।
कर्म तत् च्यते विज्ञैर्विसर्गात्मकमेव तत् ॥
translation: देश और काल के सम्बन्ध से मेरी प्रकृति के स्पन्दन को कर्म कहते है,
english_translation: The movement of my nature related to place and time is called action by the wise; it is merely a form of release.
essence: Action is the natural movement of changing nature in relation to time and place.
simple_meaning: Action is the natural movement of the world connected to time and place, seen by the wise as a release.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing action as personal effort to seeing it as the unfolding of natural forces.
modern_relevance: When you rush to judge your choices as success or failure, remember they are just natural movements shaped by circumstances beyond you.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
भूतभावोद्भवकरो विसर्गो विद्यते किल ।
त्रिविधं कथ्यते कर्म सहजादिप्रभेदतः ॥
translation: वह भूतभावोद्भव कर विसर्गरूप है । वह कर्म सहजादि रूप से त्रिविध कहाता है ।
english_translation: The divine is the cause from which all beings arise and dissolve; action is described in three kinds by its nature and origin.
essence: All existence flows from one source; actions naturally divide into three types.
simple_meaning: Everything that exists comes from one origin and returns there; actions naturally appear in three types.
insight: This verse shifts your view to see your actions as natural expressions arising from a shared origin.
modern_relevance: You can feel overwhelmed by choices, but recognizing actions fall into clear types helps you find your place in the flow.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अपि तेपामनेकांश्च भेदान कर्मविदो विदुः ।
यदा मे ज्ञानिनो भक्ता जीवन्मुक्तिपदं ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: कर्मतत्वदर्शियों ने उन तीनों के भी अनेक भेद कहे हैं। मेरे ज्ञानी भक्त जब जीवन्मुक्त पदवी को
english_translation: Even the experts in action describe many distinctions among the three paths. But my wise devotees firmly attain the state of living liberation.
essence: Wise devotion transcends distinctions and guarantees living liberation.
simple_meaning: Different experts describe many distinctions in the three paths, but wise devotees firmly achieve living liberation.
insight: It shifts focus from debating paths to trusting devotion as the sure way to freedom.
modern_relevance: You might hear many opinions about how to grow or find freedom, but your sincere devotion can guide you steadily beyond confusion.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
प्राप्नुवन्ति तदा देश-कालकर्म्माणि तानहो ।
किञ्चिन्नैवापवाधन्ते सत्यं सत्यं ब्रवीमि वः ॥
translation: प्राप्त कर लेते हैं तो देश, काल और कर्म उनको कुछ भी बाधा नहीं दे सकते
english_translation: Once you attain that, place, time, and actions no longer obstruct you; truly, I tell you this.
essence: True attainment frees you from all external limitations of time, place, and actions.
simple_meaning: When you truly reach a certain state, external factors like place, time, or past actions cannot stop you.
insight: It teaches you to see beyond external conditions and realize your progress is not confined by them.
modern_relevance: You feel stuck by your circumstances, deadlines, or past mistakes, but this shows you can still move beyond those limits.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
गुणत्रयस्य सम्बन्धादेषां भेदांश्र वर्णये ।
श्रूयन्तां सावधानैस्ते भवद्भिश्च शनैः शनैः ॥
translation: त्रिगुण के सम्बन्ध से इनका भेद वर्णन करता हूँ, सुनें ।
english_translation: I describe the distinctions among the three qualities slowly and attentively; please listen carefully.
essence: Clear understanding requires careful, slow explanation of subtle distinctions.
simple_meaning: I will explain the differences between the three qualities carefully and slowly for you to understand.
insight: It teaches you to approach complex knowledge patiently and attentively for clear understanding.
modern_relevance: When learning complex ideas, taking time and attention reveals their true meaning clearly.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
विभ्वनिर्वचनीयौ द्वावतिसूक्ष्मौ गुणान्वयात् ।
शक्यौ देशमहाकालौ विज्ञातुं नैव कहिर्चित ॥
translation: सूक्ष्माति सूक्ष्म, विभु और अनिर्वचनीय देश और महाकाल गुण के सम्बन्ध से जाने नहीं जाते
english_translation: The vast and the indescribable are too subtle and fine to be truly known through qualities or time.
essence: The vast and indescribable cannot be captured by qualities or time.
simple_meaning: The infinite and indescribable cannot be understood by typical qualities or by measuring time or space.
insight: It teaches you to accept that some realities are beyond conceptual grasp and measurement.
modern_relevance: You try to fully understand something immense, but it slips beyond all labels and measures.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
किन्तु तौ भावसम्बन्धाज्ज्ञातुं शक्यौ न संशयः ।
जीवन्मुक्ता महात्मानः शक्तितो देशकालयोः ॥
translation: परन्तु वह भाव के सम्बन्ध से जाने जाते हैं। जीवन्मुक महापुरुष ब्रह्मभाव की धारणा  द्वारा देश और काल की शक्ति से
english_translation: However, they are known by their connection to feelings; the liberated great beings realize the supreme nature beyond the power of place and time.
essence: True freedom is known through feeling its connection beyond time and place.
simple_meaning: Great liberated beings are recognized by their connection to deep feelings and the supreme nature beyond all limits of place and time.
insight: It teaches you to see your identity beyond external conditions, recognizing your timeless inner nature.
modern_relevance: You might feel defined by your environment or schedule, but your true self connects beyond any circumstance or moment.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
स्वयं धारणयाऽऽत्मानं ब्रह्मभावस्य शुद्धया।
विमोक्तुं शक्नुवन्तीह नात्रास्ते कोऽपि विस्मयः ॥
translation: अपने आप को मुक्त कर लेते है इसमें विस्मय नहीं है।
english_translation: Those who uphold themselves in the pure state of supreme reality can free themselves here; there is no wonder in this.
essence: Steady connection to your pure true self naturally leads to your freedom here and now.
simple_meaning: When you firmly hold yourself in the pure state of your highest reality, you can free yourself; it is natural and unsurprising.
insight: It shifts your focus to sustaining pure self-awareness as the key to liberation rather than seeking external change.
modern_relevance: When you stay grounded in your core true self, even amid chaos, freedom from overwhelm naturally arises without surprise.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
यदा मे प्रकृतेधीराः ! त्रैगुण्योपाधिसंयुतः।
कल्पमन्वन्तरादीनि नानारूपाणि सन्धरन् ॥
translation: महाकाल जब मेरी प्रकृति के त्रिगुण-उपाधि से युक्त होकर कल्प मन्वन्तर आदि अनेक रूपों को धारण करके
english_translation: When the great time, bound by the three qualities of my nature, takes on many forms through cycles of creation and dissolution.
essence: Nature's three qualities shape endless forms through cosmic cycles of time.
simple_meaning: The great time, connected with the three qualities of nature, takes on many forms through cycles of cosmic creation and destruction.
insight: Recognize that the changing world and its many forms arise from underlying natural qualities acting over time.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
चतुर्युगमैहाकाल ऋतुभिः षडभिरेव च ।
प्रत्यक्षत्वं गतो लोके जीववर्गेषु सन्ततम् ॥
translation: अन्त में चार युग और छः ऋतुरूप से प्रत्यक्ष होकर जीव पर
english_translation: In the end, the four ages and six seasons manifest continuously in the cycle of living beings.
essence: Life continuously unfolds through repeating cycles of ages and seasons.
simple_meaning: The four ages and six seasons appear continuously in the world among living beings.
insight: Recognize that life unfolds within constant cycles of change beyond any one individual.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
प्रभावं तनुते स्वीयं जीवन्मुक्तमहात्मनाम् ।
अत्येति निर्मला बुद्धिस्तथाप्युक्तप्रभावतः ॥
translation: प्रभाव डालता है किन्तु तब भी जीवन्मुक्त महात्माओं की निर्मल बुद्धि उक्त प्रभावों से भी अतीत हो जाती है।
english_translation: The influence affects, yet the pure wisdom of the liberated great souls surpasses even such influences.
essence: Pure wisdom transcends all external influences without being disturbed.
simple_meaning: Influences may reach you, but pure wisdom in liberated beings goes beyond them.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that true clarity in your mind is untouched by external pressures or influences.
modern_relevance: When criticism or pressure tries to cloud your judgment, your clear understanding can still hold steady and true.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
तथैव प्रकृतेनूनं गुणान् देशो यदा धरन् ।
राशिनक्षत्रसूर्यादिग्रहोपग्रहमुख्यकान् ॥
translation: उसी प्रकार जब देश प्रकृति गुणो को धारण करके राशि, नक्षत्र, सूर्य, ग्रह और उपग्रह आदि
english_translation: Similarly, nature takes on qualities according to the region, supporting constellations, sun, planets, and satellites.
essence: Nature’s qualities change based on cosmic and regional influences.
simple_meaning: Nature adopts qualities depending on the region and the influence of celestial bodies like stars and planets.
insight: It shifts your view to see nature and environment as shaped by larger cosmic patterns rather than isolated factors.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
नानारूपोच्चयान् धृत्वा मातृभूरूपतस्ततः। 
पार्वत्यपर्वतप्राय्त्मरुदेशोपरादिभिः ॥
translation: अनेक रूपों को धारण करता हुआ,अन्त में मातृभूमि रूप से पार्वत्य, पर्वतप्राय, मरु, ऊषर,
english_translation: Taking on many forms, finally assuming the form of the motherland—like Parvati, a mountain, desert, and wilderness.
essence: The divine manifests in many forms, ultimately as the sacred motherland itself.
simple_meaning: The divine takes many forms and finally appears as the motherland, including forms like Parvati, mountains, deserts, and wilderness.
insight: Recognize the divine in diverse forms around you, including the natural world and homeland.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
सजलैजलजैश्चापि षड़ेृपैरूक्तनामकैः। 
ब्राह्मणादिचतुर्वर्णरूपभूभेदतोऽथवा ॥
translation: सजल और जलज छः रूप से अथवा ब्राह्मणादि चतुर्वर्णरूपी भूमि भेद से
english_translation: The earth is described by six forms—water-born and water-containing—or divided by the four varnas starting with Brahmins.
essence: The earth can be described in multiple ways reflecting different viewpoints.
simple_meaning: The earth is described in different ways—by six water-related forms or by its division into four varnas starting with Brahmins.
insight: It teaches that reality can be categorized differently depending on perspective or context.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
जीवानासक्तिपाशेषु निबध्नाति तथाप्यहो।
जीवन्मुक्तगणस्येह बुद्धिरव्यभिचारिणी ॥
translation: जीव को आसक्ति में बांधता है, वैसा होने पर भी जीवन्मुक्त महात्मा की अव्यभिचारिणी बुद्धि
english_translation: Attachment binds the living being, yet the liberated soul here has an unwavering intellect.
essence: Attachment binds most, but the liberated mind remains steady and unwavering.
simple_meaning: Attachment ties ordinary beings, but a liberated person’s mind stays steady and never wavers.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that your true mind can stay stable despite external attachments pulling you.
modern_relevance: You might feel overwhelmed by desires pulling you every way, yet deep inside, your mind can remain calm and steady, untouched by that chaos.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
नैवापतति कुत्रापि मुदृढ़े तस्य बन्धने । 
जीवन्मुक्तस्थितियस्मात्पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसि ॥
translation: उसके सुदृढ़ बन्धन में नहीं पड़ती है क्योंकि जीवन्मुक्तों की स्थिति जल में कमलपत्र के समान होती है
english_translation: The liberated being does not fall into any strong bondage because their state of freedom is like a lotus leaf on water.
essence: True freedom leaves you untouched by any strong bond, like a lotus leaf on water.
simple_meaning: When you reach true freedom, no strong bond can hold you, just like a lotus leaf stays dry on water.
insight: It teaches you to see yourself as naturally untouchable by external pressures and attachments.
modern_relevance: You’ve faced tough challenges, yet you remain unshaken and free, like a lotus leaf floating above the waves.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
पितृजे मत्यपि स्थूले गुणाधारे वपुष्यहो।
सर्वेषु देशकालेषु जीवन्मुक्तात्मवेदिनाम् ॥
translation: और माता पिता से उत्पन्न स्थूल शरीर गुणों का आधार होने पर भी जीवन्मुक्त की प्रतिभा सब देश और काल में
english_translation: Even though born from parents and having a gross body as the basis of qualities, the brilliance of the liberated true self shines in all places and times.
essence: The true self shines beyond body, birth, place, and time.
simple_meaning: Your true self shines clearly in every place and time, beyond your physical body born of parents.
insight: It shifts the mind from identifying with body and birth to recognizing the timeless nature of the true self.
modern_relevance: You may feel tied to your appearance or background, but your deeper self remains bright and free everywhere you go.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
प्रतिमा निर्मलोक्तस्य स्थूलदेहस्य तैर्गुणैः।
मुद्यते पितरो नैव सत्यमेतद्रवीमि वः ॥
translation: निर्मल रहकर उक्त स्थूल शरीर के गुणों से मोहित नहीं होती है, यह मैं सत्य कहता हूं
english_translation: The true self, pure and untouched, is never deluded by the qualities of the gross body; this I speak as truth to you.
essence: The true self is pure and never deceived by the body's qualities.
simple_meaning: Your true self is pure and never confused or affected by the changing qualities of your physical body.
insight: It shifts your focus from identifying with your body to recognizing your unchanging inner self.
modern_relevance: You may feel overwhelmed by how your body ages or changes, but your true self remains steady and untouched beneath those shifts.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
सन्ततं मयि युक्तानां जीवन्मुक्तमहात्मनाम् ।
जायन्ते सर्वकर्माणि तदर्थं भ्रष्टवीजवत् ॥
translation: हे पितृगण! मुझमें सदा युक्त होने से जीवन्मुक्त महात्माओं के सब कर्म उनके लिये भ्रष्ट बीजवत होजाते हैं
english_translation: For those always united with me, all their actions arise like spoiled seeds, yet they remain liberated in life.
essence: Being continuously united with the divine makes all your actions harmless and frees you in life.
simple_meaning: If you stay constantly connected to the divine, your actions do not bind you like bad seeds but lead to freedom in life.
insight: It shifts your view from fearing consequences to trusting your inner alignment dissolves their power.
modern_relevance: You can make mistakes or face setbacks, yet your rooted connection to what truly matters keeps you free from lasting harm.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
आयस्कान्तगिरेः पोते गच्छत्येवान्तिकं यथा।
पृथग्भवन्ति लौहानि कीलकान्यखिलान्यलम् ॥
translation: जिस प्रकार चुम्बक के पर्वत के निकट होते ही पोत के शरीर की सब लोहे की कीले
english_translation: Just as all the iron nails of a ship stick together when near the magnet mountain,
essence: A strong force naturally unites scattered parts into a single whole.
simple_meaning: When a ship carrying iron nails comes near a magnet mountain, all the nails come together tightly.
insight: It teaches how a powerful presence or influence can unify scattered elements effortlessly.
modern_relevance: Like metal nails drawn together by a magnet, your thoughts or people around you can naturally come into harmony when a strong influence is present.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
तस्मिन्नेव भवन्त्याशु सलग्नानि धराधरे।
सपोतश्च क्षणे तस्मिंस्तत्रैवाब्धौ निमज्जति ॥
translation: पोत से खुलकर उस पर्वत में जा मिलती हैं और वह पोत समुद्रमग्न हो जाता है,
english_translation: The boats quickly attach to the mountain, and the boat itself sinks into the ocean there.
essence: Temporary attachment can lead quickly to complete immersion or loss.
simple_meaning: Boats quickly stick to the mountain and then sink immediately into the ocean there.
insight: Recognizes how appearances of stability can be momentary and misleading.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
तथैव मयि युक्तानां जीवन्मुक्तमहात्मनाम् । 
श्रयन्तेऽखिलकेर्माणि ब्रह्माण्डाकाशमेव वै ॥
translation: उसी प्रकार मुझमें युक्त जीवन्मुक्तों के सब कर्म ब्रह्माण्डाकाश को आश्रय कर लेते हैं
english_translation: Similarly, for those united with me, all actions of the liberated great souls rest like the cosmic space.
essence: When united with the divine, your actions rest effortlessly like infinite space.
simple_meaning: When you unite with the divine, your actions settle calmly like the vast cosmic space.
insight: It shifts your view from struggling with outcomes to embodying calm connection, letting your actions flow without clinging.
modern_relevance: You finish a demanding project and realize your efforts no longer weigh on you—they settle naturally, like space holding everything effortlessly.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
बारिबिन्दुरिवाकाशात्पतितस्ते महार्णवे:।
 जीवन्मुक्ता महात्मानो लयं गच्छन्ति मव्यहो ॥
translation: और जीवन्मुक्त आकाशपतित वारिविन्दु के समान मुझमें मिल जाते हैं
english_translation: Just as water droplets fall from the sky into the great ocean, liberated beings merge into me.
essence: Liberated beings lose their separateness and merge completely into the supreme reality.
simple_meaning: Liberated beings lose their separate selves and become one with the supreme reality, like water drops joining an ocean.
insight: This verse shifts focus from clinging to a separate self toward embracing unity with the supreme reality.
modern_relevance: When you release your ego and separate identity, you can find deep peace by feeling connected to something vast and unchanging.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
एकैकस्यं गुणस्याथ या वृत्तिद्धयरूपतः।
आहारो मैथुनं निद्रा भयं ज्ञानं सुखैपणा ॥
translation: जीव में जो एक एक गुण की दो दो वृत्ति रूप से आहार, निद्रा, भय, मैथुन, ज्ञान और सुखेच्छा
english_translation: In every individual, each quality has two modes: intake, sleep, fear, desire, knowledge, and pleasure.
essence: Every quality inside you naturally expresses itself in two opposite ways.
simple_meaning: Every quality within you appears in two forms, like seeking and resting, or fear and knowledge.
insight: It shifts your view to see qualities as fluid pairs, helping you embrace change in yourself without judgment.
modern_relevance: You notice how your habits and feelings often come in pairs, like wanting something then resting from it.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
इमा षड्वृत्तयः सन्त्यास्थावराज्जीवसङ्घतः।
देवतोन्नतसृष्टयन्तं विद्यमानाः समानतः ॥
translation: यह छः वृत्तियां स्थावर आदि जीव से लेकर देवता आदि उन्नत सृष्टि में भी समानता से विद्यमान
english_translation: These six modes exist equally throughout all beings, from inert matter to living beings to the highest deities.
essence: Six fundamental qualities exist equally in all beings from lowest to highest.
simple_meaning: Six qualities or tendencies are found equally in all things, from non-living matter to living beings and even the highest divine beings.
insight: Recognize the shared patterns beneath apparent differences among all existence.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
कर्मजालेषु तान् सर्वानावद्धान कुर्वते च ताः ।
स्थावरान जंगमाञ्जीवान देवमादिकान् ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: रहकर कर्मजाल में उनको नाबद्ध रखती है
english_translation: The divine binds all beings—immovable, moving, and divine alike—in the net of karma.
essence: All beings, from the smallest to the divine, are entwined in the net of karma.
simple_meaning: Everything alive, still or moving, and even divine beings are bound by the consequences of their actions.
insight: Understand that no one exists outside the consequences of their actions, shifting focus from blame to personal responsibility.
modern_relevance: You feel stuck by past choices, seeing how unseen patterns bind you and everyone else, no matter your status.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
परन्तु जीवन्मुक्तेपु नूनं स्वाभाविकास्त्रपि।
सतीप्वपि किलैतासु त्यजन्ति स्वगुणान् हि ताः ॥
translation: परन्तु हे विज्ञवरो! जीवन्मुक्त में ये स्वाभाविक छः वृत्तियां रहने पर भी अपने स्वाभाविक गुणों को परित्याग कर देती हैं।
english_translation: However, among those who are truly liberated, even with these natural six tendencies present, they abandon their natural qualities.
essence: True freedom means releasing attachment to natural traits without erasing them.
simple_meaning: Even when natural habits or tendencies remain, truly free people let go of being controlled by them.
insight: It teaches you to recognize habitual patterns without letting them define your actions or identity.
modern_relevance: You might still feel your usual impulses or moods, yet you can choose not to react or be limited by them.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
निद्राऽहारस्वरूपिण्यस्तामासिक्यो हि वृत्तयः।
स्थूलदेहाश्रयेणैषां तिष्ठेयुर्नष्टवासनाः ॥
translation: आहार और निद्रारूपी तामसिक वृत्तियां केवल उनके स्थूल शरीर के आश्रय से वासनाशून्य होकर जीवित रहती हैं।
english_translation: The tamasic modes of sleep and eating survive only by residing in the gross body, devoid of desires.
essence: Sleep and hunger exist only with the body; the true self is beyond them.
simple_meaning: Sleep and eating are tamasic habits that exist only because the physical body supports them; without the body, they vanish.
insight: Recognize urges like hunger and sleep as temporary body-driven events, not your unchanging self.
modern_relevance: When you notice hunger or tiredness, remember they arise from your body—not your deeper awareness beyond it.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
भयमैथुनरूपिण्यो जीवन्मुक्तौघटत्तयः।
