राजसिक्यो विलीयन्ते स्वीयेषु कारणेवलम् ॥
translation: जीवन्मुक्तों की भय और मैथुन रूपी राजसिक वृत्तियां अपने स्वकारण में लय हो जाती हैं और
english_translation: In the liberated beings, the fear and passion-like rajasic tendencies dissolve completely in their own source.
essence: Fears and desires vanish by dissolving naturally into their own origin in liberation.
simple_meaning: Fear and desire-like tendencies in liberated beings disappear by merging back into their own source.
insight: It teaches you to see fears and desires as temporary waves that calm when you trace them back to their root.
modern_relevance: You notice your anxious thoughts and cravings losing hold as you observe them deeply instead of reacting.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
सुखेच्छाज्ञानरूपिण्यस्तेषां सात्विकवृत्तयः ।
समं विश्वेन तादात्म्यभाजः सत्यः स्वधाभुजः ! ॥
translation: उनकी ज्ञान और मुखेच्छा रूपी सात्त्विक वृत्तियां जगत के साथ तदाकाररूप धारण करके
english_translation: Their pure knowledge and desire, as sattvic tendencies, share the same essence with the universe and are truly rooted in their own nature.
essence: Pure knowledge and desire share the same true essence as the universe.
simple_meaning: Pure, wise desires and knowledge reflect the same true essence as the entire universe.
insight: This verse shifts your view to see that pure desires and knowledge are not separate from the world but part of its essence.
modern_relevance: When your honest wishes and clear understanding align with the world, you experience natural peace and belonging.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
आभिमुख्येन मे नित्यं प्रवहन्ते न संशयः।
एवं मे ज्ञानिनो भक्ताः शक्नुवन्ति जगद्गुरोः ॥
translation: मेरी ओर सदा प्रवाहित होती हैं । इस प्रकार से मेरे ज्ञानी भक्त जगद्गुरु
english_translation: There is no doubt that streams always flow toward me; thus, my wise devotees can reach the world teacher.
essence: True devotion naturally flows to the genuine teacher without hesitation.
simple_meaning: Devotion naturally moves toward the divine teacher without hesitation or doubt.
insight: Recognize that genuine devotion flows effortlessly toward what truly supports your growth and clarity.
modern_relevance: When you feel a quiet pull toward someone or something that truly inspires you, it shows your inner guidance working without resistance.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
जगतो रंक्षकस्यापि पदमाप्तुमसंशयम्।
इति वो ज्ञानमाख्यातं श्रूयतां वः पुनर्ब्रूवे ॥
translation: और जगदरक्षक पदवी को प्राप्त करने में समर्थ होते हैं। इस प्रकार का ज्ञान कहा गया और भी आप लोगों से कहता हूं सुनो।
english_translation: Those who possess such knowledge undoubtedly attain the status of protector of the world. This knowledge has been named, and I tell you again: listen.
essence: Clear knowledge empowers you to become a protector of the world without doubt.
simple_meaning: When you gain this knowledge, you become confident and capable of protecting the world. This teaching is important and worth hearing again.
insight: It shifts your view from small personal concerns to recognizing the power of knowledge to serve greater causes.
modern_relevance: You realize that deep understanding of your purpose can give you strength to face challenges beyond personal limits.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
यद्यपि स्वेच्छयैवाहं स्वशक्तयात्मककर्मणः ।
 स्वानुशासनरूपाया धमाधर्मव्यवस्थितेः ॥
translation: यद्यपि मैं अपनी इच्छासे ही अपनी ही शक्तिरूपी कर्म और अपने ही अनुशासनरूपी धर्माधर्म की
english_translation: Although I act by my own will, my actions are the power itself, shaped by my own discipline of dharma and adharma.
essence: Your free will acts through inner power shaped by your own discipline of right and wrong.
simple_meaning: You act by your own will, but your actions are formed by your own inner power and the discipline of right and wrong you follow.
insight: Recognize that your will alone doesn't determine action; your inner discipline shapes its nature.
modern_relevance: You decide what to do, but your habits and values shape how your actions really play out in life.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
निघ्नताञ्चोररीकृत्य जगत्कल्याणहेतवे ।
यदा कदाचिद्विश्वस्मिन्नतीर्णो भवाम्यहो ॥
translation: अधीनता स्वीकार करके इस जगत में इसके कल्याण के लिये जब कभी अवतार धारण करता हूँ।
english_translation: Accepting submission, whenever I incarnate in this world, it is for its welfare.
essence: Choosing limitation to serve the world's welfare is a conscious act of humility and power.
simple_meaning: Whenever I take a form in this world, it is by accepting limitation to work for its well-being.
insight: It teaches you to accept constraints willingly when your purpose is to serve a higher good beyond yourself.
modern_relevance: When you step into a new role or responsibility, you might feel limited but your aim can be to serve something bigger than yourself.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
जीवन्मुक्तपदप्राप्तान किन्तु भक्तगणानहम्।
सर्वथा कर्मभिर्मुक्तात् विदधे पितरो ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: परन्तु हे पितृगण ! जीवन्मुक्ति पदवी प्राप्त भक्त गण को मैं सब प्रकार के कर्म से मुक्त कर देता हूँ
english_translation: But O ancestors, I free my devoted followers who have attained the state of living liberation from all kinds of actions.
essence: True devotion combined with living liberation frees you from all binding actions.
simple_meaning: Those devoted to the divine who have reached living liberation are freed from the binding effect of all actions.
insight: It shifts your understanding from seeing actions as binding to seeing devotion as liberating, changing how you engage with life.
modern_relevance: You might feel stuck by the consequences of past choices, but devotion and inner freedom can release you from that burden.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
नानाविधाश्च जायन्तेऽवतारा मे युगे युगे ।
समष्टिकर्मसादेते सम्पद्यन्ते न संशयः ॥
translation: युग युग में मेरे अवतार अनेक प्रकार के होते हैं वह सब समष्टिका धीन होते हैं।
english_translation: In every age, many types of my incarnations appear; all arise to fulfill collective karma without doubt.
essence: The divine manifests repeatedly in many forms to address collective karma across ages.
simple_meaning: Many forms of my incarnations appear in every age, all arising from collective karma.
insight: It shifts how you see challenges as part of a larger unfolding action beyond individual control.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
प्राधान्यं त्रिविधानां मे शक्तीनामेव जायते।
ममावतारपुञ्जेषु तेऽतो मच्छत्स्यपक्षकाः ॥
translation: मेरे अवतारों में मेरी त्रिविध शक्ति की ही प्रधानता रहती है इस कारण वह मेरी शक्ति सापेक्ष हैं
english_translation: My threefold powers are foremost among my incarnations; thus, they are relative to my power.
essence: The threefold powers in incarnations reflect their source in supreme power.
simple_meaning: My incarnations highlight my three main powers, showing how they relate to my overall strength.
insight: Recognize that different expressions of your power are interconnected aspects of a greater whole.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अपेक्षते तु मच्छक्तीर्जीवन्मुक्तेषु कोऽपि न ।
सर्वमुक्ता हि जायन्ते जीवन्मुक्ता न संशयः ॥
translation: परन्तु जीवन्मुक्तगण में से कोई भी मेरी शक्ति की अपेक्षान हीं रखता,
english_translation: But none among the liberated beings depends on my power; all are liberated, no doubt about it.
essence: True liberation depends on nothing outside the self; it is complete and self-sufficient.
simple_meaning: Those who are truly free do not depend on Shiva's power or anything else; their freedom is complete and unquestionable.
insight: It teaches you to recognize freedom as independent of external powers, rooted solely in your own inner state.
modern_relevance: You’ve reached a point where you no longer seek external approval or support to feel free in your choices and being.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
आत्मज्ञानं यदासाद्य ज्ञानिभक्तगणो मम ।
लभते पितरो नूनं जीवन्मुक्तिपदं परम् ॥
translation: हे पितृगणं ! जिस आत्मज्ञान को प्राप्त करके मेरे ज्ञानी भक्तगण उत्तम जीवन्मुक्त पदवी को प्राप्त करते हैं
english_translation: O ancestors, the wise devotees who attain self-knowledge surely reach the highest state of freedom in life.
essence: Wisdom combined with devoted love leads to the highest living freedom.
simple_meaning: Those who combine wisdom and devoted love to the divine gain the highest freedom in life through self-knowledge.
insight: It teaches you that gaining self-knowledge enriched by devotion shifts you from bondage to freedom in your daily life.
modern_relevance: You’ve worked hard to understand yourself deeply and stay devoted to your values; this leads you to real freedom from inner struggles.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
आविर्भूतेस्तस्य वेदे दशात्रैविध्यमीरितम्।
वेदान्तप्रतिपाद्यस्य सच्चिदानन्दरूपिणः ॥
translation: उस आत्मज्ञान के आविर्भाव की दशा वेद में तीन श्रेणी की कही गई है। वेदान्त प्रतिपाद्य सच्चिदानन्दमय
english_translation: The emergence of that self-knowledge is described in the Vedas in three categories. It reveals the true self characterized by existence, consciousness, and bliss as taught in Vedanta.
essence: Self-knowledge reveals itself in three fundamental forms: existence, consciousness, and bliss.
simple_meaning: Self-knowledge appears in three forms described in the Vedas, revealing the true self as existence, consciousness, and bliss.
insight: It guides you to recognize your true self beyond appearances by understanding its three essential qualities.
modern_relevance: You may sense different ways your true self shows up in life—through being, awareness, or joy—each pointing to your real nature.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
स्वस्वरूपस्य सँल्लब्धावपरोक्षानुभूतितः ।
सत्यां स्वतो विमुच्यन्ते जीवाः संसारबन्धनात् ॥
translation: स्वरूप की उपलब्धि अपरोक्षानुभूति द्वारा करते ही जीव बन्धनरहित हो जाता है;
english_translation: When a being directly experiences its own true nature, it is naturally freed from the bonds of reactivity.
essence: Direct experience of your true self naturally frees you from reactive bondage.
simple_meaning: When you directly experience who you truly are, you naturally become free from reactivity and suffering.
insight: It shifts your focus from trying to escape suffering to directly experiencing your unchanging nature, which dissolves bondage.
modern_relevance: You feel stuck in repetitive patterns until a moment of clear self-understanding frees you from old reactions.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
तेषां पारब्धमावल्याभ्रमत्कौलालचक्रवत् ।
तञ्चित्तस्य तदा किन्तु विक्षेपो नैव नश्यति ॥
translation: किन्तु उस समय घूमते हुए कुलाल चक्र के समान उसके चित्त के विक्षेप उसके प्रारब्ध की प्रबलता के कारण दूर नहीं होते हैं
english_translation: But at that time, the distractions in the mind do not disappear because of the strong force of past karma, like the spinning potter's wheel.
essence: Strong past karma can keep the mind restless despite effort to quiet it.
simple_meaning: When your past actions have strong influence, your mind's distractions keep spinning like a potter's wheel and don't easily stop.
insight: Recognize that past actions can powerfully sustain mental distractions, requiring patient discipline to calm.
modern_relevance: Your mind races uncontrollably when past habits and consequences strongly tug your attention, making focus feel impossible.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
तव्युत्थानदशा नूनं बाहुल्येन हि जायते।
किन्तु ते भाग्यवन्तो मे भक्ता ज्ञानाब्धिपारगाः ॥
translation: और उसकी व्युत्थान दशा अधिकता से बनी रहती है परन्तु यह भाग्यवान् मेरा भक्त
english_translation: Your state of upheaval is indeed often intense, but fortunate are my devotees who have mastered the ocean of wisdom.
essence: Devotion paired with deep wisdom makes one fortunate despite life's upheavals.
simple_meaning: Though your life may often feel chaotic, those devoted and wise are truly fortunate and steady.
insight: It teaches you to see devotion and wisdom as anchors that transform turbulent experiences into strength.
modern_relevance: You face constant stress and upheaval, yet your steady faith and insight keep you grounded and fortunate.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
यान्ति मे तीव्रत्तीनां स्वतः सन्धौ स्वरूपताम् । 
विक्षेपबहुलेनान्तःकरणेन समन्विताः ॥
translation: तीव्रवृत्तियों की सन्धि में अपने आप ही मेरे स्वस्वरूप में पहुंच जाया करता है ।
english_translation: The intense waves of the mind naturally converge into my own true nature.
essence: Even restless mental waves naturally unite in your true self.
simple_meaning: The mind’s intense and restless thoughts naturally come together in your true self despite distractions.
insight: It teaches you to see the mind’s turbulence as part of the natural flow toward your true self.
modern_relevance: When your thoughts race and distract you, notice how they still guide you closer to your authentic self.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
सन्तोऽपि स्वस्वरूपस्य ह्यपरोक्षानुभूतितः। 
मुक्तात्मानोऽभिधीयन्ते श्रेणीमाद्यां गता अमी ॥
translation: विक्षेप बहुल अन्तःकरण से युक्त होने पर भी स्व स्वरूप की अपरोक्षानुभूति द्वारा वह मुक्तात्मा प्रथम श्रेणी का कहलाता है।
english_translation: Even when the mind is full of distractions, those who directly experience their true nature are called the liberated, the highest class.
essence: True freedom is knowing your real self directly, even amid mental distractions.
simple_meaning: Even if your mind is restless and distracted, directly experiencing your true self means you are truly free.
insight: It shifts the idea that freedom requires perfect mental quiet to understanding it can coexist with distraction.
modern_relevance: Your mind races with thoughts and worries, yet moments arise when you glimpse your true self clearly — that is genuine freedom.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
प्राकृतेन कलंकेन  दृश्यासत्या च वर्जिता । 
जगजालविहीनयमवस्था जायते ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: यह अवस्था जगज्जालरहित प्राकृतिक कलंक रहित और दृश्य की आसक्ति से रहित होती है
english_translation: This state is free from the world's entanglement, natural blemish, and attachment to appearances.
essence: A stable state arises beyond natural flaws and attachment to appearances.
simple_meaning: There is a state of being without natural defects, without being caught in the world's illusions or attachments to what you see.
insight: It teaches you to see beyond appearances and natural flaws, recognizing a stable, untainted state within.
modern_relevance: When your mind stops clinging to surface impressions and flaws, you discover calm beyond everyday distractions.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
मनोऽपि जायते नूनं सम्यग्भर्जीतवीजवत् ।
तस्मिन दि ज्ञानिभक्तेऽहं मनोमोहात्मकेन वै ॥
translation: मन भुने हुए बीज के सदृश्य हो जाता है और उस ज्ञानी भक्त मे मैं तय मनोमोहरुपी
english_translation: The mind indeed arises like a sprouted seed; in that wise devotee, I reside as the mind's deluding principle.
essence: The divine dwells beyond the restless mind’s illusions in a wise devotee.
simple_meaning: The mind arises like a sprouted seed, full of confusion, but in a wise devotee, the divine dwells beyond this delusion.
insight: It teaches you to recognize the divine presence beyond the restless and confusing patterns of your mind.
modern_relevance: When your thoughts spiral and you feel lost in mental noise, remember a calm presence within you that is untouched by confusion.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
व्युत्याने मेघजालेन पिडितोऽप्यन्तरान्तरा।
प्रकाशे श्रावणें मामे यथा सोर्य्यो घनावृत्त: ॥
translation: मेघजाल से व्युत्थान दशा में ढके जाने पर भी श्रावणमास के घनावृत सूर्य की तरह निरन्तर बीच बीच में प्रकाशित भी होता रहता हूँ
english_translation: Even when overwhelmed by the stormy clouds of adversity, I shine through intermittently like the sun hidden behind thick clouds in the month of Shravan.
essence: You can intermittently shine through adversity like the sun behind dark clouds.
simple_meaning: I remain visible like the sun behind dense clouds even when surrounded by difficulties.
insight: It teaches you to recognize your inner light even during tough times, sustaining hope and presence.
modern_relevance: You feel weighed down by constant stress, yet moments of clarity and brightness still break through your struggles.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अस्यामाघदशायां हि जीवन्मुक्ताः स्वधाभुजः!।
परिश्रान्ता भवन्तोऽपि पदे ज्ञानमये परे ॥
translation: इस प्रथम अवस्था में जीवन्मुक्त परिश्रान्त रहने पर भी ज्ञानमय
english_translation: In this first stage, those freed while living remain weary but reside in the supreme state of knowledge.
essence: Living liberation includes phases of weariness even amid supreme knowledge.
simple_meaning: Living beings who are free remain tired but dwell in a supreme state of wisdom at this first stage.
insight: It shifts expectations by showing liberation includes stages with effort and rest, not constant ease.
modern_relevance: You may feel exhausted despite your inner growth or breakthroughs, and that is part of the process, not a sign of failure.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
प्राप्नुवन्येव विश्रान्ति परमानन्दरूपिणि ।
द्वितीयायामवस्थायां जीवन्मुक्तमहात्मनाम् ॥
translation: परमानन्द रूपी परमपद में ही विश्रान्ति लाभ किया करते हैं। जीवमुक्त की दूसरी अवस्था
english_translation: The liberated great souls rest in the supreme state of bliss in their second stage of freedom.
essence: True rest arises in the supreme bliss found in the second stage of liberation.
simple_meaning: The great souls who are freed experience rest in the highest bliss during their second stage of liberation.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that freedom has stages, and true rest lies in embracing the highest bliss beyond mere release.
modern_relevance: After overcoming major struggles, you realize a deeper peace that goes beyond just being free—it is a blissful rest within.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
चितसचा हि ममोन्मुक्ता मनसः शान्तिशालिनी । 
तमोज्योतिर्गणैमुक्ता राजते व्योमवद्विभुः ॥
translation: मन से उन्मुक्त शान्तिशालिनी मेरी चित्सत्ता समस्त तम और समस्त ज्योति से मुक्त होकर विभुव्यापक आकाश की तरह विराजमान रहती है
english_translation: My consciousness, freed from the mind, peaceful and serene, shines like the vast sky, liberated from all darkness and all light.
essence: Consciousness freed from mind and duality shines peacefully like the infinite sky.
simple_meaning: Your true consciousness is free from the restless mind, peaceful, and shines widely beyond all darkness and light.
insight: It teaches you to recognize your awareness as spacious and unaffected by mental fluctuations or opposites.
modern_relevance: When your mind quiets, you experience an inner space that feels limitless and peaceful, no longer pulled by conflicting thoughts or emotions.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अत्र गाढ़सुपुप्तेभै पितरोऽनुभवो यथा ।
पाषाणप्विव काटिन्यमधवा व्योममण्डले ॥
translation: इस दशा में गाढ़ सुषुप्ति दशा के अनुभव की तरह अथवा प्रस्तर में कठिनता की तरह अथवा आकाश में
english_translation: Here, the experience is like deep sleep or hardness like a stone or like the vastness of the sky.
essence: Some states of experience are deeply still, hard to penetrate, and boundlessly vast.
simple_meaning: The state is described as similar to deep sleep or the hardness of stone or the vast openness of the sky.
insight: It shows how some inner states feel completely still, solid, and vast beyond usual perception.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
विभुः शून्या यथा शक्तिबीहान वै विषयान्प्रति ।
स्वभावादुन्मुखत्वस्य परित्यागेन सर्वथा ॥
translation: विभु शून्य शक्ति की तरह बाह्य विषय के प्रति उन्मुखता को स्वभाव से परित्याग करके
english_translation: Just as the supreme being is naturally free from attachment to external objects by renouncing all inclination,
essence: True freedom arises when you naturally renounce all attraction to external things.
simple_meaning: You can become naturally free from attachment to outside things by fully giving up all inclination toward them.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate renunciation as a natural state, not a forced denial.
modern_relevance: You find peace when you stop chasing every distraction and let your cravings fade naturally.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
सचिदानन्दभावानां स्वस्वरूपेऽनुभूयते ।
अद्वैतसत्ता नितरां नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥
translation: स्वस्वरूप में सच्चिदानन्द भाव की अद्वैतसत्ता सर्वथा अनुभूत होती है
english_translation: In its own nature, the state of existence, consciousness, and bliss is directly experienced as absolute non-dual reality without doubt.
essence: Your true nature is directly experienced as complete and beyond all duality.
simple_meaning: Your true nature is pure existence, consciousness, and bliss experienced as completely non-dual without any need to question.
insight: It shifts your mind from seeking external validation to resting in the direct experience of your true being as unified existence and bliss.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by confusion or doubt, knowing your true nature is already whole and beyond duality brings calm and clarity.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अस्यां द्वितीयावस्थायां जीवन्मुक्तमहात्मनाम् ।
अत्यंत जायते स्वल्पा दशा व्युत्थाननामिका ॥
translation: जीवन्मुक्त की इस द्वितीय दशा व्युत्थान दशा बहुत कम होती है और साथ ही साथ अन्तःकरण रूपी समुद्र की
english_translation: In this second stage, the state of the liberated beings is very rare, marked by a condition called Vyutthana.
essence: Rare inner states mark the second stage of liberation among great liberated beings.
simple_meaning: In the second stage of liberation, the rare condition called Vyutthana arises among liberated souls.
insight: Recognize that even in freedom, rare inner states arise and pass; liberation unfolds progressively.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
आदावन्ते च प्रत्येकवीचेश्चित्तमहोदधेः।
लभन्ते ज्ञानिभक्ता ये मत्सायुज्यमसंशयम् ॥
translation: वृत्तिरूपी प्रत्येक वीचि के आदि अन्त में ही मेरे ज्ञानीभक्त मत्सायुज्य को प्राप्त करते रहते हैं
english_translation: At the beginning and end of every cycle of the vast inner ocean, my wise devotees surely attain union with me.
essence: Steadfast devotion and wisdom always lead to certain union with the divine.
simple_meaning: Every cycle in the vast inner ocean of your mind begins and ends with the wise devotees reaching union with the divine without doubt.
insight: It shifts focus to embracing devotion and wisdom together as a reliable way to reach inner union beyond life's cycles.
modern_relevance: When life feels like endless ups and downs, your steady devotion and clear understanding can guide you to a deeper connection beyond the chaos.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
दशां तृतीयां प्राप्तेषु जीवन्मुक्तेषु भूतिदाः!। 
नीरक्षीरसुसम्मेलसन्निमा चित्सवानिका ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! जीवन्मुक्त भक्त तीसरी दशा को प्राप्त करने पर उसमें नीर क्षीर के सम्मेलन की तरह चित्प्रधान
english_translation: O ancestors! Devotees who have attained the third stage of liberation are like a union of water and milk, full of consciousness.
essence: Advanced liberation blends consciousness as perfectly as water and milk unite.
simple_meaning: Those who reach the third stage of liberation are united and full of consciousness, like water and milk blended perfectly.
insight: It highlights the deep integration and purity of consciousness achieved in advanced liberation stages.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
सत्ता मे त्रिविधाऽखण्डब्रह्माकारत्वमाश्रिता।
तत्राभिन्नेव संयुक्ता मया सह विराजते ॥
translation: मेरी त्रिविधसत्ता अखण्ड ब्रह्माकार भाव को प्राप्त करके मेरे साथ अभेद से बनी रहती है
english_translation: My threefold existence, rooted in the indivisible supreme reality, abides inseparably united with me.
essence: Threefold existence is inseparably united with the indivisible supreme reality and Shiva.
simple_meaning: My threefold being is inseparably united with the undivided supreme reality and shines with me.
insight: It shows that diverse aspects of existence are expressions of one indivisible reality, inviting us to see unity beyond differences.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
सत्ता तात्कालिकी नामरूपातीततया खलु।
ब्रह्मात्मेसादिसंज्ञाभ्यो ह्यतीता केवलेन च ॥
translation: और उस समय की सत्ता नाम रूप से अतीत होने के कारण ब्रहा आत्मा इत्यादि संज्ञाओ से भी अतीत होकर केवल रूप से
english_translation: Existence at that moment transcends names and forms, surpassing even terms like Brahman and Atman, remaining solely as pure being.
essence: Existence in its purest moment is beyond all names and forms, even sacred ones.
simple_meaning: At the deepest moment, existence goes beyond all labels like name, form, Brahman, and Atman, remaining just pure being.
insight: It teaches you to stop identifying with names or concepts and rest in pure, unnamed presence.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by your many roles and titles, remember your true self is beyond all labels and concepts.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
नित्या रूपेण नित्यं सा स्वतः पूर्णाऽवतिष्ठते ।
अवस्थेयं प्रकृत्याश्च स्वतीता देशकालतः ॥
translation: नित्य और स्वतः पूर्ण होकर अवस्थान करती है। यह अवस्था देश काल और प्रकृति से अतीत हो
english_translation: The true self eternally exists in its perfect form, beyond place, time, and nature.
essence: The true self exists forever whole beyond all conditions of time, place, and nature.
simple_meaning: You are always whole and perfect in your true nature, beyond changes of place, time, and the natural world.
insight: It shifts focus from the changing external world to the eternal inner completeness you already embody.
modern_relevance: When everything around you shifts—your job, your home, your mood—remember your core remains whole and untouched.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
स्वस्वरूपे तुरीयादिदशाभ्योऽपि वहिर्गता।
परभावमयी नित्या जायते परमाद्भुता ॥
translation: स्वस्वरूप में तुरीयातीत आदि अवस्था ले भी अतीत होकर अद्भुत परम भावमय हो जाती है।
english_translation: Even beyond the original state and the fourth stage, the true self transcends and eternally manifests as the supreme wondrous essence.
essence: The true self transcends all states to eternally embody supreme wonder.
simple_meaning: Your true self goes beyond all known states, becoming an eternal and wondrous supreme essence.
insight: It shifts your view from identifying with changing states to experiencing your unchanging, supreme essence.
modern_relevance: In moments when you feel stuck in changing moods or thoughts, remember your true self is beyond all these shifting states and remains steady and magnificent.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
निखिलेभ्योऽपि मार्गेभ्यः पान्थेभ्यो दूरवर्तिनी ।
विदेहाख्याऽपि यस्मात्सा ततो मत्सन्निभाऽस्यसौ ॥
translation: यह तृतीय अवस्था सभी पथ और सभी पथिकों से दूरवर्ती होने से और विदेह कहलाने से मेरे तुल्य है।
english_translation: This third state is beyond all paths and travelers, and is called bodiless; it is like me.
essence: There is a state beyond all paths and travelers, like the divine presence itself.
simple_meaning: The third state is beyond every path and traveler and is described as bodiless, resembling the speaker.
insight: It points to an experience beyond all methods and identities, inviting a recognition of pure being.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
इयं ह्युपनिषद्विय सर्वथा पितरो हिता।
वेद्या भवद्भिरप्येषा श्रुतिः साध्वी सनातनी ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! इसी को हितकरी उपनिषद्विद्या और सनातनी श्रुति जानो
english_translation: O ancestors! Consider this eternal Vedic knowledge and Upanishadic wisdom as truly beneficial for you.
essence: Eternal Vedic knowledge is truly beneficial for the ancestors.
simple_meaning: This eternal scripture, the Upanishadic knowledge, is meant to be understood as beneficial and good for the ancestors.
insight: It invites respect and trust in ancient wisdom as a source of lasting benefit beyond immediate time.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
देवादिदेव ! सर्वात्मन् ! सर्वाधार ! जगद्गुरो ! ।
वयं यद्यपि सर्वेश ! नेशाः सम्यक्तया विभो !॥
translation: हे देवादिदेव ! हे सर्वेश्वर ! हे सर्वाधार ! हे सर्वात्मन! हे जगद्गुरो ! हे विभो ! यद्यपि हम सम्यक रूप से
english_translation: O God of gods, the supreme self, the support of all, world teacher, though we are all lords indeed!
essence: The verse names the supreme being with many titles but lacks a completed teaching.
simple_meaning: Many titles are being addressed with reverence, acknowledging supreme qualities, but the statement remains incomplete and unclear.
insight: The incomplete verse doesn't present a concrete shift in thinking or acting.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
जीवन्मुक्तिरहस्यं वै विधातुं हृदयङ्गमम् ।
अन्वभूम तथाप्येतत्कृपातो भवतो ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: जीवन्मुक्तरहस्य को हृदयङ्गम नहीं कर सके परन्तु हे प्रभो ! इतना अवश्य आपकी परम कृपा से हमारे अनुभव में आ गया है
english_translation: The secret of liberation of the living being cannot be fully grasped, but by your supreme grace, it has certainly entered our experience.
essence: The deepest freedom cannot be fully known but can be experienced through grace.
simple_meaning: The mystery of true freedom is too deep to fully understand, but through the divine's kindness, it has touched us.
insight: It shifts the mind from needing full understanding to accepting grace as a way to experience truth.
modern_relevance: Sometimes the most important truths in life feel beyond your grasp, but moments of grace bring glimpses that sustain you.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
शाश्वतस्यास्ति धर्मस्य परशक्तयात्मकस्य ते ।
सर्वजीवहितं नित्यं कुर्वाणस्यान्तिम फलम् ॥
translation: कि शाश्वत, सर्वजीव हितकर, आपकी परम शक्ति रूपी धर्म का अन्तिम फल
english_translation: The eternal dharma of your supreme power always results in the welfare of all beings as its final outcome.
essence: True eternal power expresses itself as universal welfare through dharma.
simple_meaning: The highest, eternal principle of your power always aims to benefit every living being ultimately.
insight: It shifts the focus from power as control to power as a force for universal well-being.
modern_relevance: When you lead or make choices, remembering that true strength supports everyone can guide decisions beyond personal gain.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
जीवन्मुक्तिर्न सन्देहो विद्यते हि सदा प्रभो ।
जीवन्मुक्तिपदं प्राप्य त्वयातो दयानिधे ! ॥
translation: निरन्तर जीवन मुक्ति ही है और जीवन्मुक्ति पदवी को प्राप्त करके आपकी कृपा से
english_translation: There is no doubt that continuous freedom in life exists; having attained this state of liberation, it is by your compassion.
essence: Continuous freedom in life is real and sustained by compassionate grace.
simple_meaning: True freedom in life is always possible and is assured by the compassionate grace of the divine.
insight: It shifts your perspective from seeing freedom as a final achievement to experiencing it as ongoing, held by compassionate presence.
modern_relevance: When you feel stuck in repeated struggles, knowing that continuous freedom is possible and supported by kindness offers hope beyond your challenges.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
जनो भागवतो नूनं भगवानेव जायते । 
तवाऽपारकृपापुञ्जजज्ञातमस्माभिरित्यपि ॥
translation: भागवत जन भगवान् ही हो जाते हैं और यह भी आपकी अपार कृपा से समझ में आ गया कि
english_translation: People truly become devoted to the divine, and this has come to be known by us because of your boundless compassion.
essence: Devotion grows from boundless compassion, not by chance alone.
simple_meaning: People become devoted to the divine, and this truth is known to us because of your great compassion.
insight: It highlights that inspiring devotion or commitment comes from genuine care and compassion, not force or chance.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
सार्द्ध भेदो भवद्भक्तैर्जीवन्मुक्तिपदङ्गतैः ।
भवतः कोऽपि कुत्रापि कथञ्चिन्नव वर्तते ॥
translation: जीवन्मुक्ति पदवी प्राप्त आपके भक्तों में और आपमें कहीं किसी प्रकार कोई भी भेद नहीं है।
english_translation: There is no difference whatsoever between your devotees who have attained liberation and you anywhere at all.
essence: Liberated devotees and the divine are completely indistinguishable everywhere.
simple_meaning: Those who love you deeply and have reached freedom are not different from you in any way.
insight: It shifts the mind from seeing separation to recognizing unity with those who embody freedom and devotion.
modern_relevance: When you see someone who has grown beyond struggle and pain, you realize they're not separate from what you seek.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
निजभक्तैर्भवान् यत्र लिङ्गाकारेऽच्यते प्रभो !।
यथार्थ तत्स्वरूपं नो दर्शयित्वा कृतार्थय ॥
translation: हे प्रभो ! अपने भक्तों के द्वारा जिस लिङ्गाकार में आप पूजे जाते हैं उसका यथार्थ स्वरूप क्या है ? सो हमें दिखाकर कृतकृत्य कीजिये
english_translation: O Lord! Please reveal to us the true nature of the linga form in which you are worshipped by your devotees, so we may be fulfilled.
essence: The true form behind sacred symbols reveals deeper fulfillment to devoted seekers.
simple_meaning: Devotees ask the Lord to reveal the true form of the linga so they can understand and feel fulfilled.
insight: It invites you to seek beyond symbols to the underlying truth that brings lasting fulfillment.
modern_relevance: You might wonder what lies behind symbols or rituals you follow, seeking a deeper experience beyond surface appearances.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
हे वर्णाश्रमधर्माणां रक्षकाः ! पितरोऽखिलाः।
वासनाभिः शुभाभिर्वः प्रसन्नोऽहमतोऽधुना ॥
translation: हे वर्णाश्रमधर्म के रक्षक पितृगण ! आपकी शुभ कामना से मैं प्रसन्न हुआ हूँ
english_translation: O protectors of the duties of the social orders and stages of life, ancestors! I am pleased now by your auspicious wishes.
essence: Acknowledging and receiving blessings from those who uphold social duties brings joy.
simple_meaning: The speaker expresses gratitude and happiness for the auspicious blessings given by the ancestors who uphold social duties.
insight: Recognizing support from those who sustain social and familial duties fosters humility and connectedness.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
देवदानवमर्त्यानां युष्माकञ्च सुदुर्लभम् ।
दिव्यं ज्ञानमयं चक्षुरदः कालकृते ददे ॥
translation: स कारण देव दानव पितृ मनुष्य आदि को दुर्लभ ज्ञान नेत्र इस समय के लिये आपको प्रदान करता हूँ ।
english_translation: For you, the divine grants a rare, knowledge-filled eye to devas, asuras, ancestors, and humans at this time.
essence: Rare, divine knowledge opens your vision beyond ordinary time and perception.
simple_meaning: You are granted a rare and divine knowledge that lets you see clearly beyond normal limits in this time.
insight: This verse invites you to recognize and value the rare moments when your understanding expands beyond everyday limits.
modern_relevance: Sometimes, clarity and understanding come as rare gifts that let you see your situation in a new light.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
चिन्मयस्यास्य लिङ्गस्य स्वरूप मे यथायथम् ।
यूयं पश्यत येनाद्य जायतां का कृतार्थता ॥
translation: आप मेरे चिन्मय लिंग का यथार्थ स्वरूप दर्शन करो जिससे आपलोगों की कृतकृत्यता हो
english_translation: Behold the true form of my conscious divine sign so that your sense of indebtedness may arise.
essence: Seeing the true conscious form awakens heartfelt gratitude.
simple_meaning: Look at my true conscious form so you can feel grateful and fulfilled.
insight: It teaches you to open your perception fully to experience genuine gratitude and fulfillment.
modern_relevance: You pause to truly see what matters deeply, and suddenly gratitude fills your heart for things often taken for granted.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अहो विस्मृतात्मान आश्वद्य जाताः
परात्मन् ! वयं नैव विद्योऽत्र हेतुम् ।
भवाँञ्चिन्मयस्येह बीजस्यं दातृ
धरन् लिङ्गरूपं विराइविश्वयोनों ॥
translation: हे परमात्मन् ! अहो ! अब हम अपने को भूल गये। हम लोग इसका कारण नहीं समझ रहे हैं। अब हम देखते हैं कि आप चिन्मय बीज दाता लिङ्गरूप होकर विश्वयोनि में
english_translation: O supreme being! Alas, we have forgotten ourselves and do not understand the cause. Now we see you as the conscious seed-giver in the form of the mark within the world-womb.
essence: Forgetting the true self hides the conscious source within the world from view.
simple_meaning: We have forgotten our true self and do not understand why. Now we recognize the divine as the conscious source within the universe.
insight: It opens the mind to see beyond personal confusion and recognize a conscious source at the foundation of existence.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
समालोक्यते सम्प्रवेशं प्रकुर्वन्
पुनर्लिङ्गपीठद्वयं दृश्यते च ।
धरन्वेकयुग्मस्वरूपं मनोज्ञं
समाच्छादयविश्वमेतत्समस्तम् ॥
translation: प्रवेश करते हो। हम पुनः देखते हैं कि वह लिङ्ग और पीठ दोनों एक युगलरूप को धारण करके सारे विश्व को छा रहा है।
english_translation: Entering, he is seen again covering the whole universe with the paired forms of lingam and pedestal.
essence: The divine's paired forms unify and cover the entire universe as one presence.
simple_meaning: The divine appears again, holding the paired symbols of lingam and pedestal, covering the entire universe.
insight: Recognize how seemingly separate forms combine to reveal the unity underlying all things.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
समालोक्यतेऽस्माभिरित्यत्र भूयो
भवञ्चिन्मयाऽद्वैतलिङ्गादतीतम् ।
अहो नोऽपरं वस्तु कुत्रापि किञ्चित्
कथश्चिन्न चक्षुःपथं नूनमति ॥
translation: हम पुनः यहाँ देखते हैं कि अहो ! आपके चिन्मय अद्वितीय लिङ्ग के अतीत और कोई दूसरी वस्तु किसी प्रकार कहीं कुछ भी दिखाई नहीं देती
english_translation: We again see here that beyond your unique sign of pure consciousness, no other object appears anywhere at all.
essence: Only pure consciousness truly appears; nothing else exists beyond it.
simple_meaning: Only pure consciousness is truly real; beyond it, no other thing appears anywhere.
insight: It teaches you to recognize pure awareness as the sole reality behind all appearances.
modern_relevance: In moments of deep focus, everything else fades away, and only your clear, aware presence remains.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अहो सर्वसाक्षिन् ! विभो !
विश्वयोन्या प्रकृत्या पुनर्विश्वसृष्टेरिहादौ।
त्थार्न्ते भवल्लिङ्गसँल्लीनयैव  परो
द्योत्यते चिन्मयोऽद्वैतभावः ॥
translation: हे सर्वसाक्षिन् ! विभो ! सम्पूर्ण सृष्टि के आदि और अन्त में विश्वयोनि प्रकृति पुनः आपके लिंग में ही लय होकर अद्वैत चिन्मयभाव की प्रकाशक बनती है
english_translation: O all-witnessing sovereign! The universal source, nature in creation and dissolution merges again into your form, shining as the non-dual consciousness.
essence: All creation arises and dissolves back into one non-dual conscious reality.
simple_meaning: Everything that exists begins and ends as nature emerging from and merging back into Shiva's non-dual consciousness.
insight: It shifts your view from separate things to the underlying unity behind all change and form.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
महादेव ! पश्याम आद्यन्तशून्ये
पृथक् तेऽत्र लिङ्गे पृथग् यत्र तत्र ।
अनन्तेषु केन्द्रेषु पार्थक्यतो हि
जगत्सृष्टि-रक्षा-लयान् कुर्वतोऽलम् ॥
translation: हे महादेव ! हम देखते हैं कि आपके उस आदि अन्त रहित लिङ्ग में जहां तहां अलग अलग भलीभांति सृष्टि स्थिति और लय का कार्य करते
english_translation: O Mahadeva! We see that in your limitless, eternal form, creation, preservation, and dissolution happen differently everywhere.
essence: The infinite divine manifests creation, preservation, and destruction differently everywhere.
simple_meaning: In Shiva's endless form, the processes of creation, maintenance, and destruction happen in many different ways everywhere.
insight: It invites seeing the divine as both unified and manifesting in infinite diverse ways simultaneously.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अनेकान् विधींश्चैव विष्णून महेशान
निरीक्षामहे विश्वगोलव्रजञ्च।
पुनर्भूषितं विश्वमूर्तेऽत्र लिङ्गे
अनेकैरहो भग्रहोपग्रहैश्च ॥
translation: अलग अलग ब्रह्मा विष्णु महेश अनन्त स्थानों में दिखाई पड़ते हैं। हे विराटमूर्ते ! उस लिङ्ग पर अनेक तारा नक्षत्र ग्रह उपग्रह आदि से भूषित अनन्त ब्रह्माण्डसमूह आसमान दिखाई पड़ते हैं
english_translation: We observe Brahma, Vishnu, and Mahesha appearing in countless realms; the cosmic form here is adorned by innumerable stars, planets, and satellites across infinite universes.
essence: The cosmic form is infinite, manifesting countless divine aspects and celestial bodies.
simple_meaning: Different divine forms appear across countless realms, and the cosmic form is decorated with endless stars and planets.
insight: It expands your view of existence beyond your immediate world, inviting awe at the vast interconnected cosmic display.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अहो ! सर्वसाक्षिन ! कियन्त्यत्र लिङ्गे
समं विश्वगोलानि जायन्त आये ।
कियन्त्यासते च प्रलीयन्त आशु
निमग्नान्यमुष्मिन् कियन्ति प्रभो ! ते ॥
translation: हे सर्वसाक्षिन् प्रभो! अहो ! आपके उस लिङ्ग में कितने ही ब्रह्माण्ड एक साथ ही उत्पन्न होते हैं, कितने ही ब्रह्माण्ड स्थित दिखाई पड़ते हैं और कितने ही ब्रह्माण्ड उसमें डूब कर शीघ्र लय होते दिखाई पड़ते हैं
english_translation: O all-witnessing lord! In your form, countless universes arise, coexist, and dissolve rapidly.
essence: Infinite universes coexist and dissolve within the divine form simultaneously.
simple_meaning: In the form of the divine, countless universes appear, exist together, and quickly dissolve.
insight: It invites you to recognize the vast scope of existence beyond immediate experience and to feel connected to a cosmic rhythm.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
निरीक्षामहेऽनन्त ! भूयो वयं यः
दनेके हि जिज्ञासवो देवसङ्घाः।
महर्षितजास्तस्य लिङ्गस्य चादि ।
प्रत्ताः समन्वेष्टुमन्तं परन्तु ॥
translation: हे अनन्त ! हम लोग देखते हैं कि अनेक जिज्ञासु देवतागण और महर्षिगण उस लिंग का आदि और अन्त अन्वेषण करने में प्रवृत्त होते हैं परन्तु
english_translation: O Infinite One, many curious divine beings and great sages observe the origin and end of that symbol but are still striving to discover its true nature.
essence: Many seekers observe the symbol but still strive to grasp its true nature.
simple_meaning: Many divine beings and sages observe and inquire about the origin and end of the symbol, but the complete understanding remains elusive.
insight: It shows that deep truths may require more than observation—they need guidance or revelation.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
न चादि न चान्तं समासाद्य तस्य
त्वयं वर्तते नूनमायन्तशून्यः।
विराविश्वयोनौ प्रविष्टो हि लिङ्गः
स्वसिद्धान्तमित्येव कुर्वन्ति मुग्धाः ॥
translation: वे मूढ़ अन्त में उसस विराट्योनि में प्रविष्ट लिंग का आदि और अन्त न पाकर उसका आदि और अन्त नहीं है ऐसे सिद्धान्त पर उपनीत होते हैं
english_translation: The mark that has entered the cosmic womb has no beginning or end; it is beyond origin and conclusion, as taught by the wise.
essence: The true reality has no beginning or end and is beyond all limits.
simple_meaning: The true essence behind all existence has no beginning or end. It is beyond any origin or conclusion.
insight: It teaches you to see beyond beginnings and ends, recognizing the timeless nature of your true self.
modern_relevance: You feel caught in stories about where things began or how they must end. This teaching frees you to rest beyond those limits.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
प्रभो ! शब्दजातादतीताखिलात्मन् !
निरीक्षामहे ते पुनस्तत्र लिङ्गे।
विराजत्स्वनेकेषु लोकेषु सिद्धाः
महर्षिबजास्त्वाञ्च शब्दैः प्रणोतुम् ॥
translation: हे शब्द समूह से अतीत ! सर्वात्मन् ! प्रभो ! हम देखते हैं कि उस लिङ्ग में विराजमान अनेक लोकों में सिद्ध महर्षिगण वेद और शास्त्रो के शब्दों के द्वारा
english_translation: O supreme being beyond all words! We observe that in that form, many perfected sages in various worlds manifest and invoke you through the words of the Vedas and scriptures.
essence: Perfected sages across worlds invoke the supreme beyond words through sacred scriptures.
simple_meaning: Many perfected sages in different worlds invoke the supreme being beyond words through sacred Vedic words in that form.
insight: It highlights the power of sacred tradition and the recognition of the supreme beyond ordinary language by wise beings.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
यतन्ते सदा वैदिकैलौकिकैश्च
परञ्चैव वाचस्तथा शब्दपुनात् ।
अतीतो भवान् वर्ततेऽतः स्वयं ते
हवाचः क्षणात्स्युः मुमूकाश्च सन्नाः॥
translation: आपकी स्तुति करने का यत्न करते हैं, परन्तु आप वाक् और शब्द से प्रतीत होने के कारण थोड़े ही समय में वह निर्वाक् होकर स्तब्ध और मूकवत् हो जाते हैं।
english_translation: Many try to praise you with words, but because you transcend speech and sound, their praises quickly become silent and dumb.
essence: The true nature of the divine goes beyond all speech and sound, making verbal praise fleeting.
simple_meaning: People try to praise the divine with words and sounds, but since the divine is beyond speech, these praises soon fall silent.
insight: Recognize that some realities transcend language and that silence can hold deeper meaning than words.
modern_relevance: You’ve tried to express something profound, but words fail and silence takes over instead.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
विभो ! ते महेशान ! लिङ्गं विराज
निमग्ना वयं विस्मयाब्धौ निरीक्ष्य।
अहो दृश्यते ते विराडेष लिङ्गो
दशायां हि सृष्टेर्विभुव्योममध्ये ॥
translation: हे महेश्वर ! हम आपके विराट् लिंग को देखकर विस्मयसमुद्र में डूबते हुए चकित होते हैं और देखते हैं कि सृष्टि दशा में वह लिंग विभु आकाश में
english_translation: O Great Lord! We gaze in wonder, immersed like an ocean, at Your vast form shining in the cosmic space where the worlds exist.
essence: Witnessing the vast cosmic form inspires deep awe and wonder beyond words.
simple_meaning: We are overwhelmed and amazed as we see the vast cosmic form of the Great Lord shining in the middle of creation's space.
insight: It invites you to pause in wonder when faced with vastness beyond understanding, cultivating humility and openness.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
प्रभो ! ओतप्रोतो ह्यनाधन्तभावं
तवाऽऽदय बुद्धिं विधत्ते विमूढाम् ।
सदाऽस्माकमेवं मनो मूच्छितञ्चन्वतो
नो न वाचः स्फुटं निस्सरन्ति ॥
translation: हे प्रभो ! ओत प्रोत हो आपका अनादित्व और अनन्तत्व दिखाकर हमारी बुद्धि को थकित करता है और मन को मूर्छित करता है इसलिये हमारी स्पष्ट बातें नहीं निकलती
english_translation: O Lord! Your endless and eternal nature overwhelms our mind and confuses our intellect, so our clear words do not emerge.
essence: The infinite nature of the divine can overwhelm mind and intellect, blocking clear speech.
simple_meaning: The endless and eternal nature of the divine overwhelms the mind and confuses the intellect, making it hard to express clear thoughts.
insight: Recognize that feeling mentally overwhelmed can block clear communication and understanding.
modern_relevance: When facing complex or overwhelming ideas, your mind may feel exhausted and your thoughts hard to express clearly.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
तथेक्षामहे तस्य सृष्टेरतीत
दशायां सदा देशतः कालतश्च ।
अवस्थाऽपरिच्छिन्नभावं गताऽलं
प्रभोऽद्वैतभावं यदा द्योतयेन्नु ॥
translation: पुनः वैसे ही जब देखते हैं कि सृष्टि से अतीत अवस्था में उसकी देश काल से अपरिच्छिन्न अवस्था अद्वैतभाव को प्रकट करती है
english_translation: When we look beyond creation, we see the supreme reality shining timelessly, inseparable from all space and time.
essence: The true self shines timelessly, beyond all space and creation.
simple_meaning: Beyond all creation, there is a timeless, unchanging reality present everywhere beyond space and time.
insight: It teaches you to shift focus from fleeting events to the constant presence beyond them.
modern_relevance: When life feels chaotic and time slips away, remember there is a part of you untouched by all change and pressure.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अवस्थां तदेमामवेक्ष्येह नोऽलं
लयं याति शीघ्रं मनः सेन्द्रियं हि ।
तथाऽस्माकमुत्सृज्य बुद्धिः स्वयञ्च
दशां त्रैपुटर्टी सत्त्वरं सँल्लिनाति ॥
translation: तो स्वतः ही हमारे मन इन्द्रियों के साथ और हमारी बुद्धि त्रिपुटी दशा को छोड़कर शीघ्र लय हो जाती है
english_translation: Our mind naturally dissolves quickly along with the senses, and our discerning mind abandons the threefold state of existence.
essence: True wisdom releases attachment, causing mind and senses to dissolve naturally.
simple_meaning: When wisdom naturally lets go of clinging to the threefold states, the mind and senses quickly quiet and dissolve.
insight: It teaches you to release mental grip on changing states so your mind and senses relax effortlessly.
modern_relevance: After a stressful day, when you stop resisting your feelings and thoughts, your mind naturally calms and quiets without force.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अहो ! कारणानां प्रभो ! कारणात्मन् !
विभो याति लिङ्गे यदा चिन्मये ते ।
लयं विश्वगोलबजो दीप्यमान
स्तदालोक्यते कौतुकं तत्र चित्रम् ॥
translation: हे सर्व कारणकारण ! जब उस विभु चिन्मय लिंग मे भासमान ब्रह्माण्डसमूह लय को प्राप्त होते हैं तो हम देखते हैं कि
english_translation: O Lord of all causes! When the supreme cause merges into the conscious form, the dissolution of the cosmic sphere is seen as a wondrous, vibrant spectacle.
essence: The cosmic dissolution reveals a wondrous, conscious spectacle beyond ordinary perception.
simple_meaning: When the all-causing principle merges into the conscious form, the cosmic world dissolves, appearing as a wondrous and vivid spectacle.
insight: It invites you to see endings as moments of transformation filled with unexpected beauty and deeper mystery.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
विभु व्योम भूतान्तरं सर्वमेव
सलीलं स्वलीनं विधाय स्वयश्च।
विलीयाम्बुधौ देशकालस्वरूपे
सदेशं सकालं सदेत्थं निमग्नम् ॥
translation: विभु आकाश अन्यान्य सब भूतसंघों को अपने में अनायास लय  करके स्वयं देशकालरूप समुद्र में लय होकर
english_translation: The all-pervading sky effortlessly absorbs all beings, dissolving itself into the ocean of space and time, merging all place and time into itself.
essence: All beings and moments dissolve into one vast, timeless space without effort.
simple_meaning: Everything and everyone merges effortlessly into the vast space-time ocean, losing all separation.
insight: It invites you to see beyond separateness, embracing that all apparent differences dissolve into one continuous reality.
modern_relevance: When you feel isolated or fragmented, remember that you are already part of a vast, seamless whole that transcends time and place.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
भवत्यस्य लिङ्गस्य कस्मिन् प्रदेशे
यथा तस्य सत्तानुभानः कथचिन ।
न सन्तिष्ठते कापि नूनं कुनश्चित परात्मन !
प्रभो ! नाथ : शम्भो ! दयालो: ॥
translation: उनके साथ उस लिंग के कौन से स्थान में इस प्रकार डूब जाता है कि हे परमात्मन् ! हे दयालो नाथ ! हे प्रभो शम्भो ! किसी प्रकार कहीं से उसकी सत्ता का कुछ अनुभव ही नही रहता है
english_translation: In which place does one become so absorbed in that form that no trace of existence remains anywhere? O supreme being, O compassionate lord Shambhu!
essence: Complete absorption in the divine form erases all sense of separate existence.
simple_meaning: It asks where someone can become so absorbed in the divine form that they lose all sense of their own existence.
insight: It invites you to consider a state of complete merging where your separate self fades away in devotion.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
विभो ! विश्चगोलप्रकाण्टा अनन्नता
अहो चिन्मयं तत्र लिने विराजि।
अनेकैः सहवाग्विलाधाररूप !
पितृवातंदवत्रजप्योवर्हि ॥
translation: हे सर्वाधार ! उस चिन्मय विराट् लिङ्ग पर अनन्त ब्रह्माण्डसमूह, अनेक देव, ऋषि,
english_translation: O sovereign, that vast cosmic form is endless, filled with many divine beings, sages, and all foundations.
essence: The cosmic form is infinite, conscious, and filled with countless beings and energies.
simple_meaning: A vast cosmic form filled with many divine beings, sages, and foundations is endless and shines with consciousness.
insight: It invites you to recognize the infinite and interconnected nature of the cosmos beyond ordinary perception.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अनन्तैर्मनुप्यासुरेर्भूतसङ्घ श्रतुर्धा
विभक्तः प्रतीयन्न इत्यम ।
यथा चित्रिता मूर्तयः स्तम्भमध्ये
विचित्रा विचित्रेऽठमभिनिर्मितेऽलम ॥
translation: पितृ, असुर, मानव और चतुर्विध भूतसंघ के साथ ऐसे प्रतीत होते हैं जैसा कि किसी पत्थर के खम्बे पर विचित्र मूर्तियां
english_translation: With ancestors, shadow beings, humans, and the fourfold creatures, they appear like strange forms carved on a stone pillar.
essence: Many diverse beings appear as strange forms unified on a single structure.
simple_meaning: Various beings like ancestors, shadow beings, humans, and four types of creatures appear like strange statues on a stone pillar.
insight: It invites you to see diverse beings as part of a shared, intricate existence rather than isolated entities.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
प्रभो ! सन्ति ता मूर्तयः प्रस्तरेषु
सदाऽऽलेव्यभावं गताः केवलं हि ।
न चान्यत् परं वर्तते तत्र किञ्चिदहो
वस्तुतो ज्ञानसिंधो ! दयालो ! ॥
translation: खुदी हुई हो । हे ज्ञान सिन्धो ! हे दयालो ! वह  मूर्तियां भी प्रस्तर खोदित हैं और कुछ नहीं है
english_translation: O Ocean of Wisdom! Even those idols are carved from stone and nothing else exists there.
essence: Revered forms are only shaped matter; true reality lies beyond appearances.
simple_meaning: Idols, however sacred, are only carved stones without any deeper essence beyond their form.
insight: It teaches you to see beyond physical forms, recognizing the limits of outward appearances.
modern_relevance: You look at objects you revere and realize their value is in your mind, not in the object itself.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अनन्ताऽमिता विश्वगोलव्रजा हि
विराजन्त एवं विधास्तत्र लिंगे।
परं सोऽपि लिङ्गस्तु निर्लिप्त एव
प्रतीयेत तैर्नात्र सन्देहलेशः ॥
translation: वास्तव में वैसे ही अनन्तकोटि ब्रह्माण्ड समूह उस लिङ्ग में हैं परन्तु वह लिङ्ग उन सबसे निर्लिप्त ही प्रतीत होता है, इसमें सन्देह का लेश भी नहीं है
english_translation: Indeed, countless infinite universes reside in that symbol, yet that symbol appears detached from all, without even a trace of doubt.
essence: A single symbol can contain infinite worlds while remaining completely detached.
simple_meaning: Infinite countless universes exist within that symbol, yet the symbol itself remains completely detached from them.
insight: It shifts your view to see the divine as both the container and beyond all things simultaneously.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
न चादिर्न चान्तोऽस्ति लिङ्गस्य
तस्य समस्तेश ! सर्वस्वरूप ! प्रभो ! भोः !
भवञ्चिन्मयो वर्चते लिङ्ग एषः।
सदाऽन्तवहिः पूर्ण एवं भवन्वै ॥
translation: उस लिङ्ग का न आदि है और न अन्त है। हे सर्वेश्वर समय विभो परमात्मन् ! आपका चिन्मय लिङ्ग बहिः पूर्ण अन्तः पूर्ण और
english_translation: That symbol has neither beginning nor end. O Lord of all, that conscious symbol shines fully within and without, complete in every way.
essence: The divine symbol is infinite, complete, and present everywhere without limits.
simple_meaning: The symbol representing the divine has no start or end and is fully present everywhere, inside and out.
insight: It shows that the divine essence transcends time and space, inviting you to see beyond beginnings and endings.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अहो देशकालाऽपरिच्छिन्न आरा
दनाद्यन्तरूपेण पूर्णः परात्मन् !।
निरीक्ष्येत नूनं सदा सर्वतो हि
न चास्तेऽत्र सन्देहलेशः कथञ्चित् ॥
translation: देश काल से अपरिच्छिन्न होकर अनादि और अनन्त रूप से सर्व पूर्ण दिखाई पड़ता है, इसमें किसी प्रकार का सन्देह लेश नहीं है
english_translation: The supreme being appears complete everywhere, beyond limits of place and time, without any doubt.
essence: The true self is complete and boundless, beyond all limits and doubt.
simple_meaning: The true self is complete and present everywhere, beyond all limits of place and time, without any doubt.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing yourself as limited by circumstances to recognizing your boundless and complete nature.
modern_relevance: When you feel scattered or uncertain about your place or time, remember your true self is whole and present beyond all limits.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
प्रदर्श प्रदर्श सदा लिङ्गमेनं
विराणमूर्तिभृत् ! ज्ञाननेत्रस्य नोऽलम ।
क्षमत्वं यदा दूरदृष्टविनश्येत्
तदैकापरूपं प्रदृश्येत रूपम् ॥
translation: हे विराट मूर्ते ! आपके विराट् लिंग को देखते देखते हमारे ज्ञान नेत्र की दूरदर्शन शक्ति जब थकित होकर नष्ट हो जाती है तब हमें आपका और एक अपरूप रूप दिखाई देने लगता है
english_translation: O cosmic form! When the power of your knowledge eye to see far fades, another formless form of yours appears.
essence: When clear perception fades, a deeper, formless reality reveals itself.
simple_meaning: When our ability to perceive your vast cosmic form with knowledge weakens, another deeper, formless aspect becomes visible.
insight: It invites you to trust that limits of your current knowledge open space for deeper wisdom beyond visible forms.
modern_relevance: Sometimes your understanding of a complex truth feels exhausted, yet a deeper, subtler insight quietly emerges beyond your current awareness.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
यदा ते दयासागरैतद्विचित्रं
मनोबुद्धिवाग्वैभवातीतलिङ्गम् ।
समालोक्य किकार्यमूढाः स्वचित्तैः । 
किमप्याश्रयामस्तदेक्षामहेऽन्यत् ॥
translation: हे करुणावरुणालय ! जब आपके इस चमत्कार वाङ्मन और बुद्धि से अग्राहा लिङ्ग को देखकर हम अपने अन्तःकरणों के द्वारा किंकर्तव्यविमूढ़ होकर आपके शरणागत होते हैं तो कुछ हम और ही देखने लगते हैं
english_translation: O ocean of compassion! When your wondrous speech, mind, and intellect reveal the sign beyond desire, we, confused in our own minds, become your refuge and begin to see something else.
essence: Confusion in your mind can lead you to refuge and fresh understanding beyond desire.
simple_meaning: When your deep compassion and wisdom show a sign beyond craving, we become confused but also seek your refuge and start seeing things differently.
insight: It invites you to trust your confusion as a gateway to refuge and fresh insight beyond ego’s limits.
modern_relevance: When your mind is overwhelmed by uncertainty, encountering a deeper wisdom can bring surprising clarity and a new perspective.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
लिनातीह शब्देऽखिला स्थूलस्राष्टिः।
स्वराः पड्जनामादयः सप्त चैवम् ।
सदौङ्कारशब्देऽद्वितीये लिनन्ति
अविच्छिन्न आस्ते यथा तैलधारा ॥
translation: हम देखते हैं कि सब स्थूल.सृष्टि शब्द में लय होती है, षड्ज आदि सप्तस्वर अद्वितीय प्रणव में लय होते हैं जो तैलधारा की भांति अवच्छिन्न है
english_translation: All gross creation dissolves into sound; the seven notes merge into the unique primal sound, continuous like a flowing oil.
essence: All creation merges into one continuous primal sound flowing without break.
simple_meaning: All physical creation ultimately dissolves into sound. The seven musical notes merge into the one unique primal sound that flows endlessly like oil.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing separate forms to recognizing a continuous, unified flow beneath appearances.
modern_relevance: When you listen to music or sounds around you, remember everything visible is part of one continuous flow beneath the surface.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
यथा दीर्घघण्टानिनादोऽस्ति यस्तु
सदैकेन भावेन युक्तस्तथैव ।
समुत्पादकोऽस्त्येकतत्त्वस्य सोऽयम
भवानासने प्राणवे तंत्र माति ॥
translation: और दीर्घ घंटे के शब्द की भांति एक भावयुक्त होकर एकतत्व उत्पादक है, आप उसी प्रणव आसन पर बैठे हैं।
english_translation: Just as the long sound of a bell is a unified vibration, you seated on the pranava seat are the source of oneness.
essence: You are the fundamental source from which all unity arises, like one vibration.
simple_meaning: You are like the single unified vibration of a long bell sound, the source of all oneness seated in the primal sound.
insight: This verse shifts attention to recognizing yourself as the fundamental source from which unity and essence emerge.
modern_relevance: When you focus deeply on a single sound or moment, you can access a sense of connectedness as the origin of harmony.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
अनन्तात्मकस्ते जया दिक्समूहः
त्रिकालात्मकं ते विशालं त्रिनेत्रम् ।
अनन्तो विभुवर्तते ते दयालो !
सुयज्ञोपवीतं पवित्रं मनोज्ञम् ॥
translation: हे दयालो! अनन्त रूपधारी दशो दिशाएँ आपकी जटा हैं. त्रिकालरूपी आपके तीन विशाल नेत्र हैं, विभुरूपधारी अनन्तः आपका पवित्र मनोहर यज्ञोपवीत है
english_translation: O compassionate one! Your matted hair is infinite in all ten directions, your three large eyes span past, present, and future; infinite and all-pervading, your sacred sacred thread is beautiful and pure.
essence: The divine form transcends all directions and time, embodying infinite sacredness.
simple_meaning: This verse describes the limitless, all-encompassing form of Shiva, highlighting his cosmic aspects like infinite hair, three eyes spanning time, and a pure sacred thread.
insight: It invites seeing the divine as beyond all limits of space and time, encouraging expansive perspective.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
लयस्थानभूतोऽपि विश्वस्य देव !
भवान भूपिताङ्गो विभूत्या विभाति ।
चतुर्हस्तमध्येऽस्त्यहो खप्परस्ते
त्रिशूलञ्च शृङ्गं डमर्वाख्यवाद्यम् ॥
translation: हे देव ! आप संसार के लयस्थान होकर विभूतिभूषिताङ्ग हैं, आपके चारों हाथों में त्रिशुल खप्पर सिंगा और डमरु
english_translation: O divine being! You are the dissolution point of the universe, radiant with manifestations. In your four hands are the trident, skull, horn, and drum.
essence: The divine is the cosmic center holding many symbolic powers in unity.
simple_meaning: The divine is the source and end of everything, shining through many forms, holding sacred symbols in four hands.
insight: Recognize that the ultimate reality is beyond form but expresses itself through meaningful symbols you can relate to.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
परासिद्धिमोक्षस्त्रितापञ्च नूनम्
प्रभो वर्तते खपरश्व त्रिशूलम् ।
निवृत्त्यात्मको धर्म एवास्ति शृङ्गं
डमर्वाख्यवायं चतुर्धाऽर्थ एव ॥
translation: त्रिताप, परासिद्धि रूपी मोक्ष, निवृत्तिधर्म और चतर्विध अर्थरूप से शोभायमान हैं,
english_translation: The supreme accomplishment, freedom like the highest mastery, the path of withdrawal, and the fourfold purposes all shine forth, O Lord, like the trident, horse, and drum.
essence: Mastery, withdrawal, and life's aims unify and shine like sacred symbols of power.
simple_meaning: The highest success, freedom from suffering, withdrawing the self, and four key life aims are bright and clear like sacred symbols.
insight: Recognize that mastery, purposeful withdrawal, and life’s aims are interconnected aspects of your inner strength.
modern_relevance: When your highest skills, clear purpose, and the ability to step back from distractions come together, you feel a strong, bright force inside.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
सदैकाऽद्वितीयोऽपि नैजी स्वशक्ति
प्रकृत्यात्मिकां तां स्वतो निर्गमय ।
स्वशक्तया तया श्यामया शोभिताको
भवान् राजतेऽलं धरन् प्रेमतस्ताम् ॥
translation: आप एक अद्वितीय होने पर भी अपने ही में से अपनी प्रकृति को बाहर करके अपने काम अङ्क पर अति प्रेम से धारण करते हुए शोभायमान हो
english_translation: Though you are unique, you manifest your own nature outwardly and shine brilliantly, holding it with deep love.
essence: You shine brightly by lovingly expressing your unique true nature.
simple_meaning: You are unique and express your true nature outwardly with love, which makes you shine brightly.
insight: It teaches you to lovingly accept and express your true nature as your source of radiance.
modern_relevance: You feel most alive when you fully embrace and express your unique qualities with genuine care and pride.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
तया श्यामया भूयते पूर्णशक्त्या
सती तद्विधैवाऽस्यसौ पोड़शी च ।
करेणात्तपाशेन जीवाय बन्धं
सविद्याकुशेन प्रदत्ते च मुक्तिम् ॥
translation: वह श्यामा पूर्णशक्ति शालिनी होकर षोड़शी है और अपने हाथों में पाश और अंकुश धारण करके जीवों को मायाजाल में फांसती भी है और ज्ञान रूपी अंकुश द्वारा मुक्त भी करती है,
english_translation: That Shyama, the full-power sixteen-faced one, holds a noose and goad in her hands, ensnaring beings in the web of illusion and also freeing them with the goad of wisdom.
essence: The divine can both bind beings in illusion and free them through wisdom.
simple_meaning: Shyama, a powerful sixteen-faced figure, holds tools that both trap beings in illusion and free them through wisdom.
insight: Recognize that forces around you can both limit and free, depending on your understanding and response.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अविद्यास्वरूपा सपाशेयमेव
तथा साकुंशा सैव विद्यास्वरूपा।
 सती पाति सृष्टेरलं वैभवं ते
वयं नाथ ! विद्यापते ! त्वां नमामः ॥
translation: पाशविधायिनी होकर वही अविद्यारुपी और अंकुश विधायिनी होकर वही  विद्यारूप होती हुई आपके सृष्टि-वैभव की रक्षा करती है, हे विद्यापते स्वामिन् ! आपको नमस्कार है
english_translation: Ignorance acts like reins, and wisdom like a goad, both protecting the grand splendor of creation; we bow to you, lord of knowledge.
essence: Ignorance and wisdom both guide and uphold the world’s grand order under the lord of knowledge.
simple_meaning: Both ignorance and wisdom act as controls, guiding and protecting the vast splendor of creation governed by the lord of knowledge.
insight: Recognize that both confusion and insight are necessary forces that help steer your life’s unfolding with balance.
modern_relevance: When you face conflicting thoughts, remember both confusion and clarity shape your growth and protect your wider purpose.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
त्रयाणां गुणानां गुणाधार ! बीजं
तथेशो गुणग्रामिणां वर्तसे त्वम् ।
गुणेभ्योऽप्यतीतस्य तेऽन्के गुणात्मप्रकृत्या
स्थितं सन्नमामो भवन्तम् ॥
translation: हे गुणाधार ! आप त्रिगुण के बीजस्वरूप और गुणियों के ईश्वर हो और आप गुणातीत होने पर भी गुणमयी प्रकृति आपके आश्रय से ही आपके अंक पर स्थिता है, आपको नमस्कार है
english_translation: O support of the three qualities, you are their seed and lord, and though beyond qualities, the quality-filled nature abides in you; I bow to you.
essence: The source beyond all qualities contains and sustains them within itself.
simple_meaning: You are the source and essence of the three qualities. Although you are beyond these qualities, all qualities exist within your nature. I honor that truth.
insight: Recognizing that all changing qualities arise from a deeper unchanging source shifts perspective from fluctuation to stability.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
प्रभो ! सिद्धरूपस्तथा सिद्धिबीजं
अहो ! सिद्धराजोऽपि सिद्धलयोऽसि ।
ददभाग्यवद्भयः परासिद्धिमतानितो
मोचयेस्ते नमः सिद्धिनाथ ! ॥
translation: हे सिद्धिनाथ ! आप सिद्ध स्वरूप, सिद्धिबीज और सिद्धगण के अधीश्वर होने पर भी आप ही सिद्धि के लय स्थान हो और हे प्रभो ! आप ही परा सिद्धि देकर परमभाग्यशाली जीव को मुक्ति पद प्रदान करते हो, आपको नमस्कार है
english_translation: O Lord of the perfected ones! You are the perfected form, the seed of perfection, the king of the perfected, and the resting place of perfection. You grant the supreme perfection and liberation to the supremely fortunate beings; salutations to you, Lord of perfection!
essence: The divine is the ultimate source, embodiment, and shelter of all perfection and liberation.
simple_meaning: You are the highest source and refuge of all true perfection and you grant supreme liberation to the fortunate.
insight: It shifts your view from seeking perfection outside to recognizing it as your true source and refuge.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by imperfection or struggle, remember there is a source of perfect freedom and support beyond your fears.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
स्त्रतेजोमयस्तेजआधाररूपोऽपि
तेजस्मुवीजञ्च तेजस्विनाथः।
तिजः कर्षसि प्राणिनस्तेजसा स्वाभिमुख्येन
तेजोमय ! त्वां नमामः ॥
translation: हे तेजोभय ! आप 'तेजाधार तेजबीज तेजस्वरूप और तेजस्विगण के ईश्वर होने पर भी निरन्तर अपने तेज द्वारा तेजस्वी जीवों को अपनी ओर आकर्षण करते रहते हो, आपको नमस्कार है
english_translation: O Radiant Lord, you are the source, seed, and form of light. You continuously draw all radiant beings toward yourself with your brilliance. Radiant One, we bow to you.
essence: The divine radiance naturally pulls all luminous beings toward itself.
simple_meaning: You are the source and embodiment of radiant energy, constantly attracting all radiant beings toward yourself.
insight: Recognize your own inherent brilliance and how it naturally attracts connection without force.
modern_relevance: When you feel inspired by someone’s radiant energy, remember that such light naturally draws others toward it, like this verse describes.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
असि ज्ञान्यधीशोऽपि बुद्धेरतीत
स्त्वधिष्ठाय बुद्धिं सतः पाणिनस्त्वम् ।
नयस्येव शश्वद्धिया मोक्षभूमि वयं धीश !
नम्रा नमामो भवन्तम् ॥
translation: हे धीश ! ज्ञानिगण के ईश्वर होने पर भी आप बुद्धि से अतीत हो और आप ही बुद्धि में अधिष्ठित होकर बुद्धि द्वारा सदा जीवंगण को मुक्ति भूमि में पहुंचा दिया करते हो, आपको नमस्कार है
english_translation: O wise lord, though you are the lord of the wise, you transcend intellect. You dwell within intellect and, through it, guide beings to the land of freedom. We humbly bow to you.
essence: The divine transcends intellect yet uses it to guide beings to freedom.
simple_meaning: You are the master of wisdom who exists beyond intellect yet uses it to guide beings toward freedom.
insight: It invites you to trust that true guidance transcends mental limits and leads you beyond confusion.
modern_relevance: When you feel stuck in overthinking, remember that guidance and freedom can come from beyond your own mind.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
विभो ! सृष्टिरक्षाविनाशकहतो!
परेभ्यः पर! त्वं प्रभो ! वर्तसेऽलम्।
महीयोविराहपक्षस्य बीजं वयं
सर्वशक्तयात्मक ! त्वां नमामः ॥
translation: हे सर्वशक्तिमय ! सृष्टि स्थिति और प्रलय के कारण के ईश्वर ! हे परमात्मन् ! हे प्रभो ! आप ही महा विराट रूप तरु के बीज हो, आपको नमस्कार है
english_translation: O all-powerful one! You are the cause of creation, preservation, and destruction! O supreme being, you are the seed of the great cosmic tree; we bow to you.
essence: The supreme power is the root cause behind all cosmic cycles and forms.
simple_meaning: You are the source behind creation, preservation, and destruction. You are the seed of the great cosmic form. We honor you.
insight: It invites seeing the universe as rooted in one source beyond all changes, deepening reverence for life’s cycles.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
तवास्याङ्कुरेणैव मूलप्रकृत्या
तथा वर्त्यते विष्णुवेधोमहेशैः।
त्रिभिः स्कन्धरूपैः सुरादिभिस्तै
रनेकैर्हि शाखाप्रशाखास्वरूपैः ॥
translation: हे आशुतोष ! हे विश्वनाथ! आपकी मूल प्रकृति अंकुर है, ब्रह्मा विष्णु महेश उसके तीन स्कन्ध हैं, ऋषिगण और देवतागण आदि उसकी शाखा प्रशाखा हैं,
english_translation: O Ashutosh, your original nature is a seed; Brahma, Vishnu, and Mahesh are its three branches; sages and gods are its many twigs and sub-branches.
essence: All cosmic forms arise as branches from the singular seed of the divine’s original nature.
simple_meaning: The divine’s original nature is a seed that unfolds into many parts, including great beings like Brahma, Vishnu, and Mahesh, and many sages and radiant beings.
insight: It invites you to see all diverse forms as expressions of one underlying source, helping you find unity in apparent multiplicity.
modern_relevance: Like a single idea branching into many projects and teams, your deepest nature can express itself in countless connected ways.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अहो तस्य वृक्षस्य संसार एव
फलं विद्यते नात्र सन्देहलेशः।
विभो ! विश्वनाथ ! प्रणम्याशुतोष !
वयं सादरं साअलि त्वां नमामः ॥
translation: संसार उसका फल है, विभो ! विश्वनाथ ! आपको सादर हाथ जोड़कर नमस्कार है
english_translation: The fruit of that tree is the cycle of reactivity; there is no doubt about this. O Lord of the universe, O Ashutosh, we respectfully bow to you.
essence: The cycle of reaction is the inevitable fruit of action, honored by bowing to the divine source.
simple_meaning: The endless cycle of reactions and consequences is like the fruit of a tree that cannot be denied. We respectfully honor the divine as the source.
insight: Recognize that consequences naturally arise from actions, and honoring the source brings clarity and respect.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अपि त्वं महीयस्तरोस्तस्य बीजं
तदाधार आस्सेऽखिलाधाररूपः।
निराधाररूपोऽपि धर्मात्मना तु
प्रभो ! धर्म मूर्ते! भवन्तं नमामः ॥
translation: हे धर्ममूर्ते ! आप उस महान् वृक्ष के वीज होने पर भी उसके आधाररूप हो और स्वयं निराधार होकर भी आप ही धर्मरूप से सबका आधार हो, आपको नमस्कार है
english_translation: O embodiment of dharma! Though you are the seed of that great tree, you are also its foundation; though formless, you are the support of all as the form of dharma. We bow to you.
essence: The ultimate source is also the enduring support of all as dharma's form.
simple_meaning: You are both the seed and the foundation of the great tree of dharma, formless yet the support of all through your form as dharma.
insight: It reveals how something can be both the invisible cause and the visible support, inviting a view beyond duality.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
विहारिन् ! विभो ! भक्तचेतोनिकेते
शरण्यं किलैकान्ततस्त्वां व्रजामः ।
यथा नो भवेदत्र कल्याणमाशु
तदेवाधुना देव ! शम्भो ! विधेहि ॥
translation: हे भक्तमनोमन्दिरविहारी ! अब हम आपके एकान्त शरणागत होते हैं, हे देव शम्भो ! जिससे हमारा शीघ्र कल्याण हो ऐसा करिये
english_translation: O beloved of devoted minds! Now we come as your sole refuge, O divine Shambhu! Please grant us swift welfare here.
essence: Complete trust in the divine refuge brings swift well-being and protection.
simple_meaning: You can fully surrender as the only refuge to the divine and receive quick help and well-being.
insight: It teaches you to surrender your worries completely to a trusted refuge, opening space for quick healing.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed, you can turn fully to a trusted source of support and find relief faster than expected.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
भवतां सम्प्रसन्नोऽस्मि स्तवेरीभिः स्वधाभुजः ।
कल्याणं त्रिविधं भूयाद्भवद्भयो निश्चितं सदा ॥
translation: हे संसारसुखदायी पितृगण ! मैं आपकी इन स्तुतियों से प्रसन्न हूँ, आप लोगों का सदा विविध कल्याण हो
english_translation: O beings who bring worldly happiness! I am pleased with your praises; may you always have assured threefold welfare.
essence: Receiving genuine praise inspires blessings for assured, triple welfare.
simple_meaning: The divine expresses happiness at the praises and wishes the beings constant assured well-being in three ways.
insight: It shows the power of gratitude and appreciation to foster positive relationships and blessings.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
प्राप्य त्रिविधकल्याणमेवं मुक्तिपदेऽनिशम् ।
अग्रेसरत निर्वाधं सलीलं विश्वभूतिदाः ! ॥
translation: और विविध कल्याण प्राप्त करके आप मुक्तिपद में अनायास बेरोक अग्रसर हो
english_translation: Having attained the threefold welfare, beings effortlessly progress unhindered on the path to liberation, flowing like the source of the universe.
essence: Complete well-being opens a smooth, unstoppable path to lasting freedom.
simple_meaning: After gaining all-round well-being, you move smoothly and without obstacles toward lasting inner freedom.
insight: It teaches that complete welfare in body, mind, and spirit clears the way for effortless spiritual advancement.
modern_relevance: You’ve worked hard on your health, relationships, and mind. Now progress toward freedom feels natural and unstoppable.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
जैवैशसहजाख्यानां द्रष्टा सन् कर्मणामहम् ।
गया स्वतन्त्रयाऽमीभिस्त्रिभिरेव स्वतन्त्रया ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! मैं जैव ऐश और सहज कर्म का द्रष्टा होकर इन तीनों के द्वारा ही स्वतन्त्र स्वतन्त्र गति से
english_translation: O ancestors! I am the witness of natural, essential action and the self; through these three alone, I move freely and independently.
essence: Freedom arises by witnessing natural action as the true self beyond it.
simple_meaning: You are the observer who watches natural and essential actions without interference; through this witnessing, you move with true freedom.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate the inner observer that lets you act naturally while remaining free from attachment.
modern_relevance: When you watch your impulses and choices without judgment, you create space to act freely instead of reactively.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
सम्प्रयच्छामि कैवल्यं त्रिविध वैविशेषतः।
नैव कश्चन सन्देहो विद्यतेऽत्र स्वधाभुनः !॥
translation: सम्यक् त्रिविध मुक्ति का विधान करता हूँ, इसमें कुछ सन्देह नहीं है
english_translation: I now explain the three distinct types of complete freedom; there is no doubt about this.
essence: Complete freedom exists in three clear, distinct forms beyond doubt.
simple_meaning: There are three specific kinds of complete inner freedom, and this teaching explains them clearly without any doubt.
insight: It shifts your mind to expect clarity and certainty about liberation rather than confusion or doubt.
modern_relevance: When life feels chaotic, knowing there are clear, distinct ways to find lasting inner freedom can bring calm and direction.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
जैवेन कर्मणा दत्त्वा पदं शुक्लपथान्वयि ।
ऐशेन कर्मणा नूनं पदं त्रैमौर्तिकं वरम् ॥
translation: ऐश कर्म से त्रिमूर्तिपद और जैव कर्म द्वारा शुक्लपथगामी पद प्रदान करके
english_translation: By the living being's action, one attains the white path; by the divine's action, surely the supreme place of the three deities is attained.
essence: Your choice of action shapes your path beyond this life.
simple_meaning: What you do shapes where you go after life: ordinary actions lead to a pure path; divine actions lead to the highest realm.
insight: Recognize that your intentions and the nature of your actions influence your life's long-term direction.
modern_relevance: When you decide between routine tasks and inspired actions, you shape your future beyond immediate results.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
जीवन्मुक्तिपदं श्रेष्ठं कर्मणा सहजेन च ।
सार्थकं स्वं त्रिनेत्रत्वं विदधेऽहं स्वधाभुजः ॥
translation: और सहज कर्म से श्रेष्ठ जीवन्मुक्त पद प्रदान करके अपने त्रिनेत्र की सार्थकता करता हूँ
english_translation: I grant the supreme state of liberation in life through natural action and demonstrate the true purpose of my three-eyed form.
essence: Supreme freedom arises through natural, effortless action revealing true meaning.
simple_meaning: True liberation comes from acting naturally and effortlessly, revealing the deeper meaning behind your actions.
insight: It shifts your focus from controlling results to embracing natural, effortless action as the path to freedom.
modern_relevance: You find freedom not by forcing every move but by trusting your natural flow in daily tasks.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
वर्णाश्रमीयधर्माणां भवन्तो रक्षका यतः।
अतः सहैव सम्बन्धस्त्रिभिर्व: परियुज्यते ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! वर्णाश्रमधर्म के रक्षक होने के कारण तीनों से ही आपका सम्बन्ध है,
english_translation: O ancestors, as protectors of the duties of the four classes and stages of life, you have a relationship with all three.
essence: Protecting social duties links you to diverse groups simultaneously.
simple_meaning: The ancestors have connections with all three groups because they protect the duties of the four social classes and life stages.
insight: Recognize how fulfilling your role creates connections beyond immediate circles.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
यत्राग्रगामिभावस्य वर्त्ततेच्छात्र वो मुदा।
तदग्रेसरतां लव्धुं भवन्तः शक्नुवन्ति च ॥
translation: जिसकी ओर आप अग्रसर होना चाहते हो, हो सकते हो
english_translation: You can become what you want to move toward.
essence: You have the ability to become what your heart truly desires.
simple_meaning: You can become what you want to move toward if you have the desire and willingness.
insight: Recognize that your intentions and desires empower you to progress; focus your energy on what you want to become.
modern_relevance: You feel drawn to a new career or passion, unsure if you can change — this reminds you that your desire itself is the first step toward becoming.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
भवन्तो धर्ममाश्रित्य कर्तव्यज्ञानतत्पराः ।
पितरः ! स्वीयकार्येषु निरता भवत ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: हे पितृगण ! आप धर्म का आश्रय करके कर्तव्यबुद्धिपरायण होकर अपने कार्य में तत्पर हो
english_translation: O ancestors! Rely on your dharma and be devoted to understanding your duty, firmly engaged in your own work.
essence: Firmly focus on your own duty by relying on your true purpose and understanding.
simple_meaning: You should rely on your true purpose and be deeply focused on understanding and performing your own duties.
insight: It teaches you to anchor your energy in your own responsibilities rather than comparing or wandering aimlessly.
modern_relevance: When distractions pull you in many directions, grounding yourself in your own responsibilities helps you stay steady and effective.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text:
तथा जगति धर्माणां पूर्णरूपप्रकाशने ।
सहायकाः सदा यूयं भवत द्रागतन्द्रिताः ॥
translation: और जगत में धर्म का पूर्ण स्वरूप प्रकाश करने में आलस्य रहित होकर सदा सहायक हो
