translation: मन के अस्तित्व से ही दुःख होता है क्योंकि मन ही दु:खकारी संकल्प करता है। जो मानस रहित है, उसे दुःख छूता तक नहीं

verse_text:
प्रारब्धकर्मजं दुःखं जीवनमुक्तस्य कथ्यते ।
कर्मत्रयविहीनस्य विदेहस्य कथन्नु  तत ॥
translation: जीवन्मुक्त को प्रारब्ध कर्मों से उत्पन्न होने वाले दुःख भोगने पड़ते हैं परन्तु कर्मत्रय विहीन विदेह पुरुष के लिये ऐसा कैसे सम्भव है

verse_text:
कर्म कर्तव्यमिति वा न कर्तव्यमितीह वा।
यदि मन्येत वैदेही न मुक्तिं प्राप्तवास्तुं  स: ॥
translation: अमुक कर्म करना है अथवा अमुक नहीं करना इस प्रकार का विधि निषेध जो मानता हो, उसे विदेह मुक्ति प्राप्त नहीं हुई, ऐसा  जानना चाहिये

verse_text:
समाधिर्वाऽय कर्तव्यो न कर्तव्य इतीह वा।
यदि मन्येत वैदेहीं न मुक्तिं प्राप्तवास्तुं  स: ॥
translation: समाधि करना है अथवा नहीं करना है, इसका जो विचार करे, उसे विदेह मुक्ति प्राप्त नहीं हुई है, ऐसा जानना चाहिये

verse_text:
पूर्व बद्धोऽधुना मुक्तोऽस्यहमित्येव बन्धनात।
यदि मन्येत वैदेहीं न मुक्तिं प्राप्तवास्तुं  स: ॥
translation: पहले मैं बद्ध था और अब बन्धन से मुक्त हुआ हूँ ऐसा जो माने, उसे विदेहमुक्ति प्राप्त नहीं हुई है

verse_text:
पूर्वमष्यभवन मुक्तो मध्ये भ्रान्तिस्तु बन्धवत् ।
यदि मन्येत वैदेहीं न मुक्तिं प्राप्तवास्तुं  स: ॥
translation: पहले मैं मुक्त ही था, पर बीच में भ्रम के चक्कर में पड़कर बद्ध की तरह अपने को समझने लगा था, ऐसा जो माने, वह विदेह्मुक्त नहीं कहा जा सकता

verse_text:
बन्ध्यापुत्रादिवत्सर्वं  मयभूदसदित्यति ।
यदि मन्येत वैदेही न मुक्तिं प्राप्तवास्तुं  स: ॥
translation: बन्ध्या पुत्र की तरह मुझमें सब कुछ असत् हो गया-ऐसा जो माने, उसे विदेहमुक्ति प्राप्त हुई है

verse_text:
आविद्यकं तमो ध्वस्तं स्वप्रकाशेन वा इति।
यदि मन्येत वैदेही न मुक्तिं प्राप्तवास्तुं  स: ॥
translation: स्वप्रकाश से अविद्या के अन्धकार का नाश हो गया है, यह जिसकी भावना हो जाय, वह विदेहमुक्त नहीं है

verse_text:
स्वप्नेऽपि नाऽहंभावोऽस्ति मम देहेन्द्रियादिषु।
यदि मन्येत वैदेही न मुक्तिं प्राप्तवास्तुं  स: ॥
translation: देह और इन्द्रियादि के विषय में मुझे अहंभाव नहीं है, ऐसा जो स्वप में भी माने उसे विदेह मुक्ति प्राप्त नहीं हुई है

verse_text:
अरूपनष्टमनसो विदेहत्वं प्रकीत्तर्यते।
तत् कथं मन्यमानस्य यत्किचित् स्यादनात्मन: ॥
translation: रूप और मन जिस का नष्ट हो गया हो, वही सच्चा विदेहमुक्त है। जो केवल चिन्तता मात्र से ही ऐसा मानता है कि मैं विदेहमुक्त हूँ, ऐसे अनात्मा को भला विदेह पद कैसे प्राप्त हो सकता है

verse_text:
मनो नश्यति निःशेष मननस्य विसर्जनात ।
अमनस्कस्वभावं तत्पदं तस्याऽवशिष्यते ॥
translation: मनन के त्याग से ही मनोनाश होता है और तब विदेहमुक्ति के अधिकारी के लिए अमन्सक स्वभाव मात्र  ही अवशिष्ट रहता है

verse_text:
यस्य सर्वे समारम्भाः कामसंकल्पावर्जिता:।
ज्ञानाग्निदग्धकर्माण तमाहुः पण्डितं बुधाः ॥
translation: जिसके सब कार्यारम्भ कामसंकल्प रहित हैं ज्ञानाग्नि से दग्ध कर्मा उस महापुरुष को विज्ञ जन पण्डित (विदेहमुक्त) कहते हैं

verse_text:
मननेन विनिश्चित्य वैदेही मुक्तिमात्मन:।
नैष्कम्यसिद्धि वदतां का तृप्तिरविवेकिनाम ॥
translation: जो व्यक्ति मन से ही अपनी विदेहमुक्ति हुई है-ऐसा समझकर नैष्यकर्म  सिद्धि की बातें केवल मुख से कहते हैं, ऐसे अविवेकियों की तृप्ति कैसे हो सकती है

verse_text:
स्वानुभूति बिना ययत्कुर्वन्ति भुवि मानवा:।
तत्तत्सर्वं वृथैव स्यान्मरुभूमौ कृषिर्यथा ॥
translation: स्वानुभव के विना पृथ्वी में मनुष्य जो कुछ करते हैं, वह मरुभूमि में खेती करने के समान व्यर्थ हो जाता है

verse_text:
स्वानुभूत्यर्थकं कर्म निकृष्मपि सर्वथा।
उत्तमं विबुधैः श्लाध्यं नाऽत्र कश्चन संशय ॥
translation: स्वानुभव से युक्त अर्थात् अध्यात्म लक्ष्ययुक्त होकर जो कर्म किया खाता है, वह निकृष्ट कर्म भी देवताओं को अत्यन्त प्रिय होता है। इसी कोई सन्देह नहीं है

verse_text:
यस्तु वश्येन्द्रियं शान्त निष्कामं सदगुरु सदा
स्वात्मैकरसिकं मुक्तयै स धीमानुपगच्छति ॥
translation: जिसके इन्द्रियाँ वश में हों, जो शान्त हो, जो निष्काम हो, जो आत्माराम हो, ऐसे सद्गुरु के पास मुक्ति की इच्छा से जो जाता है, वही बुद्धिमान् है

verse_text:
काम्यकर्मणि चोत्सृज्य निष्कामो यो मुमुक्षया
शान्त्यादिगुणसंयुक्तं गुरुं प्राप्त: स मुच्यते ॥
translation: काम्य कर्मों को छोड़कर जो निष्काम हो गया है और जो शान्ति आदि गुणों से युक्त सद्गुरु को मुक्ति की इच्छा से प्राप्त हुआ है, वह मुक्त होता है।

verse_text:
ज्ञानाभिमानी कश्चित्तु गुरुभक्तिं विना क्वचित।
रहस्यमस्या गीतायाः सम्यग ज्ञातुं न शक्नुयात ॥
translation: गुरुभक्तिहीन कोई भी साधक इस गीता के पाठ करने मेरे सान्निध्य को नहीं प्राप्त होगा

verse_text:
गुरुभक्तिविहीनस्तु साधको नैव कश्चन
अस्याः पाठेन गीतायाः मुत्सान्निध्यं प्र्लपस्य्ते ॥
translation: कोई भी ज्ञानाभिमानी कहीं भी गुरुभक्ति के सिवा इस गीता के रहस्य को अच्छी रीति से नहीं समझ सकता है

verse_text:
मन्त्ररूपेऽपि शब्देऽसा गुरुभक्ति विनानया।
सूर्ययागेऽनुष्ठितेऽपि साधकः सफलो न हि ॥
translation: इस गीता के शब्द मंत्ररूप होने पर  भी गुरु भक्ति के बिना इसके द्वारा अनुष्ठान किया हुआ सूर्य याग साधक को सफलता नहीं दे सकता

verse_text:
कर्म वोपासना वाऽपि ज्ञानं वा भवति ध्रुवं।
तत्र सर्वेषु वर्त्तेत गुरुभक्ते: प्रधानता ॥
translation: कर्म उपासना और ज्ञान इन में से कोई भी हो, इन सभी में गुरु भक्ति की प्रसन्नता है

verse_text:
कल्याणायैन सर्वेषां गीतेयं श्राविता मया।
एतां प्रचार्य सर्वत्र  यूयं कुरुत मगलम ॥
translation: सबके कल्याण के लिये यह गीता मैने आपकी सुनायी है। इसका पूर्ण रूप से प्रचारकर आप जन साधारण का मङ्गल करें

verse_text:
गुरुश्रद्धाविहीनेभ्यो नास्तिकेभ्यश्च सर्वथा
अविश्वासाऽपवित्रेभ्यो न देयैषा  कदाचन ॥
translation: जो गुरुभक्ति से हीन, नास्तिक और अविश्वास से अपवित्र हों, उनको इसका उपदेश कभी न दिया जाए

verse_text:
गुरौ शास्त्रे श्रद्दधद्भय: विरक्तेभ्यश्च सर्वथा।
प्रारब्धवदभ्यो भक्तेभ्य: प्रदेयेयं प्रयत्नतः॥
translation: गुरु और शास्त्रों में जिसकी श्रद्धा हो, जो सर्वथा विरक्त हो और जो भाग्यवान् भक्त हो, उसको इसका उपदेश  अवश्य करना चाहिये

verse_text:
सम्यगध्ययनादस्या सातापत्रयविमुक्तित:।
कैवल्यमधिगच्छन्ति साधकाः शान्तमानसाः ॥
translation: इसका अच्छी तरह अध्ययन करने से तीनों ताप छूट जाते हैं और फिर वह शान्तचेता साधक कैवल्य को प्राप्त करता है।

verse_text:
शृण्वतां पठतां वैतां श्रद्धया प्राणिनां  हितां।
आधयो व्याधयः सर्वे निवर्तन्ते ध्रुवं ध्रुवं ॥
translation: श्रद्धा के साथ इस कल्याणकारिणी गीता का पाठ करने से अथवा सुनने ही से प्राणिमात्र की आधि व्यघि छूट जाती है, यह निश्चय है

verse_text:
पठनात् पाठनाद भक्त्या श्रवणादपि सर्वथा।
रोगीरोगात्प्रमुक्तः सन् शान्तिमाप्नोति भक्तिमान् ॥
translation: भक्ति भाव से इसका पठन पाठन या श्रवण करने से  भक्ति मान् रोगी रोग से मुक्त होकर शान्तिलाभ करता है

verse_text:
आर्त्तो जिज्ञासुरर्थार्थी त्रय एते सदाशयाः ।
पठित्वा पाठयित्वेमां श्रुत्वा स्युः सफलाशयाः ॥
translation: आर्त्त, जिज्ञासु और अथार्थी  ये तीनों सदाशय इसको पढ़कर, पढ़ाकर, अथवा सुनकर सफलमनोरथ हो सकते हैं

verse_text:
ज्ञानी भक्तो ममैतस्याः श्रवणात्पठनादपि।
पाठनादपि मां द्रष्टुं सदैव भवति प्रभु: ॥
translation: ज्ञानी भक्त भी मेरी इस गीता का  श्रवण कर, पढ़कर अथवा  पढ़ाकर मुझको देखने समर्थ हो सकते हैं

verse_text:
पाठेनाऽस्था मन्त्रतश्च सूर्ययागे ह्यनुष्ठिते।
ज्वरादीनां हि सर्वेषां रोगाणां जायते यः ॥
translation: इस गीता के पाठ से और इस गीता के शब्दरूप मन्त्रों से सूर्ययाग का अनुष्ठान करने पर ज्वरादि सब रोगों का क्षय हो जाता है

verse_text:
इयं हि गीता रोगाणां मृतांजीवनी ध्रुवा।
अनाश्या अपि रोगा हि नश्यन्त्यस्याः प्रसादतः ॥
translation: यह गीता रोगों के लिये मृतसंजीवनी है, असाध्य रोग भी इस गीता के प्रसाद से नष्ट होते हैं।

verse_text:
अस्याः प्रसादतो बाह्या: नश्यन्ति व्याधयो यथा।
तथान्तवर्याधयो नूनं विराय यान्त्यलं लयम् ॥
translation: इसके प्रसाद से जैसे बहिर्व्याधियां नाश होती हैं, वैसे ही अंतर्व्यधियाँ भी निर्मूल हो जाती हैं

verse_text:
चतुर्भिराश्रमैर्वर्णैरस्याः पाठेन सर्वथा।
सन्ततं सर्वकल्याणं लभ्यते नाऽत्र संशयः ॥
translation: चारों आश्रम और चारों वर्ण इसके पाठ करने से निरन्तर समस्त कल्याण को प्राप्त करते हैं। यह निस्सन्देह है

verse_text:
उपासकेम्यो गीताया अस्या दानेन भक्तित:।
धर्मार्थकामा लभ्यन्ते निरायासं प्रदातृभिः ॥
translation: उपासकों को इस गीता के दान करने से दाता को निरायास धर्मार्थ और काम प्राप्त होते हैं

verse_text:
पठनाच्छवणादस्या मननात् पाठनादपि ।
मुमुक्षवो निरायासं लभन्ते मोक्षव्ययम ॥
translation: इस गीता के पठन श्रवण और मनन से और पाठन से भी मुमुक्षु निरायास अव्यय मोक्ष को प्राप्त करते हैं

verse_text:
त्रितापहारिणी सत्यमेषाऽभ्युदयकारिणी। 
निःश्रेयसकरी नूनं ब्र्वीहमसंशयम् ॥
translation: यह तीनों तापों को हरण करने वाली, इहलोक में अभ्युदयकारिणी और परलोक में निःश्रेयस पद प्रदान करने वाली है। यह जो मैं कहता हूँ, इसमें कुछ भी सन्देह नहीं है

verse_text:
यदुक्तं भवता देव ! भगवान् विश्वपालकः।
अपूर्वचिन्मयज्योतीरूपः पूर्ण प्रकाशितः ॥
translation: हे देव ! आपने जो कहा कि विश्वपालक,अपूर्व चिन्मय ज्योति रूप, पूर्ण प्रकाशमान श्रीभगवान् ने
english_translation: O Deva! What you have spoken about is the supreme being, the protector of the universe, uniquely conscious and fully radiant.
essence: The supreme being is uniquely conscious, radiant, and the protector of all.
simple_meaning: You spoke about the supreme being who protects the world and shines with a unique conscious light.
insight: It reminds you to recognize and respect the vastness and uniqueness of the divine presence around you.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
देवलोके हि देवानां भयं सत्यमनाशयत् ।
इच्छामस्तत्समाकर्ण्य वयमाप्तुं कृतार्थताम् ॥
translation: देवलोक में देवताओं को भय से मुक्त किया, यह सत्य है परन्तु हम उस वृतांत को सुनकर कृतार्थता को प्राप्त करना चाहते हैं।
english_translation: It is true that in the divine realm the radiant beings were freed from fear, but we desire to hear that and attain complete fulfillment.
essence: Hearing how radiant beings overcame fear inspires our desire for fulfillment.
simple_meaning: The divine beings in their realm are free from fear, and we want to hear about this to feel fulfilled.
insight: It invites you to listen deeply to truths that can free you from fear and bring fulfillment.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
मनोबुद्धिवचोऽतीतश्चिन्मयज्योतिरुज्ज्वलः।
परमः पुरुषः कोऽसावाविरासीत्कृपानिधिः ॥
translation: मन बुद्धि और वचन से अतीत, चिन्मय ज्योति, प्रकाशमान, कृपालु, परमपुरुष जो आविर्भूत हुए थे वे कौन थे
english_translation: Who is this supreme being, beyond mind, intellect, and speech, radiant with conscious light and full of compassion?
essence: A radiant, compassionate supreme being transcends mind, intellect, and speech.
simple_meaning: The verse wonders about a supreme being who is beyond mind, intellect, and speech, shining with conscious light and full of compassion.
insight: It invites shifting focus from surface thoughts to the radiant conscious source beyond all mental activity.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
देवानामुपदेशैः कैः स निराकृतवान्भयम् ।
कृपया श्रावयित्वा तद्धन्यानस्मान् कुरु प्रभो ! ॥
translation: और किन उपदेशों के द्वारा उन्होंने देवताओं के भय का निराकरण किया था, वह कृपया सुना कर हे प्रभो! हमलोगों को धन्य कीजिए
english_translation: By which teachings did he remove the gods' fear? Kindly tell us, Lord, and make us blessed.
essence: A request to learn which teaching removed fear and brought blessing.
simple_meaning: They ask the Lord to kindly explain which teachings removed the gods' fear and blessed them.
insight: It encourages seeking clarity from the divine to overcome fear and find strength.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
द्वन्द्वात्मकोऽस्ति सर्गोऽयं दिवा रात्र्या च सन्ततम् ।
प्रभया तमसा चाऽपि ज्ञानतोऽज्ञानतो यथा ॥
translation: जैसे दिन और रात, प्रकाश और अन्धकार, ज्ञान और अज्ञान आदि से यह संसार निरन्तर द्वन्द्वात्मक है
english_translation: This world continuously exists as pairs of opposites: day and night, light and darkness, knowledge and ignorance.
essence: Life continuously unfolds as a play of opposing forces in constant balance.
simple_meaning: The world you live in is always made of opposing pairs like day and night or knowledge and ignorance.
insight: Recognize that opposing forces are natural and necessary, helping you accept fluctuations without resistance.
modern_relevance: When you face conflicting emotions or decisions, remember that life naturally swings between opposites, making balance a constant challenge.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सुखदुःखादिभिः सम्यक् स्थूलसूक्ष्मात्मकं खलु ।
ब्रह्माण्डञ्च सदा व्याप्तमनुभूतञ्च भावुकैः ॥
translation: वैसे ही स्थूलसूक्ष्मात्मक और अनुभव करने वालों के द्वारा अनुभूत यह ब्रह्माण्ड सदा सुख दुःखादि से सम्यक् परिव्याप्त है
english_translation: The vast universe, both gross and subtle, is always pervaded completely by experiences of pleasure and pain.
essence: Every part of existence is always experienced through joy and suffering together.
simple_meaning: Everything in the universe, both visible and invisible, is always experienced through feelings of happiness and sadness.
insight: It teaches you to see pleasure and pain as part of the universal experience, not personal exceptions.
modern_relevance: When you notice your own ups and downs, remember that all life experiences these feelings constantly, not just you alone.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सामञ्जस्यं तथा  सृष्टेर्गत्या द्वन्द्वस्वरूपया।
समन्तात्सवर्वथा पातुं सुरा अप्यसुरा अपि ॥
translation: इस संसार का  स्वरूप द्वन्द्वमय होने के कारण सृष्टिकी समता को सब ओर और सब तरह से रक्षा करने के लिये देवता और असुर अति यत्न से
english_translation: Because the world is inherently full of dualities, both the deities and the shadow beings strive intensely to protect cosmic balance everywhere and in every way.
essence: Opposites work together to protect harmony throughout the world.
simple_meaning: The world is full of opposing forces, so both radiant and shadow beings work hard to keep harmony everywhere.
insight: It shifts the view from seeing conflict as purely negative to recognizing its role in sustaining overall balance.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
दैवे जगति लिप्सन्ते प्रभुत्वमतियत्नतः।
सुरासुरविरोधस्तत्सूक्ष्मे जगति सर्वदा ॥
translation: दैवजगत में अपने अपने प्रभुत्व को चाहते हैं इसी कारण सूक्ष्म जगत् में देवता और असुरो का सर्वदा विरोध रहता है
english_translation: In the divine world, each desires dominance, which causes the subtle realm to always have conflict between radiant beings and shadow beings.
essence: Hidden desire for control fuels constant subtle conflict between opposing forces.
simple_meaning: In the divine realm, everyone wants to be in control, so the subtle world always has a conflict between radiant and shadow beings.
insight: Recognize that hidden struggles for power shape the subtle dynamics around you.
modern_relevance: You feel tension when people around you compete quietly for influence, even when it’s not obvious.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
देवराज्ये यदा देवाः प्राधान्यं यान्ति सर्वथा ।
धर्मपूर्णत्वतः सृष्टेः सामञ्जस्यं तदाऽनघं ॥
translation: दैवराज्य में जब देवताओं का सर्वथा प्राधान्य हो जाता है तब धर्म की पूर्णता हो जाने से सृष्टि में निर्दोष सामञ्जस्य होता है
english_translation: When the divine beings completely dominate the divine realm, perfect dharma arises, bringing flawless harmony to creation.
essence: Complete dharma leadership creates perfect harmony throughout creation.
simple_meaning: When divine beings fully lead their realm, perfect dharma brings complete harmony to the world.
insight: It teaches that shared commitment to rightness creates natural harmony beyond force or control.
modern_relevance: Imagine a team where everyone follows shared values fully; the work flows effortlessly and harmony prevails.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
कालप्रभावान्जीवानां प्रारब्धाच समष्टितः।
शैथिल्यं देवसाम्राज्यं यदा प्राप्नोति सर्वथा ॥
translation: काल के प्रभाव से अथवा जीवों के समष्टि प्रारब्ध के कारण देवताओं का आधिपत्य जब पूर्णत: शिथिल हो जाता है
english_translation: When the divine beings' reign is completely weakened by the influence of time or the collective destiny of living beings.
essence: Even supreme reigns weaken completely under time and collective destiny.
simple_meaning: The power of the divine beings weakens completely due to the effects of time or the collective destiny of living beings.
insight: It teaches that all powers and states, no matter how exalted, are subject to change and decline over time.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
प्राधान्यममुराणान्तु वृद्धिमेति तदा ध्रुवम् ।
देवक्रियासु वैषम्यात्सृष्टौ नाना विपर्ययः ॥
translation: तब असुरों का प्राधान्य बढ जाता है यह निश्चित है और दैवक्रिया में वैषम्य हो जाने से सृष्टि में नाना विपर्याय होते हैं
english_translation: Then the dominance of shadow beings increases for sure, and imbalance in divine workings causes many distortions in creation.
essence: Growth of ego causes imbalance that distorts the entire creation.
simple_meaning: When beings of ego and shadow grow dominant, the divine processes become unbalanced, leading to many distortions in the world.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that inner imbalance affects everything you do and see around you.
modern_relevance: When selfishness and ego take over in your actions, your relationships and projects start to feel chaotic and out of control.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
क्षीणे तपसि देवानामसुरा यान्ति मुख्यताम् ।
तेषां तपःक्षये देवा लभन्ते प्रभुतां पुनः ॥
translation: देवताओं के तप का क्षय हो जाने पर असुर मुख्यता को प्राप्त होते हैं और असुरों के तप का क्षय हो जाने पर देवता पुनः प्रभुता को प्राप्त हो जाते हैं
english_translation: When the austerity of the radiant beings declines, the shadow beings gain supremacy; when the shadow beings' austerity declines, the radiant beings regain authority.
essence: Effort sustains power; when effort fades, opposing forces rise in dominance.
simple_meaning: When the radiant beings lose their disciplined effort, the shadow beings take over; when the shadow beings lose their power, the radiant beings regain control.
insight: It teaches that maintaining steady effort preserves positive influence; losing it invites opposing forces to gain control.
modern_relevance: In any group or system, when the focused effort of one side fades, opposing forces fill the gap—like teams losing momentum and others gaining ground.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
आधिदैवे सदा राज्य इत्थं यान्ति सुरासुराः।
प्रभुत्वं निससंग्रामरहस्यं हि तयोरिदम् ॥
translation: सदा ही इस प्रकार अधिदैवराज्य में देवता और असुर समय समय पर प्रभुता को प्राप्त होते रहते हैं यही देवता और असुरों के परस्पर के नित्य संग्राम का रहस्य है
english_translation: The gods and demons always attain sovereignty in the higher realm; this is the secret behind their eternal conflict.
essence: The constant power struggle of divine forces reflects a cycle in the higher realm.
simple_meaning: The divine beings and their opposites continuously gain power in the higher realm, which explains their endless conflict.
insight: Recognize that some conflicts are part of larger cycles beyond personal control or resolution.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सुराणाममुराणाञ्च सर्वदेवत्थमुत्कटः।
ब्रह्माण्डेऽपि च पिण्डेऽपि संग्रामो जायते महान् ॥
translation: सर्वदाही देवता और असुरों का इस प्रकार ब्रह्माण्ड में भी और पिण्ड में भी उत्कट महान् संग्राम होता है
english_translation: There is a fierce great battle between the radiant beings and the shadow beings in the universe and in every particle.
essence: Conflict between radiant and shadow beings pervades all scales of existence.
simple_meaning: The verse describes a fierce battle between radiant and shadow beings happening everywhere, in the cosmos and in the smallest parts.
insight: It highlights how struggle and opposition can be found everywhere, not just in visible places.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
बहून्येव निमित्तानि समाश्रिय प्रवर्त्तते ।
सुरासुरेषु संग्रामो नैमित्तिक इहाऽमितः ॥
translation: और बहुत से निमित्त कारणों का प्राश्रय लेकर इस संसार में देवता और असुरो का असाधारण नैमित्तिक संग्राम भी प्रवृत्त होता है।
english_translation: Many causes arise, leading to an extraordinary but temporary conflict between radiant beings and shadowy forces in this world.
essence: Many causes combine to start a special, temporary battle between radiant and shadowy forces.
simple_meaning: Many causes come together to start a special, temporary battle between radiant and shadowy beings in this world.
insight: Recognize that complex conflicts usually have many underlying reasons, not a single cause.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
पुरा यदा सुराः सर्वे भोगद्ध्या तपःक्षयम् ।
कुर्वन्तो बहुधा ह्यासन भीतभीताः प्रमादिनः ॥
translation: पूर्वकाल में जब ही देवता भोग के द्वारा तपःक्षम करते हुए अनेक प्रकार से अत्यन्त भयभीत और प्रमादी हो गये
english_translation: Long ago, the devas exhausted their spiritual power through indulgence, becoming fearful and negligent in many ways.
essence: Even the mighty lose strength when distracted by indulgence and fear.
simple_meaning: In the past, the devas lost their spiritual power by indulging in pleasures, which made them fearful and careless.
insight: It reminds you that losing focus on your inner discipline can weaken your confidence and lead to carelessness.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
प्राप्याऽवसरमुत्कृष्टमसुरा बलशालिनः।
राज्यविस्तृतये तीव्र यतमानाः सदाऽभवन् ॥
translation: तब अपने लिये इस उत्तम अवसर को प्राप्त कर बलशाली असुर सदा राज्यविस्तार के लिए तीव्र यत्न करने लगे
english_translation: Having gained this excellent opportunity, powerful Asuras always exerted intense efforts to expand their kingdom.
essence: Powerful beings use rare chances to fiercely pursue growth and expansion.
simple_meaning: Powerful Asuras seized a great chance and constantly worked hard to extend their kingdom.
insight: Recognize how seizing opportunities fuels intense focused effort toward expansion or change.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
सिद्धानां देवराज्यानामंशास्तु बहवोऽभवन् ।
क्रमशोऽधिकृताः सम्यगसुरैबृलशालिभिः ॥
translation: और बलशाली असुरों ने देवताओं की स्वाभाविक वासभूमि स्वर्गराज्य के बहुत से अंश सम्यक् प्रकार से क्रमशः अधिकार में कर लिये
english_translation: Many parts of the natural realm of the devas were gradually taken over by powerful asuras with great force.
essence: Powerful forces can gradually seize what rightly belongs to others.
simple_meaning: The powerful asuras gradually seized many parts of the devas' natural domain.
insight: It shows how unchecked force can disrupt natural order and rightful balance.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
नारदस्यैव देवर्षेस्तदा सदुपदेशतः ।
भयदुःखे निराकृस चक्रुस्तीत्र तपः सुराः ॥
translation: उस समय देवर्षि नारद के सदुपदेश देने पर भय और दुःख का परित्याग करके देवताओं ने तीव्र तपस्या की
english_translation: At that time, following the wise counsel of the divine sage Narada, the deities abandoned fear and sorrow and undertook intense austerity.
essence: Fear and sorrow disappear when wise guidance inspires dedicated practice.
simple_meaning: The divine beings stopped feeling fear and sorrow after receiving Narada's advice and began intense spiritual practice.
insight: It shows how wise counsel can dissolve emotional obstacles and inspire committed action.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
प्रसन्नस्तपसा तेषां तत्त्वातीतः परात्परः ।
चिन्मयस्सन् महाविष्णुराविरासीत्पुरुः स्वतः ॥
translation: उनकी तपस्या से प्रसन्न होकर तत्त्वातीत परात्पर श्री महाविष्णु भगवान् स्वयं चिन्मय रूप से उनके सम्मुख आविर्भूत हुए
english_translation: Pleased by their austerity, the supreme beyond all principles, great Vishnu, appeared before them in pure consciousness.
essence: Deep dedication brings forth the supreme presence beyond all concepts.
simple_meaning: Great Vishnu, pleased by their deep practice, appeared to them in a pure conscious form beyond all principles.
insight: It shows that deep commitment can reveal realities beyond ordinary understanding.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
चिन्मयोऽपि बभौ ज्योतिर्जितकोटिरविप्रभः ।
तेनाऽऽहतानि नेत्राणि तेषां संकोचमाप्नुवन् ॥
translation: वे यद्यपि चिन्मय है, परन्तु उस समय वह करोडों सूर्यो की प्रभा को जीतने वाली ज्योति से शोभायमान होने लगे और उस ज्योति से देवताओं के नेत्र अभिभूत होकर सङ्कचित हो गये
english_translation: Though made of pure consciousness, that light shone brighter than millions of suns, dazzling the gods' eyes and causing them to shrink back.
essence: Pure consciousness can shine with overwhelming brilliance that humbles even radiant beings.
simple_meaning: A being made of pure consciousness shone with a light brighter than millions of suns, so bright that the gods' eyes were overwhelmed and they recoiled.
insight: It shows that inner true nature can shine with a power that surprises even the highest beings, inspiring humility and awe.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
तज्ज्योतिः सूक्ष्मतां भेजे द्रुतमत्यन्तमद्भुतम् ।
चिव्याप्तं देवहृव्योम स्वत आकृष्टतां गतम् ॥
translation: और वह अत्यन्त अद्भुत ज्योति तत्काल सूक्ष्मत्व को प्राप्त हुई और चिन्मयत्व से व्याप्त देवताओं के हृदयाकाश का स्वतः आकर्षण हुआ
english_translation: That light swiftly attained extreme subtlety and, pervaded by pure consciousness, was naturally drawn to the heart-space of the devas.
essence: Pure subtle consciousness naturally draws itself toward radiant beings' heart-spaces.
simple_meaning: A divine light quickly became extremely subtle and filled with pure consciousness, naturally attracting the heart-space of radiant beings.
insight: It shows that deep refinement and inner clarity naturally attract higher states of awareness and connection.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
बाह्यबोधस्तदा देवाः शून्या आनन्दसागरे ।
सुखं निमज्जनं प्राप्ता मूच्छिता इव चाऽभवन् ॥
translation: उस समय देवता बहिर्ज्ञान शून्य होकर आनन्दसागर में सुखपूर्वक डूब गये और मूर्छितों के समान हो गये
english_translation: At that time, the radiant beings’ outer awareness vanished, and they blissfully immersed in the ocean of joy, becoming like those unconscious.
essence: Complete joy can dissolve outer awareness into peaceful absorption.
simple_meaning: The radiant beings lost their outer awareness and joyfully immersed themselves in bliss, appearing like unconscious beings.
insight: Shows how deep joy can quiet the mind to the point of losing external awareness.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
तदा सुराणां मुग्धानां विद्यारूपा शुभप्रदा ।
विष्णुप्रिया महामाया हृद्याविर्भावयाप ह ॥
translation: तब मुग्ध देवताओं के हृदयों में विद्यारूपा शुभदायिनी विष्णुप्रिया महामाया आविर्भूत हुईं
english_translation: Then, for the innocent devas, the auspicious great illusion, beloved of Vishnu and embodying knowledge, appeared in their hearts.
essence: A divine knowledge awakens within innocent hearts as a great auspicious power.
simple_meaning: A divine, auspicious power embodying knowledge appeared in the hearts of innocent devas.
insight: It shows how openness and purity of heart can allow profound wisdom to arise naturally.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
निवृत्तायामविद्यायां मूछायां तत्समागमात् ।
देवैरधिगता सर्वै:  सम्पूर्णा प्रकृतिस्थता ॥
translation: बहिर्ज्ञानशून्य अवस्था में विद्या के समागम द्वारा अविद्या के निवृत्त होने पर सब देवता पूर्ण प्रकृतिस्थ हुए
english_translation: When ignorance is removed through the arrival of true understanding in a withdrawn state, all radiant beings become fully established in the natural world.
essence: Clarity arising in quiet removes confusion, grounding all radiant beings in nature.
simple_meaning: When deep confusion ends through true understanding in a quiet state, all radiant beings become fully grounded in the natural world.
insight: It teaches you to withdraw from mental noise so true understanding can dissolve confusion.
modern_relevance: You’ve paused your busy mind and finally understood a complex problem. That clarity ends your confusion and grounds you in reality.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ततः स्वच्छहृदो देवा ददृशुः सम्मुखस्थितम्।
कमप्यदृष्टपूर्वं हि पुरुषं परमाद्भुतम् ॥
translation: तदनन्तर स्वच्छहृदय देवताओं ने सम्मुख स्थित अदृष्टपूर्व परम अद्भुत किसी पुरुष को देखा
english_translation: Then the gods with pure hearts saw before them a supreme being unlike any seen before.
essence: Pure-hearted beings recognize a supreme presence never seen before.
simple_meaning: Pure-hearted gods saw a supreme and wondrous being they had never seen before.
insight: Recognize moments when something truly extraordinary appears, shifting your perspective beyond the familiar.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
सर्वसौन्दर्यशोभाढयं शान्तज्योतिःसमुज्ज्वलम् ।
विस्मयानन्दसन्दोहप्रद दृष्टिमनोहरम् ॥
translation: वह पुरुष सर्वसौन्दर्य की शोभा से पूर्ण हैं, शान्त ज्योति से प्रकाशमान हैं, अनेक विस्मय और अनेक आनन्द को देने वाले और देखने में मनो हर हैं
english_translation: That being is full of all beauty, radiant with peaceful light, bestowing wonder and joy, and enchanting to behold.
essence: The divine shines with peaceful beauty that fills the heart with wonder and joy.
simple_meaning: The divine being shines with peaceful light, is full of beauty, and inspires wonder and joy when seen.
insight: Seeing the divine as radiant and soothing can deepen your feeling of connection and reverence.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
शङ्खचक्रगदापद्मसुशोभितचतुर्भुजम् ।
भक्तेभ्यस्तु चतुर्वर्ग प्रेम्णा दातुमिवाऽऽगतम् ॥
translation: जिनके चारों हाथ शङ्ख चक्र गदा और पद्म से सुशोभित है, मानों भक्तो को प्रेमपूर्वक चतुर्वर्ग (धर्म अर्थ काम मोक्ष) देने को आये हैं
english_translation: The one whose four hands are adorned with conch, discus, mace, and lotus appears to come to lovingly grant devotees the fourfold aims of life.
essence: The divine lovingly offers all four aims of life to devoted seekers.
simple_meaning: The divine being with four symbolic arms comes lovingly to grant devotees the four aims: duty, prosperity, desire, and freedom.
insight: It shows you how devotion connects you to a source that lovingly supports your complete life journey.
modern_relevance: You might feel overwhelmed by life's demands, but this reminds you that love supports you in balancing all your goals—purpose, success, passion, and freedom.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
दिव्यश्यामाकृति कान्तं कौस्तुभेन विभूषितम् ।
अनन्तरूपेऽनन्ताख्ये पर्यङ्के शायिनं विभुम् ॥
translation: दिव्य श्याम जिनका वर्ण है, अनन्त रूप धारी अनन्त जिनका पर्याङ्क है, कौस्तुभमणि से विभूषित हैं
english_translation: The divine one has a dark blue form, adorned with the Kaustubha gem, infinite in form and infinite in name, reclining on the infinite serpent.
essence: The divine is infinite, beautiful, and eternally supported beyond all limits.
simple_meaning: The divine being Vishnu is described as having a dark blue form, adorned with the Kaustubha gem, infinite in form and reclining on the infinite serpent.
insight: It invites you to imagine the divine as boundless and majestic, beyond human scale or limits.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
कोटिमूर्यग्रहज्योतिःसेवितोज्ज्वलविग्रहम् ।
वनमालालसद्गात्रं विभ्रतकेयूरकुण्डलम् ॥
translation: कोटि सूर्य-ग्रहों की ज्योति से सेवित प्रकाशमान शरीर वाले हैं, केयूर, और कुण्डल को धारण करने वाले हैं, वनमाला से विभूषित हैं
english_translation: He has a radiant form illuminated by the light of millions of suns and planets, adorned with armlets, earrings, and a garland of forest flowers.
essence: A radiant figure shines with the light of countless suns, adorned with nature’s ornaments.
simple_meaning: The description shows a brilliant, radiant figure adorned with shining ornaments and a garland of forest flowers.
insight: This verse invites you to see beyond ordinary appearances and appreciate brilliance that inspires awe.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
नखात्मकनिरकेन्दुकौमुदीद्योतितं श्रिया।
सेवितं पुण्डरीकाक्षं स्मितशोभिमुखाम्बुजम् ॥
translation: उनके नख मानों निष्कलङ्क चन्द्र हैं उनकी कौमुदी से वह शोभायमान हैं, लक्ष्मी के द्वारा सुसेवित हैं, कमलनेत्र है, मन्दहास्य से मुखकमल जिनका शोभायमान है
english_translation: Their nails are spotless moonlight, shining like the moon's glow; served by Lakshmi, with lotus-like eyes and a smiling lotus-like face.
essence: Radiant purity and grace characterize the divine form served by prosperity.
simple_meaning: The verse describes Vishnu's radiant and beautiful appearance, illuminated like the pure moonlight and served by the divine Lakshmi.
insight: Acknowledge the presence of radiance and grace in the world as reflections of higher qualities.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
स्थानं निःशेषशोभानां सौन्दर्यनिकराकरम्।
भगवन्तं रमानाथं प्रसन्नं पुण्यदर्शनम् ॥
translation: अखिल शोभा के स्थान हैं, सब प्रकार के सौन्दर्य के आकर भगवान् रमानाथ प्रसन्न और पुण्य दर्शन हैं
english_translation: The divine Ramānātha is the abode of all splendors, the embodiment of every beauty, ever serene and the vision of virtue.
essence: The divine presence is the calm, perfect home of all beauty and virtue.
simple_meaning: The divine Ramānātha is the home of every kind of beauty and splendor, always calm and the sight of virtue.
insight: It invites you to remember that divine calm and true beauty are always accessible beyond worldly distractions.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by chaos or ugliness, remembering a calm and beautiful presence can center your heart and mind.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
दिव्यदृष्टयाऽथ ते देवा दृष्ट्वा विस्मितचेतसः।
अपूर्वदर्शनं देवमाविभूतं प्रतुष्टुवुः ॥
translation: अनन्तर देवगण अपूर्व जिनका दर्शन है ऐसे आविर्भूत देवादि देव के दिव्य दृष्टि के द्वारा दर्शन करके विस्मित चित्त होकर स्तुति करने लगे
english_translation: Then the divine beings, amazed in mind, saw the unprecedented vision of the manifest divine and praised it.
essence: Profound visions of the divine inspire amazement and heartfelt praise.
simple_meaning: The divine beings saw a new, amazing vision of the divine and responded with amazement and praise.
insight: It highlights how encountering profound truths naturally invites awe and appreciation.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
देवादिदेव ! हे नाथ ! विश्वेश्वर ! जगत्पते ।
सच्चिदानन्दरूपस्त्वमपरिच्छेदतो विभुः ॥
translation: हे देवादिदेव ! हे नाथ ! हे विश्वेश्वर ! हे जगत्पते ! आप सच्चिदानन्दरूप, व्यवधानरहित, विभु अर्थात् व्यापक,
english_translation: O lord of lords, master of the universe, you are the form of truth, consciousness, and bliss, vast and without division.
essence: The supreme being is infinite, indivisible truth, consciousness, and bliss.
simple_meaning: You are the all-encompassing divine being, embodying truth, consciousness, and bliss without any division or limitation.
insight: It invites you to see the divine as an infinite, undivided presence beyond ordinary distinctions.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
एक एवाऽद्वितीयोऽसि विश्वात्मा विश्वपालकः।
अनादिश्चाऽप्यनन्तोऽसि विश्वसेव्य ! नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
translation: अद्वितीय, एक, विश्वात्मा,विश्वपालक, अनादि और अनन्त हैं, हे विश्वसेव्य! आपको प्रणाम है
english_translation: You are the one without a second, the universal self, the protector of all, without beginning and endless, O servant of the universe! I bow to you.
essence: One infinite presence protects and pervades all without beginning or end.
simple_meaning: There is only one true self who is universal, eternal, and the protector of everything. This being has no beginning and no end.
insight: This verse invites you to see beyond separation and realize an unbroken, timeless support beneath all appearances.
modern_relevance: When you feel isolated or overwhelmed, remembering that an infinite presence supports all can bring comfort and belonging.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
त्वमेवासि प्रभो ! कार्य त्वमेव कारणं सदा ।
कार्यकारणरूपस्त्वं सर्वात्मक ! नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
translation: हे प्रभो ! सदा आप ही कार्य और आप ही कारण हैं, आप कार्य कारण रूप हैं, हे सर्वात्मक ! आपको प्रणाम है
english_translation: O Lord! You alone are always the action and the cause; you are the form of both action and cause, O all-pervading one! I bow to you.
essence: The true self is always both the cause and the action in all things.
simple_meaning: You alone are the cause behind everything that happens and the action itself, always present everywhere.
insight: Recognize that the true self is both the origin and the force behind all actions, dissolving separation.
modern_relevance: When you feel powerless, remember that the source of every action and its unfolding is present within and around you.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
भवानेव जगन्नूनं जगदेव भवान् विभो !।
भवत्येव जगद् भाति जगद्रूप ! नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
translation: हे विभो! आप अवश्य ही जगत् हैं और जगत् ही आप हैं एवं आपमें ही जगत भासमान होता है, हे जगद्रूप! आपको प्रणाम है
english_translation: O Vibo! You alone are the entire universe, and the universe is you; in you alone the universe shines. Salutations to you, the form of the universe!
essence: The divine and the universe are one, inseparably shining together.
simple_meaning: The divine being is the whole universe and the universe exists and radiates through that being.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing the universe as separate to recognizing all as one manifestation of the divine.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
जगदभूयो भवत्येव वर्तते किन्तु तत्त्वतः।
न वर्त्तते भवाँस्तत्र विश्वाधार ! नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
translation: पुनः आपमें ही जगत् स्थित है परन्तु तत्त्वतः आप उसमें नहीं हैं, हे विश्वाधार ! आपको प्रणाम है
english_translation: The world appears to exist in you, but in truth, you do not exist in it, O Supporter of the Universe! I bow to you.
essence: You can contain the world yet remain beyond it at the same time.
simple_meaning: Everything that exists appears within you, but you are not truly contained by the world.
insight: It shifts your view from being defined by external life to recognizing your independent, unbounded essence.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by tasks and worries, remember that your true self is untouched by external chaos and pressures.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
तवैव प्रकृतिस्त्वत्तोऽव्यक्ताऽपि व्यक्तिमागता।
बुद्ध्यहङ्कारतन्मात्राभूतेन्द्रियतया सदा ॥
translation: आप ही की अव्यक्ता प्रकृति भी व्यक्ता होकर बुद्धि अहङ्कार तन्मात्रा पञ्चभूत और इन्द्रियरूप से सदा
english_translation: Your unmanifest nature also becomes manifest as intellect, ego, subtle elements, the five elements, and senses always.
essence: The mind, ego, and senses emerge from your unseen natural essence.
simple_meaning: Your unseen natural essence becomes the mind, ego, subtle energies, physical elements, and senses you experience.
insight: Recognize that your mind and ego are expressions of a deeper natural source, helping you detach from identifying completely with them.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by your thoughts or emotions, remember they arise from a deeper, unseen part of you beyond the noise.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
स्थूलसूक्ष्मात्मकं विश्वमुत्पादयति सर्वथा ।
मूलशून्य ! जगन्मूलमूलभूत ! नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
translation: स्थूल सूक्ष्मात्मक विश्व को सर्वथा उत्पन्न करती है, हे प्रभो! आप जगत् की मूल जो प्रकृति उसके भी मूल हो और स्वयं मूलशून्य हो, आप को प्रणाम है
english_translation: You create the gross and subtle worlds completely; you are the root of the world's root, fundamentally empty; salutations to you.
essence: The origin of all worlds is an empty root that creates everything fully.
simple_meaning: Everything visible and invisible arises fully from you, who are the fundamental root beyond all things and empty in essence.
insight: It shifts the mind from seeing complexity as separate to recognizing a single empty root behind all forms.
modern_relevance: When feeling overwhelmed by complexity, remember that the source of all things is simple emptiness, not chaos or confusion.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
कोषेणाऽनमयेन त्वं स्थूलविश्वमयो भवन्।
जीवान् विमोहयस्येव मोहहेतो ! नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
translation: अन्नमयकोष से आप स्थूल विश्वमय होते हुए जीवों को मोहित करते हैं, हे मोह हेतो ! आपको प्रणाम है
english_translation: You become the gross physical world through the sheath of food and thus delude living beings; salutations to you, cause of delusion.
essence: The physical body veil causes confusion that hides the true nature of living beings.
simple_meaning: You take the form of the physical world through the food sheath, causing living beings to be confused and deluded.
insight: It teaches you to distinguish between the physical body and the deeper true self behind it.
modern_relevance: When you identify fully with your body and needs, it’s easy to lose sight of who you truly are beneath.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
स्थूलो वै मृत्युलोकोऽस्ति सूक्ष्मो लोकोऽस्ति वैबुधः।
भवान् प्राणमयः कोषो भूत्वा स्थापयति स्वतः ॥
translation: स्थूल मृत्युलोक और सूक्ष्म दैवलोक इन दोनों लोकों में आप प्राणमयकोष होकर स्वतः स्थापन करते हैं
english_translation: There is a gross mortal world and a subtle divine world; you establish yourself naturally as the vital sheath in both.
essence: You naturally exist as the vital life force connecting both gross and subtle worlds.
simple_meaning: You naturally exist as the vital life force connecting the physical mortal world and the subtle divine world.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing yourself only as a physical body to recognizing your subtle life force bridging two realities.
modern_relevance: You feel split between your daily physical struggles and your inner spiritual longings, yet your true being is the vital life force connecting both.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
परस्परं सुसम्बन्धमनयोर्लोकयोः सतोः।
सम्बन्धस्थापनाकम्मदक्षताभाक् ! नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
translation: इन दोनों लोकों परस्पर सम्बन्ध हे सम्बन्ध स्थापन के कर्म में परम दक्ष ! आपको प्रणाम है
english_translation: You are supremely skilled in the action that establishes connections between these two worlds; I bow to you.
essence: Skillful action creates and sustains vital connections between separate worlds.
simple_meaning: You have great skill in performing actions that create and maintain connections between different realms or worlds.
insight: It teaches you to see your actions as powerful bridges that connect beyond what is immediately visible.
modern_relevance: When you build bridges between different people or ideas, your skill creates unity where there was separation.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
मनोमयेन कोषेणाविद्यायाः परमादभुतम्।
विज्ञानमयकोषेण विद्यायाश्च निकेतनम् ॥
translation: मनो-मय कोष से परम अद्भुत अविद्या निकेतन को बना कर और विज्ञानमय कोष से विद्या के निकेतन को
english_translation: The supreme wonder of ignorance arises from the mind-filled sheath, while the abode of knowledge is formed by the intellect-filled sheath.
essence: Confusion lives in the restless mind; true knowledge dwells in the clear intellect.
simple_meaning: Ignorance arises from the restless mind, while true knowledge lives in the discerning intellect within you.
insight: It teaches you to notice whether your mind is clouded by restless thoughts or led by clear discrimination.
modern_relevance: When your thoughts overwhelm you, confusion grows; but when your clear thinking guides you, understanding blossoms.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सृष्टवाऽऽनन्दमये कोषे निसानन्दो विराजसे।
सृष्टिशोभादिनैपुण्यकुलगेह ! नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
translation: बनाकर आनन्दमयकोष में आप नित्यानन्दरूप से विराजमान रहते हैं, आप सृष्टि की शोभादि के नैपुण्य में मुख्याधिष्ठाता हैं, आपको प्रणाम है
english_translation: Having created the blissful sheath, you reside eternally as pure bliss, the chief guide of creation's excellence; I bow to you.
essence: The divine dwells eternally as bliss, guiding the excellence of creation.
simple_meaning: You dwell eternally as bliss within the blissful sheath and oversee the excellence of creation. I honor you.
insight: It invites seeing the source of all creation as a presence of joy and mastery beyond appearances.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
वैचित्र्यं भवतोऽपूर्व भवान् सन् हि भवानसन्।
सदसद्भ्यामतीतोऽपि भवान् भाति नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
translation: आपका अपूर्व वैचित्र्य है, आप सत् भी हैं और असत् भी हैं एवं आप सत् असत् से अतीत भी प्रतीत होते हैं, आपको प्रणाम है
english_translation: Your uniqueness is unprecedented; you are both real and unreal, and appear beyond reality and unreality. I bow to you.
essence: True uniqueness transcends the boundaries of real and unreal existence.
simple_meaning: You are unlike anything else, existing beyond simple categories of real and unreal. Your presence goes beyond ordinary understanding.
insight: It invites you to hold space for mystery and uniqueness beyond fixed concepts of reality.
modern_relevance: You meet someone whose character or presence feels impossible to define—beyond any label or category you know.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
तवैवार्द्धाङ्गिनी शक्तिस्तुरीया विश्वमोहिनी ।
कारणस्थूलसूक्ष्मत्वमधिगस निरन्तरम् ॥
translation: आपकी ही अर्धाङ्गिनी विश्वमोहिनी तुरीया शक्ति कारण सूक्ष्म और स्थूलरूप को प्राप्त होकर अनेक प्रकार से
english_translation: Your half-consort is the supreme power, the threefold energy that continuously manifests the universe in both subtle and gross forms.
essence: The divine threefold energy continuously manifests all subtle and gross forms of existence.
simple_meaning: The divine energy, described as your half-consort, is the continuous force that creates and sustains all subtle and gross aspects of the universe.
insight: It reveals the cosmic energy behind all appearances, inviting a deeper sense of connection with the universe's unfolding.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
ब्रह्माण्डं बहुधाऽनन्तं प्रसूते पाति च स्वतः।
विचित्रशक्ते ! शक्तीश ! निसशक्त ! नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
translation: अनन्त ब्रह्माण्डो को निरन्तर उत्पन्न करती हैं और रक्षा करती हैं, हे विचित्रशक्ति ! हे शक्तीश! हे नित्यशक्त ! आपको प्रणाम है।
english_translation: The infinite cosmos continuously arises and is sustained by you, O wondrous power! O energy! O eternal strength! I bow to you.
essence: A wondrous force continuously creates and sustains the infinite cosmos.
simple_meaning: The infinite universe keeps coming into being and is maintained by a mysterious, powerful energy to whom respect is given.
insight: It invites seeing the universe as alive and supported by a constant, dynamic power beyond ordinary perception.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
भवानेव महाविष्णुस्त्वत्तोऽसंख्या निरन्तरम् ।
ब्रह्माणो विष्णवो रुद्रा आविर्भाव परं गताः ॥
translation: आप ही महाविष्णु हैं आपसे असंख्य ब्रह्मा विष्णु और रुद्र निरन्तर आविर्भाव को प्राप्त होकर
english_translation: You alone are the great Vishnu; from you countless Brahmas, Vishnus, and Rudras continuously emerge.
essence: Countless divine manifestations continuously emerge from the one supreme Vishnu.
simple_meaning: The supreme being Vishnu is the source from whom countless creators, preservers, and transformers arise continuously.
insight: It shifts focus from separate divine forms to their shared origin, encouraging seeing unity beneath diversity.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
स्वस्वब्रह्माण्डसवानां सृष्टिस्थितिलयानलम् ।
सम्पादयन्ति नियतं सर्वधातर्नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
translation: अपने अपने ब्रह्माण्डसंघों के सृष्टि स्थिति और प्रलयों को नियतरूप से सम्पादन करते हैं, हे सर्वधातः! आपको प्रणाम है
english_translation: The lords of their own universes constantly perform creation, preservation, and dissolution; salutations to you, all elemental beings.
essence: Cosmic lords continuously manage creation, preservation, and dissolution in their realms.
simple_meaning: Different cosmic lords regularly carry out cycles of creation, preservation, and destruction, and all elemental beings are honored.
insight: Recognize the ongoing natural cycles beyond individual control that sustain the universe’s flow.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
जड़े सच्चेन चित्त्वेन चेतने तु द्वयोस्तयोः।
आनन्दत्वेन भासि त्वं सच्चिदानन्द ! ते नमः ॥
translation: जड़ में सत्सत्तारूप से और चेतन में चित्सत्तारूप से और सत् चित् इन दोनों में आनन्द सत्ता रूप से आप भासमान होते हैं, हे सञ्चिदानन्द ! आपको प्रणाम है
english_translation: In the inanimate, you appear as the essence of existence; in the conscious, as the essence of awareness; and in both existence and awareness, you shine as the essence of bliss, O Satchidananda! Salutations to you.
essence: Your true self shines as existence, awareness, and bliss everywhere in all things.
simple_meaning: You are the presence behind all things: in the lifeless as pure being, in the conscious as awareness, and in both combined as bliss.
insight: This verse invites you to recognize your identity beyond separation—as the underlying reality of being, knowing, and happiness.
modern_relevance: When you pause to notice, you realize your true self is not just your thoughts or body but the deep presence shining as life, awareness, and joy everywhere.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
विष्णोः सूर्य्यस्य शक्तेश्च गणेशस्य शिवस्य च।
रूपेण सगुणं रम्यं गृहीत्वा मूर्तिपञ्चकम् ॥
translation: हे देव ! विष्णु सूर्य शक्ति गणेश और शिवके स्वरूप से मङ्गलकर सगुण पञ्चमूर्ति को ग्रहण करके
english_translation: O divine one, embracing the five beautiful manifested forms of Vishnu, Surya, Shakti, Ganesha, and Shiva.
essence: The divine embraces many beautiful forms together as one.
simple_meaning: The verse describes taking up five beautiful forms representing Vishnu, Surya, Shakti, Ganesha, and Shiva together.
insight: It shows that the divine can encompass many forms, highlighting unity in diversity.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
भवानेकोऽद्वितीयः सन्नुपास्तिपदवीं हिताम् ।
करोति सुगमा देव ! भक्तिहतो ! नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
translation: आप एक और अद्वितीय होने पर भी हितकारक उपासना की शैली को सुगम करते हैं, हे भक्तिहेतो ! आपको प्रणाम है
english_translation: Even as the unique supreme being, you make the path of beneficial worship easy, O devoted one! I bow to you.
essence: The unique supreme being makes beneficial devotion easy and approachable.
simple_meaning: You are uniquely supreme yet you make worship that benefits others easy and accessible.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing devotion as difficult to seeing it as a simple, heartfelt connection.
modern_relevance: When spiritual practices feel too complex or distant, this reminds you that true devotion is accessible and welcoming.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सर्वेश्वर ! भवानव स्वयं यज्ञेशरूपतः ।
मोक्षदां कर्मकाण्डीयां गति पासि नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
translation: हे सर्वेश्वर ! आप स्वयं ही यज्ञेश्वर रूप से मोक्षदायिनी कर्म काण्डीय गति की रक्षा करते हैं आपको प्रणाम है
english_translation: O Lord of all, you yourself, in the form of the lord of sacrifice, protect the path of liberation through ritual actions; I bow to you.
essence: The supreme protector guards the path of liberation through sacred actions.
simple_meaning: The verse praises the divine as the protector of the path to liberation through rituals, offering respectful obeisance.
insight: It highlights trusting a greater guiding force that supports disciplined practice as a way to freedom.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
त्वं चिद्गावमयो विष्णुः सद्भावात्ममयः शिवः ।
तेजोभावमयः मूर्यो गणेशो ज्ञानितामयः ॥
translation: आप चिद्भावमय विष्णु सद्भावमय शिव, तेजोभावमय सूर्य, ज्ञान भावमय गणेश और
english_translation: You are the conscious essence like Vishnu, the embodiment of goodness like Shiva, radiant like the Sun, and the embodiment of wisdom like Ganesha.
essence: Your true self embodies consciousness, goodness, radiance, and wisdom together.
simple_meaning: You embody the essence of consciousness, goodness, radiance, and wisdom represented by Vishnu, Shiva, the Sun, and Ganesha respectively.
insight: It teaches you to recognize your inner being as a blend of conscious awareness, goodness, energy, and wisdom.
modern_relevance: You may feel fragmented, but recognizing your inner qualities as unified can bring strength and clarity.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
शक्तिभावमयी देवी भूत्वाऽभ्याऽन्याऽधिकारिणः ।
बोधयत्यात्मबोधं सगुणोपास्तौ नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
translation: शक्तिभावमयी देवी होकर अन्यान्य अधिकारियों को सगुणोपासना में आत्मज्ञान का उपदेश देते हैं, आपको प्रणाम है।
english_translation: Becoming the embodiment of power, the goddess teaches self-knowledge to other authorities in qualified worship; salutations to you.
essence: Powerful leadership teaches self-awareness through devoted practice.
simple_meaning: A powerful goddess teaches self-knowledge through worship to other leaders, and she is respectfully honored.
insight: It shows that true authority grows by guiding others toward understanding beyond mere power.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
हे सर्वशक्तिमन् ! शक्त ! हे सर्वात्मन् ! कृपानिधे ।
तवैव शक्तितो नूनं भवामश्चालिता वयम् ॥
translation: हे सर्वशक्तिमन् ! हे शक्त ! हे सर्वात्मन् ! हे कृपानिधे! आपकी ही शक्ति से हम सब देवतागण चालित होते हैं यह निश्चय है।
english_translation: O all-powerful one! O source of strength! O all-pervading one! O ocean of compassion! It is certain that by your power alone we beings are moved and active.
essence: All action and movement arise solely through the power of the compassionate, all-pervading divine.
simple_meaning: We move and act only because of the power of the divine, who is compassionate and all-pervading.
insight: It shifts the mind from self-reliance to grateful acknowledgment of the greater power energizing all action.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed or stuck, remembering that your strength comes from a greater source can relieve pressure and renew motivation.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
तवैव सत्तया देव ! सत्तावन्तो वयं तव ।
आश्रिता आपि मूढास्त्वां विस्मरामो हि मायया ॥
translation: आप की ही सत्ता से हे देव ! हम सत्तावान् हैं, आपके आश्रित होने पर भी हम मूढ़ माया के द्वारा आपको भूल जाते हैं
english_translation: By your power alone, O divine! We exist, yet even as your dependents, we foolishly forget you due to illusion.
essence: You exist because of the divine, yet illusion causes you to forget this truth.
simple_meaning: Your existence depends entirely on the divine, yet even as your dependents, we foolishly forget you because of illusion.
insight: Recognizing illusion’s power to disconnect you helps you return to trust and presence with the divine.
modern_relevance: You rely on support and connection daily, yet distractions and confusion often make you forget that foundation.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
त्वाद्विस्मृतिमतां मोहमस्माकं हरसि प्रभो!।
विपच्छासनतो नूनमहो ते महती दया ॥
translation: हे प्रभो! आपको भूलने वाले हम लोगों को मोह को आप विपत्ति रूप शासन के द्वारा अवश्य हरण करते हैं, अहो ! आपकी महती दया है
english_translation: O Lord! You remove the delusion of those who forget you by governing calamity; your compassion is immense.
essence: Life’s hardships are compassionate acts that remove confusion from those who forget the divine.
simple_meaning: When we forget the divine, life’s hardships help remove our confusion through divine compassion.
insight: It teaches you to see hardships as compassionate guidance clearing confusion, not just random suffering.
modern_relevance: You face unexpected setbacks that shake your certainty, but these moments gently guide you back to deeper understanding and care.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
वयं शरणमापन्नाः शरणागतवत्सल !।
भयं नो मोहजं येन विनश्यति तथा कुरु ॥
translation: हे शरणागतवत्सल ! हम आपके शरण आये हैं जिससे हमारा मोहजनित भय नाश हो जाय ऐसा आप करें
english_translation: O protector of those who seek refuge, we have come to you so that the fear born of delusion may be destroyed; please make it so.
essence: Seeking refuge opens the way for fears born of confusion to be gently removed.
simple_meaning: You come seeking protection so that the fear caused by confusion and false beliefs can be removed.
insight: It invites you to trust a source beyond your own confusion and fears, allowing those fears to diminish through that trust.
modern_relevance: You’ve been carrying worries that twist your mind. When you find a safe space or person to turn to, those fears begin to lose their grip.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
तथोपदेशं याचामो ज्ञातुं स्म ञ्च तत्त्वतः ।
त्वां शताः स्मो यथा मोहे न पतामः पुनः क्वचित् ॥
translation: ऐसे उपदेश की हम आपसे याचना करते हैं जिससे हम आपको तत्त्वरूप से जानने को और स्मरण करने को समर्थ हो सकें और पुनः कभी मोह में नहीं पड़ें
english_translation: We earnestly seek your teaching that helps us truly know and remember you, so we never fall into delusion again.
essence: True teaching frees you from confusion by enabling lasting knowledge and remembrance.
simple_meaning: We ask for a teaching that helps us truly understand and remember the divine so we never get lost in confusion again.
insight: It teaches you to seek knowledge that sticks and protects against repeated confusion.
modern_relevance: You long for guidance that helps you understand something deeply and never forget it, so confusion no longer clouds your mind.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
विश्वासो नो ध्रुवो जातो यत्त्वां संस्मरतां सदा ।
अस्माकं निखिला भीतिस्तापोऽभावश्च नक्ष्यति ॥
translation: हम लोगों को ठीक विश्वास हो गया है कि आपको सदा स्मरण करने से हमारे सब भय, त्रिविध ताप और अभाव नाश हो जायेंगे
english_translation: We have firm trust that always remembering you will destroy all our fears, triple sufferings, and lacks.
essence: Steady trust in the divine through constant remembrance removes all fears and lacks.
simple_meaning: You develop a strong trust that always remembering the divine will remove all your fears, sufferings, and deficiencies.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate unwavering faith through steady remembrance, which dissolves fear and suffering over time.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by worries and challenges, simply holding trust in a steady caring presence can ease your inner struggles and bring comfort.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
त्वां सदा स्मरतां नूनमुद्यमो नः फलिष्यति।
सर्वे मनोरथाः सिद्धा भविष्यन्ति नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
translation: आपको सदा स्मरण करनेसे निश्चय ही हमारा पुरुषार्थ सफल होगा और हमारे सभी मनोरथ सिद्ध होंगे, आपको प्रणाम है
english_translation: By always remembering you, our efforts will surely succeed, and all our desires will be fulfilled; salutations to you.
essence: Constant remembrance of the divine guarantees that your efforts will succeed and wishes fulfill.
simple_meaning: If you always keep the divine in your thoughts, your efforts will succeed and your wishes will come true.
insight: It teaches you to anchor your actions in steady remembrance, transforming effort into assured success.
modern_relevance: You face a tough project but find strength by recalling what grounds you; this steadies your effort and opens possibilities.
speaker: Devotee (Unknown)

verse_text:
युष्माकं स्तुतिभिर्देवाः ! प्रसन्नोऽस्मि ततस्त्वहम् ।
श्रेयसे वो यथायोग्यं ब्रवीमि वचनं शुभम् ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! मैं तुम्हारी स्तुति से प्रसन्न हुआ इस कारण तुम्हारे कल्याण के लिये मैं यथायोग्य शुभ वचन कहता हूँ
english_translation: O radiant beings, I am pleased by your praise; therefore, I speak auspicious words for your well-being.
essence: Praise opens the way for blessings and well-being.
simple_meaning: The divine being feels pleased by your praise and responds by sharing appropriate blessings for your good.
insight: It shows how acknowledging appreciation can open a heart to respond with care and positivity.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सदाचारच्युता यूयं भवथ स्म दिवौकसः।
स्वकर्तव्यं स्वधर्मश्च भवन्तो व्यहमरच्छुभम् ॥
translation: तुम लोग सदाचारभ्रष्ट हो गये हो इस कारण तुम मंगलमय निज कर्त्तव्य और स्वधर्मा को भूल गये हो
english_translation: You have fallen from righteous conduct and therefore forgotten your own duty and true purpose.
essence: Losing sight of your duty means losing your way in life.
simple_meaning: You have abandoned good conduct and forgotten your own duty and life purpose.
insight: It shifts your focus from external chaos back to your personal responsibility and authentic purpose.
modern_relevance: You’ve been so caught up in distractions that your core responsibilities and values have slipped from view.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अत एव समाक्रामच्चित्तं वो मोहज भयम् ।
त्तापोऽयोग्यप्र्वार्त्युत्थोऽभावो मत्स्मृतिनाशत: ॥
translation: इसी से तुम्हारे चित्त पर मोह जनित भय, अयोग्य- प्रवृत्ति जनित ताप और मेरे विस्मरण जनित अभाव, इन सभी ने अधिकार कर लिया है
english_translation: Because of this, your mind is overwhelmed by delusion-born fear, pain from unworthy actions, and absence caused by forgetting me.
essence: Fear and pain arise when you forget your true self and act from confusion.
simple_meaning: Your mind is overwhelmed by fear caused by confusion, pain from unworthy actions, and emptiness from forgetting your true self.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that fear and pain arise from losing touch with your true nature and acting out of confusion.
modern_relevance: You’ve felt trapped by anxiety and regret after acting against your values, while feeling disconnected from your deeper source of strength.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यूयामाचारश्चेत्स्वककर्तव्यपरायणा: ।
स्वधर्मनिरताश्चाऽपि भवितुं खलु शक्ष्यथ ॥
translation: यदि तुम आचारवान् होने से कर्तव्य परायण, स्वधर्मनिरत और मद्गतचित्त हो सकोगे
english_translation: If you become disciplined, devoted to your duty, absorbed in your own dharma, then you will surely succeed.
essence: Dedication and discipline in your own duty are the surest paths to success.
simple_meaning: When you live with discipline, focus on your responsibilities, and stay true to your purpose, success follows.
insight: It teaches you to anchor your energy in consistent discipline and devotion to your chosen role, fostering progress.
modern_relevance: You wake up and follow your daily routine with quiet focus, knowing this steady path moves you towards your goals.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
माञ्चित्ताश्चेत्तदा यूयं भयात्तापादभावतः ।
विमुक्ताः सर्वकल्याणं लप्स्यध्वे मत्प्रसादतः ॥
translation: तभी भय और ताप मुक्त होकर सभी  प्रकार के अभाव को दूर करते हुए मेरी कृपा से यावत् मङ्गल लाभ करोगे
english_translation: Then, freed from fear and suffering, you will attain all kinds of welfare by my grace.
essence: Releasing fear and pain invites divine grace that grants complete well-being.
simple_meaning: When you free your mind from fear and suffering, you will receive all kinds of well-being through my grace.
insight: It teaches you to release fear and suffering to open up to compassionate support beyond your control.
modern_relevance: When anxiety and pain weigh you down, trusting a deeper source can bring unexpected ease and support.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
आचारः सर्वकल्याणमूलं नूनं दिवौकसः !॥
शक्ष्यन्त्याचारवन्तो हि प्राप्तुं कल्याणसम्पदः ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! आचार ही सब कल्याणों का मूल है आचारवान ही सब कुछ प्राप्त कर सकते हैं
english_translation: O divine beings! Conduct is indeed the root of all welfare; those with good conduct attain all prosperity.
essence: Good conduct is the true root of all lasting welfare and prosperity.
simple_meaning: Good conduct is the foundation of every blessing and prosperity in life. Only those who live with proper conduct truly gain lasting welfare.
insight: It teaches you to focus on cultivating consistent good conduct to unlock lasting prosperity, not just chasing results.
modern_relevance: You notice how your daily choices and behavior set the tone for your success and happiness, even beyond what you expect.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
आचारमूला जातिः स्यादाचारः शास्त्रमूलकः।
वेदवाक्यं शास्त्रमूलं वेदः साधकमूलकः ॥
translation: जाति आचार मूलक होती है, प्राचार शास्त्र मूलक होता है, शास्त्र का मूल वेदवाक्य है, वेद का मूल साधक है
english_translation: Conduct is the root of caste, conduct is based on scripture, scripture is rooted in the Vedic statement, and the Veda's root is the practitioner.
essence: Your true role arises from your conduct, rooted in practice beyond scripture.
simple_meaning: Your behavior defines your social role. This behavior is based on scripture, scripture is based on Vedic teachings, and those teachings are based on the person who practices them.
insight: It shifts focus from external labels to how your consistent behavior and practice shape your true role.
modern_relevance: When you consistently live your values, your true role emerges beyond titles or external labels.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
साधकश्च क्रियामूलः क्रियाऽपि फलमूलिका।
फलमूलं सुखं देवाः ! सुखमानन्दमूलकम् ॥
translation: साधक की मूल क्रिया है, क्रिया का मूल फल है, हे देवगण ! फल का मूल सुख है, सुख का मूल आनन्द है,
english_translation: The root of a seeker is action; the root of action is its result; the root of result is happiness; and the root of happiness is bliss.
essence: Action is the foundation that ultimately leads to bliss through results and happiness.
simple_meaning: Your efforts start with taking action, which leads to results, then to happiness, and finally to deep joy.
insight: It shifts your focus to see action as the starting point for a chain leading to true joy, making effort feel meaningful.
modern_relevance: You finish a challenging task and feel a small happiness, which can deepen into a profound satisfaction beyond momentary pleasure.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
आनन्दो ज्ञानमूलस्तु ज्ञानं वै ज्ञेयमूलकम् ।
तत्त्वमूलं ज्ञेयमानं तत्वं हि ब्रह्ममूलकम् ॥
translation: आनन्द का मूल ज्ञान है, ज्ञान का मूल ज्ञेय है, सकल ज्ञेयों का मूल तत्व है, तत्त्व का मूल ब्रह्म है,
english_translation: Bliss is rooted in knowledge; knowledge is rooted in the known; the source of all known is the essence; the essence's root is the supreme reality.
essence: Bliss flows from the essence that underlies knowledge and all that is known.
simple_meaning: Bliss arises from knowledge, knowledge comes from what is understood, and all understanding is rooted in the essential reality beneath everything.
insight: It shifts your focus from chasing facts to connecting with the deeper essence behind all knowledge and joy.
modern_relevance: When you feel true happiness, it’s often because you understand something real beneath surface distractions, not just facts or fleeting emotions.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ब्रह्मज्ञानं त्वैक्यमूलमैक्यं स्यात्सर्वमूलकम् ।
ऐक्यं तद्धि सुपर्वाणः ! भावातीतं सुनिश्चितम् ॥
translation: ब्रह्मज्ञान का मूल ऐक्य है और ऐक्य सबका मूल है, हे देवगण ! वही ऐक्य भावातीत है यह निश्चित है
english_translation: The root of supreme knowledge is unity, and unity is the root of all; that unity is beyond all emotions and certain, O divine beings!
essence: True knowledge is rooted in an unchanging unity beyond all emotions.
simple_meaning: The deepest knowledge comes from understanding that everything ultimately unites into one, which is beyond any feelings or emotions.
insight: It shifts the mind from chasing changing feelings to resting in the unchanging unity that underlies all experience.
modern_relevance: When emotions feel overwhelming, you can find steady ground by sensing the unity that connects all things beyond those feelings.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
भावातीतमिदं सर्वे प्रकाशये भावमात्रकम ।
नास्त्यत्र संशय: को पि सत्यं सत्यं वदाम्यहम ॥
translation: यह सकल संसार प्रकाश रूप से केवल भावमय है परन्तु वस्तुतः भावातीत है, इसमें कोई भी सन्देह नहीं है मैं सत्य सत्य कहता हूँ
english_translation: All this universe appears as pure light filled only with feeling, yet truly it is beyond feeling; there is no doubt in this, I speak the truth.
essence: Everything appears as feeling but is truly beyond all feeling.
simple_meaning: The entire world looks like it is made of light and feeling, but actually it goes beyond any feeling or emotion.
insight: It shifts your mind to recognize that appearances of feelings do not define the ultimate nature of reality.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by emotions or sensory overload, remember that beneath all feelings there is a calm space that stays untouched.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अज्ञानदेव भीतीनामुत्पत्तिजायते सुरा : ।
अज्ञानमेव जन्तूनां हेतुस्तापत्रयस्य वै ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! अज्ञान से ही भय की उत्पत्ति होती है, अज्ञान ही त्रिताप का कारण है
english_translation: O divine beings, ignorance alone gives rise to fear; ignorance is the cause of the threefold suffering.
essence: Fear and suffering arise only from ignorance, not from reality itself.
simple_meaning: Fear and suffering arise from ignorance. When you do not understand, fear appears along with pain.
insight: Recognize that fear and suffering are symptoms of ignorance, shifting your focus toward gaining clear understanding.
modern_relevance: You feel anxious because you don’t see the full picture; confusion feeds your worries and suffering.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ज्ञानेन रहिता जीवा: साधुसैभाग्यवंचिता: ।
द्रष्टुं स्मर्तृञ्च मां नित्यं कदाचिदपि नेशते ॥
translation: ज्ञानरहित जीव सौभाग्य से वञ्चित हैं और वह मेरे दर्शन लाभ करने में और यहां तक कि मेरे स्मरण करने तक में असमर्थ होते हैं।
english_translation: Beings without wisdom are deprived of good fortune; they cannot perceive or even remember me.
essence: Without wisdom, beings fail to perceive or remember the divine presence.
simple_meaning: Without wisdom, beings lose their chance to connect with the divine and cannot see or remember it.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate wisdom so you can recognize and hold onto what truly matters.
modern_relevance: You might know something valuable but without clear understanding, you fail to fully appreciate or remember it when it matters.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
नूनं कर्तव्यनिष्ठो यो निजधर्मपरायणः ।
ज्ञानवान्स भयान्मुक्तः सयमेव ब्रवीमि वः ॥
translation: परन्तु मैं तुम्हें सत्य कहता हूँ कि जो कर्तव्यनिष्ठ और स्वधर्मपरायण होते हैं वह अतिसुगमता से ही आत्मज्ञान लाभ करके भयमुक्त हो जाते हैं
english_translation: But I tell you truly, those devoted to their duty and their own path easily attain self-knowledge and become free from fear.
essence: Steadfast commitment to your true duty naturally brings fearless self-knowledge.
simple_meaning: Fully committing to your own duty leads naturally to clear understanding and freedom from fear.
insight: It shifts the mind from fearing outcomes to trusting steady commitment to your purpose.
modern_relevance: You face a tough choice at work or home and feel stuck; focusing on what you truly must do clears confusion and calms anxiety.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तापत्रयं न शक्नोति कदाचित् स्प्रष्टुमेव तम् ।
अचिरेणैव कालेन स मुक्तिमधिगच्छति ॥
translation: पुनः त्रिताप उनको स्पर्श नहीं कर सकता और वह शीघ्र ही मुक्ति को प्राप्त करते हैं
english_translation: One who is beyond the threefold suffering can never be touched by it and soon attains freedom.
essence: Freedom comes swiftly when suffering can no longer touch you.
simple_meaning: If you rise above the three kinds of suffering, they can no longer affect you, and you quickly reach freedom.
insight: This verse shifts the mind from fearing pain to recognizing your deeper self beyond suffering.
modern_relevance: When overwhelming stress or pain hits, you can find refuge in the part of you that remains untouched, moving you toward freedom.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
श्रेयो हि ज्ञानमभ्यासाजज्ञानाद्धयानं विशिष्यते ।
ध्यानात् कर्मफलसागस्यागाच्छान्तिरनन्तरम् ॥
translation: अभ्यास की अपेक्षा ज्ञान श्रेष्ठ है, ज्ञान से ध्यान विशेष माना गया है, ध्यान से कर्मफलों का त्याग श्रेष्ठ है और त्याग के अनंतर ही शान्ति होती है
english_translation: Practice is inferior to wisdom; wisdom excels over ignorance. Meditation surpasses wisdom; renouncing the fruits of action is higher than meditation. Beyond renunciation alone lies peace.
essence: Peace arises only after you fully renounce attachment to action’s results.
simple_meaning: Wisdom is more valuable than just practice; meditation is better than wisdom; and giving up attachment to results leads directly to peace.
insight: It shifts your focus from constant effort to releasing attachment to outcomes, opening space for inner calm.
modern_relevance: You’ve worked hard on a project, but the real calm comes when you stop worrying about how it will turn out.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यो मां पश्यति सर्वत्र सर्वञ्च माय पश्यति ।
तस्याऽहं न प्रणश्यामि स च मे न प्रणश्यति ॥
translation: जो मुझको सर्वत्र देखता है और सबको मुझमें देखता है उसके लिये मैं कभी अन्तर्धान नहीं होता हूँ और वह भी मुझसे अदृश्य नहीं होता है
english_translation: Whoever sees me everywhere and sees everything in me, to them I never disappear, and they never disappear from me.
essence: Seeing all as the divine means the divine and you are inseparable.
simple_meaning: If you see the divine everywhere and recognize everything as part of it, the divine never leaves you, and you never leave the divine.
insight: It teaches you to experience connection as a constant, dissolving separation and fear of abandonment.
modern_relevance: In moments when you feel isolated, remember that seeing yourself and others as connected to something greater means you are never truly alone.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
देवादिदेव ! सर्वज्ञ ! सृष्टिस्थितिलयप्रभो !
त्वद्विस्मरणतो नूनं दुर्गतिर्नोऽभवत्स्वयम् ॥
translation: हे देवादिदेव ! हे सृष्टिस्थितिप्रलयकर्त्ता ! हे सर्वज्ञ ! अब हमलोगों को यह विदित हुआ कि आपको विस्मृत होने से ही हमलोगों की यह दुर्गति हुई है
english_translation: O lord of all lords, all-knowing, controller of creation, preservation, and dissolution! We have realized that our downfall happened because we forgot you.
essence: Forgetting the divine causes downfall and hardship.
simple_meaning: Forgetting the divine who controls everything caused our difficulties and downfall.
insight: It shifts the mind to see forgetting support leads to personal and collective hardship.
modern_relevance: You realize your struggles grew when you stopped acknowledging the bigger support that holds things together.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
आज्ञाऽस्ति भवतः सत्या जीवा अभ्यासयोगतः।
निर्भयायां पदव्यान्तु भवन्सग्रेसरा ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: आपकी आज्ञा सत्य है कि अभ्यास के द्वारा ही जीव निर्भयपद की ओर अग्रसर होते हैं
english_translation: Your instruction is true: through practice, beings steadily progress toward the fearless state.
essence: Steady practice is the sure path leading beings to fearless stability.
simple_meaning: Regular practice is the true way for beings to move steadily toward a fearless state.
insight: It teaches you to trust the process of repeated effort as the key to overcoming fear.
modern_relevance: You keep returning to your meditation every day, even when distractions arise; this steady effort quietly builds your inner strength.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
क्रमशो निर्भयाः सन्तस्ते जीवा भाग्यशालिनः ।
अतुलां परमां शान्तिमधिगच्छन्ति सत्वरम् ॥
translation: और क्रमशः भयरहित होकर परमभाग्यशाली हो परमशान्ति को शीघ्र प्राप्त करते हैं
english_translation: Step by step, fearless beings attain supreme fortune and quickly reach the highest peace.
essence: Fearlessness, taken step by step, quickly leads to supreme peace and fortune.
simple_meaning: By moving forward without fear, beings steadily become fortunate and quickly find deep peace.
insight: It teaches you to replace hesitation with steady courage, accelerating your progress toward peace.
modern_relevance: You face a difficult change but stay calm and brave, and soon find relief and confidence growing.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तदुक्तक्त्रमतो देव ! दीनाश्रय ! यथा वयं ।
प्रशांता निर्भया: स्याम कृप्यैव तथाऽऽदिश ॥
translation: अतः हे दीनजनों के आश्रयदाता ! आपके कहे हुए क्रम के अनुसार हम शान्ति को प्राप्त करके कैसे भयरहित हो सकते हैं वह कृपया आज्ञा कीजिये
english_translation: O refuge of the humble! According to your instructions, please kindly teach how we can become peaceful and fearless.
essence: Peace and fearlessness arise by trusting and following kind guidance.
simple_meaning: The speaker asks the divine refuge of the humble to kindly explain how to become peaceful and free from fear by following the given instructions.
insight: It encourages you to place trust in compassionate guidance as a path to inner calm and fearlessness.
modern_relevance: You feel anxious and uncertain, hoping for clear guidance to find calm and courage in your life.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
हे देवाः ! इन्द्रियैर्जीवा विषयेषु निरन्तम् ।
सक्ताः सन्तस्तदाकारवृत्तिभिः स्युः मुदुःखिताः ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! जीव इन्द्रियों की सहायता से विषयों में फँसकर विषयाकार वृत्ति को प्राप्त करता हुआ नाना दुःख प्राप्त करता है
english_translation: O divine beings! The living being, constantly attached through the senses to objects, experiences various pains due to these attachments.
essence: Attachment through the senses causes repeated cycles of pleasure and pain.
simple_meaning: When you constantly cling to things through your senses, you experience both pleasure and pain because of that attachment.
insight: It teaches you to observe how sensory attachments lead to fluctuating moods and suffering.
modern_relevance: You scroll endlessly through social media, chasing likes and updates that feel good briefly but leave you restless and unsatisfied.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
दशेयमेव भीहेतुः स्वर्गादिप्राप्तिकारणम् ।
एषैव विषमा नूनं आवागमनकारणम् ॥
translation: यही दशा सब भयों की कारण है, यही दशा स्वर्ग नरक प्रेत पितृ आदि नाना लोकप्राप्ति और आवागमन का मूलकारण है
english_translation: This very condition is the cause of all fears and the root reason for coming and going across many realms.
essence: Restlessness and fear cause endless movement through many realms.
simple_meaning: Your unsettled state creates fear and causes you to move through many states of existence repeatedly.
insight: It teaches you to identify restlessness and fear as the real reasons for your repeating struggles and cycles.
modern_relevance: You feel anxious and unsettled, trapped in repeating patterns, as though you keep shifting between different emotional states without rest.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ततो विषयवैराग्यैर्यदा शिथिलबन्धनः।
प्रारब्धवान् साधकः स्यात्तदा सफलतालयः ॥
translation: अतः विषयवैराग्य द्वारा इस बन्धन को शिथिल करता हुआ अभ्यास की सहायता से प्रारब्धवान् साधक जब सफलता लाभ करता है
english_translation: When the seeker loosens attachment through dispassion toward sense objects, they begin to attain success.
essence: Loosening attachment to desires initiates true progress toward success.
simple_meaning: By loosening attachment to desires and sense objects, the seeker starts making progress toward success.
insight: This verse teaches you to reduce craving as the first step toward meaningful success.
modern_relevance: You realize your anxiety fades as you stop obsessing over every craving and outcome.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तदैव विमलं ज्ञानमासाद्य निर्मलाशयः।
समुन्नताधिकराप्तेरधिकार भवत्यलम् ॥
translation: तब ही वह ज्ञानवान् होकर उन्नत अधिकार प्राप्त करने का अधिकारी बनता है
english_translation: Only then, having attained pure knowledge, does one become worthy of elevated authority.
essence: True authority comes only after achieving pure knowledge and clarity of heart.
simple_meaning: You become qualified for higher responsibility only when your knowledge is pure and your heart is clear.
insight: It shifts your view from seeking power to cultivating genuine understanding as the basis of rightful authority.
modern_relevance: Before taking a leadership role, you realize knowledge and clear intention make your authority meaningful and respected.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
नश्वरस्य शरीरस्य सम्बन्धाद्भवतां भयम् ।
भ्रान्तिमूलं यदेतत्तद्देवाः ! तत्त्वबुभुत्मवः ! ॥
translation: हे तत्त्वनिज्ञासु देवतागण ! नश्वर शरीर के सम्बन्ध से आपलोगों का जो भय है सो भ्रममूलक है
english_translation: O wise beings, the fear you have from the connection to the perishable body is rooted in confusion.
essence: Fear comes from confusing the lasting self with the perishable body.
simple_meaning: Fear arises because you mistakenly identify with your mortal body instead of seeing beyond it.
insight: It shifts your view from identifying with the body to recognizing fear as a product of that misidentification.
modern_relevance: When you worry about aging or illness, this teaching reminds you that your true self is not your fragile body.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
इह दृश्यानि सर्वाणि नवराणि भवन्यहो ।
अविवेकमयोऽयं यत्समारोऽतो भयाप्लुतः ॥
translation: इस संसार की समस्त वस्तु नश्वर है, विशेषतः यह संसार अज्ञानमय होने के कारण भय से पूर्ण है
english_translation: Everything seen in this world is perishable and full of fear because it is born of ignorance.
essence: The world you perceive is fleeting and filled with fear because it arises from ignorance.
simple_meaning: All things in this world are temporary and come with fear because they arise from ignorance.
insight: This shifts your view to see the world’s things as temporary appearances that do not define your true self.
modern_relevance: You notice how every plan or possession feels fragile and uncertain, stirring anxiety that comes from not fully understanding the nature of things.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अविवेकसमुद्भूतविषयासक्तितः कचित् ।
लब्धुं न कोऽपि शक्रोति निर्भयत्वामिह स्वतः ॥
translation: अज्ञानसम्भूत विषय में प्रासक्त रहने से कोई भी भयरहित नहीं हो सक्ता
english_translation: No one can attain fearlessness while being attached to objects born of ignorance.
essence: Fearlessness cannot arise while attachment to confusion-born objects remains.
simple_meaning: You cannot become free from fear if you stay attached to things that arise from confusion or lack of clear understanding.
insight: It teaches you to notice how clinging to unclear desires blocks your courage and calm.
