modern_relevance: You feel anxious when you desperately cling to uncertain outcomes or confusing desires that cloud your mind.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
पुत्रमित्रकलत्रादिस्वजनाः स्वस्वकर्मणा ।
भोगार्थ युगपन्नूनमेकत्रोत्पत्तिमाश्रिताः ॥
translation: पुत्र मित्र कलत्रादि स्वजन केवल अपने अपने कर्म भोगने के लिये एक देशकाल में उत्पन्न होकर
english_translation: Children, friends, spouses, and other loved ones are born together in one place and time only to experience the results of their own actions.
essence: Loved ones gather only to experience their own actions’ consequences together.
simple_meaning: People you call family or friends come together only to experience the results of their own actions.
insight: It shifts the mind to see relationships as opportunities to meet your own actions’ results, not as escapes or mere attachments.
modern_relevance: You notice how even in close relationships, everyone faces their own challenges and outcomes, no one escapes their personal journey.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
आत्मीयत्वेन राजन्ते ध्रुवं स्वस्वार्थसिद्धये ।
संस्थाप्यानृतसम्बन्धमेषु यान्ति महद्भयम् ॥
translation: अपने अपने स्वार्थ सिद्धि के लिये आत्मीय रूप से प्रतीत होते हैं उनमें मिथ्या सम्बन्ध स्थापन करके देही अनेक भयों को प्राप्त होता है
english_translation: Beings appear friendly only to fulfill their own interests, creating false relationships that bring great fear to the embodied self.
essence: Friendships based on self-interest create false ties that bring fear to the self.
simple_meaning: People often act like friends to achieve their own goals, forming false bonds that cause fear inside you.
insight: It teaches you to recognize when relationships are driven by self-interest, helping you protect your inner peace.
modern_relevance: You smile with a colleague who helps only when it benefits them, leaving you uncertain about true trust.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
एतदात्मीयजं दुःखं भयं चाऽज्ञानमूलकम् ।
न जायते सुखं सत्यं नश्वरात्काञ्चनादितः ॥
translation: यह सब आत्मीयजनित भय और दुःख अज्ञानमूलक है। नश्वर कामिनी काञ्चन आदि भोगपदार्थ अपनी नश्वरता के कारण कदापि सत्य सुख को उत्पन्न नहीं कर सकते
english_translation: All suffering and fear born of attachment arise from deep confusion. Fleeting pleasures like gold and others cannot produce true happiness.
essence: Fear and pain come from confusion; fleeting things cannot bring true happiness.
simple_meaning: Fear and suffering arise from deep confusion caused by attachment. Temporary pleasures like gold cannot bring lasting happiness.
insight: Recognize that clinging to temporary things fuels fear and suffering; true happiness lies beyond them.
modern_relevance: You feel restless chasing status or possessions, but they never satisfy you deeply or for long.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ईशे नश्वरेऽर्थे हि सक्तो देही निरन्तरम्।
विविधं दुःखमाप्नोति भयञ्चैवाऽधिगच्छति ॥
translation: इस प्रकार के नश्वर विषयों में फंसकर देही निरन्तर अनेक प्रकार के दुःख और भय प्राप्त करता है
english_translation: The embodied being, attached to fleeting things, continuously suffers various pains and fears.
essence: Attachment to what fades brings endless fear and suffering to the embodied self.
simple_meaning: Being attached to temporary and passing things causes continuous suffering and fear.
insight: It shifts your focus from chasing fleeting things to recognizing how attachment fuels ongoing fear and pain.
modern_relevance: You keep scrolling through social media, hoping to find lasting joy, but every new post fades and leaves you restless.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
जरामृत्युभयं देहे पुत्रादौ कालजादिकम्।
राजंतस्करजं द्रव्ये जराजं यौवने भयम् ॥
translation: शरीर में जरा और मृत्यु का भय है, पुत्रकलत्रादि में काल और वियोग का भय है, धन में राजा और चोर का भय है, यौवन में वार्द्धक्य का भय है
english_translation: The body fears old age and death; children and spouses bring fears of separation and time; wealth carries fears of kings and thieves; youth fears growing old.
essence: Fears arise only from what changes, never from the true self.
simple_meaning: The body, relationships, wealth, and youth all bring different fears because they are temporary and vulnerable.
insight: Recognize that fears are tied to external, impermanent things, freeing you to detach and focus on what remains constant.
modern_relevance: You notice your anxiety rising when you think about losing your job, your loved ones drifting away, or your health declining with age.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
जरारोगभयं रूपे वले शत्रुभवं भयम् ।
भोगे रोगभयं नूनं कुले पतन भयम् ॥
translation: रूप में जरा और रोग का भय है, बल में शत्रु का भय है, भोग मे रोग का भय है, कुल में पतित होने का भय है
english_translation: There is fear of old age and disease in appearance, fear of enemies in strength, fear of disease in enjoyment, and fear of downfall in lineage.
essence: All that seems strong or joyful carries hidden fears that reveal its impermanence.
simple_meaning: Everything you value—your looks, strength, pleasures, and family—has some hidden fear or weakness.
insight: It teaches you to see that all external things are vulnerable, encouraging detachment and deeper stability.
modern_relevance: You might worry about losing your youth, health, influence, or family reputation—this verse shows these fears are natural but reveal impermanence.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
दीनताजं भयं माने गुणे खलभयं खलु ।
भयं निन्दकजं शक्तौ विद्यायां वादिनं भयम् ॥
translation: मान में दीनता का भय है, गुण में खलों का ही भय है, शक्ति में निन्द का भय है, विद्या में वादी का भय है
english_translation: In humility, fear of lowliness arises; in virtue, fear of wickedness; in strength, fear of criticism; in knowledge, fear of argument.
essence: Your best qualities can also be the source of your fears.
simple_meaning: Fear arises in different qualities: humility fears being seen as weak, virtue fears evil people, strength fears criticism, and knowledge fears argument.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that fear can arise alongside your best qualities, inviting you to face it without retreat.
modern_relevance: You may hesitate to show kindness fearing judgment, or doubt your knowledge fearing debate, even when these are your strengths.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
स्वर्गेऽपि प्रार्थ्यमानेऽस्मिन्नीपर्याप्तनज भयम् ।
वैराग्यपदमेवाऽत्र तिष्ठत्यभयमुत्तमम् ॥
translation: सब लोगों के अभीप्सित स्वर्ग में भी ईष्या और पतन का भय है , केवल उत्तम वैराग्यपद  ही भयरहित है
english_translation: Even in the most desired higher realms, envy and fear of downfall exist; only the highest state of detachment is truly free of fear.
essence: Only supreme detachment offers complete fearlessness beyond any desired realm.
simple_meaning: Even the most desired heavenly places have envy and fear of falling; only the highest level of detachment is completely free of fear.
insight: This verse shifts your focus from chasing external success to cultivating inner detachment as true security.
modern_relevance: You may achieve many goals and places others envy, yet still feel anxious about losing them. Only letting go fully brings peace.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
येनैव हि विचारेण तत्तु लभ्येत निर्जराः !।
जगतां श्रेयसे नूनं तं ब्रवीमि निबोधत ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! जिस विचार के द्वारा इसकी प्राप्ति निश्चय ही होती है उसको जगत् कल्याण के लिये ही कहता हूँ सो जानो
english_translation: O divine beings! The thought by which that is surely attained is called the welfare of the world, understand this.
essence: Focused thought that leads to attainment is the true welfare of the world.
simple_meaning: The thought or reflection that leads to certain attainment is what brings true welfare to the world.
insight: It encourages you to focus your mind on clear, purposeful thinking that benefits beyond yourself.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by many options, focusing your thinking on what truly benefits everyone guides you to wiser choices.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
देहिनोऽस्मिन् यथा देहे कोमारं यौवनं जरा।
तथा देहान्तरप्राप्तिधीरस्तत्र न मुह्यति ॥
translation: देहाभिमानी जीव का जिस प्रकार इस देह में कौमार यौवन और वार्धक्य है देहान्तरप्राप्ति अर्थात् मृत्यु भी उसी प्रकार है (अवस्थाभेदमात्र है) अतएव ज्ञानी उसमें मोहित नहीं होते हैं
english_translation: Just as the body experiences childhood, youth, and old age, the wise are not deluded by the body's death.
essence: The true self is steady and undeluded despite the body's aging and death.
simple_meaning: The body passes through stages like childhood, youth, and old age, but the wise know its death is just another change and are not confused by it.
insight: It teaches you to see your identity beyond physical changes, reducing fear of death and loss.
modern_relevance: You watch a loved one age or face illness, but you sense their true being remains beyond these shifts and endings.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
मात्रास्पर्शास्तु गीर्वाणाः! शीतोष्णसुखदुःखदाः।
आगमापायिनोऽनित्यास्ताँस्तितिक्षध्वमुत्तमाः ! ॥
translation: हे श्रेष्ठ देवगण! इन्द्रियों की वृत्ति और उनके साथ इन्द्रियों के विषयो का संयोग ये ही शीतोष्णादि सुख दुःख को देनेवाले हैं। ये सब आगमापायी ( उत्पत्तिनाशविशिष्ट) है अतएव अनित्य हैं उनको सहन करो अर्थात् हर्षविषाद आदि के वशीभूत मत हो
english_translation: O exalted devas! The contact of the senses with their objects brings cold and heat, pleasure and pain. These experiences arise and pass away; endure them and do not be controlled by joy or sorrow.
essence: Pleasure and pain arise from senses and pass; endurance frees you from their control.
simple_meaning: Your senses meet things that cause feelings like cold, heat, pleasure, and pain. These feelings come and go, so you should endure them without letting joy or sorrow control you.
insight: It teaches you to recognize sensations as temporary and not react by chasing pleasure or avoiding pain.
modern_relevance: You get a sudden chill or warmth, or a mood swings quickly after a text or news. Recognizing these feelings as temporary helps you stay calm and balanced.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
यं हि न व्यथयंत्य्ते पुरुषं विबुर्ध्षभा:।
ममदुःखसुखं धीरं सोऽमृतत्वाय कल्पते ॥
translation: हे देवश्रेष्ठो! ये सब (मात्रास्पर्श) सुख दुःख में संभव युक्त जिस धीर व्यक्ति को व्यथा नहीं देते हैं वह अमरत्व प्राप्त करता है
english_translation: O best of gods! Those great beings who are not disturbed by these joys and sorrows attain immortality.
essence: True strength is staying steady through both joy and sorrow.
simple_meaning: A person who is not shaken by happiness or sadness is steady and attains freedom from suffering.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate a steady mind that neither clings to joy nor rejects pain, leading to lasting freedom.
modern_relevance: When you face unexpected praise or criticism, staying steady lets you keep your peace and move forward without losing yourself.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
नाऽसतो विद्यते भावो नाऽभावो विद्यते सतः।
उभयोराप दृष्टोऽन्तस्त्वनयोस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः ॥
translation: अनित्य वास्तु स्थायी नहीं है और नित्य वास्तु का विनाश नहीं होता, अर्थात अनित्य शरीर और जगत का अवश्य नाश होगा और नित्य वस्तु आत्मा का क्तिकाल मे विनाश नहीं है । तत्त्वदर्शी लोगों ने इन दोनों का ही तत्त्व देखा है।
english_translation: The impermanent has no lasting reality; the permanent is never destroyed. The wise have seen the truth of both.
essence: The temporary disappears; the true self endures forever.
simple_meaning: Some things in life are temporary and will end, while others are eternal and cannot be destroyed. Wise people understand this difference clearly.
insight: It shifts your view from clinging to changing things toward recognizing your lasting inner reality.
modern_relevance: You watch a relationship or phase end, feeling loss, but deep inside you sense something within that never changes.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अविनाशि तु तद्वित्त येन सर्वमिदं ततम् ।
विनाशमव्ययस्याऽस्य न कश्चित् कर्तुमर्हति ॥
translation: जो  उत्पत्तिनाश शील इन सब  देहादि में व्याप्त है उस आत्मस्वरूप को अविनाशी मानना चाहिए। कोई भी उस अव्यय उत्पत्तिनाशशून्य आत्मा का विनाश नहीं कर सकता
english_translation: The true self that pervades all creation is indestructible; no one can destroy this imperishable essence.
essence: The true self that pervades everything is eternal and cannot be destroyed.
simple_meaning: Your true self is eternal and cannot be destroyed by anything in the world.
insight: It shifts your view from fearing loss to recognizing your enduring inner being.
modern_relevance: When facing loss or change, knowing your core essence is unbreakable brings calm and strength.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यदा वो मोहकलिलं बुद्धिर्व्यतितरिष्यति ।
तदा गन्तास्थ निर्वेदं श्रोतव्यस्य श्रुतस्य च ॥
translation: जब तुम्हारी बुद्धि मोहरूप गहन दुर्ग अर्थात देहादि में आत्मबुद्धि को परित्याग करेगी तब तुम श्रोतव्य और श्रुत अर्थों से वैराग्य प्राप्त होगे
english_translation: When your intellect crosses beyond the deep darkness of delusion, then detachment arises from both the listener and the heard.
essence: Detachment arises when your intellect transcends deep delusion and confusion.
simple_meaning: Your intellect moves beyond deep confusion, and then true detachment arises from understanding both what is heard and the listener.
insight: It teaches you to recognize and move beyond mental confusion to achieve detachment from external inputs and internal reactions.
modern_relevance: When your mind stops being clouded by doubt and distraction, you naturally stop clinging to ideas or outcomes.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
श्रुतिविप्रतिपन्ना वो यदा स्थास्यति निश्चला।
समाधावचला बुद्धिस्तदा योगमवाप्स्यथ ॥
translation: जब तत्त्वज्ञान सम्बन्धी उपदेशों के सुनने से और उनके मनन के द्वारा तुम्हारी बुद्धि अविचलित होकर समाधि उत्तमरूप से स्थिर रहेगी तब तुम योग प्राप्त होगे।
english_translation: When your intellect becomes steady and unwavering through listening and reflecting on true knowledge, then you will attain yoga.
essence: Steady, unwavering intellect through true knowledge is the gateway to yoga.
simple_meaning: By deeply listening and reflecting, your mind becomes steady and clear, leading you to attain yoga.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate steady intellect through thoughtful reflection, enabling inner stillness and progress.
modern_relevance: You’ve read, thought deeply, and now your restless thoughts settle—opening space for clarity and focus.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
बासस्पर्शेष्वसत्तात्मा विन्दत्यात्माने यत्सुखम् ।
स ब्रह्मयोगयुक्तात्मा मुखमक्षय्यमश्नुते ॥
translation: बाहोन्द्रियों के सभी विषयों में अनासक्तचित्त व्यक्ति, आत्मा में जो शान्ति सुख है उसकी प्राप्ति करता है, वह ब्रह्म में योग के द्वारा युक्तात्मा होकर अक्षय सुख प्राप्त करता है
english_translation: The self-controlled person, detached from all external senses, finds inner peace and attains imperishable joy through the yoga of Brahman.
essence: Detachment from the senses opens the door to lasting inner joy through union with the supreme.
simple_meaning: When you stop clinging to external things, you find deep peace and lasting joy within yourself through spiritual practice.
insight: It shifts your practice from chasing external pleasure to cultivating inner peace through detachment and yoga.
modern_relevance: You scroll endlessly, distracted by notifications and noise. When you detach from this sensory flood, a calm joy emerges from within.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ये हि संस्पर्शजा भोगा दुःखयोनय एव ते।
आद्यन्तवन्तो विबुधाः ! न तेषु रमते बुधः ॥
translation: विषयजनित जो सब सुख हैं वह निश्चय ही दुःख के हेतु हैं एवं आदि और अन्त विशिष्ट अर्थात् अनित्य हैं इसी कारण हे देवगण ! विवेकी पुरुष इन सब में रत नहीं होते हैं
english_translation: All pleasures born of contact with the senses are surely causes of suffering; they have a beginning and an end, and the wise do not delight in them.
essence: Pleasures born from senses are temporary and cause suffering; the wise avoid delighting in them.
simple_meaning: Pleasures that come from sensory contact always cause suffering because they are temporary. Wise people do not get attached to them.
insight: Shift your focus from chasing temporary pleasures to seeking lasting inner steadiness beyond sensory experiences.
modern_relevance: You scroll social media for quick hits of happiness, but soon feel empty and restless; this teaches you to see those pleasures as temporary distractions.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
वासांसि जीर्णानि यथा विहाय नवानि गृह्णाति नरोऽपराणि ।
तथा शरीराणि विहाय जीर्णान्यन्यानि संयाति नवानि देही ॥
translation: जिस प्रकार मनुष्य जीर्ण वस्त्र परित्याग करके दुसरे नवीन वस्त्र धारण करता है, उसी प्रकार आत्मा जीर्ण शरीर परित्याग करके अन्य नूतन देह धारण करता है
english_translation: Just as a person discards old clothes and puts on new ones, the true self leaves the old worn-out body and takes on a new one.
essence: The true self discards old bodies as easily as changing worn clothes.
simple_meaning: The true self is not the body. When the body gets old, the true self moves on to a new body like changing clothes.
insight: Recognize the distinction between your ever-changing body and your unchanging true self; this shifts your identity beyond physical form.
modern_relevance: When you feel trapped by aging or illness, remember your true self is beyond the body’s limits and changes.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अव्यक्तादीनि भूतानि व्यक्तमध्यानि निर्जराः ।
अव्यक्तनिधनान्येव ह्येतदेवावधार्यताम् ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! सकल भूत प्रारम्भ में अव्यक्त चक्षु आदि के अगोचर हैं, केवल बीच में व्यक्त-प्रकाशित हैं एवं मरणकाल में भी अव्यक्त हैं, यह सब ही आप विचार करें
english_translation: O divine beings! All creatures begin as unmanifest and imperceptible, become manifest in the middle, and return to unmanifest at death; reflect on this truth.
essence: Life appears briefly between two vast periods of invisibility and change.
simple_meaning: All beings start hidden and invisible, appear briefly during life, and vanish back into invisibility at death.
insight: This shifts your view from clinging to appearances toward accepting the deeper unseen cycles of change.
modern_relevance: You watch a new project bloom, then fade—realizing the visible phase is just part of a larger hidden process.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
आश्चर्यवत्पश्यति कश्चिदेनपाश्चर्यवद्वदति तथैव चान्याः।
आश्चर्यवच्चैन्मन्य: शृणोति श्रुत्वाऽप्येनं  वेद न चैव कांश्चित ॥
translation: कोई इस आत्मा को आश्चर्यवत् देखता है, इसी प्रकार कोई इसको आश्चर्य्यवत् कहता है और कोई इस को आश्चर्य्यवत् सुनता है और कोई सुनकर भी इसको नहीं जानता है
english_translation: Some see the true self as a wonder, some call it wondrous, others hear of it, yet none truly know it.
essence: Many encounter the true self differently, but true understanding is rare.
simple_meaning: Many encounter the true self in different ways—seeing, speaking, or hearing—but few truly understand it.
insight: It shifts your focus from passive hearing or speaking to seeking direct, personal understanding of your true self.
modern_relevance: You might hear inspiring ideas or see others talk about deep truths, but truly grasping your own essence remains rare and precious.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
देवाधिदेव ! हे नाथ ! भवतः कृपयाऽधुना।
ज्ञात्वा वैराग्यमाहात्म्यं तत्स्वरूपच सुस्फुटम् ॥
translation: हे देवादिदेव! हे नाथ ! इस समय वैराग्य की महिमा और उसका स्वरूप आपकी कृपा से भलीभांति जानकर
english_translation: O supreme being, O lord! By your grace now clearly knowing the greatness and true nature of renunciation.
essence: True renunciation becomes clear and powerful through the grace that reveals it.
simple_meaning: You can understand how powerful and clear true renunciation is when guided by grace.
insight: It teaches you to trust that letting go is not loss but a clear power revealed through grace.
modern_relevance: When you finally understand the strength in releasing control, you find peace amid uncertainty.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
निर्भया: स्मो वयं जाता देवास्त्वत्पदसेविन: ।
इदानी वर्णयन्सम्यक् सृष्टिप्रकरणं तथा ॥
translation: हम सब आपके चरण सेवक देवगण भय से रहित हुए हैं।  अब सृष्टिप्रकरण और
english_translation: We have become fearless servants at your feet, O divine one. Now, clearly describe the creation process.
essence: Fearlessness and devotion prepare the mind to receive knowledge about creation.
simple_meaning: The divine beings say they are now fearless servants ready to hear a clear explanation of how creation began.
insight: It shows that openness and fearlessness are the first steps to understanding complex truths.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
तद्रहस्यं महाविष्णो ! ज्ञापयन्यच्छ नोऽधुना।
विवेकं तादृशं येन जानीमो विस्तराद्वयम् ॥
translation: उसका रहस्य अच्छी तरह वर्णन करके हे महाविष्णो! हमको ऐसा विवेक दीजिए जिससे हम अच्छी तरह समझ सकें
english_translation: Reveal that secret now, O Mahavishnu, and grant us the discernment to deeply understand it.
essence: True understanding comes from seeking clear, guided discernment of hidden truths.
simple_meaning: Requesting clear guidance to gain the kind of understanding that uncovers hidden truths deeply.
insight: It teaches you to actively seek clear discernment to truly grasp subtle, important truths.
modern_relevance: When facing confusing situations, asking for clear insight can help you understand complex challenges deeply.
speaker: Suta

verse_text: का सृष्टिः कश्च सम्बन्धस्तया नस्सह सम्मतः॥
translation: की सृष्टि क्या है और सृष्टि के साथ हमारा क्या सम्बन्ध है।
english_translation: What is creation, and what is our relationship with it?
essence: The question of what creation is and how you relate to it opens the path to wisdom.
simple_meaning: Creation is the world around us, and this asks what connection you have to it.
insight: It encourages shifting from automatic living to consciously exploring your role in the unfolding whole.
modern_relevance: When you stop to ask what your life really connects to, you open space for meaning beyond daily tasks.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
निर्गुणावस्थितावस्मि खल्वव्यक्तोऽद्वितीयकः ।
आविर्भवति मे शक्तिमर्त्त एव यदा सुराः ! ॥
translation: मैं निर्गुण अवस्था में अव्यक्त और अद्वितीय ही रहता हूँ। हे देवता गण ! जब मेरी शक्ति मुझसे ही उत्पन्न होती है
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
महाविष्णुस्तदा भूत्वा सगुणं धारये वपुः।
शक्तिर्मम महामाया द्विधा कृत्वाऽऽत्मनो वपुः ॥
translation: तब मैं महाविष्णु होकर सगुणरूप को धारण करता हूँ। मेरी शक्ति महामाया अपने में से दो रूप प्रकट करके वे
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
विद्यारूपेण सततं सेवायां रमते मम ।
करोति ज्ञानिनो जीवन्मां प्रत्ग्रेसरंश्च सा ॥
translation: विद्यारूप से सदा मेरी सेवा में रत रहती हैं और वे ज्ञानी जीवों को मेरी ओर अग्रसर करती रहती हैं
english_translation: I remain unmanifested, without qualities, and without a second. O deities, my power arises from me alone.
essence: The supreme source is unmanifested, unique, and the origin of all power.
simple_meaning: I exist beyond qualities and form, unique and unmanifested. My power comes forth from me alone.
insight: It invites you to see your deepest source as beyond all changing traits, the origin of your own power.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तथाऽविद्यास्वरूपेण सैव जीवानर्निशम ।
अज्ञानबन्धने बद्ध्वा तेषां बंधनकारणम ॥
translation: वे ही पुनः अविद्यारूप से जीवों को अज्ञानबन्धन में अहर्निश फंसाकर उनके बन्धन तथा
english_translation: Then I become Mahavishnu, adopting a form with qualities; my great power, Mahamaya, manifests two forms from itself.
essence: The supreme being manifests diverse forms through its great power of illusion.
simple_meaning: I take on a form with qualities as Mahavishnu, and my great power, Mahamaya, creates two forms from itself.
insight: It shows how the supreme being reveals multiplicity from unity by manifesting diverse forms through power.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सृष्टिस्थिथ्योश्च जगत: कारणं भवति ध्रुवम ।
वस्तुतोऽह निजानन्दप्रकाशाय हि केवलम् ॥
translation: जगत की सृष्टि स्थिति का निश्चित कारण बनती हैं। हे श्रेष्ठ देवगण ! वास्तव में केवल
english_translation: The form of knowledge is always delighted in my service and guides wise beings toward me.
essence: Knowledge joyfully serves and leads the wise toward their true self.
simple_meaning: The form of knowledge happily serves the divine and helps wise beings move closer to their true self.
insight: It teaches you to see knowledge as a living, loving guide that supports your growth rather than just abstract facts.
modern_relevance: When you study or reflect deeply, that seeking itself becomes a joyful guide moving you closer to your inner truth.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
धरामि द्वैतरूपं तज्जानीत विबुर्ध्षभा: ।
ममानन्दस्य तस्याऽस्ति महामायैव कारणम् ॥
translation: अपने आनन्द के प्रकाश के लिये ही मैं द्वैतरूप को धारण करता हूँ, इस बात को जानो । मेरे उस आनन्द का कारण महामाया ही है
english_translation: They continuously bind living beings in the bondage of ignorance, which itself is the nature of ignorance.
essence: Ignorance itself continuously traps living beings in bondage.
simple_meaning: Ignorance is the very cause that continuously traps living beings in bondage, preventing freedom.
insight: Recognize that the obstacles you face are caused by persistent misunderstanding, not your essential being.
modern_relevance: When you feel stuck in recurring mistakes or patterns, it’s often because deep confusion keeps pulling you back, not your true self.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
माच्छत्तिरूपां   या प्राहुर्मूलप्रकृतिरित्यापी ।
विदन्ति प्रकृति तां मे त्रिगुणां तत्त्वदर्शिनः ॥
translation: जिसको मेरी शक्तिरूपिणी और मूलप्रकृति भी कहते हैं। उस मेरी प्रकृति को त्रिगुणमय करके तत्त्वदर्शिगण जानते हैं
english_translation: The world’s creation and maintenance definitely have a cause. Indeed, it is solely for the true self’s blissful illumination.
essence: The world’s existence depends on the true self’s blissful light as its definite cause.
simple_meaning: The world’s coming into being and staying stable definitely has a cause, which is the true self shining in bliss.
insight: It shifts your view to see the world’s phenomenon as expressions of an underlying blissful reality.
modern_relevance: When faced with chaos or uncertainty, remembering that a deeper cause supports existence can bring calm and trust.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
नाना तत्त्वविभाक्तां तां केचन ज्ञानिनो विदु: ।
तामेव प्रकृति केचिच्चतुर्विशतिधा जगुः ॥
translation: कोई तत्त्वज्ञानी उसको नानातत्त्वों में विभक्त जानते हैं। कोई तत्वज्ञानी उसी प्रकृति को चतुर्विंश भाग में विभक्त कहते हैं
english_translation: Know that I uphold the dual form to manifest my bliss; the great illusion is the cause of that bliss.
essence: Your experience of duality is the stage for bliss born from great illusion.
simple_meaning: The divine maintains the appearance of two separate forms so that the bliss of existence can be revealed, and this bliss arises because of the great illusion.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing duality as limitation to understanding it as the stage for bliss to manifest.
modern_relevance: When you feel divided inside or see the world in opposites, remember that this separation can reveal deeper joy hidden beneath appearances.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
वस्तुतो मेऽष्टधा  भिन्ना प्राधान्यत्प्रकृतिर्मता ।
जगत्प्रविनी शक्तिर्युमाभिरवधार्य्यताम ॥
translation: वास्तव में प्रधानतः मेरी शक्तिरूपिणी जगत्प्रसविनी प्रकृति अष्टया विभक्त है, सो आप जानें
english_translation: My energy, which is also called the original nature, is understood by those with true insight as composed of the three qualities.
essence: The true self’s original nature is a dynamic energy made of three qualities.
simple_meaning: The divine power is also the original nature of everything, seen by the wise as made of three fundamental qualities.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing yourself as fixed to seeing your nature as a dynamic balance of three forces.
modern_relevance: When you notice your moods shift between calm, active, or resistant states, you’re sensing the three qualities that shape your inner being.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अन्या चेतनमय्यस्ति प्रकृतिर्जीवमुक्तिदा ।
उक्ताष्टप्रकृर्तेर्भिना यां ही पश्यन्ति योगिन: ॥
translation: और चेतनमयी प्रकृति जो जीव को मुक्त करती है, वह इससे अलग है जिसको योगी लोग उक्त आठ प्रकार की प्रकृति से भिन्न देखते हैं
english_translation: Some wise ones perceive the supreme reality as divided into many aspects; others describe this same nature as divided into twenty-four parts.
essence: The same ultimate nature can be seen as many aspects or as twenty-four parts.
simple_meaning: The supreme reality can be understood in different ways: some see it as many separate aspects, others as twenty-four parts of one nature.
insight: It teaches you to hold space for diverse understandings without insisting on one absolute view.
modern_relevance: You might find yourself puzzled by different views on truth or meaning; this reminds you that multiple perspectives can all hold value.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
मम प्रकृतिसम्भूतसंसारस्य सुरर्षभाः ।
सृष्टिः प्रवाहरूपेण ह्यनाद्यन्ता प्रकीर्तिता ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! मेरी प्रकृति से उत्पन्न इस संसार की सृष्टि प्रवाह रूप से ही अनादि अनन्त कही गई है
english_translation: In essence, my power that generates the world is primarily divided into eight aspects, now understand this.
essence: The creative power behind the world divides into eight main aspects.
simple_meaning: The divine power that creates the world is mainly split into eight different parts. This is important to know.
insight: It shifts understanding from a unitary view of creation to recognizing multiple fundamental forces at play.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अपि ब्रह्माण्डमयस्यानन्तत्वे प्रकृतिर्मम।
प्रतिब्रह्माण्डमेवासौ सृष्टिस्थिीतलयान्खलु ॥
translation: ब्रह्माण्डसमूह के अनन्त होने पर भी प्रत्येक ब्रह्माण्ड की ही उत्पत्ति स्थिति और लय,
english_translation: The conscious nature that grants liberation is different from the eight types of nature seen by yogis.
essence: True liberation comes from a conscious nature beyond all known types of nature.
simple_meaning: There is a conscious nature that frees the true self, which is different from the eight types of nature yogis usually recognize.
insight: It shifts your mind from identifying with known natural forms to seeking the transcendent source of liberation.
modern_relevance: When you feel stuck in familiar patterns or identities, know there is a deeper freedom beyond what you usually perceive.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
स्वयं करोति दुर्जेया जीवैर्मद्वशत्तिनी।
ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेशानां रूपेणाऽहं सहायवान् ॥
translation: जीवों के द्वारा दुर्ज्ञेया यह मेरी प्रकृति मेरे वश में रहकर स्वयं ही करती है।  मैं ही ब्रह्मा, विष्णु और महेश रूप से
english_translation: O divine beings! The creation of this world born from my nature is described as an endless, continuous flow without beginning or end.
essence: Creation flows endlessly from divine nature without beginning or end.
simple_meaning: The world created from my nature flows endlessly, having no beginning or end.
insight: Recognize that the world and its changes are part of an infinite, ongoing process beyond your control.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सृष्टिस्थितिलये वर्ते प्रतिब्रह्मंडेव हि ।
स्वस्वशक्तचाश्रयान्नूनं त्रय एते हि हेतवः ॥
translation: प्रत्येक ब्रह्माण्ड में सृष्टि स्थिति और लय में सहायक रहता हूँ ! हे श्रेष्ठ देवगण !
english_translation: Even though the cosmic systems are infinite, each has its own cycle of creation, preservation, and dissolution.
essence: Infinite worlds exist, each with its own cycle of creation and dissolution.
simple_meaning: Though cosmic systems are infinite, each has its own process of arising, sustaining, and dissolving.
insight: It teaches you to see cycles as natural and unique, helping you accept change without resistance.
modern_relevance: You notice how different projects or phases in life begin, grow, and end uniquely, even when many seem endless.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सृष्टिस्थितिल्याना वै भवन्ति सुरसत्तमा:
ब्रह्मा मच्छक्तिमाश्रित्य जीवकर्मानुसारतः ॥
translation: स्थिति और लय के कारण होते हैं। हे देवगण ! ब्रह्मा मेरी शक्ति का आश्रय लेकर जीवों के पूर्वकर्म के अनुसार
english_translation: My nature acts on its own through living beings who are difficult to control, yet they remain under my influence. I am Brahma, Vishnu, and Mahesha in form, the one who supports all.
essence: Even difficult actions arise through my nature, supported by my cosmic forms.
simple_meaning: My nature moves through living beings who are hard to control, yet they act within my influence. I am the support in the forms of Brahma, Vishnu, and Mahesha.
insight: Recognize that your apparent lack of control is still within a larger, supportive reality.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तथा स्वाभाविकं कर्माप्रवाहं प्रकृतेः सुराः ।
आश्रित्य तनुते नित्यं स्थावरं जङ्गमं जगत् ॥
translation: तथा प्रकृति के स्वाभाविक कर्म-प्रवाह का अवलम्बन करके स्थावर जङ्गमात्मक संसार को सदा विस्तार करते हैं
english_translation: I support each universe through creation, maintenance, and dissolution, O supreme radiant beings!
essence: The divine power continuously sustains all universes through creation, preservation, and destruction.
simple_meaning: The divine supports every universe through the processes of creation, maintenance, and dissolution.
insight: It shows the vast, ongoing cycles that underlie all existence, inviting awe beyond daily concerns.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
उद्भिदः स्वेदजस्याथ झण्डजस्य तथा सुराः ।
जरायुजस्य मर्त्ताना पितृणां भवतां तथा ॥
translation: हे देव गण ! उद्भिज, स्वेदज, अण्डज, जरायुज, मनुष्य, पितृ, देवता
english_translation: Creation, preservation, and destruction arise from me; Brahma acts by my power according to beings' past actions.
essence: Cosmic cycles flow through divine power guided by beings' past actions.
simple_meaning: Creation, preservation, and destruction happen through the divine power. Brahma works by that power following beings' past actions.
insight: Understand that actions have consequences operating within a greater cosmic order beyond individual control.
modern_relevance: When you witness change and cycles in life, recognize a greater force at work guiding events beyond your control.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तत्त्वज्ञानोपदेष्ट्रणामृषीणां चैव सर्वशः।
ब्रह्मैव कुरुते सृष्टिं महामायाप्रभावतः ॥
translation: और 'तत्वज्ञानोपदेशक ऋषियो की, इन सब प्रकार की सृष्टि को ब्रह्माजी ही महामाया के प्रभाव से करते हैं
english_translation: The radiant beings continuously extend the moving and unmoving world by naturally following the flow of actions of the natural world.
essence: Radiant beings sustain the world by naturally following nature’s flow of actions.
simple_meaning: Radiant beings continuously maintain and expand the world by following the natural flow of nature’s actions.
insight: It shows how aligning with natural rhythms supports ongoing growth and stability in life and surroundings.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
इमे मन्मायया भ्रान्ताः सृष्टिचक्रे भ्रमन्त्यहो।
यूयं सर्वेऽपि मन्मायामोहिताः स्थ विशेषतः ॥
translation: अहो ! मेरी माया से भूले हुए ये सब सृष्टिचक्र मे घूमते रहते हैं। आप सब भी मेरी माया से विशेष विमोहित हैं
english_translation: O divine beings! There are born from sprouts, sweat-born, egg-born, womb-born, human, ancestors, and gods.
essence: Life arises through diverse origins across many forms of beings.
simple_meaning: There are many kinds of beings born in different ways: from plants, sweat, eggs, wombs, humans, ancestors, and divine beings.
insight: Recognize the vast array of life forms and origins beyond just human birth.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
सृष्टिचक्रविवेकन्तु निबोधत समाहिताः ।
यमत्र सन्निधौ देवाः ! भवतां प्रब्रवीम्यहम् ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! आपलोगों के समीप जिस सृष्टिचक्र के विवेक को मैं यहाँ कहता हूँ उसको सावधान होकर समझो
english_translation: All sages who teach knowledge of reality agree: the supreme reality alone creates all existence through great illusion.
essence: The supreme reality alone creates all existence through a powerful cosmic illusion.
simple_meaning: All great teachers agree that the supreme reality alone creates the entire universe through a powerful veil of illusion.
insight: It invites you to see beyond appearances and recognize a unified source behind diversity, shifting your view from fragmentation to oneness.
modern_relevance: When you see chaos or separation around you, remember that all things come from a single source shaping appearances like a powerful illusion.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सहस्रयुगपर्यन्तमहर्यद ब्रह्मणो विदुः।
रात्रिं युगसहस्रान्तां तेऽहोरात्रविदो जनाः॥
translation: सहस्त्रयुग पर्यन्त ब्रह्मा का जो एक दिन उसको जो जानते हैं एवं सहस्त्रयुगान्ता जो रात्रि उसको जो जानते हैं, वह लोग अहोरात्रवेत्ता हैं
english_translation: Alas! All these beings wander confused in the cycle of creation by my illusion. You too are especially deluded by my illusion.
essence: Confusion and endless wandering arise from being caught in the divine's illusion.
simple_meaning: All beings are trapped, confused in the cycle of creation due to the divine's illusion, including you especially.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that much confusion comes from unseen illusions shaping perception.
modern_relevance: When you feel stuck in repetitive patterns and confusion, it’s often because unseen illusions shape your view more than you realize.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अव्यक्ताद व्यक्तयः सर्वाः प्रभवन्त्यहगगमे ।
रात्र्यागमे प्रलीयन्ने तत्रैवाव्यत्तसंज्ञके ॥
translation: ब्रह्मा के दिन के आरम्भ में अव्यक्त से सब व्यक्त (चराचर प्राणिमात्र ) प्रादुर्भूत होते हैं एवं ब्रह्मा की रात्रि के प्रारम्भ में उसी अव्यक्तस्वरूप में ही लीन हो जाते हैं
english_translation: O beings of light! Attentively understand here the discernment of the cycle of creation I now explain before you.
essence: Calm, focused attention is essential to understand the cycle of creation.
simple_meaning: Listen carefully with a calm mind to understand the workings of the cycle of creation explained here.
insight: It teaches you to steady your mind to perceive deeper truths beyond surface distractions.
modern_relevance: In a noisy world, pausing with steady focus helps you grasp complex patterns you otherwise miss.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
भूतग्रामः स एवायं भूत्वा भूत्वा प्रलीयते ।
रात्रयागमेऽवशो देवाः ! प्रभवत्यहरागमे ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! वही व्यक्त सचराचर सब प्राणिवर्ग बारम्बार जन्म ग्रहण करके रात्रि के समागम होने पर लीन होते हैं एवं दिन के प्रारम्भ में अपने अपने कर्मादि के वश होकर उत्पन होते हैं
english_translation: Those who know the day of Brahma lasting a thousand yugas and the night ending after a thousand yugas are the true knowers of day and night.
essence: True understanding of day and night comes from grasping vast cosmic time cycles.
simple_meaning: Some people understand that one day and night of Brahma each last thousands of cosmic cycles, showing deeper knowledge of time.
insight: It shifts your mind from short-term urgency to appreciating vast cosmic rhythms and cycles.
modern_relevance: When feeling pressed by daily deadlines, remembering that time flows in immense, repeating cycles can ease pressure and expand perspective.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
परस्तस्मात्तु भावोऽन्योऽव्यक्तो व्यक्तात्सनातनः ।
यः स सर्वेषु भूतेषु नश्यत्स्वपि न नश्यति ॥
translation: किन्तु उस व्यक्तभाव से भी श्रेष्ठ अतीन्द्रिय अनादि जो एकभाव है वह सकल प्राणियों के नष्ट होने पर भी नष्ट नहीं होता है
english_translation: At the start of Brahma's day, all manifest from the unmanifest and return to it at nightfall.
essence: All existence cycles between the unseen unmanifest and the manifest world repeatedly.
simple_meaning: All living beings come into existence from the unmanifest state when Brahma's day begins and dissolve back into it at night.
insight: It shifts your view from clinging to appearances toward seeing all as temporary expressions of a deeper ground.
modern_relevance: You watch the day begin and end, noticing how everything around you appears, changes, and quietly fades away again.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अव्यक्तोऽक्षर इत्युक्तस्तमाहुः परमां गतिम् ।
ये प्राप्य न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम ॥
translation: जो अव्यक्त अर्थात् अतीन्द्रिय भाव अक्षर कहा गया है उसको परम गति अर्थात् परमपुरुषार्थ कहते हैं, जिसको प्राप्त होकर पुनः प्रत्यावर्तित होना नहीं होता है वह मेरा ही परमधाम है।
english_translation: O radiant beings, all living and non-living beings repeatedly take birth, dissolve at nightfall, and arise again with the dawn, driven by their actions.
essence: All beings endlessly dissolve and arise daily, driven by their past actions.
simple_meaning: All beings continually cycle through birth and death, dissolving each night and arising each day, driven by their actions.
insight: Recognize the repetitive cycle of arising and passing beyond your immediate control, shaped by past actions.
modern_relevance: You notice how every day ends and begins anew, like your thoughts and feelings that dissolve and arise without your bidding.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
पुरुषः स परो देवो भक्तया लभ्यस्त्वनन्यया।
यस्यान्तः स्थानि भूतानि येन सर्वमिदं ततम् ॥
translation: हे देव गण! जिसमें भूतगण (प्राणिमात्र) स्थित हैं एवं जो इस सकल जगत् में व्याप्त है वह परमपुरुष एकान्तभक्ति द्वारा ही प्राप्य है
english_translation: Beyond the manifest form, there is another unmanifest eternal state that pervades all beings and does not perish even when they perish.
essence: An eternal, unmanifest essence pervades all beings and never truly disappears.
simple_meaning: There is a timeless, unchanging reality beyond everything that appears, which does not vanish even when all living beings perish.
insight: This verse shifts your focus from fleeting appearances to the unchanging eternal essence within and beyond all life.
modern_relevance: When everything around you changes or disappears, you can find comfort knowing there is a part of you that never fades.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
न च मत्स्थानि भूतानि दृश्यतां योग ऐश्वरः।
भूतभृन्न च भूतस्थो ममात्मा भूतभावनः ॥
translation: मेरे ऐश्वरीय योग को देखो, सकलप्राणी मुझ में अवस्थित होकर भी अवस्थित नहीं हैं अर्थात् मैं उनसे निर्लिप्त हूँ, मैं भूतधारक और भूतपालक हूँ तथापि भूतगण में मैं अवस्थित नहीं हूँ
english_translation: That which is unmanifested and imperishable is called the supreme destination; those who attain it do not return. That supreme abode is mine.
essence: The unchanging, unmanifest supreme state is the final destination where return ceases.
simple_meaning: There is a supreme state beyond all forms and change, eternal and unchanging. Once you reach it, you do not come back to the cycle of change. This supreme state is the highest dwelling, belonging to the divine.
insight: It shifts your view from chasing temporary results to seeking lasting, unchanging presence beyond all appearances.
modern_relevance: When life feels full of constant change and restlessness, knowing there is a final, peaceful place beyond all upheaval brings deep calm and hope.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यथाकाशस्थिनो नित्यं वायुः सर्वत्रगो महान् ।
तथा सर्वाणि भूतानि मत्स्थानीन्युपधार्यताम् ॥
translation: सर्व व्यापी और महान वायु जिस प्रकार आकाश में नित्य स्थित सकल भूत भी वैस ही मुझमें अवस्थित हैं ऐसा समझो
english_translation: The supreme being, within whom all creatures reside and who pervades the entire universe, is attained only through exclusive devotion.
essence: The supreme presence within all is reached only through exclusive devotion.
simple_meaning: The supreme being who lives within all creatures and fills the entire world can only be reached by wholehearted, exclusive devotion.
insight: It shifts your practice from scattered efforts to a focused, exclusive devotion as the key to deeper experience.
modern_relevance: When your heart focuses completely on what matters most, you access a deeper connection beyond distractions.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सर्वभूतानि गीर्वाणाः ! प्रकृति यान्ति मामिकाम् ।
कल्पक्षये पुनस्तानि कल्पादौ विसृजाम्यहम् ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! प्रलयकाल में सब भूतगण मेरी प्रकृति को प्राप्त होते हैं एवं पुनः सृष्टि के प्रारम्भ में मैं उनको उत्पन्न करता हूँ
english_translation: Behold my sovereign yoga: all beings abide in me yet are not truly established in me; I sustain and nurture them but am not established among them.
essence: You can uphold all beings without being established or trapped among them.
simple_meaning: Though everything exists within you and you support all life, you remain detached and not limited by them.
insight: It teaches you to engage fully in supporting life without losing your inner freedom or sense of separateness.
modern_relevance: You care for others deeply but stay centered when emotions and demands try to overwhelm you.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
प्रकृति स्वामवष्टभ्य विसृजामि पुनः पुनः ।
भूतग्राममिमं कृत्स्नमवशं प्रकृतेर्वशात् ॥
translation: मैं अपनी प्रकृति में अधिष्ठान करके स्वभाव वश होकर कर्मादि परवश इन समस्त भूतगण की पुनः पुनः सृष्टि करता रहता हूँ
english_translation: Just as the vast and eternal wind pervades the sky, all beings also dwell in Me.
essence: All beings dwell within the divine as wind dwells eternally in the vast sky.
simple_meaning: All living beings exist within the divine presence just as the wind constantly fills the vast sky.
insight: It shifts your view from separation to recognizing your presence within all things like the omnipresent wind.
modern_relevance: When you feel isolated, remember you are as connected and present everywhere as the wind in the open sky.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
न च मां तानि कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति दिवौकसः ।
उदासीनवदासीनमसक्तं तेषु कर्मसु ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! उन सब कर्मों में अनासक्त और उदासीनवत् अवस्थित मुझको वह सब कर्म बाँध नहीं सकते हैं
english_translation: O divine beings! At the time of dissolution, all beings return to my nature, and at the beginning of creation, I manifest them again.
essence: All beings dissolve into and emerge anew from divine nature in endless cycles.
simple_meaning: All beings dissolve back into the divine nature at the end of a cycle and are recreated by the divine at the next beginning.
insight: It shows the natural rhythm of endings and beginnings, teaching acceptance of change as part of a greater whole.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
मयाऽध्यक्षेण प्रकृतिः सूयते सचराचरम ।
हेतुनाऽनेन वै देवाः ! जगद्विपरिवर्त्तते ॥
translation: मेरे अधिष्ठान से प्रकृति चराचर सहित विश्व को उत्पन्न करती है हे देवगण ! इस कारण जगत् बारम्बार उत्पन्न होता है
english_translation: I establish myself in my own nature and, compelled by it, repeatedly create all these groups of beings through action.
essence: Creation arises naturally from being established in one's own nature, beyond separate will.
simple_meaning: The divine establishes itself in its own nature and, driven by that nature, continuously creates all beings through action.
insight: It shifts your perspective from seeing yourself as a separate doer to recognizing being part of a larger natural process.
modern_relevance: When you act and create repeatedly, it often feels less like your individual choice and more like a natural flow beyond your control.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
न मे विदर्भवन्तो हि प्रभवं न महर्षयः ।
अहमादिहि वो देवाः ! महीणाञ्च सर्वशः ॥
translation: मेरा प्रभव (आविर्भाव) तुमको अवगत नहीं है महर्षिगण को भी अवगत नहीं है क्योंकि मैं हे देवगण ! तुम लोगों का और महर्षिगण का सर्व प्रकार से आदि हूँ
english_translation: O divine beings! Those actions do not bind me, who remain detached and indifferent to them.
essence: You can be fully active yet remain detached and free from binding consequences.
simple_meaning: You can act without being attached or emotionally involved, so those actions do not trap or bind you.
insight: It teaches you to act without emotional investment, separating your identity from outcomes.
modern_relevance: You finish a difficult task but don't obsess over praise or failure; your peace stays intact regardless.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यो मामजमनादिश्च वेति लोकमहेश्वरम् ।
असंमूढः स सर्वत्र सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ॥
translation: जो मुझको अनादि, जन्मरहित, और सकल लोकों का महान् ईश्वर जानता है वह सब जगह मोहरहित होकर सकल पापों से मुक्त हो जाता है
english_translation: Under my guidance, nature creates the moving and unmoving world; for this reason, the world undergoes continual change, O radiant beings.
essence: The world changes endlessly because nature acts under a higher guidance.
simple_meaning: Nature, guided by the divine, creates all life and matter, causing the world to keep changing endlessly.
insight: Recognize that constant change happens through a guiding source beyond what appears, deepening acceptance.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
महर्षयः सप्त पूर्वे चत्वारो मनवस्तथा ।
मद्भावा मानला जाता येषां लोक इमाः प्रजाः ॥
translation: भृगु श्रादि सात महर्षि और उनके पूर्ववर्ती सनकादि चार महर्षि तथा स्वायंभुवादि चौदह मनु ये सभी मेरे प्रभाव से युक्त हैं एवं मेरे हिरण्य गर्भ रूप के सङ्कल्पमात्र से ही उत्पन्न हैं, समस्त संसार के सभी जीव उन्हीं की सृष्टि की हुई प्रजा है
english_translation: Neither the sages nor the Vidarbha folk know my origin; I am the origin of you all and the sages in every way.
essence: The ultimate origin is beyond all knowledge, yet it is the source of all beings.
simple_meaning: No one, including the great sages or the people of Vidarbha, fully knows my origin. I am the source of everything and everyone.
insight: It invites you to accept that some truths about existence are beyond complete human understanding.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
एतां विभूति योगश्च मम यो वेत्ति नत्त्वतः।
सोऽविकम्पेन योगेन युज्यते नात्र संशयः ॥
translation: जो तत्त्वज्ञान के द्वारा मेरी उक्त विभूति एवं योगको जानता है वह अचल समाधि मे युक्त होता है इसमें सन्देह नहीं
english_translation: Whoever understands me as unborn, without beginning, and the great lord of all worlds is freed everywhere from all wrongs.
essence: Seeing the divine as unborn and limitless frees you from all faults everywhere.
simple_meaning: If you understand the divine as eternal and beyond birth, you become free from all faults everywhere.
insight: This shifts your view from seeing life as chained by origins to seeing the divine as an eternal, freeing presence.
modern_relevance: When you stop labeling yourself and others by beginnings or limits, you feel lighter and free from blame or guilt.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
बुद्धिर्ज्ञानमसम्मोहः क्षमा सत्यं दमः शमः ।
सुखं दुःख भवोऽभावो भयञ्चाभयमेव च ॥
translation: बुद्धि, ज्ञान, असम्मोह, क्षमा, सत्य, दम, शम, सुख, दुःख, भव ( उद्भव), अभव (नाश) भय, अभय,
english_translation: Seven great sages, four ancient Manus, and fourteen progenitors arose from my essence; all beings in the world descend from their creation.
essence: All beings arise from divine essence through ancient sages and progenitors.
simple_meaning: Seven great sages, four ancient Manus, and fourteen progenitors were born from the divine essence; all living beings come from their creation.
insight: It reveals the interconnected origin of all beings from a shared divine essence, encouraging reverence for life.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अहिंसा समता तुष्टिः स्तपो दानं यशोऽयशः।
भवन्ति भावा भूतानां मत्त एव पृथविधाः ॥
translation: अहिंसा, समता, तुष्टि, तप, दान, यश, अयश, प्राणियों के ये सब नाना प्रकार के भाव मुझसे ही उत्पन्न होते हैं
english_translation: Whoever knows my manifested powers and yoga through true knowledge is surely established in unwavering absorbed presence without doubt.
essence: Deep knowledge of the divine's power brings unwavering, absorbed steadiness.
simple_meaning: When you truly understand the divine's powers and yoga, you become steady and fully absorbed without doubt.
insight: It teaches you to root your awareness in clear knowledge of the true self, creating steady inner absorption.
modern_relevance: When you fully grasp your own strengths and deeper purpose, you find calm focus even amidst chaos.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अहं सर्वस्य प्रभवो मत्तः सर्व प्रवर्तते।
इति मन्वा भजन्ते मां बुधा भावसमन्विताः ॥
translation: मैं सकल जगत की उत्पत्ति का हेतु हूँ और मुझसे ही सब जगत् प्रवृत्ति को प्राप्त करता है यह जानकर विवेकी गण मेरे भाव को प्राप्त होकर मेरा भजन करते हैं
english_translation: Discerning mind, knowledge, freedom from delusion, patience, truthfulness, self-restraint, tranquility, pleasure, pain, existence, non-existence, fear, and fearlessness.
essence: True clarity embraces patience, truth, and opposite experiences without confusion.
simple_meaning: A clear mind embodies qualities like knowledge, patience, truthfulness, calm, and experiences both pleasure and pain, fear and fearlessness.
insight: It teaches you to recognize both positive and negative experiences without losing your inner balance.
modern_relevance: When your mind races between stress and calm, remembering these qualities helps you steady your thoughts and emotions.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अनादिदेव ! सृष्टीनां कर्तः ! पालक ! हारक! ।
प्रभो ! विश्वनियन्तनः कृपया कथयाऽधुना ॥
translation: हे विश्वनियन्ता ! हे सृष्टि के कर्त्ता पालक और संहारक प्रभो ! अब कृपा करके यह बताइये
english_translation: Non-violence, equanimity, contentment, austerity, charity, fame, and dishonor—all these diverse qualities in beings arise from me alone.
essence: All diverse qualities in beings arise from one divine source within everything.
simple_meaning: Every quality you notice in others or yourself—like kindness, pride, or hardship—originates from the divine source within everything.
insight: It shifts your view to see all experiences as expressions of one underlying reality, removing judgment and fostering acceptance.
modern_relevance: When you feel pride or face criticism, remember both arise from the same inner source, helping you hold balanced perspective.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
इयं सृष्टिः किमाधारा तथाऽस्याः को नियामकः ।
आलम्ब्य कमिमे जीवाः परिणाममयीमिमाम् ॥
translation: कि यह सृष्टि किस आधार पर स्थित है और सृष्टि का नियामक कौन है और किसको अवलम्बन करके इस परिणाममय
english_translation: I am the source of everything; from me, all activity arises. Knowing this, the wise devoted ones worship me with full feeling.
essence: Knowing yourself as the source of all awakens sincere and deep devotion.
simple_meaning: Everything begins from me, and all activity happens through me. Wise people who understand this worship me with sincere feeling.
insight: It shifts your view from isolated effort to seeing your actions as part of a greater source, inspiring genuine devotion.
modern_relevance: When you realize your work and energy come from a deeper source, your efforts become acts of heartfelt devotion, not just tasks.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सृष्टिं जयन्तो वहन्ति प्राप्तुं त्वां मोक्षदायिनं ।
ज्ञानानन्दपदं नित्यं भक्ताभीष्टफलप्रदम् ॥
translation: सृष्टि को जय करते हुए जीव, ज्ञानानन्दप्रद नित्य भक्ताभीष्ट फल प्रद और मोक्ष दायी आपको प्राप्त कर सकते हैं ।
english_translation: O eternal divine! Creator, protector, and destroyer of all creation! O lord, controller of the universe! Please kindly explain now.
essence: Respectful openness invites guidance from the eternal source of creation and change.
simple_meaning: A respectful request is made to the eternal divine, creator, protector, and destroyer, asking for a kind explanation.
insight: It teaches the importance of humility and reverence when seeking profound knowledge or guidance.
modern_relevance: When facing something vast and unclear, starting with respect and openness invites clarity and guidance.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
धर्ममाधारा स्थिता सृष्टि: स एवास्या नियामक: ।
केवलं धर्ममेवैकमाश्रित्य जीवजातयः॥
translation: सृष्टि धर्म के आधारपर स्थित है, सृष्टि का नियामक धर्म ही है और एकमात्र धर्म को ही अवलम्बन करके ये जीवगण
english_translation: What is the foundation of this creation? Who controls it? On whom do living beings depend for this resulting world?
essence: Creation depends on a foundation and controller that living beings rely upon.
simple_meaning: This asks what supports the entire creation, who controls it, and on whom living beings rely.
insight: It encourages shifting from accepting appearances to seeking the deeper underlying reality and its source.
modern_relevance: When everything feels uncertain, you may find yourself asking what truly holds your life and who guides your path.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अग्रेसरा भवन्तीमा मां प्रत्येव न संशयः।
ममानुशासनं धर्म इति तत्त्वविदो विदुः ॥
translation: मेरी ओर ही अग्रसर होते हैं इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। मेरा अनुशासन धर्म है ऐसा तत्त्वज्ञ समझते हैं
english_translation: Living beings who conquer creation can attain you, the giver of liberation, eternal bliss of wisdom, and the desired fruit of devotion.
essence: Overcoming worldly cycles lets you reach the divine who grants eternal joy and devotion’s rewards.
simple_meaning: Those who overcome the cycle of creation can reach the divine who gives lasting freedom, eternal joy from knowledge, and the rewards of devotion.
insight: It encourages you to see devotion as a path to lasting freedom and deep fulfillment beyond immediate circumstances.
modern_relevance: When life feels overwhelming, remember you can connect with something greater that offers lasting joy and fulfillment beyond temporary struggles.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
जगन्नियामिका शक्तिर्धर्मरूपाऽस्ति या मम ।
तया ह्यनन्तब्रह्माण्डान्यनन्ता लोकराशयः ॥
translation: मेरी जगन्नियामिका शक्तिरूप धर्म से अनन्त ब्रह्माण्डसमूह, अनन्त लोकसमूह और
english_translation: The creation stands firmly on dharma; dharma alone governs it. All beings rely solely on dharma.
essence: All creation and life depend solely on living by true purpose.
simple_meaning: Everything that exists depends on dharma, the true purpose or natural order, and all beings live by relying on it.
insight: This shifts your focus from scattered desires to anchoring actions in your deeper purpose, providing clarity and direction.
modern_relevance: When your work, relationships, or choices feel unstable, grounding yourself in your true purpose can create steady strength.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ऋषयः पितरो यूयं स्वस्वस्थान स्थिताः सदा ।
रक्षन्ति सृश्तिखिलामिति जानीत सत्तमा: ! ॥
translation: ऋषि देवता पितृगण अपने अपने स्थान पर सदा स्थित रहकर सम्पूर्ण सृष्टि की रक्षा करते हैं, हे श्रेष्ठ देवगण ! इसको जानो
english_translation: There is no doubt that all who advance turn towards me; true seekers recognize my teaching as dharma.
essence: True seekers naturally turn to the divine’s teaching as their true path.
simple_meaning: Those who sincerely seek the truth naturally turn towards the divine, recognizing this teaching as the true way.
insight: It shifts your trust from external confusion toward the inner certainty found in devoted seeking.
modern_relevance: When you feel lost or uncertain, your genuine desire to find meaning quietly draws you to trustworthy guidance.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
धर्मे धारणरूपा या शक्तिरस्ति दिवौकसः।
तयैव स्वस्वकक्षायामिमे सर्वे स्थिताः सदा ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! मेरी धर्म की धारिका शक्ति द्वारा ही अपनी अपनी कक्षा में सदा स्थित रहते हैं
english_translation: My power that governs the universe is the form of dharma; by it, infinite universes and countless worlds exist.
essence: The power sustaining infinite worlds is dharma, the universal governing force.
simple_meaning: The divine power that controls everything is dharma itself, and through it infinite universes and worlds exist.
insight: Recognize that a universal order underlies all diversity and change, sustaining existence beyond what you see.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ग्रहनक्षत्रप्रमुखा लोका ब्रह्माण्डकानि च ।
तयैव पितरो यूयमृषयश्च तथाऽसुराः ॥
translation: समस्त ब्रह्माण्ड और सभी ग्रह नक्षत्र आदि लोकसमूह और उसी के द्वारा ऋषि, पितृ, आपलोग और अनुरगण भी
english_translation: The sages, deities, and ancestors always remain in their own places, protecting the entire creation, O supreme deities, know this.
essence: Timeless beings remain in place, continuously protecting all creation.
simple_meaning: Sages, deities, and ancestors always stay in their own places and protect all of creation.
insight: Recognize that some protective forces work quietly and constantly beyond your view.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
रक्षन्तः पदमर्यादा स्वीयां लोकानवन्त्यलम् ।
यदा स्वधर्माच्च्यवथ विप्लबो जायते तदा ॥
translation: अपनी अपनी पद मर्यादा की रक्षा करते हुए संसार की रक्षा में भलीभांति प्रवृत्त रहते हैं। आपलोग जब स्वधर्म से च्युत होते हो तभी जगत में विप्लव उपस्थित होता है
english_translation: O divine beings! By the power that sustains dharma, all always remain in their own realm.
essence: A sustaining power maintains all beings in their proper realms through dharma.
simple_meaning: All beings remain constantly in their own respective realms by the power that upholds dharma.
insight: Recognize that an underlying power maintains order and balance beyond individual control.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अत्यन्तं येन लोकेषु नित्यं सीदन्ति प्राणिनः ।
अनन्तकोटिब्रह्माण्डयुक्तदृष्टिप्रवाहकः ॥
translation: जिससे लोकों में प्राणिमात्र नित्य अत्यन्त क्लेश पाते हैं, मुझमें स्थित अनन्तकोटि ब्रह्माण्डयुक्त सृष्टिप्रवाह
english_translation: All the worlds including the cosmos, planets, and stars, along with the sages, ancestors, and radiant beings, are part of that same reality.
essence: All cosmic elements and beings are interconnected parts of one reality.
simple_meaning: The entire cosmos with all its planets, stars, and worlds, along with sages, ancestors, and radiant beings, belong to one interconnected existence.
insight: Recognize all aspects of existence as interconnected parts of one cosmic whole.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
मतिस्थत: केवलं धर्ममेवैकमवल्म्ब्य हि ।
वर्तते धर्म एवातो विश्वधारक ईरितः ॥
translation: एकमात्र धर्म को अवलम्बन करके ही स्थित है इसी कारण धर्म विश्वधारक कहा गया है।
english_translation: By protecting their own ranks and boundaries, beings maintain the world's order; when they forsake their own duty, disorder arises.
essence: Order depends on each person protecting their own rightful duty and place.
simple_meaning: Everyone keeps the world in balance by guarding their own role. When you abandon your duty, chaos follows.
insight: It teaches you to focus on fulfilling your role well to support broader harmony and prevent chaos.
modern_relevance: At work or home, when you stick to your responsibilities, everything flows smoothly; stepping away can cause disruption.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अनन्ता ये ग्रहाः सर्व्ये तथोपग्रहराशयः ।
ब्रह्माण्डशब्दनिर्बाच्यास्तथैवामरपुङ्गवाः !॥
translation: हे देवश्रेष्ठ गण ! अनंत ग्रह उपग्रह्मय ब्रह्माण्ड और
english_translation: I am the flow of creation that sustains countless universes, from which all beings constantly suffer minimal distress.
essence: The divine is the sustaining flow behind infinite universes where beings face ongoing suffering.
simple_meaning: The divine is the sustaining flow behind countless worlds where all living beings experience ongoing suffering.
insight: It reveals the vast, interconnected reality that includes both cosmic grandeur and the persistent challenges for all beings.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
नानावैचित्र्यसंयुक्ता उद्भिज्जस्वेदजाण्डजाः ।
जरायुजा इमे नूनं भूतसङ्काः समीरिनाः ॥
translation: अनन्त विचित्रतापूर्ण उद्विज, स्वदेज, अंडज और जरायुजरुपी चतुर्विध भूतसंघ
english_translation: Only by firmly adhering to the one true dharma does the world remain sustained; that is why dharma is called the support of the universe.
essence: The universe depends on unwavering commitment to one true dharma.
simple_meaning: Everything in the universe stays steady because it follows one true dharma. That is why dharma supports all.
insight: It shifts your view from isolated acts to seeing your steady values as the foundation for all stability.
modern_relevance: When your choices align with your deepest values, you become a steady force others rely on, even if they don’t see it.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सर्वानेतान्वीनिर्देष्टे नियमे परिचाल्यन ।
एक एवाऽस्ति धर्मोऽतो जगतां स नियामकः ॥
translation: इन सबको निर्दिष्ट नियम पर चलने वाला एकमात्र धर्म है इस कारण धर्म को जगन्नियंता कहते हैं ।
english_translation: The infinite planets, their satellites, the entire universe, and the immortal foremost beings.
essence: The cosmos includes endless worlds, their satellites, and immortal exalted beings.
simple_meaning: This verse lists vast cosmic entities like infinite planets, their moons, the universe, and immortal exalted beings.
insight: It expands your sense of scale, inviting awe at the universe's vastness beyond daily concerns.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
प्रकृतेर्मे वशं याता मूढा जीवगणा हि ये।
क्रमशो मां समायान्ति निश्चितं विबुधोत्तमा: ॥
translation: हे देवश्रेष्ठगण ! मेरी प्रकृति के अधीन रहकर मूढ़ जीवगण क्रमशः मुझको निश्चित ही प्राप्त होते हैं
english_translation: Indeed, the beings in the world arise in four diverse forms: those born from sprouts, sweat, eggs, and wombs.
essence: Life manifests in four distinct forms based on origin.
simple_meaning: Living beings arise in four different ways: from plants, sweat, eggs, and wombs.
insight: Recognize that life manifests diversely, beyond a single origin or form.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
विशिष्टचेतना जीवस्तद्वनमेव चाऽऽश्रिता: ।
मां प्रत्यग्रेसराः सन्तो मामेवायान्ति चै क्रमात् ॥
translation: और उसी प्रकार से मुझे ही आश्रय करके विशिष्ट चेतन जीवगण क्रमशः मेरी ओर अग्रसर होते हुए मुझको ही प्राप्त करते हैं।
english_translation: The one duty that governs all is to follow the prescribed rules; thus, this duty is the regulator of the world.
essence: Following your one true duty maintains the order that governs all existence.
simple_meaning: There is one essential duty: to follow the rules that govern everything. This duty maintains order in the world.
insight: It teaches you to see your responsibilities as part of a larger system that keeps life stable.
modern_relevance: When you decide to respect the basic rules at work or in your community, you contribute to a balanced, functioning whole.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अतः कर्म द्विधा मुख्यं सहजं जैवमेव च ।
तस्मात् कर्मविदो धीरा धर्म कर्मेति सजगुः ॥
translation: इसी कारण कर्म सहज और जैव रूप से प्रधानतः दो प्रकार का कहलाता है। कर्म के जानने वाले महापुरुषगण इसी से धर्म को कर्म नाम से अभिहित करते हैं।
english_translation: O best of the devas, the deluded living beings, being under my nature, gradually surely come to me.
essence: Confused beings bound by nature ultimately return to the divine inevitably.
simple_meaning: Deluded living beings, controlled by my nature, gradually and surely come back to me.
insight: It reveals that confusion and delusion do not prevent an ultimate return to the true source.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
एवं यज्ञस्तथा धर्म उभौ पर्यायवाचकौ ।
कथितौ वेद्निष्णतै: शस्त्रज्ञै: शास्त्रविस्तरे ॥
translation: इसी प्रकार यज्ञ और धर्म दोनों को पर्यायवाची शब्द हैं, इस बात को वेदनिष्णात शास्त्रों ने शास्त्र विस्तार में कहा है ।
english_translation: Distinct conscious beings, relying on that sound, gradually move toward me and finally reach only me.
essence: Trusting a higher sound leads conscious beings gradually to the divine presence.
simple_meaning: Conscious beings who rely on the true sacred sound gradually approach and finally reach the divine being.
insight: It teaches you to trust a guiding inner truth that naturally draws you closer to your higher purpose.
modern_relevance: You might feel lost, but trusting a guiding truth or inner voice helps you move steadily toward what truly matters.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सहयज्ञाः मजाः सृष्ट्वा पुरोवाच प्रजापतिः।
अनेन जीवा राध्यन्तामसावस्त्विष्टकामधुक् ॥
translation: सृष्टि के प्रारम्भ में यज्ञक साथ ही साथ प्रजाओं को उत्पन्न करके प्रजापतिने कहा, “ इससे जीवगण आराधना करें, यह उन लोगों का अभीष्ट प्रदानकारी हो"।
english_translation: Therefore, action is chiefly twofold: natural and biological; wise experts call this dharma as action.
essence: Action is both effortless natural flow and life’s biological expression of purpose.
simple_meaning: Action has two main types: natural, which happens effortlessly, and biological, which relates to life itself. Wise people call this dharma, or true purpose, action.
insight: It shifts your view to see purpose as expressed both naturally and biologically through your actions.
modern_relevance: You notice some work flows easily, while other tasks connect deeply to your life’s purpose—both are true action.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
भावयन्तु हि वोऽनेन भवन्तो भावयन्तु तान् ।
परस्परम भावयन्त: श्रेयो देवा: ! अवाप्स्यथ ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! जीवगण इसके द्वारा आपलोगों को सम्बर्द्धित करें और आपलोग उनको सम्बर्द्धित करें इसी प्रकार परस्पर सम्बर्द्धित होकर सभी कल्याण प्राप्त करेंगे ।
english_translation: Similarly, sacrifice and duty are synonymous, as explained in detail by the scripture experts well-versed in the Vedas.
essence: Sacrifice and duty are the same; fulfilling duty is sacred action.
simple_meaning: Sacrifice and duty mean the same thing; experts in the scriptures have explained this clearly.
insight: This shifts your view from seeing duties as chores to acts of spiritual significance.
modern_relevance: When you complete your daily tasks with sincerity, you are performing a meaningful offering beyond mere work.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
इष्टान भोगान् भवन्तो हि दास्यन्ते यज्ञभाविताः।
अदत्त्वा वो भवहत्तान् यो भुंक्ते स्तेन एव सः ॥
translation: आपलोग यज्ञ से  सम्बर्द्धित होकर उनको अभीलाषित भोग प्रदान करेंगे इसलिए आपके दिए भोगों को आपलोगों के अर्पण किए बिना ही जो भोगता है वह चोर ही है
english_translation: At creation's start, Prajapati said: 'Having created sacrifices and beings, let these beings worship; this grants their heartfelt desires.'
essence: Creation began with sacrifice and beings meant to worship for their desires.
simple_meaning: In the beginning, Prajapati created sacrifices and beings, instructing that beings worship through sacrifice to receive their desires.
insight: It highlights how early teachings linked action (sacrifice) with intention to shape outcomes.
speaker: Prajapati

verse_text:
यज्ञशिष्टाशिनः सन्तो मुच्यन्ते सर्वकिल्विषः।
भुजते ते त्वधं पापा ये पचन्सात्मकारणात् ॥
translation: यज्ञ का अवशिष्ट भोजन करने वाले सज्जनगण सब पापों से मुक्त हो जाते हैं किन्तु जो अपने ही लिये भोजन बनाते हैं वे पापिगण पाप को ही भोजन करते हैं
english_translation: O radiant beings! By mutually honoring each other, you all will attain higher well-being together.
essence: Mutual honoring among beings creates shared growth and well-being.
simple_meaning: You should honor others and let them honor you in return; this mutual respect brings greater well-being for all.
insight: It teaches you to see others' success as intertwined with your own, promoting a cycle of mutual support.
modern_relevance: You notice how a simple act of appreciation from a colleague brightens your day, and your kindness inspires theirs right back.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अन्नाद् भवन्ति भूतानि पर्जन्यादन्नसम्भवः।
यज्ञाद् भवति पर्जन्यो यज्ञः कर्मसमुद्भवः ॥
translation: जीव समूह अन्न से उत्पन्न होते हैं, अन्न वृष्टि होने से उत्पन्न होता है और यज्ञ से वृष्टि होती है एवं यज्ञ कर्म द्वारा सम्पन्न होता है।
english_translation: Those who are devoted to sacrifice receive the desired enjoyments; anyone who enjoys without offering is indeed a thief.
essence: Receiving is rightful only when preceded by sincere offering.
simple_meaning: Enjoyments come to those who offer with devotion. Taking without giving is like stealing.
insight: It teaches you to honor the natural cycle of giving before receiving, fostering fairness and integrity.
modern_relevance: When you take from others without contributing, it leaves a sense of imbalance and guilt, unlike when you give first with respect.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
कर्म ब्रह्मोद्भवं वित्त ब्रह्माक्षरसमुद्भवम् ।
तस्मात् सर्वगतं ब्रह्म नित्यं यज्ञे प्रतिष्ठितम ॥
translation: कर्म को ब्रह्म (वेद ) द्वारा उत्पन्न समझो और ब्रह्म (वेद) अक्षर (ब्रह्म) से उत्पन्न है इसलिये सर्वव्यापी ब्रह्म यज्ञ में नित्य प्रतिष्ठित है ।
english_translation: Those who eat the remnants of yajna are freed from all faults; but those who cook only for themselves consume sin itself.
essence: Sharing sacred offerings frees you; selfish cooking keeps you bound by harm.
simple_meaning: Eating food offered in sacred rituals frees you from faults. Cooking only for yourself leads to harm.
insight: It teaches you to find freedom by acting with generosity rather than serving only your own desires.
modern_relevance: You prepare a meal just for yourself, skipping sharing. You feel a quiet heaviness, unlike the lightness you notice when you give food or help others.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
एवं प्रवर्तितं चक्रं नानुवर्त्तयतीह यः।
अघायुरिन्द्रियारामो मोघं देवाः ! स जीवति ॥
translation: इस लोक में जो इस प्रकार प्रवर्तित चक्र का अनुसरण नहीं करता है, हे देवगण ! इंद्रियासक्त पापजीवन वह व्यक्ति व्यर्थ जीता है ।
english_translation: Living beings arise from food; food comes from rain; rain arises from sacrifice; and sacrifice is born of action.
essence: Your actions start a chain that sustains all life through sacrifice, rain, and food.
simple_meaning: All living things depend on a cycle: your actions create sacrifice, which brings rain, which grows food, which sustains life.
insight: It teaches you to see your actions as part of a larger natural cycle sustaining life.
modern_relevance: When you choose to act responsibly, you help sustain not just yourself but the entire ecosystem around you.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
दैवमेवापरे यज्ञं योगिन: पर्ययृपास्ते।
ब्रह्माग्नादपरे यज्ञं यज्ञेनैवोपजुह्वति ॥
translation: कितने योगिगण देवयज्ञ की ही उपासना करते हैं, कोई कोई यज्ञरूप उपाय द्वारा ब्रह्मरूपी अग्नि में यज्ञ को सम्पन्न करते हैं
english_translation: Action originates from the supreme teachings and the supreme teachings arise from the imperishable supreme reality; therefore, the all-pervading supreme reality is eternally established in sacrifice.
essence: All actions arise from an eternal supreme reality present in sacred practice.
simple_meaning: All actions arise from supreme teachings, which themselves come from the eternal supreme reality, and this reality is always present in the act of sacrifice.
insight: It teaches you to see your actions as expressions of a deeper, eternal reality that transcends daily outcomes.
modern_relevance: When you commit to your work or service deeply, you participate in a timeless flow that connects you to something greater than yourself.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
श्रोतादीनीन्द्रियाष्यन्ते संयमाग्निषु जुह्वति ॥
शब्ददीन विषयानन्ये इन्द्रियाग्निषु जुह्वति ॥
translation: और कोई योगी संयमरूपी अग्नि में अपनी श्रवण आदि इन्द्रियों का हवन करते हैं और कितने योगिगण इन्द्रियरूपी अग्नि में शब्द आदि विषयों को हवन करते हैं
english_translation: In this world, one who does not follow the established cycle, O radiant beings, lives a wasted life bound by senses and wrongdoing.
essence: Ignoring your natural path leads to a restless, empty life.
simple_meaning: Living without following your natural role and inner cycle leads to a wasted life of restless desire and harm.
insight: It teaches you to recognize when you are off your true path and to realign with your natural responsibilities.
modern_relevance: You may find yourself caught in distractions or habits that feel good but leave you empty, missing what truly matters.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सर्वाणीन्द्रियकर्माणि प्राणकर्माणि चापरे ।
आत्मसंयमयोगाग्नौ जुह्वति ज्ञानदीपिते ॥
translation: कितने योगिगण ज्ञान के द्वारा प्रज्वालित आत्मसंयमरूप योगाग्नि में सम्पूर्ण इन्द्रियकर्म और प्राणकर्मों का हवन करते हैं
english_translation: Some yogis worship the divine sacrifice; others complete the sacrifice by offering it into the supreme fire of Brahman.
essence: Offering to the divine or merging with the supreme reality both fulfill the sacred act.
simple_meaning: Some yogis worship the divine presence itself, while others offer their sacrifice directly into the supreme reality, completing it through that union.
insight: It shifts the mind from separate acts of worship to a deeper union with the greater reality behind all devotion.
modern_relevance: When you give your effort, you might focus on honoring what inspires you or fully merge your work into a greater purpose that transcends individual acts.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
द्रव्ययज्ञास्तपोयज्ञा योगयज्ञास्तथाऽपरे।
स्वाध्यायज्ञानयज्ञाश्च यतयः संशितव्रताः ॥
translation: कोई कोई द्रव्यदानरूपी यज्ञ, कोई तपोयज्ञ और कोई योगयज्ञ के अनुष्ठाता है तथा नियम में दृढ़ रहने वाले यतिगण स्वाध्याय और ब्रह्मज्ञानरूपी यज्ञ का अनुष्ठान करते हैं।
english_translation: Some yogis offer their senses like hearing into the fire of restraint, and many others offer objects like sound into the fire of the senses.
essence: Discipline is offering senses and their objects into a fire that burns distraction and craving.
simple_meaning: You can practice self-control by offering your senses and the objects they perceive into the fire of restraint, reducing distraction.
insight: It teaches you to use discipline as a fire that consumes distractions by consciously managing senses and their objects.
modern_relevance: When notifications and sounds pull your attention everywhere, choosing to focus is like offering your senses into a calming fire of control.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
आपने जुह्वति प्राणं प्राणेऽपानं तथाऽपरे।
प्राणापानगती रुद्ध्वा प्राणायामपरायणाः ॥
translation: अन्य कोई कोई अपान में प्राण और प्राण में अपान का हवन करते हैं और इस प्रकार से प्राण अपान की गति को जय करके प्राणायाम परायण हो जाते हैं
english_translation: Many yogis offer all sensory and life-force actions as a sacrifice into the fire of self-discipline kindled by wisdom.
essence: Wisdom lights the fire of self-discipline that transforms all your actions.
simple_meaning: You can transform all your bodily and breath actions by offering them into self-discipline fueled by wisdom.
insight: It teaches you to use wisdom to ignite self-control, turning every action into a conscious practice.
modern_relevance: When you focus your mind with clear understanding, even restless impulses and habits can be transformed into deliberate, meaningful actions.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अपरे नियताहाराः प्राणान् प्राणेषु जुह्वति।
सर्वेऽप्येते यज्ञविदो यज्ञक्षपितकल्मपाः ॥
translation: अन्य कोई कोई नियताहारी होकर प्राण में प्राण को हवन करते हैं। यज्ञ के द्वारा निष्पाप, सभी यज्ञवेत्ता
english_translation: Some perform sacrifices of material gifts, some perform sacrifices of disciplined austerity, some perform sacrifices of yoga, and some steadfast ascetics perform sacrifices of self-study and knowledge of the supreme reality.
essence: Dedication to the divine takes many sincere forms, all are valid sacrifices.
simple_meaning: People honor the divine in different ways: giving gifts, practicing austerity, doing yoga, or studying sacred knowledge with firm commitment.
insight: It teaches you to recognize and respect diverse forms of sincere spiritual effort without judging one as better than another.
modern_relevance: You might see people showing commitment differently—some by donating, some by sticking to tough habits, some by meditating, others by learning deeply.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यज्ञशिष्टामृतमुजो यान्ति ब्रह्म सनातनम् ।
नायं लोकोऽस्त्ययज्ञस्य कुतोऽन्यस्त्रिदिवौकसः ! ॥
translation: यज्ञ का अवशिष्ट अमृत भोजन करने वाले सनातन ब्रह्म को ही प्राप्त होते हैं। हे देवतागण ! जो लोग यज्ञानुष्ठान से रहित हैं न उनका इहलोक है और न उनका परलोक ही है
english_translation: Some offer the life force into the downward breath or the downward breath into the life force, controlling the flow between them and dedicating themselves to breath control.
essence: Controlling breath directs your vital energy and deepens your focused discipline.
simple_meaning: You can offer your energy by controlling the flow between your inward life force and outward breath, dedicating yourself to breath control.
insight: It teaches you to channel scattered energy by mastering the natural rhythm between inhalation and exhalation.
modern_relevance: When you pause and focus on your breathing during stress, you engage this ancient practice of balancing inner energy and breath.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
एवं बहुविधा यज्ञा वितता ब्रह्मणो मुखे।
कर्मजान वित्त तान् सनिवं ज्ञात्वा विमोक्ष्यते ॥
