translation: ब्रह्म के जानने वालों के मुख से इस प्रकार से बहुप्रकार के यज्ञो का विस्तार हुआ है उन सबको कर्म से उत्पन्न जानो, ऐसा जानकर तुम मुक्ति को प्राप्त होगे
english_translation: Some, disciplined in their habits, offer life force into life force. All these knowledgeable in sacrifice are free from faults through sacrifice.
essence: Steady, disciplined action purifies faults and renews your inner life force.
simple_meaning: People who maintain steady habits offer their life force through disciplined action, which cleanses their faults.
insight: It shifts your focus from sporadic effort to consistent, disciplined practice as the path to inner cleansing.
modern_relevance: You keep a daily routine—whether meditation, exercise, or work—that gradually clears your stress and self-doubt without dramatic effort.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
श्रेयान् द्रव्यमयाद यज्ञान ज्ञानयज्ञोऽमृतान्धसः ।
सर्व कर्माग्विलं देवाः ! ज्ञाने परिसमाप्यते ॥
translation: हे अमृत भोजी देवतागण ! द्रव्यमय यज्ञ से ज्ञानयज्ञ श्रेष्ठ है क्योंकि ज्ञान में ही सब कर्मों की पूर्णरूप से परि समाप्ति हुआ करती है
english_translation: Only the eternal supreme reality attains the immortal nectar left from sacrifice; those without sacrifice have neither this world nor the higher realm.
essence: True sacrifice is the gateway to eternal fulfillment and higher realms.
simple_meaning: Only those who engage in true sacrifice receive the immortal essence and reach the eternal supreme reality. Without sacrifice, neither this world nor the higher realm is accessible.
insight: It teaches you that engaging earnestly in selfless acts connects you to lasting reality beyond transient experience.
modern_relevance: You give your time and energy to a cause bigger than yourself; this offering nourishes your deepest fulfillment and connection beyond daily life.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अश्रद्दधाना जीवा वै धर्मस्यास्य सुधाशनाः !।
अप्राप्य मां निवर्तन्ते मृत्युसंसारवमनि ॥
translation: हे सुधा के पान करने वाले देवतागण ! इस धर्म में अश्रद्धा करने वाले जीवगण मुझको न प्राप्त करके मृत्युमय संसारमार्ग में लौट आते हैं
english_translation: From the mouths of those who know the supreme reality, many types of sacrifices have been declared; knowing all these arise from action, you will attain freedom.
essence: Understanding that all sacred acts originate in action leads to genuine freedom.
simple_meaning: Many kinds of sacred actions come from the supreme reality. When you understand these actions arise from effort, you gain freedom.
insight: It teaches you to see all results as products of your actions, which shifts focus from attachment to understanding.
modern_relevance: You notice how every project, task, or relationship unfolds from your actions. Realizing this gives you control and peace beyond outcomes.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
त्रविद्या मां सोमपाः पृतपापा: यज्ञैरिष्टा स्वर्गतिं प्रार्थयनते ।
ते पुण्यमासाद्य सुरेन्द्रलोक पश्नन्ति दिव्यान दिवि देवभोगान ॥
translation: वेदत्रय के अनुसार कर्मकाण्डपरायण  सकामकर्मीगण यज्ञ द्वारा मेरा यजन करके यज्ञ शेषरूपी सोमपान करते हुए और निष्पाप होते हुए स्वर्गगति की प्रार्थना करते हैं, वे लोग पुण्यस्वरूप इन्द्रलोक में पहुंच कर वहां दिव्य देवभोग समूह भोग करते हैं।
english_translation: O immortal enjoyers among the radiant beings! The sacrifice of knowledge is superior to the sacrifice of material wealth because through knowledge all actions come to complete fulfillment.
essence: Knowledge completes all actions more fully than material offerings.
simple_meaning: Offering knowledge is better than offering material things because knowledge brings all actions to their full completion.
insight: It shifts your focus from external offerings to cultivating inner understanding to fulfill your efforts.
modern_relevance: You’ve worked hard and given your time, but understanding your purpose brings deeper completion than material achievement alone.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ते तं भुक्त्वा स्वर्गलोकं विशालं क्षीणे पुण्ये मर्त्यलोकं विशन्ति ।
एवं त्रयीधर्ममनुभपन्ना गतागतं कामकामा लभन्ते ॥
translation: वे उन विपुल स्वर्ग सुख समूह को भोग करने के अनन्तर पुण्य क्षीण होने पर मृत्युलोक में लौट आते हैं और वेदत्रयविहित धर्मों को अवलम्बन करके भोग की इच्छा करते हुए आवागमन चक्र में आया जाया करते हैं
english_translation: Those without faith in this dharma do not reach me and return to the death-bound cycle of existence.
essence: Without trust in the path, you cannot reach the true self and remain trapped in suffering.
simple_meaning: Those who lack trust in this teaching fail to reach the divine and return to endless suffering.
insight: It teaches you that trust is not optional—it unlocks progress toward the true self, while doubt keeps you trapped.
modern_relevance: You hesitate to fully commit to a new path, and so you find yourself stuck repeating old painful patterns.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अहं हि सर्वयज्ञानां भोक्ता च प्रभुरेव च ।
न तु मामभिजानन्ति तत्त्वेनातश्च्यवान्त ते ॥
translation: मैं ही सभी यज्ञो का भोक्ता और प्रभु हूँ परन्तु वे लोग मेरे यथार्थ स्वरूप को नहीं जानते हैं इस कारण उनकी पुनरावृत्ति होती है।
english_translation: According to the three Vedas, those devoted to ritual acts perform sacrifices and drink the Soma; being free of sin, they seek heavenly realms and enjoy divine pleasures among the gods.
essence: Ritual actions bring heavenly rewards but do not lead to ultimate freedom.
simple_meaning: People who follow ritual acts perform sacrifices and drink Soma to become pure and seek to reach heaven, where they enjoy divine pleasures.
insight: It highlights the ritual path's temporary goals and rewards, contrasting with deeper spiritual freedom.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
सम्पत्तिमासुरी प्राहुग्धर्मस्य विवर्द्धिनीम्।
धर्मप्रवर्द्धिनी देवी सम्पत्तिं तद्वदेव हि ॥
translation: आसुरी सम्पत्ति को अधर्म वर्द्धिनी कहते हैं और उसी प्रकार दैवी सम्पत्ति को धर्मवर्द्धिका कहते हैं
english_translation: After enjoying the vast pleasures of the higher realm, when their virtue is exhausted, they return to the mortal world and, following the threefold duties, repeatedly come and go driven by desire.
essence: Desire causes repeated returns to the mortal world despite enjoying higher pleasures.
simple_meaning: After enjoying happiness in the higher realm, when their merit ends, they return to the mortal world and keep coming back driven by desire, following prescribed duties.
insight: It reveals how desire fuels repeated cycles of action and consequence, even after experiencing joy and rest.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
तस्मात्सोव्वौर्हि युष्माभिर्देवैः श्रेयोऽभिकाङ्गिभिः।
कर्तव्य आश्रयो दैव्याः सम्पत्तेरेव सर्वदा ॥
translation: इस कारण सर्वदा कल्याण चाहने वाले आप सबको दैवी सम्पत्ति का ही आश्रय लेना उचित है
english_translation: I am indeed the recipient and lord of all sacrifices, yet they do not truly know my real nature, and thus they fall back into repetition.
essence: Not knowing the divine nature behind actions causes endless repetitive cycles.
simple_meaning: The divine is the true recipient of all sacrifices and actions, but people fail to recognize this reality, causing them to repeat their cycles.
insight: This shifts your focus from external rituals or results to recognizing the deeper presence behind all your actions.
modern_relevance: You keep repeating the same mistakes or habits, unaware that you have not yet seen the deeper truth behind your actions.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अभयं सत्त्वसंशुद्धिर्ज्ञानयोगव्यवस्थितिः ।
दानं दमश्च यज्ञश्च स्वाध्यायस्तप आर्जवम् ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! भयशून्यता, चित्त की प्रसन्नता, आत्मज्ञान के उपायों में निष्ठा, दान, इन्द्रिय संयम, यज्ञ, स्वाध्याय, तप, सरलता,
english_translation: Wealth associated with ego is called adharma-increasing, while divine wealth is called dharma-increasing.
essence: Wealth either increases ego and confusion or supports righteous growth and purpose.
simple_meaning: There are two kinds of wealth: one that grows ego and leads away from your true purpose, and one that supports and increases righteous living.
insight: You learn to distinguish between possessions that strengthen your purpose and those that inflate ego, shifting how you relate to success.
modern_relevance: You might receive money or success that either fuels your pride and anxiety or supports your values and well-being.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अहिंसा सत्यम क्रोधस्त्याग: शांतिरपैशुनम ।
दया भूतेप्वलोलुप्त्वं मार्द्द्वं ह्रीरचापलम ॥
translation: अहिंसा, सत्य, क्रोध का न होना, त्याग, शान्ति, खलता का त्याग, सब प्राणियों पर दया, लोभ का त्याग, अहंकार का त्याग ही अर्थात् पापकर्म से लज्जा, चपलता का त्याग,
english_translation: Therefore, you all who desire well-being should always rely on divine qualities alone.
essence: True well-being always rests on relying on divine qualities alone.
simple_meaning: You should always depend only on divine qualities to achieve true well-being and success.
insight: It shifts focus from chasing fleeting external comforts to cultivating reliable inner qualities for well-being.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by temporary solutions, you remember that true support comes from your inner strength and values.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तेज: क्षमा धृति: शौचमद्रोहो नातिमानिता ।
भवन्ति सम्पदं दैवीयभिजातस्य निर्जराः! ॥
translation: तेजस्विता, क्षमा, धैर्य, शौच, द्रोह का त्याग और अपने पूज्य होने के अभिमान का अभाव, यह सभी धर्मवृत्तियाँ दैवी संपत्ति वाले व्यक्तियों मे हुआ करती है
english_translation: O divine beings, fearlessness, purity of mind, steady practice of knowledge yoga, charity, self-control, sacrifice, study of scriptures, austerity, and straightforwardness are qualities to cultivate.
essence: Steady courage, generosity, and self-control together build true inner discipline.
simple_meaning: Fearlessness, purity of mind, steady wisdom practice, generosity, control of senses, sacrifice, study, austerity, and honesty help you grow in discipline.
insight: It teaches you to strengthen yourself through balanced courage, generosity, and steady inner work.
modern_relevance: You commit to daily habits like honest effort, learning, and kindness that quietly shape your character over time.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
दम्भो दर्पोऽभिमानश्च क्रोधः पारुष्यमेव च ।
अज्ञानञ्चाभिजातस्य देवाः ! सम्पदमासुरीम् ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! दम्भ, दर्प, अहङ्कार, क्रोध, निष्ठुरता, अविवेक, ये सब पाप सम्बन्धीय वृत्तियां बासुरी सम्पत्ति वाले व्यक्तियों में हुआ करती हैं
english_translation: Non-violence, truthfulness, absence of anger, renunciation, peace, giving up malice, compassion for all beings, freedom from greed, humility, shame of wrongful acts, and abandoning restlessness.
essence: True discipline is letting go of harmful emotions and embracing kindness and peace.
simple_meaning: Living with kindness, truth, peace, and compassion means letting go of anger, greed, and restlessness.
insight: It shifts your focus from reacting with anger or desire to cultivating gentleness and peacefulness in daily actions.
modern_relevance: After a tense argument, you choose calmness and kindness instead of holding onto anger or resentment.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
दैवी सम्पद्विमोक्षाय निबन्धायासुरी मता।
नैव शोचत भो देवाः ! दैवी सम्पदमास्थिताः ॥
translation: देवी सम्पत्तियां मोक्ष का कारण होती हैं और आसुरी सम्पत्तियां बन्धन का कारण हुआ करती है। इस कारण हे देवतागण ! आपलोग चिन्ता ही न करो क्योंकि आपलोग देवी सम्पत्ति में स्थित हो
english_translation: Radiance, forgiveness, patience, purity, renouncing betrayal, and absence of pride in being revered are qualities born in those with divine nature.
essence: Steadfast virtues like patience and humility arise naturally in those with divine nature.
simple_meaning: Certain noble qualities like patience, forgiveness, purity, avoiding betrayal, and humility naturally arise in those connected to the divine nature.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate steady virtues that build inner strength and steady your character.
modern_relevance: In a heated argument, choosing forgiveness and humility helps you stay steady and respected, even when others react harshly.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
द्वौ भूतसर्गाौ लोकेऽस्मिन् दैव आसुर एव च।
देवो विस्तरशः प्रोक्त आसुरं शृणुतामराः ॥
translation: हे अमरगण ! इस संसार के प्राणियों में देवीभाव और आसुरीभाव रूप से दो प्रकार की सृष्टि है। इनमे से दैवी भाव का विस्तारित विवरण कहा गया है अब आसुरी भाव का विवरण मुझसे सुनो
english_translation: O divine beings! Hypocrisy, pride, ego, anger, harshness, and ignorance are qualities found in those attached to lower tendencies.
essence: Harsh emotions reveal attachment to lower, restless tendencies, not your true self.
simple_meaning: Pride, ego, anger, harshness, and ignorance are signs of a disturbed mind caught in lower tendencies.
insight: It teaches you to notice harsh emotions as signals of deeper confusion, inviting you to detach and observe.
modern_relevance: When you snap at a loved one or feel proud to prove a point, these feelings reveal your mind’s unrest and block your deeper peace.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
प्रत्तिञ्च निवृत्तिञ्च जना न विदुरासुराः।
न शौचं नापि चाचारो न सत्यं तेषु विद्यते ॥
translation: आसुरी प्रकृत्ति वाले व्यक्तिगण प्रवृत्ति और निवृत्ति दोनों को नहीं जानते हैं इस कारण उनमें न शौच है न आचार है और न सत्य है।
english_translation: Divine qualities lead to freedom, while demonic qualities cause bondage. So, beings of light, do not grieve, for you abide in divine qualities.
essence: Freedom arises from divine qualities; bondage comes from shadow qualities.
simple_meaning: Divine qualities lead to freedom, while demonic qualities cause bondage. You should not worry because you possess divine qualities.
insight: It shifts focus from fearing negative traits to recognizing and resting in your inherent freedom.
modern_relevance: When you feel trapped by your darker impulses, remember your true qualities are freeing and can guide you beyond limitation.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
असत्यमप्रतिष्ठञ्च जगदाहुरनीश्वरम् ।
अपरस्परसंभूतं किमन्यत कामहैूतुकम ॥
translation: वे असुरमावापन्न लोग कहते हैं कि यह जगत् असत्य है,धर्म अधर्म व्यवस्थाशून्य अप्रतिष्ठ है, ईश्वर शून्य है, विनापरम्परा सम्बन्ध के यही अचानक उत्पन्न हुआ है, इसका और कुछ भी कारण नहीं है केवल स्त्री पुरुष के काम से उत्पन्न हैं
english_translation: O immortal beings! In this world, there are two kinds of beings: divine and shadowy. The detailed description of the divine nature has been given; now listen to the description of the shadowy nature from me.
essence: The world contains two kinds of beings: divine and shadowy, each with distinct qualities.
simple_meaning: There are two kinds of beings in the world: those with divine qualities and those with shadowy qualities. The divine side has been explained; now the shadowy side will be described.
insight: It prepares you to see the world as a balance of opposing qualities, not just one-sided.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
एतां दृष्टिमवष्टभ्य नष्टात्मानोऽल्पबुद्धयः ।
प्रभवन्त्युग्रकर्माणः क्षयाय जगतोऽहिताः ॥
translation: यह सब अल्पबुद्धि असुरगण ऐसे विचारों को प्राश्रय करके मलिनचित्त उग्रकर्मा और अहितकारी होकर जगत के नाश के लिये उत्पन्न होते हैं
english_translation: Beings of shadow nature do not understand activity or cessation; in them are no purity, conduct, or truth.
essence: Lack of understanding both action and resting causes loss of purity, conduct, and truth.
simple_meaning: Beings driven by ego and confusion neither understand how to act rightly nor how to stop; they lack purity, proper conduct, and truth.
insight: It teaches you to recognize the importance of balancing activity with rest to maintain clarity and truthfulness.
modern_relevance: When you rush without pause or avoid necessary action, you lose touch with integrity and honesty in your life.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
कामाश्रित दुष्पूरं दम्भमानम्दान्विता: ।
मोहादगृहीत्वा सद्ग्राहान प्रवर्तन्तेऽशुचिव्रता: ॥
translation: वे लोग पूर्ण नहीं होने वाली कामनाओं को आश्रय लेकर, दम्भ अभिमान और गर्व से युक्त होकर, मोह से दुराग्रहों को धारण करने अपवित्र व्रतों को करते हुए अकार्यों मे प्रवृत हुआ करते हैं
english_translation: Those who have fallen into ignorance say the world is unreal, without order or the divine, spontaneously born only from desire and union, with no other cause.
essence: The world is not merely a random product of desire; it has a deeper foundation.
simple_meaning: Some say the world is unreal and only arose from desire without any deeper cause or divine order.
insight: It shifts the mind from seeing the world as meaningless chance to recognizing a deeper structure beyond desire.
modern_relevance: When chaos and confusion hit, it’s easy to think everything is random and meaningless, but deeper order often exists beneath the surface.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
चिन्तामपरिमेयाञ्च प्रलयान्तामुपाश्रिताः।
कामोपभोगपरमा एतावदिति निश्चिताः ॥
translation: मरणकाल पर्यन्त व्यापिनी अपरिमित चिन्ता को आश्रय करते हुए कामभोग परायण होकर "यह कामभोग ही परमपुरुषार्थ है" ऐसा निश्चय करते हुए
english_translation: Those with limited understanding, embracing such views, become restless doers harming the world’s well-being and leading to its decay.
essence: Limited understanding fuels harmful actions that damage the world’s wellbeing.
simple_meaning: Holding onto wrong ideas leads to harmful actions that damage others and the world.
insight: It teaches you to recognize how harmful beliefs fuel destructive behavior, urging a clearer, disciplined mind.
modern_relevance: When you fixate on narrow, negative thoughts, you might act out in ways that hurt your relationships or community without realizing it.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
आशापाशशतैर्बद्धाः कामक्रोधपरायणाः।
ईहन्ते कामभोगार्थमन्यायेनार्थ संचयान ॥
translation: सैकड़ों आशारूपी पाशों में बंधकर और काम क्रोध परायण होते हुए, वह लोग कामभोग के लिये अन्यायपूर्वक अर्थ संचय की इच्छा करते हैं
english_translation: People who cling to unfulfillable desires, filled with pride and arrogance, hold on to wrong attachments out of confusion, and engage in impure practices.
essence: Clinging to impossible desires fuels pride and confusion, leading to harmful attachments.
simple_meaning: Holding on to desires that can never be fulfilled creates pride and confusion, leading you to harmful attachments and impure actions.
insight: Recognize when your desires are unrealistic and how pride from unmet wants fuels harmful attachments; then shift focus to realistic, wholesome aims.
modern_relevance: You chase goals that feel out of reach, building pride when you achieve little, and cling to habits that don’t serve you, causing frustration.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
इदमद्य माया लब्धमिदं प्राप्स्ये मनोरथम ।
इदमस्तीदमपि मे भविष्यति पुनर्धनम ॥
translation: आज मुझे यह लाभ हुआ, यह मनोरथ प्राप्त होगा, मेरा यह धन है,  और यह धन भी मेरा होगा,
english_translation: They rely on endless worries until death, certain that satisfying desires is the highest goal.
essence: Endless worry and desire are mistaken for the highest purpose until life ends.
simple_meaning: Many live absorbed in endless worry, believing that fulfilling desires is life's highest achievement.
insight: It shifts your view from chasing desires as the highest aim to questioning what truly matters beyond worry.
modern_relevance: You scroll endlessly through social media, chasing likes and desires, convinced this will bring lasting happiness.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
असौ मया इतः शत्रुहनिध्ये चापरानपि ।
ईश्वरोऽहमहं भोगी सिद्धोऽहं बलवान् मुखी ॥
translation: मेरे द्वारा इस शत्रु का नाश हुआ है, और शत्रुओ का भी नाश करूंगा, मैं ईश्वर हूँ, मैं भोगी हूँ, मैं सिद्ध हूँ, मैं बलवान् हूँ, मैं सुखी हूँ,
english_translation: Bound by hundreds of chains of desire and driven by craving and anger, they wrongly accumulate wealth for sensual pleasures.
essence: Desire and anger trap you in wrongful craving for fleeting pleasure.
simple_meaning: People get trapped by many desires and driven by craving and anger, wrongly gathering wealth just for pleasure.
insight: Recognize how desire and anger fuel harmful, endless seeking; shifting focus frees your energy.
modern_relevance: You might find yourself chasing more money or status out of frustration or craving, losing sight of what truly matters.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
आढयोऽभिजनवानसमि कोऽन्योऽस्ति सद्र्श्यो मया ।
यक्ष्ये दास्यामि मोदिष्य इत्यज्ञानविमोहिताः ॥
translation: मैं धनवान् हूँ, मैं कुलीन हूँ, मेरे समान और कौन है, मैं यज्ञ करूंगा, मैं दान करूंगा, मैं हर्षको प्राप्त होऊंगा इस प्रकार से वे अज्ञान से विमोहित व्यक्तिगण
english_translation: Today I have gained this, I will obtain this desire, this wealth is mine, and this wealth will be mine again.
essence: Attachment to gains and desires binds the mind to temporary possessions.
simple_meaning: The speaker talks about having gained something today and expecting to gain more, considering wealth and desires as possessions.
insight: It highlights how clinging to possessions and expecting more can anchor the mind in temporary gains.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अनेकचित्तविभ्रान्ता मोहजाल समावृता
प्रसक्ताः कामभोगेषु पतन्ति नरकेऽशुचौ ॥
translation: अनेक विषयों में अपने चित्त को फसाये हुए विक्षिप्त रहते हैं और मोहमय जाल से श्रावृत होकर और कामभोग में आसक्त होकर अपवित्र नरक में पड़ते हैं
english_translation: I have destroyed this enemy, and I will destroy other enemies too; I am the lord, the enjoyer, the accomplished, the strong, the joyful.
essence: A victorious being declares strength and joy after defeating enemies.
simple_meaning: The speaker declares having defeated one enemy and intends to defeat others, claiming to be powerful, accomplished, and joyful.
insight: It shows a moment of triumph and self-assurance but does not offer a broader teaching for personal growth.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
आत्मसम्भाविताः स्तब्धा धनमानमदान्विताः।
यजन्ते नामयज्ञैस्ते दम्भेनाविधिपूर्वकम् ॥
translation: अपने आप को ही बड़े और पूज्य मानते हुए, अविनयी, धनादिक के अभिमान से अभिमानित और गर्वित होकर वह दम्भ के साथ नाममात्र के यज्ञो द्वारा अविधिपूर्वक यजन किया करते हैं
english_translation: I am wealthy, I am noble, who else is like me? I will perform sacrifices, I will give gifts, I will be joyful — thus deluded by ignorance.
essence: Pride in wealth and status deludes and blinds you from true understanding.
simple_meaning: Thinking 'I am the richest and best' and believing this leads to confusion and blindness to reality.
insight: It shifts your mind to recognize pride as a form of ignorance that hides your deeper self and true clarity.
modern_relevance: You see someone boasting about their achievements or possessions, convinced it makes them superior, yet this pride hides their deeper insecurities.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अहंकारं बलं दर्प काम क्रोधश्च संश्रिताः।
मामात्मपरदेहेषु प्रद्विषन्तोऽभ्यसूयकाः॥
translation: अहङ्कार, बल, दर्प, काम और क्रोध का अवलम्बन करते हुए अपने देह में और औरों के देह में रहनेवाला जो मैं हूँ उससे द्वेष करते हुए सच्चे पथ के चलनेवाले साधु लोगों के गुणों की निन्दा किया करते हैं
english_translation: Disturbed by many thoughts and trapped in the web of delusion, people fall into the impure lower realm through attachment to desire and pleasure.
essence: A restless, desire-bound mind traps you in a web that leads away from freedom.
simple_meaning: When your mind is restless and caught in illusions, attachment to desires drags you down into an impure state.
insight: Recognize how distraction and craving cloud your mind and pull your life off course.
modern_relevance: You scroll endlessly, distracted by impulses and cravings, feeling stuck yet pulled toward more momentary pleasures.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तानहं द्विषतः क्रूरान् संसारे प्राणिनोऽधमान् ।
क्षिपाभ्यजत्रमशुभानामुरीष्वेव योनिषु ॥
translation: मैं संसार में मेरी हिंसा करनेवाले इन सब क्रूर अधम अशुभ व्यक्तियों को आसुरी योनियों में ही निरन्तर गिराया करता हूँ
english_translation: Considering themselves great and venerable, proud from wealth and arrogance, they perform meaningless rituals with deceit and without true discipline.
essence: Empty pride and false rituals block real inner progress.
simple_meaning: People who see themselves as superior and proud because of wealth perform meaningless rituals with deceit and without real discipline.
insight: It shifts attention from external show and pride to sincere, disciplined effort as the path forward.
modern_relevance: You might see people around who boast or show off wealth but lack genuine effort or sincerity in what they do.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
आसुरी योनिमापन्ना मूढ़ा जन्मनि जन्मनि ।
मामप्राप्यैव गीर्वाणास्ततो यान्त्यधमाँ गतिम् ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! वह मूढ़गण जन्म जन्म में आसुरी योनि प्राप्त करके मुझे प्राप्त न होकर और भी अधमगति को प्राप्त होते हैं
english_translation: Those who rely on ego, strength, pride, desire, and anger hate the true self within themselves and others, criticizing the virtues of sincere seekers.
essence: Pride, desire, and anger cause you to hate the true self in yourself and others.
simple_meaning: People who depend on ego, pride, desire, and anger end up hating the true self in themselves and others, criticizing those who follow a sincere path.
insight: Recognize how ego and strong emotions distort your perception of yourself and others, opening space for kindness and acceptance.
modern_relevance: When you let pride and frustration take over, you push away your own values and judge others harshly instead of understanding them.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
त्रिविधं नरकस्येदं द्वारं नाशनमात्मनः ।
कामः क्रोधस्तथा लोभस्तस्मादेतत्रयं त्यजेत् ॥
translation: काम, क्रोध और लोभ, नरक यह तीन प्रकार के द्वार हैं, यह तीनों आत्मज्ञान के नाशक हैं इस कारण इन तीनों को त्याग कर देना चाहिये
english_translation: I cast those cruel, lowest, and inauspicious beings who hate me into demonic births in the cycle of existence again and again.
essence: Cruelty and hatred lead to continued difficult rebirths within the cycle of existence.
simple_meaning: The divine says that those who act cruelly and oppose the divine cycle experience repeated births in lower, troubled forms.
insight: It reminds you that harmful actions lead to difficult consequences, encouraging care in how you treat others.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
एतैविर्मुक्तो जीवस्तु तमोद्वारैत्रिभिः खलु ।
आचरत्यात्मनः श्रेयस्ततो याति परां गतिम् ॥
translation: नरक के द्वाररूपी इन तीनो से ही विमुक्त जीव अपना मङ्गल करनेवाला आचरण करता है और तदन्तर परमगतिरूपी मोक्ष को प्राप्त करता है।
english_translation: Those deluded beings, born repeatedly into demonic origins, fail to reach me and instead fall into a lower realm.
essence: Repeated confusion and ego-born states block the path to the divine and cause decline.
simple_meaning: Repeatedly being born into deluded and harmful states keeps beings away from the divine and leads them to worse conditions.
insight: Recognize that staying trapped in ego and confusion prevents progress toward your inner freedom.
modern_relevance: When you keep repeating harmful patterns without clear purpose, you move farther from your true self and deeper into confusion.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यः शास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य वर्त्तते कामकारतः ।
न स सिद्धिमवाप्नोति न सुखं न परां गतिम् ॥
translation: जो व्यक्ति शास्त्रविधि को त्याग करके स्वेच्छानुकूल कार्य में प्रवृत्त होता है वह सिद्धि शान्ति और मोक्ष को प्राप्त नहीं हो सकता
english_translation: Desire, anger, and greed are the three gates to the lower realm that destroy self-knowledge; therefore, these three must be abandoned.
essence: Desire, anger, and greed are gates destroying self-knowledge and must be abandoned.
simple_meaning: Desire, anger, and greed block your true self-knowledge and lead to suffering. Letting go of them is essential.
insight: This verse shifts focus from chasing wants to noticing and letting go of disruptive emotions.
modern_relevance: When frustration, craving, or jealousy arise during your day, they cloud your judgment and peace. Noticing and releasing them opens clarity.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तस्माच्छास्त्रं प्रमाणं वः कार्याकार्यव्यवस्थितौ ।
ज्ञात्वा शास्त्रविधानोक्तं कर्म कर्तुमिहार्हथ ॥
translation: इस कारण इस विश्व में यह कार्य है और यह अकार्य है इसकी व्यवस्था करने में शास्त्र ही आपके लिये प्रमाण है । शास्त्र विधानोक्त कर्म को जानकर उसको कर सकते हो
english_translation: A being freed from the three gates of the lower realm acts for its own welfare and then attains the supreme state.
essence: Freedom comes by acting beyond three gates of darkness toward your true welfare.
simple_meaning: When a person frees themselves from three harmful entrances of darkness, they act for their own good and reach the highest state.
insight: This verse teaches you to identify and release three key inner blocks so your actions become truly beneficial.
modern_relevance: When you recognize and step beyond three harmful habits or fears, your actions align with your well-being and growth.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
दैवीभावस्य रक्षायै आसुरीभावतो भयात् ।
मयैव वर्णधर्मस्य कृता सृष्टिर्दिवौकसः ॥
translation: हे देव गण! आसुरी भाव के भय से दैवी भाव की रक्षा करने के लिये मैंने ही वणधर्म की सृष्टि की है
english_translation: One who abandons scriptural discipline and acts driven by desire does not attain accomplishment, happiness, or ultimate freedom.
essence: Ignoring disciplined guidance for desire-driven actions blocks lasting success and freedom.
simple_meaning: Acting without following the right principles and chasing desires prevents real success, peace, and freedom.
insight: It shifts your mindset from following impulses to honoring steady discipline as the path to true fulfillment.
modern_relevance: You decide to skip your core values to chase quick pleasures, only to feel empty and restless afterward.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
प्रतिरोधको वर्णधर्माः सत्वविवर्द्धकः।
स्वधर्मरक्षकस्तदेवीसम्पत्प्रवर्तकः ॥
translation: वर्णधर्म प्रवृत्तिरोधक सत्त्वगुण वर्द्धक स्वधर्मरक्षक और दैवीसम्पत्तिप्रवर्तक है
english_translation: Therefore, scripture is your guide to distinguish what actions should be done and which should not; knowing the scriptural injunctions, you should act accordingly.
essence: Clear guidance from scripture reveals what actions are right and which are not.
simple_meaning: Scripture is the reliable guide that helps you know which actions to do and which to avoid. By understanding scriptural instructions, you can act rightly.
insight: It teaches you to rely on trusted principles to clarify your responsibilities and avoid confusion.
modern_relevance: When unsure about a tough choice, you turn to trusted guidelines or principles to decide what you must do and what to avoid.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविशां शूद्राणाञ्च सुधाभुजः !।
कर्माणि प्रविभक्तानि स्वाभावप्रभवैगुणै ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! ब्राह्मण क्षत्रिय वैश्य और शूद्रगण के कर्मसमूह पूर्व जन्म के संस्कार से उत्पन्न गुण  विशेषरूप से विभक्त हैं
english_translation: O divine beings, to protect the divine nature from the fear of the demonic nature, I alone created the system of classes and duties.
essence: Social roles exist to protect the good from destructive forces.
simple_meaning: A system of social roles and duties was created to protect goodness from harmful forces.
insight: Recognize your responsibilities as part of a protective design that sustains what you value.
modern_relevance: When chaos threatens your values, your role and responsibilities act as a shield to uphold what matters.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
शमो दमस्तपः शौचं क्षान्तिरार्जवमेव च ।
ज्ञानं विज्ञानमास्तिक्यं ब्रह्मकर्म स्वभावजम् ॥
translation: शम, दम, तपस्या,शौच,क्षमा,सरलता, ज्ञान विज्ञान और आस्तिकता, यह सब ब्राह्मण गण के स्वाभाविक कर्म हैं
english_translation: The protector of the duties of caste is the enhancer of goodness, the guardian of one's own duty, and the promoter of divine qualities.
essence: Protecting your true duties cultivates goodness and fosters divine qualities in you.
simple_meaning: You protect your true role by performing your duties, which increases goodness and brings divine qualities into your life.
insight: It teaches you to see your duties as a source of inner growth rather than just obligations.
modern_relevance: When you stay committed to your responsibilities, you naturally cultivate kindness and integrity, which influence your surroundings positively.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
शौर्य तेजो धृतिर्दाक्ष्यं युद्धे चाप्यपलायनम् ।
दानमीश्वरभावश्च क्षात्रं कर्म स्वभावजम् ॥
translation: शौर्य, तेज, धृति, दक्षता, युद्ध से नहीं भागना, दान और प्रभुता की शक्ति, यह सब क्षत्रिय जाति के स्वाभाविक कर्म हैं
english_translation: O divine beings! The duties of Brahmins, Kshatriyas, Vaishyas, and Shudras are divided according to the qualities born from their past life's nature.
essence: Your true duties flow from qualities shaped by your past nature.
simple_meaning: Different groups have different duties based on qualities they developed from past lives.
insight: Recognize that your natural talents and tendencies guide you toward your most fitting actions.
modern_relevance: You notice how your strengths and habits guide what you do best, naturally shaping your role at work or home.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
कृषिगोरक्षवाणिज्यं वैश्यकर्म स्वभावजम् ।
परिचर्यात्मकं कर्म शूद्रस्यापि स्वभावजम् ॥
translation: कृषि, पशुपालन और वाणिज्य, यह वैश्य जाति के स्वाभाविक कर्म हैं और परिचर्यात्मक कर्म शूद्रजाति का भी स्वाभाविक कर्म है
english_translation: Calmness, self-control, disciplined effort, purity, forgiveness, straightforwardness, wisdom, discriminating knowledge, and belief in the supreme reality are natural duties of the Brahmin community.
essence: Calmness and honest wisdom are natural duties born from your true nature.
simple_meaning: Certain qualities like calmness, self-discipline, purity, forgiveness, honesty, and wisdom are natural duties for those on a spiritual path.
insight: It teaches you to recognize and cultivate natural, virtuous qualities as your true daily duties.
modern_relevance: When you face daily stress, returning to calmness and honest clarity grounds your choices and actions.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
स्वे स्वे कर्मण्यभिरतः संसिद्धिं लभतेऽखिलाः।
स्वकर्मनिरतः सिद्धिं श्रूयतां विन्दते यथा ॥
translation: अपने अपने कर्म में निष्ठावान् सभी व्यक्ति सिद्धि को प्राप्त करते हैं। स्वकर्म में निरत व्यक्ति जिस प्रकार से  सिद्धि को प्राप्त करते हैं, वह सुनो
english_translation: Courage, brilliance, steadiness, skill, not fleeing in battle, generosity, and leadership are all natural duties of the warrior class.
essence: Bravery, skill, generosity, and steadfastness are natural duties that define your role.
simple_meaning: Being brave, skilled, steady, generous, and facing challenges without fleeing are natural duties for a warrior.
insight: This verse helps you recognize and own your natural strengths and responsibilities, guiding your actions with confidence.
modern_relevance: When you face tough decisions or pressure, remember your natural strengths and responsibilities guide you to stand firm and act with generosity.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यतः प्रतिभूतानां येन सर्वमिदं ततम् ।
स्वकर्मणा तमभ्यर्च्य सिद्धिं विन्दति साधकः
॥
translation: जिनसे जीवों की प्रवृत्ति अर्थात् चेष्टा का उदय होता है और जो इस सम्पूर्ण विश्व में व्याप्त हैं, स्वकर्म के द्वारा साधक उनकी अर्चना करके सिद्धि प्राप्त करता है।
english_translation: Farming, herding, and trade are the natural duties of the Vaishya class, and service work is the natural duty of the Shudra class.
essence: Different social groups are described with distinct traditional duties.
simple_meaning: Different social groups have traditional roles: Vaishyas in farming and trade, Shudras in service work.
insight: Recognize the verse reflects social roles, not personal dharma for everyone; be cautious applying it universally.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
श्रेयान स्वधम्मो विगुणः परश्चान्स्वनुष्ठितात् ।
स्वभावनियतं कर्म कुर्वन्नाप्नोति किल्बिषम् ॥
translation: अपना धर्म यदि सदोष भी हो तो वह पूर्णरूप से अनुष्ठित परधर्म की अपेक्षा श्रेष्ठ है क्योंकि स्वभाव से निश्चित कर्म को करता हुआ जीव पाप को प्राप्त नहीं होता है
english_translation: Everyone attains perfection by being dedicated to their own action. Listen to how one devoted to their own duty attains perfection.
essence: True success comes from dedicated focus on your own chosen actions.
simple_meaning: By focusing sincerely on your own work, you can achieve true success and fulfillment.
insight: It teaches you to commit fully to your unique responsibilities instead of comparing yourself to others.
modern_relevance: You see colleagues rushing to copy others’ tasks, but your own steady focus is what truly builds progress.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सहज कर्म विबुधाः ! सदोषमपि न त्यजेत् ।
सर्वारम्भा हि दोषेण धूमेनाग्निरिवाटताः ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! सदोष होने पर भी सहज अर्थात् खभाव से उत्पन्न कर्म का त्याग नहीं करना चाहिये क्योंकि जिस प्रकार अग्नि को धूम ढककर रहता है उसी प्रकार सभी कर्म दोष से आवृत हैं।
english_translation: From whom all beings' tendencies arise and who pervades the entire universe, the practitioner attains perfection by worshipping through their own actions.
essence: You gain true success by honoring the universal source through your own actions.
simple_meaning: You achieve true accomplishment by honoring the origin of all beings through your own committed actions.
insight: Shift from seeking external rewards to honoring your effort as a form of reverence toward the greater whole.
modern_relevance: When you focus fully on your work, recognizing it as part of a greater whole, you find deeper fulfillment beyond results.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
असक्तबुद्धिः सर्वत्र जितात्मा विगतस्पृहः ।
नैष्कर्म्यसिद्धि परमां सन्न्यासेनाधिगच्छति ॥
translation: सभी विषयों में अनासक्तबुद्धि, जितात्मा और इच्छारहित व्यक्ति सन्न्यास अर्थात् आसक्ति और कर्मफल के त्याग द्वारा परमोन्नत नैष्ककर्मय सिद्धि को प्राप्त करता है
english_translation: Better is your own duty, though imperfect, than the duty of another well performed; performing the duty ordained by your nature, you incur no blame.
essence: Doing your own natural duty, even imperfectly, is better than perfect duty not your own.
simple_meaning: You should follow your own natural duty, even if imperfect, rather than perfectly doing someone else's duty. Acting according to your nature avoids blame.
insight: It shifts your focus from imitating others to embracing your unique role and natural actions.
modern_relevance: You face choices where you might copy others perfectly or follow your own imperfect instincts. Trusting your nature helps you avoid regret and blame.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
विशिष्टचेतना जीवाः सुराः : त्रिगुणभेदतः ।
चतुर्वेवाऽधिकारेषु विभक्ताः सन्ति सर्वदा ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! त्रिगुण के भेद से विशिष्ट चेतन जीव सर्वदा चार ही अधिकारों में विभक्त हैं
english_translation: O enlightened beings! Even if actions have faults, do not abandon natural spontaneous actions, for just as fire is covered by smoke, all actions are covered by faults.
essence: Natural action is valuable even when flawed; faults don’t justify stopping acting.
simple_meaning: You should not give up your natural, spontaneous actions just because they contain some faults. Like fire is hidden by smoke, all actions have some flaws.
insight: It teaches you to accept imperfection in your natural efforts without abandoning them completely.
modern_relevance: You tried to do something from your heart, but mistakes happened. Still, stopping because of flaws means losing what’s real and natural about your effort.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
राक्षसा असुरा: देवा: कृतविद्याश्च ते मता: ।
केवलं तम आश्रिय विपरीतं प्रकुर्वते ॥
translation: उन्हीं को राक्षस असुर देवता और कृतविद्य कहते है। केवल तमोगुण के आश्रित होकर जो विपरीत
english_translation: A person with a mind free from attachment, self-conquered and desireless attains the highest perfection of actionlessness through renunciation.
essence: True freedom arises when the mind is free from attachment and desire through renunciation.
simple_meaning: You can achieve the highest freedom by letting go of attachments, controlling yourself, and giving up desire through renunciation.
insight: It teaches you to focus on releasing attachments and desires, which clears the way for inner freedom.
modern_relevance: You feel stuck when wanting things pulls your mind every which way. Letting go of craving opens a path to calm and clarity.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
कर्म तानाक्षसानाहुर्गुणभेदविदो बुधाः ।
रजोद्वारेण ये जीवा इन्द्रियासक्तचेतमः ॥
translation: कर्म करते हैं उनको गुणभेद के जाननेवाले विद्वान लोग राक्षस कहते हैं। जो जीव इन्द्रियासक्त चित्त होकर रजोगुण के द्वारा
english_translation: O gods, the distinct conscious beings are always divided into four categories according to the three qualities.
essence: Conscious beings are naturally sorted into four groups by three qualities of nature.
simple_meaning: Distinct conscious beings are always classified into four groups based on the three qualities that define nature.
insight: It invites you to recognize that differences among beings arise from natural qualities, not arbitrary separation.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तम प्रधानं विषयवहुलं कर्म कुर्वते ।
असुरास्ते समाख्याता देवाञ्च्छृणुत देवताः ॥
translation: तमोन्मुख विषय बहुल कर्म करते हैं वह असुर हैं। देवाधिकार के जीवों का लक्षण सुनो,
english_translation: Demons, shadow beings, radiant beings, and practitioners of sorcery are all called so because they rely solely on the quality of darkness and act in opposition.
essence: Beings depending solely on darkness act contrary to harmony and order.
simple_meaning: Those called demons, shadow beings, radiant beings, and sorcerers act from darkness and follow opposing ways.
insight: It teaches to recognize forces or tendencies that arise from confusion and opposition rather than clarity and harmony.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
रजःसाहाय्यमाश्रित्य कर्म सत्त्वप्रधानकम् ।
विषयाच्छन्नमतयः कुर्वते ते विचक्षणाः ॥
translation: जो विषय वासना रखते हुए रजोगुण की सहायता से सत्वगुण उन्मुख कर्म में प्रवृत्त होते हैं वे विलक्षण व्यक्ति देवता कहलाते हैं
english_translation: The wise, who understand the distinctions of qualities, call those who act with minds attached to the senses and influenced by the quality of passion as demons.
essence: Passionate mind attached to senses drives restless, binding actions.
simple_meaning: Those who understand qualities see that living beings acting with sense-driven passionate minds are caught in rajas, a binding quality.
insight: It teaches you to observe when your mind clings to sensory desires and understand that such attachment causes restless, unbalanced action.
modern_relevance: You notice how your desires and restless mind drive impulsive decisions, trapping you in cycles of dissatisfaction.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
शुद्धसत्वे स्थिता ये स्युः कृतविद्या मतास्तु ते ।
अहं तु कृतविधेषु ह्यादर्शोऽस्मि सुरर्षभाः ॥
translation: जो शुद्ध सत्त्वगुण में स्थित हैं चे कृतविद्य कहाते हैं। हे देवतागण ! मैं ही कृतविद्योका आदर्श हूँ
english_translation: Those who are dominated by darkness perform actions full of attachments; such beings are called shadowed ones. Listen to the traits of beings aligned with the divine.
essence: Actions driven by craving bind you to darkness and restless confusion.
simple_meaning: People who act driven by craving and attachments are trapped in darkness. This behavior is called shadowed or ego-driven action.
insight: Recognize craving as the root that darkens your actions; this awareness lets you shift toward clarity.
modern_relevance: You notice when your choices come from frustration or craving, making even simple tasks feel heavy and chaotic.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यतो विद्या ममाधीना वर्तते सन्ततं ध्रुवम् ।
दृष्टिश्चेद् युष्मदीया मां प्रत्येव सततं भवेत् ॥
translation: क्योंकि विद्या सदा मेरे अधीन ही रहती है। हे देवतागण ! यदि आप लोगों की दृष्टि सदा मेरी ही ओर रहे
english_translation: Those who, supported by passion and driven by goodness, perform actions veiled by desires are called wise beings.
essence: Wise action can arise from passion and goodness, even when desire clouds the mind.
simple_meaning: People who act with energy and goodness but still have desires are considered wise beings.
insight: Recognize that acting with passion and goodness, despite desires, still reflects wisdom.
modern_relevance: You rush to finish a project driven by ambition but keep your values clear—this blend makes your effort wise.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तदा वश्च्यवनं नैव भयं वा न भविष्यति ।
उन्नतिः क्रमशो नूनं युष्माकं च भविष्यति ॥
translation: तो आप लोगों का  न पतन होगा और न आपको भय होगा और आप लोगों की क्रमशः उन्नति अवश्य होगी
english_translation: Those established in pure goodness are called wise in their actions. O radiant beings, I am the ideal among those wise in action.
essence: True wisdom is shown by acting from pure goodness; the ideal is embodied in living example.
simple_meaning: People rooted in pure goodness are called wise because their actions reflect that. I am the perfect example of such wisdom in action.
insight: It shifts your focus to embodying goodness in every action, making wisdom visible through how you live.
modern_relevance: When you choose kindness and integrity in your daily choices, you become wise through your actions, just like a role model you admire.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
देवादिदेव ! धर्माभिप्रवर्तक : महाप्रभो ।
लोकोत्तरगति तद्वद्रहस्यं परमाद्भुतम् ॥
translation: हे देवादिदेव ! हे धर्म के प्रवर्तक ! हे महाप्रभो ! हे विभो! धर्म की लोकोत्तर गति और परम अद्भुत रहस्य
english_translation: Because knowledge always remains under my control. O radiant beings! If your gaze always remains fixed on me,
essence: Steady focus on the divine keeps knowledge constant and unshaken.
simple_meaning: Steady knowledge stays with the one who keeps their attention continually on the divine presence.
insight: It teaches you to maintain steady focus on your inner guide to keep wisdom stable within.
modern_relevance: When you keep your attention on what truly matters, your understanding deepens and becomes steady despite distractions.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ज्ञात्वा धर्मस्य जाताः स्मः कृतकृत्या वयं विभो ! ।
जगद्गुरो ! चतुर्भेदा भेदतस्त्रिगुणस्य ये ॥
translation: समझकर हमलोग कृत्यकृत्य हुए। हे जगद्गुरो ! त्रिगुण के भेद से आपने जो चार भेद
english_translation: Then you will have neither downfall nor fear, and your progress will surely grow step by step.
essence: Steady effort eliminates fear and guarantees gradual progress.
simple_meaning: You will not experience failure or fear, and your progress will grow gradually and surely.
insight: It teaches you to trust steady effort over anxiety about failure, focusing on slow, sure progress.
modern_relevance: When you feel stuck or anxious about setbacks, this reminds you that consistent effort removes fear and leads to growth.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
विशिष्टचेतनापन्नजीवानां कथितास्त्वया।
त्रिगुणानां हि तेषां वै स्वरूपं गुणभेदतः ॥
translation: विशिष्ट चेतन जीवों के  वर्णन किये हैं, हे प्रभो ! उन्हीं त्रिगुणों का स्वरूप और त्रिगुणों के विचार से
english_translation: O God of gods! O great lord, the promulgator of dharma! The transcendental goal of dharma and its supreme, wondrous mystery are like that.
essence: The highest source of dharma leads to a supreme, transcendent mystery beyond the world.
simple_meaning: This verse praises a supreme being as the source and upholder of dharma, whose ultimate goal and mystery surpass the world.
insight: It invites respect for the profound, unseen principles that govern purposeful living beyond immediate logic.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
धर्मङ्गिानाञ्च सर्वेषामाचाराणां तथा प्रभो !।
वर्णयन्नः प्रधानानां भेदानुपदिशाखिलान् ॥
translation: धर्म के सभी अङ्गों और प्रधान आचारों के सम्पूर्ण भेदों का वर्णन करते हुए ऐसा उपदेश दें
english_translation: Knowing our dharma, we have become accomplished. O world teacher! From the three qualities, you have made four distinctions.
essence: True understanding of dharma reveals clear distinctions beyond superficial qualities.
simple_meaning: Understanding your true purpose helps you become accomplished. The teacher explains how the three qualities lead to four important distinctions.
insight: It teaches you to look beyond surface traits to find your true purpose and mastery.
modern_relevance: You finally see your role clearly after sorting through confusing personality traits and expectations.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
येन द्रष्टुं वयं सर्वे भवन्तं शक्नुमः सदा।
भावातीतं गुणातीतमवाङ्मनसगोचरम ॥
translation: हमको कि जिससे हम सब भावों से अतीत, गुणों से अतीत और मन वाणी से अगोचर आपको हर समय देखने का सामर्थ्य प्राप्त कर सके
english_translation: You have described the distinct conscious beings and the nature of the three qualities based on their differences.
essence: Distinct conscious beings differ fundamentally by their three qualities.
simple_meaning: You have explained different conscious beings and how the three qualities vary among them.
insight: It invites recognizing the diversity of consciousness through the lens of qualities shaping identity.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
लीनाऽव्यक्तदशायां में प्रकृतिमयि सर्वदा ।
तथा व्यक्तदशायां सा प्रकटीभूय सर्वतः ॥
translation: मेरी प्रकृति अव्यक्त दशा में मुझमें सर्वदा लीन रहती है और व्यक्त दशा में यह प्रकट होकर
english_translation: O Lord, please teach us by describing all parts of dharma and all the distinctions among its main codes of conduct.
essence: Complete understanding of all parts and distinctions of dharma is essential before teaching.
simple_meaning: The speaker asks the Lord to explain all aspects and distinctions of dharma and its main rules clearly.
insight: It encourages seeking thorough understanding of ethical guidance before applying it in life.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
त्रिगुणानां तरङ्गेशु स्वभावाद्धि तरङ्गाति ।
नैवात्र संशयः कोऽपि वर्तते विबुधर्षभाः ! ॥
translation: स्वभाव से ही त्रिगुण तरङ्गले सब ओर तरङ्गित होने लगती है। हे देवतागण ! इसमें कुछ सन्देह नहीं है।
english_translation: By which we all can always see you beyond emotions, beyond qualities, beyond speech and mind.
essence: You can perceive the true self beyond all emotions, qualities, and mental expressions at all times.
simple_meaning: You can learn to see the true self beyond all emotions, qualities, and mental expressions at any time.
insight: It teaches you to shift your awareness beyond reactive feelings and mental labels to a pure witnessing of what is.
modern_relevance: When your mind is overwhelmed by emotions or chatter, this teaching reminds you that you can still see clearly beyond all that noise.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सत्त्वं रजस्तम इति गुणाः प्रकृतिसंभवाः ।
निबध्नन्ति सुपर्वाणो देहे देहिनमव्ययम् ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! सत्व रज और तम ये तीन गुण प्रकृति से उत्पन्न होकर देहों में स्थित निर्विकार देही को आवद्ध किया करते हैं
english_translation: My nature remains always merged in me in the unmanifest state, and in the manifest state it appears everywhere.
essence: True nature is simultaneously hidden within and revealed everywhere.
simple_meaning: Your essential nature stays hidden within you in quiet moments but shows up clearly in active times all around.
insight: This verse shifts your view from seeing yourself as either hidden or visible to embracing both as your true reality.
modern_relevance: When you feel quiet and unnoticed, and when you express yourself fully, both are parts of your true nature.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तत्र सत्त्वं निर्मलत्वात्प्रकाशकमनामयम् ।
सुखसङ्गेन बनाति ज्ञानसङ्गेन चानघाः ! ॥
translation: हे पाप रहितो! इन तीनों गुणों से निर्मल होने के कारण, प्रकाशक और दोषरहित सत्त्वगुण सुखासनि के द्वारा और ज्ञानसंग के द्वारा बद्ध करता है
english_translation: The waves of the three qualities naturally arise and move everywhere; among the wise, there is no doubt about this.
essence: The three qualities flow naturally; the wisest accept this without doubt.
simple_meaning: The three qualities (sattva, rajas, tamas) naturally arise and move everywhere without interruption, and wise people have no doubt about this fact.
insight: It shifts your perspective to accept natural fluctuations as inherent, reducing inner conflict about change.
modern_relevance: When you notice your mood shifting naturally through energy, calm, or inertia, you can trust this flow as part of your nature without resistance.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
रजो रागात्मकं वित्त तृष्णासङ्गसमुद्भवम् ।
तन्निबनाति भो देवाः ! कर्मसङ्गेन देहिनम् ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! रजोगुण को रागात्मक, और तृष्णासक्ति से उत्पन्न जानना चाहिए, वह देही को कर्म आसक्ति  द्वारा आबद्ध किया करता है।
english_translation: Sattva, Rajas, and Tamas are qualities born of nature that bind the changeless true self to the body.
essence: The changeless true self is bound by nature’s three qualities within the body.
simple_meaning: Three qualities of nature—goodness, passion, and ignorance—bind the unchanging true self to the body.
insight: It teaches you to see the difference between your changeless true self and the shifting qualities that influence your experience.
modern_relevance: You feel stuck or overwhelmed by your moods and impulses, yet your true self remains untouched beneath them all.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तमस्त्वज्ञानजं वित्त मोहनं सर्वदेहिनाम् ।
प्रमादालास्यनिद्राभिस्तन्निव्धान्ति निर्जरा ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! तमोगुण को अज्ञान से उत्पन्न और सब प्राणियों मे भ्रम उत्पन्न करनेवाला जानो, वह प्रमाद अनुद्दम धम और चित्त की अवसन्नता द्वारा देही को आबद्ध करता है।
english_translation: Pure sattva, being luminous and free from fault, binds through attachment to pleasure and to knowledge.
essence: Pure clarity can bind you when it fuels attachment to pleasure or knowledge.
simple_meaning: Pure qualities that illuminate and are free of faults can still bind you if you become attached to pleasure or knowledge.
insight: Recognize that attachment can arise even from good qualities, shifting your task to release craving itself.
modern_relevance: You might feel your clarity or learning is freeing, but craving comfort or certainty can still trap you in endless cycles.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सत्त्वं सूखे सञ्जयति रजः कणि चामराः।
ज्ञानमावृत्य तु तमः प्रमादे सञ्जयत्युत ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! सत्त्वगुण जीव को सुख में आबद्ध करता है, रजोगुण कर्म में आबद्ध करता है और तमोगुण ज्ञान को आवरण कर के प्रमाद में आबद्ध करता है
english_translation: O radiant beings, know that wealth born of desire and attachment to passion binds the embodied self through attachment to action.
essence: Desire-born wealth binds the self through attachment to action.
simple_meaning: Wealth that arises from desire and attachment binds the true self because it creates attachment to actions and their outcomes.
insight: Recognize how craving for outcomes creates bondage; shifting focus away frees your actions.
modern_relevance: You chase money driven by craving, only to find it pulls you deeper into stress and endless doing.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
रजस्तमश्चाभिभूय सत्त्वं प्रभु भवसलम् ।
रजः सत्त्वं तमश्चैव तमः सत्त्वं रजस्तथा ॥
translation: रज एवं तमोगुण को दबा करके. सत्त्वगुण बलवान होता है, सत्त्व एवं तमोगुण को परास्त करके रजोगुण प्रबल होता है और सत्त्व एवं रजोगुण को दबा कर के तमो गुण प्रबल होता है
english_translation: O beings, know that the quality of darkness born from ignorance causes delusion in all living beings; it binds the embodied self through carelessness, laziness, and drowsiness.
essence: Ignorance-born darkness binds living beings through careless laziness and mental dullness.
simple_meaning: Darkness arising from ignorance causes confusion and binds living beings through carelessness, laziness, and drowsiness.
insight: Recognize how carelessness and mental dullness act like chains, and begin to notice these patterns to break free.
modern_relevance: You find yourself distracted and stuck, tired yet unable to focus, trapped by your own mental fog and inertia.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सर्वद्वारेषु देहेऽस्मिन् प्रकाश उपजायते ।
ज्ञानं यदा तदा विद्याद्विवृद्धं सत्चमित्युत ॥
translation: जब इस देह में श्रोत्रादि सब द्वारो में ज्ञानमय प्रकाश होता है तब सत्त्वगुण की विशेष वृद्धि हुई है ऐसा समझना चाहिये
english_translation: The quality of goodness binds the being to happiness, passion binds to action, and ignorance covers knowledge, binding one to negligence.
essence: Your nature's qualities bind you differently—to happiness, to action, or to negligence.
simple_meaning: Goodness ties you to happiness, passion ties you to action, and ignorance hides knowledge, causing carelessness.
insight: Recognize which quality influences your current state; this awareness helps you shift toward clarity and care.
modern_relevance: You notice sometimes you pursue pleasure, sometimes get caught up in busyness, or overlook important things because your own nature pulls you different ways.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
लोभः प्रवृत्तिरारम्भः कर्मणामशमः स्पृहा ।
रजस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे विबुधर्षभाः ! ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! लोभ, प्रवृत्ति अर्थात् सर्वदा सकाम कर्म करने की इच्छा, कर्मों का आरम्भ अर्थात् उद्यम, अशम अर्थात् अशान्ति एवं स्पृहा अर्थात् विषय तृष्णा, यह सब रजोगुण बढ़ने पर उत्पन्न होते हैं
english_translation: By overcoming rajas and tamas, sattva becomes dominant; by overcoming sattva and tamas, rajas becomes dominant; by overcoming sattva and rajas, tamas becomes dominant.
essence: One of the three qualities dominates only when it suppresses the other two.
simple_meaning: Among the three qualities—activity, inertia, and harmony—one becomes strong only after the other two are overcome within you.
insight: It teaches you to recognize which inner quality currently governs your mind and how the others recede, helping you observe your shifting states.
modern_relevance: When you feel energetic, calm, or dull, it’s because one inner quality is overshadowing the others, shaping how you act and feel.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अप्रकाशोऽप्रवृत्तिश्च प्रमादो मोह एव च ।
तमस्येतानि जायन्ते विटद्धे सुरसत्तमाः ! ॥
translation: हे देवश्रेष्ठो! विवेकभ्रंश, उद्यमहीनता, कर्तव्य के अनुसन्धान का न रहना और मिथ्या अभिमान यह सभी तमो  गुण के बढ़ने पर उत्पन्न होते हैं
english_translation: When knowledge arises as light in all the senses of this body, it shows a clear growth of the quality of goodness.
essence: Knowledge illuminating all senses reveals the blossoming of inner goodness.
simple_meaning: When knowledge lights up all your senses and awareness, it shows that your inner goodness is growing.
insight: Recognize when your awareness brightens your senses as a sign of increased clarity and goodness within.
modern_relevance: You notice moments when your perceptions feel sharper, clearer, and more balanced, signaling growth in your character.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यदा सत्त्वे प्रद्धे तु प्रलयं याति देहभृत् ।
तदोत्तमविदां लोकानमलान प्रतिपद्यते ॥
translation: यदि सत्वगुण के विशेषरूप से बढ़नेपर जीव मृत्युको प्राप्त हो तब वह ब्रह्मवेत्ताओ के प्रकाशमय लोकों को प्राप्त होता है अर्थात् उसकी उत्तम गति होती है
english_translation: Greed, urge, beginning of action, unrest, and craving arise when the quality of passion grows.
essence: Passion intensifies greed, restless urges, and craving in all your actions.
simple_meaning: Greed, urges to act, restlessness, and craving come from increasing passion in your mind.
insight: This verse helps you see how passion fuels restless desire and action, encouraging you to cultivate calmness.
modern_relevance: You wake up feeling restless and driven by wants, rushing into tasks without peace or clarity.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
रजसि प्रलयं गत्वा कर्मसंगिषु जायते ।
तथा प्रलीनस्तमसि मूढ़योनिषु जायते ॥
translation: रजोगुण की वृद्धि के समय मृत्यु होने पर कर्मासक्त मनुष्य लोक में जन्म होता है एवं तमोगुण बढ़ने पर मृतव्यक्ति (पशु प्रेत आदि) मूढ़ योनियों में जन्म लेता है
english_translation: O best of the radiant ones! Loss of discernment, inactivity, neglect of duty, and false pride all arise from the increase of darkness.
essence: Growing inner darkness causes loss of clarity, laziness, neglect, and false pride.
simple_meaning: Losing clarity, becoming inactive, ignoring your responsibilities, and falling into false pride come from growing inner darkness.
insight: It teaches you to recognize how inner darkness harms your clarity and motivation to act rightly.
modern_relevance: You start doubting yourself and procrastinating when confusion and pride cloud your mind during tough times.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
कर्मणः सुकृतस्याहुः सात्त्विकं निर्मलं फलम् ।
रजसस्तु फलं दुःखमज्ञानं तमसः फलम् ॥
translation: सुकृत अर्थात् सात्त्विक कर्मका सात्त्विक और निर्मल फल है, राजस कर्म को फल दुःख और तामस कर्म का फल अज्ञान अर्थात् मूढ़ता है, ऐसा ज्ञानी लोग कहते हैं
english_translation: When the body-holder departs by the supreme mode of goodness, they reach the pure realms of the wise.
essence: Departing with pure goodness leads the true self to radiant realms of wisdom.
simple_meaning: When a person's body ends with the highest goodness in their nature, their true being attains pure, wise realms beyond.
insight: It shifts focus to nurturing goodness in life as a way to prepare for a peaceful transition beyond the body.
modern_relevance: You notice how peaceful moments after deep kindness or clarity feel like a glimpse of something beyond daily struggles.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सत्त्वात् संजायते ज्ञानं रजसो लोभ एव च ।
प्रमादमोहौ तमसो भवतोऽज्ञानमेव च ॥
translation: सत्त्व से ज्ञानोत्पत्ति होती है, रज से लोभ उत्पन्न होता है और तमोगुण से प्रमाद अविवेक और अज्ञान उत्पन्न होता है
english_translation: When death comes during the increase of rajas, the person attached to actions is born in the human world; when tamas increases, the deceased is born in foolish forms.
essence: Your state of mind at death determines the nature of your next birth.
simple_meaning: Where your mind is fixed at death shapes your next birth—attachment leads to human life; darkness leads to confused, lower forms.
insight: This teaching shifts focus from external actions to the inner quality of mind at death as key in shaping future experience.
modern_relevance: When you react in frustration or dullness, you shape your mental habits that influence your future wellbeing and choices deeply.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
उर्दध्वं गच्छन्ति सत्त्वस्था मध्ये तिष्ठन्ति राजसाः ।
जघन्यगुणवृतिस्था अघो गछन्ति तामसा: ॥
translation: सत्त्वप्रधान व्यक्ति उर्द्ध्वलोक को जाते हैं, रजोगुण प्रधान व्यक्ति मध्यलोक में रहते हैं और निकृष्टगुणावलम्बी तामसिक व्यक्ति अधोलोक में जाते हैं
english_translation: The fruit of pure, virtuous action is called sattvic and is pure; the fruit of passionate action is pain; the fruit of ignorant, dark action is ignorance.
essence: The quality of your action shapes whether its result is clarity, pain, or confusion.
simple_meaning: Actions done with purity and good intention bring clear and good results. Actions done with passion cause pain. Actions done in ignorance lead to confusion.
insight: It teaches you to recognize how your mindset colors the results of your actions and to choose clarity over impulse.
modern_relevance: You notice that when you act calmly and with good intent, outcomes feel clear. But when driven by stress or confusion, results often cause more pain or frustration.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
नान्यं गणेभ्यः कर्तारं यदा द्रष्टानुपश्यति ।
गुणेभ्यश्च परं वेत्ति मद्भावं सोऽधिगच्छति ॥
translation: जब ज्ञानी व्यक्ति गुण के अतिरिक्त और किसी को कर्त्ता करके नहीं देखता है और गुण से परे जो गुण का दर्शक आत्मा है उसको जानता है वह मुझको प्राप्त हो जाता है
english_translation: From sattva arises wisdom, from rajas greed, and from tamas negligence, delusion, and ignorance.
essence: Your inner qualities shape your mind into wisdom, greed, or ignorance.
simple_meaning: Three qualities shape your mind: clarity brings wisdom, restlessness causes greed, and darkness leads to confusion and ignorance.
insight: It helps you to notice whether your mind is clear, restless, or dull to choose wiser responses.
modern_relevance: When your mind feels calm and clear, you understand better; when restless, you chase wants; when dull, confusion takes over.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
गुणानेतानतीत्य त्रीन देही देहसमुद्भवान् ।
जन्ममृत्युजरादुः रैविर्मुक्तोऽमृतमश्नुते ॥
translation: देह से उत्पन्न इन तीनों गुणों को अतिक्रमण करके जन्ममृत्युजरारूप दुःखों से मुक्त होकर देही परमानन्द को प्राप्त हो जाता है
english_translation: People dominated by sattva ascend to higher realms, those with rajas dwell in the middle realms, and those bound by tamas descend to lower realms.
essence: Your inner qualities determine whether you rise, remain, or fall in existence.
simple_meaning: People’s qualities influence where they go: purity leads upward, passion keeps one in the middle, and darkness pulls downward.
insight: Recognize how your dominant qualities shape your experience and direction in life.
modern_relevance: You notice how your mindset and habits influence whether you feel uplifted, stuck, or dragged down in daily life.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
प्रकाशश्च प्रवृत्तिश्च मोहमेव च निर्जराः !
न द्वष्टि सम्प्रवृत्तानि न निवृत्तानि काङ्गति ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! प्रकाश, प्रवृत्ति और मोह (तीनों गुणों के यथाक्रम कार्य) से सब गुणकार्य प्रारम्भ होने पर जो व्यक्ति द्वेष नहीं करता है और इनके निवृत्त होने पर जो इनमें इच्छा नहीं रखता है वह गुणातीत कहलाता है
english_translation: When a wise person sees no doer beyond the qualities and knows the self that observes these qualities, they attain me.
essence: True wisdom is seeing yourself as the observer beyond all qualities and doers.
simple_meaning: A wise person understands that no one acts independently beyond qualities and recognizes the self that watches these qualities, thus connecting with the divine.
insight: It teaches you to shift from identifying as the doer to recognizing yourself as the witness behind all qualities.
modern_relevance: When you notice your moods and habits without blaming a separate 'you,' you start to experience inner freedom beyond your traits.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
उदासीनवदासीनो गुणैयों न विचाल्यते ।
गुणा वर्तन्त इत्येवं योऽवतियुति नेङ्गते ॥
translation: जो उदासीन अर्थात् केवल साक्षीरूप से स्थित है और गुणों से जो विचलित नहीं होता है और गुणसमूह अपना अपना कार्य करते हैं ऐसा समझकर जो स्थिर रहता है और स्वयं चेष्टा नहीं करता है वह गुणातीत कहलाता है
english_translation: Surpassing the three qualities born from the body, the embodied one becomes free from the sorrows of birth, death, old age, and pain, and attains supreme bliss in the body.
essence: True bliss arises when you transcend the body’s three qualities and its cycle of suffering.
simple_meaning: You can go beyond the three qualities that come from your body and be free from birth, death, aging, and pain to experience supreme joy within yourself.
insight: It shifts your view from identifying with bodily qualities to recognizing a transcendent bliss within the embodied experience.
modern_relevance: When your body feels weak or pain arises, remember you are more than these changes and can find lasting joy beyond them.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
समदुःखसुखः स्वस्थः समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः ।
तुल्यनियापियो धीरस्तुल्यनिन्दात्मसंस्तुतिः ॥
translation: जिसको सुखदुःख समान हैं, जो आत्मा अवस्थित है, जिसके लिये मिटटी का ढेला पत्थर और सुवर्ण सब समान है, जिसके निकट प्रिय और अप्रिय दोनों समान हैं, जिसने अपनी इन्द्रियों को जीत लिया है और जिसके निकट निन्दा और स्तुति दोनों समान है वह गुणातीत कहलाता है
english_translation: O radiant beings! When light, activity, and delusion arise, if a person does not hate them, and when they cease, if they hold no desire for them, that person is called beyond the qualities.
essence: Freedom arises when you neither hate nor desire the inner qualities as they come and go.
simple_meaning: You become free from qualities when you neither hate their arising nor desire their passing.
insight: It teaches you to relate to inner forces without resistance or attachment, opening space for freedom.
modern_relevance: When your feelings and impulses arise, you neither reject nor chase them, and peace naturally follows.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
मानापमानयोस्तुल्यस्तुल्यो मित्रारिपक्षयोः ।
सर्वारम्भपरिसागी गुणातीतः स उच्यते ॥
translation: जो मान अपमान में समभाव रखता है, जो मित्र और शत्रु के विषय में समभाव रखता है और सब कर्मों के  आरम्भ का त्याग करने वाला है अर्थात् जो नवीन कर्म नहीं करता वह गुणातीत कहलाता है
english_translation: One who remains indifferent like a witness, unmoved by qualities as they act, and stays steady without engaging, is called beyond qualities.
essence: Remaining steady and detached like a witness means you are beyond all qualities acting around you.
simple_meaning: You stay calm and steady like a witness, not disturbed or involved by changing qualities around you.
insight: It teaches you to step back mentally and watch thoughts and feelings without reacting or identifying with them.
modern_relevance: When emotions or moods shift rapidly, you can choose to simply observe without getting swept away by them.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
माञ्च योऽव्यभिचारेण भक्तियोगेन सेवते।
म गुणान् समतीत्यैतान ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते ॥
translation: और जो एकान्त भक्तियोग के द्वारा मेरी सेवा करता है वह इन गुणों को विशेष रूप से अतिक्रमण करके ब्रह्म भाव को प्राप्त होता है।
english_translation: One who sees pleasure and pain as equal, and values clay, stone, and gold alike, who regards friend and foe the same, has conquered the senses and treats praise and blame equally; such a one is beyond qualities.
essence: True steadiness arises when you treat opposites like pain and pleasure as equal.
simple_meaning: You become steady when you treat pleasure and pain, praise and blame, as the same and don’t let them disturb your mind.
insight: It teaches you to keep your inner state unaffected by external praise or blame, balancing your mind like an even scale.
modern_relevance: You receive a compliment and a criticism in the same day, but your heart stays calm, neither elated nor crushed.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ब्रह्मणो हि प्रतिष्ठाऽहममृतस्याव्ययस्य च ।
शाश्वतस्य च धर्मस्य सुखम्यैकान्तिकस्य च ॥
translation: क्योंकि मैं नित्यस्थित और मोक्ष स्वरूप ब्रह्म के प्रतिष्ठा (स्थिति) का स्थान हूँ, मैं ही सनातनधर्म और ऐकान्तिक सुख का स्थान हूँ
english_translation: One who treats honor and dishonor equally, sees friend and enemy alike, and renounces all new actions is called beyond qualities.
essence: Steady balance toward all people and outcomes marks freedom from inner qualities.
simple_meaning: You stay balanced whether praised or blamed, treat friends and enemies the same, and let go of starting new actions.
insight: It teaches you to observe without preference or aversion, making your mind steady and free from new attachments.
modern_relevance: You receive a compliment or criticism at work and stay calm. You meet a loved one or rival and respond with the same steady heart.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
धर्मस्य साम्प्रतं देवाः ! विशेषाणां ब्रवीम्यहम् ।
अङ्गानां त्रिविधं रूपं युष्माभिरवधार्यताम् ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! अब मैं धर्म के विशेष विशेष अङ्गों का त्रिविध स्वरूप वर्णन करता हूँ आपलोग ध्यानपूर्वक सुनिये
english_translation: One who serves me with exclusive devoted love transcends these qualities and attains the state of supreme reality.
essence: Exclusive devotion lets you transcend natural qualities and reach the supreme state.
simple_meaning: Serving with exclusive, unwavering devotion helps you go beyond ordinary qualities and reach the highest state of being.
insight: It shifts your focus from personal traits and limitations to wholehearted devoted service, enabling spiritual transcendence.
modern_relevance: When you commit to a cause or person with full, undivided love, you move beyond your usual limits and find deeper meaning.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यज्ञो दानं तपस्त्रीणि धाङ्गानि प्रधानतः ।
तेष यज्ञः प्रधानं स्यात्तस्य भेदास्त्रिधा मताः ॥
translation: धर्म के प्रधान तीन अंग हैं, यज्ञ तप और दान। उनमें मुख्य अङ्ग जो यज्ञ है उसके तीन भेद हैं
english_translation: I am the foundation of Brahman, eternal and imperishable, the seat of eternal dharma and ultimate happiness.
essence: You are the unchanging foundation of eternal truth, law, and lasting happiness.
simple_meaning: You are the unchanging foundation of the supreme reality, the eternal law, and pure lasting happiness.
insight: It invites you to identify with the eternal foundation beneath change rather than with temporary ups and downs.
modern_relevance: When everything feels fleeting or unstable, recognizing your inner source of lasting truth and happiness can steady you deeply.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ज्ञानोपासनकर्माणि यदुक्तानि मनीषिभ: ।
सर्वशास्त्रेषु निष्णानस्तत्त्वज्ञानाब्धिपारगैः ॥
translation: ज्ञान , कर्म और उपासना, इस बात को सर्वशास्त्रनिष्णात तत्त्वज्ञानी पण्डितों ने कहा है।
english_translation: O divine beings! Now I will describe the threefold nature of the special aspects of dharma for you to carefully understand.
essence: Dharma has three special parts that need careful understanding.
simple_meaning: The divine addresses the assembly to explain that he will now describe three special aspects of dharma.
insight: Recognize when a moment calls for full attention before learning something important.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
विशिष्टचेतनायुक्ता नराचा जीवजातयः।
स्वस्वाभाविकयोः सौख्यैश्वर्ययोस्त्यागतो ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! विशिष्टचेतन मनुष्य आदि जीवगण अपने स्वाभाविक सुख और ऐश्वर्य के त्याग द्वारा
english_translation: The three primary limbs of dharma are sacrifice, austerity, and charity; sacrifice is the chief among them and is classified into three types.
essence: True purpose is upheld by sacrifice, discipline, and giving, with sacrifice as the key.
simple_meaning: Dharma, your true purpose, has three main parts: sacrifice, discipline, and giving; sacrifice is the most important and has three kinds.
insight: Recognize that your life's true purpose is supported by giving, disciplined effort, and self-offering; sacrifice holds a special place.
modern_relevance: When you balance self-discipline, generosity, and meaningful offerings, your actions align with a deeper purpose beyond daily routines.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अदृष्टशक्तिं परमां यां लभ्यन्ते सुरर्षभा:।
नमव यज्ञं संपाहुः सर्वे नत्त्वविवेचकाः ॥
translation: जो परम अदृश्य शक्ति अवश्य प्राप्त करते हैं उसी को तत्त्वविवेचक लोग यज्ञ कहते हैं।
english_translation: The wise scholars, experts in all scriptures, have declared that knowledge, action, and devotion are essential.
essence: True wisdom recognizes knowledge, action, and devotion as inseparable and essential together.
simple_meaning: Wise scholars who know all the scriptures say that knowledge, action, and devotion are interconnected essentials.
insight: It teaches you to integrate your understanding, your efforts, and your heartfelt devotion into one seamless approach.
modern_relevance: When you face complex decisions, remember that learning, doing, and caring must all work together for balance.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
एतेषामेव सर्वेषामङ्गानां क्रमशः सुराः।
शृणु्दध्वं त्रिविधान भेदान् वाम्यहं गुणभेदतः ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! इन्हीं सब अङ्गों के त्रिविध भेदों को क्रमशः बतलाता है, आपलोग शांत चित्त होकर ध्यान से सुनिए
english_translation: Beings with distinct consciousness, like humans, attain certainty by renouncing their natural comforts and wealth.
essence: Certainty arises when conscious beings renounce their natural pleasures and wealth.
simple_meaning: Distinct conscious beings like humans gain true certainty by giving up their natural pleasures and wealth.
insight: It shifts you from identifying with comfort to embracing certainty through renunciation.
modern_relevance: You might cling to familiar comforts and possessions, but real confidence grows when you step beyond them.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
दातव्यामिति यहानं दीयतेऽनुपकारिणे ।
देशे काले च पात्रे च तदानं सात्त्विकं स्मृतम् ॥
translation: "दान करना उचित है" इस विचार से देश काल और पात्र की विवेचना करके प्रत्युपकार करने में असमर्थ व्यक्ति को जो दान किया जाता है वह सात्त्विक दान कहा गया है।
english_translation: The supreme unseen power attained by the highest beings is called sacrifice by the discerning.
essence: True sacrifice is the attainment of a supreme unseen power by the highest beings.
simple_meaning: The greatest unseen power attained by noble beings is called sacrifice by those who understand its true nature.
insight: It teaches you to see sacrifice not as external ritual but as connecting with an inner, unseen power.
modern_relevance: When you push beyond what you see or control, you tap into a force that wise people recognize as true offering or sacrifice.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यत्तु प्रत्युपकारार्थ फलमुद्दिश्य वा पुनः।
दीयते च परिक्लिष्टं तद्राजसमुदाहृतम् ॥
translation: किन्तु जो दान प्रत्युपकार के लिये अथवा फल की कामना करके कष्टपूर्वक दिया जाता है उस दान को राजस दान कहते हैं।
english_translation: O radiant beings! Listen carefully as I explain the threefold distinctions of all these parts in order.
essence: Calm attention prepares you to understand the threefold distinctions among all parts.
simple_meaning: You are asked to listen carefully as the speaker explains the three types of distinctions among all parts.
insight: It teaches the value of calm attention before receiving knowledge that unfolds in stages.
modern_relevance: You pause and quiet your mind just before an important explanation that will clarify complex ideas.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अदेशकाले यदानमपात्रेभ्यश्च दीयते।
असत्कृतमवज्ञातं तत्तामसमुदाहृतम् ॥
translation: देश और काल की विवेचना न करके, सत्कारशून्य और तिरस्कारपूर्वक अपात्रों को जो दान दिया जाता है वह तामस दान कहलाता है
english_translation: Giving charity with consideration of place, time, and recipient, even to one unable to reciprocate, is called pure (sattvic) charity.
essence: Pure giving happens when you consider place, time, and recipient without expecting return.
simple_meaning: Giving charity thoughtfully by checking the right place, time, and recipient, even if they cannot return the favor, is considered pure giving.
insight: It teaches you to give with care and timing rather than impulsively, valuing the act over the return.
modern_relevance: You decide to help a friend who can’t repay you right now, choosing the moment and way carefully—it feels right and meaningful.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
श्रद्धया परया तप्तं तपस्तत्रिविधं सुराः।
अफलाकालिंक्षभिर्ययुक्तैः सात्विकं परिचक्षते ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! आत्मा में अवस्थित व्यक्तियों के द्वारा परम श्रद्धापूर्वक और फल-कामना रहित होकर अनुष्ठित शारीरिक वाचनिक और मानसिक तप को सात्त्विक कहते हैं
english_translation: But a gift given with the intention of return or desire for fruit, and given with difficulty, is called rajasic gift.
essence: Giving with expectation creates inner struggle and is not true generosity.
simple_meaning: Giving with expectation or wanting something in return creates tension and is called rajasic giving.
insight: It teaches you to notice when giving is motivated by desire, making your actions less pure and more stressful.
modern_relevance: You offer help or gifts hoping for thanks or favors, but that hope makes you anxious and less free.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सत्कारमानपूजार्थं तपो दम्भेन चैव यत् ।
क्रियते तदिह प्रोक्तं राजसं चलमध्रुवम् ॥
translation: संस्कार मान और पूजा के लिये एवं दम्भपूर्वक जो तपस्या की जाती है इस लोक में अनित्य और क्षणिक वह तपस्या राजस कही जाती है
english_translation: Giving gifts to unworthy recipients without considering place and time, done with disrespect, is called tamasic giving.
essence: Giving without respect for time, place, and recipient is harmful and dark in quality.
simple_meaning: Giving without considering the right place, time, or worthy recipients, and done disrespectfully, is improper giving called tamasic.
insight: It teaches you to pause and consider timing, recipient, and attitude before giving to keep your action pure.
modern_relevance: You offer help or gifts impulsively, ignoring whether the timing or the person is right, making your efforts less meaningful or even harmful.
speaker: Vishnu
