verse_text:
मूढग्राहेणात्मनो यत् पीड़या क्रियते तपः ।
परस्योत्सादनार्थम्वा तत्तामसमुदाहृतम ॥
translation: अविवेक के वश होकर दूसरों के नाश के वा आत्मपीड़ा के द्वारा जो तपस्या की जाती है उसको तामस कहते हैं
english_translation: O divine beings! The supreme austerity performed with utmost faith by those established in the true self, without desire for results, through body, speech, and mind, is called sattvic.
essence: Discipline rooted in faith and free from desire purifies body, speech, and mind.
simple_meaning: Discipline done with deep faith, without wanting rewards, using body, speech, and mind, is called pure or sattvic discipline.
insight: It teaches you to focus fully on your actions with faith, releasing attachment to what follows.
modern_relevance: You push yourself hard in your daily routine but stay calm because your effort isn't tied to praise or results.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
नियतं सङ्गरहितमरागद्वेषतः कृतम् ।
अफलपेप्सुना कर्म यत्तत्सात्त्विकमुच्यते ॥
translation: निष्काम व्यक्तियों के द्वारा नियमितरूप से विहित, आसक्तिशून्य और रागद्वेषरहित होकर जो कर्म किया जाता है उसे सात्त्विक कर्म कहते हैं
english_translation: Any austerity performed here for respect, honor, or show is described as rajasic—unstable and fleeting.
essence: Effort done for show is unstable and quickly fades away.
simple_meaning: Doing spiritual practices only to gain respect or praise is unstable and temporary.
insight: It teaches you to examine your motivation, shifting from seeking approval to authentic inner commitment.
modern_relevance: You work hard just to impress others, but the feeling of emptiness remains once the applause fades.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यत्तु कामेपमुना कर्म साहङ्कारेण वा पुनः।
क्रियते वहुलायासं तद्राजसमुदाहृतम् ॥
translation: फलाकांक्षी अथवा अहंकारयुक्त व्यक्तियों के द्वारा बहुत प्रयास से जो कर्म किया जाता है उसको राजस कहते हैं
english_translation: When suffering or austerity is performed out of ignorance or to harm others, it is called tamasic.
essence: Discipline that arises from ignorance or harm to others is false and dark.
simple_meaning: Discipline or austerity done in ignorance or to hurt others is harmful and considered tamasic.
insight: It shifts your practice from harmful self-punishment to respectful, conscious effort that supports all beings.
modern_relevance: Trying to push yourself through pain or to hurt others never leads to true growth or peace.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अनुबन्ध भयं हिंसामनपेक्ष्य च पौरुषम् ।
मोहादारभ्यते कर्म यत्तत्तामसमुच्यते ॥
translation: परिणाम में बन्धन, नाश, हिंसा और सामर्थ्य इन सबकी उपेक्षा करके मोहवश जो कर्म प्रारम्भ किया जाता है उसको तामस कहते हैं
english_translation: Action performed regularly by selfless persons, free from attachment, desire, and hatred, is called pure (sattvic) action.
essence: Pure action is steady, selfless, and free from craving and hatred.
simple_meaning: Regular actions done without attachment, desire, or hatred, and without expecting results, are pure and good.
insight: It shifts your focus from craving outcomes to steady, balanced action without emotional disturbance.
modern_relevance: You keep doing your tasks each day without obsessing over praise or blame, finding calm in steady effort.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
मुक्तसङ्गोऽनहवाडी धृत्युत्साहसमन्वितः।
सिद्भयसिद्धयोनिर्विकारः कर्त्ता सात्त्विक उच्यते ॥
translation: आसक्तिशून्य, "अहं" इस अभिमान से शून्य धैर्य और उत्साहयुक्त, सिद्धि और असिद्धि में विकारशून्य कर्ता सात्त्विक कहा जाता है
english_translation: Actions done with desire or ego-driven effort are called rajasic.
essence: Effort driven by desire or ego creates restless, rajasic action.
simple_meaning: Actions performed with craving or ego involve intense effort and are called rajasic nature.
insight: It teaches you to notice when desire or ego drives your effort, so you can shift toward calmer action.
modern_relevance: You push hard on projects because you want praise or to prove yourself, making your work feel heavy and restless.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
रागी कर्मफलप्रेप्सुलुब्धो हिमात्मकोऽशुचिः।
हर्षशोकान्वितः कर्त्ता राजसः परिकीर्तितः ॥
translation: विषयानुरागी, कर्म फलाकांक्षी, लोभी, हिंसाशील, अशुचि, लाभा लाभ में आनन्द और विषादयुक्त कर्ता राजस कहा जाता है
english_translation: Actions begun out of delusion, ignoring bondage, destruction, violence, and strength, are called tamasic.
essence: Actions begun in delusion, ignoring harm or strength, are tamasic in nature.
simple_meaning: When you act out of confusion, ignoring harm, consequences, or your strength, your actions are called tamasic.
insight: Recognize when confusion drives your actions and choose clarity to avoid harm.
modern_relevance: You might rush into decisions ignoring risks or your true capacity, acting from confusion rather than clarity.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अयुक्तः प्राकृतः स्तब्धः शठोऽनष्कृतिकोऽलसः।
विषादी दीर्घसूत्री च कर्ता तामस उच्यते ॥
translation: इन्द्रियासक्त, विवेकहीन, उद्धत; शठ, निष्कृति-शून्य, आलस्य युक्त, विषाद युक्त और दीर्घसूत्री का तामस कहा जाता है
english_translation: A detached doer, free from the pride of 'I', with steady patience and enthusiasm, untainted by success or failure, is called sattvic.
essence: A true doer acts with calm patience and joy, free of ego and outcome.
simple_meaning: You are steady and enthusiastic without pride or attachment, unaffected by success or failure. This balanced doer is called sattvic.
insight: It shifts your focus from ego and outcomes to steady, joyful effort in the present moment.
modern_relevance: You face a challenge with calm patience and energy, not obsessed with winning or losing, simply doing your best.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
उपास्तेः प्राणरूपा या भक्तिः प्रोक्ता दिवौकसः !।
गुणत्रयानुसारेण सा त्रिधा वर्तते ननु ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! उपासना की जो प्राणरूपा भक्ति कही गई है वह भक्ति तीन गुणों के अनुसार निश्चय तीन प्रकार की है
english_translation: One who is attached to sense objects, desires the fruits of actions, is greedy, violent, impure, and experiences joy and sorrow as the doer is called rajasic.
essence: Desire and craving make you a restless doer caught in emotional extremes.
simple_meaning: If you are attached to things, want rewards, act greedily or violently, and feel happiness and sadness as the doer, you are driven by rajasic energy.
insight: See how craving creates emotional ups and downs and fuels restless, impure actions.
modern_relevance: You find yourself chasing rewards, swinging between excitement and disappointment as you act with craving and impatience.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
आर्त्तनां तामसी सा स्याजिज्ञामूनाञ्च राजसी।
सात्त्विक्यार्थिनां ज्ञेया उत्तमा सोत्तरोत्तरा ॥
translation: आर्तभक्तों की भक्ति तामसी, जिज्ञासु भक्तों की भक्ति राजसी और अर्थार्थी भक्तों की भक्ति सात्त्विकी जानना चाहिये। इन तीन प्रकार की भक्तियों मे उत्तरोतर श्रेष्ठ है
english_translation: The one who is unprepared, natural in ignorance, motionless, deceitful, without initiative, lazy, full of despair and long-winded is called tamasic.
essence: Inertia, despair, and laziness together create a state that clouds clear action and knowing.
simple_meaning: When you are inactive, confused, lazy, and full of despair, these qualities reflect a tamasic nature.
insight: It teaches you to identify and move beyond inertia and despair, which block your natural energy.
modern_relevance: You sit frozen, overwhelmed by negative thoughts and apathy, unable to start the work you care about.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
भूतप्रेतपिशाचादीनासुरं भावमाश्रितान् ।
अर्चन्ति तामसा भक्ता नित्यं तद्गावभाविताः ॥
translation: तामसिक भक्त आसुरीसंपत्ति युक्त भूत प्रेत पिशाचादि की उपासना तत्तद्भावों में भावित होकर नित्य करते हैं
english_translation: O divine beings! The devotion that is the life force of worship is indeed threefold, according to the three qualities.
essence: Devotion naturally expresses itself in three distinct forms shaped by fundamental qualities.
simple_meaning: Devotion, the vital energy of worship, naturally appears in three forms based on different qualities.
insight: Recognize that devotion is not one fixed feeling but varies naturally with your inner qualities and circumstances.
modern_relevance: When you notice how your feelings of devotion or care change with your mood or environment, you glimpse these three natural forms at work within you.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सकामा राजसा ये म्युः ऋषीन पितृश्च देवताः।
वह्वीदैवदेवीश्च मे शक्तीः पूजयन्तीह ते सदा ॥
translation: सकाम राजसिक भक्त ऋषि देवता और पितर एवं मेरी बहुत सी दैवी शक्तियों की उपासना सदा करते हैं
english_translation: Devotion of the distressed is tamasic, of the curious is rajasic, and of those seeking meaning is sattvic; the latter is progressively superior.
essence: Devotion evolves from confusion and restlessness toward a clear, meaningful, and superior form.
simple_meaning: There are three kinds of devotion: arising from suffering (dark and confusing), from restless curiosity (active but unsettled), and from seeking true meaning (clear and pure). The last is the highest form.
insight: It teaches you to recognize your devotion’s quality and gently guide it from restlessness or pain toward meaningful clarity.
modern_relevance: When your feelings push you to seek support out of pain or curiosity, your devotion feels unstable. But when you find deeper purpose, your commitment calms and strengthens.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
केवलं सात्त्विका ये स्युर्मद्भक्ताः साधका इह।
त एवं ज्ञात्वा मद्रूपं मम भक्तौ सदा रताः॥
translation: इस संसार में केवल जो साधक मेरे सात्त्विक भक्त है वह ही मेरे रूप को जानकर सदा मेरी भक्ति में तत्पर रहते हैं
english_translation: Devotees influenced by darkness constantly worship beings like ghosts, spirits, and shadowy forces, absorbed in their own states.
essence: Your inner mood shapes the objects of your devotion and worship.
simple_meaning: Your feelings and inner state determine what you devote yourself to and what you worship.
insight: Recognize how your emotional state directs your focus and devotion, and choose to cultivate clarity to uplift your attention.
modern_relevance: When your mind is clouded with fear or confusion, you might find yourself drawn to harmful habits or negative influences without realizing it.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
पंचाना सगुणानां ते मद्रूपाणा स्माश्रयात ।
मद्धयानमग्नास्तिष्टन्ति निर्गुणं हाथवा मम ॥
translation: वह मेरे मेरे पांच सगुण रूपों के आश्रय से मेरे ध्यान में मग्न रहते हैं अथवा मेरे निर्गण परमभावरूप
english_translation: Desiring and passionate devotees like sages, deities, ancestors, and many divine energies always worship me.
essence: Passionate longing draws many beings to devotedly honor the divine presence.
simple_meaning: Many beings filled with desire and passion, including sages, ancestors, and divine forces, always worship the divine presence.
insight: It teaches you that devotion naturally arises from longing and passion, connecting you to the larger flow of dedicated love.
modern_relevance: When you feel drawn to someone or something deeply, you are joining a long tradition of devoted attention flowing toward what moves the heart.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सच्चिदानन्दभावं तं भावं परममाश्रिताः।
मम ध्यानाम्बुधौ मग्ना नन्दन्ति नितरां सुराः ! ॥
translation: उस सच्चिदानन्द भावका आश्रय करके मेरे ध्यानरूप समुद्र मे मग्न होकर हे देवगण! अंत्यंत आनंद उपभोग करते हैं
english_translation: Only those devotees who are pure and sattvic can truly know my form and remain always devoted to me.
essence: Pure, sattvic devotion is the key that reveals and sustains connection with the divine form.
simple_meaning: Only pure and sincere devotees can truly recognize the divine form and remain devoted continuously.
insight: It teaches you that sincere, pure devotion is what reveals deeper spiritual realities and keeps your commitment alive.
modern_relevance: When your intentions are pure and your heart open, you naturally connect deeply with what matters most.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ज्ञानी भक्तस्तु भगवद्र्प एव मतो यतः।
गुणातीतस्य तस्यात्र न निवेशो विधीयते ॥
translation: और चतुर्थ ज्ञानी भक्त तो भगवद्रपही है क्योंकि वह गुणातीत है अतः उसका यहां विचार नहीं किया गया है
english_translation: The five with attributes take refuge in my forms, and the rest, without attributes, remain absorbed in my essence.
essence: Connection to the divine happens through either form with qualities or formlessness without them.
simple_meaning: Some beings focus on the divine with qualities, while others are absorbed in the divine without qualities.
insight: It teaches you to accept diverse ways of relating to the divine—through concrete forms or abstract essence.
modern_relevance: Sometimes you relate to a clear image or idea of what matters; other times, you connect through silence and openness beyond form.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
श्रद्धावान् साधको यश्च भोगमैहिकमेव हि ।
विशेषतः समीहेत दम्भाहकारसंयुतः ॥
translation: जो श्रद्धावान् साधक ऐहलौकिक भोग की ही विशेषरूप से इच्छा करे, दम्भ और अहङ्कार से युक्त हो
english_translation: Those who take refuge in that supreme state of truth, consciousness, and bliss, immersed in the ocean of my meditation, delight immensely, O celestial beings!
essence: Deep immersion in the supreme meditation brings boundless joy to those who seek refuge.
simple_meaning: When you take refuge in the supreme state of truth, consciousness, and bliss and immerse yourself deeply in meditation on the divine, you experience great joy.
insight: It teaches you that surrendering fully to meditation opens the way to profound joy beyond ordinary pleasure.
modern_relevance: You sit quietly, fully focused, and suddenly feel a wave of deep joy that nothing else can bring.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
इष्टं वेदविधि हित्वा मदुपासनतत्परः ।
विज्ञेयो लक्षणादस्मात् तामसः स उपासकः ॥
translation: और उपयुक्त वेदविधि का त्याग करके मेरी उपासना में तत्पर हो, इन लक्षणों से उस उपासक को तामसिक उपासक जानना चाहिये
english_translation: A wise devotee is truly like the supreme being because they transcend qualities and are not considered here.
essence: Transcending qualities makes a devotee indistinguishable from the supreme being.
simple_meaning: A wise devotee transcends all qualities and is seen as one with the supreme being.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that transcending personal qualities aligns you with the highest essence beyond change.
modern_relevance: When you stop identifying with your moods and habits, you experience a deep connection to something greater than yourself.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यः श्रद्धालुर्विशेषेण पारलौकिकमेव हि।
सुखमिच्छंस्तथा शीलगुणराशियुतो यदि ॥
translation: जो श्रद्धालु साधक पारलौकिक सुख को ही विशेषरूप से चाहता हुआ यदि शीलगुणों से युक्त होकर
english_translation: A sincere practitioner who especially desires worldly pleasures is bound by deceit and ego.
essence: Focusing faith on worldly pleasure binds you to ego and deceit.
simple_meaning: If you focus your faith on seeking only worldly pleasures, you become attached to ego and falsehood.
insight: It shifts your focus from deeper purpose to surface desires, strengthening ego and false appearances.
modern_relevance: You might find yourself chasing status or material things, not noticing how pride and illusion quietly grow inside you.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
वेदानुसारतः सक्तो मदुपास्तौ हि साधकः।
राजसः स हि विज्ञेय उपासक इति स्मृतिः ॥
translation: वेदविधि के अनुसार मेरी उपासना में आसक्त रहता है तो उसको राजसिक उपासक जानना चाहिये, ऐसा स्मृतिकारों का मत है
english_translation: One who abandons the prescribed Vedic rituals and eagerly devotes themselves to my worship is known by these signs as a tamasic devotee.
essence: True devotion includes respecting proper practice, not just eager worship alone.
simple_meaning: Giving up correct rituals yet focusing only on worship without understanding is a sign of a tamasic (ignorant or dull) devotee.
insight: It teaches you to balance heartfelt devotion with disciplined, wise practice to avoid falling into confusion.
modern_relevance: You might focus on passion or desire in your practice but miss the essential habits and understanding that give it true power.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सात्त्विक्या श्रद्धया युक्तो भाग्यवान विबुधर्षभाः ।
वितृष्णो लोकिकादागात्तद्द्वै पारलौकिकात् ॥
translation: हे देवश्रेष्टों ! जो भाग्यवान् साधक सात्त्विकी श्रद्धा से युक्त होकर ऐहलौकिक और पारलौकिक भोगों की तृष्णा से रहित होता हुआ
english_translation: If a devoted practitioner especially desires only worldly happiness and is attached to qualities of character,
essence: Devotion can begin with sincere desire for worldly happiness combined with virtuous qualities.
simple_meaning: A sincere person who mainly wants worldly happiness but has good qualities is still devoted.
insight: Recognize that devotion begins with honest, even worldly, desires combined with good character.
modern_relevance: You care deeply about success and good character; this natural start is a doorway to deeper devotion.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
साधकोऽनन्यया वृत्या ज्ञानतो निरतः सदा ।
मदुपास्तौ स विज्ञेयः सात्त्विकोपासको वरः॥
translation: ज्ञानपूर्वक अनन्यवृत्ति से मेरी उपासना में सदा तत्पर रहता है उसको श्रेष्ठ सात्त्विक उपासक जानना चाहिये
english_translation: According to the Vedas, one who is attached to worshiping me is to be known as a rajasic worshiper, say the scriptures.
essence: Attachment in worship reveals a restless, desire-driven devotion, not true surrender.
simple_meaning: When someone worships with attachment, scriptures say that person follows rajasic devotion, driven by desire and restlessness.
insight: Recognize attachment in your devotion or efforts as a sign to shift from desire-driven actions to freer, selfless practice.
modern_relevance: You might find yourself clinging to how your efforts are recognized or rewarded, which shows rajasic tendencies in your devotion or work.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सर्वभूतेषु येनैकं भावमव्ययमीक्षते ।
अविभक्तं विभक्तेपु तज़ज्ञानं वित्त सात्त्विकम् ॥
translation: जिस ज्ञान के द्वारा विभक्त रूप सब भूतों में अविभक्त, एक और विकारहीन भाव ज्ञानी देखता है उस ज्ञान को सात्त्विक ज्ञान जानना चाहिए
english_translation: O best of the divine beings! The fortunate practitioner with pure faith is free from craving both worldly and beyond-worldly pleasures.
essence: Pure faith frees you from craving both worldly and spiritual pleasures.
simple_meaning: Having pure and sincere trust helps you let go of desires for both worldly and spiritual pleasures.
insight: It shifts your focus from craving outcomes to resting in steady trust, calming restless desires.
modern_relevance: You feel stuck wanting success or recognition, but pure trust can free you from chasing every reward.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
पृथक्त्वेन तु यज्ज्ञानं नानाभावान् पृवविधान् ।
अतत्त्वार्थवदल्पञ्च तत्तामममुदाहृतम् ॥
translation: जो ज्ञान पृथक रूप से सभी प्राणियों मे पृथक पृथक अनेकों प्रकार के भाव जानता है उस ज्ञान को राजसिक ज्ञान जानना चाहिए
english_translation: One who is devoted to me with exclusive focus and always absorbed in knowledge is to be known as the best sattvic devotee.
essence: Exclusive focus combined with knowledge defines the highest form of devotion.
simple_meaning: The best devotee is one who worships with full, exclusive focus and is always absorbed in knowledge.
insight: Shift your devotion from scattered attention to focused knowledge, deepening your connection profoundly.
modern_relevance: When you dedicate yourself fully to a passion or belief, grounding it in clear understanding, you become truly exceptional.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यत्तु कृत्सनवदेकास्मिन कार्य सक्तमहैतुकम ।
अत्त्तार्वथवादाल्पन्च्य तत्तामसमुदाहृतं ॥
translation: जो एक कार्य में परिपूर्णवत् आसक्त, हेतुशून्य, परमार्थरहित और अल्प अर्थात् तुच्छ ज्ञान है उसको तामस ज्ञान कहते है
english_translation: The knowledge by which a knower sees the undivided, one, and unchanging essence in all beings, beyond their divided forms and faults, is called sattvic knowledge.
essence: True knowledge is seeing one pure essence beyond all divided forms and faults.
simple_meaning: You can know a pure kind of wisdom when you see the same unchanging essence in every being, beyond their many forms and faults.
insight: This verse teaches you to shift your perception from external differences to the unified essence beneath.
modern_relevance: When you stop judging others by their flaws and see the shared essence in everyone, relationships and understanding deepen.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सूरा: ! श्रुनुध्वमधुना सम्बन्धत्रिगुणस्य ह । 
अन्यान्यपि रहस्यानि कानिचिद्वर्णयाम्यहम् ॥
translation: हे देवगण! अब मैं त्रिगुणसम्बन्ध से सम्बंधित कुछ अन्य रहस्यों का कुछ वर्णन करता हूँ वह सुनिए
english_translation: Knowledge that separately perceives many different qualities in all beings is called rajasic knowledge.
essence: Knowing many separate qualities is incomplete knowledge, lacking deeper unity.
simple_meaning: Knowing many things as separate and different is a kind of knowledge, but it doesn’t see the whole truth.
insight: It teaches you to see beyond separate appearances to grasp deeper unity.
modern_relevance: When you focus on differences and categories in people or situations, you might miss the full, connected picture underneath.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सत्त्वावलम्बिनो यूयं शृण्वन्तो भवतादरात्।
सत्त्वं क्रमावर्द्धयदि स्त्रैगुण्ये च यत्यताम् ॥
translation: और आप उसको आदरपूर्वक सुनते हुए सत्वगुण अवलंबी होइए और क्रमशः सत्वगुण की वृद्धि करते हुए गुणातीत पद के लिये प्रयत्न करिये
english_translation: The knowledge that is completely attached to a single action, without reason, lacking true purpose, and is small or insignificant is called tamasic knowledge.
essence: Clinging blindly to one action without reason is shallow, tamasic knowledge.
simple_meaning: When your knowledge is fixed on just one action, without reason or deeper purpose, and is very limited, it is called tamasic knowledge.
insight: It teaches you to notice when your focus is too narrow and encourages seeking broader, reasoned understanding.
modern_relevance: When you insist on doing one thing your way without questioning or understanding why, your perspective shrinks and your growth stalls.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अफलाकाङ्गिभिर्यज्ञो विधिदृष्टो य इज्यते ।
यष्टव्यमेवेति मनः समाधाय स सात्त्विकः ॥
translation: फल आकांशा रहित व्यक्ति "यज्ञानुष्ठान अवश्य कर्तव्य कर्म है। ऐसा विचार कर और मन को शांत करके जिस विधि विहित यज्ञ को करते हैं उसको सात्त्विक कहते हैं
english_translation: O radiant beings! Now I will describe some other secrets related to the three qualities. Listen.
essence: There are deeper secrets about the three qualities yet to be revealed.
simple_meaning: The speaker invites listeners to hear more secrets about the three qualities that govern nature and life.
insight: It reminds you to stay open to deeper layers of understanding beyond initial knowledge.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अभिसन्धाय तु फलं दम्भार्थमपि चैव यत् ।
इज्यते विबुधश्रेष्ठाः ! तं यज्ञ वित्त राजसम्  ॥
translation: किन्तु हे देवश्रेष्ठो ! फल मिलने के उद्देश्य से अथवा केवल अपने महत्त्व के प्रकट करने के अर्थ जो यज्ञ किया जाता है उस यज्ञ को राजस मानना चाहिए
english_translation: And you, respectfully listening, become devoted to the quality of goodness, gradually increasing it while striving for the state beyond the three qualities.
essence: You can steadily grow goodness while striving to transcend all qualities.
simple_meaning: Respectfully listen and embrace the quality of goodness. Gradually increase it by effort, aiming to move beyond all three qualities.
insight: It teaches you to honor your current goodness while actively striving to surpass all limiting qualities.
modern_relevance: You recognize positive habits growing inside you and decide to nurture them while aiming for a deeper transformation beyond just good or bad traits.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
विधिहीनमसृष्टान्ने मन्त्रहीनमदक्षिणम् ।
श्रद्धाविरहितं यज्ञं तामसं परिचक्षते ॥
translation: अन्नदानशून्य, मन्त्रहीन, दक्षिणाहीन और श्रद्धा रहित यज्ञ को तामस यज्ञ कहते हैं
english_translation: A person who performs the prescribed sacrifice without desire for results, with a calm and focused mind, is called sattvic.
essence: Act without desire for results; calm focus makes your action pure.
simple_meaning: You should perform your duties calmly and without wanting any reward; this kind of action is pure and right.
insight: It shifts your attention from chasing outcomes to holding steady focus on the action itself.
modern_relevance: You finish a tough task without checking your phone for praise or results, simply focused on doing it well.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
प्रवृत्तिञ्च निवृत्तिञ्च कार्याकायें भयाभये ।
बन्धं मोक्षञ्च या वेत्ति बुद्धिः सा सात्त्विकी सुगः ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! प्रवृत्ति निवृत्ति, कार्य्य अकार्य, भय अभय और बन्ध मोक्ष जो जानती है वह सात्त्विकी बुद्धि है
english_translation: But O best of the radiant beings, a sacrifice performed with the intention of gaining a result or merely to show off should be considered of the rajasic nature.
essence: Acting with desire or pride makes your action restless and attached.
simple_meaning: When you act only to get something or to appear important, your action is driven by restlessness and attachment.
insight: Recognize when your motivation is desire or pride and shift towards acting for its own sake, freeing your effort from restlessness.
modern_relevance: You work hard to impress others or chase rewards, but that restless energy makes your efforts feel heavy and unsatisfying.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यया धर्ममधर्मञ्च कार्यञ्चाकार्यमेव च ।
अयथावत प्रजानाति बुद्धिः सा राजसी मता ॥
translation: जिसके द्वारा धर्म अधर्म और कार्य अकार्य यथावत् परिज्ञात न हो उसको राजसी बुद्धि कहते हैं
english_translation: A sacrifice without food offering, without mantra, without gift, and without faith is called a tamasic sacrifice.
essence: Actions without intention, support, or faith become empty and lifeless.
simple_meaning: A ritual without food, mantra, gift, or faith is empty and called tamasic.
insight: Recognize that actions without wholehearted intention and support lose their power and meaning.
modern_relevance: You might go through motions at work or with loved ones without genuine care, making efforts feel empty and lifeless.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अधर्म धर्ममिति या मन्यते तमसावृता।
सर्वार्थान् विपरीतांश्च बुद्धिः सा तामसी मता ॥
translation: जो बुद्धि अधर्म को धर्म मानती है और सब विषयों को विपरीत मानती है उस तमोगुणाच्छन्न बुद्धि को तामसी बुद्धि कहते हैं
english_translation: The intellect that understands action and inaction, fear and fearlessness, bondage and freedom is the pure intellect.
essence: True intellect clearly perceives what to act on and what to avoid without fear.
simple_meaning: True clarity arises when the mind can distinguish what actions to take or avoid, what causes fear or fearlessness, and what leads to bondage or freedom.
insight: It shifts your thinking to carefully distinguish between necessary actions and distractions, reducing anxiety about outcomes.
modern_relevance: When you face tough choices, your mind feels calm if it can clearly tell what’s worth acting on and what to let go.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
धृत्या यया धारयते मनःमाणेन्द्रियक्रियाः।
योगेनाव्यभिचारिण्या देवाः ! सा सात्त्विकी धृतिः ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! योग के द्वारा विषयान्तर धारणा न करनेवाली जिस धृति से मन प्राण और इन्द्रियों की क्रिया धारण की जाती है अर्थात् नियमन होती है वह धृति सात्त्विकी धृति है।
english_translation: The intellect that cannot properly distinguish between right and wrong, and what should or should not be done, is called rajasic intellect.
essence: Confused intellect that can't distinguish right from wrong is ruled by rajasic nature.
simple_meaning: An intellect that fails to clearly understand what is right or wrong, and what should or should not be done, is influenced by rajasic qualities.
insight: It teaches you to recognize when confusion clouds your decisions and to seek clarity beyond restless impulses.
modern_relevance: You hesitate at work or in life because your mind can't clearly tell which choice aligns with your values and which doesn't.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यया तु धर्मकामार्थान् धृत्या धारयतेऽमराः।
प्रसङ्गेन फलाकांक्षी धृतिः सा राजसी मता ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! जिस धृति के द्वारा (जीव) धर्म अर्थ और कामको धारण करता है एवं प्रसङ्गवश फलाकांक्षी होता है उस धृति को राजसी कहते हैं
english_translation: The intellect that mistakes unrighteousness for righteousness and sees all things in reverse is called the intellect covered by darkness (Tamas).
essence: Confusing wrong for right reveals a mind clouded by darkness and distorted perception.
simple_meaning: When your understanding mistakes what is wrong for what is right and sees everything backward, that mind is clouded by darkness.
insight: This verse teaches you to recognize when your mind reverses reality, prompting you to seek clearer understanding.
modern_relevance: You catch yourself defending decisions or beliefs that deep down feel wrong, realizing your perspective is clouded and needs clearing.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यया स्वप्नं भयं शोकं विषादं मदमेव च ।
न विमुञ्चति दुर्मेधा धृतिः सा तामसी सुराः । ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! विवेकहीन व्यक्ति जिसके द्वारा निद्रा, भय, शोक,विषाद और अहंकार का त्याग नहीं करता है वही तामसी धृति है
english_translation: O divine beings! The steadfastness by which the mind, life force, and senses are controlled without distraction through yoga is called sattvic steadfastness.
essence: True steadiness means controlling mind and senses without distraction through yoga.
simple_meaning: Steadfastness means controlling your mind, life force, and senses without distraction through yoga.
insight: It teaches you to steady your mind and senses through unwavering yoga practice, strengthening inner control.
modern_relevance: When your attention drifts during work or conversation, steadying your mind helps you stay present and effective.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
स्मृति व्यतीत विषयां मतिमागामि गोचाराम
प्रज्ञा नवनवोन्मेषशालिनी प्रतिभा विदुः ॥
translation: अतीत विषयों से सम्बन्ध रखनेवाली प्रज्ञा को स्मृति, आगामि विषयों से सम्बन्ध रखनेवाली प्रज्ञा को बुद्धि और नवीन  ज्ञान विज्ञानों का उद्भव करने वाली प्रज्ञा को प्रतिभा कहते हैं
english_translation: The steadfastness by which beings uphold duty, wealth, and desire, yet cling to results, is called rajasic steadfastness.
essence: Steadfastness tied to craving results is rajasic, even when it upholds duty and desire.
simple_meaning: Some people hold onto their duties, desires, and wealth but still want the rewards from them. This way of holding on with craving is called rajasic steadfastness.
insight: It teaches you to notice when your steady efforts are still motivated by wanting something back, not just by the action itself.
modern_relevance: You finish a task but keep checking for praise or reward, feeling restless until you get it.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
द्रष्टुर्दश्यस्योपलब्धौ क्षमा चत् प्रतिभा तदा।
सात्त्विकी सा समाख्याता सर्वलोकहिते रता ॥
translation: जब द्रष्टा और दृश्य की उपलब्धि प्रतिभा समर्थ होती है तब सभी लोकों के हित में तत्पर वह प्रतिभा सात्त्विकी कही जाती है।
english_translation: O divine beings, that dull determination which does not abandon sleep, fear, sorrow, grief, and ego is the tamasic resolve.
essence: Clinging to fear and ego is a dull resolve that blocks true clarity and freedom.
simple_meaning: Holding on to sleepiness, fear, sorrow, grief, and ego without letting go is a dull and confused kind of determination called tamasic resolve.
insight: It teaches you to recognize when your determination is actually resistance to growth, rooted in fear and confusion.
modern_relevance: You find yourself stuck in old fears and negative moods, unable to shake off tired patterns that drain your energy.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यदा शिल्पकलायां सा पदार्थालोचन तथा।
प्रसरेदराजसी ज्ञेया तदा सा प्रतिभा बुधैः ॥
translation: जब वह शिल्पकला और पदार्थीको आलोचना में प्रसार को प्राप्त होती है तब उस प्रतिभा को बुधगण राजसी प्रतिभा जानते हैं
english_translation: Pragya connected to past objects is memory; to future objects is intellect; that which creates new knowledge is insight.
essence: Wisdom divides into memory of past, intellect of future, and insight creating new knowledge.
simple_meaning: Wisdom works in three ways: memory recalls the past, intellect plans the future, and insight creates new understanding.
insight: Recognize these three mental modes so you can balance recalling, planning, and creating without being overwhelmed by any one.
modern_relevance: Your mind replays yesterday's events, worries about tomorrow's tasks, and suddenly sparks new solutions in the present moment.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
साधारणं लौकिकञ्चेत् सदसद्रिमृशेत्तदा ।
तामसी सा समाख्याता प्रत्युत्पन्नमतिश्च सा ॥
translation: जब वह साधारण लौकिक सत् असत का विचार करे तो उसको तामसी प्रतिभा कहते हैं और उसको प्रत्युत्पन्नमति भी कहते हैं
english_translation: When the seer and the seen are truly realized, that clarity is called sattvika, devoted to the welfare of all worlds.
essence: Clarity arises when you realize both the observer and the observed, devoted to universal welfare.
simple_meaning: When you truly perceive yourself and what you observe clearly, that wisdom is pure and seeks the good of all.
insight: It shifts your view from separation to unity, inspiring actions that serve the greater good.
modern_relevance: You notice a moment when your judgments soften and understanding deepens, opening your heart to others' needs beyond yourself.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
त्रिविधा भवति श्रद्धा देहिमकातिभेदतः।
सात्त्विकी राजसी चैव तामसी च बुभुत्सवः ! ॥
translation: हे जिज्ञासुओं! प्राणियों की प्रकृति के अनुसार श्रद्धा तीन प्रकार की होती है, सात्त्विकी राजसी और तामसी
english_translation: When skill expands into the analysis of form and substance, that brilliance is known by the wise as rajasic intellect.
essence: Deep analysis transforms skill into bright, active intelligence recognized by the wise.
simple_meaning: When your skill extends into examining the details of form and substance, this focused intelligence is recognized by the wise as a vibrant, active mind.
insight: It teaches you to value the moment when your effort becomes focused inquiry, turning doing into knowing.
modern_relevance: You notice your focus sharpen when you stop rushing and start really understanding the details of a project or problem.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तासान्तु लक्षणं देवाः ! शृणुध्वं भक्तिभावतः ।
श्रद्धा सा सात्त्विकी ज्ञेया विशुद्धज्ञानमूलिका ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! अब उनके लक्षण भक्ति भाव से सुनो। जो विशुद्ध ज्ञान मूलक श्रद्धा है उसको सात्त्विकी जानो
english_translation: When the mind contemplates the ordinary worldly distinction between existence and non-existence, that is called tamasic intellect, also known as reactive thinking.
essence: Ordinary dualistic thinking is tamasic, a reactive mind state.
simple_meaning: When your mind judges things only as simply true or false in the ordinary world, that thinking is called tamasic, a dull and reactive way of understanding.
insight: It encourages you to notice when your mind reacts habitually, limiting your ability to see complexity.
modern_relevance: You catch yourself judging events or people as simply right or wrong, stuck in a dull, reactive mindset.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
प्रवृतिमूलिका चैव जिज्ञासामूलिका परा।
विचारहीनसंस्कारमूलिका त्वन्तिमा मता ॥
translation: प्रवृत्ति और जिज्ञासामूलक श्रद्धा राजसी है और विचारहीन संस्कारमूलक श्रद्धा तामसी कही गई है
english_translation: O seekers! The faith of beings is of three kinds according to their nature: sattvic, rajasic, and tamasic.
essence: Faith naturally arises in three distinct forms reflecting the nature of each being.
simple_meaning: Faith in beings appears in three forms based on their nature: pure (sattvic), passionate (rajasic), and dull (tamasic).
insight: It teaches you to identify the quality of your faith to better understand your motivations and responses.
modern_relevance: When you feel inspired, restless, or stuck, it reflects the kind of faith driving your thoughts and choices.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
वेदेष्वथ पुराणेषु तन्त्रेऽपि श्रुतिसम्मते ।
भयानक रोचकं हि यथार्थमिति भेदतः ॥
translation: वेद, पुराण और श्रुतिसम्मत तन्त्रों में भयानक रोचक और यथार्थ इन भेदों से
english_translation: O divine beings! Now listen to their characteristics born of devotion. That faith, rooted in pure knowledge, is called sattvic.
essence: Faith grounded in devotion and pure knowledge is steady and true.
simple_meaning: Faith that arises from devotion and is based on pure knowledge is considered pure and balanced.
insight: It shifts your trust from blind belief to faith grounded in clear, discerning knowledge combined with heartfelt devotion.
modern_relevance: When you commit to something because you truly understand and feel connected, your trust becomes strong and clear.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
वाक्यानि त्रिविधान्याहुस्तद्विदो मद्विभावकाः।
श्रूयतां दत्तचित्तैर्हि तत्राऽस्त्येवं व्यवस्थितिः ॥
translation: तीन प्रकार के वाक्य मेरे भावों से भावित तत्त्ववेत्ताओ ने कहे हैं । इस विषय में निम्नलिखित प्रकार से ही व्यवस्था है सो चित्त लगाकर सुनिये
english_translation: Faith rooted in action and inquiry is of the nature of passion, while faith born of thoughtless habits is considered of inertia.
essence: Faith rooted in conscious action and inquiry energizes; faith from thoughtless habit dulls.
simple_meaning: Faith that arises from active effort and sincere questioning is lively and passionate, while faith based on unthinking habits is dull and inactive.
insight: Recognize the source of your faith and nurture the kind that grows from conscious engagement rather than mindless repetition.
modern_relevance: When you follow routines without thinking or question, your trust feels flat. But when you engage your mind and heart, faith becomes alive and motivating.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
पपच्चाऽज्ञानसम्भूताद्विषयादभीतीकृद्धच:।
भयानकमिति प्राहुर्जानिनस्तत्त्वदर्शिनः ॥
translation: पाप से और अज्ञानसम्भूत विषय से डर दिखाने वाले जो वचन हैं तत्त्वदर्शी ज्ञानिगण उनको भयानक कहते हैं
english_translation: In the Vedas, Puranas, and accepted scriptures, these distinctions are indeed terrifying, fascinating, and true.
essence: Ancient scriptures acknowledge profound and unsettling distinctions as true.
simple_meaning: These scriptures recognize that distinctions can be frightening, interesting, and real.
insight: It invites acceptance of complex truths that challenge simple understanding.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
मुकृतेऽध्यात्मलक्ष्ये च रूचिकृवचनं मुराः ।
रोचकं तद्धि विज्ञेयं श्रुतो तन्त्रपुराणयोः ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! पुण्य में और अध्यात्म लक्ष्य में रुचि उत्पन्न करने वाले जो वचन वेद तन्त्र और पुराणों में हैं उनको रोचक जानना चाहिये।
english_translation: The wise who understand me have spoken of three kinds of expressions; listen carefully, for this is the established order.
essence: The divine truth is revealed through three kinds of expressions known by the wise.
simple_meaning: There are three kinds of statements revealing my nature, known by the wise; listen with focus as this is the proper order.
insight: It prepares you to receive teachings in a structured way, highlighting the importance of focused attention.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
आध्यात्मतत्त्वसंलिष्ट तत्वज्ञानोपदेशकम ।
वचो यथार्थ सम्प्रोक्तं यूयं जानीत निर्जराः ! ॥
translation: अध्यात्म तत्त्व से युक्त और तत्व ज्ञान का उपदेश देने वाले वचन को हे देवगण ! यथार्थ वचन कहते हैं ऐसा आप जानिये
english_translation: The wise who see the truth call fearful those words born of sin and ignorance.
essence: Fearful words come from ignorance, not from clear understanding of truth.
simple_meaning: Words that cause fear arise from ignorance and misunderstanding, not from truth.
insight: It teaches you to question fearful thoughts as products of ignorance rather than facts.
modern_relevance: When worries or fearful messages arise, it's often your mind's confusion, not actual danger.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
भयानकं वचो नित्यं तामसायाधिकारिणे।
रोचकं राजसायैव यथार्थ सात्त्विकाय वै ॥
translation: हे विभुत्तमो! भयानक वचन सदा ही तामसिक अधिकारी के लिये, रोचक वचन राजसिक अधिकारी के ही लिये और यथार्थ वचन सात्त्विक अधिकारी के लिये ही
english_translation: O divine beings! Words that inspire interest in virtue and spiritual goals, found in the Vedas, Tantras, and Puranas, should be considered fascinating.
essence: Teachings that inspire interest in virtue and spirituality are meant to be engaging.
simple_meaning: Words that spark interest in virtue and spiritual goals, found in sacred scriptures, should be seen as engaging.
insight: It shows the importance of engaging language to make spiritual teachings attractive and accessible.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
विशेषतो हितकर विज्ञेयं विबुधोत्तमाः। 
अतोऽधिकारभेदेन वचनं व्याहृतं मुराः ॥
translation: विशेषरूप से हितकर हैं ऐसा जानना चाहिये, इसलिये हे देवतागण ! शास्त्रों में अधिकारभेद से वचन कहे गये हैं
english_translation: O divine beings, know that these words, grounded in spiritual truth and teaching essence, are truly accurate.
essence: Words grounded in spiritual truth convey true and reliable knowledge.
simple_meaning: These words teach deep spiritual truth and wisdom. You should know they are true and reliable.
insight: It encourages you to receive teachings with openness, trusting their foundation in deep spiritual understanding.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
श्रुतौ पुराणे तन्त्रे च त्रिधा वर्णनरीतयः।
दृश्यन्ते क्रमशः सर्वास्ता वच्मि भवतां पुरः ॥
translation: वेद पुराण और तंत्रों में तीन प्रकार को वर्णन शैलियां देखी जाती हैं उन सब को आप लोगों के सामने मैं क्रमश कहता हूँ
english_translation: Fearful words always belong to those attached to inertia; enticing words belong to those driven by passion; truthful words belong only to those of pure nature.
essence: Words always reveal the speaker’s dominant inner nature: fear, passion, or purity.
simple_meaning: People speak differently based on their inner nature: fearful words come from inertia, tempting words from passion, and truthful words from purity.
insight: It teaches you to listen beyond words to the speaker’s inner nature, discerning truth from shadow.
modern_relevance: When someone speaks harshly, you recognize their fear; when they entice, their passion shows; only pure words resonate deeply.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
समाधिभाषा प्रथमा लौकिकी च तथाऽपरा ।
तृतीया परकीयेति शास्त्रभाषा त्रिधा स्मृता ॥
translation: पहली समाधिभाषा, दूसरी लौकिकभाषा और तीसरी परकीयभाषा, इस प्रकार से शास्त्र की भाषा तीन प्रकार की कही गई है।
english_translation: It is especially beneficial to understand this, O best of the wise! Therefore, the scriptures speak differently according to the qualifications of the listener.
essence: Teachings change according to the listener's readiness and understanding.
simple_meaning: The scriptures teach differently depending on the listener's qualifications, because understanding varies among people.
insight: Recognize that teachings adapt to your readiness and background, so be patient with variations.
modern_relevance: You notice how advice changes when talking to different friends, because each understands differently and needs tailored guidance.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
इतिहासमयी शश्वत्कर्णयोर्मधुगऽमला।
मनोमुग्धकरी तद्वञ्चित्ताहलादविवर्धिनी ॥
translation: जिसमें निरन्तर इतिहास आए, जो निर्मल और श्रुतिमधुर हो, जो मन को लुभाने वाली और इसी तरह चित्त के आह्लाद को बढ़ानेवाली हो
english_translation: In the Vedas, Puranas, and Tantras, three types of explanation methods appear; I will describe them to you in order.
essence: Ancient teachings use three different ways to explain knowledge, all worth understanding.
simple_meaning: There are three ways to explain things in the Vedas, Puranas, and Tantras. I will tell you all of them step by step.
insight: Recognize that knowledge can come in different forms and methods; being open helps learning.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
धर्मसिद्धांत संयुक्ता समासबहुला न हि ।
ज्ञेया सा परकीयेति शास्त्रवर्णनपद्धतिः ॥
translation: जो धर्म सिद्धान्तों से युक्त हो और जिसमें जटिलता न हो उस शास्त्रवर्णन की पद्धति को परकीय जानना चाहिये
english_translation: The scripture states that language is threefold: first, the language of absorption; second, the worldly language; and third, the language beyond this world.
essence: Sacred teachings use three language types: absorption, worldly, and beyond-world.
simple_meaning: The scripture describes three types of language used: one for deep absorption, one for everyday life, and one for transcending the world.
insight: Recognize that teachings may come in different forms—practical, philosophical, or transcendent—each suited to different understanding.
modern_relevance: Sometimes conversations shift between everyday talk, deep reflection, and abstract ideas beyond normal experience.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
इमामज्ञानिने तद्वत्तामसायाऽधिकारिणे।
विशेषतो हितकरी प्राहुस्तत्तत्त्वदर्शिनः ॥
translation: इस पद्धति के तत्त्वदर्शीगण इसको अज्ञानी के लिये और इसी तरह तामसिक अधिकारी के लिये विशेष हितकरी कहते हैं
english_translation: Which contains continuous history, is pure and melodious to hear, captivates the mind, and thus increases the joy of the inner state.
essence: Pure, sweet teachings captivate the mind and increase inner joy continuously.
simple_meaning: The verse describes something that contains ongoing history, is pure and sweet to listen to, attracts the mind, and increases the joy of the inner state.
insight: It shows how pure, engaging knowledge nourishes the mind and uplifts inner joy.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अतीन्द्रियाध्यात्मराज्यस्थितं विषयगह्वरम्।
लौकिकी रीतिमाश्रित्य वर्णयेद् याऽतिसंस्फुटम् ॥
translation: अतीन्द्रिय अध्यात्म राज्य में स्थित गूढ़ विषय को लौकिक रीति का आश्रय लेकर जो अच्छी तरह वर्णन करे
english_translation: A scripture that is united with established principles of dharma and free from complexity should not be regarded as foreign.
essence: Clear, principle-based teachings are never foreign or disconnected from you.
simple_meaning: A teaching that aligns with established principles of right conduct and is easy to understand should not be seen as strange or foreign.
insight: It encourages you to recognize authentic wisdom by its clarity and coherence, avoiding confusion or rejection of true guidance.
modern_relevance: When you find advice that fits your core values and is easy to grasp, you feel drawn to it, not alienated.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
नथा समाधिगम्यानां भावानां प्रतिपादिका ।
सा पूर्णा लौकिकैस्तद्रद्रसैर्भापाऽस्ति लौकिकी ॥
translation: तथा समाधिगम्य भावों की प्रतिपादि का हो और इसी तरह लौकिक रसों से भी पूर्ण हो वह भाषा लौकिकी भाषा है
english_translation: Those who see the truth say this path is especially beneficial for the ignorant and those bound by darkness.
essence: Certain wisdoms serve best those burdened by confusion and darkness.
simple_meaning: This teaching is especially helpful for people who feel confused or stuck in negativity.
insight: Recognize that some teachings are especially designed to help when your mind is clouded or heavy.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by confusion or stuck in negative moods, this teaching offers clear guidance and relief.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
इयं राजसिकायैव साधकायाधिकारिणे ।
सूतेऽधिकं सदा भव्यं सत्यं सत्यं दिवौकसः ! ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! यह भाषा राजसिक अधिकार वाले ही साधक के लिये सदा अधिक कल्याण पैदा करती है, यह सत्य है सत्य है ।
english_translation: One who clearly describes the profound subject residing in the spiritual realm by relying on worldly methods.
essence: Deep spiritual truths become clear through relatable worldly explanation.
simple_meaning: Someone who explains deep spiritual truths clearly by using familiar worldly ways.
insight: It shifts teaching from abstract to relatable, making spiritual truths accessible through familiar language.
modern_relevance: You find complex ideas easier to grasp when someone explains them using examples from daily life.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
प्रकाशयति या ज्ञानं कार्यकारणब्रह्मणोः।
समाधिसिद्धभावैर्या सम्पूर्णा सर्वतस्तथा ॥
translation: जो भाषा कार्य ब्रह्म और कारण ब्रह्म के ज्ञान को प्रकाशित कर देती है तथा जो भाषा सर्वत्र समाधि सिद्ध भावों से पूर्ण हो
english_translation: Language that conveys states attained through absorbed presence and is also full of worldly feelings is called worldly language.
essence: Worldly language fully expresses both deep states and everyday feelings together.
simple_meaning: Worldly language expresses both deep spiritual states and everyday emotions richly.
insight: It teaches that communication can bridge profound inner experience and common human feelings seamlessly.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
तत्वज्ञानमयी तद्वद्या ही वर्णन पद्धति: ।
ज्ञेया समाधिभाषा या सात्विकायोपकारिका ॥
translation: और इसी तरह जो वर्णनपद्धति तत्त्व ज्ञानमयी हो उसको समाधि भाषा जानना चाहिये। वह सात्त्विक अधिकारी के लिये हितकरी है
english_translation: O beings of the higher and lower realms! This speech always brings more welfare to those qualified in the mode of passion; this is true, indeed true.
essence: Speech in passion touches those qualified in that mode most and brings them welfare.
simple_meaning: Speech influenced by passion benefits those ready to act in that mode more than others; this is absolutely true.
insight: Recognize that the effectiveness of guidance depends on the listener's readiness and nature.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
श्रवणं मननं तद्विन्नीदिध्यासनमेव च ।
एतात्रितयरूपो य: पुरुषार्थ इहोच्यते ॥
translation: श्रवण मनन और निदिध्यासन, यह जो त्रितयरूप पुरुषार्थ जगत में कहा जाता है वह सब त्रितयरूप पुरुषार्थ
english_translation: That speech which reveals the knowledge of the effect Brahman and the cause Brahman, and which is everywhere filled with the qualities of perfected absorption.
essence: True speech reveals the deep unity of cause and effect filled with meditative presence.
simple_meaning: Speech that reveals the deep knowledge of cause and effect Brahman is always full of qualities of deep inner absorption.
insight: It teaches you to bring your full inner calm and understanding into your speech, making communication a reflection of wisdom.
modern_relevance: When you speak with full presence and deep understanding, your words carry calmness and clarity that others can feel clearly.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
निर्वृतिमूलकं भूत्वा सक्तं ब्रह्मनिरूपणे
यदा चेत् त्रितयं सर्वं तदा तत् साविकं मतम् ॥
translation: जब निवृत्ति मूलक होकर ब्रह्मके निरूपण में  लगता है तब वह सात्त्विक माना जाता है।
english_translation: Similarly, the method of explanation that is filled with knowledge of the true nature should be understood as the language of absorbed presence, beneficial for the discerning mind.
essence: True knowledge is best expressed through calm, absorbed presence that benefits a clear mind.
simple_meaning: The best way to explain deep truth is through the language of absorbed presence, which helps a clear and discerning mind.
insight: It teaches you to value calm clarity over noisy explanation when seeking or sharing deep understanding.
modern_relevance: When someone explains complex ideas calmly and clearly, your mind settles and you understand better without confusion or overwhelm.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यदा तत्त्रयमुत्पत्तिस्थिसत्ययस्वरूपिणि।
भावे भावं समासाद्य द्वैतरूपं निषेवते ॥
translation: हे देवतागण! जब वह उत्पत्ति स्थिति लय. स्वरूप भाव में भावित होकर द्वैतरूप को प्राप्त होता है
english_translation: Hearing, reflection, and deep meditation—these three forms of effort are called the triple practice in this world.
essence: True effort integrates hearing, thoughtful reflection, and deep meditation as one process.
simple_meaning: Growth comes through three stages: listening carefully, thinking deeply, and meditating profoundly.
insight: It teaches you to move from passive reception to active reflection and then to deep absorption.
modern_relevance: You read advice, mull it over during your day, then sit quietly to let it truly settle and transform you.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तदा तं राजसं देवाः ! पुरुषार्थ प्रचक्षते।
यो हि नास्तिकतामूलः स तामस उदाहृतः ॥
translation: तब उस त्रितयरूप पुरुषार्थ को राजसिक कहते हैं और जो नास्तिकता. मूलक त्रितयरूप पुरुषार्थ है वह तामसिक कहा गया है
english_translation: When the mind, becoming rooted in renunciation, is firmly established in the supreme reality, then it is considered pure and sattvic.
essence: A mind rooted in renunciation and clear understanding becomes pure and balanced.
simple_meaning: When your mind is deeply settled in letting go and focused on the true reality, it becomes pure and balanced.
insight: It teaches you to stabilize your mind by letting go of attachments and embracing clear understanding.
modern_relevance: You find calm and balance when you stop chasing distractions and focus on what truly matters.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
आयुःसत्त्वबलारोग्यमुखप्रीतिविवर्द्धनाः ।
रस्याः स्निग्धाः स्थिरा हृद्या आहाराः सात्त्विकप्रियाः॥
translation: आयु, सात्त्विकभाव, शक्ति, आरोग्य, चित्तप्रसाद और रुचि के बढानेवाले, रसयुक्त एवं स्नेहयुक्त, जिनका सारांश देह में स्थायी रूप से रहे और चित्त को परितोष करने वाले आहार सात्विक पुरुषों के प्रिय होते हैं
english_translation: O divine beings! When the three qualities of creation, preservation, and destruction unite in their true form, the manifested and the unmanifested coexist in duality.
essence: The true nature unites creation, preservation, and destruction in simultaneous duality.
simple_meaning: The three fundamental states of existence—creation, preservation, and destruction—combine in their true essence, where the seen and unseen coexist as dual aspects.
insight: It invites you to see beyond appearances and recognize the unity underlying all change and difference.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
कट्वाललवणात्युष्णताक्ष्णरूक्षविदाहिनः।
आहारा राजसस्येष्टा दुःखशोकामयप्रदाः॥
translation: कटु, अम्ल, लवण (क्षार) अत्युष्ण, तीक्ष्ण, रूक्ष, विदाही, यह सब दुःख सन्ताप और रोगप्रद आहार राजसिक व्यक्तियों के प्रिय हैं।
english_translation: Then the gods call that threefold purpose rajasic; one rooted in disbelief is called tamasic.
essence: Motivations rooted in passion or disbelief shape the nature of your purpose.
simple_meaning: The gods describe purposes motivated by passion as rajasic, and those rooted in disbelief as tamasic.
insight: It shifts your view to notice whether your actions come from clarity or confusion, affecting how you choose to act.
modern_relevance: When you feel driven by restless ambition or doubt, noticing these motives can guide you toward clearer choices.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
यातयामं गतरसं पृति पर्युषितञ्च यत् ।
उच्छिष्टमपि चामेध्यं भोजनं तामसप्रियम् ॥
translation: एक पहर पहले बना हुआ (ठंडा) विरस, दुर्गन्धयुक्त, बासी, झूठा और अपवित्र जो आहार है वह तामसिक व्यक्तियों को प्रिय होता है।
english_translation: Foods that increase lifespan, vitality, strength, health, and joyful disposition, rich in essence and nourishing, staying steady in the body and pleasing to the mind are loved by those with a pure nature.
essence: Steady, nourishing foods build lasting strength and calm favored by pure minds.
simple_meaning: Certain foods help increase your lifespan, strength, health, and happiness by nourishing your body and mind steadily.
insight: It teaches you to select foods that benefit both your physical strength and your mental peace.
modern_relevance: After a long day, choosing a wholesome meal that steadies your energy and calms your mind can transform your evening.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सुखं त्विदानी त्रिविध शृणुतामृतभोजिनः।
अभ्यासादरमते यत्र दुःखान्तञ्च निगच्छति ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! अब सुनो सुख भी तीन प्रकार का है। जिस सुख में अभ्यास से अर्थात् स्वतः ही परमानन्द लाभ करता है और दुःख का अन्त प्राप्त करता है,
english_translation: Sharp, sour, salty, very hot, pungent, rough, and burning foods are dear to rajasic people and cause pain, sorrow, and disease.
essence: Certain foods that excite the senses also bring pain and sorrow to body and mind.
simple_meaning: Certain kinds of sharp, hot, and spicy foods attract restless energy but bring pain, sorrow, and illness.
insight: Notice how your food choices affect your mind's restlessness and your body's health, guiding you to choose with awareness.
modern_relevance: After a late night binge on spicy snacks, you wake up feeling restless and uneasy, realizing what you ate affects more than just your stomach.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यत्तदग्रे विपमिव परिणामेऽमृतोपमम् ।
तत्सुखं सात्त्विकं प्रोक्तमात्मबुद्धिप्रसादजम् ॥
translation: वह आदि में विषवत् किन्तु परिणाम मे अमृततुल्य और आत्मबुद्धि के प्रसाद से उत्पन्न सुख सात्त्विक कहा जाता है।
english_translation: Stale, foul-smelling, leftover, and impure food is liked by tamasic people.
essence: Impure, stale food dulls your body and mind, fostering inertia and confusion.
simple_meaning: Eating old, smelly, leftover, or impure food reflects a dull, heavy state of being.
insight: It teaches you to be mindful of what you consume, seeing food as a foundation for clear action and discipline.
modern_relevance: You grab leftover fast food late at night and wake feeling sluggish, foggy, and unmotivated.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
विश्येंद्रियसंयोगादयत्तदग्रेऽमृतोपमम ।
परिणामे विषमिव तत्सुखं राजसं स्मृतम् ॥
translation: विषय और इन्द्रियों के संयोग से आदि में अमृततुल्य किन्तु परिणाम में विपतुल्य सुख राजस कहा जाता है
english_translation: O divine beings! Listen: happiness is of three kinds. The happiness that arises naturally through practice leads to supreme bliss and an end to suffering.
essence: Steady practice naturally brings deep happiness that ends suffering.
simple_meaning: Happiness can be of three types, but the kind that comes naturally from steady practice leads to lasting bliss and frees you from suffering.
insight: It teaches you to trust that steady practice transforms your experience from struggle to ease and joy.
modern_relevance: After weeks of rehearsing a skill, you suddenly feel confident and joyful without effort or anxiety about failure.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यदने चानुबन्धे च सुखं मोहनमात्मनः ।
निद्रालस्यामादोत्थं तत्तामसमुदाहृतम् ॥
translation: निद्रा आलस्य और प्रमाद से उत्पन्न एवं आदि और अन्त में चित्त मोह उत्पन्न करने वाला जो सुख है उसे तामस कहते हैं
english_translation: That which at first seems bitter but ultimately results in nectar-like bliss born from clarity of the true self is called sattvic happiness.
essence: Bitterness at first can become pure happiness through clarity of the true self.
simple_meaning: Sometimes what feels bitter at first leads to deep, clear happiness that comes from understanding your true self.
insight: It teaches you to see initial difficulty as a necessary phase that clears the way for authentic happiness.
modern_relevance: You start a challenging project or relationship feeling discomfort, but as you gain insight and clarity, it becomes deeply rewarding and joyful.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
नियतस्य तु संन्यास: कर्मणो नोपपद्यते
मोहात्तस्य परिसागस्तामसः परिकीर्तितः॥
translation: नित्यकर्म का त्याग नहीं हो सकता, मोहवश जो नित्यकर्म का त्याग होता है उसे तामस त्याग कहते हैं
english_translation: The pleasure arising from contact with sense objects is initially like nectar but eventually turns into painful poison; this is called rajasic pleasure.
essence: Pleasure from senses starts sweet but inevitably turns painful and trapping.
simple_meaning: Pleasure from sense contact feels like nectar at first but eventually becomes painful, showing its rajasic nature.
insight: Recognize the temporary sweetness of sensory pleasures and choose not to be trapped by their harmful outcomes.
modern_relevance: You binge on sweets or social media; the first moments are joyful, but later regret or discomfort follows.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
दुःखमित्येव यत्कर्म कायक्लेशभयात्त्यजेत् ।
स कृत्वा राजसं त्यागं नैव त्यागफलं लभेत् ॥
translation: जो व्यक्ति दुःख होता है ऐसा जानकर दैहिक क्लेश के भय से कर्म त्याग करता है वह राजस त्याग करके त्याग का फल नहीं प्राप्त करता है
english_translation: The pleasure born of sleep, laziness, and negligence, which arises at the beginning and end and causes confusion of the mind, is called tamas.
essence: Pleasure born of laziness and negligence clouds the mind with confusion.
simple_meaning: Pleasure that comes from sleep, laziness, or carelessness confuses your mind and is called tamas.
insight: It teaches you to recognize pleasures that reduce mental clarity and avoid them for clear perception.
modern_relevance: After a night of poor rest or procrastination, you might feel a foggy pleasure that dulls your focus and confuses your thoughts.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
कार्यमित्येव यत्कर्म नियतं क्रियतेऽमराः।
सङ्गं त्यकत्वा फलं चैव स त्यागः सात्त्विको मतः ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! इन्द्रियसंग और फल का त्याग करके “ कर्त्तव्य " जानकर जो नियमपूर्वक कर्म किया जाता है वह न्याग सात्त्विक त्याग माना गया है
english_translation: The renunciation of prescribed duties is never attained; abandoning them out of delusion is called tamasic renunciation.
essence: Giving up your rightful duties from confusion is false renunciation.
simple_meaning: You cannot truly give up your rightful duties. Leaving them due to confusion is a wrong kind of renunciation.
insight: This verse shifts your mindset from avoidance to responsible action, showing renunciation as disciplined engagement, not escape.
modern_relevance: You feel tempted to skip important responsibilities when overwhelmed, but true letting go means acting without craving, not avoiding your role.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
न तदस्ति पृथिव्यां वा दिवि युष्मासु वा पुनः ।
सत्त्वं प्रकृतिजैर्मुक्तं यदेभिः स्यानिभिर्गुणः ॥
translation: पृथिवी में स्वर्ग मे अथवा आप लोगों में ऐसा जीव नहीं है जो प्रकृति से उत्पन्न इन तीन गुणों से सम्मलित न हो
english_translation: One who abandons action out of fear of bodily pain, thinking it is sorrow, does not gain the fruit of renunciation despite giving up rajasic activity.
essence: Giving up action from fear is not true renunciation and yields no real benefit.
simple_meaning: If you stop acting just because you fear pain or sorrow, that isn't true renunciation and you won't get its benefits.
insight: Recognize that true renunciation requires acting beyond fear, not just quitting when it hurts.
modern_relevance: You hesitate to take on challenges fearing discomfort, but avoiding effort this way blocks growth and meaningful change.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
त्रैगुणयविषया वेदा निस्त्रैगुणया: स्त निर्जर्रा
निर्द्वन्दा नित्यसत्त्वस्था निर्योगक्षेमकात्मकाः ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! सब वेदों में तीनों गुणों का ही विषय है, तुम तीनों गुणों से रहित हो जाओ, सुख दुःखादि द्वन्द्वों से रहित हो जाओ, नित्य सत्त्वगुण में रहो, अलब्ध वस्तु के लाभ में और लब्ध वस्तु की रक्षा में यत्नशून्य हो जाओ एवं आत्मवान् अर्थात् अप्रमत्त हो जाओ
english_translation: O divine beings, actions performed regularly as duty, without attachment or desire for results, constitute true renunciation.
essence: True renunciation is acting on duty without attachment to results or desires.
simple_meaning: Act regularly with clear understanding of your duty, giving up attachment to results and desires. This is true renunciation.
insight: Shift focus from wanting results to steady, disciplined action; this purifies your intention.
modern_relevance: You finish a task fully but stay calm when the outcome is uncertain or out of your hands.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यावानर्थ उदपाने सर्वतः सम्प्लुतोदके ।
तावान् सर्वेषु वेदेषु ब्राह्मणस्य विजाननः॥
translation: सब स्थान जलमें डूब जाने पर क्षुद्र जलाशय से जितना प्रयोजन रहता है, ब्रह्मनिष्ठ ब्रह्मज्ञ को सब वेदों से उतना ही प्रयोजन रहता है
english_translation: There is no being on earth, in the higher realm, or among you that is not bound by the three qualities born of nature.
essence: No being exists without the influence of nature’s three fundamental qualities.
simple_meaning: Everything alive, everywhere, is influenced by three fundamental qualities that arise from nature.
insight: Recognizing the universal influence of these three qualities shifts your judgment from personal to compassionate understanding.
modern_relevance: When you meet anyone, remember they are shaped by fundamental forces beyond their control, just like you.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
चातुर्वण्यं मया सृष्टं गुणकर्मविभागशः ।
तस्य कर्तारमपि मां वित्ताकर्तारमव्ययम् ॥
translation: मैंने गुण और कर्मों के विभाग द्वारा चारों वर्णों की सृष्टि की है, उनका कर्ता होने पर भी अव्यय होने के कारण मुझको अकर्ता जानो
english_translation: O divine beings! All the Vedas deal with the three qualities, but you transcend them, free from dualities like pleasure and pain, established in eternal goodness, unattached to gain or protection, and ever vigilant as the true self.
essence: You can live beyond all changing qualities and dualities, steady in eternal goodness.
simple_meaning: Everything in the Vedas relates to three qualities, but you can go beyond them and their opposites, staying forever steady in goodness without clinging to gain or loss.
insight: It teaches you to see beyond shifting qualities and outcomes, anchoring in unchanging goodness and awareness.
modern_relevance: When emotions swing wildly between success and failure, you can find balance by not letting those states define you.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ये चैव सात्विका भावा राजसास्तामसाश्च ये।
मन एवेति तान वित्त न त्वहं तेषु ते मयि ॥
translation: जो सब सात्त्विकभाव, राजसिकभाव एवं तामसिकभाव हैं, वह सब मुझसे ही उत्पन्न हुए हैं ऐसा उनको जानो। मैं उन सब में नहीं हूँ परन्तु वह मुझमें हैं ।
english_translation: Just as a small pond is enough when the entire land is flooded, a Brahman devoted to Brahman gains all he needs from all the Vedas.
essence: Deep understanding makes vast knowledge feel small and fully satisfying.
simple_meaning: When someone truly understands the highest truth, even a small part of sacred knowledge is enough to satisfy them.
insight: It shifts the mind from seeking more knowledge to appreciating depth over breadth, trusting that true understanding is concise.
modern_relevance: You might have access to endless information online yet find peace and clarity in just a few trusted sources that truly resonate with you.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
त्रिभिर्गुणमयभावैरेभिः सर्वमिदं जगत् ।
मोहितं नाभिजानाति मामेभ्यः परमव्ययम् ॥
translation: इन तीन गुणमय भावो से मोहित यह सब जगत् इन सब भावों से अतीत एवं निर्विकारस्वरूप मुझको नहीं जानता है ।
english_translation: I created the four classes based on qualities and actions; though their doer, know me as the immutable non-doer.
essence: You act in roles shaped by qualities, but your true self remains unchanging and detached.
simple_meaning: The world’s social classes arise from qualities and actions, yet the creator behind them remains unchanged and not truly the doer.
insight: It teaches you to see your actions as roles shaped by qualities, not as your unchanging true self.
modern_relevance: You may play many roles in life—parent, worker, friend—but your true self is deeper than any role or action.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
दैवी ह्येषा गुणमयी मम माया दुरत्यया।
मामेव ये प्रपद्यन्ते मायामेतां तरन्ति ते ॥
translation: यह मेरी सत्व आदि गुणमयी अलौकिक माया निश्चय ही दुस्तरा है, जो मुझको प्राप्त होते है वही इस मायाको अतिक्रमण कर सक्ते हैं
english_translation: Know that all the sattvic, rajasic, and tamasic qualities arise from me; I am not in them, but they are in me.
essence: Qualities arise from the divine, but the divine transcends all qualities.
simple_meaning: All qualities of nature—pure, active, and dull—originate from the divine. The divine is not limited by these qualities but contains them all.
insight: It shifts your view from identifying with temporary qualities to recognizing a deeper, unchanging essence.
modern_relevance: When moods or traits overwhelm you, remember they come from a source greater than them—and you are not limited to them.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
गुणत्रयस्य विज्ञानं गुरो ! तब मुखाम्बुजात् ।
कृतकृत्या वयं जाताः श्रुत्वा तन्महदद्भुतम् ॥
translation: हे गुरो ! हमलोग उस अत्यन्त अद्भुत गुणत्रय के विज्ञान को आपके मुखकमल से सुनकर कृतकृत्य हुए
english_translation: This entire world is deluded by the three qualities and does not recognize me, the supreme imperishable, beyond them.
essence: The true self is beyond all changing qualities that cloud perception.
simple_meaning: The world is trapped in three qualities that cause confusion and do not see the supreme, unchanging reality beyond them.
insight: It shifts your perspective from identifying with fluctuating qualities to recognizing your unchanging inner reality.
modern_relevance: You might feel overwhelmed by moods or personality traits, forgetting your deeper, steady self beyond shifting feelings and thoughts.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
इदानीच वयं सर्वे भवतः कृपया विभो !।
रजस्तमोऽभिसंसक्ता नाऽधःपातं व्रजेम हि ॥
translation: हे विभो ! अब हम सब आपकी कृपा से रजोगुण तमोगुण में फंसकर अपने अवनति नहीं करेंगे
english_translation: This divine, composed of the three qualities, my supreme illusion is very difficult to cross; only those who surrender to me can transcend this illusion.
essence: Only surrender to the divine can overcome the most difficult cosmic illusion.
simple_meaning: The divine illusion made of the three qualities is very hard to cross, but those who fully surrender to the divine can overcome it.
insight: It teaches you that surrendering to the divine is the key to transcending deep confusion and limitation.
modern_relevance: When you face overwhelming confusion or obstacles, complete surrender to your inner guidance can help you break through.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
कृपासिन्धो ! वयं येन ज्ञानेन त्रिगुणस्य वै।
रहस्यं द्रष्टुमर्हाः स्मः प्रत्यक्षं सर्वदैव हि ॥
translation: हे कृपानिधे ! हमें वह ज्ञान बताइये कि जिस ज्ञान से हम त्रिगुण के रहस्य को प्रत्यक्ष करने में सदा ही समर्थ हो
english_translation: O teacher, having heard the profound knowledge of the three qualities from your lotus mouth, we feel deeply grateful.
essence: Gratitude arises from receiving profound knowledge directly from a teacher.
simple_meaning: We are deeply grateful after hearing the wonderful knowledge about the three qualities from the teacher.
insight: It shows the importance of gratitude and openness when receiving deep knowledge from a trusted source.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
तथैव सर्वदाऽस्मासु शक्तिस्त्रिगुणदर्शिनी ।
विशेषतोऽनिशं तिष्ठत्तजज्ञानं नः समादिश ॥
translation: और त्रिगुण को विशेष रूप से निरन्तर देखने की शक्ति हम लोगों में सदा बनी रहे
english_translation: Now, by your grace, O Lord, we all shall not sink into decline, caught in passion and ignorance.
essence: Divine grace prevents falling into confusion and harmful passions.
simple_meaning: With the divine's kindness, we will avoid slipping into harmful states caused by passion and ignorance.
insight: It teaches you to rely on the divine's grace to stay clear from harmful, reactive impulses.
modern_relevance: When life feels overwhelming and confusion pulls you down, trusting a higher support can help you stay steady.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
त्रिदशा:! त्रिगुणैनिर्त्यम सृष्टिस्थित्तिलाया इमे ।
प्रपञ्चात्मकदृश्यस्य भवन्तीत्यवधार्यताम् ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! त्रिगुण के द्वारा दृश्य प्रपंच के यह सृष्टि स्थिति लय नित्य होते हैं, वह जानो
english_translation: O ocean of compassion, please reveal the knowledge by which we can always perceive the secret of the three qualities directly.
essence: With the right knowledge, you can always directly perceive the hidden truth of the three qualities.
simple_meaning: You can gain knowledge that lets you directly perceive the secret behind the three qualities that shape everything.
insight: It encourages active seeking of knowledge that reveals underlying truths rather than accepting surface appearances.
modern_relevance: You want to understand the patterns and forces shaping your behavior, not just guess but see clearly what's behind them.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
त्रिभावेनैव ते सर्वे ज्ञायन्ते च विशेषतः।
त्रिभावव्यक्षिका चाऽस्ति तत्त्वज्ञानोन्नतिः किल ॥
translation: और त्रिभाव के द्वारा ही वह सब विशेष रूप से जाने जाते हैं और तत्त्वज्ञान की उन्नति ही त्रिभावव्यंजिका है
english_translation: May the power to continually perceive the three qualities clearly always remain within us.
essence: Sustained power to clearly perceive the three qualities frees us from ignorance.
simple_meaning: You can maintain the ability to clearly see the three qualities of nature without losing focus.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate continuous clear awareness of your inner tendencies, reducing confusion.
modern_relevance: When emotions and thoughts pull you every which way, steady clarity helps you keep your balance and see what really drives you.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
मयि यत् सच्चिदानन्दरूपेणाऽस्ति दिवौकसः!।
मूलमध्यात्मभावस्याधिदेवस्य तथैव च ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! मुझमें जो सत् चित् और आनन्दरूप से अध्यात्मभाव अधिदैवभाव और
english_translation: O divine beings, know that the visible world arises, exists, and dissolves eternally through the three qualities.
essence: The visible world continuously cycles through creation, existence, and dissolution by three fundamental qualities.
simple_meaning: Everything you see in the world is created, maintained, and dissolved continuously by three fundamental qualities.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that change and impermanence are natural expressions of deeper qualities governing existence.
modern_relevance: When your plans shift or life feels unstable, remember everything you experience flows through cycles shaped by underlying forces beyond your control.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अधिभूतस्य भावस्य ज्ञापकन्तु तदेव हि ।
तटस्थज्ञानसाहाय्यात्रिगुणस्य मतं बुधाः ॥
translation: अधिभूतभाव का मूल विद्यमान है, वही हे विशो ! तटस्थज्ञान की सहायता से त्रिगुण का ज्ञापक माना गया है
english_translation: All things are known distinctly through the three modes; the highest wisdom reveals these three modes clearly.
essence: Clear understanding arises by distinctly seeing the three fundamental modes behind all things.
simple_meaning: Everything is understood clearly through the three modes that shape reality. True knowledge comes from seeing these modes distinctly.
insight: It teaches you to focus on seeing the underlying modes shaping experience, not just surface events.
modern_relevance: When you notice the patterns behind your moods or choices, your insight deepens and confusion fades.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अविद्याऽऽवरिका ज्ञेया मत्स्वरूपस्य निश्चितम् ।
पुष्टिस्तस्याश्च रजसा तमसैव विजायते ॥
translation: मेरे स्वरूपज्ञान को आवरण करने वाली अविद्या को ही जानो। रज और तमोगुण के द्वारा ही विद्या की पुष्टि होती है
english_translation: O radiant beings! That which exists in me is of the nature of truth, consciousness, and bliss; it is the essential spiritual nature and the supreme divine.
essence: The true self is unchanging truth, consciousness, and bliss within all beings.
simple_meaning: The divine within is the true self, made of truth, awareness, and bliss; it is the essential spiritual nature and highest divine power.
insight: It invites you to recognize your inner being as pure awareness and joy beyond change.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सत्त्वात्प्रकाशो विद्याया भवतीति विभाव्यनाम।
अविद्याऽऽवियते लोके यथा तच्छ्यतां सुगः ॥
translation: सत्त्वगुण के द्वारा विद्या का प्रकाश होता है वह जानो। हे देवतागण ! संसार में अविद्या जिस प्रकार से आवरण करती है वह सुनो
english_translation: The fundamental nature of the material world is known through detached knowledge, which helps the wise perceive the three qualities.
essence: Detached knowledge reveals the true nature of the material world and its qualities.
simple_meaning: You grasp the true nature of the material world by using detached, unbiased knowledge to see beyond appearances.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate an observer’s mind that watches without reacting, revealing the true nature of what you face.
modern_relevance: When emotions cloud your judgment, stepping back and observing without attachment lets you see what’s really happening beneath the surface.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
काम एष क्रोध एष रजोगुणसमुद्भवः ।
महाशनो महापाप्मा वित्तनमिह वैरिणम ॥
translation: रजोगुणसम्भूत अत्युग्र और दुष्पूरणीय काम और क्रोध को इस संसार में शत्रु समझो
english_translation: Ignorance is the veil that hides the true nature of the self; the qualities of passion and darkness support this ignorance.
essence: Ignorance veils the true self and is sustained by passion and darkness.
simple_meaning: Ignorance is like a veil covering the true self. It is sustained by the qualities of passion and darkness within us.
insight: Recognizing ignorance as a veil supported by inner qualities helps shift focus from self-blame to understanding the source of confusion.
modern_relevance: When emotions like restlessness or depression overwhelm you, it’s often the inner forces of passion and darkness veiling your true nature.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
धूमेनावियते वह्निर्यथादशों मलेन च ।
यथोल्वेनाटतो गर्भस्तथा तेनेदमावृतम् ॥
translation: जिस प्रकार अग्नि धूम्रके द्वारा, शीशा धूल के द्वारा और गर्भ जरायु के द्वारा आवृत रहता है उसी प्रकार आत्मज्ञान काम के द्वारा आवृत रहता है।
english_translation: Know that knowledge shines through the quality of goodness. Just as ignorance covers the world, listen to this truth.
essence: Goodness makes knowledge shine clearly, even though ignorance tries to hide it.
simple_meaning: Goodness (sattva) allows knowledge to shine clearly, even though ignorance tries to cover it in the world.
insight: It teaches you to trust the presence of goodness within as the source of clear knowledge amid confusion.
modern_relevance: When confusion and misinformation cloud your mind, the inner quality of goodness helps your true understanding shine through.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
आवृतं ज्ञानमेतेन ज्ञानिनो नित्यवैरिणा।
कामरूपेण भो देवाः ! दुष्प्ररेणानलेन च ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! ज्ञानी के नित्य वैरी इस दुष्पूरणीय कामरूप अग्नि के द्वारा ज्ञान आच्छन्न है
english_translation: Desire and anger, born of the quality of passion, are fierce and difficult to satisfy; consider wealth in this world your enemy.
essence: Desire, anger, and worldly wealth fiercely oppose your inner peace and true purpose.
simple_meaning: Desire and anger arise from passion and are hard to satisfy. Wealth in this world often opposes your wellbeing.
insight: It teaches you to see desire, anger, and wealth attachment as barriers to calm and wise action.
modern_relevance: You may chase money or react in anger, but these urges often drain your energy and cloud your judgment.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
इन्द्रियाणि मनो बुद्धिर्स्याधिष्ठानमुच्यते।
एतर्विमोहयत्येष ज्ञानमावृत्य देहिनम् ॥
translation: इन्द्रियां, मन और बुद्धि, इस काम के अधिष्ठान कहे जाते हैं, इन्हीं के द्वारा यह ज्ञान को प्राच्छन्न करके देही को मोहित किया करता है
english_translation: Just as fire is covered by smoke, glass by dust, and a fetus by a womb, similarly self-knowledge is covered by desire.
essence: Desire only covers self-knowledge; it does not destroy it.
simple_meaning: Self-knowledge is hidden by desire just as fire is hidden by smoke or glass by dust.
insight: It shifts your view from believing desire blocks your true self permanently to seeing it as a temporary veil.
modern_relevance: When your mind is clouded by cravings or distractions, your inner clarity feels lost, though it remains beneath it all.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यूयं तदिन्द्रियाण्यादौ नियम्य विबुधर्षभाः।
पाप्मानं प्रहतैनं हि ज्ञानविज्ञाननाशनम् ॥
translation: इस कारण हे देवश्रेष्ठो! तुम पहले इन्द्रियों का संयम करके इस ज्ञान विज्ञाननाशक पापी काम को नाश करो
english_translation: O radiant beings, knowledge is always veiled by the relentless fire of desire, the eternal enemy of the wise.
