essence: Desire’s relentless fire always veils the clear knowing of the wise.
simple_meaning: Your natural wisdom is hidden by desire, which acts like a persistent, burning fire blocking clear understanding.
insight: Recognize how desire clouds your discernment and begin to see it as a barrier to clear wisdom.
modern_relevance: You find it hard to focus or think clearly when craving or wanting pulls your attention away like a distracting flame.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
इन्द्रियाणि पराण्याहुरिन्द्रियेभ्यः परं मनः।
मनसस्तु परा बुद्धिर्यो बुद्धेः परतस्तु सः ॥
translation: देह की अपेक्षा इन्द्रियाँ श्रेष्ठ हैं इन्द्रियों की अपेक्षा मन श्रेष्ठ है, मन की अपेक्षा बुद्धि श्रेष्ठ है और जो बुद्धि से श्रेष्ठ है वही आत्मा है
english_translation: The senses, mind, and intellect are called the seat of action; they veil knowledge and delude the embodied self.
essence: The senses, mind, and intellect veil true knowledge and confuse the embodied self.
simple_meaning: Your senses, mind, and intellect form the basis of your actions and create confusion by hiding clear understanding from your true self.
insight: Recognize that your perceptions and reasoning can cloud your awareness, encouraging you to look beyond them for truth.
modern_relevance: When your emotions and thoughts overwhelm you, it feels like your true clarity is lost behind noise and distraction.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
एवं बुद्धे परं बुद्धवा संस्तभ्यात्मानमात्मना।
हत शत्रु सुरश्रेष्ठा: ! कामरूपं दुरासदम् ॥
translation: हे देवश्रेष्ठो ! इस प्रकार बुद्धि की अपेक्षा श्रेष्ठ आत्मा को जानकर और बुद्धि के द्वारा मन को संयत करके काम रूप दुर्निवार शत्रु का नाश करो
english_translation: Therefore, O best of the divine beings, first control the senses to destroy this sinful desire that destroys knowledge and wisdom.
essence: Controlling your senses first is key to destroying desire that destroys wisdom.
simple_meaning: You must first control your senses to overcome desire that destroys your knowledge and wisdom.
insight: It teaches you to redirect your attention from reactive impulses to disciplined sense control, preserving clear understanding.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by impulses—like scrolling endlessly or reacting emotionally—gaining control helps protect your focus and clarity.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
नाहं प्रकाशः सर्वस्य योगमायासमावृतः ।
मूढ़ोऽयं नाभिजानाति लोको मामजमव्ययम्
translation: महामायाके द्वारा आवृत होने के कारण मुझे सब नहीं देख सकते हैं। यह मूढ़ संसार मुझे अजन्मा और अविनाशी नहीं जानता है
english_translation: The organs are said to be superior to the body; the mind is superior to the organs; the intellect is superior to the mind; and the true self is superior to the intellect.
essence: You exist beyond body, senses, mind, and intellect as the true self.
simple_meaning: There is a hierarchy: senses are above the body, mind above senses, intellect above mind, and beyond intellect lies the true self.
insight: It shifts your attention inward from external sensations and mental processes to the unchanging true self beyond intellect.
modern_relevance: When your thoughts overwhelm you, remember you are not just your mind or senses but something deeper that observes all.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
वेदाहं समतीतानि वर्त्तमानानि चामरा: !।
भविष्याणि च भूतानि मान्तु वेद न कश्चन ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! मैं भूत भविष्यत् और वर्तमान काल में स्थित समस्त स्थावर जंगम प्राणियों को जानता हूँ परन्तु मुझको कोई नहीं जानता है
english_translation: O best of gods! Knowing the supreme true self beyond the intellect, restrain your mind by that intellect and destroy the insurmountable enemy called desire.
essence: Knowing your highest self empowers you to control the mind and defeat desire.
simple_meaning: By recognizing the highest true self beyond intellect and using intellect to control the mind, you can conquer the powerful enemy called desire.
insight: It teaches you to apply your intellect as a tool to discipline your restless mind and weaken desire’s hold.
modern_relevance: When cravings pull you away, knowing your deeper self helps you steady your focus and resist temptation.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
इच्छोद्वेषसमुत्थेन द्वन्द्वमोहेन निर्जराः।
सर्वभूतानि सम्मोहं सर्गे यान्त्यसुरारयः ! ॥
translation: हे असुरशत्रु देवतागण ! इच्छा और द्वेष से सम्भूत द्वन्द्व के मोह से सृष्टिकाल में सब जीव सम्मोह को प्राप्त होते हैं
english_translation: I am not the light of all because I am veiled by the yoga-maya; the deluded world does not know me as unborn and imperishable.
essence: The true self is hidden by illusion and misunderstood by the confused world.
simple_meaning: The divine presence is hidden by a powerful illusion, so most people fail to see it as eternal and unchanging.
insight: This shifts your view from identifying with the fleeting world to recognizing the unchanging essence beneath appearances.
modern_relevance: At times, you feel lost in confusion and fail to recognize the steady presence inside yourself that never changes.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
येपान्त्वन्तगतं पापं जनानां पुण्यकर्मणाम् ।
ते द्वन्द्वमोहनिर्मक्ता भजन्ते मां दृढव्रताः ॥
translation: किन्तु जिन पुण्यात्मा व्यक्तियों का पाप नष्ट हो गया है वे इन्द्रजनित मोह से रहित होकर दृढ़वत होते हुए मेरी भक्ति में रत रहते हैं
english_translation: O radiant beings! I know all beings past, present, and future, but no one knows me.
essence: Knowing everything does not mean being known by anything.
simple_meaning: The speaker knows all beings across time but remains unknown to anyone else.
insight: It shifts your mind to recognize that knowing others does not guarantee being known yourself.
modern_relevance: You might understand everyone around you deeply, yet feel that no one truly understands you.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
जरामरणमोक्षाय मामाश्रित्य यतन्ति ये।
ते ब्रह्म तद्विदुः कृत्स्नमध्यात्म कर्म चाखिलम् ॥
translation: जरा और मरण से बचने के लिये मेरा आश्रय करके जो प्रयत्न करते हैं वह उस ब्रह्म को, समस्त अध्यात्म को और समस्त कर्म को जानते हैं
english_translation: O enemies of the Asuras and hosts of the Devas! At creation, all beings fall into delusion born from conflict of desire and aversion.
essence: All beings begin with confusion born from conflicting desires and aversions.
simple_meaning: All living beings begin their existence confused because of the inner conflict caused by wanting some things and rejecting others.
insight: Recognize that the root of confusion is the conflict between wanting and rejecting, which distorts your perception of reality.
modern_relevance: You notice how often your mind flips between craving something and pushing something away, trapping you in confusion that feels like it has been there since the beginning.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
साधिभूताधिदैवं मां साधियज्ञं च य विदु:।
प्रयाणकालेऽपि च मां ते विदुर्युक्तचेतसः ॥
translation: जो मुझको अधिदैव अधिभूत और अधियज्ञ के सहित जानते हैं मुझमें आसक्तचित्त वह मरणकाल में भी मुझको जानते हैं
english_translation: But those virtuous people whose sins have been destroyed, free from the delusion of the senses born of Indra, remain steadfast and devoted to me.
essence: True devotion blossoms when inner faults and sensory illusions are overcome.
simple_meaning: People who have overcome their wrong actions and freed themselves from confusing desires remain firmly devoted to the divine.
insight: It shows how shedding inner confusion and past mistakes helps you develop unwavering devotion.
modern_relevance: You feel stuck in cycles of regret and distraction, but when you let go of those burdens, your connection to what truly matters becomes steady and clear.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
किं तब्रह्म किमध्यात्मं किं कर्म परमेश्वर ।
अधिभूतञ्च किं मोक्तमधिदैवं किमुच्यते ॥
translation: हे परमेश्वर ! वह ब्रह्म क्या है, अध्यात्म क्या है, कर्म क्या है, अधिभूत किसको कहा गया है, अधिदैव किसको कहते हैं,
english_translation: Those who seek refuge in me striving to transcend old age and death know that supreme reality, all spirituality, and all action completely.
essence: Seeking refuge in the divine reveals complete knowledge of reality, spirituality, and action.
simple_meaning: Those who turn to the divine to overcome aging and death understand the supreme reality, complete spirituality, and all action fully.
insight: It shifts your focus from fearing decay to embracing the divine as the source of all existence and action.
modern_relevance: When facing fears of aging or loss, turning to your inner refuge opens awareness beyond these limits to deeper wholeness.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अधियज्ञः कथं कोऽत्र देहेऽस्मिन् दैत्यमूदन।
प्रयाणकाले च कथं ज्ञेयोऽसि नियतात्मभिः ॥
translation: इस देह में  अधियज्ञ कौन है और कैसे वह इस देह में स्थित है और हे दैत्य सूदन ! आप मरणकाल में संयतात्मा व्यक्तियों के द्वारा कैसे जाने जाते हैं
english_translation: Those who understand me as the inner deity, the essence of all beings, and the supreme sacrificial principle, know me even at the time of death with a devoted mind.
essence: True devotion perceives the divine within and endures beyond death.
simple_meaning: Those who recognize the divine as the inner force in all beings and the ultimate sacred principle, keep that devotion even at death.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate a devoted mind that remains connected to the divine beyond life’s transitions.
modern_relevance: When facing life’s hardest moments, like loss or endings, your steady devotion can be a source of inner strength and clarity.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अक्षरं ब्रह्म परमं स्वभावोऽध्यात्ममुच्यते ।
भूतभावोद्भवकरो विसर्गः कर्मसंज्ञितः ॥
translation: परम अक्षर जिसका क्षय नहीं है अर्थात् जगत का मूल कारण वही ब्रह्म है, स्वभाव ही अर्थात आत्मभाव ही  अध्यात्म कहा जाता है, भूतभावोद्भवकर अर्थात् सकल प्राणिमात्र की उत्पत्ति और स्थिति करने वाला जो विसर्ग अर्थात् त्याग है वहीं कर्म है
english_translation: O supreme being! What is Brahman? What is the inner self? What is action? What is called the physical realm? What is called the divine realm?
essence: Deep questions about reality and self open the path to true understanding.
simple_meaning: This verse asks fundamental questions about the supreme reality, the true self, action, and the different levels of existence.
insight: It encourages shifting from assumptions to active inquiry about existence and the self.
modern_relevance: When confusion clouds your mind, asking clear questions about your true nature and the world can open new perspectives.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अधिभूतं क्षरो भावः पुरुषश्चाधिदैवतम्।
अधियज्ञोऽहमेवात्र देहे देहभृताम्बराः !॥
translation: हे देहधारियों में श्रेष्ठो! नाशवान् भाव देहादि अधिभूत हैं पुरुष स्वांशभूत सब दैवी शक्तियों का अधिपति अधिदैव है और इन शरीरों में मैं ही अधियज्ञ कूटस्थ चैतन्य हूँ
english_translation: Who is the supreme sacrificer in this body, and how does he reside here? O Daityamudana, how is he known by those with self-control at the time of death?
essence: The supreme presence within the body is recognized by the disciplined at life's final moment.
simple_meaning: There is a supreme presence within your body, known by disciplined people especially when life ends.
insight: It teaches you to look beyond the physical and recognize a deeper presence especially in critical moments.
modern_relevance: When facing loss or watching a loved one near death, you sense something deeper beyond the physical body.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ओंतत्सदिति निर्देशो ब्रह्मणस्त्रिविधः स्मृतः।
ब्राह्मणास्तेन वेदाश्च यज्ञाश्च विहिताः पुरा ॥
translation: ॐ तत सत्, यह तीन ब्रह्म के नाम हैं, इन तीनों के द्वारा पूर्वकाल में ब्राह्मण, वेद और यज्ञो की सृष्टि हुई थी।
english_translation: The imperishable supreme reality is called the true self; the source and sustainer of all beings is the act known as karma.
essence: The unchanging true self is the source from which all beings and their actions arise.
simple_meaning: The true self is the imperishable essence behind everything. The natural origin and source of all beings and their actions is the process called karma.
insight: It shifts the mind to see karma not just as actions but as natural expressions arising from your true self.
modern_relevance: When life feels chaotic, remembering your unchanging true self can bring calm and clarity amidst constant change.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तस्मादोमित्युदाहृत्य यज्ञदानतपःक्रियाः।
प्रवर्त्तन्ते विधानोक्ताः सततं ब्रह्मवादिनाम ॥
translation: इसी कारण ओम, यह शब्द उच्चारण करके ब्रह्मवादियों के  शास्त्रोक्त यज्ञ दान और तप कर्म निरन्तर सम्पन्न हुआ करते हैं
english_translation: O best among those who bear bodies! The perishable nature of the body is the physical realm; the true self is the lord of all divine powers; I am the inner controller and consciousness within these bodies.
essence: Your true self is the eternal inner controller beyond the perishable body.
simple_meaning: The body is perishable and part of the physical world, but the true self inside is the supreme controller and source of divine power within.
insight: It shifts your perspective from identifying with the body to recognizing your inner conscious presence as the true source of control.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by your changing emotions and physical limits, remembering that your true self is beyond these can bring calm and clarity.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तदित्यनभिसन्धाय फलं यज्ञ तपः क्रियाः।
दानक्रियाश्च विविधाः क्रियन्ते मोक्षकांक्षिभिः ॥
translation: मुमुक्षगण फलाकांक्षा त्याग करके और तत् इस शब्द को उच्चारण करके विविध प्रकार के यज्ञ तप और दान कर्म करते हैं
english_translation: Om Tat Sat are three names of Brahman; through these three, Brahmins, Vedas, and sacrifices were created in ancient times.
essence: Three sacred sounds embody the origin of sacred knowledge, priests, and rituals.
simple_meaning: The sacred syllables Om, Tat, and Sat represent the supreme reality and have given rise to priests, scriptures, and rituals since ancient times.
insight: It teaches you to recognize the power of foundational spiritual sounds that shape tradition and inner understanding.
modern_relevance: When you chant or reflect on Om Tat Sat, you tap into the deep roots of spiritual knowledge and practice that shaped culture.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सद्भावे साधुभावे च सदित्येतत् प्रयुज्यते।
प्रशस्ते कर्माणि तथा सच्छब्दो युज्यतेऽमराः ! ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! सद्भाव में (अस्तित्व में) और साधुभाव में (साधुत्व में) सत् इस शब्द का प्रयोग होता है एवं श्रेष्ठ कर्म में भी सत् शब्द प्रयुक्त होता है
english_translation: Therefore, by uttering the syllable Om, the scripture-prescribed acts of sacrifice, charity, and austerity are continuously performed by the followers of Brahman.
essence: The utterance of Om sustains continuous sacred action by those devoted to Brahman.
simple_meaning: Uttering the sound Om supports continuous sacred actions like sacrifice, charity, and austerity as prescribed by scripture.
insight: It teaches you to anchor your spiritual effort in a simple, steady practice that sustains long-term discipline.
modern_relevance: You repeat a simple mantra or habit daily, and it becomes the steady engine for your deeper, disciplined practice.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यज्ञे तपसि दाने च स्थितिः सदिति चोच्यते।
कर्म चैव तदर्थीयं सदित्येवाभिधीयते ॥
translation: यज्ञ, तपस्या और दान कर्मों में लगे रहने को भी सत् कहा जाता है और तदर्थीय कर्म को भी सत ही कहते हैं
english_translation: Those seeking freedom perform various sacrifices, austerities, and acts of giving without desire for results, uttering the word 'That'.
essence: True seekers act with pure intent, free from desire for results.
simple_meaning: People seeking inner freedom perform sacrifices, austerities, and giving without expecting rewards, focusing instead on pure intent.
insight: Shift your focus from wanting results to committing fully to the action itself.
modern_relevance: You work hard on a project but keep your focus on doing your best, not on the praise or reward it might bring.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अश्रद्धया हुतं दत्तं तपस्तप्तं कृतञ्च यत् ।
अमदित्युच्यते देवाः ! न च तत् प्रेत्य नो इह ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! अश्रद्धापूर्वक होम करना, दान करना, तपस्या करना एवं जो कुछ भी करना, असत् कहा जाता है, वह न परलोक में और न इहलोक में फलदायक होता है
english_translation: O divine beings! The word 'sat' is used for true existence, virtuous nature, and excellent actions.
essence: The word 'sat' unifies true existence, virtue, and noble action as one reality.
simple_meaning: The word ‘sat’ is used to describe true existence, virtuous nature, and the highest quality of actions.
insight: It guides you to see that truth is not separate in existence, character, or action but unified under one word.
modern_relevance: When you call something 'real' or 'good'—whether a person, their nature, or their work—you are using the same deep standard of truth.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तत्त्वज्ञानस्य यन्मूलं संक्षेपाच्छृणुतामराः ! ॥
अवश्यमेव विजेयमित्येतावत् सुरर्षभाः ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! मैं संक्षेप से तत्त्वज्ञान का मूल कहता हूँ सुनो। इतना अवश्य ही आपलोगों को जानना उचित है
english_translation: Being engaged in sacrifice, austerity, and charity is called existence; action done for their sake is also called existence.
essence: True existence is steady commitment to selfless, purposeful action.
simple_meaning: Being consistently involved in acts like sacrifice, discipline, and giving is true existence, as is acting with that purpose.
insight: It shifts focus from chasing results to valuing consistent engagement in right actions.
modern_relevance: You commit daily to causes or habits that feel right, and in that steady devotion, you find your true presence.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
प्रपञ्चमयदृश्येऽस्मिन नास्ति किञ्चित्रिभावतः।
रहितं वस्तु भावो हि कारणं गुणदर्शने ॥
translation: कि इस प्रपञ्चमय दृश्य में कोई पदार्थ भी त्रिभाव से रहित नहीं है; क्योंकि भाव ही गुणदर्शन का कारण है
english_translation: O radiant beings! Actions like offerings, giving, and austerities performed without faith are called unreal; they bear no fruit here or beyond.
essence: Actions without faith are empty and bear no lasting fruit.
simple_meaning: Actions like offerings, donations, or austerities done without faith are ineffective and do not bring results here or after death.
insight: It teaches you to root your actions in genuine trust to make them effective and meaningful.
modern_relevance: You might complete a task or help someone but feel disconnected or doubtful, making your effort feel hollow and unrewarding.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
प्रकृतिस्त्रिगुणा या मे प्रथमं त्रीन गुणान् स्वकान्।
स्वस्मिन् सम्यक् विलय्यैव तदा सा मयि लीयते ॥
translation: त्रिगुणमयी मेरी प्रकृति पहले तीनों अपने गुणों को अपने में सम्यक् लय करके ही तब वह मुझ में विलीन होती है
english_translation: O divine beings! I will briefly explain the root of true knowledge. This much you must certainly know.
essence: True knowledge has a simple root everyone must understand.
simple_meaning: You are about to hear the essential core of true knowledge in brief. This is important and certain for you to understand.
insight: It encourages focusing on the essential core rather than getting lost in details, making wisdom accessible.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by complex ideas, you can find relief in focusing on the core truth that matters most.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
आदौ देवाः ! त्रयो भावाः स्थिताः स्वस्वस्वरूपतः।
पश्चादद्वैतरूपत्वमाश्रयन्तीति सम्मतम् ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! प्रथम तीनों भाव अपने अपने स्वरूप से प्रकट रहकर पीछे अद्वैत रूप को  आश्रय करते हैं, यह निश्चय है
english_translation: In this world of appearances, nothing exists without the three qualities; because feeling is the cause of perceiving qualities.
essence: Feelings cause you to perceive qualities; nothing appears without them.
simple_meaning: Everything you see is influenced by three qualities because your feelings shape how you perceive them.
insight: This verse teaches you to notice how your feelings influence what qualities you see in everything around you.
modern_relevance: When you react emotionally to a person or situation, you realize your feelings tint your perception, not just the facts.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
गुणदर्शनहेतुर्हि तस्माद्भावः प्रकीर्तितः।
साधकानां मुराः ! भावो हवलम्बनमन्तिमम् ॥
translation: इस कारण से भाव गुण दर्शन का हेतु कहा गया है। हे देवतागण ! साधकों का अन्तिम अवलम्बन भाव है
english_translation: My nature is composed of three qualities; when it fully dissolves its own qualities into itself, then it merges into me.
essence: The three qualities of nature dissolve only when fully absorbed into the true self.
simple_meaning: Your natural makeup has three qualities that vanish only when they fully merge back into you.
insight: It teaches you to see qualities as temporary and to focus on the unchanging presence beneath them.
modern_relevance: You experience moods and traits that seem fixed until you realize they can dissolve when you deeply connect with your true self.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ममैवांशो जीवलोके जीवभूतः सनातनः ।
मन:षष्ठानीन्द्रियाणि प्रकृतिस्थानि कर्षति ॥
translation: मेरा ही अंश सनातन अर्थात् माया के कारण सदा संसारी रूप से प्रसिद्ध जीव, प्रकृति में स्थित मन और पञ्चेन्द्रियों को जीवलोक में आकर्षण करता है
english_translation: O divine beings! Initially, the three states exist in their own forms and later rest in the non-dual reality; this is certain.
essence: Apparent separate states arise but ultimately rest in one non-dual reality.
simple_meaning: Three states appear in their own forms first, then they rest in the one non-dual reality; this is certain.
insight: It shifts the view from seeing separate experiences to recognizing their shared root in non-duality.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
शरीरं यद्वाप्नोति यच्चाप्युत्क्ताम्तीश्वर:।
गर्हीत्वैतानि संयति वायुर्गंधानिवाशयात ॥
translation: ईश्वर अर्थात् देही जिस शरीर को प्राप्त होता है और जिस शरीर को परित्याग करता है, जिस प्रकार वायु आशय अर्थात् कुसुमादि से गन्धयुक्त सूक्ष्मांश ग्रहण करके जाता है उसी प्रकार प्राप्त शरीर में पूर्वपरित्यक्त शरीर से  इन सब इन्द्रियादि को लेकर जाता है
english_translation: Because of this, the inner attitude is called the cause for perceiving qualities; O radiant beings, the ultimate support for seekers is the inner attitude.
essence: Your inner attitude shapes what qualities you perceive and is your ultimate support.
simple_meaning: The way you feel inside is why you notice certain qualities. For seekers, this inner attitude is their final support.
insight: It shifts your view to see that perception depends on your inner state, not just external facts.
modern_relevance: Before deciding or judging, you realize your mood and attitude shape what you notice and trust.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
श्रोतं चक्षु: स्पर्श्नच्य रसनं घ्राणमेव च ।
अधिष्ठाय मनश्चाय विष्यानुप सेवते ॥
translation: यह देही श्रोत्र चक्षु त्वक रसना और घ्राण इन बाह्येन्द्रियों पर और अन्तःकरण पर अधिष्ठान करके विषयों का उपभोग करता है।
english_translation: The eternal living being in the world is a part of me; it draws the mind and five senses, situated in nature, into the realm of living beings.
essence: An eternal part within you draws the mind and senses into the natural world.
simple_meaning: You are an eternal living presence that draws your mind and senses into the changing world around you.
insight: Recognize the difference between your eternal true self and the natural mind-sense complex that pulls you into reactivity.
modern_relevance: You might feel overwhelmed as your senses and thoughts pull you into distractions around you, unaware of the timeless presence within you.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
उत्क्रामन्तं स्थितम्वापि भुजानम्वा गुणान्वितम्।
विमूढा नानुपश्यन्ति पश्यन्ति ज्ञानचक्षुषः ॥
translation: एक देह से देहान्तर मे जाने वाले देह में स्थित विषयभोगकारी और इन्द्रियादि से युक्त देही को विमूढ़ व्यक्ति नहीं देखते हैं किन्तु प्रात्मज्ञानी देखते हैं
english_translation: The inner being takes possession of the body it attains and leaves it like wind carrying scents from flowers; it carries subtle elements from the previous body to the new one.
essence: The true self moves through bodies like wind carries fragrance, beyond physical form.
simple_meaning: Your true self receives a body, lives in it, then leaves it like wind carries fragrance from flowers to flowers.
insight: Recognize your inner self as a traveler beyond physical form, carrying subtle impressions forward.
modern_relevance: You feel restless leaving behind old habits or identities, knowing something deeper moves with you beyond your current self.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यतन्तो योगिनश्चैनं पश्यन्त्यात्मन्यवस्थितम् ।
यतन्तोऽप्यकृतात्मानो नैनं पश्यन्त्यचेतसः ॥
translation: संयतचित्त योगिगण इस देही को देह में अवस्थित देखते हैं और शास्त्रादि पाठ द्वारा यत्नशील होने पर भी आत्म तत्त्वानभिज्ञ मन्दमति इसको देख नहीं सकते
english_translation: The embodied self uses the external senses of hearing, sight, touch, taste, and smell, and the inner mind to enjoy objects.
essence: Your senses and mind together serve to experience the world of objects.
simple_meaning: You use your five senses and your mind to experience and enjoy things around you.
insight: It teaches you that perception is not just through senses but also shaped by the mind’s engagement with what the senses detect.
modern_relevance: You notice how your phone, music, taste, and thoughts all combine to create what feels real to you right now.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
द्वाविमौ पुरुषौ लोके क्षरश्चाक्षर एव च।
क्षरः सर्वाणि भूतानि कूटस्थोऽक्षर उच्यते ॥
translation: क्षर और अक्षर नामक ये दो पुरुष लोक में प्रसिद्ध हैं उनमे से सब भूतगण क्षर पुरुष और कूटस्थ चैतन्य अक्षर पुरुष कहा जाता है
english_translation: People lost in delusion do not see the true self that moves through different bodies with qualities; only those with the eye of wisdom perceive it.
essence: Only wisdom reveals the true self moving beyond changing bodies and qualities.
simple_meaning: Only those with clear understanding see the true self that moves through different bodies and experiences qualities. Confused people cannot perceive this reality.
insight: It teaches you to shift attention from surface changes to the unchanging observer within.
modern_relevance: When you identify only with your changing moods or roles, you miss the unchanging core that truly is you.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
उत्तम: पुरुषस्त्वन्य: परमात्मेत्युदाहृत।
यो लोकत्रयमाविशय विभर्त्तयव्यय  ईश्वर: ॥
translation: इन क्षर और अक्षर से अन्य उत्तम पुरुष परमात्मा कहे गये हैं जो ईश्वर और निर्विकार हैं एवं लोकत्रय में प्रविष्ट होकर पालन करते हैं
english_translation: Disciplined yogis see the inner being dwelling within the body, but those undisciplined in mind do not perceive it.
essence: Only a disciplined mind can perceive the true self within the body.
simple_meaning: Those who discipline their mind through practice can perceive their true self inside, while the undisciplined cannot.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate mental discipline to witness your true self clearly.
modern_relevance: When your mind is restless and distracted, you struggle to see who you truly are beneath the noise and chaos.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यस्मात् क्षरमतीतोऽहमक्षरादपि चोत्तमः।
अतोऽस्मि लोके वेदे च प्रथितः पुरुषोत्तमः ॥
translation: क्योंकि मैं क्षर से अतीत हूँ, और अक्षर की अपेक्षा भी उत्तम हूँ इसी कारण लोक में और वेद में पुरुषोत्तम प्रसिद्ध हैं
english_translation: In the world, there are two kinds of beings: the perishable and the imperishable. All creatures are perishable, but the unchanging consciousness is called the imperishable.
essence: Among all beings, the unchanging consciousness alone is truly imperishable.
simple_meaning: Everything in the world changes and passes away, but the inner consciousness remains constant and unchanging.
insight: Shift attention from fleeting events to the unchanging witness within, grounding your identity in permanence not flux.
modern_relevance: In moments of stress, when everything around you feels unstable, remember your true self is steady and beyond change.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यो मामेवमसम्मूढो जानाति पुरुषोत्तमम् ।
स सर्वविद्भजति मां सर्वभावेन निर्जराः ! ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! इस प्रकार निश्चित बुद्धि होकर जो मुझको पुरुषोत्तम समझता है वह सर्वज्ञ व्यक्ति मुझको ही सर्वभाव से पूजता है
english_translation: The supreme being, distinct from the perishable and imperishable, is called the highest self who pervades and sustains the three worlds without change.
essence: An unchanging supreme presence pervades and sustains all three worlds.
simple_meaning: There is a supreme being beyond what changes and what does not, who enters and upholds the three worlds without alteration.
insight: It shifts focus from transient things to the enduring presence behind all existence.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
इति गुह्यतम शास्त्रमिदमुक्तं मयाऽनघाः ।
एतबुवा बुद्धिमान् स्यात् कृतकृत्यश्च देवताः ॥
translation: हे निर्दोष देवता गण ! यह परमगुहा शास्त्र मैंने कहा है इसको समझकर साधक सम्यक शानी और कृतकृत्य होता है
english_translation: Because I transcend the perishable and am even superior to the imperishable, I am known as the Supreme Being in the world and the Vedas.
essence: Your true self is beyond all change and is known as the supreme reality.
simple_meaning: The true self goes beyond everything that changes and is even higher than what never changes. That is why it is known as supreme everywhere.
insight: It shifts your view from identifying with temporary things to recognizing your unchanging, highest nature.
modern_relevance: When everything around you feels unstable, you can find a part of yourself untouched by change and truly supreme.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
जगद्गुरो! देवदेव: करुणावरुणालय !।
निर्भयाः स्मो वयं जाता उपदेशन ते विभो ! ॥
translation: हे देवादिदेव ! हे जगद्गुरो ! हे करुणावरुणालय ! हे विभो ! आपके उपदेश द्वारा हम निर्भय हुए हैं
english_translation: Anyone who truly knows me as the supreme being worships me with complete devotion and understanding.
essence: True knowledge of the supreme being naturally creates complete, steadfast devotion.
simple_meaning: When someone fully understands the supreme being without confusion, they worship with complete and unwavering devotion.
insight: It teaches you that clear understanding removes confusion and naturally leads to wholehearted devotion.
modern_relevance: You recognize someone’s true value clearly, and your respect and care for them naturally deepen without doubt.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
रहस्यं जगत:सृष्टेस्त्रिगुणैजनितं तथा ।
सृष्टेविभागमेतस्याः यथावज्ञानलब्धये ॥
translation: संसार की सृष्टि का रहस्य, त्रिगुणजनित सृष्टि का विभाग और उसके यथावत् ज्ञान को प्राप्त करने के लिये
english_translation: O pure radiant beings! I have spoken this most secret teaching; understanding it, the seeker becomes wise and fulfilled.
essence: Understanding the deepest teaching brings wisdom and fulfillment.
simple_meaning: I have shared the deepest teaching. Those who understand it become wise and feel complete.
insight: Recognizing and internalizing profound teachings transforms the seeker into a wise and fulfilled person.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ज्ञात्वा भावरहस्यं च कृतकृत्यत्वमागताः।
अतस्ते कृपया काऽपि पतिप्यामो भये न हि ॥
translation: भाव का रहस्य समझकर हम कृतकृत्य हुए। अतः आपकी कृपा से हम किसी भी भय में पतित नहीं होंगे
english_translation: O world teacher! O Deva of Devas! O abode of compassion! By your instruction, we have become fearless, O Vibhō!
essence: Fear fades when wise guidance from a compassionate teacher is received.
simple_meaning: By the teachings of this compassionate world teacher, we have become free from fear.
insight: It highlights how guidance from a trusted source can dissolve fear and build inner confidence.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
स्वासीमकृपयेदानीमस्मानुपदिश प्रभो !।
सृष्टनिंदानं किं देव ! तदुत्पत्तिः किमर्थिका ॥
translation: हे देव! हे प्रभो! अब अपनी असीम कृपा द्वारा हमको उपदेश दीजिये कि सृष्टि का मूल कारण क्या है? क्यों सृष्टि उत्पन्न हुई है?
english_translation: The secret of the world's creation, the division of the world born of the three qualities, and how to truly understand it.
essence: True understanding reveals the secret divisions born from the three fundamental qualities.
simple_meaning: The verse introduces the mystery behind creation linked to the three qualities and how to gain true understanding of it.
insight: It encourages seeking clear understanding of the forces shaping reality rather than accepting appearances.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तस्याः प्रवर्तकः कोऽस्ति मूलनिर्मूलने स्फुटः।
उपायः कश्च तब्रूहि भवव्याधिनिवृत्तये ॥
translation: उस सृष्टि का प्रवर्तक कौन है? और इसके मूल को निर्मूल करने का स्पष्ट उपाय क्या है? भवरोग की निवृत्ति के लिये कृपया कर यह सब कहें
english_translation: Having understood the secret of emotions and our debts, we will not fall into any fear by your grace.
essence: Understanding emotional debts and grace removes all fear.
simple_meaning: When you understand the true nature of your emotions and debts, your trust in the divine protects you from fear.
insight: It shifts your mind from fearing consequences to trusting in protective grace and acceptance.
modern_relevance: You’ve faced emotional challenges and mistakes, but knowing you’re supported helps you stop fearing what might come next.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सृष्टिप्रवाहो विबुधाः ! मदिच्छातः प्रवर्त्तते ।
आधन्तरहितस्तद्वविस्तारावधिवर्जितः ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! अनादि अनन्त और जिसके विस्तार की अवधि नहीं है ऐसा सृष्टि प्रवाह मेरी इच्छा से प्रवाहित रहता है।
english_translation: O Lord! Please now bless us with your boundless grace and teach us: What is the original cause of creation? Why did creation arise?
essence: A heartfelt plea to understand why and how the universe began.
simple_meaning: A humble request is made to the divine being to kindly explain the origin and reason for the creation of the universe.
insight: It encourages honest questioning and openness to receiving wisdom about existence's root cause.
modern_relevance: When life feels confusing and overwhelming, you might long for a clear explanation of why everything exists as it does.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
निजानन्दप्रकाशाय साहाय्यात् सचितोः स्वयोः।
स्वीयां शक्ति महामायां स्वतः प्रकटयाम्यहम् ॥
translation: मैं अपने आनन्द को प्रकाशित करने के लिये अपने सत् और चिद्भाव की सहायता से अपने मे से अपनी शक्ति महामाया को प्रकट करता हूँ
english_translation: Who is the originator of that creation? And what is the clear method to uproot its root? Please explain this for the cessation of the disease of existence.
essence: Understanding the origin and remedy of existence's suffering is key to freedom.
simple_meaning: A question is asked about who started the creation and how to remove the root cause of worldly suffering.
insight: It encourages moving beyond surface problems to identify and address the deepest cause of suffering.
modern_relevance: You might find yourself asking what started your current struggles and how to truly end them, seeking a clear path beyond confusion.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सैव शक्तिश्च मे देवाः ! जगतो जननी मता।
किन्तु सर्वस्य जगतः स्थित्युत्पत्तिलयेष्वपि ॥
translation: और हे देवगण ! वही मेरी शक्ति जगत को उत्पन्न करती है, परन्तु सम्पूर्ण जगत की उत्पत्ति स्थिति और लयों में भी
english_translation: O divine beings! The endless flow of creation moves by my will, without beginning or end, and beyond measure.
essence: Creation flows endlessly and limitlessly from the divine will.
simple_meaning: The endless flow of creation happens because of the divine will, without any limit or starting point.
insight: It invites you to see creation as a vast, ongoing movement beyond beginnings or ends, shaped by a profound inner will.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
केवलं कारणं कर्म विज्ञेयं मुरसत्तमाः ।
जड़चेतनभेदेन मदीया प्रकृतिद्विधा ॥
translation: एकमात्र कारण कर्म ही है ऐसा जानना चाहिये। जड़ और चेतन भेद से मेरी प्रकृति दो प्रकार की है
english_translation: I manifest my great power, the supreme illusion, through my own truth and consciousness to illuminate my own bliss.
essence: Your own truth and awareness manifest your greatest creative power and joy.
simple_meaning: You can reveal your deepest joy by manifesting your own truth and consciousness through your innate great power.
insight: It teaches you to trust your own consciousness as the source of creative power and joy.
modern_relevance: When you face moments of doubt, remember your ability to create joy comes from your own inner strength and clear understanding.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
विद्या तु चेतना ज्ञेया जडाऽविद्या प्रकीर्तिता।
त्रिगुणा सा समाख्याता तत एव च हेतुतः ॥
translation: चेतनमयी विद्या कहलाती है और जड़ अविद्या कहलाती है। वह त्रिगुणमयी है और त्रिगुणमयी होने से
english_translation: O divine beings! That same power of mine creates the world, and also sustains and dissolves the entire universe.
essence: One power creates, sustains, and dissolves all that exists.
simple_meaning: The divine power that creates the world also governs its maintenance and destruction.
insight: It shifts your perspective to see all changes in life as expressions of one continuous power, reducing fear of loss or change.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
कम्मोत्पत्तर्हि सा हेतुर्भवतीयवधार्यताम्।
परिणामात्तदुत्पत्तिस्त्रिगुणस्य मता सुराः ॥
translation: कर्म की उत्पत्ति का कारण बन जाती है, सो जानो। हे देवगण ! त्रिगुण परिणाम से ही कर्मों की उत्पत्ति मानी गई है
english_translation: Action alone is the sole cause; know this well. My nature is twofold, distinguished as inert and conscious.
essence: Action alone causes results; the divine nature is both inert and conscious.
simple_meaning: The root cause of everything is action. The divine nature has two parts: one that is inert and one that is conscious.
insight: It teaches you to focus on your actions as the true cause, not external factors or excuses.
modern_relevance: When you face outcomes beyond your control, recognize that your actions are the true cause, not external circumstances or blame.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
जैवैशसहजा भेदा: कर्मणस्तस्य कीर्तिता: ।
कर्मणा सहजेन स्युर्ब्रह्माण्डानां त्रयः सदा ॥
translation: कर्म के तीन भेद है, उनको जैव, सहज और ऐश कहते हैं । हे विपुल बलशाली देवगण! सहज कर्म द्वारा ब्रह्माण्डो के
english_translation: Knowledge is understood as consciousness, while ignorance is called inertness. Both are characterized by the three qualities, and this is the cause.
essence: Knowledge is conscious awareness; ignorance is inertness shaped by three qualities.
simple_meaning: Knowledge is consciousness, alive and aware. Ignorance is lifeless and defined by three qualities that bind it.
insight: It teaches you to see knowledge as vibrant awareness and ignorance as passive inertia shaped by three forces.
modern_relevance: You notice moments when clarity lights up your mind versus times you feel stuck in dull confusion — that contrast is the difference between knowledge and ignorance.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सृष्टिस्थितिलया एते क्रमशो ह्यमितौजसः ।
विशिष्टचेतना  जीवा: सम्बद्धा जैवकर्मणा ॥
translation: उत्पत्ति स्थिति और लय क्रम से हुआ करते हैं, जैव कर्म के साथ विशिष्ट चेतन जीवों का सम्बन्ध है
english_translation: Know that the cause of action’s origin is the effect of the three qualities, O devas.
essence: Actions arise as effects of the three fundamental qualities within nature.
simple_meaning: Actions come into being because of the three fundamental qualities affecting everything.
insight: It shifts your view to see actions as effects of natural qualities, not isolated events.
modern_relevance: When you notice your habits or reactions, they stem from deep qualities inside you shaping your behavior.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
कर्मणैशेन सम्बन्धः पितृणां भवतां नथा।
ऋषीणां चावताराणां सर्वेषां मे दिवौकसः ॥
translation: और मेरे सब अवतारों के साथ तथा पितृ ऋषि और आपलोगों के साथ ऐश कर्म का सम्बन्ध है
english_translation: There are three kinds of action: natural, innate, and divine; through innate action, the three worlds are always sustained.
essence: Three types of actions exist; spontaneous action sustains the cosmos continuously.
simple_meaning: Actions are of three kinds: those done naturally, those done spontaneously, and those done with divine purpose; the spontaneous actions keep the universe functioning.
insight: Recognize which actions arise effortlessly and trust their role in sustaining your life and environment.
modern_relevance: When you perform daily habits without forcing them, you contribute effortlessly to the world’s flow, like breathing or walking naturally.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
कर्मणी ऐशसहजे शुद्ध एव सदा मते ।
शुद्धाशुद्धविभेदस्तु जैवकर्मसु विद्यते ॥
translation: ऐश कर्म और सहज कर्म सदा शुद्ध ही होते हैं। जैव कर्म के दो भेद हैं, एक शुद्ध और एक अशुद्ध
english_translation: Creation, preservation, and dissolution happen in order; distinct conscious beings are connected through biological actions.
essence: Life cycles endlessly connect distinct consciousness through ordered creation and dissolution.
simple_meaning: The universe follows a cycle of creation, maintenance, and destruction, where distinct conscious beings connect through their life actions.
insight: Recognize your actions connect you to a larger living system cycling through birth, upkeep, and transformation.
modern_relevance: You notice how your daily choices affect others, part of a wider cycle of growth and change you can’t fully control.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
उभे एते समाख्याते कारणं पुण्यपापयोः ।
कामनाजनितावेतौ भेदौ हि परिकीर्तितो ॥
translation: यह दोनों कर्म पुण्य और पाप के कारण होते हैं। ये दोनों भेद कामना जनित कहे गये हैं
english_translation: I am connected by action with the ancestors, the sages, and all my incarnations.
essence: Your actions connect you intimately with all beings across time.
simple_meaning: You are connected to your ancestors, sages, and past incarnations through your actions.
insight: It teaches you to see your actions as threads weaving you into a timeless community.
modern_relevance: You realize that what you do today affects not just you but also connects you with those who came before and those yet to come.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अनाधन्तो वासनायाः प्रवाहो ह्येव कारणम् ।
सृष्टेरनाद्यनन्तायाः प्रवाहस्य सुरर्षभाः ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! अनादि अनन्त वासनाप्रवाह ही अनादि अनन्त सृष्टिप्रवाह का कारण है
english_translation: Natural desire-driven actions and spontaneous actions are always pure; biological actions have both pure and impure types.
essence: Actions from natural desire or spontaneity are always pure; biological actions can be mixed.
simple_meaning: Actions done out of natural desire or spontaneously are always pure. But actions driven by biological impulses can be pure or impure.
insight: It teaches you to recognize which actions arise naturally and are pure, versus those influenced by conflicting impulses.
modern_relevance: You sometimes act naturally or follow your desires without overthinking, and those moments are free from guilt. Other times, your impulses may lead to mixed results.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
वासनानाशमात्रेण कर्मणोः सहजैशयो।
जैवस्य परिणामः स्यादृशेयं कर्मयोगिनी ॥
translation: वासना के नाश होते ही जैवकर्म भी सहज कर्म और ऐश कर्मों में परिणत हो जाता है। इस दशा को कर्मयोग कहते हैं
english_translation: Both these actions arise from desire and are the causes of merit and demerit.
essence: Desire underlies actions that create merit and demerit.
simple_meaning: Actions motivated by desire lead to good or bad consequences.
insight: It teaches you to notice how desire fuels your actions and their effects.
modern_relevance: When you act driven by wants, you risk getting tangled in rewards or regrets that follow.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
नेहाभिक्रमनाशोऽस्ति प्रत्यवायो न विद्यते ।
स्वल्पमप्यस्य धर्मस्य त्रायते महतो भयात् ॥
translation: इस निष्काम कर्मयोग में प्रारम्भ की विफलता नहीं है, प्रत्यवाय अर्थात् विध्न भी नहीं है, इस धर्म का अल्प आचरण भी महाभय से रक्षा करता है
english_translation: O divine beings! The endless flow of desire is indeed the cause of the endless flow of creation from eternity.
essence: Endless desire is the root cause behind the endless flow of creation.
simple_meaning: The endless desires within beings cause the never-ending creation and change in the universe.
insight: It teaches you to see desire as the originating force behind ongoing change and creation.
modern_relevance: You notice how your persistent wants keep your mind restless and life in constant motion.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
व्यवसायात्मिका बुद्धिरेकेह यज्ञभुग्वराः !।
बहुशाखा ह्यनन्ताश्च बुद्धयोऽव्यवसायिनाम् ॥
translation: हे यज्ञभाग-भोग करने वालों में श्रेष्ट देवगण ! इस कर्मयोग, व्यवसायात्मिका अर्थात् निश्चयात्मिका बुद्धि एक होती है किन्तु अव्यवसायी अर्थात् सकाम कर्म करने वालों की बुद्धियाँ बहुशाखाओ से युक्त और अनन्त होती हैं
english_translation: When desires are destroyed, the natural and instinctive actions become effortless, marking the state called karma yoga.
essence: Destroy desire and action becomes effortless natural flow—this is karma yoga.
simple_meaning: When your desires disappear, your actions become natural and effortless. This effortless action is called karma yoga.
insight: It teaches you to let go of craving, allowing your actions to arise spontaneously and naturally without inner struggle.
modern_relevance: After frustration fades, your daily tasks feel lighter and more natural, as if they flow without force.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यामिमां पुष्पितां वाचं प्रवदन्त्यविपश्चितः।
वेदवादरता देवाः ! नान्यदस्तीति वादिनः ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! वेद के अर्थवाद में तत्पर, "जगत के अतिरिक्त ईश्वरतत्त्व और कोई नहीं है" इस प्रकार कहने वाले,
english_translation: There is no failure or reversal in selfless action; even a small part of this practice protects from great fear.
essence: Even the smallest selfless action never fails and guards you from great fear.
simple_meaning: Any selfless action you take will never fail or reverse. Even a small effort in this way protects you from great fear.
insight: It shifts your mind to value every selfless act, no matter how small, as truly protective and never wasted.
modern_relevance: You stayed up late trying to help someone without expecting a reward. Even that small effort builds your courage and peace.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
कामात्मानः स्वर्गपरा जन्मकर्मफलपदाम् ।
क्रियाविशेषबहुलां भोगैश्वर्यगति प्रति ॥
translation: कामात्मा और स्वर्ग सुख की इच्छा करने वाले जो अज्ञानी जीव हैं, वह जन्मकर्म फलप्रद, भोगैश्वर्य प्राप्ति के साधनभूत और यज्ञादि क्रिया विशेषप्राय पुष्पित वाक्य कहते रहते हैं
english_translation: Among those who enjoy the sacred ritual, the highest have a focused, steady wisdom; others have many scattered, endless thoughts.
essence: Focused effort produces clear wisdom; scattered effort creates endless confusion.
simple_meaning: A focused and steady mind brings the highest wisdom in action, while a distracted mind multiplies endless confused thoughts.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate steady attention and discipline to unify your mental energy for effective action.
modern_relevance: When you try to juggle too many tasks or ideas, your mind feels chaotic; focusing on one purpose brings clarity and calm.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
भोगैश्वर्यप्रसक्तानां तयापहृतचेतसाम् ।
व्यवसायात्मिका बुद्धिः समाधौ न विधीयते ॥
translation: उन पुष्पित वाक्यों से विचलित चित्त और भोगैश्वर्य में आसक्त व्यक्तियों की व्यवसायात्मिका बुद्धि समाधिक योग्य नहीं है
english_translation: O divine beings! The wise who speak this flourishing teaching of the Vedas say: there is nothing beyond the supreme reality in the world.
essence: Only the supreme reality exists beyond all else in the universe.
simple_meaning: The wise say that beyond everything in the universe, there is only the supreme reality and nothing else.
insight: It shifts your view to see that all appearances point to a single ultimate reality, simplifying confusion.
modern_relevance: When you feel lost in complexity, remember that at the core, only one true reality exists beyond all distractions.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यत्र काले ह्यनात्तिमात्तिश्चैव योगिनः।
प्रयाता यान्ति तं कालं वक्ष्यामि विबुधर्षभाः ॥
translation: हे देवता गण ! जिस काल में अर्थात् कालरूप मार्ग में मरण के पश्चात् जाकर योगिगण अनावृत्ति (मोक्ष) और आवृत्ति (संसार में पुनः आगमन) को प्राप्त होते हैं उस कालरूप मार्ग का वर्णन करता हूँ
english_translation: Those driven by desire and craving for heavenly pleasures get caught in birth and karmic results, endlessly speaking of rituals and enjoyment as means to wealth and power.
essence: Desire-driven actions trap you in endless cycles chasing fleeting pleasures and power.
simple_meaning: When you act driven by desire for pleasure or status, you stay stuck in a cycle of birth and karmic results, focusing on rituals and enjoyment as the goal.
insight: Recognize how desire-driven actions keep you tied to outcomes and prevent freedom from endless craving.
modern_relevance: You keep busy with habits and routines hoping to gain status or comfort, yet feel stuck in repeating cycles without true satisfaction.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अग्निज्योतिरहः शुक्लः षण्मासा उत्तरायणम् ।
तत्र प्रयाता गच्छन्ति ब्रह्म ब्रह्मविदो जनाः ॥
translation: अग्निज्योति अर्थात् अर्चि (तेज) की सकल अधिष्ठातृ देवताएँ, अहः अर्थात् दिवसाधिष्ठातृ देवता, शुक्लः अर्थात् शुक्ल पक्षाधिष्ठातृ देवता, उत्तरायण रूप छ:मास अर्थात् उत्तरायणाविष्ठातृ देवता, इन देवता गण का जो मार्ग है उसमें मृत्यु के बाद जाने वाले ब्रह्मवेत्तागण ब्रह्म को प्राप्त होते हैं
english_translation: For those distracted by pleasant words and attached to enjoyment and power, a focused intellect cannot settle into absorbed presence.
essence: Attachment to enjoyment and power prevents focused intellect from reaching deep stillness.
simple_meaning: When your mind is distracted by pleasures and power, it can't focus deeply or find quiet inner stillness.
insight: This verse teaches you to recognize how attachment to fleeting rewards fragments your focus and blocks deep concentration.
modern_relevance: Your phone buzzes with endless notifications. Enjoying them feels good, but your focus breaks and inner quiet fades.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
धूमो रात्रिस्तथा कृष्णः षण्मासा दक्षिणायनम् ।
तत्र चान्द्रमस ज्योतिर्योगी प्राप्य निवर्त्तते ॥
translation: कर्मयोगी (मरण के पश्चात् ) धूम, रात्रि, कृष्णपक्ष और दक्षिणायन छःमास इन सबके अधिष्ठातृ देवताओ के पास उत्तरोत्तर जाकर क्रम से चन्द्रलोक को प्राप्त करके भोगावसान में पुनः वहां से संसार में आता है
english_translation: O divine ones, I will describe the path of time where yogis, after death, attain liberation or return to the cycle of rebirth.
essence: After death, yogis follow a time-path leading either to freedom or return to rebirth.
simple_meaning: There is a path related to time where yogis, after death, either achieve freedom from rebirth or return again into the cycle.
insight: It invites seeing death as a transition governed by deeper cosmic laws, not an end or random event.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
शुक्लकृष्णे गती होते जगतः शाश्वते मते ।
एकया यात्यनादृत्तिमन्ययाऽऽवर्त्तते पुनः ॥
translation: प्रकाशमय अचिरादि शुक्ला गति एवं तमोमय धूमादि कृष्णा गति, जगत् के ये दो मार्ग अनादि. रूप से प्रसिद्ध हैं, इन दोनों से एक के द्वारा मोक्ष प्राप्त होता है और दूसरे के द्वारा पुनः संसार में प्रत्यावृत्ति होती है
english_translation: After death, those who know Brahman follow the path of the six months of the northern course—fire, light, day, bright fortnight, and the six-month ascending sun.
essence: Enlightened beings follow a sacred cosmic path after death to reach supreme understanding.
simple_meaning: Those who understand the supreme reality after death follow a sacred path aligned with natural cycles and reach union with that reality.
insight: It highlights a symbolic path of transformation aligned with natural rhythms leading to higher understanding beyond physical life.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
कर्मेव कारणं शुक्लकृष्णगत्योर्न संशयः ।
स्वर्लोक निरयम्वाऽपि पितृलोकमथापि वा ॥
translation: कर्म ही शुक्ल और कृष्ण दोनों गति का निःसन्देह कारण है। हे देवगण ! जीवों को स्वर्गलोक प्राप्ति, नरकलोक प्राप्ति, पितृलोक प्राप्ति अथवा
english_translation: After death, the karma yogi passes through smoke, night, the dark lunar fortnight, and the six months of the southern solstice, reaching the moon's realm and then returning to the cycle of existence.
essence: The committed actor moves through dark phases before returning to act again.
simple_meaning: After death, the person who acts with commitment passes through stages of darkness and time before returning to the world of life.
insight: Recognize that difficult endings are part of a cycle leading to fresh starts and renewed effort.
modern_relevance: You’ve faced dark, confusing phases in life that felt like endings but led to new beginnings and growth.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
आसाद्य प्रेतलोकम्बा जीवा यान्ति पुनः पुनः ।
मर्त्यलोके जनि देवाः ! कृष्णगत्या न संशयः ॥
translation: प्रेतलोक प्राप्ति करा कर  वारंवार मृत्युलोक में जन्मप्राप्ति कराना कृष्णगति का कार्य है इसमें सन्देह नहीं
english_translation: The world moves in two eternal ways: the bright path leads to freedom, the dark path returns to the cycle again.
essence: The world follows two eternal paths: one leads to liberation, the other to repeated return.
simple_meaning: The world follows two eternal paths: one bright leading to freedom without return, another dark leading back to repeated cycles.
insight: It shifts your understanding from seeing life as random to seeing two fundamental directions: ongoing return or final freedom.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सत्यलोकन्तु सम्प्राप्य शुक्लगत्या समुन्नतम् ।
तत्र कर्मबलेनैव कैवल्यं लभ्यते ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: शुक्लगति के द्वारा समुन्नत सत्य लोक में पहुंचकर कर्म के बल से ही वहां निश्चय मुक्ति प्राप्त की जाती है
english_translation: There is no doubt that karma is the cause of both the white and black paths, leading beings to heaven, the mortal world, or the realm of ancestors.
essence: Every path you take results directly from the actions you perform.
simple_meaning: The results of your actions determine the path your life follows, whether toward higher or lower realms.
insight: Recognize that your current state is shaped by past actions, empowering you to act wisely now.
modern_relevance: After a day of choices, you realize how every decision nudges your life’s direction, shaping your experience beyond your control.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
कृष्णगत्यां प्रधानाऽस्ति प्रवृत्तिवि बुधर्षभाः!।
शुक्लगत्यां निहत्तेस्तु प्राधान्यं परिकीर्तितम् ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! कृष्ण गति में प्रवृत्ति प्रधान है और शुक्लगति में निवृत्ति प्रधान कही गई है
english_translation: Beings repeatedly go to the realm of spirits and return to mortal life; birth in the mortal world is surely the path of Krishna.
essence: Existence cycles between spirit realms and mortal life without interruption.
simple_meaning: Beings repeatedly die and are born again, moving between the spirit realm and mortal world, following the cycle known as Krishna's path.
insight: Recognize life as a cycle of recurring births and deaths beyond what we immediately perceive.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
आभ्यां भिन्ना गतिश्चान्या गतिभ्यां समुदाहृता ।
सहजाख्या च वो देवाः ! याऽधिकाराद्वहिर्गता॥
translation: इन दोनों गतियों के अतिरिक्त एक तीसरी गति और कही गई है जिसको सहज गति कहते हैं जो सहजगति हे देवतागण ! आपलोगों के अधिकार से बाहर है
english_translation: By reaching the exalted realm of truth through the pure path, unwavering liberation is attained solely by the power of action.
essence: True freedom comes only through steadfast, pure action in the highest realm of truth.
simple_meaning: You can reach a high realm of truth by following a pure path, and only through your actions can you gain lasting freedom.
insight: It shifts focus from waiting for external help to trusting that your sincere actions create true freedom.
modern_relevance: After you commit fully to a challenging goal with integrity, you realize that only your genuine efforts lead to lasting success, not shortcuts or waiting.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
मद्भक्ता धर्मतत्त्वज्ञा आत्मज्ञानरताश्च ये।
त एवैतां महात्मानो  लभ्यन्ते सहजां गतिम् ॥
translation: जो धर्मतत्त्व के जानने वाले, आत्मज्ञान में तत्पर, मेरे भक्त महापुरुष गण हैं, वे ही इस तीसरी गति को प्राप्त होते हैं
english_translation: O divine beings! In the dark path, action dominates, and in the bright path, renunciation prevails.
essence: Movement through life balances between acting and renouncing depending on the path you choose.
simple_meaning: There are two ways of moving through life: the dark way focuses on action, the bright way focuses on renunciation or stopping.
insight: It shifts your view to recognize both action and renunciation as valid paths depending on your inner state.
modern_relevance: You juggle times when pushing hard feels right and times when stepping back and releasing feels wiser.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तत्वज्ञास्य लाभे ये वासनया: क्षये तथा ।
कर्मयोगे रता यन्ति जीन्मुक्तास्तु तां गतिम् ॥
translation: जो वासना का नाश, तत्त्वज्ञान लाभ और कर्मयोग में रत हैं, वे जीवन्मुक्तगण इस गति को प्राप्त करते हैं
english_translation: Besides these two paths, there is a third called the natural path, which lies beyond your control, O deities.
essence: A third natural course exists beyond any control or authority you hold.
simple_meaning: Besides two known paths, there is a third called the natural path that exists beyond your control or authority.
insight: It invites you to recognize and accept what unfolds naturally beyond your influence without resistance.
modern_relevance: You plan and prepare, but sometimes life unfolds in ways you cannot steer or control.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अतीवास्ति सुदुज्ञेया गतिर्देवा: ! हि कर्मण: ।
तत्रोदाहरण ह्योकं विषदं शृणुतामरा:! ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! कर्म की गति अत्यन्त ही दुर्ज्ञेय है। हे देवगण ! इसमें एक स्पष्ट उदाहरण सुनो
english_translation: Those who know the essence of dharma, are eager in self-knowledge, and are my devoted noble ones alone attain this natural state.
essence: Devoted love and self-knowledge together bring a natural, effortless state.
simple_meaning: Only those who sincerely love the divine, understand true dharma, and seek self-knowledge reach an effortless, natural state.
insight: It shifts your focus from chasing external results to cultivating inner devotion and wisdom together.
modern_relevance: When your passion for what’s right meets a sincere desire to understand yourself, your life feels more naturally aligned and peaceful.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ग्रंथीना बन्धनं कर्म ग्रंथिमोचनमित्यपि ।
तुल्यं कर्मद्वयं देवा उदर्के त्वन्तरं महत् ॥
translation: गांठ का बांधना भी कर्म है और गांठ का खोलना भी कर्म,  हे देवगण ! दोनों कर्म तुल्य हैं किन्तु अन्तिम परिणाम में बड़ा भेद है
english_translation: Those who destroy desires, attain knowledge of reality, and delight in the yoga of action reach the state of liberation while alive.
essence: Freedom arises when desire ends and action is embraced with clarity and joy.
simple_meaning: You reach true freedom alive by ending desires, gaining clear understanding, and fully engaging in selfless action.
insight: It shifts your focus from chasing outcomes to embracing pure action, opening the possibility of freedom now.
modern_relevance: After endless scrolling, you realize that letting go of wants and focusing on meaningful work brings a calm freedom alive.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
मोचनान्मुच्यते वस्तु बन्धनाचनियम्यते ।
तथा सकामनिष्कामौ देवा जानीत कर्मणी ॥
translation: गांठ के बांधने रूपी कर्म द्वारा जैसे पदार्थ बांधा जाता है वैसे गांठ के खोलने रूपी कर्मा द्वारा पदार्थ खुल जाता है । इसी उदाहरण के अनुसार हे देवगण ! सकाम और निष्काम कर्म जो जानो
english_translation: O radiant beings! The course of action is extremely difficult to understand. O radiant beings! Listen to a clear example of it.
essence: The course of action is extremely complex and hard to understand.
simple_meaning: The path of action is very hard to fully grasp. Here is a clear example to help understand it.
insight: It shows that action and its consequences are not always straightforward, inviting patience and careful study.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
हैमी लौहमयी वापि शङ्खला किम्विधापि चेत् ।
पाणिनां बन्धनायैव कल्पते नात्र संशयः ॥
translation: लौह निर्मित अथवा स्वर्ण निर्मित किसी प्रकार की भी शृंखला हो वह जीवों को बांधती ही है इसमें सन्देह नहीं
english_translation: Tying a knot is action, and untying a knot is also action; both actions are equal, O deities, but the final result differs greatly.
essence: Two equal actions can produce very different results depending on their nature.
simple_meaning: Both tying and untying a knot are actions, but while the actions seem equal, their outcomes are very different.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that the apparent similarity of actions hides very different consequences and to act with awareness of outcome.
modern_relevance: You might work hard either to create or to undo a situation; although both require effort, the lasting effects can be very different.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तथा सकामकर्माऽपि शुभं वाप्यशुभं भवेत् ।
बनाति मुदृढ़ जीवानिति जानीत निर्जराः ॥
translation: उसी प्रकार सकाम कर्म चाहे शुभ या अशुभ हो वह जीवों को अच्छी तरह बाँधता ही है, हे देवगण ! सो जानो
english_translation: Just as an object tied by binding knots is freed by untying those knots, similarly, O radiant beings, understand that both desire-driven and desireless actions are performed.
essence: Both desireful and desireless actions can free you from bondage.
simple_meaning: Just like untying knots frees what was tied, you can free yourself by performing both desire-driven and selfless actions.
insight: It teaches you to see all action as a tool for liberation, not just selfless acts.
modern_relevance: You feel stuck in habits or problems, but taking action—whether motivated by want or by selflessness—can help you break free.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
वासनाया: क्षये जाते तत्त्वज्ञानेन सर्वथा ।
कर्तव्यबुद्धया यत्कर्म निष्कामं क्रियतेऽमराः ॥
translation: तत्त्वज्ञान के द्वारा वासना के सर्वथा नाश होने पर कर्तव्य बुद्धि के अनुसार जो कर्म निष्काम भाव से किया जाता है हे देवगण !
english_translation: Whether made of iron or gold, any chain binds living beings without doubt.
essence: All attachments, regardless of their appearance, bind living beings without exception.
simple_meaning: Chains made of any material, like iron or gold, bind living beings without exception.
insight: It teaches you to see that the form of what binds you doesn’t matter; the binding itself is what limits.
modern_relevance: You might cling to comforts or achievements, but no matter their nature, they can still limit your freedom.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
कैवल्यकारणं भूत्वा जीवेभ्यस्ताद्धि निश्चितम्।
यस्या न पुनराशत्तिस्तां दत्ते सहजां गतिम् ॥
translation: वही निश्चय मुक्ति का कारण होकर जिससे पुनरावृत्ति नहीं होती उस सहजगति को जीवों को देता है
english_translation: Similarly, even desire-driven actions, whether good or bad, firmly bind living beings, O radiant ones, know this well.
essence: Desire-driven actions bind living beings firmly, regardless of being good or bad.
simple_meaning: Actions done with desire, whether positive or negative, strongly bind living beings to consequences.
insight: It shifts your view to see desire itself as the binding force, not just the action’s outcome.
modern_relevance: You chase a promotion or avoid conflict, but your craving keeps you tied, whether the result feels good or bad.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
जीवन्मुक्तोऽथ सम्प्राप्तः सहजां गतिमुत्तमाम् ।
मरुस्थलेऽथवा जह्याच्छरीरं जाह्नवीतटे ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! उत्तम  सहजगति को प्राप्त जीवन्मुक्त चाहे मरुस्थल मे शरीरत्याग करे चाहे गंगातीर में शरीरत्याग करे,
english_translation: When desires are completely destroyed by true knowledge, actions performed with the intellect of duty become selfless.
essence: True knowledge ends desire, enabling selfless action driven solely by duty.
simple_meaning: When your desires vanish through clear understanding, you naturally act without wanting any results, guided only by your sense of duty.
insight: It teaches you to shift from acting for outcomes to acting because the action itself is right and necessary.
modern_relevance: You finish a tough task without hoping for praise or reward, simply because it needs to be done—and that calms your restless mind.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अथवा कृतकृत्योऽसौ  मुक्तात्मा स्वात्मवित्सुरा ।
अन्तिमश्वासपर्यन्तं वसेचाण्डालवेश्मनि ॥
translation: चाहे वह कृतकृत्य आत्मज्ञानी मुक्तात्मा चांडाल के गृह में अपने अन्तिम श्वास तक वास करे,
english_translation: The supreme cause of freedom, which prevents rebirth, grants living beings their natural way.
essence: True freedom arises from a cause that ends repeated returning and grants natural flow.
simple_meaning: There is a true cause of inner freedom that stops the cycle of returning and grants beings their natural course.
insight: It teaches to recognize and align with the natural cause that ends repetitive cycles, not just temporary fixes.
modern_relevance: When you feel stuck repeating the same patterns, this reminds you there is a cause that can naturally free you.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
प्राणायाम प्रकुर्वत वां देहं देवालये त्यजेत ।
सर्वत्र सर्वदा तस्य मुक्तावस्थाऽवतिष्ठते ॥
translation: चाहे देवमन्दिर में प्राणायाम करता हुआ देहत्याग करे, उसकी मुक्तदशा सब स्थानों में हर समय बनी रहती है
english_translation: O divine beings! A liberated being who has attained the highest natural state may leave the body either in a desert or on the banks of the Ganges.
essence: True liberation means the place of leaving the body no longer matters.
simple_meaning: A liberated person who has reached the highest natural state can leave the body anywhere without concern for place.
insight: It shifts your view from attachment to place or circumstances at death to freedom of the inner being.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
जलबिन्दुर्यथाऽऽकाशपतितो यति वारिधिम ।
तथैव स हि मुक्तात्मा लभते मामसंशयम् ॥
translation: वह मुक्तारमा आकाश पतित वारिबिन्दु के समुद्र में पतित होने के समान मुझको निस्सन्देह प्राप्त होता है
english_translation: Even if a liberated true self, knowledgeable of itself, lives until its last breath in the home of an outcast,
essence: Inner freedom remains intact regardless of external environment or social status.
simple_meaning: A truly liberated person remains free inside, no matter where they live or what their surroundings are.
insight: It teaches you to separate your inner state from external circumstances, preserving freedom despite harsh surroundings.
modern_relevance: You might feel stuck in a difficult place or situation, yet your inner being can remain free and unshaken no matter what.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
युष्माभिरपि भो देवाः ! कर्मयोगरतात्म्भि:।
कर्तव्यबुद्धया सततं कार्य कर्म विधीयताम् ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! आपको कर्मयोग में रत होकर कर्तव्य बुद्धि से सर्वदा कर्त्तव्य कर्म को करना चाहिए
english_translation: If someone leaves their body practicing breath control in a divine temple, their state of freedom remains everywhere and always.
essence: Freedom gained through focused practice transcends time and place.
simple_meaning: When someone dies while practicing breath control in a sacred place, their state of freedom continues everywhere at all times.
insight: Recognize that disciplined spiritual effort creates lasting inner freedom beyond physical limits.
modern_relevance: You might feel peaceful after a deep meditation session in a quiet room, and that calm stays with you beyond the moment and place.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
देवाः : कुरुत कम्माणि योगस्थाः सङ्गवर्जिताः।
सिद्धयसिद्धयोः समा भूत्वा समत्वं योग उच्यते ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! इन्द्रियसङ्ग का त्याग करके, सिद्धि और असिद्धि में समभावापन्न होकर और योग में अवस्थित होकर कर्म करना ,समत्व ही, योग कहा जाता है
english_translation: The liberated soul surely attains me just as a water drop falling from the sky merges into the ocean.
essence: Freedom is merging completely with the true self like a drop joining the ocean.
simple_meaning: A person freed from all bondage naturally unites with the true self, just as a water drop falls into and becomes one with the ocean.
insight: It teaches you that freedom means dissolving the illusion of separateness and embracing your essential unity.
modern_relevance: When you let go of your fears and identities, you naturally reconnect with your deepest sense of belonging and peace, like a drop falling back into the vast ocean.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
बुद्धियुक्तो जहातीह उभे सुकृतदुष्कृते।
तस्मादयोगाय युज्यध्वं योगः कर्म सुकौशलम् ॥
translation: बुद्धि द्वारा ब्रह्म में युक्त व्यक्ति इस लोक में सुकृत दुष्कृत (पुण्य पाप ) दोनों को ही त्याग करता है इस कारण आपलोग कर्मयोग में नियुक्त हुए, सुकौशल पूर्ण कर्म ही योगपद वाच्य हैं
english_translation: O radiant beings! You should always perform your duty with steady wisdom, engaged in the yoga of action.
essence: Steady wisdom and commitment guide you to perform your duties well.
simple_meaning: You should always perform your duties with steady wisdom while being fully engaged in your actions.
insight: Focus your mind steadily on your duty, letting wisdom guide your actions without distraction.
modern_relevance: You face a demanding project that requires consistent effort and clear thinking; staying steady and focused helps you meet your responsibilities well.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
कर्मजै बुद्धियुक्ता हि फलं त्यक्त्वा मनीषिणः ।
जन्मबन्धविनिर्मुक्ताः पदं गच्छन्त्यनामयम् ॥
translation: बुद्धियुक्त पंडित गण निश्चय ही कर्मजनित फल को त्याग करके जन्मरूप बन्धन से मुक्त होकर सर्वोपद्र वशुन्य मोक्षपद को प्राप्त होते हैं
english_translation: O radiant beings, perform actions established in yoga, free from attachment; being equal in success and failure, that equality is called yoga.
essence: Act fully without attachment, remaining steady through success and failure.
simple_meaning: You should act without clinging to your senses or the outcomes, staying calm whether you succeed or fail. This balanced state is called yoga.
insight: Shift focus from craving outcomes to steady action without attachment, equalizing success and failure.
modern_relevance: You sent an important email but didn’t obsess over the reply. You did your best and stayed calm no matter what happened next.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
आपूर्यमाणमचलप्रतिष्ठं समुद्रमापः प्रविशन्ति यदवत् ।
तद्वत कामा यं प्रविशन्ति सर्वे स शान्तिमाप्नोति न कामकामी ॥
translation: जिस प्रकार ( नाना नदियों के द्वारा) आपूर्यमाण और अचञ्चल समुद्र में (अन्य ) जलप्रवेश करते हैं अर्थात् उसमें मिल जाते हैं। उसी प्रकार जिसमें सकल कामनाएं प्रवेश करती हैं अर्थात् लीन होती हैं वह शान्ति को प्राप्त होता है किन्तु भोगकामनाशील व्यक्ति शान्ति को नहीं प्राप्त होता है
english_translation: A person united with the discerning mind abandons both good and bad deeds here; therefore, engage in yoga, for yoga is skillful action.
essence: Wise action frees you from attachment to both praise and blame.
simple_meaning: When you act with a discerning mind, you give up attachment to good or bad outcomes. Yoga means skillful action without craving results.
insight: It shifts your focus from outcomes to the quality of your effort, making your action pure and present.
modern_relevance: You finish a project knowing your effort was good, yet you don’t obsess over praise or criticism that follows.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
विहाय कामान् यः सर्वान् प्राणी चरति निःस्पृहः।
निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः स शान्तिमधिगच्छति ॥
translation: जो प्राणी सकल काम्य वस्तुओं की उपेक्षा करके नि:स्पृह निरहङ्कार और विषयों में ममताशून्य होकर यत्र तत्र भ्रमण करता है वह शान्ति को प्राप्त होता है
english_translation: Wise people united with discernment renounce the fruits of actions and become free from the bondage of birth, attaining the spotless state of liberation.
essence: Acting with discernment and releasing attachment to results leads to true freedom.
simple_meaning: You can act with clear understanding and give up expecting results, freeing yourself from the cycle of rebirth and reaching liberation.
insight: Shift focus from expecting outcomes to performing actions with wisdom and detachment.
modern_relevance: You finish a project and accept whatever happens next, freeing yourself from stress over results beyond your control.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
लोकेऽस्मिन् द्विविधा निष्ठा पुरा प्रोक्ता मयाऽनघाः !।
ज्ञानयोगेन सांख्ययानां कर्मयोगेन योगिनाम ॥
translation: हे निष्पापो ! इस लोक में दो प्रकार की निष्ठा मैंने पहले कही है, यथाः- ज्ञानयोग द्वारा सांख्यों की और कर्म योग द्वारा योगियों की
english_translation: Just as countless rivers enter the ever-full and steady ocean, all desires that merge within bring peace; but those who cling to desires do not find peace.
essence: True peace arises when all desires merge and settle within like rivers in the ocean.
simple_meaning: When all your desires come together and settle calmly within you, you find peace. But if you cling to desires, peace stays distant.
insight: It teaches you to allow desires to merge and quiet rather than resist or chase them, opening the way to inner peace.
modern_relevance: You’ve felt scattered, pulled by endless wants—peace arrives only when you let these desires settle, like rivers joining the ocean.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
न कर्मणामनारम्भानप्कम्य साधकोऽश्नुते ।
न च सन्न्यसनादेव सिद्धिं समधिगच्छति ॥
translation: कोई साधक कर्म का अनुष्ठान न करके नैष्कर्म्य अवस्था को प्राप्त नहीं कर सकता है एवं आसक्ति त्याग के बिना  केवल सन्न्यास कर्म त्याग से ही सिद्धि को प्राप्त नहीं होता है
english_translation: One who gives up all desires, moves without craving, without attachment or ego, attains peace.
essence: Peace arises when you move without craving, attachment, or ego.
simple_meaning: You find peace when you let go of all desires, attachments, and ego, moving through life without craving.
insight: This teaches you to act without chasing outcomes or owning your identity and thus discover inner peace.
modern_relevance: You scroll endlessly, chasing wants and comparisons, feeling restless. Letting go of craving opens space for calm, no matter where you are.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
न हि कश्चित् क्षणमपि जातु तिष्ठत्यकर्मकृत।
कार्यते ह्यवश: कर्मा सर्वै: प्रकृतिजैर्गुणै: ॥
translation: किसी भी अवस्था में क्षणमात्र भी कोई कर्म न करके नहीं ही रह सक्ता है, प्रकृतिजनित ( सत्त्वादि) सब गुण ही अवश करके कर्म कराते हैं।
english_translation: O sinless one, in this world I have previously taught two kinds of devotion: the path of wisdom for the contemplatives and the path of action for the yogis.
essence: Steadiness in life arises through either knowledge or selfless action.
simple_meaning: There are two main ways to steady your devotion: through knowledge or through selfless action.
insight: Recognize that steady devotion can arise either through clear understanding or through engaged action.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by choices, remember you can deepen your connection by learning deeply or by acting selflessly—both are valid.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
कर्मेन्द्रियाणि संयम्य य आस्ते मनसा स्मरन
इन्द्रियार्थान् विमुढात्मा मिथ्याचारः स उच्यते ॥
translation: जो व्यक्ति कर्मेन्द्रियों को संयत करके मन में इन्द्रियों के सकल विषयों को स्मरण करता रहता है उस विमूढात्मा को कपटाचारी कहते हैं।
english_translation: No practitioner attains the state of non-action by not starting actions, nor does one achieve perfection merely by renouncing attachment through renunciation.
essence: True freedom isn’t gained by avoiding action or mere renunciation alone.
simple_meaning: You cannot achieve a state of true non-action simply by avoiding all actions, nor by only renouncing attachments without effort.
insight: It teaches you that true freedom requires disciplined engagement beyond mere avoidance or renunciation.
modern_relevance: You might stop reacting to situations or quit old habits, but real growth demands more than just stopping—it needs active inner work.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यस्त्विान्द्रयाणि मनसा नियम्यारभतेऽमराः ।
कम्मेन्द्रियैः कर्मयोगममक्तः स विशिष्यते ॥
translation: किन्तु हे देवतागण! जो मन द्वारा इन्द्रियों को संयत करके कर्मेन्द्रियों से कर्मयोग का अनुष्ठान करता है फल कामनाहीन वह व्यक्ति विशिष्ट है अर्थात् प्रशंसायोग्य है
english_translation: No one can remain without action even for a moment; all actions are inevitably caused by the qualities born of nature.
essence: Action is unavoidable because natural qualities constantly drive all doing.
simple_meaning: You cannot avoid acting even for a moment; your natural qualities compel you to act.
insight: It shifts your perspective from resisting action to understanding it as a natural, continuous flow.
modern_relevance: When you feel stuck or guilty for not doing enough, remember your nature is always prompting you to move and act.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
नियतं क्रियतां कर्म कर्म ज्यायो ह्यकर्मणः ।
शरीरयात्राऽपि च वो न प्रसिद्धयेदकर्मणाम् ॥
translation: आप लोग अवश्य कर्तव्य कर्म करो क्योंकि कर्म न करने से कर्म करना श्रेष्ट है। कर्मों का, त्याग करने से आप लोगों का शरीर यात्रा निर्वाह भी नहीं होगा
english_translation: One who controls the organs of action and constantly remembers the objects of the senses with the mind, but is deluded, is called a hypocrite.
essence: Discipline of action without control of the mind is self-deception.
simple_meaning: Controlling your actions alone isn't enough; if your mind keeps craving sense objects, you remain confused and self-deceiving.
insight: It shifts your focus from external control to inner clarity and mindful presence.
modern_relevance: You may follow rules and routines perfectly but still feel unsettled if your mind chases distractions and cravings.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यज्ञार्थात् कर्मणोऽन्यत्र लोकोऽयं कम्मबन्धनः ।
तदर्थ कर्म देवौघाः : मुक्तसंङ्गा विधत्त भोः ॥
translation: हे देवता गण ! यज्ञार्थ कर्मों के अतिरिक्त कर्म करने पर इस लोक में कर्म बन्धन होता है अतएव यज्ञके लक्ष्य से निष्काम होकर कर्मों को करो
english_translation: But those immortals who control their senses with the mind and perform the yoga of action without craving the results are truly distinguished.
essence: Acting with controlled senses and no craving for results sets you apart.
simple_meaning: You become special when you control your senses with your mind and act without wanting the outcome.
insight: It teaches you to focus your mind on controlling impulses and to perform your duties without attachment to outcomes.
modern_relevance: You stay focused in a noisy, distracting world, doing your work without obsessing over praise or reward.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यस्त्वात्मरतिरेव स्यादात्मतृप्तश्च साधकः ।
आत्मन्येव च सन्तुष्टस्तस्य कार्य न विद्यते ॥
translation: किन्तु जो साधक आत्मा में ही रत है, आत्मा में ही तृप्त है एवं आत्मा में ही सन्तुष्ट रहता है उसके लिये कुछ भी कर्त्तव्य नहीं है
english_translation: You must perform your prescribed duties, for action is better than inaction; without action, even bodily survival is not possible.
essence: Doing your duty is necessary; inaction endangers your very existence.
simple_meaning: You should always do your prescribed duties because taking no action is worse; without action, even your body cannot be maintained.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that fulfilling your responsibilities is essential for sustaining your life and growth.
modern_relevance: You face a day when avoiding tasks seems easier, but skipping them risks your wellbeing and progress.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
नैव तस्य कृतेनार्थो नाऽकृतेनेह कश्चन ।
नचास्य सर्वभूतेषु कश्चिदर्थव्यपाश्रयः ॥
translation: इस लोक में किये हुए कर्मद्वारा उसको पुण्य भी नहीं होता है और न करने से कोई पाय भी नहीं होता है एवं सकल भूतों में स्थित ऐहिक या पारत्रिक कोई भी विषय उसके लिये आश्रयनीय नहीं है
english_translation: O divine beings! Actions done for any purpose other than the sacred offering bind one to the cycle of karma; therefore, act selflessly with the goal of the offering.
