essence: Actions aimed at personal gain bind you; selfless action frees you.
simple_meaning: Only actions done selfishly bind you to consequences; acting without craving for results frees you.
insight: Shift your focus from personal results to the value of your actions themselves, dissolving attachment.
modern_relevance: You put time and energy into tasks beyond your main goals; knowing to focus on purpose helps avoid burnout and regret.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तस्मादसक्तैः सततं काय्य कर्म विधीयताम् ।
असक्ताः कर्म कुर्वन्तो लभन्ते पूरुषं परम्  ॥
translation: अत: आपलोग फलासक्ति शून्य होकर सर्वदा आवश्यक कर्तव्य कर्मों के अनुसार अनुष्ठान करो क्योंकि अनासक्त होकर कर्म करने से साधक मोक्ष को प्राप्त होते हैं।
english_translation: But the practitioner who delights in the true self, is fulfilled in the true self, and content in the true self has no further duties to perform.
essence: Complete inner contentment removes the need for any further action or duty.
simple_meaning: When you find full delight, fulfillment, and contentment in your true self, you have no further obligations to fulfill.
insight: It shifts your focus from external achievement to inner fulfillment as the true measure of completion.
modern_relevance: After finishing a long journey of self-discovery, you feel calm inside and realize there’s nothing more you must prove or do.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
कर्मणैव हि संसिद्धि मास्थिता साधका: सुरा: ! ।
लोकसंग्रहमेवापि पश्यन्तः कर्तुमर्हथ ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! साधकगण कर्म के द्वारा ही संसिद्धि अर्थात ज्ञान प्राप्त करते हैं। सब लोगों को अपने अपने धर्म में प्रवर्तित करने के विषय का लक्ष्य रखकर भी कर्म करना उचित है।
english_translation: In this world, no merit comes from doing or not doing, and no worldly or other support exists for it among all beings.
essence: Neither doing nor not doing guarantees merit or support in this world.
simple_meaning: Neither doing something nor avoiding it brings true reward or lasting support in this world or among beings.
insight: It shifts your focus from expecting rewards to acting without craving outcomes, freeing your motivation.
modern_relevance: You might feel pressured to constantly do or avoid things to earn approval, but realizing no action alone guarantees reward can ease that burden.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यद्यदाचरति श्रेष्ठस्तत्तदेवेतरः खलु।
म यत्प्रमाणं कुरुते लोकस्तदनुवर्त्तते ॥
translation: क्योंकि श्रेष्ठ व्यक्ति जो कर्मा करते हैं अन्यान्य लोग भी  वही कर्म करते हैं, वह जिसको कर्तव्य समझते हैं उसी का अनुवर्तन अन्य लोग करते हैं
english_translation: Therefore, always perform your necessary duties with no attachment, for those who act without attachment attain the supreme being.
essence: You can act fully without attachment and still reach the highest goal.
simple_meaning: You should always perform your necessary duties without attachment to the results. Acting without craving leads to the highest attainment.
insight: Shift your focus from outcomes to the actions you can control, freeing your effort from expectation.
modern_relevance: You completed a task and wonder if it will be recognized. Freedom comes by doing your best without needing approval.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
देवाः! मेऽस्ति न कर्त्तव्यं त्रिषु लोकेषु किञ्चन !
नानवाप्तमवाप्तव्यं वर्त्त एव च कर्मणि ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! मेरा कर्तव्य कुछ नहीं है क्योंकि त्रिलोकी में मेरे लिये अप्राप्त वा प्राप्तव्य कुछ नहीं है तथापि मैं कर्म में प्रवृत्त ही रहता हूँ
english_translation: O radiant beings! Practitioners achieve perfection through action alone. Seeing the goal as the welfare of the world, they should act accordingly.
essence: True mastery comes from acting with the welfare of all as your aim.
simple_meaning: True progress comes through committed action focused on the welfare of all, not by inaction or selfishness.
insight: It teaches you to focus your energy on actions that benefit the greater good, making your efforts meaningful and complete.
modern_relevance: You put your heart into a project that helps others, feeling motivated because your work supports more than just your own success.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यदि ह्यहं न वर्लयं जातु कर्मण्यतन्द्रितः।
मम वानुवर्त्तन्ते प्राणिनः सर्वशोऽमराः ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! कभी यदि मैं आलस्यरहित होकर कर्मानुष्ठान न करूँ तो निश्चय ही जीवधारी मेरे मार्ग सभी प्रकार से अनुसरण करेंगे
english_translation: Whatever actions a great person performs, others follow that example; whatever standard they set, the world adheres to it.
essence: Your conduct becomes the standard others naturally follow.
simple_meaning: When someone acts with integrity and excellence, others naturally imitate their behavior and follow their example.
insight: Recognize your role as a model; your choices ripple beyond your immediate actions.
modern_relevance: In your team or family, your way of handling challenges quietly shapes how others respond and behave.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
उत्सीदेयुरिमे लोका न कुटयाँ कर्म चेदहम् ।
सङ्करस्य च कर्त्ता स्यामुपहन्यामिमाः प्रजाः ॥
translation: यदि मैं कर्म न करूँ तो यह सभी लोग धर्म का लोप होने से विनष्ट हो जायँगे और मैं वर्णसंकर का कर्ता हो जाऊँगा, इस प्रकार मैं ही इन प्रजाओ के नाश का कारण बनूँगा
english_translation: O radiant beings! I have no duty because there is nothing left to gain or lose in the three worlds, yet I remain engaged in action.
essence: You can act fully even when nothing is left to gain or lose.
simple_meaning: There is nothing left for the divine to gain or lose in all worlds, so no duty binds him, yet he continues to act.
insight: It teaches you to act from presence and commitment, not from expectation or obligation.
modern_relevance: You might feel stuck waiting for rewards or clear purpose, but this shows you can keep acting even when nothing seems owed or expected.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सक्त्ता: कर्मण्यविद्वांसो यथा कुर्वन्ति निर्जरा: ! ।
कुर्याद्रिद्वांस्तथाऽसक्तश्चिकीर्षुर्लोकसंग्रहम ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! कर्म में आसक्त अज्ञानी लोग जिस प्रकार कर्म करते हैं उसी प्रकार कर्म में अनासक्त ज्ञानी लोग भी लोगो को स्वधर्म में प्रवर्तित करने के लिये इच्छुक होकर कर्म करते हैं।
english_translation: O divine beings! If I were ever to cease acting without laziness, all living beings would surely follow my path in every way.
essence: Consistent, earnest action inspires all beings to follow naturally.
simple_meaning: If you perform your duties without laziness or delay, others will naturally follow your example.
insight: It teaches you that steadfast, energetic action naturally influences others to follow your path.
modern_relevance: You start a project without procrastination, and soon colleagues adopt your focused approach without being told.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
न बुद्धिभेदं जनयेदज्ञानां कर्मसङ्गिनाम् ।
योजयेत् सर्वकम्माणि विद्वान युक्तः समाचरन्  ॥
translation: कर्मासक्त अज्ञ लोगों का बुद्धिभेद नहीं करना चाहिये, प्रत्युतन्तु ब्रह्मज्ञ पण्डित व्यक्ति को स्वयं सब कर्मों का अनुष्ठान करके अज्ञ लोगों को कर्म में नियुक्त करना चाहिये
english_translation: If I do not act, all these people will perish due to the loss of dharma, and I will become the cause of their destruction through mixing of classes.
essence: Avoiding your duty causes harm and makes you responsible for destruction.
simple_meaning: You must act to protect the social order and prevent chaos; inaction will cause harm to others and yourself.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that your choices affect not just you but the broader community.
modern_relevance: You hesitate to step up, fearing failure, but avoiding action can cause bigger problems for those who depend on you.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
प्रकृतेः क्रियमाणानि गुणैः कम्माणि सर्वशः।
अहङ्कारविमूढात्मा कर्ताऽहमिति मन्यते ॥
translation: सब कर्म प्रकृति के गुणों द्वारा सर्वतोभावेन निष्पादित होते हैं किन्तु अहङ्कार से विमूढ चित्त व्यक्ति "मैं कर्ता हूँ, ऐसा समझता है
english_translation: Just as ignorant people act attached to their actions, the wise act without attachment but still perform actions to uphold the world's order.
essence: You can act fully without attachment while still desiring the world's welfare.
simple_meaning: You can act without being attached to your actions, yet still care deeply about supporting others and the world.
insight: It shifts your focus from personal gain to selfless contribution while maintaining full engagement.
modern_relevance: You finish a project without obsessing over praise, yet still hope it makes a difference for your team.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तत्त्ववित्तु सुपर्वाणः ! गुणकर्मविभागयोः।
गुणा गुणेषु वर्तन्त इति मत्वा न मज्जते ॥
translation: परन्तु हे देवतागण ! गुण और कर्मों के विभाग के तत्व को जानने वाला व्यक्ति “इन्द्रियाँ विषयों में प्रवृत्त होती हैं। ऐसा समझकर कर्तापन का अभिमान नहीं करता है
english_translation: A wise person devoted to the divine should not confuse the ignorant attached to action but engage in all deeds themselves and involve the ignorant in action.
essence: Wise people act fully and guide the attached without creating confusion.
simple_meaning: You should not confuse people attached to actions because of ignorance. Instead, a wise person acts fully and guides others by example.
insight: It teaches you to avoid confusing others and instead show the way through your own engaged action.
modern_relevance: You see coworkers overwhelmed and stuck in busywork; instead of arguing, you focus on doing your work well and help them learn by your steady example.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
प्रकृतेर्गुणसम्मूढाः सज्जन्ते गुणकर्मसु।
नानकृत्स्नाविदो मन्दान् कृत्स्नविन विचालयेत् ॥
translation: प्रकृति के सत्त्वादि त्रिगुणों से मोहित होकर जो इन्द्रियों में और इन्द्रियों के कार्यों में आसक्त होते हैं, सर्वज्ञ व्यक्ति को उन मन्दमति अज्ञ लोगों को विचलित नहीं करना चाहिए
english_translation: All actions arise from the qualities of the natural world everywhere, but the confused mind, deluded by the sense of separate self, thinks 'I am the doer.'
essence: All actions arise naturally, but the ego falsely claims sole authorship.
simple_meaning: All actions happen because of nature's qualities, but the confused mind wrongly believes it alone causes them.
insight: Shift from identifying as the sole doer to witnessing actions as arising naturally; this eases pressure and blame.
modern_relevance: When your plans go wrong, you may blame yourself, but many forces beyond your control shape outcomes.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
मयि सर्वाणि कर्माणि सन्न्यस्याध्यात्मचेतसा ।
निराशिषो निर्ममाश्च यतवं विगतज्वराः ॥
translation: मुझमें समस्त कर्म अर्पण करके आत्मा में चित्त को रखते हुए निष्काम और ममता शून्य होकर शोक त्यागपूर्वक कर्म करना चाहिए
english_translation: But, O divine beings! One who knows the essence of qualities and actions understands that qualities act within qualities and does not fall into the pride of doership.
essence: Qualities act within qualities; knowing this dissolves the pride of doership.
simple_meaning: Understanding that qualities operate within other qualities helps you avoid getting caught in the illusion of being the doer.
insight: It teaches you to see actions as expressions of qualities, not as something you personally own or control fully.
modern_relevance: You realize that your personality traits and habits influence your actions deeply, so blaming yourself or others for outcomes feels less urgent.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ये मे मतमिदं नित्यमनुतिष्ठन्ति साधकाः ।
श्रद्धावन्तोऽनसूयन्तो मुच्यन्ते तेऽपि कर्मभिः ॥
translation: जो साधक मेरे इस सिद्धान्त के अनुसार श्रद्धावान् और दोषदृष्टि विहीन होते हुए कर्मों को नित्य करते रहते हैं वे कर्म करनेवाले होने पर भी कर्मों से मुक्त रहते हैं।
english_translation: Those deluded by the three qualities of nature become attached to the senses and their actions; the wise should not disturb these dull-minded ones.
essence: The wise hold steady without disturbing those confused by nature’s qualities.
simple_meaning: People attached to their senses and actions are confused by nature’s qualities. The wise shouldn’t disturb them.
insight: It teaches you to hold compassion and restraint when others remain unaware and attached.
modern_relevance: You notice friends stuck in habits and distractions. Trying to shake them often backfires; patience is wiser.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ये त्वेतदभ्यसूयन्तो नानुतिष्ठन्ति मे मतम् ।
सर्वज्ञानविमूढांस्तान्वित्त नष्टानचेतसः ॥
translation: किन्तु जो केवल दोष. दर्शन करते हुए मेरे इस सिद्धान्त के अनुसार कर्मानुष्ठान नहीं करते हैं उन विवेकहीनों को सर्वज्ञान विमूढ़ और नष्ट जानना चाहिए
english_translation: By dedicating all your actions to me with a spiritual mind, acting without desire or attachment, and free from sorrow, you should perform your duties.
essence: You can fully act while letting go of desire and sorrow.
simple_meaning: You should dedicate all your actions to the divine with a focused mind, acting without desire, attachment, or sorrow.
insight: Shift your focus from outcomes to wholehearted action, freeing yourself from emotional burdens.
modern_relevance: You finish a hard task and release the urge to control what happens next, freeing yourself from stress and disappointment.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सदृशं चेष्टते स्वस्याः प्रकृतेर्शानवानपि ।
प्रकृति यान्ति भूतानि निग्रहः किं करिष्यति ॥
translation: ज्ञानवान् भी अपनी प्रकृति के अनुसार कर्म करता है और प्राणि मात्र ही अपनी प्रकृति का अनुसरण करते हैं अतः इन्द्रियों का निग्रह क्या करेगा?
english_translation: Those practitioners who constantly act with trust in my teaching and without envy are freed from the bondage of actions despite acting.
essence: You can act faithfully without envy and still be free from your actions' bondage.
simple_meaning: You can keep doing your actions regularly with trust and without jealousy, and still be free from being tied down by those actions.
insight: It teaches you to act with trust and without envy, which liberates your mind from attachment to results.
modern_relevance: You keep working hard and honestly without comparing or resenting others, freeing yourself from stress over outcomes.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
इन्द्रियम्येन्द्रियस्यार्थे रागद्वेषौ व्यवस्थितौ ।
तयोर्न वशमागच्छेत्तौ ह्यस्य परिपन्थिनौ ॥
translation: प्रत्येक इन्द्रिय का अपने अपने अनुकूल विषय में अनुराग और प्रतिकूल विषय में द्वेष अवश्य होता है अतएव इन दोनों के वश में नहीं होना चाहिये क्योंकि ये दोनों मुमुक्ष के प्रतिपक्षी हैं
english_translation: But those who only criticize and do not follow my teaching are bewildered and lost in false knowledge.
essence: Criticism without practice leads to confusion and lost understanding.
simple_meaning: People who just criticize this teaching and don't practice it are confused and lost in false knowledge.
insight: It teaches you to move beyond criticism and engage sincerely with what guides growth.
modern_relevance: You might find yourself endlessly doubting advice or wisdom but never applying it, leaving you frustrated and stuck.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
श्रेयान स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात् ।
स्वधर्मे निधनं श्रेयः परधर्मो भयावहः ॥
translation: सुचारुरूप से अनुष्ठित परधर्म की अपेक्षा दोषसहित स्वधर्म श्रेष्ठ है, अपने धर्म में स्थित रहते हुए मरना भी अच्छा है किन्तु परधर्म भयोत्पादक है।
english_translation: A wise person acts according to their nature, and all beings follow their nature; what can controlling the senses accomplish?
essence: Your natural tendencies shape your actions more than trying to control your senses.
simple_meaning: Everyone acts according to their own nature. Even wise people do this, so simply trying to control your senses won't stop natural behaviors.
insight: Shift focus from strict control of impulses to understanding and aligning with your true nature for lasting change.
modern_relevance: You try to force yourself to resist old habits, but deep down your natural tendencies keep pulling you back.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
न मां कम्माणि लिम्पन्ति न मे कर्मफले स्पृहा ।
इति मां योऽभिजानाति कर्मभिर्न स बध्यते ॥
translation: “मुझको सकल कर्म शासक्त नहीं कर सकते एवं कर्मफल में मेरी स्पृहा नहीं है" इस प्रकार जो मुझको जानता है वह कर्म में बद्ध नहीं होता है
english_translation: Every sense has attachment for its own objects and aversion for the opposite; one should not be controlled by either because they oppose the seeker of freedom.
essence: Refusing to be controlled by attraction or aversion frees your movement and choice.
simple_meaning: Your senses naturally attract you to some things and repel you from others, but you shouldn’t let this pull you around because it stops your progress.
insight: It teaches you to notice your attractions and aversions without letting them decide your actions or peace.
modern_relevance: You find yourself wanting certain notifications and avoiding others, but letting these cravings and avoidances dictate your mood keeps you stuck.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
एवं ज्ञात्वा कृतं कर्म पूर्वैरपि मुमुक्षुभिः ।
तस्माद्विधत्त कम्मैव पूर्वैः पूर्वतरं कृतम् ॥
translation: इस प्रकार जानकर पूर्वकालीन मुमुक्षुओं ने भी कर्म किया है अतः आपलोग भी पुरातन काल के मुमुक्षुओं द्वारा पूर्वकाल में किए हुए कर्म को ही करो
english_translation: Performing your own duty, even if imperfect, is better than performing another's duty perfectly; dying in your own duty is preferable, while another's duty causes fear.
essence: Following your own imperfect duty is safer and better than perfectly doing another’s.
simple_meaning: It’s better to follow your own duty, even if not perfectly, than to perform another’s duty flawlessly. Staying true to your own role is safer and more honorable.
insight: It teaches you to prioritize your authentic responsibilities over trying to be perfect in roles not meant for you.
modern_relevance: When you face pressure to do what others expect, remember it’s better to act on your own values even if imperfect.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
किं कर्म किमकर्ममेति कवयोऽप्यत्र मोहिताः।
तद्वः कर्म प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ज्ञात्वा मोक्ष्यथाशुभात् ॥
translation: कर्म क्या है और अकर्म क्या है इस विषय में विवेकी लोग भी मोहित होते हैं अतएव जिसके जानने से आपलोग अशुभ अर्थात् कर्मासक्ति से मुक्त होगे मैं उस कर्म को कहता हूँ
english_translation: "My actions do not bind me, nor do I desire their results. Whoever understands me this way is not bound by actions."
essence: You can act fully without being bound by your actions or their results.
simple_meaning: You do actions, but they do not trap you. You do not crave the results. Knowing this frees you from being bound by actions.
insight: It shifts your view from identifying with the action or result to recognizing your freedom beyond them.
modern_relevance: You finish a demanding task but don’t obsess over the outcome or recognition. You stay steady, unshaken by success or failure.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
कर्मणो ह्यपि बोद्धव्यं बोद्धव्यं च विकर्मणः ।
अकर्मणश्च बोद्धव्यं गहना कर्मणो गतिः ॥
translation: कर्म अर्थात् निष्काम कर्म का रहस्य भी जानने योग्य है, विकर्म अर्थात् सकाम कर्म का रहस्य भी जानने योग्य है और अकर्म अर्थात् कर्म भाव का भी रहस्य जानने योग्य है क्योंकि कर्म की गति अतिगहन है
english_translation: Knowing this, seekers of freedom performed actions; therefore, you should perform actions like those done by earlier seekers.
essence: Following the actions of past seekers guides your own path toward freedom.
simple_meaning: Those who seek freedom have acted before you; following their example helps you act rightly now.
insight: Embracing the example of past seekers shifts your focus from uncertainty to confident action.
modern_relevance: You face a challenge that others have met before. Trust in their experience as a guide for your own efforts.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
कर्मण्यकर्म यः पश्येदकर्माणि च कर्म यः।
स बुद्धिमान साधकेषु स युक्तः कृत्स्नकर्मकृत् ॥
translation: जो निष्काम कर्म में कर्म भाव देखता है और कर्म रहित अवस्था में जो कर्म का होना देखता है वह साधकों में बुद्धिमान है और वह सभी कर्म करते रहने पर भी मुझमें युक्त है
english_translation: What is action and what is inaction, even the wise are confused about this; I will explain the action that, when known, frees you from harmful attachment.
essence: Knowing which action frees you dissolves confusion about what truly counts as acting or not.
simple_meaning: Even wise people get confused about what counts as action and inaction. Knowing the right kind of action frees you from harmful attachments.
insight: It teaches you to distinguish binding actions from freeing ones, guiding your choices wisely.
modern_relevance: When you hesitate, unsure if acting or waiting is right, this helps you see which actions truly help you move beyond harmful patterns.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यस्य सर्वे समारम्भाः कामसङ्कल्पवर्जिताः।
जानानिदग्धकमणिं तमाहुः पण्डितं बुधाः ॥
translation: जिसके सब कर्म कामना और सङ्कल्प से रहित हैं ज्ञानीलोग उस ज्ञान अग्नि के द्वारा दग्ध्कर्मा व्यक्ति को पंडित कहते हैं
english_translation: You must understand the mystery of action, the mystery of wrong action, and the mystery of inaction, because the path of action is profound.
essence: The mysteries of right action, wrong action, and inaction all must be understood—they shape your path deeply.
simple_meaning: You should understand three aspects: action done rightly, wrong action, and inaction, because the way of action is complex and deep.
insight: It teaches you to explore not just your actions, but also your inactions and mistakes, seeing how all shape your journey.
modern_relevance: You’re caught in choices: doing what’s right, what feels wrong, or doing nothing at all. Each choice carries hidden depth and consequences you might not see.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
त्यकत्वा कर्मफलासङ्गं नित्यतृप्तो निराश्रयः ।
कर्मण्यभिप्रवृत्तोऽपि नैव किञ्चित् करोति सः ॥
translation: वह कर्म और कर्मफल पर आसक्तिरहित होकर नित्यानंद मे तृप्त और निरवलंबन होकर कर्म मे प्रवृत रहने पर भी कुछ भी नहीं करता है
english_translation: The one who sees action in inaction and inaction in action is wise among practitioners and remains united with me while performing all actions.
essence: True wisdom is seeing action and inaction as intertwined without losing your inner balance.
simple_meaning: You are wise when you recognize that even in doing nothing there is action, and in doing something there can be stillness. Staying connected to your deeper self lets you act without losing balance.
insight: It teaches you to hold steady awareness amid all activity, seeing rest and action as connected.
modern_relevance: When your mind races between tasks and moments of rest, you can learn to see both as part of your flow, not chaos or failure.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
निराशीर्यतचित्तात्मा त्यक्तसर्व परिग्रहः ।
शारीरं केवलं कर्म कुर्वन्नाप्नोति किल्विषम् ॥
translation: जो शरीर के द्वारा केवल नाममात्र के लिये कर्म करता है वह निष्काम, यतचित्त आत्मा और त्यक्त सर्व परिग्रह होने के कारण पाप को प्राप्त नहीं होता है।
english_translation: One whose every action is free from desire and intention is called wise by those enlightened through the fire of knowledge.
essence: True wisdom is acting without desire or personal intention behind any action.
simple_meaning: You are wise when you do all your actions without wanting anything or planning outcomes.
insight: It teaches you to shift focus from achieving results to performing actions for their own sake, clearing mental clutter.
modern_relevance: You deliver your work fully without obsessing over praise or reward, feeling calm because your focus is on the task itself.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यदृच्छालाभसन्तुष्टो द्वन्द्राततिो विमत्सरः।
ममः सिद्धावसिद्धौ च कृत्वाऽपि न निबध्यते ॥
translation: एवं वह इच्छा लाभ में सन्तुष्ट, द्वन्द्वातीत, शत्रुताशून्य और सिद्धि और असिद्धि में हर्ष विषादशून्य होने के कारण कर्म करने पर भी बद्ध नहीं होता है
english_translation: Abandoning attachment to the results of action, always content and independent, one engaged in action indeed does nothing at all.
essence: You can act fully without craving results and still remain untouched by outcomes.
simple_meaning: You can engage in your work without clinging to its results, staying content and independent inside. Even while acting, you remain as if doing nothing.
insight: It shifts your focus from seeking rewards to simply doing your part, freeing you from stress.
modern_relevance: You give your best at work without obsessing over promotions or praise, feeling steady regardless of what happens next.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
गतसङ्गस्य मुक्तस्य ज्ञानावस्थितचेतसः।
यज्ञायाचरतः कर्म समग्रं पविलीयते ॥
translation: निष्काम, सर्वबन्धनमुक्त, ज्ञान में अवस्थितचित्त और यज्ञ के लक्ष्य से कर्म करने वाले व्यक्ति के समस्त कर्म विलय को प्राप्त हो जाते हैं
english_translation: One who acts through the body merely in name, with a disciplined mind and renouncing all attachments, does not incur wrongdoing.
essence: Acting without desire or attachment frees you from wrongdoing despite bodily action.
simple_meaning: You can perform actions through your body without desire, with a disciplined mind, and by giving up all attachments, thus avoiding wrongdoing.
insight: It teaches you to focus on performing your duties without craving results or holding on to outcomes.
modern_relevance: You finish a task at work without obsessing over praise or reward, feeling clear and free despite others' opinions.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
कायेन मनसा बुद्ध्या केवलैरिन्द्रियैरपि ।
योगिनः कर्म कुर्वन्ति सङ्गं त्यक्त्वात्मशुद्धये ॥
translation: शरीरद्वारा, मनद्वारा, बुद्धिद्वारा और कर्माभिनिवेश शून्य इन्द्रियगण द्वारा योगिगण कर्मफलासक्ति को परित्याग करके आत्मशुद्धि के लिये कर्म किया करते हैं
english_translation: Being content with whatever comes by chance, beyond dualities, free from envy, and unaffected by success or failure, one remains unbound by actions.
essence: Contentment and freedom from envy keep your actions from binding you, regardless of results.
simple_meaning: If you are satisfied with whatever you get without craving, free from envy and unaffected by wins or losses, your actions won't bind you.
insight: It shifts your focus from chasing rewards to accepting whatever happens without envy, freeing your choices.
modern_relevance: You finish a project and feel no jealousy or craving over others' results, freeing your mind from stress and regret.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
युक्त: कर्मफलं त्यक्त्वा शान्तिमाप्नोति नैष्ठिकीम ।
अयुक्तः कामकारेण फले सक्तो निबध्यते ॥
translation: ब्रह्म मे युक्त व्यक्ति कर्मफल का त्याग करके कर्म करने पर भी ब्रह्मनिष्ठा से उत्पन्न शांति को प्राप्त होता है और अयुक्त व्यक्ति कामना में प्रवृत्त होनेके कारण कर्मफल में आसक्त होकर बद्ध होता है
english_translation: For one who is free from craving, with a mind established in wisdom, and who performs actions aimed at sacrifice, all their actions dissolve completely.
essence: Acting selflessly with wisdom dissolves the binding power of all your actions.
simple_meaning: If you act without craving, with a mind rooted in wisdom and focused on selfless purpose, your actions no longer bind you.
insight: It teaches you to shift from craving results to dedicating effort to a greater purpose, freeing your mind from bondage.
modern_relevance: You deliver your work with clarity and no expectation of reward, finding peace even when outcomes are uncertain.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यं सन्न्यासमिति प्राहुर्योग जानीत तं सुराः।
न ह्यसन्न्यस्तसङ्कल्पो योगी भवति कश्चन ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! जिसको सन्यास कहते हैं उसीको योग जानो क्योंकि फलकामना का त्याग किये बिना कोई योगी नहीं हो सक्ता है
english_translation: Yogis perform actions with body, mind, intellect, and senses without attachment, aiming for purification of the self.
essence: You can fully engage in action through all faculties while releasing attachment to results.
simple_meaning: You act using your body, mind, intellect, and senses, but without clinging to the results, to purify your true self.
insight: Shift your focus from outcome ownership to wholehearted engagement in the process, cleansing your inner state.
modern_relevance: You throw yourself into a project, use all your skills and focus, yet you don’t obsess over how others will judge or reward you.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
आरुरुक्षोसुनेर्योग कर्म कारणमुच्यते ।
योगारूढस्य तस्यैव शमः कारणमुच्यते ॥
translation: कर्मयोग मार्ग पर चलने वाले की इच्छा करने वाले योगी के लिए कर्म ही ही कारणरूप (साधनरूप) कहा जाता है, परन्तु कर्मयोग पद पर आरूढ़ व्यक्ति के लिये समाधि ही कारणरूप (साधनरूप ) कही गई है
english_translation: A person united with the supreme being attains unwavering peace by renouncing the fruit of actions, while one not united is bound by attachment to results driven by desire.
essence: You can act fully and want nothing — these are not opposites.
simple_meaning: You can act and still keep steady peace by letting go of craving what your actions bring. Without this, desire traps you in attachment to results.
insight: It teaches you to focus on your actions themselves, shifting attention away from outcomes that cause stress and binding attachment.
modern_relevance: You finished a big project but anxiety about recognition or reward lingers. This shows peace happens when you stop chasing approval.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यदा हि नेन्द्रियार्थेषु न कर्मस्वनुषज्जते ।
सर्वसङ्कल्पसन्न्यासी योगारूढस्तदोच्यते ॥
translation: साधक जब इन्द्रियों के भोग्य विषयों पर और उनके साधनभूत कर्मों पर आसक्ति नहीं रखता है तब वह सर्व संकल्प त्यागी व्यक्ति योगारूढ़ कहा जाता है
english_translation: O deities, know that true yoga is renunciation; no yogi exists without giving up desire for results.
essence: No one can truly be a yogi without giving up desire for results.
simple_meaning: True yoga means giving up all craving for results; without this renunciation, no one can be a yogi.
insight: It shifts your focus from chasing outcomes to practicing self-mastery through renunciation of desires.
modern_relevance: You worked hard on a project but feel anxious hoping for praise. Real peace comes when you stop chasing rewards.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
देवाः ! नैवेह नामुत्र विनाशस्तस्य विद्यते ।
न हि कल्याणकृत् कश्चित् क्वापि दुर्गतिमृच्छति ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! इस लोक में वा परलोक में उसका विनाश नहीं है क्योंकि कोई भी शुभकर्मकारी कहीं भी दुर्गति को प्राप्त नहीं होता है
english_translation: For one who desires to follow the path of Karma Yoga, action is called the cause; but for the person established in Karma Yoga, stillness is called the cause.
essence: Starting with action is natural, but true progress depends on finding stillness within.
simple_meaning: At first, action is the tool for those wanting to practice Karma Yoga, but when they reach mastery, inner stillness becomes the true cause or support.
insight: It teaches you to recognize when effort must shift from external doing to internal calm as your practice matures.
modern_relevance: You push hard at the start of a new project, but as you gain skill, quiet confidence and calm focus become your real strength.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
प्राप्य पुण्यकृतां लोकानुषित्वा शाश्वतीः समाः।
शुचीनां श्रीमतां गेहे योगभ्रष्टोऽभिजायते ॥
translation: योगभ्रष्ट व्यक्ति पुण्यात्माओं के लोकों को प्राप्त होकर और वहां बहुत वर्षों तक सुखभोग करके पवित्रात्मा श्रीमानों के घर में जन्म ग्रहण करता है
english_translation: When a practitioner is no longer attached to sensory objects or the actions that sustain them, they are called a renouncer of all desires and said to have ascended yoga.
essence: You ascend yoga by renouncing all attachment to senses and their actions.
simple_meaning: You become established in yoga when you stop being attached to sensory pleasures and the actions that support them.
insight: It teaches shifting focus from chasing sensory rewards to steady practice free from grasping.
modern_relevance: You scroll past distractions but your mind still clings to desires; this verse invites you to release that grip and find steadiness.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अथवा योगिनामेव कुले भवति धीमताम् ।
एतद्धि दुर्लभतरं लोके जन्म यदीदृशम् ॥
translation: अथवा ज्ञानी योगियों के वंश मे वह जन्म ग्रहण करता है ऐसा जन्म होना जगत में निश्चय ही दुर्लभतर है
english_translation: O divine beings! There is no destruction for him in this world or the higher realm, for no one who performs auspicious actions ever meets with misfortune anywhere.
essence: Rightful action guarantees safety from destruction across all realms.
simple_meaning: If you perform good and rightful actions, you will not face destruction or misfortune anywhere, in this world or beyond.
insight: It shifts your focus from fearing outcomes to trusting that good actions build lasting security.
modern_relevance: You did the right thing today, even if no one noticed. That choice protects your path forward, no matter what happens next.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तत्र तं बुद्धिसंयोग लभते पौर्वदहिकम ।
यतते च ततो भूयः संसिद्धौ विबुधर्षभाः ॥
translation: हे देव गण ! वह उक्त दोनों प्रकार के जन्मों में ही पूर्वजन्म में उत्पन्न ब्रह्म विषयक बुद्धि-संयोग को प्राप्त करता है और मोक्ष के विषय में अधिक प्रयत्न करता है
english_translation: A person who falls from yoga attains the worlds of the virtuous and, after enjoying there for many years, is born in a pure and prosperous family.
essence: Falling from yoga leads to rebirth in purity and prosperity after enjoying virtuous realms.
simple_meaning: If someone loses the path of yoga, they still reach good worlds and are reborn in pure, wealthy families after enjoying long lives.
insight: It shifts the mind to see spiritual setbacks as temporary, encouraging continued effort without despair.
modern_relevance: You might lose your way in a personal goal but still find opportunities to grow and return stronger.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
पूर्वाभ्यासेन तेनैव हियते ह्यवशोऽपि सः ।
जिज्ञासुरपि योगस्य शब्दब्रह्मातिवर्त्तते ॥
translation: पूर्वजन्म का अभ्यास ही उसको अवश करके ब्रह्मनिष्ठ बना देता है क्योकि योग के स्वरूप को जानने की इच्छा करनेवाला व्यक्ति भी वेद के शब्दसम्बन्धी स्वरूप को अतिक्रमण कर जाता है
english_translation: Or else, the wise yogi is born into that lineage; such a birth is indeed the rarest in the world.
essence: Being born into a wise yogi lineage is among the rarest and most precious births.
simple_meaning: Being born into a family of wise yogis is a very rare and valuable occurrence in life.
insight: Recognize and value the unique opportunity your background gives to seek deeper understanding and practice.
modern_relevance: Imagine realizing your family or background offers you access to wisdom that many never find — it's a chance to honor and build on that rare foundation.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
प्रयत्नादयतमानस्तु योगी संशुद्धकिल्विषः।
अनेकजन्मसंसिद्धस्ततो याति परां गतिम् ॥
translation: और प्रयत्नपूर्वक साधन करने वाला योगी पाप रहित होकर अनेक जन्मों में योगसिद्ध होकर तत्पश्चात् परम गति को प्राप्त होता है।
english_translation: O divine beings! In both kinds of birth, the highest sages regain the wisdom connection from past lives and strive more for liberation.
essence: Renewed effort is strengthened by wisdom gained from past lives.
simple_meaning: The highest sages regain the wisdom from their past lives and then work even harder to achieve full liberation.
insight: It teaches you to recognize and build upon past inner clarity to strengthen your spiritual efforts.
modern_relevance: You remember lessons from past experiences and push yourself harder when seeking real personal growth.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अन्तकाले च मामेव स्मरन् मुक्त्वा कलेवरम् ।
यः प्रयाति स मभावं याति नास्त्यत्र संशयः ॥
translation: शरीरान्त के समय मुझको स्मरण करते करते जो देह त्याग करता है वह मेरे भाव को प्राप्त होता है इसमें सन्देह नहीं
english_translation: Repeated practice from past lives compels one to become established in the supreme reality, because even a seeker of yoga surpasses the word-bound nature of the Vedas.
essence: Long practice compels you beyond words into the true experience of yoga.
simple_meaning: Long-standing practice, even from past lives, shapes you deeply and helps you go beyond just words to experience the true nature of yoga.
insight: Recognize that persistent practice builds an inner momentum that transcends intellectual learning and brings direct experience.
modern_relevance: After years of committing to a skill or habit, you find yourself naturally moving beyond just instructions to a deeper understanding and embodiment.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यं यं वापि स्मरन् भावं त्यजत्यन्ते कलेवरम्।
तं तमेवेति भो देवाः ! सदा तद्भावभावितः ॥
translation: देहान्त के समय जिस जिस भाव का स्मरण करते करते वह योगी देहत्याग करता है, हे देवतागण ! सर्वदा उसी उसी भावना में चित्त के स्थित रहने के कारण उसी भाव को ही प्राप्त होता है
english_translation: A yogi who practices diligently becomes free from faults, attains perfection over many lifetimes, and then reaches the highest state.
essence: Persistent, sincere effort purifies and leads to the highest state across time.
simple_meaning: With steady and sincere effort, a yogi becomes free from faults and gradually perfects their practice, eventually reaching the highest state.
insight: It teaches you to value steady, persistent effort as the true path to transformation and freedom.
modern_relevance: You keep returning to your practice despite setbacks, trusting that consistent effort will bring lasting change over time.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तपस्विभ्योऽधिको योगी ज्ञानिभ्योऽपि मतोऽधिकः।
कम्मिभ्यश्चाधिको योगी तस्मादभवत योगिनः ॥
translation: मेरी सम्मति में योगी तपस्वियों से भी श्रेष्ठ है, ज्ञानियों भी श्रेष्ठ है और कर्मनिष्ठ व्यक्तियों से भी श्रेष्ठ है, अत: आप सभी को योगत्व की इच्छा ही रखनी चाहिए
english_translation: At the time of leaving the body, whoever remembers me and departs attains my essence; there is no doubt about this.
essence: Remembering the divine at death ensures reaching its essence without doubt.
simple_meaning: If you remember the divine at the moment of death and leave your body, you will reach that divine essence without doubt.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate devotion so your final moments naturally align with your highest truth.
modern_relevance: When life feels fragile, remembering your deepest values in your hardest moments can bring peace and clarity.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
कम्मण्येवाधिकारो वो मा फलेषु कदाचन ।
न कर्मफलहेतुत्वं न वः सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्माणि ॥
translation: कर्म करने में ही आपलोगों का अधिकार है, फल इन इच्छा आप लोगों को कभी नहीं होनी चाहिए  आपको  कर्मफल की प्राप्ति के कारण भी नहीं होना चाहिए और न ही सकाम कर्मों में आपलोगों की प्रवृत्ति होनी चाहिये
english_translation: At death, the yogi departs with the mind fixed on whatever state they remember, and the divine beings say, 'They always remain absorbed in that very state.'
essence: Your final remembered state at death shapes what you become next.
simple_meaning: At the moment of death, the state you remember most deeply is the one you carry forward beyond the body.
insight: This verse teaches to cultivate steady, positive states of mind so they become your lasting focus at life's end.
modern_relevance: When you fall asleep after a long day, the last thoughts you hold can influence your dreams and mood on waking.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
वदेषु यज्ञेषु तपःसु चैव दानेषु यत्पुण्यफलं प्रदिष्टम् ।
अत् ति तत्सर्वमिदं विदित्वा योगी परं  स्थानमुपैति चाद्यम् ॥
translation: वेदपाठ करने से, यज्ञ करने से, तपस्या करने से और दान करने से जो पुण्य कहा गया है, इस कर्मयोग के रहस्य को जान लेने से योगी उन सब पुण्यफलो को प्राप्त कर लेता है और जगत के मूलभूत परमपद को प्राप्त करता है
english_translation: In my view, the yogi is superior to ascetics, wiser than scholars, and greater than those devoted to action; therefore, everyone should aspire to be a yogi.
essence: Living as a yogi surpasses being only an ascetic, scholar, or dedicated actor.
simple_meaning: Being a yogi is considered superior to being just a renunciate, a scholar, or a person focused on action. You should aim to live as a yogi.
insight: It teaches you to unify disciplines—renunciation, wisdom, and action—into a single integrated path of yoga.
modern_relevance: You balance learning, doing, and discipline but wonder which path leads to the fullest life. This reminds you the yogi way integrates all these qualities.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
हृन्मान्दराविहारिन् ! भो भक्तानां भक्तवत्सल !।
भवतः प्राप्तये देवा ऋषयो मानवास्तथा ॥
translation: हे भक्तवत्सल ! हे भक्त मनोमन्दिर विहारी ! हे नाथ ! आपको प्राप्त करने के लिये साधनमार्गगामी सब ऋषि, देवता, मनुष्य और
english_translation: Your right is to act only, never to the fruit of action; never let the fruit be your motive, nor let your attachment be to inaction.
essence: You only control your action, not its results or avoidance.
simple_meaning: You have the right to do your work, but not to control the results. Don't act because of desire for outcomes, nor avoid action out of fear.
insight: It shifts your focus from chasing results to giving your best effort regardless of outcome.
modern_relevance: You send that important email, but can’t control the reply. Focusing on your effort frees you from stress over responses.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
पितरश्चैव हे नाथ : सर्वे साधनमार्गगाः।
कीदृशं मार्गमालम्ब्य भवेयुः सफलाशयाः ॥
translation: पितृगण किस प्रकार के पथ को अवलम्बन करके सफल काम होंगे
english_translation: By knowing the secret of karmayoga, a yogi attains all the fruits of Vedic study, sacrifices, austerities, and charity, and reaches the supreme foundation of the world.
essence: Knowing selfless action’s secret surpasses all ritual merit and leads to the highest state.
simple_meaning: Understanding the true practice of selfless action gives you the benefits of all rituals and leads you to the highest state.
insight: Shift focus from external rituals to inner understanding of action’s essence, transforming how you engage with life.
modern_relevance: You might work hard on tasks, hoping for rewards, but true success comes from acting with mindful purpose beyond seeking outcomes.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
कथं विभुर्गुणातीतो भवन्नपि सदा भवान् ।
जीवोपकारकरणे प्रत्तो भवति स्वयं ॥
translation: आप विभु और गुणातीत होने पर भी किस प्रकार जीवो के उपकार में सदा स्वयं प्रवृत्त होते हैं
english_translation: O beloved of devotees, O dweller in the heart of devotees, O Lord! To attain you, sages, deities, and humans all follow the path of spiritual practice.
essence: All sincere seekers pursue the divine who dwells lovingly within their hearts.
simple_meaning: You are deeply loved and present in the hearts of all devotees. Sages, divine beings, and humans all strive to reach you on their spiritual path.
insight: It teaches you to recognize the divine presence within yourself and others as a shared spiritual goal.
modern_relevance: When you feel alone or distant, remember you are held deeply in the hearts of those who seek connection and love.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
कस्मात्साधनतो लभ्यं भवत्सानिध्यमीप्सितम् ।
तत्सर्वे  कृपया नूनमुपदिश्यमाहि प्रभो !॥
translation: किस साधन से अभिलषित आपका सान्निध्य प्राप्त हो सकता है, हे प्रभो ! कृपया अवश्य आप हम लोगों को इन सब बातों का उपदेश करें
english_translation: O Lord, what kind of path should the ancestors follow to achieve success in their endeavors?
essence: Success depends on choosing the right path to follow.
simple_meaning: The verse asks what kind of path the ancestors should follow to achieve their goals successfully.
insight: It encourages asking about the proper approach before acting, highlighting the importance of clarity in direction.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
देवाः ! मम यदा भक्ता मत्स्वरूपस्य तत्त्वतः ।
ज्ञातारः स्युस्तदा सर्वे ज्ञानिनस्तेऽधिकारिणः ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! मेरे भक्तगण जब मेरे स्वरूप को ठीक ठीक जान लेते हैं, तब वे सब ज्ञानी भक्त
english_translation: How do you, the all-pervading and beyond all qualities, still always engage yourself in benefiting living beings?
essence: Being beyond qualities does not prevent you from always acting to help others.
simple_meaning: You are beyond all qualities but still choose to act continuously to help others.
insight: It shifts your view to see true care as something that can exist beyond personal traits or conditions.
modern_relevance: You might feel disconnected from the world’s noise yet find yourself instinctively helping a friend in need without thinking.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
पराभक्तर्भवेयुर्हि मां तदैव समीशते।
देशे काले च सर्वस्मिन पात्रे द्रष्टुं न संशयः ॥
translation: पराभक्ति के अधिकारी होते हैं और तब ही मुझको सब देश काल और पात्र में देखने में समर्थ होते हैं, इसमें सन्देह नहीं है
english_translation: By what practice can the desired proximity to you be attained? Please, O Lord, surely teach us all these things by your grace!
essence: Trustful asking invites grace and clear guidance to reach the divine.
simple_meaning: You ask what practice can bring you close to the divine and request clear guidance by grace.
insight: It encourages you to openly seek guidance with trust, opening space for learning through grace.
modern_relevance: You feel lost and want to find a clear path to what matters most, hoping someone will kindly show you the way.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
पराभक्तेः किन्तु यावन्न ते स्युरधिकारिणः।
तावन्मे सगुणस्यैव रूपस्योपासनां सदा ॥
translation: परन्तु जब तक भक्त, पराभक्ति के अधिकारी न हो तब तक मेरे सगुण रूप की ही उपासना करते हुए निष्पाप होकर सदा
english_translation: O radiant beings! When my devotees truly understand my nature, they become all wise and qualified.
essence: Devotees who truly understand the divine’s nature become wise and capable.
simple_meaning: When devotees genuinely understand the true nature of the divine, they become wise and capable.
insight: It shifts your focus from mere devotion to gaining clear knowledge, showing that wisdom grows from understanding the divine’s true nature.
modern_relevance: You’ve met someone or something that changed how you see the world—this deep understanding grows your confidence and clarity.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
कुर्वन्तः कृतकृत्यत्वं विन्दन्ति गतकल्मषाः।
रागात्मिकाया भक्तेर्मे ये भक्ता अधिकारिणः ॥
translation: कृतकृत्यता लाभ करते हैं। हे देवतागण! मेरी रागात्मिका भक्ति के अधिकारी भक्त
english_translation: Only those truly devoted can perceive me in every place, time, and person without doubt.
essence: Supreme devotion alone allows clear, unwavering perception of the divine in all contexts.
simple_meaning: Only those with supreme devotion can truly perceive the divine everywhere and at all times without doubt.
insight: It shifts your awareness from doubt and separation to confident recognition of the divine in all contexts.
modern_relevance: When your heart is fully open and trusting, you start to notice the deeper presence in everyday moments and people around you.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
लीलामयाऽवतारस्य मम ते प्रायशः सुराः ।
विविधायां हि लीलायामासक्ता विग्रहस्य मे ॥
translation: प्रायः मेरे लीलामय अवतारों की विविध लीलाओं में आसक्त होकर मेरे, लीलामय विग्रह की
english_translation: But until devotees become eligible for supreme devotion, they should always worship my manifested form without fault.
essence: Sincere worship of the divine’s visible form is the foundation before higher devotion arises.
simple_meaning: You should always worship the divine’s manifested form sincerely until your devotion grows fully mature.
insight: It encourages devotion as a process, allowing your practice to evolve naturally from form to deeper experience.
modern_relevance: You might not fully grasp the bigger picture yet, but committing sincerely to what you can connect with is a powerful step forward.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
लीलामयस्य चोपास्त्या लभन्ते मां सुनिश्चितम् ।
मम यन्निगुणं रूपं सगुणं तहदेव हि ॥
translation: उपासना करके मुझको निश्चय प्राप्त करते हैं। मेरे निर्गुण रूप, मेरे सगुण रूप और
english_translation: Those who act find a sense of accomplishment; my devotees who are devoted with attachment are entitled to this.
essence: Acting with devoted attachment brings a genuine sense of accomplishment.
simple_meaning: When you act, you find a feeling of completion and fulfillment. Those devoted with attachment to the divine receive this sense of accomplishment.
insight: It teaches you to appreciate how earnest effort combined with heartfelt devotion leads to genuine fulfillment.
modern_relevance: You stayed late finishing a project you truly care about. That effort brings a deep, satisfying feeling beyond just the outcome.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
लीलामयं विग्रहश्च सर्वमेकमुदीरितम् ।
अधिकारस्य भेदन भक्ता एव हि केवलं ॥
translation: मेरे लीलामय विग्रह सब एक ही हैं। हे देवगण ! केवल अधिकार भेद से भक्तों को ही
english_translation: The celestial beings are often attached to my playful incarnations and the diverse pastimes of my form.
essence: Attachment to the divine's playful forms can limit seeing the true self beyond appearances.
simple_meaning: Divine beings often become attached to the various playful forms and pastimes of the divine.
insight: It teaches you to look beyond surface attractions and pastimes to grasp the essence beneath appearances.
modern_relevance: You might get caught up admiring personalities or roles instead of seeing the deeper truths behind them.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तारतम्यं निरीक्षन्त एषु रूपेषु मेऽमराः ।
पूर्णाशाऽऽवेशरूपादिरूपैर्हि विविधैः खलु ॥
translation: इन मेरे रूपों में नारतम्य दिखाई पड़ता है । हे देवतागण ! पूर्ण, अंश और आवेश आदि विभिन्न रूपों से समय समय पर
english_translation: By devoted worship, people surely attain me—both my formless and my with-form aspects.
essence: Devotion reliably connects you with both the formless and formed aspects of the divine.
simple_meaning: Devoted worship leads to certain connection with the divine, whether you focus on the formless or the with-form aspect.
insight: It teaches you to trust your personal devotional approach without needing to pick a single 'correct' way to relate to the divine.
modern_relevance: When you pause in your busy day to connect with something bigger, you realize your way of relating—through feeling or form—both lead you inward.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अहं हि लोके मायातोऽवतीर्य समये सुराः।
भक्तिं ददामि भक्तेभ्यो येन नन्दन्ति ते सदा ॥
translation: मैं ही जगत में मायावलम्बन से अवतीर्ण होकर भक्तों को भक्ति प्रदान करता हूँ जिससे वे सदा आनन्दित रहते हैं
english_translation: My playful form and all manifestations are one; only my devotees perceive differences in roles.
essence: The divine’s many forms are one; only devoted love sees role differences.
simple_meaning: All the divine forms and expressions are fundamentally one, but only devotees notice differences based on roles or appearances.
insight: It teaches you to look beyond superficial roles and see the oneness beneath through devotion.
modern_relevance: When you hold on to surface differences in people or situations, devotion can help you see the underlying unity instead.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
नैवात्र विस्मयः कार्यः सन्देहो वा कथञ्चन।
धर्मसंरक्षणं देवाः ! रोचते मे निरन्तरम् ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! धर्म की निरन्तर रक्षा करना मुझको अत्यंत प्रिय है, इनमे किसी प्रकार कुछ भी संदेह या विस्मय नहीं करना चाहिए
english_translation: Among these my forms, the immortals observe a hierarchy; indeed, they vary as whole, partial, and influenced forms.
essence: The divine's many forms exist in a clear, layered hierarchy of completeness and influence.
simple_meaning: The divine beings see a clear order among my various forms, which appear in many kinds like whole, partial, and influenced.
insight: Recognize that differences and variety often follow an underlying order, helping you to see complexity without confusion.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अजोऽपि सन्नव्ययात्मा भूतानामीश्वरोऽपि सन् ।
प्रकृति स्वामधिष्टाय सम्भवाम्यात्ममायया ॥
translation: जन्मरहित अविनश्वर और प्राणि मात्र का ईश्वर होकर भी मैं अपनी प्रकृति पर अधिष्ठान करके अपनी माया के द्वारा उत्पन्न होता हूँ
english_translation: I descend into the world wrapped in the veil of illusion to give devoted love to those who rejoice eternally.
essence: The divine appears within illusion to grant devoted love that brings unending joy.
simple_meaning: The divine comes into the world wrapped in illusion to give devoted love to those who find joy in it.
insight: It teaches you to open your heart to devoted love as a source of enduring joy beyond appearances.
modern_relevance: When life feels confusing or overwhelming, you can remember you are supported by a love that transcends all challenges and brings lasting happiness.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति निर्जराः!।
अभ्युत्थानमधर्मस्य तदात्मानं सृजाम्यहम् ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! जब जब धर्मपर ग्लानि और अधर्म का आधिक्य होता है उसी समय मैं आविर्भूत होता हूँ
english_translation: O radiant beings! I continuously cherish the protection of dharma; there should be no doubt or astonishment about this.
essence: Protecting what is right is a clear, unwavering duty you must cherish.
simple_meaning: You should always value protecting what is right without any hesitation or doubt.
insight: It guides you to embrace your responsibility firmly, removing hesitation or uncertainty about your role.
modern_relevance: You face choices where doing the right thing is clear; trusting this clarity lets you act with steady confidence.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
परित्राणाय साधूनां विनाशाय च दुष्कृताम् ।
धर्मसंस्थापनार्थाय सम्भवामि युगे युगे ॥
translation: साधुओं की रक्षा के लिये, दुष्कर्म कारियों के नाश के लिये और धर्म के संस्थापन के लिये मैं युग युग में अवतार धारण करता हूँ
english_translation: Though unborn and imperishable, the lord of beings, I manifest through my nature by my illusion.
essence: The eternal self appears in the world through nature and illusion without losing its true nature.
simple_meaning: Your true self never undergoes birth or death and is the lord of all beings, but it appears in the world through nature and illusion.
insight: It teaches you to see beyond appearances and recognize your timeless essence beneath change.
modern_relevance: When life feels confusing and ever-changing, remembering your core self is untouched by all this helps you find steadiness.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
जन्म कर्म च मे दिव्यमेवं यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः।
त्यक्त्वा देहं पुनर्जन्म नैति मामेति सोऽमराः! ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! जो मेरे इस प्रकार के अलौकिक जन्म और कर्मको यथार्थरूप से जानता है वह देहत्याग करके फिर जन्म ग्रहण नहीं करता है और मुझ को प्राप्त होता है
english_translation: Whenever there is a decline in dharma and a rise of adharma, I manifest myself.
essence: The divine manifests whenever righteousness declines and unrighteousness grows.
simple_meaning: Whenever the natural order weakens and wrongdoing grows, the divine manifests to restore balance.
insight: This verse shifts focus from despair to trust that restorative forces activate during crisis.
modern_relevance: When everything feels out of control and values falter, remember unseen forces work to bring things back on track.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
वीतरागभयक्रोधा मन्मया मामुपाश्रिताः।
बहवो ज्ञानतपसा पूता मद्भावमागताः ॥
translation: अनुराग, क्रोध्शून्य एवं मुझमें एकाग्रचित, मेरे आश्रित और ज्ञानरूपी तप से पवित्र अनेक साधक मेरे भाव को प्राप्त हुए हैं अर्थात् मुक्त हो गये हैं
english_translation: To protect the virtuous, to destroy wrongdoers, and to establish dharma, I manifest in every age.
essence: The divine manifests repeatedly to protect good and restore dharma across time.
simple_meaning: The divine appears in every age to protect good people, destroy wrongdoing, and restore dharma.
insight: This teaching shifts your view from helplessness to trust in a recurring cosmic support for justice.
modern_relevance: When you face injustice or feel overwhelmed by wrongdoing, remember that forces beyond you work to restore balance and protect what is right.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ये यथा मां प्रपद्यन्ते तांस्तथैव भजाम्यहम्।
मम वानुवर्तन्ते साधकाः सर्वशः सुराः ॥
translation: जो मुझको जिस भाव से आश्रय करते हैं उनको मैं उसी भाव से आश्रय में रखता हूँ अर्थात् फल प्रदान करता हूँ। हे देवगण ! साधक लोग सब प्रकार से मेरे मार्ग का ही अनुसरण करते हैं
english_translation: O divine beings, whoever truly understands my transcendental birth and actions, after leaving the body, does not take birth again and attains me.
essence: True understanding of divine birth and action frees you from rebirth and leads to union.
simple_meaning: If you truly understand the divine nature of my birth and actions, you will not be reborn after death and will unite with me.
insight: It teaches you to see beyond appearances of birth and death, embracing a timeless connection with the divine.
modern_relevance: When you grasp the deeper meaning behind your life's purpose and actions, fear of failure or loss loses its hold on you.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
काङ्कन्तः कर्मणां सिद्धिं यजन्त इह देवताः।
क्षिप्रं लोके साधकानां सिद्धिर्भवति कर्मजा ॥
translation: कर्म की सिद्धि चाहनेवाले साधक देवताओं की उपासना करते हैं । इस संसार में साधकों को कर्म सम्बन्धी सिद्धि शीघ्र प्राप्त होती है
english_translation: Those free from attachment, fear, and anger, absorbed in me, purified by the penance of knowledge, have attained my nature.
essence: Letting go of fear, anger, and attachment reveals the divine nature within you.
simple_meaning: Those who let go of attachment, fear, and anger, focus their minds on the divine, and purify themselves through knowledge, realize the divine nature within.
insight: It teaches you to combine emotional balance with focused devotion and knowledge to embody the divine nature.
modern_relevance: You’ve felt overwhelmed by fear or anger, but when you center your attention on what truly matters and learn deeply, you find peace and connection beyond those emotions.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तबुद्धयस्तदात्मानस्तनिष्ठास्तत्परायणाः।
गच्छन्त्यपुनरावृत्तिं ज्ञाननिधूतकल्मषाः ॥
translation: परमात्मा में जिनके बुद्धि और चित्त लगे हुए हैं, उन्हीं में जिनकी निष्ठा है और उन्ही में जो परायण हैं एवं ज्ञान से जिनके पाप नष्ट हो गये हैं वह मोक्ष को प्राप्त होते हैं
english_translation: I reciprocate the devotion shown to me in the same manner; all sincere seekers follow my path in every way.
essence: The divine meets your devotion in the exact form you offer it.
simple_meaning: The divine responds to your devotion exactly as you express it; sincere seekers follow this path wholeheartedly.
insight: It teaches you to recognize how your attitude toward the divine influences what you receive in return.
modern_relevance: When you invest genuine care and openness in a relationship, it naturally reflects back to you in kind, shaping your experience.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
मम प्राप्त्यै सदा भक्ता आश्रयन्ति दिवौकसः! ।
भक्तिं भवमयीं योग क्रियात्मकमपि ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! मुझको प्राप्त करने के लिये उपासक सदा भावमयी भक्ति और क्रियामय योग का भी आश्रय अवश्य लेते हैं
english_translation: Those who desire success in their actions worship the deities here; in this world, success from action comes quickly to such practitioners.
essence: Seeking success through devotion brings swift results in action.
simple_meaning: If you want success in your work, honoring higher beings helps. Those who do so find their efforts succeed quickly.
insight: It teaches you to combine focused action with respectful devotion to support your goals.
modern_relevance: You prepare for an important project by mentally committing and seeking support beyond yourself. That trust helps your efforts succeed faster.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
वैध्या रागात्मिका वै भक्तेरधिगमो मत:।
वैधी सा साधनाल्लभ्या श्रीगुरोरुपदेशतः ॥
translation: वैधी भक्ति से ही रोगात्मिका भक्ति की प्राप्ति मानी गई है, वह वैधी भक्ति श्रीगुरूपदेश के अनुसार साधन करने से प्राप्त होती है
english_translation: Those whose mind and intellect are fixed on the supreme self, who are devoted and free from stains of ignorance by knowledge, attain freedom from rebirth.
essence: Steady devotion and clear knowledge of the true self end the cycle of rebirth.
simple_meaning: You reach freedom from rebirth when your mind and intellect focus steadily on the true self with devotion and knowledge that removes confusion.
insight: It shifts your effort from scattered distractions to focused devotion and wisdom, ending the cycle of reactivity.
modern_relevance: When you focus deeply on your true nature with devotion and clear understanding, you escape repetitive harmful habits and find lasting peace.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यदा चित्तलयं कर्तुमभ्यासो माय जायते ।
रागात्मिकायां भक्तौ हि तदा मज्जात सत्वरम् ॥
translation: जब मुझमें चित्त लीन करने का अभ्यास हो जाता है तब मेरी रागात्मिका भक्ति में वह
english_translation: The divine beings always take refuge in heartfelt devotion and active yoga to reach me.
essence: Sincere devotion and active practice together reliably connect you to the divine.
simple_meaning: Those who seek the divine take refuge in deep devotion and consistent active practice.
insight: It teaches you to blend loving devotion with practical action for a steady connection.
modern_relevance: When you struggle to connect with something greater, combining heartfelt care with steady effort opens the way.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
उन्मज्जति मुहुस्तद्वत् भाग्यवान साधकोत्तमः।
भक्तिरेषा पराभक्तेजननी वर्त्तते सुराः ! ॥
translation: भाग्यवान् श्रेष्ठ साधक शीघ्र उन्मज्जन और निमज्जन बार बार करने लगता है। हे देवतागण ! यह भक्ति परामक्ति को उत्पन्न करने वाली है
english_translation: According to the revered teacher's instruction, disciplined devotion is the means to attain passionate devotion.
essence: Disciplined practice is the gateway to deep, passionate devotion.
simple_meaning: Passionate, heartfelt devotion is reached by first practicing disciplined, steady devotion as taught by a trusted teacher.
insight: It teaches you to trust the process of steady devotional practice as the foundation for genuine love.
modern_relevance: You spend time each day practicing kindness or gratitude, and over weeks, your feelings deepen beyond habit into true caring.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
उपास्तेः प्राणरूपास्ति भक्तिर्हि मामकी सुराः।
क्रियायोगः शरीरं स्याचतुर्धा स प्रकीर्तितः ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! मेरी भक्ति उपासनाकी प्राणरूपा और क्रिया योग शरीररूप है। हे देवश्रेष्ठो! क्रियायोग के भी
english_translation: When the mind becomes absorbed through practice, then devotion born of attachment quickly leads to immersion.
essence: Attachment-based devotion leads the mind to quick and deep absorption through practice.
simple_meaning: When you practice deeply focusing your mind, devotion born from attachment quickly draws you fully in.
insight: It shows how attachment can be a powerful force that brings your mind to full immersion in devotion through practice.
modern_relevance: You find yourself completely absorbed when your passion for something comes from a genuine emotional connection.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
नाम्ना मन्त्रहठावेतौ लयराजौ तथैव च ।
आधिकारस्य भेदेन विज्ञेयास्ते सुरोत्तमाः !॥
translation: अधिकार भेद से चार भेद हैं, वह  मन्त्र, हठ  लय और राज नाम से जाने जाते हैं।
english_translation: The fortunate best practitioner repeatedly immerses and emerges; this devotion generates supreme devotion, O devas.
essence: Devotion deepens through repeated immersion and emergence, growing stronger over time.
simple_meaning: A fortunate and excellent practitioner repeatedly immerses themselves in devotion, which leads to the highest form of devoted love.
insight: It teaches you to embrace devotion as an ongoing cycle of engagement, not a one-time event.
modern_relevance: You come back to your practice or passion many times, each return making your connection stronger and more meaningful.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
गुरोर्वै कृपयेमानि लभ्यते साधकैर्धवम् ।
म्त्प्राप्तिसाधनानीति प्रवदन्ति मनीषिण: ॥
translation: गुरुकृपा से ही मेरी प्राप्ति के इन साधनों को साधक निश्चय लाभ करते हैं, इस बात को पण्डितगण कहते हैं
english_translation: O gods, my devotion is the life force of worship, and Karma Yoga is its embodiment in the body, described as fourfold.
essence: Devotion is the living spirit of worship; action is its bodily form.
simple_meaning: Devotion is the vital energy in worship, and Karma Yoga is how that devotion expresses itself in action through the body.
insight: Recognize that devotion must be embodied through your actions to be real and transformative.
modern_relevance: When your heartfelt intentions turn into deliberate actions, you see devotion as a living force, not just a feeling.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
स्पर्शान कृत्वा बहिर्वाधान चक्षुश्चैवान्तरे भ्रुवोः।
प्राणापानौ समौ कृत्वा नासाभ्यन्तरचारिणौ ॥
translation: रूप रसादि बाह्य विषयों को बाहर ही रखकर दृष्टि को दोनों भवों के बीच में रखकर नासिका के भीतर विचरण करने वाले प्राण और अपान वायु को समान करके अर्थात् समभाव से चलने वाला बना कर
english_translation: By the distinction of authority, four types are known: mantra, hatha, laya, and raja.
essence: Spiritual practices classify into four distinct types based on authority and method.
simple_meaning: There are four types distinguished by authority: mantra, hatha, laya, and raja.
insight: Recognizing distinct methods helps you choose the right practice aligned with your capacity and goals.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
यतेन्द्रिययमनोबूधिर्मुनिर्मोक्षपरायण: ।
विगतेच्छाभयक्रोधो य: सदा मुक्त एव स: ॥
translation: इन्द्रिय मन और बुद्धिका संयम करने वाला, मोक्षपरायण और इच्छा भय एवं क्रोधशून्य जो मुनि है वही सदा मुक्त है
english_translation: By the grace of the Guru, seekers surely attain these means of realization, as the wise declare.
essence: The teacher’s grace is essential for seekers to gain means for realization.
simple_meaning: The grace of the teacher makes it certain that seekers will obtain the means to reach realization.
insight: It teaches you to rely on the teacher’s kindness as a vital support, not just your own effort.
modern_relevance: When you feel stuck, remember that support and guidance from someone wiser can open doors you cannot open alone.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
भोक्तारं यज्ञतपसां सर्वभूतमहेश्वरम।
सुहृदं सर्वभूतानां ज्ञात्वा मां शान्तिमृच्छति ॥
translation: मुझे यज्ञों और तपस्या का भोक्ता, सकल लोकों का महान् ईश्वर और सकल प्राणिमात्र का सुहद् समझकर साधक मोक्ष को प्राप्त होता है
english_translation: Keep your eyes focused between the eyebrows, setting aside external sights and sensations; balance the inward-moving life breaths through the nostrils with equal steadiness.
essence: Steady your gaze inward and balance your breath to calm body and mind.
simple_meaning: Turn your attention away from outside distractions and keep your eyes focused between your eyebrows. Balance your inward and outward breath evenly through the nose.
insight: It teaches you to use physical focus and balanced breathing to calm restless thoughts and enter a centered state.
modern_relevance: When your mind races and distractions crowd your vision, pausing to steady your gaze and balance your breath can ground your awareness instantly.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
उद्धरेदात्मनात्मानं नात्मानमवसादयेत् ।
आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव रिपुरात्मनः ॥
translation: आत्मा के द्वारा अर्थात् बुद्धि के द्वारा आत्मा का अर्थात् मन का उद्धार करना चाहिये, आत्मा को अर्थात् मन को नीचे नहीं गिरने दिया जान चाहिए क्योंकि मेरी ओर खिंचा हुआ आत्मा अर्थात् मन ही अपना अर्थात् साधक का बन्धु है और नीचे की ओर अर्थात् इन्द्रियादिक में खिंचा हुआ आत्मा अर्थात् मन हीं अपना अर्थात् साधक का शत्रु है
english_translation: The sage who controls the senses, mind, and intellect, who seeks freedom, and who is free from desire, fear, and anger, is always liberated.
essence: True freedom arises from mastering senses, mind, and releasing desire, fear, and anger.
simple_meaning: You become free when you control your senses, mind, and intellect, and release desire, fear, and anger.
insight: It teaches you to steady your inner faculties and let go of harmful emotions to live freely.
modern_relevance: When frustration or fear rises inside you, remembering to steady your mind and release anger can bring lasting calm and freedom.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
बन्धुरात्मात्मनस्तस्य येनैवात्मात्मना जितः ।
अनात्मनस्तु शत्रुत्वे वर्जेतात्मैव शत्रुवत् ॥
translation: जिस उपासक ने अपनी आत्मा अर्थात् बुद्धि के द्वारा मन को वशीभूत कर लिया है उसी की आत्मा अर्थात् मन अपना अर्थात् उपासक का बन्धु है; परन्तु अजितेन्द्रिय व्यक्ति की आत्मा अर्थात् बुद्धि ही शत्रुता में शत्रुवत् प्रवृत्त हुआ करती है।
english_translation: Knowing me as the enjoyer of sacrifices and austerities, the great lord of all beings, and the friend of all living creatures, the practitioner attains peace.
essence: Recognizing the divine as friend and lord of all brings deep peace.
simple_meaning: When you recognize the divine as the one who enjoys offerings and is friend to all beings, you attain inner peace.
insight: It shifts focus from seeing the divine as distant to experiencing it as a close, supportive friend, opening the heart to peace.
modern_relevance: You pause in a busy day and feel a quiet support that all life is connected and cared for, calming your restless heart.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
योगी युन्जीत सतत्तमात्मानं रहसी स्थित: ।
एकाकी यतचित्तात्मा निराशीरपरिग्रहः ॥
translation: योगी को उचित है कि सब समय एकान्त में अवस्थित रहकर एकाकी, संयतचित्त, संयतात्मा, इच्छाशून्य और परिग्रह शन्य होकर मन को समाहित करे
english_translation: You must uplift the self by the self and never let the self fall; the self alone is the friend of the self, and the self alone is the enemy of the self.
essence: Your true self is both your greatest friend and your greatest enemy depending on how you treat it.
simple_meaning: You must use your own inner strength to raise yourself and not let yourself sink. Your true self can be your closest friend or your greatest enemy.
insight: It teaches you to recognize your mind’s power to be your ally or adversary and choose to strengthen it.
modern_relevance: When your thoughts pull you toward doubt or distraction, you alone can choose to steady and uplift your mind toward clarity.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
शुचौ देशे प्रतिष्ठाप्य स्थिरमासनमात्मनः ।
नात्युच्छ्रितं नातिनीचं चैलाजिनकुशोत्तरम् ॥
translation: पवित्र स्थान में कुशासन के ऊपर मृगचर्म और उसके ऊपर रेशम का वस्त्र रखकर न बहुत ऊंचा और न बहुत नीचा आसन स्थिर करके और
english_translation: The devotee who has conquered the mind by the true self sees the mind as a friend; but the unconquered intellect turns the mind into an enemy.
essence: Mastering your mind from the true self turns it from enemy into friend.
simple_meaning: When you control your restless mind using your true self, the mind becomes your friend. Without this control, the mind acts like an enemy.
insight: This verse teaches you to use your true self to tame the restless mind, shifting it from opposition to harmony.
modern_relevance: When stress overwhelms you and your thoughts fight each other, gaining control over your mind brings peace and turns inner turmoil into cooperation.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तत्रैकाग्रं मनः कृत्वा यताचित्तेन्द्रियक्रियः ।
उपविश्यासने युज्यादयोगमात्मविशुद्धये ॥
translation: उस आसन पर बैठकर मन को एकाग्र करके चित्त और इन्द्रियों की क्रिया को वशीभूत करते हुए उपासक को चित्तशुद्धि के निमित्त योगाभ्यास करना उचित है
english_translation: The yogi should always remain in solitude, alone, with a controlled mind and self, free from desire and attachment.
essence: True strength grows in solitude with a calm, desireless, and unattached mind.
simple_meaning: You should spend time alone with a steady mind and self, free from desires and attachments.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate inner stability by withdrawing into solitude and calming restless desires.
modern_relevance: When life feels noisy and overwhelming, stepping back alone helps you regain focus without craving or clinging.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
समं कायशिरोग्रीवं धारयन्नचलं स्थिरः।
सम्प्रेक्ष्य नासिकाग्रं स्वं दिशश्चानवलोकयन् ॥
translation: देह का मध्यभाग मस्तक और ग्रीवा देशः सरल और निश्चल भाव से रखकर, स्थिर होकर अपनी नासिका के अग्रभाग का अवलोकन करते हुए एवं अन्य ओर का देखना छोड़कर
english_translation: In a pure place, place a seat made of kusa grass, topped with deer skin and silk cloth, neither too high nor too low, and sit steadily.
essence: A steady, balanced seat supports steady mind and practice.
simple_meaning: Choose a clean, balanced seat made of natural materials and sit steadily to prepare for practice.
insight: Setting a balanced physical foundation helps your mind remain steady and focused during practice.
modern_relevance: You arrange your chair and environment before a meditation or deep focus session to help your mind settle.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
प्रशान्तात्मा विगतभीब्रह्मचारित्रते स्थितः।
मनः संयम्य मच्चित्तो युक्त आसीत मत्परः ॥
translation: प्रशान्तचित्त भयरहित  और ब्रह्मचर्य में अवस्थित होकर मन का दमन करते हुए मुझमें ही चित्त समर्पण करके मत्परायण होते हुए युक्त होकर अवस्थान करना उचित है
english_translation: Sitting on that seat, focus your mind, control the mind and senses, and practice yoga for purifying the inner state.
essence: Steady sitting and controlled mind form the foundation for purifying the inner state.
simple_meaning: You should sit steadily with your mind focused and senses under control to practice yoga that purifies your inner being.
insight: This verse teaches you to establish steady focus and self-control as the foundation for inner purification.
modern_relevance: You sit quietly in your chair, pushing away distractions from your phone and thoughts, preparing to focus fully on your task.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
युजन्नेवं सदात्मानं योगी विगतमानसः।
शांति निर्वाणपरमां मत्संस्थामधिगच्छति ॥
translation: उक्त रूप से सदा मन को दमन करने वाला संयतचित्त योगी निर्वाण मुक्ति देने वाली एवं मुझमें रहने वाली शान्ति को प्राप्त करता है
english_translation: Keeping the body upright and steady, the head and neck held straight, calmly focusing on the tip of the nose and not looking elsewhere.
essence: Steady body and focused gaze quiet the restless mind.
simple_meaning: You keep your body straight and still, focusing your eyes gently on the tip of your nose without looking around.
insight: It teaches you how steady physical posture combined with focused gaze stabilizes your mental state.
modern_relevance: When your mind races, try sitting quietly with your spine straight and eyes softly fixed on one point to find calm.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
नात्यशंतस्तु योगोऽस्ति न चैकांतमंश्न्त: ।
न चातिस्वप्नशीलस्य जाग्रतो नैव चामराः ! ॥
translation: परन्तु हे देवतागण ! अधिक भोजन करने वाले को योग की प्राप्ति नहीं होती और न निरन्तर उपवास करने वाले को ही योग की प्राप्ति होती है, उसी प्रकार बहुत सोने वाले को भी योग की प्राप्ति नहीं होती है और न बहुत जागने वाले को ही योग की प्राप्ति होती है
english_translation: One should be calm, free from fear, steady in celibacy, control the mind, and be devoted with the mind fixed on me.
essence: Calm, fearless self-control rooted in devotion steadies the restless mind.
simple_meaning: You should remain calm and fearless, live with self-restraint, control your restless mind, and fix your attention devotedly on the divine.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate calmness and self-restraint as a stable base for devoted focus and effective action.
modern_relevance: When overwhelm hits and distractions pull you every way, grounding yourself with calm focus and clear priorities helps you stay steady and connected to what matters.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
युक्ता विहारस्य युक्तचेष्टस्य कर्मसु ।
युक्तस्वप्नावबोधस्य योगो भवति दुःखहा ॥
translation: जो साधक नियमित आहार और विहार करते हैं और कर्मों को भी नियमाधीन होकर करते हैं, नियम के साथ निद्रित होते हैं और नियम के साथ जागते हैं उनका योगाभ्यास दुःख का नाश करने वाला होता है
english_translation: A yogi who thus always controls the mind and is free from mental distractions attains the supreme peace of liberation abiding in me.
essence: Calming your restless mind leads you to the highest peace abiding within.
simple_meaning: You can reach the highest peace by always calming your mind and staying steady within yourself.
insight: It teaches you to focus inward steadily, calming the restless mind to experience true peace.
modern_relevance: You sit quietly after a hectic day, letting go of racing thoughts, and feel a deep calm settle inside you.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यदा विनियतं चित्तमात्मन्येवावतिष्ठते ।
निःस्पृहः सर्वकामेभ्यो युक्त इत्युच्यते तदा ॥
translation: जब चित्त विशेषरूप से संयत होकर आत्मा मे ही अवस्थान करता है तब सभी प्रकार की कामनाओं से निःस्पृह व्यक्ति युक्त कहलाता है
english_translation: But, O divine beings, one who overeats does not attain yoga, nor does one who fasts continually; similarly, one who sleeps excessively does not attain yoga, nor does one who stays awake continuously.
essence: Yoga cannot be attained through extreme or unbalanced habits of eating or sleeping.
simple_meaning: Yoga is not gained by eating too much or fasting all the time, nor by sleeping excessively or staying awake constantly. Balance is key.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate moderate habits, avoiding extremes that block steady progress in practice.
modern_relevance: After binge eating or pulling an all-nighter, you realize true growth doesn’t come from extremes but from steady balance.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यथा दीपो निवातस्थो नेग्नते सोमपा स्मृता।
योगिनो यतचित्तस्य युन्ज्य्तो योगमात्मन: ॥
translation: जैसे वायुरहित स्थान में दीप विचलित नहीं हुआ करता, आत्मा के उद्देश्य से योग का अभ्यास करने वाले संयतात्मा योगी के अचञ्चल चित्त को ऐसा ही समझना चाहिये
english_translation: Those who regulate their food and activities, perform actions with discipline, and maintain regular sleep and wakefulness have a yoga practice that destroys suffering.
essence: Discipline in daily life creates a yoga that ends suffering.
simple_meaning: Following a balanced routine for eating, activity, work, and sleep leads to a practice that ends suffering.
insight: It shifts your focus from chasing results to cultivating steady, wholesome habits that protect your well-being.
modern_relevance: You wake up, eat on time, work with focus, and sleep regularly—this order quietly eases your stress and pain.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यत्रोपरमते चित्तं निरुद्धं योगसेवसा ।
यत्र चैवात्मनातमाँ पश्यन्नात्मनि तुष्यति ॥
translation: जिस अवस्था में योगाभ्यास द्वारा संयत चित्त उपरति को प्राप्त होता है और जिस अवस्था में आत्मज्ञान द्वारा आत्मा को देखते हुए आत्मा मे ही उपासक संतुष्ट हो जाता है वही योगावस्था है
english_translation: When the mind is fully controlled and rests in the true self, free from all desires, one is called united.
essence: True union happens when the mind rests silently in the true self, free from desire.
simple_meaning: When your mind is firmly focused and stays on your true self without distraction, and you no longer crave desires, you are considered united and steady.
insight: It teaches you to settle your mind steadily on your true self, reducing distraction from desires.
modern_relevance: You notice how your mind races chasing likes, achievements, or approval. This verse invites you to let go and simply be with yourself without craving more.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सुखमात्यन्तिकं यत्तबुद्धिग्राह्यमतीन्द्रियम् ।
वेत्ति यत्र न चैवायं स्थितश्चलति तत्त्वतः ॥
translation: जिस अवस्थाविशेष में युक्त व्यक्ति उस अनिर्वचनीय अतीन्द्रिय और केवल बुद्धि से ग्रहण करने योग्य परम सुख का अनुभव करता है और जिस अवस्था में स्थित होने पर ही यथार्थरूप से वह अविचलित रहता है उसी अवस्था को योग कहते हैं
english_translation: Just as a lamp in a windless place does not flicker, the mind of a yogi focused on the true self remains steady.
essence: A mind focused on the true self remains as steady as a lamp without wind.
simple_meaning: When you practice yoga focused on your true self, your mind becomes steady like a lamp in a place without wind.
insight: It encourages shifting your attention inward to keep mental calm instead of reacting to external distractions.
modern_relevance: When your thoughts race before a big decision, remember how a steady lamp stays calm without wind and find your inner quiet.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
