यं लब्ध्या चापरं लाभं मन्यते नाधिकं ततः ।
यस्मिन् स्थितो न दुःखेन गुरुणापि विचाल्यते ॥
translation: जिस अवस्था में अन्य सब अवस्थाओं के लाभ को उस अवस्था से अधिक न समझा जाय और जिस अवस्था में रहने से महादुःख भी विचलित न कर सके उस अवस्था को योग कहते हैं
english_translation: The state where the mind is restrained through yoga practice, and the practitioner, seeing the true self within, is satisfied in that self, is the state of yoga.
essence: Yoga is the calm mind that sees and finds joy in the true self.
simple_meaning: Yoga is the state where your restless mind becomes calm through practice, and you see and feel satisfied with your true self within.
insight: It teaches you to steady your mind through practice and rest in the satisfaction of your inner self.
modern_relevance: After a long day of distractions, when your mind finally quiets and you notice your own steady presence, a deep calm naturally arises.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तं विद्याद्दुःखसंयोगवियोगं योगसंज्ञितम् ।
स निश्चयेन योक्तव्यो योगो निर्विण्णचेतसा ॥
translation: जिस अवस्थाविशेष में दुःख का सम्पर्क नहीं रहता है वही अवस्था योगशब्दवाच्य है और निर्विषण चित्त उसी ही योग का अभ्यास करना उचित है
english_translation: Yoga is the state where a person experiences supreme, indescribable bliss beyond the senses, grasped only by the discerning mind, and remains truly unshaken in that state.
essence: True yoga is lasting inner steadiness born from bliss beyond the senses.
simple_meaning: Yoga is being in a state of deep, indescribable happiness that only a wise mind can understand, where you stay completely steady and unshaken.
insight: It teaches you to recognize the difference between fleeting sensory pleasure and a profound, steady joy known only through clear inner awareness.
modern_relevance: When your excitement or anxiety fades into a calm joy that your mind alone senses, you discover a steadiness that no distraction can shake.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
संकल्पप्रभवान् कामान् त्यक्त्वा सर्वानशेषतः।
मनसैवेन्द्रियग्रामं विनियम्य समन्ततः ॥
translation: संकल्प से उत्पन्न होने वाली सभी इच्छाओ को विशेष रूप से त्याग कर, मन के ही द्वारा इन्द्रियगण को सब विषयसमूह से
english_translation: The state in which no other gain is considered greater and where even great sorrow cannot disturb is called yoga.
essence: Yoga is an unshakable calm beyond all gains and pains.
simple_meaning: Yoga is the state where no other achievement seems better, and even great suffering cannot shake your calm.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate an inner stability that remains unshaken by external gains or losses, even intense suffering.
modern_relevance: You face a crisis that would normally upset you deeply, but you notice a quiet center inside that remains calm no matter what happens.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
शनैः शनैरुपरमेद्बद्धया धृतिगृहीतया।
आत्मसंस्थं मनः कृत्वा न किञ्चिदपि चिन्तयेत् ॥
translation: विशेषरूप से रोक करके धारणा से वशीभूत की हुई बुद्धि द्वारा मन को आत्मा में  निश्चलरूप से स्थापन करके क्रमशः उपराम को प्राप्त हो और कोई चिन्ता न रक्खे
english_translation: The state where there is no contact with suffering is called yoga; one should practice yoga with a mind free from agitation.
essence: Yoga is the calm mind free from suffering's contact.
simple_meaning: Yoga means reaching a state where suffering no longer touches you, practiced with a calm, untroubled mind.
insight: It teaches you to approach yoga as calming the mind beyond emotional disturbance, not just physical effort.
modern_relevance: When painful news strikes, and your mind races with worry, this verse reminds you to steady your thoughts and find calm beyond that pain.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यतो यतो निश्चरति मनश्चञ्चलमस्थिरम् ।
ततस्ततो नियम्यैतदात्मन्येव वशं नयेत् ॥
translation: स्वभाव से चञ्चल और संयम करने पर भी चलायमान होने वाला मन जिस जिस विषय में जावे उस उस विषय से उसको खींच कर आत्मा मे ही स्थिर करना चाहिये
english_translation: Completely renounce all desires born from resolve; by the mind itself, control all the senses from every direction.
essence: You can fully give up desires and govern your senses solely through your mind.
simple_meaning: Let go completely of all desires that arise from your intentions, and use your mind to regulate all your senses.
insight: It teaches you to use your mind actively to regulate senses, shifting focus from satisfying desires to self-mastery.
modern_relevance: You notice your mind chasing after every impulse and craving. This verse shows you how to pause, let go, and gently steer your attention away.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
प्रशान्तमनसं ह्येनं योगिनं मुखमुत्तमम्।
उपैति शान्तरजसं ब्रह्मभूतमकल्मषम् ॥
translation: क्योंकि उक्त प्रकार से रजोगुण से रहित प्रशान्तचित्त, निष्पाप और ब्रह्मभाव को प्राप्त योगी को परमसुख प्राप्त होता है
english_translation: Gradually, steadily restrain the mind with focused determination, establish it firmly in the true self, and do not entertain any worries.
essence: Steadily restrain your mind and fix it firmly in your true self without worry.
simple_meaning: You should gradually and firmly restrain your restless mind, fixing it steadily in your true self without letting any worries arise.
insight: It teaches you to patiently and steadily hold your attention in the true self, reducing mental turbulence.
modern_relevance: You sit quietly after a stressful day, gently bringing your scattered thoughts back to yourself, refusing to spiral into anxiety.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
युन्ज्न्नेव सदात्मानं योगी विगतकल्मषः।
मुखेन ब्रह्मसंस्पर्शमत्यन्तं सुखमश्नुते ॥
translation: इस प्रकार से सदा मन को ब्रह्म में युक्त करता हुआ निष्पाप योगी अनायास ब्रह्म संस्पर्श रूपी सर्वोत्कृष्ट सुख को प्राप्त कर लेता है
english_translation: Whenever the restless and unsteady mind wanders, it should be controlled and drawn back to the true self alone.
essence: A restless mind should be gently controlled and consistently redirected to the true self.
simple_meaning: When your restless mind moves away, you should gently control it and bring it back to your true self.
insight: This verse teaches you to notice when your mind drifts and patiently redirect your attention inward without judgment.
modern_relevance: Your mind jumps from one notification to another, but you can pause and gently bring your focus back to yourself.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सर्वभूतस्थमात्मानं सर्वभूतानि चात्मनि ।
ईक्षते योगयुक्तात्मा सर्वत्र समदर्शनः ॥
translation: योग के द्वारा समाहित चित्त और सर्वत्र समदर्शन करने वाला वह योगी आत्मा को सर्वभूतों में अवस्थित देखता है और सर्वभूतों को आत्मा में देखता है
english_translation: Because a yogi who is free from the mode of passion, whose mind is peaceful, and who is pure and established in the supreme reality attains supreme bliss.
essence: Calm, pure awareness free from desire brings the highest joy.
simple_meaning: A yogi who has a calm mind, free from passion and impurity, and who is established in the supreme reality experiences the highest happiness.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate a peaceful, desire-free mind to experience true joy beyond external circumstances.
modern_relevance: After a hectic day filled with craving and stress, you finally find a moment of calm and clarity, feeling a deep contentment arise from within.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सर्वभूतस्थितं यो मां भजत्येकत्वमास्थितः।
सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि स योगी मयि वर्त्तते ॥
translation: जो सर्वभूत में अवस्थित मुझको अद्वितीय रूप से आश्रय करके मेरी उपासना करता है, संसार में वर्तमान रहने पर भी वह योगी सर्वथा मुझमे ही अवस्थान करता है।
english_translation: By always uniting the mind with the supreme reality, the yogi free from all faults effortlessly attains the supreme bliss of contact with the supreme reality.
essence: Effortless union of mind with the supreme reality frees you and brings supreme bliss.
simple_meaning: If you always keep your mind connected to the supreme reality, you become free from faults and easily experience the highest bliss.
insight: It teaches you to rest your mind steadily on the true self, dissolving inner obstacles effortlessly.
modern_relevance: When your mind settles naturally on what truly matters, peace and joy come without forcing or striving.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
आत्मौपम्येन सर्वत्र समं पश्यति योऽमराः ।
सुखं वा यदि वा दुःखं स योगी परमो मतः ॥
translation: हे देवगण! जो अपनी उपमा से सब भूतो को समान देखता हैं और सुख दुःख को समान देखता है वह योगी श्रेष्ठ है, यही मेरी सम्मति है
english_translation: The yogi with a focused mind sees the true self dwelling in all beings and all beings within the true self, perceiving equality everywhere.
essence: The true self is equally present in all beings, and all beings exist within the true self.
simple_meaning: A person who practices yoga with a calm mind sees the true self inside all beings and sees all beings as part of the true self, feeling equal to everything.
insight: It teaches you to shift from seeing yourself as separate to seeing unity with others, fostering compassion and balance.
modern_relevance: When you stop judging others and see them as part of yourself, conflicts soften and empathy grows naturally.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
असंशयं सुपर्वाणः ! मनो दुर्निग्रहं चलम् ।
अभ्यासेन तु भो देवाः ! वैराग्येण च गृह्यते ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! मन दुर्निग्रह और चञ्चल है इसमें सन्देह नहीं; किन्तु हे देवगण ! अभ्यास और वैराग्य द्वारा मन का निग्रह किया जाता है
english_translation: Whoever worships me, dwelling in all beings as the one without a second, remains always in me, even while living in the world.
essence: Worshiping the unity within all beings keeps you always connected to the divine.
simple_meaning: If you worship the divine as the one present in all beings, you remain connected to the divine even while living in the world.
insight: It shifts your focus from separation to unity, allowing you to stay devoted while active in the world.
modern_relevance: You can stay spiritually connected even amid daily chaos by recognizing the divine presence in everyone you meet.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
असंयतात्मना योगो दुष्पाप इति मे मतिः।
वश्यात्मना तु यतता शक्योऽवाप्तुमुपायतः ॥
translation: जिसका चित्त संयत नहीं है मेरा मत है कि उसके लिये योग दुष्प्राप्य है; किन्तु गुरूपदिष्ट उपाय द्वारा संयतचित्त व्यक्ति यदि प्रयत्नशील हो तो योग को प्राप्त कर सकता है
english_translation: The highest yogi sees all beings as equal to their own self and views pleasure and pain as the same.
essence: Seeing yourself in all and feeling pleasure and pain equally is supreme yoga.
simple_meaning: You reach the highest yogic state when you see all beings as yourself and treat pleasure and pain equally.
insight: It teaches you to dissolve separation between self and others, balancing emotional responses to pleasure and pain.
modern_relevance: In moments of conflict or joy, you pause and recognize others experience what you do; this softens reactions and deepens your calm.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
योगिनामपि सर्वेषां मद्गतेनान्तरात्मना ।
श्रद्धावान भजते यो मां स मे युक्ततमो मतः ॥
translation: सब योगियों में से भी जो श्रद्धावान् व्यक्ति मद्गतचित्त से मेरी उपासना करता है वह अतिश्रेष्ठ योगी है, यह मेरा मत है।
english_translation: Undoubtedly, the mind is restless and hard to control; but through practice and dispassion, the divine beings control the mind.
essence: Restless minds can be disciplined through steady practice and letting go.
simple_meaning: The mind is naturally restless and difficult to control. But with consistent practice and detachment, it can be disciplined.
insight: It teaches you to use steady effort and detachment as tools to master your restless mind.
modern_relevance: When your thoughts keep jumping around during work or study, regular practice and stepping back from attachments help you regain focus.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
न मां दुष्कृतिनो मूढा:  प्रपद्यन्ते नराधमाः।
माययाऽपहृतज्ञाना आसुरं भावमाश्रिताः॥
translation: पापशील विवेकहीन नराधम व्यक्ति माया के द्वारा हतज्ञान होकर आसुरीभाव को प्राप्त होते हुए मुझको प्राप्त नहीं होते हैं
english_translation: I believe that yoga is very difficult for one whose mind is uncontrolled; but one with a controlled mind can attain yoga through disciplined effort and proper methods.
essence: Yoga is nearly impossible with an uncontrolled mind but attainable through steady effort and discipline.
simple_meaning: Yoga is very hard to achieve if your mind is uncontrolled, but with control and effort, it becomes possible.
insight: It teaches you to channel restless energy into disciplined effort to unlock yoga’s fruits.
modern_relevance: You keep trying to focus but your mind jumps around. Yet with patience and steady effort, you find calm and progress.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
चतुर्विधा भजन्ते मां जनाः सुकृतिनो ननु।
आतॊ जिज्ञासुरर्थार्थी ज्ञानी च विबुधर्षभाः ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! आर्त्त, जिज्ञासु, अर्थार्थी और ज्ञानी, यह चार प्रकार के पुण्यात्मा व्यक्ति मेरी उपासना करते हैं
english_translation: Among all yogis, the one who worships me with faith and inner devotion is the highest yogi, in my view.
essence: True spiritual excellence comes from faithful, heartfelt worship of the divine.
simple_meaning: The best yogi is the one who worships the divine with sincere faith and an inner focused heart.
insight: It shifts focus from external practices to inner faith and heartfelt devotion as the true measure of spiritual success.
modern_relevance: When you fully trust and focus your heart in what you believe, you stand out as truly dedicated and connected.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तेषां ज्ञानी नित्ययुक्त एकभक्तिविशिष्यते।
प्रियो हि ज्ञानिनोऽत्यर्थमहं स च मम प्रियः ॥
translation: इनमे से ज्ञानी सर्वदा मुझमें निष्ठावान् और एकमात्र मुझमें ही भक्ति रखने वाला होने से श्रेष्ठ है, क्योंकि मैं  ज्ञानी भक्त का अतिप्रिय हूँ और वह भी मेरा प्रिय है।
english_translation: Those who perform evil deeds and lack discernment, the lowest among humans, do not seek me; they are lost in ignorance stolen by illusion and take on a shadowed nature.
essence: Ignorance and illusion block the lowest from reaching the true self.
simple_meaning: People who do wrong and lack clear understanding do not come to the true self; they are trapped by illusion and ego.
insight: It shows that ignorance and illusion create barriers to devotion and connection with the true self.
modern_relevance: You notice people caught in patterns of harmful behavior and confusion who resist deeper connection or clarity about themselves.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
उदाराः सर्व एवैते ज्ञानी त्वात्मैव मे मतम् ।
आस्थितः स हि युक्तात्मा मामेवानुत्तमां गतिम् ॥
translation: ये सब ही महान हैं परन्तु ज्ञानी मेरा ही स्वरूप है, यह मेरा मत है; क्योंकि वह ज्ञानी भक्त मुझमें एक चित्त होकर सर्वोत्तम गतिस्वरूप मुझको ही आश्रय करता है
english_translation: O divine beings! Four types of noble people worship me: the distressed, the seekers, the aim-driven, and the wise.
essence: Devotion takes many forms—pain, inquiry, purpose, and wisdom all lead inward.
simple_meaning: People approach devotion in four ways: through pain, seeking answers, pursuing goals, or through deep wisdom.
insight: It shifts your view to accept multiple valid paths of spiritual connection, freeing you from needing a single 'right' way.
modern_relevance: Whether you're suffering, searching, chasing goals, or reflecting deeply, your way of devotion is real and honored.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
बहूनां जन्मनामन्ते ज्ञानवान मां प्रपद्यते ।
परमात्मा सर्वमिति स महात्मा मुर्लभः ॥
translation: बहुत जन्म ग्रहण करनेके बाद ज्ञानवान् व्यक्ति “यह चराचरः विश्व ही परमात्मस्वरूप है " ऐसा अनुभव करके मुझको प्राप्त होता है, ऐसा महात्मा जगत में दुर्लभ है
english_translation: Among them, the wise one who is always devoted to me alone is superior, for I am exceedingly dear to the wise devotee, and he is dear to me.
essence: Steady, exclusive devotion creates a mutual, deep love between you and the divine.
simple_meaning: The person who is always devoted to the divine alone is the highest because the divine loves that devoted person greatly, and that person loves the divine.
insight: It teaches you to value unwavering devotion as a path that nurtures mutual love between you and the divine.
modern_relevance: When you remain consistently loyal and true in your care for something or someone, that bond deepens and becomes a source of genuine love and connection.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
कामैस्तैस्तैहिनज्ञानाः पद्यन्ते किलेतरान् ।
तं तं नियममास्थाय प्रकृत्या नियताः स्वया ॥
translation: सांसारिक अनेक प्रकार की कामनाओ से हतज्ञान व्यक्ति अनेक प्रकार के नियमों का अवलम्बन करके अपनी प्रकृति को नियमित करते हुए ही औरों की (देवतादि की) उपासना करते रहते हैं।
english_translation: All these are noble, but the true knower is my form; the united soul attains the highest state in me.
essence: True knowledge arises when your soul unites fully with the divine presence.
simple_meaning: Among all noble beings, the true knower is one whose soul is united with the divine and attains the highest state.
insight: It shifts your focus from external knowledge to inner unity as the true mark of wisdom.
modern_relevance: When you feel fully connected with your deepest values or purpose, you experience a calm that surpasses all external achievements.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यो यो यां यां तनुं भक्तः श्रद्धयाऽर्चितुमिच्छति ।
तस्य तस्याचलां श्रद्धां तामेव विदधाम्यहम् ॥
translation: जो जो भक्त जिस जिस मूर्ति की श्रद्धापूर्वक उपासना करने की इच्छा करता है, मैं उस उस भक्त की उस उस मूर्ति में वैसी ही दृढ़श्रद्धा विधान करता हूँ
english_translation: After many births, a wise person understands that I am the supreme self who pervades all beings; such a great soul is rare in the world.
essence: Only after many lifetimes does one realize the supreme self pervades all existence.
simple_meaning: After many lifetimes, a wise person realizes that the supreme self is present in everything and attains this rare understanding.
insight: It teaches you to recognize the unity behind all diversity, shifting from separation to oneness.
modern_relevance: You’ve lived through many challenges and lessons before finally recognizing that your true self connects deeply with everything around you.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
स तया श्रद्धया युक्तस्तस्याराधनमीहते ।
लभते च ततः कामान् मयैव विहितान हितान् ॥
translation: वह भक्त उस श्रद्धा से युक्त होकर उस मूर्ति की आराधना करता है और तदनन्तर मेरे ही द्वारा सम्पादित हितकारी उन सकल कामनाओं का लाभ करता है
english_translation: People lacking true wisdom follow various rules and regulate their nature through many desires, while worshipping others.
essence: Following many rules driven by desires lacks true wisdom and fails to bring real guidance.
simple_meaning: Without true wisdom, people get caught in many desires and follow various rules to control themselves, but this does not lead to real understanding.
insight: It teaches you to see that real wisdom comes before rules; otherwise, desire-driven actions only create more confusion.
modern_relevance: You might follow countless habits or rules to manage your life, but without clarity, these efforts leave you feeling stuck and confused.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अन्तवत्तु फलं तेषां तद्भवत्यल्पमेधसाम् ।
अन्यानन्ययजो यान्ति मद्भक्ता यान्ति मामपि ॥
translation: परन्तु उन क्षुद्रबुद्धि व्यक्तियों का वह फल विनाशशील है क्योकि औरो की उपासना करने वाले अन्य लोको को प्राप्त होते हैं और मेरे भक्त मुझको प्राप्त होते हैं
english_translation: For every devotee wishing to worship a form with faith, I establish that devotee's firm faith in that very form.
essence: Sincere devotion to any form is met by the divine strengthening your faith in it.
simple_meaning: When you truly wish to worship a form with faith, that faith is firmly established within you by the divine.
insight: It shifts your trust inward, showing that faith grows as a response to your honest desire to connect.
modern_relevance: You may feel uncertain when you choose how to express your devotion or spirituality; this reminds you that sincere intent alone deepens your inner trust.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अव्यक्तं व्यक्तिमापनं मन्यन्ते मामबुद्धयः।
परं भावमजानन्तो ममाव्ययमनुत्तमम् ॥
translation: अल्पबुद्धि व्यक्ति मेरे नित्य सर्वोत्तम और परमस्वरूप को न जानकर, मैं अव्यक्त अर्थात् मायातीत हूँ, तब भी मुझको व्यक्तिभाव को प्राप्त समझते हैं
english_translation: One who worships the form with faith obtains by me the fulfillment of all beneficial desires.
essence: Faithful devotion invites the divine to fulfill all your true and beneficial desires.
simple_meaning: If you worship with genuine faith, the divine grants you all beneficial desires destined for your well-being.
insight: It teaches you to surrender outcomes with full trust, shifting focus from effort to faith.
modern_relevance: You pray or dedicate your efforts wholeheartedly, then feel comforted knowing the universe supports your true well-being.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तस्मात् सर्वेषु कालेषु मामनुस्मरतामराः ।
मप्यर्पितमतिस्वान्ता मामसंशयमेष्यथ ॥
translation: इस कारण हे देवतागण ! सर्वदा मुझको स्मरण करना चाहिए, मुझमें मन और बुद्धि को अर्पण करने पर निःसन्देह आपलोग मुझको प्राप्त होगे
english_translation: But the result of the small-minded is destruction; those who worship others go to other realms, while my devotees come to me.
essence: Devotion to the true self leads to connection; scattered worship leads to loss.
simple_meaning: Those with limited understanding who worship others face destruction, but devoted followers reach the divine.
insight: It shifts your focus from chasing many distractions to committing fully to one true path of devotion.
modern_relevance: When your focus and loyalty are scattered, your efforts often lead nowhere, but dedicated commitment brings you closer to what truly matters.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अभ्यासयोगयुक्तेन चेतसा नान्यगामिना ।
परमं पूरुषं दिव्यं भक्तो यात्यनुचिन्तयन् ॥
translation: अभ्यास योग द्वारा एकाग्र और अनन्यगामी चित्त से चिन्ता करते करते साधक दिव्य परमपुरुष को प्राप्त होता है
english_translation: Those with little understanding mistake me for the manifest form, not knowing my imperishable supreme nature beyond manifestation.
essence: The true self is beyond all visible forms and is eternally supreme.
simple_meaning: People with limited understanding see only the visible form and miss the deeper, unchanging supreme reality beyond it.
insight: It teaches you to look beyond external appearances and recognize the unchanging essence beneath.
modern_relevance: You might judge yourself or others by surface traits, missing the deeper qualities that truly define a person.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
कविं पुराणमनुशासितार मणोरणीयांसमनुस्मरेदयः।
सर्वस्य धातारमचिन्त्यरूपमादित्यवर्ण तमसः परस्तात् ॥
translation: कवि (सर्वज्ञ )पुराण (अनादि ) अनुशासिता (नियन्ता) सूक्ष्म से भी सूक्ष्मतम, सबका पालन करने वाला, अचिन्त्यरूप, प्रकृति से परे स्थित, सूर्य के समान वर्ण वाले
english_translation: Therefore, O radiant beings, always remember me; by dedicating your mind and discernment to me, you will surely attain me without doubt.
essence: Remembering the divine fully with mind and wisdom removes doubt and ensures connection.
simple_meaning: You should always remember the divine and dedicate your mind and wisdom to that remembrance to truly connect and reach the true self.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate continuous mindful devotion as a way to overcome doubt and deepen connection.
modern_relevance: When your mind wanders in distraction, simply bringing your focus back to your core purpose or belief can restore calm and clarity.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
प्रयाणकाले मनसाऽचलेन भक्त्या युक्तो योगबलेन चैव ।
भ्रुवोर्मध्ये प्राणमावेश्य सम्यक् स तं परं पुरुषमुपैति दिव्यम् ॥
translation: पुरुष का, शरीरत्याग के समय भकियुक्त होकर स्थिर चित्र से योगबल द्वारा भ्रूयुगल के मध्य में प्राणवायु को भलीभांति स्थिर करके जो ध्यान करता है वह उस दिव्य परमात्मस्वरुप पुरुष को प्राप्त होता है
english_translation: Through disciplined practice with a focused and single-minded mind, the devotee attains the divine supreme being by constant contemplation.
essence: Steady, focused practice and mind lead the devotee to the divine supreme being.
simple_meaning: By practicing with a concentrated and unwavering mind, you gradually reach the divine supreme being through devoted contemplation.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate unwavering focus and disciplined practice to connect deeply with your higher purpose.
modern_relevance: When you keep your attention fixed on a meaningful goal without distraction, you move steadily toward deep fulfillment.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यदक्षरं वेदविदो वदन्ति विशन्ति यद्यतयो वीतरागाः।
यदिच्छन्तो ब्रह्मचर्य चरान्ति तद्वः पदं संग्रहेण प्रवक्ष्ये ॥
translation: ब्रह्मागण जिसको अक्षर कहते हैं, वीतराग यतिगण जिसमें प्रवेश करते हैं और जिसको जानने की इच्छा करके साधक ब्रह्मचर्य व्रत धारण करते हैं मैं आपलोगों को वह पद संक्षेप से कहता हूँ
english_translation: Remember the ancient supreme seer, the subtle controller, the nourisher of all, whose form is beyond thought and beyond darkness, radiant like the sun.
essence: A radiant, ancient presence nourishes all beyond thought and darkness.
simple_meaning: This verse describes the supreme seer as ancient, subtle, the nourisher of all, beyond thought and darkness, radiant like the sun.
insight: It invites recognizing a nourishing presence beyond all limitations and mental grasp.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
सर्वद्वाराणि संयम्य मनो हदि निरुध्य च ।
मून्याधायात्मनः प्राणमास्थितो योगधारणम् ॥
translation: सब इन्द्रियो को उनके विषयो से प्रत्याहरण करके मन को हृदय में  स्थिर करके और मूर्द्धा अर्थात् सहस्रार में अपने प्राण को रखकर योगधारणा में स्थिर होता हुआ और
english_translation: At the time of leaving the body, one who with steady mind and devotion, by the power of yoga, firmly holds the life force between the eyebrows attains that supreme divine being.
essence: Steady devotion and focused life force at departure reveal the supreme divine.
simple_meaning: At death, focusing your calm mind with devotion and steady yoga power on the life force between your eyebrows helps you reach the supreme divine being.
insight: It teaches you to stabilize your inner energy with devotion at critical moments to connect with your higher self.
modern_relevance: When facing big endings or transitions, steady focus and heartfelt devotion can help you move beyond fear and uncertainty toward peace.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ओमित्येकाक्षरं ब्रह्म व्याहरन् मामनुस्मरन् ।
यः प्रयाति सजन देहं स याति परमां गतिम् ॥
translation: ॐ इस एकाक्षर ब्रह्मस्वरूप मन्त्र का  उच्चारण करता हुआ मुझको स्मरण करके स्थूल देह को त्याग करके जाता है वह परमगति रूपी मुक्तिपद को प्राप्त करता है।
english_translation: I will briefly describe the state that the learned call imperishable, the detached ascetics enter, and which seekers attain through celibacy.
essence: Detachment and disciplined celibacy lead seekers into the imperishable state of freedom.
simple_meaning: There is a special state beyond change that wise, detached people enter and seekers reach by practicing celibacy. This verse introduces that state briefly.
insight: It teaches that disciplined renunciation leads to an unchanging inner state beyond the restless mind.
modern_relevance: You’ve faced moments when giving up distractions and desires felt necessary to find lasting clarity and calm.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अनन्यचेताः सततं यो मां स्मरात नित्यशः।
तस्याहं सुलभो देवाः ! निसयुक्तस्य योगिनः ॥
translation: अनन्य चित्त होकर जो मेरा सब समय नियमित रूप से चिन्तन करता है, हे देवतागण ! नित्ययुक्त उस योगी के लिये मैं सुलभ हूँ
english_translation: Withdrawing all the senses from their objects, fixing the mind in the heart, and placing the life force in the crown, one remains steady in yoga concentration.
essence: Steady concentration arises by withdrawing senses and centering life force within.
simple_meaning: You control your senses by turning them away from distractions, focus your mind inside your heart, and stabilize your life energy at the crown to hold steady in meditation.
insight: It teaches you to actively still your senses and center your vital energy to hold concentration without distraction.
modern_relevance: When your phone, noise, and thoughts pull you every way, you quiet the chaos by turning your focus inward and holding your breath steady.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
मामुपेय पुनर्जन्म दुःखालयमशाश्वतम् ।
नाप्नुवन्ति महात्मानः संसिद्धिं परमां गताः॥
translation: महात्मागण मुझको प्राप्त करके पुनः त्रिताप के आलयरूप अनित्य जन्म को प्राप्त नहीं होते क्योंकि वह परासिद्धि रूपी मोक्ष को प्राप्त हुए हैं
english_translation: Whoever utters the one-syllable Om, remembering me, leaves the physical body and attains the supreme state.
essence: Remembering the divine with Om frees your true self beyond the physical form.
simple_meaning: Saying the sacred syllable Om while remembering the divine leads your true self beyond the physical body to the highest freedom.
insight: It teaches you to use remembrance and the sacred syllable Om as a simple, powerful practice to transcend physical limits.
modern_relevance: When life feels overwhelming, quietly recalling a sacred sound and your connection to the divine can help you feel grounded and move beyond stress.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
आब्रह्मभुवनाल्लोकाः पुनरावर्तिनोऽमराः।
मामुपेत्य तु गीर्वाणाः ! पुनर्जन्म न विद्यते ॥
translation: हे अमरगण ! ब्रह्मलोक से भी आकर सब लोग पुनः पुनः जन्म ग्रहण करते हैं परन्तु हे देवतागण ! मुझको प्राप्त करके पुनर्जन्म की प्राप्ति नहीं होती है
english_translation: I am easily reached by the yogi who constantly remembers me with focused mind alone.
essence: Focused, constant remembrance opens a direct path to the divine presence.
simple_meaning: If you constantly remember the divine with full focus and no distractions, the divine becomes easily accessible to you.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate constant, focused remembrance, making connection effortless.
modern_relevance: You find peace when you return your full attention to what truly matters, cutting through daily distractions.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अवजानन्ति मां मूढाः सगुणां तनुमाश्रितम् ।
परं भावमजानन्तो मम भूतमहेश्वरम् ॥
translation: मूर्ख व्यक्तिगण सर्वभूतों के महेश्वररूपी मेरे परमभाव को न जानकर मुझको सगुण देहधारी देखकर
english_translation: Great beings who have attained me do not take rebirth in the transient world of suffering; they have reached supreme perfection.
essence: Those who reach the divine no longer return to suffering and rebirth.
simple_meaning: Those who have reached the divine do not return to the endless cycle of painful rebirth; they have attained ultimate freedom.
insight: This verse shifts focus from fearing repeated hardship to seeking lasting freedom through inner realization.
modern_relevance: When you feel trapped by repeated failures or hardships, remember freedom from these cycles is possible by realizing your true nature.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
मोघाश मोघकर्मणो मोघज्ञाना विचेतस: ।
राक्षसीमासुरीश्चैव प्रकृति मोहिनीं श्रिताः ॥
translation: बुद्धिभ्रंशकारी आसुरी और राक्षसी प्रकृति को धारण करने वाले, विफलाशाकारी, विफल कर्मा, अध्यात्मज्ञानरहित, विषय से चंचल चित्त मूर्ख मुझको सगुण देहधारी देखकर मेरी अवज्ञा करते हैं
english_translation: All beings of the higher realms return again and again to birth; but those who reach me do not take birth again.
essence: Reaching the divine ends the endless cycle of rebirth.
simple_meaning: Even beings from the highest realms are born again, but those who reach the divine avoid rebirth forever.
insight: It shifts the mind from fearing endless repetition toward seeking a state beyond cycles through connection with the divine.
modern_relevance: When you feel trapped in repeated struggles or patterns, this shows reaching a deeper center can free you from repeating old cycles.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
महात्मानस्तु मां देवा:! दैवीं प्रकृतिमिश्रता: ।
भजन्त्यनन्यमनसो ज्ञात्वा भूतादिमव्ययम् ॥
translation: परन्तु हे देवतागण ! दैवीप्रकृतियुक्त महात्मागण अनन्यचित्त होकर मुझको जगत कारण और नित्य स्वरूप जानकार मेरी उपासना किया करते हैं
english_translation: Fools mistake me, the great lord of all beings, for merely a being with qualities, not knowing my supreme reality.
essence: Your true nature is beyond the qualities and form others see.
simple_meaning: People who see only the body with qualities do not understand the supreme and true nature behind it.
insight: It shifts your view from identifying with your external traits to recognizing your eternal true nature.
modern_relevance: When others judge you by your role or appearance, remember your deeper true self remains untouched and vast.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सततं कीर्तयन्तो मां यतन्तश्च दृढव्रताः।
नमस्यन्तश्च मां भत्तया नित्ययुक्ता उपासते ॥
translation: उनमें से कोई कोई सर्वदा मेरा कीर्तन करते हैं, कोई कोई दृढ़निमय से युक्त होकर प्रयत्नशील होते हैं, कोई कोई भक्ति के साथ प्रणाम करते हैं और कोई कोई नित्य युक्त होकर मेरी उपासना करते हैं।
english_translation: Those who are deluded, engaged in fruitless actions and knowledge, and who embody a demonic and cruel nature, become captivated by the illusion of the manifested divine form and disrespect me.
essence: Empty knowledge and actions born of confusion cause disrespect and blindness to the divine reality.
simple_meaning: People who act without true understanding, who pursue useless knowledge and actions, and who have a harsh, confused nature, become trapped by illusions and disrespect the divine form.
insight: This verse teaches you to discern the difference between meaningful wisdom and empty knowledge, freeing your mind from illusions.
modern_relevance: You may work hard or seek knowledge but still feel lost, disrespected, or disconnected when your efforts lack true clarity or purpose.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ज्ञानयज्ञेन चाप्यन्ये यजन्तो मामुपासते।
एकत्वेन पृथक्त्वेन बहुधा विश्वतोमुखम् ॥
translation: अन्य कोई कोई ज्ञानयज्ञ द्वारा भी पूजा करके मेरी उपासना करते हैं, उनमेंसे कोई कोई अभेदभाव से, कोई कोई दासभाव से और कोई कोई मुझे सनात्मक जानकर नाना प्रकार से पासना करते हैं
english_translation: But the great souls among the radiant beings, united with the divine nature, worship me with single-hearted devotion, knowing me as the cause of the world and the eternal reality.
essence: Devoted love arises from knowing the eternal source behind all that exists.
simple_meaning: Great souls connected to the divine nature worship the source of all things with devoted single-heartedness.
insight: It teaches you to unify your heart around the inner source, turning knowledge into devoted action.
modern_relevance: When you recognize the deeper cause behind your life’s challenges and successes, your heart naturally opens to sincere devotion and trust.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अनन्याश्चिन्तयन्तो मां ये जनाः पर्युपासते।
तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेम वहाम्यहम् ॥
translation: अन्य देवताओं की उपासना करके मुझे ही स्मरण करते हुए जो उपासना करते हैं, उन नित्य मत्परायण आवश् विषयों  को मैं वहन करता हूँ
english_translation: Some constantly sing my praise, some firmly strive with vows, some bow with devoted love, and some always worship me with dedication.
essence: Devotion to the divine flows through many sincere, personal expressions.
simple_meaning: Different people express their devotion in various ways—some sing praises, some make firm vows and strive, some bow with love, and others worship continuously with dedication.
insight: It teaches you to honor your own authentic way of devotion without comparing or doubting your practice.
modern_relevance: You might see friends honoring their beliefs through music, disciplined practice, respectful rituals, or quiet daily dedication—each path is genuine and meaningful.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति ।
तदहं भक्त्युपहृतमश्नामि प्रयतात्मनः ॥
translation: जो मुझको भक्तिपूर्वक पत्र पुष्प फल और जल अर्पण करता है मैं उस संयतात्मा द्वारा भक्ति पूर्वक अर्पित वे पत्र पुष्पादि ग्रहण करता हूँ
english_translation: Others worship me through the sacrifice of knowledge; some with unity, some with separation, and some in many ways, all facing different directions.
essence: Devotion to the divine can take many valid forms, unified or diverse.
simple_meaning: People worship the divine through knowledge in many ways: with unity, separation, or diverse approaches from all around.
insight: Accept that devotion can express itself in diverse ways without losing its sincerity or connection.
modern_relevance: You might see people praying or meditating differently—some quietly focused, some broadly inclusive—but all their sincere efforts connect to the divine.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
समोऽहं सर्वभूतेषु न मे द्वेष्योऽस्ति न प्रियः ।
ये भजन्ति तु मां भक्त्या माये ते तेषु चाप्यहम् ॥
translation: मैं सकल भूतों में समानरूप से अवस्थित हूँ अतः मेरा प्रिय और द्वेष्य कोई नहीं है किन्तु जो मेरी भक्तिपूर्वक उपासना करते हैं वह मुझमें स्थित हैं और मैं भी उनमें स्थित हूँ
english_translation: Those who always think of me alone and worship me with exclusive devotion, I protect the yoga practice and well-being of such steadfast beings.
essence: Exclusive devotion invites the divine’s care and protection for your spiritual wellbeing.
simple_meaning: If you worship the divine alone with constant devotion, the divine supports and protects your spiritual practice and wellbeing.
insight: It teaches you to commit your attention completely, trusting that this focus brings protection and sustains your path.
modern_relevance: When you commit to a practice or belief fully, without distraction, you gain support and strength to continue, no matter the challenges.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अपि चेत्सुदुराचारो भजते मामनन्यभाक् ।
साधुरेव स मन्तव्यः सम्यगव्यवसितो हि सः॥
translation: यदि अत्यन्त दुराचारी व्यक्ति भी अनन्य-भक्तियुक्त होकर मेरी उपासना करे तो उसको भी साधु ही मानना चाहिये क्योंकि वह उत्तम यत्न कर रहा है
english_translation: Whoever offers me leaves, flowers, fruit, and water with devoted love, I accept those offerings made with devotion by the self-controlled.
essence: Devotion and self-control make every offering accepted by the divine.
simple_meaning: The divine accepts any simple offering given with devotion and self-control.
insight: It shifts your focus from the size of the gift to the sincerity behind it.
modern_relevance: You might think your small acts of kindness or care go unnoticed, but sincere devotion makes them meaningful and received fully.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
क्षिप्रं भवति धर्मात्मा शश्वच्छान्तिं निगच्छति ।
हे देवाः ! खलु जानीत न मे भक्तः प्रणश्यति ॥
translation: अत्यन्त दुराचारी व्यक्ति भी मेरी उपसना करने पर शीघ्र धर्मात्मा हो जाता है और निरंतर शांति को प्राप्त  करता है हे देवगण ! मेरा भक्त नाशको नहीं प्राप्त होता है, यह तुम निश्चय जानो
english_translation: I am equally present in all beings; I have no favorite or enemy. Those who worship me with devotion are in me, and I am in them.
essence: The divine is equally present in all beings and intimately present with devoted ones.
simple_meaning: The divine is equally present in every being without preference or dislike. When you worship with devotion, you and the divine dwell within each other.
insight: It invites you to see devotion as a relationship where you and the divine truly coexist, dissolving separation.
modern_relevance: When you feel isolated or judged, remember that the divine sees all equally and is accessible through sincere devotion, creating a shared presence beyond differences.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
मां हि देवाः ! व्यपाश्रित्य येऽपि स्युः पापयोनयः ।
स्त्रियो वैश्यास्तथा शूद्रास्तेऽपि यान्ति परां गतिम् ॥
translation: क्योंकि हे देवगण ! पापयोनि सम्भूत स्त्रियां वैश्य और शूद्र चाहे कोई भी हो मेरा आश्रय लेकर परम गति को प्राप्त होते हैं
english_translation: Even a very wrongdoer who worships me with exclusive devotion should be considered a good person because they are truly focused.
essence: Pure devotion transforms even the worst past into goodness.
simple_meaning: If someone with a bad past sincerely worships with exclusive devotion, they should be seen as good because their focus is true.
insight: It shifts your view from judging by past actions to valuing the sincerity of your current devotion.
modern_relevance: You might judge yourself harshly for past mistakes, but wholehearted sincerity in what you truly care for changes everything.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
किं पुनर्ब्राह्मणाः पुण्या भक्ता राजर्षयस्तथा ।
अनित्यमसुखं लोकं भजध्वामिममेत्य माम् ॥
translation: सुकृतिशाली ब्राह्मण और भक्तिमान् राजर्षिगण की तो बात ही क्या है अतः तुम इस कष्टप्रद और अनित्य लोक को प्राप्त होकर मेरी उपासना करो
english_translation: Even a deeply unrighteous person quickly becomes righteous and attains steady peace by worshipping me; know for certain, my devotee never perishes.
essence: Sincere devotion transforms even the most unrighteous into steady peace and righteousness.
simple_meaning: Anyone, no matter how unrighteous, can become good and find lasting peace by worshipping the divine. A true devotee never loses their way.
insight: It teaches you to trust that sincere devotion can swiftly change your inner state, no matter your past.
modern_relevance: When you feel lost in mistakes or bad choices, know that sincere devotion can quickly bring you back to steadiness and peace.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
मन्मनस्काः स्त मे भक्ता याजिनो नमताऽमराः!।
मामेवैष्यथ युक्त्वैवमात्मानं मत्परायणाः ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! आपलोग मद्गतचित्त, मेरे भक्त और मेरे उपासक होकर और मुझे नमस्कार करो, इस प्रकार मत्परायण होकर मन को मुझ में ही युक्त करने से मुझको ही प्राप्त होगे
english_translation: Because, O radiant beings, even those born in sinful families — women, merchants, and laborers — attain the highest state by taking refuge in me.
essence: Sincere refuge in the divine allows anyone to reach the highest spiritual state.
simple_meaning: Anyone, regardless of birth or social status, who takes refuge in the divine attains the highest spiritual state.
insight: It shifts the mind from exclusion based on identity to inclusion based on sincere devotion.
modern_relevance: You might feel limited by your background or status, but true transformation is available to anyone who sincerely seeks support beyond themselves.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
मच्चित्ता मद्गतप्राणा बोधयन्तः परस्परम् ।
कथयन्तश्च मां निसं तुष्यन्ति च रमन्ति च ॥
translation: जिनका चित्त केवल मुझ में ही रत है और जिनका प्राण केवल मेरे में ही अर्पित है, ऐसे व्यक्ति परस्पर मेरे स्वरूप का ज्ञान कराते हुए एवं सदा मेरा कीर्तन करते हुए सन्तोष और शान्ति को प्राप्त होते हैं
english_translation: What need is there to speak of virtuous Brahmins and devoted royal sages? Therefore, come to this painful and temporary world and worship me.
essence: You don't need to be perfect to worship the divine in this temporary world.
simple_meaning: You don't have to be a perfect Brahmin or sage to worship the divine; come as you are to this temporary and difficult world and offer your devotion.
insight: It removes the barrier of needing achievement before devotion, encouraging immediate heartfelt connection.
modern_relevance: You feel overwhelmed by not being 'spiritual enough' or perfect but still want to connect with something greater; this invites you to begin now without waiting.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तेषां सततयुक्तानां भजतां प्रीतिपूर्वकम् ।
ददामि बुद्धियोगं तं येन मामुपयान्ति ते ॥
translation: सदा मुझ में अर्पित चित्त एवं प्रीतिपूर्वक मेरी उपासना करने वाले उन भक्तो को मैं उस बुद्धियोग ज्ञान को प्रदान करता हूँ जिससे वह मुझ को प्राप्त हो जाते हैं।
english_translation: O radiant beings! Devote yourselves to me with focused minds, bow in reverence, and you will surely reach me by dedicating your hearts to me alone.
essence: Complete devotion focused inward leads directly to union with the divine.
simple_meaning: You become devoted and connected to the divine by focusing your mind and heart fully on it.
insight: It teaches you to center your mind and heart fully on your chosen devotion, making that focus your true path.
modern_relevance: When your attention and care are fully committed to what matters most, you find deeper connection and fulfillment.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तेषामेवानुकम्पार्थमहमज्ञानजं तमः ।
नाशयाम्यात्मभावस्थो ज्ञानदीपेन भास्वता ॥
translation: उनके हित के अर्थ ही मैं उनकी बुद्धिवृत्ति में अवस्थित होकर प्रकाशमान तत्त्वज्ञानरूप दीप द्वारा उनके अज्ञान रुपी अन्धकार का नाश करता हूँ
english_translation: Those whose mind is fixed on me and whose life force is dedicated to me, they teach each other about my nature, sing my praise, and find lasting joy and peace.
essence: Shared devotion creates joyful connection and lasting peace among those devoted.
simple_meaning: People who keep their mind and life dedicated to the divine teach and remind each other of that connection, creating happiness and peace together.
insight: It teaches you to nurture your spiritual focus by engaging in loving, joyful community with others.
modern_relevance: You connect deeply with friends who share your passion and values, lifting each other up in shared purpose and joy.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
मय्यावश्य मनो ये मां नित्ययुक्ता उपासते ।
श्रद्धया परयोपेतास्ते मे युक्ततमा मताः ॥
translation: मुझमें मन को एकाग्र करके, सर्वदा मुझमें  युक्त रहकर एवं परम श्रद्धान्वित होकर जो मेरी उपासना करते हैं वे मेरी सम्मति में युक्ततम अर्थात् प्रधान योगी हैं
english_translation: I give the wisdom of discriminating yoga to those who always worship me with devoted love, by which they come to me.
essence: Devoted love grants the wisdom that leads directly to the divine.
simple_meaning: If you continuously worship with genuine love, you receive the wisdom that guides you to the divine.
insight: It teaches you that devoted love is the key that unlocks deeper understanding and connection.
modern_relevance: When you dedicate yourself with sincere care and love, you naturally gain the insight that guides you through confusion.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ये त्वक्षरमनिर्देश्यमव्यक्तं पर्युपासते ।
सर्वत्रगमाचन्त्यञ्च कूटस्थमचलं ध्रुवम् ॥
translation: जो व्यक्ति अनिर्वचनीय, रूपादिविहीन, सर्वव्यापी, अचिन्त्य, स्थिर,नित्य, अविनाशी कूटस्थ की उपासना करते हैं
english_translation: For their benefit, I, abiding in their intellect, destroy the darkness born of ignorance with the bright lamp of true knowledge.
essence: True knowledge inside you destroys the darkness born of ignorance.
simple_meaning: The divine dwells in your mind, shining the light of true knowledge to remove your ignorance and confusion.
insight: It teaches you to trust the inner clarity that can dissolve confusion from within your own awareness.
modern_relevance: When confusion clouds your decisions, imagine a steady light within your mind clearing away doubt and fear.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सनियम्येन्द्रियग्रामं सर्वत्र समबुद्धयः ।
ते प्राप्नुवन्ति मामेव सर्वभूतहिते रताः ॥
translation: किन्तु सर्वत्र समबुद्धियुक्त इन्द्रियों को अच्छी तरह से संयत करके सकलभूतों के हितकारी वह व्यक्ति मुझे ही प्राप्त होते हैं।
english_translation: Those who always fix their mind on me, remain devoted, and worship me with supreme trust are considered my highest yogis.
essence: Deep, constant focus combined with supreme trust makes you the highest devotee.
simple_meaning: If you keep your mind focused on the divine, stay devoted, and trust deeply, you become the highest kind of devotee.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate continuous mental focus and heartfelt trust to deepen your devotion.
modern_relevance: When your thoughts stay calm and focused on what truly matters, and you trust the process deeply, you find your strongest inner alignment.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
क्लेशोऽधिकतरस्तेषामव्यक्तासक्तचेतसाम् ।
अव्यक्ता हि गतिर्दुःखं प्राणभृद्भिरवाप्यते ॥
translation: अव्यक्त में जिनका चित्त आसक्त हुआ है उनको अधिक परिश्रम करना पड़ता है क्योंकि मेरे अव्यक्तरूप में निष्ठा प्राणियों को कठिनता से प्राप्त
english_translation: Those who meditate on the imperishable, indefinable, formless, all-pervading, unthinkable, unmoving, eternal, and unchanging reality.
essence: True meditation is on the timeless, formless reality beyond all appearances.
simple_meaning: You can meditate on the true reality that is formless, eternal, and unchanging beyond all description.
insight: It shifts your mind from chasing fleeting forms to resting in the steady reality beneath all change.
modern_relevance: When your thoughts overwhelm you, turning attention to something steady and unchanging calms your mind and restores balance.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ये तु सर्वाणि कर्माणि मायि सन्न्यस्य मत्पराः ।
अनन्येनैव योगेन मां ध्यायन्त उपासते ॥
translation: किन्तु जो एकान्त भक्ति योग द्वारा सब कर्म मुझमें अर्पण करके मत्परायण होकर मेरा ध्यान करते हुए उपासना करते हैं
english_translation: But those who control all their senses everywhere, with equal intellect, devoted to the welfare of all beings, attain only me.
essence: Balanced self-control combined with care for all leads directly to the divine.
simple_meaning: By mastering all your senses with steady intellect and focusing on the good of everyone, you connect with the divine.
insight: It shifts focus from indulging the senses to balancing them with intellect and universal care, transforming action into devotion.
modern_relevance: You face distractions pulling you every way, but when you hold steady and care beyond yourself, you feel grounded and connected.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तेषामहं समुद्धर्ता मृत्युसंसारसागरात् ।
भवामि नचिरादेवाः ! मय्यावेशितचेतसाम ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! मैं मृत्युयुक्त संसार समुद्र से मुझमें निवेशित चित्त उन भक्तों का शीघ्र उद्धार करता हूँ
english_translation: Those whose minds are attached to the unmanifested face many troubles, but the unmanifested state is the difficult-to-reach refuge for the life-bearers.
essence: Clinging to the unseen increases struggle because reaching that hidden state is difficult.
simple_meaning: When your mind clings to what is unseen and unclear, you face more difficulties because reaching that hidden state is very hard.
insight: It teaches you to notice when your mind clings to unclear things and how that increases your struggle.
modern_relevance: You’ve tried to hold onto unclear feelings or vague hopes, only to find yourself more stressed and restless.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
मय्येव मन आधद्ध्वं माय बुद्धिर्निवेश्यताम्।
निवसिष्यथ मय्येव अत ऊर्दध्वं न संशयः ॥
translation: मुझ में ही मन स्थिर करो और मुझ में ही बुद्धिसंनिवेश करो तो इससे आगे मुझमे ही निवास करोगे इसमें सन्देह नहीं है
english_translation: But those who dedicate all their actions to me with exclusive devotion and meditate on me with focused love.
essence: Complete devotion turns every action into a meditation on the divine presence.
simple_meaning: You can offer every action to the divine with exclusive, loving focus and devotion.
insight: It teaches you to unify your daily actions by dedicating them wholeheartedly to your true inner focus.
modern_relevance: When you fully commit your work or care for others with loving focus, your actions become expressions of devotion, not just tasks.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अथ चित्तं समाधातुं न शक्नुथ मयि स्थिरम् ।
अभ्यासयोगेन तत इच्छताप्तुं सुराः ! हि माम् ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! यदि मुझमें चित्त को स्थिर न रख सको तो अभ्यास योग द्वारा मुझे प्राप्त करने की इच्छा करो
english_translation: O divine beings! I swiftly rescue those devoted whose minds are immersed in me from the ocean of death and rebirth.
essence: Devoted minds receive swift rescue from the cycle of rebirth and death.
simple_meaning: The divine says they quickly save those whose minds are focused on them from the endless cycle of life and death.
insight: It teaches you to trust that sincere devotion activates swift support beyond your struggles.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by repeated struggles, focusing your heart deeply on what grounds you brings rapid relief and rescue.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अभ्यासेऽप्यसमथर्मे भूयतां कर्म्मतत्परैः।
मदर्थमपि कर्माणि कुद्भिः सिद्धिरेष्यते ॥
translation: यदि अभ्यास करने में भी असमर्थ हो तो मेरे कर्मों में निरत हो, केवल मेरे लिये ही सब कर्मों को करते हुए भी सिद्धि को प्राप्त होगे
english_translation: Fix your mind in me alone; let your intellect dwell in me alone. There is no doubt you will then reside in me alone beyond.
essence: Fixing your mind and intellect on the divine leads to unwavering spiritual residence.
simple_meaning: You should steady your mind and intellect by focusing them on the divine. Doing this lets you live fully connected to the divine without doubt.
insight: Focus your restless mind and discerning intellect exclusively on the divine to steady your inner state.
modern_relevance: When your thoughts and decisions are fully focused on what truly matters, you find a calm sense of belonging beyond distractions.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अथैतदप्यशक्ताः स्थ क मदद्योगमाश्रिताः।
सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं यतात्मानो विधत्त वै ॥
translation: यदि इसके करने में भी असमर्थ हो तो एकमात्र मेरे शरणागत और संयतचित्त होकर सब कर्मों के फलों का त्याग करों
english_translation: O divine beings, if you cannot keep your mind steady on me, then desire to attain me through the practice of yoga.
essence: Steady focus on the divine grows through disciplined practice, even if it feels impossible.
simple_meaning: If you can’t keep your mind steady on the divine, then practice yoga regularly to develop that steadiness.
insight: It shifts your mindset from expecting instant focus to valuing disciplined, gradual improvement.
modern_relevance: When your mind keeps jumping between tasks and distractions, the only way forward is steady, consistent practice.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां भैत्रः करुण एव च ।
निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः समदुःखसुखः क्षमी ॥
translation: समस्त प्राणियों का, अद्वेष्टा, मित्र और कृपालु, ममताहीन, निरहङ्कार, सुख दुःख में समता समझने वाला, क्षमावान,
english_translation: If you cannot even practice, then be devoted to my actions; by performing all actions for me alone, you will attain success.
essence: Devotion to purposeful action brings success even when steady practice fails.
simple_meaning: If you find it hard to keep up practice, dedicate yourself to doing actions for the divine alone to achieve success.
insight: It shifts your effort from self-focused discipline to purpose-driven action, making success more attainable.
modern_relevance: You feel burnt out trying to maintain daily habits. Instead, redirect your energy to meaningful work dedicated to a cause bigger than yourself.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सन्तुष्टः सततं योगी यतात्मा दृढनिश्चयः।
मय्यार्पतमनोबुद्धियों मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः ॥
translation: सदा सन्तुष्ट, संयतचित्त योगी मेरी ओर स्थिर लक्ष्य रखने वाला, और मुझमें मन और बुद्धि को समर्पण करने वाला जो मेरा भक्त है वह मेरा प्रिय है
english_translation: If you are still unable, then take refuge in me alone with controlled mind and renounce the fruits of all actions.
essence: When struggling, steady your mind and renounce attachment to all action results.
simple_meaning: If you feel powerless, take refuge in steady focus and give up attachment to all results of your actions.
insight: Shift from struggling to control outcomes to steady trust and renouncing results, calming your efforts.
modern_relevance: When everything feels overwhelming and you can't control results, grounding yourself and releasing expectations brings relief.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यस्मानोद्विजते लोको लोकानोद्विजने च यः।
हर्षामर्षभयोद्वेगैर्मुक्तो यः म च मे प्रियः ॥
translation: जिसके द्वारा संसार उद्विग्न नहीं होता है, जो संसार से उद्विग्न नहीं होता है और जो हर्ष अमर्ष (अन्य को लाभ होनेसे कातर होना ) भय और चित्तक्षोभ से रहित है वह मेरा प्रिय है
english_translation: One who harbours no hatred towards any being, is a friend and compassionate, free from attachment and ego, equal in sorrow and joy, and forgiving.
essence: True friendship and compassion arise when you release hatred and ego.
simple_meaning: You can be a true friend to all by dropping hate, ego, and attachment, staying calm through highs and lows, and forgiving others.
insight: It teaches shifting from reactive hatred and ego to steady compassion and forgiveness.
modern_relevance: You meet frustration and stress at work or home, but choosing kindness without ego helps you stay steady and forgiving.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अनपेक्षः शुचिर्दन उदासीनो गतव्यथः ।
सर्बारम्भपरित्यागी यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः ॥
translation: सकल विषयों में निःस्पृह, शुचि, चतुर, उदासीन, जिसको व्यथा नहीं होती, और सब सङ्कल्पों का त्याग करने वाला जो मेरा भक्त है वह मेरा प्रिय है
english_translation: The yogi who is always content, disciplined, firmly resolved, and who surrenders mind and intellect to me with devotion is dear to me.
essence: Firm contentment and surrendered devotion make you dear to the divine.
simple_meaning: You become dear by being always content, steady in discipline, and offering your mind and intellect with devoted love.
insight: You learn to steady your mind and offer it fully in loving devotion, strengthening your connection.
modern_relevance: You feel most connected when you calmly accept what is, stay steady in your practice, and trust deeply with your whole mind.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यो न हृष्यति न दृष्टि न शोचति न काङ्क्षति ।
शुभाशुभपरित्यागी भक्तिमान यः स मे प्रियः ॥
translation: जो प्रसन्न नहीं होता है, द्वेष नहीं करता है, शोक नहीं करता है, आकांशा नहीं करता है, पाप पुण्यों का परित्याग करने वाला है और मुझमें भक्तिमान् है वह मेरा प्रिय है
english_translation: He by whom the world is not disturbed, who is not disturbed by the world, and who is free from joy, anger, fear, and agitation, is dear to me.
essence: Being undisturbed by the world and free from emotional upheaval makes you truly dear.
simple_meaning: You are dear when you neither disturb others nor are disturbed by them, staying free from strong emotions.
insight: It teaches you to hold an inner balance that neither provokes nor is shaken by others, creating true emotional freedom.
modern_relevance: In a noisy room where people argue, you remain quietly steady, unaffected by their turmoil or your own shifting feelings.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
समः शत्रौ च मित्रे च तथा मानापमानयोः।
शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु समः सङ्गविवर्जितः ॥
translation: जो शत्रु और मित्र में एवं मान और अपमान में एकरूप रहता है, शीत उष्ण और सुख दुःखों में विकारहीन है, निःसंग है,
english_translation: One who is unattached to all things, pure, wise, indifferent, without pain, and who has renounced all intentions is dear to me as my devotee.
essence: Devotion rooted in purity, calm, and freedom from attachment is deeply beloved.
simple_meaning: You become dear through devotion by being pure, wise, calm, unattached, free from pain, and by giving up all selfish intentions.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate calm detachment within devotion, freeing your heart from pain and craving.
modern_relevance: You find peace when you care deeply but don’t cling or get hurt by daily ups and downs.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तुल्यनिन्दास्तुतिौनी सन्तुष्टो येन केनचित्।
अनिकेतः स्थिरमतिर्भक्तिमान मे प्रियो हि सः ॥
translation: निन्दा और प्रशंसा में समभावापन्न है, मौनी (मन को दमन करनेवाला) है, जो कुछ मिल जाए  उससे सन्तुष्ट है, वासस्थानहीन है, स्थिरचित्त है और भक्तिमान् है वह मेग प्रिय है
english_translation: He who neither rejoices nor hates, neither grieves nor desires, who has renounced good and bad and is devoted to me, is dear to me.
essence: True devotion is steady love beyond all emotional extremes and judgments.
simple_meaning: You are dear when you neither get excited nor upset, neither grieve nor desire, and you give up judging things as good or bad while staying devoted.
insight: It shifts your focus from emotional reactivity to steady loving dedication, freeing you from distractions.
modern_relevance: When your emotions swing wildly through joy and frustration, you lose focus; steady devotion lets you connect deeply without being tossed by feelings.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ये तु धर्मामृतमिदं यथोक्तं पर्युपासते । 
श्रद्दधाना मत्परमा भक्तास्तेऽतीव मे प्रियाः॥
translation: जो लोग इस उक्त अमृतरूप धर्म का अनुष्ठान करते हैं, वह श्रद्धाशील मत्परायण भक्तगण मेरे अतिप्रिय हैं
english_translation: One who remains equal to friend and enemy, and to honor and insult, is free from attachment amid cold, heat, pleasure, and pain.
essence: True balance comes from treating friends and enemies, praise and blame, as the same.
simple_meaning: You can remain calm and unaffected whether someone is your friend or enemy, or whether you receive praise or insult.
insight: It teaches you to observe emotional ups and downs without clinging or aversion, maintaining inner balance.
modern_relevance: When someone criticizes you on social media or praises you at work, you can keep your calm and not let their words disturb your peace.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
निशम्य नितरां नाथ ! पराराव्य ! जगद्गुरो!।
रहस्यं भक्तियोगस्योपासनायास्तथादभूतम् ॥
translation: नाथ ! पराराव्य ! आराध्य और उपासना का अद्भुत रहस्य अविच्छिन्न रूप से सुनकर
english_translation: He who is equal in blame and praise, silent, satisfied with whatever he gets, homeless, steady-minded, and devoted is dear to me.
essence: Being steady, content, and devoted makes you beloved to the divine.
simple_meaning: You become dear to the divine by being steady in mind, content with what you have, silent, and devoted without a fixed home.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate even-mindedness and devotion regardless of external ups and downs.
modern_relevance: You feel calm sitting quietly after a long day, unbothered by praise or criticism, simply content with what you have.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
कृतार्था: स्मो वयं सम्यक करुणावरुणालय!।
भूयोऽपि श्रोतुमिच्छामस्त्वत्तो ज्ञानमयीं गिरम् ॥
translation: हम लोग अच्छी तरह कृतकृत्य हुए। हम फिर भी ज्ञानवार्ता को आप से सुनना चाहते हैं
english_translation: Those who faithfully practice this nectar-like dharma with devotion to me are very dear to me.
essence: Faithful, trustful devotion to the divine makes you deeply beloved and precious.
simple_meaning: You are very dear when you practice this sacred path with trust and devotion to the divine.
insight: It teaches you to value devotion grounded in trust as the highest form of connection with the divine.
modern_relevance: When you commit fully to a path or purpose with trust and open heart, you create bonds that matter deeply.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
श्रूयते हि जगन्नाथ ! ज्ञानमेवास्ति कारणम् ।
मुक्तेरतो दयासिन्धो ! सादरं प्रार्थयामहे ॥
translation: हे जगन्नाथ ! हमने सुना है कि ज्ञान ही मुक्ति का कारण है, इस कारण हे दयासिन्धो! हम सविनय प्रार्थना करते हैं कि
english_translation: O Lord, Pararavya, the wondrous secret of devotion's practice and worship has been heard completely.
essence: The full, wondrous secret of devoted practice can be completely known by sincere listening.
simple_meaning: You have completely heard the wonderful secret behind devoted practice and worship.
insight: It invites you to trust the process of devotion as a living, wondrous secret rather than a fixed formula.
modern_relevance: You just finished a deep talk that opened your heart to what true devotion really is.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
गूढं ज्ञानस्वरूपं यद्रहस्यञ्चापि दुर्गमम् ।
वैदिकज्ञानकाण्डस्य ज्ञानाज्ञानविनिर्णयम् ॥
translation: ज्ञान का गूढ़ स्वरूप, वेद के ज्ञानकाण्ड का दुर्गम रहस्य, ज्ञान और अज्ञान का लक्षण
english_translation: We have fulfilled our duties well. Yet, we still wish to hear from you the knowledge-filled speech.
essence: Completion does not end the desire to receive deeper wisdom.
simple_meaning: They express having completed their tasks well but still want to listen to the wise teachings from the speaker.
insight: It teaches the value of ongoing learning and humility, even after completing expected duties.
modern_relevance: After finishing a project, you still crave insight from a mentor to deepen your understanding beyond just completion.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
ज्ञानिनां लक्षणञ्चैव प्रतिपाद्य प्रभोऽधुना ।
आत्मज्ञानोपदेशेन चित्ते शान्ति विधत्स्व नः ॥
translation: और ज्ञानी का लक्षण भी कहकर तथा हे प्रभो! आत्मज्ञान का उपदेश देकर हमारे चित्त में अब शान्ति प्रदान कीजिए
english_translation: O Lord of the universe! We have heard that knowledge alone is the cause of liberation; therefore, O ocean of compassion, we humbly pray.
essence: Freedom arises from gaining true knowledge, not from external efforts.
simple_meaning: Knowledge alone leads to true freedom from bondage. This verse expresses a humble request to receive that knowledge.
insight: It shifts focus from seeking external help to valuing inner clarity as the path to freedom.
modern_relevance: You feel stuck in old patterns and realize that learning a new perspective can free you from them.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
तटस्थञ्च स्वरूञ्च द्विविधं ज्ञानमीरितम् ।
ज्ञानं यद्धि स्वरूपाख्यं स्वरूपं तन्ममैव वै ॥
translation: ज्ञान दो प्रकार का कहा गया है, स्वरूपज्ञान और तटस्थज्ञान। स्वरूपज्ञान मेरा ही स्वरूप है
english_translation: The profound nature of knowledge, the difficult secret of the Vedic knowledge section, distinguishing knowledge and ignorance.
essence: True knowledge is a hidden secret that distinguishes wisdom from ignorance.
simple_meaning: True knowledge is subtle and hidden; it reveals how to tell real understanding from ignorance.
insight: It teaches you to recognize the subtle difference between true insight and superficial belief.
modern_relevance: You’ve faced moments when what you thought was clear suddenly feels confusing—this teaching helps you see the difference between real understanding and illusion.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
पराभक्तिप्रवीणेन समाधौ निर्विकल्पके ।
ज्ञानिना शान्तचित्तेन यद्भक्तेनानुभूयते ॥
translation: जो निर्विकल्प समाधि में पराभक्ति में प्रवीण, शान्तचित्त ज्ञानी भक्त के अनुभव में आता है
english_translation: And now, O Lord, by explaining the marks of the wise and teaching self-knowledge, grant peace to our minds.
essence: Peace in the mind comes from understanding wisdom and self-knowledge clearly.
simple_meaning: Understanding what makes someone truly wise and learning about the true self brings calmness to your mind.
insight: It shows you how learning clear signs of wisdom and self-understanding directly soothes mental unrest.
modern_relevance: After struggling with anxiety and confusion, you seek clear guidance that calms your mind and helps you find steady peace.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
ज्ञानं तद्धि स्वरूपाख्यं सच्चिदानन्दरूपकम् ।
देवाः ! जानीत तन्नूनमवाङ्मनसगोचरम् ॥
translation: वह स्वरूप ज्ञान सच्चिदानन्दमय है। हे देवगण ! उसको अवश्य मन वचन से अतीत जानना चाहिए
english_translation: Two types of knowledge are described: impartial knowledge and true form knowledge. True form knowledge is my own true nature.
essence: The deepest knowledge is recognizing the divine as your own true nature.
simple_meaning: There are two kinds of knowledge: one that is detached and one that reveals the deepest truth of who you are, which is the true nature of the divine within you.
insight: It shifts your mind from seeing knowledge as external facts to recognizing it as a direct awareness of your own true self.
modern_relevance: When you face confusing choices or inner conflict, knowing your true nature helps you find clarity beyond distractions.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
द्वारीकृत्य तटस्थाख्यं ज्ञानमेव तु केवलम् ।
जिज्ञासुर्लभते नूनं योगयुन्जानमानसः ॥
translation: केवल तटस्थज्ञान के द्वारा ही योगाभ्यासनिरत जिज्ञासु
english_translation: That which is experienced by a devotee skilled in supreme devotion, in undisturbed absorption, and by a serene-minded wise person.
essence: The deepest experience arises when devotion, clear wisdom, and calmness unite fully.
simple_meaning: Deep experience happens when devotion is complete, the mind is calm, and wisdom is clear.
insight: It teaches you that true spiritual experience arises not from just one quality, but from devotion, wisdom, and calmness combined.
modern_relevance: When you’re deeply focused, loving, and mentally calm, you can access a powerful, peaceful experience beyond distraction.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
आत्मानात्मविवेकं हि कुर्वाणो मामसंशयम् ।
तटस्थाख्यं हि यज्ज्ञानं तत्र यद्यपि वर्तते ॥
translation: आत्मा और अनात्मा का विचार करता हुआ ही निसन्देह मुझको प्राप्त होता है । हे देवगण !
english_translation: True knowledge is the awareness of the true self, made of existence, consciousness, and bliss; O radiant beings, it must be known beyond mind and speech.
essence: True knowledge is experiencing your self beyond mind and speech as pure being and bliss.
simple_meaning: True knowledge is realizing your true self as pure existence, consciousness, and bliss beyond mind and speech.
insight: Shift your focus from mental chatter to the direct experience of being aware and joyful presence.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by thoughts and labels, this reminds you your true self is beyond those noisy layers.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ज्ञातुर्ज्ञानस्य सम्बन्धो ज्ञेयस्यापि दिवौकस:।
तत्तथापि समाख्यातं स्वरूपज्ञानकारणम ॥
translation: ज्ञाता ज्ञान ज्ञेय रूपी त्रिपुटि से युक्त होने पर भी स्वरूपज्ञान-प्राप्ति का कारण कहा गया है
english_translation: Only through impartial wisdom does the mind engaged in yoga practice surely attain inquiry.
essence: Only an impartial, steady mind practicing yoga can truly awaken deep inquiry.
simple_meaning: A mind that stays balanced and free from bias, focused through yoga practice, gains true understanding by inquiry.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate balanced, unbiased attention to invite genuine inquiry in your practice.
modern_relevance: When your mind stops swinging between extremes and stays calm, your curiosity naturally deepens and meaningful insights arise.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ज्ञानस्यास्य तटस्थस्य तिस्रो भूम्यः प्रकीर्तिताः ।
आद्यायां भूमिकायान्तु तत्त्वज्ञानी दिवौकसः ! ॥
translation: इस तटस्थज्ञान की तीन भूमिकाएँ कही गई हैं। हे देवगण ! प्रथम भूमिका में तत्वज्ञानी जगत
english_translation: By discerning the self from what is not self, one undoubtedly attains me. That knowledge, even if it appears detached, is true wisdom.
essence: Clear discernment between self and non-self leads to certain knowledge of the true self.
simple_meaning: Understanding the difference between your true self and what is not yourself leads you without doubt to the deeper reality.
insight: It teaches you to actively distinguish your true self from transient experiences, shifting your awareness from identification to clear witnessing.
modern_relevance: When you pause and clearly notice which thoughts or feelings are really 'you' and which are just passing, your confusion starts to lift.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
जगतश्च जगाग्तातुर्ज्ञानं लब्ध्वानुमानिकम।
ज्ञानभूम्यां विशालकायां स्र्त्यग्रे न संशय: ॥
translation: और जगत्कर्ता का अनुमानिक ज्ञान प्राप्त करके  विशाल ज्ञानभूमि में नि:संदेह अग्रसर होता है।
english_translation: The knower, the knowledge, and the known together form a triad, yet the knower is called the cause of the knowledge of true nature.
essence: You, as the knower, are the cause of realizing your true nature beyond knowledge and objects.
simple_meaning: Knowing, knowledge, and what is known form a triad, but the knower is the cause behind realizing the true nature.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing knowledge as external to recognizing your role as the source of insight.
modern_relevance: When you reflect on your experiences, you see that your awareness shapes how deeply you understand yourself and the world.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अत्रव ज्ञानभूमौ ही योगी भोगपरागमुख ।
वैराग्यं विषयान्नूनं लभते च विषोपमात् ॥
translation: इसी ज्ञानभूमि में योगी भोगपराङ्मुख होकर विषतुल्य विषयो से वैराग्य को भी निःसन्देह ही प्राप्त होता है
english_translation: The detached knowledge has three roles. O divine beings! In the first role, the knower of truth is the world.
essence: Detached knowledge functions through three distinct roles, beginning with the knower as the world.
simple_meaning: Detached knowledge has three roles, and the first role is that the knower of truth is the world.
insight: It invites you to recognize that knowledge and its roles vary, shaping how you understand reality.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
योगी भूमौ द्वितीयायां क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोस्तथा ।
सम्यगज्ञानमवाप्नोति नास्त्यत्र प्रच्युतर्भयम् ॥
translation: दूसरी भूमि के क्षेत्र और क्षेत्रज्ञ का सम्यक ज्ञान प्राप्त करता है और इस भूमि में योगी के लिए पतन का भय नहीं है
english_translation: One who attains inferential knowledge of the creator of the universe advances without doubt into the vast realm of knowledge.
essence: Clear, reasoned knowledge of the cosmic source removes doubt and opens vast understanding.
simple_meaning: By understanding the creator of the universe through reasoning, you confidently move forward into deeper knowledge.
insight: It shifts your mind from uncertainty to confidence by anchoring knowledge in reason and inference.
modern_relevance: When you research and understand the root cause of a problem, your confidence to solve it grows without hesitation.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
भूमिकायां तृतीयायां योगी योगसमुन्नतः ।
मदीयाद्वैतसत्तां हि ज्ञानेनानुभवन् किल ॥
translation: तीसरी भूमि में योगसमुन्नत योगी मेरी अद्वैत  सत्ता का ज्ञान के द्वारा ही अनुभव करता हुआ निष्पाप होक
english_translation: In this field of wisdom, the yogi, turning away from pleasure, surely attains detachment even from pleasures as poisonous as poison.
essence: Detachment arises naturally when you turn away from pleasure, even from desires as poisonous as poison.
simple_meaning: When a yogi turns away from seeking pleasure, they naturally gain detachment even from things as harmful as poison.
insight: It shifts your view from just avoiding pleasure to recognizing and releasing the hidden toxicity in all desires.
modern_relevance: You might resist small temptations, yet still feel trapped by deeper cravings that poison your peace without you noticing.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
मत्स्वरूपाग्रगो देवाः ! भवन् विगतकिल्विषः।
भूत्वा योगपदारूढो लभते कृतकृत्यताम् ॥
translation: हे देवगण !  मेरे स्वस्वरूप की ओर अग्रसर होता हुश्रा योगारूढ़ होकर कृतकृत्यता को प्राप्त करता है
english_translation: On the second plane, the yogi attains correct knowledge of the field and the knower of the field, and there is no fear of falling there.
essence: True knowledge of self and world removes the fear of falling on the higher plane.
simple_meaning: The yogi who understands both the changing world and the unchanging observer deeply has no fear of failure on this higher plane.
insight: It shifts attention from being caught in outcomes to steady awareness of what is stable and real.
modern_relevance: When you clearly understand your role and your true self beyond changing circumstances, you stop fearing setbacks at work or in life.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
एतदेव फलं भूमेस्तृतीयाया दिवौकसः।
अन्तिमं हिं विनिर्दिष्टं तत्त्वज्ञानविशारदः ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! इस तीसरी भूमि का यही अंतिम फल तत्वज्ञान विशारदों ने कहा है
english_translation: On the third plane, the elevated yogi experiences my non-dual reality through knowledge, becoming pure.
essence: True wisdom reveals the pure, non-dual reality within and transforms the yogi profoundly.
simple_meaning: An advanced yogi on the third spiritual level experiences the divine non-dual reality through knowledge, becoming pure and free from faults.
insight: It teaches you to seek direct knowledge of your true nature, which purifies your experience and being.
modern_relevance: When you deeply understand your true self beyond everyday distractions, clarity and purity naturally arise.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
द्विधा मत्प्रकृतिभिन्ना विद्ययाऽविद्यया तथा।
अविद्या कारणं सृष्टेबन्धनस्यापि जायते ॥
translation: मेरी प्रकृति के दो भेद हैं, विद्या और अविद्या। अविद्या सिष्टि और बंधन का कारण होती है
english_translation: O radiant beings! Advancing toward my true nature, one who ascends the path of yoga attains freedom from regret.
essence: Advancing on yoga’s path toward your true self ends regret and self-blame.
simple_meaning: When you follow the path of yoga toward your true self, you become free from regret and blame.
insight: It teaches you to focus on inner growth through yoga to dissolve regret and blame.
modern_relevance: You’ve tried hard and made peace with your choices; now you can let go of self-judgment and move forward.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
साहाय्येन तु विद्याया योगी मुक्तोऽथ बन्धनात् ।
देवाः ! सृष्टेलयं कुर्वन् क्षिप्रं मामेति निश्चितम् ॥
translation: और विद्या की सहायता से योगी बन्धन से मुक्त होकर हे देवगण ! सृष्टि का विलय करता हुआ शीघ्र मुझको ही प्राप्त होता है
english_translation: O divine beings! This third land is its ultimate fruit, as declared by experts in true knowledge.
essence: Experts in true knowledge define the ultimate fruit of this third land.
simple_meaning: The divine beings say that the final result or essence of this third land is what the experts in true knowledge have declared.
insight: It shows the importance of respecting expert knowledge but does not itself teach a principle.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अमानित्य मद्म्भित्वमहिंसा क्षन्तिर्राजवम ।
आचार्योपासनं शौच स्थैर्यमात्मविनिग्रहः ॥
translation: आत्मश्लाघाराहित्य, दम्भहीनता, परपीड़ात्याग, सहिष्णुता, सरलता, गुरुसेवा, अन्तःशुचिता और बहिःशुचिता, स्थिरता, मनः संयम
english_translation: My nature has two aspects, wisdom and deep confusion; deep confusion causes creation and bondage.
essence: Two forces in nature — wisdom and confusion — shape creation and bondage.
simple_meaning: Your nature has two parts: clear understanding and deep confusion. Confusion causes the cycle of creation and binding.
insight: Recognize confusion as a natural force causing struggle; seek wisdom to loosen its grip.
modern_relevance: When you feel stuck or overwhelmed, this reminds you that confusion is natural but not the whole truth within you.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
इन्द्रियार्थेषु वैराग्यमनहङ्कार एव च ।
जन्ममृत्युजराव्याधिदुःखदोषानुदर्शनम् ॥
translation: विषयों में वैराग्य, अहङ्कारराहित्य, जन्म मृत्यु जरा और व्याधि दुःख और दोष का अनुदर्शन अर्थात् स्पष्ट उपलब्धि,
english_translation: With the help of knowledge, the yogi is freed from bondage and quickly merges with creation, surely reaching me, O radiant beings!
essence: Knowledge frees the yogi from bondage and swiftly brings reunion with the whole creation.
simple_meaning: Using knowledge, a yogi frees themselves from bonds and quickly merges with the entire creation.
insight: It shifts your view from being stuck in limitations to seeing that knowledge can rapidly free you.
modern_relevance: When you gain clear understanding, you can let go of what traps you and feel a quick return to your true nature.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
असक्तिरनभिष्वङ्गः पुत्रदारगृहादिषु ।
नित्यश्च समचित्तत्वमिष्टानिष्टोपपतिषु ॥
translation: पुत्र स्त्री गृह आदि में अनासक्ति और उनके सुख दुःख में सुखी दुःखी न होना, इष्ट और अनिष्ट की प्राप्ति होने पर सर्वदा चित्त की समानता,
english_translation: Humility without self-praise, freedom from hypocrisy, non-violence, patience, simplicity, service to the teacher, inner and outer purity, steadiness, and self-restraint.
essence: True discipline is a steady practice of humility, patience, purity, and self-control.
simple_meaning: You should cultivate qualities like humility, patience, non-violence, simplicity, respect for your teacher, purity inside and out, steadiness, and self-control.
insight: It teaches you to build lasting inner strength through steady humility and disciplined self-restraint.
modern_relevance: You stay calm and clear when tensions rise, choosing patience, humility, and self-control over reaction.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
मयि चानन्ययोगेन भक्तिरव्यभिचारिणी।
विविक्तदेशसेवित्वमरतिर्जनसंसदि ॥
translation: मुझमें अनन्य योग (सर्वत्र समष्टि ) द्वारा अव्यभिचारिणी (अनन्य) भक्ति निर्जन स्थान में रहना, लोकसमाज में वैराग्य,
english_translation: Detachment from sensory objects, freedom from ego, and clear seeing of birth, death, aging, disease, pain, and faults.
