essence: True detachment arises by dissolving ego and clearly seeing life’s unavoidable sufferings.
simple_meaning: You become detached from desires and the ego, clearly understanding the realities of birth, death, aging, sickness, pain, and faults.
insight: It teaches you to observe life’s challenges objectively, without ego, fostering true detachment and clarity.
modern_relevance: When you face illness or loss, releasing ego and seeing these as natural helps you stay calm and centered.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अध्यात्मज्ञाननित्यत्वं तत्त्वज्ञानार्थदर्शनम् ।
एतज्ज्ञानमिति प्रोक्तमज्ञानं यदतोऽन्यथा ॥
translation: आत्मज्ञानपरायणता और तत्त्वज्ञान के फल (मोक्ष) का दर्शन, ये ज्ञान के लक्षण कहे जाते हैं इनसे विपरीत जो लक्षण हैं, वह सभी अज्ञान के लक्षण हैं
english_translation: Be unattached to sons, wives, and homes; remain always steady in mind through pleasure and pain, through gain and loss.
essence: Steady your mind by letting go of attachment to family and possessions.
simple_meaning: You should not cling to family or possessions and keep your mind steady through good and bad experiences.
insight: It teaches you to practice emotional balance by releasing attachment to external people and things.
modern_relevance: You face social pressures to cling to relationships or status, but true calm comes from not letting these define your peace.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
निश्चितं वच्मि वो देवाः ! श्रीगुरोर्दयया विना ।
किञ्चित् कदापि कुत्रापि कथञ्चिन्नैव लभ्यते ॥
translation: हे देवतागण ! मैं आप लोगों को निश्चय करके कहता हूँ कि बिना श्रीगुरुकृपा के कभी भी कहीं भी किसी प्रकार से भी कुछ भी प्राप्त नहीं होता है।
english_translation: Devotion to me without deviation, practicing exclusive yoga, dwelling in solitude, and detachment from worldly society.
essence: Steady devotion grows in quiet solitude, free from social distractions.
simple_meaning: Devotion that focuses exclusively on the divine and remains steady grows by spending time alone and avoiding the distractions of society.
insight: It encourages you to cultivate focused devotion by seeking quiet and limiting social distractions that pull your attention away.
modern_relevance: You find your deepest focus and love when you step away from constant social noise and distractions, creating space for steady connection.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
आत्मज्ञानोपलब्धौ हि हेतुरस्ति गुरोः कृपा ।
आत्मज्ञानन्तु मत्माप्तौ कारणं नात्र संशयः ॥
translation: आत्मज्ञान प्राप्ति का कारण गुरु कृपा ही है और मुझे प्राप्त करने का कारण आत्मज्ञान है, इसमें सन्देह नहीं
english_translation: Self-knowledge is eternal and truth-realizing; these are the marks of true wisdom. Anything opposite to these are marks of ignorance.
essence: True wisdom is recognizing the eternal nature of your self and reality.
simple_meaning: True knowledge is realizing your self is eternal and recognizing the true nature of reality. Anything that denies this is ignorance.
insight: It shifts your focus from fleeting experiences to the unchanging truth of your self, fostering lasting clarity.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by change or uncertainty, remembering your true self is eternal brings calm and clarity.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तद्वित्त मणिपातेन परिप्रश्नेन सेवया ।
उपदेक्ष्यन्निबो ज्ञानं ज्ञानिनस्तत्वदर्शिनः ॥
translation: प्रणिपात, जिज्ञासा और गुरुसेवा के द्वारा उस ज्ञान का लाभ करोतत्त्वदर्शी ज्ञानिगण तुमको ज्ञान का उपदेश देंगे
english_translation: O divine beings! I firmly say nothing is ever attained anywhere without the grace of the revered teacher.
essence: Nothing is ever truly attained without the grace of a sincere teacher.
simple_meaning: Nothing can truly be gained without the kindness and guidance of a sincere teacher.
insight: It shifts your perspective to value trust in guidance as the foundation for all growth and attainment.
modern_relevance: Before mastering a skill or making a big change, you recall how much a mentor’s support shaped your progress.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यजज्ञात्वा न पुनर्मोहमेवं यास्यथ निर्जराः ।
येन भूतान्यशेषेण द्रक्ष्यथात्मन्यथो मयि ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! जिस ज्ञान के जान लेने से पुनः इस प्रकार के मोह को नहीं प्राप्त होगे। और जिसके द्वारा भूतगण को आत्मा में और अनन्तर मुझमें सब कुछ देख सकोगे
english_translation: The cause for the attainment of self-knowledge is the grace of the guru, and the reason for attaining me is self-knowledge; there is no doubt about this.
essence: Self-knowledge arises through the grace of a teacher and leads to knowing the true self without doubt.
simple_meaning: The grace of a teacher is what makes self-knowledge possible, and gaining self-knowledge is what leads to knowing the true self without doubt.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that self-understanding arises not just from effort but from receiving guidance and openness from a trusted source.
modern_relevance: When you struggle to understand yourself, a trusted guide or mentor can help you see what was hidden and open your eyes to your deeper nature.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अपि स्थ यदि पापेभ्यः सर्वेभ्यः पापकृत्तमाः।
सर्व ज्ञानप्लवेनैव वृजिनं सन्तरिष्यथ ॥
translation: यदि सकल पापियों से भी तुम अधिक पापी हो तो भी सम्पूर्ण पापरूप समुद्र को ज्ञान रूपी जहाज द्वारा सम्यक रूप से पार कर सकोगे
english_translation: By bowing down, questioning, and serving the teacher, those who see the truth will teach you knowledge.
essence: True wisdom comes through humble respect, sincere inquiry, and devoted service to the teacher.
simple_meaning: You gain true understanding by showing respect, asking sincere questions, and serving your teacher.
insight: It teaches you to actively engage with your teacher through respectful questioning and service, which deepens your understanding.
modern_relevance: Before a mentor session, you prepare thoughtful questions and listen carefully, knowing respect and effort open the door to real learning.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यथैधांसि समिद्धोऽग्निभस्मसात्कुरुतेऽमराः ! ।
ज्ञानाग्निः सर्वकर्माणि भस्मसात्कुरुते तथा ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! जिस प्रकार प्रज्वलित अग्नि काष्ठ समूह को भस्मसात् करती है उसी प्रकार ज्ञानरूप अग्नि सकल कर्मों को भस्मसात् कर देती है
english_translation: O divine beings, by knowing this knowledge, you will no longer be deluded and will see all beings in the true self and afterwards see everything in me.
essence: Complete knowledge ends delusion and reveals unity of self and all existence.
simple_meaning: Knowing this knowledge removes delusion forever and lets you see all beings as part of your true self and then see everything reflected in the divine.
insight: It shifts your mind from separation and confusion to unified awareness of self and all beings.
modern_relevance: When your doubts vanish, you suddenly see people and situations as connected parts of a greater whole.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
नहि ज्ञानेन सद्रशं पवित्रमिह विद्यते ।
तत्स्वयं योगसंसिद्धाः कालेनाऽऽत्मनि विन्दथ ॥
translation: क्योंकि इस लोक में ज्ञान के समान पवित्र और कोई नहीं है, योगद्वारा सिद्धि प्राप्त होने पर उस आत्म ज्ञान को यथासमय अपने में स्वयं प्राप्त करोगे
english_translation: Even if you are the most sinful among all sinners, you can cross the entire ocean of sin by the boat of knowledge.
essence: Deep knowledge can completely overcome even the greatest wrongdoing.
simple_meaning: Even if you have done many wrong things, deep understanding can help you overcome all of them completely.
insight: It shifts your mindset from being trapped by past faults to using knowledge as a tool for complete transformation.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by your past mistakes or regrets, remember that learning and understanding can help you move beyond them fully.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
श्रद्धावान् लभते ज्ञानं तत्परः संयतेन्द्रियः ।
ज्ञानं लब्ध्वा परां शान्तिमचिरेणाऽधिगच्छति ॥
translation: श्रद्धावान् तत्परायण और जितेन्द्रिय व्यक्ति ज्ञान प्राप्त करता है और ज्ञान को प्राप्त करके अतिशीघ्र परमशान्ति (मोक्ष) को प्राप्त होता है
english_translation: Just as blazing fire turns wood to ashes, the fire of knowledge burns all actions to ashes.
essence: The fire of knowledge can completely burn away all actions and their effects.
simple_meaning: Knowledge acts like fire that completely destroys all your actions and their effects.
insight: It teaches you to use wisdom to dissolve attachment to your actions and their outcomes.
modern_relevance: You face regrets and consequences from past choices that feel like heavy burdens—knowledge can help you release them fully.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अज्ञश्चाश्रधानश्च संशयात्मा विनश्यति ।
नाऽयं लोकोऽस्ति न परो न सुखं संशयान्मनः ॥
translation: अश्रद्धालु संशयात्मा और मूढ़ व्यक्ति नाश को प्राप्त होता है। संशयात्मा व्यक्ति के लिये इहलोक और परलोक दोनों कष्टप्रद होते हैं और उसको सुख प्राप्त नहीं होता है
english_translation: There is nothing as pure in this world as true knowledge; those perfected in yoga eventually find that self-knowledge within themselves in time.
essence: True knowledge is uniquely pure and unfolds naturally within those devoted to yoga.
simple_meaning: True knowledge is the purest thing in this world, and those who master yoga will gradually realize this self-knowledge inside themselves.
insight: It shifts focus from rushing results to patiently trusting that deep understanding will emerge through steady practice.
modern_relevance: When you commit to a practice like meditation or self-inquiry, clarity and deep understanding arise naturally, even if not immediately visible.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
योगसन्नस्तकर्माणं ज्ञानसंछिन्नसंशयानम ।
आत्मवन्तं न कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति दिवौकसः ! ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! जिस व्यक्ति ने योग द्वारा सकल कर्मों को आत्मा में अर्पण किया है और जिसने आत्मज्ञान द्वारा सकल संशय छिन्न कर दिये हैं ऐसे आत्म ज्ञान सम्पन्न व्यक्ति को कर्म बन्धन नहीं कर सकते हैं
english_translation: A person with trust, focused and with controlled senses, attains knowledge; having gained knowledge, they quickly reach supreme peace.
essence: Trust combined with focused self-control quickly leads to true knowledge and deep peace.
simple_meaning: When you trust deeply, stay focused, and control your senses, you gain true knowledge that leads you quickly to profound peace.
insight: This verse shifts your mind to hold faith as a real power that, combined with focus and self-control, accelerates your inner growth.
modern_relevance: You start a new practice or habit unsure if it will work. With trust and steady focus, you soon gain clarity and calm you didn’t expect.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तस्मादज्ञानसंभूतं हृत्स्थं ज्ञानासिनात्मनः ।
छित्त्वैनं संशयं योगमातिष्ठत बुभुत्सवः ! ॥
translation: अत: हे जिज्ञासु देवगण ! अपने अज्ञान से उत्पन्न हृदयस्थ संशय को ज्ञानरूप खड्ग द्वारा छेदन करके इस योग का अवलम्बन करो
english_translation: A person without faith and full of doubt perishes; for them, neither this world nor the higher realm is pleasant.
essence: Doubt destroys peace; only trust lets happiness flourish across all realms.
simple_meaning: Without trust in the divine or your path, your mind suffers doubt that brings destruction and blocks happiness in any realm.
insight: It teaches you to replace indecision with trust, freeing your mind to experience peace and joy fully.
modern_relevance: You hesitate before a big decision, torn by uncertainty. That doubt makes even good options feel heavy and joyless.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
नादत्ते कस्याचित्पापं न चैव सुकृतं विभुः।
आज्ञानेनावृतं ज्ञानं तेन मुह्यन्ति जन्तवः ॥
translation: ईश्वर किसी का भी पाप ग्रहण नहीं करते हैं और पुण्य भी ग्रहण नहीं करते हैं। अज्ञानके द्वारा ज्ञान आच्छन्न है इसी कारण जीवधारी मोहित होते हैं अर्थात् इन्द्रियासक्त होते हैं
english_translation: O divine beings! One who, through yoga, has surrendered all actions to the true self and whose doubts have been destroyed by self-knowledge is not bound by the consequences of actions.
essence: Clear inner knowing and surrendered action together free you from all binding consequences.
simple_meaning: You become free from being bound by results when you surrender your actions through yoga and remove all doubts through true knowledge.
insight: It teaches you to dissolve doubt through knowledge and surrender your actions, freeing yourself from attachment to consequences.
modern_relevance: You’ve wrestled with uncertainty and tried to control outcomes, but peace comes when you trust your clear inner knowing and release your grip on results.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ज्ञानेन तु तदज्ञानं येषां नाशितमात्मनः ।
तेपामादियवज्ज्ञानं प्रकाशयति तत्परम् ॥
translation: किन्तु आत्म ज्ञान के द्वारा जिनका वह अज्ञान नष्ट होजाता है, सूर्य जिस प्रकार अन्धकार को नाश करके सकल वस्तुओं को प्रकाशित कर देता है। उसी प्रकार उनका वह ज्ञान परमात्मा को प्रकाशित कर देता है
english_translation: Therefore, O seekers among the divine beings, cut through the doubt born of ignorance in your heart with the sword of knowledge and firmly hold on to this yoga.
essence: Doubt born from ignorance can be cut by knowledge and steadiness in yoga.
simple_meaning: You can overcome the doubt that comes from ignorance by using clear understanding and firmly practicing this yoga.
insight: It teaches you to confront inner doubts actively with knowledge and maintain firm commitment to your practice.
modern_relevance: When your mind is clouded with uncertainty about your path, rely on clear understanding and steady practice to move forward.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
विद्याविनयसम्पने ब्राह्मणे गवि हस्तिनि ।
शुनि चैव श्वपाके च पण्डिताः समदर्शिनः ॥
translation: विद्या और विनयसम्पन्न ब्राह्मणपर और चाण्डाल पर एवं गौ हाथी और कुत्ते पर ज्ञानीगण समदर्शी हुआ करते है
english_translation: The supreme being accepts neither sin nor merit from anyone; knowledge is hidden by ignorance, causing beings to be deluded and attached to the senses.
essence: Your true value is beyond actions; ignorance alone clouds your knowing.
simple_meaning: The supreme being does not take on anyone’s bad or good actions. Ignorance hides true knowledge, making beings confused and attached to their senses.
insight: It shifts the focus from external approval to recognizing how ignorance distorts your self-view and blocks true understanding.
modern_relevance: You felt judged for a mistake or praised for success, yet the deeper truth is your worth isn’t defined by outcomes but by your clarity of mind.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
इहैव तैर्जितः सर्गो येषां साम्ये स्थितं मनः ।
निर्दोषं हि समं ब्रह्म तस्मादब्रह्मणि ते स्थिताः॥
translation: जिनका मन समभाव में स्थित है, संसार में रहकर ही उन्होंने संसार को जीत लिया है क्योंकि समान और निर्दोषरूप से ब्रह्म व्यापक हैं अतः वह ब्रह्म भाव में स्थित रहते हैं
english_translation: But for those whose ignorance is destroyed by true knowledge, that knowledge reveals the supreme being as the sun dispels darkness and lights all things.
essence: True knowledge removes ignorance and reveals the supreme as sunlight reveals all.
simple_meaning: When your ignorance is removed by true knowledge, that knowledge reveals the supreme being clearly, just as the sun removes darkness and lights everything.
insight: It teaches you to trust that gaining understanding clears away deep confusion and opens you to the supreme reality.
modern_relevance: When confusion clouds your mind, gaining clear knowledge can suddenly reveal what was always there, like morning light after a long night.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
न प्रहृप्येत् प्रियं प्राप्य नोद्विजेत्याप्य चाऽप्रियम् ।
स्थिरबुद्धिरसम्मूढो ब्रह्मविदब्रह्मणि  स्थितः ॥
translation: ब्रह्मभाव में अवस्थित, स्थिरबुद्धि और मोहहीन ब्रह्मवेत्ता व्यक्ति प्रियवस्तु पाकर हर्षित नहीं होता है और अप्रिय वस्तु पाकर विषादयुक्त नहीं होता है
english_translation: The wise see equally the learned Brahmin, the cow, the elephant, the dog, and even the outcast.
essence: Wisdom is seeing all beings with equal respect, beyond social distinctions.
simple_meaning: True wisdom means seeing all beings—learned or lowly—without discrimination or prejudice.
insight: It shifts your mind to recognize the shared value in everyone, removing barriers of status or identity.
modern_relevance: When you meet people from different backgrounds or walks of life, this teaching invites you to honor each one without judgment.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
योऽन्तःसुखोऽन्तरारामस्तथाज्योर्तिरेव यः।
स योगी ब्रह्म निर्वाणं ब्रह्मभूतोऽधिगच्छति ॥
translation: आत्मभाव ही जिसको सुखबोध होता है आत्मभाव में ही जिसको आमोद होता है और आत्मभाव की ओर ही जिसकी दृष्टि है वह योगी ब्रह्मभाव में स्थित होकर ब्रह्मनिर्धाण अर्थात् मोक्ष को प्राप्त होता है
english_translation: Those whose minds remain steady in equanimity have conquered the world while living in it, because Brahman is equal and faultless everywhere; thus they abide in the state of Brahman.
essence: A mind steady in equal vision conquers the world by abiding in faultless reality.
simple_meaning: You master the world by maintaining a steady, balanced mind that sees everything equally and without fault.
insight: Shift your focus from external chaos to steady inner balance to experience true mastery of your life.
modern_relevance: You face a stressful day with conflicting demands, yet your quiet, balanced mind keeps you steady and unshaken.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
लभन्ते ब्रह्मनिर्वाणमृषयः क्षीणकल्मषाः ।
छिन्नद्वैधा यतात्मानः सर्वभूतहिते रताः ॥
translation: पाप जिनके क्षीण हो गये हैं, संशय जिनके छिन्न हो गये हैं, जिनका अन्तःकरण संयमशील है और सकल प्राणिमात्र का हित करने में जो तत्पर हैं ऐसे ऋषिगण ब्रह्मनिर्वाण अर्थात् मोक्ष को प्राप्त करते हैं
english_translation: One established in the state of Brahman, with steady mind and free from delusion, does not rejoice on getting what is liked nor grieve on getting what is disliked.
essence: True wisdom is steady calm beyond liking or disliking.
simple_meaning: A person rooted in the supreme reality remains calm and steady, not reacting with joy or sorrow to what they like or dislike.
insight: It shifts your mindset from emotional reactivity to balanced observation, freeing you from being tossed by external events.
modern_relevance: You face unexpected news at work and feel neither elated nor crushed, simply steady and clear inside.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
काम क्रोध वियुक्ताना यतीनां यातचेतसाम ।
अभितो ब्रह्मनिर्वाणं वर्तते विदितात्मनाम् ॥
translation: कामक्रोधरहित संयमी और आत्मतत्वज्ञ यातिगण के लिए सर्वत्र ही मोक्ष है, अर्थात वह देहांत होने पर ही मुक्त होते हैं ऐसा नहीं है, देह रहते हुए भी वे मुक्त ही हैं
english_translation: A yogi who finds joy and delight within their true self, and whose vision is fixed on the true self, attains liberation by becoming one with the supreme reality.
essence: True joy arises from resting your vision fully on your true self, leading to liberation.
simple_meaning: True happiness and delight come from connecting deeply with your true self; focusing your awareness there leads to inner freedom.
insight: It teaches you to redirect your awareness from outer distractions to the inner true self, opening a path to freedom.
modern_relevance: When stress floods your mind, turning your attention inward can uncover a quiet joy untouched by external chaos.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
जितात्मनः प्रशान्तस्य परमात्मा समाहितः।
शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु तथा मानाषमानयोः ॥
translation: केवल जितेन्द्रिय और प्रशांत अर्थात रागादिशून्य व्यक्ति का आत्मा अर्थात अंत:करण शीत उष्ण, सुख दुःख, और मान अपमान में अचल रह सकता है
english_translation: Sages who have eradicated faults, whose doubts are dispelled, whose inner selves are disciplined, and who delight in the welfare of all beings attain liberation in the supreme reality.
essence: Freedom arises when doubt is gone, faults are cleansed, and care extends to all beings.
simple_meaning: Those who have removed their inner faults and doubts, control their inner selves, and focus on helping all beings, achieve ultimate freedom.
insight: It teaches you to cleanse mental obstacles and widen your concern beyond yourself to experience true liberation.
modern_relevance: You feel lighter when your worries clear, your doubts settle, and you care genuinely for others around you.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ज्ञानविज्ञानतृप्तात्मा कूटस्थो विजितेन्द्रियः।
मुक्त इत्युच्यते योगी समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः ॥
translation: जिसका चित्त ज्ञान और विज्ञान द्वारा आकांक्षाहीन है जो कूटस्थ अर्थात् निर्विकार है, वह जितेन्द्रिय है और जिसकी मिटटी के ढेले में, पत्थर में और सुवर्ण में समदृष्टि है ऐसा योगी मुक्त कहा जाता है
english_translation: For those restrained from desire and anger, whose minds are steady and who know the true self, liberation is present everywhere; they are free even while living in the body.
essence: Freedom is present now when desire and anger no longer bind your mind.
simple_meaning: When you let go of desire and anger and steady your mind knowing your true self, freedom is present everywhere, even while alive.
insight: This verse shifts your focus from waiting for freedom after death to recognizing it in your current mental steadiness.
modern_relevance: After calming anger during a heated argument, you realize peace and freedom are available now, not only after some distant change.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सुहृन्मित्राय्युर्दासीनमध्यस्थद्वेष्यबन्धुषु।
साधुप्वपि च पापेपु समबुद्धिर्विशिष्यते ॥
translation: सुहृत् ( स्वभावतः हितैषी) मित्र ( स्नेहवशतः हितैषी ) अरि (धातुक) उदासीन (विवाद करने वाले दोनों पक्षों की उपेक्षा करने वाला) मध्यस्थ (विवाद करने वाले दोनों पक्षों का हितैषी) द्वेष्य (द्वेष करने योग्य व्यक्ति) बन्धु (सम्बन्ध युक्त व्यक्ति) साधु और यहां तक कि पापियों पर भी जो समबुद्धि रखने वाला है वही योगियों में  प्रधान है
english_translation: The supreme self is established in the mind of the self-controlled and peaceful person, remaining steady amid heat and cold, pleasure and pain, honor and dishonor.
essence: True calm holds steady through all life's ups and downs.
simple_meaning: If your mind is peaceful and your senses controlled, you remain steady through all changes and challenges.
insight: It teaches you to keep your inner state unmoved by external fluctuations, creating mental balance.
modern_relevance: You face unexpected feedback at work or shifting moods in relationships but remain grounded and unshaken inside.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
मय्यासक्तमनस्का हि युजाना योगमाश्रिताः ।
यथा ज्ञास्यथ पूर्ण मां तथा शृणुत निश्चितम् ॥
translation: मुझमे आस्क्तिचित्त होकर, योग के आश्रय से अभ्यास करते हुए जिस प्रकार से मुझे पूर्णरूप से निश्चयपूर्वक जान सकोगे उनको सुनो
english_translation: A yogi whose mind is fulfilled with knowledge and wisdom, steady and unaffected, who has conquered the senses, and who sees clay, stones, and gold alike is called free.
essence: True freedom comes from steady wisdom and equal vision beyond the senses.
simple_meaning: You are free when your mind is calm from clear understanding, you control your senses, and see all things without preference.
insight: It teaches you to steady your mind through wisdom and resist sensory distractions, seeing beyond surface value.
modern_relevance: You encounter situations where your mind races with desires or judgments. Finding calm and equal regard for all things brings true freedom.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
जानं वोऽहं सविज्ञानमिदं वक्ष्याम्यशेषतः ।
यज्ञात्वा नेह भूयोऽन्यज्ज्ञातव्यमवशिष्यते ॥
translation: मैं आपलोगों को विज्ञानसहित इस ज्ञान को सम्पूर्ण रूप से कहूँगा जिसके  जान लेने से जगत में फिर कुछ जानने का विषय अवशेष नहीं रहता है
english_translation: Among friends, well-wishers, neutrals, enemies, relatives, saints, and even sinners, the yogi who has equal wisdom stands supreme.
essence: True wisdom treats friend and foe alike without preference or aversion.
simple_meaning: A yogi who sees friends, enemies, relatives, saints, and sinners with equal wisdom is the highest among them.
insight: It teaches you to hold your mind steady and unbiased toward all people, regardless of their relation to you.
modern_relevance: When a colleague, friend, or stranger acts against you, your calm and equal mind keeps you steady and respected.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
मनुष्याणां सहस्रेषु कश्चिद्यतति सिद्धये ।
यततामपि सिद्धानां कश्चिन्मां वेत्ति तत्त्वतः ॥
translation: हजारों मनुष्यों में कोई एक सिद्धि के लिये यत्न करता है और अनेक यत्न  करने वाले सिद्धों मेले भी कोई एक वास्तवतः मेरे स्वरूप को जानता है
english_translation: By dedicating your mind to me and practicing yoga, you will surely come to know me fully; listen carefully.
essence: Focused devotion combined with yoga practice guarantees full knowing of the divine.
simple_meaning: When you focus your mind on the divine and practice devotion with yoga, you will come to fully know the true self. Listen carefully to this promise.
insight: It teaches you to trust that steady heartfelt devotion naturally leads to clear knowledge of the true self.
modern_relevance: You keep returning to a daily meditation or prayer, unsure if it works—this promises that steady focus will bring deep understanding.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
भूमिरापोऽनलो वायुः खं मनो बुद्धिरेव च ।
अहङ्कार इतीयं मे भिन्ना प्रकृतिरष्टया ॥
translation: पृथिवी जल तेज वायु आकाश मन बुद्धि और अहङ्कार इन आठ प्रकार के भेदों से युक्त मेरी प्रकृति है
english_translation: I will fully explain this knowledge with all its understanding, knowing which nothing else remains to be known in the world.
essence: Complete understanding of this knowledge ends all further seeking.
simple_meaning: You can fully understand this knowledge with complete insight, after which nothing else is left to learn.
insight: It shifts your mind from partial knowledge to seeking the complete, unshakable truth.
modern_relevance: You find a guide who offers the one clear answer that resolves your restless search for meaning.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अपग्यमितस्त्वन्यां प्रकृति वित मे पराम् ।
जीवभूतां मुपर्वाणो ययेदं धार्यते जगत् ॥
translation: यह अपरानाम्नी है। हे देवगण ! इस अपरा प्रकृति से भिन्न मेरी परानाम्नी जीवस्वरूपा एक प्रकृति है ऐसा जानो, जिसके द्वारा यह जगत् धारण किया जाता है अर्थात् जो जगद्धारिका है
english_translation: Among thousands of humans, one strives for perfection, and among many who strive, only one truly knows my real nature.
essence: Deep spiritual understanding is extremely rare, even among those who strive for it.
simple_meaning: Many try to reach perfection, but only a very few truly understand the divine nature deeply.
insight: It teaches you to value genuine understanding over mere effort and to recognize true wisdom as rare.
modern_relevance: In a world full of advice and self-improvement, very few truly grasp the deeper essence behind their efforts.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
एतद्योनीनि भूतानि सर्वाणीत्युपधार्यताम ।
अहं कृत्स्नस्य जगतः प्रभवः मलयस्तथा ॥
translation: इन्हीं दो प्रकार की मेरी प्रकृतियो से पंचभूतमय सकल जगत की उत्पत्ति हुई है ऐसा जानो, मैं सकल जगत का परमकारण स्वरूप और प्रलय स्थान हूँ
english_translation: My nature is composed of eight distinct types: earth, water, fire, air, ether, mind, intellect, and ego.
essence: Your nature is a composite of eight changing elements and faculties.
simple_meaning: Everything that makes up your nature includes five elements plus mind, intellect, and ego.
insight: This verse teaches you to recognize that your sense of self includes changing physical and mental components, not a fixed essence.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed, remembering that your being includes shifting elements and thoughts can help you find perspective.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
मत्तः परतरं नान्यत् किश्चिदस्ति दिवौकसः।।
माय सर्वमिदं प्रोतं सूत्रे मणिगणा इव ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! मुझसे परे और कुछ नहीं है। सूत्रमें मणियों के समान मुझमें यह समस्त जगत् आश्रित है।
english_translation: This is the supreme subtle nature, distinct from the other nature, the living being, by which this world is sustained.
essence: A subtle living essence distinct from nature sustains the entire world.
simple_meaning: Beyond the natural world, there is a living essence that supports and sustains everything you see.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing only surface change to recognizing a deeper sustaining presence behind all life.
modern_relevance: When life feels overwhelming and unpredictable, this verse reminds you that beneath all chaos, a steady living essence supports everything you experience.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
इदं गुह्यतमं वश्चाऽनुसूयुभ्यो वेऽधुना ।
ज्ञानं विज्ञानसहितं यज़ज्ञान्वा मोक्ष्यथाशुभात् ॥
translation: अब मैं यह परमगुप्त विज्ञान सहित ज्ञान भी तुम दोषदृष्टि हीनों को कहता हूँ जिसको जानकर तुमलोग सकल पापों से मुक्त हो जाओगे
english_translation: Know that all beings arise from these two types of my natural energies; I am the origin and dissolution of the entire world.
essence: All existence flows from and returns to the divine's two natural energies.
simple_meaning: Everything in the world comes from two energies of the divine, who is both the cause of creation and the place of dissolution.
insight: Recognize your life’s changes as part of a continuous flow from and back to the divine's energy.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by change, remember that all things start and end in the same deeper energy within you.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
इदं शरीरं भो देवाः! क्षेत्रमित्यभिधीयते ।
एतद्यो वेत्ति तं पाहुः क्षेत्रज्ञ इति तद्विदः ॥
translation: हे देवगण यह शरीर क्षेत्र नाम से अभिहित होता है और इस क्षेत्र को जो जानता है उसको तत्त्वज्ञानी क्षेत्रज्ञ कहते हैं
english_translation: There is nothing beyond me, O divine beings. All this universe is woven in me like jewels on a thread.
essence: Nothing exists beyond the divine presence that holds all things together like jewels on a thread.
simple_meaning: Nothing exists beyond the divine presence. The entire universe depends on this presence like jewels strung on a thread.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing yourself as separate to recognizing your inseparable connection with the whole.
modern_relevance: When life feels fragmented or overwhelming, remember that everything you see and feel is connected and supported by a single unifying presence.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
क्षेत्रज्ञं चाऽपि मां वित्त सर्वक्षेत्रेषु निर्जगः।
क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोर्ज्ञानं यत्तज़ज्ञानं मतं मम ॥
translation: और हे देवगण ! सब क्षेत्रों में भी मुझको क्षेत्रज्ञ जानो । क्षेत्र और क्षेत्रज्ञ का जो ज्ञान है वह ज्ञान मेरा अभिमत है
english_translation: Now I reveal this most secret knowledge combined with clear understanding to you free from envy, by knowing which you will be freed from all wrongdoing.
essence: Knowing secret wisdom with clear understanding frees you from all harmful actions.
simple_meaning: You are given the deepest secret knowledge combined with clear understanding, which frees you from all harmful actions.
insight: It encourages you to embrace clear understanding as the key to freeing yourself from harmful patterns.
modern_relevance: You discover a hidden insight that clears confusion and stops you from repeating harmful mistakes.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तत् क्षेत्रं यच्च याहक च यद्विकारि यतश्च यत् ।
स च यो यत्मभावश्च तच्छृणुध्वं समासतः ॥
translation: जो क्षेत्र है वह जो है जैसा है जिन जिन विकारों से युक्त है और जिससे उत्पन्न है एवं वह क्षेत्र भी जो है और जिस प्रभाव का है वह संक्षेप से सुनो
english_translation: O divine beings, this body is called the field, and the one who knows this field is called the knower of the field.
essence: You are the conscious knower distinct from your physical body.
simple_meaning: Your body is like a field, and the true self is the one who observes and knows this field.
insight: It teaches you to shift your identity from the body to the conscious awareness that observes it.
modern_relevance: When you pause and notice your body, you realize that you are the awareness behind the sensations, not just the physical form.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ऋषिभिर्बहुधा गीतं छन्दोभिर्विविधैः पृथक ।
ब्रह्मसूत्र पदैश्चैव हेतुमाद्भिर्विनिश्चितै: ॥
translation: जो ऋषियों से ब्रह्मसूत्र के पदों से और युक्तियुक्त तथा विनिश्चित पृथक् पृथक विविध वैदिक मन्त्रों से अनेक  प्रकार से निरूपित है (उसको संक्षेप से कहता हूँ )
english_translation: And O divine beings! Know Me as the knower of all fields. The knowledge of the field and the knower of the field is considered My wisdom.
essence: You are the observer behind all experiences; that knowing is true wisdom.
simple_meaning: You are the observer of every aspect of life. Recognizing this is true wisdom.
insight: This verse shifts your perspective to seeing yourself as the observer, not just the doer or experiencer.
modern_relevance: When you pause and watch your thoughts and feelings without getting swept away, you connect with the part of you that observes everything calmly.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
महाभूतान्यहंकारो बुद्धिरव्यक्त मेंव च ।
इन्द्रियाणि दशैकञ्च पञ्च चन्द्रियगोचराः ॥
translation: पंच पृथिव्यादि महाभूत, अहङ्कार, बुद्धि, मूल प्रकृति, दश इन्द्रियां एक मन और इन्द्रियों के विषय (शब्दस्पर्शादि ) पंच तन्मात्रा
english_translation: Listen briefly to the field, what it is, its qualities, and its transformations.
essence: Understanding the nature and changes of the field is the foundation for wisdom.
simple_meaning: The verse invites you to understand the nature of the field, its qualities, and how it changes, including what it comes from and what influences it.
insight: It prepares your mind to observe and reflect on the nature and changes of your own experience.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
इच्छा द्वेषः सुखं दुःखं संघातश्चेतना धृतिः ।
एतत् क्षेत्रं समासेन सविकारमुदाहृतम् ॥
translation: इच्छा, द्वेष, सुख, दुःख, संघात (शरीर), चेतना (मनोवृत्ति) और धैर्य यह विकारयुक्त क्षेत्र संक्षेप से  कहा गया है
english_translation: The teaching is presented many ways by sages, through varied Vedic hymns and clear, reasoned Brahmasutra passages.
essence: Timeless wisdom appears in many forms but can be clearly summarized.
simple_meaning: The teachings have been explained by sages in many ways, using different Vedic hymns and clear logical Brahmasutra arguments.
insight: Recognize that deep truths can be expressed through many methods yet point to one essence.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
ज्ञेयं यत्ततप्रवक्ष्यामि यजज्ञात्वाऽमृतमश्नुते ।
अनादिमत्परं ब्रह्म न सत्तन्नासदुच्यते ॥
translation: जो ज्ञेय है उसको कहूँगा जिसको जानकर (साधक) मोक्ष प्राप्त करता है। वह  अनादि परब्रह्म सत् भी नहीं कहे गये हैं और असत् भी नहीं कहे गये हैं
english_translation: The five great elements, the ego, the intellect, the unmanifest root nature, the ten senses, the one mind, and the five objects of the senses.
essence: Your existence is a union of elements, mind, ego, and senses forming a complex whole.
simple_meaning: Your true self includes the five elements, ego, intellect, root nature, mind, senses, and their objects.
insight: It teaches you to see yourself as more than immediate experiences, understanding the layered composition of your being.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by your thoughts and surroundings, remember you are composed of many layers beyond just your mind and body.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सर्वतः पाणिपादं तत् सर्वतोऽक्षिशिरोमुखम् ।
सर्वतः श्रुतिमल्लोके सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठति ॥
translation: वह ( ब्रह्म) सर्वत्र पाणि, पाद, नेत्र, मस्तक, मुख और कर्ण विशिष्ट होकर संसार में सबको आवृत करके ठहरे हुए है
english_translation: Desire, aversion, pleasure, pain, bodily union, consciousness, and perseverance together briefly define the field of change.
essence: Your experience is a field shaped by desire, pain, and steady awareness.
simple_meaning: The body and mind together form a field marked by desires, aversions, joys, pains, and steady effort.
insight: It teaches you to observe desires and feelings as parts of a changing field, reducing identification with them.
modern_relevance: You notice how your moods, wants, and pains make your day feel unstable, like a field always shifting beneath your feet.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सर्वेन्द्रियगुणाभासं  सर्वेन्द्रियविवर्जितम ।
असक्तं सबभृच्चैव निर्गुणं गुणभोक्त च ॥
translation: वह सभी  इन्द्रियों के गुणों के आभास से विशिष्ट, सब इन्द्रियों से रहित, संगशून्य, सभी के आधारभूत, गुणो से रहित और गुणों के भोक्ता हैं
english_translation: I will explain what must be known, by knowing which the seeker attains freedom. It is the eternal supreme reality, neither called existence nor non-existence.
essence: Ultimate reality transcends all labels of existence and non-existence.
simple_meaning: There is a supreme truth to know that leads to freedom. It is eternal and cannot be described simply as existence or non-existence.
insight: It shifts your mind beyond limited categories to embrace a boundless reality.
modern_relevance: When you face impossible questions about what is real, you can find peace knowing some truths are beyond simple labels.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
बहिरन्तश्च भूतानामचरं चरमेव च ।
मूक्ष्मत्वात्तदविज्ञेयं दूरस्थं चान्तिके च यता॥
translation: जो जीवों के बाहर और भीतर है, चर भी हैं और अचर भी हैं, सूक्ष्म होने के कारण अविज्ञेय हैं तथा जो दूर भी हैं और समीप भी हैं
english_translation: The supreme reality pervades everywhere with hands, feet, eyes, head, mouth, and ears, covering and sustaining all in the world.
essence: The supreme reality pervades everything, sustaining all through every part.
simple_meaning: The supreme reality is present everywhere through all limbs and senses, covering and sustaining the entire world.
insight: This verse shifts your view to see the divine presence as intimately involved in every part of existence, not distant or separate.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अविभक्तञ्च भूतेषु विभक्तमिव च स्थितम् ।
भूतभर्तृ च तज्ज्ञेयं ग्रसिष्णु प्रभविष्णु च ॥
translation: जो भूतों में अविभक्त होने पर भी विभक्त की भांति अवस्थित हैं और वह प्राणियों के पालक, संहारक तथा उत्पादक भी हैं ऐसा जानना चाहिए
english_translation: He is distinct from all qualities perceived by the senses, devoid of all senses, unattached, the foundation of all, beyond qualities, and the experiencer of qualities.
essence: The true self is beyond qualities yet witnesses and experiences them without attachment.
simple_meaning: You are separate from the qualities sensed by the body and mind. You do not cling to anything but are the foundation that experiences all qualities.
insight: It shifts your view from identifying with passing qualities to recognizing yourself as the steady experiencer behind them.
modern_relevance: When you're overwhelmed by your emotions or thoughts, this reminds you that your true self is beyond those shifting states yet aware of them.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ज्योतिपामपि तज्ज्योतिस्तमसः परमुच्यते ।
ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं ज्ञानगम्यं हदि सर्वस्य धिष्ठितम् ॥
translation: वह ज्योतियों की भी ज्योति है और अज्ञान से परे स्थित कहे जाते हैं तथा वे ज्ञान, ज्ञेय, ज्ञान से  प्राप्त करने योग्य और सबके हृदय में अवस्थित हैं
english_translation: What exists outside and inside beings, both moving and unmoving, is subtle and beyond perception; it is both distant and near.
essence: You are part of a subtle, unperceivable reality that is both near and far.
simple_meaning: Everything that exists inside and outside living beings, whether moving or still, is subtle and cannot be directly perceived. It is present both near and far.
insight: It shifts your view from seeing yourself as separate to recognizing a subtle, inseparable connection with all existence.
modern_relevance: When you feel isolated or separate, remember that what you truly are is connected to everything subtle and vast, near and far.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
इति क्षेत्र तथा ज्ञानं शेयं चोक्तं समासतः ।
मद्भक्त एतद्विज्ञाय मदावायोपपद्यते ॥
translation: इस प्रकार से क्षेत्र, ज्ञान और ज्ञेय संक्षेप से कहे गये । मेरा भक्त इनको जानकर ब्रह्मत्व प्राप्ति के योग्य होता है
english_translation: The divine is indivisible within beings yet appears divided; it is the sustainer, destroyer, and creator of all beings.
essence: The true self is indivisible yet appears as many in the world.
simple_meaning: The divine presence is both indivisible and appears divided in all beings; it sustains, destroys, and creates all life.
insight: It shifts perception from seeing separation to recognizing underlying unity in all forms.
modern_relevance: In moments of conflict or division, you can remember that beneath appearances, everything is connected and whole.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
प्रकृति पुरुषं चैव वित्तानादी उभावपि ।
विकाराँश्च गुणाँश्चैव वित्त प्रकृतिसम्भवान ॥
translation: प्रकृति और पुरुष इन दोनों को ही अनादि जानो और (देह इन्द्रिय आदि) विकार एवं ( सत्त्व आदि) गुणो को प्रकृति से उत्पन्न समझो।
english_translation: That is the light beyond all lights and beyond darkness; it is knowledge, the object of knowledge, attainable by knowledge, and dwells in every heart.
essence: The highest knowledge shines beyond all darkness and dwells within every heart.
simple_meaning: There is a supreme light beyond all ordinary lights and darkness. This light is true knowledge, the goal and means of understanding, and it lives in every heart.
insight: It shifts your focus from seeking knowledge outside to realizing knowledge is present inside, making inner exploration the true path.
modern_relevance: When you feel lost in confusion or overwhelmed by information, remember the deepest clarity is already within you, waiting to be recognized.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
कार्यकारणकर्तृत्वे हेतुः प्रकृतिमच्यते।
पुरुषः सुखदुःखानां भोक्तृत्वे हेतुरुच्यते !! ॥
translation: कार्य और कारण के कर्तृत्व में प्रकृति हेतु कही गई है और पुरुष सुख दुःखों के भोक्तृत्व में हेतु कहा गया है
english_translation: Thus, the field, the knower, and the known have been briefly explained; my devotee, knowing these, attains the state of supreme reality.
essence: Knowing the relationship of self, world, and awareness leads to supreme realization.
simple_meaning: Three key concepts — the field, the knower, and the known — have been summarized. Knowing them helps you reach the supreme reality.
insight: It shifts the mind to see reality as a relationship between self, experience, and awareness, opening the door to deeper understanding.
modern_relevance: When faced with confusion about yourself and your experience, grasping these three simple ideas can bring clarity and peace.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
पुरुष: प्रकृतिस्थो हि भुन्ज्य्ते प्रकृतिजान गुणान ।
कारणं गुणसङ्गोऽस्य सदसद्योनिजन्मसु  ॥
translation: क्योंकि पुरुष प्रकृतिस्थ होकर प्रकृति से उत्पन्न सब गुणों को भोगता है किन्तु इस पुरुष के सत् एवं असत् योनियो में जन्म होने का कारण गुणों (सत्त्व आदि) का सङ्ग है
english_translation: Know that both Purusha and Prakriti are without beginning; the modifications and qualities arise from Prakriti.
essence: Pure awareness and nature are both eternal; change arises only from nature.
simple_meaning: Pure awareness and nature have no starting point. All changes and qualities come from nature alone.
insight: It shifts your view to see awareness as timeless and stable, separate from the ever-changing qualities around you.
modern_relevance: When life feels chaotic or uncertain, knowing that your true awareness has no beginning or end can bring deep calm amid constant change.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
उपद्रष्टानुऽमन्ता च भर्ता भोक्ता महेश्वरः।
परमात्मेति चाप्युक्तो देहेऽस्मिन् पुरुषः परः ॥
translation: इस देह में (वर्तमान भी) पुरुष (इससे) परे अर्थात् पृथक् हैं क्योंकि वह साक्षिमात्र, अनुग्रहकर्ता, पोषणकर्ता, प्रतिपालक और महेश्वर हैं
english_translation: In the doership of action and cause, nature is called the cause; in experiencing pleasure and pain, the true self is called the cause.
essence: Nature acts as cause, while your true self simply experiences pleasure and pain.
simple_meaning: Nature causes your actions, but your true self experiences their effects like pleasure and pain.
insight: It shifts your view from blaming yourself for outcomes to recognizing your role as the receiver of experience.
modern_relevance: When you face success or failure, realize your efforts were part of conditions beyond you; you simply experience the results.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
य एवं वेत्ति पुरुष प्रकृतिञ्च गुणैः सह ।
सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि न स भूयोऽभिजायते ॥
translation: जो इस प्रकार से पुरुष को और गुणों के साथ प्रकृति को जानता है वह किसी प्रकार से अथवा किसी अवस्था में वर्तमान रहने पर भी पुनर्जन्म ग्रहण नहीं करता है।
english_translation: The true self dwells in the natural world and experiences its qualities; the cause of births in the realms of existence and non-existence is attachment to these qualities.
essence: Attachment to nature’s qualities causes repeated births of being and non-being.
simple_meaning: The true self lives within the natural world and experiences its qualities, but being attached to these qualities leads to repeated births in different realms.
insight: This verse shifts your view from identifying with qualities to seeing attachment as the root cause of repeated reactivity.
modern_relevance: You notice how clinging to moods, habits, or roles keeps pulling you back into old patterns and restless cycles.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ध्यानेनात्मनि पश्यन्ति केचिदात्मानमात्मना ।
अन्ये सांख्येन योगेन कर्मयोगेन चापरं ॥
translation: कोई कोई ध्यानयोग से आत्मा को बुद्धि के द्वारा देह में देखते हैं, अन्य कोई ज्ञानयोग के द्वारा और कोई (निष्काम) कर्मयोग के द्वारा आत्मा को देखते हैं।
english_translation: In this body, the true self is distinct and beyond, as the mere witness, guide, sustainer, protector, and supreme controller.
essence: Your true self is the silent witness beyond your body and its experiences.
simple_meaning: You are not the body but the true self inside who watches, guides, and sustains all experience.
insight: It shifts your view from identifying with the body to recognizing your presence as the silent witness and guide.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by stress or identity struggles, remember you are more than your body or roles—you are the calm observer inside.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अन्ये त्वेवमजानन्तः श्रुत्वाऽन्येभ्य उपासते ।
तेऽपि चातितरन्त्येव मृत्यु श्रुतिपरायणाः ॥
translation: किन्तु अन्य कोई कोई इस प्रकार से अर्थात सांख्ययोग आदि के द्वारा आत्मा को नहीं जानते हुए अन्य अर्थात् गुरु आचार्य आदि से सुनकर उपासना करते हैं वह भी श्रुतिपरायण होकर मृत्यु को अतिक्रमण करते ही हैं
english_translation: One who thus knows the true self and the natural world with its qualities, though present in all states, is never reborn again.
essence: Knowing the true self along with nature frees you from being born again.
simple_meaning: If you understand the true self and the natural world together, even while living in any state, you will not be born again.
insight: It teaches you to see your true self beyond all changing qualities and conditions, ending repeated rebirth.
modern_relevance: You can face every part of your life fully aware, yet not be trapped by repeated patterns or old identities.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यावत्संजायते किञ्चित् सत्त्वं स्थावरजङ्गमम्।
क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञसंयोगात् तद्वित्त विबुधर्षभाः !॥
translation: हे देवश्रेष्ठों ! जो कुछ स्थावर या जंगम जीव उत्पन्न होते हैं वे सब क्षेत्र और क्षेत्रज्ञ के संयोग से त्पन्न होते हैं सो जानो
english_translation: Some see the true self within the body through meditation, others through wisdom, and some through selfless action.
essence: Your true self can be known through meditation, wisdom, or selfless action.
simple_meaning: You can realize your true self in different ways: through focused meditation, clear wisdom, or by acting without desire for results.
insight: It opens your mind to accept multiple valid approaches for inner realization, encouraging flexibility in practice.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by choices, remember that quiet reflection, clear understanding, or dedicated service can all help you connect with who you really are.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
समं सर्चषु भूतेषु तिष्ठन्तं परमेश्वरम् ।
विनश्यत्स्वविनश्यन्तं यः पश्यति स पश्यति ॥
translation: सब जीवों में संभाव से अवस्थित और सब जीवों के विनाश होते रहने पर भी अविनाशी जो परमात्मा हैं उनको जो देखता है वही देखता है।
english_translation: Others, not knowing the true self through direct experience, worship based on what they have heard from teachers; even they overcome death by faithfully following the scripture.
essence: Trusting and practicing teachings heard from others can still lead beyond death.
simple_meaning: Some people don’t directly realize their true self but follow teachings they’ve heard from teachers. Even this devotion helps them overcome death.
insight: It teaches you to value sincere devotion to teachings, even without full direct understanding.
modern_relevance: You might not fully understand a spiritual truth yourself but following trusted guidance with faith can still transform your life deeply.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सम पश्च्यन ही सर्वत्र समवस्थितमीश्वरम   
न हिनस्त्यात्मनात्मानं ततो याति परां गतिम् ॥
translation: क्योंकि सब भूतों में समभाव से अवस्थित परमात्मा को देखता हुआ साधक अपने से अपने को हनन नहीं करता है इसलिये वह परागति अर्थात् मुक्ति को प्राप्त होता है
english_translation: O best of the divine beings, all that arises—whether immovable or moving life—comes from the union of the field and the knower of the field.
essence: All existence arises from the union of the physical and the conscious knower.
simple_meaning: All living and non-living things come into being because of the connection between the physical body and the consciousness that knows it.
insight: This verse shifts focus from identifying as only the body or mind to recognizing the dynamic relationship that creates experience.
modern_relevance: When you feel stuck or limited by your body or thoughts, remember that life arises from their union, not just from one part alone.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
प्रकृत्यैव च कर्माणि क्रियमाणानि सर्वशः।
यः पश्यति तथात्मानमकर्तारं स पश्यति ॥
translation: प्रकृति ही सब प्रकार के कार्यों को करती है और आत्मा अकर्ता है, इस प्रकार जो देखता है वही देखता है
english_translation: One who sees the supreme being as equal in all beings, existing permanently yet witnessing their destruction, truly sees.
essence: True seeing is recognizing the unchanging divine equally present in all beings despite their changes.
simple_meaning: The supreme being exists equally in every being, unchanged despite their birth and death. Seeing this is true vision.
insight: It shifts your vision from seeing only change and loss to perceiving an unchanging presence in all.
modern_relevance: When you see everyone as equally connected to something unchanging, judgments soften and compassion grows naturally.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यदा भूतपृथगभावमेकस्थमनुपश्यति ।
तत एव च विस्तारं ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा ॥
translation: जब भूतो के पृथक भाव को एकस्थ अर्थात् एक हीं ब्रह्म में अवस्थित देखता है और उसी एक से भूतों का विस्तार देखता है तब वह ब्रह्म हो जाता है
english_translation: Seeing the supreme being equally present in all beings, the practitioner does not harm the self, and thus attains the highest freedom.
essence: Seeing the divine equally in all stops inner harm and leads to supreme freedom.
simple_meaning: When you recognize the divine equally in everyone, you stop hurting yourself and reach the highest freedom.
insight: This verse guides you to view all beings as one, shifting behavior from self-harm to self-care.
modern_relevance: In moments of conflict, realizing others share your true nature can stop you from self-destructive reactions.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अनादित्वानिर्गुणत्वात् परमात्मायमव्ययः।
शरीरस्थोऽपि भो देवाः ! न करोति न लिप्यते ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! यह परमात्मा अनादि और निर्गुण होने के कारण अविकारी हैं इसलिये शरीर में रहने पर भी न करते हैं और न फलों से लिप्त होते हैं
english_translation: All actions are performed by the natural world; the true self sees itself as not the doer.
essence: The true self is the silent witness while nature performs all actions.
simple_meaning: All actions happen through the natural world, while your true self remains detached as the observer, not the doer.
insight: Shift your mind from identifying as the doer to observing actions as natural processes beyond personal control.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by responsibilities, remember that many forces beyond your control shape outcomes; your core self remains untouched.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यथा सर्वगतं सौम्यादाकाशं नोपलिप्यते ।
सर्वत्रावस्थितो देहे तथात्मा नोपलिप्यते ॥
translation: जिस प्रकार सभी मे विद्यमान आकाश सूक्ष्म होने के कारण लिप्त नहीं होता है उसी प्रकार देह में सर्वत्र अवस्थित परमात्मा (देह धर्म से) लिप्त नहीं होते हैं
english_translation: When someone sees the separate existence of beings as one and the vastness of all beings in that one, then they become the supreme reality.
essence: True self-realization comes from seeing all beings as one unified whole.
simple_meaning: You realize the supreme reality when you see that all beings are expressions of one unity.
insight: Shift your perception from separation to unity; this changes your sense of self and connection.
modern_relevance: When you stop seeing others as separate and instead recognize your shared essence, conflicts and loneliness soften.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यथा प्रकाशयत्येक: कृत्सनं लोकमिम रवि: ।
क्षेत्र क्षेत्री तथा कृत्सनं प्रकाशयति निर्जरा ! ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! जिस प्रकार एक सूर्य इस सम्पूर्ण लोक को प्रकाशित करता है उसी प्रकार क्षेत्री अर्थात् क्षेत्र आत्मा सम्पूर्ण क्षेत्र अर्थात् महाभूतादि विशिष्ट शरीरों को प्रकाशित करता है
english_translation: O radiant beings, the supreme reality is beginningless and without qualities; residing in the body, it neither acts nor is attached to the results.
essence: The eternal self within you acts not and is never attached to outcomes.
simple_meaning: The supreme reality inside your body is eternal, without qualities, does not act, nor does it get attached to outcomes.
insight: Recognize the difference between your eternal true self and the temporary actions and attachments of your body.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by your roles and results, remember there is a part of you untouched and free inside.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोरेवमंतरं ज्ञानचक्षुषा ।
भूतप्रकृतिमोक्षश्च ये विर्दुयान्ति ते परम ॥
translation: इस प्रकार से जो क्षेत्र और क्षेत्रज्ञ का प्रभेद एवं जीवों की प्रकृति से मुक्ति ज्ञान नेत्र से जानते हैं वह परमपद को प्राप्त होते हैं
english_translation: Just as the all-pervading sky remains untouched by anything subtle, the true self present throughout the body is not tainted by the body.
essence: Your true self pervades your body but remains untouched by it.
simple_meaning: Your true self is everywhere in your body but remains pure and unaffected by it.
insight: It teaches you to see your inner being as separate from the body’s fluctuations and remain unaffected by them.
modern_relevance: You notice your thoughts and feelings arise and pass, yet the core of who you are feels steady and untouched.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
परं भूयः प्रवक्ष्यामि ज्ञानानां ज्ञानमुत्तमम् ।
यज्ज्ञात्वा मुनयः सर्वे परां सिद्धिमितो गताः ॥
translation: मैं पुनः सब ज्ञानों में उत्तम परम ज्ञान अर्थात् परमात्म सम्बन्धी ज्ञान कहूँगा जिसको जानकर सब मुनिगण इस देह बन्धन से (मुक्त होकर) परा सिद्धि अर्थात् मोक्ष को प्राप्त हुए हैं।
english_translation: Just as one sun illuminates the entire world, similarly the knower of the field illuminates all bodies composed of elements.
essence: Your true self lights up your entire being just as one sun lights the world.
simple_meaning: The true self within you shines through your body just as the sun lights the whole world.
insight: It shifts your view from identifying with the body to recognizing the true self as the illuminator within.
modern_relevance: When you feel scattered or lost, remembering that your true self shines through all your experience can steady your mind.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
इदं ज्ञानमुपाश्रित्य मम साधर्म्यमागताः।
सर्गेऽपि नोपजायन्ते प्रलये न व्यथन्ति च ॥
translation: इस ज्ञान को पाकर मेरे स्वरूपत्व को प्राप्त होते हुए वह  मुनिगण सृष्टिकाल में भी उत्पन्न नहीं होते और न प्रलयकाल में प्रलय का  दुःख अनुभव करते हैं
english_translation: Those who clearly distinguish the field and the knower of the field with the eye of knowledge, and who understand freedom from the nature of beings, attain the supreme state.
essence: True freedom arises from seeing the difference between the observer and the observed.
simple_meaning: You become free when you understand the difference between the changing world and the one who observes it.
insight: It shifts your mind from identifying with change to resting as the witness, reducing reactivity.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by emotions or thoughts, recognizing you are the observer—not the feelings—can bring calm and freedom.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
मम योनिर्महद्ब्रह्म तस्मिन् गर्भ दधाम्यहं ।
सम्भवः सर्वभूतानां ततो भवाति निन्जर्राः ! ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! महद्ब्रह्म अर्थात् मूलप्रकृति मेरी योनि अर्थात गर्भाधान का स्थान  है, उसी में मैं गर्भाधान करता हूँ उससे सब भूतों की अर्थात् ब्रह्मा आदि की उत्पत्ति होती है।
english_translation: I will now declare the supreme knowledge beyond all knowledge, which, when known by sages, leads them beyond the body’s bondage to the highest accomplishment.
essence: Knowing the supreme knowledge frees you beyond bodily limitation to highest accomplishment.
simple_meaning: There is a supreme knowledge beyond all others. Knowing it frees sages from the body and grants the highest achievement.
insight: It shifts your view from limited identity to a limitless state beyond the body and mind.
modern_relevance: When you discover a truth that changes how you see yourself, it can free you from the limits you feel every day.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सर्वयोनिषु भो देवाः ! मूर्तयः सम्भवन्ति याः।
तासां ब्रह्म महद्योनिरहं बीजप्रदः पिता ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! सब योनियों में जो स्थावर जङ्गम रूपी मूर्तियां उत्पन्न होती हैं महद्ब्रह्म अर्थात् मूलप्रकृति उनकी योनि अर्थात् मातृस्थानीय है और मैं बीजप्रद गर्भाधान कर्ता पिता हूँ
english_translation: Those who take refuge in this knowledge and attain likeness to me are not born at creation nor distressed at dissolution.
essence: True knowledge aligns you with the divine, freeing you from birth and death.
simple_meaning: Those who deeply grasp this knowledge and become like the divine are not reborn nor shaken by destruction.
insight: It shifts your view from fearing change to seeing yourself as beyond birth and loss.
modern_relevance: You face endings and new beginnings in life, but understanding your true self can keep you steady through all transitions.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
पंचैतानि सुरश्रेष्ठा ! कारणानि निबोधत ।
सांख्ये कृतान्ते प्रोक्तानि सिद्धये सर्वकर्मणाम् ॥
translation: हे सुरश्रेष्ठो! सभी कर्मों की सिद्धि के लिये ज्ञान प्रतिपादक शास्त्र में कहे हुए वक्ष्यमाण पांच कारणों को जानो
english_translation: O divine beings, the great Brahman is my source; in it I place the seed, from which all beings arise and then dissolve.
essence: All beings arise and dissolve from one supreme source where creation begins.
simple_meaning: The supreme reality is the source where I place the seed of creation, from which all beings come and later dissolve.
insight: It shifts understanding from separate beings to a single source that births and absorbs all existence.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अधिष्ठानं तथा कर्ता करणञ्च पृथग्विधम् ।
विविधाश्च पृथक चेष्टा दैवं चैवात्र पञ्चमम् ॥
translation: इस संसार में अधिष्ठान शरीर कर्ता अहङ्कार अनेक प्रकार के करण चक्षुरादि इन्द्रियां नानाविध चेष्टा अर्थात् प्राण अपान आदि की क्रियाएँ और देव पाचवां है
english_translation: O radiant beings, all forms that arise in every source come from the great Brahman, the primal nature, and I am the seed-giving father.
essence: All forms arise from the primal nature; I am the seed-giving originator.
simple_meaning: All forms in the world come from the great primal nature, and I am the source that initiates their creation.
insight: Recognize that all diverse forms have a common origin and a source that initiates manifestation.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
शरीरवाङ्मनोभिर्यत् कर्म प्रारभ्यते खलु ।
न्याय्यं वा विपरीतं वा पञ्चेते तस्य हेतवः ॥
translation: शरीर, वाक और मन द्वारा जो धर्म अथवा अधर्म कर्म किया जाता है, पूर्वोक्त ये ही पांच उसके हेतु हैं
english_translation: O best of the Devas! Understand the five causes explained in the wisdom teachings that lead to the perfection of all actions.
essence: Understanding five fundamental causes unlocks the perfection of all actions.
simple_meaning: There are five important causes explained in wisdom teachings that lead to success in all actions.
insight: It teaches you to look deeper at fundamental causes behind your actions rather than just their effects.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by choices, knowing the core reasons behind your actions can clear confusion and point you forward.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तत्रैवं सति कर्तारमात्मानं केवलन्तु यः।
पश्यत्यकृतबुद्धित्वान्न स पश्याति दुर्मतिः ॥
translation: ऐसा होने पर उक्त विषय में जो व्यक्ति केवल (निःसङ्ग) आत्मा को कर्ता समझता है, अनिर्मल बुद्धि होने के कारण वह दुर्मति देख नहीं सकता है अर्थात् यथार्थदर्शी नहीं है
english_translation: In this world, the foundation is the body; the doer is the sense of ego; the instruments are various; the senses are many kinds of activities; and the divine is the fifth.
essence: You are body, ego, senses, and beyond them, the divine support.
simple_meaning: The body is the base where action happens; the sense of ego feels like the doer; many instruments and senses perform different activities; beyond all these is the divine presence.
insight: Recognize your experience as multiple layers and shift attention from the ego-doer to the divine support behind all action.
modern_relevance: When you feel overwhelmed by your thoughts, feelings, and actions, remember there is a deeper presence supporting you beyond your body and ego.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यस्य नाऽहंकृतो भावो बुद्धिर्यस्य लिप्यते।
हत्वाऽपि स न इमान् लोकान् न हन्ति न निवध्यते ॥
translation: जिसको “ मैं कर्ता हूँ" यह भाव नहीं है और  जिसकी बुद्धि (इष्टानिष्ट कर्म में ) लिप्त नहीं होती है वह इन सब लोको को नाश करके भी नहीं नाश करता है और बन्धन को प्राप्त नहीं होता है
english_translation: Action begins through body, speech, and mind; its cause is always one of five reasons, whether right or wrong.
essence: Every action arises through body, speech, or mind driven by five causes, right or wrong.
simple_meaning: All actions start through the body, speech, or mind and arise from five possible causes, whether right or wrong.
insight: It helps you recognize which faculty—body, speech, or mind—is driving your actions and what motivates them.
modern_relevance: You notice how your choices come from what you say, do, or think, influenced by clear reasons behind them.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
दूरेण ह्यवरं कर्म बुद्धियोगादिवौकसः।
अन्विच्छताश्रयं बुद्धौ कृपणाः फलहेतवः ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! ज्ञानयोग की अपेक्षा कर्मयोग अत्यंत ही निकृष्ट है इसलिये आपको ज्ञानयोग के आश्रय की इच्छा करनी चाहिए, फलके चाहने वाले व्यक्ति कृपण अर्थात् निकृष्ट होते हैं
english_translation: When someone sees only the self as the doer in that situation, their impure mind prevents them from seeing the truth; such a person lacks clear understanding.
essence: Seeing only yourself as doer blocks clear understanding of reality.
simple_meaning: If you consider only your separate self as the doer, your mind becomes unclear and you fail to see the whole truth.
insight: It teaches you to broaden your view beyond personal ego as the sole doer to gain clear perception.
modern_relevance: When you take full credit for events without seeing the bigger picture, you limit your understanding and cause frustration.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
या निशा सर्वभूतानां तस्यां जागृति संयमी ।
यस्यां जाग्रति भूतानि सा निशा पश्यतो मुनेः॥
translation: अज्ञानाच्छन्न समस्त प्राणियों के लिये जो रात्रि है अर्थात् वह वे आत्मा को नहीं देख सकते हैं उस रात्रि में जितेन्द्रिय व्यक्ति जागता है अर्थात् आत्म साक्षात्कार करता है और जिस (विषयबुद्धि) में जीवगण जागते हैं अर्थात् जगत को सत्य अनुभव करते हैं वह आत्मतत्त्व दर्शी मुनि के लिये रात्रि के समान है अर्थात् उसकी विषयों की ओर दृष्टि नहीं रहती है
english_translation: One who has no sense of 'I am the doer' and whose mind is not attached to desired or undesired actions does not destroy these worlds even by killing, nor is bound.
essence: Acting without ego or attachment means your deeds neither bind nor harm you.
simple_meaning: If you do not feel that you are the doer and your mind is not attached to outcomes, your actions do not bind or destroy you.
insight: It shifts your mind from ownership of action to pure engagement without ego, freeing you from bondage to results.
modern_relevance: You finished a difficult task without boasting or clinging to praise. You realize your effort is your own, not your identity.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
प्रजहाति यदा कामान् देवाः ! सर्वान् मनोगतान् ।
आत्मन्येवात्मना तुष्ट: स्थितप्रज्ञस्यदोच्य्ते ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! परमानन्द स्वरुप आत्मा में ही स्वयं तुष्ट होकर जब (योगी) मनोगत सम्पूर्ण कामनाओं का त्याग करता है तब वह स्थितप्रज्ञ कहा जाता है
english_translation: Action without wisdom is far inferior; those who desire only results are miserly and low.
essence: Acting only for outcomes is shallow; wisdom gives true depth to action.
simple_meaning: Actions done without wisdom are weak and lower; wanting only the reward shows smallness.
insight: It shifts your focus from craving results to seeking understanding, enriching your actions.
modern_relevance: You push hard to finish a task just for praise or bonus, but feel empty inside because the deeper meaning is missing.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
दु:खेष्वनुद्विगनमना: सुखेषु विगतस्पृह: ।
वीतरागभयक्रोध: स्थितधीर्मुनीरुच्य्ते ॥
translation: जिसका मन दुःखों में उद्विग्न नहीं होता है, सुखों में जिसकी स्पृहा नहीं है और जिसके राग, भय एवं क्रोध दूर होग ये हैं वह मुनि ‘स्थितधी' कहा जाता है
english_translation: For all beings, that which is ignorance is night; for the self-controlled, that same is awakening. Where beings are awake, that is night for the seer who perceives the true self.
essence: Your true awareness feels like awakening while others remain lost in ignorance.
simple_meaning: What feels like ignorance and darkness to most is awakening and clear seeing for the self-controlled seer.
insight: It shifts your perspective to recognize that your awareness may differ from the crowd’s perception, highlighting the value of self-control.
modern_relevance: When everyone around you seems confused or caught up in distractions, you can remain clear and aware of what truly matters.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यः सर्वत्रानभिस्नेहस्तत्तत् प्राप्य शुभाशुभम् ।
नाभिनन्दात न द्वेष्टि तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता ॥
translation: जो सब विषयों में ममता शून्य होकर उस उस शुभ और अशुभ को प्राप्त करके न आनन्दित होता है और न विषादयुक्त होता है उसकी प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठित होती है अर्थात् प्रकृष्टरूप से ब्रह्म में स्थित रहती है
english_translation: When a yogi renounces all desires born in the mind and is satisfied in the true self alone, he is called a person of steady wisdom.
essence: Steady wisdom arises when inner fulfillment replaces all desires.
simple_meaning: You become steady and wise when you let go of all desires and feel satisfied within your true self.
insight: It teaches you to shift focus from chasing desires to embracing inner satisfaction as true strength.
modern_relevance: After scrolling endlessly through wants and distractions, you pause and realize your calm center is enough.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यदा संहरते चायं कूर्मोऽङ्गानीव सर्वशः।
इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेभयस्तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठता ॥
translation: जब यह (योगी) इन्द्रियों के सभी विषयों से इन्द्रियों को, कछुपा जैसे अङ्गो को खींच लेता है उसी प्रकार सर्वथा खींच लेता है तब उसकी प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठित होती है।
english_translation: A sage whose mind is undisturbed by pain, without craving in pleasure, free from attachment, fear, and anger is called steady-minded.
essence: True steadiness comes from freedom from craving, fear, and anger amid life's fluctuations.
simple_meaning: A person who does not get upset by pain, does not crave pleasure, and has let go of attachment, fear, and anger is steady-minded.
insight: It teaches you to observe experiences without being pulled into craving or aversion, stabilizing your inner state.
modern_relevance: You face criticism or praise at work but your peace stays firm, untouched by external highs or lows.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
विषया विनिवर्तन्ते निराहारस्य देहिनः।
रसवर्ज रसोऽप्यस्य परं दृष्ट्वा निवर्त्तते ॥
translation: जो इन्द्रिय द्वारा विषय ग्रहण नहीं करता है ऐसे देहधारी व्यक्ति के विषय निवृत्त हो जाते हैं किन्तु भोगाभिलाषा निवृत्त नहीं होती है; परन्तु परमात्मा के साक्षात्कार होने पर उसकी वह विषयभोग की अभिलाषा भी निवृत्त हो जाती है
english_translation: One whose wisdom is established neither clings to nor rejects good or bad experiences everywhere.
essence: True wisdom is steady in all experiences, neither drawn nor repelled.
simple_meaning: You can face every experience, good or bad, without clinging or pushing it away. This steady mind shows true wisdom.
insight: It teaches you to hold your attention steady, not pulled by attraction or aversion toward events.
modern_relevance: You receive praise or criticism at work but stay calm inside, neither overly proud nor upset.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यततो ह्यपि हे देवाः ! साधकस्य विपश्चितः।
इन्द्रियाणि प्रमाथीनि हरन्ति प्रसभं मनः॥
translation: क्योंकि हे देवगण ! यत्न करते हुए विद्वान् साधक के भी मन को प्रमाथी अर्थात् क्षोभ उत्पन्न करने वाले इन्द्रियगण हठात् खींच लेते हैं
english_translation: When a yogi withdraws the senses from their objects, just as a tortoise pulls its limbs inside, then his wisdom is firmly established.
essence: Withdrawing your senses from distractions stabilizes your wisdom like a tortoise withdrawing its limbs.
simple_meaning: When you consciously withdraw your senses from their distractions, your wisdom becomes steady and clear like a tortoise pulling its limbs inside.
insight: It teaches you to redirect attention inward, away from external distractions, stabilizing your mind for wiser action.
modern_relevance: When you stop checking your phone or social media and pull back from constant input, you create space for clear insight.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तानि सर्वाणि संयम्य युक्त आसीत मत्परः।
वशे हि यस्येन्द्रियाणि तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता ॥
translation: योगी को उन सभी इन्द्रियों को संयत करके आत्मपरायण होकर रहना चाहिए क्योंकि जिसकी इन्द्रियां वश में हैं उसकी प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठित है
english_translation: Objects of sense withdraw from the embodied one who does not grasp them; yet desire for enjoyment remains; but upon realizing the supreme reality, even that desire subsides.
essence: You can resist pleasures but desire ends only by recognizing the supreme reality.
simple_meaning: When you don’t seek sense pleasures, their pull lessens, but desire may still stay until you realize a deeper truth beyond them.
insight: It teaches you to distinguish between sensory avoidance and the deeper shift that ends desire through realization.
modern_relevance: You may avoid distractions like social media or junk food, yet still feel restless until you connect with something deeper within.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ध्यायतो विषयानस्य सङ्गस्तेषूपजायते ।
सङ्गात्संजायते कामः कामात् क्रोधोऽभिजायते ॥
translation: विषयों की चिन्ता करने वाले  योगी की आसक्ति विषयों में होजाती है और आसक्ति से काम उत्पन्न होता है एवं काम से क्रोध उत्पन्न होता है
english_translation: Even the wise practitioner struggles as restless senses suddenly pull the mind away.
essence: Striving alone doesn’t stop restless senses from pulling your mind away.
simple_meaning: Even a wise person who strives can have their mind disturbed by restless senses.
insight: Recognize that restless senses will challenge your discipline; persistence is essential despite interruptions.
modern_relevance: You sit to meditate, determined to focus, but distractions keep pulling your attention away unexpectedly.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
क्रोधात् भवति संमोहः संमोहात स्मृतिविभ्रमः ।
स्मृति भ्रन्शादबुद्धिनाशो बुद्धिनाशात प्रणश्यति ॥
translation: क्रोध से सम्मोह होता है, सम्मोह से स्मृतिविभ्रम, स्मृति करे भ्रष्ट होने से बुद्धि का नाश और बुद्धि के नाश से जीव नष्ट हो जाता है अर्थात अत्यंत रूप से पतित हो जाता है
english_translation: The yogi should control all the senses and be devoted to the inner being, for whose senses are controlled, wisdom is established.
essence: True wisdom arises when your senses are controlled and your focus is devoted inward.
simple_meaning: You should control all your senses and stay devoted to your true self; when your senses are under control, your wisdom becomes steady.
insight: It teaches you to practice self-discipline over your senses so your discerning mind can stabilize and guide you.
modern_relevance: You notice how distractions pull your attention in every direction—when you regain control, your clarity and confidence return.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
रागद्वेषवियुक्तैस्तु विषयानिन्द्रियैश्चरन ।
आत्मवश्यैविधेयात्मा प्रसादमधिगच्छति ॥
translation: किन्तु राग द्वेष से रहित आत्म वशीभूत इन्द्रियों क्र द्वारा विषयभोग करने पर जिसका मन वशीभूत है, ऐसा व्यक्ति आत्मप्रसाद अर्थात शान्तिलाभ करता है
english_translation: Fixing the mind on objects causes attachment; attachment leads to desire; desire breeds anger.
essence: Focusing on objects triggers attachment, which leads to desire and then anger.
simple_meaning: When you focus your mind on external things, attachment grows. That attachment creates desire, which then leads to anger.
insight: It teaches you to notice how your mental focus creates emotional chains and to redirect your attention before attachment forms.
modern_relevance: You scroll social media, obsessing over likes and comments; that fixation sparks craving and frustration when things don't go your way.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
प्रसादे सर्व्दु:खानां हानिरस्योपजायते ।
प्रसन्नचेतसो ह्याशु बुद्धिः पर्यवतिष्ठते ॥
translation: आत्मप्रसाद प्राप्त करने पर योगी के सब दुःख नष्ट हो जाते हैं क्योंकि प्रसन्नचित्त व्यक्ति की बुद्धि शीघ्र प्रतिष्ठित अर्थात् आत्मनिष्ठ हो जाती है
english_translation: Anger leads to confusion, confusion causes memory loss, memory loss destroys discernment, and without discernment, the being is lost.
essence: Anger initiates a chain that destroys mental clarity and leads to self-loss.
simple_meaning: Anger causes confusion, which leads to memory mistakes, destroying clear thinking, and ultimately causes loss of self-awareness.
insight: It teaches you to recognize anger’s ripple effect that gradually erodes your mental clarity and self-control.
modern_relevance: When you lose your temper during a stressful day, your thoughts scatter, making it hard to remember or decide clearly.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
नास्ति बुद्धि युक्तस्य न चायुक्तस्य भावना ।
न चाभावयतः शान्तिरशान्तस्य कुतः सुखम् ॥
translation: ब्रह्म में अयुक्त व्यक्ति की आत्म विषयिणी बुद्धि नहीं होती है, अयुक्त व्यक्ति को भावना अर्थात् आत्मविषयक ध्यान भी नहीं होता है, आत्मध्यानविहीन व्यक्ति को शान्ति नहीं मिलती और शान्तिहीन व्यक्ति के लिये मोक्षानन्द रूप सुख कहाँ ?
english_translation: But one who, free from attachment and aversion, controls the senses and acts with a disciplined mind attains inner calm.
essence: Calm arises when you master senses free from craving and aversion.
simple_meaning: When you act without craving or dislike and keep your senses under control, your mind becomes calm and peaceful.
insight: It shifts your focus from being ruled by likes and dislikes to steady control over your senses, creating inner calm.
modern_relevance: You notice how peace slips away when your emotions pull you toward what you want or push you away from what you dislike. Learning to steady your mind brings lasting calm.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
इन्द्रियाणा ही चरतां यन्मनोऽनुविधीयते ।
तदस्य हरति प्रज्ञा वायु वमिवाम्भसि ॥
translation: क्योंकि जिस प्रकार वायु असावधानी वश  कर्णधार वाली नौका को जल में डुबा देता है उसी प्रकार इन्द्रियां जिस ओर जाती हैं उसी ओर जो मन चला जाता है वह मन योगी की प्रज्ञा को (विषय में ) खींच लेता है
english_translation: When the inner being is delighted, all suffering fades; a serene mind quickly gains steady wisdom.
essence: Inner delight dissolves suffering and quickly grounds steady wisdom in the mind.
simple_meaning: When your inner being is joyful and calm, all your suffering disappears because your mind settles into clear wisdom.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate inner delight to dissolve suffering and stabilize your understanding.
modern_relevance: You find a quiet moment of true joy, and suddenly your worries lose their grip, leaving your mind clear and steady.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
तस्माद्यस्य सुरश्रेष्ठाः : निगृहीतानि सर्वशः।
इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेभ्यस्तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता ॥
translation: इसलिये हे सुरश्रेष्ठों ! जिसकी इन्द्रियां इन्द्रियों के विषयों से सब प्रकार से निगृहीत हैं उसकी बुद्धि प्रतिष्ठित होती है
english_translation: One without discerning mind lacks focused attention on the true self; without such attention, there is no peace; without peace, how can there be lasting happiness?
essence: Without clear inner focus, peace and lasting happiness cannot arise.
simple_meaning: Without a clear, discerning mind focused on your true self, you cannot find peace, and without peace, lasting happiness is impossible.
insight: It teaches you to cultivate steady attention on your true self as the foundation for inner peace and happiness.
modern_relevance: When your mind is scattered and restless, no matter how hard you try, true calm or joy feels out of reach.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ज्ञानाधार ! दयागार ! विश्वात्मन् ! विश्वभावन !।
रहस्यं ज्ञानकाण्डस्य वैदिकस्य तदद्भुतम् ॥
translation: हे ज्ञानाधार ! हे दयासिन्धो ! हे विश्वात्मन् ! हे विश्वभावन ! वैदिक ज्ञानकाण्ड के इस अद्भुत रहस्य को
english_translation: Just as the wind carelessly overturns a boat with a helmsman, so the mind follows the senses, pulling the yogi's wisdom into worldly objects.
essence: The mind blindly follows the senses, risking loss of steady wisdom like a boat overturned by wind.
simple_meaning: The mind follows the senses like a boat pushed by the wind, pulling your wisdom away from its steady course.
insight: It teaches you to recognize the mind’s tendency to chase senses and to cultivate steady awareness despite distractions.
modern_relevance: You notice your attention slipping toward notifications, pulling you away from your calm focus and inner clarity.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
श्रुत्वा साम्प्रतमज्ञानान्मुक्ता जाता वयं विभो ।
किन्तु संश्रूयते नाथ ! कश्चिज्जीवो न चाहति ॥
translation: सुनकर हे विभो! हम इस समय प्रज्ञानमुक्त हुए हैं परन्तु हे नाथ! सुना है कि कोई जीव कभी
english_translation: Therefore, O best of the gods, one whose senses are fully restrained from sense objects has established wisdom.
essence: True wisdom arises when your senses no longer chase after external things.
simple_meaning: Your wisdom becomes steady when you completely control your senses and do not chase after their objects.
insight: It teaches you to restrain sensory impulses, redirecting energy inward to establish steady wisdom.
modern_relevance: Your phone buzzes, notifications flood in; wisdom grows when you resist these distractions and keep your focus steady.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सन्न्यासेन विना मुक्तिमधिगन्तुं कदाचन ।
सन्यासलक्षणंचातद्रहस्यंच हे प्रभो ॥
translation: बिना संन्यास के मुक्त नहीं हो सकता इसलिए हे प्रभो ! सन्यास क्या है और इसका रहस्य क्या है
english_translation: O foundation of knowledge, ocean of compassion, universal self, creator of the universe, this is the wondrous secret of the Vedic knowledge section.
essence: Profound wisdom arises from the compassionate universal source behind all knowledge.
simple_meaning: This verse calls out to the divine by many names, introducing a wondrous secret from the Vedic knowledge section.
insight: It prepares the mind to receive deep wisdom by honoring its source, opening the heart for learning.
speaker: Unknown
