verse_text:
ब्रूहि यह कृतार्था हि भवामसत्वरितं वयं ।
प्राप्नुम: परमात्मानं भवंत चैव मुक्तिदम ॥
translation: वह कहिये जिससे हम शीघ्र कृतकृत्य होवें तथा परमात्मा और मुक्तिदाता, स्वयं आपको प्राप्त कर सकें
english_translation: Having heard this, O Vibhava, we have now become freed from ignorance, but O Lord, it is heard that no living being ever truly desires freedom.
essence: Many understand freedom but few truly desire to embrace it fully.
simple_meaning: We have become free from ignorance by hearing, but it is said that no living being truly wants freedom.
insight: It reveals the gap between intellectual understanding and heartfelt desire for inner freedom.
modern_relevance: You might understand a concept clearly but still feel resistance or doubt about truly embracing freedom or change.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सन्न्यासः कर्मयोगश्च निःश्रेयसकरावुभौ ।
तयोस्तु कर्मसन्यासात् कर्मयोगो विशिष्यते ॥
translation: कर्मत्याग और कर्मयोग दोनों मोक्षदायक हैं किन्तु उनमें कर्म सन्यास से कर्मयोग श्रेष्ठ है
english_translation: Without renunciation, liberation can never be attained; explain, O Lord, the nature and secret of renunciation.
essence: Liberation requires true renunciation and understanding its hidden meaning.
simple_meaning: You cannot attain liberation without renunciation; understanding what renunciation truly means is essential.
insight: This verse shifts your focus from seeking freedom externally to starting with inner renunciation and understanding its nature.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by attachments, you sense freedom is impossible until you learn to let go deeply and truly.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
ज्ञेयः स नित्यसन्न्यासी यो न द्वेष्टि न काङ्क्षति ।
निर्द्वन्द्वो हि सुपर्वाणः ! मुखं बन्धाद्विमुच्यते ॥
translation: जो न द्वेष करता है और न आकांषा करता है उसको नित्य सन्यासी अर्थात् कर्म के अनुष्ठान काल में भी सन्यासी जानना उचित है क्योंकि हे देवगण ! राग द्वेषादि द्वन्द्व से रहित व्यक्ति अनायास बन्धन से छूट जाता  है
english_translation: Speak of that through which we quickly become fulfilled and attain the supreme being and the giver of liberation.
essence: Knowing what leads quickly to true fulfillment brings freedom and connection to the supreme being.
simple_meaning: You are asked to explain what helps us quickly feel complete and reach the supreme being who grants freedom.
insight: It shifts the focus from vague searching to learning the direct path to fulfillment and freedom.
modern_relevance: You want a clear answer that helps you feel truly satisfied and free, without wasting time wandering.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
सांख्ययोगौ पृथग्बालाः प्रवदन्ति न पण्डिताः।
एकमप्यास्थितः सम्यगुभयोर्विन्दते फलम् ॥
translation: साङ्ख्य और योग अर्थात् ज्ञानयोग और कर्मयोग पृथक् हैं इस बात को अज्ञानी कहते हैं,  पण्डित ऐसा नहीं कहते क्योंकि एक का सम्यक् आश्रय करने वाला भी दोनों का फल प्राप्त करता है
english_translation: Renunciation of action and the yoga of action both lead to inner freedom, but the yoga of action is superior to renunciation of action.
essence: Mindful action frees you more than simply giving up action.
simple_meaning: Both giving up action and acting with detached awareness can bring freedom, but acting mindfully leads to a higher freedom.
insight: It shifts your approach from avoidance to conscious engagement, encouraging active participation without attachment.
modern_relevance: You might feel tempted to avoid challenges, but facing them with mindful effort often brings deeper growth and freedom.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यत्सान्ख्यैः प्राप्यते स्थानं तद्योगैरपि गम्यते ।
एकं सांख्यञ्च योगच यः पश्यति स पश्यति ॥
translation: जो स्थान साङ्ख्य से प्राप्त होता है वह योग से भी प्राप्त होता है, जो साङ्ख्य और योग को एक देखता है वह देखता है अर्थात् वह यथार्थ दर्शी है
english_translation: One who neither hates nor desires is known as a true renunciate, free from all dualities and easily liberated from bondage.
essence: Freedom arises naturally when you act without hatred or desire.
simple_meaning: A true renunciate is someone who neither hates nor desires, remaining free from all inner conflicts and easily released from bondage.
insight: Shift your focus from resisting or craving outcomes to simply being present without inner turmoil.
modern_relevance: You feel stuck in resentment or longing, but real freedom begins when you stop fueling those feelings.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सन्न्यासस्तु मुरश्रेष्ठाः ! दुःखमाप्तुमयोगतः ।
योगयुक्तो मुनिब्रह्म नचिरेणाऽधिगच्छति ॥
translation: हे सुरश्रेष्ठो ! कर्मयोग के बिना सन्यास का प्राप्त करना दुःसाध्य है किन्तु योगयुक्त मुनि शीघ्र ही ब्रह्म को प्राप्त करता है
english_translation: Ignorant people say that knowledge yoga and action yoga are separate, but the wise know that one who fully embraces either attains the fruit of both.
essence: Fully embracing either knowledge or action brings the fruits of both together.
simple_meaning: People who don't understand say knowledge and action yoga are separate. But the wise see that fully embracing either leads to the rewards of both.
insight: It shifts the mind from seeing paths as isolated to recognizing their deep interconnectedness through full engagement.
modern_relevance: You might feel torn between learning and doing. This verse reminds you that fully committing to either learning or action can bring the results of both.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
योगयुक्तो विशुद्ध आत्मा विजितात्मा जितेन्द्रिय: ।
सर्वभूतात्मभूतात्मा कुर्वनपि न लिप्यते ॥
translation: विशुद्धचित्त, विजितमन, जितेन्द्रिय और सब भूतो की आत्मा ही जिसकी आत्मा है ऐसा योगयुक्त व्यक्ति कर्म करता हुआ भी कर्म में बद्ध नहीं होता है
english_translation: The state reached by wisdom (Jnana) is also attained by yoga (union); one who sees both as one truly sees reality.
essence: True vision comes from seeing wisdom and yoga as one unified path.
simple_meaning: The state of deep understanding reached by wisdom can also be reached through yoga. Recognizing them as the same is true seeing.
insight: It shifts the mind from seeing paths as opposed to seeing them as complementary ways to the same goal.
modern_relevance: When you feel torn between study and practice, remember they both guide you to the same clarity and peace.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
नैव किञ्चित् करोमीति युक्तो प्रन्येत तत्ववित् ।
पश्यन् शृग्वन्स्पृशन जिघनश्नन् गच्छन्स्वपन श्वसन ॥
translation: मैं कुछ भी नहीं करता हूँ ऐसा समझता है ब्रह्म में युक्त तत्त्ववित् व्यक्ति दर्शन, श्रवण, स्पर्श, घ्राण, भोजन, गमन, निद्रा, श्वास,
english_translation: O best of sages! Without Karma Yoga, renunciation is hard to attain, but a yogi quickly attains Brahman.
essence: True renunciation requires yoga-infused action; without it, renunciation is unreachable.
simple_meaning: Renunciation is difficult to reach without acting with yoga, but a sage practicing yoga quickly attains the supreme reality.
insight: It shifts your approach from mere withdrawal to active, mindful engagement as the path to true renunciation.
modern_relevance: You struggle to quit old habits by avoidance alone, but when you engage fully with mindful effort, real transformation happens faster.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
प्रलपन् विसृजन गृहन्नुन्मिपन्निमिषन्नपि ।
इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेषु वर्तन्त इति धारयन् ॥
translation: भाषण, त्याग, ग्रहण, उन्मेष और निमेष करता हुआ भी, इन्द्रियगण इन्द्रिय के विषयों में प्रवृत्त होते हैं ऐसी धारणा करता हुआ
english_translation: A person united in yoga, pure in mind, victorious over the self and senses, and the inner being of all beings acts without being bound by action.
essence: You can act fully and remain free by mastering your mind and senses.
simple_meaning: A person who is steady in yoga, pure in mind, and has conquered their senses can act without becoming attached or bound by the results.
insight: It teaches you to act with awareness and self-mastery, preventing your actions from creating bondage.
modern_relevance: You face constant pressure to act and achieve, yet when you stay centered and calm, your efforts don’t trap or overwhelm you.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ब्रह्मण्याधाय कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा करोति यः ।
लिप्यते न स पापेन पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसा ॥
translation: जिस प्रकार पनपत्र जल में लिप्त नहीं होता है उसी प्रकार कर्मों को ब्रह्म में समर्पित और फलासक्ति त्याग करके जो कर्म करता है वह पाप अर्थात् बन्धन करने वाले कर्मों से लिप्त नहीं होता है
english_translation: A person established in the supreme reality knows: “I do nothing.” They see, hear, touch, eat, walk, sleep, and breathe without identifying as doer.
essence: You can experience life’s actions without being attached to doing them yourself.
simple_meaning: You can live fully—seeing, hearing, eating, and breathing—without feeling like you are the one doing it.
insight: It shifts your mind from identifying as the doer to recognizing your role as the witness of action.
modern_relevance: You rush through your day feeling responsible for every little thing, unaware that some parts of life simply happen through you.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सर्वकर्माणि मनसा सन्न्यस्यास्ते मुखं वशी।
नवद्वारे पुरे देही नैव कुर्वन न कारयन् ॥
translation: जितेन्द्रिय देही विवेक युक्त मन के द्वारा सब कर्मों का त्याग करके नव द्वारों से युक्त पुर में अर्थात् स्थूल शरीर में नहीं कुछ करता हुआ और नहीं कुछ कराता हुआ सुखपूर्वक रहता है
english_translation: Even while speaking, renouncing, taking, opening, and blinking, the senses remain engaged with their objects, one believes.
essence: Senses often remain engaged even when the mind tries to withdraw from them.
simple_meaning: Even when you speak or try to let go, your senses keep following their objects, as if unaware.
insight: Recognize that detachment is a process; senses often continue their habits despite your conscious will.
modern_relevance: You decide to stop scrolling, but your eyes dart back to the screen, drawn by notifications and images.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अनाश्रितः कुर्मफलं कार्य कर्म करोति यः ।
स सन्न्यासी च योगी च न निरग्निर्न चाऽक्रियः॥
translation: जो कर्मफल का आश्रय नहीं करके कर्तव्य कर्म करता है वही सन्यासी है और वही योगी है। निरग्नि अर्थात् अग्निसाध्य ईष्टादि कर्म त्यागी और अक्रिय (पूर्त्यदिकर्म रहित) व्यक्ति सन्यासी नहीं होता है
english_translation: Just as a lotus leaf remains untouched by water, one who performs actions dedicated to the supreme reality without attachment to results is not bound by harmful consequences.
essence: Act fully with dedication but without attachment; then harmful bonds cannot touch you.
simple_meaning: You can perform your duties fully if you dedicate your actions to the supreme reality and give up attachment to their results. Then, like a lotus leaf untouched by water, you are not affected by harmful consequences.
insight: It teaches you to dedicate effort to a greater purpose and release fixation on the outcomes, freeing your mind.
modern_relevance: You finish a difficult task without obsessing over praise or failure, and find peace regardless of the outcome.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यत्कुरुध्वे यद्श्नीथ यज्जूहुध्वे छ दत्थ यत ।
यत्तपस्यथ भो देवाः! तत्कुरुध्वं मदर्पणम् ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! आपलोग जो कर्म करते हैं, जो भोजन करते हैं, जो होम करते हैं, जो दान देते हैं और जो तपस्या करते हैं उसको मुझमें अर्पण करें
english_translation: With controlled senses and a discerning mind, the true self renounces all actions mentally, dwelling peacefully in the body without doing or causing anything.
essence: You can fully withdraw from action internally while living in the body.
simple_meaning: You can mentally let go of all actions by controlling your senses and mind, living peacefully without doing or causing anything physically.
insight: It shifts the mind from feeling compelled to act outwardly to resting as the observer within.
modern_relevance: You sit quietly, letting your restless mind and impulses settle, feeling peaceful without needing to act or control the world around you.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
शुभाशुभफलैरेवं मोक्ष्यध्वे कर्मबन्धनैः ।
सन्न्यासयोगयुक्ता हि विमुक्ता मामुपैष्यथ ॥
translation: ऐसा करने से शुभ और अशुभ फल देने वाले कर्मबन्धनों से आप छूट जाओगे क्योंकि आप लोग मुझ में फल समर्पण रूपी संन्यास योग मे युक्त होने के कारण विमुक्त होकर मुझको प्राप्त करोगे
english_translation: One who performs their duty without attachment to the result is both a renunciate and a yogi; one who abandons sacred rites and remains inactive is not a renunciate.
essence: You can perform your duties fully without clinging to their results; that is true renunciation.
simple_meaning: You become a true renunciate and yogi by doing your duty without expecting any reward or result.
insight: It teaches you to focus on your action itself, not on what you might gain or lose afterward.
modern_relevance: You stayed up late finishing a project, not for praise but because it was your responsibility—and that is true dedication.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
काम्यानां कर्मणां न्यासं सन्न्यासं कवयो विदुः ।
सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं प्राहुस्त्यागं विचक्षणाः ॥
translation: दूरदर्शी पण्डितलोग काम्यकर्मों के त्याग को सन्यास कहते हैं और सभी कर्मों के फलों के त्याग को त्याग कहते हैं
english_translation: O divine beings, whatever actions you perform, whatever you eat, offer, give, or practice as austerity, dedicate all to me.
essence: All actions become sacred when offered as a gift to the divine.
simple_meaning: Whatever you do—work, eat, offer, give, or practice austerity—offer it as a gift to the divine.
insight: It teaches you to see each daily action as a chance to connect deeply through offering.
modern_relevance: You prepare a meal, send a gift, or work hard—offering these acts as devotion makes them meaningful beyond routine.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
त्याज्यं दोषवादत्येके कर्म प्राहुर्मनीषिणः।
यज्ञदानतपः कर्म न त्याज्यमिति चापरे ॥
translation: कोई कोई पण्डितलोग दोषयुक्त कर्म को त्याज्य कहते हैं और कोई यज्ञ, तप और दान त्याज्य नहीं है ऐसा कहते हैं
english_translation: By practicing renunciation yoga with dedication to me, you will be freed from bonds of good and bad karmic results and attain liberation.
essence: You free yourself from karmic bonds by acting with surrender to the divine.
simple_meaning: You become free from binding consequences of good and bad actions by practicing renunciation through dedicating your work to the divine.
insight: This verse shifts focus from craving outcomes to dedicating effort, which breaks the cycle of binding consequences.
modern_relevance: You finished a difficult project without obsessing over praise or blame, feeling lighter because you didn’t cling to results.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
श्रूयतां निश्चयस्तत्र त्यागे मेऽमृतभोजिनः!।
त्यागो हि विबुधश्रेष्ठाः ! त्रिविधः परिकीर्तितः ॥
translation: हे अमृतभोजी देवश्रेष्ठो ! उस त्याग के विषय में मेरा निश्चय सुनो। त्याग तीन प्रकार का कहा गया है
english_translation: Wise thinkers say that giving up actions done for desire is renunciation, and giving up attachment to the fruits of all actions is true renunciation.
essence: Renouncing desire for results is true renunciation, not just giving up actions.
simple_meaning: Giving up only actions done to satisfy desires is called renunciation. But real renunciation is giving up attachment to the results of all actions.
insight: It shifts your focus from abandoning actions to abandoning craving for their results, enabling balanced engagement.
modern_relevance: You might stop chasing certain goals but still feel trapped by results. True freedom comes from releasing your hold on outcomes, not just actions.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
यज्ञदानतपाकर्म न त्याज्यं कार्यमेव तत् ।
यज्ञो दानं तपश्चैव पावनानि मनीषिणाम् ॥
translation: यज्ञ, तप और दान ये तीन कर्म त्याग करने के योग्य नहीं हैं, यह निश्चय ही कर्तव्य हैं, यज्ञ तप और दान विवेकियों को भी पवित्र करनेवाले हैं
english_translation: Some wise ones say that actions with faults should be abandoned, while others say that acts of sacrifice, charity, and discipline should never be abandoned.
essence: Not all flawed actions must be abandoned; some sacred acts must be sustained.
simple_meaning: Some say all faulty actions should be stopped, but others say acts like sacrifice, charity, and disciplined effort should never be stopped.
insight: It teaches you to evaluate actions by their nature and purpose, not just their imperfections, so you don't give up on meaningful practices.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by guilt over past mistakes, you might wonder whether to quit or keep trying; this helps you see some efforts are worth continuing despite flaws.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
एतान्यपि तु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा फलानि च ।
कर्तव्यानीति मे देवाः ! निश्चितं मतमुत्तमम ॥
translation: किन्तु हे देवगण ! ये कर्म भी आसक्ति और फल का त्याग करने योग्य हैं यह मेरा निश्चित ही उत्तम मत है
english_translation: Listen closely, O supreme among the divine, to my determination about renunciation. Renunciation is described in three forms.
essence: Renunciation is not singular but has three distinct, recognized forms.
simple_meaning: There are three kinds of renunciation, and this verse introduces a clear determination to explain them.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that giving up attachments isn’t one-size-fits-all but has distinct approaches.
modern_relevance: You’ve felt the urge to let go but wondered how — this verse points to three ways to release what no longer serves.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
न द्वेष्टयकुशलं कर्म कुशले नानुषज्जते ।
त्यागी सत्त्वसमाविष्टो मेधावी छिन्नसंशयः ॥
translation: सत्त्वगुण शाली मेधावी संशयरहित त्यागी व्यक्ति अकुशल (दुःखजनक) कर्म में द्वेष नहीं करता है और न कुशल (सुखकर) कर्म में आसक्त होता है
english_translation: Sacrifices, charity, and disciplined acts are never to be abandoned; these duties purify even the wise.
essence: Certain selfless actions are essential duties that purify all practitioners.
simple_meaning: Actions like sacrifice, charity, and disciplined effort are essential duties that should never be abandoned because they purify everyone, including the wise.
insight: Recognize some actions as essential duties that purify, regardless of outcome or recognition.
modern_relevance: When you hesitate to give time, money, or effort because you doubt their impact, remember these acts purify and strengthen your character.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
नहि देहभृता शक्यं त्यक्तुं काण्यशेषतः।
यस्तु कर्मफलत्यागी स त्यागीत्यभिधीयते ॥
translation: क्योंकि देहधारी विशेषरूप से कर्मों का त्याग नहीं कर सकता है किन्तु जो कर्म के फलको त्याग करता है वह त्यागी कहलाता है
english_translation: But, O divine beings, these actions too should be performed by abandoning attachment and the fruits; this is certainly my highest teaching.
essence: You can act without craving results; that is the highest way to act.
simple_meaning: You should perform actions without attachment to them or their outcomes; this is the best teaching.
insight: It shifts your focus from expecting rewards to fully engaging in the work itself, cleaning the motivation behind your actions.
modern_relevance: You finish a task completely but feel anxious about the outcome. This teaching reminds you to release that anxiety and trust the process.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अनिष्टमिष्टं मिश्रञ्च त्रिविध कर्मणः फलम् ।
भवत्यत्यागिनां प्रेत्य न तु सन्न्यासिनां कचित् ॥
translation: इष्ट, अनिष्ट और मिश्र अर्थात् इष्टानिष्ट, यह कर्म का त्रिविध फल सकाम व्यक्तियों को परलोक में होता है किन्तु सन्यासियों को कहीं भी नहीं होता है
english_translation: A person endowed with sattva, wise and free from doubt, does not hate unskillful actions nor cling to skillful ones; such a renouncer is steady and clear-minded.
essence: True steadiness comes from neither hating hardship nor clinging to comfort.
simple_meaning: You can be steady and clear by neither hating difficult actions nor clinging to easy ones.
insight: It teaches you to act without emotional swings—neither aversion nor craving colors your effort.
modern_relevance: You face tasks you dislike and tasks you enjoy. Staying balanced means not resisting the tough ones or clinging to the easy ones.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सिद्धि प्राप्तो यथा ब्रह्म तथाप्नोति निवोधत ।
समासेनैव भो देवाः ! निष्ठा ज्ञानस्य या परा ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! नैष्कर्म्यसिद्धि-प्राप्त व्यक्ति जिस प्रकार ब्रह्म को प्राप्त होता है और जो चरम ज्ञान है उसको संक्षेप से ही सुनो
english_translation: Because a being with a body cannot completely abandon actions, but one who renounces the fruits of actions is called a renunciant.
essence: Renunciation means letting go of attachment to results, not ceasing all action.
simple_meaning: You cannot stop doing all actions because of your body, but you can give up attachment to the results of your actions.
insight: It shifts your focus from stopping action to stopping craving results, freeing your effort from anxiety.
modern_relevance: You keep working hard, but often stress over outcomes beyond your control. Letting go of this worry lightens your daily load.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
बुद्धया विशुद्धया युक्तो धृत्यात्मानं नियम्य च ।
शब्दादीन विषयाँस्त्यक्त्वा रागद्वेषौ व्युदस्य च ॥
translation: विशुद्ध-बुद्धियुक्त होकर धैर्य के द्वारा बुद्धि को संयत करके शब्दादि विषयो का त्याग करके और राग द्वेष को दूर करके
english_translation: The threefold fruits of action—desirable, undesirable, and mixed—affect those attached to outcomes after death, but never the renunciates.
essence: Desire binds you to action’s results; renunciation frees you from them entirely.
simple_meaning: Actions produce good, bad, or mixed results for those who want outcomes, but renunciates are free from these results.
insight: It shifts your focus from chasing results to releasing desire, freeing your mind from outcome anxiety.
modern_relevance: You’ve worked hard on a project and worried about the outcome; this shows how releasing attachment frees you from that stress.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
विविक्तसेवी लघ्वाशी यतवाक्कायमानसः।
ध्यानयोगपरो नित्यं वैराग्यं समुपाश्रितः ॥
translation: निर्जनस्थान वासी एवं मितभोजी होकर शरीर वाणी और मन को संयत करके सदाशान योग में तत्पर होता हुआ वैराग्य का भलीभांति आश्रय करके
english_translation: O radiant beings! Just as a person who attains mastery in action reaches the supreme reality, hear briefly about the highest steadfastness in wisdom.
essence: Mastery in action and highest wisdom share a deep, connected steadfastness.
simple_meaning: Mastery in selfless action leads you to the supreme reality, and now hear the essence of highest wisdom briefly.
insight: It teaches you to see mastery in action as a gateway to deeper wisdom and steadfastness.
modern_relevance: You’ve worked hard to master your craft or practice; now it’s time to understand the deeper wisdom that grounds your success.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अहङ्कारं बलं दर्प कामं क्रोधं परिग्रहम् ।
विमुच्य निर्ममः शान्तो ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते ॥
translation: अहङ्कार, बल, दर्प, काम, क्रोध और परिग्रह का त्याग करके ममता शून्य होकर शनी व्यक्ति ब्रह्म ही हो जाता है
english_translation: With purified intellect, controlled mind by patience, renouncing sense objects like sounds, and abandoning attachment and aversion.
essence: Steady patience and a purified intellect free you from craving and aversion.
simple_meaning: You purify your intellect, control yourself with patience, let go of sensory distractions, and abandon likes and dislikes.
insight: It teaches you to use patience to restrain restless impulses and release emotional extremes.
modern_relevance: When your mind jumps at every notification or distraction, steadying yourself with calm patience helps you focus and stay balanced.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ब्रह्मभृतः प्रसन्नात्मा न शोचति न काङ्क्षति ।
समः सर्वेषु भूतेषु सन्न्यासं लभते परम् ॥
translation: ब्रह्मभूत और प्रसन्नचित्त व्यक्ति नष्ट वस्तुओं के लिये आकांशा नहीं करता है, सब भूतों में समभावापन्न होकर श्रेष्ठ सन्न्यास को प्राप्त होता है
english_translation: Living in solitude, moderate in eating, controlling body, speech, and mind, always devoted to meditation yoga and firmly relying on dispassion.
essence: Living simply with self-control and steady meditation anchored in dispassion leads to spiritual progress.
simple_meaning: You live alone in a quiet place, eat moderately, control your body, speech, and mind, and constantly focus on meditation while relying on detachment.
insight: It teaches you to build habits of moderation and steady focus supported by detachment from distractions.
modern_relevance: You choose quiet moments alone, eat lightly, and calm your restless mind to stay focused on what truly matters.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
मां सन्न्यासेन जानाति यावान् यश्चाऽस्मि तत्त्वतः ।
ततो मां तत्त्वतो ज्ञात्वा विशते तदनन्तरम् ॥
translation: मैं जिस प्रकार का और जो हूँ सो यथार्थरूप से सन्यास के द्वारा वह जानता है और मुझको यथार्थरूप से जानकर अनन्तर मुझमें प्रवेश कर जाता है।
english_translation: By renouncing ego, strength, pride, desire, anger, and possession, becoming free of attachment and peaceful, a person is established in the supreme reality.
essence: Peace and true being arise by releasing ego, desire, anger, and attachment.
simple_meaning: Let go of ego, pride, desire, anger, and attachment to become peaceful and realize your true nature beyond the self.
insight: This verse shifts your focus from grasping to letting go, cultivating peaceful detachment and connection to something deeper than the restless self.
modern_relevance: You feel overwhelmed by your rising pride, anger, and wanting more, but peace comes only when you release those burdens.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सर्वकर्माणयपि सदा कुर्वाणो मद्व्यपाश्रय: ।
मत्प्रसादादवाप्नोति शाश्वतं पदमव्ययम् ॥
translation: सर्वदा सब प्रकार का कर्म करता हुआ भी मत्परायण व्यक्ति मेरे अनुग्रह से सनातन नित्यपद को प्राप्त होता है ।
english_translation: One who is established in the supreme reality and whose mind is serene neither grieves nor desires; being equal to all beings, they attain the highest renunciation.
essence: Calmness and equal regard free you from grief and craving, revealing supreme renunciation.
simple_meaning: A person whose mind is calm and established in the supreme reality does not grieve or crave. They see all beings equally and reach the highest renunciation.
insight: It teaches you to balance your mind with calm acceptance and equal regard, dissolving restless desires.
modern_relevance: After a tough loss, you stop chasing what’s gone and see others with kindness, freeing yourself from endless craving.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
चेतसा सर्व्वकर्माणि मयि सन्न्यस्य मत्पराः ।
बुद्धियोगमुपाश्रित्य मञ्चित्ताः स्यात सर्वथा ॥
translation: आप लोग चित्त से सब कर्मों को मुझमें अर्पण करके मत्परायण होकर बुद्धियोग का आश्रय लेकर सर्वथा अपने चित्त को मुझमें लीन कर लीजिये।
english_translation: One who truly knows what I am through renunciation then enters me without delay.
essence: True renunciation leads to direct knowledge and immediate union with the divine.
simple_meaning: When you sincerely renounce attachment, you come to truly understand the divine and unite with that reality.
insight: It teaches you that renouncing attachments sharpens your understanding and opens the way to deep union.
modern_relevance: When you stop clinging to outcomes or identities, you can discover a deeper truth and connect fully with your inner being.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सर्वलोकाश्रयश्रेष्ठ ! परमात्मन् ! जगद्गुरो !।
त्वत्प्राप्तिमुख्यहेतोहि ज्ञानकाण्डस्य हे प्रभो !॥
translation: हे सर्वलोकाश्रयश्रेष्ठ ! हे प्रभो ! हे परमात्मन् ! हे जगद्गुरो! आपकी प्राप्ति के प्रधान कारण रूप ज्ञानकाण्ड का
english_translation: One who always performs all kinds of actions while relying on me attains by my grace the eternal imperishable state.
essence: Trusting the divine while acting leads to eternal, unchanging peace.
simple_meaning: You can keep doing all kinds of actions but if you rely on the divine with trust, you reach the eternal, unchanging state by divine grace.
insight: This verse teaches you to keep acting while shifting trust from outcomes to inner reliance on the divine's grace.
modern_relevance: You keep juggling tasks and roles, but when you take a moment to trust that your efforts are supported by something greater, you move toward lasting peace.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
रहस्यं मुक्तिदं जाता गृण्वतां नः कृतार्थता ।
भूयोऽपि श्रोतुमिच्छामो मधुरां ते गिरं हिताम् ॥
translation: मुक्तिप्रद रहस्य सुनकर हमलोग कृतार्थ हुए। हम फिर भी आपकी मधुर और हितकरी वाणी को सुनना चाहते हैं
english_translation: Surrender all your actions mentally to me, devoted to me; relying on the yoga of discernment, fully merge your mind in me.
essence: Complete mental surrender of all actions, supported by discernment, merges your mind with the divine.
simple_meaning: Mentally give all your actions to the divine, stay devoted, and rely on clear understanding to fully merge your mind in that devotion.
insight: It teaches you to shift your mental focus from personal gain to devoted surrender supported by clear wisdom.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by daily choices, mentally offering your efforts to a trusted higher purpose helps calm the mind and steady your focus.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
कस्मिन रूपे भवन्त हि चिन्तयन्तो वयं विभो ।
शक्नुमोऽनुपलं लब्धं भवन्तं ज्ञानदायिनम् ॥
translation: हे विभो ! किस रूप में आप ज्ञानदाता को चिन्तन करने से हम लोग हर समय आपको प्राप्त करने में समर्थ होंगे
english_translation: O best refuge of all worlds! O supreme being! O world teacher! You are the chief cause for attaining the knowledge section, O Lord!
essence: The supreme being is the chief cause and refuge for attaining true knowledge.
simple_meaning: This verse praises the supreme being as the greatest refuge and teacher, the main cause for attaining knowledge.
insight: It reminds you that true understanding comes through connection with a guiding source beyond yourself.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
अशेषं वर्णयित्वेदमस्मानाश्वासय प्रभो ।
भवता साम्प्रतं नाथ ! कृपयाऽसीमया यतः ॥
translation: हे प्रभो ! इस विषय को पूर्णतया वर्णन करके हमें आश्वासन दीजिये क्योंकि हे नाथ! इस समय आपने जो असीम कृपा करके
english_translation: Hearing this secret that grants freedom, we feel fulfilled. Yet we still wish to hear your sweet and beneficial words.
essence: Fulfillment from truth awakens a longing for more wisdom.
simple_meaning: We have heard a secret that grants freedom and feel fulfilled, yet we want to hear more of your sweet and helpful words.
insight: It reminds you to stay open and eager for wisdom, even after feeling fulfilled.
modern_relevance: After finishing a meaningful conversation, you still want to hear more wisdom from that trusted voice.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
नानाज्ञानमयैर्वाक्यैः कृतकृया वयं कृताः।
अतो न विरहं सोढुं शक्ष्यामः क्षणमप्युत ॥
translation: अनेक ज्ञानमय उपदेशों  हम लोगों को कृतकृत्य किया है इसलिये हम लोग आपके विरह को क्षणभर भी सहन नहीं कर सकेंगे
english_translation: O Lord, in which form should we always contemplate you to be able to attain you, the giver of wisdom?
essence: Asking how to focus on the true source unlocks steady wisdom.
simple_meaning: You wonder in what way to focus your mind so that you can always connect with the one who gives wisdom.
insight: It teaches you to ask clearly how to maintain steady focus on wisdom rather than drifting.
modern_relevance: You pause, wondering how to hold your attention on what truly matters amid constant distractions.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अपि वः श्रद्धया भक्त्या प्रसन्नोऽस्मि दिवौकसः ।
भवद्यः साम्प्रतं दिव्यं ज्ञाननेत्रं ददाम्यहम् ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! आप लोगों की श्रद्धा और भक्ति से मैं प्रसन्न हूँ, अब मैं आप लोगों को दिव्य ज्ञान नेत्र प्रदान करता हूँ
english_translation: O Lord! Please fully explain this subject and assure us, for now you have shown boundless compassion.
essence: True assurance comes from complete understanding given with deep compassion.
simple_meaning: Please explain this topic completely and give us assurance because you have shown great compassion now.
insight: It highlights the importance of clear guidance and reassurance when facing complex or difficult subjects.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
यूयं यज्ज्ञाननेत्रेण स्थातुं शक्ताः सुरर्षभाः ।
चेद्विज्ञानमये कोषे तदा भवितुमर्हथ ॥
translation: जिसके द्वारा हे सुरश्रेष्ठों ! आप यदि विज्ञानमय कोष में स्थित रह सकोगे तो मेरे इस
english_translation: Many teachings full of knowledge have made us indebted; therefore, we cannot endure separation from you even for a moment.
essence: Deep gratitude to wisdom makes even brief separation unbearable.
simple_meaning: We have received so much guidance that we feel deeply connected and cannot bear being apart, even briefly.
insight: It shows how deep trust and connection create a sense of belonging that resists any separation.
modern_relevance: When you've learned so much from someone, even a short time apart feels like a painful distance you don't want.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
कृतकृत्या अनाद्यन्तं दृष्ट्वा नित्यस्थितं विभुम् ।
रूपं स्थूलादपि स्थूलं ममैतद्धि प्रतिक्षणम् ॥
translation: अनादी अनंत नित्यस्थित विभु स्थूलतीस्थूल रूप को हर समय दर्शन करके कृतकृत्य हो सकोगे
english_translation: O radiant beings! I am pleased by your trust and devotion; now I grant you the divine eye of wisdom.
essence: Trust and devoted love open the door to receiving divine wisdom.
simple_meaning: Your trust and devoted love please the divine, and now you are granted a divine vision of wisdom.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that sincere trust and devotion are the keys to unlocking higher understanding.
modern_relevance: When you fully trust and open your heart in any pursuit, new insights and clarity naturally arise.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ततो ज्ञान निधिर्मान्यो  महाविष्णुर्दयाणव ।
दिव्यं ज्ञानमयं चक्षुर्देवेभ्यो दत्तवान् प्रभुः ॥
translation: तब करुणासागर ज्ञाननिधि और मान्य प्रभु महाविष्णु ने देवताओं को ज्ञानमय दिव्य चक्षु प्रदान किया
english_translation: O best of the devas! If you can stand firm in the treasury of true understanding, then you will be worthy indeed.
essence: True worth comes from standing steady in deep understanding.
simple_meaning: You become worthy when you can remain steady in deep understanding and clear insight.
insight: It teaches you to anchor your confidence in steady knowledge rather than fleeting feelings or doubts.
modern_relevance: When overwhelmed by confusion or pressure, you find strength by grounding yourself in clear understanding and steady insight.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
सर्वे देवास्तदानीम्बै स्थिराङ्गाः स्थिरलोचनाः।
स्माधिस्था भवन्तो ही विस्मिर्ताश्च विशेषत: ॥
translation: तब वे सब देवगण स्थिर गात्र और स्थिर नेत्र होकर समाधिस्थ और विशेष विस्मित होते हुए
english_translation: Seeing the infinite, eternal, all-pervading form, even the gross form appears gross to me every moment.
essence: Seeing the eternal vastness makes all gross forms seem small and insignificant.
simple_meaning: When you perceive the eternal and all-pervading form, even the gross physical form seems insignificant every moment.
insight: It changes your perspective from fixating on surface appearances to recognizing deeper, boundless reality beneath.
modern_relevance: When you recognize the vastness beyond everyday appearances, the challenges and distractions around you feel less overwhelming.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
बुद्धरतीतं जीवानामवाङ्मनसगोचरम् ।
विरारूपञ्च पश्यन्तस्तुष्टुवुस्ते तदद्भुतम् ॥
translation: जीवों के मन वचन और बुद्धि से अतीत उस अद्भुत विराटरूप का दर्शन करते हुए स्तुति करने लगे
english_translation: Then the compassionate great Vishnu, the treasure of wisdom, granted the gods a divine eye full of knowledge.
essence: Compassionate wisdom grants the power to perceive divine knowledge clearly.
simple_meaning: The compassionate Vishnu gave the gods a special divine eye full of knowledge.
insight: It shows that true wisdom can transform perception, allowing you to see what was hidden before.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
देवादिदेव ! त्वदचिन्त्यदेहे आद्यन्तशून्ये प्रसमीक्ष्य नूनम् ।
देवानृषीन् पितृगणाननन्तान पृथक स्थितान् विस्मयमावहामः ॥
translation: हे देवादिदेव ! हम लोग आपके अनादि अनन्त और अचिन्त्य देह में अनन्त देवसमूह, ऋषिसमूह और पितृसमूह को पृथक पृथक् स्थित देखकर अवश्य ही विस्मित हो रहे हैं
english_translation: Then all the radiant beings became steady in body and steady in eyes, established in absorbed presence, yet especially astonished.
essence: Complete stillness can accompany deep wonder and astonishment.
simple_meaning: All the radiant beings became still in body and eyes, deeply absorbed, yet notably astonished.
insight: Stillness of body and mind does not exclude being open to new, surprising experiences.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
तवैव देहादभुवनानि देव ! चतुर्दशैतेषु निवासिनो हि ।
देवाश्च दैत्याश्च मनुष्यसङ्का उचतुर्विधा भूतगणाश्च सर्वे ॥
translation: हे देव ! आपके ही देह से चतुर्दश भुवन और इनके निवासी देव, दैत्य, मनुष्यसमूह और सब चतुर्विध भूतसङ्घ उत्पन्न हुए हैं,
english_translation: Living beings, transcending mind, speech, and intellect, behold the wondrous cosmic form and praise it.
essence: Living beings praise the wondrous cosmic form beyond mind and speech.
simple_meaning: Living beings see and praise the wondrous cosmic form beyond ordinary mind and speech.
insight: It shifts perspective from ordinary understanding to reverence for what exceeds mental grasp.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
जाताः पृथक सन्ति चतुर्दशस्त्रहो यान्न्यत्र नाशं भुवनैनिःसमम्।
संपश्यतामीदृशमद्भुतं प्रभो ! बुद्धिम॑मे मजति नः समाकुला ॥
translation: चतुर्दश भुवनों में पृथक पृथक हैं और अहो! अपने लोकों के साथ इसी (आपके देह में) नाश को प्राप्त होते हैं। हे प्रभो ! इस प्रकार आश्चर्य को देखते हुए हम लोगो की बुद्धि व्याकुल होकर भ्रम में मग्न होती है
english_translation: O Deva-adideva, seeing the infinite gods, sages, and ancestors separately established in your inconceivable, eternal body, we are indeed amazed.
essence: The infinite divine contains countless beings distinctly within its inconceivable form.
simple_meaning: Seeing countless gods, sages, and ancestors distinctly present within the infinite and unthinkable body amazes us deeply.
insight: It invites you to recognize the immense, mysterious presence that supports all existence beyond what you can easily grasp.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
देवाश्च ये स्थूलशरीरमानिनो विशन्ति ते सूक्ष्मशरीरमानिषु ।
देवास्तु ये मूक्ष्मशरीरमानिनो विशन्त्यहो कारणकायमानिषु ॥
translation: अहो ! जो स्थूल देहाभिमानी देवतागण हैं वे सूक्ष्म देहाभिमानी देवताओं में प्रवेश करते हैं और जो सूक्ष्म देहाभिमानी देवतागण हैं वे कारण देहाभिमानी देवताओ में प्रवेश करते हैं
english_translation: O divine one! From your body arose the fourteen worlds and their inhabitants: Devas, Asuras, humans, and all four kinds of beings.
essence: All worlds and beings arise from the divine's body and presence.
simple_meaning: All fourteen worlds and their residents—divine beings, shadow beings, humans, and all four types of creatures—came from your body.
insight: It reveals that everything you see and experience is interconnected through a single origin, inviting respect and reverence for all life.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
इमे तु सर्वे प्रविशन्त्यचिन्त्ये महामभावे कच तन्न विद्मः।
दृष्ट्वेदृशं तेऽद्भुतकार्यमीश ! वयं विमुग्धाः खलु ते प्रभावात् ॥
translation: किन्तु ये सब किस अचिन्त्य महाप्रभाववान् में प्रवेश करते हैं सो हमलोग नहीं समझ रहे हैं। हे ईश ! इस प्रकार आपका अद्भुत कार्य देखकर आपके प्रभाव से हम लोग विमुग्ध हो रहे हैं
english_translation: The fourteen worlds exist separately and perish along with their beings; witnessing this marvel, our minds grow confused and restless, O Lord!
essence: Seeing all separate worlds perish naturally unsettles the mind, but deeper steadiness is possible.
simple_meaning: All fourteen worlds exist separately and end with their beings, which confuses and unsettles the mind when witnessed.
insight: Recognize that confusion at loss is natural, but the true self remains steady beyond endings.
modern_relevance: You watch a beloved project or relationship end, and your mind spins in disbelief and unrest.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
साचिन्त्यशक्तिर्भवतो धुवा किम ? या वांगमनो बुद्धिभीर प्रमेया।
त्वत्तो जनित्वा निजगर्भमध्ये लोकान् धरत्येव चतुर्दशालम ॥
translation: क्या वह नित्या अचिन्त्य शक्ति आपकी है? वाणी मन और बुद्धि से अगोचर जो शक्ति आप से ही उत्पन्न होकर चतुर्दश लोकों को अपने गर्भ में भलीभांति धारण करती है
english_translation: Those who identify with the gross body among the deva beings enter the subtle-bodied devas, and those who identify with the subtle body enter the causal-bodied devas.
essence: Your sense of self deepens by passing from gross to subtle and then causal layers of being.
simple_meaning: Your sense of self changes as you move from identifying with the physical body to subtler levels of existence beyond it.
insight: Shift your view of yourself from a fixed body to a flowing presence spanning multiple layers of existence.
modern_relevance: When you feel stuck in your physical or emotional identity, this reminds you that your sense of self can evolve beyond immediate appearances.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ब्रह्माण्डयप्येवमनन्तपिण्डमयश्च सर्ग धरते सदा सा।
सर्व प्रसूते पुनरन्तकाले लीन तु तत् सा कुरुते स्वगर्भे ॥
translation: इसी प्रकार वह शक्ति अनन्त ब्रह्माण्ड और पिण्डमय सृष्टि को भी सदा स्थित रखती है, सबको उत्पन्न करती है और पुनः अन्तकाल में वह उन सभी को अपने गर्भ में लीन कर लेती है
english_translation: But we do not understand how all enter the inconceivable supreme power. O Lord, seeing your wondrous work, we are amazed by your influence.
essence: The supreme power's workings are wondrous and beyond our understanding.
simple_meaning: We do not understand how all beings enter the inconceivable supreme power. Seeing this wondrous work, we are amazed by its influence.
insight: It reveals how some truths remain beyond full understanding, inviting humble amazement.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
दृष्ट्वा चमत्कारामिमं न विद्यः कथं भवत्यद्भुतमेतदीश !। 
किं कारणञ्चास्य पुनः क आदिरस्य प्रवाहस्य तथाऽस्ति कोऽन्तः ॥
translation: हे ईश ! इस चमत्कार को देखकर हम नहीं समझ रहे हैं कि यह चमत्कार कैसे हो रहा है, इसका कारण क्या है और इस प्रवाह का आदि क्या है तथा अन्त क्या है
english_translation: Is that eternal, inconceivable power yours? The power born from you, invisible to speech, mind, and intellect, which perfectly sustains the fourteen worlds within its womb.
essence: An eternal power beyond mind and speech perfectly sustains all worlds.
simple_meaning: There is an eternal, unimaginable power born from the divine that holds and supports all the fourteen worlds perfectly within itself.
insight: It invites you to sense the unseen power supporting all life, beyond your usual thinking and senses.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अनन्त ! सर्वेऽनुभवाम आदरात त्वामीश ! जन्मस्थितिनाशवर्जितम् ।
अनन्तवत्रं बहुधा स्तुतं मुरै गन्धर्वयक्षर्विविधैश्च सूरिभिः ॥
translation: हे अनन्त ! हे ईश ! हम सब भलीभांति अनुभव करते हैं कि आप उत्पत्ति, स्थिति और विनाश से रहित हो, अनन्तमुख हो और अनेक देवता गन्धर्व यक्ष और विद्वानों के द्वारा अनेक प्रकार से स्तुत हो
english_translation: In the same way, that power eternally sustains the infinite cosmic and embodied creation, always generating all beings and at the end absorbing them back into itself.
essence: The infinite power creates, sustains, and ultimately reabsorbs all existence.
simple_meaning: A powerful force continuously maintains the vast universe and all forms of life, creating them and eventually reabsorbing them back into itself at the end.
insight: Recognize the endless cycle where creation and dissolution are unified by a sustaining power beyond individual existence.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अमितशक्तियुतोऽपि भवन भवा नमितबाहुरसि त्वमनन्तपात् ।
अमितसूर्य मृगाङ्क-शिखिग्रहा-दमितनेत्रघरस्त्वामिहेक्षसे ॥
translation: आप हम लोगों को यहां अमित शक्ति युक्त होते हुए भी अनन्त बाहु एवं अनन्त पादविशिष्ट और अनन्त सूर्य चन्द्र तथा अग्नि को ग्रहण करने वाले होने के कारण अनन्त नेत्रधारी दृष्टि गोचर हो रहे हैं
english_translation: O Lord! Seeing this wonder, I do not understand how this miracle happens, what causes it, and what the beginning and end of this flow are.
essence: Witnessing wonder can inspire deep curiosity about its cause and limits.
simple_meaning: Someone is amazed and confused by a great wonder and is asking what causes it and where its beginning and end lie.
insight: It encourages embracing honest questioning when faced with mysteries beyond immediate understanding.
modern_relevance: You encounter a situation so surprising it leaves you questioning how it works and where it all began or will end.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
त्वं तह्सां तह इहासि चेतने चैतन्यरूऽसि ददासि शक्तये ।
शक्तिं प्रभो ! प्रेरयसे मति तथा त्वत्सत्तया सर्वमिदं हि सत्त्ववत् ॥
translation: आप तेजों के भी तेज हैं, चेतन में चैतन्यरूप हैं, हे प्रभो ! आप शक्ति को शक्ति देते हैं और बुद्धि को सत्कर्मों में प्रेरित करते हैं क्योंकि आपकी सत्ता से यह समस्त विश्व यहां सत्तावान् हो रहा है
english_translation: O Infinite One! We all deeply experience that you are beyond birth, existence, and destruction, with infinite faces, praised in many ways by gods, gandharvas, and sages.
essence: The divine transcends all change and is revered by countless beings.
simple_meaning: Everyone recognizes the divine as eternal, without birth or death, with countless forms, praised by many celestial beings.
insight: It invites seeing the divine as beyond all cycles and forms, expanding awareness beyond ordinary limits.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
विभो ! त्वयैकेन हि मध्यलोक अङ्घ तथाऽधश्च दिशां समूहः ।
अनाद्यनन्तः समयस्तथासौ व्याप्तोऽस्ति धीर्येन विमोहिता नः ॥
translation: हे विभो ! एक आप से ही ऊर्ध्वलोक,अधोलोक, मध्यलोक, अनादि अनन्त यह दिकसमूह और अनादि अनन्त यह काल व्याप्त हैं जिससे हमारी बुद्धि विमुग्ध हो रही है
english_translation: You appear here with infinite power, countless arms and feet, and countless eyes that behold the infinite sun, moon, and fire.
essence: Infinite power and perception manifest in countless forms reveal the vastness of the divine.
simple_meaning: You are described as having limitless power, many arms and feet, and countless eyes that see the endless sun, moon, and fire.
insight: It helps you feel the magnitude of the divine beyond human scale, expanding your view of presence and power.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
गुरो ! जगत्कारण ! ते शरीरा द्वैतरूपात्तव शक्तिराया।
याऽचिन्तनीया प्रकटत्वमेति ब्रह्माण्डमेषा तनुते ह्यनन्तम् ॥
translation: हे जगत्कारण ! हे गुरो! अद्वैतरूप आपके शरीर से जो आपकी अचिन्तनीया आद्या शक्ति प्रकट होती है वही अनन्त ब्रह्माण्डो का विस्तार करती है
english_translation: You are the brilliance beyond all brilliance, the conscious consciousness; O Lord, you empower strength and inspire the mind towards good deeds, for by your existence all this world becomes vibrant.
essence: Your true source empowers your strength and inspires your mind toward good.
simple_meaning: You are the highest source of power and consciousness, inspiring strength and guiding the mind toward good actions.
insight: It teaches you to recognize that your inner strength and clear thinking arise from a deeper source beyond yourself.
modern_relevance: When your energy feels low or your mind confused, remember a greater source fuels your strength and guides your thoughts toward kindness.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
पूर्व महत्तत्त्ववराभिमानी जातस्ततोऽहतितत्त्वमानी।
देवस्ततो मानसतत्त्वमानी निर्माति चोत्लद्य विचित्रदृश्यम् ॥
translation: पहले श्रेष्ठ महत्तत्त्वका अभिमानी देवता प्रकट होता है, अनन्तर अहङ्कार तत्त्व का अभिमानी देवता और उसके पश्चात् मानस तत्त्व का अभिमानी देवता प्रकट होकर विचित्र दृश्य की रचना करते हैं
english_translation: O Sovereign! By you alone, the middle world, the upper and lower worlds, the directions, and endless time are pervaded; this overwhelms our discerning mind.
essence: The true self permeates all space and time, beyond the mind's comprehension.
simple_meaning: The divine pervades all realms and infinite time, overwhelming our discerning mind with its vastness.
insight: It shifts your view from trying to grasp everything to accepting the infinite presence beyond mind’s limits.
modern_relevance: You try to hold on to control but realize the forces shaping your life are vast and beyond your grasp.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ततः क्रमेणैव सुरा इमे सदा तन्मात्रतत्त्वस्य किलाभिमानिन: ।
ज्ञानेन्द्रियाणामथ येऽभिमानिनः कर्मेन्द्रियाणामाप येऽभिमानिनः ॥
translation: उसी क्रम से ही पञ्चतन्मात्रा के अभिमानी देवता, पञ्चज्ञानेन्द्रिय और पञ्चकम्मेन्द्रिय के अभिमानी देवता और
english_translation: O cause of the world, O teacher! From your twofold body arises your inconceivable primal power that manifests and expands into the infinite universe.
essence: The infinite universe unfolds from an inconceivable primal power in the twofold body.
simple_meaning: Your twofold body reveals a primal power that brings forth and spreads the infinite universe.
insight: It shifts the view from seeing the universe as separate to seeing it as an unfolding power within the divine source.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
य पञ्चभूतैकपराभिमानिन स्त त्वच्छरीरादभिजायमानाः।
नास्तिस्वरूपाजगतोऽस्तिभावं प्रकुर्वते ते गहनप्रभावः ॥
translation: पञ्चमहाभूतों के परम अभिमानी देवता यह सभी सदा आपके शरीर से प्रकट होते हुए जगत को नास्ति रूप से आस्ति रूप में कर देते हैं; आपका प्रभाव गहन अर्थात महान है
english_translation: First appears the proud great principle, then the proud principle of ego, followed by the proud principle of mind, creating a wondrous vision.
essence: Your mind and ego proudly create the confusing illusions you take as reality.
simple_meaning: Your mind and ego create complex illusions that feel real, shaping how you see the world.
insight: It teaches you to see your mental stories as constructed illusions, not absolute truths.
modern_relevance: When you replay worries or stories in your head, you’re watching how mind and ego invent confusing realities.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
शक्तिस्तवाचिन्सविभावशालिनी स्वस्यां तनौ सर्वलयं प्रकुर्वती ।
त्वय्येव ने विलयं वितन्वती प्रपातयत्यत्र विचित्रतासु नः ॥
translation: आपकी अचिन्त्य प्रभावशालिनी शक्ति अपने शरीर में सभी का लय करती हुई अपना विलय आप ही में करती हुई हमको यहां विचित्रता में गिरा रही है अर्थात् हमको आश्चर्य में डुबा रही है
english_translation: In that same order are the gods proud of the five subtle elements, the senses of knowledge, and the senses of action.
essence: Pride arises sequentially in subtle elements, knowledge senses, and action senses.
simple_meaning: Certain divine beings take pride in the five subtle elements, the senses of knowledge, and the senses of action, in that order.
insight: It reveals how identification with subtle faculties can cause pride, affecting behavior and perception.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
कुर्वन्ति सम्भूय जनि स्थिति लयम् ।
ब्रह्माण्डकस्याप्यमितस्य सर्वथा चराचरस्यागतचित्रताजुषः॥
translation: आपसे ही अनन्त ब्रह्मा विष्णु और महेश प्रकट होकर आश्चर्ययुक्त विचित्रतापूर्ण चराचरमय अनंत ब्रह्मांडों की उत्पत्ति, स्थिति और लय का भी सर्वथा विधान करते हैं
english_translation: The lord who is the supreme controller of the five great elements manifests all from your body, transforming nothingness into existence; your influence is profound and vast.
essence: All existence emerges from a profound source beyond visible form.
simple_meaning: The supreme controller of the five great elements shows all creation appearing from your body, turning non-existence into existence through your deep power.
insight: It reveals that everything visible arises from a deep hidden source beyond form or shape.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
केचिद्यथा वालगणा रजोगृहं निर्मान्त्यवन्त्यन्य इदं तथाऽपरे ।
विनाशयन्तीति वयं तवाधुना पश्याम इत्थं वपुषि ध्रुवं प्रभो ! ॥
translation: हे प्रभो ! जैसे कोई बालक धूलिका घर बनाते हैं, कोई उसकी रक्षा करते हैं और अन्य कोई उसको नष्ट कर देते हैं; उसी प्रकार हम निश्चय इस समय आपके शरीर में ब्रह्मांडों की उत्पत्ति,  स्थिति और लयके विषय को देख रहे हैं
english_translation: Your inconceivable, powerful energy dissolves all within itself in your own form, yet by you alone it does not vanish and instead casts us into wonder here.
essence: The divine power absorbs all without disappearing, inspiring wonder within us.
simple_meaning: The divine's immense power dissolves everything within itself but does not disappear; instead, it fills us with awe in this strange world.
insight: It reveals that true power transcends disappearance and instead invites curiosity and wonder about existence.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
रुद्राश्च सर्वे वसवश्च निर्जरा आदित्यसंघा मघवा प्रजापतिः।
विश्वेसरा वायुगसंख्यकामरा दैत्या ह्यनन्ताः पितरस्तथर्षयः ॥
translation: एकादश रूद्र गण, द्वादश आदित्यगण, अष्ट वसुदेवता गण, इन्द्र, प्रजापति, विश्वेदेवा, वायु, ये सब असंख्य देवंगण, अनन्त ऋषि एवं पितृगण और अनन्त असुरगण सभी
english_translation: From you alone, infinite Brahma, Vishnu, and Mahesh emerge, governing the creation, maintenance, and dissolution of countless wondrous moving and unmoving universes.
essence: All creation and dissolution arise from one supreme source manifesting as cosmic functions.
simple_meaning: The divine beings Brahma, Vishnu, and Mahesh come from the supreme source and fully control the endless creation, sustaining, and destruction of all that moves and does not move.
insight: Recognize that the vast cycles of change and stability around you reflect a deeper source beyond appearances.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
त्वतकायजास्त्वां बहुधा यतन्ते ज्ञातुं परन्ते न हि पारयन्ते।
अतो विमुग्धास्तव मायया ते पुनर्विशन्त्येत्य तवैव काये ॥
translation: आपके शरीर से प्रकट होकर आपको जानने के लिये अनेक प्रकार से यत्न करते हैं परन्तु वह पार नहीं पाते हैं इसलिये आपकी माया से विमुग्ध होकर वह  फिर भी जाकर आपके ही शरीर में प्रवेश कर जाते हैं।
english_translation: O Lord! Just as children build, protect, and destroy a sandcastle, we now surely see the creation, preservation, and dissolution of universes within your body.
essence: The cosmos cycles like children building and destroying a sandcastle inside the divine.
simple_meaning: We observe the universe's creation, maintenance, and destruction occurring within the divine body, like children building and destroying a sandcastle.
insight: It shifts perspective from seeing the universe as fixed to understanding it as transient and playful.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
कारणं कारणानां त्वमेवाक्षरं ब्रह्म विज्ञेयमेकं त्वमेवास्यहो।
आश्रयस्थानमेकं निधानं परं विश्वसङ्घस्य जानन्ति ते कोविदाः ॥
translation: अहो ! आप ही कारणों के कारण हैं, आप ही अक्षर (अविनाशी) परब्रह्म हैं और एक आप ही जानने के योग्य हैं, एक आप ही विश्वसमूह के आश्रय स्थान और परम रक्षा स्थान हैं, इस बात को प्रसिद्ध पण्डितगण जानते हैं
english_translation: All eleven Rudras, twelve Adityas, eight Vasus, Indra, Prajapati, Vishvedevas, Vayu, countless divine beings, infinite sages, ancestors, and countless shadow beings.
essence: A vast assembly of cosmic beings, sages, and ancestors surrounds great events.
simple_meaning: This verse lists many divine and cosmic beings, sages, ancestors, and shadow beings gathered or present.
insight: Recognize the vast, interconnected presence behind any great moment or teaching.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
त्वमव्यय: शाश्वतधर्म गोप्ता सनातनस्त्वं पुरुषो मतो नः।
प्रभोऽतितेजोमयमादिहीन मनन्तमप्येकमनेकवर्णम् ॥
translation: आप विकार रहित हैं, सनातन धर्म के रक्षक हैं और आप सनातन पुरुष है, यह हमारा मत है । हे प्रभो ! आप के अतितेजोमय, आदिहीन, अनन्त होने पर भी एक, अनेकवर्ण
english_translation: Many strive in various ways to know you through your body but cannot cross beyond; thus, bewildered by your illusion, they re-enter your own body again.
essence: Apparent forms cannot reveal the true self; illusion causes repeated confusion and return.
simple_meaning: Many try to understand you by your body but cannot reach beyond it; confused by illusion, they fall back into the same form.
insight: It teaches to look beyond physical forms and illusions to perceive what is truly ungraspable by surface means.
modern_relevance: You seek to understand someone's true nature but get stuck judging by appearances, missing the deeper reality beneath.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अचिन्तनीय हवितर्कणीयं किलामिनैरङ्गभरैः सुपूर्णम् ।
पश्यंत आश्चर्यकर प्रदीप्त विराटशरीरं तब विस्मिताः स्मः ॥
translation: अचिन्त्य, अवितर्कय, अगणित अवयवों से पूर्ण, विस्मयकर और देदीप्यमान विराट् शरीर को देखते हुए हम विस्मित हो रहे हैं
english_translation: You are the cause of all causes, the imperishable supreme reality, the sole one worthy of knowledge, the refuge and ultimate shelter of the entire universe, as wise scholars understand.
essence: Everything originates and rests in one imperishable supreme source known by the wise.
simple_meaning: You are the origin of all causes, the unchanging supreme reality, and the ultimate refuge for the entire universe, known by wise scholars.
insight: It invites you to see beyond surface causes and rest your understanding in an unchanging foundation.
modern_relevance: When life feels chaotic and uncertain, recognizing a single unshakable source beneath it all can bring profound calm and clarity.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
धृतिन्न विन्दाम इह त्वदीये कायेऽमितॉस्तान्प्रसमीक्ष्य लोकान् ।
प्रसीद देवेश ! जगनिवास ! त्वमेव नः सम्मत आदिदेवः॥
translation: हे जगन्निवास! हे देवेश ! इस आपके विराट्  शरीर में उन अगणित लोको को देखकर हम धृति को लाभ नहीं कर रहे हैं, इसलिये आप प्रसन्न हो, हमारा मत है कि आप ही आदिदेव हैं
english_translation: You are imperishable, the eternal guardian of the timeless dharma, the eternal being as we understand. O Lord! Though infinite, without origin, and beyond brilliance, you manifest in many forms.
essence: The eternal being is beyond time yet manifests as many forms in unity.
simple_meaning: You are the eternal protector of the timeless dharma, an imperishable being manifesting in many forms beyond origin and brilliance.
insight: It invites holding the paradox of unity and multiplicity in the divine, expanding how you see identity beyond limits.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अहो किमाश्चर्यमिदं विभाति क्षुद्रात समारभ्य तृणादसीम्नः ।
ब्रह्माण्ड पर्यंतविशालसृष्टे: सृष्टिस्थितिप्रत्यवहारहेतोः॥
translation: अहो ! यह क्या चमत्कार शोभायमान हो रहा है । एक क्षुद्र तृण से लेकर ब्रह्माण्डपर्यन्त जो असीम विशाल सृष्टि है उसकी उत्पत्ति, स्थिति और लय के लिये
english_translation: Seeing the supreme body, inconceivable and beyond reasoning, complete with countless limbs, wondrous and radiant, we stand amazed.
essence: Encountering the inconceivable cosmic form inspires deep amazement.
simple_meaning: We are amazed to see a supreme, radiant body that is beyond thought and filled with countless limbs.
insight: It shows how encountering something truly vast and complex can humble and expand your sense of reality.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
यथार्भकाः क्रीडनसक्तचित्ता विमोहितास्तन्मयतामुपेताः।
अनेकथाऽनेकविधस्वरूपा स्तथा पृथक् देवगणा नियुक्ताः ॥
translation: अनेक प्रकार से अनेक प्रकार के रूप वाले देवतागण ऐसे मोहित और तन्मय होकर पृथक् पृथक् नियुक्त हैं जैसे खेल में आसक्तचित्त बालकगण तन्मय और विमोहित रहते हैं
english_translation: O Lord of the universe, seeing countless worlds in your vast body, we lack the courage; please be pleased, for we believe you are the primal divine.
essence: Trust in the divine begins even when your courage is not yet found.
simple_meaning: Seeing the vastness of the divine's form, we feel weak and lack courage, so we ask for kindness and affirm our faith in the primal divine.
insight: It teaches you to embrace vulnerability and place trust even when courage is absent.
modern_relevance: You face a challenge so big it shakes your confidence; admitting doubt opens space for trust and support.
speaker: Suta

verse_text:
स्थूलात्स्थूलतरं नित्यं ज्ञानलोचनगोचरम् ।
अनाद्यन्तं विरारूपं दृष्ट्वा ते विभुमदभुतम् ॥
translation: ज्ञानदृष्टि से देखने योग्य, स्थूलातिस्थूल, अनादि, अनन्त, नित्य, अद्भुत और व्यापक आपके विराट रूप का दर्शन करके
english_translation: Wow! What a wonder appears — from a tiny blade of grass to the vast universe, the cause of creation, preservation, and dissolution unfolds.
essence: The vast universe and its cycles arise from the smallest beginnings in a wondrous way.
simple_meaning: Amazement arises seeing how the entire vast universe unfolds from something as small as a blade of grass, covering creation, maintenance, and destruction.
insight: It invites you to see the extraordinary in the ordinary and recognize the vast processes behind everyday life.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अपिचत् परमानन्दो जातो नश्चेतसि प्रभो ! ।
न तथापि वयं दृष्टुं शक्नुयाम बहुक्षणम् ॥
translation: हे प्रभो ! यदि हम लोगों के चित्त में परमानन्द की प्राप्ति हुई है परन्तु हमलोग बहुत देर तक इस रूप का दर्शन नहीं कर सकते हैं
english_translation: Like children absorbed and enchanted in play, many divine beings of various forms are separately appointed, absorbed and enchanted in many ways.
essence: Absorbed like playing children, many divine beings act in varied, devoted forms.
simple_meaning: Many divine beings of different forms are each absorbed and enchanted in their own way, like children lost in play.
insight: It reveals how absorption can lead to focused dedication, whether in divine roles or human tasks.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
जीवानां मनसो बुद्धचिोऽगोचरमिन्यहो ।
अपूर्व भवतो रूपमालोक्याश्चर्यमङकुलम् ॥
translation: अहो! जीवों के वाणी, मन और बुद्धि से अगोचर इस अपूर्व आप के आश्चर्यमय रूप को देखकर
english_translation: Seeing your vast, eternal, and wondrous cosmic form with the eye of wisdom reveals something beyond all grossness.
essence: Wisdom reveals a vast, eternal cosmic reality beyond gross appearances.
simple_meaning: With clear wisdom, you can perceive a vast, eternal, and wondrous cosmic form beyond the ordinary.
insight: It teaches you to shift perception from surface to a profound, limitless reality seen through wisdom.
modern_relevance: When you pause and look deeper than surface appearances, you experience something vast and timeless beyond your everyday view.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
मनो नो मूर्छितं बुद्धिः स्थगिता भवति प्रभो!।
शैथिल्यं यान्ति हे स्वामिनिन्द्रियाण्यखिलानि नः ॥
translation: हे स्वामी ! हे प्रभो ! हमारी सभी इन्द्रियां शिथिल. मन मूर्छित और बुद्धि शिथिल होती है
english_translation: O Lord! Even if supreme bliss arises in our mind, we cannot perceive it for long.
essence: Supreme bliss can arise in the mind but cannot be sustained or clearly seen for long.
simple_meaning: Sometimes, even when deep joy arises in your mind, it doesn't stay visible or clear for long.
insight: Recognize that bliss often arises briefly; learning not to cling lets you appreciate its true nature.
modern_relevance: You experience a sudden wave of happiness, but before you can savor it fully, it slips away, leaving you wanting more.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
अतो वयं हि विश्वात्मन् ! विनीतं प्रार्थयामहे ।
त्वद्विभूतिस्वरूपेषु यद्वन्तं वयं विभो ! ॥
translation: इस कारण हे विश्वात्मन् ! हम लोगों की यह विनीत प्रार्थना है कि हे विभो जिसमें हम आपको
english_translation: Wow! Seeing your wondrous form, beyond speech, mind, and intellect, fills me with awe.
essence: Some truths are beyond speech, mind, and intellect, inspiring pure wonder.
simple_meaning: Seeing this extraordinary form that no words, mind, or intellect can grasp fills the speaker with deep wonder.
insight: Recognize that some realities can only be felt, not fully understood by thinking or speaking.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
देशे काले च सर्वत्र पात्रे द्रष्टुं यथेशमहे ।
उपदिश्यामहे नाथ ! तथोपायं वयं स्वयम् ॥
translation: हे नाथ ! आपकी विभूतियों के रूप में प्रत्येक देश काल पात्र में दर्शन करने में समर्थ हो सकें आप ऐसे उपाय को स्वयं उपदेश दीजिये
english_translation: O Lord! Our mind becomes faint, intellect inactive, and all our senses grow weak.
essence: Mental dullness and sensory weakness signal a need to pause and regain clarity.
simple_meaning: Your mind becomes dull, your intellect slows, and your senses lose energy when you are overwhelmed or exhausted.
insight: It teaches you to notice when mental and sensory exhaustion dulls your clarity, signaling the need to pause and restore.
modern_relevance: After hours of nonstop work or stress, you notice your focus slips and your energy fades, making decisions feel harder.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
आनन्दः सर्वजीवेषु प्रभाऽस्मि शशिमूर्ययोः ।
प्रणवः सर्व्ववेदेषु शब्दः खे चास्मि निर्जरा ॥
translation: समस्त जीवों में मैं आनन्द हूँ, चन्द्रमा और सूर्य में प्रभा हूँ, हे देवगण ! मैं सब वेदों में प्रणव और आकाश में शब्द हूँ
english_translation: Therefore, O universal self, we humbly pray that you reveal yourself in the forms of your divine manifestations in which we reside.
essence: Humbly asking the universal self to reveal itself in its divine forms where we exist.
simple_meaning: We humbly ask the universal self to appear in the divine forms where we exist.
insight: It encourages opening your heart with humility to perceive the divine presence within all aspects of life.
modern_relevance: You might find yourself quietly asking for clarity or support from a greater presence that feels part of everything around you.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
वायो स्पर्शोऽस्मि भो देवाः ! रूपं हुतवहे तथा ।
अप्सु चाहं रसो नूनं सत्यमेतन्न संशयः॥
translation: हे देवगण ! मैं वायु में स्पर्श, अग्नि में रूप और जल में रस हूँ, यह सत्य ही है इसमें सन्देह नहीं
english_translation: O Lord! Please teach us the method by which we can perceive your manifestations everywhere, at all times, and in all beings.
essence: Knowing how to see the divine everywhere requires direct teaching and practice.
simple_meaning: We ask for guidance to recognize the divine presence everywhere, at all times, and in everyone around us.
insight: It invites shifting perception to recognize divinity beyond form, time, and place.
modern_relevance: You want to notice the deeper meaning and presence behind everyday people and moments but don’t know how to open your eyes to it.
speaker: Unknown

verse_text:
पुण्यो गन्धः पृथिव्याञ्च तेजश्चाऽस्मि विभावसौ ।
जीवनं सर्वभूतेषु तपश्चाऽस्मि तपस्विषु ॥
translation: पृथिवी में पवित्र गन्ध, अग्नि में तेज, सब भूतों में जीवन और तपस्वियों में तपोरूप हूँ
english_translation: I am the bliss in all living beings, the radiance in the moon and sun, the primal sound in all Vedas, and the word in the sky.
essence: Bliss and radiant sound pervade all beings and cosmic elements as their true essence.
simple_meaning: The divine is the bliss inside all living beings, the shining light of the sun and moon, the sacred sound in ancient knowledge, and the eternal word in the sky.
insight: Recognize your true self as the source of joy and radiant presence in all things, beyond physical form.
modern_relevance: When you feel small or alone, remember you carry the same radiant bliss and light that shines in the sun, moon, and ancient wisdom.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
वर्णेषु ब्राह्मणो वर्ण आश्रमेष्वन्तिमाश्रमः ।
सतीत्वमार्य्यनारीषु तथास्मि पौरुषं नृषु ॥
translation: वर्णों में ब्राह्मण वर्ण, आश्रमों में अन्तिम आश्रम अर्थात् सन्यास आश्रम, आर्य नारियों में सतीत्व और पुरुषों में पौरुष अर्थात् पुरुषार्थ हूँ
english_translation: O radiant beings! I am the touch in the wind, the form in the fire, and the taste in the water; this truth is beyond doubt.
essence: The divine pervades all elements through touch, form, and taste without doubt.
simple_meaning: I am present as the touch you feel in the wind, the visible form in the fire, and the taste in water. This is an undeniable truth.
insight: Recognize the sacred presence within everyday sensations and natural elements around you.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यावद्देवगणाः सर्वे सात्त्विक्यो मे विभृतयः ।
यावन्तस्तेऽसुराश्चैव तामस्यो मे विभूतयः ॥
translation: जितने देवता हैं वे मेरी सात्त्विक विभूतियां हैं और जितने ही असुर हैं वे मेरी तामसिक विभूतियां हैं
english_translation: I am the pure fragrance in the earth, the radiance in fire, life in all beings, and the austerity in ascetics.
essence: The sacred essence manifests as life, light, and strength within all aspects of existence.
simple_meaning: The divine presence is expressed as pure fragrance in earth, brightness in fire, life in every creature, and spiritual strength in those who practice austerity.
insight: Recognize your own inner presence as part of the sacred essence that flows through all nature and discipline.
modern_relevance: You can feel the sacred in simple things around you — the fresh soil, a glowing flame, the breath of life, and the quiet strength of focused effort.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
बीजं मां सर्वभूतानां वित्त देवाः ! सनातनम् ।
बुद्धिर्बुद्धिमतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम् ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! सब भूतों का सनातन बीज मुझको जानों मैं बुद्धिमानों में बुद्धि और तेजस्वियों में तेज हूँ
english_translation: Among classes, I am the Brahmin; among stages of life, I am the renunciate; among noble women, I am chastity; among men, I am manly strength.
essence: The highest ideals of each role and stage reveal your true nature.
simple_meaning: You represent the best qualities in each social role: wisdom in teachers, renunciation in the final stage of life, chastity in noble women, and strength in men.
insight: This verse teaches you to identify and embody the noblest qualities appropriate to your role and stage in life.
modern_relevance: When you face the demands of your role—whether at work, in family, or community—remember your highest qualities give you strength and clarity.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
बलं बलवतामस्मि कामरागविवर्जितम्।
धर्माविरुद्धो भूतेषु कामोऽस्मि विवुधर्षभाः ! ॥
translation: हे देवश्रेष्ठो ! बलवानों में मैं काम और राग से रहित बल हूँ और भूतों में धर्माविरुद्ध अर्थात् धर्म के अनुकूल काम हूँ
english_translation: All the gods are my sattvic manifestations, and all the asuras are my tamasic manifestations.
essence: Both light and shadow qualities arise as manifestations of the same divine source.
simple_meaning: The radiant gods represent my pure, sattvic qualities, while the darker asuras represent my tamasic qualities.
insight: It teaches you to accept all parts of yourself as expressions of the same underlying reality.
modern_relevance: You notice both your best intentions and your darker impulses — both come from the same inner source.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अहं ऋतुरहं यज्ञः स्वधाहमहमौषधम् ।
मन्त्रोऽहमहमेवाज्यमहमग्निरहं हुतम् ॥
translation: मैं क्रतु (श्रौत अग्निष्टोमादि यज्ञ ) हूँ, मैं यज्ञ (पञ्चमहायज्ञादि) हूँ, मैं स्वधा हूँ, मैं औषध हूँ, मैं मन्त्र हूँ, मैं आज्य (घृत) हूँ, मैं अग्नि हूँ और मैं बाहुति हूँ
english_translation: O radiant beings! Know that I am the eternal seed of all beings; among the wise, I am wisdom, and among the radiant, I am brilliance.
essence: The eternal source within you is the root of all wisdom and brilliance.
simple_meaning: You are the eternal source from which all life springs. Among those who are wise and radiant, you embody wisdom and brilliance.
insight: Recognize that your true nature includes timeless wisdom and inner brilliance beyond surface fluctuations.
modern_relevance: When you face moments of doubt or low energy, remember that deep inside you is an unchanging source of wisdom and radiant strength.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
पिताऽह्मस्य जगतो माता धाता पितामह: ।
वेद्यं पवित्रमोंकार ऋक साम यजुरेव च ॥
translation: इस विश्व का मैं पिता, माता, धाता (धारण और पोषण करने वाला) और पितामह हूँ। मैं ही जानने के योग्य हूँ,  पवित्र ओंकार मैं ही हूँ तथा ऋक् यजुः और साम मैं ही हूँ
english_translation: O best of the gods! Among the powerful, I am strength free from desire and attachment; among beings, I am desire aligned with dharma.
essence: True strength is desire free and desire aligned with what is right.
simple_meaning: True strength is acting without desire or attachment, and true desire supports what is right and just.
insight: It teaches you to separate craving from true strength and to align desire with your deeper purpose.
modern_relevance: When you face pressure to want more or compete, remember your real power grows when you act without craving and align desires with your values.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
ज्योतिषामंशुमान् सूर्यो वित्तेशो यक्षरक्षसाम्।
मरीचिर्मरुतामास्मि नक्षत्राणामहं शशी ॥
translation: ज्योतियों में मैं किरणमाली सूर्य हूँ, यक्ष रक्षोगण में वित्तेश (कुबेर) हूँ, मरुतों में मरीचि हूँ और नक्षत्रों में मैं शशी (चन्द्रमा) हूँ
english_translation: I am the sacred rite, the sacrifice, the offering to ancestors, the healing herb, the mantra, the clarified butter, the fire, and the oblation.
essence: All sacred rituals and elements are expressions of the one divine presence.
simple_meaning: The divine expresses itself as all sacred elements in rituals, showing unity behind many forms.
insight: Recognize the sacred in all your acts, seeing them as expressions of the divine whole.
modern_relevance: When you light a candle, say a prayer, or heal someone, you touch the same sacred essence Vishnu describes here.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
वेदानां सामवेदोऽस्मि देवानामस्मि वासवः ।
इन्द्रियाणां मनश्चाऽस्मि भूतानामम्मि चेतना ॥
translation: वेदों में सामवेद हूँ, देवताओं में इन्द्र हूँ, इन्द्रियों में मन हूँ और प्राणियों में चेतना हूँ
english_translation: I am the father, mother, sustainer, and grandfather of this world. I am the knower, the pure Om, and the Rig, Yajur, and Sama Vedas themselves.
essence: The divine is the source, essence, and sacred foundation of all existence and wisdom.
simple_meaning: The divine being says that it is the source and support of all existence, the sacred sound Om, and the essence of the Vedic knowledge.
insight: It invites you to see the divine as the root and support behind everything you experience and know.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
आदित्यानामहं विष्णुः वसूनामस्मि पावकः ।
रूद्राणां शङ्करश्चाऽस्मि मेहः शिखरिणामहम् ॥
translation: द्वादश आदित्यों में मैं विष्णु हूँ, अष्ट वसुओं में पावक हूँ, एकादश रुद्रों में शङ्कर हूँ और पर्वतों में मैं मेरु हूँ
english_translation: Among the lights, I am the radiant sun; among the yakshas and rakshasas, I am Kubera; among the winds, I am Marichi; and among the stars, I am the moon.
essence: The true self shines as the sun, moon, and all radiant cosmic powers.
simple_meaning: The divine presence expresses itself as the sun, the lord of wealth, a wind deity, and the moon among stars.
insight: Recognize your inner being as part of the vast radiant forces that support life and order.
modern_relevance: When you feel small or lost, remember you share the same energy as the sun and moon lighting the sky.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
पुरोधसाच मुख्यं मां वित्त देवाः ! वृहस्पतिम्।
सेनानीनामहं स्कन्दः सरसामस्मि सागरः ॥
translation: हे देवगण ! मुझको पुरोहितों में श्रेष्ठ पुरोहित बृहस्पति जानो, सेनानायकों में मैं स्कन्द (कार्तिकेय) हूँ और जलाशयों में मैं सागर हूँ
english_translation: Among the Vedas, I am the Sama Veda; among the deities, Indra; among the senses, the mind; and among living beings, consciousness.
essence: The true self is the pure consciousness behind mind, senses, and all life.
simple_meaning: You are not just your mind or senses. At your core, you are pure consciousness, the essence behind all experience.
insight: Shift your identity from the restless mind and senses to the steady awareness that witnesses experience.
modern_relevance: When distractions overwhelm you, remember you are not your busy mind or shifting feelings but the silent awareness behind them.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
महर्षीणां भृगुरहं गिरामस्म्येकमक्षरम् ।
यज्ञानां जपयज्ञोऽस्मि स्थावराणां हिमालयः ॥
translation: महर्षियों में मैं भृगु और वाणियों में मैं एक अक्षर अर्थात् ॐकार हूँ, यज्ञों में जपयज्ञ हूँ और स्थावरों में हिमालय हूँ
english_translation: Among the twelve Adityas I am Vishnu, among the eight Vasus I am the fire, among the eleven Rudras I am Shankara, and among mountains, I am Meru.
essence: The supreme reality reveals itself as the essence within all great cosmic powers and forms.
simple_meaning: The divine is present as the highest aspect in all great cosmic forces and beings, manifesting as Vishnu, fire, Shiva, and the sacred mountain.
insight: Recognizing the divine as the core essence in diverse forms invites seeing unity beyond apparent differences.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अश्वत्थः सर्वक्षाणां देवर्षीणाञ्च नारदः।
गन्धर्वाणां चित्ररथः सिद्धानां कपिलो मुनिः ॥
translation: समस्त  वृक्षों में अश्वत्थ अर्थात् पीपल का वृक्ष हूँ, देवर्षियों में नारद हूँ, गन्धवों में चित्ररथ और सिद्धों में कपिल मुनि हूँ
english_translation: O celestial beings, among priests I am the chief priest Brihaspati, among commanders I am Skanda, and among waters I am the ocean.
essence: The true self embodies the highest form in every essential role and domain.
simple_meaning: The speaker identifies himself with the highest priest, the greatest commander, and the vast ocean, showing his supreme presence in many roles.
insight: It teaches you to recognize the multiple roles and powers within yourself beyond any single identity.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
उच्चैःश्रवसमवानां वित्त माममृतोद्भवम् ।
ऐरावतं गजेन्द्राणां नराणाञ्च नराधिपम् ॥
translation: अश्वों में मुझको अमृत अर्थात् अमृत जिससे उत्पन्न हुआ है ऐसे समुद्र से उत्पन्न उच्चैःश्रवा जानो, गजेन्द्रों में ऐरावत और मनुष्यों में नराधिप अर्थात् प्रजाओं को प्रसन्न रखनेवाला नृप जानो
english_translation: Among sages, I am Bhrigu; among sounds, the imperishable syllable; among sacrifices, the chanting sacrifice; among immovables, the Himalaya.
essence: The divine essence is present as the highest exemplar in every domain of existence.
simple_meaning: I am the greatest among sages, the sacred sound among all voices, the chanting sacrifice among rituals, and the Himalaya among immovable things.
insight: It invites seeing the divine presence in the highest expression of all aspects of life and nature around you.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
अहं वैश्वानरो भूत्वा प्राणिनां देहमाश्रितः ।
प्राणापानसमायुक्तः पचाम्यन्नं चतुर्विधम् ॥
translation: मैं वैश्वानर नामक अग्नि होकर प्राणियों के देह को आश्रय करके प्राण और अपान वायुयों से युक्त होता हुआ चतुर्विध (लेह्य, चूष्य, पेय आदि) अन्नों को पचाता हूँ
english_translation: Among all trees I am the Ashvattha (peepal) tree; among divine sages, I am Narada; among gandharvas, I am Chitraratha; and among siddhas, I am Kapila muni.
essence: The divine essence manifests as the highest example in every revered group.
simple_meaning: The divine says he is present as the most important example in many groups: the sacred peepal tree, the sage Narada, the gandharva Chitraratha, and the sage Kapila.
insight: Recognize that the divine essence permeates diverse forms and roles, inviting reverence for the unity behind variety.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
यदादित्य गतं तेजो जगाद्भास्य्तेऽखिलम ।
यचन्द्रमसि यचाऽग्नौ तत्तेजो वित्त मामकम् ॥
translation: जो सूर्य्गन तेज सम्पूर्ण जगत को प्रकाशित करता है और जो तेज चन्द्र और अग्नि में है, उस तेज को मेरा तेज समझो
english_translation: Among horses, I am Uchhaishravas born from the nectar ocean; among elephants, I am Airavata; among humans, I am the king who pleases his subjects.
essence: The divine manifests as the highest exemplar in every category of beings.
simple_meaning: The divine identifies as the best example in each category: the finest horse, elephant, and human king.
insight: It teaches to see the divine excellence manifest in different realms and roles around you.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
गामाविश्य च भूतानि धारयाम्यहमोजसा।
पुषणामि चौषधी: सर्वा: सोमो भूत्वा रसात्मक: ॥
translation: मैं पृथ्वी में प्रवेश करके ( अपने) बल से भूतो को धारण करता हूँ और रसात्मक सोम होकर सब ओषधियों को पुष्ट करता हूँ
english_translation: I am the cosmic fire residing in beings, digesting all four types of food with the life and outgoing breaths.
essence: A cosmic fire within you digests all nourishment using life’s vital breaths.
simple_meaning: Inside every living being, there is a cosmic fire that, combined with breath, digests all kinds of food.
insight: This verse teaches you to recognize the sacredness in ordinary body functions and see your connection to cosmic processes.
modern_relevance: When you eat a meal, your body’s unseen inner fire is hard at work transforming that food into energy you can use.
speaker: Vishnu

verse_text:
आयुधानामहं वज्रं धेनूनामस्मि कामधुक् ।
प्रजनश्चाऽस्मि कन्दर्पः सर्पाणामस्मि वासुकिः ॥
