modern_relevance: You walk into a room and realise the atmosphere is larger than the decorations, larger than the plan. Something has happened there that no spreadsheet or blueprint could have predicted.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: सिवँ समुझाए देव सब जनि आचरज भुलाहु। हृदयँ बिचारहु धीर धरि सिय रघुबीर बिआहु ॥
translation: तब शिवजी ने सब देवताओं को समझाया कि तुम लोग आश्चर्य में मत भूलो। हृदय में धीरज धरकर विचार तो करो कि यह (भगवान की महामहिमामयी निजशक्ति) श्री सीताजी का और (अखिल ब्रह्माण्डों के परम ईश्वर साक्षात् भगवान) श्री रामचन्द्रजी का विवाह है ॥
english_translation: Then Shiva explained to all the gods: do not lose yourselves in wonder. Hold your mind steady and reflect that this is the marriage of Sita and Raghuvir.
essence: Wonder must give way to clear seeing.
simple_meaning: Shiva tells the gods not to be dazzled by the sight. They should steady themselves and understand that they are witnessing the sacred marriage of Sita and Ram.
insight: It shifts attention from dazzlement to steady recognition of what is sacred.
modern_relevance: You are watching something beautiful unfold and your mind starts racing with awe, comparison, and noise. Shiva's reminder is simple: settle yourself first, then understand what you are actually seeing.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text: जिन्ह कर नामु लेत जग माहीं। सकल अमंगल मूल नसाहीं॥ करतल होहिं पदारथ चारी। तेइ सिय रामु कहेउ कामारी ॥
translation: जिनका नाम लेते ही जगत में सारे अमंगलों की जड़ कट जाती है और चारों पदार्थ (अर्थ, धर्म, काम, मोक्ष) मुट्ठी में आ जाते हैं, ये वही (जगत के माता-पिता) श्री सीतारामजी हैं, काम के शत्रु शिवजी ने ऐसा कहा ॥
english_translation: Those whose name, spoken in the world, destroys the root of all inauspiciousness, and whose hands hold all four aims of life—Shiva, enemy of desire, spoke thus of Sita and Ram.
essence: Ram's name removes harm and contains every fulfillment.
simple_meaning: Speaking Ram and Sita's name removes the root of all badness. Shiva says that through them, the four aims of life are fulfilled.
insight: It shifts attention from fear and fragmentation to refuge in Ram's presence and name.
modern_relevance: You are spiraling before a difficult call, and one steady reminder cuts through the noise. A single sacred word, repeated with trust, can reset the whole mind.
speaker: Shiva

verse_text: एहि बिधि संभु सुरन्ह समुझावा। पुनि आगें बर बसह चलावा॥ देवन्ह देखे दसरथु जाता। महामोद मन पुलकित गाता ॥
translation: इस प्रकार शिवजी ने देवताओं को समझाया और फिर अपने श्रेष्ठ बैल नंदीश्वर को आगे बढ़ाया। देवताओं ने देखा कि दशरथजी मन में बड़े ही प्रसन्न और शरीर से पुलकित हुए चले जा रहे हैं ॥
english_translation: In this way Shiva explained the matter to the gods, and then led his noble bull forward. The gods saw Dasharath walking ahead, filled with great joy and his body thrilled with delight.
essence: Joy shows itself in the body before words arrive.
simple_meaning: Shiva finishes explaining the situation to the gods, and the scene shifts to Dasharath moving forward in joy, his body filled with delight.
insight: It keeps attention on the living emotion inside a public event, not just the event itself.
modern_relevance: You catch a parent walking ahead of a wedding procession, smiling before anyone else can. The day is not just ceremony; it is relief, blessing, and shared joy moving together.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: साधु समाज संग महिदेवा। जनु तनु धरें करहिं सुख सेवा॥ सोहत साथ सुभग सुत चारी। जनु अपबरग सकल तनुधारी ॥
translation: उनके साथ (परम हर्षयुक्त) साधुओं और ब्राह्मणों की मंडली ऐसी शोभा दे रही है, मानो समस्त सुख शरीर धारण करके उनकी सेवा कर रहे हों। चारों सुंदर पुत्र साथ में ऐसे सुशोभित हैं, मानो सम्पूर्ण मोक्ष (सालोक्य, सामीप्य, सारूप्य, सायुज्य) शरीर धारण किए हुए हों ॥
english_translation: The company of holy people and priests shone around him, as if joy itself had taken form to serve him. The four beautiful sons beside him shone like freedom itself in embodied form.
essence: Holy company makes joy and freedom seem tangible.
simple_meaning: The king is surrounded by holy people and his four beautiful sons. The scene is so radiant that joy and freedom seem to have taken visible form.
insight: It frames auspicious company as something that visibly transforms a space and makes joy feel embodied.
modern_relevance: You walk into a room where a family is gathered after a long wait, and everyone suddenly seems lighter. No speech is needed — the right presence itself changes the air.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: मरकत कनक बरन बर जोरी। देखि सुरन्ह भै प्रीति न थोरी॥ पुनि रामहि बिलोकि हियँ हरषे। नृपहि सराहि सुमन तिन्ह बरषे ॥
translation: मरकतमणि और सुवर्ण के रंग की सुंदर जोड़ियों को देखकर देवताओं को कम प्रीति नहीं हुई (अर्थात् बहुत ही प्रीति हुई)। फिर रामचन्द्रजी को देखकर वे हृदय में (अत्यन्त) हर्षित हुए और राजा की सराहना करके उन्होंने फूल बरसाए ॥
english_translation: Seeing the beautiful pair in emerald and gold, the gods felt deep delight. Then, beholding Rama, their hearts filled with joy; they praised the king and showered flowers.
essence: Rama's presence turns beauty into blessing.
simple_meaning: The gods admire the royal family and feel even greater joy when they see Rama. They praise Dasharath and shower flowers in blessing.
insight: It shifts attention from surface splendour to the presence that gives splendour meaning.
modern_relevance: You spot a family arriving at a ceremony, dressed with quiet grace. Then one face in the group stops you cold — the whole room seems brighter because of that presence.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: राम रूपु नख सिख सुभग बारहिं बार निहारि। पुलक गात लोचन सजल उमा समेत पुरारि ॥
translation: नख से शिखा तक श्री रामचन्द्रजी के सुंदर रूप को बार-बार देखते हुए पार्वतीजी सहित श्री शिवजी का शरीर पुलकित हो गया और उनके नेत्र (प्रेमाश्रुओं के) जल से भर गए ॥
english_translation: Shiva, together with Parvati, kept beholding Ram’s beautiful form from head to toe again and again. Their bodies thrilled with delight and their eyes filled with tears.
essence: Repeated seeing turns beauty into devotion.
simple_meaning: Shiva and Parvati keep looking at Ram’s beautiful form, and devotion makes their bodies thrill and their eyes fill with tears.
insight: It shifts attention from description to reverent seeing, where repeated remembrance deepens devotion.
modern_relevance: You catch a photo of someone you love and stare at it longer than you meant to. Your chest tightens, your eyes soften, and for a moment nothing else matters.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: केकि कंठ दुति स्यामल अंगा। तड़ित बिनिंदक बसन सुरंगा॥ ब्याह बिभूषन बिबिध बनाए। मंगल सब सब भाँति सुहाए ॥
translation: रामजी का मोर के कंठ की सी कांतिवाला (हरिताभ) श्याम शरीर है। बिजली का अत्यन्त निरादर करने वाले प्रकाशमय सुंदर (पीत) रंग के वस्त्र हैं। सब मंगल रूप और सब प्रकार के सुंदर भाँति-भाँति के विवाह के आभूषण शरीर पर सजाए हुए हैं ॥
english_translation: Ram's body is dark like a peacock's neck, with garments bright as lightning. He wears many wedding ornaments, all auspicious and beautiful in every way.
essence: Auspicious beauty can make the ordinary world feel consecrated.
simple_meaning: Ram is dressed for the wedding in bright, auspicious ornaments. His dark body and shining clothes make him look beautiful beyond compare.
insight: It trains attention to see sacred beauty in form, color, and ceremonial order.
modern_relevance: You see someone dressed for a once-in-a-lifetime ceremony, and everything about them feels composed and radiant. The outer form is not vanity here; it carries meaning, blessing, and joy.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: सरद बिमल बिधु बदनु सुहावन। नयन नवल राजीव लजावन॥ सकल अलौकिक सुंदरताई। कहि न जाई मनहीं मन भाई ॥
translation: उनका सुंदर मुख शरत्पूर्णिमा के निर्मल चन्द्रमा के समान और (मनोहर) नेत्र नवीन कमल को लजाने वाले हैं। सारी सुंदरता अलौकिक है। (माया की बनी नहीं है, दिव्य सच्चिदानन्दमयी है) वह कहीं नहीं जा सकती, मन ही मन बहुत प्रिय लगती है ॥
english_translation: His lovely face is like a clear autumn moon, and his fresh eyes shame newly opened lotuses. All beauty there is beyond the world, beyond speech, and dear to the heart.
essence: Ram's beauty is so complete that words fail before the heart does.
simple_meaning: Ram's face is like a clear autumn moon, and his eyes outshine fresh lotuses. His beauty is beyond ordinary words and wins the heart inwardly.
insight: It shifts attention from physical description to reverent recognition of a presence that exceeds speech.
modern_relevance: You catch a glimpse of someone walking into a room and the noise inside you goes quiet. Some presence cannot be explained; it is simply felt first.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: बंधु मनोहर सोहहिं संगा। जात नचावत चपल तुरंगा। राजकुअँर बर बाजि देखावहिं। बंस प्रसंसक बिरिद सुनावहिं ॥
translation: साथ में मनोहर भाई शोभित हैं, जो चंचल घोड़ों को नचाते हुए चले जा रहे हैं। राजकुमार श्रेष्ठ घोड़ों को (उनकी चाल को) दिखला रहे हैं और वंश की प्रशंसा करने वाले (मागध भाट) विरुदावली सुना रहे हैं ॥
english_translation: The handsome brothers ride together, guiding their restless horses. Royal princes display fine steeds, while bards sing praises of the dynasty.
essence: Royal splendor becomes visible in motion and song.
simple_meaning: The princes ride out together on lively horses, looking splendid as bards sing their praises.
insight: It shifts attention from plot to atmosphere, letting the grandeur of the moment carry the meaning.
modern_relevance: A wedding convoy rolls past with music, polished cars, and relatives calling out blessings. The scene itself feels complete before anyone even speaks.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: जेहि तुरंग पर रामु बिराजे। गति बिलोकि खगनायकु लाजे॥ कहि न जाइ सब भाँति सुहावा। बाजि बेषु जनु काम बनावा ॥
translation: जिस घोड़े पर श्री रामजी विराजमान हैं, उसकी (तेज) चाल देखकर गरुड़ भी लजा जाते हैं, उसका वर्णन नहीं हो सकता, वह सब प्रकार से सुंदर है। मानो कामदेव ने ही घोड़े का वेष धारण कर लिया हो ॥
english_translation: On the horse where Ram is seated, even Garuda would feel shy at its speed. It cannot be fully described; it is beautiful in every way, as if Cupid himself had taken the form of a horse.
essence: Even the horse seems divine when Ram sits upon it.
simple_meaning: Ram rides a horse so splendid and swift that even Garuda would be humbled. Its beauty is beyond description, like Cupid himself has taken the horse's form.
insight: It shifts attention from the object itself to the radiance that dignity and presence give it.
modern_relevance: You catch one glimpse of someone entering a room with total ease, and everything feels elevated. The clothes, the posture, the movement — all of it carries a presence that cannot be faked.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: जनु बाजि बेषु बनाइ मनसिजु राम हित अति सोहई। आपनें बय बल रूप गुन गति सकल भुवन बिमोहई॥ जगमगत जीनु जराव जोति सुमोति मनि मानिक लगे। किंकिनि ललाम लगामु ललित बिलोकिसुर नर मुनि ठगे॥
translation: मानो श्री रामचन्द्रजी के लिए कामदेव घोड़े का वेश बनाकर अत्यन्त शोभित हो रहा है। वह अपनी अवस्था, बल, रूप, गुण और चाल से समस्त लोकों को मोहित कर रहा है। उसकी सुंदर घुँघरू लगी ललित लगाम को देखकर देवता, मनुष्य और मुनि सभी ठगे जाते हैं।
english_translation: It was as if Cupid himself had taken the form of a horse for Ram, and shone with great beauty. Its age, strength, form, qualities, and gait enchanted all the worlds. The glittering saddle, bright ornaments, and jeweled trappings looked like stars on a glowing body. Its charming reins and bells left gods, humans, and sages stunned.
essence: Beauty can overwhelm even the wise.
simple_meaning: A horse so beautiful appears before Ram that it seems like Cupid himself has taken that form. Its beauty, strength, and ornaments amaze everyone who sees it.
insight: It shifts attention from the event itself to the power of form, movement, and ornament to overwhelm the mind.
modern_relevance: You catch a glimpse of a perfectly prepared wedding car, a stage entrance, or a restored classic and everyone falls quiet for a second. Beauty can still stop a room.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: प्रभु मनसहिं लयलीन मनु चलत बाजि छबि पाव। भूषित उड़गन तड़ित घनु जनु बर बरहि नचाव ॥
translation: प्रभु की इच्छा में अपने मन को लीन किए चलता हुआ वह घोड़ा बड़ी शोभा पा रहा है। मानो तारागण तथा बिजली से अलंकृत मेघ सुंदर मोर को नचा रहा हो ॥
english_translation: The horse, with its mind absorbed in the Lord's will, moved in such beauty. Adorned with stars and lightning, it seemed like a cloud making a noble peacock dance.
essence: Grace becomes visible when everything moves in harmony.
simple_meaning: The horse is moving in perfect beauty, as if the sky itself is decorating and animating it.
insight: It invites attention to beauty as an experience, not just an object to describe.
modern_relevance: A wedding procession passes under bright lights, and everyone pauses at one stunning detail — the way movement, color, and music suddenly feel larger than life.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: जेहिं बर बाजि रामु असवारा। तेहि सारदउ न बरनै पारा॥ संकरु राम रूप अनुरागे। नयन पंचदस अति प्रिय लागे ॥
translation: जिस श्रेष्ठ घोड़े पर श्री रामचन्द्रजी सवार हैं, उसका वर्णन सरस्वतीजी भी नहीं कर सकतीं। शंकरजी श्री रामचन्द्रजी के रूप में ऐसे अनुरक्त हुए कि उन्हें अपने पंद्रह नेत्र इस समय बहुत ही प्यारे लगने लगे ॥
english_translation: On the splendid horse that Ram rides, even Saraswati cannot fully describe it. Shiva became so absorbed in Ram's form that his fifteen eyes felt especially dear to him.
essence: Ram's presence is so radiant that even divine sight falls silent.
simple_meaning: Ram's horse is so splendid that even Saraswati cannot fully describe it. Shiva becomes so absorbed in Ram's beauty that his many eyes feel precious.
insight: It shifts attention from description to direct awe, showing that devotion begins where language ends.
modern_relevance: You see someone walk into a room and the whole atmosphere changes. Words fail first, then admiration takes over. Some presence is felt before it is understood.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: हरि हित सहित रामु जब जोहे। रमा समेत रमापति मोहे॥ निरखि राम छबि बिधि हरषाने। आठइ नयन जानि पछिताने ॥
translation: भगवान विष्णु ने जब प्रेम सहित श्री राम को देखा, तब वे (रमणीयता की मूर्ति) श्री लक्ष्मीजी के पति श्री लक्ष्मीजी सहित मोहित हो गए। श्री रामचन्द्रजी की शोभा देखकर ब्रह्माजी बड़े प्रसन्न हुए, पर अपने आठ ही नेत्र जानकर पछताने लगे ॥
english_translation: When Hari saw Ram with loving delight, Lakshmi's lord became enchanted along with Lakshmi. Seeing Ram's beauty, Brahma was delighted, then regretted having only eight eyes.
essence: Ram's beauty overwhelms even the highest beings.
simple_meaning: Ram's beauty delights even the highest beings. Brahma rejoices at seeing him, then regrets having only eight eyes.
insight: It shifts attention from ordinary admiration to reverent astonishment before Ram's form.
modern_relevance: You meet someone whose calm and grace make the whole room soften. You smile, then realise you do not have enough attention, enough words, enough of anything to hold that presence.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: सुर सेनप उर बहुत उछाहू। बिधि ते डेवढ़ लोचन लाहू॥ रामहि चितव सुरेस सुजाना। गौतम श्रापु परम हित माना ॥
translation: देवताओं के सेनापति स्वामि कार्तिक के हृदय में बड़ा उत्साह है, क्योंकि वे ब्रह्माजी से ड्योढ़े अर्थात बारह नेत्रों से रामदर्शन का सुंदर लाभ उठा रहे हैं। सुजान इन्द्र (अपने हजार नेत्रों से) श्री रामचन्द्रजी को देख रहे हैं और गौतमजी के शाप को अपने लिए परम हितकर मान रहे हैं ॥
english_translation: The commander of the gods feels great joy in his heart, for he gains the blessed sight of Ram with twelve eyes instead of one pair. Wise Indra gazes at Ram and counts Gautama's curse as a supreme blessing.
essence: A setback becomes a blessing when it brings you closer to Ram.
simple_meaning: Indra and other heavenly beings are overjoyed to behold Ram. Even a curse is seen as a blessing because it led to this sight.
insight: It shifts the mind from resenting setbacks to recognising how they can open a better sightline.
modern_relevance: You miss a train, then meet the person who changes your life on the platform. Later, the delay stops looking like bad luck and starts looking like grace.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: देव सकल सुरपतिहि सिहाहीं। आजु पुरंदर सम कोउ नाहीं॥ मुदित देवगन रामहि देखी। नृपसमाज दुहुँ हरषु बिसेषी ॥
translation: सभी देवता देवराज इन्द्र से ईर्षा कर रहे हैं (और कह रहे हैं) कि आज इन्द्र के समान भाग्यवान दूसरा कोई नहीं है। श्री रामचन्द्रजी को देखकर देवगण प्रसन्न हैं और दोनों राजाओं के समाज में विशेष हर्ष छा रहा है ॥
english_translation: All the gods envy Indra, saying, “Today no one is as fortunate as he.” Seeing Ram, the hosts of gods rejoice, and special joy fills both royal assemblies.
essence: Ram's presence turns envy into joy.
simple_meaning: The gods feel joy at Ram's presence, and both the divine and royal gatherings are filled with special happiness.
insight: It shifts attention from status and comparison to the transforming power of a worthy presence.
modern_relevance: A room goes quiet when the person everyone was waiting for finally walks in. The mood changes before anyone speaks. Presence itself can settle a crowd and lift its heart.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: अति हरषु राजसमाज दुहु दिसि दुंदुभीं बाजहिं घनी। बरषहिं सुमन सुर हरषि कहि जय जयति जय रघुकुलमनी॥ एहि भाँति जानि बरात आवत बाजने बहु बाजहीं। रानी सुआसिनि बोलि परिछनि हेतु मंगल साजहीं॥
translation: दोनों ओर से राजसमाज में अत्यन्त हर्ष है और बड़े जोर से नगाड़े बज रहे हैं। देवता प्रसन्न होकर और 'रघुकुलमणि श्री राम की जय हो, जय हो, जय हो' कहकर फूल बरसा रहे हैं। इस प्रकार बारात को आती हुई जानकर बहुत प्रकार के बाजे बजने लगे और रानी सुहागिन स्त्रियों को बुलाकर परछन के लिए मंगल द्रव्य सजाने लगीं॥
english_translation: The royal assembly rejoices on both sides; drums thunder loudly. The radiant beings, delighted, shower flowers and cry, "Victory, victory, victory to the jewel of the Raghu clan!" Knowing the wedding procession is arriving, many instruments sound, and the queens call auspicious married women to prepare the ceremonial welcome.
essence: Joy prepares itself before the beloved arrives.
simple_meaning: Everyone rejoices as the wedding procession arrives. Drums sound, flowers fall, and the queens prepare the ceremonial welcome.
insight: It turns arrival into a shared celebration and shows reverence through preparation.
modern_relevance: A house fills with noise before the first guest arrives: cousins rushing, aunties setting trays, someone checking the flowers again. The happiness is not private anymore; it spreads through every room.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: सजि आरती अनेक बिधि मंगल सकल सँवारि। चलीं मुदित परिछनि करन गजगामिनि बर नारि ॥
translation: अनेक प्रकार से आरती सजकर और समस्त मंगल द्रव्यों को यथायोग्य सजाकर गजगामिनी (हाथी की सी चाल वाली) उत्तम स्त्रियाँ आनंदपूर्वक परछन के लिए चलीं ॥
english_translation: Women of noble bearing, having arranged the auspicious offerings in many ways, joyfully went out to perform the welcoming ritual.
essence: Welcome itself becomes auspicious when done with joy.
simple_meaning: The noble women prepared the welcoming lamps and all auspicious items, then went joyfully to greet the arriving guests.
insight: It shifts attention from ceremony as duty to ceremony as shared delight.
modern_relevance: You are rushing to greet guests before the doorbell rings, straightening the tray, lighting the lamp, making the room feel ready. Careful welcome becomes its own joy.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: बिधुबदनीं सब सब मृगलोचनि। सब निज तन छबि रति मदु मोचनि॥ पहिरें बरन बरन बर चीरा। सकल बिभूषन सजें सरीरा ॥
translation: सभी स्त्रियाँ चन्द्रमुखी (चन्द्रमा के समान मुख वाली) और सभी मृगलोचनी (हरिण की सी आँखों वाली) हैं और सभी अपने शरीर की शोभा से रति के गर्व को छुड़ाने वाली हैं। रंग-रंग की सुंदर साड़ियाँ पहने हैं और शरीर पर सब आभूषण सजे हुए हैं ॥
english_translation: All the women have moon-like faces and deer-like eyes, and their beauty makes even Rati's pride fall away. They wear garments of many colors, and their bodies are adorned with every ornament.
essence: Celebration itself becomes sacred when every detail shines.
simple_meaning: The women are richly dressed and beautifully adorned, with faces and eyes compared to the moon and deer. Their beauty is so striking that it outshines even legendary beauty itself.
insight: It shifts attention from plot to atmosphere, letting the reader feel the grandeur of the celebration.
modern_relevance: A wedding hall fills with color, perfume, silk, and laughter before the first ritual begins. Everyone is dressed to honor the moment, and the whole room feels lifted by shared joy.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: सकल सुमंगल अंग बनाएँ। करहिं गान कलकंठि लजाएँ॥ कंकन किंकिनि नूपुर बाजहिं। चालि बिलोकि काम गज लाजहिं ॥
translation: समस्त अंगों को सुंदर मंगल पदार्थों से सजाए हुए वे कोयल को भी लजाती हुई (मधुर स्वर से) गान कर रही हैं। कंगन, करधनी और नूपुर बज रहे हैं। स्त्रियों की चाल देखकर कामदेव के हाथी भी लजा जाते हैं ॥
english_translation: With every limb adorned in auspicious beauty, they sing so sweetly that even the cuckoo is humbled. Bracelets, waist-bells, and anklets ring; their graceful walk shames even Cupid's elephant.
essence: Grace makes even sound and movement feel auspicious.
simple_meaning: The women are beautifully dressed, singing sweetly, and moving so gracefully that their ornaments ring as they walk.
insight: It shifts attention from plot to atmosphere, letting the reader feel the sacred celebration taking shape.
modern_relevance: A wedding hall is filling up, bangles clinking, music rising, everyone moving with that special careful joy. The scene matters before anyone even speaks.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: बाजहिं बाजने बिबिध प्रकारा। नभ अरु नगर सुमंगलचारा॥ सची सारदा रमा भवानी। जे सुरतिय सुचि सजह सयानी ॥
translation: अनेक प्रकार के बाजे बज रहे हैं, आकाश और नगर दोनों स्थानों में सुंदर मंगलाचार हो रहे हैं। शची (इन्द्राणी), सरस्वती, लक्ष्मी, पार्वती और जो स्वभाव से ही पवित्र और सयानी देवांगनाएँ थीं, ॥
english_translation: Various kinds of musical instruments are sounding. Auspicious celebrations fill the sky and the city. Shachi, Saraswati, Lakshmi, Parvati, and other pure, wise celestial women...
essence: Auspicious joy announces a moment before words do.
simple_meaning: The celebration is in full swing. Music fills the sky and the city, while divine women arrive beautifully dressed and ready for the auspicious event.
insight: It shifts attention from the event itself to the sacred atmosphere surrounding it.
modern_relevance: A wedding hall hums before the ceremony begins: drums, flowers, silk, and a room charged with anticipation. The moment feels larger than the people inside it.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: कपट नारि बर बेष बनाई। मिली सकल रनिवासहिं जाई॥ करहिं गान कल मंगल बानीं। हरष बिबस सब काहुँ न जानीं ॥
translation: वे सब कपट से सुंदर स्त्री का वेश बनाकर रनिवास में जा मिलीं और मनोहर वाणी से मंगलगान करने लगीं। सब कोई हर्ष के विशेष वश थे, अतः किसी ने उन्हें पहचाना नहीं ॥
english_translation: They disguised themselves as beautiful women and went into the royal women's quarters. They sang auspicious songs in sweet voices, and everyone was so overjoyed that no one recognized them.
essence: Delight can hide what fear would instantly notice.
simple_meaning: They enter the royal women’s quarters in disguise and sing auspicious songs. Everyone is so delighted that nobody notices who they really are.
insight: It shows how collective joy can dissolve suspicion and blur identity.
modern_relevance: At a crowded wedding, everyone is swept up in music, color, and laughter. In that kind of joy, even the most unlikely presence can pass unnoticed.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: को जान केहि आनंद बस सब ब्रह्मु बर परिछन चली। कल गान मधुर निसान बरषहिं सुमन सुर सोभा भली॥ आनंदकंदु बिलोकि दूलहु सकलहियँ हरषित भई। अंभोज अंबक अंबु उमगि सुअंग पुलकावलि छई॥
translation: कौन किसे जाने-पहिचाने! आनंद के वश हुई सब दूल्हे बने हुए ब्रह्म का परछन करने चलीं। मनोहर गान हो रहा है। मधुर-मधुर नगाड़े बज रहे हैं, देवता फूल बरसा रहे हैं, बड़ी अच्छी शोभा है। आनंदकन्द दूल्हे को देखकर सब स्त्रियाँ हृदय में हर्षित हुईं। उनके कमल सरीखे नेत्रों में प्रेमाश्रुओं का जल उमड़ आया और सुंदर अंगों में पुलकावली छा गई॥
english_translation: Who can know whom? Overcome by bliss, all went to behold the bridegroom Brahma. Sweet songs rose, drums rained, and the gods showered flowers in fine splendour. Seeing the joy-filled bridegroom, all the women’s hearts overflowed with delight. Tears of love filled their lotus-like eyes, and goosebumps covered their lovely bodies.
essence: Joy at Ram’s sight overflows into tears, music, and trembling delight.
simple_meaning: The wedding scene overflows with joy, music, flowers, and wonder. Everyone is so moved by the sight of the bridegroom that tears, delight, and goosebumps appear together.
insight: It shifts attention from ceremony to presence: the sight of what is sacred makes joy physical.
modern_relevance: You walk into a wedding hall and the room changes before anyone speaks. Music starts, people smile through tears, and one sight makes the whole crowd feel blessed.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: जो सुखु भा सिय मातु मन देखि राम बर बेषु। सो न सकहिं कहि कलप सत सहस सारदा सेषु ॥
translation: श्री रामचन्द्रजी का वर वेश देखकर सीताजी की माता सुनयनाजी के मन में जो सुख हुआ, उसे हजारों सरस्वती और शेषजी सौ कल्पों में भी नहीं कह सकते (अथवा लाखों सरस्वती और शेष लाखों कल्पों में भी नहीं कह सकते) ॥
english_translation: The joy that Sita's mother felt upon seeing Ram in bridegroom's dress cannot be told even by a hundred thousand Saraswatis or Sheshas over countless ages.
essence: Some joy is too vast for language to hold.
simple_meaning: Seeing Ram dressed as the bridegroom filled Sita's mother with joy beyond words. Even endless time and countless voices could not describe it.
insight: It shifts attention from describing joy to feeling its fullness directly.
modern_relevance: You catch sight of your child in a graduation gown, and your chest tightens before any words come. Some pride and tenderness are bigger than explanation.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: नयन नीरु हटि मंगल जानी। परिछनि करहिं मुदित मन रानी॥ बेद बिहित अरु कुल आचारू। कीन्ह भली बिधि सब ब्यवहारू ॥
translation: मंगल अवसर जानकर नेत्रों के जल को रोके हुए रानी प्रसन्न मन से परछन कर रही हैं। वेदों में कहे हुए तथा कुलाचार के अनुसार सभी व्यवहार रानी ने भलीभाँति किए ॥
english_translation: The queens, knowing this was an auspicious moment, held back their tears and joyfully performed the welcoming rites. They carried out every formality properly, according to the Vedas and family custom.
essence: Joy becomes complete when it is expressed through rightful action.
simple_meaning: The queens suppress their tears, feel joy, and perform the welcoming ritual properly, following sacred law and family custom.
insight: It teaches that devotion can be both emotional and exact, with feeling guided by right conduct.
modern_relevance: You are smiling through tears at your child’s wedding, doing the ritual steps one by one because love needs form, not just feeling.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: पंच सबद धुनि मंगल गाना। पट पाँवड़े परहिं बिधि नाना॥ करि आरती अरघु तिन्ह दीन्हा। राम गमनु मंडप तब कीन्हा ॥
translation: पंचशब्द (तंत्री, ताल, झाँझ, नगारा और तुरही- इन पाँच प्रकार के बाजों के शब्द), पंचध्वनि (वेदध्वनि, वन्दिध्वनि, जयध्वनि, शंखध्वनि और हुलूध्वनि) और मंगलगान हो रहे हैं। नाना प्रकार के वस्त्रों के पाँवड़े पड़ रहे हैं। उन्होंने (रानी ने) आरती करके अर्घ्य दिया, तब श्री रामजी ने मंडप में गमन किया ॥
english_translation: The sounds of five kinds of instruments and five sacred cries rose with auspicious songs. Fine cloths were laid down in many ways. They performed aarti and offered arghya, then Ram entered the wedding pavilion.
essence: Reverence prepares the way before joy enters.
simple_meaning: The wedding pavilion fills with music, ritual offerings, and celebration as Ram enters.
insight: It shifts attention from the arrival alone to the care that makes arrival sacred.
modern_relevance: A home fills with music, flowers, and careful preparation before a loved one arrives. The welcome itself becomes part of the joy.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: दसरथु सहित समाज बिराजे। बिभव बिलोकि लोकपति लाजे॥ समयँ समयँ सुर बरषहिं फूला। सांति पढ़हिं महिसुर अनुकूला ॥
translation: दशरथजी अपनी मंडली सहित विराजमान हुए। उनके वैभव को देखकर लोकपाल भी लजा गए। समय-समय पर देवता फूल बरसाते हैं और भूदेव ब्राह्मण समयानुकूल शांति पाठ करते हैं ॥
english_translation: Dasharath sat there with his assembled company. Seeing his splendor, the guardians of the world felt humbled. At intervals, the radiant beings showered flowers, and the learned priests recited peace chants in fitting sequence.
essence: Royal splendour and sacred ceremony announce the coming of Ram.
simple_meaning: Dasharath sits in royal splendour while flowers fall from above and priests recite blessings in order.
insight: It shifts attention from the king to the charged atmosphere surrounding Ram's arrival.
modern_relevance: You walk into a hall before the ceremony begins, and every detail is already arranged: the flowers, the chants, the waiting crowd. The room itself seems to know something important is about to happen.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: नभ अरु नगर कोलाहल होई। आपनि पर कछु सुनइ न कोई॥ एहि बिधि रामु मंडपहिं आए। अरघु देइ आसन बैठाए ॥
translation: आकाश और नगर में शोर मच रहा है। अपनी-पराई कोई कुछ भी नहीं सुनता। इस प्रकार श्री रामचन्द्रजी मंडप में आए और अर्घ्य देकर आसन पर बैठाए गए ॥
english_translation: There was uproar in the sky and the city. No one heard anything else. In this way, Ram entered the wedding pavilion, was honored with offerings, and seated.
essence: Ram's arrival turns the whole city into celebration.
simple_meaning: The whole city is filled with celebration as Ram enters the wedding pavilion and is seated with honor.
insight: It turns attention to the sacred arrival itself, not the details around it.
modern_relevance: A wedding hall erupts when the bridegroom finally walks in. Music, voices, footsteps, and laughter blur together — the kind of moment where celebration itself becomes the message.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: बैठारि आसन आरती करि निरखि बरु सुखु पावहीं। मनि बसन भूषन भूरि वारहिं नारि मंगल गावहीं॥ ब्रह्मादि सुरबर बिप्र बेष बनाइ कौतुक देखहीं। अवलोकि रघुकुल कमल रबि छबि सुफल जीवन लेखहीं॥
translation: आसन पर बैठाकर, आरती करके दूल्हे को देखकर स्त्रियाँ सुख पा रही हैं। वे ढेर के ढेर मणि, वस्त्र और गहने निछावर करके मंगल गा रही हैं। ब्रह्मा आदि श्रेष्ठ देवता ब्राह्मण का वेश बनाकर कौतुक देख रहे हैं। वे रघुकुल रूपी कमल को प्रफुल्लित करने वाले सूर्य श्री रामचन्द्रजी की छबि देखकर अपना जीवन सफल जान रहे हैं।
english_translation: Having seated him, the women perform the aarti and feel joy at seeing the groom. They shower heaps of jewels, clothes, and ornaments, singing auspicious songs. Brahma and the other radiant beings, disguised as Brahmins, watch the spectacle. Seeing the beauty of Ram, the sun of the Raghu clan, they feel their lives have become fruitful.
essence: Ram’s presence turns celebration into fulfillment.
simple_meaning: The wedding hall overflows with joy. Women sing, offer gifts, and celebrate Ram’s beauty, while even the radiant beings in disguise watch in wonder and feel their lives are fulfilled.
insight: It shifts attention from the ceremony itself to the presence that gives the ceremony meaning.
modern_relevance: You walk into a wedding hall where everyone has paused mid-conversation, not from etiquette but awe. The room feels larger because one presence has made ordinary celebration feel holy.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: नाऊ बारी भाट नट राम निछावरि पाइ। मुदित असीसहिं नाइ सिर हरषु न हृदयँ समाइ ॥
translation: नाई, बारी, भाट और नट श्री रामचन्द्रजी की निछावर पाकर आनंदित हो सिर नवाकर आशीष देते हैं, उनके हृदय में हर्ष समाता नहीं है ॥
english_translation: The barber, washerman, bard, and dancers receive Ram's gifts, bow their heads, and offer blessings. Their hearts overflow with joy.
essence: Honor given freely returns as joy.
simple_meaning: The people serving the wedding receive gifts from Ram and feel so happy that they bow and bless him with overflowing joy.
insight: It shifts attention from the main ceremony to the dignity of every person who helps hold it together.
modern_relevance: At a wedding, the caterer, musician, and driver are all treated with real warmth. The event feels different because no one is invisible.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: मिले जनकु दसरथु अति प्रीतीं। करि बैदिक लौकिक सब रीतीं॥ मिलत महा दोउ राज बिराजे। उपमा खोजि खोजि कबि लाजे ॥
translation: वैदिक और लौकिक सब रीतियाँ करके जनकजी और दशरथजी बड़े प्रेम से मिले। दोनों महाराज मिलते हुए बड़े ही शोभित हुए, कवि उनके लिए उपमा खोज-खोजकर लजा गए ॥
english_translation: Janak and Dasharath met with great affection, following all Vedic and worldly customs. As the two royal fathers met in splendor, poets searched for a comparison and then felt ashamed.
essence: Greatness can be so graceful that comparison fails.
simple_meaning: Janak and Dasharath meet with deep affection and full ceremony. Their royal dignity is so great that poets cannot find a fitting comparison.
insight: It shifts attention from event to reverence, showing that form and courtesy can reveal true greatness.
modern_relevance: At a wedding where two families meet with folded hands, careful rituals, and quiet pride, you can feel the room change. Some encounters carry a dignity that no caption can fully hold.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: लही न कतहुँ हारि हियँ मानी। इन्ह सम एइ उपमा उर आनी॥ सामध देखि देव अनुरागे। सुमन बरषि जसु गावन लागे ॥
translation: जब कहीं भी उपमा नहीं मिली, तब हृदय में हार मानकर उन्होंने मन में यही उपमा निश्चित की कि इनके समान ये ही हैं। समधियों का मिलाप या परस्पर संबंध देखकर देवता अनुरक्त हो गए और फूल बरसाकर उनका यश गाने लगे ॥
english_translation: No comparison could be found, so they accepted in their hearts: these two are equal. Seeing the union of the families, the radiant beings grew delighted, showered flowers, and began singing their praise.
essence: Some unions are so perfect that praise itself becomes celebration.
simple_meaning: No one could find a comparison equal to this royal match, so they settled on one: these two are alike. The heavenly beings rejoiced, showered flowers, and sang their praise.
insight: It shifts attention from measuring people to recognising a rare, complete harmony.
modern_relevance: At a wedding where both families are equally gracious, everyone falls quiet for a moment. No compliment feels large enough, and the room itself seems to bless the match.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: जगु बिरंचि उपजावा जब तें। देखे सुने ब्याह बहु तब तें॥ सकल भाँति सम साजु समाजू। सम समधी देखे हम आजू ॥
translation: (वे कहने लगे-) जबसे ब्रह्माजी ने जगत को उत्पन्न किया, तब से हमने बहुत विवाह देखे- सुने, परन्तु सब प्रकार से समान साज-समाज और बराबरी के (पूर्ण समतायुक्त) समधी तो आज ही देखे ॥
english_translation: Since Brahma created the world, we have seen and heard many weddings, but only today have we seen a match so perfectly equal in every respect.
essence: Even the oldest witnesses find no comparison for this perfect union.
simple_meaning: The assembled kings say they have seen many weddings since the world began, but never one as perfectly matched and splendid as this one.
insight: It frames the marriage as a once-in-a-lifetime harmony, not just a social event.
modern_relevance: You walk into a wedding where every detail feels strangely right — the families, the timing, the atmosphere. Everyone knows they are witnessing something rare before a single ceremony begins.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: देव गिरा सुनि सुंदर साँची। प्रीति अलौकिक दुहु दिसि माची॥ देत पाँवड़े अरघु सुहाए। सादर जनकु मंडपहिं ल्याए ॥
translation: देवताओं की सुंदर सत्यवाणी सुनकर दोनों ओर अलौकिक प्रीति छा गई। सुंदर पाँवड़े और अर्घ्य देते हुए जनकजी दशरथजी को आदरपूर्वक मंडप में ले आए ॥
english_translation: Hearing the gods’ beautiful and true words, both sides were filled with extraordinary affection. Offering graceful steps and respectful gifts, Janaka ceremoniously led Dasharatha into the pavilion.
essence: Honor given sincerely turns ceremony into affection.
simple_meaning: The gods’ blessing and praise fill both sides with affection, and Janaka respectfully escorts Dasharatha into the wedding pavilion.
insight: It shows how reverent hospitality can transform a public event into shared affection.
modern_relevance: You walk into a wedding hall where two families once felt like strangers. A warm welcome, a seat offered with care, and the whole room changes before a single word is spoken.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: मंडपु बिलोकि बिचित्र रचनाँ रुचिरताँ मुनि मन हरे। निज पानि जनक सुजान सब कहुँ आनि सिंघासन धरे॥ कुल इष्ट सरिस बसिष्ट पूजे बिनय करि आसिष लही। कौसिकहि पूजन परम प्रीति कि रीति तौ न परै कही॥
translation: मंडप को देखकर उसकी विचित्र रचना और सुंदरता से मुनियों के मन भी हरे गए (मोहित हो गए)। सुजान जनकजी ने अपने हाथों से ला-लाकर सबके लिए सिंहासन रखे। उन्होंने अपने कुल के इष्टदेवता के समान वशिष्ठजी की पूजा की और विनय करके आशीर्वाद प्राप्त किया। विश्वामित्रजी की पूजा करते समय की परम प्रीति की रीति तो कहते ही नहीं बनती॥
english_translation: Seeing the pavilion, its strange design and beauty captivated even the sages. Wise Janak personally brought and placed seats for everyone. He honored Vashishtha as his family deity and received blessings with humility. The warmth with which he worshiped Vishvamitra cannot even be fully described.
essence: Honor becomes real when pride gives way to humble service.
simple_meaning: Janak welcomes the sages with great honor, placing seats for them himself and worshiping Vashishtha and Vishvamitra with deep respect and love.
insight: It shifts attention from ceremony as display to ceremony as reverent welcome.
modern_relevance: A host who is already exhausted still pulls out chairs, pours water, and greets the elders first. That quiet care makes the whole room feel respected.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: बामदेव आदिक रिषय पूजे मुदित महीस॥ दिए दिब्य आसन सबहि सब सन लही असीस ॥
translation: राजा ने वामदेव आदि ऋषियों की प्रसन्न मन से पूजा की। सभी को दिव्य आसन दिए और सबसे आशीर्वाद प्राप्त किया ॥
english_translation: The king joyfully honored Vamadeva and the other sages. He gave each a divine seat and received blessings from all.
essence: Honor the wise first; blessings follow naturally.
simple_meaning: King Janak respectfully welcomes the sages, seats them with honor, and receives their blessings in return.
insight: It teaches you to honor wisdom before asking for anything from it.
modern_relevance: You welcome elders into your home, pull out the best chairs, and listen before speaking. That simple respect changes the whole atmosphere of the room.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: बहुरि कीन्हि कोसलपति पूजा। जानि ईस सम भाउ न दूजा॥ कीन्हि जोरि कर बिनय बड़ाई। कहि निज भाग्य बिभव बहुताई ॥
translation: फिर उन्होंने कोसलाधीश राजा दशरथजी की पूजा उन्हें ईश (महादेवजी) के समान जानकर की, कोई दूसरा भाव न था। तदन्तर (उनके संबंध से) अपने भाग्य और वैभव के विस्तार की सराहना करके हाथ जोड़कर विनती और बड़ाई की ॥
english_translation: Then Janaka honored the king of Kosala, knowing him as equal to Shiva and feeling no other regard. He joined his hands, offered praise, and spoke of his own fortune and greatness.
essence: Honor becomes sacred when pride is absent.
simple_meaning: Janaka honors King Dasharath with deep respect, seeing him as equal to Shiva. He then folds his hands and praises the good fortune and grandeur that have come to his house.
insight: It teaches respect that is wholehearted, not performative, and praise that comes from genuine gratitude.
modern_relevance: You meet your child’s future in-laws at the door, and the room is tense. One person’s humility can soften everything, turning formality into warmth.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: पूजे भूपति सकल बराती। समधी सम सादर सब भाँती॥ आसन उचित दिए सब काहू। कहौं काह मुख एक उछाहू ॥
translation: राजा जनकजी ने सब बारातियों का समधी दशरथजी के समान ही सब प्रकार से आदरपूर्वक पूजन किया और सब किसी को उचित आसन दिए। मैं एक मुख से उस उत्साह का क्या वर्णन करूँ ॥
english_translation: King Janak honored all the wedding guests in every proper way, as a father-in-law honors a son-in-law. He gave everyone fitting seats. How can I describe that joy in a single mouth?
essence: Honor becomes visible in the way every guest is received.
simple_meaning: Janak welcomed every guest with full respect and gave each person a proper seat. The joy of the scene is so great it feels impossible to describe fully.
insight: It shifts attention from ceremony itself to the dignity shown through how each guest is received.
modern_relevance: You walk into a wedding hall where the host remembers every name, every seat, every elder’s comfort. No one feels like an extra. That is the kind of welcome Janak gives.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: सकल बरात जनक सनमानी। दान मान बिनती बर बानी॥ बिधि हरि हरु दिसिपति दिनराऊ। जे जानहिं रघुबीर प्रभाऊ ॥
translation: राजा जनक ने दान, मान-सम्मान, विनय और उत्तम वाणी से सारी बारात का सम्मान किया। ब्रह्मा, विष्णु, शिव, दिक्पाल और सूर्य जो श्री रघुनाथजी का प्रभाव जानते हैं, ॥
english_translation: Janak honored the whole wedding party with gifts, respect, humility, and gracious speech. Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva, the guardians of directions, and the sun know the power of Raghubir.
essence: Honor becomes sacred when it reaches everyone without pride.
simple_meaning: Janak welcomes every guest with gifts, respect, humility, and kind words. Even the highest beings know Ram's power.
insight: It shifts attention from status display to generous conduct that makes others feel seen.
modern_relevance: A host notices the shy cousin at the edge of the room and makes space for him first. That small act of grace says more than the decorations ever could.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: कपट बिप्र बर बेष बनाएँ। कौतुक देखहिं अति सचु पाएँ॥ पूजे जनक देव सम जानें। दिए सुआसन बिनु पहिचानें ॥
translation: वे कपट से ब्राह्मणों का सुंदर वेश बनाए बहुत ही सुख पाते हुए सब लीला देख रहे थे। जनकजी ने उनको देवताओं के समान जानकर उनका पूजन किया और बिना पहिचाने भी उन्हें सुंदर आसन दिए ॥
english_translation: They had disguised themselves as clever Brahmins and watched the whole spectacle with delight. Janak honored them as though they were divine beings and gave them fine seats without recognizing them.
essence: Honor first; recognition can come later.
simple_meaning: The disguised men enjoyed the ceremony, and Janak honored them generously without knowing who they were.
insight: It shifts attention from status and recognition to immediate, respectful conduct.
modern_relevance: You meet someone at a crowded function and they seem ordinary, but you still offer warmth, water, and a seat. Later you learn you treated them with dignity before knowing anything about them.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: पहिचान को केहि जान सबहि अपान सुधि भोरी भई। आनंद कंदु बिलोकि दूलहु उभय दिसि आनँदमई॥ सुर लखे राम सुजान पूजे मानसिक आसन दए। अवलोकि सीलु सुभाउ प्रभु को बिबुध मन प्रमुदित भए॥
translation: कौन किसको जाने-पहिचाने! सबको अपनी ही सुध भूली हुई है। आनंदकन्द दूल्हे को देखकर दोनों ओर आनंदमयी स्थिति हो रही है। सुजान (सर्वज्ञ) श्री रामचन्द्रजी ने देवताओं को पहिचान लिया और उनकी मानसिक पूजा करके उन्हें मानसिक आसन दिए। प्रभु का शील-स्वभाव देखकर देवगण मन में बहुत आनंदित हुए।
english_translation: Who knows who here? Everyone has forgotten their own identity. Seeing the source of joy, the bridegroom, both sides are filled with joy. Wise Ram recognised the devas and honoured them with mental worship and seats in the mind. Seeing the Lord's noble conduct and nature, the devas became delighted in their hearts.
essence: True greatness honours others without losing its own radiance.
simple_meaning: At Ram and Sita's wedding, everyone is so absorbed in joy that they forget themselves. Ram notices the visiting devas, honours them inwardly, and their hearts fill with delight at his noble nature.
insight: It shifts admiration from appearance alone to the humility that makes true dignity visible.
modern_relevance: You walk into a room and the person at the center of attention still notices the quiet guest near the wall. That small act of recognition changes the whole atmosphere.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: रामचन्द्र मुख चंद्र छबि लोचन चारु चकोर। करत पान सादर सकल प्रेमु प्रमोदु न थोर ॥
translation: श्री रामचन्द्रजी के मुख रूपी चन्द्रमा की छबि को सभी के सुंदर नेत्र रूपी चकोर आदरपूर्वक पान कर रहे हैं, प्रेम और आनंद कम नहीं है (अर्थात बहुत है) ॥
english_translation: The moon-like face of Ramchandra is beautiful; all the lovely eyes drink it like chakors. Love and delight do not lessen at all.
essence: Ram's beauty feeds the gaze without ever being exhausted.
simple_meaning: Ram's face is so beautiful that everyone keeps looking at it with love and delight, and that joy never runs out.
insight: It shifts attention from the event around Ram to the transforming effect of beholding him.
modern_relevance: You catch yourself staring at a bride and groom during the ceremony, smiling without meaning to. Some presence makes the whole room soften, and no one wants to look away.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: समउ बिलोकि बसिष्ठ बोलाए। सादर सतानंदु सुनि आए॥ बेगि कुअँरि अब आनहु जाई। चले मुदित मुनि आयसु पाई ॥
translation: समय देखकर वशिष्ठजी ने शतानंदजी को आदरपूर्वक बुलाया। वे सुनकर आदर के साथ आए। वशिष्ठजी ने कहा- अब जाकर राजकुमारी को शीघ्र ले आइए। मुनि की आज्ञा पाकर वे प्रसन्न होकर चले ॥
english_translation: Vashishtha saw the right moment and called Shatananda with respect. Hearing him, Shatananda came reverently. Vashishtha said, "Go quickly and bring the princess here." Receiving the sage's command, he left happily.
essence: The right moment moves forward through respectful, joyful obedience.
simple_meaning: Vashishtha notices the right moment, respectfully calls Shatananda, and sends him to bring the princess. Shatananda obeys gladly.
insight: It teaches that even major turning points depend on calm timing and dignified coordination.
modern_relevance: A family gathering is already humming with anticipation, and one person quietly notices the exact moment to speak. The right instruction, given respectfully, can move everything forward without strain.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: रानी सुनि उपरोहित बानी। प्रमुदित सखिन्ह समेत सयानी॥ बिप्र बधू कुल बृद्ध बोलाईं। करि कुल रीति सुमंगल गाईं ॥
translation: बुद्धिमती रानी पुरोहित की वाणी सुनकर सखियों समेत बड़ी प्रसन्न हुईं। ब्राह्मणों की स्त्रियों और कुल की बूढ़ी स्त्रियों को बुलाकर उन्होंने कुलरीति करके सुंदर मंगल गीत गाए ॥
english_translation: Hearing the priest's words, the wise queen rejoiced with her companions. She called the wives of the Brahmins and the elder women of the household, and they sang auspicious songs according to family custom.
essence: Joy becomes complete when it is prepared with reverence.
simple_meaning: The queen hears the priest's instruction, feels joyful, gathers the women of the household, and has auspicious songs sung in the proper family way.
insight: It shifts attention from private excitement to shared preparation and reverent action.
modern_relevance: A family gets the call that the ceremony can begin. Instead of panic, someone steady starts gathering the right people, setting the mood, and making the room ready. Calm leadership can bless the whole moment.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: नारि बेष जे सुर बर बामा। सकल सुभायँ सुंदरी स्यामा॥ तिन्हहि देखि सुखु पावहिं नारी। बिनु पहिचानि प्रानहु ते प्यारीं ॥
translation: श्रेष्ठ देवांगनाएँ, जो सुंदर मनुष्य-स्त्रियों के वेश में हैं, सभी स्वभाव से ही सुंदरी और श्यामा (सोलह वर्ष की अवस्था वाली) हैं। उनको देखकर रनिवास की स्त्रियाँ सुख पाती हैं और बिना पहिचान के ही वे सबको प्राणों से भी प्यारी हो रही हैं ॥
english_translation: The celestial women, appearing in the form of beautiful human women, are all naturally lovely and youthful. The women of the palace feel joy at seeing them, and without knowing who they are, they become dearer than life itself.
essence: Grace is recognized before identity is known.
simple_meaning: Beautiful celestial women appear among the palace women, and everyone feels joy simply by seeing them. Their grace is so natural that they are loved before anyone even knows who they are.
insight: It shifts attention from outward status to the natural warmth that makes people feel safe and happy.
modern_relevance: You walk into a room where everyone seems instantly at ease around one person you barely know. No performance, no introduction — just a presence that makes others smile before they can explain why.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: बार बार सनमानहिं रानी। उमा रमा सारद सम जानी॥ सीय सँवारि समाजु बनाई। मुदित मंडपहिं चलीं लवाई ॥
translation: उन्हें पार्वती, लक्ष्मी और सरस्वती के समान जानकर रानी बार-बार उनका सम्मान करती हैं। (रनिवास की स्त्रियाँ और सखियाँ) सीताजी का श्रृंगार करके, मंडली बनाकर, प्रसन्न होकर उन्हें मंडप में लिवा चलीं ॥
english_translation: The queen repeatedly honored them, knowing them to be like Uma, Rama, and Saraswati. After adorning Sita and arranging the wedding party, the joyful women led her to the pavilion.
essence: Honor deepens when every woman is seen as sacred presence.
simple_meaning: The queen treats the visiting women with great respect, seeing them as divine figures. Then Sita is dressed beautifully and taken joyfully to the wedding pavilion.
insight: It shifts attention from ceremony as display to ceremony as reverent welcome.
modern_relevance: A bride’s room is full of careful hands fixing her veil, jewelry, and confidence before she walks out. The mood is reverent, not rushed.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: चलि ल्याइ सीतहि सखीं सादर सजि सुमंगल भामिनीं। नवसप्त साजें सुंदरी सब मत्त कुंजर गामिनीं॥ कल गान सुनि मुनि ध्यान त्यागहिं काम कोकिल लाजहीं। मंजीर नूपुर कलित कंकन ताल गति बर बाजहीं॥
translation: सुंदर मंगल का साज सजकर (रनिवास की) स्त्रियाँ और सखियाँ आदर सहित सीताजी को लिवा चलीं। सभी सुंदरियाँ सोलहों श्रृंगार किए हुए मतवाले हाथियों की चाल से चलने वाली हैं। उनके मनोहर गान को सुनकर मुनि ध्यान छोड़ देते हैं और कामदेव की कोयलें भी लजा जाती हैं। पायजेब, पैंजनी और सुंदर कंकण ताल की गति पर बड़े सुंदर बज रहे हैं।
english_translation: The women and companions, adorned with auspicious finery, respectfully led Sita forward. All the beautiful women, dressed in sixteen ornaments, moved like intoxicated elephants. Hearing their sweet songs, sages abandon meditation; even the cuckoos of desire are shamed. Anklets, toe-rings, and bracelets ring beautifully in time with the rhythm.
essence: Grace enters before the bride does.
simple_meaning: Sita is led forward in a grand, festive procession. The women around her are beautifully dressed, their songs and ornaments creating a scene of overflowing grace and celebration.
insight: It turns attention from the individual object to the whole atmosphere a person creates.
modern_relevance: A wedding aisle, a room full of relatives, the sound of bangles and soft laughter before the first entrance — some moments carry their own sacred electricity.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: सोहति बनिता बृंद महुँ सहज सुहावनि सीय। छबि ललना गन मध्य जनु सुषमा तिय कमनीय ॥
translation: सहज ही सुंदरी सीताजी स्त्रियों के समूह में इस प्रकार शोभा पा रही हैं, मानो छबि रूपी ललनाओं के समूह के बीच साक्षात परम मनोहर शोभा रूपी स्त्री सुशोभित हो ॥
english_translation: Sita shines among the women like natural beauty itself among beautiful ladies.
essence: Natural grace outshines every display.
simple_meaning: Sita stands out among the women because her beauty is effortless and naturally radiant.
insight: It shifts attention from decoration to natural presence, showing that real charm needs no display.
modern_relevance: You walk into a room full of polished, carefully styled people, and one person quietly changes the atmosphere without trying. Their ease makes everyone else look like they are performing.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: सिय सुंदरता बरनि न जाई। लघु मति बहुत मनोहरताई॥ आवत दीखि बरातिन्ह सीता। रूप रासि सब भाँति पुनीता ॥
translation: सीताजी की सुंदरता का वर्णन नहीं हो सकता, क्योंकि बुद्धि बहुत छोटी है और मनोहरता बहुत बड़ी है। रूप की राशि और सब प्रकार से पवित्र सीताजी को बारातियों ने आते देखा ॥
english_translation: Sita's beauty cannot be described. The mind is too small to grasp her charm. The wedding party saw Sita arrive, a treasure of form, pure in every way.
essence: Some radiance cannot be put into words.
simple_meaning: Sita's beauty is beyond description, and the wedding guests see her arriving as pure, radiant, and complete in every way.
insight: It shifts attention from trying to explain beauty to simply recognizing its overwhelming presence.
modern_relevance: You see someone enter a room and the whole atmosphere changes before anyone speaks. Some moments are understood first by the heart, and only later, imperfectly, by words.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: सबहिं मनहिं मन किए प्रनामा। देखि राम भए पूरनकामा॥ हरषे दसरथ सुतन्ह समेता। कहि न जाइ उर आनँदु जेता ॥
translation: सभी ने उन्हें मन ही मन प्रणाम किया। श्री रामचन्द्रजी को देखकर तो सभी पूर्णकाम (कृतकृत्य) हो गए। राजा दशरथजी पुत्रों सहित हर्षित हुए। उनके हृदय में जितना आनंद था, वह कहा नहीं जा सकता ॥
english_translation: Everyone bowed to him in their hearts. Seeing Ram, they felt fully fulfilled. King Dasharath rejoiced with his sons. The joy in his heart cannot be spoken.
essence: Ram’s presence alone makes everyone feel complete.
simple_meaning: Everyone silently bowed as Ram arrived. Seeing him, they felt complete, and Dasharath rejoiced with his sons beyond words.
insight: It shifts attention from outward ceremony to the inner recognition that true presence creates.
modern_relevance: You walk into a room after months apart, and the tension drops before anyone speaks. Some arrivals settle every heart at once.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: सुर प्रनामु करि बरिसहिं फूला। मुनि असीस धुनि मंगल मूला॥ गान निसान कोलाहलु भारी। प्रेम प्रमोद मगन नर नारी ॥
translation: देवता प्रणाम करके फूल बरसा रहे हैं। मंगलों की मूल मुनियों के आशीर्वादों की ध्वनि हो रही है। गानों और नगाड़ों के शब्द से बड़ा शोर मच रहा है। सभी नर-नारी प्रेम और आनंद में मग्न हैं ॥
english_translation: The radiant beings bow and shower flowers. The sages' blessings sound, source of all auspiciousness. Drums and songs rise in a great uproar. Men and women are lost in love and joy.
essence: A sacred moment makes even the crowd feel blessed.
simple_meaning: Heavenly beings bow and shower flowers while sages bless the scene. Drums, songs, and joyful noise fill the air as everyone is swept up in love and delight.
insight: It shifts attention from the event itself to the shared reverence it awakens.
modern_relevance: A wedding hall goes silent for one breath, then erupts as the couple appears. The noise, the flowers, the tears — everyone knows they are witnessing something larger than the room.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: एहि बिधि सीय मंडपहिं आई। प्रमुदित सांति पढ़हिं मुनिराई॥ तेहि अवसर कर बिधि ब्यवहारू। दुहुँ कुलगुर सब कीन्ह अचारू ॥
translation: इस प्रकार सीताजी मंडप में आईं। मुनिराज बहुत ही आनंदित होकर शांतिपाठ पढ़ रहे हैं। उस अवसर की सब रीति, व्यवहार और कुलाचार दोनों कुलगुरुओं ने किए ॥
english_translation: In this way Sita entered the pavilion. The great sages, filled with joy, recited auspicious prayers. At that moment, both family teachers performed all the proper rites and customs.
essence: A holy occasion becomes complete through proper rite and blessing.
simple_meaning: Sita enters the wedding pavilion, while the sages recite blessings and both family teachers carry out the proper rituals and customs.
insight: It shifts attention from the main event to the sacred discipline that makes the event complete.
modern_relevance: A wedding hall goes quiet as the elders begin the ritual and everyone finds their place. The beauty of the moment comes not from spectacle, but from the care that holds it together.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: आचारु करि गुर गौरि गनपति मुदित बिप्र पुजावहीं। सुर प्रगटि पूजा लेहिं देहिं असीस अति सुखु पावहीं॥ मधुपर्क मंगल द्रब्य जो जेहि समय मुनि मन महुँ चहें। भरे कनक कोपर कलस सो तब लिएहिं परिचारक रहैं ॥
translation: कुलाचार करके गुरुजी प्रसन्न होकर गौरीजी, गणेशजी और ब्राह्मणों की पूजा करा रहे हैं (अथवा ब्राह्मणों के द्वारा गौरी और गणेश की पूजा करवा रहे हैं)। देवता प्रकट होकर पूजा ग्रहण करते हैं, आशीर्वाद देते हैं और अत्यन्त सुख पा रहे हैं। मधुपर्क आदि जिस किसी भी मांगलिक पदार्थ की मुनि जिस समय भी मन में चाह मात्र करते हैं, सेवकगण उसी समय सोने की परातों में और कलशों में भरकर उन पदार्थों को लिए तैयार रहते हैं ॥
english_translation: Following the family customs, the teacher joyfully had Gauri, Ganapati, and the Brahmins worshipped. The radiant beings appeared, accepted the worship, gave blessings, and felt great delight. Whatever auspicious drink or offering the sages desired in their minds, servants immediately brought it in golden plates and vessels.
essence: True reverence makes every needed offering appear at once.
simple_meaning: The wedding ceremony is being carried out with perfect ritual care. Even the radiant beings and sages are honored immediately, and every needed offering appears without delay.
insight: It shifts attention from ceremony as performance to ceremony as wholehearted service.
modern_relevance: A wedding hall is buzzing, and the family keeps moving before anyone asks. Flowers, water, food, seating — everything is ready because everyone is serving the moment, not themselves.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: कुल रीति प्रीति समेत रबि कहि देत सबु सादर कियो। एहि भाँति देव पुजाइ सीतहि सुभग सिंघासनु दियो॥ सिय राम अवलोकनि परसपर प्रेमु काहुँ न लखि परै। मन बुद्धि बर बानी अगोचर प्रगट कबि कैसें करै ॥
translation: स्वयं सूर्यदेव प्रेम सहित अपने कुल की सब रीतियाँ बता देते हैं और वे सब आदरपूर्वक की जा रही हैं। इस प्रकार देवताओं की पूजा कराके मुनियों ने सीताजी को सुंदर सिंहासन दिया। श्री सीताजी और श्री रामजी का आपस में एक-दूसरे को देखना तथा उनका परस्पर का प्रेम किसी को लख नहीं पड़ रहा है, जो बात श्रेष्ठ मन, बुद्धि और वाणी से भी परे है, उसे कवि क्यों कर प्रकट करे? ॥
english_translation: With love and due respect, the Sun himself speaks of all the family customs. In this way, after the divine beings were worshipped, a beautiful throne was given to Sita. The mutual sight of Sita and Ram, and their love for each other, cannot be seen by anyone; how can a poet reveal what lies beyond the best mind, intellect, and speech?
essence: True love between Ram and Sita cannot be captured by speech.
simple_meaning: The wedding hall is full of reverence and ritual, but the deepest thing there is the silent love between Sita and Ram. That love is beyond ordinary seeing or describing.
insight: It shifts attention from ceremony to the invisible bond that ceremony only points toward.
modern_relevance: You watch two people at a wedding glance at each other across a crowded room, and the whole noise of the event fades. What matters most is not what gets announced, but what is quietly recognized.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: होम समय तनु धरि अनलु अति सुख आहुति लेहिं। बिप्र बेष धरि बेद सब कहि बिबाह बिधि देहिं ॥
translation: हवन के समय अग्निदेव शरीर धारण करके बड़े ही सुख से आहुति ग्रहण करते हैं और सारे वेद ब्राह्मण वेष धरकर विवाह की विधियाँ बताए देते हैं ॥
english_translation: At the time of the fire ritual, the fire deity took a body and gladly accepted the offerings. The Vedas, dressed as priests, explained the rites of the wedding.
essence: Sacred rites become alive when the whole world seems to bless them.
simple_meaning: At the wedding fire ritual, the sacred fire seemed to take form and gladly receive the offerings, while the Vedas appeared as priests and taught the marriage rites.
insight: It shifts attention from ritual as performance to ritual as living blessing.
modern_relevance: A wedding hall is full, the chants begin, and every detail suddenly feels larger than ceremony. The moment carries the sense that something sacred is being formally welcomed into ordinary life.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: जनक पाटमहिषी जग जानी। सीय मातु किमि जाइ बखानी॥॥ सुजसु सुकृत सुख सुंदरताई। सब समेटि बिधि रची बनाई ॥
translation: जनकजी की जगविख्यात पटरानी और सीताजी की माता का बखान तो हो ही कैसे सकता है। सुयश, सुकृत (पुण्य), सुख और सुंदरता सबको बटोरकर विधाता ने उन्हें सँवारकर तैयार किया है ॥
english_translation: Janaka's queen, known throughout the world, and Sita's mother—how can anyone describe her? The creator shaped her by gathering fame, virtue, joy, and beauty together.
essence: Grace can be so complete that words fall short.
simple_meaning: Sita's mother is beyond ordinary description. She is presented as someone fashioned from fame, virtue, joy, and beauty themselves.
insight: It shifts attention from events to the quiet radiance that makes the whole scene sacred.
modern_relevance: You meet someone whose kindness, dignity, and warmth make everyone softer around them. Later, you try to describe them and fail. Some presence is larger than description.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: समउ जानि मुनिबरन्ह बोलाईं। सुनत सुआसिनि सादर ल्याईं॥ जनक बाम दिसि सोह सुनयना। हिमगिरि संग बनी जनु मयना ॥
translation: समय जानकर श्रेष्ठ मुनियों ने उनको बुलवाया। यह सुनते ही सुहागिनी स्त्रियाँ उन्हें आदरपूर्वक ले आईं। सुनयनाजी (जनकजी की पटरानी) जनकजी की बाईं ओर ऐसी सोह रही हैं, मानो हिमाचल के साथ मैनाजी शोभित हों ॥
english_translation: Knowing the right moment, the sages called them. Hearing this, the married women respectfully brought them in. Sunayana shone on Janak's left side, like Maina beside the Himavan.
essence: Dignity itself becomes visible when a house is ready for blessing.
simple_meaning: At the proper moment, the sages summoned the women. The married women brought Sunayana respectfully, and she stood beside Janak like Maina beside Himavan.
insight: It turns a ceremonial arrival into an image of honor, grace, and auspicious order.
modern_relevance: A family room falls quiet when the bride’s mother enters with that steady, proud dignity. Everyone knows the day is bigger because she is there.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: कनक कलस मनि कोपर रूरे। सुचि सुगंध मंगल जल पूरे॥ निज कर मुदित रायँ अरु रानी। धरे राम के आगें आनी ॥
translation: पवित्र, सुगंधित और मंगल जल से भरे सोने के कलश और मणियों की सुंदर परातें राजा और रानी ने आनंदित होकर अपने हाथों से लाकर श्री रामचन्द्रजी के आगे रखीं ॥
english_translation: The king and queen, delighted, brought golden vessels and jeweled trays filled with pure, fragrant, auspicious water and placed them before Ram with their own hands.
essence: True reverence shows itself in what you place before the beloved.
simple_meaning: The king and queen joyfully place ceremonial vessels of pure, fragrant water before Ram.
insight: It shifts devotion from feeling alone to a deliberate act of honoring someone with care.
modern_relevance: You set out the best cups before a guest arrives, then realize the care matters more than the display. Respect becomes real only when your hands do the welcoming.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: पढ़हिं बेद मुनि मंगल बानी। गगन सुमन झरि अवसरु जानी॥ बरु बिलोकि दंपति अनुरागे। पाय पुनीत पखारन लागे ॥
translation: मुनि मंगलवाणी से वेद पढ़ रहे हैं। सुअवसर जानकर आकाश से फूलों की झड़ी लग गई है। दूल्हे को देखकर राजा-रानी प्रेममग्न हो गए और उनके पवित्र चरणों को पखारने लगे ॥
english_translation: The sages recite the Vedas with auspicious words. Knowing the moment, flowers rain down from the sky. Seeing the groom, the king and queen are filled with love and begin washing his sacred feet.
essence: True honour begins when love bows before greatness.
simple_meaning: The wedding moment turns sacred: sages chant, flowers fall, and the king and queen lovingly wash Ram's feet.
insight: It shifts attention from ceremony to recognition: the deepest response is humble devotion.
modern_relevance: You meet someone whose presence changes the whole room. The conversation stops, the noise drops away, and even ordinary gestures feel reverent.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: लागे पखारन पाय पंकज प्रेम तन पुलकावली। नभ नगर गान निसान जय धुनि उमगि जनु चहुँ दिसि चली॥ जे पद सरोज मनोज अरि उर सर सदैव बिराजहीं। जे सुकृत सुमिरत बिमलता मन सकल कलि मल भाजहीं ॥
translation: वे श्री रामजी के चरण कमलों को पखारने लगे, प्रेम से उनके शरीर में पुलकावली छा रही है। आकाश और नगर में होने वाली गान, नगाड़े और जय-जयकार की ध्वनि मानो चारों दिशाओं में उमड़ चली, जो चरण कमल कामदेव के शत्रु श्री शिवजी के हृदय रूपी सरोवर में सदा ही विराजते हैं, जिनका एक बार भी स्मरण करने से मन में निर्मलता आ जाती है और कलियुग के सारे पाप भाग जाते हैं,॥1।
english_translation: They began washing Ram's lotus feet, their bodies trembling with love. Songs, drums, and cries of victory surged through heaven and the city. Those lotus feet always rest in Shiva's heart, and even a single remembrance of them brings purity while all stains of Kali-yuga fall away.
essence: Ram's feet purify the one who remembers them with love.
simple_meaning: Ram's feet are washed with love, and that same remembrance is said to purify the mind and drive away all darkness.
insight: It shifts devotion from a feeling into an act that transforms the one who offers it.
modern_relevance: You pause before a wedding ceremony, hands shaking as you help someone you deeply respect. The gesture feels small, but your whole body knows it is not small at all.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: जे परसि मुनिबनिता लही गति रही जो पातकमई। मकरंदु जिन्ह को संभु सिर सुचिता अवधि सुर बरनई॥ करि मधुप मन मुनि जोगिजन जे सेइ अभिमत गति लहैं। ते पद पखारत भाग्यभाजनु जनकु जय जय सब कहैं ॥
translation: जिनका स्पर्श पाकर गौतम मुनि की स्त्री अहल्या ने, जो पापमयी थी, परमगति पाई, जिन चरणकमलों का मकरन्द रस (गंगाजी) शिवजी के मस्तक पर विराजमान है, जिसको देवता पवित्रता की सीमा बताते हैं, मुनि और योगीजन अपने मन को भौंरा बनाकर जिन चरणकमलों का सेवन करके मनोवांछित गति प्राप्त करते हैं, उन्हीं चरणों को भाग्य के पात्र (बड़भागी) जनकजी धो रहे हैं, यह देखकर सब जय-जयकार कर रहे हैं ॥
english_translation: Those feet transformed Ahalya, the wife of Gautama, who had fallen into sin. Their pollen-rasa is praised by Shiva, the limit of purity. The sages and yogis worship those feet in their minds and attain the state they seek. Janak, fortunate among men, washes those feet, and all cry victory.
essence: The purest feet are washed by the fortunate.
simple_meaning: Ram's feet are so holy that they lifted Ahalya, are praised by Shiva, and are sought by sages and yogis. Now King Janak washes those same feet in joy.
insight: It shifts status from social rank to spiritual worth, showing that true honor belongs to what transforms others.
modern_relevance: You meet someone whose quiet integrity changes the room, and even the most accomplished people lower their heads. Real reverence feels natural when character is unmistakable.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: बर कुअँरि करतल जोरि साखोचारु दोउ कुलगुर करैं। भयो पानिगहनु बिलोकि बिधि सुर मनुज मुनि आनँद भरैं॥ सुखमूल दूलहु देखि दंपति पुलक तन हुलस्यो हियो। करि लोक बेद बिधानु कन्यादानु नृपभूषन कियो ॥
translation: दोनों कुलों के गुरु वर और कन्या की हथेलियों को मिलाकर शाखोच्चार करने लगे। पाणिग्रहण हुआ देखकर ब्रह्मादि देवता, मनुष्य और मुनि आनंद में भर गए। सुख के मूल दूल्हे को देखकर राजा-रानी का शरीर पुलकित हो गया और हृदय आनंद से उमंग उठा। राजाओं के अलंकार स्वरूप महाराज जनकजी ने लोक और वेद की रीति को करके कन्यादान किया ॥
english_translation: The family priests joined the bride and groom’s hands and began the wedding rites. Seeing the marriage complete, Brahma, the gods, humans, and sages were filled with joy. The king and queen’s bodies thrilled with delight at the blessed bridegroom, and Janak, ornament of kings, gave Sita in marriage according to worldly custom and Vedic law.
essence: A true marriage blesses everyone who sees it.
simple_meaning: The wedding begins, everyone rejoices, and Janak gives Sita away in the proper ritual way.
insight: It frames marriage as a shared sacred event, not a private transaction.
modern_relevance: At a wedding, the room goes quiet as the hands are joined and the vows begin. Even the people who came only to witness feel the weight of something holy and complete.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: हिमवंत जिमि गिरिजा महेसहि हरिहि श्री सागर दई। तिमि जनक रामहि सिय समरपी बिस्व कल कीरति नई॥ क्यों करै बिनय बिदेहु कियो बिदेहु मूरति सावँरीं। करि होमु बिधिवत गाँठि जोरी होन लागीं भावँरीं ॥
translation: जैसे हिमवान ने शिवजी को पार्वतीजी और सागर ने भगवान विष्णु को लक्ष्मीजी दी थीं, वैसे ही जनकजी ने श्री रामचन्द्रजी को सीताजी समर्पित कीं, जिससे विश्व में सुंदर नवीन कीर्ति छा गई। विदेह (जनकजी) कैसे विनती करें! उस साँवली मूर्ति ने तो उन्हें सचमुच विदेह (देह की सुध-बुध से रहित) ही कर दिया। विधिपूर्वक हवन करके गठजोड़ी की गई और भाँवरें होने लगीं ॥
english_translation: Just as Himavan gave Parvati to Shiva and the ocean gave Lakshmi to Vishnu, so Janak gave Sita to Ram, and a new glory spread through the world. How can Videha make an offering? That dark beauty had made him truly beyond the body. After the fire ritual, the sacred knot was tied and the wedding rounds began.
essence: Their union is shown as the world's ancient pattern returning in human form.
simple_meaning: Janak gives Sita to Ram just as sacred cosmic unions are given in the world of the divine. The marriage is performed with ritual fire, the knot is tied, and the wedding rounds begin.
insight: It frames a marriage as a cosmic alignment, not a private transaction.
modern_relevance: A wedding hall goes quiet as the sacred knot is tied, and everyone feels it: this is not just two people starting a life. The room senses a larger order settling into place.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: जय धुनि बंदी बेद धुनि मंगल गान निसान। सुनि हरषहिं बरषहिं बिबुध सुरतरु सुमन सुजान ॥
translation: जय ध्वनि, वन्दी ध्वनि, वेद ध्वनि, मंगलगान और नगाड़ों की ध्वनि सुनकर चतुर देवगण हर्षित हो रहे हैं और कल्पवृक्ष के फूलों को बरसा रहे हैं ॥
english_translation: Hail cries, praise cries, Vedic chants, auspicious songs, and drumbeats rise. Hearing them, the wise radiant beings rejoice and shower celestial flowers.
essence: Joy in the marriage spills into heaven and earth alike.
simple_meaning: The wedding ceremony fills the air with victory cries, praise, sacred chants, songs, and drums. The radiant beings in the higher realm rejoice and shower flowers.
insight: It shifts attention from the private ritual to the shared joy it creates around it.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: कुअँरु कुअँरि कल भावँरि देहीं। नयन लाभु सब सादर लेहीं॥ जाइ न बरनि मनोहर जोरी। जो उपमा कछु कहौं सो थोरी ॥
translation: वर और कन्या सुंदर भाँवरें दे रहे हैं। सब लोग आदरपूर्वक (उन्हें देखकर) नेत्रों का परम लाभ ले रहे हैं। मनोहर जोड़ी का वर्णन नहीं हो सकता, जो कुछ उपमा कहूँ वही थोड़ी होगी ॥
english_translation: The prince and princess are exchanging graceful rounds. Everyone watches with reverence and drinks in the sight. The beautiful pair cannot be described; any comparison would fall short.
essence: Perfect union can be seen, but never fully said.
simple_meaning: Ram and Sita are circling the sacred fire as bride and groom. Everyone watches with deep joy, but their beauty is beyond full description.
insight: It shifts attention from explanation to reverent seeing, letting beauty be witnessed without being reduced.
modern_relevance: You stand at the back of a wedding hall, phone forgotten in your hand, watching two people move through a moment that feels larger than language. You do not need commentary; the beauty is enough.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: राम सीय सुंदर प्रतिछाहीं। जगमगात मनि खंभन माहीं मनहुँ मदन रति धरि बहु रूपा। देखत राम बिआहु अनूपा ॥
translation: श्री रामजी और श्री सीताजी की सुंदर परछाहीं मणियों के खम्भों में जगमगा रही हैं, मानो कामदेव और रति बहुत से रूप धारण करके श्री रामजी के अनुपम विवाह को देख रहे हैं ॥
english_translation: The beautiful reflections of Ram and Sita shimmer in the jeweled pillars, as if Kama and Rati have taken many forms to witness Ram's incomparable wedding.
essence: Beauty becomes so complete it seems to invite divine witnesses.
simple_meaning: Ram and Sita's reflections shine in the jewel pillars, and the scene is so beautiful it seems even Kama and Rati have come to watch.
insight: It turns a wedding scene into a vision of overwhelming beauty, making the surroundings feel conscious of the moment.
modern_relevance: You catch your reflection in a glass lobby before a wedding, and for a second everything feels arranged around one perfect moment. Beauty can make even a room feel alive.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: दरस लालसा सकुच न थोरी। प्रगटत दुरत बहोरि बहोरी॥ भए मगन सब देखनिहारे। जनक समान अपान बिसारे ॥
translation: उन्हें (कामदेव और रति को) दर्शन की लालसा और संकोच दोनों ही कम नहीं हैं (अर्थात बहुत हैं), इसीलिए वे मानो बार-बार प्रकट होते और छिपते हैं। सब देखने वाले आनंदमग्न हो गए और जनकजी की भाँति सभी अपनी सुध भूल गए ॥
english_translation: The longing to behold them and the shyness to reveal themselves were both strong, so they kept appearing and disappearing again and again. All the onlookers became absorbed, and like King Janaka, they forgot themselves.
essence: True beauty makes self-consciousness vanish.
simple_meaning: The crowd is so overwhelmed by Ram and Sita's beauty that they keep losing themselves in wonder, just like Janaka.
insight: It shifts attention from managing your image to being fully present in wonder.
modern_relevance: You catch a glimpse of someone walking onto the stage and forget your own script for a moment. Some moments are so full they erase self-consciousness.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: प्रमुदित मुनिन्ह भावँरीं फेरीं। नेगसहित सब रीति निवेरीं॥ राम सीय सिर सेंदुर देहीं। सोभा कहि न जाति बिधि केहीं ॥
translation: मुनियों ने आनंदपूर्वक भाँवरें फिराईं और नेग सहित सब रीतियों को पूरा किया। श्री रामचन्द्रजी सीताजी के सिर में सिंदूर दे रहे हैं, यह शोभा किसी प्रकार भी कही नहीं जाती ॥
english_translation: The sages joyfully completed the wedding rites and gifts. Ram places vermilion on Sita's head, and no one can describe the beauty of that sight.
essence: Marriage becomes sacred when beauty outgrows speech.
simple_meaning: The wedding rituals are completed, and Ram places vermilion on Sita's head. The scene is so beautiful that words fail.
insight: It teaches you to recognize certain moments as beyond commentary and meet them with awe.
modern_relevance: You watch two people you care about complete a ceremony that changes everything. Everyone is smiling, but what you really feel is the hush that comes when a life reaches a sacred turning point.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: अरुन पराग जलजु भरि नीकें। ससिहि भूष अहि लोभ अमी कें॥ बहुरि बसिष्ठ दीन्हि अनुसासन। बरु दुलहिनि बैठे एक आसन ॥
translation: मानो कमल को लाल पराग से अच्छी तरह भरकर अमृत के लोभ से साँप चन्द्रमा को भूषित कर रहा है। (यहाँ श्री राम के हाथ को कमल की, सेंदूर को पराग की, श्री राम की श्याम भुजा को साँप की और सीताजी के मुख को चन्द्रमा की उपमा दी गई है।) फिर वशिष्ठजी ने आज्ञा दी, तब दूल्हे और दुलहिन एक आसन पर बैठे ॥
english_translation: Like red pollen filling a lotus, and a serpent adorning the moon for the sake of nectar, Vashishtha then gave the order, and the bride and groom sat on one seat.
essence: Sacred union deserves both beauty and order.
simple_meaning: The verse uses poetic images to describe the beauty of the wedding, then says Vashishtha instructed Ram and Sita to sit together on one seat.
insight: It turns a ceremony into a moment of reverence, showing how ritual gives shape to love.
modern_relevance: You watch two people walk to the front of the hall, and the room goes quiet. The formality, the beauty, the pause before the vows — all of it matters because a life is being joined.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: बैठे बरासन रामु जानकि मुदित मन दसरथु भए। तनु पुलक पुनि पुनि देखि अपनें सुकृत सुरतरु पल नए॥ भरि भुवन रहा उछाहु राम बिबाहु भा सबहीं कहा। केहि भाँति बरनि सिरात रसना एक यहु मंगलु महा ॥
translation: श्री रामजी और जानकीजी श्रेष्ठ आसन पर बैठे, उन्हें देखकर दशरथजी मन में बहुत आनंदित हुए। अपने सुकृत रूपी कल्प वृक्ष में नए फल (आए) देखकर उनका शरीर बार-बार पुलकित हो रहा है। चौदहों भुवनों में उत्साह भर गया, सबने कहा कि श्री रामचन्द्रजी का विवाह हो गया। जीभ एक है और यह मंगल महान है, फिर भला, वह वर्णन करके किस प्रकार समाप्त किया जा सकता है ॥
english_translation: Ram and Janaki sat on the royal seat. Dasharath was filled with joy, and his body thrilled again and again, seeing the new fruit of his merit tree. Joy filled the whole world as everyone said, “Sri Ramchandra has been married.” How can such a great blessing be described and ended with one tongue?
essence: Joy can overflow beyond the reach of speech.
simple_meaning: Ram and Janaki are seated in marriage, Dasharath overflows with joy, and the whole world celebrates this great blessing.
insight: It shifts attention from narration to gratitude: some joys are meant to be witnessed, not contained.
modern_relevance: You watch your child step into a new life, and your chest tightens with pride you cannot explain. The room feels larger, brighter, almost sacred, and words suddenly seem too small.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: तब जनक पाइ बसिष्ठ आयसु ब्याह साज सँवारि कै। मांडवी श्रुतकीरति उरमिला कुअँरि लईं हँकारि कै॥ कुसकेतु कन्या प्रथम जो गुन सील सुख सोभामई। सब रीति प्रीति समेत करि सो ब्याहि नृप भरतहि दई ॥
translation: तब वशिष्ठजी की आज्ञा पाकर जनकजी ने विवाह का सामान सजाकर माण्डवीजी, श्रुतकीर्तिजी और उर्मिलाजी इन तीनों राजकुमारियों को बुला लिया। कुश ध्वज की बड़ी कन्या माण्डवीजी को, जो गुण, शील, सुख और शोभा की रूप ही थीं, राजा जनक ने प्रेमपूर्वक सब रीतियाँ करके भरतजी को ब्याह दिया ॥
english_translation: Then, having received Vashishtha's command, Janaka prepared the wedding arrangements and summoned Mandavi, Shrutakirti, and Urmila. He gave Mandavi, the eldest daughter of Kushadhvaja, who was full of virtue, conduct, joy, and beauty, to Bharat in marriage with full rites and affection.
essence: Sacred unions are completed through care, not haste.
simple_meaning: Janaka, following Vashishtha's instruction, arranges the wedding and gives Mandavi to Bharat with full ceremony and love.
insight: It shifts attention from spectacle to proper conduct, showing that important bonds deserve complete care.
modern_relevance: A family meeting turns into a careful planning session, and every detail matters because two lives are being joined. The verse carries the quiet dignity of doing something sacred with full attention.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: जानकी लघु भगिनी सकल सुंदरि सिरोमनि जानि कै। सो तनय दीन्ही ब्याहि लखनहि सकल बिधि सनमानि कै॥ जेहि नामु श्रुतकीरति सुलोचनि सुमुखि सब गुन आगरी। सो दई रिपुसूदनहि भूपति रूप सील उजागरी ॥
translation: जानकीजी की छोटी बहिन उर्मिलाजी को सब सुंदरियों में शिरोमणि जानकर उस कन्या को सब प्रकार से सम्मान करके, लक्ष्मणजी को ब्याह दिया और जिनका नाम श्रुतकीर्ति है और जो सुंदर नेत्रों वाली, सुंदर मुखवाली, सब गुणों की खान और रूप तथा शील में उजागर हैं, उनको राजा ने शत्रुघ्न को ब्याह दिया ॥
english_translation: Knowing Janaki's younger sister Urmila as the foremost of all beautiful women, Janak honored the marriage in every way and gave her to Lakshman. He then gave Shrutakirti, lovely-eyed, sweet-faced, full of virtues, radiant in beauty and character, to Shatrughna.
essence: Marriage becomes complete when each match is honored with equal care.
simple_meaning: Janak gives the two younger princesses in marriage with full honor: Urmila to Lakshman and Shrutakirti to Shatrughna.
insight: It shifts attention from the main event to the equal dignity given to every relationship in the family.
modern_relevance: A family wedding where every detail is handled with dignity, not hurry, feels like this. The care given to each person says as much as the ceremony itself.
speaker: Narrator

verse_text: अनुरूप बर दुलहिनि परस्पर लखि सकुच हियँ हरषहीं। सब मुदित सुंदरता सराहहिं सुमन सुर गन बरषहीं॥ सुंदरीं सुंदर बरन्ह सह सब एक मंडप राजहीं। जनु जीव उर चारिउ अवस्था बिभुन सहित बिराजहीं ॥
translation: दूल्हे और दुलहिनें परस्पर अपने-अपने अनुरूप जोड़ी को देखकर सकुचाते हुए हृदय में हर्षित हो रही हैं। सब लोग प्रसन्न होकर उनकी सुंदरता की सराहना करते हैं और देवगण फूल बरसा रहे हैं। सब सुंदरी दुलहिनें सुंदर दूल्हों के साथ एक ही मंडप में ऐसी शोभा पा रही हैं, मानो जीव के हृदय में चारों अवस्थाएँ (जाग्रत, स्वप्न, सुषुप्ति और तुरीय) अपने चारों स्वामियों (विश्व, तैजस, प्राज्ञ और ब्रह्म) सहित विराजमान हों ॥
english_translation: The brides and grooms, suited to one another, shyly rejoice in their hearts. Everyone is delighted, praising their beauty, and the gods shower flowers.
